rows.original:
Azyrran smiles and shakes her head, pulling out her honey-gem choker. "Heh, here we go again, hmm?" 

                After setting her stance and tossing her hair to present a smooth, caramel neck to you... honestly it's tempting to bite and kiss at the offered flesh, but you settle for a singular smooch to make her giggle as you tie the choker in place.
                
                The effect is almost instant; Azzy staggers and sways to the side, letting out a lurid moan as her soft flaxen hair becomes luscious and streaked in Kasyrra-black. Her armor all but melts off of her in time with the bindings around her chest snapping and rethreading themselves. Frills burst from her skirt, and the remains of her armor transform into a bright corset doomed to failure against the sheer size of her expanded, honey-lactating bust.
                
                You're almost knocked back by the newly-bimbo-fied bug's big fuzzy bum, but she catches you in a firm grasp and holds you upright. "There we go! All honey-maiden-y!" Azzy bounces and giggles, taking a deep breath and waiting for the world to stop spinning before she properly affixes her attention on you. "What now?" 
                
                The heady aroma of sex, flowers, and honey wash over you in the face of a bright and sunshine-y smile. Although your heart leaps up into your throat, and your brain is awash in all of the ways you'd happily bury yourself in her — figuratively and literally — you manage to keep your wits at least somewhat-together.
rows.translation:
阿兹兰微笑着摇了摇头，取出她的蜜晶项圈。“呵，又要来一次了，嗯？” 

                她站稳身姿，甩开头发，向你露出光滑的焦糖色脖颈……说实话，那片主动送到面前的肌肤实在诱人，让你很想又咬又吻；不过你最后只轻啄了一口，逗得她咯咯直笑，同时替她系好项圈。
                
                效果几乎立刻显现；阿齐踉跄着歪向一旁，发出一声淫靡的呻吟。她柔软的亚麻色秀发变得丰盈亮丽，染上了卡希拉般的乌黑色泽。她的盔甲几乎从身上融化脱落，胸前的束带也同时崩断，又自行重新编织。裙摆上绽出层层褶边，残余的盔甲则化作一件鲜艳的束腰，却注定兜不住她那对膨胀后泌着蜂蜜乳汁的巨乳。
                
                这个刚被变成傻乎乎辣妹的虫娘用毛茸茸的大屁股一撞，险些把你顶得后退；好在她一把牢牢抓住你，扶你站稳。“好啦！这下浑身上下都像个蜜糖少女啦！”阿齐蹦跳着咯咯直笑，深吸一口气，等天旋地转的感觉平息后，才重新把注意力好好放到你身上。“接下来呢？” 
                
                面对那明媚如阳光的笑容，性爱、鲜花与蜂蜜交织而成的醉人芳香扑面而来。尽管你的心几乎跳到了嗓子眼，脑海里也满是各种想要埋进她身体里的念头——无论比喻意义还是字面意义——你至少还勉强保持着几分清醒。

Azyrran summons the Amazon Spear into being, and you're treated to the unique delight of your caramel cuddlebug shuddering with untold ecstasy. Her entire body tenses, before visibly growing— both in musculature, and stature. At the same time her bindings fall away and reform, turning from thick cloth to sheer silks, with plates of dragon-inspired armor clinging to them. 

                You're almost immediately pulled in for a tight hug, while she seethes and hisses at the abrupt burst of energy... all but grinding you to paste against her abs. "There we go... Lumia's beautiful rear, does that ever feel good."

rows.original:
Azzy gasps, nearly burying your face in her endless tits and planting a great big pink-lipstick-print on your cheek. "I see how it is, [pc.mascFem|handsome|cutie], getting a little worn out?"

                It might have been a harsh accusation if she weren't literally massaging your scalp and buzzing with a bright smile... as it is you're already drowning in lusty hormones at the sheer presence of her. You unclip the choker and let it rest in Azzy's hands, smiling as she hugs the gift close to herself and the goddess' light envelops her.
                
                Like liquid silk the brightly-colored corset and skirts retreat, soft fabric becoming solid until it's once-more reminiscent of the usual backend bronze. With one last little gush of honey her tits shrink down, and she stands a little less heavily on her perfectly-shaped feet as everything becomes a little bit more lithe and toned.
                
                The smile is still on Azzy's face as the glowing diminishes, although her eyes are a little dazed at the abrupt change. But now she once again resembles the Hive Knight of old... and she's blushing brightly as she rubs the bright lipstick print off of your cheek. "Eh-heh-heh..."
                
                "Feeling alright?"
                
                "Mhm, just give me a moment to pull myself together, yes?" Your caramel-cuddlebug-turned-tomato straightens her hair and adjusts the bindings holding her chest as though they suddenly feel too large.
rows.translation:
阿齐倒抽一口气，几乎把你的脸埋进她那无穷无尽的胸部里，同时还在你的脸颊上留下了一个明显的、带着粉色口红印迹的痕迹。“现在我明白是怎么回事了[pc.mascFem|英俊的|可爱的人或物]是不是有点累了呢？”

                如果她没有真的在为你按摩头皮，也没有面带灿烂的笑容的话，这种说法或许会显得有些严厉……但事实上，仅仅是因为她的存在，你的体内就已经充满了欲望的荷尔蒙。你解开项圈，将它放在阿齐的手中。看到她将这份礼物紧紧抱在怀中，脸上露出幸福的笑容，而女神的光芒也笼罩着她，你不禁笑了起来。
                
                那件色彩鲜艳的紧身胸衣和裙摆就像液态丝绸一般缓缓退开，柔软的布料逐渐变得坚硬，最终又恢复了那种常见的青铜色。随着最后一丝蜂蜜的流出，她的胸部逐渐恢复了原来的大小，她站在那双形状完美的脚上，显得更加轻盈、匀称了。
                
                当光芒逐渐消退时，阿齐的脸上依然挂着笑容，不过面对这种突如其来的变化，她的眼睛里却带着一丝茫然。但现在，她又一次恢复了往日蜂群骑士的形象……她一边红着脸，一边轻轻擦去你脸颊上残留的亮色口红痕迹，一边咯咯笑着：“呵呵呵……”
                
                “感觉还好吗？
                
                嗯，给我一点时间让自己冷静下来，好吗？”那个原本像焦糖般温暖、现在却变得像西红柿一样红润的女孩整理了一下自己的头发，调整了一下束在胸前的发带，仿佛那些发带突然变得太紧了似的。

rows.original:
Remembering Livrea's tale of the bard Keldoran Moratia, who sung away the wrath of the Frost Wyvern Queen and her children, you begin playing Keldoran's Song. 
        
        The moment the first note is played, the tension and aggression held within the wyvern's body melts, his slitted pupils fattening until they're round with enamour. He takes two slow steps forward, eyelids fluttering heavily until they slide closed with finality, and promptly faceplants into the ground beneath him. A quick glance is enough to confirm that the wyvern is in a deep slumber, lulled into dreams with the melody of Keldoran.
        
        [flags.F_WYVERN_SONG
            |You lull him into another dreamful sleep, watching with [pc.dcb
                |amusement
                |satisfaction
                |glee
            ] as your draconic [pc.isBimbo
                |not-quite-friend-yet
                |adversary
            ] once again faceplants into the ground beneath him. You don't know if you'll ever really get tired of watching him do that.
            |...huh. It actually worked. [pc.dcb
                |Fuck yeah, it did.
                |You’ll have to tell Livrea the next time you see her!
                |That was like, so cool!
            ]
        ]
rows.translation:
回想起莉维娅讲述的关于吟游诗人凯尔多兰·莫拉蒂亚的故事——正是他那美妙的歌声平息了冰霜翼龙女王及其后代的怒火，你便开始演奏《凯尔多兰之歌》。
        
        当第一个音符被奏响的瞬间，翼龙体内积聚的紧张与敌意便瞬间消散了，它那狭长的瞳孔也逐渐变得圆润，仿佛被那美妙的音乐迷住了。他缓缓向前走了两步，眼皮不断颤动，最终彻底闭上了眼睛，随即重重地摔在了地面上。只需匆匆一瞥，就能确认那条翼龙正处于沉睡之中——凯尔多兰的旋律让它进入了梦乡。
        
        [flags.F_WYVERN_SONG
            |你再次将他哄入梦乡，怀着[pc.dcb
                |好笑的心情
                |满足感
                |喜悦
            ]看着这位翼龙[pc.isBimbo
                |还不算朋友的家伙
                |对手
            ]又一次脸朝下栽在地上。你真的不知道，看他这样一次次摔倒，自己到底什么时候才会感到厌烦。
            |……哈，真的奏效了。 [pc.dcb
                |太棒了，确实如此。
                |下次见到莉维娅的时候，你一定要告诉她这件事！
                |太酷了！简直棒极了！
            ]
        ]

rows.translation: 舒适服装
舒适服装

rows.original: Heavy wool clothing common in the Frost Marches. Lacking in color or any significant protection except from the cold, but the garments are easy enough to move in that both farmers and fighters can be found wearing this sort of outfit.
rows.translation: 这种厚羊毛衣物在霜冻边境地区十分常见。它们的颜色较为单调，除了能抵御寒冷之外，并没有其他显著的防护作用，但这类衣物穿着起来十分方便，因此无论是农民还是战士都会选择穿着这种服装。
rows.raw: "Heavy wool clothing common in the Frost Marches. Lacking in color or any significant protection except from the cold, but the garments are easy enough to move in that both farmers and fighters can be found wearing this sort of outfit."

rows.translation: 鳞甲
鳞甲

rows.original: Common armor made of interlocking plates of metal over a padded jacket, this armor provides decent protection and is relatively cheap compared to other heavy armors. This armor was once standard-issue to the armies of ancient Belhar, but has fallen out of style due to the complexity of its making.
rows.translation: 这种常见的盔甲由相互连接的金属板制成，内层还配有衬垫，因此既能提供足够的防护，价格也相对较低，与其他重型盔甲相比更为经济实惠。在古代贝尔哈尔，这种盔甲曾是军队的标准装备，但由于制作工艺较为复杂，后来已经不再被广泛使用了。
rows.raw: "Common armor made of interlocking plates of metal over a padded jacket, this armor provides decent protection and is relatively cheap compared to other heavy armors. This armor was once standard-issue to the armies of ancient Belhar, but has fallen out of style due to the complexity of its making."

rows.translation: 锁子胸甲
锁子胸甲

rows.original: One of the most difficult pieces of armor to assemble, this shirt of mail is made up of hundreds and hundreds of small, interlocking rings that can catch and stop just about anything. The sheer cost of this armor makes it prohibitive for all but the wealthiest mercenaries and soldiers, but its protective abilities and light weight make it worth the cost for those exploring the wild frontiers.
rows.translation: 这种锁子甲是所有盔甲中最为难以组装的类型之一，它由成百上千个相互连接的小环组成，这些小环能够捕捉并阻挡几乎任何形式的攻击。由于制造这种盔甲的成本极高，除了最富有的雇佣兵和士兵之外，其他人根本无力购买。然而，对于那些在荒野边境探险的人来说，它的防护性能和轻便特性使得这种盔甲的价值远远超过了它的价格。
rows.raw: "One of the most difficult pieces of armor to assemble, this shirt of mail is made up of hundreds and hundreds of small, interlocking rings that can catch and stop just about anything. The sheer cost of this armor makes it prohibitive for all but the wealthiest mercenaries and soldiers, but its protective abilities and light weight make it worth the cost for those exploring the wild frontiers."

rows.translation: 胸甲
胸甲

rows.original: A single, solid metal plate covering your entire chest, with padded leather underneath and covering your extremities. This armor is expensive and heavy, but provides solid protection. As long as you don't need to be very flexible, anyway.
rows.translation: 一块整块的金属板覆盖着你的整个胸部，下方衬有软垫皮革，同时也能保护你的四肢。这种盔甲价格昂贵且十分沉重，但确实能提供坚实的防护——当然，前提是你不需要具备极高的灵活性。
rows.raw: "A single, solid metal plate covering your entire chest, with padded leather underneath and covering your extremities. This armor is expensive and heavy, but provides solid protection. As long as you don't need to be very flexible, anyway."

rows.translation: 蒂拉胸甲
蒂拉胸甲

rows.original: A Tiran plate bikini of incredible craftsmanship. Tiny silver spinnerets swirl across the phantasmal black of the metal. It's not as protective as something more traditional, but it certainly is enchanting. Special Effect: All Tease damage you deal is increased by 20%.
rows.translation: 这件蒂拉教会风格的比基尼制作工艺极为精湛。细小的银色旋涡图案在金属表面呈现出梦幻般的黑色效果。虽然它的防护性能不如一些更为传统的款式，但无疑极具魅力。 特效：你造成的所有挑逗伤害都会增加20%。
rows.raw: "A Tiran plate bikini of incredible craftsmanship. Tiny silver spinnerets swirl across the phantasmal black of the metal. It's not as protective as something more traditional, but it certainly is enchanting.\n \n Special Effect: All Tease damage you deal is increased by 20%."

rows.translation: 学徒长袍
学徒长袍

rows.original: Robes designed for magic-users, granting the utmost comfort and warmth when tucked away in alchemical laboratories for days on end. Provides nothing in the way of armor, but the robes are lightly warded against magic damage and are very easy to move in.
rows.translation: 这些长袍专为魔法师设计，当他们在炼金实验室里连续工作数日时，能够提供极致的舒适与保暖。虽然这些长袍并不具备任何防护作用，但它们能有效地抵御魔法伤害，同时也能让穿着者行动更加自如。
rows.raw: "Robes designed for magic-users, granting the utmost comfort and warmth when tucked away in alchemical laboratories for days on end. Provides nothing in the way of armor, but the robes are lightly warded against magic damage and are very easy to move in."

rows.translation: 森林长袍
森林长袍

rows.original: You suspect these were once ceremonial Velunite robes. Now they're dyed purple and yellow, enchanted with magical resistance, but the effect on naturalistic spells remains. Special Effect: All Blight damage you deal is increased by 40%.
rows.translation: 你怀疑这些曾经是用于仪式的维伦尼特长袍。如今它们被染成了紫色和黄色，并被施加了抗魔魔法，但它原本对自然系法术的增幅效果仍在。 特效：你造成的所有枯萎伤害都会增加40%。
rows.raw: "You suspect these were once ceremonial Velunite robes. Now they're dyed purple and yellow, enchanted with magical resistance, but the effect on naturalistic spells remains.\n \n Special Effect: All Blight damage you deal is increased by 40%."

rows.translation: 红色托加袍
红色托加袍

rows.original: A full-bodied toga, made to be worn comfortably in a civilized setting. Available in a range of colors, this is what you see most people wearing around the city. This one is a striking red, evoking imagery of a vibrant sunset.
rows.translation: 这款设计考究的托加袍穿着舒适，非常适合在文明场合穿着。它有多种颜色可供选择，也是你在城市里最常看到人们穿着的款式。这款红色托加袍格外醒目，让人联想到绚烂的日落景象。
rows.raw: "A full-bodied toga, made to be worn comfortably in a civilized setting. Available in a range of colors, this is what you see most people wearing around the city. This one is a striking red, evoking imagery of a vibrant sunset."

rows.translation: 淡紫色托加袍

rows.original: A full-bodied toga, made to be worn comfortably in a civilized setting. Available in a range of colors, this is what you see most people wearing around the city. This one is a pale, almost faded purple.
rows.translation: 这款设计考究的托加袍穿着舒适，非常适合在文明场合穿着。它有多种颜色可供选择，也是你在城市里最常看到人们穿着的那种款式。这一件则是淡紫色，几乎带有褪色的色调。
rows.raw: "A full-bodied toga, made to be worn comfortably in a civilized setting. Available in a range of colors, this is what you see most people wearing around the city. This one is a pale, almost faded purple."

rows.translation: 深绿托加袍

rows.original: A full-bodied toga, made to be worn comfortably in a civilized setting. Available in a range of colors, this is what you see most people wearing around the city. This one is relatively nondescript, but it looks good for daily wear.
rows.translation: 这款设计考究的托加袍穿着舒适，非常适合在文明场合穿着。它有多种颜色可供选择，也是你在城市里最常看到人们穿着的款式。这款颜色较为普通，但日常穿着来说非常合适。
rows.raw: "A full-bodied toga, made to be worn comfortably in a civilized setting. Available in a range of colors, this is what you see most people wearing around the city. This one is relatively nondescript, but it looks good for daily wear."

rows.translation: 橙色托加袍

rows.original: A full-bodied toga, made to be worn comfortably in a civilized setting. Available in a range of colors, this is what you see most people wearing around the city. This one is dyed in the colors of a sunrise, a fancy statement.
rows.translation: 这款设计考究的托加袍穿着舒适，非常适合在文明场合穿着。它有多种颜色可供选择，也是你在城市里最常看到人们穿着的款式。这款托加袍采用了日出时的色彩进行染色，显得非常别致。
rows.raw: "A full-bodied toga, made to be worn comfortably in a civilized setting. Available in a range of colors, this is what you see most people wearing around the city. This one is dyed in the colors of a sunrise, a fancy statement."

rows.translation: 浅蓝色托加袍

rows.original: A full-bodied toga, made to be worn comfortably in a civilized setting. Available in a range of colors, this is what you see most people wearing around the city. This one is a soft, light blue, easy on the eyes.
rows.translation: 这款设计考究的托加袍穿着舒适，非常适合在文明场合穿着。它有多种颜色可供选择，也是你在城市里最常看到人们穿着的那种款式。这款托加袍采用了柔和的浅蓝色，看起来非常赏心悦目。
rows.raw: "A full-bodied toga, made to be worn comfortably in a civilized setting. Available in a range of colors, this is what you see most people wearing around the city. This one is a soft, light blue, easy on the eyes."

rows.translation: 亮紫色托加袍

rows.original: A full-bodied toga, made to be worn comfortably in a civilized setting. Available in a range of colors, this is what you see most people wearing around the city. This one is a deep, stark purple, symbolizing wealth and means.
rows.translation: 这款设计考究的托加袍穿着舒适，非常适合在文明场合穿着。它有多种颜色可供选择，也是你在城市里最常看到人们穿着的那种款式。这款托加袍采用了深沉的纯紫色，这种颜色象征着财富与地位。
rows.raw: "A full-bodied toga, made to be worn comfortably in a civilized setting. Available in a range of colors, this is what you see most people wearing around the city. This one is a deep, stark purple, symbolizing wealth and means."

rows.translation: 装甲长袍
装甲长袍

rows.original: Mage's robes that have been reinforced with hard leather at the shoulders and hips, giving some added protection without disrupting the aethetic flow around the wearer. At least, that's why you'd assume so much of the legs, stomach, and chest are bared.
rows.translation: 法师的长袍在肩部和臀部用硬皮革加固，这样既能提供额外的保护，又不会破坏整体穿着的美感。至少，你是会这么认为的——毕竟长袍的下半部分，包括大腿、腹部和胸部，都是裸露的。
rows.raw: "Mage's robes that have been reinforced with hard leather at the shoulders and hips, giving some added protection without disrupting the aethetic flow around the wearer. At least, that's why you'd assume so much of the legs, stomach, and chest are bared."

rows.translation: 皮革背心
皮革背心

rows.original: A vest of boiled leather that covers the chest and upper arms. Just about the lightest armor you can get away with on the battlefield, but it provides excellent mobility.
rows.translation: 一件覆盖胸部和上臂的煮熟皮革制成的护甲。这几乎是战场上最轻便的护甲了，但它能提供极佳的活动灵活性。
rows.raw: "A vest of boiled leather that covers the chest and upper arms. Just about the lightest armor you can get away with on the battlefield, but it provides excellent mobility."

rows.translation: 皮革外套
皮革外套

rows.original: A heavy coat made of leather, popular with magicians and rogues who prefer to steer clear of proper armor. Doesn't provide all that much in the way of protection, but it's stylish as hell and easy to move in.
rows.translation: 这种由皮革制成的厚外套很受那些不喜欢穿戴正规盔甲的法师和盗贼们的欢迎。虽然它的防护效果并不显著，但外观非常时尚，而且穿着也非常方便。
rows.raw: "A heavy coat made of leather, popular with magicians and rogues who prefer to steer clear of proper armor. Doesn't provide all that much in the way of protection, but it's stylish as hell and easy to move in."

rows.translation: 欢愉女祭司服
欢愉女祭司服

rows.original: Cait's standard attire is a sinfully short skirt and a sheer white top that shows off a lot of cleavage and belly. While hardly practical here up north, her garments are the standard attire of a Jassiran priestess of the distant desert lands. Now they look as much like the skimpy attire of a charmer as they do that of a holy woman.
rows.translation: 凯特的标准装束是一条短得过分暴露的裙子，以及一件透明的白色上衣，这些服饰将她的胸部和腹部线条充分展现出来。虽然在北方这样的地区这种装束几乎不太实用，但这些衣物其实是遥远沙漠地区贾西兰女祭司们的标准装束。如今看来，这些衣服既像是一位魅惑者的装束，也像是一位神圣女性的服饰。
rows.raw: "Cait's standard attire is a sinfully short skirt and a sheer white top that shows off a lot of cleavage and belly. While hardly practical here up north, her garments are the standard attire of a Jassiran priestess of the distant desert lands. Now they look as much like the skimpy attire of a charmer as they do that of a holy woman."

rows.translation: 日舞者丝衣
日舞者丝衣

rows.original: Beautiful silks and veils, jewelry and sensual perfumes, straight from the heart of Mallach's faith in sun-kissed Jassira. This alluring outfit leaves precious little to the imagination, letting Cait strut her stuff like the desert harlot she was raised to be.
rows.translation: 精美的丝绸与面纱、珠宝以及诱人的香水——这一切都源自马拉赫对阳光照耀下的贾西拉的深深信仰。这套迷人的装扮几乎完全消除了人们的想象空间，让凯特能够像她从小被培养成的那种沙漠中的艳妇一样，自信地展现自己的魅力。
rows.raw: "Beautiful silks and veils, jewelry and sensual perfumes, straight from the heart of Mallach's faith in sun-kissed Jassira. This alluring outfit leaves precious little to the imagination, letting Cait strut her stuff like the desert harlot she was raised to be."

rows.translation: 太阳神妓丝衣

rows.original: Pink silks of various shades, sewn by Nelia to fit Brienne's towering frame and styled after the attire of a Jassiran temple harlot. Gold and silver jewelry, a sparkling jewel at the waist, and long silks trailing from her arms complete the look. It hides very little, and it's not supposed to.
rows.translation: 深浅不一的粉色丝绸，由内莉娅依照布蕾妮高大的身材缝制，样式仿照贾西拉神殿妓女的服饰。金银首饰、腰间闪耀的宝石，以及从她双臂垂下的长条丝绸令整套装束更加完整。它遮不住多少东西——本来也没打算遮。
rows.raw: "Pink silks of various shades, sewn by Nelia to fit Brienne's towering frame and styled after the attire of a Jassiran temple harlot. Gold and silver jewelry, a sparkling jewel at the waist, and long silks trailing from her arms complete the look. It hides very little, and it's not supposed to."

rows.translation: 天赋女巫服
天赋女巫服

rows.original: Given to Cait by Viviane, this black outfit is standard fare for witches and enchantresses like Viv.
rows.translation: 这是薇薇安送给凯特的黑色服装，对于像薇薇安这样的女巫和魔法师来说，这种服装简直是标配。
rows.raw: "Given to Cait by Viviane, this black outfit is standard fare for witches and enchantresses like Viv."

rows.translation: 妖刃皮甲
妖刃皮甲

rows.original: A set of firm leather armor, including an underbust corset, boots, gloves, and a jaunty hat — all dyed red. Cait says this armor reminds her of her sister, Calla, and insisted on keeping it after she saved an enslaved gnoll from a centaur pack's deprivations.
rows.translation: 一套质地坚硬的皮革盔甲，包括束腰胸衣、靴子、手套，还有一顶俏皮的帽子——所有这些部件都被染成了红色。凯特说，这套盔甲让她想起了她的姐姐卡拉，因此在从半人马群体的欺凌中救出那头被奴役的豺狼人后，她坚决要求保留这套盔甲。
rows.raw: "A set of firm leather armor, including an underbust corset, boots, gloves, and a jaunty hat — all dyed red. Cait says this armor reminds her of her sister, Calla, and insisted on keeping it after she saved an enslaved gnoll from a centaur pack's deprivations."

rows.translation: 乳胶紧身衣
乳胶紧身衣

rows.original: The latex catsuit Viviane had specially commissioned for her from Marilla. It seems specially designed and enchanted to empower the shadow magic that the witch uses while wearing it. And to emphasize her generous figure, of course.
rows.translation: 薇薇安专门让玛丽拉为她定制了这套乳胶紧身衣。这套衣服似乎是经过特殊设计并被施加了魔法，这样当女巫穿上它时，她的暗影魔法就能得到增强。当然，它的另一个作用也是为了凸显她那丰满的身材。
rows.raw: "The latex catsuit Viviane had specially commissioned for her from Marilla. It seems specially designed and enchanted to empower the shadow magic that the witch uses while wearing it. And to emphasize her generous figure, of course."

rows.translation: 灵魂图腾战皮
灵魂图腾战皮

rows.original: Largely the same as her typical warhides, Arona now wears her wolfen cloak along with it. Crafted by Viviane and warded against foes from beyond the grave, this outfit's headdress does come at the cost of some of the sexiness her choice of clothing usually provides.
rows.translation: 与她平时穿的战袍差不多，阿罗娜这次也穿上了那件狼皮斗篷。这件由薇薇安制作的衣物具有驱邪避害的功效，能够保护穿戴者免受死灵的侵害。不过，这种设计确实让她的装扮失去了一些平时所拥有的性感魅力。
rows.raw: "Largely the same as her typical warhides, Arona now wears her wolfen cloak along with it. Crafted by Viviane and warded against foes from beyond the grave, this outfit's headdress does come at the cost of some of the sexiness her choice of clothing usually provides."

rows.translation: 战皮
战皮

rows.original: The standard battle-dress of the islander orc tribes, such as the Kervus. These thick, heavy hides have been tanned and treated to provide some measure of protection — but really, they're worn to emphasize the brawny, sculpted physiques of the warriors that wear them. Little more than a loincloth and, for the amazons among the orc tribes, a tight chest wrap.
rows.translation: 这些厚实的皮革经过鞣制和处理，能够提供一定的保护作用——但实际上，这些服饰的主要作用是突出穿着它们的战士们结实而富有线条感的体格。对于兽人部落中的女性战士来说，她们还会在身上佩戴紧身的胸饰。这种服饰基本上只包括一条缠腰布而已。
rows.raw: "The standard battle-dress of the islander orc tribes, such as the Kervus. These thick, heavy hides have been tanned and treated to provide some measure of protection — but really, they're worn to emphasize the brawny, sculpted physiques of the warriors that wear them. Little more than a loincloth and, for the amazons among the orc tribes, a tight chest wrap."

rows.translation: 缠腰布与护具
缠腰布与护具

rows.original: [brint.isBrienne|Rough fabric wrapped around Brienne's waist and secured by a leather strap. Paired with ornamental wristguards. Her equipment doesn't look like much, but it's made of high-quality material.|Rough fabric wrapped around Brint's waist and secured by a leather strap. Paired with ornamental wristguards. His equipment doesn't look like much, but they are made of high-quality material.]
rows.translation: [brint.isBrienne|布里恩妮的腰间缠着粗糙的布料，用一条皮带固定着。她还配上了装饰性的护腕。她的装备看起来并不复杂，但都是用高品质材料制成的。|布里恩特腰间缠着粗糙的布料，用一条皮带固定着。他还配上了装饰性的护腕。他的装备看起来并不复杂，但所有材料都是高品质的。]
rows.raw: "[brint.isBrienne|Rough fabric wrapped around Brienne's waist and secured by a leather strap. Paired with ornamental wristguards. Her equipment doesn't look like much, but it's made of high-quality material.|Rough fabric wrapped around Brint's waist and secured by a leather strap. Paired with ornamental wristguards. His equipment doesn't look like much, but they are made of high-quality material.]"

rows.translation: 缠腰布与护具
缠腰布与护具

rows.original: [brint.isBrienne|Rough fabric wrapped around Brienne's waist and secured by a leather strap. Paired with ornamental wristguards. Her equipment doesn't look like much, but it's made of high-quality material.|Rough fabric wrapped around Brint's waist and secured by a leather strap. Paired with ornamental wristguards. His equipment doesn't look like much, but they are made of high-quality material.]
rows.translation: [brint.isBrienne|布里恩妮的腰间缠着粗糙的布料，用一条皮带固定着。她还配上了装饰性的护腕。她的装备看起来并不复杂，但都是用高品质材料制成的。|布里恩特腰间缠着粗糙的布料，用一条皮带固定着。他还配上了装饰性的护腕。他的装备看起来并不复杂，但所有材料都是高品质的。]
rows.raw: "[brint.isBrienne|Rough fabric wrapped around Brienne's waist and secured by a leather strap. Paired with ornamental wristguards. Her equipment doesn't look like much, but it's made of high-quality material.|Rough fabric wrapped around Brint's waist and secured by a leather strap. Paired with ornamental wristguards. His equipment doesn't look like much, but they are made of high-quality material.]"

rows.translation: 焰术士装束
焰术士装束

rows.original: A hood, skirt, corset, and a set of leggings, each of them faded red or black with bits of leather along the outline of the top to provide structural support. Brienne's bust taxes it to a large degree, but it seems to hold up well. The skirt is open down one side, exposing Brienne's bare thigh and fur-covered leg. It's quite the sight.
rows.translation: 一件兜帽外套、一条裙子、一条束腰，以及一条紧身裤——这些衣物的颜色都是褪色的红或黑，衣物的边缘还镶着皮革，用以提供结构支撑。布蕾妮丰满的胸部在穿着这些衣物时显得格外突出，但似乎并没有因此而影响衣物的整体效果。裙子的其中一侧是开衩的，露出了布蕾妮裸露的大腿和覆盖着毛发的腿部，这一景象确实相当引人注目。
rows.raw: "A hood, skirt, corset, and a set of leggings, each of them faded red or black with bits of leather along the outline of the top to provide structural support. Brienne's bust taxes it to a large degree, but it seems to hold up well. The skirt is open down one side, exposing Brienne's bare thigh and fur-covered leg. It's quite the sight."

rows.translation: 链甲比基尼
链甲比基尼

rows.original: An extremely skimpy set of armor made of interlocking metal links over a soft fur padding. While it seems to offer little physical protection compared to heavy armor, it remains a favorite of many warrior-women who enjoy victory in bed as much as on the battlefield.
rows.translation: 这套由相互连接的金属环制成的盔甲覆盖在柔软的毛皮衬里之上，显得极为轻薄。与重型盔甲相比，它所提供的物理防护似乎相当有限，但仍然深受许多战士女性的喜爱——因为她们既渴望在战场上取得胜利，也同样热衷于在床上赢得胜利。
rows.raw: "An extremely skimpy set of armor made of interlocking metal links over a soft fur padding. While it seems to offer little physical protection compared to heavy armor, it remains a favorite of many warrior-women who enjoy victory in bed as much as on the battlefield."

rows.translation: 召唤师长袍
召唤师长袍

rows.original: A set of black robes. They're fairly short and have a split down the right thigh, and the set also fits rather tightly against the frame. Most importantly though, the robes look great with a big, pointy, wide-brimmed mage's hat!
rows.translation: 一套黑色长袍。这套长袍的长度较短，右侧大腿处有开口设计，而且穿在身上会紧紧贴合身体轮廓。最重要的是，这套长袍搭配一顶宽边、尖顶的法师帽，看起来简直棒极了！
rows.raw: "A set of black robes. They're fairly short and have a split down the right thigh, and the set also fits rather tightly against the frame. Most importantly though, the robes look great with a big, pointy, wide-brimmed mage's hat!"

rows.translation: 女巫束腰
女巫束腰

rows.original: It's perfect. This corset is made for you. Literally you, Sophie.
rows.translation: 太完美了。这件束身衣就是为你而做的。字面意义上的你，索菲。
rows.raw: "It's perfect. This corset is made for you. Literally you, Sophie."

rows.original: This mysterious black leather corset is oh-so-tight and pushes up the bosom in that perfect temptress look straight out of the old stories about witches and stray knights. There are a few ways to improve a beautiful black corset... though the faint enchantment still lingering on this one is certainly one of them. This particular corset is also paired with a lacy skirt that's sinfully short.
rows.translation: 这条神秘的黑色皮革紧身胸衣紧得令人窒息，将胸部完美地托起，呈现出那种源自古老巫女与迷途骑士故事中的诱惑人心的造型。其实有几种方法可以让这条黑色紧身胸衣更加完美……而这件胸衣上残留的淡淡魔力，无疑也是其中之一。此外，这条紧身胸衣还搭配了一条短得令人心动的蕾丝裙。
rows.raw: "This mysterious black leather corset is oh-so-tight and pushes up the bosom in that perfect temptress look straight out of the old stories about witches and stray knights. There are a few ways to improve a beautiful black corset... though the faint enchantment still lingering on this one is certainly one of them. This particular corset is also paired with a lacy skirt that's sinfully short."

rows.translation: 游骑兵皮甲
游骑兵皮甲

rows.original: A simple but expertly-crafted set of leather hunting armor over a dark green tunic. The design is clearly northern, and is well suited for the lithe and acrobatic fighting style of the boreal elves. The physical protection this set offers is lacking in comparison to harder, heavier armors from the southlands.
rows.translation: 这套由皮革制成的狩猎护甲设计简单却制作精良，内衬深绿色的束腰外衣。其风格明显带有北方特色，非常适合极北精灵那种灵活敏捷的战斗方式。不过，与南方地区那些更为坚固、更沉重的护甲相比，这套护甲所提供的物理防护效果确实稍显不足。
rows.raw: "A simple but expertly-crafted set of leather hunting armor over a dark green tunic. The design is clearly northern, and is well suited for the lithe and acrobatic fighting style of the boreal elves. The physical protection this set offers is lacking in comparison to harder, heavier armors from the southlands."

rows.translation: 先锋胸甲
先锋胸甲

rows.original: A single, solid metal plate covering your entire chest, with padded leather underneath and covering your extremities. This armor is expensive and heavy, but provides solid protection. As long as you don't need to be very flexible, anyway.
rows.translation: 一块整块的金属板覆盖着你的整个胸部，下方衬有软垫皮革，同时也能保护你的四肢。这种盔甲价格昂贵且十分沉重，但确实能提供坚实的防护——当然，前提是你不需要具备极高的灵活性。
rows.raw: "A single, solid metal plate covering your entire chest, with padded leather underneath and covering your extremities. This armor is expensive and heavy, but provides solid protection. As long as you don't need to be very flexible, anyway."

rows.translation: 德鲁伊皮甲
德鲁伊皮甲

rows.original: Firm-fitting leathers with a cloak and headwrap for protection from the elements. Dyed all over in irregular patterns, the exact colors of the outfit shift to match the wearer's surroundings and provide effective camouflage in most temperate wildernesses. A fine work of druidic craftsmanship indeed, infused with enchantments to ward off most ills of the natural world and perfect for the outdoorsy type.
rows.translation: 这些皮质服饰贴合身体，还配有斗篷和头巾，能够有效抵御自然环境中的各种恶劣因素。整个服饰采用不规则的颜色图案进行染色，其具体颜色会随着穿着者的周围环境而变化，从而在大多数温带荒野中提供出色的伪装效果。这确实是德鲁伊工艺的杰作，其中还蕴含了各种魔法效果，能够抵御自然界中的大多数危险，因此非常适合喜欢户外活动的人士穿着。
rows.raw: "Firm-fitting leathers with a cloak and headwrap for protection from the elements. Dyed all over in irregular patterns, the exact colors of the outfit shift to match the wearer's surroundings and provide effective camouflage in most temperate wildernesses. A fine work of druidic craftsmanship indeed, infused with enchantments to ward off most ills of the natural world and perfect for the outdoorsy type."

rows.translation: 公主裙
公主裙

rows.original: A beautiful dress fit for a warrior-queen, made up of rich white silks and hardened white leather, accompanied by a holy spear bearing Lumia's sunburst. This royal attire was commissioned by Queen Alissa of the Winter City for her little sister, ostensibly in recognition of Etheryn's royal heritage... but it bears an uncanny resemblance to a Belharan wedding dress, hinting to Alissa's true intentions for her half-sexed sibling.
rows.translation: 这件适合战神女王穿的美丽礼服，由质地精美的白色丝绸和经过特殊处理的白色皮革制成，还配有一支印有卢米娅太阳图案的圣矛。这套皇家服饰是冬城的女王艾莉莎为她的妹妹定制的，表面上是为了承认伊瑟琳的皇室血统……但实际上，它与贝尔哈兰的婚礼礼服有着惊人的相似之处，这暗示着艾莉莎对她这个拥有半性的妹妹真正的意图。
rows.raw: "A beautiful dress fit for a warrior-queen, made up of rich white silks and hardened white leather, accompanied by a holy spear bearing Lumia's sunburst. This royal attire was commissioned by Queen Alissa of the Winter City for her little sister, ostensibly in recognition of Etheryn's royal heritage... but it bears an uncanny resemblance to a Belharan wedding dress, hinting to Alissa's true intentions for her half-sexed sibling."

rows.translation: 王室女武神礼服
王室女武神礼服

rows.original: A glorious raiment of war, forged by the hands of Lumia's Valkyries and blessed by the goddess's own hands. This equipment was granted to Etheryn by the Argent Wing shortly after her crowning, so that like her grandmother before her the new Elvenqueen can stand fearlessly at the vanguard of a holy crusade to rid the world of darkness.
rows.translation: 这套辉煌战装由卢米娅的女武神亲手锻造，并由女神本人赐福。伊瑟琳加冕后不久，银翼便将它赠予她，使这位新任精灵女王能像祖母当年一样，无畏地站在神圣远征的最前线，扫除世间黑暗。
rows.raw: "A glorious raiment of war, forged by the hands of Lumia's Valkyries and blessed by the goddess's own hands. This equipment was granted to Etheryn by the Argent Wing shortly after her crowning, so that like her grandmother before her the new Elvenqueen can stand fearlessly at the vanguard of a holy crusade to rid the world of darkness."

rows.translation: 符文束缚背心
符文束缚背心

rows.original: A one piece jerkin, meant to cover the sensitive parts of the body while allowing the wearer to retain freedom of movement. The surface is peppered with protective charms and runes of fortification, meant to keep the wearer safe from the harms of adventuring.
rows.translation: 这种紧身衣物专门设计用来覆盖身体的敏感部位，同时让穿着者能够保持行动自由。其表面布满了各种具有保护作用的护身符以及增强力量的符文，这些设计旨在帮助穿着者在冒险过程中免受各种伤害。
rows.raw: "A one piece jerkin, meant to cover the sensitive parts of the body while allowing the wearer to retain freedom of movement. The surface is peppered with protective charms and runes of fortification, meant to keep the wearer safe from the harms of adventuring."

rows.translation: 狂战士毛皮
狂战士毛皮

rows.original: A chest wrap and a thick pelt designed to give the wearer the greatest possible freedom of movement. It provides less coverage than a vest and can't truly be called armor, but it shows off your dullahan companion's physique while allowing the flow of magic to protect her better than a suit of armor ever could.
rows.translation: 这件胸裹和厚毛皮的设计目的在于为穿戴者提供最大的活动自由度。它的覆盖面积比背心要小，严格来说也不能被称为真正的盔甲，但它能够凸显你那位无头骑士同伴的体格特征，同时让魔法力量更顺畅地流动，从而为她提供比任何盔甲都更有效的保护。
rows.raw: "A chest wrap and a thick pelt designed to give the wearer the greatest possible freedom of movement. It provides less coverage than a vest and can't truly be called armor, but it shows off your dullahan companion's physique while allowing the flow of magic to protect her better than a suit of armor ever could."

rows.translation: 札甲
札甲

rows.original:
Running off similar principles as scale armor, this suit has been made from many, many small scales of iron laced into leather with cord, and then lacquered. Lighter and far more flexible than scale armor with proportionally less protection against crushing blows, it's more suited to kitsune and tanuki physiology than any of the Marches' native races. The most vital parts have been fashioned from iron; the rest is hardened leather, presumably to reduce weight. Curiously enough, the right sleeve is missing, perhaps to enable one to draw a bow better?

        Given how intricately everything's linked together, a lot of time must have gone into making this; considering that this is apparently standard infantry issue in the Old Country, they must have a lot of time over there.
rows.translation:
这套护甲的原理与鳞甲相近，由许多细小铁片以绳索缀在皮革上，再涂漆制成。它比鳞甲更轻、更灵活，但抵御钝击的能力也相应较弱，因此比起边疆本地种族，更适合狐族与狸族的身体结构。关键部位由铁打造，其余部分则采用硬化皮革，大概是为了减轻重量。奇怪的是，右袖缺失了，也许是为了方便拉弓？

        各个部件连接得如此精细，制作它必定耗费了大量时间；而这显然只是古国步兵的标准装备，看来那里的人确实很有时间。
rows.raw:
"Running off similar principles as scale armor, this suit has been made from many, many small scales of iron laced into leather with cord, and then lacquered. Lighter and far more flexible than scale armor with proportionally less protection against crushing blows, it's more suited to kitsune and tanuki physiology than any of the Marches' native races. The most vital parts have been fashioned from iron; the rest is hardened leather, presumably to reduce weight. Curiously enough, the right sleeve is missing, perhaps to enable one to draw a bow better?

        Given how intricately everything's linked together, a lot of time must have gone into making this; considering that this is apparently standard infantry issue in the Old Country, they must have a lot of time over there.
        "

rows.translation: 前邪教徒外套
前邪教徒外套
腹地锁甲
腹地锁甲

rows.original: Armor designed like that worn in Belhar's successor states. It provides the protection of heavy armor, further improved with the addition of a shield bearing Quintillus' family crest. The set is dyed red with black, drawing friendly and foes' attention alike.
rows.translation: 这种护甲的设计源自贝尔哈尔的继承国，它具备重型护甲所提供的防护效果，而加入了印有昆蒂卢斯家族徽章的盾牌后，其防护性能更是得到了进一步提升。这套护甲被染成红黑相间的颜色，这种配色既能吸引友方的注意，也会引起敌人的警觉。
rows.raw: "\n        Armor designed like that worn in Belhar's successor states. It provides the protection of heavy armor, further improved with the addition of a shield bearing Quintillus' family crest. The set is dyed red with black, drawing friendly and foes' attention alike.\n        "

rows.translation: 贵族浴衣
贵族浴衣

rows.original: A silken summer dress done in the style of the Old Country, held together by a red sash and golden string tied about the waist. Looser than most of its kind, airy, and flowing; the white cloth is patterned with a golden floral print and red lining that complements your fox-wife's natural colors.
rows.translation: 这条丝绸制成的夏季连衣裙采用了乡村风格的设计，腰部用红色腰带和金色丝线固定。与大多数同类服装相比，它的设计更为宽松、透气且飘逸；白色布料上印有金色花卉图案，内里还衬有红色里料，这些设计完美地衬托出了你这位狐狸妻子的天然肤色。
rows.raw: "A silken summer dress done in the style of the Old Country, held together by a red sash and golden string tied about the waist. Looser than most of its kind, airy, and flowing; the white cloth is patterned with a golden floral print and red lining that complements your fox-wife's natural colors."

rows.translation: 邪教徒长袍
邪教徒长袍

rows.original: Robes designed for members of Tollus's cult, they're awkward and a bit too long. While it seems like these may have some basic padding, it's almost certainly not particularly effective.
rows.translation: 这些长袍是为托勒斯教派的成员设计的，但它们穿着起来很不方便，而且长度也有些过长。虽然这些长袍似乎添加了一些衬垫，但它们的防护效果几乎可以肯定是不太理想的。
rows.raw: "Robes designed for members of Tollus's cult, they're awkward and a bit too long. While it seems like these may have some basic padding, it's almost certainly not particularly effective."

rows.translation: 皇家皮甲
皇家皮甲

rows.original: A set of white fur-padded leathers once worn on the hunt by Alissa, the fallen Elvenqueen. This armor is sturdy and light, typical of the warg-riding elven huntresses of the Winter City, though she clearly took pains to secure only the finest materials for her personal vest. It leaves just enough skin around the chest and hips exposed to be damn sexy, but it covers... most... of your vital organs with rigid leather and thick hides.
rows.translation: 这套白色毛皮衬里的皮革盔甲，曾经是已故的精灵女王艾莉莎在狩猎时所穿的。这种盔甲既坚固又轻便，正是冬城那些骑着战马的精灵女猎手们的典型装备。显然，艾莉莎特意挑选了最上等的材料来制作自己的这套盔甲。它的设计使得胸部和臀部有足够的皮肤裸露在外，显得极为性感，但同时，坚硬的皮革和厚实的毛皮也有效地保护了你身体上最重要的器官。
rows.raw: "A set of white fur-padded leathers once worn on the hunt by Alissa, the fallen Elvenqueen. This armor is sturdy and light, typical of the warg-riding elven huntresses of the Winter City, though she clearly took pains to secure only the finest materials for her personal vest. It leaves just enough skin around the chest and hips exposed to be damn sexy, but it covers... most... of your vital organs with rigid leather and thick hides."

rows.translation: 女忍紧身衣
女忍紧身衣

rows.original: The upper part of the uniform worn by the Den's kunoichi. This flexible skintight bodysuit covers everything from your shoulders to your ankles. Both of its wrist-length sleeves are just as tight, yet the entire suit never squeezes too hard when you move; it's almost like wearing nothing at all. Its lotus-colored tabard with a deep neck exposes much of your chest, too, but dim embroidered bands around the collar and waist of the tabard let you easily adjust just how little — or much — you show off. Its extra length can easily be wrapped and secured as a skirt or let hang loose, depending on how much ass you want to show off.
rows.translation: 这是狐窟女忍者所穿制服的上半部分。这种柔软贴身的连体衣能够覆盖从肩膀到脚踝的整个身体部位。它的袖子长度刚好到手腕处，同样非常紧身，但在你活动时，这套服装却丝毫不会造成压迫感；几乎就像你什么都没穿一样。这件莲花色罩衣的领口设计很深，因此会暴露出大部分胸部。不过，罩衣领口和腰际处装饰着淡色的刺绣条纹，你可以根据自己的喜好，轻松调节露出身体的面积。罩衣下摆够长，既可以将其卷起当作裙子穿着，也可以让它自然垂下——完全取决于你想展示多少身材。
rows.raw: "The upper part of the uniform worn by the Den's kunoichi. This flexible skintight bodysuit covers everything from your shoulders to your ankles. Both of its wrist-length sleeves are just as tight, yet the entire suit never squeezes too hard when you move; it's almost like wearing nothing at all. Its lotus-colored tabard with a deep neck exposes much of your chest, too, but dim embroidered bands around the collar and waist of the tabard let you easily adjust just how little — or much — you show off. Its extra length can easily be wrapped and secured as a skirt or let hang loose, depending on how much ass you want to show off."

rows.translation: 束缚装具
束缚装具

rows.original: This clothing, if it can be called that, is made entirely of strips of sturdy leather held together by links of short chain. While obviously not designed to be worn during every day activity, the outfit does provide a surprising amount of support. The tight bindings do nothing to cover ones endowments, and if anything they accentuate and draw the eyes to the facets of the body they leave uncovered. A shiny rubber ball gag is included, but optional.
rows.translation: 这种服装，如果真的可以称之为服装的话，完全是由坚韧的皮革条带通过短链环连接而成的。虽然显然不是为日常穿着而设计的，但这种装束确实提供了相当程度的支撑力。那些紧绷的绑带并不会遮盖身体的任何部位，反而会突出那些暴露在外的身体部位，吸引人们的目光。配套还提供了一个闪亮的橡胶口塞，不过使用它是可选的。
rows.raw: "This clothing, if it can be called that, is made entirely of strips of sturdy leather held together by links of short chain. While obviously not designed to be worn during every day activity, the outfit does provide a surprising amount of support. The tight bindings do nothing to cover ones endowments, and if anything they accentuate and draw the eyes to the facets of the body they leave uncovered. A shiny rubber ball gag is included, but optional."

rows.translation: 紧身衣
紧身衣

rows.original: A very tight suit that hugs your body, exposing your asscheeks with a few tactical rips and your [pc.hasBreasts|breasts with a viewing window. It does – barely – manage to keep your nipples hidden, though anyone large enough is going to be showing off their areolae...|chest with a viewing window.]
rows.translation: 这套极为紧身的衣服贴合你的身体，几处刻意留下的开口露出你的臀瓣；[pc.hasBreasts|胸前的窗口也露出你的乳房。它勉强遮住了乳头，但胸部足够丰满的人仍会露出乳晕……|胸前还开着一扇透视窗。]
rows.raw: "A very tight suit that hugs your body, exposing your asscheeks with a few tactical rips and your [pc.hasBreasts|breasts with a viewing window. It does – barely – manage to keep your nipples hidden, though anyone large enough is going to be showing off their areolae...|chest with a viewing window.]"

rows.translation: 优雅礼服
优雅礼服

rows.original: A beautiful dress, expertly fitted and tailored to the standards of Belharan nobility. Dresses such as theses were favored for small, intimate parties in the old empire as they were both a status symbol and a sex symbol. All it takes is the slightest effort to hike them up, and you can get straight to business, perhaps without anyone but your partner even noticing.
rows.translation: 一条精美的连衣裙，经过精心设计，完全符合贝尔哈兰贵族的标准。在旧帝国时期，这样的连衣裙非常适合用于小型、私密的聚会，因为它们既是一种地位的象征，也是一种性感的象征。只要稍微抬高一点裙摆，你就可以直接开始正事，而且很可能除了你的伴侣之外，没有人会注意到这一点。
rows.raw: "A beautiful dress, expertly fitted and tailored to the standards of Belharan nobility. Dresses such as theses were favored for small, intimate parties in the old empire as they were both a status symbol and a sex symbol. All it takes is the slightest effort to hike them up, and you can get straight to business, perhaps without anyone but your partner even noticing."

rows.translation: 野外服装
野外服装

rows.original: Comfortable clothes, allowing for freedom of movement and the skin to breathe under the heat of exertion and daylight. Mother was always annoyed by your habit of sleeping in the same clothes you'd wear out to the fields the next day, but it always made sense. Nothing fancy in the least — linens and wool — but simple as they are, the clothes are respectable, and more importantly, bring you joy. There is something to be said for simple beauty by virtue of utility, and the hardy, tear-resistant, fading-resistant fabric is a mark of that. If Mother can't see the value you do, that's her problem.
rows.translation: 舒适的衣服让你活动自如，即使在日晒和劳作的暑热中，皮肤也能透气。母亲总嫌你睡觉时还穿着第二天要下田的衣服，可你一直觉得这很合理。 衣服毫不华丽，不过是亚麻与羊毛，却朴素得体，更重要的是，穿着让你开心。实用自有一种简洁的美；结实、耐撕扯又不易褪色的布料就是明证。母亲看不出你眼中的价值，那是她的问题。
rows.raw: "Comfortable clothes, allowing for freedom of movement and the skin to breathe under the heat of exertion and daylight. Mother was always annoyed by your habit of sleeping in the same clothes you'd wear out to the fields the next day, but it always made sense.\n\n Nothing fancy in the least — linens and wool — but simple as they are, the clothes are respectable, and more importantly, bring you joy. There is something to be said for simple beauty by virtue of utility, and the hardy, tear-resistant, fading-resistant fabric is a mark of that. If Mother can't see the value you do, that's her problem."

rows.translation: 王室和服
王室和服

rows.original: Even when sleeping, there's no reason why you shouldn't look your best — the true test of character is how you behave when you think no one's watching, after all. Ostentatious, perhaps, to sleep in silk, but when you dress the part, you feel the part, and in turn you act the part a lot better. And now more than ever, you need to do that to the utmost of your ability. By virtue of your position and bloodline, you have duties that you need to uphold.
rows.translation: 即使是在睡觉的时候，你也没有理由不让自己看起来最好——毕竟，真正考验一个人品格的，就是看他在以为没有人注意的时候会如何表现。穿着丝绸睡觉或许有些张扬，但穿得符合自己的身份，便能更有身处其位的感觉，也就更能在言行上符合这个身份。 而现在，比以往任何时候都更需要你竭尽全力去做到这一点。凭借你的地位和血统，你肩负着必须履行的责任。
rows.raw: "Even when sleeping, there's no reason why you shouldn't look your best — the true test of character is how you behave when you think no one's watching, after all. Ostentatious, perhaps, to sleep in silk, but when you dress the part, you feel the part, and in turn you act the part a lot better.\n\n And now more than ever, you need to do that to the utmost of your ability. By virtue of your position and bloodline, you have duties that you need to uphold."

rows.translation: 酋长青铜铠
酋长青铜铠

rows.original: A suit of bronze armor made by the Kervus' master smith on special order for Arona once she became the tribe's chieftain. This armor is bulky enough to leave Arona free to focus all her efforts on massive two-handed hammer swings, forgoing her shield and any attempt at active defense for a berserker's charge in the vanguard, leading her comrades to victory in her wake!
rows.translation: 这套青铜铠甲是由克尔维斯族的大匠师专门为阿罗娜制作的，是在她成为部落首领之后才定制的。这套铠甲非常厚重，因此阿罗娜可以将全部精力投入到挥动那把巨大的双手锤上。在冲锋陷阵时，她放弃了使用盾牌，也不再进行任何主动防御，而是像狂战士一样走在最前方，带领她的战友们取得胜利！
rows.raw: "A suit of bronze armor made by the Kervus' master smith on special order for Arona once she became the tribe's chieftain. This armor is bulky enough to leave Arona free to focus all her efforts on massive two-handed hammer swings, forgoing her shield and any attempt at active defense for a berserker's charge in the vanguard, leading her comrades to victory in her wake!"

rows.translation: 舞者丝绸
舞者丝绸

rows.original: A full compliment of luxurious dancer's silks, imported from the far eastern deserts of Jassira. These loose garments are worn by belly-dancers and courtesans, and some Mallachite priestesses as well, to stoke the fires of passion in those fortunate enough to see them shake their hips and asses. Brightly colored, nearly transparent, and hardly protective... but what they lack in defense they make up for in pure provocation.
rows.translation: 这些奢华的舞者丝绸全部进口自贾西拉远东的沙漠地区。这种宽松的服饰被肚皮舞者、交际花，以及一些马拉克信徒女祭司所穿着，目的就是为了让那些有幸看到她们摇摆身躯的人感受到激情的燃烧。这些丝绸色彩鲜艳，几乎透明，几乎没有任何防护作用……但它们在防护功能上的缺失，完全被其极具挑逗性的设计所弥补了。
rows.raw: "A full compliment of luxurious dancer's silks, imported from the far eastern deserts of Jassira. These loose garments are worn by belly-dancers and courtesans, and some Mallachite priestesses as well, to stoke the fires of passion in those fortunate enough to see them shake their hips and asses. Brightly colored, nearly transparent, and hardly protective... but what they lack in defense they make up for in pure provocation."

rows.translation: 黑化青铜胸甲
黑化青铜胸甲
一块被烧黑的青铜胸甲。
龙骑士护甲
龙骑士护甲

rows.original: Dragoon's Armor: Reshaped by the forces buried within the bound Amazon Spear, this armor consists of wicked and beautiful plates of royal purple and gold, framed and caped by sheer silks. This decadent, incredibly sexual, dragon-themed set is the perfect attire for [silly|making new pets|facing down your foes].
rows.translation: 龙骑兵铠甲：这套铠甲经封印在亚马逊长矛中的力量重塑，由华丽而凌厉的皇家紫与金色甲片组成，外饰轻薄丝绸与披肩。这套奢华、极其性感的龙纹装备，最适合用来[silly|收养新宠物|直面敌人]。
rows.raw: "Dragoon's Armor: Reshaped by the forces buried within the bound Amazon Spear, this armor consists of wicked and beautiful plates of royal purple and gold, framed and caped by sheer silks. This decadent, incredibly sexual, dragon-themed set is the perfect attire for [silly|making new pets|facing down your foes]."

rows.translation: 漂亮粉色束腰
漂亮粉色束腰
一件漂亮的粉色紧身胸衣。
梦境胸甲
梦境胸甲

rows.original: A breastplate — looks like Tollus was fashioning this for Leold, but got interrupted by your timely arrival. A bronze piece, no different from what Ogrish might craft at his anvil... save for the tiny blue crystals infused into the metal. That can't be good for its durability, which raises the question of what this was meant to protect the wearer from.
rows.translation: 一块胸甲——看起来托勒斯原本是为莱奥德制作的，但被你的及时到来打断了。这是一块青铜制品，与奥格里斯在他的铁匠铺里打造的那些东西没什么两样……唯一的不同就是金属中融入了那些蓝色的晶体。这些晶体肯定会对胸甲的耐用性产生不良影响，这就让人不禁怀疑：这块胸甲究竟是用来保护佩戴者免受什么伤害的？
rows.raw: "A breastplate — looks like Tollus was fashioning this for Leold, but got interrupted by your timely arrival. A bronze piece, no different from what Ogrish might craft at his anvil... save for the tiny blue crystals infused into the metal. That can't be good for its durability, which raises the question of what this was meant to protect the wearer from."

rows.translation: 乳胶紧身衣
乳胶紧身衣

rows.original: A full-body suit that stretches to fit you. Easier to get in and out of than you'd think, and the feeling of latex on your body is a seductive prospect.
rows.translation: 这套全身套装能够根据你的体型进行弹性调整，穿脱起来比你想象中要方便得多，而且乳胶材质贴在身上的感觉也相当舒适诱人。
rows.raw: "A full-body suit that stretches to fit you. Easier to get in and out of than you'd think, and the feeling of latex on your body is a seductive prospect."

rows.translation: 网袜套装
网袜套装

rows.original: This outfit is a set of stretchy netting designed to fit over your entire body. The nets are wide enough so as to not cover anything that matters, but just thin enough to rub over your exposed bits every time you move. Still, they manage to secure your parts enough to provide for a shocking range of movement. If not for the constant rubbing as a reminder, it would feel like you were wearing nothing at all.
rows.translation: 这套服装是由具有弹性的网料制成的，设计目的是能够完全覆盖你的身体。这种网料宽度足够，不会遮挡任何重要的部位，同时又足够薄，因此在你移动时会产生摩擦感。不过，这种设计依然能够有效地固定你的身体各部位，从而让你拥有极其宽广的活动范围。如果不存在这种持续的摩擦感作为提醒，你甚至会以为自己根本什么都没穿。
rows.raw: "This outfit is a set of stretchy netting designed to fit over your entire body. The nets are wide enough so as to not cover anything that matters, but just thin enough to rub over your exposed bits every time you move. Still, they manage to secure your parts enough to provide for a shocking range of movement. If not for the constant rubbing as a reminder, it would feel like you were wearing nothing at all."

rows.translation: 连体网衣
连体网衣

rows.original: A whole-body fishnet stocking that comes with a cute collar to hold the front in place. It hides nothing, but that's why you wear it.
rows.translation: 这种全身型渔网袜配有可爱的领口设计，可以固定袜子的前部位置。它并不会遮盖任何部位，但恰恰因为这样，你才会选择穿它。
rows.raw: "A whole-body fishnet stocking that comes with a cute collar to hold the front in place. It hides nothing, but that's why you wear it."

rows.translation: 蒂拉法衣
蒂拉法衣

rows.original: Tiran vestments, typically worn by those who closely adhere to the faith — not necessarily clergy, but also, say, those on pilgrimages. Cut out of black cloth with gold trimmings, they look very fancy, and very form-fitting to boot despite being easy to move around in; the fashion has clearly been designed for somewhere far warmer than the Marches in general, although it holds up well in the heat of the undermountain. All in all, quite functional, although you could be seen as making a religious statement by wearing these in public.
rows.translation: 蒂拉教派的服饰，通常由那些虔诚遵循这一信仰的人穿着——不一定是神职人员，也可能是那些前往朝圣的人。这些服饰由黑色布料制成，上面装饰着金色边纹，看起来非常华丽，而且虽然穿着方便，但却非常贴身；显然，这种服饰的设计是针对气候比霜冻边境温暖得多的地方，不过在地下山脉的炎热环境中，它们依然能够很好地发挥作用。总的来说，总体而言，这套服饰相当实用，不过在公共场合佩戴它们，可能会让人觉得你在表达某种宗教信仰。
rows.raw: "Tiran vestments, typically worn by those who closely adhere to the faith — not necessarily clergy, but also, say, those on pilgrimages. Cut out of black cloth with gold trimmings, they look very fancy, and very form-fitting to boot despite being easy to move around in; the fashion has clearly been designed for somewhere far warmer than the Marches in general, although it holds up well in the heat of the undermountain. All in all, quite functional, although you could be seen as making a religious statement by wearing these in public."

rows.translation: 蒂拉修女服
蒂拉修女服

rows.original: A tiran nun's habit, cut from black cloth, trimmed with gold and held together by a clasp in the shape of an hourglass overlaying a crescent moon. Rather revealing and clearly designed for a climate far balmier than the Marches, although it admittedly holds up well in the heat of the undermountain. Very fancy and form-fitting, typically worn by close adherents to the faith, these are favored by the Tiran clergy. Although not exclusive to them, wearing these out in public is pretty much tantamount to making a religious statement.
rows.translation: 这是一位蒂拉教会修女的服饰，由黑色布料制成，边缘装饰着金色纹样，整体通过一个形状像沙漏、上面还印有新月图案的扣件固定在一起。这种服饰相当暴露，显然是为气候温暖得多的地区设计的，不过不得不承认，在地下山脉的炎热环境中，它依然能够保持良好的穿着效果。这些服饰极为精致且贴合身体，通常由那些虔诚的信徒佩戴，因此也很受蒂拉教会的教士们的青睐。虽然并非只有他们才会穿着这些服饰，但在公共场合穿着它们，几乎等同于在表达一种宗教信仰。
rows.raw: "A tiran nun's habit, cut from black cloth, trimmed with gold and held together by a clasp in the shape of an hourglass overlaying a crescent moon. Rather revealing and clearly designed for a climate far balmier than the Marches, although it admittedly holds up well in the heat of the undermountain. Very fancy and form-fitting, typically worn by close adherents to the faith, these are favored by the Tiran clergy. Although not exclusive to them, wearing these out in public is pretty much tantamount to making a religious statement."

rows.translation: 蒂拉圣骑士胸甲

rows.original: A heavy blackened chestpiece with a stylised skull and hourglass emblazoned on it. While it might have been part of a more comprehensive set in the past, this still affords pretty good protection for your torso alone.
rows.translation: 一件重型的、被烧黑了的胸甲，上面印有风格化的骷髅图案和沙漏图案。虽然它过去可能是某套完整装备的组成部分，但仅凭这件胸甲，也已经能为你的躯干提供相当好的保护了。
rows.raw: "A heavy blackened chestpiece with a stylised skull and hourglass emblazoned on it. While it might have been part of a more comprehensive set in the past, this still affords pretty good protection for your torso alone."

rows.translation: 焰翼服
焰翼服

rows.original: An outfit consisting of three flame capes, hand-sewn together by Agnimitra herself. The style is minimalistic and open, reminiscent of her home culture in Tronarii, leaving much of her skin exposed — it was designed to keep her decent, nothing more. The flame-repellant material of the outfit adds to her already-formidable resistance to heat.
rows.translation: 这套服装由三件火焰斗篷组成，都是阿格尼米特拉亲手缝制的。其设计风格极为简约开放，让人联想到她故乡特洛纳里伊的文化风格——这种设计使得她的皮肤大部分都暴露在外。这套服装的材质具有防火功能，进一步增强了她原本就强大的耐热能力。
rows.raw: "An outfit consisting of three flame capes, hand-sewn together by Agnimitra herself. The style is minimalistic and open, reminiscent of her home culture in Tronarii, leaving much of her skin exposed — it was designed to keep her decent, nothing more. The flame-repellant material of the outfit adds to her already-formidable resistance to heat."

rows.translation: 裁决者服装
裁决者服装

rows.original: Clothing blessed by Sorra to grant whoever wears it the ability to command the very weather. Primarily black and yellow with metal insets, the outfit is loud, brash, and intense, and with some proper makeup, anyone could confuse the wearer with a demon. The outfit itself offers little protection and emphasizes speed and power over defense.
rows.translation: 索拉赐予的这件衣物，能让任何穿上它的人掌控天气。这套服装以黑色和黄色为主色调，配以金属装饰，显得十分醒目、大胆而充满力量。只要稍加化妆，任何人都会将穿着它的人误认为是恶魔。不过，这件衣物本身的防护作用并不强，它更注重速度与力量，而非防御功能。
rows.raw: "Clothing blessed by Sorra to grant whoever wears it the ability to command the very weather. Primarily black and yellow with metal insets, the outfit is loud, brash, and intense, and with some proper makeup, anyone could confuse the wearer with a demon. The outfit itself offers little protection and emphasizes speed and power over defense."

rows.translation: 女巫连衣裙
女巫连衣裙

rows.original: Viv's typical outfit, composed of her black dress, shoes, and hat, perfectly fitting for a "witch of the woods" like her. Each one accents her sexuality, teasing without becoming indecent.
rows.translation: 薇芙典型的装扮——黑色连衣裙、鞋子和帽子——简直再适合她这样一个“森林女巫”了。这些服饰既突出了她的性感魅力，又不会显得过于低俗。
rows.raw: 'Viv\'s typical outfit, composed of her black dress, shoes, and hat, perfectly fitting for a "witch of the woods" like her. Each one accents her sexuality, teasing without becoming indecent.'

rows.translation: 征服者胸甲
征服者胸甲

rows.original: One of Vitruvius' masterworks, this bronze breastplate is shined to perfection. On a battlefield, it'd be damn near impossible to fail to notice the wearer of this, a trait that both makes commanding allies easier and provides an easier target for foes. Thankfully, the skilled craftsmanship and enchantments help ward off attacks of all kinds. Special Effect: The wearer generates 10% more Threat.
rows.translation: 作为维特鲁维乌斯的杰作之一，这块青铜胸甲被打磨得光彩照人。在战场上，几乎不可能有人会忽视穿戴它的人——这一特点既有助于指挥盟友，也会使敌人更容易将目标锁定在穿戴者身上。幸运的是，精湛的工艺与附魔效果能够帮助抵御各种攻击。 特效佩戴者造成的威胁值会增加10%。
rows.raw: " One of Vitruvius' masterworks, this bronze breastplate is shined to perfection. On a battlefield, it'd be damn near impossible to fail to notice the wearer of this, a trait that both makes commanding allies easier and provides an easier target for foes. Thankfully, the skilled craftsmanship and enchantments help ward off attacks of all kinds. Special Effect: The wearer generates 10% more Threat."

rows.translation: 巨人胸甲
巨人胸甲

rows.original:
This armor is a truly brutal piece of metal, whose shoulders, elbows, and chest-ornamentation feature curves and ridges that must have been beaten in place by what looks like a similarly brutal mace. 

        Its weight is monstrous, though hopefully it will distribute that weight properly across your shoulders, judging by the internal leather straps that remain untouched by time and tide. You won't be winning any beauty pageants with this thing on, and your maneuverability is essentially [silly|casul|nonexistent].
rows.translation:
这副铠甲是一件粗犷的金属杰作：肩部、肘部与胸甲装饰上的弧线和棱脊，看起来像是用一柄同样粗犷的战锤敲出来的。

        它重得惊人，不过，从历经岁月与风浪仍完好无损的内侧皮带来看，它应该能把重量妥善分散到你的双肩。穿着它别想在选美比赛中获胜，行动灵活性更是基本上[silly|菜得要命|荡然无存]。
rows.raw:
"
        This armor is a truly brutal piece of metal, whose shoulders, elbows, and chest-ornamentation feature curves and ridges that must have been beaten in place by what looks like a similarly brutal mace. 

        Its weight is monstrous, though hopefully it will distribute that weight properly across your shoulders, judging by the internal leather straps that remain untouched by time and tide. You won't be winning any beauty pageants with this thing on, and your maneuverability is essentially [silly|casul|nonexistent]."

rows.original: The weighty plate of bronze settles over you like a titan's grip, although once you manage to get the straps within cinched up on your waist it settles down... somewhat. You test the encumbrance with a few slow squats, and an attempt to touch your [pc.hasFeet |toes |hoofy-tips ], grunting and straining but gratified to find there's no stabbing pain in your lower back at least. And then rather suddenly that straining becomes far easier; your fingers make contact with your [pc.hasFeet |toes |hooves ], as though you'd suddenly grown longer. When you stand again, there are moments of headrush, and [party.som |the floor seems a lot further away than it was before... |[companion1.name] is tilting their head differently to make eye-contact. "Huh?" |your companions share a stunned look before you realize they're tilting their heads differently to make eye-contact. "Didn't expect that." [companion2.name] tilts [companion2.mf |his |her ] head. ] You've grown a foot taller!
rows.translation: 那块沉重的青铜板仿佛巨人的手般压在你的身上，但一旦你将背带固定在腰间，这种压迫感就会……有所减轻。 你做了几个缓慢的深蹲来试探负重，又试着触碰自己的[pc.hasFeet |脚趾 |蹄尖 ]，吃力地哼着声，不过至少让你欣慰的是，下背部没有刺痛。 突然间，动作变得轻松了许多；你的手指碰到了自己的[pc.hasFeet |脚趾 |蹄子 ]，仿佛你的身体突然变长了。再次站起时，你感到一阵眩晕，[party.som |现在，地板看起来比之前远了很多…… |[companion1.name]抬头看你的角度变了。“咦？” |同伴们震惊地对视一眼，你这才意识到他们抬头看你的角度变了。“真没想到。”[companion2.name]歪着[companion2.mf |他的 |她的 ]头。 ] 你长高了一英尺！
rows.raw: " The weighty plate of bronze settles over you like a titan's grip, although once you manage to get the straps within cinched up on your waist it settles down... somewhat. You test the encumbrance with a few slow squats, and an attempt to touch your [pc.hasFeet |toes |hoofy-tips ], grunting and straining but gratified to find there's no stabbing pain in your lower back at least. And then rather suddenly that straining becomes far easier; your fingers make contact with your [pc.hasFeet |toes |hooves ], as though you'd suddenly grown longer. When you stand again, there are moments of headrush, and [party.som |the floor seems a lot further away than it was before... |[companion1.name] is tilting their head differently to make eye-contact. "Huh?" |your companions share a stunned look before you realize they're tilting their heads differently to make eye-contact. "Didn't expect that." [companion2.name] tilts [companion2.mf |his |her ] head. ] You've grown a foot taller! "

rows.translation: 下一步
圣城全套铠甲
圣城全套铠甲

rows.original: A suit of gleaming plate armor, emblazoned with glowing runes and protective sigils. A mane of golden fur surrounds the neck, keeping it comfortable even when maneuvering in tight spaces. This armor was intended to be used during the Godswar to withstand any threat. There's no reason it shouldn't also stand up to any threat in the modern age. While it looks like it should weigh you down, some of the magic in it causes it to be no heavier than your average leather hauberk. Special Effect: Grants immunity to Sundered.
rows.translation: 一套闪闪发光的板甲，上面镌刻着发光的符文与防护印记。一圈金色毛皮如鬃毛般围住颈部，即使在狭窄的空间中移动也能确保佩戴者的舒适。这套铠甲原本是为神战而设计的，旨在抵御任何威胁；因此，在现代社会，它也应该能够应对任何挑战。虽然看起来这套铠甲应该会让人感到沉重，但实际上其中蕴含的魔法使得它的重量与普通的皮制护甲差不多。 特效：赋予对破甲效果的免疫能力。
rows.raw: " A suit of gleaming plate armor, emblazoned with glowing runes and protective sigils. A mane of golden fur surrounds the neck, keeping it comfortable even when maneuvering in tight spaces. This armor was intended to be used during the Godswar to withstand any threat. There's no reason it shouldn't also stand up to any threat in the modern age. While it looks like it should weigh you down, some of the magic in it causes it to be no heavier than your average leather hauberk. Special Effect: Grants immunity to Sundered."

rows.translation: 伊兹坎蒂礼服
伊兹坎蒂礼服

rows.original: An elegant dress of silk, scale, and feather once worn by the first queen of Izkanti. The dress breathes like [silly|Egyptian cotton|you're wearing nothing but air], but the cuirass feels like it would stop a giant's arrow. The silk-and-down combo is eminently comfortable, and on top of that the pristine white color resists smudging and dirt. Special Effect: After taking magic damage of a given type, gain +25 resistance to that type for 2 turns.
rows.translation: 这件由丝绸、鳞片和羽毛制成的优雅礼服，曾属于伊斯坎蒂的第一位女王。礼服透气得仿佛[silly|埃及棉一般|身上只穿了一层空气]，胸甲却似乎足以挡住巨人的箭矢。丝绸与羽绒的搭配舒适极了，洁白的布料还不易沾上污渍和灰尘。 特殊效果：受到某种类型的魔法伤害后，对该伤害类型的抗性提高25点，持续2回合。
rows.raw: " An elegant dress of silk, scale, and feather once worn by the first queen of Izkanti. The dress breathes like [silly|Egyptian cotton|you're wearing nothing but air], but the cuirass feels like it would stop a giant's arrow. The silk-and-down combo is eminently comfortable, and on top of that the pristine white color resists smudging and dirt. Special Effect: After taking magic damage of a given type, gain +25 resistance to that type for 2 turns."

rows.translation: 华贵和服
华贵和服

rows.original: An exquisite and lightweight set of robes fit for Old Country nobility, yet expertly crafted and tailor-made for you. Composed of silken fabric and adorned with floral designs, this form-fitting gown promotes its wearer's assets without sacrificing the stylish elegance which comes with comfortable movement. However, unlike its more traditional counterparts, this outfit is infused with kitsune magic. By wearing this, you feel a deepening attunement with the foxen people. Special Effect: All sources of Blight and Fire damage you deal are increased by 20%.
rows.translation: 这套精致而轻便的长袍专为旧国贵族设计，但却是经过精心制作、专门为您量身打造的。它由丝绸材质制成，上面还装饰着花卉图案，这种贴身的设计既突出了穿着者的身材优势，同时也保留了时尚与优雅，让穿着者在行动时依然感到舒适自在。然而，与那些更为传统的服饰不同，这套服装蕴含着狐妖的魔力——穿上它，你会感受到与这些狐族生物之间日益紧密的联系。 特效：你造成的所有枯萎伤害和火焰伤害都会增加20%。
rows.raw: " An exquisite and lightweight set of robes fit for Old Country nobility, yet expertly crafted and tailor-made for you. Composed of silken fabric and adorned with floral designs, this form-fitting gown promotes its wearer's assets without sacrificing the stylish elegance which comes with comfortable movement. However, unlike its more traditional counterparts, this outfit is infused with kitsune magic. By wearing this, you feel a deepening attunement with the foxen people. Special Effect: All sources of Blight and Fire damage you deal are increased by 20%."

rows.translation: 厚外套
厚外套

rows.original: A heavy woolen coat done in kitsune style, dyed black and stuffed with loose silk. Warm, comfortable and flowing, the thick garment comes with a sash and [pc.mascFem|dark blue trousers|pleated skirts] to complete the ensemble of cold weather casual wear.
rows.translation: 这件狐妖风格的厚羊毛外套染成黑色，填有松软的丝绸。厚实的衣料保暖、舒适而飘逸，另配一条腰带和[pc.mascFem|深蓝色长裤|百褶裙]，构成一套适合寒冷天气的休闲装。
rows.raw: "\n        A heavy woolen coat done in kitsune style, dyed black and stuffed with loose silk. Warm, comfortable and flowing, the thick garment comes with a sash and [pc.mascFem|dark blue trousers|pleated skirts] to complete the ensemble of cold weather casual wear."

rows.translation: 和服
和服

rows.original: An unadorned, monocolor kimono complete with sash. The entire thing is made from a single bolt of cloth, and is sewn in such a way as to allow it to be disassembled when washed.
rows.translation: 一件朴素的单色和服，配有腰带。整个和服是用一块布缝制而成的，其缝制方式使得在清洗时可以将其拆开。
rows.raw: "\n        An unadorned, monocolor kimono complete with sash. The entire thing is made from a single bolt of cloth, and is sewn in such a way as to allow it to be disassembled when washed."

rows.translation: 龙鳞
龙鳞

rows.original: An ancient suit of crimson armor, supposedly made from the scales of a true dragon. It certainly bears draconic motifs in its decorations, and is curiously warm to the touch. A faint scent of woodsmoke clings comfortingly to the hauberk, reminiscent of a campfire. Special Effect: You cannot be made Burning.
rows.translation: 一套古老的深红色盔甲，据说是用真正的龙的鳞片制成的。它的装饰图案中确实充满了龙的主题元素，而且触感异常温暖。盔甲上还萦绕着一丝淡淡的木烟气息，这种气息让人感到舒适，仿佛让人联想到篝火旁的场景。 特效：你无法被点燃。
rows.raw: " An ancient suit of crimson armor, supposedly made from the scales of a true dragon. It certainly bears draconic motifs in its decorations, and is curiously warm to the touch. A faint scent of woodsmoke clings comfortingly to the hauberk, reminiscent of a campfire. Special Effect: You cannot be made Burning."

rows.translation: 皇家先锋铠甲
皇家先锋铠甲

rows.original: A panoply of golden-hued armor with a mantle of gilded scales. This armor was gifted to Raqian Ignafaerus by King Kelsaz upon the former's ascent to the captain of the Chargers, the royal guard of Khor'minos. Despite the many battles it's seen, this suit of armor is in immaculate condition, tended to with the care afforded a man's most prized possession.
rows.translation: 一套金色的铠甲，外覆着镀金的鳞片。这套铠甲是克尔萨兹国王在拉基安·伊格纳费鲁斯被任命为科尔米诺斯皇家卫队的队长时赠送给他的。尽管经历了许多战斗，这套铠甲依然保持着完好无损的状态，人们像对待一个人最珍视的财物一样细心地照料它。
rows.raw: "\n        A panoply of golden-hued armor with a mantle of gilded scales. This armor was gifted to Raqian Ignafaerus by King Kelsaz upon the former's ascent to the captain of the Chargers, the royal guard of Khor'minos. Despite the many battles it's seen, this suit of armor is in immaculate condition, tended to with the care afforded a man's most prized possession."

rows.translation: 贞女祭袍
贞女祭袍

rows.original: A set of lightly-enchanted scale armor presented to Cait by Ogrish and Ivris, the town's premier craftsmen, to help her better stand in the vanguard of Hawkethorne's defense. Combined with her own holy vestments, this gear grants Cait a tremendous resistance to physical and magical harm.
rows.translation: 奥格里什和艾薇莉丝——这座小镇最顶尖的工匠们——送给凯特一套经过轻微魔法的强化鳞甲，帮助她更好地站在鹰棘镇防御阵线的最前沿。这套装备与她自己佩戴的圣洁法衣相结合，使凯特能够有效抵御各种物理伤害和魔法攻击。
rows.raw: "A set of lightly-enchanted scale armor presented to Cait by Ogrish and Ivris, the town's premier craftsmen, to help her better stand in the vanguard of Hawkethorne's defense. Combined with her own holy vestments, this gear grants Cait a tremendous resistance to physical and magical harm."

rows.translation: 受祝福青铜胸甲
受祝福青铜胸甲
一件神圣的青铜胸甲。
执政官胸甲
执政官胸甲

rows.original: A set of strong leather straps that carry across the chest and back, designed for attachment at the shoulder of the dominant hand. [pc.cupRange flat D|The former owner probably wore this quite differently than you would...|It's a good thing it's adjustable or neither you nor the former owner would ever be able to fit into it.]
rows.translation: 一套结实的皮革背带，横跨胸前与背后，设计成固定在惯用手一侧肩膀上的样式。[pc.cupRange flat D|前主人穿戴它的方式，恐怕和你大不相同……|幸好它可以调节，否则你和前主人都未必穿得上。]
rows.raw: "A set of strong leather straps that carry across the chest and back, designed for attachment at the shoulder of the dominant hand. [pc.cupRange flat D|The former owner probably wore this quite differently than you would...|It's a good thing it's adjustable or neither you nor the former owner would ever be able to fit into it.]"

rows.translation: 焰术士胸甲
焰术士胸甲

rows.original: A tight garment that hugs the chest, leaving the collar and stomach entirely exposed. The cloth has been reinforced with leather and bronze, but it remains predominantly cloth. Calling it armor is a bit optimistic, but it's undeniably sensuous. These garments were part of the common attire for priests of the Terrestrial Fire, an animist cult that once existed in the Frostwood, protected from the cold by the eternal flame they worshiped.
rows.translation: 这种衣物紧贴胸部，领口和腹部完全暴露在外。布料上还添加了皮革和青铜材料作为加固，但主体部分仍然由布料构成。将其称为“盔甲”或许有些夸张，但不可否认，这种服饰确实极具性感魅力。这类衣物曾是“大地之火”教派祭司们的常见装束。这个信仰自然主义的教派曾经存在于霜木之地，他们所崇拜的永恒之火为他们抵御严寒提供了保护。
rows.raw: "A tight garment that hugs the chest, leaving the collar and stomach entirely exposed. The cloth has been reinforced with leather and bronze, but it remains predominantly cloth. Calling it armor is a bit optimistic, but it's undeniably sensuous. These garments were part of the common attire for priests of the Terrestrial Fire, an animist cult that once existed in the Frostwood, protected from the cold by the eternal flame they worshiped."

rows.translation: 吟游诗人服饰
吟游诗人服饰

rows.original: Rather than her usual black robes and hat, Viv has chosen to don the traditional Marcher bard garments. These consist of a short-sleeved, deep cut yellow tunic that ends halfway down her thighs with fine needlework decoration at its edges; tight-fitting cloth pants that leave little of her legs to the imagination; a thick woolen cloak; and an ornamented dull red hat that's not unlike her usual hat in shape, but with a shorter brim and longer %"crown."
rows.translation: 与她平时穿的黑色长袍和帽子不同，薇芙这次选择穿上了传统的吟游诗人服装。这套服装包括一件短袖、领口开得很低的黄色束腰外衣，外衣的下摆刚好到达她的大腿中部，边缘还装饰着精美的针线花纹；一条紧身布裤，几乎完全遮住了她的双腿；一件厚实的羊毛斗篷；以及一顶装饰华丽的暗红色帽子。这顶帽子的形状与她平时戴的帽子相似，但帽檐更短，“帽冠”部分则更长一些。
rows.raw: 'Rather than her usual black robes and hat, Viv has chosen to don the traditional Marcher bard garments. These consist of a short-sleeved, deep cut yellow tunic that ends halfway down her thighs with fine needlework decoration at its edges; tight-fitting cloth pants that leave little of her legs to the imagination; a thick woolen cloak; and an ornamented dull red hat that\'s not unlike her usual hat in shape, but with a shorter brim and longer %"crown."'

rows.translation: 帝国胸甲
帝国胸甲

rows.original: A suit of armor left over from a Belharan officer in service to the Imperial household. It's anyone's guess if this was brought north during the Godswar, or even as far back as the Belharan Empire's border skirmishes with the boreal elves of the Frostwood long before that. The breastplate bears a beautiful blue crescent moon etched into its bronze plates, and has moonstones stitched into its leather underpadding.
rows.translation: 这是一套属于曾为皇室服务的贝尔哈兰军官的盔甲。没有人能确定这套盔甲是在神战期间被带到北方的，还是更早的时候，当贝尔哈兰帝国还与霜木林的极北精灵发生边境冲突时就被带过来的。胸甲的青铜板上刻着一道美丽的蓝色新月图案，而皮革衬垫中还缝着月长石。
rows.raw: "A suit of armor left over from a Belharan officer in service to the Imperial household. It's anyone's guess if this was brought north during the Godswar, or even as far back as the Belharan Empire's border skirmishes with the boreal elves of the Frostwood long before that. The breastplate bears a beautiful blue crescent moon etched into its bronze plates, and has moonstones stitched into its leather underpadding."

rows.translation: 叛逆学者装束
叛逆学者装束

rows.original: A set of lightweight field attire, mixing airy cloth robes and hardened leather plates to create an outfit that's easy to move in, leaves little to the imagination, and yet provides some padding and protection to the extremities and upper chest. You doubt you'd see anything like this in respectable scholarly institutions, but it certainly makes an argument for itself among the more risque patrons who might hire the services of a rogue academic.
rows.translation: 这套轻便的野外服装结合了透气的布质长袍和经过加固处理的皮革护甲，既保证了行动的灵活性，也不会过于显眼，同时还能为四肢和上胸部提供一定的防护。你可能会怀疑，在那些正规的学术机构里，根本见不到这样的服装，但在那些愿意雇佣那些不拘一格的学者的人当中，这种服装无疑具有很大的吸引力。
rows.raw: "A set of lightweight field attire, mixing airy cloth robes and hardened leather plates to create an outfit that's easy to move in, leaves little to the imagination, and yet provides some padding and protection to the extremities and upper chest. You doubt you'd see anything like this in respectable scholarly institutions, but it certainly makes an argument for itself among the more risque patrons who might hire the services of a rogue academic."

rows.translation: 石板铠甲
石板铠甲

rows.original: An immensely heavy 'suit' of armor made from a natural arrangement of several slabs of solid rock. While the protection it grants is beyond compare, its obscene weight means that you won't be dodging much, or moving quickly. The sheer thickness of the armor serves to greatly improve your balance, however. Special Effect: You cannot be Stunned or knocked Prone.
rows.translation: 这套由多块天然岩石紧密拼接而成的重型盔甲，其防护效果无与伦比。然而，由于其极其惊人的重量，你将无法快速移动或灵活闪避攻击。不过，这种厚重的盔甲结构反而能显著提升你的平衡能力。 特效你不会被击晕，也不会被击倒陷入倒地状态。
rows.raw: "An immensely heavy 'suit' of armor made from a natural arrangement of several slabs of solid rock. While the protection it grants is beyond compare, its obscene weight means that you won't be dodging much, or moving quickly. The sheer thickness of the armor serves to greatly improve your balance, however.\n \n Special Effect: You cannot be Stunned or knocked Prone."

rows.translation: 权贵法袍
权贵法袍

rows.original: Thick, heavy robes that obscure most of one's form. Dyed black in honor of Nareva, the goddess of magic, though most owners will adorn theirs with buttons of gold and silver if nothing else. Robes such as these are iconic to the arcane scholars of yesteryear, and donning them is oft taken as a sign of prestige. Those magisters who rise to wear them have awoken to a great and terrible truth about their forebears: these robes are just really, really comfortable for wearing around the house all day.
rows.translation: 厚重的长袍将穿戴者的身形大部分遮掩起来。这些长袍被染成黑色，以纪念魔法女神娜瑞瓦；不过，大多数拥有者都会在长袍上添加金银质纽扣作为装饰。这样的长袍是古代神秘学者的标志，穿上它们往往被视为一种地位的象征。那些得以穿上这些长袍的法师们，其实都发现了一个关于他们祖先的惊人事实：这些长袍实在非常舒适，穿着它们在屋里闲逛一整天简直再合适不过了。
rows.raw: "Thick, heavy robes that obscure most of one's form. Dyed black in honor of Nareva, the goddess of magic, though most owners will adorn theirs with buttons of gold and silver if nothing else. Robes such as these are iconic to the arcane scholars of yesteryear, and donning them is oft taken as a sign of prestige. Those magisters who rise to wear them have awoken to a great and terrible truth about their forebears: these robes are just really, really comfortable for wearing around the house all day."

rows.translation: 镶钴皮甲
镶钴皮甲

rows.original: A finely tailored vest of leather, threaded with gold and held together by lapis buttons. Cobalt-infused metal plates reinforce the breast, offering some additional measure of protection — and act to amplify the wearer's own magical currents. This armor is based on that worn by a secretive order of rogue magicians once based in Tychris, though their art has long been lost to time.
rows.translation: 这件精心制作的皮制背心上镶嵌着黄金纹饰，各部位用青金石制成的纽扣固定在一起。含有钴元素的金属板加固了胸部的防护结构，不仅提供了额外的保护，还能增强穿戴者自身的魔法能量。这种盔甲的设计灵感来源于曾经驻扎在提克里斯的某个秘密法师组织所使用的装备，不过他们的技艺早已随着时间的流逝而失传了。
rows.raw: "A finely tailored vest of leather, threaded with gold and held together by lapis buttons. Cobalt-infused metal plates reinforce the breast, offering some additional measure of protection — and act to amplify the wearer's own magical currents. This armor is based on that worn by a secretive order of rogue magicians once based in Tychris, though their art has long been lost to time."

rows.original:
Made of inter-woven layers of some of the south's finest pitch-black silks, this hardy tunic hides a number of secret pockets, and does its very best to provide you a sexy look, and plenty of protection without compromising on your mobility.

        It's almost long enough to reach your knees, and is clearly meant to be part of a full outfit, but even alone the suit gives you a sophisticated sense of style and flair.
rows.translation:
这件结实的长衣由南方最上等的漆黑丝绸交织缝制而成，里面藏着不少暗袋；它竭力让你显得性感迷人，同时提供充分的防护，又丝毫不妨碍行动。

        衣摆几乎长及膝盖，显然本该与一整套服饰搭配；不过哪怕单独穿着，也足以让你显得优雅而富有格调。
rows.raw:
"Made of inter-woven layers of some of the south's finest pitch-black silks, this hardy tunic hides a number of secret pockets, and does its very best to provide you a sexy look, and plenty of protection without compromising on your mobility.

        It's almost long enough to reach your knees, and is clearly meant to be part of a full outfit, but even alone the suit gives you a sophisticated sense of style and flair.
        "

rows.translation: 花格呢装束
花格呢装束

rows.original: Lightweight clothing common to the people of Tychris: a kilt and a tunic that leaves most of the chest bare, done up in colorful square patterns. Heartlanders might consider it mad to wear so little so far north, but to frostscale salamanders, a winter's day in the Marches can be downright balmy.
