Some clever little loops have been stitched into the sides of the boots, so that a black cloth strip on the underside can dampen the sound of that metal. Of course, if you're not sneaking, those metal soles have a really seductive click-clack to them that have men and women perking up with interest.
rows.translation: 一双线条纤长的金属底长靴，鞋跟足有一英寸半高，却又设计得恰到好处。靴子两侧巧妙地缝着几个小环，可以把藏在鞋底的黑色布条拉出来，压住金属落地的声响。当然，如果你不打算潜行，那双金属鞋底踏出的诱人嗒嗒声，足以让男女都兴致勃勃地竖起耳朵。
rows.raw: "Slender boots with metal soles and a defined — yet sensible inch-and-a-half — heel. Some clever little loops have been stitched into the sides of the boots, so that a black cloth strip on the underside can dampen the sound of that metal. Of course, if you're not sneaking, those metal soles have a really seductive click-clack to them that have men and women perking up with interest."

rows.translation: 铁手套
铁手套

rows.original: Full metal gauntlets over a heavy leather glove, these guards give your hands unparalleled protection at the cost of fine manipulation.
rows.translation: 在厚实的皮手套外面再套上全金属护手，这些护具虽然会牺牲一定的灵活性，但能为你的双手提供无与伦比的防护。
rows.raw: "Full metal gauntlets over a heavy leather glove, these guards give your hands unparalleled protection at the cost of fine manipulation."

rows.translation: 护臂
护臂

rows.original: Light arm guards made of leather with metal plates on the outer side, these are the standard fare of soldiers and mercenaries all over the world.
rows.translation: 由皮革制成，外侧装有金属护板的轻质护臂，这是全世界士兵和雇佣兵的标准装备。
rows.raw: "Light arm guards made of leather with metal plates on the outer side, these are the standard fare of soldiers and mercenaries all over the world."

rows.translation: 银手镯
银手镯

rows.original: A pair of slender silver bracelets dangle from Cait's wrists. They're inscribed with prayers of protection and safe-keeping from her god, radiating the faintest heat of her homeland across her body.
rows.translation: 凯特的手腕上悬挂着一对纤细的银手镯。上面刻着她所信仰的神明赐予的护身祷文，这些祷文仿佛为她的身躯带来了故乡那缕淡淡的温暖。
rows.raw: "A pair of slender silver bracelets dangle from Cait's wrists. They're inscribed with prayers of protection and safe-keeping from her god, radiating the faintest heat of her homeland across her body."

rows.translation: 金胡萝卜手镯
金胡萝卜手镯

rows.original: This golden bracelet has a tiny little carrot motif on it, and a series of stamped magic runes on the inside that feel warm against your [pc.sfs|skin|fur|scales|arm]. Special Effect: While above 75% Health, Critical hits gain +25 Crit Effectiveness.
rows.translation: 这只金手镯饰有一枚小小的胡萝卜图案，内侧压印着一串魔法符文，贴在你的[pc.sfs|皮肤|毛皮|鳞片|手臂]上时暖洋洋的。 特殊效果：生命值高于75%时，暴击效果提高25点。
rows.raw: " This golden bracelet has a tiny little carrot motif on it, and a series of stamped magic runes on the inside that feel warm against your [pc.sfs|skin|fur|scales|arm]. Special Effect: While above 75% Health, Critical hits gain +25 Crit Effectiveness."

rows.translation: 臂长皮手套
臂长皮手套

rows.original: Black leather, and they give you that 'snap' sound that's oh-so-delightful.
rows.translation: 黑色皮革，而且它们在使用时会发出那种非常悦耳的“咔嗒”声。
rows.raw: "Black leather, and they give you that 'snap' sound that's oh-so-delightful."

rows.translation: 王室手套
王室手套

rows.original: Silken gloves that belonged to Queen Alissa of the Winter City. Though at first glance nothing more than expensive formalwear, these gloves bear an echo of the queen's relentless fighting style enchanted upon them...
rows.translation: 这些丝质手套曾属于冬城的艾莉莎女王。乍看之下，它们只不过是昂贵的正式服装罢了，但实际上，这些手套上蕴含着女王那毫不留情的战斗风格所赋予的魔力……
rows.raw: "Silken gloves that belonged to Queen Alissa of the Winter City. Though at first glance nothing more than expensive formalwear, these gloves bear an echo of the queen's relentless fighting style enchanted upon them..."

rows.translation: 胆小猫手套
胆小猫手套

rows.original: A pair of black leather gloves lined with soft white fur. When put on, they adhere closely to the skin and leave you with a slight tingling sensation right where the fur touches against your [pc.arms]. Special Effect: Each time you flee combat, the cursed nature of the glove makes you more and more feline in appearance.
rows.translation: 一副黑色皮革手套，内衬柔软的白色毛皮。戴上后，它们会紧密贴合皮肤，毛皮贴着你[pc.arms]的地方会传来轻微的刺麻感。 特效每次你从战斗中逃跑时，这只手套的诅咒效果都会让你的外表变得越来越像猫。
rows.raw: "A pair of black leather gloves lined with soft white fur. When put on, they adhere closely to the skin and leave you with a slight tingling sensation right where the fur touches against your [pc.arms].\n\n Special Effect: Each time you flee combat, the cursed nature of the glove makes you more and more feline in appearance."

rows.translation: 巨力手套
巨力手套

rows.original: A pair of runic hide gloves, clearly magical given how they've survived eons languishing in a treasury at the bottom of the sea with minimal degradation. While clearly meant for jotun hands much, much larger than your own, the cinches about the wrists would allow you to tie them about your palms and knuckles as handwraps. An imperfect solution, but a workable one that's worth the power these could afford you.
rows.translation: 这是一副符文皮革手套，显然具有魔法效果——毕竟它们在海底的宝库中沉睡了数亿年，却几乎没有任何损坏。虽然这些手套显然是为那些比你的手大得多的巨人之手设计的，但手腕处的设计也可以让你将它们缠绕在手掌和指节上，当作护手使用。这个办法虽然并不完美，但却非常实用，而且它们所赋予你的力量绝对值得这个代价。
rows.raw: "A pair of runic hide gloves, clearly magical given how they've survived eons languishing in a treasury at the bottom of the sea with minimal degradation. While clearly meant for jotun hands much, much larger than your own, the cinches about the wrists would allow you to tie them about your palms and knuckles as handwraps. An imperfect solution, but a workable one that's worth the power these could afford you."

rows.translation: 乳胶手套
乳胶手套

rows.original: Two long gloves that come all the way up your forearm. Good for caressing skin or producing a slight squeak by rubbing the fingers together.
rows.translation: 两只长手套，能够覆盖整个前臂。非常适合用来抚摸皮肤，或者通过摩擦手指来发出轻微的声响。
rows.raw: "Two long gloves that come all the way up your forearm. Good for caressing skin or producing a slight squeak by rubbing the fingers together."

rows.translation: 执政官臂甲
执政官臂甲

rows.original: A heavy armplate that extends all the way from the shoulder of your dominant arm to your fingertips, enclosing the top side in armor and the bottom in a softer underlayer. Its intricate construction ensures full movement of your arm and its strength ensures you can deflect blows – if you have the skill.
rows.translation: 一块厚重的护臂，从你主导手的肩膀一直延伸到指尖，上层为坚硬的护甲，下层则采用较为柔软的材料。这种精巧的设计既保证了你的手臂能够自由活动，其强大的防护性能也能帮助你有效抵挡攻击——当然，这前提是你具备相应的技巧。
rows.raw: "A heavy armplate that extends all the way from the shoulder of your dominant arm to your fingertips, enclosing the top side in armor and the bottom in a softer underlayer. Its intricate construction ensures full movement of your arm and its strength ensures you can deflect blows – if you have the skill."

rows.translation: 焰术士手套
焰术士手套

rows.original: Long black gloves, proofed against fire. These garments were part of the common attire for priests of the Terrestrial Fire, an animist cult that once existed in the Frostwood, protected from the cold by the eternal flame they worshiped.
rows.translation: 长黑手套，具有防火性能。这种服装曾是“大地之火”教派祭司们的常规服饰。这个信仰自然主义的教派曾经存在于霜木之地，他们所崇拜的永恒之火为他们抵御严寒提供了保护。
rows.raw: "Long black gloves, proofed against fire. These garments were part of the common attire for priests of the Terrestrial Fire, an animist cult that once existed in the Frostwood, protected from the cold by the eternal flame they worshiped."

rows.translation: 地卜师护腕
地卜师护腕

rows.original: A set of electrum bracers which once belonged to
rows.translation: 一对曾属于
rows.raw: "A set of electrum bracers which once belonged to "

rows.translation: 卡蒂亚的兄长，一位技艺精湛的地术师

rows.original: . The ductile metal doesn't offer much in the way of armor, but wearing them allows for greater ease and efficacy of channeling one's magic. Their conductive nature may somewhat increase your own magical vulnerability, however.
rows.translation: 的电铬护腕。这种延展性金属并不能提供多少护甲，但佩戴它们能让你更轻松、更有效地引导自身魔力。不过，它们的导电特性也可能会略微提高你自身对魔法的脆弱性。
rows.raw: ". The ductile metal doesn't offer much in the way of armor, but wearing them allows for greater ease and efficacy of channeling one's magic. Their conductive nature may somewhat increase your own magical vulnerability, however."

rows.original: These gloves are without fingers, leaving your pinchers free to do their wicked work. Made with a stretchy and forgiving thin leather, the gloves are coal black, and embroidered in golden thread. They don't do much for temperature, or the weather, but they look damnably fine... and that has to count for something.
rows.translation: 这双露指手套让你的手指得以自由施展那些坏心眼的把戏。它以富有弹性、柔韧服帖的薄皮革制成，色泽乌黑，并用金线绣出纹饰。它既不怎么保暖，也挡不住恶劣天气，但穿起来真他妈好看……这总该算点什么吧。
rows.raw: "These gloves are without fingers, leaving your pinchers free to do their wicked work. Made with a stretchy and forgiving thin leather, the gloves are coal black, and embroidered in golden thread. They don't do much for temperature, or the weather, but they look damnably fine... and that has to count for something."

rows.translation: 女巫帽
女巫帽

rows.original: A proudly-peaked black hat for the aspiring witch. Long ago, these hats were in vogue among the mages of lost Estelore, all but part of their uniform; modern hedge witches favor them both for their ancient tradition and their utility in the field.
rows.translation: 这是一顶让那些有志成为女巫的人引以为豪的黑色帽子。很久以前，在已经消失的埃斯托洛尔，这些帽子在法师们中非常流行，几乎已经成为他们制服的一部分；而现代的乡村女巫们则因为它们古老的传统以及在实际使用中的便利性，而依然偏爱佩戴它们。
rows.raw: "A proudly-peaked black hat for the aspiring witch. Long ago, these hats were in vogue among the mages of lost Estelore, all but part of their uniform; modern hedge witches favor them both for their ancient tradition and their utility in the field."

rows.translation: 决斗帽
决斗帽

rows.original: This fine felt hat is comfortable and stylish, with one side of its brim curled up and the other containing a brilliant harpy feather. What's not to love?
rows.translation: 这顶精美的毡帽舒适又时髦，一侧帽檐卷起，另一侧饰着一根艳丽的哈比羽毛。还有什么不讨人喜欢的呢？
rows.raw: "This fine felt hat is comfortable and stylish, with one side of its brim curled up and the other containing a brilliant harpy feather. What's not to love?"

rows.translation: 宽檐帽
宽檐帽

rows.original: This leather hat has a tall, flat crown and an incredibly wide brim, along with a belt encircling the crown. You imagine this would be good for keeping the sunlight out of your eyes, as well as completely shrouding your face in shadow, if that's something you'd want for some reason.
rows.translation: 这款皮帽的帽顶较高且较为平坦，帽边也非常宽大，帽顶还配有一条环绕其周边的带子。可以想象，这样的设计既能有效阻挡阳光进入眼睛，也能将你的整个面部完全笼罩在阴影之中——当然，如果你有这样的需求的话。
rows.raw: "This leather hat has a tall, flat crown and an incredibly wide brim, along with a belt encircling the crown. You imagine this would be good for keeping the sunlight out of your eyes, as well as completely shrouding your face in shadow, if that's something you'd want for some reason."

rows.translation: 英雄头盔
英雄头盔

rows.original:
A plumed great helm that seems to be more for show than anything else. Lupine runes have been gilded in a circle above the eye slits, and someone's tacked on a pair of small, stubby horns that clearly wasn't part of the helm's original design. Reinforced with metal bands on the inside, it feels too heavy for most people to wear comfortably in battle, but judging from where the helm would meet a gorget it's a headpiece for the stout and broad-shouldered.

        Anyone donning this helm would instantly be marked as some kind of big deal, but doesn't that just mean the wearer would be that much more of a target in battle?
rows.translation:
一顶装饰着羽毛的华丽头盔，看起来更多是用于炫耀而非实际用途。在头盔的眼孔上方，用金箔装饰着狼族图案；而有人还额外添加了一对短小的角，这些显然并不是头盔最初设计的一部分。内部装有金属加固条，因此对于大多数人来说，这种头盔在战斗中佩戴时会显得过于沉重，难以舒适地使用。但从头盔与颈甲的连接部位来看，这种头盔显然是为那些体格魁梧、肩膀宽阔的人设计的。

        任何戴上这种头盔的人，都会立刻被视为重要人物，但这样一来，他们在战斗中不就更容易成为目标吗？
rows.raw: "A plumed great helm that seems to be more for show than anything else. Lupine runes have been gilded in a circle above the eye slits, and someone's tacked on a pair of small, stubby horns that clearly wasn't part of the helm's original design. Reinforced with metal bands on the inside, it feels too heavy for most people to wear comfortably in battle, but judging from where the helm would meet a gorget it's a headpiece for the stout and broad-shouldered.\n\n        Anyone donning this helm would instantly be marked as some kind of big deal, but doesn't that just mean the wearer would be that much more of a target in battle?"

rows.translation: 角盔
角盔

rows.original: A traditional favorite of young orc men looking to show off, the horns on this helmet usually come from goats, although others have been used in the past. To be quite frank, the horns don't actually serve any purpose and even get in the way of the helmet's proper function, but one has to admit that they do make the wearer stand out, if only for being as insane as to seriously consider such a display in the heat of battle. Special Effect: You generate 20% more Threat.
rows.translation: 这种头盔上的角通常是山羊的角，也是年轻兽人男性们喜欢用来炫耀的装饰品。当然，过去也使用过其他材料的角。说实话，这些角其实并没有任何实际用途，甚至还会妨碍头盔的正常使用，但不得不承认，它们确实能让佩戴者显得与众不同——至少那些在激烈的战斗中还愿意冒险佩戴这种头盔的人，确实显得相当“疯狂”。 特效：你产生的威胁值增加20%。
rows.raw: " A traditional favorite of young orc men looking to show off, the horns on this helmet usually come from goats, although others have been used in the past. To be quite frank, the horns don't actually serve any purpose and even get in the way of the helmet's proper function, but one has to admit that they do make the wearer stand out, if only for being as insane as to seriously consider such a display in the heat of battle. Special Effect: You generate 20% more Threat."

rows.translation: 霍普隆头盔
霍普隆头盔

rows.original: A one-piece plate helmet whose design originates from ancient Belhar. It covers the head and nose with solid protection, but leaves much of the face exposed to allow for breathing and sight. Comes standard with a majestic plume.
rows.translation: 这种一体式头盔的设计源于古老的贝尔哈尔。它能够为头部和鼻子提供坚实的保护，但脸部的大部分区域仍然保持开放，以便呼吸和视线不受阻碍。标配一根华丽的羽饰。
rows.raw: "A one-piece plate helmet whose design originates from ancient Belhar. It covers the head and nose with solid protection, but leaves much of the face exposed to allow for breathing and sight. Comes standard with a majestic plume."

rows.translation: 兜
兜

rows.original:
A lightweight iron helmet with a little artistic flair to it in kitsune style. It's clearly a second-hand piece, far too embellished to have been something a conscript from the peasantry or even the middle class might have owned; one wonders what happened to the previous owner, quite possibly an ocean away. The metal itself is thin, relying more on its structure to spread out blows rather than absorbing it with sheer material bulk; the inside has been padded with cloth akin to a gambeson.

        Either way, it's clear that the helmet's been designed for a kitsune or tanuki, considering the little ears sticking out to either side. While weakening the helmet's ability to spread out the shock of blows, being effectively deafened while wearing it isn't a price that the intended wearer was willing to pay.
rows.translation:
一顶带有狐族艺术风格的轻质铁盔。它显然是件二手货，装饰华丽得绝非农民征召兵、甚至普通中产者所能拥有；不禁令人猜想，它那位或许远在重洋彼岸的前主人究竟遭遇了什么。金属本身很薄，主要依靠结构分散冲击，而非用厚重材料硬扛；内部则衬有类似武装衣的软垫。

        无论如何，从两侧伸出的小耳朵便能看出，这顶头盔是为狐族或狸族设计的。耳孔会削弱它分散冲击的能力，但设计者显然认为，让佩戴者几乎什么都听不见更无法接受。
rows.raw:
"A lightweight iron helmet with a little artistic flair to it in kitsune style. It's clearly a second-hand piece, far too embellished to have been something a conscript from the peasantry or even the middle class might have owned; one wonders what happened to the previous owner, quite possibly an ocean away. The metal itself is thin, relying more on its structure to spread out blows rather than absorbing it with sheer material bulk; the inside has been padded with cloth akin to a gambeson.

        Either way, it's clear that the helmet's been designed for a kitsune or tanuki, considering the little ears sticking out to either side. While weakening the helmet's ability to spread out the shock of blows, being effectively deafened while wearing it isn't a price that the intended wearer was willing to pay.
        "

rows.translation: 常春花兜帽
常春花兜帽

rows.original: A marriage gift from Ahmri. This veil of delicate seeming lace and multicolored flowers is much more durable than it seems. It fits snugly over your head, and creates no impairment to your vision. Even just holding it, you feel the love that went into it filling you with determination. Special Effect: Whenever you take damage from an enemy, you lose 5% of your current Threat and heal 15% of your Max HP over 3 turns.
rows.translation: 这是阿赫米送的结婚礼物。这条看似由精致蕾丝和彩色花朵制成的面纱，其实比看上去要结实得多。它能够紧密地贴合在你的头上，而且完全不会影响你的视线。哪怕只是轻轻握在手中，你也能感受到其中蕴含的关爱，这种关爱会让你充满决心。 特效每当你受到敌人的攻击而受到伤害时，你的当前“威胁值”会减少5%，同时会在3个回合内恢复15%的最大生命值。
rows.raw: " A marriage gift from Ahmri. This veil of delicate seeming lace and multicolored flowers is much more durable than it seems. It fits snugly over your head, and creates no impairment to your vision. Even just holding it, you feel the love that went into it filling you with determination. Special Effect: Whenever you take damage from an enemy, you lose 5% of your current Threat and heal 15% of your Max HP over 3 turns."

rows.translation: 银面具
银面具

rows.original: A simple mask made of gleaming, pristine silver that covers most of your face, leaving holes for your eyes and not reaching down far enough to cover your nose. While it fits your face perfectly, it's too thick to be worn underneath a more protective helmet and it doesn't cover enough of your skull to offer any protection. But while it's on, you feel an unusual power stirring inside you...
rows.translation: 这是一种由闪亮、纯净的银质材料制成的简单面罩，它可以覆盖你面部的绝大部分区域，只留下眼睛的位置供你视线透过，同时面罩的下缘并没有延伸到你的鼻子部位。虽然这种面罩与你的脸型非常贴合，但它太厚了，因此无法与更具有防护功能的头盔一起佩戴；此外，它也无法完全覆盖你的头骨，因此无法提供足够的保护。然而，当你戴上它的时候，会感觉到一种不同寻常的力量正在你体内涌动……
rows.raw: "\n        A simple mask made of gleaming, pristine silver that covers most of your face, leaving holes for your eyes and not reaching down far enough to cover your nose. While it fits your face perfectly, it's too thick to be worn underneath a more protective helmet and it doesn't cover enough of your skull to offer any protection. But while it's on, you feel an unusual power stirring inside you..."

rows.translation: 欲魔之眼
欲魔之眼

rows.original: One of the lureling's trio of beady white eyes, its core as dark as the void between the spheres save for the starry light within, much like an anglerfish's lure. According to Tollus's notes on the abyssal beast, it sheds these to distract enemies like a lizard sheds its tail, but you get the gut feeling there's more to it than that... how are you supposed to put this thing on? Is it really on, or are you just imagining things?
rows.translation: 这种深海生物那三只闪着微光的白眼中，有一只的核心部分呈现出如同宇宙虚空般的暗影，唯有内部闪烁着星星般的光芒，这与鲶鱼诱饵的构造颇为相似。根据托勒斯对这种深渊生物的记载，它会像蜥蜴甩掉尾巴一样丢弃这些眼睛来迷惑敌人，但你总觉得其中肯定还有别的原因……这种生物到底该怎么使用呢？是吗？这是真的发生了，还是你只是在胡思乱想而已？
rows.raw: "\n One of the lureling's trio of beady white eyes, its core as dark as the void between the spheres save for the starry light within, much like an anglerfish's lure. According to Tollus's notes on the abyssal beast, it sheds these to distract enemies like a lizard sheds its tail, but you get the gut feeling there's more to it than that... how are you supposed to put this thing on? Is it really on, or are you just imagining things?"

rows.translation: 奥术头环
奥术头环

rows.original: A silver-chased circlet set with focusing gemstones, letting war-mages cast their spells without fear of backlash even if disarmed of their staves — or if they choose to wield mightier weapons of war, as is common in the Khor'minoan auxiliary corps.
rows.translation: 一个镶嵌有聚焦宝石的银质环饰，使得战法师们即使在失去法杖的情况下，也能毫无惧意地施展法术——当然，如果他们选择使用更强大的武器进行战斗，也同样适用。这种做法在科尔米诺辅助部队中十分普遍。
rows.raw: "A silver-chased circlet set with focusing gemstones, letting war-mages cast their spells without fear of backlash even if disarmed of their staves — or if they choose to wield mightier weapons of war, as is common in the Khor'minoan auxiliary corps."

rows.translation: 明晰头环
明晰头环

rows.original: A mage's circlet made of chased silver, set with
rows.translation: 一枚由精炼银材制成、镶嵌着珍贵宝石的法师戒指
rows.raw: "\n        A mage's circlet made of chased silver, set with "

rows.original: Special Effect: Grants the Cunning personality trait, along with +10 Spellpower and +5 Critical Chance. When you have the Cum Filled or Pent Up status: if you are female you are granted the Bimbo personality trait, if you are male the Cunning personality and stats are lost.
rows.translation: 特效：赋予机敏性格特质，并使法术强度增加10点，暴击几率增加5点。当处于“精液充盈”或“欲求不满”状态时：如果你是女性，将会获得“花瓶”性格特质；如果你是男性，那么“狡猾”性格特质及相应属性将会消失。
rows.raw: "\n \n Special Effect: Grants the Cunning personality trait, along with +10 Spellpower and +5 Critical Chance. When you have the Cum Filled or Pent Up status: if you are female you are granted the Bimbo personality trait, if you are male the Cunning personality and stats are lost."

rows.original: a bright pink, softly glowing gemstone that's totally smoothing out all your nasty thoughts and making the world seem bright and bubbly!
rows.translation: 一颗柔和发光的亮粉色宝石，它会把你所有讨厌的念头都抚平，让整个世界看起来明亮又欢快！
rows.raw: "a bright pink, softly glowing gemstone that's totally smoothing out all your nasty thoughts and making the world seem bright and bubbly!"

rows.original: a dark leycrystal that's been wreathed with enchantments that focus the mind and enhance perception. Though... it is amateurish work, by any standards. You wonder how much stress that mental sharpness would hold up to.
rows.translation: 一块被施加了各种魔法的暗影晶石，这些魔法能够集中注意力、增强感知能力。不过……以任何标准来看，这些魔法的制作都相当粗糙。你不禁会想，这种敏锐的思维能力能够承受多大的压力呢？
rows.raw: "a dark leycrystal that's been wreathed with enchantments that focus the mind and enhance perception. Though... it is amateurish work, by any standards. You wonder how much stress that mental sharpness would hold up to."

rows.translation: 施法者兜帽
施法者兜帽

rows.original: A heavy cloth hood, meant to be attached to a robe or mantle. While hoods are common all across Savarra, especially in the intemperate Marches, this particular cowl has been stitched with warding patterns meant more to help focus magic than the keep the ears warm — not that it's a slouch at that, either.
rows.translation: 这种厚重的布制兜帽是专为搭配长袍或斗篷使用的。虽然在整个萨瓦拉地区，尤其是在气候严酷的边境地带，兜帽非常常见，但这种特殊的兜帽上缝制的防护图案，其主要作用是帮助集中魔力，而非仅仅为了保暖——当然，它的保暖效果也相当不错。
rows.raw: "A heavy cloth hood, meant to be attached to a robe or mantle. While hoods are common all across Savarra, especially in the intemperate Marches, this particular cowl has been stitched with warding patterns meant more to help focus magic than the keep the ears warm — not that it's a slouch at that, either."

rows.translation: 饰羽头盔
饰羽头盔

rows.original: Popular amongst gladiators in the arena, this bronze helmet bears a large plume of hair that runs across its back length. Covering the wearer's face, however, is an ornate 'grill' face visor. While it does slightly limit the wearer's vision, the defensive benefits are more than worth it in the minds of those who choose to wear these.
rows.translation: 这种青铜头盔在竞技场中的角斗士们中非常受欢迎，它的背部装饰着一排长长的羽毛。不过，佩戴者脸部被一块精美的“格栅”面甲所覆盖。虽然这种设计会略微限制佩戴者的视线，但在那些选择使用这种头盔的人看来，其带来的防御优势绝对值得这个牺牲。
rows.raw: "Popular amongst gladiators in the arena, this bronze helmet bears a large plume of hair that runs across its back length. Covering the wearer's face, however, is an ornate 'grill' face visor. While it does slightly limit the wearer's vision, the defensive benefits are more than worth it in the minds of those who choose to wear these."

rows.translation: 青铜佩塔索斯
青铜佩塔索斯

rows.original: While most petasoi are made from felt or straw, this one is made of bronze, to serve as protection from some blows instead of just from the sun. While it's not the best in terms of defensive capabilities, it conserves your vision and keeps the sun out of the way.
rows.translation: 虽然大多数遮阳帽都是用毛毡或稻草制成的，但这个却是用青铜打造的，它的作用不仅仅是遮挡阳光，还能有效抵御某些冲击。虽然它的防护性能并非最佳，但它确实能够保护你的视线，同时阻挡阳光的照射。
rows.raw: "While most petasoi are made from felt or straw, this one is made of bronze, to serve as protection from some blows instead of just from the sun. While it's not the best in terms of defensive capabilities, it conserves your vision and keeps the sun out of the way."

rows.translation: 贵族面具
贵族面具

rows.original: A mask belonging to the first king of Khor'minos, styled after the fashion of the minoan druids that came before the tribe permanently settled under the mountain but graven in Velun's fatherly image. The mask is quite heavy, predominantly made of copper, and sloped somewhat to fit equally well over a muzzle or humanoid face. The mask has a pronounced beard and curly hair, imparting an aura of strength and dependability. Special Effect: You are immune to Overburdened.
rows.translation: 这面面具属于科尔米诺斯的第一位国王，其设计风格借鉴了在该部落永久定居于山脉之下之前生活的米诺斯德鲁伊们的传统。不过，面具上雕刻的却是维伦父亲的形象。这面面具相当沉重，主要由铜制成，其形状略微倾斜，因此既适合覆盖动物的口部，也适合人类的面部。面具上雕刻着浓密的胡须和卷曲的头发，这些图案为它增添了一种充满力量与可靠感的氛围。 特效你对“过载状态”具有抗性。
rows.raw: " A mask belonging to the first king of Khor'minos, styled after the fashion of the minoan druids that came before the tribe permanently settled under the mountain but graven in Velun's fatherly image. The mask is quite heavy, predominantly made of copper, and sloped somewhat to fit equally well over a muzzle or humanoid face. The mask has a pronounced beard and curly hair, imparting an aura of strength and dependability. Special Effect: You are immune to Overburdened."

rows.translation: 巨型帽
泰坦帽

rows.original: An absolutely oversized hat, perfect for only the most powerful of witches. Wearing it on your head adds four feet and eight pounds to you. It's been enchanted with a powerful spell: even just holding it in your hands makes you feel like you're better than you've ever been before. Special Effect: Increases your Attack Power, Spellpower, or Sexiness based on the highest of your corresponding attributes (Strength, Willpower, or Presence, respectively). Currently increasing
rows.translation: 一顶大得离谱的帽子，只有最强大的女巫才适合佩戴。戴上它后，你的身高会增加四英尺八磅。这顶帽子被施了强大的魔法：哪怕只是将它拿在手中，也会让你感觉自己比以往任何时候都要强大。 特效根据你相应属性中最高的数值（分别是力量、意志力或魅力），来提升你的攻击强度、法力值或魅力值。目前这一效果正在生效中。
rows.raw: " An absolutely oversized hat, perfect for only the most powerful of witches. Wearing it on your head adds four feet and eight pounds to you. It's been enchanted with a powerful spell: even just holding it in your hands makes you feel like you're better than you've ever been before. Special Effect: Increases your Attack Power, Spellpower, or Sexiness based on the highest of your corresponding attributes (Strength, Willpower, or Presence, respectively). Currently increasing "

rows.translation: 攻击强度
发簪
发簪

rows.original: A copper hairpin, decorated in the shape of a flower and set with a semi-precious stone. Sharp and sturdy enough to be used as a makeshift weapon in a pinch like the legends tell, but also good for keeping one's hair in order. One would expect such apparel to be made from gold, silver or something precious, but maybe there just isn't much call for such here on the frontier.
rows.translation: 一根铜制发夹，上面雕刻着花朵的图案，并镶嵌着一颗半宝石。正如传说中所说，它既锋利又结实，在紧急情况下完全可以当作临时武器使用；同时，它也能很好地固定头发。人们通常会认为这样的饰品应该由黄金、白银或其他珍贵的材料制成，但也许在边疆地区，人们并没有太大的需求去使用这样的饰品吧。
rows.raw: "A copper hairpin, decorated in the shape of a flower and set with a semi-precious stone. Sharp and sturdy enough to be used as a makeshift weapon in a pinch like the legends tell, but also good for keeping one's hair in order. One would expect such apparel to be made from gold, silver or something precious, but maybe there just isn't much call for such here on the frontier."

rows.translation: 冬之王冠
冬之王冠

rows.original: The original crown of House Ridell, broken in twain with the schism between Queen Atheldred and her consort Synneva. Special Effect: Allows the use of Dawnbreak.
rows.translation: 里德尔家族的原始王冠，在阿瑟尔德雷德女王与她的伴侣辛妮瓦之间发生的分裂中被摔成了两半。 特效：允许使用《黎明破晓》。
rows.raw: " The original crown of House Ridell, broken in twain with the schism between Queen Atheldred and her consort Synneva. Special Effect: Allows the use of Dawnbreak."

rows.translation: 执政官头盔
执政官头盔

rows.original: A rounded, fully enclosed helmet with two eyeholes and a fin along the top. This was worn by a renowned gladiator some twenty years ago, and it's still in great condition.
rows.translation: 这种头盔形状圆润，完全封闭，有两个眼洞，顶部还有一条突起。大约二十年前，有一位著名的角斗士佩戴过这种头盔，而如今它依然保存得非常好。
rows.raw: "A rounded, fully enclosed helmet with two eyeholes and a fin along the top. This was worn by a renowned gladiator some twenty years ago, and it's still in great condition."

rows.translation: 焰术士兜帽
焰术士兜帽

rows.original: A crimson hood made of spun cloth, made by Karithea the Hellhound for you. These garments were part of the common attire for priests of the Terrestrial Fire, an animist cult that once existed in the Frostwood, protected from the cold by the eternal flame they worshiped.
rows.translation: 这顶由卡里泰娅这位地狱猎犬为你制作的深红色头巾，其实是大地之火教派祭司们常用的服饰之一。大地之火教派是一个曾经存在于霜木地区的泛灵主义宗教组织，他们的信徒们依靠所崇拜的永恒之火来抵御严寒。
rows.raw: "A crimson hood made of spun cloth, made by Karithea the Hellhound for you. These garments were part of the common attire for priests of the Terrestrial Fire, an animist cult that once existed in the Frostwood, protected from the cold by the eternal flame they worshiped."

rows.translation: 魔术师兜帽
魔术师兜帽

rows.original: A dark cowl, typically worn by apprentice magicians who have not yet graduated to wearing a peaked hat — itself once a sign of graduation from the Belharan college of Estelore. In the aftermath of that prestigious academy's downfall, fewer mages wear the pointed hat, and more content themselves with the more unassuming hood.
rows.translation: 一种深色的兜帽，通常由那些尚未获得资格佩戴尖顶帽的魔法学徒们穿着——而尖顶帽本身曾经是人们从贝尔哈兰的埃斯特洛尔学院毕业的象征。在那所享有盛誉的学院衰落之后，越来越少的法师选择佩戴尖顶帽，他们更倾向于选择这种更为低调的兜帽。
rows.raw: "A dark cowl, typically worn by apprentice magicians who have not yet graduated to wearing a peaked hat — itself once a sign of graduation from the Belharan college of Estelore. In the aftermath of that prestigious academy's downfall, fewer mages wear the pointed hat, and more content themselves with the more unassuming hood."

rows.translation: 钴蓝帽
钴蓝帽

rows.original: A jaunty cap made from azure-dyed thread, with a long blue feather stuck through it. Caps like these were once worn by a secretive order of rogue magicians based in Tychris, though their art has long been lost to time.
rows.translation: 一顶用天蓝色线编织而成的俏皮帽子，上面还插着一根长长的蓝色羽毛。曾经，一群隐匿在提克里斯的叛逆法师们会戴着这样的帽子，不过他们的魔法技艺早已随着时间的流逝而消失无踪了。
rows.raw: "A jaunty cap made from azure-dyed thread, with a long blue feather stuck through it. Caps like these were once worn by a secretive order of rogue magicians based in Tychris, though their art has long been lost to time."

rows.original: This neatly-forged mask is made of solid, soot-blackened bronze in the likeness of a cat. It rests on your face with some thankfully-soft padding behind it, where it can cover you from the cheekbones and up. Very dashing... and it might even protect you from a blow or two to the dome.
rows.translation: 这副锻造精巧的猫面具由整块青铜制成，表面熏得漆黑。面具内侧贴着柔软得令人庆幸的衬垫，覆住你颧骨以上的面庞。戴起来英姿飒爽……说不定还能替你的脑袋挡下一两次重击。
rows.raw: "This neatly-forged mask is made of solid, soot-blackened bronze in the likeness of a cat. It rests on your face with some thankfully-soft padding behind it, where it can cover you from the cheekbones and up. Very dashing... and it might even protect you from a blow or two to the dome."

rows.original: Cannot call a class as a function
rows.raw: "Cannot call a class as a function"

rows.original: Super expression must either be null or a function
rows.raw: "Super expression must either be null or a function"
rows.curatedReason: Babel/JavaScript 类继承辅助代码的内部异常字符串或异常消息拼接片段，不属于游戏显示文本。

rows.original: Derived constructors may only return object or undefined
rows.raw: "Derived constructors may only return object or undefined"
rows.curatedReason: Babel/JavaScript 类继承辅助代码的内部异常字符串或异常消息拼接片段，不属于游戏显示文本。

rows.translation: 守护护符
守护护符

rows.original: An amulet enchanted by a great wizard to protect his bumbling apprentices from backfiring experiments, this small silver amulet is equally competent at stopping ablating enemy magic and massive physical trauma on the battlefield.
rows.translation: 这枚由一位伟大的巫师施以魔法的护身符，旨在保护那些经常犯错的学徒们免受那些失败实验带来的伤害。事实上，这枚小巧的银质护身符在阻挡敌人的魔法攻击以及减轻战场上的致命物理伤害方面，也同样十分有效。
rows.raw: "An amulet enchanted by a great wizard to protect his bumbling apprentices from backfiring experiments, this small silver amulet is equally competent at stopping ablating enemy magic and massive physical trauma on the battlefield."

rows.translation: 转移护符
转移护符

rows.original: The amber orb set in this amulet serves as the link between you and Kiyoko's Astral Plane. If you wish to see your kitsune [kiyoko.fucked|lover|friend] in your dreams, all you need to do is go to sleep with this item equipped.
rows.translation: 这枚护身符上镶嵌的琥珀圆珠，是连接你与清子星界的纽带。若想在梦中见到你的狐妖[kiyoko.fucked|恋人|朋友]，只需戴着它入睡。
rows.raw: "The amber orb set in this amulet serves as the link between you and Kiyoko's Astral Plane. If you wish to see your kitsune [kiyoko.fucked|lover|friend] in your dreams, all you need to do is go to sleep with this item equipped."

rows.original: A plain silver amulet with an amber orb set in it. There's a sense of foreboding about it.
rows.translation: 一枚朴素的银护符，镶着一颗琥珀色圆珠。它隐隐透着不祥之感。
rows.raw: "A plain silver amulet with an amber orb set in it. There's a sense of foreboding about it."

rows.translation: 联合护符
联合护符

rows.original: The amber orb set in this amulet serves as the link between you and Kiyoko's Astral Plane. Once per encounter, you may use the power this accessory grants to allow the kitsune spirit to temporarily manifest at your side in order to aid you in battle. Furthermore, if you wish to visit Kiyoko in her little pocket realm, all you need to do is go to sleep with this item equipped.
rows.translation: 这款护身符中镶嵌的琥珀球体，正是你与清子的星界之间连接的纽带。每次遭遇敌人时，你都可以利用这件饰品赋予的力量，让那只狐灵暂时出现在你身边，帮助你作战。此外，如果你想要前往清子的那个小世界，只需在佩戴这件物品的状态下入睡即可。
rows.raw: "The amber orb set in this amulet serves as the link between you and Kiyoko's Astral Plane. Once per encounter, you may use the power this accessory grants to allow the kitsune spirit to temporarily manifest at your side in order to aid you in battle. Furthermore, if you wish to visit Kiyoko in her little pocket realm, all you need to do is go to sleep with this item equipped."

rows.translation: 少女之盾
少女之盾

rows.original: An enchanted amulet given to Lusina when she was a girl. She's kept it close all these years, hoping someday it would lead her back to her family's lost glory. In the meantime, it remains a memento of days gone by that's kept her sane in her darkest hours.
rows.translation: 这是露西娜小时候得到的一枚被施了魔法的护身符。这些年来，她一直将它珍藏在身边，希望有朝一日它能帮助她找回家族曾经失去的荣耀。与此同时，这枚护身符也成为了她回忆过去时光的象征，在她最黑暗的时刻，它始终陪伴着她，帮助她保持理智。
rows.raw: "An enchanted amulet given to Lusina when she was a girl. She's kept it close all these years, hoping someday it would lead her back to her family's lost glory. In the meantime, it remains a memento of days gone by that's kept her sane in her darkest hours."

rows.translation: 蛇形吊坠
蛇形吊坠

rows.original: An ophidian necklace of blue glass beads, granted to you by the goddess Nareva at the Convocation. While worn, allows you to summon the spirit of Princess Phyria to your side.
rows.translation: 一条由蓝色玻璃珠制成的蛇形项链，这是娜瑞瓦女神在集会时赐予你的。佩戴这条项链后，你就可以将菲莉亚公主的灵魂召唤到自己身边。
rows.raw: "An ophidian necklace of blue glass beads, granted to you by the goddess Nareva at the Convocation. While worn, allows you to summon the spirit of Princess Phyria to your side."

rows.translation: 狐尾护符
狐尾护符

rows.original: A foreign charm made from several miniature fox tails tied together, each one of a different color. Faint wisps of blue play along the fur when you look at it out the corner of your eye.
rows.translation: 这是一种由几根颜色各异的迷你狐狸尾巴编织而成的装饰品，散发着异国风情。当你侧目望去时，那些淡淡的蓝色条纹会在光线的作用下在毛茸茸的表面上闪烁着微光。
rows.raw: "A foreign charm made from several miniature fox tails tied together, each one of a different color. Faint wisps of blue play along the fur when you look at it out the corner of your eye."

rows.translation: 勾玉
勾玉

rows.original: A small, curved teardrop of jade with a length of cord threaded through it. You're not sure what it means, but there's a palpable spiritual and magical power to what might otherwise be mistaken for simple jewellery.
rows.translation: 一块小巧而弯曲的泪滴形玉器，上面穿着一根细绳。你并不清楚它的含义，但这种物件显然蕴含着某种精神力量与魔法气息，否则它根本不可能被误认为是普通的珠宝。
rows.raw: "A small, curved teardrop of jade with a length of cord threaded through it. You're not sure what it means, but there's a palpable spiritual and magical power to what might otherwise be mistaken for simple jewellery."

rows.translation: 黑色乌头
黑色乌头

rows.original:
A dried and pressed flower of the sort found growing in mountain meadows in the Old Country. While the parts used in medicine are chiefly the roots and tubers, even the flowers themselves can be deadly; tengu people of the island nation's inland mountainous regions have used arrowheads coated in the plant's toxin to hunt bears.

        While the preservation process should have deactivated the toxins in the flower and stem, you can't help but feel a little hesitant at handling this stuff in the same way being close to blood iris gives anyone sane the jitters.
rows.translation:
这是一朵采自古国山间草甸、经过干燥压制的花。虽然药用部分主要是它的根和块茎，但就连花朵本身也有可能致命；这个岛国的内陆山区的天狗族曾用涂有这种植物毒素的箭头来猎杀熊。

        虽然这种保存方法应该已经去除了花朵和茎秆中的毒素，但在处理这些材料时，你还是会不由得感到有些犹豫——毕竟，接触这种东西，任何神志清醒的人都会感到不安，就像靠近血鸢尾一样。
rows.raw:
"
        A dried and pressed flower of the sort found growing in mountain meadows in the Old Country. While the parts used in medicine are chiefly the roots and tubers, even the flowers themselves can be deadly; tengu people of the island nation's inland mountainous regions have used arrowheads coated in the plant's toxin to hunt bears.

        While the preservation process should have deactivated the toxins in the flower and stem, you can't help but feel a little hesitant at handling this stuff in the same way being close to blood iris gives anyone sane the jitters."

rows.translation: 蓬松围巾
蓬松围巾

rows.original:
An incredibly thick and fluffy scarf woven out of some kind of fur. It doesn't seem like any kind of dye's been applied to it — the lovely reds and golds that make it up are all-natural. Just touching it makes one feel all good and warm inside, and it's got a calming smell to it, too...

        Just the perfect thing to wrap up in on a cold day in the Marches.
rows.translation:
一条由某种毛皮编织而成的、厚实而蓬松的围巾。看起来完全没有使用过任何染料——那些美丽的红色和金色都是天然的。只要轻轻触碰它，就会让人感到温暖舒适，而且它还散发着一种令人放松的香气……

        在三月那些寒冷的日子里，这条围巾简直是完美的保暖选择。
rows.raw:
"An incredibly thick and fluffy scarf woven out of some kind of fur. It doesn't seem like any kind of dye's been applied to it — the lovely reds and golds that make it up are all-natural. Just touching it makes one feel all good and warm inside, and it's got a calming smell to it, too...

        Just the perfect thing to wrap up in on a cold day in the Marches. 
        "

rows.original: A pendant in the shape of Nareva's holy symbol, a serpent devouring its own tail. Threaded by what looks like a string of glass beads, such items were made to exploit the spellcasting abilities of first-generation Astrida by promoting the circulation of magical energies between caster and focus. It worked well, too well.
rows.translation: 一枚形状如同娜瑞瓦神圣象征的吊坠——那是一条吞噬自己尾部的蛇。吊坠上串着一排看似玻璃珠的物件，这类物品的设计目的就是利用第一代阿斯特丽达的法术施放能力，促进施法者与施法媒介之间的魔法能量流动。它的效果很好，甚至好得过了头。

rows.original: A ruby, meticulously cut and polished, set into one layer of silver and itself set into one layer of gold. The amulet is large enough to snugly fit into your palm, and a thin golden chain with an easy-to-work latch connects it behind your neck. While worn, you can feel Oma's strength as a genie envelope you like an aura.
rows.translation: 一颗经过精心切割与打磨的红宝石，被镶嵌在一层银饰之中，而银饰本身又嵌在一层金饰里。这个护身符的大小正好可以放在你的手掌中，一条带有便捷锁扣的细金链将它挂在你的脖后。当你佩戴它的时候，会感受到奥玛这位精灵所拥有的力量，那种力量就像一层光环一样环绕着你。

The amulet is large enough to snugly fit into your palm, and a thin, bronze chain with an easy-to-work latch connects it behind your neck. While worn, you can feel a wisp of something fantastic envelope you like an aura.

While worn, you can feel a wisp of something fantastic envelope you like an aura."

This protective charm was given to the Iavari Roses by their mother, a priestess of the wilder-god, before her passing. Special Effect: Balance of Life — Whenever you land a Critical Hit, you gain a surge of Fertility and Virility, lasting for 24 hours. Each instance stacks.
rows.translation: 一枚形状如树的玉饰，是维伦神的神圣象征，悬挂在白金链子上。这份护身符是雅瓦里玫瑰家族的母亲——那位野生之神的祭司——在去世前送给他们的。 特效生命平衡——每当你造成一次暴击时，你会获得一次生育力与阳气的提升，这种效果会持续24小时。每次暴击都会使这种效果叠加。

rows.original: A simple golden band representing your marriage to Atani of the Marefolk, but just wearing it fills you with strength and determination. Special Effect: You restore 5% of your max HP each round in combat.
rows.translation: 一枚朴素的金戒指，象征着你与马雷族的阿塔妮之间的婚姻关系；而仅仅佩戴着它，就能让你感受到力量与决心。 特效：每轮战斗中，你可以恢复自身最大生命值的5%。
rows.raw: " A simple golden band representing your marriage to Atani of the Marefolk, but just wearing it fills you with strength and determination. Special Effect: You restore 5% of your max HP each round in combat."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] regenerate[tps|s] some health from Mare's Ring.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]从母马之戒恢复[tps|]少量生命值。
rows.raw: "\n        \n        [attacker.CombatName] regenerate[tps|s] some health from Mare's Ring."

rows.translation: 黄蜂戒指
黄蜂戒指

rows.original: A ring handed down through Queen Nyzerrah's bloodline, a ring made for deadly warriors. Something smells... decidedly lustful about it now, and every time it rubs against your skin, a little shiver of pleasure runs through your chest. Special Effect: Whenever you crit, your breasts get larger.
rows.translation: 这是一枚通过奈泽拉女王的血脉传承下来的戒指，一枚专为勇猛的战士打造的戒指。但现在，它似乎散发着某种……令人心生欲望的气息；每当它与你的皮肤接触时，都会让你感到一阵愉悦的颤动。 特效每当你打出暴击时，你的胸部就会变大。
rows.raw: " A ring handed down through Queen Nyzerrah's bloodline, a ring made for deadly warriors. Something smells... decidedly lustful about it now, and every time it rubs against your skin, a little shiver of pleasure runs through your chest. Special Effect: Whenever you crit, your breasts get larger."

rows.translation: 幸运一击戒指
幸运一击戒指

rows.original: A strange foreign charm fashioned not from paper, but from a thin strip of iron. Supposed to bring good luck and wealth, but can you really trust what Mai says? Special Effect: Earn 10-20% extra Electrum Coins from combat.
rows.translation: 一种奇异的异国魅力，并非由纸张制成，而是用一条薄铁条锻造而成。据说它能带来好运与财富，但你能真的相信舞所说的话吗？ 特效在战斗中额外获得10%到20%的琥珀金币。
rows.raw: "A strange foreign charm fashioned not from paper, but from a thin strip of iron. Supposed to bring good luck and wealth, but can you really trust what Mai says?\n \n Special Effect: Earn 10-20% extra Electrum Coins from combat."

rows.translation: 护符
护符

rows.original: A stiffened paper charm which has had various characters in the kitsunes' mother tongue written on it. You've seen Miko, Mai and Komari tote these around in their ceremonial duties as caretakers of Keros' shrine, as well as in several other places in the kitsune den. [pc.ra kitsune|While you're making some progress, your understanding of the kitsune mother tongue is still sorely limited|The mix of pictograms and alphabet is completely foreign to you], but at least you're fairly sure this particular one is an appeal to Keros for good fortune. Asking a trickster god for good fortune seems a little chancy, though...
rows.translation: 一张硬挺的纸符，上面写着狐妖母语的各种文字。你见过米可、舞和麻里在凯罗斯神社履行守护职责时随身带着这种纸符，也在狐妖巢穴的其他地方见过。[pc.ra kitsune|虽然你有所进步，但对狐妖母语仍只懂一点|象形符号与字母混杂的文字对你来说完全陌生]；不过，你至少相当确定，这张纸符是在向凯罗斯祈求好运。只是，向一位诡计之神求好运，似乎有些冒险……
rows.raw: "\n        A stiffened paper charm which has had various characters in the kitsunes' mother tongue written on it. You've seen Miko, Mai and Komari tote these around in their ceremonial duties as caretakers of Keros' shrine, as well as in several other places in the kitsune den. [pc.ra kitsune|While you're making some progress, your understanding of the kitsune mother tongue is still sorely limited|The mix of pictograms and alphabet is completely foreign to you], but at least you're fairly sure this particular one is an appeal to Keros for good fortune. Asking a trickster god for good fortune seems a little chancy, though... \n        "

rows.translation: 宽永通宝
宽永通宝

rows.original: An old iron coin from centuries past when the shogun's bakufu government effectively ruled the Old Country. Small and circular with a square hole in the middle, four characters in the kitsune native tongue have been stamped adjacent to either side of the square. While these coins are no longer in circulation, having being phased out by a new currency following the Celestial Restoration in the wake of the Godswar, those which survive are nevertheless kept as good-luck charms signifying fortune and wealth. Special Effect: Earn twice the amount of EC from combat. This bonus does not stack with equipment that confers similar benefits.
rows.translation: 这是一枚来自几个世纪前的古老铁币，当时将军的幕府政府实际上统治着整个日本。这种硬币形状小巧，呈圆形，中间有一个方形的孔洞，在方孔的两侧分别印有四行用狐妖族语言书写的文字。虽然这些硬币已经不再流通了——在“神战”之后，随着新货币的推行，它们被逐渐淘汰了——但那些保存下来的硬币仍然被视为象征好运和财富的吉祥物被人们珍藏起来。 特效在战斗中获得的经验值将是平时的两倍。此加成效果不会与那些能提供类似收益的装备效果叠加。
rows.raw: " An old iron coin from centuries past when the shogun's bakufu government effectively ruled the Old Country. Small and circular with a square hole in the middle, four characters in the kitsune native tongue have been stamped adjacent to either side of the square. While these coins are no longer in circulation, having being phased out by a new currency following the Celestial Restoration in the wake of the Godswar, those which survive are nevertheless kept as good-luck charms signifying fortune and wealth. Special Effect: Earn twice the amount of EC from combat. This bonus does not stack with equipment that confers similar benefits."

rows.translation: 大地链戒
大地链戒

rows.original: An enchanted ring of copper and electrum, made to ground the caster in the earth rather than the aether. While you won't rival the archmages while wearing this, you might just survive their spells if you insist you can.
rows.translation: 这是一枚由铜和电金制成的魔法戒指，它的作用是使佩戴者与大地紧密相连，而非悬浮于以太之中。虽然戴上这枚戒指后，你无法与那些大法师相媲美，但如果你坚持认为自己能够抵挡他们的法术，或许真的能够活下来。
rows.raw: "\n        An enchanted ring of copper and electrum, made to ground the caster in the earth rather than the aether. While you won't rival the archmages while wearing this, you might just survive their spells if you insist you can."

rows.translation: 幸运之戒
幸运之戒

rows.original: An enchanted ring said to grant great fortune to those who wear it. That's certainly not the case in any long-term sense, as it was taken from the quite crispy cadaver of one of Khor'minos's orcish enemies — who himself had doubtless taken it from another. Still, the rumor clings to this bit of gold like tar...
rows.translation: 有一枚被施了魔法的戒指，据说佩戴它的人会获得巨大的财富。但从长远来看，事实显然并非如此。因为这枚戒指其实是从科尔米诺斯的一个兽人敌人的尸体上取下来的——而那个兽人敌人自己，也很可能是从别人那里得到了这枚戒指。不过，这个谣言依然像焦油一样紧紧附着在这块黄金上……
rows.raw: "\n        An enchanted ring said to grant great fortune to those who wear it. That's certainly not the case in any long-term sense, as it was taken from the quite crispy cadaver of one of Khor'minos's orcish enemies — who himself had doubtless taken it from another. Still, the rumor clings to this bit of gold like tar..."

rows.translation: 太阳碎片戒
太阳碎片戒

rows.original: A band of etched gold, curved spokes sticking out from along its circumference to give a distinctly solar motif. Held by the Order of the Oriflamme until recently, the artifact is supposed to be forged from a sun-shard — whatever that is. Only the paladins know, and they're not telling. Its surface gleams reflectively, refusing to lose any of its shine regardless of dirt and dust. Special Effect: All your spells deal half your Presence in extra Fire damage.
rows.translation: 一条由蚀刻金箔制成的带状物，其边缘分布着弯曲的辐条，整体呈现出鲜明的太阳主题。这件神器直到最近还由“圣焰骑士团”掌管着，据传说它是用某种“太阳碎片”锻造而成的——不过具体是什么，只有那些圣骑士们知道，但他们拒绝透露这个秘密。它的表面具有很强的反光性能，无论积聚了多少污垢和灰尘，依然能保持光亮如新。 特效你使用的所有法术都会使你的“存在感”值减半，并因此造成额外的火属性伤害。
rows.raw: " A band of etched gold, curved spokes sticking out from along its circumference to give a distinctly solar motif. Held by the Order of the Oriflamme until recently, the artifact is supposed to be forged from a sun-shard — whatever that is. Only the paladins know, and they're not telling. Its surface gleams reflectively, refusing to lose any of its shine regardless of dirt and dust. Special Effect: All your spells deal half your Presence in extra Fire damage."

rows.translation: 命运之环
命运之环

rows.original: A midnight-black ring, so dark that no light reflects from its surface nor glint of the precious metal beneath its shadowy coloration. The only flaw in its smooth black surface, if you could call it so, is [flags.RING_SECRET|the faintly-glowing jade tearstone set upon it.|a single tear-shaped indentation on its outer band.] Special Effect: Halves all Corruption you would gain, and Corruption cannot go over 99.
rows.translation: 一枚深沉如午夜的黑色戒指，其表面如此晦暗，以至于没有任何光线能够从其表面反射出来，也看不到那种珍贵金属在暗色之下所散发出的光芒。如果说它的光滑黑色表面有什么瑕疵的话，那就是[flags.RING_SECRET|那颗微微发光的翡翠泪珠被镶嵌在上面。|其外环上有一个泪珠状的凹痕。] 特效会将你获得的所有腐败值减半，且腐败值不会超过99。
rows.raw: " A midnight-black ring, so dark that no light reflects from its surface nor glint of the precious metal beneath its shadowy coloration. The only flaw in its smooth black surface, if you could call it so, is [flags.RING_SECRET|the faintly-glowing jade tearstone set upon it.|a single tear-shaped indentation on its outer band.] Special Effect: Halves all Corruption you would gain, and Corruption cannot go over 99."

rows.translation: 幸运硬币
幸运硬币

rows.original: A silver coin, kept by its previous owner as a good-luck charm. Although heavily tarnished given the conditions it's endured over the centuries, its value is still undeniable; one face bears the likeness of Queen Atheldred, while the other bears the symbol of a large tree, its branches fanning out and roots sinking deep. The coin is dated from the start of Atheldred's reign, which tells you something about how the boreal elves reckoned time before the Godswar... Special Effect: Earn twice the amount of EC from combat. This bonus does not stack with equipment that confers similar benefits.
rows.translation: 这是一枚银币，它的前主人将其视为幸运符而珍藏起来。尽管几个世纪以来它经历了种种变迁，表面已经严重锈蚀，但其价值依然不容忽视：其中一面刻着阿瑟尔德雷德女王的形象，而另一面则印着一棵大树的图案，树枝向四周伸展，树根深深扎根于大地之中。这枚银币的铸造时间正是阿瑟尔德雷德开始执政的那个时候，这一事实足以让我们了解到，在“神战”之前，极北精灵们是如何计算时间的…… 特效在战斗中获得的经验值将是平时的两倍。此加成效果不会与那些能提供类似收益的装备效果叠加。
rows.raw: " A silver coin, kept by its previous owner as a good-luck charm. Although heavily tarnished given the conditions it's endured over the centuries, its value is still undeniable; one face bears the likeness of Queen Atheldred, while the other bears the symbol of a large tree, its branches fanning out and roots sinking deep. The coin is dated from the start of Atheldred's reign, which tells you something about how the boreal elves reckoned time before the Godswar... Special Effect: Earn twice the amount of EC from combat. This bonus does not stack with equipment that confers similar benefits."

rows.original: Your ring of bonding, exchanged with [bri.name] after your marriage. A signifier that no matter what, [brint.isBrienne|she|he] will always be close to you. Special Effect: You add half of [brint.names] Toughness to your Mental Defense. Currently granting +
rows.translation: 这是你婚后与[bri.name]交换的羁绊之戒，象征着无论发生什么，[brint.isBrienne|她|他]都会与你相伴。 特效：将[brint.names]韧性的一半加到你的精神防御上。当前提供+
rows.raw: " Your ring of bonding, exchanged with [bri.name] after your marriage. A signifier that no matter what, [brint.isBrienne|she|he] will always be close to you. Special Effect: You add half of [brint.names] Toughness to your Mental Defense. Currently granting +"

rows.translation: 温暖之戒
温暖之戒
白花戒指
白花戒指

rows.original:
A white-gold ring set with a diamond stud, and engraved with floral patterns. This is a treasure of the Kyabetsu family, the lords of a rural province on Hashima. Their lands have always been rough and vulnerable, but possessed of a rustic beauty and abundant fertility — much like the kitsune who settled it centuries ago. This ring was given to you as a promise of marriage from Hana Kyabetsu, the firstborn and reluctant heir of the island's lord.
        
        <b>Special Effect: When you score a Critical Hit or Critical Heal, all enemies gain
rows.translation:
一枚镶嵌着钻石、饰有花卉图案的白金戒指。这是Hashima岛上某个乡村地区的领主家族——Kyabetsu家族的传家之宝。他们的土地虽然贫瘠且易受自然环境的影响，但却拥有质朴的美景与丰富的肥沃土壤，就如同几个世纪前定居于此的狐妖一般。这枚戒指，是岛主的长女、也是这个家族中唯一的不情愿继承家业的人——哈娜 Kyabetsu，作为婚约的象征送给你的。
        
        <b>特效：当你造成暴击伤害或获得暴击治疗效果时，所有敌人都会获得相应收益。
rows.raw: "A white-gold ring set with a diamond stud, and engraved with floral patterns. This is a treasure of the Kyabetsu family, the lords of a rural province on Hashima. Their lands have always been rough and vulnerable, but possessed of a rustic beauty and abundant fertility — much like the kitsune who settled it centuries ago. This ring was given to you as a promise of marriage from Hana Kyabetsu, the firstborn and reluctant heir of the island's lord.\n        \n        <b>Special Effect: When you score a Critical Hit or Critical Heal, all enemies gain "

rows.original: stacks of Resonance and are Staggered for a turn.
rows.translation: 层共鸣，并踉跄一回合。
rows.raw: " stacks of Resonance and are Staggered for a turn."

rows.translation: 财富戒指
财富戒指

rows.original: A ring made of unpolished bronze, perfectly fitted to your finger. It holds no jewel; it bears no stud; there are no engravings on either the inside or outside. To the unassuming, it's barely worth its weight as scrap. But while it's on your finger, wealth has an easier time finding its way to you... Special Effect: Earn twice the amount of EC from combat. This bonus does not stack with equipment that confers similar benefits.
rows.translation: 一枚由未经抛光的青铜制成的戒指，完美地贴合在你的手指上。它没有任何宝石镶嵌，也没有任何装饰性的凸起；戒指的内外都没有任何雕刻。对于那些不挑剔的人来说，这种戒指甚至连当作废铁都几乎不值钱。然而，一旦它戴在了你的手指上，财富似乎就会更容易找到你…… 特效在战斗中获得的经验值是平时的两倍。此加成效果不会与那些能提供类似收益的装备效果叠加。
rows.raw: " A ring made of unpolished bronze, perfectly fitted to your finger. It holds no jewel; it bears no stud; there are no engravings on either the inside or outside. To the unassuming, it's barely worth its weight as scrap. But while it's on your finger, wealth has an easier time finding its way to you... Special Effect: Earn twice the amount of EC from combat. This bonus does not stack with equipment that confers similar benefits. "

rows.translation: 生育与繁衍之戒
生育与繁衍之戒

rows.original: An old copper ring with a deep green patina, well-worn by age but still carrying a heat inside it that's never quite dissipated even after centuries of neglect. A verdant, blooming flower sits atop it rather than a gemstone, a symbol that seems to have been deeply associated with the local cult that forged it. Special Effect: Increases pregnancy speed by 10% if you have a vagina; increases semen output by 10% if you have a penis.
rows.translation: 一枚古老的铜环，表面覆着一层深绿色的铜锈，经过岁月的侵蚀而显得十分陈旧，但它内部依然蕴含着某种热量，即便经历了几个世纪的忽视，这种热量也从未消散。环顶上并非镶嵌着宝石，而是一朵盛开的绿花，这个象征似乎与铸造这枚铜环的当地宗教团体有着密切的联系。 特效如果你有阴道，怀孕速度会提高10%；如果你有阴茎，精液量也会增加10%。
rows.raw: " An old copper ring with a deep green patina, well-worn by age but still carrying a heat inside it that's never quite dissipated even after centuries of neglect. A verdant, blooming flower sits atop it rather than a gemstone, a symbol that seems to have been deeply associated with the local cult that forged it. Special Effect: Increases pregnancy speed by 10% if you have a vagina; increases semen output by 10% if you have a penis. "

rows.translation: 苍白火焰之戒
苍白火焰之戒

rows.original: Based off a motif common in Tychrisian poetry, the concept of the Pale Flame is that of a desire, sometimes perhaps even a true love, that burns so brightly that it makes a frostscale salamander's auroran tail burst into a colorless pyre, all its heat drawn into the heart of its owner. So too does this ring yearn to draw its heatless glimmer into the target of its owner's desires.
rows.translation: 这一概念源自提克里西亚诗歌中常见的主题：所谓的“苍白火焰”，其实象征着一种渴望，甚至可能是真正的爱情。这种渴望如此强烈，以至于能让霜鳞蝾螈的极光之尾绽放出无色的火焰，将其所有的热量都引入持有者的内心。而这款戒指，也同样渴望将自己那微弱而无热的光芒，引向持有者所渴望的目标之上。
rows.raw: "Based off a motif common in Tychrisian poetry, the concept of the Pale Flame is that of a desire, sometimes perhaps even a true love, that burns so brightly that it makes a frostscale salamander's auroran tail burst into a colorless pyre, all its heat drawn into the heart of its owner. So too does this ring yearn to draw its heatless glimmer into the target of its owner's desires."

rows.translation: 铁戒
铁戒

rows.original: Iron is a rarity in the Frost Marches in the aftermath of the Godswar. There's a great paucity of ore, and few smiths retain the knowledge to work it. Copper and tin, the core components of bronze, are however commonplace in the region. Still, iron remains ingrained as a symbol of strength from the last years of the Belharan Empire. Those who live by the blade or bow pay a premium for trinkets made from it, even crude rings reshaped by the hammer such as this.
rows.translation: 在神战之后，铁在冰霜边境地区已经变得极为稀少。这种矿石的数量极为有限，而且很少有铁匠还掌握加工铁矿的知识。然而，铜和锡——青铜的主要成分——在这一地区却相当常见。尽管如此，由于贝尔哈兰帝国末期的影响，铁依然被视为力量的象征。那些以刀剑或弓箭为武器的人，总是愿意花更多的钱来购买用铁制成的小饰品，哪怕只是那些用锤子简单锻造出来的粗糙戒指。
rows.raw: "Iron is a rarity in the Frost Marches in the aftermath of the Godswar. There's a great paucity of ore, and few smiths retain the knowledge to work it. Copper and tin, the core components of bronze, are however commonplace in the region. Still, iron remains ingrained as a symbol of strength from the last years of the Belharan Empire. Those who live by the blade or bow pay a premium for trinkets made from it, even crude rings reshaped by the hammer such as this. "

rows.translation: 印玺戒指
印玺戒指

rows.original: Signets are used by nobles and wealthy merchants, pressed into wax seals as a mark of authenticity. In the late Belharan Empire, it became common practice to engrave them into rings rather than stamps or rods, and soon enough signet rings were held up as status symbols, marks of authority for all the world to see. Even now, in these dark days, rings such as these remain popular among the upper classes, a reminder of bygone glory.
rows.translation: 贵族和富商们会使用印章，将其压在蜡封上作为真实性的标志。在贝拉兰帝国的晚期，人们开始将印章刻在戒指上，而不是印章或棒状物上。很快，这种印章戒指就成为了地位的象征，成为了人人都能看到的权力标志。即使在如今这个暗影的时代，这样的戒指仍然在上层社会中很受欢迎，它们让人们回想起过去的辉煌。
rows.raw: "Signets are used by nobles and wealthy merchants, pressed into wax seals as a mark of authenticity. In the late Belharan Empire, it became common practice to engrave them into rings rather than stamps or rods, and soon enough signet rings were held up as status symbols, marks of authority for all the world to see. Even now, in these dark days, rings such as these remain popular among the upper classes, a reminder of bygone glory."

rows.translation: 极光戒指

rows.original: A ring crafted from white gold, but through secret techniques unique to the smiths of Tychris has been made to bear an aurora-like pattern, much like the tails of the city's majority inhabitants. It is said these rings grant a natural measure of magic resistance — for who would be more able to ward off foul spellcraft than the salamanders that call the City of Sorcery home?
rows.translation: 一枚用白金打制的戒指，提克里斯的工匠以独门秘技为它赋予了极光般的纹路，宛如城中多数居民那摇曳的尾羽。据说这些戒指能赋予佩戴者一定程度的天然魔法抗性——毕竟，还有谁比那些把魔法之城称作故乡的火蜥蜴人更擅长抵御邪恶法术呢？
rows.raw: "A ring crafted from white gold, but through secret techniques unique to the smiths of Tychris has been made to bear an aurora-like pattern, much like the tails of the city's majority inhabitants. It is said these rings grant a natural measure of magic resistance — for who would be more able to ward off foul spellcraft than the salamanders that call the City of Sorcery home?"

rows.translation: 火焰披风
火焰披风

rows.original: A heavy cape made of a fire-retardant material, meant to help protect the wearer against flame magic and monstrous creatures. No self-respecting dragonslayer leaves home without one.
rows.translation: 一件由防火材料制成的厚重披风，其作用是保护佩戴者免受火焰魔法和凶猛生物的伤害。任何自诩为屠龙者的勇士，在出发前都会穿上这件披风。
rows.raw: "A heavy cape made of a fire-retardant material, meant to help protect the wearer against flame magic and monstrous creatures. No self-respecting dragonslayer leaves home without one."

rows.translation: 女祭司披风
女祭司披风

rows.original: The true mark of a Mallachite priestess, the white cloak hangs around Cait's neck by a rose-red gemstone clasp. While much of Cait's attire is weather-worn and sewn with patches, her holy cloak is as pristine as the day she left Jassira.
rows.translation: 作为马拉克信徒女祭司的标志，那件白色斗篷通过一枚玫瑰红色的宝石扣挂在凯特的脖子上。虽然凯特的其他衣物都因长时间使用而破旧，需要修补，但她的这件神圣斗篷却依然像她离开贾西拉那天一样崭新完好。
rows.raw: "The true mark of a Mallachite priestess, the white cloak hangs around Cait's neck by a rose-red gemstone clasp. While much of Cait's attire is weather-worn and sewn with patches, her holy cloak is as pristine as the day she left Jassira."

rows.translation: 希鲁德的斗篷
希鲁德的斗篷

rows.original: A road-worn traveling cloak that bears a distinctive musk. It's a deep, blood-red color — the same as the royal guard of Khor'minos. It's pinned at the breast by a Lumian holy symbol, a relic of Selima's former life. She's asked you keep it with her blessing.
rows.translation: 这件旅行披风历经风霜，散发着独特的麝香气息。它的颜色是深沉的血红色——与科尔米诺斯皇家卫队的制服颜色相同。胸前用一枚卢米安族的圣物固定着这件披风，那是塞利玛前世留下的遗物。她恳求你将这件披风收好，作为她的祝福赠予你。
rows.raw: "A road-worn traveling cloak that bears a distinctive musk. It's a deep, blood-red color — the same as the royal guard of Khor'minos. It's pinned at the breast by a Lumian holy symbol, a relic of Selima's former life. She's asked you keep it with her blessing."

rows.translation: 冬日斗篷
冬日斗篷

rows.original: A long, voluminous cloak, stretching all the way to one's feet. Sewn together from thick, heavy wool and trimmed with fur, it's light gray on the outside and a patchwork of colors on the inside, ranging from white to brown to dark gray.
rows.translation: 一件长长的、厚实的斗篷，一直垂到脚边。它由厚实的羊毛制成，边缘还装饰着毛皮；外表呈浅灰色，而内侧则是各种颜色的拼接图案，颜色从白色到棕色，再到深灰色，应有尽有。
rows.raw: "A long, voluminous cloak, stretching all the way to one's feet. Sewn together from thick, heavy wool and trimmed with fur, it's light gray on the outside and a patchwork of colors on the inside, ranging from white to brown to dark gray."

rows.translation: 皮革肩甲
皮革肩甲

rows.original: Cheap and effective shoulder guards for those who prefer mobility and light armor over heavier plates. These shoulder pads are rather simple and made out of firm but flexible leather — capable of offering a certain degree of protection from slashing blows.
rows.translation: 对于那些更注重机动性与轻便护甲，而非厚重护板的人来说，这些价格低廉且效果显著的护肩是理想的选择。这些护肩设计简单，采用坚韧而富有弹性的皮革制成，能够有效抵御一些切割性的攻击。
rows.raw: "Cheap and effective shoulder guards for those who prefer mobility and light armor over heavier plates. These shoulder pads are rather simple and made out of firm but flexible leather — capable of offering a certain degree of protection from slashing blows."

rows.translation: 青铜肩甲
青铜肩甲

rows.original: A thin bronze plate and guard that protects the shoulders and part of the neck. Such armor is relatively simple, with just a few straps to secure them and a bit of cloth padding for added comfort.
rows.translation: 一块薄薄的青铜板以及用于保护肩膀和颈部部分的护甲。这种盔甲结构相对简单，只需要几条带子将其固定，再添加一些布质衬垫来提升佩戴舒适度即可。
rows.raw: "A thin bronze plate and guard that protects the shoulders and part of the neck. Such armor is relatively simple, with just a few straps to secure them and a bit of cloth padding for added comfort."

rows.translation: 卫兵披风
卫兵披风

rows.original: This cape of pale icy sky-blue belongs to guards of the Winter City. It's a layer of weather-treated linen stitched atop a layer of wool, and provides more protection from the elements than one would normally expect.
rows.translation: 这种淡冰蓝色斗篷属于冬城的守卫们。它是由经过特殊处理的亚麻布料与羊毛层共同缝制而成的，因此其防风防雨性能远超人们的预期。
rows.raw: "This cape of pale icy sky-blue belongs to guards of the Winter City. It's a layer of weather-treated linen stitched atop a layer of wool, and provides more protection from the elements than one would normally expect."

rows.translation: 海织物萨满斗篷
海织物萨满斗篷

rows.original: This cape is full of pockets and pouches, with waterproof ties and pearl buttons made to preserve slightly drier components. The lining is resistant to water, and the natural seaweed-like nature of its construction seems to have imbued it with a decent resistance to tearing and blight. Special Effect: Grants immunity to Sundered.
rows.translation: 这件斗篷布满了各种口袋和储物空间，还配备了防水拉绳和珍珠纽扣，这些设计都是为了保护那些较为容易受潮的部件。它的内衬具有防水功能，而且这种采用类似海藻材料的制作工艺，似乎也让这件斗篷具备了较强的抗撕裂性和耐磨损性。 特效：赋予对“Sundered”效果的免疫能力。
rows.raw: " This cape is full of pockets and pouches, with waterproof ties and pearl buttons made to preserve slightly drier components. The lining is resistant to water, and the natural seaweed-like nature of its construction seems to have imbued it with a decent resistance to tearing and blight. Special Effect: Grants immunity to Sundered."

rows.translation: 深渊斗篷
深渊斗篷

rows.original: This Minoan military cloak[silly|, or paludamentum,] will help any wearer look the part of a high-ranking officer or noble with its beautiful[silly| Tyrian] purple hue — a dye only available to the very wealthy or to those who hunt a particular kind of sea snail. This one is unquestionably a personal gift, and the brooch that fastens it together is just as personal, designed specially for you in the shape of a [pc.isSoulbound|[pc.swornGod keros lumia nareva|cherry blossom|sun|ouroboros]|hawk].[silly| You do, however, have to wonder why it's called a 'deeps' cloak when it's so clearly meant to resist DPS.] Special Effect: When the wearer is healed, they receive a buff to Armor, Ward, and Focus of +10 each for 2 turns.
rows.translation: 这件米诺斯军用斗篷[silly|，又称paludamentum，]有着漂亮的[silly|泰尔]紫色，足以让任何穿戴者看起来像高级军官或贵族——这种染料只有巨富或专门捕猎某种海螺的人才能弄到。它无疑是一份专为你准备的礼物，连固定斗篷的胸针也为你量身设计，形状是[pc.isSoulbound|[pc.swornGod keros lumia nareva|樱花|太阳|衔尾蛇]|鹰]。[silly|不过，你不禁纳闷，既然它明明用来抵挡DPS伤害，为什么还叫“deeps”（与DPS谐音）斗篷呢？] 特效：穿戴者受到治疗时，获得护甲、魔防和专注各+10的增益，持续2回合。
rows.raw: " This Minoan military cloak[silly|, or paludamentum,] will help any wearer look the part of a high-ranking officer or noble with its beautiful[silly| Tyrian] purple hue — a dye only available to the very wealthy or to those who hunt a particular kind of sea snail. This one is unquestionably a personal gift, and the brooch that fastens it together is just as personal, designed specially for you in the shape of a [pc.isSoulbound|[pc.swornGod keros lumia nareva|cherry blossom|sun|ouroboros]|hawk].[silly| You do, however, have to wonder why it's called a 'deeps' cloak when it's so clearly meant to resist DPS.] Special Effect: When the wearer is healed, they receive a buff to Armor, Ward, and Focus of +10 each for 2 turns."

rows.translation: 钴蓝斗篷
钴蓝斗篷

rows.original: A fine cloak woven with azure-dyed thread, produced locally in Tychris. These cloaks were once worn by a secretive order of rogue magicians based in Tychris, though their art has long been lost to time. Even now some magicians continue to wear them without truly knowing why.
rows.translation: 这种用天蓝色丝线编织而成的精美斗篷，是泰克里斯本地生产的。这些斗篷曾经被一个隐匿在泰克里斯的神秘法师组织所使用，不过他们的制作技艺早已随着时间的流逝而失传了。即便到了现在，仍然有一些法师会穿着这些斗篷，却并不真正明白其中的原因。
rows.raw: "A fine cloak woven with azure-dyed thread, produced locally in Tychris. These cloaks were once worn by a secretive order of rogue magicians based in Tychris, though their art has long been lost to time. Even now some magicians continue to wear them without truly knowing why."

rows.original:
This black silken cape clips high up on your left shoulder, with a golden string looping around beneath your right arm to keep it nicely situated. Golden trim traces the edges of the entire cape, giving it just that little bit of extra definition. You look like a regular slice of high society with this thing on.

The expensive material is surprisingly robust, and although it won't do you any good against crushing blows, it stands up to penetration [silly|better than Cait's butthole|better than most].
rows.translation:
这件黑色丝绸披风高高扣在你的左肩，一根金色细绳从右臂下方绕过，将它稳稳固定。披风四周都缀着金边，为整体轮廓更添几分鲜明。穿上它，你俨然成了上流社会中的一员。

这昂贵的面料出乎意料地坚韧；尽管面对钝击时帮不上什么忙，抵御穿刺的本事却[silly|比凯特的屁眼还强|胜过大多数材料]。
rows.raw: "This black silken cape clips high up on your left shoulder, with a golden string looping around beneath your right arm to keep it nicely situated. Golden trim traces the edges of the entire cape, giving it just that little bit of extra definition. You look like a regular slice of high society with this thing on.\n\nThe expensive material is surprisingly robust, and although it won't do you any good against crushing blows, it stands up to penetration [silly|better than Cait's butthole|better than most]."

rows.translation: 蕾丝胸罩
蕾丝胸罩

rows.original: A comfortable looking bra made of fine lace. From a quick glance, it seems to provide exactly the support you're looking for, all while staying sexy.
rows.translation: 这款胸罩采用精致的蕾丝材质制成，外观十分舒适。乍一看，它似乎能提供你所需要的支撑力，同时还能保持性感的外观。
rows.raw: "A comfortable looking bra made of fine lace. From a quick glance, it seems to provide exactly the support you're looking for, all while staying sexy."

rows.translation: 丝绸衬衫
丝绸衬衫

rows.original: A comfortable shirt, designed to help protect against chafing, as well as helping look good when you're out and about.
rows.translation: 这款舒适衬衫专为防止擦伤而设计，同时也能让你在外出时看起来更加得体。
rows.raw: "A comfortable shirt, designed to help protect against chafing, as well as helping look good when you're out and about."

rows.translation: 吊带背心
吊带背心

rows.original: A black camisole designed to reveal just enough to one's partner to make them want to see more. It perfectly accentuates one's cleavage, teasing at what's underneath.
rows.translation: 一件黑色背心，设计得恰到好处，能让伴侣看到足以让他们产生继续探索欲望的细节。它完美地突出了胸部的曲线，让人忍不住想要一探究竟。
rows.raw: "A black camisole designed to reveal just enough to one's partner to make them want to see more. It perfectly accentuates one's cleavage, teasing at what's underneath."

rows.translation: 丝绸束腰
丝绸束腰

rows.original: A silken corset designed to make a woman appear bustier, whether worn underneath an outfit or as outerwear ready to be torn off by an aggressive lover.
rows.translation: 这种丝质紧身胸衣的设计目的就是让女性看起来胸部更加丰满，无论是在衣物内部穿着，还是作为外衣使用——当一个热情的恋人想要亲热时，这种胸衣也很容易被撕开。
rows.raw: "A silken corset designed to make a woman appear bustier, whether worn underneath an outfit or as outerwear ready to be torn off by an aggressive lover."

rows.translation: 丝绸胸衣
丝绸胸衣

rows.original: A silken bustier that highlights and accentuates the curves of your body. Sensual nightwear that's very easy to slip into... and out of.
rows.translation: 一款丝质胸衣，能够突显你身体的曲线，让你的身形更加迷人。这款性感的内衣非常方便穿戴……脱下也毫不费力。
rows.raw: "A silken bustier that highlights and accentuates the curves of your body. Sensual nightwear that's very easy to slip into... and out of."

rows.translation: 亚麻束腰衣
亚麻束腰衣

rows.original: A standard linen tunic, designed either to go under armor or to be worn around as a form of casual wear.
rows.translation: 一种标准的亚麻长袍，既可以穿在铠甲里面，也可以作为日常休闲服装穿着。
rows.raw: "A standard linen tunic, designed either to go under armor or to be worn around as a form of casual wear."

rows.translation: 羊毛衫
羊毛衫

rows.original: A wonderfully comfortable sweater, lovingly hand-knitted by Clementine and your children. Crafted from the wool of your herd, it feels akin to being always hugged by a cloud. The Sweater is a harmonious mix of white, black and brown wool, each shade and tint representing the different members of your wooly family. With their love evident in every stitch, it's a gentle reminder of the family and home you have with your adorable sheep girl.
rows.translation: 这件毛衣柔软舒适极了，是克莱门汀和你的孩子们用心手织而成的。它采用你们家羊群产的羊毛制成，穿上它后，仿佛总有一片云朵在轻轻拥抱你。毛衣采用了白色、黑色和棕色的羊毛混合编织而成，每种颜色都象征着你们这个“羊毛家族”中的不同成员。每一针每一线都蕴含着他们满满的爱意，这份关爱仿佛在默默提醒你：你拥有一个充满温暖的家庭，还有那个可爱的羊姑娘陪伴在你身边。
rows.raw: "A wonderfully comfortable sweater, lovingly hand-knitted by Clementine and your children. Crafted from the wool of your herd, it feels akin to being always hugged by a cloud. The Sweater is a harmonious mix of white, black and brown wool, each shade and tint representing the different members of your wooly family. With their love evident in every stitch, it's a gentle reminder of the family and home you have with your adorable sheep girl."

rows.translation: 黑色海织物胸罩
黑色海织物胸罩

rows.original: This stretchy black bra appears to be made for going under clothing, or in place of it for a little swimming. It's water-resistant and shines brilliantly in the light.
rows.translation: 这款有弹性的黑色胸罩似乎是专为穿在衣物里面使用的，或者也可以在游泳时直接穿着。它具有防水功能，在光线下会闪耀出迷人的光芒。
rows.raw: "\n        This stretchy black bra appears to be made for going under clothing, or in place of it for a little swimming. It's water-resistant and shines brilliantly in the light."

rows.translation: 粉色海织物胸罩
粉色海织物胸罩

rows.original: This stretchy pink bra appears to be made for going under clothing, or in place of it for a little swimming. It's water-resistant and shines brilliantly in the light, with what appears to be a miniature pink bow set in the center for your cleavage.
rows.translation: 这款有弹性的粉色胸罩似乎是专为穿在衣物里面使用的，或者也可以在游泳时直接穿着。它具有防水功能，在光线下会闪耀着迷人的光芒，中间还装饰着一个小小的粉色蝴蝶结，正好位于乳沟部位。
rows.raw: "\n        This stretchy pink bra appears to be made for going under clothing, or in place of it for a little swimming. It's water-resistant and shines brilliantly in the light, with what appears to be a miniature pink bow set in the center for your cleavage."

rows.translation: 乳胶胸罩
乳胶胸罩

rows.original: A snug, tight-fitting and comfortable brassiere that has a bit of stretch to it thanks to the properties of slimes. Guaranteed to fit no matter the size.
rows.translation: 这款胸罩设计得既贴身又舒适，由于采用了某种特殊材料，因此还具备一定的弹性。无论你的身材大小如何，这款胸罩都一定能适合你。
rows.raw: "\n        A snug, tight-fitting and comfortable brassiere that has a bit of stretch to it thanks to the properties of slimes. Guaranteed to fit no matter the size."

rows.translation: 奶牛纹胸罩
奶牛纹胸罩

rows.original: A very comfortable bra styled after a black and white spotted cow. As you'd expect from the land of cowgirls, there's a lot of support.
rows.translation: 这款舒适的文胸采用黑白斑点奶牛式样。不愧是来自奶牛姑娘之乡的产品，它的承托力十分充足。
rows.raw: "A very comfortable bra styled after a black and white spotted cow. As you'd expect from the land of cowgirls, there's a lot of support."

rows.translation: 裹胸布

rows.original: A white, cotton-made piece of cloth that can be worn around your chest for padding or to keep your breasts covered. Favored by kitsune, these wraps are renowned for their practicality and comfort.
rows.translation: 一条白色棉布，可以缠在胸前作为衬垫，也能用来遮住乳房。这种裹布深受狐族喜爱，以实用舒适而闻名。
rows.raw: "A white, cotton-made piece of cloth that can be worn around your chest for padding or to keep your breasts covered. Favored by kitsune, these wraps are renowned for their practicality and comfort."
