rows.translation: 药水腰带
药水腰带

rows.original: Cait's belt is more fashion accessory than utility, but she's modified it to support several small potions and vials along her hips, giving her quick access to her field medicine and alchemical supplies.
rows.translation: 凯特的腰带更像是一件时尚配饰，而非实用工具，但她对它进行了改造，可以在腰间放置几小瓶药剂和药水，这样她就能随时取用野战医疗用品和炼金材料了。
rows.raw: "Cait's belt is more fashion accessory than utility, but she's modified it to support several small potions and vials along her hips, giving her quick access to her field medicine and alchemical supplies."

rows.translation: 腰侧箭袋
腰侧箭袋

rows.original: A brown leather quiver with a belt that loops around the waist, letting it sit comfortably despite its contents. In addition, its location provides easy access to arrows in the heat of battle, a boon any archer can appreciate.
rows.translation: 一个棕色皮革制成的箭袋，配有一条可以绕在腰间的皮带，因此即使装满了箭，也能舒适地佩戴在身上。此外，在激烈的战斗中，这种设计使得箭袋的位置非常便于取箭，对于任何弓箭手来说，这都是一个极其实用的优点。
rows.raw: "A brown leather quiver with a belt that loops around the waist, letting it sit comfortably despite its contents. In addition, its location provides easy access to arrows in the heat of battle, a boon any archer can appreciate."

rows.translation: 勇者腰带
勇者腰带

rows.original: A large leather girdle embossed with brass studs and a large gold-hued clasp on the front, bearing the facade of a screaming hawk — the emblem of the barony. A faint enchantment lingers over this girdle, emboldening its master with the fierce power needed to defend Hawkethorne from all that would threaten the sleepy little thorpe.
rows.translation: 一条厚实的皮革腰带，表面镶嵌着黄铜制成的饰钉，正面还有一个金色的大扣环，上面雕刻着一只正在尖叫的鹰的图案——这正是该男爵家族的象征。这条腰带上似乎萦绕着一股微弱的魔力，它赋予佩戴者强大的力量，使佩戴者能够保护鹰棘镇这个宁静的小村庄，抵御一切可能带来的威胁。
rows.raw: "A large leather girdle embossed with brass studs and a large gold-hued clasp on the front, bearing the facade of a screaming hawk — the emblem of the barony. A faint enchantment lingers over this girdle, emboldening its master with the fierce power needed to defend Hawkethorne from all that would threaten the sleepy little thorpe."

rows.translation: 柳木腰带
柳木腰带

rows.original: This well-worn belt has seen better days, though it still gets its job done. With the exception of the buckle, the belt itself is made entirely of fibers from local sallow trees. On the buckle, one can make out the faintest impression of what was once an engraving of a tree of some kind, likely a willow tree.
rows.translation: 这条使用多年的皮带虽然已经不再像从前那样崭新，但它仍然能够完成自己的使命。除了扣环之外，这条皮带的所有部分都是由当地桑树纤维制成的。在扣环上，还能隐约看到曾经刻有某种树木图案的痕迹，很可能是柳树。
rows.raw: "This well-worn belt has seen better days, though it still gets its job done. With the exception of the buckle, the belt itself is made entirely of fibers from local sallow trees. On the buckle, one can make out the faintest impression of what was once an engraving of a tree of some kind, likely a willow tree."

rows.translation: 带袋腰带
带袋腰带

rows.original: This simple leather belt has a nice large pouch on the side, perfect for quickly grabbing an item during combat.
rows.translation: 这条简单的皮腰带侧面有一个很大的口袋，在战斗中可以方便地快速取用物品。
rows.raw: "This simple leather belt has a nice large pouch on the side, perfect for quickly grabbing an item during combat."

rows.translation: 皮革腰甲
皮革腰甲

rows.original: A series of thick, overlapping leather pieces and strips which are joined together with bronze rings and rivets. It's a basic piece of leather armor that's meant to cover and protect the waist and loins of its user. It's not fancy, but it's reliable, durable, and flexible.
rows.translation: 由多层厚实的皮革片和条带拼接而成，这些材料通过青铜环和铆钉固定在一起。这种皮革护甲结构简单，主要用于保护使用者的腰部和臀部。虽然外观并不华丽，但它非常可靠、耐用且具有较好的灵活性。
rows.raw: "A series of thick, overlapping leather pieces and strips which are joined together with bronze rings and rivets. It's a basic piece of leather armor that's meant to cover and protect the waist and loins of its user. It's not fancy, but it's reliable, durable, and flexible."

rows.translation: 常青女士的丰收袋
常青女士的丰收袋

rows.original: Evergreen's bountiful bag, which you retrieved from the foxes. Whatever extradimensional properties it has don't work for you, apparently, but it exudes a faint warmth. Special Effect: Healing you receive is increased by 20%.
rows.translation: 你从那些狐狸那里获得的常青女士的丰饶袋子。无论它拥有什么超越维度的特性，显然这些特性对你并没有作用，但它散发出一种微弱的温暖。 特效你获得的治愈效果会增加20%。
rows.raw: " Evergreen's bountiful bag, which you retrieved from the foxes. Whatever extradimensional properties it has don't work for you, apparently, but it exudes a faint warmth. Special Effect: Healing you receive is increased by 20%."

rows.translation: 蓬松腰带
蓬松腰带

rows.original: A fluffy furred belt with a base of leather and fur on the outside. Feels really good to pet and stroke, and it looks like it's all-natural, too... wonder what kind of animal this came from. Does it matter, especially when just being near it makes you feel all warm and good inside?
rows.translation: 这条毛茸茸的皮带，外层由皮革和毛发制成。抚摸它的时候感觉非常舒适，看起来也完全是天然材料制成的……不知道它是哪种动物身上的毛呢。不过，这些其实都不重要吧，只要站在它旁边，就能让人感到温暖和愉悦，这才是最重要的。
rows.raw: "A fluffy furred belt with a base of leather and fur on the outside. Feels really good to pet and stroke, and it looks like it's all-natural, too... wonder what kind of animal this came from. Does it matter, especially when just being near it makes you feel all warm and good inside?\n        "

rows.translation: 千人针腰带
千人针腰带

rows.original: A length of white silk, long enough to be wrapped about your waist and embroidered with a thousand red stitches. The very fabric itself is wrapped with an immense number of protective charms, fueled by the sheer strength of your fox-wife and daughter's love alike. Special Effect: Once per rest, when you take damage that would fell you, the damage is negated and you gain 100 shield HP for one round.
rows.translation: 一段白色丝绸，长度足以环绕你的腰身，上面还绣着上千道红色针脚。这条丝绸本身就被施加了大量的保护咒语，而这些咒语的力量，源自你那位狐狸妻子以及你女儿无与伦比的爱意。 特效每轮休息时，每当你受到足以使你失去生命的伤害时，这些伤害将会被抵消，同时你将在一个回合内获得100点的盾牌生命值。
rows.raw: "A length of white silk, long enough to be wrapped about your waist and embroidered with a thousand red stitches. The very fabric itself is wrapped with an immense number of protective charms, fueled by the sheer strength of your fox-wife and daughter's love alike. Special Effect: Once per rest, when you take damage that would fell you, the damage is negated and you gain 100 shield HP for one round. "

rows.translation: 沉臀腰带
沉臀腰带

rows.original: A leather belt with electrum runes scrawled along its length. The belt, while heavy, does its job well; you don't know that you can think of another that's held your trousers up quite as well. Special Effect: This enchanted belt takes the nutrients from a proper anal filling and uses them to increase the size of the wearer's rear.
rows.translation: 一条上面刻着琥珀金符文的皮腰带。虽然这条腰带很重，但它确实非常实用——你甚至想不出还有哪种腰带能像它一样将你的裤子固定得如此牢固。 特效这条被施了魔法的腰带会从恰当的肛门填充物中吸收养分，然后利用这些养分来增大佩戴者的臀部尺寸。
rows.raw: "A leather belt with electrum runes scrawled along its length. The belt, while heavy, does its job well; you don't know that you can think of another that's held your trousers up quite as well. \n\n Special Effect: This enchanted belt takes the nutrients from a proper anal filling and uses them to increase the size of the wearer's rear."

rows.translation: 魔典挂套
魔典挂套

rows.original: This leather belt has a holster for a spellbook strapped to it. Currently, it contains Barriers for Beginners, and Other Supportive Spells, gifted to Cait by Viviane.
rows.translation: 这条皮腰带上配有用于固定法术书的插槽，目前里面装着初学者的屏障术与其他辅助法术。这是薇薇安送给凯特的礼物。
rows.raw: "This leather belt has a holster for a spellbook strapped to it. Currently, it contains Barriers for Beginners, and Other Supportive Spells, gifted to Cait by Viviane."

rows.translation: 试剂袋
试剂袋

rows.original: A simple handysack crammed full of useful material components for spellcasting. While most spells don't need more than willpower and a magical focus to use, sacrificing metaphorically apt material to fuel them is a time-honored tradition among mages from all over the world.
rows.translation: 一个简单的手袋，里面装满了用于施法的各种有用材料组件。虽然大多数法术只需要意志力和魔法焦点就能施展，但用这些象征性的材料来为它们提供能量，这一传统早已在世界各地的法师们中流传开来。
rows.raw: "A simple handysack crammed full of useful material components for spellcasting. While most spells don't need more than willpower and a magical focus to use, sacrificing metaphorically apt material to fuel them is a time-honored tradition among mages from all over the world.\n        "

rows.translation: 霜缚魔典
霜缚魔典

rows.original: This frost-crusted spellbook was carried to the Marches by a young Mallachite mendicant in the aftermath of the Godswar. She came to the cold north with a heart full of desert fire, intending to spread hope and joy through a land devastated by horrific war. The cold, dark forest proved an unrelenting adversary as she tended to the scattered beastfolk tribes still eeking out an existence there, until the day she found a bastion of welcoming warmth hidden in the forest that drew her in and never let her go.
rows.translation: 这本被霜冻覆盖的魔法书，是在神战之后，由一位年轻的马拉克信徒苦行僧带到了边境地区。她怀着满腔的热忱来到这片寒冷的北方，决心为这片被战争摧毁的土地带来希望与欢乐。然而，在那片寒冷而暗影的森林中，她面临着种种艰难险阻，她要照顾那些仍在那里艰难生存的野兽部落成员。直到有一天，她在森林中发现了那个充满温暖与接纳的地方，那里吸引了她，也让她永远留在了那里。
rows.raw: "This frost-crusted spellbook was carried to the Marches by a young Mallachite mendicant in the aftermath of the Godswar. She came to the cold north with a heart full of desert fire, intending to spread hope and joy through a land devastated by horrific war. The cold, dark forest proved an unrelenting adversary as she tended to the scattered beastfolk tribes still eeking out an existence there, until the day she found a bastion of welcoming warmth hidden in the forest that drew her in and never let her go.\n        "

rows.translation: 霜缚魔典
霜缚魔典

rows.translation: 焰术士短裙
焰术士短裙

rows.original: A long, robe-like garment with a split down the side, ostensibly to make it easier to move. The end result is sensuous and revealing, whether or not you choose to pair it with the long stockings Kari made for you as part of the attire. These garments were part of the common attire for priests of the Terrestrial Fire, an animist cult that once existed in the Frostwood, protected from the cold by the eternal flame they worshiped.
rows.translation: 这件长袍式的衣物侧面有开口设计，显然这样设计是为了方便行动。无论你是否选择搭配卡莉为你准备的長筒袜，这件衣物都会呈现出性感而暴露的效果。这类服饰曾是“大地之火”教派祭司们的常见装束。这个信仰自然主义的教派曾经存在于霜木之地，他们所崇拜的永恒之火为他们抵御严寒。
rows.raw: "A long, robe-like garment with a split down the side, ostensibly to make it easier to move. The end result is sensuous and revealing, whether or not you choose to pair it with the long stockings Kari made for you as part of the attire. These garments were part of the common attire for priests of the Terrestrial Fire, an animist cult that once existed in the Frostwood, protected from the cold by the eternal flame they worshiped."

rows.translation: 丰饶腰带
丰饶腰带

rows.original: A beautiful leather girdle adorned with gold thread in the shape of galloping mares. The design of the garment is clearly meant to support large stomachs, perhaps in service of ensuring comfortable pregnancies. Special Effect: While worn, you gain a heat and/or rut cycle if you didn't have one already (or an additional +10 Feracity if you did), and your pregnancies do not Overburden you.
rows.translation: 一条精美的皮革腰带，上面用金线绣出了奔腾的马匹图案。这种服饰的设计显然是为了支撑较大的腹部，或许是为了让孕妇在怀孕期间更加舒适。 特效在佩戴该物品的情况下，如果你原本没有热循环或发情周期，那么你会获得这些生理机制；如果你已经具备这些机制，那么你的耐力值还会额外增加10点。此外，怀孕也不会给你带来任何负担。
rows.raw: "A beautiful leather girdle adorned with gold thread in the shape of galloping mares. The design of the garment is clearly meant to support large stomachs, perhaps in service of ensuring comfortable pregnancies.\n \n Special Effect: While worn, you gain a heat and/or rut cycle if you didn't have one already (or an additional +10 Feracity if you did), and your pregnancies do not Overburden you."

rows.original: This silk girdle is hitched up on the abdomen, performing the double-duty of keeping your insides on the inside, and giving additional figure to baggy clothing. Patches of tough leather have been hidden inside the fabric to improve the girdle's resistance to a stabbing.
rows.translation: 这条丝绸束腰高高系在腹部，既能把你的内脏好好留在肚子里，也能让宽松衣物更显身材。布料内还藏着数块坚韧的皮革，以增强束腰抵御刺击的能力。
rows.raw: "This silk girdle is hitched up on the abdomen, performing the double-duty of keeping your insides on the inside, and giving additional figure to baggy clothing. Patches of tough leather have been hidden inside the fabric to improve the girdle's resistance to a stabbing."

rows.raw: "Invalid attempt to destructure non-iterable instance.\nIn order to be iterable, non-array objects must have a [Symbol.iterator]() method."

rows.translation: 属性倾向：
欢愉女祭司服
欢愉女祭司服

rows.original: Cait's passion priestess attire, consisting of a skirt, boots, and cleavage-bearing blouse. While sensual, these articles are primarily designed to help the budding mage channel her magics.
rows.translation: 凯特所穿的激情女祭司装束，包括一条裙子、一双靴子，以及一件露出乳沟的上衣。这些服饰虽然充满性感魅力，但它们的主要作用其实是帮助这位初出茅庐的法师更好地引导她的魔法力量。
rows.raw: "Cait's passion priestess attire, consisting of a skirt, boots, and cleavage-bearing blouse. While sensual, these articles are primarily designed to help the budding mage channel her magics."

rows.translation: 日舞者丝衣
舞者丝绸

rows.original: Beautiful silks and veils, jewelry and sensual perfumes, straight from the heart of Mallach's faith in sun-kissed Jassira. This alluring outfit leaves precious little to the imagination, letting Cait strut her stuff like the desert harlot she was raised to be.
rows.translation: 精美的丝绸与面纱、珠宝以及诱人的香水——这一切都源自马拉赫对阳光照耀下的贾西拉的深深信仰。这套迷人的装扮几乎完全消除了人们的想象空间，让凯特能够像她从小被培养成的那种沙漠中的艳妇一样，自信地展现自己的魅力。
rows.raw: "Beautiful silks and veils, jewelry and sensual perfumes, straight from the heart of Mallach's faith in sun-kissed Jassira. This alluring outfit leaves precious little to the imagination, letting Cait strut her stuff like the desert harlot she was raised to be."

rows.translation: 手杖
凯特的法杖
巫师装备
巫师装备

rows.original: Cait's witch gear. Given to her by Viviane, this outfit includes a new staff, corset, skirt, hat, and various other accessories. Its enchanted nature combined with the spellbook given with the outfit help Cait cast a range of defensive and healing spells.
rows.translation: 凯特的女巫装备。这是薇薇安送给她的，这套装备包括一根新的法杖、束腰、裙子、帽子以及各种其他配饰。这些装备具有魔法效果，再加上随装备赠送的法术书，帮助凯特施展各种防御性和治疗性法术。
rows.raw: "Cait's witch gear. Given to her by Viviane, this outfit includes a new staff, corset, skirt, hat, and various other accessories. Its enchanted nature combined with the spellbook given with the outfit help Cait cast a range of defensive and healing spells."

rows.translation: 妖刃皮甲
妖刃皮甲

rows.original: A set of firm leather armor, including an underbust corset, boots, gloves, and a jaunty hat — all dyed red. Cait says this armor reminds her of her sister, Calla, and insisted on keeping it after she saved an enslaved gnoll from a centaur pack's deprivations. When she wears this armor, Cait sets aside her healer's staff and instead weaves deadly offensive magic through an enchanted spellblade.
rows.translation: 一套坚固的皮革盔甲，包括束腰胸衣、靴子、手套，还有一顶俏皮的帽子——所有这些部件都被染成了红色。凯特说，这套盔甲让她想起了她的姐姐卡拉，因此在从半人马群体的压迫中救出一只被奴役的豺狼人后，她坚决要求保留这套盔甲。每当她穿上这套盔甲时，凯特就会放下她的治疗法杖，转而用附魔的剑刃释放致命的攻击性魔法。
rows.raw: "A set of firm leather armor, including an underbust corset, boots, gloves, and a jaunty hat — all dyed red. Cait says this armor reminds her of her sister, Calla, and insisted on keeping it after she saved an enslaved gnoll from a centaur pack's deprivations. When she wears this armor, Cait sets aside her healer's staff and instead weaves deadly offensive magic through an enchanted spellblade."

rows.translation: 贞女的长袍
贞洁之衣

rows.original: Clad in blessed bronze and bearing a shielding tome once wielded by a Mallachite paladin, Cait has the power and confidence to step up to the vanguard and lead her comrades on holy crusade. With this set, she's able to draw the ire of her enemies to herself, layer herself in protective magics, and can strike down those who would do her harm with Mallach's blinding light.
rows.translation: 凯特身披神圣的青铜铠甲，手持一位马拉克信徒圣骑士曾经使用过的护身法典。她拥有这样的力量与信心，足以挺身而出，带领战友们共同投身于神圣的征战中。这套装备使她能够吸引敌人的仇恨，为自己施加保护性魔法，同时也能用玛拉基特那耀眼的光芒消灭一切企图伤害她的人。
rows.raw: "Clad in blessed bronze and bearing a shielding tome once wielded by a Mallachite paladin, Cait has the power and confidence to step up to the vanguard and lead her comrades on holy crusade. With this set, she's able to draw the ire of her enemies to herself, layer herself in protective magics, and can strike down those who would do her harm with Mallach's blinding light."

rows.translation: 霜心套装
霜心套装

rows.original: Cait has resurrected the near-heretical research of the mothfolk Mallachite Aenisa Meriel, hybridizing it with her own self-taught passion magic to create a balance between light and frost. With staff and tome in hand, Cait uses razor-sharp ice to tear down her foes and shield her allies from harm.
rows.translation: 凯特重新诠释了那些几乎被视为异端的研究——那些关于蛾人马拉克信徒艾尼萨·梅里尔的研究，并将自己的自学魔法知识与之结合，从而在光明与寒霜之间找到了平衡。手持法杖与典籍，凯特用锋利如刀的冰刃消灭敌人，同时保护盟友免受伤害。
rows.raw: "Cait has resurrected the near-heretical research of the mothfolk Mallachite Aenisa Meriel, hybridizing it with her own self-taught passion magic to create a balance between light and frost. With staff and tome in hand, Cait uses razor-sharp ice to tear down her foes and shield her allies from harm."

rows.translation: 旅人皮甲
旅者皮甲

rows.original: Brint's road-worn leathers. The most eye-catching part of his bare-chested ensemble is a thick loincloth that carries a particularly masculine aroma built up over the minotaur's long journey. While this kit may not provide the best protection, it's easy to move in — perfect for a two-fisted whirlwind of a berzerker.
rows.translation: 布林特那双磨破的皮靴……他这套赤裸上身的装束中最引人注目的，是一条厚厚的缠腰布——在弥诺陶洛斯漫长的旅程中，这条缠腰布散发着一种格外阳刚的气息。虽然这套装备可能并不能提供最好的保护，但它确实非常便于移动，对于那些喜欢用双拳发起猛烈攻击的狂战士来说，简直是完美的选择。
rows.raw: "Brint's road-worn leathers. The most eye-catching part of his bare-chested ensemble is a thick loincloth that carries a particularly masculine aroma built up over the minotaur's long journey. While this kit may not provide the best protection, it's easy to move in — perfect for a two-fisted whirlwind of a berzerker."

rows.original: Brienne's road-worn leathers. The most eye-catching part of her decorative ensemble is a thick loincloth tied up and worn as a dress. While this kit may not provide the best protection, it's easy to move in — perfect for a two-fisted whirlwind of a berzerker.
rows.translation: 布蕾妮那件历经风霜的皮制衣物。她这套装饰性服装中最引人注目的部分，是一条被系紧并当作裙子穿着的厚实裹腰布。虽然这套装备可能无法提供最好的保护，但它确实非常便于活动——对一位挥舞双拳、攻势如旋风的狂战士来说，简直是完美的选择。
rows.raw: "Brienne's road-worn leathers. The most eye-catching part of her decorative ensemble is a thick loincloth tied up and worn as a dress. While this kit may not provide the best protection, it's easy to move in — perfect for a two-fisted whirlwind of a berzerker."

rows.translation: 竞技场护甲
竞技场护甲

rows.original: The leather-and-scale armor of a novice arena fighter, never destined to be a champion but still a favorite of the folks back home. Accompanied by a barbed throwing trident and a heavy tower shield. Brint wears this old kit with pride, though the armor fits him as though it were made for someone else entirely.
rows.translation: 这位新手竞技场战士所穿的皮甲鳞甲，虽然注定成不了冠军，但在家乡人们心中依然很受欢迎。他手持一根带刺的投掷三叉戟，身披一面重型的塔盾。布林特带着这套旧装备感到非常自豪，尽管这些盔甲穿在他身上，似乎是完全为别人量身定做的。
rows.raw: "The leather-and-scale armor of a novice arena fighter, never destined to be a champion but still a favorite of the folks back home. Accompanied by a barbed throwing trident and a heavy tower shield. Brint wears this old kit with pride, though the armor fits him as though it were made for someone else entirely."

rows.original: The leather-and-scale armor of a novice arena fighter, never destined to be a champion but still a favorite of the folks back home. Accompanied by a barbed throwing trident and a heavy tower shield. Brienne wears this old kit with pride, though the armor fits her as though it were made for someone else entirely.
rows.translation: 这位新手竞技场战士所穿的皮甲鳞甲，虽然注定成不了冠军，但在家乡人们心中依然很受欢迎。他同时还配备了带倒钩的投掷三叉戟和重型的塔盾。布蕾妮虽然自豪地穿着这套旧装备，但这套铠甲穿在她身上，却仿佛是为别人量身定做的。
rows.raw: "The leather-and-scale armor of a novice arena fighter, never destined to be a champion but still a favorite of the folks back home. Accompanied by a barbed throwing trident and a heavy tower shield. Brienne wears this old kit with pride, though the armor fits her as though it were made for someone else entirely."

rows.translation: 绿骑士套装
绿骑士套装

rows.original: Clad in heavy armor and bearing a blade and shield, [brint.name] brings both the aspects of wrath and of regrowth to battle in Velun's name. [brint.HeShe] is able to infuse allies with regenerative prayers, and strike down foes with thorny briars and divine smites.
rows.translation: 身披厚重的盔甲，手持刀剑与盾牌，[brint.name]以维伦的名义，将愤怒与重生这两种力量带入战斗之中。[brint.HeShe]能够为盟友施加恢复性的祈祷，同时用带刺的荆棘和神圣的力量击败敌人。
rows.raw: "Clad in heavy armor and bearing a blade and shield, [brint.name] brings both the aspects of wrath and of regrowth to battle in Velun's name. [brint.HeShe] is able to infuse allies with regenerative prayers, and strike down foes with thorny briars and divine smites."

rows.original: Clad in heavy armor and bearing a blade and shield, [brint.name] brings both the aspects of wrath and of regrowth to battle in Velun's name. [brint.HeShe] is able to infuse allies with regenerative prayers, and strike down foes with thorny briars and divine smites.
rows.translation: 身披厚重的盔甲，手持刀剑与盾牌，[brint.name]以维伦的名义，将愤怒与重生这两种力量带入战斗之中。[brint.HeShe]能够为盟友施加恢复性的祈祷，同时用带刺的荆棘和神圣的力量击败敌人。
rows.raw: "Clad in heavy armor and bearing a blade and shield, [brint.name] brings both the aspects of wrath and of regrowth to battle in Velun's name. [brint.HeShe] is able to infuse allies with regenerative prayers, and strike down foes with thorny briars and divine smites."

rows.translation: 冬日骑士套装
冬日骑士套装

rows.original: A shield made of solid ice, rectangular and large enough to protect all of Brint's massive frame. Within the shield is a source of ancient power, gifted to Brint by an ancient ghost-smith in a long-forgotten tower, giving him the ability to control ice to protect and smite in equal measure. When battle is joined, the shield projects a suit of frigid armor around Brint, and he uses his skull-crushing mace to wade through his foes.
rows.translation: 这是一面由实心冰块构成的盾牌，呈矩形，其大小足以保护布林特那庞大的身躯。在这面盾牌内部，蕴含着一种远古的力量——这是由一位隐居在久远遗忘的高塔中的古老铁匠赠予布林特的，这种力量使他能够随心操控冰元素，既能用来保护自己，也能用来攻击敌人。当战斗开始时，这面盾牌会为布林特形成一套冰冷的护甲，而他则会使用那把能粉碎敌人头骨的巨锤，奋力冲破敌人的防线。
rows.raw: "A shield made of solid ice, rectangular and large enough to protect all of Brint's massive frame. Within the shield is a source of ancient power, gifted to Brint by an ancient ghost-smith in a long-forgotten tower, giving him the ability to control ice to protect and smite in equal measure. When battle is joined, the shield projects a suit of frigid armor around Brint, and he uses his skull-crushing mace to wade through his foes."

rows.translation: 火术士的布料
火术师之布

rows.original: A set of sensual cloth imbued with powerful magic that enables Brienne to wield the element of fire like second nature. Though it appears ragged and worn, it fits her well — if a little snugly in the chest.
rows.translation: 这套充满魔力的性感织物让布蕾妮能够像运用自身本能一样自如地操控火元素。虽然看起来破旧不堪，但它却非常合她的身材——只是胸前稍微有些紧绷而已。
rows.raw: "A set of sensual cloth imbued with powerful magic that enables Brienne to wield the element of fire like second nature. Though it appears ragged and worn, it fits her well — if a little snugly in the chest."

rows.original: Dancing silks in the style of a Jassiran temple harlot, made to fit Brienne by Nelia. With Cait's lessons in Jassiran dance under her belt, Brienne fights with sultry, swaying grace and when the moment comes, she still lowers her horns and charges.
rows.translation: 由内莉娅为布蕾妮量身制作的舞衣，样式仿照贾西拉神殿妓女的丝绸服饰。掌握了凯特教授的贾西拉舞蹈后，布蕾妮会以性感摇曳的优雅身姿战斗；而时机一到，她依然会低下双角发起冲锋。
rows.raw: "Dancing silks in the style of a Jassiran temple harlot, made to fit Brienne by Nelia. With Cait's lessons in Jassiran dance under her belt, Brienne fights with sultry, swaying grace and when the moment comes, she still lowers her horns and charges."

rows.translation: 斧
召唤师装备
Summ.Gear

rows.original: Berwyn's arcane gear. The most eye-catching part of his getup is a long, pointed hat. While this kit may not provide the best protection, it's easy to move in and is ideal for spell casting.
rows.translation: 贝尔温的神秘装备。他这套装束中最引人注目的就是一顶长长的尖顶帽。虽然这套装备可能无法提供最好的保护，但它非常便于移动，非常适合施法使用。
rows.raw: "Berwyn's arcane gear. The most eye-catching part of his getup is a long, pointed hat. While this kit may not provide the best protection, it's easy to move in and is ideal for spell casting."

rows.translation: 前邪教成员护甲
Cult.Armor

rows.original: Quintillus's armor. Common attire used by the cultists, a reminder of his past as member of the cult. It consists of a cloak and a leather jerkin.
rows.translation: 昆蒂卢斯的盔甲。这是那些邪教徒常用的普通服饰，也是对他曾经是邪教成员这一身份的象征。这套盔甲由一件斗篷和一件皮制紧身上衣组成。
rows.raw: "Quintillus's armor. Common attire used by the cultists, a reminder of his past as member of the cult. It consists of a cloak and a leather jerkin."

rows.translation: 霍普骑士套装
H.KnightSet

rows.original: A shield and armor styled like the legionnaires of old Belhar: a bastion of leather and bronze mail. Quin uses it to draw the threat of foes onto himself and channel is fire magic, making a magically-powerful defensive fighter.
rows.translation: 这种盾牌与盔甲的设计灵感来源于古代贝尔哈尔的军团战士：它们由皮革与青铜制成的护甲构成。昆因运用这种装备将敌人的攻击引向自己，同时释放火系魔法，从而成为一名拥有强大防御能力的战斗者。
rows.raw: "A shield and armor styled like the legionnaires of old Belhar: a bastion of leather and bronze mail. Quin uses it to draw the threat of foes onto himself and channel is fire magic, making a magically-powerful defensive fighter."

rows.translation: 骑手装备
Outrdr.Gear

rows.original: A set of relatively plain hunting leathers, though they're made of superior craftsmanship. Etheryn finds these comfortable and familiar. It consists of simple hunting garb and a short skirt, with a leather vest, guards, and boots to offer some modicum of protection from whatever beasts she may track. One of her gloves has been replaced with a large falconry gauntlet, giving her the ability to call down and commune with her war-hawk.
rows.translation: 这套狩猎皮装虽然设计简单，但却采用了精湛的工艺制成。伊瑟琳觉得它们既舒适又熟悉。这套装备包括朴素的狩猎服、一条短裙，以及一件皮制背心、护手和靴子，这些都能为她在与野兽搏斗时提供一定的保护。她的其中一只手套被换成了一个大型猎鹰护手，这样她就能与自己的战鹰进行交流了。
rows.raw: "A set of relatively plain hunting leathers, though they're made of superior craftsmanship. Etheryn finds these comfortable and familiar. It consists of simple hunting garb and a short skirt, with a leather vest, guards, and boots to offer some modicum of protection from whatever beasts she may track. One of her gloves has been replaced with a large falconry gauntlet, giving her the ability to call down and commune with her war-hawk."

rows.translation: 冰川卫队
冰川卫队

rows.original: Etheryn uses her frost magic to create an impenetrable barrier of ice to protect herself and her comrades. Once behind a fortified position, she lets loose a hail of enchanted arrows and her warbird strikes viciously from above.
rows.translation: 伊瑟琳运用她的冰霜魔法构筑出一道坚不可摧的冰墙，以此保护自己和她的同伴们。一旦进入这个加固过的防御阵地，她便会射出一阵附有魔力的箭矢，而她的战鸟也会从空中发起猛烈的攻击。
rows.raw: "Etheryn uses her frost magic to create an impenetrable barrier of ice to protect herself and her comrades. Once behind a fortified position, she lets loose a hail of enchanted arrows and her warbird strikes viciously from above."

rows.translation: 骑士套装
骑士套装

rows.original: A one piece vest made of tough but flexible spider silk cloth. Atugia is able to move with ease while wearing it, and the attached skirt is barely long enough to leave anything to the imagination. A pair of sturdy boots are oft left out entirely when the ground is less treacherous, but nevertheless complete the outfit. A lack of lower coverage sometimes leads to her opponents being given a nice view...
rows.translation: 一件由坚韧而柔韧的蜘蛛丝织物制成的背心。穿着它，阿图吉娅可以轻松自如地移动，而搭配的短裙长度恰好足以激发人们的想象力。当地面不太危险时，人们往往会忽略那双结实的靴子，但它们依然是这套装束的完整组成部分。不过，由于下身衣物覆盖得较少，有时会让她的对手们看到一些……不错的景象。
rows.raw: "A one piece vest made of tough but flexible spider silk cloth. Atugia is able to move with ease while wearing it, and the attached skirt is barely long enough to leave anything to the imagination. A pair of sturdy boots are oft left out entirely when the ground is less treacherous, but nevertheless complete the outfit. A lack of lower coverage sometimes leads to her opponents being given a nice view..."

rows.translation: 符文狂战士套装
狂战士套装

rows.original: A combination of Southern runic magic and the fury of orcish battle frenzy. Runes that normally channel the aspects of one's ancestors can be used to funnel repressed rage from that same source. While still protective of one's allies, this set is geared toward making the threats disappear.
rows.translation: 南方符文魔法与兽人战斗狂怒的结合。那些通常用于引导祖先力量的符文，如今也可以用来释放源自同一根源的压抑怒火。这套符文体系在保护盟友的同时，更侧重于消灭那些威胁。
rows.raw: "A combination of Southern runic magic and the fury of orcish battle frenzy. Runes that normally channel the aspects of one's ancestors can be used to funnel repressed rage from that same source. While still protective of one's allies, this set is geared toward making the threats disappear."

rows.translation: 御道

rows.original: The Old Country art of sorcery, combining geomancy, deception and spirit summoning into one unified whole. This ability set is geared towards causing maximal, widespread destruction in minimal time.
rows.translation: 这种古国的魔法技艺，将风水术、欺骗手段与灵魂召唤融为一体。这套能力的设计目的，就是在最短的时间内造成最大范围的破坏。
rows.raw: "The Old Country art of sorcery, combining geomancy, deception and spirit summoning into one unified whole. This ability set is geared towards causing maximal, widespread destruction in minimal time."

rows.translation: 狐火

rows.original: The kitsune's magical art of illusion and hexes, stemming from their inherent ability of foxfire. This ability set is geared towards debilitating enemy defenses and taking advantage of those created weaknesses.
rows.translation: 狐妖们所拥有的这种利用幻术与诅咒进行迷惑敌人的魔法能力，其实源于它们与生俱来的“狐火”特质。这套魔法技能专门用于削弱敌人的防御力，并利用由此产生的弱点来发动攻击。
rows.raw: "The kitsune's magical art of illusion and hexes, stemming from their inherent ability of foxfire. This ability set is geared towards debilitating enemy defenses and taking advantage of those created weaknesses."

rows.translation: 神之道

rows.original: The way of the spirit gods is the province of Old Country priesthood, but especially revered are those who serve the August Master at the Center of Heaven. Only kitsune may be Kerosite shinshoku, and only they may say prayers and perform rituals that call on his power. This ability set is geared towards crippling enemies' abilities to harm you and punishing them for it.
rows.translation: 灵神之道由古国的祭司掌管，其中侍奉天之中央尊主的祭司尤其受人敬重。只有狐妖才能成为凯罗斯的神职，也只有他们能通过祈祷与仪式借用他的力量。这套技能旨在削弱敌人伤害你的能力，并惩罚他们。
rows.raw: "The way of the spirit gods is the province of Old Country priesthood, but especially revered are those who serve the August Master at the Center of Heaven. Only kitsune may be Kerosite shinshoku, and only they may say prayers and perform rituals that call on his power. This ability set is geared towards crippling enemies' abilities to harm you and punishing them for it."

rows.translation: 坎索

rows.original: A school of geomancy developed in Kitsuhon, kanso was intended for the beautification and spiritual defense of homes and fortifications, but the techniques developed have been adapted for personal defense. Focusing on simplicity and the flow of ki in a space, it seeks to divert malicious intents and energies around someone like a stream about a boulder rather than meet it head-on. While defensive in nature, this set does not primarily seek to heal incurred damage, but prevent it from being inflicted in the first place through means of shields and damage mitigation.
rows.translation: 在关东的北丰地区，发展出了一套风水术法，其初衷在于美化住宅与防御工事，并赋予它们精神层面的保护作用，但随着时间的推移，这些技术也被改良用于个人防护。这种风水术法注重简洁性与流畅性ki在某种环境中，它会像溪流绕过巨石一样，将针对某人的恶意意图和能量引导开，而不是直接迎头而上。 虽然这种防御机制本质上是出于防御目的，但它的主要目的并非治愈已经造成的伤害，而是通过盾牌和伤害减免手段，从源头上防止伤害的发生。
rows.raw: "A school of geomancy developed in Kitsuhon, kanso was intended for the beautification and spiritual defense of homes and fortifications, but the techniques developed have been adapted for personal defense. Focusing on simplicity and the flow of ki in a space, it seeks to divert malicious intents and energies around someone like a stream about a boulder rather than meet it head-on.\n\n While defensive in nature, this set does not primarily seek to heal incurred damage, but prevent it from being inflicted in the first place through means of shields and damage mitigation."

rows.translation: 管弦

rows.original: Played at the imperial court of Kitsuhon, Kangen is classical music performed by wind, string and percussion instruments. With the music's importation from Macah also came the magic as practiced by several mystic's sects: as a result, the art of Kangen in Kitsuhon is restricted to three musicians' guilds and select members of the nobility. This ability set is aimed at cooldown manipulation.
rows.translation: 在基苏洪的皇廷中演奏的管弦，是由管乐器、弦乐器和打击乐器合奏的古典音乐。这种音乐从马卡传入时，几个神秘教派所修习的魔法也一同传入；因此，基苏洪的管弦技艺仅限三个乐师行会和部分贵族传习。 这套技能主要用于操控冷却时间。
rows.raw: " Played at the imperial court of Kitsuhon, Kangen is classical music performed by wind, string and percussion instruments. With the music's importation from Macah also came the magic as practiced by several mystic's sects: as a result, the art of Kangen in Kitsuhon is restricted to three musicians' guilds and select members of the nobility. This ability set is aimed at cooldown manipulation."

rows.translation: 王室礼服
女王礼服

rows.original: A beautiful dress fit for a warrior-queen, made up of rich white silks and hardened white leather, accompanied by a holy spear bearing Lumia's sunburst. This royal attire was commissioned by Queen Alissa of the Winter City for her little sister, ostensibly in recognition of Etheryn's royal heritage... but it bears an uncanny resemblance to a Belharan wedding dress, hinting to Alissa's true intentions for her half-sexed sibling.
rows.translation: 这件适合战神女王穿的美丽礼服，由质地精美的白色丝绸和经过特殊处理的白色皮革制成，还配有一支印有卢米娅太阳图案的圣矛。这套皇家服饰是冬城的女王艾莉莎为她的妹妹定制的，表面上是为了承认伊瑟琳的皇室血统……但实际上，它与贝尔哈兰的婚礼礼服有着惊人的相似之处，这暗示着艾莉莎对她这个拥有半性的妹妹真正的意图。
rows.raw: "A beautiful dress fit for a warrior-queen, made up of rich white silks and hardened white leather, accompanied by a holy spear bearing Lumia's sunburst. This royal attire was commissioned by Queen Alissa of the Winter City for her little sister, ostensibly in recognition of Etheryn's royal heritage... but it bears an uncanny resemblance to a Belharan wedding dress, hinting to Alissa's true intentions for her half-sexed sibling."

rows.translation: 战士女王
战士女王

rows.original: A glorious raiment of war, forged by the hands of Lumia's Valkyries and blessed by the goddess's own hands. This equipment was granted to Etheryn by the Argent Wing shortly after her crowning, so that like her grandmother before her the new Elvenqueen can stand fearlessly at the vanguard of a holy crusade to rid the world of darkness. So equipped, Queen Etheryn can protect her allies with her shield and lead her allies to heights of heroism.

It focuses upon applying and manipulating poisons to bypass the defenses of agile but physically delicate foes by primarily targeting Physical Defense instead of Evasion.

She's forgone her shield—choosing instead to focus all her strength into her mighty hammer—picked up some tricks from Garth, covered herself with blue warpaint, and honed her rage into a weapon all its own. Seems the orc will be leading the charge in the future.

A heavy winter cloak hangs off her broad shoulders, a pair of heeled, thigh-high leather boots hug her powerful legs, and she's taken to painting her face with dark, striking makeup to match. When the war drums start to thunder, Arona sings the storm itself into her allies, her booming voice shaking the battlefield as surely as any lightning strike.

圣水
圣水

rows.original:
Blessed by a priest of any of the Seven, holy water has long been used to anoint the body as a warding against evil. The practice is said to have begun in the Holy City of Belhar itself, built upon an endless reservoir of ice-cold water that springs forth from the earth. Every drop is considered sacred, and to bathe oneself in it is to be baptised in the gods' own blessing upon the Empire.
        
        <b>Using this will increase your Ward by 5+
rows.translation:
受到七大圣神中任何一位神父的祝福，圣水长期以来一直被用来为人们涂抹身体，以此抵御邪恶。据说这一习俗起源于贝尔哈尔圣城——这座城市建在一片源源不断的冰冷水源之上，这些水从地下涌出。每一滴水都被视为神圣的，而用这些水沐浴，就意味着获得了诸神对帝国的祝福。
        
        <b>使用此物品后，你的守卫数量将增加5个以上。
rows.raw: "Blessed by a priest of any of the Seven, holy water has long been used to anoint the body as a warding against evil. The practice is said to have begun in the Holy City of Belhar itself, built upon an endless reservoir of ice-cold water that springs forth from the earth. Every drop is considered sacred, and to bathe oneself in it is to be baptised in the gods' own blessing upon the Empire.\n        \n        <b>Using this will increase your Ward by 5+"

rows.original: A travel keg with Pupperidge-brewed ale, enough to get a whole adventuring party tipsy. The girls of Pupperidge are tough folk, and their ale is sure to impart a little of their own hardiness to weary travelers. Maximizes the entire party's Toughness for 24 hours.
rows.translation: 这桶旅行用啤酒由帕珀里奇镇酿造，其量足以让整个冒险小队都微醺起来。帕珀里奇镇的姑娘们可都是些体魄的人，而她们酿造的啤酒肯定也能让疲惫的旅人感受到那份体魄与力量。 使整个团队在24小时内获得最高的耐力值。
rows.raw: "A travel keg with Pupperidge-brewed ale, enough to get a whole adventuring party tipsy. The girls of Pupperidge are tough folk, and their ale is sure to impart a little of their own hardiness to weary travelers.\n \n Maximizes the entire party's Toughness for 24 hours."

rows.original:
[party.som|Right now seems like the perfect time to take the edge off, and you pick a spot to sit down and pull out your keg of Pupperidge Farm beer. You take your time, filling up a travel mug to the brim before knocking it back. Satisfying fizz does battle with refreshment that you can feel from head-to-toe. By the time you're finished drinking you feel far better, greatly relaxed, and more than a bit less sober than before.|You stretch and take a seat, pulling out the little travel-keg of Pupperidge Farm beer. [companion.Name] rubs [companion.hisHer] hands together and retrieves [companion.hisHer] traveling mug, eagerly awaiting a chance to partake. You pour [companion.himHer] a full mug before doing the same for yourself, and after a clunk and a toast you begin to chug. 

        After a pleasant hour of sitting and drinking, the both of you are a little less sober than before but feeling much relaxed.|It seems like the perfect chance to sit down and relax, and your companions seem to agree judging by how they settle down next to you. Their expressions warm up a great deal when you pull out your travel-keg of Pupperidge Farm beer. They retrieve some travel mugs and wait (surprisingly patiently) for you to serve them all, and then you toast you warmly before beginning. 
        
        Perhaps an hour of drinking and relaxing passes, and by the time you're all finally finished and the keg has run dry there's a toastiness to your stomach. Much better.]
rows.translation:
[party.som|现在似乎正是放松身心的最佳时机。你找了个地方坐下来，拿出了那桶小狗岭农场啤酒。你慢慢来，把旅行杯倒得满满当当，然后一饮而尽。那令人愉悦的气泡与带来的清凉感在全身蔓延，让你感到无比舒畅。喝完之后，你发现自己放松了许多，不过……也比之前少了几分清醒了。|你伸了个懒腰，然后坐下来，拿出了装着小狗岭农场啤酒的便携小酒桶。[companion.Name]搓着[companion.hisHer]双手，取出[companion.hisHer]旅行杯，迫不及待地等着喝上一杯。你先给[companion.himHer]倒满，再给自己倒上一杯，碰杯祝酒后便大口喝了起来。

        愉快地坐下来喝酒了一个小时之后，你们俩虽然比之前稍微不那么清醒了，但整个人却感觉轻松了许多。|这似乎是一个绝佳的机会，可以坐下来放松一下，而你的同伴似乎也这么认为——他们纷纷在你身边坐下。当你拿出那桶来自小狗岭农场的啤酒时，他们的表情顿时变得愉悦起来。他们拿出了几只旅行杯，然后（出人意料地耐心地）等待你把酒倒进这些杯子里。之后，在开始喝酒之前，你会先和他们一起热切地干杯。
        
        也许过了一个小时的饮酒和放松时光，等到你们终于喝完酒，酒桶也空了的时候，你们的肚子已经变得暖暖的。好多了。]

"
        [party.som|Right now seems like the perfect time to take the edge off, and you pick a spot to sit down and pull out your keg of Pupperidge Farm beer. rows.original:
A traditional orc heartlander drink, which required an ox to chew the near-tasteless brazenberries before brewing them with malt to make a particularly strong ale. Other races were quick to substitute yeast to mimic the process responsible for the body and flavor, thereby excluding oxen regurgitation from the process.
        
        Brazenberry ale is still a staple drink amongst those who live in the Belharan Heartlands, where it's said to be a favorite of mercenaries. Sometimes it's not keen judgement that's needed, but a simple willingness to leap into the fray.
        
        <b>Imbibing this will increase your Attack Power by 10+
rows.translation:
这是一种传统的兽人腹地居民饮品：在酿造这种酒之前，需要用牛来咀嚼那些几乎毫无味道的铜莓，然后再将其与麦芽一起发酵，从而制成一种酒精度极高的啤酒。其他种族很快便采用了酵母来替代这一过程，从而模仿出这种酒的独特风味与口感，也因此不再需要依赖牛的咀嚼过程了。
        
        在贝尔哈兰心脏地带，厚颜无耻果啤酒仍然是当地居民们喜爱的饮品，据说这种啤酒特别受雇佣兵们的欢迎。有时候，我们并不需要过于精明的判断，只需要有一颗敢于投身到战斗中的勇气罢了。
        
        <b>饮用此物后，你的攻击强度将提升10%以上。
rows.raw:
"A traditional orc heartlander drink, which required an ox to chew the near-tasteless brazenberries before brewing them with malt to make a particularly strong ale. Other races were quick to substitute yeast to mimic the process responsible for the body and flavor, thereby excluding oxen regurgitation from the process.
        
        Brazenberry ale is still a staple drink amongst those who live in the Belharan Heartlands, where it's said to be a favorite of mercenaries. Sometimes it's not keen judgement that's needed, but a simple willingness to leap into the fray.

Something pulsates behind the smoky glass of this cylindrical canister, creating an ever-shifting shadowplay across the reflective surface. [pc.bg arcanist|You're intimately familiar with what this is — conjurer's concoction, you yourself having used it on occasion. Magicians carry this stuff around, downing the concoction before setting to work casting incantations and spinning hexes. For a brief period of time the imbiber would become intensely focused, ignorant of events outside their purpose.|You've heard tales of what this is — a conjurer's concoction, also known as the sorcerer's helper. Apparently the many mages of Estelore were the biggest producers and consumers of this alchemically altered fluid, imbibing it to aid in their spellcasting until... well, Estelore disappeared.]

rows.original:
While occurring in nature on the worn slopes of the Windy Peaks, these egg-sized pebbles are far more common synthesized by budding enchanters as practice. By capturing a small amount of a storm's energy in a specially-prepared stone, the user can store the power of a lightning strike for later use. It's said that scouts of the old Belhar Empire would use them as emergency signals, or as escape tools when facing imminent capture.

        <b>Throwing this will Stagger and deal 20+
rows.translation:
这种蛋大小的卵石天然存在于风啸峰饱经侵蚀的山坡上，但更常见的是由初学附魔师合成作为练习。只要把少量风暴能量封入特制石头，使用者便能储存一次雷击之力，以备日后使用。据说古贝尔哈尔帝国的斥候会用它发出紧急信号，或在即将被俘时借其脱身。

rows.original:
Refined by alchemists from mineral oils found deep beneath the earth, this viscous, jelly-like substance burns hot enough to sear flesh, yet cool enough to leave most weapons unharmed. Some use it for lighting, but a far more effective — and intimidating — application is to create flaming weapons.

        <b>Applying this to your weapon during combat will add 10+
rows.translation:
这种黏稠如果冻的物质由炼金术士从地底深处的矿物油中提炼而成。它燃烧得足以灼伤血肉，却又不会损坏大多数武器。有些人用它照明，但更有效——也更具威慑力——的用途，是制造燃烧武器。

        <b>在战斗中将它涂抹于武器，会为武器增加10+
rows.raw: "Refined by alchemists from mineral oils found deep beneath the earth, this viscous, jelly-like substance burns hot enough to sear flesh, yet cool enough to leave most weapons unharmed. Some use it for lighting, but a far more effective — and intimidating — application is to create flaming weapons.\n\n        <b>Applying this to your weapon during combat will add 10+"

Bubbles rise from the bottom of the flask as you shake it, floating to the top of the viscous yellow liquid. You're not exactly sure of the veracity of its reputation of being distilled from the gall bladders of striped toads, but the endurance the alchemical substance bestows is undeniable.

A potent medicinal aroma wafts from the small clay jar as you look it over, the sharp, antiseptic tang snapping your mind to attention. Opening it up just a fraction, you're faced with a pale green paste with a most disagreeable consistency, clearly meant for topical use. As you gingerly touch the compounded salve with a fingertip, warmth radiates up your finger and down the length of your arm; you're not sure what exactly went into this, but this is clearly potent medicine. At least you won't have to swallow this stuff to reap its benefits.

Their usefulness is only matched by how difficult they are to cultivate, resulting in most people gathering them in the wild. rows.original: One can never quite be sure what lies inside these wrapped bundles, but dried fish, smoked meats, roasted nuts and pickled root vegetables are most common in the Frost Marches, with perhaps a little preserved fruit or honey on the side as a treat. While still lightweight and resistant to spoilage, the food inside — enough to constitute a meal for three — promises to taste far better than the hardtack and jerky usually found in camping supplies. Applies the Well Fed status to the party for 24 hours.
rows.translation: 人们永远无法确定这些包裹里究竟装着什么，但在冰霜边境地区，最常见的食物通常是干鱼、熏肉、烤坚果和腌根茎类蔬菜，偶尔也会有一些腌制水果或蜂蜜作为点心。虽然这些食物重量轻且不易变质，但其中所含的食物量足以满足三个人的饮食需求，而且其味道肯定比露营用品中常见的硬饼干和肉干要好得多。 使整个团队在24小时内获得“营养充足”的状态。
rows.raw: "One can never quite be sure what lies inside these wrapped bundles, but dried fish, smoked meats, roasted nuts and pickled root vegetables are most common in the Frost Marches, with perhaps a little preserved fruit or honey on the side as a treat. While still lightweight and resistant to spoilage, the food inside — enough to constitute a meal for three — promises to taste far better than the hardtack and jerky usually found in camping supplies.\n \n Applies the Well Fed status to the party for 24 hours."

rows.translation: 观察者

rows.original: Just taking the bundles out into the open makes your stomach growl in anticipation. Wasting no time, you undo the strings holding them together and tear open the waxed paper, eager to get at the food within; your efforts are rewarded with a faint but delicious smell wafting from the opened packages. Chow time! [rand| The first thing you pull out is a large loaf of black bread, standard at most tables in the Frost Marches. Tough and thick-crusted, the peasant loaf serves to fill the stomach and helps stretch other provisions a little further. It's not the most glamorous thing and is largely dry and tasteless, but at least it doesn't need to be sopped in water before eating like hardtack does. | The main course this time around is a number of lamb legs, their oily sheen reflected on the now unwrapped wax paper. Even cold, the juicy meat looks delicious; smoked, soaked in brine and then chilled, they've been preserved fairly well without needing to dry them out. You can see slits where the cook has inserted slivers of garlic, infusing the meat with a heavenly flavor. It's hard to use too much garlic when it comes to these things, but this one comes close. | The biggest bundle contains a whole roast chicken dinner, skin appropriately crispy and an almost overpowering scent of sharp-smelling herbs rising from it. While you know that the herbs are there more to keep it fit for eating than for any enhancement of its flavor, there's still a certain something or the other when they mix in with the alas, now gamey chicken. | What constitutes the bulk of this meal is a large number of vegetable biscuits, each one as large as your spread palm and as thick as a finger. Carrots, cabbage and other assorted greens have been finely chopped and grated before being baked in with flour, then all of it dried and lightly salted. It's one way of getting vegetables into oneself while on the move, even if some find the taste off-putting. They don't keep as well as hardtack — few things do — but at least they're more nutritious. | Your eyes widen as the first thing you uncover from the waxed paper is a whole salted salmon, easily as long as your arm from elbow to fingertips. Much effort has been put into preparing this — you can still see the black lines on its skin from its time on the grill, crossed with slits in which brine has been introduced into the fish. Another light coating of salt finishes the job, resulting in a hardy, nutritious travel food. During good years, the rivers of the Frost Marches are thick with these fish as they head upstream to spawn, making them a traditional staple. | The largest bundle of this ensemble is a cluster of tightly wrapped dry sausages. The tight casings keep the meat within compact and ready to eat. In the cold weather of the Frost Marches sausage keeps nigh on forever, and ends up being a popular choice for travel meals as a result. These particular rolls [rand|smell strongly of garlic|smell vaguely of pepper|have a smell akin to sweet apples|have a salty sweet smell that tickles your nose]. ] [rand| In addition to the main course, there's a large wheel of goat cheese. Aged in damp, cold caverns or cellars, this firm white cheese bears a heady odour to it, and promises to bear the sharp bite cherished by many in Hawkethorne and Harvest Valley. Thin veins of green and blue streaking through the wheel show the mold used in its aging — indeed, the whole reason the cheese keeps is because it's technically already rotting. The mold was supposedly brought to the region by the old Belhar Empire, which found the climate of the Frost Marches perfect for cheese ripening. Strange, but given how fantastic the tales of that old civilization are, this is practically mundane in comparison. | The next thing you fish out of the bundles is a large pot of yoghurt, a distinct sour smell rising from it as you undo the seal and pop it open. It's hard to tell what kind of milk it came from — could be cow, goat, sheep, gods, the rumours even say that the minotaurs of Khor'minos make it out of their womenfolk's breast milk, putting it in hide bags to churn and ferment while they travel. No, that's not a thought you want to entertain right before eating. | In one of the smaller bundles, you discover a jar of pickled cabbage. Growing season for leafy vegetables tends to be relatively short this far north — to compensate, gardeners grow far more than they could hope to eat while it's warm, then preserve the rest in vinegar, garlic and spicy herbs. There're a couple of onions swimming in there, too — definitely not food for the weak-stomached. With food like this, you either beat it, or it beats you. | Coming up on that is a plethora of nuts, spilling out in all directions as you unwrap the wax paper. Hazelnuts and walnuts, roasted over an open flame until glossy and hard — they keep forever, so long as they don't come into contact with moisture. A handful of dried mushrooms and anchovies have been thrown in for variety, forming a well-balanced side dish. | Off to the side, there's a heavy glass jar filled to the brim with root vegetables of all kinds — turnips, carrots, onions, radishes, and a handful of garlic cloves for good measure. The lot has been jarred, sealed and then boiled in brine in a huge heavy iron pot, rendering them impervious so long as the jar remains sealed. Hardtack is impressive, but there are local legends of people in Hawkethorne finding jars of this stuff from their great-grandparents' time in their root cellars, still well-preserved and perfectly edible. ] [rand| Last but not least, there's a bag of dried fruit. Once, this might have been a bountiful mound of fruit straight from Harvest Valley; fresh blackberries, swollen with juice, nearly bursting; golden apples, still wet with morning dew; grapes piled high in alternating clumps of green and purple. The stuff of dreams, a handful of which would certainly last you at least a day. Now, the blackberries are all wrinkly, the apples sliced and coated with a dusting of fine sugar, and the grapes better known as raisins. Still mighty fine, though. | The last of the bundles holds a small measure of honey in a clay jar. Beekeeping is common in Harvest Valley, as most farms keep a hive or two to pollinate the orchards and crops. However, it's so valuable as a food in its own right — let alone as a sweetener or preservative — that few farms have any excess to sell. Whatever homestead this jar came from must have had an excellent year. | Finally, there're a handful of hard candies, each one perhaps half the size of a hen's egg. Finely minced nuts mixed with caramelised sweet sap — your teeth would break if you tried to bite into these. A traditional elf favorite, the warrior women of the Winter City sometimes carry these to sustain themselves on long marches or on patrol. | The final bundle you unwrap contains a number of blackberry jam tarts, tightly packed in the wax paper. Odd that these would be in trail rations; pastries aren't particularly known for their resistance to spoilage. Then again, these aren't exactly your run-of-the-mill tarts — they're more jam than anything else, encased in a thin, hard shell of baked pastry. The jam is cloyingly sweet, and is clearly made to be eaten with something to drink in hand. ] [party.isJustPC| Now that's quite the spread! It feels like a bit of a waste to eat it all alone, but at the very least you won't be complaining that you're still hungry after all of this. Using the remnants of the wax paper to protect your meal from the elements, you sit down to dig in. It's a while before you're finally done, having to eat the lot by yourself, but when you're well and truly finished you have to shake off the impulse to have a lie-down. Sleeping here without anyone to watch your back wouldn't be a good idea. | [party.comp cait brint berwyn arona etheryn atugia |"Never quite appreciated the importance of a hot meal until I started traveling with Father and Calla," Cait says wistfully. "Say what you like, as least we got hot meals three times a day at the temple, maybe more if some petitioners came in and had a particular kink for that kind of thing. There's something about sitting down at a table that pulling out something salted and wrapped in wax paper just doesn't capture, and it's neither taste nor texture." | "No matter how long it's been since I left the Undermountain, I still can't get used to the tiny portions you lot have," Brint says, rubbing his head a little sheepishly. "How do you live on so little? I'd starve." Well, it's a good thing that you saved him a minotaur-sized portion, right? Brint laughs and claps you on the back. "I like the way you think, [pc.name]." | "This reminds me of mealtimes with Mistress," Berwyn says with a little sigh. "Before... that happened. Things were happier back then... why couldn't it all have stayed the same?" On the other hand, if it's any small consolation... if things had stayed the same, he wouldn't have met you. Berwyn says nothing to that, the dogboy simply applying himself to his food as if wishing to bury his sorrows. | "Needs more meat," Arona mutters as she picks at her food. "Needs more of everything, really. Good thing I'm carrying my own extras on me." Well, she's a big girl. Big girls eat big; it's only to be expected. She just grins toothily at you. "Tell you what, let's stop to camp and I'll show you something else that's big." | "I used to sit at feasts in the palace with the highest nobles of the pale elves," Ryn says with a sigh, her eyes downcast. "We had everything one could ever hope for served up at our table... but Alissa managed to make everything turn to ashes in my mouth by her mere presence." You nod. "This may be simple fare, really, but it tastes much better than anything the Winter City could bring to bear. I'm glad to be out here with you." | "It all looks so good! I'll never understand how people up north manage to package high class meals into storable packages," Atugia licks her lips as she stares at the various food items. You raise an eyebrow, unsure if she's being serious, but the look in her eyes seems genuine. Well, all the better if someone considers it a feast. ] With that, [party.combatNames] tuck into the spread, and a good thing, too — it'd have been a waste to eat this all alone, and food's always better when shared with others. ] Well, that's that. You wipe the last crumbs from your mouth, and spend a few moments cleaning up your little picnic before preparing to set off once more.
rows.translation: 只要把这些食物包拿到外面，你的肚子就会立刻开始“咕咕”叫，充满期待。你毫不耽搁，立刻解开捆绑它们的绳子，撕开蜡纸，迫不及待地想要吃到里面的食物；而你的努力也得到了回报——从打开的包装中飘出来的淡淡香气，实在令人垂涎欲滴。 开饭啦！ [rand| 你首先拿出来的是一大块黑面包，这种面包在霜冻边境的许多家庭中都是常见的食物。它的外皮坚硬厚实，食用后不仅能填饱肚子，还能让其他食物更好地发挥作用。虽然这种面包并不显得多么精致，口感也较为干涩无味，但至少在食用前不需要像吃硬饼干那样先泡在水里。 | 这次的主菜是几只羊腿，它们油亮的光泽在已经拆开的蜡纸上清晰可见。即使冷着，这种多汁的肉质看起来依然非常诱人；这些羊腿经过烟熏、浸泡在盐水中，然后再冷藏处理，这样的保存方法让它们无需经过风干也能保持良好的口感。你可以看到厨师在羊腿上切了一些小口，然后将大蒜片插入其中，这样一来，肉就充满了浓郁的风味。对于这类菜肴来说，使用太多大蒜确实有点过头了，但这次的用量已经差不多到极限了。 | 最大的套餐里包含了一整只烤鸡，鸡皮酥脆可口，散发着浓郁的香草气息。虽然你知道这些香草主要是为了保证鸡肉可以食用而添加的，并非为了提升它的味道，但当它们与这种带有淡淡“游戏味”的鸡肉结合在一起时，还是会产生一种独特的风味。 | 这道菜的主要成分是大量的蔬菜饼干，每一块都有一掌那么大，厚度则有手指那么厚。胡萝卜、卷心菜等各种蔬菜都被切得细细的，然后与面粉一起烘烤，之后再将其晾干并稍微加盐。这是一种在旅途中补充蔬菜营养的方法，尽管有些人可能会觉得这种食物的味道不太合口味。虽然这类食物的保存时间不如硬饼干那么长——其实几乎没有哪种食物能够长时间保存——但至少它们更加营养丰富。 | 当你从蜡纸上揭开第一层覆盖物时，你的眼睛立刻被一条完整的咸鲑鱼吸引住了——它的长度简直有你的手臂那么长，从肘部一直延伸到指尖。制作这条鲑鱼肯定耗费了大量的精力：你仍然能看到它皮肤上那些因为在烤制过程中留下的黑色痕迹，以及那些用来注入盐水的切口。再撒上一层薄盐，就能制成这种既耐储存又营养丰富的旅行食品。在丰收的年份，霜冻边境地区的河流里会充满这种鱼，因为它们会逆流而上进行产卵，因此这种鱼也成为了当地的传统主食。 | 这套食品中最大的一包，实际上是一叠包装得非常紧密的干香肠。这些紧密的包装使肉馅保持紧实的状态，随时都可以食用。在霜冻之地寒冷的天气里，这种香肠几乎可以保存很长时间，因此也成为了旅行途中非常受欢迎的食品选择。而这些特定的包装方式[rand|有很浓的大蒜味|带着一丝胡椒的味道|散发着类似甜苹果的气味|那种带有咸甜气息的味道会刺激你的鼻子，让人感到十分愉悦]。 ] [rand| 除了主菜之外，还有一大块山羊奶酪。这种在潮湿寒冷的洞穴或地窖中陈酿而成的白色奶酪香气浓郁，其辛辣的味道正是霍克索恩和收获谷地许多人所喜爱的。轮子上那些纵横交错的绿蓝色条纹，正是这种霉菌在发酵过程中留下的痕迹——事实上，这种奶酪能够保存下来，正是因为它已经在“腐烂”过程中发生了变化。据说，这种霉菌是古老的贝尔哈尔帝国传入这一地区的，他们发现霜冻边境的气候非常适合奶酪的发酵过程。奇怪的是，考虑到那个古老文明的故事是多么精彩离奇，相比之下，这件事简直平淡无奇。 | 从这些包裹里拿出来的下一件物品是一大罐酸奶，当你打开它的封口时，一股浓重的酸味便扑面而来。很难判断这种酸奶是用哪种牛奶制成的——可能是牛奶、山羊奶、羊奶……甚至有传言称，科尔米诺斯的弥诺陶洛斯是用她们女性的母乳来制作这种酸奶的，然后把母乳装在皮袋里，边旅行边搅拌发酵。不过，在吃之前，你肯定不想去想这些事情吧…… | 在一个较小的包裹里，你会发现一罐腌卷心菜。在这么靠北的地方，叶类蔬菜的生长期通常比较短——为了弥补这个缺点，园丁们会在天气暖和的时候种植大量的蔬菜，然后把剩下的部分用醋、大蒜和辛辣香草腌制起来保存起来。里面还泡着几颗洋葱，这些食物绝对不适合肠胃脆弱的人食用。面对这样的食物，要么你把它吃掉，要么它就会反过来影响你的健康。 | 当你撕开蜡纸时，会看到一大堆坚果散落在四周——榛子、核桃，都在明火上烤至表面光亮、变得坚硬。只要不接触湿气，这些坚果可以保存很久。为了增加口感的多样性，还加入了一些干蘑菇和凤尾鱼，这样就能制成一道口味均衡的配菜了。 | 在角落里，有一个装满了各种根茎类蔬菜的厚玻璃罐——有芜菁、胡萝卜、洋葱、萝卜，还加了几瓣大蒜。这些蔬菜被装进罐中密封好后，再放入一个巨大的铁锅里用盐水煮沸，这样只要罐子保持密封状态，这些蔬菜就能长时间保持新鲜不变质。硬饼干确实非常不错，但当地有传说称，在霍克索恩，有些人会在自家地窖里发现他们曾祖父辈时代留下的这些饼干罐，这些饼干保存得非常好，依然可以食用。 ] [rand| 最后但同样重要的是，还有一袋干果。这些干果原本可能是直接从丰收谷采摘来的新鲜水果：鲜嫩的黑莓，汁水饱满，几乎要裂开；金黄色的苹果，还带着清晨的露珠；成串的葡萄，绿紫相间，堆得高高的。这些简直是梦中的美食，只要吃上一点点，就足以让你满足一整天的口腹之欲。如今，那些黑莓都已经变得皱巴巴的，苹果也被切成了片，表面还撒了一层细糖，而那些葡萄呢，早已变成了人们熟知的葡萄干。 不过，依然相当不错。 | 最后一个包裹里装着一个陶罐，里面盛着少量的蜂蜜。在收获谷地，养蜂是非常普遍的做法，因为大多数农场都会养上一两个蜂箱，用来帮助果园和农作物授粉。然而，蜂蜜本身作为一种食物就具有极高的价值——更不用说它还可以用作甜味剂或防腐剂了——因此很少有农场会有多余的蜂蜜可以出售。这个陶罐肯定来自某个收成极为丰富的农场。 | 最后，还有一些硬糖，每一颗的大小大概只有半个鸡蛋那么大。这些糖是由细切的坚果与焦糖化的甜汁混合制成的——如果你试图咬下去，牙齿肯定会受伤的。这种糖是传统精灵们非常喜爱的零食，冬之城的战士女性们有时会带着它们，在长途行军或执行巡逻任务时作为能量来源。 | 你最终拆开的那个包裹里，装着几块用蜡纸紧紧包裹起来的黑莓果酱馅饼。真是奇怪这些这些点心只能靠配给的食物来充饥；毕竟，糕点本来就不是以耐储存而闻名的。不过，这些点心也确实不同于普通的果馅饼——它们更像是果酱，只是被包裹在一层薄薄的硬酥皮里。果酱甜得发腻，显然就是为搭配饮料一起食用而制作的。 ] [party.isJustPC| 这分量也太大了吧！一个人吃掉这些未免有点浪费，但至少吃完之后你肯定不会再觉得饿了吧。用剩下的蜡纸把食物包起来，防止它们受到外界环境的影响，然后你便开始大吃特吃起来。虽然一个人吃掉所有这些食物确实需要一些时间，但当你终于吃完时，你真的会忍不住想要躺下来休息一会儿。不过，在这里睡觉而没有别人在旁边照看，可可不是个好主意啊。 | [party.comp cait brint berwyn arona etheryn atugia |直到开始和父亲与卡拉一起旅行，我才真正意识到热餐的重要性。凯特满怀惆怅地说道。你们爱怎么说就怎么说吧，至少在寺庙里我们每天能吃到三顿热腾腾的饭菜，如果有些信徒特意前来请求，或许还能吃到更多。但是，坐在桌子前，拿出用蜡纸包裹好的咸菜来吃，这种体验确实无法用语言来描述——它既无法用味道来体现，也无法用口感来表达。 | 无论我离开幽暗山脉已经过去了多久，我还是无法习惯你们这些人所拥有的那些狭小的空间。布林特有点尴尬地挠了挠头，说道。怎么做你靠这么少的收入生活？我肯定会饿死的。 嗯，幸好你给他留了相当于一个米诺陶尔那么大的份量，对吧？ 布林特笑着拍了拍你的背。“我喜欢你的思路，[pc.name]。” | 这让我想起了和夫人一起用餐的时光。贝尔温轻轻叹了口气说道。在……之前…… 那个那些事情真的发生了。那时候，一切都要快乐得多……为什么一切都不能保持原样呢？ 另一方面，如果这能带来一丝安慰的话……如果情况真的如此的话拥有过如果一切保持不变，他就不会遇见你。 贝尔温对此没有发表任何评论，那个男孩只是专心地吃着自己的食物，仿佛想要借此来忘却自己的悲伤。 | 还需要再加些肉。阿罗娜一边吃着东西，一边低声嘟囔着什么。其实，各种东西都还需要再准备一些。幸好我随身带着自己的备用物品。 嗯，她已经是个大姑娘了。大姑娘就该吃得多一点，这也很正常嘛。 她只是冲你咧嘴一笑而已。告诉你吧，我们停下来露营吧，然后我会给你看一些更厉害的东西。 | 我曾经与苍白精灵中最高贵的贵族们一起参加宫廷宴会。小琳叹了口气，低下了头。我们原本可以得到一切想要的东西……但仅仅因为艾莉莎的出现，一切都变得毫无意义了。 你点了点头。 这可能算不上什么高级美食，但实际上它的味道比冬城能提供的任何食物都要好。能和你一起在这里享用这些食物，我感到非常开心。 | 看起来真棒！我永远也想不明白，北方的人们是怎么把这么高档的美食包装成便于储存的形式的。”阿图吉娅一边舔着嘴唇，一边盯着那些各式各样的食物。你挑了挑眉毛，不确定她是不是在开玩笑，但她眼中的神情看起来很认真。嗯，如果有人觉得这真是一场盛宴，那当然再好不过了。 ] 就这样， [party.combatNames]尽情享用这些美食吧，这样也真是太好了——如果一个人独自吃掉这些，未免太浪费了，而且与他人分享食物，味道总会更好。 ] 好吧，就这样。你把嘴边的最后一点残渣擦干净，花几分钟时间整理一下你的野餐用品，然后就可以再次出发了。
rows.raw: " Just taking the bundles out into the open makes your stomach growl in anticipation. Wasting no time, you undo the strings holding them together and tear open the waxed paper, eager to get at the food within; your efforts are rewarded with a faint but delicious smell wafting from the opened packages. Chow time! [rand| The first thing you pull out is a large loaf of black bread, standard at most tables in the Frost Marches. Tough and thick-crusted, the peasant loaf serves to fill the stomach and helps stretch other provisions a little further. It's not the most glamorous thing and is largely dry and tasteless, but at least it doesn't need to be sopped in water before eating like hardtack does. | The main course this time around is a number of lamb legs, their oily sheen reflected on the now unwrapped wax paper. Even cold, the juicy meat looks delicious; smoked, soaked in brine and then chilled, they've been preserved fairly well without needing to dry them out. You can see slits where the cook has inserted slivers of garlic, infusing the meat with a heavenly flavor. It's hard to use too much garlic when it comes to these things, but this one comes close. | The biggest bundle contains a whole roast chicken dinner, skin appropriately crispy and an almost overpowering scent of sharp-smelling herbs rising from it. While you know that the herbs are there more to keep it fit for eating than for any enhancement of its flavor, there's still a certain something or the other when they mix in with the alas, now gamey chicken. | What constitutes the bulk of this meal is a large number of vegetable biscuits, each one as large as your spread palm and as thick as a finger. Carrots, cabbage and other assorted greens have been finely chopped and grated before being baked in with flour, then all of it dried and lightly salted. It's one way of getting vegetables into oneself while on the move, even if some find the taste off-putting. They don't keep as well as hardtack — few things do — but at least they're more nutritious. | Your eyes widen as the first thing you uncover from the waxed paper is a whole salted salmon, easily as long as your arm from elbow to fingertips. Much effort has been put into preparing this — you can still see the black lines on its skin from its time on the grill, crossed with slits in which brine has been introduced into the fish. Another light coating of salt finishes the job, resulting in a hardy, nutritious travel food. During good years, the rivers of the Frost Marches are thick with these fish as they head upstream to spawn, making them a traditional staple. | The largest bundle of this ensemble is a cluster of tightly wrapped dry sausages. The tight casings keep the meat within compact and ready to eat. In the cold weather of the Frost Marches sausage keeps nigh on forever, and ends up being a popular choice for travel meals as a result. These particular rolls [rand|smell strongly of garlic|smell vaguely of pepper|have a smell akin to sweet apples|have a salty sweet smell that tickles your nose]. ] [rand| In addition to the main course, there's a large wheel of goat cheese. Aged in damp, cold caverns or cellars, this firm white cheese bears a heady odour to it, and promises to bear the sharp bite cherished by many in Hawkethorne and Harvest Valley. Thin veins of green and blue streaking through the wheel show the mold used in its aging — indeed, the whole reason the cheese keeps is because it's technically already rotting. The mold was supposedly brought to the region by the old Belhar Empire, which found the climate of the Frost Marches perfect for cheese ripening. Strange, but given how fantastic the tales of that old civilization are, this is practically mundane in comparison. | The next thing you fish out of the bundles is a large pot of yoghurt, a distinct sour smell rising from it as you undo the seal and pop it open. It's hard to tell what kind of milk it came from — could be cow, goat, sheep, gods, the rumours even say that the minotaurs of Khor'minos make it out of their womenfolk's breast milk, putting it in hide bags to churn and ferment while they travel. No, that's not a thought you want to entertain right before eating. | In one of the smaller bundles, you discover a jar of pickled cabbage. Growing season for leafy vegetables tends to be relatively short this far north — to compensate, gardeners grow far more than they could hope to eat while it's warm, then preserve the rest in vinegar, garlic and spicy herbs. There're a couple of onions swimming in there, too — definitely not food for the weak-stomached. With food like this, you either beat it, or it beats you. | Coming up on that is a plethora of nuts, spilling out in all directions as you unwrap the wax paper. Hazelnuts and walnuts, roasted over an open flame until glossy and hard — they keep forever, so long as they don't come into contact with moisture. A handful of dried mushrooms and anchovies have been thrown in for variety, forming a well-balanced side dish. | Off to the side, there's a heavy glass jar filled to the brim with root vegetables of all kinds — turnips, carrots, onions, radishes, and a handful of garlic cloves for good measure. The lot has been jarred, sealed and then boiled in brine in a huge heavy iron pot, rendering them impervious so long as the jar remains sealed. Hardtack is impressive, but there are local legends of people in Hawkethorne finding jars of this stuff from their great-grandparents' time in their root cellars, still well-preserved and perfectly edible. ] [rand| Last but not least, there's a bag of dried fruit. Once, this might have been a bountiful mound of fruit straight from Harvest Valley; fresh blackberries, swollen with juice, nearly bursting; golden apples, still wet with morning dew; grapes piled high in alternating clumps of green and purple. The stuff of dreams, a handful of which would certainly last you at least a day. Now, the blackberries are all wrinkly, the apples sliced and coated with a dusting of fine sugar, and the grapes better known as raisins. Still mighty fine, though. | The last of the bundles holds a small measure of honey in a clay jar. Beekeeping is common in Harvest Valley, as most farms keep a hive or two to pollinate the orchards and crops. However, it's so valuable as a food in its own right — let alone as a sweetener or preservative — that few farms have any excess to sell. Whatever homestead this jar came from must have had an excellent year. | Finally, there're a handful of hard candies, each one perhaps half the size of a hen's egg. Finely minced nuts mixed with caramelised sweet sap — your teeth would break if you tried to bite into these. A traditional elf favorite, the warrior women of the Winter City sometimes carry these to sustain themselves on long marches or on patrol. | The final bundle you unwrap contains a number of blackberry jam tarts, tightly packed in the wax paper. Odd that these would be in trail rations; pastries aren't particularly known for their resistance to spoilage. Then again, these aren't exactly your run-of-the-mill tarts — they're more jam than anything else, encased in a thin, hard shell of baked pastry. The jam is cloyingly sweet, and is clearly made to be eaten with something to drink in hand. ] [party.isJustPC| Now that's quite the spread! It feels like a bit of a waste to eat it all alone, but at the very least you won't be complaining that you're still hungry after all of this. Using the remnants of the wax paper to protect your meal from the elements, you sit down to dig in. It's a while before you're finally done, having to eat the lot by yourself, but when you're well and truly finished you have to shake off the impulse to have a lie-down. Sleeping here without anyone to watch your back wouldn't be a good idea. | [party.comp cait brint berwyn arona etheryn atugia |"Never quite appreciated the importance of a hot meal until I started traveling with Father and Calla," Cait says wistfully. "Say what you like, as least we got hot meals three times a day at the temple, maybe more if some petitioners came in and had a particular kink for that kind of thing. There's something about sitting down at a table that pulling out something salted and wrapped in wax paper just doesn't capture, and it's neither taste nor texture." | "No matter how long it's been since I left the Undermountain, I still can't get used to the tiny portions you lot have," Brint says, rubbing his head a little sheepishly. "How do you live on so little? I'd starve." Well, it's a good thing that you saved him a minotaur-sized portion, right? Brint laughs and claps you on the back. "I like the way you think, [pc.name]." | "This reminds me of mealtimes with Mistress," Berwyn says with a little sigh. "Before... that happened. Things were happier back then... why couldn't it all have stayed the same?" On the other hand, if it's any small consolation... if things had stayed the same, he wouldn't have met you. Berwyn says nothing to that, the dogboy simply applying himself to his food as if wishing to bury his sorrows. | "Needs more meat," Arona mutters as she picks at her food. "Needs more of everything, really. Good thing I'm carrying my own extras on me." Well, she's a big girl. Big girls eat big; it's only to be expected. She just grins toothily at you. "Tell you what, let's stop to camp and I'll show you something else that's big." | "I used to sit at feasts in the palace with the highest nobles of the pale elves," Ryn says with a sigh, her eyes downcast. "We had everything one could ever hope for served up at our table... but Alissa managed to make everything turn to ashes in my mouth by her mere presence." You nod. "This may be simple fare, really, but it tastes much better than anything the Winter City could bring to bear. I'm glad to be out here with you." | "It all looks so good! I'll never understand how people up north manage to package high class meals into storable packages," Atugia licks her lips as she stares at the various food items. You raise an eyebrow, unsure if she's being serious, but the look in her eyes seems genuine. Well, all the better if someone considers it a feast. ] With that, [party.combatNames] tuck into the spread, and a good thing, too — it'd have been a waste to eat this all alone, and food's always better when shared with others. ] Well, that's that. You wipe the last crumbs from your mouth, and spend a few moments cleaning up your little picnic before preparing to set off once more."

rows.original: The colorless liquid within the flute-necked bottle radiates a pervasive feeling of sadness, as impossible as that ought to be. Golden motes of light pulse within its clear depths, swarming from one side of the glass to another in response to one touching the bottle's featureless surface; otherwise, it looks no different from simple spring water. As one continues to stare through the liquid, one steadily gains a sense of disconnected clarity, as if taking on a new perspective on life, a powerful sense of redemption... ... Either way, it's very possible that this liquid and perhaps even the bottle itself did not originate on Savarra. Use to revive a downed ally in combat.
rows.translation: 那个细长瓶颈的玻璃瓶中盛着的无色液体，散发着一种弥漫人心的悲伤气息，尽管这种感觉本该是不可能存在的。在它清澈的液体深处，金色的光点正在闪烁跳动，每当有人触碰到瓶子那毫无特色的表面时，这些光点就会从瓶子的一侧飞向另一侧；否则，这种液体看起来与普通的泉水并无任何区别。当人们持续凝视着这种液体时，会逐渐产生一种仿佛与现实脱节的清晰感，仿佛获得了看待生活的全新视角，一种强烈的救赎感…… ……无论如何，这种液体，甚至这个瓶子本身，很可能并非源自萨瓦拉星球。 在战斗中用于复活被击倒的盟友。

rows.original: When the elite of the old Belharan Empire wanted to flaunt their wealth, they served razorcup nectar. The piercing thorns and finger-slicing leaves of the plant made extraction of the nectar a hazardous procedure, and the average blossom yielded but a drop of the sweet, clear liquid; a small shot was the result of a hundred laborers working months to grow, harvest and process the thorny blossoms into something worth imbibing. Despite the cost, many nevertheless paid for the genuine article. Taste aside, razorcup nectar was said to open the mind to new experiences, something the elite of Behlar were desperate for in their gilded ennui. How this tiny thimbleful has survived until this day, you don't know. On use, grants the boon "Razorcup Nectar," which grants +10 accuracy and +10 evasion; and +25 attack power, spellpower, and sexiness.

德鲁伊卷轴匣
德鲁伊卷轴匣

rows.original: An ancient scroll case, painted with swirling green druidic sigils and sealed with wax. Gods only know how old it is. Use this to read the contents within.
rows.translation: 一个古老的卷轴盒，上面绘满了旋转的绿色德鲁伊符号，并用蜡封住了。只有神才知道它有多古老。使用这个卷轴盒来阅读里面的内容吧。
rows.raw: "An ancient scroll case, painted with swirling green druidic sigils and sealed with wax. Gods only know how old it is. Use this to read the contents within."

rows.original: The wax seal on the scroll case breaks with barely any force, and you delicately extricate its contents: a set of ancient scrolls, no surprise, though they're written in Belharan — at least the first one is, anyway. The rest appear to be a set of spells, marked down with ancient runes in a shaky, timid hand. The enemy is closing. Whatever the enemy even is! Wraiths, we've taken to calling them, shadows that move and writhe. Demons that strip you of yourself. Archdruid Xadaron is nowhere to be found. The sickness must have taken him, too. Baron Revarra's men are all dead. The foreigners have broken and fled, all except the raccoon woman and a handful of southerners that survived the explosion in the river-fort. Archmagister Oxana is preparing us for a breakout. We're going to the Hornpeaks, where we've heard someone brought down one of the demons. I am not sure I believe it, but I have to have hope in something. I did not think anything could harm them. If there is a way, then we have to learn — we have to study it. The Archmagister's tower is there, east of a place she calls the Steps of Sorra, and she promises we will find shelter there. In the meantime, I will leave behind what Oxana has taught me, just in case. At least these spells can harm the wraith-hearted we fight, before the shadow demons arrive. If you find this, may the Wyld guide you to safety, for what little we have found now runs thin. A grim final account from centuries ago. [party.has cait|"That was hard to read," Cait murmurs from over your shoulder. "Poor things must have been terrified. Imagine facing down a Wraith before the gods revealed themselves."] [party.has etheryn|Ryn frowns. "The druids had no idea what they were dealing with, but they already knew they couldn't fight them..."] The spell scrolls the author left behind were never used by someone to fight the Wraiths, but perhaps you could employ them against more modern demons.
rows.translation: 卷轴盒上的蜡封几乎不需要用力就能被拆开，你小心翼翼地取出了里面的物品：一套古老的卷轴，这并不奇怪，不过这些卷轴是用贝尔哈兰语写成的——至少第一份卷轴是这样。剩下的那些卷轴似乎是一系列咒语，上面用古老的符文记录了下来，而这些符文显然是用颤抖而稚嫩的手迹写成的。 敌人正在逼近。不管敌人究竟是什么！我们把这些东西称为“幽灵”——那些会移动、会扭动的阴影，那些会剥夺你自我意识的恶魔。 大德鲁伊扎达伦已经不见了，他肯定也中了那种瘟疫。雷瓦拉男爵的手下全都死了。那些外国人都已经逃走了，只有那个浣熊女人以及少数在河畔要塞的爆炸中幸存下来的南方人还留在那里。 大法师奥克萨娜正在为我们准备突围行动。我们要前往霍恩峰地区，因为听说有人在那里击败了一只恶魔。我不确定自己是否该相信这一切，但我总得对某些事情抱有希望。我原本以为没有什么东西能够伤害到他们。如果真的有办法的话，我们就必须去学习、去研究它。大法师的塔就在那里，位于她所说的“索拉阶梯”以东的地方，她承诺我们在那里能够找到庇护所。与此同时，我会把奥克萨娜教给我的那些方法留下来，以备不时之需。至少在这些阴影恶魔到来之前，这些法术还能对我们所对抗的那些心怀怨恨的生物造成伤害。 如果你找到了这个，愿荒野之力引导你走向安全之处，因为我们现在所拥有的这些资源已经所剩无几了。 几个世纪前留下的凄惨结局。 [party.has cait|那内容真让人难以理解，”凯特在你身后轻声说道，“那些可怜的生物肯定吓坏了。想象一下，在众神显现之前，它们竟然不得不面对那些幽灵……] [party.has etheryn|小琳皱起了眉头。“那些德鲁伊根本不知道自己正在面对什么，但他们早就意识到自己无法与它们抗衡……] 作者留下的那些法术卷轴，从来没有人用它们来对抗那些幽灵，但或许你可以用它们来对付那些更现代的恶魔。

奥克萨娜的魔法书
奥克萨娜的魔法书

rows.original: A grimoire of arcane lore compiled by the Archmagister Oxana. It smells like manticore nip and ashes. Use it to obtain her knowledge.
rows.translation: 这本由大法师奥克萨娜编纂的神秘学典籍，散发着曼提科尔兽香与灰烬的气息。利用它，你就能获得她的智慧与知识。
rows.raw: "A grimoire of arcane lore compiled by the Archmagister Oxana. It smells like manticore nip and ashes. Use it to obtain her knowledge. "

rows.original: You crack open the grimoire, only for a letter to fall out from where it's long been pressed between the evergreen tree cover and the first pages of script. It's written in an elegant, flowing hand; crimson ink upon expensive vellum. The magic preserving the spellbook itself must have also kept this from being destroyed by the passage of years and the harsh blizzards on the mountaintops. That thrice-accursed twink Caedwynn has doomed us all, but I refuse to die quietly. The Minoan sailors say this monster is the same one that swallowed Dracia and its dragons. They've been tracking it while it devours the coast. They say it's behaving strangely now. Perhaps it's gorged itself full to bursting. It doesn't matter. It's headed inland now. You cannot kill these demons any more than you can kill a god. We've learned that the hard way. They are immune to our magic and our blades. We have also learned that these things have a deep and driving hunger to flense the spirits from our bodies, leaving only husks behind. Husks touched by their dark power, left mindless and bloodthirsty. I refuse to let that be my fate. No creature is without weakness. The demons' hunger must be theirs. If we are to die, let it be trying to bring down what can't be killed. Let it be an attempt to exploit that weakness, and see if a shadow can be brought to heel. One of the young mages I brought with me, a girl from across the sea, is with child. Children, several of them. Mine. These demons hunger for souls? I have them in abundance. In the face of apocalypse, nothing is forbidden. If a shadow demon cannot be killed, we will see if it can be lured. If it can be bound. Nareva forgive me for what I am about to do, but there is no price too great to pay when all the world is at stake. Your lips draw taut reading that. Good gods, the desperation. The madness of it. Besides the letter, there remains the contents of the spellbook to peruse...
rows.translation: 你翻开那本魔法书，一封长期夹在绘有常青树的封面与开篇书页之间的信随之掉了出来。信上的字迹优雅流畅，以猩红墨水写在昂贵的犊皮纸上。保护魔法书本身的法术想必也让这封信免遭岁月侵蚀与山巅暴风雪的摧残。 那个该遭三重诅咒的小白脸凯德温害惨了我们所有人，但我绝不肯悄无声息地死去。 米诺斯水手说，这头怪物与吞噬达拉西亚及其巨龙的是同一个。他们一路追踪着它，看它吞噬海岸。水手们说，它如今的举止很反常。也许它已经饱胀到了极点。那不重要。它现在正向内陆进发。 这些恶魔就像神明一样，根本无法杀死。我们付出惨痛代价才明白这一点。我们的魔法与刀剑都伤不了它们。我们还发现，这些东西怀有一种深沉而强烈的饥渴，想把灵魂从我们的肉体中剥离，只留下躯壳。被它们的黑暗力量侵染的躯壳，会失去心智、嗜血成狂。我绝不接受那样的命运。 没有任何生物毫无弱点。恶魔的饥渴必定就是它们的弱点。 如果我们注定要死，那也要死在试图扳倒不可杀之物的路上。让我们利用那项弱点，看看能否令暗影屈服。 我带来的年轻法师中，有个来自海对岸的女孩怀孕了。怀了几个孩子。我的孩子。那些恶魔渴求灵魂？我这里多的是。末日当前，再无禁忌。 如果暗影恶魔无法被杀死，我们就试试能否把它引来。能否将它束缚。 娜瑞瓦，请宽恕我即将犯下的罪行；但当整个世界都命悬一线时，再高的代价也值得支付。 读到这里，你紧抿双唇。诸神在上，这是何等绝望，又是何等疯狂。 除了这封信，魔法书本身的内容也仍待你翻阅……
