rows.translation: 下一步
便当盒
便当盒

rows.original: A lunchbox, wrapped in cloth and containing various non-perishable foods in the style of Kiyoko's homeland. There's even enough to go around should you have friends with you. Maximizes the entire party's Willpower and grants Well-Fed for 24 hours.
rows.translation: 一个用布包裹好的午餐盒，里面装着各种不易变质的食物，这些食物的制作风格体现了清子的家乡风味。如果还有朋友一起用餐，里面的食物也足够分给大家。 使整个团队的意志力达到最高值，并在24小时内持续提供“营养充足”的状态。
rows.raw: "A lunchbox, wrapped in cloth and containing various non-perishable foods in the style of Kiyoko's homeland. There's even enough to go around should you have friends with you.\n\n Maximizes the entire party's Willpower and grants Well-Fed for 24 hours."

rows.translation: 观察者

rows.original: [party.has kiyoko |Upon seeing you take out the packed meal from your things, Kiyoko gives you a little frown. "That was the meal I packed for you some time ago when I wasn't traveling with you..." She did say the food was non-perishable and would keep for weeks. "Even so..." she holds her arms under her [kiyoko.numKits 16|motherly ]chest. "It means that you have not been taking care of yourself as you should." Well, you are now, so there's that. Come on, there's no need for her to be mad — why don't you enjoy the food she was so kind to prepare together? |You take out the packed meal from your things and smile. Even across all this distance and time, you can feel Kiyoko's warmth reaching out to your hands, as if she were there. Ah... well, there's no point in standing about here and reminiscing when there's more important work to be done, like actually polishing off this meal. ] First to go is the wrapping cloth — you put that away carefully. If nothing else, Kiyoko can use it to wrap the next meal she makes for you... the airtight box is a bit of a struggle to open without going overboard and sending the contents all over the place, but eventually the lid comes loose with a pop and rush of air. Your fox-wife truly has spared no expense in even a packed meal — despite the simplicity of the cooked rice, preserves and salted and dried odds and ends, everything's been artistically arranged in beautiful fashion, set firmly against or into the rice so that it won't go out of place despite the jostling and shifting of travel. No wonder the box felt so full... Unlike your time together on the Astral Plane, Kiyoko can't conjure up delicacies for you out of the ether, but this — real, tangible, sweet — is so much more evocative of... of what, exactly? Ah... You spend the next few minutes [party.hasCompanions|scarfing the lot down|sharing the box's contents with [party.compNames]]. It feels a little sacreligious to be eating such a work of art and in such a fashion to boot, but it would be even more terrible to let it all go to waste, wouldn't it? But at the end of it all, you feel warm and full inside, content in a way that goes beyond the physical. Ahh... time to get a move on, then. Wouldn't do to let all this energy go to waste.
rows.translation: [party.has kiyoko |当看到你从包里拿出那份打包好的食物时，清子微微皱了皱眉头。那是我之前没有和你一起旅行的时候，为你准备的食物…… 她确实说过，这份食物不易腐坏，能保存好几个星期。 “即便如此……”她将双臂抱在[kiyoko.numKits 16|母亲般丰满的]胸脯下方。“这说明你没有好好照顾自己。” 好吧，你现在开始照顾自己了，总算不迟。好了，她没必要生气——不如一起享用她精心准备的食物？ |你从背包里拿出那份打包好的食物，露出了微笑。即使隔着这么远的距离和漫长的时间，你依然能感受到清子的温暖，仿佛她就在你身边一样。啊……不过，现在有更重要的事情要做，比如赶紧吃完这份食物，所以在这里沉溺于回忆也没什么意义。 ] 首先要把包装布收好——一定要小心存放。就算没有其他用途，清子也可以用它来包裹下次为你准备的食物……而那个密封盒打开起来确实有点麻烦，如果不小心的话，里面的东西就会散得到处都是，不过最终盖子还是会“啪”的一声打开，同时也会有空气冲出来。你的狐狸妻子在准备这份简单的饭菜时确实花费了不少心思——虽然只是煮熟的米饭，再加上一些腌制品和风干的食物，但这一切都被她巧妙地摆放得非常美观，紧紧地固定在米饭上，这样在旅途中即使受到颠簸，这些食物也不会移位。难怪这个盒子看起来那么满…… 与你们在星界中共度的时光不同，清子无法从虚无中为你变出美味的食物，但这个——真实、可触、甜美的东西——却更能唤起一种……一种什么感觉呢？ 啊…… 在接下来的几分钟里，你[party.hasCompanions|狼吞虎咽地吃光饭菜|与[party.compNames]分享盒中的食物]。吃掉这样一件艺术品，而且还是以这样的方式来食用它，确实有点违背常理，但让这些美食白白浪费掉，那才真是太可惜了，不是吗？不过，吃完之后，你会感到内心温暖而满足，这种满足感远远超出了物质层面的享受。 啊……那么，是时候继续行动了。可不能让这些能量白白浪费掉啊。

Come on, there's no need for her to be mad — why don't you enjoy the food she was so kind to prepare together? |You take out the packed meal from your things and smile. Even across all this distance and time, you can feel Kiyoko's warmth reaching out to your hands, as if she were there. Ah... well, there's no point in standing about here and reminiscing when there's more important work to be done, like actually polishing off this meal. ] First to go is the wrapping cloth — you put that away carefully. If nothing else, Kiyoko can use it to wrap the next meal she makes for you... the airtight box is a bit of a struggle to open without going overboard and sending the contents all over the place, but eventually the lid comes loose with a pop and rush of air. Your fox-wife truly has spared no expense in even a packed meal — despite the simplicity of the cooked rice, preserves and salted and dried odds and ends, everything's been artistically arranged in beautiful fashion, set firmly against or into the rice so that it won't go out of place despite the jostling and shifting of travel. No wonder the box felt so full... Unlike your time together on the Astral Plane, Kiyoko can't conjure up delicacies for you out of the ether, but this — real, tangible, sweet — is so much more evocative of... of what, exactly? Ah... You spend the next few minutes [party.hasCompanions|scarfing the lot down|sharing the box's contents with [party.compNames]]. It feels a little sacreligious to be eating such a work of art and in such a fashion to boot, but it would be even more terrible to let it all go to waste, wouldn't it? But at the end of it all, you feel warm and full inside, content in a way that goes beyond the physical. Ahh... time to get a move on, then. Wouldn't do to let all this energy go to waste."

rows.translation: 下一步
果汁
果汁

rows.original: A ceramic jug of holding a viscous violet mixture of brazenberry ale, conjuror's concoction and winterstem, plus whatever Nina did to it. This dream-alcoholic gunk will grant you second sight for a full day, maximising your Penetration, Critical Chance and Evasion as if their relevant base stats were maximised. This effect is a boon.
rows.translation: 这个陶瓷罐里装着一种粘稠的紫色混合物——由铜莓啤酒、巫师秘制配方以及冬茎酒调制而成，再加上妮娜添加的某些成分。这种神奇的酒精混合物能让你拥有整整一天的“第二视力”，使你的穿透力、暴击几率和闪避能力得到极大提升，仿佛这些属性的初始值已经被提升到了最高水平。这种效果简直太棒了。
rows.raw: "A ceramic jug of holding a viscous violet mixture of brazenberry ale, conjuror's concoction and winterstem, plus whatever Nina did to it. This dream-alcoholic gunk will grant you second sight for a full day, maximising your Penetration, Critical Chance and Evasion as if their relevant base stats were maximised. This effect is a boon."

rows.translation: 观察者

rows.original: You sigh, relax your mind, and unstopper the jug before tipping your head back and downing the contents in several deep swallows. The juice is viscous and clings to your throat as it slides on down, but it has yet to settle before its effects kick in: a brief sense of disorientation kicks in as a world of potential possibilities opens up before you. Six senses feeding into a mind made for five... at least the effects will only last a day or so, because you might very well go mad if this stuck with you for the rest of your life.
rows.translation: 你叹了口气，放松心情，然后拧开罐子的盖子，仰头将里面的液体一饮而尽。这种果汁黏稠度很高，流下喉咙时会附着在黏膜上，但还没等它完全咽下去，效果就已经显现了——一阵短暂的眩晕感袭来，与此同时，一个充满各种可能性的新世界在你面前展开了。六种感官的信息输入到一个原本只为五种感官而设计的大脑中……至少这种效果只会持续一天左右，因为如果这种感觉伴随你一生，你很可能会发疯的。
rows.raw: "\n        You sigh, relax your mind, and unstopper the jug before tipping your head back and downing the contents in several deep swallows. The juice is viscous and clings to your throat as it slides on down, but it has yet to settle before its effects kick in: a brief sense of disorientation kicks in as a world of potential possibilities opens up before you. Six senses feeding into a mind made for five... at least the effects will only last a day or so, because you might very well go mad if this stuck with you for the rest of your life."

母马苹果酒

rows.original: A stored container of Callie's cider, straight from the tap. Even with the stopper in, you can smell a strong scent of apple emanating from within. Maximizes Agility for 24 hours.
rows.translation: 这是一瓶直接从酒桶龙头接取的凯莉自酿苹果酒。即使塞着瓶塞，你仍能闻到浓郁的苹果香气。 使敏捷达到最大值，持续24小时。
rows.raw: "A stored container of Callie's cider, straight from the tap. Even with the stopper in, you can smell a strong scent of apple emanating from within.\n \n Maximizes Agility for 24 hours."

rows.original: You pull the stopper off the container of cider and tip your head back. Every drop pours down your throat over a couple gulps, and by the second swallow you feel the rush of sugar kicking in. The feeling lingers when you're finished drinking, and you feel like the rushed feeling extends to every movement and reflexive action you take. It makes you wonder if Callie feels like this all the time, or if it's just a side effect of her cider.
rows.translation: 你拔掉苹果酒容器的塞子，仰起头将酒一饮而尽。每一滴酒都迅速流入你的喉咙，随着几口下去，你立刻感受到了糖分带来的刺激感。这种感觉在你喝完酒后依然持续，仿佛你的每一个动作和反应都受到了这种影响。你不禁想知道，凯莉是否总是有这种感觉，还是说这只是她喝的这种苹果酒带来的副作用而已。

It makes you wonder if Callie feels like this all the time, or if it's just a side effect of her cider."

rows.translation: 观察者

rows.original: Although you could have hoped for better circumstances under which to study it, you break the manual's wax seal and begin to read. After an hour's laboring with the difficult, spidery writing, you're able to commit the techniques within to memory. While the words on the yellowed paper etch indelible patterns in your thoughts, the pages grow brittle, then crumble slowly between your fingers like sun-dried leaves; all that's left is to put what you've learned into practice and get your body up to speed with your mind.
rows.translation: 虽然你本可以期待在更理想的环境中学习这些内容，但最终还是拆开了手册的封蜡，开始阅读起来。经过一个小时的努力，你终于弄懂了那些晦涩难懂的文字，并将其中的内容牢记在心。当那些写在发黄纸张上的文字在你脑海中留下难以磨灭的印象时，这些纸张却逐渐变得脆弱，最终像被阳光晒干的树叶一样，在你手指间慢慢碎裂；此刻，你所能做的，就是将所学的知识付诸实践，让自己的行动速度跟上思维的速度。

rows.translation: 观察者

rows.original: Although you could have hoped for better circumstances under which to study it, you break the manual's wax seal and begin to read. After an hour's laboring with the difficult, spidery writing, you're able to commit the techniques within to memory. While the words on the yellowed paper etch indelible patterns in your thoughts, the pages grow brittle, then crumble slowly between your fingers like sun-dried leaves; all that's left is to put what you've learned into practice and get your body up to speed with your mind.
rows.translation: 虽然你本可以期待在更理想的环境中学习这些内容，但最终还是拆开了手册的封蜡，开始阅读起来。经过一个小时的努力，你终于弄懂了那些晦涩难懂的文字，并将其中的内容牢记在心。当那些写在发黄纸张上的文字在你脑海中留下难以磨灭的印象时，这些纸张却逐渐变得脆弱，最终像被阳光晒干的树叶一样，在你手指间慢慢碎裂；此刻，你所能做的，就是将所学的知识付诸实践，让自己的行动速度跟上思维的速度。
rows.raw: "\n        Although you could have hoped for better circumstances under which to study it, you break the manual's wax seal and begin to read. After an hour's laboring with the difficult, spidery writing, you're able to commit the techniques within to memory. While the words on the yellowed paper etch indelible patterns in your thoughts, the pages grow brittle, then crumble slowly between your fingers like sun-dried leaves; all that's left is to put what you've learned into practice and get your body up to speed with your mind."

rows.raw: "A tome of forbidden magic, copied from the body of Ynes of Courlund, a witch made Dreamless by the Order Astrida for her crimes. Includes a corpus of spells ripe to be learned."

rows.original: [var0|You contemplate the book in your hands, flipping through its pages, all full of familiar contents. There's nothing left for you to learn here, but there's something oddly comforting about having these spell-runes so close at hand...|You take a seat and crack open the Astridan spellbook, cradling it in your lap as you begin to flip through its pages. The runes within are a mad scrawl of swirling occult shapes, hashed onto the page with a frantic hand. You can see why — your head starts swimming before you've flipped past the first page of the spell you've chosen to read, like someone's sticking a dagger of flame into the base of your skull and started to twist. You make it quick, studying as hard and as fast as you can, committing each rune to memory in a frenzy of darting eyes and flipping pages. A few minutes is all you can stand before you slam the book closed, tearing your gaze away from it. The image of the runes lingets in your vision, imprinted there by their own magic, fading only slow. But the memory doesn't wane. You've learned the [var1] spell!]

rows.original: You unjar the bottle and sigh, gently shaking the contents around before plucking out the contents. You place the first lens on your eye, trying not to feel too alarmed at the sudden change in color of the world — at least until you blink. Once you do so it's just barely possible to feel the lens settle slowly into place, and when next your eyelids open everything... looks normal. With a shrug you do the other eye, pausing only momentarily at the temporary discomfort before you're blinking tears away. [party.som|You shake your head and look around for something reflective, but once you manage it becomes obvious; you have [pc.eyeColor] eyes.|You look towards [companion.name], who makes sure to lean in and get a really good look at you... rows.raw: "Applied to the face or head, will prevent the growth of hair."

rows.original: The tangy, acrid scent on this stuff makes your mouth water and your skin crawl, but it looks like it can be applied to your head or face.
rows.translation: 这种东西散发出的刺鼻气味会让人流口水、皮肤发痒，但看起来它可以被涂抹在头部或脸上。
rows.raw: "\n        The tangy, acrid scent on this stuff makes your mouth water and your skin crawl, but it looks like it can be applied to your head or face."

rows.translation: 头发

rows.original: Suppressing a shiver at the smell of this scrub, you quickly mash the thick paste into your scalp and start to rub, trying to get things nice and deep. After that is a short wait for the scrub to take effect. It's definitely torture waiting for the ticklish sensation and the building heat to stop, but once it does you can finally rinse your [pc.hair] clean. Your hair growth has stopped!
rows.translation: 闻到这种磨砂膏的气味，你不禁打了个寒颤，但还是迅速将浓稠的膏体涂抹在头皮上，然后开始揉搓，努力让它深入头皮。接下来，就需要耐心等待一段时间，让这种磨砂膏发挥效果。 等待那种刺痒的感觉以及头皮逐渐发热的过程确实很煎熬，但一旦这些症状消失，你终于可以把[pc.hair]冲洗干净了。你的头发生长已经停止了！
rows.raw: " Suppressing a shiver at the smell of this scrub, you quickly mash the thick paste into your scalp and start to rub, trying to get things nice and deep. After that is a short wait for the scrub to take effect. It's definitely torture waiting for the ticklish sensation and the building heat to stop, but once it does you can finally rinse your [pc.hair] clean. Your hair growth has stopped! "

rows.translation: 下一步
将其涂抹在头发上。

rows.original: Your hair growth has already been stopped.
rows.translation: 你的头发生长已经停止了。
rows.raw: "Your hair growth has already been stopped."

rows.translation: 胡子

rows.original: It feels unsafe to be putting something that smells like this so close to your face, but you suck your lips in, grit your teeth to the discomfort, and rub the scrub into your waiting flesh. The effect is almost instantaneous; it tickles and itches, growing hot as the elixir within does its wicked work to you... thankfully it only lasts for a minute or two before you can wash the scrub clean again. Your facial-hair growth has stopped!
rows.translation: 把这种有这种气味的东西放在这么靠近脸部的地方，确实会让人觉得不太安全。但你必须咬住嘴唇，忍住那种不适感，然后把这种磨砂膏涂抹在需要护理的皮肤上。 效果几乎是立竿见影的——你会感到皮肤一阵阵发痒、发热，因为里面的成分正在起作用……不过幸运的是，这种感觉只持续一两分钟，之后你就可以把磨砂膏洗干净了。你的面部毛发已经停止生长了！
rows.raw: " It feels unsafe to be putting something that smells like this so close to your face, but you suck your lips in, grit your teeth to the discomfort, and rub the scrub into your waiting flesh. The effect is almost instantaneous; it tickles and itches, growing hot as the elixir within does its wicked work to you... thankfully it only lasts for a minute or two before you can wash the scrub clean again. Your facial-hair growth has stopped! "

rows.translation: 下一步
用它来打理你的胡须吧。

rows.original: Your beard has already stopped growing.
rows.translation: 你的胡子已经不再长了。
算了
促毛药水
促毛药水

rows.original: A potion to increase your hair length a few inches. Also resumes passive hair-growth!
rows.translation: 一种能让头发长度增加几英寸的药剂，同时还能重新激活头发的自然生长功能！
rows.raw: "A potion to increase your hair length a few inches. Also resumes passive hair-growth!"

rows.original: Itchy. That's the first word you would use to describe this stuff. You pour out the thick liquid directly onto your head, hurriedly massaging the potion into your scalp. The effort of going slowly and not scratching away wildly is enough to have your hands shaking and your eyes screwed shut, but eventually that itch wears off... In fact drawing your fingers through your hair reveals... well, lots of hair to draw your fingers through; [pc.hairRange 1 3|you've got some nice short hair|you've got lovely long hair]. [flags.HAIR_GROW_OFF|It looks like your natural hair-growth has resumed again, however.]
rows.translation: 痒。这应该是你用来描述这种东西的第一个词。 你把这种浓稠的液体直接倒在头上，然后急忙将其涂抹在头皮上。为了不抓得太过用力而造成伤害，你不得不尽量动作轻柔，这种努力让你的双手开始颤抖，眼睛也不自觉地闭上了……不过，最终那种痒感还是消退了…… 事实上，当你用手指穿过自己的头发时，你会发现……嗯，自己的头发确实很多，足以让你的手指在其中穿梭。[pc.hairRange 1 3|你的短发看起来真的很漂亮。|你的头发又长又漂亮。]。 [flags.HAIR_GROW_OFF|不过，看起来你的自然头发生长又恢复了吧。]
rows.raw: " Itchy. That's the first word you would use to describe this stuff. You pour out the thick liquid directly onto your head, hurriedly massaging the potion into your scalp. The effort of going slowly and not scratching away wildly is enough to have your hands shaking and your eyes screwed shut, but eventually that itch wears off... In fact drawing your fingers through your hair reveals... well, lots of hair to draw your fingers through; [pc.hairRange 1 3|you've got some nice short hair|you've got lovely long hair]. [flags.HAIR_GROW_OFF|It looks like your natural hair-growth has resumed again, however.] "

rows.translation: 下一步
胡须生长药水
胡须生长药水

rows.original: A potion to grow out your facial fuzz a few inches. Also resumes passive beard-growth!
rows.translation: 一种能让面部胡须生长几英寸的药剂，同时还能重新激活胡须的自然生长机制！
rows.raw: "A potion to grow out your facial fuzz a few inches. Also resumes passive beard-growth!"

rows.original: You'd expected some discomfort after pouring this out into your hand and running it along your face. Shivers erupt unconsciously across your body as you feel your pores open, heat spread across your jawline, and your beard begin to grow... You're also quick to rinse your hands off; there are plenty enough old wives' tales about hairy palms. After a few minutes of prickling and warmth, the scent of whatever goes into these potions comes to a halt. Just a soft trail of your [pc.nails] through your beard shows there's plenty springy face-fuzz waiting for you. [pc.beardRange 1 3 5|You've got a short beard now!|That's a handsome thick beard you've got there.|That's an impressively long beard you're now sporting.] [flags.BEARD_GROW_OFF|It would also appear that your natural beard-growth has resumed.]
rows.translation: 当你将这些液体倒在手上，然后涂抹在脸上时，你本以为会感到一些不适。不知不觉中，你的全身开始发抖，因为你感觉到自己的毛孔正在张开，热量沿着下颌线扩散，而你的胡须也开始生长…… 你也会立刻冲洗双手，因为关于手掌上长毛的迷信说法实在太多了。 几分钟后，那种刺痛感和温暖感逐渐消失，那些成分散发出的气味也渐渐消失了。只留下了一丝淡淡的香味[pc.nails]从你的胡须来看，显然还有许多柔软的胡须毛发在等着你呢。[pc.beardRange 1 3 5|你现在留着短胡子了呢！|你的胡子可真浓密，看起来很帅呢。|你现在留的胡子可真长啊，真是令人印象深刻。] [flags.BEARD_GROW_OFF|看来你的自然胡须生长已经恢复了。]
rows.raw: " You'd expected some discomfort after pouring this out into your hand and running it along your face. Shivers erupt unconsciously across your body as you feel your pores open, heat spread across your jawline, and your beard begin to grow... You're also quick to rinse your hands off; there are plenty enough old wives' tales about hairy palms. After a few minutes of prickling and warmth, the scent of whatever goes into these potions comes to a halt. Just a soft trail of your [pc.nails] through your beard shows there's plenty springy face-fuzz waiting for you. [pc.beardRange 1 3 5|You've got a short beard now!|That's a handsome thick beard you've got there.|That's an impressively long beard you're now sporting.] [flags.BEARD_GROW_OFF|It would also appear that your natural beard-growth has resumed.] "

rows.translation: 下一步
上好面部磨砂膏
上好面部磨砂膏

rows.original: Clean and feminize that face of yours.
rows.translation: 把你的脸收拾得干净些，再弄得看起来更女性化一些。
rows.raw: "Clean and feminize that face of yours."

rows.original: There's a smell of peaches and cream from the cream you pour into your hands, although it's speckled with abrasive-looking bits of sand. Already the mixture is tingling on your skin, so you hurry with rubbing it thoroughly into your face. It feels like the dirt is being literally drawn right out of your pores, only to be rubbed away; the skin beneath feels beautifully smooth and fresh. After another ten or so minutes of careful application and rubbing, the facial scrub is all used up and your face is just a little bit raw... but hey, your face is looking a lot more feminine now.
rows.translation: 当你将这种乳霜涂抹在手上时，会闻到一股桃子和奶油的芬芳气息，不过乳霜表面还散布着一些看起来像沙粒的颗粒。这种混合物在接触到皮肤后立刻会让人感到一阵刺痒，因此你赶紧将其均匀地涂抹在脸上。感觉就像皮肤上的污垢真的被从毛孔里吸了出来，然后再被彻底擦掉；皮肤下面变得无比光滑、清新。 再仔细使用并擦拭大约十分钟之后，这款面部磨砂膏就被用完了，而你的脸也会变得有点微微发红……不过，嘿，你的脸现在看起来女性化了好多。。
rows.raw: " There's a smell of peaches and cream from the cream you pour into your hands, although it's speckled with abrasive-looking bits of sand. Already the mixture is tingling on your skin, so you hurry with rubbing it thoroughly into your face. It feels like the dirt is being literally drawn right out of your pores, only to be rubbed away; the skin beneath feels beautifully smooth and fresh. After another ten or so minutes of careful application and rubbing, the facial scrub is all used up and your face is just a little bit raw... but hey, your face is looking a lot more feminine now. "

rows.translation: 下一步
灰烬石
灰烬石

rows.original: A gray stone with just a trace of glowing red around the middle. It feels cold to the touch and looks rather mundane, but some blacksmiths still use the small red part for cheap jewelry. You can probably sell it for some coin.
rows.translation: 一块灰色的石头，中间仅有微弱的红色光芒。触感冰冷，外观也相当普通，但仍有些铁匠会利用那块红色的部分来制作廉价的饰品。你大概可以把它卖掉，换来一些钱吧。
rows.raw: "A gray stone with just a trace of glowing red around the middle. It feels cold to the touch and looks rather mundane, but some blacksmiths still use the small red part for cheap jewelry. You can probably sell it for some coin."

rows.translation: 余烬石
余烬石

rows.original: A blazingstone that has already lost part of its shine and heat. Merchants used to say that the soul trapped inside is already starting to die. Nowadays everyone knows that unless treated with the right technique, fresh air cools down the blazingstone and steals its color. This one can still be sold and treated, but will not regain the shine it has already lost.
rows.translation: 这块炽石已经失去了部分光泽与热度。商人们过去常说，被封印在其中的灵魂已经开始消亡。如今，大家都明白，除非用正确的方法进行处理，否则新鲜空气只会让炽石冷却下来，使其颜色褪去。这块炽石仍然可以出售并接受处理，但它再也无法恢复曾经拥有的光泽了。
rows.raw: "A blazingstone that has already lost part of its shine and heat. Merchants used to say that the soul trapped inside is already starting to die. Nowadays everyone knows that unless treated with the right technique, fresh air cools down the blazingstone and steals its color. This one can still be sold and treated, but will not regain the shine it has already lost."

rows.translation: 炽焰石
炽焰石

rows.original: A glowing red gemstone that feels searing to the touch. Merchants used to say that the stone has the soul of a fire elemental trapped inside and that you can feel its weak heartbeat when you hold it in your hand. Nowadays everyone knows that the only thing that you can feel when you hold a blazingstone for too long is your own hand burning. Still, it's a beautiful jewel commonly used in necklaces and rings, and will get you some money if you sell it.
rows.translation: 这种宝石呈现出炽热的红色，触感仿佛会被灼伤。商人们过去常说，这种宝石内部封印着火元素的灵魂，当你握在手中时，甚至能感受到它微弱的心跳。不过如今，大家都知道，如果长时间握住这种火焰宝石，只会让自己的手被烫伤。尽管如此，它仍然是一种非常美丽的宝石，常被用来制作项链和戒指；如果将其出售，也能带来不错的收益。
rows.raw: "A glowing red gemstone that feels searing to the touch. Merchants used to say that the stone has the soul of a fire elemental trapped inside and that you can feel its weak heartbeat when you hold it in your hand. Nowadays everyone knows that the only thing that you can feel when you hold a blazingstone for too long is your own hand burning. Still, it's a beautiful jewel commonly used in necklaces and rings, and will get you some money if you sell it."

rows.translation: 武器箱
武器箱

rows.original: A crate full of boreal elven weapons, crafted in the distant realm of Dracia. These are exceptional blades, bows, and staves — and enough to arm a whole platoon of fighters. Good thing you kept them from the clutches of the enemy.
rows.translation: 一箱装满了来自遥远达拉西亚王国的北方精灵武器。这些刀剑、弓箭和法杖都非常精良，足以装备一整个战斗小队。幸好你把它们从敌人手中夺了回来。
rows.raw: "A crate full of boreal elven weapons, crafted in the distant realm of Dracia. These are exceptional blades, bows, and staves — and enough to arm a whole platoon of fighters. Good thing you kept them from the clutches of the enemy."

rows.translation: 冰冻狗头人
冰冻狗头人

rows.original: A kobold you had literally stumbled upon in the frozen wastes of the Glacial Rift. It's still breathing, but only barely, and it needs a consistent, gentle source of heat in order to wake it from its near-death hibernation. Maybe you should stop to rest somewhere....
rows.translation: 你在冰川裂谷的冰封荒原中偶然发现了一只狗头人。它还在呼吸，但已经奄奄一息了，它需要持续、温和的热量才能从这种近乎死亡的休眠状态中苏醒过来。也许你应该找个地方停下来休息一下……
rows.raw: "A kobold you had literally stumbled upon in the frozen wastes of the Glacial Rift. It's still breathing, but only barely, and it needs a consistent, gentle source of heat in order to wake it from its near-death hibernation. Maybe you should stop to rest somewhere...."

rows.translation: 温暖羽翼
温暖羽翼

rows.original: A set of ragged clothing scraps from an older woman that you met on the street in the Wayfort, as well as a hot-to-the-touch downy feather. The woman drew a map on the palm of your hand, guiding you to the northeast of the Wayfort, with the instruction to bring her remains there.
rows.translation: 你在荒废驿堡街上遇到的一位老妇人留下的一堆破旧衣物碎片，以及一根柔软、温暖的绒毛。那位老妇人在你的手掌上画了一张地图，指引你前往荒废驿堡的东北方向，并嘱咐你将她的遗骸带到那里。
rows.raw: "A set of ragged clothing scraps from an older woman that you met on the street in the Wayfort, as well as a hot-to-the-touch downy feather. The woman drew a map on the palm of your hand, guiding you to the northeast of the Wayfort, with the instruction to bring her remains there."

rows.translation: 金币
金币

rows.original: A coin made of solid gold that you happened to come across in Matiha's Fortress in the Ways Between. A massive letter B is stamped into one of the faces of the coin. Being made of gold, it's sure to fetch a half-decent price!
rows.translation: 一枚由纯金制成的硬币，你恰好在“道路之间”的玛蒂哈要塞里发现了它。硬币的一面刻有一个巨大的字母“B”。由于是由黄金打造的，这种硬币肯定能卖个不错的价钱！
rows.raw: "A coin made of solid gold that you happened to come across in Matiha's Fortress in the Ways Between. A massive letter B is stamped into one of the faces of the coin. Being made of gold, it's sure to fetch a half-decent price!"

rows.translation: 追击者护甲套装加成:

rows.original: 2: +1 to the higher of your Agility and Presence
rows.translation: 2：将你的敏捷值与气场中较高的那个数值增加1。
rows.raw: "2: +1 to the higher of your Agility and Presence "

rows.original: 4: The lower of Agility and Presence has its score equalled to the higher
rows.translation: 4：敏捷与气场中数值较低的一项提升至与较高项相同。
rows.raw: "4: The lower of Agility and Presence has its score equalled to the higher "

rows.translation: （已激活）
（未激活）
（已激活）
（未激活）
贵族盗贼套装加成：
3件：你产生的威胁值降低25%

rows.original: 5: You earn twice the amount of EC from combat. (This does not stack with items that grant similar benefits)
rows.translation: 5件：你从战斗中获得的琥珀金币翻倍。（此效果与提供类似收益的物品不叠加）
rows.raw: "5: You earn twice the amount of EC from combat. (This does not stack with items that grant similar benefits) "

rows.translation: (未激活)
(未激活)
火术师的套装加成:

rows.original: 2: On taking Fire damage, gain a Fire-empowered weapon and become Aroused for a turn
rows.translation: 2：当受到火焰伤害时，会获得一件被火焰力量强化的武器，并在接下来的一轮时间内处于兴奋状态。
rows.raw: "2: On taking Fire damage, gain a Fire-empowered weapon and become Aroused for a turn "

rows.original: 4: Spellpower is equalled to Sexiness, if it's higher
rows.translation: 4：如果性感度更高，则法术强度等同于性感度
rows.raw: "4: Spellpower is equalled to Sexiness, if it's higher "

rows.translation: (未激活)
(未激活)
皇家珠宝
皇家珠宝

rows.original: The personal jewelry of Khor'minos's eldest princess: glittering gold, priceless trinkets, exotic baubles. Worth a small fortune to any merchant unscrupulous or unsuspecting enough to take them.
rows.translation: 科尔米诺斯大公主的个人珠宝：闪闪发光的黄金、无价的小饰品、异国风情的装饰品。对于任何不择手段或毫无戒心的商人来说，这些珠宝都价值连城。
rows.raw: "The personal jewelry of Khor'minos's eldest princess: glittering gold, priceless trinkets, exotic baubles. Worth a small fortune to any merchant unscrupulous or unsuspecting enough to take them."

rows.translation: 油灯
油灯

rows.original: An old, dirty, beaten-up oil lamp that's been so neglected over the years that you can't tell what metal it's made of. Aside from the jewel adorning its lid, it's worthless in its current state. Naptha is a common oily jelly that could be used to light it while at camp, if you can find some...
rows.translation: 一盏又旧又脏、破败不堪的油灯，这些年来一直无人照料，以至于根本看不出它由什么金属制成。除了灯盖上的宝石外，它目前毫无价值。石脑油是一种常见的油状胶质；如果能找到一些，你就可以在营地用它点燃这盏灯……
rows.raw: "An old, dirty, beaten-up oil lamp that's been so neglected over the years that you can't tell what metal it's made of. Aside from the jewel adorning its lid, it's worthless in its current state. Naptha is a common oily jelly that could be used to light it while at camp, if you can find some..."

rows.translation: 神灯
神灯

rows.original: An oil lamp made of what appears to be solid gold, polished and shined to perfection, with a sparkling ruby placed atop its lid. Light the wick and give the lamp a rub, and you'll summon Oma, the genie residing within.
rows.translation: 这是一盏由纯金制成的油灯，表面经过精心打磨，光泽无比；灯盖上还镶嵌着一颗闪闪发光的红宝石。只要点燃灯芯，轻轻擦拭灯身，里面的精灵奥玛就会应声出现。
rows.raw: "An oil lamp made of what appears to be solid gold, polished and shined to perfection, with a sparkling ruby placed atop its lid. Light the wick and give the lamp a rub, and you'll summon Oma, the genie residing within."

rows.translation: 金灯
金灯

rows.original: An oil lamp made of what appears to be gold. Sitting atop its fanciful lid is a flawless ruby, amplifying any light that passes through it, and connecting the lid to the lamp is a small chain fastened to the handle. What was once a mystical item of immense power and opportunity is now nothing but an ordinary lamp – although, with its make, it's probably worth a fair amount. Or you could keep it as a night light.
rows.translation: 一盏由黄金制成的油灯。它的盖子上镶嵌着一颗无瑕的红宝石，这颗宝石会放大透过它的任何光线。盖子与灯身之间用一条小链子连接在一起，链子固定在灯把上。这件曾经拥有巨大魔力与价值的神秘物品，如今只不过是一盏普通的油灯罢了——不过，考虑到它的材质，它的价值应该还是相当可观的。或者，你也可以把它当作一盏夜灯来使用。
rows.raw: "An oil lamp made of what appears to be gold. Sitting atop its fanciful lid is a flawless ruby, amplifying any light that passes through it, and connecting the lid to the lamp is a small chain fastened to the handle. What was once a mystical item of immense power and opportunity is now nothing but an ordinary lamp – although, with its make, it's probably worth a fair amount. Or you could keep it as a night light."

rows.translation: 无用的书
无用的书

rows.original: A leatherbound book with pristine parchment and unblemished leather, tied together with beautiful black string as the spine. More pages appear within the leather as necessary. But the only thing that can be written in its pages is the word 'anything,' and only you can write it, making it absolutely useless and worthless.
rows.translation: 这是一本用皮革装订的书，书页由保存完好的羊皮纸制成，皮革也完好无损，书脊用漂亮的黑色绳子固定在一起。根据需要，书中还可以添加更多的页页。但唯一可以写在这本书页上的，只有“任何事情”这个词——而且只有你才能写下它，因此这本书实际上毫无用处，毫无价值。
rows.raw: "A leatherbound book with pristine parchment and unblemished leather, tied together with beautiful black string as the spine. More pages appear within the leather as necessary. But the only thing that can be written in its pages is the word 'anything,' and only you can write it, making it absolutely useless and worthless."

rows.original: In your hand is a book that you wished for from Oma the Genie. It's a plain, featureless book that's bound with leather and twine, and although it only has one page in it right now, a new page will appear as the current pages fill. The intent was that anything you wrote in it would come true, as a way to circumvent her 'only three wishes' rule. Instead, what you have is a book that only allows the word 'anything' to be written in it, and only by your hand. Anything else you write will simply vanish off the page. [rand |You write the word 'anything' on its page. Yep, it stays. You write the word 'anything2' on the page. It vanishes. rows.translation: 你手中拿着一本你向精灵奥玛祈求得到的书。这本书外观朴素，没有任何装饰，是用皮革和绳子装订而成的。虽然目前它只有一页内容，但当现有的页面被填满后，新的页面就会自动出现。 其初衷是，无论你在书中写下什么，那些愿望都一定会实现，这样就能绕过她“只能许三个愿望”的规则。然而，实际上得到的却是一本只能让你自己亲手写下“任何事情”的书。你写的任何其他内容都会从页面上消失不见。 [rand |你在它的页面上写下“anything”这个词，没错，这个词依然留在那里。 然后你在同一页面上写下“anything2”这个词，这个词却消失了。 还是毫无用处。 |你在纸上戳出一些小小的洞，试图在这些洞形成的负空间里画出字母。你试着写下“我希望得到一千枚琥珀金币”这句话。 然而，什么也没有发生。现在，那张纸只不过是一张被戳得满是洞、已经无法使用的纸而已。 不过，书中马上又出现了一张新的纸。所以，这个方法还是可行的。 |你在那页纸上反复写下“anything”这个词，尽可能用长而笔直的线条来书写每个字母。然后，你把那页纸撕下来，仔细地将每一个“anything”拆分成一条条纸条，这样你就得到了一堆上面画着长线条的纸片。 最后，你将所有这些线条重新粘贴到那张新制作的纸上，努力使那些条纹排列成字母的形状。你逐一将它们粘贴上去，直到最终在那本书的纸上，那些破烂的条纹组成了“我希望能得到一千枚琥珀金币”这句话。 什么反应都没有。还是毫无用处。 |你可能会想到这样一个尝试：用非常非常小的字体来创作艺术。把“anything”这个词写得尽可能小，然后再在第一个“anything”下面和旁边再写一个“anything”。接着把页面横过来，以与前面三个“anything”垂直的方向再写一个“anything”。 过了一段时间后，当你回头再看那张纸时，你会发现字母“I”被用了一堆“任何符号”代替了原本的三条直线来表示。不过，那个字母“I”仍然留在纸上面！ 你一丝不苟地反复进行这个过程，慢慢地将一个个单词组合成完整的句子。最终，通过这种“文字艺术”，你在纸上写出了“我希望能得到一千枚琥珀金币”这句话。 然而，什么也没有发生。而所有这些内容竟然占满了整张纸。 不过，书中马上又会形成另一份内容。所以，你还是有这个优势的。 |你在那页纸上写下“anything”这个词，没错，它依然留在那里。 然后你在同一页纸上写下“gnihtyna”这个词，它却消失了。 还是毫无用处。 |你在页面的内部垂直写下“anything”这个词，令你稍感惊讶的是，这个词竟然没有消失。 接着，你在顶部的字母A旁边写下“nything”，结果这个词也同样没有消失。 然后，你在第一个字母N旁边写下“ything”，这个词消失了，但字母N却依然留在那里。于是，你在字母N的左边写下字母A，在它的右边写下“ything”。然后它就留在那里了。 挺可爱的……不过还是没什么用处。 |你取出最上面那张纸，开始折纸。虽然你知道的折纸形状并不多，但有一种折法是在你年轻时学到的——当你捏住纸的底部，然后手腕一抖，纸就会像一只飞翔的鸟一样飞出去。 这本书就提供了这样的机会。它甚至会在里面再准备一张纸，以便在你折坏了一张后可以补充。这样真是太方便了。 ]

rows.translation: 猞猁图腾
猞猁图腾

rows.original: A beautifully crafted charm in the shape of a lynx, a native animal in the Frost Marches. Charms such as these are valued by hunters and foresters as bringers of luck, but some enterprising mages can channel magic through such totems.
rows.translation: 这是一个制作精良的护身符，其形状模仿了霜冻边境地区的本土动物——猞猁。这样的护身符深受猎人和林业工作者的喜爱，因为他们相信这些护身符能带来好运；而一些富有创意的法师们也能通过这些图腾来引导魔法力量。
rows.raw: "A beautifully crafted charm in the shape of a lynx, a native animal in the Frost Marches. Charms such as these are valued by hunters and foresters as bringers of luck, but some enterprising mages can channel magic through such totems."

rows.translation: 海浪竖琴
海浪竖琴

rows.original: A beautifully engraved and painted harp that depicts the rolling waves and white cliffs of the Khor'minoan coast. A personal gift from your girlfriend, Livrea, enchanted to evoke Sorra's celestial song with a touch. Special Effect: Allows the use of Aria of Waves.
rows.translation: 一把雕刻精美、色彩绚丽的竖琴，其图案描绘了科尔米诺海岸那连绵的波浪与白色悬崖。这是你的女友莉维娅送给你的礼物，她为这把竖琴施加了魔法，只要轻轻一触，就能唤出索拉那动听的天籁之音。 特效：允许使用《波之咏》。
rows.raw: " A beautifully engraved and painted harp that depicts the rolling waves and white cliffs of the Khor'minoan coast. A personal gift from your girlfriend, Livrea, enchanted to evoke Sorra's celestial song with a touch. Special Effect: Allows the use of Aria of Waves."

rows.translation: 熊之杯
熊之杯

rows.original: Some magical awakenings are more glamorous than others. On the lower end of the scale is an infuriated barkeep hurling the closest object at a local dreg refusing to pay his tab, and magic has a strange way of preserving intent. Special Effect: Allows the use of Rally Bear.
rows.translation: 有些魔法觉醒的效果确实比其他那些更加引人注目。而在这类现象中，最平常的例子大概就是：某个愤怒的酒保，会把手边最方便拿到的东西扔向那个拒绝付账的醉汉——而魔法，总是有一种奇怪的能力，能够完美地保留人们当时的意图。 特效：允许使用集结吧，熊兄弟！。
rows.raw: " Some magical awakenings are more glamorous than others. On the lower end of the scale is an infuriated barkeep hurling the closest object at a local dreg refusing to pay his tab, and magic has a strange way of preserving intent. Special Effect: Allows the use of Rally Bear."

rows.translation: 公牛图腾
公牛图腾

rows.original: A totem carved in the image of a raging bull. Such devices are used by mages of Khor'minos to channel the fury of earth and fire into their spells, letting them devastated the ranks of their foes in the king's name.
rows.translation: 一座雕刻着狂怒公牛形象的图腾。科尔米诺斯的法师们会使用这样的道具，将大地与火焰的狂暴之力引入他们的法术之中，从而以国王的名义摧毁敌人的军队。
rows.raw: "A totem carved in the image of a raging bull. Such devices are used by mages of Khor'minos to channel the fury of earth and fire into their spells, letting them devastated the ranks of their foes in the king's name."

rows.translation: 艾洛莎圣杯
艾洛莎圣杯

rows.original: A ceramic grail, painted with deep greens and purples though it's been chipped and faded by the passage of years. Many, many years. The cup has a faintly musky odor, not just earthy but unmistakably sexual. One whiff tells you what fluid it was used to hold in the ancient rites it once performed. Special Effect: When you land a Critical Hit, gain an Aura of Desire for the rest of the encounter, dealing passive Pheromone damage.
rows.translation: 一只陶制圣杯，绘有深绿与紫色的纹样，只是漫长岁月已使它缺损褪色——那是极其、极其漫长的岁月。杯中散发着淡淡的麝香味，不仅带有泥土气息，更有一种明确无误的情欲意味。只需闻上一口，你便知道它在往昔仪式中曾盛放过何种体液。 特殊效果：造成暴击后，在本场遭遇的剩余时间里获得欲望光环，持续造成信息素伤害。

rows.translation: 法师魔杖
法师魔杖

rows.original: A simple, etched, wooden rod with a magically-attuned piece of amber at its tip. It's a cheap, basic magical tool meant to channel and enhance minor magic. Certainly, a must-have for all sorcerous apprentices.
rows.translation: 一根简单的、经过雕刻的木棒，其末端镶嵌着一块经过魔法处理的琥珀。这是一种廉价而基础的魔法工具，用于引导和增强那些较为微弱的魔法力量。对于所有学习魔法的学徒来说，这无疑是一件必备品。
rows.raw: "A simple, etched, wooden rod with a magically-attuned piece of amber at its tip. It's a cheap, basic magical tool meant to channel and enhance minor magic. Certainly, a must-have for all sorcerous apprentices."

rows.translation: 战争图腾
战争图腾

rows.original: One of the totems sometimes carried by the Kervus into battle. It's a small cylindrical piece of wood threaded with a length of cord, able to be worn about one's neck or wrist without getting in the way. It's been painted, of course, and the symbol of Lumia has been etched into the curved face, wrapping about half the totem's circumference. If you squint and look at it from a certain angle, it looks kind of phallic...
rows.translation: 克尔维斯族在战斗中有时会携带这种图腾。它是由一小段圆柱形的木头制成，上面穿着一根绳子，可以挂在脖子上或手腕上，而不会造成任何妨碍。当然，这种图腾也会被涂上颜色，卢米亚的象征会被刻在它的弯曲表面上，这个图案大约占据了图腾周长的一半。如果你从某个角度仔细观察，会发现它看起来有点像阳具……

rows.translation: 空白卷轴
空白卷轴

rows.original:
While aesthetics may differ across cultures, the principles of magic remain the same. Kitsune and tanuki use scrolls instead of staves, totems or wands as foci, placing the attuned gems on either end of both rods. The paper itself often has a spell scribed on it for easy casting, making more powerful spells quicker to invoke than they otherwise would be. However, unlike a staff, the scroll itself is largely useless as a weapon in and of itself.

        Adorned with clear quartz as focusing gems, a blank scroll is the most general of all foci, sacrificing the convenience of a prepared spell for versatility and power.
rows.translation:
虽然不同文化在审美观念上可能存在差异，但魔法的原理始终是相同的。狐妖和狸猫使用卷轴而非法杖，以图腾或魔杖作为施法媒介，并将与之共鸣的宝石安装在卷轴的两端。这些卷轴本身通常也会刻有相应的咒语，从而便于施法者快速释放魔法，使得那些威力更强的咒语也能更迅速地被施展出来。然而，与法杖不同，空白卷轴本身作为武器使用时几乎毫无作用。

        这些空白卷轴上镶嵌着透明的石英宝石作为聚焦装置，它们是最通用型的聚焦工具。为了获得更强的灵活性与威力，人们放弃了使用预先准备好的法术所带来的便利性。
rows.raw:
"
        While aesthetics may differ across cultures, the principles of magic remain the same. Kitsune and tanuki use scrolls instead of staves, totems or wands as foci, placing the attuned gems on either end of both rods. The paper itself often has a spell scribed on it for easy casting, making more powerful spells quicker to invoke than they otherwise would be. However, unlike a staff, the scroll itself is largely useless as a weapon in and of itself.

        Adorned with clear quartz as focusing gems, a blank scroll is the most general of all foci, sacrificing the convenience of a prepared spell for versatility and power.
        "

rows.translation: 贵族竖琴
贵族竖琴

rows.original: The harp is perhaps the single most traditional instrument among the Belharan nobility, with musical traditions dating back to the earliest days of myth. Harp music written by the first emperors still survives to this day, alongside myriad hymns and long songs attributed to the lords who founded Belhar's original great houses.
rows.translation: 竖琴或许是贝尔哈兰贵族中最具传统特色的乐器了，它的音乐传统可以追溯到神话时代的最早期。最初的几位皇帝创作的竖琴曲至今仍然流传下来，与此同时，还有许多赞歌和长篇歌曲也被认为是由那些建立了贝尔哈兰最初那些显赫家族的贵族们所创作的。
rows.raw: "\n        The harp is perhaps the single most traditional instrument among the Belharan nobility, with musical traditions dating back to the earliest days of myth. Harp music written by the first emperors still survives to this day, alongside myriad hymns and long songs attributed to the lords who founded Belhar's original great houses.\n        "

rows.translation: 木排箫
木排箫

rows.original: Wood pipes are common, simple instruments popular among minstrels and wyld elves of the woodlands — and are traditionally associated with satyrs, as well. Legends say that certain pipes have a hypnotic effect on children and animals, luring them into following the piper to gods-only-know what fate.
rows.translation: 木制笛子是森林地区的吟游诗人和野精灵们常用的简单乐器，这类乐器也传统上与萨提尔们联系在一起。传说中，某些木笛会对儿童和动物产生催眠效果，会诱使它们跟随吹笛人，走向只有神明才知晓的命运。
rows.raw: "\n        Wood pipes are common, simple instruments popular among minstrels and wyld elves of the woodlands — and are traditionally associated with satyrs, as well. Legends say that certain pipes have a hypnotic effect on children and animals, luring them into following the piper to gods-only-know what fate.\n        "

rows.translation: 火焰玉
火焰玉

rows.original: A red-streaked amber gem that pulses with steady light, supposedly having interesting geomantic properties if Mai is to be believed. Despite its appearance, it's merely warm to the touch and actually feels quite comfortable to be around. Extremely durable and resistant to sudden shocks. Special Effect: Increases health restored by healing spells by 20%.
rows.translation: 这颗带有红色条纹的琥珀宝石会持续发出稳定的光芒。如果相信舞的说法的话，它还具备一些有趣的占卜功效。尽管外观如此，但它触感温和，让人佩戴起来十分舒适。这种宝石极其耐用，也能有效抵御突然的冲击。 特效：将治疗法术恢复的生命值增加20%。
rows.raw: " A red-streaked amber gem that pulses with steady light, supposedly having interesting geomantic properties if Mai is to be believed. Despite its appearance, it's merely warm to the touch and actually feels quite comfortable to be around. Extremely durable and resistant to sudden shocks. Special Effect: Increases health restored by healing spells by 20%."

rows.translation: 阳伞
阳伞

rows.original: A parasol consisting of treated mulberry paper stretched over a bamboo frame and handle. Looks good and keeps the sun and rain off your head. The hollow handle is big enough to fit the blade of a concealed weapon, but you don't have anything like that, right?
rows.translation: 这种阳伞是由经过特殊处理的桑纸覆盖在竹制框架上制成的，配有手柄。外观美观，既能遮挡阳光，也能防止雨水淋到头上。它的空心手柄尺寸足够大，可以用来隐藏武器，不过你应该没有这样的武器吧？
rows.raw: "\n        A parasol consisting of treated mulberry paper stretched over a bamboo frame and handle. Looks good and keeps the sun and rain off your head. The hollow handle is big enough to fit the blade of a concealed weapon, but you don't have anything like that, right?"

rows.translation: 卢米娅圣徽
卢米娅圣徽

rows.original: A holy symbol given to Azyrran by the Zethras family as a sign of friendship and shared commitment to the fight against demonkind.
rows.translation: 泽斯拉家族将这一神圣象征赠予阿兹兰，以此象征友谊以及共同对抗恶魔势力的决心。
rows.raw: "A holy symbol given to Azyrran by the Zethras family as a sign of friendship and shared commitment to the fight against demonkind."

rows.translation: 和谐乌德琴
和谐乌德琴

rows.original: An eleven-stringed, short-necked, pear-shaped instrument whose design originates in Jassira. While less common in the north compared to the harp, the oud's design and use spread from its homeland to the rest of the Belharan Empire during its peak and still sees use amongst certain dedicated practitioners. This particular one is made of whitewood that was gifted to Viviane's family generations ago with strings wound in electrum to enable performances that resonate with holy magic.
rows.translation: 这种乐器有十一根弦，琴颈较短，呈梨形，其设计起源于贾西拉地区。虽然在北方，它不如竖琴那么常见，但在其鼎盛时期，乌德琴的设计与使用方式从它的发源地传播到了整个贝尔哈兰帝国，至今仍有一些热衷于演奏这种乐器的人在使用它。这把乌德琴是用白木制成的，它是几代前赠送给薇薇安家族的礼物；琴弦则由电银制成，这样在演奏时就能产生与神圣魔法相呼应的声音。
rows.raw: "An eleven-stringed, short-necked, pear-shaped instrument whose design originates in Jassira. While less common in the north compared to the harp, the oud's design and use spread from its homeland to the rest of the Belharan Empire during its peak and still sees use amongst certain dedicated practitioners. This particular one is made of whitewood that was gifted to Viviane's family generations ago with strings wound in electrum to enable performances that resonate with holy magic."

rows.translation: 龙牙
龙牙

rows.original: The chipped fang of a young sea wyrm caught nesting in the waterhead near Lake Tarahugan. While the creature was only a juvenile, it could one day have grown to the size of a house and become a true menace to the people of Hawkethorne and the valley. Its snaggletooth fang was already the size of a short sword, though it's too cracked now to be used as a weapon. Still, it's uniquely suited to being used as a magical focus...
rows.translation: 在塔拉胡根湖附近的水域中，人们发现了一条正在筑巢的年轻海怪的断裂獠牙。虽然这只生物还只是幼体，但它有朝一日可能会长到房屋大小，从而成为鹰棘镇镇及周围山谷居民的真正威胁。它那参差不齐的獠牙已经有一把短剑那么长了，不过由于已经严重破损，现在无法作为武器使用。不过，这种獠牙却非常适合被用来作为魔法能量的汇聚点……
rows.raw: "The chipped fang of a young sea wyrm caught nesting in the waterhead near Lake Tarahugan. While the creature was only a juvenile, it could one day have grown to the size of a house and become a true menace to the people of Hawkethorne and the valley. Its snaggletooth fang was already the size of a short sword, though it's too cracked now to be used as a weapon. Still, it's uniquely suited to being used as a magical focus..."

rows.translation: 战鼓
战鼓

rows.original: A set of simple wooden war-drums, with hide stretched taut across the tops. These are a favorite among the warrior-skalds of the Sailgrave Archipelago, who lead their raider crews' oarsmen both on the waves and in the heat of battle.
rows.translation: 一套简单的木制战鼓，鼓面上绷着紧绷的兽皮。这些鼓深受塞尔格雷夫群岛上的战士吟游者的喜爱，他们在海浪中航行时，也在激烈的战斗中，用这些鼓来指挥船上的划手们。
rows.raw: "A set of simple wooden war-drums, with hide stretched taut across the tops. These are a favorite among the warrior-skalds of the Sailgrave Archipelago, who lead their raider crews' oarsmen both on the waves and in the heat of battle."

rows.translation: 魔法书
魔法书

rows.original: A tome of arcane lore is the caster's best friend. Many contain spells collected over a lifetime of study, or are passed on from master to apprentice, allowing schools and theories of magic to not just endure but to evolve over generations. This carefully curated collection of occultism is full of simple cantrips and battle magic, allowing for quick reference under pressure and helping its wielder to snap off spells at a brisk pace.
rows.translation: 一部蕴含深奥魔法知识的典籍，是施法者最宝贵的财富。许多这样的典籍汇集了施法者毕生研究所得的法术，或是由大师传授给学徒的智慧结晶，因此各种魔法流派与理论才能代代相传，不断发展演变。这些精心编纂的魔法典籍中包含了各种简单的法术与战斗魔法，使得施法者能够在压力之下迅速查阅所需法术，从而快速施展它们。
rows.raw: "A tome of arcane lore is the caster's best friend. Many contain spells collected over a lifetime of study, or are passed on from master to apprentice, allowing schools and theories of magic to not just endure but to evolve over generations. This carefully curated collection of occultism is full of simple cantrips and battle magic, allowing for quick reference under pressure and helping its wielder to snap off spells at a brisk pace."

rows.translation: 提克里斯长笛
提克里斯长笛

rows.original: A glass flute of Tychrisian make.
rows.translation: 一支由提克里斯人制作的玻璃长笛。
远古战号
远古战号

rows.original: A relic of ages past, this pearlescent warhorn is carved from the tusk of a mighty sea wyrm and etched with intricate glyphs of a civilization whose records are scant. Still, its magic flows like the day it was made, and you can feel your confidence surging up just by holding the horn. Blowing on it sharpens the combat instincts of your party.
rows.translation: 这件充满古老韵味的战角，是由一条巨大的海龙的长牙雕刻而成，其表面还刻着那些关于某个早已湮灭的文明的复杂符号。尽管关于这个文明的记载寥寥无几，但它的魔力依然如同诞生之初那样强大。仅仅握在手中，你就能感受到自己信心倍增；而吹响它，更会激发你所在团队的战斗潜能。
rows.raw: "A relic of ages past, this pearlescent warhorn is carved from the tusk of a mighty sea wyrm and etched with intricate glyphs of a civilization whose records are scant. Still, its magic flows like the day it was made, and you can feel your confidence surging up just by holding the horn. Blowing on it sharpens the combat instincts of your party."

rows.translation: 扭曲之角
扭曲之角

rows.original: A horn grown from a demon, shattered and then painstakingly pieced back together with electrum — a twisted mockery of a far eastern custom for broken ceramics. Perhaps it served as a reminder of its owner's place, of how she came to serve the Pleasure Cult — though whether she took pleasure in that reminder or felt shame, only Renia would know.
rows.translation: 这是一只由恶魔长出的角，被粉碎后，人们用电银精心将其重新拼接起来——这种做法其实是对远东地区修复破损陶瓷这一习俗的扭曲嘲弄。或许，这个角的存在只是为了提醒它的主人自己的出身，以及她是如何开始为“享乐教”服务的……不过，她是因此感到欣慰，还是感到羞愧，只有蕾妮娅自己才清楚。
rows.raw: "A horn grown from a demon, shattered and then painstakingly pieced back together with electrum — a twisted mockery of a far eastern custom for broken ceramics. Perhaps it served as a reminder of its owner's place, of how she came to serve the Pleasure Cult — though whether she took pleasure in that reminder or felt shame, only Renia would know."

rows.translation: 凯尔多兰的竖琴
凯尔多兰的竖琴

rows.original: A large, golden-plated harp that was passed down for generations through the royal family of Khor'minos. It was originally carried by the noble bard Keldoran, a patrician from the outer provinces of the kingdom whose playing was so enchanting that even a fearsome wyvern queen was unable to maintain her fury in the face of his song. Special Effect: Increases the damage of Keldoran's Song.
rows.translation: 一把由科尔米诺斯王室世代传承下来的大型黄金镀层竖琴。它最初由那位来自王国边远地区的贵族吟游诗人凯尔多兰持有，他的演奏技巧如此迷人，以至于就连凶猛的翼龙女王在听到他的歌声时，也无法保持自己的愤怒。 特效：提升“凯尔多兰之歌”的伤害威力。
rows.raw: "A large, golden-plated harp that was passed down for generations through the royal family of Khor'minos. It was originally carried by the noble bard Keldoran, a patrician from the outer provinces of the kingdom whose playing was so enchanting that even a fearsome wyvern queen was unable to maintain her fury in the face of his song.\n \n Special Effect: Increases the damage of Keldoran's Song."

rows.translation: 元素核心
元素核心

rows.original: The core of [silly|Reggie|the Stone Titan], an ancient earth elemental you defeated in the Coastlands. A flawless sphere of orange corundum the size of your fist, the core still contains the animus inside. With its 'spirit' remaining anchored, the core appears to possess some limited awareness, focusing in on your enemies by itself. You're unsure if the spirit inside could truly be considered sentient, but its powers over rock and stone remain sharp. Special Effect: Increases the effects of Geomancy or Earth-based magic by 10%.
rows.translation: 这是[silly|雷吉|石之泰坦]的核心——你在海岸地带击败的那只古老土元素。它是一颗拳头大小、毫无瑕疵的橙色刚玉球，内部仍留有元素之魂。由于“灵魂”依旧锚定其中，核心似乎保留着有限的意识，能自行锁定你的敌人。你不确定那灵魂是否真的具有知觉，但它操纵岩石的力量依然强大。 特殊效果：地术或大地系魔法的效果提高10%。
rows.raw: "The core of [silly|Reggie|the Stone Titan], an ancient earth elemental you defeated in the Coastlands. A flawless sphere of orange corundum the size of your fist, the core still contains the animus inside. With its 'spirit' remaining anchored, the core appears to possess some limited awareness, focusing in on your enemies by itself. You're unsure if the spirit inside could truly be considered sentient, but its powers over rock and stone remain sharp.\n \n Special Effect: Increases the effects of Geomancy or Earth-based magic by 10%."

rows.translation: 维伦圣徽
维伦圣徽

rows.original: A holy symbol of Velun, god the forest, made of bronze set with a trio of spell-catalyst gemstones. On the reverse is an etching of a mountain and three towers. You found this in the gardens behind Tychris palace.
rows.translation: 这是维伦神的圣物，维伦是森林之神，这件圣物由青铜制成，上面镶嵌了三颗能催化魔法的宝石。背面刻有一座山和三座塔的图案。你是是在提克里斯宫殿后面的花园里找到这件圣物的。
rows.raw: "A holy symbol of Velun, god the forest, made of bronze set with a trio of spell-catalyst gemstones. On the reverse is an etching of a mountain and three towers. You found this in the gardens behind Tychris palace."

rows.translation: 娜瑞瓦魔典
娜瑞瓦魔典

rows.original: A black, leather-bound grimoire with a silver ouroboros stitched onto the cover. Filled not just with spellcraft but the teachings of Nareva herself, this tome is half the goddess of magic's own prayerbook and half guide to ascendance as a master of the arcane arts, one whom all others should respect and follow. Humility, perhaps, was never the goddess's strongest suit.
rows.translation: 一本以黑色皮革装订的魔法书，封面缝着银色的衔尾蛇图案。书中不仅记载着法术技艺，还收录了纳瑞瓦本人的教诲；它既是魔法女神的祷告书，也是一本指引读者晋升为奥术大师、赢得众人敬重与追随的指南。谦逊或许从来都不是这位女神最突出的美德。
rows.raw: "A black, leather-bound grimoire with a silver ouroboros stitched onto the cover. Filled not just with spellcraft but the teachings of Nareva herself, this tome is half the goddess of magic's own prayerbook and half guide to ascendance as a master of the arcane arts, one whom all others should respect and follow. Humility, perhaps, was never the goddess's strongest suit."

rows.original: This lovely satchel of black leather hangs comfortably off of the shoulder, providing easy access to the wealth of tools and consumables within. Special Effect: Once per encounter, using an item is a free action.
rows.translation: 这只漂亮的黑色皮革挎包舒适地挂在肩侧，让你可以轻松取用其中琳琅满目的工具与消耗品。 特殊效果：每场遭遇中有一次机会，使用物品不消耗行动。
rows.raw: "This lovely satchel of black leather hangs comfortably off of the shoulder, providing easy access to the wealth of tools and consumables within.\n \n Special Effect: Once per encounter, using an item is a free action."

rows.translation: 风笛

rows.original: An instrument whose methods of construction are best described as "don't ask," the mighty bagpipe has nevertheless been a staple of Tychrisian music for centuries, and in the dark age since the Godswar has, if anything, become more popular. While the folk of Tychris may have a reputation for being uptight and erudite, even they sometimes need to let loose and make loud noises for fun. Special Ability: Grants immunity to being Silenced.
rows.translation: 若要描述这件乐器的制作方法，最好的说法是“别问”；即便如此，威风凛凛的风笛数百年来一直是提克里斯音乐的中坚，而在神战之后的黑暗年代里，它的人气反而有增无减。提克里斯人虽说以古板博学著称，可他们偶尔也需要放松下来，闹出点动静找乐子。 特殊能力：免疫沉默。
rows.raw: 'An instrument whose methods of construction are best described as "don\'t ask," the mighty bagpipe has nevertheless been a staple of Tychrisian music for centuries, and in the dark age since the Godswar has, if anything, become more popular. While the folk of Tychris may have a reputation for being uptight and erudite, even they sometimes need to let loose and make loud noises for fun.\n \n Special Ability: Grants immunity to being Silenced.'

rows.raw: "Cannot call a class as a function"

rows.translation: 霍普隆盾
霍普隆盾

rows.original: A basic, circular shield made of wood with a bronze face. These shields are used pretty much everywhere nowadays, as they provide a good mix of protection and mobility. Though many soldiers and nations decorate their shields in elaborate schemes, this particular shield is bare-faced.
rows.translation: 这种盾牌由木头制成，呈圆形，表面覆盖着青铜层。如今，这种盾牌几乎在各地都被广泛使用，因为它们既能提供良好的防护效果，又能保证使用者的机动性。虽然许多士兵和国家都会用复杂的图案来装饰他们的盾牌，但这种特定的盾牌却没有任何装饰。
rows.raw: "A basic, circular shield made of wood with a bronze face. These shields are used pretty much everywhere nowadays, as they provide a good mix of protection and mobility. Though many soldiers and nations decorate their shields in elaborate schemes, this particular shield is bare-faced."

rows.translation: 黑盾
美丽之盾
塔盾
塔盾

rows.original: A huge, rectangular shield made of several layers of metal, wood, and canvas. The tower shield protects a ludicrous amount of the user's body, making it a favorite among legions of ancient Belhar, who fought in vast shield-walls. However, it's heavy and cumbersome, reducing the user's ability to move easily.
rows.translation: 这种巨大的矩形盾牌由多层金属、木材和帆布制成。这种塔形盾牌能够有效保护使用者身体的大部分部位，因此深受古代贝尔哈尔军团士兵的喜爱——他们在战斗中常常利用这种盾牌形成坚固的防御屏障。然而，这种盾牌非常重型且笨重，严重影响了使用者的移动灵活性。
rows.raw: "A huge, rectangular shield made of several layers of metal, wood, and canvas. The tower shield protects a ludicrous amount of the user's body, making it a favorite among legions of ancient Belhar, who fought in vast shield-walls. However, it's heavy and cumbersome, reducing the user's ability to move easily."

rows.translation: 荆棘盾
荆棘盾

rows.original: A circular shield with a border of harmful spikes. Its magical enchantment promises protection — and retaliation — to its wielder. Special Effect: Every time you block a critical hit, casts Briar Armor on you.
rows.translation: 一个边缘布满致命尖刺的圆形盾牌。它的魔法效果能为持有者提供保护——同时也允许持有者进行反击。 特效每次你成功格挡一次致命攻击，就会为自己施加荆棘护甲。
rows.raw: "A circular shield with a border of harmful spikes. Its magical enchantment promises protection — and retaliation — to its wielder.\n\n Special Effect: Every time you block a critical hit, casts Briar Armor on you."

rows.original: As [target.combatName] deflect[tps|s] the worst of the blow, [target.combatName] conjure[tps|s] up a solid encasement of bark and briars that surround [target.combatHimHer]!
rows.translation: 当[target.combatName]挡开[tps|]这一击中最猛烈的部分时，[target.combatName]召来[tps|]坚实的树皮与荆棘外壳，将[target.combatHimHer]包围起来！
rows.raw: "\nAs [target.combatName] deflect[tps|s] the worst of the blow, [target.combatName] conjure[tps|s] up a solid encasement of bark and briars that surround [target.combatHimHer]!"

rows.translation: 柳条盾
柳条盾

rows.original: A simple shield made of wicker and reinforced with leather. Lightweight and extremely cheap, making it common for raiders and conscripts, but these shields provide inferior protection to the heavier wood or metal shields used by proper soldiers.
rows.translation: 这种盾牌由柳条制成，外部用皮革加固。它重量轻且价格低廉，因此常被劫掠者和征召兵使用。不过，与正规士兵使用的重型木制或金属盾牌相比，这种盾牌所提供的防护效果要差得多。
rows.raw: "A simple shield made of wicker and reinforced with leather. Lightweight and extremely cheap, making it common for raiders and conscripts, but these shields provide inferior protection to the heavier wood or metal shields used by proper soldiers."

rows.translation: 符文盾
符文盾

rows.original:
While tattoos are considered primitive forms of magical foci by most other cultures, they have a long and rich tradition amongst islander and heartlander orcs alike, especially amongst practitioners of magic. The obvious downside to tattoos, of course, is that one can't easily swap them out.

        The easiest alternative is to paint the patterns on shields; symbols to ward off bad luck, protect one from hostile magic or let a weapon strike true were common. Paints are set upon leather, which is then stretched out over wood and set in place with bronze bindings.
rows.translation:
虽然在其他许多文化中，纹身被视为原始的魔法象征，但在岛民和内陆兽人中，尤其是那些从事魔法活动的族群中，纹身却拥有悠久而丰富的传统。当然，纹身的明显缺点在于人们无法轻易地去除它们。

        最简单的办法就是在盾牌上绘制各种图案——这些象征符号用于驱散厄运、保护使用者免受敌对魔法的伤害，或者确保武器能够精准命中目标。人们通常会在皮革上绘制这些图案，然后将皮革拉伸在木制框架上，并用青铜条将其固定到位。
rows.raw:
"
        While tattoos are considered primitive forms of magical foci by most other cultures, they have a long and rich tradition amongst islander and heartlander orcs alike, especially amongst practitioners of magic. The obvious downside to tattoos, of course, is that one can't easily swap them out.

        The easiest alternative is to paint the patterns on shields; symbols to ward off bad luck, protect one from hostile magic or let a weapon strike true were common. Paints are set upon leather, which is then stretched out over wood and set in place with bronze bindings."

rows.translation: 蔷薇绽放之盾
蔷薇绽放之盾

rows.original: An ancient shield carried north by the legendary queen of the hornets, Lyzzerahn. The bronze shield is engraved with roses and hornets, and it exudes a potent, aphrodisiac aroma all around it. You're not sure if it's been corrupted or if the hornet heirloom was always meant to overpower its foes with desire... maybe both. It's hard to concentrate on anything but sexuality while you wield it, but then again, if you choose to strut your stuff, enemies will be affected by pheromones too. Special Effect: All Tease Damage you deal is converted to Pheromone Damage instead.
rows.translation: 这是一面由传说中的黄蜂女王莉泽兰带往北方的古老盾牌。这面青铜盾牌上雕刻着玫瑰与黄蜂的图案，周围弥漫着一种强烈的、具有催情效果的香气。你不确定这面盾牌是否已经被腐蚀了，还是说这种黄蜂传家之宝本来就是为了用欲望来压制敌人……或许两者都是吧。当你手持这面盾牌时，很难将注意力集中在其他事情上，但话说回来，如果你选择卖弄风情，敌人也会受到信息素的影响。 特效你造成的所有“挑逗伤害”都会转化为“信息素伤害”。
rows.raw: " An ancient shield carried north by the legendary queen of the hornets, Lyzzerahn. The bronze shield is engraved with roses and hornets, and it exudes a potent, aphrodisiac aroma all around it. You're not sure if it's been corrupted or if the hornet heirloom was always meant to overpower its foes with desire... maybe both. It's hard to concentrate on anything but sexuality while you wield it, but then again, if you choose to strut your stuff, enemies will be affected by pheromones too. Special Effect: All Tease Damage you deal is converted to Pheromone Damage instead."

rows.translation: 蛮力之盾
蛮力之盾

rows.original: This bronze-bossed shield is ornately decorated with figures and carvings of muscled warriors in combat. A first attempt at picking it up reveals that it's heavier than you initially expected, but on your second try, it's perfectly weighted for you. After putting it on, you're able to get a closer look at the inside, wherein you notice a ring of inlaid electrum runes. Special Effect: Any time your shield prevents a critical hit, you'll become more muscular and masculine.
rows.translation: 这块青铜制成的盾牌上装饰着各种图案，以及刻画着正在战斗中的肌肉发达的战士们。当你第一次尝试举起它时，会发现它比你预想的要重得多；但第二次尝试时，你就会发现它的重量正好适合你。将盾牌举在手中后，你可以仔细观察它的内部，会发现那里有一圈镶嵌着金银合金符文的环。 特效每当你的盾牌成功挡下一次致命攻击时，你的身体就会变得更强壮，也会更加充满男子气概。
rows.raw: " This bronze-bossed shield is ornately decorated with figures and carvings of muscled warriors in combat. A first attempt at picking it up reveals that it's heavier than you initially expected, but on your second try, it's perfectly weighted for you. After putting it on, you're able to get a closer look at the inside, wherein you notice a ring of inlaid electrum runes. Special Effect: Any time your shield prevents a critical hit, you'll become more muscular and masculine."

rows.original: As [target.combatName] deflect[tps|s] the worst of the blow, [target.combatNames] form fills out and grows more masculine!
rows.translation: 当[target.combatName]挡开[tps|]这一击中最猛烈的部分时，[target.combatNames]体形变得更加饱满，也更具阳刚之气！
rows.raw: "\nAs [target.combatName] deflect[tps|s] the worst of the blow, [target.combatNames] form fills out and grows more masculine!"

rows.translation: 冬之骑士盾
冬之骑士盾

rows.original: A shield made of solid ice, rectangular and large enough to protect all of Brint's massive frame.
rows.translation: 一块由实心冰构成的盾牌，呈矩形，其大小足以保护布林特那庞大的身躯。
rows.raw: "A shield made of solid ice, rectangular and large enough to protect all of Brint's massive frame."

rows.translation: 吸收之盾
吸收之盾

rows.original: One of Vitruvius' masterworks, this bronze-bossed shield is lined with both brilliant repousse work and scrolling electrum runes. While the shield itself wouldn't normally be as protective as many of its sibling items, its enchantments are used to reinforce the wearer when successfully used to block otherwise incredibly damaging blows. Special Effect: When an attack that otherwise would have been a critical hit is negated by this shield, the wielder gains a bonus to Armor, Ward, and Focus for two turns.
rows.translation: 作为维特鲁维乌斯的杰作之一，这块青铜制成的盾牌上不仅装饰着精美的浮雕工艺，还刻有螺旋状的电黄金文字。虽然这种盾牌本身的防护性能可能不如许多其他同类武器，但其附带的魔法效果在成功阻挡那些极具破坏力的攻击时，确实能够为使用者提供强大的保护。 特效当原本会造成致命伤害的攻击被这块盾牌挡住时，使用者会在两回合内获得护甲、防护效果以及专注力方面的加成。
rows.raw: " One of Vitruvius' masterworks, this bronze-bossed shield is lined with both brilliant repousse work and scrolling electrum runes. While the shield itself wouldn't normally be as protective as many of its sibling items, its enchantments are used to reinforce the wearer when successfully used to block otherwise incredibly damaging blows. Special Effect: When an attack that otherwise would have been a critical hit is negated by this shield, the wielder gains a bonus to Armor, Ward, and Focus for two turns."

rows.translation: 护盾宝珠
护盾宝珠

rows.original: An orb that glows with a faint gray light. Moving your fingers through the nimbus, the air about it is palpably thicker, as if it were mud.
rows.translation: 一个散发着淡灰色光芒的球体。当你将手指穿过这片光环时，周围的空气会明显变得浓稠起来，仿佛变成了泥浆一般。
rows.raw: "\n        An orb that glows with a faint gray light. Moving your fingers through the nimbus, the air about it is palpably thicker, as if it were mud."

rows.translation: 护盾魔典
护盾魔典

rows.original: A blessed tome of Mallachite spellcraft, hardened by magic to be as hard as a shield in combat. This was carried by Ivris's father long ago, when he was a traveling friar of the Prince of Passion, and has now been handed down to Cait to help safeguard her as she defends Hawkethorne.
rows.translation: 这是一本蕴含马拉克信徒法术的珍贵典籍，其材质经过魔法强化，因此在战斗中可以像盾牌一样发挥防护作用。很久以前，艾薇莉丝的父亲在担任“激情王子”的游方修士时曾携带这本书，如今它被传给了凯特，帮助她在保卫鹰棘镇的过程中获得保护。
rows.raw: "A blessed tome of Mallachite spellcraft, hardened by magic to be as hard as a shield in combat. This was carried by Ivris's father long ago, when he was a traveling friar of the Prince of Passion, and has now been handed down to Cait to help safeguard her as she defends Hawkethorne."

rows.translation: 女武神女王盾
女武神女王盾

rows.original: Although the elaborate Lumian decorations on this large, round aspis make it look like a ceremonial piece at first glance, the enchantments that thrum within make it an excellent defense against many forms of corrupted magic.
rows.translation: 虽然这件大型阿斯庇斯盾上精美的卢米安装饰让人乍一看以为它是一件用于仪式的物品，但实际上其中蕴含的魔法效果使它能够有效抵御多种形式的腐蚀性魔法。
rows.raw: "Although the elaborate Lumian decorations on this large, round aspis make it look like a ceremonial piece at first glance, the enchantments that thrum within make it an excellent defense against many forms of corrupted magic."

rows.translation: 幽灵盾
幽灵盾

rows.original: A shield formed from spiritual energy, just as solid feeling as any metal, but capable of shifting to catch attacks from any angle. The energy used to create the shield stems from a charcoal focus that helps to condense the ambient power into a physical form.
rows.translation: 这种由灵力构成的盾牌，其坚固程度不亚于任何金属，而且能够灵活移动，从而有效拦截来自任何角度的攻击。形成这道盾牌所需的能量，源自一个特殊的炭质聚焦装置——该装置能够帮助将周围的环境能量凝聚成实体形态。
rows.raw: "A shield formed from spiritual energy, just as solid feeling as any metal, but capable of shifting to catch attacks from any angle. The energy used to create the shield stems from a charcoal focus that helps to condense the ambient power into a physical form."

rows.translation: 龙图腾
龙图腾

rows.original: A particularly large and solid wooden totem, meant not just to be carried by a spellcaster but to block blows that might interrupt [pc.hisHer] casting. These are a staple in the city of Tychris, the most magically inclined of the Marcher states, and are carved in the shape of a great winged drake — for the city's goddess, Nareva, is known as the goddess of dragons.
rows.translation: 一个格外庞大且坚固的木制图腾，它不仅可供施法者携带，还能挡住可能打断[pc.hisHer]施法的攻击。这些雕像在提克里斯城中极为常见，而提克里斯正是这些边境诸国中魔法氛围最为浓厚的地方。这些雕像被雕刻成巨大的有翼巨龙的形象——因为这座城市的女神娜瑞瓦，正是被称为“龙之女神”的存在。
rows.raw: "A particularly large and solid wooden totem, meant not just to be carried by a spellcaster but to block blows that might interrupt [pc.hisHer] casting. These are a staple in the city of Tychris, the most magically inclined of the Marcher states, and are carved in the shape of a great winged drake — for the city's goddess, Nareva, is known as the goddess of dragons."

rows.translation: 蛇纹圆盾
蛇纹圆盾

rows.original: A shield forged with the forgotten magic of Lafanze, giving it an uncanny ability to deflect projectiles. This particular example has been painted black and white by First Spear Eirina of the Astrida, concentric circles of obsidian and ash leading to the symbol of Nareva in the middle. A number of notches have been etched into the wood backside of the shield, counting some victory or another from its owner.
rows.translation: 一面以拉凡泽失传魔法锻造的盾牌，拥有不可思议的投射物偏转能力。这面盾牌由阿斯特丽达的首席长矛手艾瑞娜涂成黑白相间，黑曜石与灰烬色的同心圆一路延伸至中央的纳瑞瓦徽记。盾牌木质背面还刻着许多缺口，似乎记录着其主人取得的一场又一场胜利。
rows.raw: "A shield forged with the forgotten magic of Lafanze, giving it an uncanny ability to deflect projectiles. This particular example has been painted black and white by First Spear Eirina of the Astrida, concentric circles of obsidian and ash leading to the symbol of Nareva in the middle. A number of notches have been etched into the wood backside of the shield, counting some victory or another from its owner."

rows.translation: 小圆盾

rows.original: A small but highly decorative type of shield native to the Tychrisian highlands. Each one is painted with symbols of its owner's clan, accomplishments, or even oaths of vengeance — each is a loud and proud advertisement of who wields it and what they stand for.
rows.translation: 一种源自提克里斯高地的小型盾牌，装饰极为华丽。每一面都绘有盾主所属氏族、功绩，乃至复仇誓言的纹样——每一面都是持有者身份与立场的响亮而自豪的宣言。
rows.raw: "A small but highly decorative type of shield native to the Tychrisian highlands. Each one is painted with symbols of its owner's clan, accomplishments, or even oaths of vengeance — each is a loud and proud advertisement of who wields it and what they stand for."

rows.translation: 狐莓
狐莓

rows.original:
A large cluster of small berries, glistening faintly in the light. Orange-red in color for the most part, the berry cluster fades to white as it tapers towards the stem, making it resemble a fox's tail. As you look at them, you can't help but get a sense of deja vu, a feeling that these look somehow familiar.

            According to the local lore of the Frost Marches, they're perfectly edible, but you'd need to be really, really hungry to want to eat these things instead of anything else. As to why that's the case... you'd have to taste some to find out.
rows.translation:
一大串小浆果，在光线中微微闪烁着光芒。这些浆果大多是橙红色的，而靠近果柄的部分逐渐变为白色，整体形状看起来像狐狸的尾巴。当你注视着它们时，会不由得产生一种似曾相识的感觉，觉得它们似乎在哪里见过。

            根据霜冻边境地区的当地传说，这些食物完全可以食用，但只有当你真的饿极了的时候，才会愿意选择吃它们而不是其他东西。至于为什么会这样……你只有亲自尝一尝才能明白。
rows.raw:
"
            A large cluster of small berries, glistening faintly in the light. Orange-red in color for the most part, the berry cluster fades to white as it tapers towards the stem, making it resemble a fox's tail. As you look at them, you can't help but get a sense of deja vu, a feeling that these look somehow familiar.

            According to the local lore of the Frost Marches, they're perfectly edible, but you'd need to be really, really hungry to want to eat these things instead of anything else. As to why that's the case... you'd have to taste some to find out."

rows.original: Twisting off the stem from the cluster, you pop the fox berries in your mouth and begin chewing. Barely moments have passed before you're reminded in the most painful and acute manner why sane people don't eat these things if they can help it at all: you feel as if you're chewing on half-dried starch. It would have been better if the berries had simply tasted bad, but these things simply have absolutely no flavor whatsoever, no matter how you chew. It's almost surreal, and the thoroughly-masticated fruit flesh clings to the insides of your gullet as it slides down with agonising slowness.
rows.translation: 你从花簇中摘下果实，将它们放入口中开始咀嚼。然而才过了短短片刻，你就以最为痛苦和明显的方式意识到了为什么正常人会尽量避免食用这些东西：咀嚼起来，你感觉自己像是在嚼半干的淀粉一样。如果这些果实的味道实在难吃，或许还能忍受一些，但事实上，无论你怎么嚼，它们都丝毫没有味道。这感觉近乎超现实。那些被充分嚼烂的果肉会粘在你的食道内壁，然后以极其缓慢的速度滑落下去。
rows.raw: "\n Twisting off the stem from the cluster, you pop the fox berries in your mouth and begin chewing. Barely moments have passed before you're reminded in the most painful and acute manner why sane people don't eat these things if they can help it at all: you feel as if you're chewing on half-dried starch. It would have been better if the berries had simply tasted bad, but these things simply have absolutely no flavor whatsoever, no matter how you chew. It's almost surreal, and the thoroughly-masticated fruit flesh clings to the insides of your gullet as it slides down with agonising slowness."

rows.translation: 猫舌莓
猫莓

rows.original: A small, flat berry from the Cat's Tongue plant that many say resembles the tongue of a common feline. In a past age there was a young catfolk prince, the last of his line. An attempt on his life left him lost in the harsh wastes of the Southlands. He wandered the dangerous dunes for over a day before resigning himself to his death, and the end of his family line. In the moments before he passed out, he saw a glimmer in the distance. Spending the last of his strength, he dragged himself toward the last speck of hope he had. His faith was well placed, as he found an oasis of fruit-bearing plants and water. He sustained himself for two more days before his people found him. The prince went on to become a powerful ruler, and he proclaimed that the bushes be spread far and wide, as they were a boon from the gods.
rows.translation: 这种果实来自“猫舌草”，外形小巧而扁平，许多人认为它确实很像普通猫科动物的舌头。在很久以前，有一位年轻的猫族王子，他是他家族的最后一位后代。在一次谋杀企图中，他流落在了南境那片荒凉的地区。他在那些危险的沙丘中徘徊了一整天，最终放弃了生存的希望，也意味着他的家族也将就此断绝。在即将昏厥的那一刻，他远远地看到了一丝光芒。他用尽最后的力气，朝着那最后一线希望爬去。他的信念没有白费，因为他找到了一个长满结果实的植物和有水的绿洲。他在那里又坚持了两天，直到他的族人找到了他。后来，这位王子成为了一位强大的统治者，他下令将这些灌木丛广泛种植开来，因为它们是神赐的恩惠。
rows.raw: "\n            A small, flat berry from the Cat's Tongue plant that many say resembles the tongue of a common feline. In a past age there was a young catfolk prince, the last of his line. An attempt on his life left him lost in the harsh wastes of the Southlands. He wandered the dangerous dunes for over a day before resigning himself to his death, and the end of his family line. In the moments before he passed out, he saw a glimmer in the distance. Spending the last of his strength, he dragged himself toward the last speck of hope he had. His faith was well placed, as he found an oasis of fruit-bearing plants and water. He sustained himself for two more days before his people found him. The prince went on to become a powerful ruler, and he proclaimed that the bushes be spread far and wide, as they were a boon from the gods."

rows.original: The small berry could barely be considered a snack in most people's eyes. You flick it up into the air and catch it on your tongue, chewing it only a few times before it's complete mush, and swallow. Surprisingly tart, but more flavorful than you'd expect for something so small.
rows.translation: 在大多数人的眼里，这种小浆果几乎算不上是一种零食。你把它抛到空中，接住后放在舌头上，嚼上几下，它就会变成一团糊状，然后被吞下去。这种浆果的酸味出人意料，但考虑到它的体积如此之小，它的味道其实比你想象的要浓郁得多。
rows.raw: "\n            The small berry could barely be considered a snack in most people's eyes. You flick it up into the air and catch it on your tongue, chewing it only a few times before it's complete mush, and swallow. Surprisingly tart, but more flavorful than you'd expect for something so small."

rows.translation: 人之根
人类的根源

rows.original: The root of some ancient plant. Long ago there was a human commune that came under the influence of a dark plague. This plague not only racked them with sickness, but slowly twisted their bodies into abominations. The people were dying, and all the rest could do was pray for some sign of relief. That relief came in the form of a knowledgeable traveler who informed them of a plant said to be able to heal all sickness. A young girl followed his directions, journeying far from home in order to help her people. However, when she found the plant, it had been picked clean, leaving nothing but the roots. The girl broke down into tearful prayers to Lumia, begging for something to save her commune. Suddenly a root sprang up under her foot, tripping her. Initially regarded as yet more bad luck, she realized that it must be a sign from her goddess. She took the roots of the plant back to her people, and with Lumia's own luck, used it to cure their affliction.
rows.translation: 某种古老植物的根茎。很久以前，有一个人类聚居地遭到了某种暗影瘟疫的侵袭。这种瘟疫不仅使他们饱受疾病的折磨，还逐渐将他们的身体扭曲成令人憎恶的形态。人们纷纷死去，而其他人所能做的，只有祈祷能出现某种缓解灾祸的迹象。这种希望来自于一位见多识广的旅行者，他告诉他们有一种植物据说能够治愈所有的疾病。一位年轻女孩按照他的指示出发了，她远离家乡，只为帮助自己的族人。然而，当她找到那种植物时，发现它已经被人们采得一干二净，只剩下根部了。女孩泪流满面地向卢米娅祈祷，恳求她能拯救她的族群。突然，她脚下长出了一根根根茎，使她绊倒了。起初，她以为这只是又一次不幸的降临，但后来她意识到，这一定是她的女神给她的启示。她将这种植物的根带回了自己的族群，而凭借卢米娅的运气，人们用这种根治愈了自己的疾病。
rows.raw: "\n            The root of some ancient plant. Long ago there was a human commune that came under the influence of a dark plague. This plague not only racked them with sickness, but slowly twisted their bodies into abominations. The people were dying, and all the rest could do was pray for some sign of relief. That relief came in the form of a knowledgeable traveler who informed them of a plant said to be able to heal all sickness. A young girl followed his directions, journeying far from home in order to help her people. However, when she found the plant, it had been picked clean, leaving nothing but the roots. The girl broke down into tearful prayers to Lumia, begging for something to save her commune. Suddenly a root sprang up under her foot, tripping her. Initially regarded as yet more bad luck, she realized that it must be a sign from her goddess.
