It proves to be surprisingly brittle, cracking and splintering into tiny chunks in your mouth, pleasantly cool as you swallow hard and feel them enter your stomach. Oddly enough, it leaves a faintly sweet taste lingering on your tongue, as if the ice had been frozen from honeyed water...
rows.translation: 你想着如果把它泡在饮料里喝下去，会不会更容易咽下去，于是把那块冰块放进嘴里，用力咬了一口。结果发现它出奇地易碎，在嘴里立刻碎成了小小的碎片。当你用力吞下去时，那些冰块带来的清凉感令人感到愉悦，而更奇怪的是，它们在舌头上留下了一丝淡淡的甜味，仿佛这些冰块原本就是用含糖的水冻制而成的……
rows.raw: "Wondering if it would go down easier if served in a drink, you pop the ice shard into your mouth and bite down hard. It proves to be surprisingly brittle, cracking and splintering into tiny chunks in your mouth, pleasantly cool as you swallow hard and feel them enter your stomach. Oddly enough, it leaves a faintly sweet taste lingering on your tongue, as if the ice had been frozen from honeyed water... "

rows.translation: 米诺血酒
米诺血酒

rows.original: A bottle of Minoblood Wine, made from a dark green glass. The wine inside glistens and smoothly slides around, coating it crimson wherever it goes.
rows.translation: 一瓶装在深绿色玻璃瓶中的弥诺陶洛斯血酒。里面的酒液泛着微光，缓缓流动，在经过之处给瓶壁染上猩红。
rows.raw: "\n        A bottle of Minoblood Wine, made from a dark green glass. The wine inside glistens and smoothly slides around, coating it crimson wherever it goes."

rows.original: Popping the cork and hefting it high, you waste no time chugging a mouthful of every minotaur's favorite beverage. The scarlet surprise warms up your whole body, tinting you with just a hit of alcohol behind its sweetness. But before you can really bask in its flavor, it's gone; you chuck the now-empty bottle away, licking your lips clean.
rows.translation: 你拔开瓶盖，将酒瓶高高举起，毫不犹豫地喝了一大口——这正是米诺陶尔们最喜爱的饮品。那猩红色的酒液瞬间温暖了你的全身，甜美的味道中隐约带着酒精的刺激感。然而，还没等你好好品味这种滋味，酒就已经喝光了；你把空瓶扔到一边，舔了舔嘴唇，回味着那短暂的美好体验。
rows.raw: "\n        Popping the cork and hefting it high, you waste no time chugging a mouthful of every minotaur's favorite beverage. The scarlet surprise warms up your whole body, tinting you with just a hit of alcohol behind its sweetness. But before you can really bask in its flavor, it's gone; you chuck the now-empty bottle away, licking your lips clean."

rows.translation: 牛奶雪利酒
博夫·雪利酒

rows.original: A gold-tinted bottle of a dark, bubbly beverage with a cowgirl mooing on its label.
rows.translation: 一瓶呈金色的、带有气泡的深色饮料，其标签上还印着一位牛仔姑娘发出的哞哞声。
rows.raw: "\n            A gold-tinted bottle of a dark, bubbly beverage with a cowgirl mooing on its label."

rows.original: Popping the cork of your bottle of sherry, you take a nice, deep drink... for about a minute. The way it tastes and how it feels in your mouth makes you want to swallow every last drop, warm or cold. The splendorous drink doesn't last long however, eventually dribbling droplets down your gullet before you set the bottle down.
rows.translation: 你拔开雪利酒瓶的瓶塞，深深地喝了一大口……这一口持续了大概一分钟。它的味道以及在口中带来的感受，让你忍不住想要把每一滴酒都喝下去，无论是温的还是冷的。然而，这种美妙的滋味并没有持续太久，最终那些酒液还是顺着你的喉咙流了下去，然后你才把酒瓶放回原处。
rows.raw: "\n            Popping the cork of your bottle of sherry, you take a nice, deep drink... for about a minute. The way it tastes and how it feels in your mouth makes you want to swallow every last drop, warm or cold. The splendorous drink doesn't last long however, eventually dribbling droplets down your gullet before you set the bottle down."

rows.translation: 坏三叶草
坏三叶草

rows.original:
A bundle of purple and green long-stem clover, bound together with white string.
            
            Originating from a nation to the south, this clover earns it name from being highly aggressive as an invasive species. Farmers — absolutely sick of the stuff — began feeding it to their sheep. It wasn't until later that they found out that it's an extremely valuable commodity to the sheepfolk and those seeking to be more ovis-like. Since then, farmers grow bundles of the stuff on the side as a luxury good.
rows.translation:
一束由紫色和绿色的长茎三叶草用白色绳子捆扎在一起。
            
            这种三叶草原产于南方的一个国家，因为它具有极强的入侵性而得名。农民们对这种植物感到非常厌烦，于是开始用它来喂养羊群。后来他们才发现，这种植物对羊群以及那些希望让自家的动物更像羊的人来说，其实是一种极其有价值的资源。从那以后，农民们就会把这种三叶草作为一种奢侈品来种植。
rows.raw:
"
            A bundle of purple and green long-stem clover, bound together with white string.
            
            Originating from a nation to the south, this clover earns it name from being highly aggressive as an invasive species. Farmers — absolutely sick of the stuff — began feeding it to their sheep. It wasn't until later that they found out that it's an extremely valuable commodity to the sheepfolk and those seeking to be more ovis-like. Since then, farmers grow bundles of the stuff on the side as a luxury good."

rows.original: Flicking the string free from the clover lets you chomp a mouthful of herbs. Although they're a bit tough, the greens are particularly refreshing! Flavorless yet hydrating you with only one bite!
rows.translation: 将绳子从三叶草上拨开，你就可以吃到一口新鲜的草本植物了。虽然这些叶子有点硬，但它们的味道确实非常清爽！虽然没有什么特别的味道，但只要咬一口，就能为你补充水分！
rows.raw: "\n            Flicking the string free from the clover lets you chomp a mouthful of herbs. Although they're a bit tough, the greens are particularly refreshing! Flavorless yet hydrating you with only one bite!"

rows.translation: 胡萝卜精液纸杯蛋糕
胡萝卜蛋糕

rows.original:
A cupcake big enough to fill one's palm, glazed in white cream with lopped carrot bits scattered across its top.
            
            One of the treats of bunny-likes everywhere, these scrumptious treats have always been found not far from the taeleer homesteads both within the Empire and abroad. There's a rumor that the first recipe used the cum of human masters to reward the enslaved bunnies. Thankfully — or perhaps regretfully — they're baked with the everyday consumer in mind and replaced it for carrot-blended cream.
rows.translation:
这种大小正好能放在手掌中的纸杯蛋糕，表面覆盖着白色奶油，上面还撒着切碎的胡萝卜丁。
            
            这种美味的小点心在帝国境内外的泰勒人聚居地附近随处都能找到，确实是让人垂涎欲滴的美食。有传言称，最初的配方中使用人类主人的精液来奖励那些被奴役的小兔子。不过，幸运的是——或者也许应该说遗憾的是——后来这些饼干在制作时考虑到了普通消费者的需求，因此改用了胡萝卜混合奶油作为原料。
rows.raw:
"
            A cupcake big enough to fill one's palm, glazed in white cream with lopped carrot bits scattered across its top.
            
            One of the treats of bunny-likes everywhere, these scrumptious treats have always been found not far from the taeleer homesteads both within the Empire and abroad. There's a rumor that the first recipe used the cum of human masters to reward the enslaved bunnies. Thankfully — or perhaps regretfully — they're baked with the everyday consumer in mind and replaced it for carrot-blended cream."

rows.original: Examining your cumpcake rather quickly, you waste no time digging in with a single carrot-crunching bite![silly|[flags.CUMPCAKES_USED 1 2 10| The cream and veggie bits make a weird mix of flavor but overall it's far from bad; if anything you imagine it's probably more of an acquired taste.| It might be a weird mix of flavors but you're starting to get why the treat is popular.| If someone tried taking this tasty treat away you might just rise up and start a revolution.]] In a matter of moments the treat is gone however and you're left feeling just an extra bit more satisfied!
rows.translation: 你很快就开始品尝你的“蛋糕”，毫不浪费时间，第一口就大口咬了下去！[silly|[flags.CUMPCAKES_USED 1 2 10| 奶油和蔬菜碎混合在一起后会产生一种奇怪的风味，但总体来说还算不错；如果说有什么不同的话，那就是这种味道可能需要一段时间才能让人习惯。| 这种口味的组合可能有点奇怪，但你现在应该明白为什么这种零食会这么受欢迎了吧。| 如果有人试图抢走这种美味的零食，你可能会奋起反抗，甚至发动一场“革命”。]]不过，转瞬间这些美味就消失了，但你会因此感到更加满足！
rows.raw: "\n        Examining your cumpcake rather quickly, you waste no time digging in with a single carrot-crunching bite![silly|[flags.CUMPCAKES_USED 1 2 10| The cream and veggie bits make a weird mix of flavor but overall it's far from bad; if anything you imagine it's probably more of an acquired taste.| It might be a weird mix of flavors but you're starting to get why the treat is popular.| If someone tried taking this tasty treat away you might just rise up and start a revolution.]] In a matter of moments the treat is gone however and you're left feeling just an extra bit more satisfied!"

rows.translation: 蝎狮乳头
蝎尾狮猫薄荷

rows.original: This small plant bears triangular, coarse-toothed leaves and carries with a fragrant aroma that is faintly reminiscent of mint. Some scholars say that housecats, catfolk, and other races that bear some resemblance to them find this plant's leaves to be alluring, and often rub it against their face and nose and will, on occasion, even ingest the leaves.
rows.translation: 这种小型植物长有三角形、边缘带有粗锯齿的叶子，散发出一种略带薄荷香气的芬芳。一些学者认为，家猫、猫族以及其他与它们有某些相似之处的种族，都会觉得这种植物的叶子非常诱人，它们经常会将叶子揉在脸上或鼻子上，偶尔甚至会将其吃下去。
rows.raw: "\n        This small plant bears triangular, coarse-toothed leaves and carries with a fragrant aroma that is faintly reminiscent of mint. Some scholars say that housecats, catfolk, and other races that bear some resemblance to them find this plant's leaves to be alluring, and often rub it against their face and nose and will, on occasion, even ingest the leaves."

rows.original: As [char.combatName] bring[tps|s] the leaves close to [char.combatHisHer] mouth, [char.ra catfolk|[char.combatNames] eyes go wide and a grin slowly forms on [char.combatHisHer] face|[char.combatName] take[tps|s] in the minty aroma of the plant]. [char.CombatHeShe] then put[tps|s] the leaves into [char.combatHisHer] waiting maw, chew[tps|s] a few times, and then swallow[tps|s] [char.ra catfolk|the euphoria-inducing plant|the manticore nip].
rows.translation: 当[char.combatName]将[tps|]叶片凑近[char.combatHisHer]嘴边时，[char.ra catfolk|[char.combatNames]双眼睁大，[char.combatHisHer]脸上慢慢浮现笑容|[char.combatName]嗅[tps|]到植物清凉的薄荷香气]。[char.CombatHeShe]随后将[tps|]叶片放进[char.combatHisHer]张开的嘴里，咀嚼[tps|]几下，再吞下[tps|][char.ra catfolk|这种令人欣快的植物|曼提科尔猫薄荷]。
rows.raw: "\n           As [char.combatName] bring[tps|s] the leaves close to [char.combatHisHer] mouth, [char.ra catfolk|[char.combatNames] eyes go wide and a grin slowly forms on [char.combatHisHer] face|[char.combatName] take[tps|s] in the minty aroma of the plant]. [char.CombatHeShe] then put[tps|s] the leaves into [char.combatHisHer] waiting maw, chew[tps|s] a few times, and then swallow[tps|s] [char.ra catfolk|the euphoria-inducing plant|the manticore nip]."

rows.translation: 壮阳剂
壮阳剂

rows.original: A small potion bottle filled with a strange pink liquid. You're not sure of much other than Vaush telling you that it grew his balls tremendously as well as boosting his cum production to ridiculous levels.
rows.translation: 一个装着奇怪粉红色液体的小药水瓶。除了沃什告诉你这种药水让他的睾丸体积大幅增大，同时还让他的精液分泌量增加到了惊人的程度之外，你对其它方面其实并不了解太多。
rows.raw: "\n        A small potion bottle filled with a strange pink liquid. You're not sure of much other than Vaush telling you that it grew his balls tremendously as well as boosting his cum production to ridiculous levels."

rows.original: You drink down the strange concoction, feeling it almost slither down your throat. There's something unmistakably sinister about it, erasing any doubt in your mind that it's related to what happened up at the temple. Is that going to stop you from drinking more in the future? That's to be seen.
rows.translation: 你将这种奇怪的混合物一饮而尽，感觉它仿佛顺着喉咙滑了下去。这种液体身上散发着一种明显的邪恶气息，让你毫不怀疑它与寺庙里发生的事情有关。不过，这是否会阻止你将来再继续饮用它呢？还有待观察。
rows.raw: "\n        You drink down the strange concoction, feeling it almost slither down your throat. There's something unmistakably sinister about it, erasing any doubt in your mind that it's related to what happened up at the temple. Is that going to stop you from drinking more in the future? That's to be seen."

rows.translation: 咯咯莓
卡克尔贝里

rows.original: A small cluster of assorted berries with a rather round appearance, looking like small furry brown balls with black stripes running around the sides. This gives them a rather outlandish, even unappetizing appearance, and as such the effects of this strange fruit are not fully known beyond laughing fits when consumed. Some scholars, however, speculate they are related to gnolls.
rows.translation: 一小簇形状较为圆润的混合浆果，看起来就像那些表面布满棕色绒毛、侧面带有黑色条纹的小球。这种外观让它们显得相当怪异，甚至让人觉得没有食欲。因此，目前人们对这种奇特水果的具体功效还知之甚少，人们吃下它们后通常只会发笑。不过，也有一些学者推测，这种水果可能与地精有关。
rows.raw: "\n        A small cluster of assorted berries with a rather round appearance, looking like small furry brown balls with black stripes running around the sides. This gives them a rather outlandish, even unappetizing appearance, and as such the effects of this strange fruit are not fully known beyond laughing fits when consumed. Some scholars, however, speculate they are related to gnolls."

rows.original: You pull the berries from the stem, rolling them around in your palm. A moment later, you pop a few of them into your mouth and chew away. The fur's texture is horrendous; it isn't until you pop through the fruit's coat and flesh before the berry's oddly sweet taste fills your mouth. It tastes so great, you could break out into laughter!
rows.translation: 你将那些浆果从茎上摘下来，在手掌中把它们滚动几下。片刻之后，你挑了几颗放进嘴里开始咀嚼。那些外皮的质地实在糟糕极了，直到你咬破果皮和果肉，那种奇怪的甜味才会充满你的口腔。这种味道实在太美味了，让你忍不住想要大笑出来！
rows.raw: "\n        You pull the berries from the stem, rolling them around in your palm. A moment later, you pop a few of them into your mouth and chew away. The fur's texture is horrendous; it isn't until you pop through the fruit's coat and flesh before the berry's oddly sweet taste fills your mouth. It tastes so great, you could break out into laughter!"

rows.original: Your body rumbling is a bit alarming... but not for long; it ends in a matter of moments and leaves you to look yourself over. You're not as wide as you were before!
rows.translation: 你的身体发出的咕噜声确实有点吓人……但这种感觉不会持续太久，很快就会结束，之后你就可以检查一下自己的身体状况了。你现在的体型已经没有以前那么魁梧了！
rows.raw: "\n Your body rumbling is a bit alarming... but not for long; it ends in a matter of moments and leaves you to look yourself over. You're not as wide as you were before!"

rows.translation: 狼人荆棘
狼人荆棘

rows.original: At first glance, this purple-leaved flower could easily be mistaken for Wolfsboon, but an unwary investigator will quickly find themselves pricked by the numerous thorns on the plant's stem. Created by the Alraune's corruption seeping into the local wolfsboon, the corruption in these plants has likely changed the transformations one could get as a result of using alchemy on one.
rows.translation: 乍一看，这种紫色叶子的植物很容易被误认为是普通的狼爪草，但任何不慎靠近的调查者很快就会发现，这种植物的茎上布满了尖刺。实际上，这些植物是阿尔劳奈的腐蚀力量渗入当地的狼爪草后形成的。这种腐蚀作用很可能改变了人们通过炼金术使用这些植物时可能产生的变化效果。
rows.raw: "\n        At first glance, this purple-leaved flower could easily be mistaken for Wolfsboon, but an unwary investigator will quickly find themselves pricked by the numerous thorns on the plant's stem. Created by the Alraune's corruption seeping into the local wolfsboon, the corruption in these plants has likely changed the transformations one could get as a result of using alchemy on one."

rows.original: You pull the plant's flower off its stem—careful to avoid any of the thorns that threaten to prick your fingers—and toss it into your mouth. You're immediately assaulted with a harsh, astringent flavor that makes you recoil. Despite the awful flavor, you manage to swallow down the flower and begin to feel its effects taking hold.
rows.translation: 你将花朵从茎上摘下来——务必小心避开那些可能会刺伤手指的刺——然后把它放进嘴里。顿时，一股刺鼻、收敛性的味道袭来，让你不由得缩了缩脖子。尽管这种味道糟糕至极，你还是勉强咽下了这朵花，随后开始感受到它带来的效果。
rows.raw: "\n        You pull the plant's flower off its stem—careful to avoid any of the thorns that threaten to prick your fingers—and toss it into your mouth. You're immediately assaulted with a harsh, astringent flavor that makes you recoil. Despite the awful flavor, you manage to swallow down the flower and begin to feel its effects taking hold."

rows.translation: 狼恩
狼恩

rows.original: A large purple flower with a 5 starred leaf pattern. Rumored to be involved in ancient Lupine hunting and mating rituals, the plant holds almost a proud aura to it's starred flora.
rows.translation: 一朵大型紫色花朵，其叶片上布满了五角星图案。据传说，这种植物与古代狼族族的狩猎及交配仪式有着密切关联，因此它的这种星形图案似乎蕴含着某种庄严而自豪的含义。
rows.raw: "\n        A large purple flower with a 5 starred leaf pattern. Rumored to be involved in ancient Lupine hunting and mating rituals, the plant holds almost a proud aura to it's starred flora."

rows.original: You bite the strange plant, expecting a basic, earthy taste. Betraying those expectations, your tongue is blasted by a spiced richness. It's almost akin to mint, but far more vivid in it's wildness. You find yourself chewing it in excess, drinking down it's juices and feeling refreshed for doing so.
rows.translation: 你咬下了这种陌生的植物，本以为它会带有那种朴实、大地般的味道。然而，出乎意料的是，你的舌头瞬间被一股浓郁的香料味冲击住了。这种味道有点像薄荷，但却带着更为浓郁的野性。你不由得开始大量咀嚼它，喝下它的汁液，感觉这样做之后整个人都变得神清气爽起来。
rows.raw: "\n        You bite the strange plant, expecting a basic, earthy taste. Betraying those expectations, your tongue is blasted by a spiced richness. It's almost akin to mint, but far more vivid in it's wildness. You find yourself chewing it in excess, drinking down it's juices and feeling refreshed for doing so."

rows.translation: 烬叶
烬叶

rows.original: A curious and uncommon form of weed, Cinderleaf is known to be a favorite of simple reptiles and common folk alike. It has a thick, dark green stem and is covered in ticklish hairs like many-a-weed while the stalk is merely a long point that continues to grow until the plant dies. However, what's prized are the hexagonal, ruby-to-orange leaves that line the stalk. [pc.bg arcanist scholar acolyte|You remember that contemporary arcanists say that using these leaves in cookery adds a 'spicy kick' to meals. The common folk are more likely to say it burns as if the sun had swallowed all Savarra. ]Sister plant to Frostleaf.
rows.translation: 这种外形奇特且较为罕见的杂草，被人们称为“灰烬叶”。它深受低等爬行动物以及普通民众的喜爱。灰烬叶拥有粗壮的深绿色茎干，茎干上布满了细小的绒毛，与许多其他杂草相似；而它的茎部实际上只是一根不断生长的细长枝条，直到植株死亡才会停止生长。真正值得珍视的，则是那些排列在茎干上的六边形叶片——这些叶片的颜色从红宝石色逐渐过渡到橙色，十分美丽。 [pc.bg arcanist scholar acolyte|你应该还记得，现代的神秘学者们说过，在烹饪中使用这些叶子会给食物增添一种“辛辣的风味”。而普通民众则更可能会说，使用这些叶子会让食物变得像被太阳烤焦了一样。 ]与霜叶草同属一个植物家族的植物。
rows.raw: "\n        A curious and uncommon form of weed, Cinderleaf is known to be a favorite of simple reptiles and common folk alike. It has a thick, dark green stem and is covered in ticklish hairs like many-a-weed while the stalk is merely a long point that continues to grow until the plant dies. However, what's prized are the hexagonal, ruby-to-orange leaves that line the stalk. [pc.bg arcanist scholar acolyte|You remember that contemporary arcanists say that using these leaves in cookery adds a 'spicy kick' to meals. The common folk are more likely to say it burns as if the sun had swallowed all Savarra. ]Sister plant to Frostleaf."

rows.original: Welp, it's a plant. In truth, only the leaves look at all appetizing so you pluck them off of the thick, dark green stalk of the weed and toss the refuse away. With a quick inhale and exhale, you stuff the small palmful of leaves into your mouth and bite down the anticipation. As you chew, a nasty spiciness spreads through your entire mouth, immediately making you hot under the collar. Might have been a hasty decision. You gulp down the leaves as quickly as possible just to get rid of that uncomfortable spice.
rows.translation: 嗯，这是一种植物。事实上，只有它的叶子看起来比较可口，所以你可以把那些叶子从那粗壮的深绿色茎上摘下来，然后把剩下的部分扔掉。深吸一口气，再呼出来，你把那一小把叶子放进嘴里，满怀期待地咬了下去。当你咀嚼的时候，一种刺鼻的辣味立刻在你的口腔中扩散开来，让你顿时感到一阵燥热。 或许这确实是一个草率的决定。你为了尽快摆脱那种难吃的味道，拼命地快速吞下那些叶子。
rows.raw: " Welp, it's a plant. In truth, only the leaves look at all appetizing so you pluck them off of the thick, dark green stalk of the weed and toss the refuse away. With a quick inhale and exhale, you stuff the small palmful of leaves into your mouth and bite down the anticipation. As you chew, a nasty spiciness spreads through your entire mouth, immediately making you hot under the collar. Might have been a hasty decision. You gulp down the leaves as quickly as possible just to get rid of that uncomfortable spice."

rows.translation: 霜叶
霜叶

rows.original: A curious and uncommon form of weed, Frostleaf is known to be a favorite of simple reptiles and common folk alike. It has a curling, bluish-green stem and is covered in ticklish hairs like many-a-weed while the stalk is merely a long point that continues to grow until the plant dies. However, what's prized are the hexagonal, blue-to-white leaves that line the stalk. [pc.bg arcanist scholar acolyte|You remember that contemporary arcanists say that using these leaves in cookery adds a 'quick method of cooling' to meals. The common folk are more likely to say it ruins a perfectly good pease pudding. ]Sister plant to Cinderleaf.
rows.translation: 这种外形奇特且较为罕见的杂草，被人们称为“霜叶草”。它深受低等爬行动物和普通民众的喜爱。它的茎呈蓝绿色，表面布满了细小的绒毛，与许多其他杂草相似；而它的茎干实际上只是一根不断生长的细长枝条，直到植株死亡才会停止生长。真正值得珍视的，是那些排列在茎干上的六边形叶片，它们的颜色从蓝色逐渐变为白色。 [pc.bg arcanist scholar acolyte|你应该还记得，现代的神秘学者们说过，在烹饪中使用这些叶子可以为食物带来“快速降温”的效果。不过，普通民众更可能会认为，这种做法会毁掉原本美味的豌豆布丁。 ]与烬叶同属一个植物家族的植物。
rows.raw: "\n        A curious and uncommon form of weed, Frostleaf is known to be a favorite of simple reptiles and common folk alike. It has a curling, bluish-green stem and is covered in ticklish hairs like many-a-weed while the stalk is merely a long point that continues to grow until the plant dies. However, what's prized are the hexagonal, blue-to-white leaves that line the stalk. [pc.bg arcanist scholar acolyte|You remember that contemporary arcanists say that using these leaves in cookery adds a 'quick method of cooling' to meals. The common folk are more likely to say it ruins a perfectly good pease pudding. ]Sister plant to Cinderleaf."

rows.original:
The light-green stalk is quite strange to the touch, having some sort of herbal coolness similar to menthol that irritates your [char.skinFurScales]. Holding it between your fingertips, you pluck off the icy-blue leaves and toss that nasty stalk away. They're cool to the touch but not at all an irritant to your skin. Feeling at ease, you put the small palmful of leaves in your mouth and chow down. Immediately, a coolness hits your tongue and mouth. The flavor reminds you of fresh air and snowy winds although is otherwise rather plain. 

        You gulp it all down and savor the freshness it leaves in your mouth.
rows.translation:
这种浅绿色的茎秆摸起来相当奇特，带有一种类似薄荷的清凉感，会刺激你的[char.skinFurScales]。将茎秆夹在指尖之间，你轻轻摘下那些冰蓝色的叶子，然后将那些难吃的茎秆扔掉。这些叶子摸起来很凉，但并不会刺激你的皮肤。你放心地把那一小把叶子放进嘴里嚼起来，顿时，一股清凉的感觉传遍了你的舌头和口腔。这种味道让你联想到新鲜空气和雪风，不过总体来说，它的味道其实相当清淡。

        你大口地将它们吞下，尽情享受它们在口中留下的清新感。
rows.raw:
"
        The light-green stalk is quite strange to the touch, having some sort of herbal coolness similar to menthol that irritates your [char.skinFurScales]. Holding it between your fingertips, you pluck off the icy-blue leaves and toss that nasty stalk away. They're cool to the touch but not at all an irritant to your skin. Feeling at ease, you put the small palmful of leaves in your mouth and chow down. Immediately, a coolness hits your tongue and mouth. The flavor reminds you of fresh air and snowy winds although is otherwise rather plain. 

        You gulp it all down and savor the freshness it leaves in your mouth."

rows.translation: 哥布番茄
哥布番茄

rows.original:
[A] [silly|dummy thicc|juicy, plump] tomato found near and around goblin settlements in the heartland of Belhar. Always harvested when it turns from red to green, its smell when cut acts as an aphrodisiac to goblins.
        
        Every goblin's favorite meal — before starting the day and before starting sex — the grottato has been the staple of Belhar foods and dinners for many years. They can be grown anywhere and mutate slightly when planted among other plants; many believe they originally looked like another plant before mimicking tomatoes. Those who eat grottatoes are known to become more goblin-like with a steady enough diet!
rows.translation:
[A] [silly|假充粗壮|多汁、饱满]在贝尔哈尔腹地的哥布林聚居地附近及周围，人们总能找到这种番茄。这种番茄总是在从红色变成绿色时被采摘下来，而切开后散发出的气味对哥布林们来说具有催情作用。
        
        对每一个哥布林来说，这种番茄都是他们最喜爱的食物——无论是在一天开始之前，还是在开始性行为之前，它多年来一直都是贝尔哈尔地区人们日常饮食中的主食。这种植物可以在任何地方种植，当与其他植物一起种植时，它的形态会发生轻微的变化；许多人认为，它在进化成番茄之前，原本看起来就像另一种植物。据说，如果经常食用这种植物，人的外貌会逐渐变得像哥布林一样！
rows.raw:
"
        [A] [silly|dummy thicc|juicy, plump] tomato found near and around goblin settlements in the heartland of Belhar. Always harvested when it turns from red to green, its smell when cut acts as an aphrodisiac to goblins.
        
        Every goblin's favorite meal — before starting the day and before starting sex — the grottato has been the staple of Belhar foods and dinners for many years. They can be grown anywhere and mutate slightly when planted among other plants; many believe they originally looked like another plant before mimicking tomatoes. Those who eat grottatoes are known to become more goblin-like with a steady enough diet!"

rows.original: Rifling through your things and pulling free [var0|one of ]your grottato[var0|es], you bite into the sucker and chew away.[pc.ra goblin| You feel a shiver of arousal race down your spine as proof of your descent into goblinhood.]
rows.translation: 你翻找随身物品，取出[var0|其中一个]哥布林番茄[var0|]，咬下一口，嚼了起来。[pc.ra goblin|一阵情欲的颤栗沿着脊背掠过，印证着你正在变成哥布林。]
rows.raw: "\n        Rifling through your things and pulling free [var0|one of ]your grottato[var0|es], you bite into the sucker and chew away.[pc.ra goblin| You feel a shiver of arousal race down your spine as proof of your descent into goblinhood.]"

rows.translation: 环纹桃
环纹桃

rows.original: A rare breed of peach. No one has been able to ascertain the origin of these odd fruits, only that they seem to appear in otherwise perfectly normal peach fields as harvests draw to a close. More superstitious farmers blame them on the tanuki, due to the ring pattern of the fruit resembled that of tanuki's tails. These farmers spread tales ranging from dark magic and blood sacrifice, to seeing the tricksters out in their fields at night with paint brushes, or rigorously %"fertilizing" their peach harvests.
rows.translation: 这是一种极为罕见的桃子品种。至今还没有人能够查明这些奇特果实的起源，只知道它们总是在那些看起来完全正常的桃园里，在收获季节即将结束时出现。一些迷信的农民将这些果实的出现归咎于狸猫，因为这些果实的花纹与狸猫的尾巴非常相似。这些农民编造出了各种离奇的故事：从暗影魔法和血祭仪式，到声称在夜晚看到这些狡猾的动物拿着画笔在果园里活动，甚至还有说法称是人们特意对桃树进行了特殊的“施肥”处理，才导致了这种奇特现象的出现。
rows.raw: '\n        A rare breed of peach. No one has been able to ascertain the origin of these odd fruits, only that they seem to appear in otherwise perfectly normal peach fields as harvests draw to a close. More superstitious farmers blame them on the tanuki, due to the ring pattern of the fruit resembled that of tanuki\'s tails. These farmers spread tales ranging from dark magic and blood sacrifice, to seeing the tricksters out in their fields at night with paint brushes, or rigorously %"fertilizing" their peach harvests.'

rows.original: You bite into the fruit only to reel back as juice gushes out in pressurized streams. It's so juicy that eating it feels more like drinking a slurry. By the time you're down to the core, you're wishing you brought a towel with how much opaque peach-juice spilled onto you.
rows.translation: 你刚咬下一口水果，果汁便如加压的液体般喷涌而出。这种果汁太过浓稠，吃起来更像是在喝一种糊状物。等到你吃到果核的时候，才会后悔没有带条毛巾，因为那么多不透明的桃汁已经溅得到了处都是。
rows.raw: "\n        You bite into the fruit only to reel back as juice gushes out in pressurized streams. It's so juicy that eating it feels more like drinking a slurry. By the time you're down to the core, you're wishing you brought a towel with how much opaque peach-juice spilled onto you."

rows.translation: 闪光粉
闪光粉

rows.original: A fine, glittering dust left from the wings of mothfolk and used by adventurers and homesteaders for its luminescent qualities. Sprinkling this dust around a candle or torch's flame causes a great myriad of colors to erupt in the air, which can be used for signaling nearby villages, luring in insects, or traversing dark caves. Sunlight has a strangely reduced effect on the dust and barely produces even a weak glitter.
rows.translation: 这种细小而闪烁的粉末源自蛾人的翅膀，冒险者和定居者们正是利用它的发光特性来使用它。将这种粉末撒在蜡烛或火把的火焰周围，会引发空气中绚丽多彩的光芒，这种光芒可以用来向附近的村庄发出信号、吸引昆虫，或是帮助人们在暗影的洞穴中前行。然而，阳光对这种粉末的影响却奇怪地减弱了，几乎无法让它发出任何微弱的光芒。
rows.raw: "\n        A fine, glittering dust left from the wings of mothfolk and used by adventurers and homesteaders for its luminescent qualities. Sprinkling this dust around a candle or torch's flame causes a great myriad of colors to erupt in the air, which can be used for signaling nearby villages, luring in insects, or traversing dark caves. Sunlight has a strangely reduced effect on the dust and barely produces even a weak glitter."

rows.original: Although you're not [flags.GLITTER_DUST_USES 1 2|entirely sure about this|quite used to this], you pop the bag open and let the dust out into your palm. [dayNight|The sun brightens the dust — albeit rather weakly — but doesn't dissuade you;|The immense shine the dust is giving off from the moonlight makes it difficult but] you eat the handful without a moment's extra hesitation.
rows.translation: 虽然你[flags.GLITTER_DUST_USES 1 2|对此还没有十足把握|还不太习惯这样做]，仍打开袋子，让粉末落在掌心。[dayNight|阳光照亮了粉末，尽管光芒颇为微弱，但你没有因此退缩；|月光让粉末闪耀得刺眼，使你看不清它，然而]你毫不犹豫地吞下了这一把粉末。
rows.raw: "\n        Although you're not [flags.GLITTER_DUST_USES 1 2|entirely sure about this|quite used to this], you pop the bag open and let the dust out into your palm. [dayNight|The sun brightens the dust — albeit rather weakly — but doesn't dissuade you;|The immense shine the dust is giving off from the moonlight makes it difficult but] you eat the handful without a moment's extra hesitation."

rows.original: Your hair feels... cooler or colder? You now have icy white hair!
rows.translation: 你的头发感觉……凉爽了一些，还是更凉了？你的头发现在变成了冰冷的白色！
rows.raw: "\n Your hair feels... cooler or colder? You now have icy white hair!"

rows.curatedReason: 内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。

rows.original: You feel like you [silly|just lost your soul.|look too cool to slow down!] You now have red hair!
rows.translation: 你会有一种这样的感觉[silly|简直失去了灵魂。|看起来太酷了，根本不可能减速！] 你现在有一头红色的头发了！
rows.raw: "\n You feel like you [silly|just lost your soul.|look too cool to slow down!] You now have red hair!"

rows.curatedReason: 内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。

rows.original: You're not quite sure but you just feel so lively and carefree! Your hair is now pink!
rows.translation: 你虽然不太确定，但就是觉得充满活力，无忧无虑！你的头发现在变成粉红色了！
rows.raw: "\n You're not quite sure but you just feel so lively and carefree! Your hair is now pink!"

rows.curatedReason: 内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。

rows.original: Your hair's color shifts and you feel more down with nature. You now have brown hair!
rows.translation: 你的头发颜色发生了变化，你也感觉自己更加与大自然融为了一体。你现在有一头棕色的头发了！
rows.raw: "\n Your hair's color shifts and you feel more down with nature. You now have brown hair!"

rows.curatedReason: 内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。

rows.translation: 贝尔哈兰炖菜
贝尔哈尔炖菜

rows.original: A staple of the Belharan Empire of old, this stew features ingredients from across the continent. From Brute Beets to Golden Eggs, Root of Man to Grottatos, this stew served as both a symbol of the empire's strength and solidarity and a meal for commoner and noble alike.
rows.translation: 这种炖菜曾是贝尔哈兰帝国的传统美食，其食材遍布整个大陆。从蛮力甜菜到金蛋，从人根草到格罗塔托斯，这种炖菜既象征着帝国的强大与团结，也是平民与贵族共同享用的美食。
rows.raw: "\n        A staple of the Belharan Empire of old, this stew features ingredients from across the continent. From Brute Beets to Golden Eggs, Root of Man to Grottatos, this stew served as both a symbol of the empire's strength and solidarity and a meal for commoner and noble alike."

rows.original: You scarf down the stew, savoring the surprisingly good selection of flavors. The beets' normally horrid taste is somehow balanced by the richness of the eggs, and the roots' somehow only serve to accentuate the Grottatos.
rows.translation: 你大口吃着这锅炖菜，品味着其中那些出人意料的美味滋味。通常令人难以忍受的甜菜味道，在鸡蛋的浓郁口感的衬托下竟然变得恰到好处；而这些根茎类食材似乎反而进一步凸显了“哥布番茄”这道菜的独特风味。
rows.raw: "\n        You scarf down the stew, savoring the surprisingly good selection of flavors. The beets' normally horrid taste is somehow balanced by the richness of the eggs, and the roots' somehow only serve to accentuate the Grottatos."

rows.original: This must be your very own mark of the wyld!
rows.translation: 这肯定是你自己在荒野中留下的独特印记吧！
rows.raw: "\nThis must be your very own mark of the wyld!"

rows.translation: 荒野之酒
荒野之酒

rows.original: This strange smelling wine is both brewed and imbibed almost exclusively by Wyld Elves. Made from a small berry found in the Frost Marches, the brewing process behind Wyld Wine causes consumers of any race other than its makers to be incredibly sick, inducing vomiting after just the first glass. Many mages who've studied the effect have hypothesized that the wyld magic that seems to be infused into the brewing attempts to cause changes in the body of those who lack the proper attunement to the wyld magic, as though it was trying to cause a wyld mark to manifest.
rows.translation: 这种散发着奇怪气味的酒，几乎完全是由野精灵们负责酿造和饮用的。这种酒是用在霜冻之地才能找到的一种小浆果制成的，而它的酿造工艺使得除了野精灵之外的任何种族饮用后都会感到极度不适，仅仅喝第一杯就会引发呕吐。许多研究过这种效应的法师推测，那些似乎被注入到酿造过程中的野生魔法，试图改变那些没有与这种野生魔法产生适当共鸣的人的身体，就好像它在试图促使某种野生印记显现出来一样。
rows.raw: "\n        This strange smelling wine is both brewed and imbibed almost exclusively by Wyld Elves. Made from a small berry found in the Frost Marches, the brewing process behind Wyld Wine causes consumers of any race other than its makers to be incredibly sick, inducing vomiting after just the first glass. Many mages who've studied the effect have hypothesized that the wyld magic that seems to be infused into the brewing attempts to cause changes in the body of those who lack the proper attunement to the wyld magic, as though it was trying to cause a wyld mark to manifest."

rows.original: You gulp down the wine and shudder at the taste. Immediately, a shudder courses down your spine and you feel the effects of the brew begin to take hold. You can also very quickly tell why most races vomit on the first glass; your stomach aches and churns at first, though it soon subsides as your body morphs and changes.
rows.translation: 你一口喝下了那杯酒，但立刻感到一阵恶心，浑身不寒而栗。很快，你便感受到了这种酒的作用开始显现。这时你也立刻明白了为什么大多数种族在第一次饮用这种酒时都会呕吐：起初你的胃会感到剧痛并不停地蠕动，但很快这种不适就会消失，因为你的身体正在发生着变化。
rows.raw: "\n        You gulp down the wine and shudder at the taste. Immediately, a shudder courses down your spine and you feel the effects of the brew begin to take hold. You can also very quickly tell why most races vomit on the first glass; your stomach aches and churns at first, though it soon subsides as your body morphs and changes."

rows.translation: 母马大麦
母马大麦

rows.original: A handful of golden brown barley grass. While normally used as an ingredient of the marefolks secret feminizing drugs, many mares chew it or brew it into tea for the taste alone.
rows.translation: 一把金棕色的大麦草。虽然这种草通常被用作制作那些能够使母马雌性化的秘方药物的原料，但许多母马也会仅仅为了它的味道而咀嚼它，或者将其泡成茶来饮用。
rows.raw: "\n        A handful of golden brown barley grass. While normally used as an ingredient of the marefolks secret feminizing drugs, many mares chew it or brew it into tea for the taste alone."

rows.original: You pop a handful of the gilded grass into your mouth, chewing absentmindedly. The flavor is decidedly bready, nearly overwhelming in its intensity. You can certainly see why it would be used to mask the taste of bitter medicine.
rows.translation: 你抓了一把这种镀金的草放进嘴里，漫不经心地咀嚼起来。它的味道明显带有面包的香气，这种浓郁的味道几乎让人难以忽视。现在你应该能理解为什么人们会用它来掩盖苦味药物的味道了。
rows.raw: "\n        You pop a handful of the gilded grass into your mouth, chewing absentmindedly. The flavor is decidedly bready, nearly overwhelming in its intensity. You can certainly see why it would be used to mask the taste of bitter medicine."

rows.translation: 牛奶糖
牛奶糖

rows.original: A small solid treat wrapped in wax paper. Minotaur huntresses in the far north leave these candies with their husbands when they leave for long hunting trips. The taste is meant to remind them of the safety of her embrace.
rows.translation: 用蜡纸包裹着的小块固体糖果。远北地区的弥诺陶洛斯猎手们，在丈夫踏上长途狩猎之旅时，会将这些糖果送给他们。这种糖果的味道旨在让丈夫们想起她温暖的怀抱所带来的安全感。
rows.raw: "\n        A small solid treat wrapped in wax paper. Minotaur huntresses in the far north leave these candies with their husbands when they leave for long hunting trips. The taste is meant to remind them of the safety of her embrace."

rows.original: You gingerly unwrap the roughly egg shaped lump of milk candy before popping it into your mouth. The taste of sweet milk invades your mouth instantly as the sweet dissolves on your tongue. The sugary taste reminds you of home and a warm embrace, all at once.
rows.translation: 你小心翼翼地剥开那块形状近似鸡蛋的牛奶糖，然后把它放进嘴里。甜美的牛奶味立刻弥漫在你的口中，当糖分在舌头上溶解时，这种甜味让你瞬间想起了家乡，以及温暖的家庭怀抱。
rows.raw: "\n        You gingerly unwrap the roughly egg shaped lump of milk candy before popping it into your mouth. The taste of sweet milk invades your mouth instantly as the sweet dissolves on your tongue. The sugary taste reminds you of home and a warm embrace, all at once."

rows.translation: 奶茶
奶茶

rows.original: A glazed clay vial of cool milk tea. A small enchantment keeps the milk tea inside fresh for as long as the cap is on. Milk is a good way to add flavor to the sometimes bitter tea brewed in the Harvest Valley.
rows.translation: 一个装有冰凉奶茶的玻璃陶罐。一个小小的魔法咒语使得只要盖子盖好，里面的奶茶就能保持新鲜。在收获谷酿造的这种有时带有苦味的茶叶中，加入牛奶确实能为它们增添不少风味。
rows.raw: "\n        A glazed clay vial of cool milk tea. A small enchantment keeps the milk tea inside fresh for as long as the cap is on. Milk is a good way to add flavor to the sometimes bitter tea brewed in the Harvest Valley."

rows.original: You pop the stopper out of the small vial of tea, drinking the sweet liquid in one go. The taste is sweet, cool, and refreshing. Despite its temperature, the drink doesn't make you any feel any colder in the march chill. If anything it helps you acclimate faster.
rows.translation: 你拔掉小瓶茶的盖子，将那甜美的液体一饮而尽。这种味道既甜美又清凉，令人神清气爽。尽管这种饮料的温度不高，但在三月的寒风中饮用它，并不会让你感到更冷，反而会帮助你更快地适应寒冷的环境。
rows.raw: "\n        You pop the stopper out of the small vial of tea, drinking the sweet liquid in one go. The taste is sweet, cool, and refreshing. Despite its temperature, the drink doesn't make you any feel any colder in the march chill. If anything it helps you acclimate faster."

rows.translation: 双生胡椒
双生胡椒

rows.original: A pupperidge pepper that's been mutated, splitting itself down the middle and growing into two identical shafts from one knotty base. Smells spicy!
rows.translation: 一种发生变异的“小狗椒”——它从中间分裂成两段，然后从同一个结节状基部生长出两根完全相同的茎。闻起来可真辣啊！
rows.raw: "\n        A pupperidge pepper that's been mutated, splitting itself down the middle and growing into two identical shafts from one knotty base. Smells spicy!"

rows.original:
Now that's a heck of a pepper, split down into two shafts by some twist of fate. A fiercely spiced scent wafts up from it even as you're pulling it out of your pack, making your nose and eyes burn. Oh, this is gonna be good. You quickly go about fashioning a meal around the pepper, slabbing it in between a few slices of bread and fresh veg you've come upon during your recent travels, and dig in.

        Your eyes are red and watering by the time you've finished. And then you feel a twisting sensation in your loins...
rows.translation:
这可真是个“厉害的东西”——由于命运的安排，它被分成了两根部分。当你从背包里把它拿出来的时候，一股浓烈的香料气息立刻扑面而来，让你的鼻子和眼睛都感到刺痛。哦，这肯定非常美味。你迅速用这些辣椒制作了一顿餐点，将它们夹在几片面包和你在最近的旅行中采到的新鲜蔬菜之间，然后开始大吃特吃。

        等到你吃完的时候，你的眼睛已经红了，还不断地流泪。然后你会感觉到腰部有一股扭动的感觉……
rows.raw:
"
        Now that's a heck of a pepper, split down into two shafts by some twist of fate. A fiercely spiced scent wafts up from it even as you're pulling it out of your pack, making your nose and eyes burn. Oh, this is gonna be good. You quickly go about fashioning a meal around the pepper, slabbing it in between a few slices of bread and fresh veg you've come upon during your recent travels, and dig in.

        Your eyes are red and watering by the time you've finished. And then you feel a twisting sensation in your loins..."

rows.original:
...Ooowwwww! Urgh, damn, so hot! You double over, grabbing your stomach as the revenge of the pepper kicks you straight in the guts. Fuck that's a spicy aftertaste! Aaaahhhhh!

        You grab for your waterskin and drain it, trying to put out the fire spreading inside you. Hot hot hot hot!
rows.translation:
……嗷嗷嗷嗷！呃，见鬼，好辣！你弯下腰，捂住肚子，辣椒的报复像是一脚踹进了你的胃里。操，这后劲也太辣了！啊啊啊啊啊！

        你一把抓过水袋，把里面的水灌了个干净，试图扑灭体内蔓延的火焰。辣辣辣辣辣！
rows.raw:
"
        ...Ooowwwww! Urgh, damn, so hot! You double over, grabbing your stomach as the revenge of the pepper kicks you straight in the guts. Fuck that's a spicy aftertaste! Aaaahhhhh!

        You grab for your waterskin and drain it, trying to put out the fire spreading inside you. Hot hot hot hot!"

rows.translation: 打结辣椒
打结辣椒

rows.original: A pupperidge pepper that's about six inches long, crimson red, and has a gnarled, knotted base bigger around than your fist. Smells spicy!
rows.translation: 一种长度约为六英寸的红色辣椒，它的基部变得扭曲、结节，直径甚至比你的拳头还要大。闻起来非常辣！
rows.raw: "\n        A pupperidge pepper that's about six inches long, crimson red, and has a gnarled, knotted base bigger around than your fist. Smells spicy!"

rows.original:
That's a hell of a thick pepper you've got there! A fiercely spiced scent wafts up from it even as you're pulling it out of your pack, making your nose and eyes burn. Oh, this is gonna be good. The knot alone is bigger than your fist, making you wonder just how you're going to even get that big boy in your mouth[silly| — that's what she said!|.] You quickly go about fashioning a meal around the pepper, slabbing it in between a few slices of bread and fresh veg you've come upon during your recent travels, and dig in.

        Your eyes are red and watering by the time you've finished. And then you feel a twisting sensation in your loins...
rows.translation:
你拿的这个辣椒可真够大的！即使你还在从包里把它拿出来的时候，那种浓烈的辛辣气味就已经扑面而来，让你的鼻子和眼睛都感到刺痛。哦，这个肯定非常美味。光是那个辣椒结就比你的拳头还要大，真让人好奇，要怎么才能把它放进嘴里呢[silly| — 她就是这么说的！|。]你迅速用这些辣椒制作了一顿简单的饭菜，将它们夹在几片面包和你在最近的旅行中采到的新鲜蔬菜之间，然后开始大吃特吃。

        吃完之后，你的眼睛已经红了，还不断地流泪。接着，你感到腰部有一种奇怪的刺痛感……
rows.raw:
"
        That's a hell of a thick pepper you've got there! A fiercely spiced scent wafts up from it even as you're pulling it out of your pack, making your nose and eyes burn. Oh, this is gonna be good. The knot alone is bigger than your fist, making you wonder just how you're going to even get that big boy in your mouth[silly| — that's what she said!|.] You quickly go about fashioning a meal around the pepper, slabbing it in between a few slices of bread and fresh veg you've come upon during your recent travels, and dig in.

        Your eyes are red and watering by the time you've finished. And then you feel a twisting sensation in your loins..."

        You grab for your waterskin and drain it, trying to put out the fire spreading inside you. Hot hot hot hot!

……嗷嗷嗷嗷！呃，见鬼，好辣！你弯下腰，捂住肚子，辣椒的报复像是一脚踹进了你的胃里。操，这后劲也太辣了！啊啊啊啊啊！

        你一把抓过水袋，把里面的水灌了个干净，试图扑灭体内蔓延的火焰。辣辣辣辣辣！
rows.raw:

        ...Ooowwwww! Urgh, damn, so hot! You double over, grabbing your stomach as the revenge of the pepper kicks you straight in the guts. Fuck that's a spicy aftertaste! Aaaahhhhh!

        You grab for your waterskin and drain it, trying to put out the fire spreading inside you. Hot hot hot hot!"

rows.translation: 蜘蛛丝
蜘蛛丝

rows.original: A thumb-sized bundle of white spider silk, wrapped into a fine ball. At first glance, spider silk might appear to be just the webbing of a drider. However, it is in fact the half-spun material that creates it. There are tales that driders would feed their lovers their silk to slowly change their bodies.
rows.translation: 一团拇指大小、包裹得极为精致的白色蜘蛛丝。乍一看，这些蜘蛛丝似乎只是那些飞行蜘蛛所编织的网而已。但实际上，这些丝线只是它们吐丝过程中形成的一部分半成品。有传说称，这些飞行蜘蛛会将自己的丝线喂给伴侣，以此逐渐改变对方的身体结构。
rows.raw: "\n        A thumb-sized bundle of white spider silk, wrapped into a fine ball. At first glance, spider silk might appear to be just the webbing of a drider. However, it is in fact the half-spun material that creates it. There are tales that driders would feed their lovers their silk to slowly change their bodies."

rows.original: Unrolling the ball, you funnel the ends of the silk into your lips and suck. Like long noodles, it passes down your throat smoothly and vanishes down your gullet in an instant. It doesn't really taste like anything but it fills you up... if you ignore the crawling feeling of it sliding down your throat.
rows.translation: 将那卷丝绸展开，将两端的丝线含在嘴唇间轻轻吸吮。就像长长的面条一样，它会顺畅地滑入你的喉咙，瞬间消失在胃里。其实它并没有什么特别的味道，但确实能让你感到饱腹……当然，前提是你得忽略那种丝线在喉咙里滑动的那种感觉。
rows.raw: "\n            Unrolling the ball, you funnel the ends of the silk into your lips and suck. Like long noodles, it passes down your throat smoothly and vanishes down your gullet in an instant. It doesn't really taste like anything but it fills you up... if you ignore the crawling feeling of it sliding down your throat."

rows.translation: 粉色松露
粉色松露

rows.original: A large, pale mushroom bearing the faint scent of ham.
rows.translation: 一种体型较大、颜色较浅的蘑菇，散发着淡淡的火腿香气。
rows.raw: "A large, pale mushroom bearing the faint scent of ham."

rows.original: You bring the truffle to your lips, biting into its round surface. As the skin is broken, the scent of ham intensifies, until it smells like you're in the middle of a luau. Appropriately enough, the truffle has the savory taste and texture of well-cooked meat, and you're left salivating for more. Before you know it, you've eaten the whole thing. You reflexively try to lick your fingers clean, but quickly realize there is no meat juice on them; you can't help but let out a disappointed snort.
rows.translation: 你将这种松露送到嘴边，轻轻咬下一小口。当松露的外皮被咬破的瞬间，那种火腿的香气顿时浓烈起来，仿佛让你置身于一场盛大的夏威夷宴会之中。这种松露确实拥有熟透肉类的鲜美味道和口感，让你忍不住想要再吃更多。不知不觉间，你就已经把整个松露吃光了。你条件反射般地试图舔干净手指，却很快发现手指上并没有任何肉汁残留，这让你不禁发出一声失望的叹息。
rows.raw: "\n        You bring the truffle to your lips, biting into its round surface. As the skin is broken, the scent of ham intensifies, until it smells like you're in the middle of a luau. Appropriately enough, the truffle has the savory taste and texture of well-cooked meat, and you're left salivating for more. Before you know it, you've eaten the whole thing. You reflexively try to lick your fingers clean, but quickly realize there is no meat juice on them; you can't help but let out a disappointed snort.\n        "

rows.translation: 狮兽药草
利奥·赫布

rows.original: Apparently, leothran children are fed these herbs to aid in digestion in their infancy. Unbeknownst to most, they also have a transformative effect should a non-leothran consume them.
rows.translation: 显然，莱奥斯兰的孩子们在婴儿期会被喂食这些草药，以帮助消化。然而大多数人并不知道，如果非莱奥斯兰人食用这些草药，也会产生某种变化。
rows.raw: "Apparently, leothran children are fed these herbs to aid in digestion in their infancy. Unbeknownst to most, they also have a transformative effect should a non-leothran consume them."

rows.original: You put the ends of the herbs in your mouth and chew experimentally. It's not that bad, really. A little plain, if anything — unsurprising given these are meant for children. Maybe you should have brought some salt. Actually, you're starting to feel a little warmer now...
rows.translation: 你把那些草药的末端放进嘴里，试着咀嚼看看。其实并没有那么难吃。只是有点淡而已——考虑到这些草药是给孩子们吃的，这也并不奇怪。也许你应该带点盐来……其实，现在你开始感觉到身体有点暖和起来了……
rows.raw: "\n        You put the ends of the herbs in your mouth and chew experimentally. It's not that bad, really. A little plain, if anything — unsurprising given these are meant for children. Maybe you should have brought some salt. Actually, you're starting to feel a little warmer now...\n        "

rows.translation: 泰坦酸茶
泰坦茶

rows.original: A spicy-smelling beverage made with brute beet, bovum sherry, minoblood wine, manticore nip, cinderleaf, a dab of milk tea, and a pinch of wolfsboon. You get the feeling the locals call this drink %"tea" as a joke rather than as an accurate descriptor.
rows.translation: 这是一种由野甜菜、博文雪利酒、米诺血酒、曼提科尔酒、烬叶草、少许奶茶以及一点点狼豆调制而成的饮品。感觉当地人把这种饮料称为“茶”，其实更像是一种玩笑，而非准确的描述罢了。
rows.raw: 'A spicy-smelling beverage made with brute beet, bovum sherry, minoblood wine, manticore nip, cinderleaf, a dab of milk tea, and a pinch of wolfsboon. You get the feeling the locals call this drink %"tea" as a joke rather than as an accurate descriptor.'

rows.original: As you open the bottle, you can't help but inhale the spicy steam escaping from your drink, little shivers of pleasure running down your back. You take that first tentative sip to make sure it's not too hot, then another when you thankfully don't burn your [pc.tongue]. A large gulp, a deep draft... And with that, the spicy concoction is downed and finished. You smack your [pc.lips] in appreciation, feeling warmed through to your core.
rows.translation: 当你打开瓶子时，不由得吸入从饮料中散发出来的辛辣蒸汽，那种愉悦的感觉会让你不自觉地打起寒颤。你先小心翼翼地尝了一小口，确认温度不会太烫，然后又喝了一口，庆幸没有烫到自己的[pc.tongue]。一大口，深深地喝下去……就这样，这瓶辛辣的饮料被一饮而尽了。你意犹未尽地咂了咂[pc.lips]，感觉暖意直透心底。
rows.raw: "\n        As you open the bottle, you can't help but inhale the spicy steam escaping from your drink, little shivers of pleasure running down your back. You take that first tentative sip to make sure it's not too hot, then another when you thankfully don't burn your [pc.tongue]. A large gulp, a deep draft... And with that, the spicy concoction is downed and finished. You smack your [pc.lips] in appreciation, feeling warmed through to your core.\n        "

rows.translation: 矮个炖菜
小炖菜

rows.original: A rich, thick stew made with root of man, potatoes, grottatoes, carrots, eggs, roasted acorns, and a few cat's tongue berries to sweeten the taste a little. A hearty meal that's easy to put together!
rows.translation: 这是一道用人根、土豆、红薯、胡萝卜、鸡蛋、烤橡果，再加上一些猫舌果来增添甜味的浓稠炖菜。这道美味佳肴制作起来非常简单，绝对是一顿令人满足的餐点！
rows.raw: "A rich, thick stew made with root of man, potatoes, grottatoes, carrots, eggs, roasted acorns, and a few cat's tongue berries to sweeten the taste a little. A hearty meal that's easy to put together!"

rows.original: The tantalizing smell and warm steam rising from the stew tempt you to take that first bite... which you savor. And then a second bite, a third, a fourth, and before you know it, you've finished the whole thing with gusto! You're full, yet can't help but wish there had been more...
rows.translation: 那诱人的香气以及从炖菜中散发出来的热气，让你忍不住吃下第一口……并细细品味。然后是第二口、第三口、第四口，不知不觉间，你就兴致勃勃地吃完了整个食物！虽然已经吃饱了，但还是忍不住希望还能有更多……
rows.raw: "\n The tantalizing smell and warm steam rising from the stew tempt you to take that first bite... which you savor. And then a second bite, a third, a fourth, and before you know it, you've finished the whole thing with gusto! You're full, yet can't help but wish there had been more... \n "

rows.translation: 盖亚叶片
盖亚之叶

rows.original: A bundle of vibrantly-colored leaves that bustle and flow from a bright red seed. Named and known for their explosive growth, this little seed may have been the start and spark of a grand forest... except you or its harvester cut that short. Now it's just a colorful arrangement of nutritional leaves brimming with life. You swear that they rustle every time you let your guard down.
rows.translation: 一束色彩鲜艳的叶子，从一颗鲜红色的种子中生长出来，它们随风摇曳、自由地伸展。这种种子因其惊人的生长速度而闻名，或许它本可以成为一片广阔森林的起源……直到你或它的采集者将它的生长过程扼杀在萌芽阶段。如今，它只不过是一堆充满生机的、色彩缤纷的叶子罢了。你发誓，每当你稍有疏忽，那些叶子就会发出沙沙的声响。
rows.raw: "A bundle of vibrantly-colored leaves that bustle and flow from a bright red seed. Named and known for their explosive growth, this little seed may have been the start and spark of a grand forest... except you or its harvester cut that short. Now it's just a colorful arrangement of nutritional leaves brimming with life. You swear that they rustle every time you let your guard down."

rows.original: Pressing your thumbs into the base of the leaves, you pop the seed cleanly in-half; the split seed stems the leaves out along your hand and radiates warmth through your palms all the way through your body. Cleanly twisting the leaflets around their respective halves, you take one and then the other into your mouth, chewing the mostly flavorless snack down. The warmth goes away but the calming energy filling you helps alleviate that loss tenfold!
rows.translation: 将拇指按在叶子的基部，轻轻一按，种子就会整齐地裂成两半；裂开的种子会让你感受到叶片沿着手掌传递而来的温暖，这种温暖会一直传遍你的全身。然后将这些叶片分别扭成两半，一片又一片地放入口中咀嚼，这种几乎没有任何味道的小零食虽然没有什么特别的味道，但它带来的宁静感却能让你感受到十倍的满足与舒适！
rows.raw: "\n        Pressing your thumbs into the base of the leaves, you pop the seed cleanly in-half; the split seed stems the leaves out along your hand and radiates warmth through your palms all the way through your body. Cleanly twisting the leaflets around their respective halves, you take one and then the other into your mouth, chewing the mostly flavorless snack down. The warmth goes away but the calming energy filling you helps alleviate that loss tenfold!\n        "

rows.translation: 笨蛋啤酒
笨蛋啤酒

rows.original: A drinking horn filled with a rich honey-mead, no doubt made with the unwitting help of the Old Forest's hornet hive. [silly|A helpful drawing on the side of the vessel shows what at first you suspect might be two chicken breasts side by side, but on closer inspection, appears to be a human brain completely devoid of weinkls|A crude drawing on the side of the vessel depicts an exaggeratedly curvy woman with a field of question-marks surrounding her head]. You get the feeling whatever is in here must have some potent effects on the mind. Handle with care...
rows.translation: 一个装满了浓郁蜂蜜酒的饮酒角杯，毫无疑问，这些蜂蜜是在古林中的黄蜂的帮助下制作出来的。 [silly|容器侧边有一张说明图，乍看之下，你可能会以为那画的是两块并排摆放的鸡胸肉，但仔细观察后，你会发现那实际上是一个完全没有任何脑回的人脑模型。|在容器的一侧，有一幅粗略绘制的图画：一个身材曲线极为夸张的女性，她的头部周围环绕着一圈问号。]你能感觉到，这里面装的什么东西肯定对人的精神状态有着某种强烈的影响。一定要小心处理……
rows.raw: "A drinking horn filled with a rich honey-mead, no doubt made with the unwitting help of the Old Forest's hornet hive. [silly|A helpful drawing on the side of the vessel shows what at first you suspect might be two chicken breasts side by side, but on closer inspection, appears to be a human brain completely devoid of weinkls|A crude drawing on the side of the vessel depicts an exaggeratedly curvy woman with a field of question-marks surrounding her head]. You get the feeling whatever is in here must have some potent effects on the mind. Handle with care..."

rows.original: [char.isBimbo |[var0 |Giggling to yourself with giddy anticipation, you pop open the mead-filled drinking horn and put it to your lips. Who could blame you for wanting more of that sweet, mind-numbing mead? It's so nice to not have to think, to worry, to care about anything that doesn't make you happy — and drinking this mead made you very happy the last time. You haven't had a sad thought since! You chug it down with a smile on your face, moaning to yourself as your brain goes cold and your body flushes with lustful heat. Oh, it's so good! Sweet as candy, and it makes your surroundings seem even more alive than ever before! Everything around you seems soft and inviting, a world free of fear and worry and so full of love. All you want to do is spread that love to everyone you see, to help them share in your overflowing joy. Your bimbofication is now complete... and permanent. |Giggling to yourself with giddy anticipation, you pop open the mead-filled drinking horn and put it to your lips. Who could blame you for wanting more of that sweet, mind-numbing mead? It's so nice to not have to think, to worry, to care about anything that doesn't make you happy — and drinking this mead made you very happy the last time. You haven't had a sad thought since! You chug it down with a smile on your face, moaning to yourself as your brain goes cold and your body flushes with lustful heat. Whew! What a rush! It feels so good, so right to just flush your withered mind with corrupted honey-mead, to reaffirm that you are what you are: a giggling, thoughtless bimbo! Just what you were always meant to be! ] |You unstop the horn and take a whiff of the sweet mead inside. And gods, is it sweet smelling, just like raw honey, but when you give the vessel a little shake, its golden contents slosh as easily as any wine. You have a feeling this is going to be a real treat! There's nothing to do but put the horn to your lips and drink deep from it. Sweet liqueur spills across your [pc.tongue], gliding down your throat with ease. There's not all that much of it, truth be told, and in a couple of gulps you've drained it dry. What a lovely drink! It was... like... soooooo tasty and... stuff? You squint, wobbling on your heels as a wave of dizziness rushes over you. Your mind seems so foggy, heavy, it's so hard to think... and then it's gone, and a wave of relief washes over you. You don't need to think anyway, silly! Everything makes so much sense now! The whole world seems vibrant and full of color, and your whole body seems so sensitive all of a sudden, like just the faintest breeze sets all your senses a-tingle! A soft giggle escapes your lips, girlish and airy. It just seems so... right... to let it out, to let the pastel world all around you know how absolutely delightful you find everything! [party.has Cait |Cait giggles too, taking your hand. "What's so funny?" she smiles, so close you can't help but throw your arms open and give the big pink kitty a hug. "Oh! Aww, you're so sweet [pc.name]!" ] [party.has arona |"What's gotten into you, huh?" Arona chuckles, slapping your ass. rows.original: Long cultivated by druid and Lumian boer'alvar alike, the translucent blue ice roses of the frozen north bring to mind that race's characteristic beauty and elegance. Delicate as they appear, their bushes are quite hardy, and many an insouciant adventurer has paid a bloody price for trying to brave a way through the icy thorns. Efforts to transplant these gorgeous plants south in the days of Old Belhar never seemed to take; perhaps there is something about the cold soil of the Frostwood and the Rift that sustains them.

Holding it between your fingertips, you pluck off the icy-blue leaves and toss that nasty stalk away. They're cool to the touch but not at all an irritant to your skin. Feeling at ease, you put the small palmful of leaves in your mouth and chow down. Immediately, a coolness hits your tongue and mouth. The flavor reminds you of fresh air and snowy winds although is otherwise rather plain. 

        You gulp it all down and savor the freshness it leaves in your mouth.

rows.original: Long a staple of Jassiran cuisine, the jackal-eared fig has been grown in the greener areas of the region since time immemorial. Often used as a natural sweetener for wines and food, owing to its saccharine taste, it is also served as a banquet food during nighttime Mallachite orgies. The jackal-eared fig derives its name from the characteristic shape of the fruit, which mimics the ears of the region's anubian residents.

rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] plant[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] feet firmly in the ground, adopting a guarded stance against all who would oppose [attacker.combatHimHer] and gaining a shield."

rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName][tps|正|正]吸引敌人的注意。
防护姿态
盾牌姿态

rows.translation: 你在盾牌后摆出防御姿态，获得+15闪避，并使护甲和守护提高50%。在该姿态下，你产生的威胁提高30%；首次进入该姿态时，你立即产生
rows.raw: "You assume a defensive stance behind your shield that grants +15 Evasion and increases your Armor and Ward by 50%. You generate 30% more Threat in this stance, and when you first enter it you instantly generate "

rows.translation: 威胁。

rows.translation: 你当前正维持盾卫姿态。你获得+15闪避、+
rows.raw: "You're currently maintaining a Shielded Stance. You gain +15 Evasion, +"

rows.translation: 魔法护盾，并额外产生30%威胁值。
[attacker.CombatName]放弃[tps|] [attacker.combatHisHer]防护姿态。

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] brace[tps|s] [attacker.combatHimselfHerself] behind [attacker.combatHisHer] shield, raising it in a shielded stance to ward off all blows.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]稳住[tps|][attacker.combatHimselfHerself]，躲在[attacker.combatHisHer]盾牌后，举盾摆出持盾架势，抵御一切攻击。
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] brace[tps|s] [attacker.combatHimselfHerself] behind [attacker.combatHisHer] shield, raising it in a shielded stance to ward off all blows."

rows.translation: 保护

rows.original: You protect an ally for 2 turns, taking health damage in their stead. The target gains +10 armor while you cover them. You also heal for 10% of your Health.
rows.translation: 你在2个回合内保护一名盟友，替他们承受伤害。在保护期间，该目标会获得+10点的护甲值，而你也会恢复自己10%的生命值。
rows.raw: "You protect an ally for 2 turns, taking health damage in their stead. The target gains +10 armor while you cover them. You also heal for 10% of your Health."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] heal[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] wounds and protect[tps|s] [target.combatName] with [attacker.combatHisHer] full body.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]治愈[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]伤口，并以[attacker.combatHisHer]整个身体保护[tps|][target.combatName]。
rows.raw: "\n        \n        [attacker.CombatName] heal[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] wounds and protect[tps|s] [target.combatName] with [attacker.combatHisHer] full body."

rows.translation: 暗影姿态
暗影姿态

rows.original: You slip into the shadows, lurking at the edges of the battlefield. While in this stance, your Threat generation is halved and you gain +50 Critical Power.
rows.translation: 你悄悄潜入阴影中，潜伏在战场的边缘。在这种状态下，你产生的威胁值会减半，但你的暴击威力会增加50%。
rows.raw: "You slip into the shadows, lurking at the edges of the battlefield. While in this stance, your Threat generation is halved and you gain +50 Critical Power."

rows.original: You are skulking in the shadows, benefiting from halved Threat on all your actions and +50 Critical Power!
rows.translation: 你正潜伏在阴影中，所有行动所面临的威胁都会减半，同时你的暴击威力还会增加50%！
rows.raw: "You are skulking in the shadows, benefiting from halved Threat on all your actions and +50 Critical Power!"

rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]放弃[tps|] [attacker.combatHisHer]暗影姿态。

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] slip[tps|s] out of sight, prowling through the shadows, waiting for a chance to strike!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]悄然[tps|]隐入视线之外，在阴影中潜行，等待出击的时机！
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] slip[tps|s] out of sight, prowling through the shadows, waiting for a chance to strike!"

rows.translation: 怪物保护
ImpProtect

rows.original: You protect an ally for 4 turns, taking health damage in their stead. The target gains +10 armor while you cover them. You also heal for 10% of your Health.
rows.translation: 你在4个回合内保护一名盟友，同时承受他们所受到的伤害。在保护期间，该目标会获得+10点的护甲值，而你也会恢复自己10%的生命值。
rows.raw: "You protect an ally for 4 turns, taking health damage in their stead. The target gains +10 armor while you cover them. You also heal for 10% of your Health."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] heal[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] wounds and protect[tps|s] [target.combatName] with [attacker.combatHisHer] full body.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]治愈[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]伤口，并以[attacker.combatHisHer]整个身体保护[tps|][target.combatName]。
rows.raw: "\n        \n        [attacker.CombatName] heal[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] wounds and protect[tps|s] [target.combatName] with [attacker.combatHisHer] full body."

rows.translation: 火焰之舌

rows.original: You cause the target's weapon to deal +
rows.translation: 你使目标的武器额外造成+
rows.raw: "You cause the target's weapon to deal +"

rows.original: Fire damage, and the target gains
rows.translation: 火焰伤害，且目标获得
rows.raw: " Fire damage, and the target gains "

rows.translation: 恢复2回合的生命值。
光之颂歌
光之颂歌

rows.original: The target's weapons and charms deal an additional
rows.translation: 目标的武器和符咒额外造成
rows.raw: "The target's weapons and charms deal an additional "

rows.original: Holy damage. On activation, the target recovers +
rows.translation: 神圣伤害。激活时，目标恢复+
rows.raw: " Holy damage. On activation, the target recovers +"

rows.original: You're currently maintaining Hymn to Light on an ally.
rows.translation: 你当前正在为一名盟友维护“光之颂歌”。
rows.raw: "You're currently maintaining Hymn to Light on an ally."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] begin[tps|s] to sing and to strum [attacker.combatHisHer] oud. The music rings out, and motes of light begin to form around [target.combatNames] [target.realWeapon]. As the playing continues, the motes wrap around it, giving the [target.realWeapon] a silver-and-gold sheen. Some of the radiance travels up [target.combatNames] arm, reinvigorating [target.combatHimHer].
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]开始[tps|]歌唱，拨动[attacker.combatHisHer]乌德琴。乐声响起，点点光芒开始在[target.combatNames][target.realWeapon]周围凝聚。随着演奏继续，光点环绕武器，为这把[target.realWeapon]镀上一层金银交映的光泽。部分光辉沿[target.combatNames]手臂向上流动，使[target.combatHimHer]重新焕发活力。
rows.raw: "\n            \n            [attacker.CombatName] begin[tps|s] to sing and to strum [attacker.combatHisHer] oud. The music rings out, and motes of light begin to form around [target.combatNames] [target.realWeapon]. As the playing continues, the motes wrap around it, giving the [target.realWeapon] a silver-and-gold sheen. Some of the radiance travels up [target.combatNames] arm, reinvigorating [target.combatHimHer]."

rows.original: The light on [target.combatNames] [target.realWeapon] vanishes with that last swing, reverting it to as it was!
rows.translation: 附在[target.combatNames][target.realWeapon]上的光芒随着最后一次挥动消散，武器恢复了原样！
rows.raw: "\n            \n            The light on [target.combatNames] [target.realWeapon] vanishes with that last swing, reverting it to as it was!"

rows.translation: 游骑兵的姿态
游骑兵的姿态

rows.original: You assume a ranger's stance, heightening your senses to gain +25 Attack Power for 2 turns. While you maintain this stance, you take a -10 penalty to Initiative and Evasion, but gain a +30 Accuracy bonus to ranged weapon attacks.
rows.translation: 你采取游荡者的姿态，使自身的感官变得更为敏锐，从而在2个回合内获得+25的攻击强度。在保持这种姿态期间，你的先攻权和闪避能力会下降10点，但远程武器的射击精准度会提高30点。
rows.raw: "You assume a ranger's stance, heightening your senses to gain +25 Attack Power for 2 turns. While you maintain this stance, you take a -10 penalty to Initiative and Evasion, but gain a +30 Accuracy bonus to ranged weapon attacks."

rows.original: You're currently maintaining a Ranger's Stance. You take a -10 penalty to Initiative and Evasion, but gain a +30 Accuracy bonus to ranged weapon attacks.
rows.translation: 你当前处于“游骑兵姿态”状态。在这种状态下，你的先攻权和闪避能力会下降10点，但远程武器的射击精准度会提高30点。
rows.raw: "You're currently maintaining a Ranger's Stance. You take a -10 penalty to Initiative and Evasion, but gain a +30 Accuracy bonus to ranged weapon attacks."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] loosen[tps|s] up, easing away from [attacker.combatHisHer] focus.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]放松[tps|]下来，不再维持[attacker.combatHisHer]专注姿态。
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] loosen[tps|s] up, easing away from [attacker.combatHisHer] focus."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] take[tps|s] a measured stance, gathering [attacker.combatHisHer] focus and calming [attacker.combatHisHer] breathing. After some moments of this, [attacker.combatHeShe] now [tps|feel|seems] a lot steadier in the face of danger.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]摆好[tps|]沉稳的架势，集中[attacker.combatHisHer]注意力，平复[attacker.combatHisHer]呼吸。片刻后，[attacker.combatHeShe][tps|感到|显得]在危险面前镇定了许多。
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] take[tps|s] a measured stance, gathering [attacker.combatHisHer] focus and calming [attacker.combatHisHer] breathing. After some moments of this, [attacker.combatHeShe] now [tps|feel|seems] a lot steadier in the face of danger."

rows.translation: 决斗者的姿态
决斗者的姿态

rows.original: You assume a duelist's stance, which grants you +10 Evasion, +10 Sexiness, and a surge of Threat. While in this stance, you make a counter-attack against the first melee attack that misses you each round.
rows.translation: 你采取决斗者的姿态，这一姿态能使你获得+10的闪避值、+10的魅力值，并使你散发出更强的威胁感。在采取这一姿态期间，每轮当有近战攻击未命中你时，你都可以进行反击。
rows.raw: "You assume a duelist's stance, which grants you +10 Evasion, +10 Sexiness, and a surge of Threat. While in this stance, you make a counter-attack against the first melee attack that misses you each round."

rows.original: You've assumed a rakish dueling stance. Gain +10 Evasion and Sexiness, and the first melee attack that misses you each round triggers an automatic riposte!
rows.translation: 你采取了那种轻浮的决斗姿态。此时，你的闪避能力和魅力值都会增加10点，而且每轮中如果第一次近战攻击没有击中你，系统会自动触发一次反击！
rows.raw: "You've assumed a rakish dueling stance. Gain +10 Evasion and Sexiness, and the first melee attack that misses you each round triggers an automatic riposte!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] loosen[tps|s] up, easing away from [attacker.combatHisHer] focus.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]放松[tps|]向上移动，逐渐远离[attacker.combatHisHer]专注。
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] loosen[tps|s] up, easing away from [attacker.combatHisHer] focus."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] spin[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon], bringing it up into a classic Belharan duelist's pose. [attacker.CombatHesShes] ready to parry and riposte the first attack that comes [attacker.combatHisHer] way.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]转动[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer][attacker.weapon]，将其举起，摆出经典的贝尔哈尔决斗者架势。[attacker.CombatHesShes]已做好准备，要格挡并反击第一下朝[attacker.combatHisHer]方向袭来的攻击。
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] spin[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon], bringing it up into a classic Belharan duelist's pose. [attacker.CombatHesShes] ready to parry and riposte the first attack that comes [attacker.combatHisHer] way."

rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName] [var0|[tps|已|已]|仍然存在[tps|]]准备予以反击了[var0||其他]进攻！
偏转

rows.original: You make ready to turn away blows aimed at you, granting you +5 Evasion. While you maintain this stance, the first two weapon attacks made against you in a round are nullified and countered with an attack of your own.
rows.translation: 你准备好了躲避针对你的攻击，因此你的闪避能力会增加5点。只要你保持这种姿态，那么在一轮攻击中，针对你的前两次武器攻击都会被无效化，而你会反过来发动一次攻击。
rows.raw: "You make ready to turn away blows aimed at you, granting you +5 Evasion. While you maintain this stance, the first two weapon attacks made against you in a round are nullified and countered with an attack of your own."

rows.original: +5 Evasion. While you maintain this stance, the first two weapon attacks made against you in a round are nullified and countered with an attack of your own.
rows.translation: +5闪避。当你维持该姿态时，每回合前两次针对你的武器攻击会被化解，并由你进行反击。
rows.raw: "+5 Evasion. While you maintain this stance, the first two weapon attacks made against you in a round are nullified and countered with an attack of your own."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] loosen[tps|s] up, easing away from [attacker.combatHisHer] focus.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]放松[tps|]下来，不再保持[attacker.combatHisHer]专注姿态。
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] loosen[tps|s] up, easing away from [attacker.combatHisHer] focus."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] spin[tps|s] and raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon], attention focused not on the near, but the far. [attacker.CombatHeShe][tps|'s| are] ready to turn any blow aimed at [attacker.combatHimHer] and return it swiftly to its sender.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]旋身[tps|]举起[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer][attacker.weapon]，目光不再盯着近处，而是投向远方。[attacker.CombatHeShe][tps|的|是]已准备好化解任何朝[attacker.combatHimHer]袭来的攻击，并迅速将其反弹给出手者。
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] spin[tps|s] and raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon], attention focused not on the near, but the far. [attacker.CombatHeShe][tps|'s| are] ready to turn any blow aimed at [attacker.combatHimHer] and return it swiftly to its sender."

rows.translation: 黑曜石之盾
黑曜石之盾

rows.original: The cumulation of Philander's craft, ingrained into the being of Nareva's chosen. Awaken the mirror magic in yourself and gain 10 Armor, Focus, and Ward, as well as a dramatic increase in threat. All spells cast at you are reflected back at their caster, friend or foe.
rows.translation: 菲兰德尔的精湛技艺已然融入娜瑞瓦选中之人的体内。唤醒你体内的镜像魔法，即可获得10点护甲值、专注力以及防护能力，同时你的威胁等级也会大幅提升。全部所有对你施加的法术都会反作用于施法者本人，无论是朋友还是敌人。
rows.raw: "The cumulation of Philander's craft, ingrained into the being of Nareva's chosen. Awaken the mirror magic in yourself and gain 10 Armor, Focus, and Ward, as well as a dramatic increase in threat. All spells cast at you are reflected back at their caster, friend or foe."

rows.original: +10 Armor, Focus, and Ward. All spells cast at you are reflected back at their caster, friend or foe.
rows.translation: +10护甲、专注和守护。所有对你施放的法术都会反射回施法者，无论敌友。
rows.raw: "+10 Armor, Focus, and Ward. All spells cast at you are reflected back at their caster, friend or foe."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] loosen[tps|s] up, easing away from [attacker.combatHisHer] focus.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]放松[tps|]下来，不再保持[attacker.combatHisHer]专注姿态。
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] loosen[tps|s] up, easing away from [attacker.combatHisHer] focus."

rows.original: Reaching deep into [attacker.combatHimselfHerself], [attacker.combatName] draw[tps|s] out a thread of powerful mirror magic that quickly wraps about [attacker.combatHimselfHerself] to form a shimmering cocoon.
rows.translation: 深入[attacker.combatHimselfHerself]内心，[attacker.combatName]抽出[tps|]一缕强大的镜像魔法，迅速将[attacker.combatHimselfHerself]缠绕起来，结成一个闪烁的茧。
rows.raw: "\nReaching deep into [attacker.combatHimselfHerself], [attacker.combatName] draw[tps|s] out a thread of powerful mirror magic that quickly wraps about [attacker.combatHimselfHerself] to form a shimmering cocoon."

rows.translation: 朝向地球

rows.original: Shroud yourself in a magic barrier, greatly increasing your resistance to all damage: you gain +50 Armor, Ward, and Focus while maintaining the spell.
rows.translation: 你能够为自己施加一道魔法屏障，从而大幅提升自己对所有伤害的抗性能力：在持续维持这个法术的状态下，你的护甲值、防护效果以及专注力都会增加50点。
rows.raw: "Shroud yourself in a magic barrier, greatly increasing your resistance to all damage: you gain +50 Armor, Ward, and Focus while maintaining the spell."

rows.original: Surrounded by a barrier of elemental earth, you gain +50 Armor, Ward, and Focus.
rows.translation: 被由土元素构成的屏障所包围，你将获得+50的护甲值、防护效果以及专注力。
rows.raw: "Surrounded by a barrier of elemental earth, you gain +50 Armor, Ward, and Focus."

rows.original: The earthen barrier surrounding [attacker.CombatName] crumbles to dust!
rows.translation: 环绕[attacker.CombatName]的土元素屏障碎裂成尘！
rows.raw: "\nThe earthen barrier surrounding [attacker.CombatName] crumbles to dust!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] clench[tps|es] [attacker.combatHisHer] fists, channeling a shroud of elemental earth around [attacker.combatHisHer] body that quickly comes to resemble a full suit of stony armor!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]握紧[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]双拳，在[attacker.combatHisHer]身周凝聚起一层土元素，转眼间便形成一整套坚硬的石甲！
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] clench[tps|es] [attacker.combatHisHer] fists, channeling a shroud of elemental earth around [attacker.combatHisHer] body that quickly comes to resemble a full suit of stony armor!"

rows.translation: 镜像架势
镜像姿态

rows.original: Assume a mystical stance of mirrors, absorbing your enemies' power. Gain +10 Armor, Focus, and Ward, but also a dramatic increase in threat. You may learn certain powers that hit you.
rows.translation: 采取一种神秘的态度，像镜子一样吸收敌人的力量。你的护甲值、专注力以及防护能力都会增加10点，但同时，你所带来的威胁也会显著增强。你甚至可能会掌握一些能够攻击自身的特殊能力。
rows.raw: "Assume a mystical stance of mirrors, absorbing your enemies' power. Gain +10 Armor, Focus, and Ward, but also a dramatic increase in threat. You may learn certain powers that hit you."

rows.original: You're currently maintaining Mirror Stance. You gain +10 Armor, Focus, and Ward. You may learn certain powers that hit you.
rows.translation: 你当前处于“镜像架势”状态。此时你的护甲值、专注力以及防护能力都会增加10点。此外，你还可以学习一些能够攻击自身的特殊能力。
rows.raw: "You're currently maintaining Mirror Stance. You gain +10 Armor, Focus, and Ward. You may learn certain powers that hit you."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] loosen[tps|s] up, easing away from [attacker.combatHisHer] focus.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]放松[tps|]下来，不再保持[attacker.combatHisHer]专注姿态。
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] loosen[tps|s] up, easing away from [attacker.combatHisHer] focus."

rows.original: Reflecting on the teachings of Prince Ander, [attacker.combatName] assume[tps|s] the stance of mirrors. [attacker.CombatName] focus[tps|es] [attacker.combatHisHer] magical energies inward, hardening [attacker.combatHimselfHerself] against [attacker.combatHisHer] foes and becoming a vacant vessel for their power.
rows.translation: 回想安德烈王子的教诲，[attacker.combatName]摆出[tps|]镜像架势。[attacker.CombatName]集中[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]魔力并将其导向体内，强化[attacker.combatHimselfHerself]以抵御[attacker.combatHisHer]敌人，化作容纳敌方力量的空容器。
rows.raw: "\nReflecting on the teachings of Prince Ander, [attacker.combatName] assume[tps|s] the stance of mirrors. [attacker.CombatName] focus[tps|es] [attacker.combatHisHer] magical energies inward, hardening [attacker.combatHimselfHerself] against [attacker.combatHisHer] foes and becoming a vacant vessel for their power."

rows.translation: 充电武器
充电武器

rows.original: You charge your weapon with argent light, causing it to deal
rows.translation: 你以银白光辉灌注武器，使其造成
rows.raw: "You charge your weapon with argent light, causing it to deal "

rows.translation: 对所有敌人造成神圣伤害。

rows.original: You are channeling argent light into your weapon, dealing
rows.translation: 你正将银白光辉导入武器，造成
