rows.original: You are immutable: the world cannot shake your inner sense of balance. You cannot be
rows.translation: 你坚不可移：世界无法撼动你内在的平衡感。你不会被
rows.raw: "You are immutable: the world cannot shake your inner sense of balance. You cannot be "

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName's] stance goes wide and rigid, and, with a deep breath and a focused mind, [attacker.CombatName] become[tps|s] immovable, immutable, and unbending, as [attacker.combatHeShe] achieve[tps|s] equilibrium.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName's]身体站得笔直而僵硬，深吸一口气，集中注意力， [attacker.CombatName]变成[tps|]坚定不移，不可更改，且毫不动摇，正如[attacker.combatHeShe]实现[tps|]平衡状态。
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName's] stance goes wide and rigid, and, with a deep breath and a focused mind, [attacker.CombatName] become[tps|s] immovable, immutable, and unbending, as [attacker.combatHeShe] achieve[tps|s] equilibrium."

rows.translation: 宁静

rows.original: Remove yourself from the world and its temptations and focus entirely on your sense of self. HP passively regenerates by
rows.translation: 将自己从世界及其诱惑中抽离，全心专注于自我感知。生命值会被动再生
rows.raw: "Remove yourself from the world and its temptations and focus entirely on your sense of self. HP passively regenerates by "

rows.original: % every turn and Tease, Pheromone, Drug, and Psychic damage is reduced by
rows.translation: 每回合都会触发该效果，同时“戏弄”、“信息素”、“药物”以及“精神攻击”所造成的伤害也会相应减少。
rows.raw: "% every turn and Tease, Pheromone, Drug, and Psychic damage is reduced by "

rows.original: Your focus is on maintaining your own inner peace — your HP passively regenerates every turn, and Tease, Pheromone, Drug, and Psychic damage is reduced!
rows.translation: 你的首要任务是保持内心的平静——每回合你的生命值都会自动恢复，同时受到嘲讽、信息素、药物以及精神攻击所造成的伤害也会相应减少！
rows.raw: "Your focus is on maintaining your own inner peace — your HP passively regenerates every turn, and Tease, Pheromone, Drug, and Psychic damage is reduced!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] take[tps|s] a deep breath, in through [attacker.combatHisHer] nose and out through [attacker.combatHisHer] mouth, and close[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] eyes a moment to recollect [attacker.combatHimHer]self. [attacker.CombatName] recover[tps|s] HP!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]做了[tps|]一次深呼吸，用[attacker.combatHisHer]鼻子吸气，再从[attacker.combatHisHer]嘴里吐出，然后闭上[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]双眼片刻，让[attacker.combatHimHer]自己重新镇定下来。[attacker.CombatName]恢复了[tps|]生命值！
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] take[tps|s] a deep breath, in through [attacker.combatHisHer] nose and out through [attacker.combatHisHer] mouth, and close[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] eyes a moment to recollect [attacker.combatHimHer]self. [attacker.CombatName] recover[tps|s] HP!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName's] focus on recollecting [attacker.combatHimHer]self from the inner and outer chaos of the battle reinvigorates [attacker.combatHimHer]. [attacker.CombatName] recover[tps|s] HP!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName's]专注让[attacker.combatHimHer]自己从战斗带来的内外混乱中重新镇定下来，为[attacker.combatHimHer]恢复活力。[attacker.CombatName]恢复了[tps|]生命值！
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName's] focus on recollecting [attacker.combatHimHer]self from the inner and outer chaos of the battle reinvigorates [attacker.combatHimHer]. [attacker.CombatName] recover[tps|s] HP!"

rows.translation: 欲望之光
渴望之光

rows.original: Used when below 50% Health. Acts as a stance that deals a small amount of Lust damage at the end of each of the user's turns.
rows.translation: 当生命值低于50%时使用。这种姿态会在使用者每个回合结束时造成少量的“欲望伤害”。
rows.raw: "Used when below 50% Health. Acts as a stance that deals a small amount of Lust damage at the end of each of the user's turns."

rows.original: You're currently maintaining an Aura of Desire. You deal Lust damage to all enemies at the start of your turn.
rows.translation: 你当前处于“欲望光环”状态。在每回合开始时，你会对所有敌人造成“欲望伤害”。
rows.raw: "You're currently maintaining an Aura of Desire. You deal Lust damage to all enemies at the start of your turn."

rows.original: "Ohh, you're making this so much harder than it needs to be," [attacker.combatName] coos, licking her lips. You suddenly become aware of a rich, honeyed scent pervading the entire battlefield. It burns at your nose, flushing your cheeks and making your head swim in a sea of musky sweetness. Everything smells like you should just lay back and relax, let the beautiful flower-woman pull you in and fuck you until you lose your mind. Yeah, that would be... uh-oh. You shake it off. Better finish this fight fast!
rows.translation: 哦，你把这件事弄得比实际需要的要复杂多了。 [attacker.combatName]呼噜声中，她舔了舔嘴唇。你突然察觉到一股浓郁的、带着蜂蜜香气的气息弥漫在整个战场上。这种气味刺激着你的嗅觉，让你的脸颊变得通红，整个头脑仿佛都被这股甜美的芬芳所淹没。一切都仿佛在告诉你：只要躺下来放松下来，让这位美丽的女子将你吸引到她身边，与你亲密接触，直到你失去理智……没错，那肯定会非常……呃，不好！你赶紧甩开这些念头，最好尽快结束这场战斗！
rows.raw: '\n \n "Ohh, you\'re making this so much harder than it needs to be," [attacker.combatName] coos, licking her lips. You suddenly become aware of a rich, honeyed scent pervading the entire battlefield. It burns at your nose, flushing your cheeks and making your head swim in a sea of musky sweetness. Everything smells like you should just lay back and relax, let the beautiful flower-woman pull you in and fuck you until you lose your mind. Yeah, that would be... uh-oh. You shake it off. Better finish this fight fast!'

rows.translation: [target.CombatName][tps|受到|受到][attacker.combatName's]信息素影响！
派珀之歌
PiperSong

rows.original: You weave magic into a truly enchanting performance, focused on one enemy. So long as you maintain the stance, the target is Aroused and Stunned.
rows.translation: 你将魔法编织进一场摄人心魄的表演，专门针对一名敌人。只要保持该姿态，目标就会陷入兴奋与眩晕状态。
rows.raw: "You weave magic into a truly enchanting performance, focused on one enemy. So long as you maintain the stance, the target is Aroused and Stunned."

rows.original: You're currently performing a Piper's Song. Your target is Aroused and Stunned.
rows.translation: 你正在演奏《派珀之歌》。目标处于兴奋和眩晕状态。
rows.raw: "You're currently performing a Piper's Song. Your target is Aroused and Stunned."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] play[tps|s] a warm and vibrant melody, twirling around [target.combatName] with gleeful grace. [target.CombatHeShe] watch[tps|es] the dance, eyes dilating as the magic woven through the song ensorcelles [target.combatHisHer] mind. [target.CombatName's] cheeks flush, and [target.combatHeShe] start[tps|s] to sway on the spot, utterly entranced by the piper's song!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]奏起[tps|]温暖而活泼的旋律，欢快优雅地绕着[target.combatName]旋转。[target.CombatHeShe]看着[tps|]舞蹈，瞳孔放大，歌声中交织的魔法迷惑了[target.combatHisHer]心智。[target.CombatName's]双颊泛红，[target.combatHeShe]开始[tps|]在原地摇摆，被笛手的乐曲彻底迷住！
rows.raw: "\n \n [attacker.CombatName] play[tps|s] a warm and vibrant melody, twirling around [target.combatName] with gleeful grace. [target.CombatHeShe] watch[tps|es] the dance, eyes dilating as the magic woven through the song ensorcelles [target.combatHisHer] mind. [target.CombatName's] cheeks flush, and [target.combatHeShe] start[tps|s] to sway on the spot, utterly entranced by the piper's song!"

rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName's]歌声继续令[char.combatName]如痴如醉！

rows.original: [char.CombatName] [tps|is|are] left reeling, [char.combatHisHer] instruments scattering around [char.combatHimHer]. It looks like [char.combatHisHer] enchanted song has been interrupted!
rows.translation: [char.CombatName][tps|已|已]踉跄失措，[char.combatHisHer]乐器散落在[char.combatHimHer]四周。看来[char.combatHisHer]魔法歌声被打断了！
rows.raw: "[char.CombatName] [tps|is|are] left reeling, [char.combatHisHer] instruments scattering around [char.combatHimHer]. It looks like [char.combatHisHer] enchanted song has been interrupted!"

rows.translation: 蛇之舞
蛇之舞

rows.original: You adopt a graceful dance around your weapon, inflicting 2 stacks of Resonance on all enemies. While you maintain the stance, you have +15 Temptation and +15 Armor Penetration, but 20% less Armor.
rows.translation: 你以优雅的舞姿挥舞着武器，使所有敌人都受到2层“共鸣”效果的影响。在保持这种战斗姿态的同时，你的“诱惑力”属性会增加15点，“护甲穿透”属性也会增加15点，但护甲值会减少20%。
rows.raw: "You adopt a graceful dance around your weapon, inflicting 2 stacks of Resonance on all enemies. While you maintain the stance, you have +15 Temptation and +15 Armor Penetration, but 20% less Armor."

rows.original: You're maintaining a lurid serpentine dance, bolstering your Temptation and Armor Penetration by +15 but lowering your Armor by 20%.
rows.translation: 你正在表演一种绚丽夺目的蛇形舞动，这种动作使你的“诱惑力”和“护甲穿透力”分别增加了15点，但同时也使你的护甲厚度减少了20%。
rows.raw: "You're maintaining a lurid serpentine dance, bolstering your Temptation and Armor Penetration by +15 but lowering your Armor by 20%."

rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]放弃[tps|] [attacker.combatHisHer]蛇形舞动。

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] plant[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] in the ground and twirl[tps|s] around it, letting [attacker.combatHisHer] armor fall away[attacker.sfs| to expose bare skin] — a canny distraction from the blows soon to follow!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]插下[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer][attacker.weapon]，将其立在地上，再绕着它旋转[tps|]，任[attacker.combatHisHer]护甲滑落[attacker.sfs|，露出肌肤]——这巧妙的诱惑，正好让人忽略紧随而来的攻击！
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] plant[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] in the ground and twirl[tps|s] around it, letting [attacker.combatHisHer] armor fall away[attacker.sfs| to expose bare skin] — a canny distraction from the blows soon to follow!"

rows.translation: 藤条束缚
自我克制

rows.original: Grapples a character, inflicting the Restrained condition until broken out of. It lasts up to 3 turns, or until the target succeeds a randomized Strength check (1d20 + STR > 20), made automatically at the start of each turn. On a failed test, the target takes a small amount of Tease damage. Like a stance, a Grapple can be disrupted by a Stun or Knockdown.
rows.translation: 抓取一个角色，使其陷入“受制”状态，直到该状态被打破。这种状态会持续最多3个回合，或者直到目标在每个回合开始时自动进行的随机力量检定中成功（1d20 + 角色的力量值 > 20）。如果检定失败，目标将会受到少量的“戏弄”伤害。与某些防御姿态一样，“抓取”状态也会被“眩晕”或“击倒”技能打断。
rows.raw: "Grapples a character, inflicting the Restrained condition until broken out of. It lasts up to 3 turns, or until the target succeeds a randomized Strength check (1d20 + STR > 20), made automatically at the start of each turn. On a failed test, the target takes a small amount of Tease damage. Like a stance, a Grapple can be disrupted by a Stun or Knockdown."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] whip[tps|s] a number of vines at [target.combatName's] limbs, lashing them around [target.combatHisHer] arms and legs and pulling the tendrils taut! [target.CombatName] [tps|is|are] restrained!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]鞭打[tps|]有许多藤蔓攀爬在[target.combatName's]之上将他们的四肢捆绑起来[target.combatHisHer]使所有的力量都凝聚起来，把那些触须拉得紧紧的！[target.CombatName] [tps|已|已]被束缚！
rows.raw: "\n \n [attacker.CombatName] whip[tps|s] a number of vines at [target.combatName's] limbs, lashing them around [target.combatHisHer] arms and legs and pulling the tendrils taut! [target.CombatName] [tps|is|are] restrained!"

rows.original: [var0 |[attacker.CombatName] [tps|gets|fill yourself with] a surge of strength, ripping [attacker.combatHisHer] arms free of the viney restraints. From there, it's easy to free [attacker.combatHisHer] legs and get back in the fight! |[attacker.CombatName] struggle[tps|s] against [target.combatName's] viney restraint, but it's an exercise in futility. [attacker.CombatName] remain[tps|s] grappled!
rows.translation: [var0 |[attacker.CombatName][tps|获得|让自己充满]一阵力量，撕开束缚[attacker.combatHisHer]双臂的藤蔓枷锁。接下来，要解放[attacker.combatHisHer]双腿并重返战斗就轻而易举了！ |[attacker.CombatName]奋力挣扎[tps|]，试图摆脱[target.combatName's]藤蔓束缚，但这根本徒劳无功。[attacker.CombatName]仍然被擒抱[tps|]着！
rows.raw: " [var0 |[attacker.CombatName] [tps|gets|fill yourself with] a surge of strength, ripping [attacker.combatHisHer] arms free of the viney restraints. From there, it's easy to free [attacker.combatHisHer] legs and get back in the fight! |[attacker.CombatName] struggle[tps|s] against [target.combatName's] viney restraint, but it's an exercise in futility. [attacker.CombatName] remain[tps|s] grappled!"

rows.translation: 收缩

rows.original: The enemy locks eyes with [target.isPC|you|[target.combatName]], and, with a sudden burst of speed, [target.isPC|it lunges for you! Its long, serpentine body wraps around you again and again, wrapping you in thick, powerful coils from head to toe. You fall to your knees – you're utterly immobilized and helpless!|it lunges for [target.combatName]! Its long, serpentine body wraps around [target.combatName] again and again, wrapping [target.combatHimHer] in thick, powerful coils from head to toe. [target.CombatHeShe] falls to [target.combatHisHer] knees, utterly helpless!] [target.CombatName] [tps|is|are] constricted!
rows.translation: 敌人盯住[target.isPC|你|[target.combatName]]，突然加速，[target.isPC|朝你猛扑过来！它修长的蛇身一圈又一圈地缠住你，从头到脚把你束缚在粗壮有力的蛇躯中。你跪倒在地，彻底动弹不得，毫无反抗之力！|朝[target.combatName]猛扑过去！它修长的蛇身一圈又一圈地缠住[target.combatName]，用粗壮有力的蛇躯从头到脚束缚住[target.combatHimHer]。[target.CombatHeShe]倒下，以[target.combatHisHer]双膝着地，毫无反抗之力！][target.CombatName][tps|已|已]被绞缠住！
rows.raw: "\n \n The enemy locks eyes with [target.isPC|you|[target.combatName]], and, with a sudden burst of speed, [target.isPC|it lunges for you! Its long, serpentine body wraps around you again and again, wrapping you in thick, powerful coils from head to toe. You fall to your knees – you're utterly immobilized and helpless!|it lunges for [target.combatName]! Its long, serpentine body wraps around [target.combatName] again and again, wrapping [target.combatHimHer] in thick, powerful coils from head to toe. [target.CombatHeShe] falls to [target.combatHisHer] knees, utterly helpless!] [target.CombatName] [tps|is|are] constricted!"

From there, it's easy to free [attacker.combatHisHer] legs and get back in the fight! |[attacker.CombatName] struggle[tps|s] against [target.combatName's] restraint, but it's an exercise in futility. [attacker.CombatName] remain[tps|s] constricted!
rows.translation: [var0 |[attacker.CombatName][tps|获得|让自己充满]一阵力量，撕开束缚[attacker.combatHisHer]双臂的枷锁。接下来，要解放[attacker.combatHisHer]双腿并重返战斗就轻而易举了！ |[attacker.CombatName]奋力挣扎[tps|]，试图摆脱[target.combatName's]束缚，但这根本徒劳无功。[attacker.CombatName]仍然被紧紧束缚[tps|]着！
rows.raw: " [var0 |[attacker.CombatName] [tps|gets|fill yourself with] a surge of strength, ripping [attacker.combatHisHer] arms free of the restraints. From there, it's easy to free [attacker.combatHisHer] legs and get back in the fight! |[attacker.CombatName] struggle[tps|s] against [target.combatName's] restraint, but it's an exercise in futility. [attacker.CombatName] remain[tps|s] constricted!"

rows.translation: 哈比之歌
哈比之歌

rows.original: Inflicts light raw Lust damage and causes Arousal each turn until the singing harlot is stopped.
rows.translation: 每回合都会造成轻微的原始欲望伤害，并引发兴奋状态，直到这个唱歌的妓女被制止为止。
rows.raw: "Inflicts light raw Lust damage and causes Arousal each turn until the singing harlot is stopped."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName's] sensual song continues to fill the air — and your heart. You can feel your grasp on your resolve becoming ever more tenuous with each enchanted note!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName's]那首充满魅力的歌曲依然回荡在空气中，也触动了你的心弦。每当那美妙的音符响起，你都会感觉到自己原本坚定的决心正在逐渐动摇……
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName's] sensual song continues to fill the air — and your heart. You can feel your grasp on your resolve becoming ever more tenuous with each enchanted note!"

rows.translation: [target.CombatName] [tps|已|已]被这首歌撩起情欲！

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] steps to the forefront, spreading [attacker.combatHisHer] clawed hands in front of [attacker.combatHisHer] like a performer and start[tps|ing] to sing. The tune carries, heavy and full of soul, across the rocky paths so that it quickly swells to be nearly all can hear. It's only a moment later that you begin to feel the rush under your [pc.skinFurScales], the burning in your loins. Lustful magic is woven into that harpy's voice, and it takes all of your willpower to keep from letting the wanton bird from drawing you into her feathery embrace. You've got to stop her!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]走到最前方，像表演者般展开[attacker.combatHisHer]带爪双手，伸到[attacker.combatHisHer]面前，开始[tps|]歌唱。厚重而饱含情感的旋律沿着崎岖的小路传开，迅速响彻四周，几乎盖过了其他一切声音。片刻后，你便感到热潮在[pc.skinFurScales]下涌动，下体阵阵灼热。那鹰身女妖的歌声交织着催情魔法，你必须拼尽意志，才能不被这只放荡的鸟儿引入羽翼的怀抱。你必须阻止她！
rows.raw: "\n \n [attacker.CombatName] steps to the forefront, spreading [attacker.combatHisHer] clawed hands in front of [attacker.combatHisHer] like a performer and start[tps|ing] to sing. The tune carries, heavy and full of soul, across the rocky paths so that it quickly swells to be nearly all can hear. It's only a moment later that you begin to feel the rush under your [pc.skinFurScales], the burning in your loins. Lustful magic is woven into that harpy's voice, and it takes all of your willpower to keep from letting the wanton bird from drawing you into her feathery embrace. You've got to stop her!"

rows.original: Finally, [char.combatNames] song has been put to an end! You breathe a sigh of relief, feeling the magic receding from the very air around you.
rows.translation: 终于， [char.combatNames]这首歌终于结束了！你松了一口气，感觉到周围的空气中那种神奇的气息正在逐渐消散。
rows.raw: "Finally, [char.combatNames] song has been put to an end! You breathe a sigh of relief, feeling the magic receding from the very air around you."

rows.translation: 授粉

rows.original: On effigy's turn, attack all enemies' Mental Defense to deal 10 Pheromone damage/round. Restores a flat 10 Health/round to all Effigies. 1/encounter.
rows.translation: 当“幻影”轮到行动时，它会攻击所有敌人的“精神防御”，每轮造成10点信息素伤害；同时，所有“幻影”每轮都会恢复10点生命值。此效果每场战斗仅触发一次。
rows.raw: "On effigy's turn, attack all enemies' Mental Defense to deal 10 Pheromone damage/round. Restores a flat 10 Health/round to all Effigies. 1/encounter."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] sink[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] fingers into [attacker.combatHisHer] flowery teats and spread[tps|s] them open, letting thick streams of amber nectar pour out from within. The scent is almost overpowering, immediately spreading out across the battlefield. Every bit of plant life, walking or not, starts looking like it's in full bloom around [attacker.combatName]! [var0|You've got to stop her before the aroma overcomes you completely!]
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]探入[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]手指，伸进[attacker.combatHisHer]花朵般的乳房，再将它们撑开[tps|]，让浓稠的琥珀色花蜜从中流淌而出。香气几乎令人招架不住，瞬间弥漫战场。所有植物，无论会不会走动，都仿佛在[attacker.combatName]周围盛开了！ [var0|你必须在这香气彻底压倒你之前阻止她！]
rows.raw: "\n [attacker.CombatName] sink[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] fingers into [attacker.combatHisHer] flowery teats and spread[tps|s] them open, letting thick streams of amber nectar pour out from within. The scent is almost overpowering, immediately spreading out across the battlefield. rows.original: Ninian heals himself back to full HP, with a 2 to 4-turn cooldown based on the balancing best judgment. This should try to encourage the PC to not try to just beat him down, whilst meaning very little to high-damage dealers who might wombo him before it can come back up. Basically, a tool to resist and further annoy the PCs who want to click-spam but make it transparent how one should face him.
rows.translation: 妮妮安能够将自己恢复到满血状态，但这一技能的冷却时间会根据平衡性调整的需要，介于2到4个回合之间。这样的设计旨在鼓励玩家不要试图一上来就将其击败，而对于那些能够造成高额伤害的角色来说，这个冷却时间几乎不会对他们产生任何影响——因为他们完全可以在妮妮安恢复之前就将其消灭。总的来说，这个技能就是一种用来抗性那些喜欢频繁攻击的角色、同时也能让玩家清楚地了解应该如何应对他的手段。
rows.raw: "Ninian heals himself back to full HP, with a 2 to 4-turn cooldown based on the balancing best judgment. This should try to encourage the PC to not try to just beat him down, whilst meaning very little to high-damage dealers who might wombo him before it can come back up. Basically, a tool to resist and further annoy the PCs who want to click-spam but make it transparent how one should face him."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] off hand toward the swirling portal overhead and shriek[tps|s], "Dark lady! Give me your protection; show this meager vessel your blessings!" The portal flares, and [attacker.combatNames] hands become suffused with the pink-purple light of its eldritch power. The sheen spreads down [attacker.combatHisHer] arms, enveloping [attacker.combatHisHer] entire body in misty light. [attacker.CombatName] laugh[tps|s] hysterically, throwing back [attacker.combatHisHer] head as [attacker.combatHisHer] body shudders and shivers. "Yes! Yes!" [attacker.combatHeShe] scream[tps|s], clutching at [attacker.combatHisHer] chest and head.

rows.original: [attacker.combatName] pulls a small, silver thurible from his robes. He hesitates for a second before pulling out a small sack with "BAD" written on it. "I hate this shit," he lets out before snapping his fingers and pouring the sack into the thurible. It alights into a crackling, reddish smoke that consumes the group. When it clears, they look far more aggressive than before, staring at you with borderline bloodlust.
rows.translation: [attacker.combatName]从长袍中取出一只小巧的银质香炉。他犹豫了一下，随后拿出了一个写着“BAD”字样的小袋子。“我讨厌这些东西，”他说道，然后打了个响指，将袋子里的东西倒入香炉中。顿时，一阵噼啪作响的红色烟雾弥漫开来，笼罩了在场的所有人。当烟雾散去后，他们看起来比之前更加凶狠了，那目光中几乎充满了杀意，紧紧地盯着你。
rows.raw: '\n[attacker.combatName] pulls a small, silver thurible from his robes. He hesitates for a second before pulling out a small sack with "BAD" written on it. "I hate this shit," he lets out before snapping his fingers and pouring the sack into the thurible. It alights into a crackling, reddish smoke that consumes the group.             |[attacker.CombatName]拿起[tps|]一瓶清澈的水，倒转瓶口，将[attacker.combatHimselfHerself]从头到脚浇遍。随后的片刻间，一圈淡淡的祝福之光萦绕在[attacker.combatHimHer]身上。
            |[attacker.CombatName]拿起[tps|]一瓶清澈的水，朝[target.combatName]泼去，把每一滴水都甩在[target.combatHisHer]身上。随后的片刻间，一圈淡淡的祝福之光萦绕在[target.combatName]身上。
        ]
rows.raw:
"
            
       [var0
            |[attacker.CombatName] take[tps|s] a philter of crystal-clear water and upends it, dousing [attacker.combatHimselfHerself] from head to toe. A certain radiance lingers on [attacker.combatHimHer] in the moments thereafter, a faint corona of blessed light.
            |[attacker.CombatName] take[tps|s] a philter of crystal-clear water and splashes it all over [target.combatName], flicking out every drop onto [target.combatHisHer] body. A certain radiance lingers on [target.combatName] in the moments thereafter, a faint corona of blessed light.
        ]"

rows.translation: 召唤师调配物
召唤师调配物

rows.original: Imbibing this will increase Focus and Spellpower by {X+scaling} until the end of combat.
rows.translation: 饮用后，专注和法术强度提高{X+scaling}，持续到战斗结束。
rows.raw: "Imbibing this will increase Focus and Spellpower by {X+scaling} until the end of combat."

rows.original:
[
            var0
            |[attacker.CombatName] unscrew[tps|s] the brass cap off the canister and take[tps|s] a long pull of the thin and tantalisingly sweet sorcerer's potion. Slowly, [attacker.combatHisHer] awareness of the world dims, shoved aside as something within [attacker.combatHimHer] reorganizes [attacker.combatHisHer] thoughts. Immediately, the cobwebs in [attacker.combatHisHer] mind dissolve and [attacker.combatHeShe] focus[tps|es] on the magical forces around [attacker.combatHimselfHerself], with no thought in [attacker.combatHimHer] mind but [attacker.combatHisHer] spellcasting.
            |[attacker.CombatName] unscrew[tps|s] the brass cap off the canister and offer[tps|s] it to [target.combatName]. [target.CombatName] look[tps|s] a little surprised, but accepts the canister and take[tps|s] a long pull of the thick and tantalisingly sweet sorcerer's potion. It doesn't take long for [target.combatName] to look a lot more focused and ready for spellcasting.
        ]
rows.translation:
[
            var0
            |[attacker.CombatName]拧开[tps|]罐子的黄铜盖，大口饮下[tps|]稀薄而甜美诱人的法师药剂。[attacker.combatHisHer]对周围世界的感知渐渐淡去，仿佛被挤到一旁；[attacker.combatHimHer]体内的某种力量正重整[attacker.combatHisHer]思绪。顷刻间，[attacker.combatHisHer]脑海中的迷雾消散，[attacker.combatHeShe]专注[tps|]于[attacker.combatHimselfHerself]周围的魔法力量，[attacker.combatHimHer]脑中除了[attacker.combatHisHer]施法之外再无其他念头。
            |[attacker.CombatName]拧开[tps|]罐子的黄铜盖，将它递给[tps|][target.combatName]。[target.CombatName]看起来[tps|]有点惊讶，但还是接过罐子，大口饮下[tps|]浓稠而甜美诱人的法师药剂。没过多久，[target.combatName]就显得更加专注，随时准备施法。
        ]
rows.raw:
"
            
        [
            var0
            |[attacker.CombatName] unscrew[tps|s] the brass cap off the canister and take[tps|s] a long pull of the thin and tantalisingly sweet sorcerer's potion. Slowly, [attacker.combatHisHer] awareness of the world dims, shoved aside as something within [attacker.combatHimHer] reorganizes [attacker.combatHisHer] thoughts. Immediately, the cobwebs in [attacker.combatHisHer] mind dissolve and [attacker.combatHeShe] focus[tps|es] on the magical forces around [attacker.combatHimselfHerself], with no thought in [attacker.combatHimHer] mind but [attacker.combatHisHer] spellcasting.
            |[attacker.CombatName] unscrew[tps|s] the brass cap off the canister and offer[tps|s] it to [target.combatName]. [target.CombatName] look[tps|s] a little surprised, but accepts the canister and take[tps|s] a long pull of the thick and tantalisingly sweet sorcerer's potion. It doesn't take long for [target.combatName] to look a lot more focused and ready for spellcasting.
        ]"

rows.translation: 石脑油

rows.original: Applying this to your weapon will add (x+scaling) fire damage to it until the end of your next combat.
rows.translation: 将其涂在武器上，可使武器在下一场战斗结束前额外造成(x+scaling)点火焰伤害。
rows.raw: "Applying this to your weapon will add (x+scaling) fire damage to it until the end of your next combat."

rows.original: Uncorking the ceramic bottle, [attacker.combatName] pour[tps|s] a small portion of naphtha over the business end of [target.combatHisHer] weapon, then wipe[tps|s] away the excess residue. It won't burn for long, but while it lasted the flame will give [target.combatHisHer] opponents something extra to worry about.
rows.translation: 拔开陶瓷瓶塞，[attacker.combatName]倒出[tps|]少许石脑油，浇在[target.combatHisHer]武器的攻击端，再擦去[tps|]多余的残液。火焰不会燃烧太久，但在熄灭之前，足以让[target.combatHisHer]对手多一份顾虑。
rows.raw: "\n            \n            Uncorking the ceramic bottle, [attacker.combatName] pour[tps|s] a small portion of naphtha over the business end of [target.combatHisHer] weapon, then wipe[tps|s] away the excess residue. It won't burn for long, but while it lasted the flame will give [target.combatHisHer] opponents something extra to worry about."

rows.translation: 坚定补剂
坚定补剂

rows.original: Applying this to your armor will increase Physical Defense and Armor by {X+scaling} until the end of your next combat.
rows.translation: 将其涂抹在护甲上，会使物理防御和护甲提高{X+scaling}，持续到下一场战斗结束。
rows.raw: "Applying this to your armor will increase Physical Defense and Armor by {X+scaling} until the end of your next combat."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] appl[tps|ies|y] a thin layer of the tonic on [var0|[target.combatHisHer]|[target.combatNames]] [target.armor], spreading it out as evenly as possible. The viscous liquid quickly dries out into a hard film; while it lasts, [target.combatName] will definitely be a little more protected from blows.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]涂上[tps||]一层薄薄的药液，覆盖在[var0|[target.combatHisHer]|[target.combatNames]][target.armor]上，尽量将其抹匀。黏稠的液体迅速干成一层硬膜；在它维持期间，[target.combatName]抵御打击的能力肯定会增强一些。
rows.raw: "\n            \n        [attacker.CombatName] appl[tps|ies|y] a thin layer of the tonic on [var0|[target.combatHisHer]|[target.combatNames]] [target.armor], spreading it out as evenly as possible. The viscous liquid quickly dries out into a hard film; while it lasts, [target.combatName] will definitely be a little more protected from blows."

rows.translation: 乳香油
橄榄油
点决心值。

rows.original:
[attacker.is target
                |Pulling out a glass vial, [attacker.combatName] lift[tps|s] it to [attacker.combatHisHer] nose and inhale[tps|s] deeply. Instantly, the cobwebs and desires in [attacker.combatHisHer] mind dissolve away, leaving [attacker.combatHimHer] more alert and focused.
                |Hurrying over to [target.combatName], [attacker.combatName] shove[tps|s] the open end of a glass vial under [target.combatHisHer] nose, allowing [target.combatHimHer] to inhale the vapours. Within moments, [target.combatName] look[tps|s] more alert and focused.
            ]
rows.translation:
[attacker.is target
                |[attacker.combatName]掏出一只玻璃小瓶，举[tps|]到[attacker.combatHisHer]鼻下深深吸[tps|]了一口。瞬间，[attacker.combatHisHer]脑中的昏沉与欲念消散，让[attacker.combatHimHer]变得更加警觉、专注。
                |急忙赶到[target.combatName]身边后，[attacker.combatName]把玻璃小瓶的开口塞[tps|]到[target.combatHisHer]鼻下，让[target.combatHimHer]吸入瓶中的气体。片刻后，[target.combatName]看[tps|]起来更加警觉、专注。
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            
            [attacker.is target
                |Pulling out a glass vial, [attacker.combatName] lift[tps|s] it to [attacker.combatHisHer] nose and inhale[tps|s] deeply. Instantly, the cobwebs and desires in [attacker.combatHisHer] mind dissolve away, leaving [attacker.combatHimHer] more alert and focused.
                |Hurrying over to [target.combatName], [attacker.combatName] shove[tps|s] the open end of a glass vial under [target.combatHisHer] nose, allowing [target.combatHimHer] to inhale the vapours. Within moments, [target.combatName] look[tps|s] more alert and focused.
            ]"

rows.translation: 治疗剂

rows.original: Clears all negative combat effects from the target.
rows.translation: 消除目标身上的所有负面战斗效果。
rows.raw: "Clears all negative combat effects from the target."

rows.original:
[attacker.is target
                |[attacker.CombatName] scoop[tps|s] up a glob of remedy paste with [attacker.combatHisHer] fingers and suck[tps|s] it down, grimacing at the bitter, vinegary taste. Within moments, [attacker.combatHeShe] relax[tps|es] as a soothing warmth spreads through [attacker.combatHisHer] body, counteracting what ails [attacker.combatHimHer].
                |[attacker.CombatName] hurr[tps|ies|y] over to [target.combatName], quickly applying some salve to the worst of [target.combatName's] wounds. [target.combatName] wince[tps|s], but soon looks much better for it.
            ]
rows.translation:
[attacker.is target
                |[attacker.CombatName]舀起[tps|]一团药糊，用[attacker.combatHisHer]手指送入口中吸食[tps|]，酸苦的滋味令人皱眉。片刻后，[attacker.combatHeShe]放松下来[tps|]，舒缓的暖意遍布[attacker.combatHisHer]全身，缓解着折磨[attacker.combatHimHer]的病痛。
                |[attacker.CombatName]赶到[tps||][target.combatName]身边，迅速在[target.combatName's]伤势最重的部位涂上药膏。[target.combatName]疼得皱起脸[tps|]，但很快便显得好些了。
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            
            [attacker.is target
                |[attacker.CombatName] scoop[tps|s] up a glob of remedy paste with [attacker.combatHisHer] fingers and suck[tps|s] it down, grimacing at the bitter, vinegary taste. Within moments, [attacker.combatHeShe] relax[tps|es] as a soothing warmth spreads through [attacker.combatHisHer] body, counteracting what ails [attacker.combatHimHer].
                |[attacker.CombatName] hurr[tps|ies|y] over to [target.combatName], quickly applying some salve to the worst of [target.combatName's] wounds. [target.combatName] wince[tps|s], but soon looks much better for it.
            ]"

rows.translation: 伤药
当前生命值。

rows.original:
[attacker.is target
                |[attacker.CombatName's] wounds sting as [attacker.combatHeShe] appl[tps|ies|y] the salve to [attacker.combatHisHer] body, the sensation of warmth only making them itch all the more. Before [attacker.combatHisHer] eyes, they begin to close — albeit slowly, and the smell is truly something to behold.
                |[attacker.CombatName] tell[tps|s] [target.combatName] to hold still as [attacker.combatHeShe] appl[tps|ies|y] the salve to [target.combatHisHer] wounds. [target.CombatName] wince[tps|s] while the process is ongoing, but soon look[tps|s] better for it.
            ]
rows.translation:
[attacker.is target
                |[attacker.CombatName's]伤口传来刺痛，[attacker.combatHeShe]正把[tps||]药膏涂在[attacker.combatHisHer]身上，那股暖意让伤口更痒了。在[attacker.combatHisHer]眼前，伤口开始缓缓闭合，而那气味实在一言难尽。
                |[attacker.CombatName]告诉[tps|][target.combatName]别动，[attacker.combatHeShe]将[tps||]药膏涂在[target.combatHisHer]伤口上。[target.CombatName]在涂药时疼得皱起脸[tps|]，但很快看起来[tps|]就好些了。
            ]

Before [attacker.combatHisHer] eyes, they begin to close — albeit slowly, and the smell is truly something to behold.
                |[attacker.CombatName] tell[tps|s] [target.combatName] to hold still as [attacker.combatHeShe] appl[tps|ies|y] the salve to [target.combatHisHer] wounds. [target.CombatName] wince[tps|s] while the process is ongoing, but soon look[tps|s] better for it.
            ]"

rows.translation: 冬茎

rows.original: % Health over three turns, or all at once if out of combat.
rows.translation: 在三个回合内逐渐恢复生命值，若处于非战斗状态，则可一次性恢复所有生命值。
rows.raw: "% Health over three turns, or all at once if out of combat."

rows.original:
[attacker.is target
                |With no time to waste, [attacker.combatName] crumble[tps|s] the dried winterstem into a small measure of water, then tip[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] head back to swig it down. A calming sensation spreads outward the moment the restorative herb hits [attacker.combatHisHer] stomach, numbing pains and soothing discomforts.
                |With no time to waste, [attacker.combatName] crumble[tps|s] the dried winterstem into a small measure of water, then rushes over to [target.combatName] to apply the resultant tincture on [target.combatHisHer] wounds. The topical application isn't as effective as directly imbibing the herb, but [target.combatName] still looks better for it.
            ]
rows.translation:
[attacker.is target
                |刻不容缓，[attacker.combatName]捏碎[tps|]干燥的冬茎，混入少量水中，随后仰起[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]头，将它一饮而尽。恢复性草药一进入[attacker.combatHisHer]胃里，舒缓的感觉便蔓延开来，减轻疼痛，抚平不适。
                |刻不容缓，[attacker.combatName]捏碎[tps|]干燥的冬茎，混入少量水中，随后赶到[target.combatName]身边，将药液涂在[target.combatHisHer]伤口上。外敷不如直接服用草药有效，但[target.combatName]看起来仍好些了。
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            
            [attacker.is target
                |With no time to waste, [attacker.combatName] crumble[tps|s] the dried winterstem into a small measure of water, then tip[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] head back to swig it down. A calming sensation spreads outward the moment the restorative herb hits [attacker.combatHisHer] stomach, numbing pains and soothing discomforts.
                |With no time to waste, [attacker.combatName] crumble[tps|s] the dried winterstem into a small measure of water, then rushes over to [target.combatName] to apply the resultant tincture on [target.combatHisHer] wounds. The topical application isn't as effective as directly imbibing the herb, but [target.combatName] still looks better for it.
            ]"

rows.translation: 凯莉拉之泪
凯莉拉的泪水

rows.original: Use to revive a downed ally in combat.
rows.translation: 在战斗中用于复活被击倒的队友。
rows.raw: "Use to revive a downed ally in combat."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] carefully unstopper[tps|s] the bottle and pour[tps|s] out the otherworldly liquid onto [target.combatName]. Within moments, [target.combatName] stir[tps|s] and struggle[tps|s] to [target.combatHisHer] feet, back in the fight.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]小心拔开[tps|]瓶塞，倒出[tps|]那超凡的液体，浇到[target.combatName]身上。片刻后，[target.combatName]动了动[tps|]，挣扎着[tps|]用[target.combatHisHer]双脚站起身来，重新加入战斗。
rows.raw: "\n            \n            [attacker.CombatName] carefully unstopper[tps|s] the bottle and pour[tps|s] out the otherworldly liquid onto [target.combatName]. Within moments, [target.combatName] stir[tps|s] and struggle[tps|s] to [target.combatHisHer] feet, back in the fight."

rows.original: Throw this at the enemy party[silly|, and them being naughty in your sight, shall snuff it| to deal incredible crushing, blight and fire damage to all targets]. This effect cannot miss — the explosion is simply too obscenely great.
rows.translation: 将它扔向敌方队伍[silly|，那些在你眼中作恶的家伙便将一命呜呼|，对所有目标造成惊人的钝击、枯萎和火焰伤害]。这一效果必定命中——爆炸范围实在大得离谱。
rows.raw: "Throw this at the enemy party[silly|, and them being naughty in your sight, shall snuff it| to deal incredible crushing, blight and fire damage to all targets]. This effect cannot miss — the explosion is simply too obscenely great."

rows.original: Trembling, [attacker.combatName] depress[tps|es] the button on the ancient device and twist[tps|s] both halves, priming it. With a firm overhand throw, [attacker.combatHeShe] send[tps|s] the marble-sized ordnance flying towards the enemy party! An enormous flash of heat and light explodes outwards as the magical grenade detonates with a thunderous roar!
rows.translation: [attacker.combatName]颤抖着按下[tps|]古老装置上的按钮，旋转[tps|]它的上下两半，将它激活。随后，[attacker.combatHeShe]以有力的过肩投掷，把[tps|]这枚弹珠大小的爆炸物掷向敌方队伍！魔法手雷在雷鸣般的轰响中引爆，耀眼的光与炽热的冲击向四面八方炸开！
rows.raw: "\n            \n            Trembling, [attacker.combatName] depress[tps|es] the button on the ancient device and twist[tps|s] both halves, priming it. With a firm overhand throw, [attacker.combatHeShe] send[tps|s] the marble-sized ordnance flying towards the enemy party! An enormous flash of heat and light explodes outwards as the magical grenade detonates with a thunderous roar!"

rows.translation: [target.CombatName] [tps|已|已]被那灼热的冲击波击中！
投掷莉里克
投掷莉里克

rows.original: Throw Lyric directly at a single enemy, [lyric.electrumRange 0 100 200|claws first, doing slashing damage|ass first, doing crushing damage|ass first, doing crushing damage and minor resolve damage]. Only [pc.name] can throw Lyric.
rows.translation: 将莉里克直接掷向单个敌人，[lyric.electrumRange 0 100 200|以爪子迎向目标，造成斩击伤害|以屁股迎向目标，造成钝击伤害|以屁股迎向目标，造成钝击伤害和少量意志伤害]。只有[pc.name]可以投掷莉里克。
rows.raw: "Throw Lyric directly at a single enemy, [lyric.electrumRange 0 100 200|claws first, doing slashing damage|ass first, doing crushing damage|ass first, doing crushing damage and minor resolve damage]. Only [pc.name] can throw Lyric."

rows.original: [lyric.CombatName] flies through the air, [lyric.electrumRange 0 100|[lyric.hisHer] claws extended, ready to maim [target.combatName].|ass first, [lyric.hisHer] enormous rear-end battering through the air towards [target.combatName].] [hitMiss|Your aim was true, and [lyric.CombatName] collides with your target, [lyric.electrumRange 0 100 200|slashing into them with [lyric.hisHer] sharp claws|smashing directly into their face with the whole weight of [lyric.hisHer] body|pounding into their with such force that you could feel it through the ground from where you stand. For a brief moment, their whole skull is wrapped in fat kobold ass]!
rows.translation: [lyric.CombatName]飞过空中，[lyric.electrumRange 0 100|[lyric.hisHer]利爪伸出，准备重创[target.combatName]。|屁股朝前，[lyric.hisHer]巨大的后臀划破空气，朝[target.combatName]猛撞过去。][hitMiss|你的瞄准非常准确，[lyric.CombatName]撞上你的目标，[lyric.electrumRange 0 100 200|用[lyric.hisHer]锋利爪子撕向他们|以[lyric.hisHer]全身重量直接砸上他们的脸|以如此巨大的力道砸上他们，甚至让你站在原地都能通过地面感到震动。短短一瞬间，他们整个脑袋都被肥硕狗头人屁股包住]！
rows.raw: "\n            \n            [lyric.CombatName] flies through the air, [lyric.electrumRange 0 100|[lyric.hisHer] claws extended, ready to maim [target.combatName].|ass first, [lyric.hisHer] enormous rear-end battering through the air towards [target.combatName].] [hitMiss|Your aim was true, and [lyric.CombatName] collides with your target, [lyric.electrumRange 0 100 200|slashing into them with [lyric.hisHer] sharp claws|smashing directly into their face with the whole weight of [lyric.hisHer] body|pounding into their with such force that you could feel it through the ground from where you stand. For a brief moment, their whole skull is wrapped in fat kobold ass]!"

rows.original: |But your aim was wide, and [lyric.CombatName] sails harmlessly past them, missing their mark by just a few inches!]
rows.translation: |但你瞄偏了，[lyric.CombatName]从他们身旁无伤掠过，离目标只差几英寸！]
rows.raw: "|But your aim was wide, and [lyric.CombatName] sails harmlessly past them, missing their mark by just a few inches!]"

rows.original: [lyric.CombatName] returns to you, jumping into your rucksack the moment [lyric.heShe] gets the chance. "Ready whenever you are!" [lyric.heShe] says.
rows.translation: [lyric.CombatName]回到你身边，[lyric.heShe]一有机会便跳进你的背包。“随时听候差遣！”[lyric.heShe]说道。
rows.raw: '\n                \n            [lyric.CombatName] returns to you, jumping into your rucksack the moment [lyric.heShe] gets the chance. "Ready whenever you are!" [lyric.heShe] says.'

rows.translation: 普通攻击
普通攻击

rows.original: Basic attack scales off Lyric's consumed electrum. The more electrum, the higher Lyric's attack.
rows.translation: 普通攻击的威力会根据莱瑞克消耗的电银量来提升。消耗的电银越多，莱瑞克的攻击力就越强。
rows.raw: "Basic attack scales off Lyric's consumed electrum. The more electrum, the higher Lyric's attack."

rows.original:
[lyric.electrumRange 0 300
            |[attacker.CombatName] charges forward, swinging [lyric.hisHer] sharpened claws at [target.combatName]! [hitMiss
                |[lyric.HisHer] swing is wild, but true, and [lyric.hisHer] claws rake across [target.combatName]!

rows.original: Palming [attacker.combatHisHer] hands together, [attacker.combatName] whisper[tps|s] a quiet, rushed prayer, [attacker.combatHisHer] voice so soft as to be a kiss on the wind. At length, [target.combatName] struggle[tps|s] to [target.combatHisHer] feet, full of resolve and ready to be back in the fight!
rows.translation: 用手掌遮住[attacker.combatHisHer]齐心协力， [attacker.combatName]低语[tps|]一声轻声而急促的祈祷， [attacker.combatHisHer]声音轻得仿佛是风中的轻吻。终于， [target.combatName]挣扎[tps|]向[target.combatHisHer]双脚充满决心，随时准备重新投入战斗！
rows.raw: "\n            \n            Palming [attacker.combatHisHer] hands together, [attacker.combatName] whisper[tps|s] a quiet, rushed prayer, [attacker.combatHisHer] voice so soft as to be a kiss on the wind. At length, [target.combatName] struggle[tps|s] to [target.combatHisHer] feet, full of resolve and ready to be back in the fight!"

rows.translation: 复活敌人
复活敌人

rows.original: Revive an enemy, restoring all of their health. Why would you use this?
rows.translation: 使敌人复活，恢复他们所有的生命值。你为什么会使用这个功能呢？
rows.raw: "Revive an enemy, restoring all of their health. Why would you use this?"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] lean[tps|s] down and stroke[tps|s] [target.combatNames] cheek. "Oh, sweet little thing, giving up so soon? I THINK NOT." A pulse of energy passes between the two[target.isPC| of you], leaving [target.combatNames] heart hammering — and still very much in the fight.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]俯下身[tps|]，抚摸[tps|][target.combatNames]脸颊。“哦，可爱的小家伙，这么快就放弃了？我可不答应。”一股能量在[target.isPC|你们]两人之间流过，让[target.combatNames]心脏怦怦直跳——显然还远没到退出战斗的时候。
rows.raw: '\n            \n            [attacker.CombatName] lean[tps|s] down and stroke[tps|s] [target.combatNames] cheek. "Oh, sweet little thing, giving up so soon? I THINK NOT." A pulse of energy passes between the two[target.isPC| of you], leaving [target.combatNames] heart hammering — and still very much in the fight.'

rows.translation: 灵魂绑定者
灵能束缚者

rows.original: You channel your magic into a summon on the field, fully healing it and granting it a massive boost to its combat power for the duration of the encounter.
rows.translation: 你将魔力注入场上的一名召唤物，使其生命值完全恢复，并在本场战斗剩余时间里大幅提升其战斗力。
rows.raw: "You channel your magic into a summon on the field, fully healing it and granting it a massive boost to its combat power for the duration of the encounter."

rows.original: Extending a hand, [attacker.combatName] point[tps|s] at [target.combatName], a brilliant blue bolt of energy racing from [attacker.combatHisHer] outstretched finger and suffusing [target.combatName] with a brilliant blue light! [target.CombatName] pulse[tps|es] with overflowing power, re-energised by the surge of energy!
rows.translation: [attacker.combatName]伸出一只手，指向[tps|][target.combatName]；一道明亮的蓝色能量从[attacker.combatHisHer]伸出的指尖疾射而出，使[target.combatName]沐浴在耀眼蓝光中！[target.CombatName]体内涌动[tps|]着充盈的力量，因这股能量而重新振作！
rows.raw: "\n            \n            Extending a hand, [attacker.combatName] point[tps|s] at [target.combatName], a brilliant blue bolt of energy racing from [attacker.combatHisHer] outstretched finger and suffusing [target.combatName] with a brilliant blue light! [target.CombatName] pulse[tps|es] with overflowing power, re-energised by the surge of energy!"

rows.translation: 外壳

rows.original: You surround yourself in a near-impenetrable magical barrier, gaining a
rows.translation: 你用近乎不可穿透的魔法屏障包围自身，获得
rows.raw: "You surround yourself in a near-impenetrable magical barrier, gaining a "

rows.original: damage shield and generating massive Threat.
rows.translation: 造成伤害盾牌，并产生巨大的威胁。
rows.raw: " damage shield and generating massive Threat."

rows.original:
[attacker.is atugia
                |[attacker.CombatName] floods power into the runes that cover [attacker.combatHisHer] body. Glowing energy spreads till it covers [attacker.combatHisHer] body, wrapping [attacker.combatHimHer] in a shell of ghostly light!
                |[attacker.CombatName] quickly trace[tps|s] several lines of glowing runes and sigils in the air, the pulsing, archaic lettering bleeding power. With a sudden clap of [attacker.combatHisHer] hands, they wrap about [attacker.combatHimHer] in a shell of ghostly blue light!
            ]
rows.translation:
[attacker.is atugia
                |[attacker.CombatName]将力量注入遍布[attacker.combatHisHer]身体的符文。发光的能量逐渐扩散，覆盖了[attacker.combatHisHer]全身，把[attacker.combatHimHer]裹在幽光构成的外壳中！
                |[attacker.CombatName]迅速在空中画出[tps|]几行发光的符文和印记，脉动的古老文字溢出魔力。[attacker.combatHisHer]双手猛然一拍，符文便环绕[attacker.combatHimHer]，形成一层幽蓝光壳！
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            
            [attacker.is atugia
                |[attacker.CombatName] floods power into the runes that cover [attacker.combatHisHer] body. Glowing energy spreads till it covers [attacker.combatHisHer] body, wrapping [attacker.combatHimHer] in a shell of ghostly light!
                |[attacker.CombatName] quickly trace[tps|s] several lines of glowing runes and sigils in the air, the pulsing, archaic lettering bleeding power. With a sudden clap of [attacker.combatHisHer] hands, they wrap about [attacker.combatHimHer] in a shell of ghostly blue light!
            ]"

rows.translation: 收费过高

rows.original: You overcharge yourself, decreasing Armor and Ward by -10, but gaining
rows.translation: 你使自身过载，护甲和守护降低-10，但获得
rows.raw: "You overcharge yourself, decreasing Armor and Ward by -10, but gaining "

rows.original: Storm damage and +20 Accuracy to your weapon, physical, and spell attacks for 3 turns.
rows.translation: 点风暴伤害，并使你的武器攻击、物理攻击和法术攻击获得+20精准度，持续3回合。
rows.raw: " Storm damage and +20 Accuracy to your weapon, physical, and spell attacks for 3 turns."

rows.original: Lightning suddenly surges about [attacker.combatName] as [attacker.combatHeShe] is taken by a burst of speed and power, [attacker.combatHisHer] blows suddenly more deadly and accurate as [attacker.combatHeShe] foregoes defense!
rows.translation: 闪电突然在[attacker.combatName]周围涌动，[attacker.combatHeShe]获得爆发性的速度与力量，[attacker.combatHisHer]攻击顿时更加致命、更加精准，而[attacker.combatHeShe]也放弃了防御！
rows.raw: "\n            \n        Lightning suddenly surges about [attacker.combatName] as [attacker.combatHeShe] is taken by a burst of speed and power, [attacker.combatHisHer] blows suddenly more deadly and accurate as [attacker.combatHeShe] foregoes defense!"

rows.translation: 太阳之刃
太阳之刃

rows.original: You call upon Lumia to bless your weapon with a burst of sunlight. All enemies suffer an attack against Magic Defense that Blinds on a hit. In addition, your weapon deals an extra
rows.translation: 你呼唤卢米娅，以一阵阳光祝福你的武器。所有敌人都会受到一次针对魔法防御的攻击，命中时会被致盲。此外，你的武器额外造成
rows.raw: "You call upon Lumia to bless your weapon with a burst of sunlight. All enemies suffer an attack against Magic Defense that Blinds on a hit. In addition, your weapon deals an extra "

rows.original: Holy damage for 3 turns. Generates massive Threat.
rows.translation: 点神圣伤害，持续3回合。产生大量威胁值。
rows.raw: " Holy damage for 3 turns. Generates massive Threat."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] to the heavens, invoking [silly|the ancient words: "I HAVE THE POWER!"|Lumia's name.] The call is answered by a flash of blinding light that leaves the weapon crackling with righteous sunlight!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]提高[tps|] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon]向上苍祈祷，祈求神明相助[silly|那句古老的话语：“我拥有力量！|卢米娅的名字。]电话被接通的瞬间，一道刺眼的光芒闪过，使得那把武器仿佛被正义的光芒所充满，发出“噼啪”的声响！
rows.raw: '\n[attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] to the heavens, invoking [silly|the ancient words: "I HAVE THE POWER!"|Lumia\'s name.] The call is answered by a flash of blinding light that leaves the weapon crackling with righteous sunlight!'

rows.original: [hitMiss|[target.CombatName] reel[tps|s] from the light, blinded!|[target.CombatName] manage[tps|s] to shield [target.combatHisHer] eyes before the blast!]
rows.translation: [hitMiss|[target.CombatName]眩晕[tps|]被光芒刺得睁不开眼睛！|[target.CombatName]设法[tps|]为了保护[target.combatHisHer]在爆炸发生之前闭上眼睛！]
rows.raw: "\n[hitMiss|[target.CombatName] reel[tps|s] from the light, blinded!|[target.CombatName] manage[tps|s] to shield [target.combatHisHer] eyes before the blast!]"

rows.translation: 引爆

rows.original: Detonate in two rounds after this ability is used, sacrificing yourself to cause massive Blight, Fire and Crushing damage in an unavoidable explosion.
rows.translation: 使用此技能两回合后自爆，牺牲自身，在无法躲避的爆炸中造成大量枯萎、火焰和钝击伤害。
rows.raw: "Detonate in two rounds after this ability is used, sacrificing yourself to cause massive Blight, Fire and Crushing damage in an unavoidable explosion."

rows.original: The fuse finally counts down, and [attacker.combatName] detonate[tps|s] in an enormous blast of pulverising heat!
rows.translation: 引信终于燃尽，[attacker.combatName]在足以粉碎一切的灼热巨爆中炸开[tps|]！
rows.raw: "\n            \n        The fuse finally counts down, and [attacker.combatName] detonate[tps|s] in an enormous blast of pulverising heat!"

rows.translation: [target.CombatName] [tps|已|已]被那巨大的爆炸波及了！

rows.original: Something whirrs and clicks within [attacker.combatName], and [attacker.combatHeShe] stand[tps|s] stock-still, hissing and ticking ominously!
rows.translation: [attacker.combatName]体内传来嗡鸣与咔嗒声，[attacker.combatHeShe]一动不动地站着[tps|]，发出不祥的嘶嘶声与滴答声！
rows.raw: "\n                \n                Something whirrs and clicks within [attacker.combatName], and [attacker.combatHeShe] stand[tps|s] stock-still, hissing and ticking ominously!"

rows.translation: 平静的心境
冷静之心

rows.original: Calm your mind, increasing Focus and Spellpower by +15 for 3 turns and restoring
rows.translation: 平复心神，使专注和法术强度提高15点，持续3回合，并恢复
rows.raw: "Calm your mind, increasing Focus and Spellpower by +15 for 3 turns and restoring "

rows.translation: 点生命值。

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] focus[tps|es] intensely, calming [attacker.combatHisHer] mind and directing [attacker.combatHisHer] thoughts into a well-honed point.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]凝神专注[tps|]，平复[attacker.combatHisHer]心绪，将[attacker.combatHisHer]思绪汇聚成锐利的一点。
rows.raw: "\n            \n            [attacker.CombatName] focus[tps|es] intensely, calming [attacker.combatHisHer] mind and directing [attacker.combatHisHer] thoughts into a well-honed point."

rows.translation: 渴望与狼为伴

rows.original: A powerful kitsune reaches out to briefly possess an enemy and scramble their body and mind, inflicting a medley of status effects on a victim. Multiple mental resistance checks are made, one for each status; each failure causes the corresponding status to be applied.
rows.translation: 一只强大的狐妖会短暂附身于敌人，扰乱其身心，从而在受害者身上施加多种状态效果。系统会进行多次精神抗性检测，每次针对一种状态效果；如果检测失败，相应的状态效果就会被施加到敌人身上。
rows.raw: "A powerful kitsune reaches out to briefly possess an enemy and scramble their body and mind, inflicting a medley of status effects on a victim. Multiple mental resistance checks are made, one for each status; each failure causes the corresponding status to be applied."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatNames] eyes flash brilliant gold for a moment, and [target.combatName] [tps|is|are] consumed by a horrible, crawling sensation under [target.combatHisHer] skin! Nerves are deadened, limbs refuse to move as some insidious force wrestles with [target.combatHimHer] for control over [target.combatHisHer] mind and body!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatNames]眼睛瞬间闪烁着灿烂的金色光芒， [target.combatName] [tps|已|已]被一种令人恐惧的、爬行般的感觉所吞噬[target.combatHisHer]皮肉都快冻僵了，四肢完全动弹不得，仿佛有什么阴险的力量正在与我搏斗[target.combatHimHer]为了获得控制权[target.combatHisHer]全身心地投入！
rows.raw: "\n        \n        [attacker.CombatNames] eyes flash brilliant gold for a moment, and [target.combatName] [tps|is|are] consumed by a horrible, crawling sensation under [target.combatHisHer] skin! Nerves are deadened, limbs refuse to move as some insidious force wrestles with [target.combatHimHer] for control over [target.combatHisHer] mind and body!"

rows.translation: [target.CombatName] [tps|已|已]现在处于[var0]状态！
渴望与狼为伴

rows.translation: 一名强大的狐妖短暂附身敌人，扰乱其身心，使受害者承受多种削弱状态，持续
rows.raw: "A powerful kitsune briefly possesses an enemy and scrambles their body and mind, inflicting a debilitating medley of status effects on a victim for "

rows.translation: 回合。

rows.translation: [attacker.CombatNames]眼睛瞬间闪烁着灿烂的金色光芒， [target.combatName] [tps|已|已]被一种令人恐惧的、爬行般的感觉所吞噬[target.combatHisHer]皮肉都快冻僵了，四肢完全动弹不得，仿佛有什么阴险的力量正在与我搏斗[target.combatHimHer]为了获得控制权[target.combatHisHer]全身心地投入！

Nerves are deadened, limbs refuse to move as some insidious force wrestles with [target.combatHimHer] for control over [target.combatHisHer] mind and body!"

rows.translation: [target.CombatName] [tps|已|已]现在处于[var0]状态！
生命之缘

rows.original: Miko and Mai will use this on the other sister after a grace period of one round if one of them is downed, reviving the other at full health and resolve. Everyone on the player's side should be able to get off at least one action to finish off the other sister before she can pull off the revival.
rows.translation: 米可和舞之中若有一人倒下，另一人会在一回合的宽限期后对倒下的姐妹使用此技能，使她以满生命值和满决心值复活。玩家方的所有成员都应至少有一次行动机会，在复活发生前击倒另一名姐妹。
rows.raw: "Miko and Mai will use this on the other sister after a grace period of one round if one of them is downed, reviving the other at full health and resolve. Everyone on the player's side should be able to get off at least one action to finish off the other sister before she can pull off the revival."

rows.original: With a sudden surge of strength, [target.combatName] pull[tps|s] [target.combatHimselfHerself] to [target.combatHisHer] feet to stand by [attacker.combatName], fully refreshed and ready to give battle once more! It's clear that neither sister will stay down while the other's standing...
rows.translation: [target.combatName]突然涌出一股力量，撑起[tps|][target.combatHimselfHerself]，靠[target.combatHisHer]双脚重新站到[attacker.combatName]身旁。现在已完全恢复，准备再次投入战斗！显然，只要其中一位姐妹还站着，另一位就不会一直倒下……
rows.raw: "\n        \n        With a sudden surge of strength, [target.combatName] pull[tps|s] [target.combatHimselfHerself] to [target.combatHisHer] feet to stand by [attacker.combatName], fully refreshed and ready to give battle once more! It's clear that neither sister will stay down while the other's standing..."

rows.translation: 因果报应
因果报应

rows.original: You ward an ally with divine favor for 2 turns. Enemies making a physical attack against that target are blasted for
rows.translation: 你以神恩守护一名盟友，持续2回合。对该目标发动物理攻击的敌人会被反击，受到
rows.raw: "You ward an ally with divine favor for 2 turns. Enemies making a physical attack against that target are blasted for "

rows.original: Holy damage, and must make a Physical Defense check against your Spellpower or be Disarmed.
rows.translation: 点神圣伤害；目标还须以物理防御对抗你的法术强度进行检定，否则会被缴械。
rows.raw: " Holy damage, and must make a Physical Defense check against your Spellpower or be Disarmed."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] focus[tps|es] [attacker.combatHisHer] concentration, beseeching divine powers to ward [target.combatName]! As the chanted prayer is finished, a nimbus of golden light envelopes [target.combatName], crackling with power!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]集中[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]精神，恳求神力庇护[target.combatName]！祷文吟诵完毕后，一圈金色光晕笼罩[target.combatName]，其中力量噼啪作响！
rows.raw: "\n        \n        [attacker.CombatName] focus[tps|es] [attacker.combatHisHer] concentration, beseeching divine powers to ward [target.combatName]! As the chanted prayer is finished, a nimbus of golden light envelopes [target.combatName], crackling with power!"

rows.translation: 兴奋起来吧！
兴奋起来吧！

rows.original: You inspire a surge of confidence in a target ally, granting +50 Attack Power, Armor, and Focus for a turn.
rows.translation: 你能够激发目标盟友的信心，使其在接下来的一轮中攻击强度、护甲值和专注力均增加50。
rows.raw: "You inspire a surge of confidence in a target ally, granting +50 Attack Power, Armor, and Focus for a turn."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] cheer[tps|s] on [target.combatName], bouncing on the spot to give [target.combatHimHer] a good look at what [target.combatHeShe] [tps|is|are] fighting for!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]为[tps|][target.combatName]加油助威，在原地蹦跳，好让[target.combatHimHer]看清[target.combatHeShe][tps|正在|正在]为什么而战！
rows.raw: "\n        \n        [attacker.CombatName] cheer[tps|s] on [target.combatName], bouncing on the spot to give [target.combatHimHer] a good look at what [target.combatHeShe] [tps|is|are] fighting for!"

rows.translation: 威胁显现
威胁显现

rows.original: You attack all enemies with powerful flame, dealing
rows.translation: 你以强大的火焰攻击所有敌人，造成
rows.raw: "You attack all enemies with powerful flame, dealing "

rows.original: Fire damage. On critical hits, inflicts Burning for 2 turns. For 2 turns, you deal
rows.translation: 点火焰伤害。暴击时施加持续2回合的灼烧。接下来的2回合，你受到物理攻击时会造成
rows.raw: " Fire damage. On critical hits, inflicts Burning for 2 turns. For 2 turns, you deal "

rows.translation: 点火焰伤害。

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] steel[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer]self, magical flame bursting around [attacker.combatHimHer]. [attacker.CombatName]'s shield channel[tps|s] all of it into one spot. Finally gathered, all the heat and fire explodes over the battlefield. [attacker.CombatName] burn[tps|s] brilliantly at the center of the surging flame, wreathed in its protective heat!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]钢铁[tps|] [attacker.combatHisHer]自我，那股神奇的火焰正在周围迸发[attacker.combatHimHer]。 [attacker.CombatName]盾牌通道[tps|]将这一切汇聚到同一个地方。当所有的热量与火焰最终聚集在一起时，它们会在战场上爆发出来。 [attacker.CombatName]燃烧[tps|]灿烂地置身于熊熊燃烧的火焰之中，被其保护性的热浪所环绕！
rows.raw: "\n            \n        [attacker.CombatName] steel[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer]self, magical flame bursting around [attacker.combatHimHer]. [attacker.CombatName]'s shield channel[tps|s] all of it into one spot. Finally gathered, all the heat and fire explodes over the battlefield. [attacker.CombatName] burn[tps|s] brilliantly at the center of the surging flame, wreathed in its protective heat!"

[hitMiss
                |[target.CombatName] can't get out of the way or stop it: the flames wash over [target.combatHimHer]
rows.translation:
[hitMiss

|[target.CombatName]迅速逃出[tps|]了这次强力攻击的爆炸范围！
            ]
rows.raw: "\n                |[target.CombatName] quickly escape[tps|s] the blast zone of the powerful attack!\n            ]"

rows.translation: 地狱之约
InfernalBond

rows.original: Used immediately after Demon's Shadow dies. Transfers half of Gytha's remaining HP to him; grants them both a +100 Armor bonus for 1 turn.

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] divebombs [target.combatName], slapping [attacker.combatHisHer] hands down on [attacker.combatHisHer] stomach before exploding into raw magic. Like a bomb, [attacker.combatHeShe] erupts and blows up on [target.combatName] and engulfs [target.combatHimHer] in magical flame!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]朝[target.combatName]俯冲，用[attacker.combatHisHer]双手猛拍[attacker.combatHisHer]腹部，随即爆发成纯粹的魔力。[attacker.combatHeShe]如同炸弹一般在[target.combatName]身上炸开，将[target.combatHimHer]吞没在魔法火焰中！
rows.raw: "\n            \n        [attacker.CombatName] divebombs [target.combatName], slapping [attacker.combatHisHer] hands down on [attacker.combatHisHer] stomach before exploding into raw magic. Like a bomb, [attacker.combatHeShe] erupts and blows up on [target.combatName] and engulfs [target.combatHimHer] in magical flame!"

rows.translation: 女妖哀嚎
女妖哀嚎

rows.original: You unleash a horrifying wail, making a Presence-based attack against all enemies' Mental Defense. Targets hit take 25 Psychic Damage and are Terrified for a turn.
rows.translation: 你发出一声令人毛骨悚然的哀嚎，对所有敌人的精神防御发动了攻击。被击中的目标会受到25点精神伤害，并且会在接下来的一轮游戏中处于恐惧状态。
rows.raw: "You unleash a horrifying wail, making a Presence-based attack against all enemies' Mental Defense. Targets hit take 25 Psychic Damage and are Terrified for a turn."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] let[tps|s] loose a horrific wail, so shrill that the very earth shudders beneath its howling force!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]发出[tps|]一声恐怖的哀嚎，凄厉的声音令大地都为之颤动！
rows.raw: "\n            \n            [attacker.CombatName] let[tps|s] loose a horrific wail, so shrill that the very earth shudders beneath its howling force!"

rows.original: [hitMiss|[target.CombatName] grab[tps|s] [target.combatHisHer] head, groaning in agony as the wail sears at [target.combatHisHer] mind.
rows.translation: [hitMiss|[target.CombatName]抱住[tps|][target.combatHisHer]脑袋，在哀嚎灼烧[target.combatHisHer]心神时痛苦呻吟。
rows.raw: "\n[hitMiss|[target.CombatName] grab[tps|s] [target.combatHisHer] head, groaning in agony as the wail sears at [target.combatHisHer] mind."

rows.original: |[target.CombatName] cover[tps|s] [target.combatHisHer] ears, avoiding the worst of the wail's effects.]
rows.translation: |[target.CombatName]捂住[tps|][target.combatHisHer]双耳，避开了哀嚎最严重的影响。]
rows.raw: "|[target.CombatName] cover[tps|s] [target.combatHisHer] ears, avoiding the worst of the wail's effects.]"

rows.translation: 绽放爆发
绽放爆发

rows.original: You whirl lustful flowers around a foe, dealing
rows.translation: 你让充满欲望气息的花朵围绕敌人旋舞，造成
rows.raw: "You whirl lustful flowers around a foe, dealing "

rows.original: Pheromone damage on a hit against Magic Defense. The petals then turn razor-sharp, causing it to Bleed for 2 turns.
rows.translation: 在攻击魔法防御时，信息素会造成伤害。随后，这些花瓣会变得锋利如剃刀，使目标在接下来的2个回合内持续出血。
rows.raw: " Pheromone damage on a hit against Magic Defense. The petals then turn razor-sharp, causing it to Bleed for 2 turns."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] pirouette[tps|s], and in so doing raise[tps|s] a hand with a series of arcane gestures, conjuring forth a rain of intoxicating rose petals around [target.combatName]. [hitMiss|The petals completely surround [target.combatName] in an erotic miasma, before clinging to [target.combatHisHer] body — and revealing they're as sharp as razorblades when they dig painfully into [target.combatHimHer]!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]旋转[tps|]起舞，同时举起[tps|]一只手做出一连串奥术手势，在[target.combatName]周围召唤出一阵令人迷醉的玫瑰花瓣雨。[hitMiss|花瓣将[target.combatName]完全包围在淫靡的瘴气中，随后贴上[target.combatHisHer]身体——当它们痛苦地刺入[target.combatHimHer]时，才显露出自己锋利如剃刀！
rows.raw: "\n            \n        [attacker.CombatName] pirouette[tps|s], and in so doing raise[tps|s] a hand with a series of arcane gestures, conjuring forth a rain of intoxicating rose petals around [target.combatName]. [hitMiss|The petals completely surround [target.combatName] in an erotic miasma, before clinging to [target.combatHisHer] body — and revealing they're as sharp as razorblades when they dig painfully into [target.combatHimHer]!"

rows.original: |The petals do little to their target but add to [target.combatHisHer] attractiveness.]
rows.translation: |花瓣对目标影响不大，但增加了[target.combatHisHer]魅力。]
rows.raw: "|The petals do little to their target but add to [target.combatHisHer] attractiveness.]"

rows.translation: 翠绿风暴
翠绿风暴

rows.original: You call forth a restoring storm that grants one ally
rows.translation: 你召来一场复苏风暴，使一名盟友获得
rows.raw: "You call forth a restoring storm that grants one ally "

rows.translation: 再生，持续2回合，同时施加

rows.original: Storm damage on all enemies if it hits their Evasion.
rows.translation: 点风暴伤害，波及闪避检定失败的所有敌人。
rows.raw: " Storm damage on all enemies if it hits their Evasion."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] weave[tps|s] a song of renewing storms, an aria to ancient powers of earth and water to come together and cleanse the world. The healing rains fall upon [target.combatName], while lightning scours the land around [target.combatHimHer].
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]编织[tps|]一首复苏风暴之歌，吟唱古老的大地与水之力携手净化世界。疗愈的雨水落在[target.combatName]身上，闪电则扫荡着[target.combatHimHer]周围的大地。
rows.raw: "\n            \n        [attacker.CombatName] weave[tps|s] a song of renewing storms, an aria to ancient powers of earth and water to come together and cleanse the world. The healing rains fall upon [target.combatName], while lightning scours the land around [target.combatHimHer]."

rows.translation: [hitMiss|[target.CombatName][tps|被|被]风暴抽打！

rows.original: |[target.CombatName] get[tps|s] low, avoiding the worst of the storm!]
rows.translation: |[target.CombatName]俯身[tps|]伏低，避开了风暴最猛烈的冲击！]
rows.raw: "|[target.CombatName] get[tps|s] low, avoiding the worst of the storm!]"

rows.translation: 辉煌咏叹调
辉煌咏叹调

rows.original: You provoke yourself or an ally to action, instantly refreshing the target's Recharge powers.
rows.translation: 你激励自己或一名盟友采取行动，立即刷新目标处于冷却中的技能。
rows.raw: "You provoke yourself or an ally to action, instantly refreshing the target's Recharge powers."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] throw[tps|s] [attacker.hisHer] head back and sings a song of longing, of love, and of immense, stirring beauty, directed squarely at [attacker.is target|[target.combatHimselfHerself]|[target.combatName]]. Energised by the soul of the music, [target.combatNames] blood burns and a new strength fills [target.combatHisHer] body!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]仰起[tps|][attacker.hisHer]头，唱起一首满含渴望、爱意与摄人美感的歌，直直献给[attacker.is target|[target.combatHimselfHerself]|[target.combatName]]。音乐的灵魂赋予[target.combatNames]力量，令其热血沸腾，新的力量充满[target.combatHisHer]身体！
rows.raw: "\n            \n            [attacker.CombatName] throw[tps|s] [attacker.hisHer] head back and sings a song of longing, of love, and of immense, stirring beauty, directed squarely at [attacker.is target|[target.combatHimselfHerself]|[target.combatName]]. Energised by the soul of the music, [target.combatNames] blood burns and a new strength fills [target.combatHisHer] body!"

rows.translation: 七情调和
HarmonySeven

rows.original: Joy, rage, worry, fear, love, hate, longing. You bring out the fullness of all seven emotions recognized in classical Kitsuhon music, placing a buff on all allies for 3 turns that causes Recharge powers to refresh twice as quickly. This power does not affect the user.
rows.translation: 喜悦、愤怒、忧虑、恐惧、爱、恨、思念。你唤醒基苏洪古典音乐所认定的七种情感，使除使用者外的所有盟友获得持续3回合的增益，让冷却中的技能以双倍速度恢复。
rows.raw: "Joy, rage, worry, fear, love, hate, longing. You bring out the fullness of all seven emotions recognized in classical Kitsuhon music, placing a buff on all allies for 3 turns that causes Recharge powers to refresh twice as quickly. This power does not affect the user."

rows.original: Bringing the full depth of [attacker.combatHisHer] spirit to bear, [attacker.combatName] play[tps|s] a melody that alternates between slow and vibrant, between vivid and dolorous, encompassing all the colors of life and existence.
rows.translation: 倾注[attacker.combatHisHer]灵魂深处的全部力量，[attacker.combatName]奏出[tps|]一段旋律，在舒缓与激昂、鲜活与哀伤之间变换，囊括生命与存在的一切色彩。
rows.raw:
"
        
        Bringing the full depth of [attacker.combatHisHer] spirit to bear, [attacker.combatName] play[tps|s] a melody that alternates between slow and vibrant, between vivid and dolorous, encompassing all the colors of life and existence.
        "

rows.original: [target.CombatName] feel[tps|s] intense emotion welling up within [target.combatHisHer], awakening [target.combatHimHer] to sudden inspiration!
rows.translation: [target.CombatName]感到[tps|]强烈的情感在[target.combatHisHer]心中涌起，令[target.combatHimHer]突然迸发灵感！
rows.raw: "\n[target.CombatName] feel[tps|s] intense emotion welling up within [target.combatHisHer], awakening [target.combatHimHer] to sudden inspiration!"

rows.translation: 寻找掩护！
寻找掩护！

rows.original: You conceal yourself in the fray, losing all your Threat. You also gain Obscurement and Covered for 3 turns, providing +30 Evasion and +20 Accuracy and Initiative.
rows.translation: 你在混战中隐藏自己，从而完全失去了自身的威胁性。同时，在接下来的3个回合内，你将获得“隐蔽”状态以及“被掩护”的优势，这使得你的闪避能力提升30点，而精准度和先攻权也会增加20点。
rows.raw: "You conceal yourself in the fray, losing all your Threat. You also gain Obscurement and Covered for 3 turns, providing +30 Evasion and +20 Accuracy and Initiative."

rows.original: Seeking respite amidst the heat of battle, [attacker.combatName] seek[tps|s] better positioning behind nearby cover, obscuring [attacker.combatHimselfHerself] from attention in the fray!
rows.translation: 为了在激战中寻得喘息之机，[attacker.combatName]寻找[tps|]附近掩体后更有利的位置，让[attacker.combatHimselfHerself]在混战中避开众人的注意！
rows.raw: "\n\n        Seeking respite amidst the heat of battle, [attacker.combatName] seek[tps|s] better positioning behind nearby cover, obscuring [attacker.combatHimselfHerself] from attention in the fray!"

rows.translation: 掩护盟友
掩护盟友

rows.original: You conceal an ally in the fray, granting them Covered for 3 turns, providing +20 Evasion, Accuracy, and Initiative.
rows.translation: 你在战斗中隐藏了一位盟友，使他们在3个回合内处于“被保护状态”，同时他们的闪避能力、命中率以及先攻权都会增加20点。
rows.raw: "You conceal an ally in the fray, granting them Covered for 3 turns, providing +20 Evasion, Accuracy, and Initiative."

rows.original: Providing respite amidst the heat of battle, [attacker.combatName] draw[tps|s] attention, covering for [target.combatName]!
rows.translation: 为了在激战中提供喘息之机，[attacker.combatName]主动吸引[tps|]注意，为[target.combatName]打掩护！
rows.raw: "\n\n        Providing respite amidst the heat of battle, [attacker.combatName] draw[tps|s] attention, covering for [target.combatName]!"

rows.translation: 普雷斯蒂

rows.original: Conjuring a bit of illusion magic, you perform minor tricks and household chores. If you do something so pointless and non-threatening in combat, surely your Threat will all be eradicated...
rows.translation: 你施展了一些幻术魔法，表演了一些简单的把戏，还做了一些家务活。如果在战斗中你也做这种毫无意义、不会带来任何威胁的事情，那么你的“威胁等级”肯定就会降为零……
rows.raw: "Conjuring a bit of illusion magic, you perform minor tricks and household chores. If you do something so pointless and non-threatening in combat, surely your Threat will all be eradicated..."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] conjure[tps|s] an illusory broom and begin[tps|s] cleaning up the place, sweeping dust like a proper domestic. [attacker.CombatName] might as well put on a kettle and — ah that's a good idea, actually, a little conjured flame and water is set to boiling. The inane, pointless display is completely non-threatening, utterly incongruous with the field of battle and best to be ignored.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]变出[tps|]一把虚幻的扫帚，由此开始[tps|]把地方打扫得干干净净，像一个称职的家庭主妇一样把灰尘都扫掉。 [attacker.CombatName]干脆烧个水壶吧——啊，其实这倒是个好主意，用一点火焰就能把水烧开。这种无聊又毫无意义的表演根本不会构成任何威胁，与战场的环境完全不搭调，最好直接忽略它。
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] conjure[tps|s] an illusory broom and begin[tps|s] cleaning up the place, sweeping dust like a proper domestic. [attacker.CombatName] might as well put on a kettle and — ah that's a good idea, actually, a little conjured flame and water is set to boiling. The inane, pointless display is completely non-threatening, utterly incongruous with the field of battle and best to be ignored."

rows.translation: 神圣切割术
神圣切割术

rows.original: Use the power of the Godslayer's Dreamblade, empowered by Lumia, to inflict your will upon the wraith, providing a number of powerful buffs to yourself and inflicting a number of critical debuffs on it.
rows.translation: 运用由卢米娅赋予力量的“弑神者之梦刃”，将你的意志强加于那些幽灵之上，从而为自己获得一系列强大的增益效果，同时给它们带来一系列致命的负面效果。
rows.raw: "Use the power of the Godslayer's Dreamblade, empowered by Lumia, to inflict your will upon the wraith, providing a number of powerful buffs to yourself and inflicting a number of critical debuffs on it."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] the Godslayer's Dreamblade, and a bolt of pure sunlight streaks through the gloom to impact it before [attacker.combatHeShe] swing[tps|s] it in a wide arc. The attack doesn't cause any physical wound, but spears of arcing light impale [target.combatName] from every angle in a painful cage. Additionally, [attacker.CombatName] feel[tps|s] a warm light enveloping [attacker.combatHimHer] as the goddess' power surges through [attacker.combatHisHer] body.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]举起[tps|]杀神之梦刃，一道纯净的阳光穿透昏暗，击中剑身；随后[attacker.combatHeShe]挥剑[tps|]斩出宽阔的弧线。这一击没有留下实体伤口，却有弧形光矛从四面八方刺穿[target.combatName]，构成痛苦的牢笼。同时，[attacker.CombatName]感到[tps|]温暖的光芒包裹着[attacker.combatHimHer]，女神之力奔涌着流过[attacker.combatHisHer]全身。
rows.raw:
"
            
        [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] the Godslayer's Dreamblade, and a bolt of pure sunlight streaks through the gloom to impact it before [attacker.combatHeShe] swing[tps|s] it in a wide arc. The attack doesn't cause any physical wound, but spears of arcing light impale [target.combatName] from every angle in a painful cage. Additionally, [attacker.CombatName] feel[tps|s] a warm light enveloping [attacker.combatHimHer] as the goddess' power surges through [attacker.combatHisHer] body.
        "

rows.translation: 腐化之血
腐化之血

rows.original: You corrupt the blood of all opponents, leeching away all healing the afflicted receive.
rows.translation: 你腐蚀了所有对手的血液，夺走了他们所获得的所有治愈效果。
rows.raw: "You corrupt the blood of all opponents, leeching away all healing the afflicted receive."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] cast[tps|s] a sense of sickening, writhing dread over the battlefield, inverting the natural flow of life!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]在战场上施加[tps|]令人作呕、蠕动不休的恐惧，颠倒了生命的自然流向！
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] cast[tps|s] a sense of sickening, writhing dread over the battlefield, inverting the natural flow of life!"

rows.original: [target.CombatNames] blood twists and burns in [target.combatHisHer] veins as the natural order is defiled!
rows.translation: [target.CombatNames]血液在[target.combatHisHer]血管中扭曲灼烧，自然秩序遭到亵渎！
rows.raw: "\n[target.CombatNames] blood twists and burns in [target.combatHisHer] veins as the natural order is defiled!"

rows.translation: 噼啪盾牌
噼啪盾牌

rows.original: You protect an ally for 2 turns, taking health damage in their stead. The target gains +10 armor while you cover them. You also heal for 10% of your health.
rows.translation: 你在2个回合内保护一名盟友，替他们承受伤害。在保护期间，该目标会获得+10点的护甲值，而你也会恢复自己10%的生命值。
rows.raw: "You protect an ally for 2 turns, taking health damage in their stead. The target gains +10 armor while you cover them. You also heal for 10% of your health."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] gather[tps|s] the surrounding vines about [attacker.combatHimselfHerself], infusing them with crackling energy!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]将周围的藤蔓聚拢[tps|]到[attacker.combatHimselfHerself]身边，向其中注入噼啪作响的能量！
rows.raw: "\n        \n        [attacker.CombatName] gather[tps|s] the surrounding vines about [attacker.combatHimselfHerself], infusing them with crackling energy!"

rows.translation: 光之印
光之印

rows.original: You hammer a divine rune-seal onto the ground at your feet. For the rest of the encounter, you generate 30% more Threat and gain +50 Armor, Ward, and Focus.
rows.translation: 你在脚下的地面上刻下了一个神圣的符文印记。在接下来的战斗中，你产生的威胁值会增加30%，同时还能获得+50点的护甲值、防护效果以及专注力。
rows.raw: "You hammer a divine rune-seal onto the ground at your feet. For the rest of the encounter, you generate 30% more Threat and gain +50 Armor, Ward, and Focus."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] slam[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] into the ground, burning a seal of brilliant light into the ground at [attacker.combatHisHer] feet. The runic brand pulses with argence whenever a foe draws near, warding [attacker.combatName] from harm!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]猛砸[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer][attacker.weapon]，将武器砸向地面，在[attacker.combatHisHer]脚下烙下璀璨的光之印记。每当敌人靠近，符文印记便闪耀银光，保护[attacker.combatName]免受伤害！
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] slam[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] into the ground, burning a seal of brilliant light into the ground at [attacker.combatHisHer] feet. The runic brand pulses with argence whenever a foe draws near, warding [attacker.combatName] from harm!"

rows.translation: 光辉礼物
RadiantGift

rows.original: Focus on infusing your allies' weapons with holy power, granting
rows.translation: 专注于用神圣力量灌注盟友的武器，赋予
rows.raw: "Focus on infusing your allies' weapons with holy power, granting "

rows.original: Holy damage to their weapons. This power lasts until the end of the encounter, or until the user is stunned or taken out.
rows.translation: 点神圣伤害，附加于盟友武器。此技能持续至战斗结束，或使用者被击晕、击败为止。
rows.raw: " Holy damage to their weapons. This power lasts until the end of the encounter, or until the user is stunned or taken out."

rows.original: You're infusing your allies' weapons with holy might, granting
rows.translation: 你正以神圣威能灌注盟友的武器，赋予
rows.raw: "You're infusing your allies' weapons with holy might, granting "

rows.translation: 点神圣伤害。

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] take[tps|s] a deep breath, close[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] eyes for a moment, and begin[tps|s] a slow, quiet chant. As it builds in both tempo and volume, light pools around [attacker.combatHisHer] form, most especially around [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon]. As the chant reaches its climax, the radiant energy moves out from [attacker.combatName], flowing through the air and wrapping around the weapons of [attacker.combatHisHer] allies!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]深吸[tps|]一口气，闭上[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]双眼片刻，开始[tps|]缓慢而轻柔的吟唱。随着节奏加快、音量升高，光芒在[attacker.combatHisHer]身体周围聚集，尤其集中在[attacker.combatHisHer][attacker.weapon]附近。吟唱达到高潮时，辉煌的能量从[attacker.combatName]身上涌出，流过空中，缠绕在[attacker.combatHisHer]盟友的武器上！
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] take[tps|s] a deep breath, close[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] eyes for a moment, and begin[tps|s] a slow, quiet chant. As it builds in both tempo and volume, light pools around [attacker.combatHisHer] form, most especially around [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon]. As the chant reaches its climax, the radiant energy moves out from [attacker.combatName], flowing through the air and wrapping around the weapons of [attacker.combatHisHer] allies!"

rows.original: The light ceases to exude from [attacker.combatName].
rows.translation: 光芒不再散发出来[attacker.combatName]。
碎片

rows.original: Play your magical instrument as fast as you can, for as long as you can. Each turn, each enemy takes

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] pulls a small, silver thurible and a small sack out of his robes. He pours a small amount of sparkling dust from the sack into it and, with a snap of his fingers, lights it, causing a white smoke to billow out. The smoke washes over the orc party, magically mending their wounds before dissipating quickly.
