rows.translation: [critHitMiss|[target.combatName]从打击前退缩[tps|]开，拼命揉着[target.combatHisHer]眼睛。[target.combatName]目盲了！
rows.raw: "\n[critHitMiss|[target.combatName] flinch[tps|es] away from the strike, rubbing at [target.combatHisHer] eyes desperately. [target.combatName] is Blinded!"

rows.original: |[target.combatName] reel[tps|s] back in pain as golden light gouges into [target.combatHimHer]!
rows.translation: |金色光芒刺入[target.combatHimHer]时，[target.combatName]因剧痛而踉跄[tps|]后退！
rows.raw: "|[target.combatName] reel[tps|s] back in pain as golden light gouges into [target.combatHimHer]!"

rows.translation: |[target.combatName]躲开[tps|]这一攻击简直轻而易举！]
旋风

rows.original: You reap a terrible storm amidst the foe, making two basic attacks against each enemy on the field.
rows.translation: 你在敌人之中引发了一场猛烈的风暴，对场上的每个敌人发动两次基本攻击。
rows.raw: "You reap a terrible storm amidst the foe, making two basic attacks against each enemy on the field."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] whirl[tps|s] through the battlefield, cleaving through the enemy again and again — a relentless onslaught of attacks against every foe in reach.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]旋转[tps|]穿越战场，一次又一次地冲破敌人的防线——对所有触手可及的敌人发起无情的攻击。
rows.raw: "\n            \n            [attacker.CombatName] whirl[tps|s] through the battlefield, cleaving through the enemy again and again — a relentless onslaught of attacks against every foe in reach."

rows.original: [target.CombatName] [hitMiss|[tps|is|are] struck by the whirlwind of blows!
rows.translation: [target.CombatName][hitMiss|[tps|被|被]连环打击的旋风击中！
rows.raw: "\n[target.CombatName] [hitMiss|[tps|is|are] struck by the whirlwind of blows!"

rows.original: |manages to avoid a swing amidst the storm!]
rows.translation: |在暴风雨中成功避开了危险的冲击！]
rows.raw: "|manages to avoid a swing amidst the storm!]"

rows.translation: 雷霆斩击
雷霆斩击

rows.original: Imbue your weapon with the power of thunder, then make a melee strike against all enemy targets. All enemies struck will have their next action delayed to the end of the turn.
rows.translation: 让你的武器蕴含雷霆之力，然后对所有敌方目标发动近战攻击。所有被击中的敌人，他们的下一个行动都将被延迟到该回合结束。
rows.raw: "Imbue your weapon with the power of thunder, then make a melee strike against all enemy targets. All enemies struck will have their next action delayed to the end of the turn."

rows.original: Gripping onto [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] with both hands, [attacker.combatName] make[tps|s] one gigantic swing against the entire opposing party. The air crackles with electricity as energy leaps from the axe towards [attacker.combatHisHer] opponents!
rows.translation: 双手紧握[attacker.combatHisHer][attacker.weapon]，[attacker.combatName]朝整个敌方队伍挥出[tps|]一记巨大的横扫。能量从斧头跃向[attacker.combatHisHer]对手，空气中电光噼啪作响！
rows.raw: "\n            \n            Gripping onto [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] with both hands, [attacker.combatName] make[tps|s] one gigantic swing against the entire opposing party. The air crackles with electricity as energy leaps from the axe towards [attacker.combatHisHer] opponents!"

rows.original: [hitMiss|[target.CombatName] [tps|is|are] struck with such force that they’re blown backward, unable to keep their footing!
rows.translation: [hitMiss|[target.CombatName][tps|被|被]如此强劲的力道击中，以至于向后飞退，无法站稳脚跟！
rows.raw: "\n[hitMiss|[target.CombatName] [tps|is|are] struck with such force that they’re blown backward, unable to keep their footing!"

rows.original: |[target.CombatName] deftly dodge[tps|s] the swing, the electricity doing little more than tickling [target.combatHisHer] [target.skinFurScalesNoun].]
rows.translation: |[target.CombatName]灵巧地躲过[tps|]挥击，电流只是轻轻掠过[target.combatHisHer][target.skinFurScalesNoun]。]
rows.raw: "|[target.CombatName] deftly dodge[tps|s] the swing, the electricity doing little more than tickling [target.combatHisHer] [target.skinFurScalesNoun].]"

rows.translation: 致命阴影
DeadlyShadow

rows.original: You gain Obscurement for 3 turns and slip behind the enemy, causing chaos. You make an attack against all enemies; targets you strike are Staggered and Terrified for 3 turns.
rows.translation: 你将在3个回合内获得“隐匿”效果，从而悄悄潜到敌人背后，制造混乱。你可以对所有敌人发动攻击；被你击中的敌人将在3个回合内处于“踉跄”状态，并感到恐惧。
rows.raw: "You gain Obscurement for 3 turns and slip behind the enemy, causing chaos. You make an attack against all enemies; targets you strike are Staggered and Terrified for 3 turns."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] duck[tps|s] behind the enemy in the heat of battle, turning into a whirling dervish of shadows and edges!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]在激战中闪到[tps|]敌人身后，化作一道挥舞利刃的旋转暗影！
rows.raw: "\n            \n            [attacker.CombatName] duck[tps|s] behind the enemy in the heat of battle, turning into a whirling dervish of shadows and edges!"

rows.translation: [hitMiss|[target.CombatName][tps|被|被]打得踉跄不稳！
|[target.CombatName]避开[tps|]了攻击！]
雷霆扫荡
雷霆横扫

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] twirls her axes by their chain, lunging toward your side of the field. Flexing and swinging the weapons by their chains, the axes arc across the battlefield!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]甩动链条上的双斧，冲向战场的你方一侧。她绷紧锁链挥动武器，让斧刃划过战场！
rows.raw: "\n        \n        [attacker.CombatName] twirls her axes by their chain, lunging toward your side of the field. Flexing and swinging the weapons by their chains, the axes arc across the battlefield!"

rows.original: [critHitMiss|[target.CombatName] can't get out of the way in time; the swinging blade [rand|slips and cuts along [target.combatHisHer] arm, leaving a sickly wound|cracks its back-end across [target.combatHisHer] head] and throwing [target.combatName] down to the ground... Being thrown prone is bad enough, but the attack has so much force it drops [target.combatHisHer] guard.
rows.translation: [critHitMiss|[target.CombatName]没能及时躲开；挥来的刀刃[rand|滑过并割开[target.combatHisHer]手臂，留下病态的伤口|用刀背砸在[target.combatHisHer]头上]，把[target.combatName]摔倒在地……被击倒已经够糟了，但这一击力道太大，还击破了[target.combatHisHer]防御。
rows.raw: "\n[critHitMiss|[target.CombatName] can't get out of the way in time; the swinging blade [rand|slips and cuts along [target.combatHisHer] arm, leaving a sickly wound|cracks its back-end across [target.combatHisHer] head] and throwing [target.combatName] down to the ground... Being thrown prone is bad enough, but the attack has so much force it drops [target.combatHisHer] guard."

rows.original: |[target.CombatName] can't get out of the way in time and the attack drops [target.combatHisHer] guard!
rows.translation: |[target.CombatName]没能及时躲开，这一击打破了[target.combatHisHer]防守！
rows.raw: "|[target.CombatName] can't get out of the way in time and the attack drops [target.combatHisHer] guard!"

rows.translation: |[target.CombatName]闪开[tps|]，险险避过飞来的武器！]
翼龙之焰
翼龙之焰

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon]. In an instant, sparks turn to an explosion; fire races out ahead of [attacker.combatName], surging toward [target.combatNames] side of the field!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]举起[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer][attacker.weapon]。转瞬间，火花爆成烈焰，火势从[attacker.combatName]前方奔涌而出，直扑[target.combatNames]所在的战场一侧！
rows.raw: "\n        \n        [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon]. In an instant, sparks turn to an explosion; fire races out ahead of [attacker.combatName], surging toward [target.combatNames] side of the field!"

rows.original: [critHitMiss|The flames engulf [target.combatName], racing up [target.combatHimHer] and leaving [target.combatName] burned!
rows.translation: [critHitMiss|火焰吞没[target.combatName]，沿着[target.combatHimHer]飞速蔓延，让[target.combatName]被烧伤！
rows.raw: "\n[critHitMiss|The flames engulf [target.combatName], racing up [target.combatHimHer] and leaving [target.combatName] burned!"

rows.translation: |烈焰吞没[target.combatName]，在[target.combatHimHer]身上翻腾燃烧。
|[target.CombatName]驱散[tps|]了魔法火焰。]
贝壳粉碎者
破甲重击

rows.original: You try and tear a hole in the target's armor, making a precision strike with +50 Armor Penetration and +50 Accuracy. On a hit, the target's armor is left Sundered for 2 turns.
rows.translation: 你试图在目标护甲上撕开缺口，以+50护甲穿透和+50命中发动一次精确攻击。命中后，目标护甲会破损2回合。
rows.raw: "You try and tear a hole in the target's armor, making a precision strike with +50 Armor Penetration and +50 Accuracy. On a hit, the target's armor is left Sundered for 2 turns."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] draw[tps|s] back hard, throwing all [attacker.combatHisHer] strength behind a pinpoint strike. [hitMiss|The strike hits and bites deep, penetrating [target.combatName's] armor and leaving it momentarily sundered!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName][tps|]向后蓄力，将[attacker.combatHisHer]全部力量灌注进一次精准刺击。[hitMiss|这一击命中并深深刺入，穿透[target.combatName's]护甲，并使其暂时破甲！
rows.raw: "\n \n [attacker.CombatName] draw[tps|s] back hard, throwing all [attacker.combatHisHer] strength behind a pinpoint strike. [hitMiss|The strike hits and bites deep, penetrating [target.combatName's] armor and leaving it momentarily sundered!"

rows.original: |The attack is just a bit too slow, though, and goes wide!]
rows.translation: |不过，这一击稍慢了一步，打偏了！]
rows.raw: "|The attack is just a bit too slow, though, and goes wide!]"

rows.translation: 《暗影打击》
暗影突袭

rows.original: You slip into the shadows, reappearing a moment later to deliver a brutal melee strike with +100 Attack Power and +50 Accuracy. You also gain Obscurement for a turn.
rows.translation: 你悄悄潜入阴影中，片刻后再度现身，发动一次攻击强度+100、精准度+50的猛烈近战攻击。同时，你还能获得“隐匿”效果，持续一回合。
rows.raw: "You slip into the shadows, reappearing a moment later to deliver a brutal melee strike with +100 Attack Power and +50 Accuracy. You also gain Obscurement for a turn."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] slip[tps|s] away from [target.combatName] in the chaos of battle: [attacker.combatHeShe] [tps|is|are] there one moment, and simply gone the next. That is, until [target.is pc|you feel a rush of air behind you, just in time to turn and see [an] [attacker.weapon] racing towards you!|[target.CombatName] cries out in surprise as [an] [attacker.weapon] lunges at [target.combatHimHer] from the shadows!] [hitMiss|[target.CombatName] [tps|cries|cry] out in pain as the [attacker.weapon] slashes and whirls, hammering into [target.combatHisHer] [target.armor].
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]在混乱战局中从[target.combatName]身边溜走[tps|]：[attacker.combatHeShe][tps|刚刚还在|刚刚还在]那里，下一瞬却消失无踪。直到[target.is pc|你感到背后一阵疾风，及时转身，看见[attacker.weapon]正朝你疾冲而来！|[target.CombatName]惊叫出声，因为[attacker.weapon]从阴影中刺向[target.combatHimHer]！][hitMiss|当[attacker.weapon]斩击旋舞、砸进[target.combatHisHer][target.armor]时，[target.CombatName][tps|痛呼|痛呼]出声。
rows.raw: "\n            \n            [attacker.CombatName] slip[tps|s] away from [target.combatName] in the chaos of battle: [attacker.combatHeShe] [tps|is|are] there one moment, and simply gone the next. That is, until [target.is pc|you feel a rush of air behind you, just in time to turn and see [an] [attacker.weapon] racing towards you!|[target.CombatName] cries out in surprise as [an] [attacker.weapon] lunges at [target.combatHimHer] from the shadows!] [hitMiss|[target.CombatName] [tps|cries|cry] out in pain as the [attacker.weapon] slashes and whirls, hammering into [target.combatHisHer] [target.armor]."

rows.original: |[target.CombatName] yelp[tps|s], jumping back to avoid the strike from the shadows!]
rows.translation: |[target.CombatName]惊叫[tps|]一声，向后跳开，避过来自阴影的袭击！]
rows.raw: "|[target.CombatName] yelp[tps|s], jumping back to avoid the strike from the shadows!]"

rows.translation: 精准推进
精准刺击

rows.original: You aim for your opponent's heart on one round and skewer it the next, dealing an attack with +500 Attack Power and +100 Accuracy. If you take damage before the attack lands, your concentration is spoiled and the attack fails.
rows.translation: 在第一轮攻击中，你瞄准对手的心脏进行攻击；而在下一轮攻击中，你则会直接刺中目标的心脏，这次攻击的攻击强度会增加500，命中率也会提高100%。然而，如果在攻击命中之前你受到了伤害，你的注意力就会分散，导致这次攻击失败。
rows.raw: "You aim for your opponent's heart on one round and skewer it the next, dealing an attack with +500 Attack Power and +100 Accuracy. If you take damage before the attack lands, your concentration is spoiled and the attack fails."

rows.original: Losing [char.combatHisHer] intense focus, [char.combatName] stagger[tps|s] and reels back!
rows.translation: [char.combatName]失去[char.combatHisHer]高度专注，踉跄[tps|]后退！
rows.raw: "Losing [char.combatHisHer] intense focus, [char.combatName] stagger[tps|s] and reels back!"

rows.original: [attacker.combatName] gather[tps|s] [attacker.hisHer] focus, aiming a deadly thrust straight for [target.combatNames] heart!
rows.translation: [attacker.combatName]集中[tps|][attacker.hisHer]精神，瞄准[target.combatNames]心脏使出致命的刺击！
rows.raw: "\n                \n            [attacker.combatName] gather[tps|s] [attacker.hisHer] focus, aiming a deadly thrust straight for [target.combatNames] heart!"

rows.original: Unfortunately for [attacker.combatName], there's no target for [attacker.combatHisHer] attack. It's wasted helplessly.
rows.translation: 可惜对[attacker.combatName]来说，没有目标能承受[attacker.combatHisHer]攻击；这一击只能无奈地落空。
rows.raw: "\n            \n            Unfortunately for [attacker.combatName], there's no target for [attacker.combatHisHer] attack. It's wasted helplessly."

rows.original: [hitMiss|[attacker.combatName] lunge[tps|s]! The tip of [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] slips between [target.combatNames] ribs and skewers [target.combatHimHer] right through!
rows.translation: [hitMiss|[attacker.combatName]猛冲[tps|]！[attacker.combatHisHer][attacker.weapon]的尖端钻入[target.combatNames]肋间，将[target.combatHimHer]直接刺穿！
rows.raw: "\n            \n        [hitMiss|[attacker.combatName] lunge[tps|s]! The tip of [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] slips between [target.combatNames] ribs and skewers [target.combatHimHer] right through!"

rows.original: |[target.CombatName] yelp[tps|s], jumping back to avoid the strike from the shadows!]
rows.translation: |[target.CombatName]惊叫[tps|]一声，向后跳开，避过来自阴影的袭击！]
rows.raw: "|[target.CombatName] yelp[tps|s], jumping back to avoid the strike from the shadows!]"

rows.translation: 塔拉蓄力
塔拉蓄力

rows.original: Also have her do a "Tarah is winding up for something big!" that plays for two turns, and then have her make a basic attack against herself.
rows.translation: 还要让她连续两回合显示“塔拉正在酝酿大招！”，随后对自己发动一次基本攻击。
rows.raw: 'Also have her do a "Tarah is winding up for something big!" that plays for two turns, and then have her make a basic attack against herself.'

rows.original: Losing [char.combatHisHer] intense focus, [char.combatName] stagger[tps|s] and reels back!
rows.translation: [char.combatName]失去[char.combatHisHer]高度专注，踉跄[tps|]后退！
rows.raw: "Losing [char.combatHisHer] intense focus, [char.combatName] stagger[tps|s] and reels back!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] is winding up for something big!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]似乎正在为某件大事做准备呢！
rows.raw: "\n                \n            [attacker.CombatName] is winding up for something big!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] is winding up for something big!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]似乎正在为某件大事做准备呢！
rows.raw: "\n                \n            [attacker.CombatName] is winding up for something big!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] tries to do a huge swing and falls on [attacker.combatHisHer] butt as [attacker.combatHeShe] flails with [attacker.combatHisHer] eyes closed.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]试图使出一记大幅挥击，却以[attacker.combatHisHer]屁股着地摔倒；[attacker.combatHeShe]紧闭[attacker.combatHisHer]双眼，手脚胡乱挥动。
rows.raw: "\n            \n        [attacker.CombatName] tries to do a huge swing and falls on [attacker.combatHisHer] butt as [attacker.combatHeShe] flails with [attacker.combatHisHer] eyes closed."

rows.translation: 重锤出击
Hammer Time

rows.original: Charge up for a massive overhead swing, causing the target to gain massive Threat. On the next turn, swing down with +300 Attack Power and +100 Accuracy. On a hit, the target is knocked Prone. On a crit, it is also Sundered.
rows.translation: 蓄力进行一次强力上挥，使目标受到巨大的威胁。在下一回合，以+300的攻击强度和+100的命中率向下挥击。如果命中目标，会使目标陷入倒地状态；如果造成暴击，还会使目标遭到重创。
rows.raw: "Charge up for a massive overhead swing, causing the target to gain massive Threat. On the next turn, swing down with +300 Attack Power and +100 Accuracy. On a hit, the target is knocked Prone. On a crit, it is also Sundered."

rows.original: [char.CombatName] [tps|loses|lose] [char.combatNames] grip on [char.combatHisHer] weapon, disrupting the oncoming blow!
rows.translation: [char.CombatName][tps|松开|松开]了[char.combatHisHer]武器，[char.combatNames]即将发动的攻击因此被打断！
rows.raw: "[char.CombatName] [tps|loses|lose] [char.combatNames] grip on [char.combatHisHer] weapon, disrupting the oncoming blow!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] ponderously raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] over [attacker.combatHisHer] head, preparing to drop it down hard on [target.combatName].
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]缓缓将[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer][attacker.weapon]举过[attacker.combatHisHer]头顶，准备狠狠砸向[target.combatName]。
rows.raw: "\n                \n            [attacker.CombatName] ponderously raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] over [attacker.combatHisHer] head, preparing to drop it down hard on [target.combatName]."

rows.original: Unfortunately for [attacker.combatName], there's no target for [attacker.combatHisHer] attack. It's wasted helplessly.
rows.translation: 可惜对[attacker.combatName]来说，没有目标能承受[attacker.combatHisHer]攻击；这一击只能无奈地落空。
rows.raw: "\n            \n            Unfortunately for [attacker.combatName], there's no target for [attacker.combatHisHer] attack. It's wasted helplessly."

rows.original:
[attacker.CombatName] swing[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] down towards [target.combatName] with thunderous force. [hitMiss
            |The strike lands with such authority that [target.combatName] [tps|is|are] crushed down on the ground like an insect, utterly overborne by the hammer blow.
rows.translation:
[attacker.CombatName][tps|]将[attacker.combatHisHer][attacker.weapon]以雷霆之势砸向[target.combatName]。[hitMiss
            |这一击威势惊人，将[target.combatName][tps|像|像]虫子一样砸倒在地，彻底压制在重击之下。
rows.raw:
"
            
        [attacker.CombatName] swing[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] down towards [target.combatName] with thunderous force. [hitMiss
            |The strike lands with such authority that [target.combatName] [tps|is|are] crushed down on the ground like an insect, utterly overborne by the hammer blow."

rows.original:
|The attack's lucky target manages to dodge aside at the last moment as [attacker.combatName] smashes [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] into the ground, sending shockwaves throughout the tower.
        ]
rows.translation:
|这个幸运的目标在最后一刻侧身躲开，[attacker.combatName]的[attacker.combatHisHer][attacker.weapon]随即重重砸入地面，震波传遍整座塔楼。
        ]
rows.raw: "\n            |The attack's lucky target manages to dodge aside at the last moment as [attacker.combatName] smashes [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] into the ground, sending shockwaves throughout the tower.\n        ]"

rows.translation: 死亡标记
Mark4Death

rows.original: You deliver a pinpoint strike with +150 Attack Power and +25 Accuracy, drawing your companions' ire to your target by dramatically increasing its Threat.
rows.translation: 你以+150的攻击强度和+25的精准度发动了一次精准打击，这一攻击使目标的威胁值大幅增加，从而惹恼了你的同伴。

rows.original: Hawkethorne's north gate stands before you, a towering bulwark of wood connecting the tall village walls on either side of the road. A pair of town militia stand near the gate, one on either side, looking awfully bored. At the moment, the gate's standing wide open, allowing you easy passage into the snowy forest north of town, or back into the safety of the town's winding main thoroughfare.
rows.translation: 鹰棘镇的北门就矗立在你面前，这是一道由木材构筑的巍然壁垒，将道路两侧的高大村墙连接在一起。门的两侧各站着一名镇民卫兵，他们看起来显得十分无聊。此刻，大门大开着，你可以轻松地穿过它，进入镇北那片被积雪覆盖的森林，或者重新回到镇上那条蜿蜒曲折的主道路上，重新回到安全的地方。
rows.raw: "Hawkethorne's north gate stands before you, a towering bulwark of wood connecting the tall village walls on either side of the road. A pair of town militia stand near the gate, one on either side, looking awfully bored. At the moment, the gate's standing wide open, allowing you easy passage into the snowy forest north of town, or back into the safety of the town's winding main thoroughfare."

rows.original:
Between the merchant quarter and the north gate of the village stand several small and unassuming households facing the road. Clotheslines hang between several of the houses, and you see evidence of chicken coops and other animal pens in the alleys behind.
    
    To the east is a cozy-looking, two-floored wooden building with bright light emanating from both the windows. There's a wood-and-brass sign hanging above the doorway that reads "Desire Stylists and Tattoos."
rows.translation:
在商业区与村庄北门之间，有几户外观朴素的小房子紧邻道路而建。其中几户房屋的阳台上悬挂着晾衣绳，而在房屋后面的小巷里，还能看到鸡舍和其他牲畜围栏的痕迹。
    
    东边有一栋看起来十分舒适的二层木结构建筑，窗户里透出明亮的光线。门楣上方挂着一个由木头和黄铜制成的招牌，上面写着“欲望造型师与纹身”。
rows.raw: 'Between the merchant quarter and the north gate of the village stand several small and unassuming households facing the road. Clotheslines hang between several of the houses, and you see evidence of chicken coops and other animal pens in the alleys behind.\n    \n    To the east is a cozy-looking, two-floored wooden building with bright light emanating from both the windows. There\'s a wood-and-brass sign hanging above the doorway that reads "Desire Stylists and Tattoos."'

rows.original: The northern part of the town square sees several larger town houses — those owned by the local merchants, no doubt — all facing toward the large statue to the south. Many of the residences seem to lean awkwardly, as if they were crudely expanded on year after year, leaving them crooked and slanted.
rows.translation: 镇广场的北部有几栋较大的联排别墅——毫无疑问，这些房子都是当地商人的财产——所有这些房屋都朝向南边那座巨大的雕像。许多住宅看起来都建得有些歪斜，仿佛是多年来不断地随意扩建造成的，因此才会变得如此不规整、倾斜。
rows.raw: "The northern part of the town square sees several larger town houses — those owned by the local merchants, no doubt — all facing toward the large statue to the south. Many of the residences seem to lean awkwardly, as if they were crudely expanded on year after year, leaving them crooked and slanted."

rows.original:
The center of the village sprawls out around you, a packed dirt circle connecting three different roads through town around a larger-than-life statue of a man holding a war axe aloft over his head, his other hand resting on a shield set beside his feet — some conquering hero of old, no doubt. The shield, though its once-intricate details have long faded, is still set with a large blue gemstone nearly the size of your head. Amazingly, it hasn't been looted in the passing decades since the statue was erected.
    
        [pc.hasKeyItem WaystoneCharm|[flags.TIMES_WARPED
            |The key pendant around your neck buzzes with familiar energy, reacting to the nearby presence of a Warpstone.
            |The small blue pendant around your neck buzzes with warm energy, and from the corner of your eye, you see a faint, almost imperceptible glow radiating from the statue's shield — the two gems are reacting to each other! Perhaps you should investigate...
        ]]
        
        West of the town square stands a towering stone church, its black spires reaching up far above anything else in the village. A pair of stone gargoyles peer over the terrace, staring down across the sweeping stone steps leading up to the temple's heavy wooden doors. A faint light shines from the windows: the cumulative effort of hundreds of candles, no doubt.
        
        [flags.RIVER_MET|[shopsOpen
            |River is in his usual spot by the foot of the statue, leaning lazily on a bench as he strums his lute idly. Every now and then, a passer-by will toss him a coin, and he'll strike up a tune or deliver the latest news in return. It's a cat's life, to be sure.
        ]]
rows.translation:
村庄的中心地带呈辐射状分布在你的周围，一条由泥土铺成的环形道路将镇上的三条不同道路连接起来，这条道路环绕着一座巨大的雕像——那是一位将战斧高高举过头顶的英雄，另一只手则放在脚边的盾牌上，毫无疑问，他是古代的一位征服者。虽然那面盾牌上曾经复杂的纹饰早已褪色，但上面仍镶嵌着一颗几乎有你的头那么大的蓝色宝石。令人惊讶的是，自从这座雕像被立起来以来，在过去的几十年里，它竟然从未被任何人盗走过。
    
        [pc.hasKeyItem WaystoneCharm|[flags.TIMES_WARPED
            |你颈间的路石护符嗡鸣着熟悉的能量，对附近跃迁石的存在作出了反应。
            |你脖子上佩戴的那颗蓝色小吊坠正散发着温暖的光芒，而你眼角的余光中，也看到雕像的盾牌上正散发着微弱而几乎难以察觉的光芒——这两颗宝石正在发生反应！或许你应该仔细调查一下……
        ]]
        
        在城镇广场的西侧，有一座高耸的石制教堂，它的黑色尖塔远远超过了村庄中任何其他建筑的高度。一对石制怪兽雕像从露台上探出头来，俯视着那些通向教堂厚重木门的宽阔石阶。窗户里透出微弱的光芒——毫无疑问，那是数百支蜡烛共同散发出的光芒。
        
        [flags.RIVER_MET|[shopsOpen
            |瑞弗像往常一样坐在雕像脚下的那个地方，懒洋洋地靠在长椅上，漫不经心地拨弄着琉特琴。偶尔会有路人向他扔一枚硬币，而他就会即兴演奏一曲，或者告诉他们最新的消息。这样的生活，倒也挺惬意的。
        ]]
rows.raw:
"
        The center of the village sprawls out around you, a packed dirt circle connecting three different roads through town around a larger-than-life statue of a man holding a war axe aloft over his head, his other hand resting on a shield set beside his feet — some conquering hero of old, no doubt. The shield, though its once-intricate details have long faded, is still set with a large blue gemstone nearly the size of your head. Amazingly, it hasn't been looted in the passing decades since the statue was erected.

            |The small blue pendant around your neck buzzes with warm energy, and from the corner of your eye, you see a faint, almost imperceptible glow radiating from the statue's shield — the two gems are reacting to each other! Perhaps you should investigate...
        ]]
        
        West of the town square stands a towering stone church, its black spires reaching up far above anything else in the village. A pair of stone gargoyles peer over the terrace, staring down across the sweeping stone steps leading up to the temple's heavy wooden doors. A faint light shines from the windows: the cumulative effort of hundreds of candles, no doubt.
        
        [flags.RIVER_MET|[shopsOpen
            |River is in his usual spot by the foot of the statue, leaning lazily on a bench as he strums his lute idly. Every now and then, a passer-by will toss him a coin, and he'll strike up a tune or deliver the latest news in return. It's a cat's life, to be sure.
        ]]"

rows.original:
You're standing outside the Frost Hound Tavern, the heart and soul of Hawkethorne village. At two stories, the building is the tallest around, save the nearby temple, and leans slightly over the street; behind it, you can see a small cabin belonging to the owner with a little chicken coop tucked between them. Over the heavy door swings a wooden sign of a big, powerful wolf carrying a dagger in its mouth. 

    A road of packed dirt leads east through the center of town and a row of merchant stalls, or westwards to the town square.
rows.translation:
你此刻站在寒霜猎犬酒馆外，这座酒馆正是鹰棘镇村庄的灵魂所在。这座两层楼的建筑是周围最高的，只有附近的寺庙能与之媲美；它略微倾斜地矗立在街道旁，而在它的背后，你可以看到酒馆主人居住的小木屋，旁边还有一个小小的鸡舍。厚重的门上悬挂着一块木牌，牌子上画着一只嘴里叼着匕首的巨大而强大的狼。

    一条由压实的泥土铺成的道路从城镇中心向东延伸，穿过一排商贩的摊位；或者向西通往城镇广场。
rows.raw:
"
    You're standing outside the Frost Hound Tavern, the heart and soul of Hawkethorne village. At two stories, the building is the tallest around, save the nearby temple, and leans slightly over the street; behind it, you can see a small cabin belonging to the owner with a little chicken coop tucked between them. Over the heavy door swings a wooden sign of a big, powerful wolf carrying a dagger in its mouth. 

    A road of packed dirt leads east through the center of town and a row of merchant stalls, or westwards to the town square."

rows.original: The southern part of the village square is dedicated to several merchant stalls, advertising wares ranging from fresh fish straight from the local lakes to metalwork and jewelry.
rows.translation: 村庄广场的南部区域专门设置了几个商贩摊位，这些摊位出售的商品种类繁多，从直接从当地湖泊捕捞上来的新鲜鱼类，到金属制品和珠宝，应有尽有。
rows.raw: "The southern part of the village square is dedicated to several merchant stalls, advertising wares ranging from fresh fish straight from the local lakes to metalwork and jewelry. "

rows.original: The stalls are all abandoned for the night, their wares taken in for safekeeping.
rows.translation: 摊档都已收摊过夜，货物也已收好存放。
rows.raw: "The stalls are all abandoned for the night, their wares taken in for safekeeping."

rows.original: A few townsfolk are milling about, moving between the stalls and conversing with the local merchants. You don't see anything on sale that's particularly interesting.
rows.translation: 有几个镇民在四处走动，他们在摊位间穿梭，与当地的商人们交谈。你并没有看到有任何特别吸引人的商品在出售。
rows.raw: "A few townsfolk are milling about, moving between the stalls and conversing with the local merchants. You don't see anything on sale that's particularly interesting."

rows.original: The Frost Hound Tavern, home away from home here in the northlands. The place is small but cozy, with several tables sandwiched between a roaring hearthfire and a bar so polished that it shines. Sawdust coats the wooden floor, soaking up spilled drinks. Behind the bar are racks and racks of ales and lagers — hearty drinks for a hearty people. Garth, the grizzled, gray-furred lupine owner, stands behind the bar in his usual place, wiping off mugs or carting out drinks to his handful of patrons.
rows.translation: 寒霜猎犬酒馆，这是北方地区人们心中的第二个家。这家酒馆虽然规模不大，但却十分温馨：几张桌子被安置在熊熊燃烧的壁炉与光亮如新的吧台之间。木制地板上铺满了木屑，这些木屑会吸收洒出来的饮料。吧台后面摆满了各式各样的麦芽酒和拉格啤酒——这些酒正是适合粗犷的北方人饮用的。灰白毛发、满脸皱纹的加斯，总是站在吧台后面，认真地擦拭着杯子，或是为为数不多的顾客送上他们点选的酒水。
rows.raw: "The Frost Hound Tavern, home away from home here in the northlands. The place is small but cozy, with several tables sandwiched between a roaring hearthfire and a bar so polished that it shines. Sawdust coats the wooden floor, soaking up spilled drinks. Behind the bar are racks and racks of ales and lagers — hearty drinks for a hearty people. Garth, the grizzled, gray-furred lupine owner, stands behind the bar in his usual place, wiping off mugs or carting out drinks to his handful of patrons."

rows.original: The town stables sit near the town gate, packed with horses and carts. What little traffic a village as remote as Hawkethorne gets passes mostly through the eastern gate, standing just ahead, hailing from the faraway cities of the south or the vast grasslands beyond. This is the first place a traveler would visit, followed shortly by the tavern — much as you did when you first arrived.
rows.translation: 镇上的马厩位于城门附近，里面停满了马匹和马车。像鹰棘镇这样偏远的村庄，几乎没有什么车辆会经过，那些从南方遥远的城市或广阔的草原上而来的车辆，大多会经过东边的城门。旅行者首先会来到这里，紧接着就会去酒馆——就像你刚来到这里时所做的那样。
rows.raw: "The town stables sit near the town gate, packed with horses and carts. What little traffic a village as remote as Hawkethorne gets passes mostly through the eastern gate, standing just ahead, hailing from the faraway cities of the south or the vast grasslands beyond. This is the first place a traveler would visit, followed shortly by the tavern — much as you did when you first arrived."

rows.original: The eastern gate of the town stands stark and imposing, bridging the gaps between the wooden wall and palisades above.
rows.translation: 城镇的东门巍然矗立，气势恢宏，它将木墙与上方的栅栏之间的缝隙巧妙地连接了起来。
rows.raw: "\n    The eastern gate of the town stands stark and imposing, bridging the gaps between the wooden wall and palisades above. "

rows.original:
A pair of militiamen stand huddled underneath a thatched awning, trying to stay warm against the winter chill. 

    The guards give you a quiet nod as you approach, though they don't seem keen to venture out from their shelter. For the moment, the gates stand open, allowing you free passage into and out of Hawkethorne.
rows.translation:
一对民兵蜷缩在茅草遮盖的棚下，试图抵御冬日的严寒。

    当你靠近时，那些守卫只是默默地点了点头，但他们似乎并不愿意离开自己的庇护所。目前，大门是敞开的，你可以自由地进出鹰棘镇。
rows.raw: "A pair of militiamen stand huddled underneath a thatched awning, trying to stay warm against the winter chill. \n\n    The guards give you a quiet nod as you approach, though they don't seem keen to venture out from their shelter. For the moment, the gates stand open, allowing you free passage into and out of Hawkethorne."

rows.original: The road east of Hawkethorne stretches on to the horizon, fading into the forested foothills. You can see the village gates standing open to the west, and to the north, a narrow path up a rocky hillside — at the top, you can
rows.translation: 鹰棘镇以东的道路一直延伸到地平线，逐渐融入那些被森林覆盖的山麓。你可以看到西边的村庄大门敞开着，而北边则有一条蜿蜒在岩石山坡上的小路——沿着这条小路走上去，你就能
rows.raw: "\n    The road east of Hawkethorne stretches on to the horizon, fading into the forested foothills. You can see the village gates standing open to the west, and to the north, a narrow path up a rocky hillside — at the top, you can "

rows.original: . Beyond it stands the high walls of an ancient castle, stark and proud against the grim sky.
rows.translation: 。远处矗立着一座古老城堡的高墙，孤傲地耸立在阴沉的天空之下。
rows.raw: ". Beyond it stands the high walls of an ancient castle, stark and proud against the grim sky.\n    \n    "

rows.original: vaguely make out the dark walls of a temple sitting high on the peak
rows.translation: 隐约看见一座坐落在峰顶的神殿黑墙
rows.raw: "vaguely make out the dark walls of a temple sitting high on the peak"

rows.original: see the temple still standing on the hilltop
rows.translation: 看见那座神庙依旧矗立在山顶上
rows.raw: "see the temple still standing on the hilltop"

rows.original: Ahead on the road, you can see the toppled tree still blocking the way east — no getting out of town that way for now. Near the branch on the path, you can see the overturned wagon Cait's family was ambushed on. Blood stains the muddy ground and snow piles where her father fell, and drag marks lead away to the north, up the slope.
rows.translation: 在前方的道路上，你可以看到那棵倒下的树依然挡住了通往东方的道路——目前暂时无法从那边离开这个小镇。在小路旁的树枝旁，你可以看到凯特一家遭遇伏击时被掀翻的马车。她的父亲倒下的地方，泥泞的地面上留有血迹，积雪也被染红了；一些拖拽的痕迹一直延伸向北方，沿着斜坡向上延伸。
rows.raw: "Ahead on the road, you can see the toppled tree still blocking the way east — no getting out of town that way for now. Near the branch on the path, you can see the overturned wagon Cait's family was ambushed on. Blood stains the muddy ground and snow piles where her father fell, and drag marks lead away to the north, up the slope.\n\n"

rows.original: You can see evidence of ancient stairs leading up from the roadside towards the dark temple on the hillside, though many years of neglect have left them as little more than impressions upon the stone. High walls of rock flank the path, seemingly all the way up, bathing you in claustrophobic darkness.
rows.translation: 你可以看到，路旁有通往山坡上那座幽暗寺庙的古老台阶的痕迹，但由于多年的无人照料，这些台阶如今在石头上留下的只不过是一些浅浅的印痕而已。高高的岩壁耸立在道路的两侧，似乎一直延伸到山顶，将人笼罩在令人窒息的暗影之中。
rows.raw: "You can see evidence of ancient stairs leading up from the roadside towards the dark temple on the hillside, though many years of neglect have left them as little more than impressions upon the stone. High walls of rock flank the path, seemingly all the way up, bathing you in claustrophobic darkness."

rows.original: You continue to follow the passage worn in the hillside, flanked by tall walls of rock and bathed in a constant cavalcade of dancing shadows. The wind howls above you like a tormented beast.
rows.translation: 你继续沿着那条蜿蜒于山坡上的小路前行，两侧是高耸的岩壁，而你的周围不断有舞动的阴影掠过。头顶上的风呼啸着，仿佛是一头受尽折磨的野兽。
rows.raw: "You continue to follow the passage worn in the hillside, flanked by tall walls of rock and bathed in a constant cavalcade of dancing shadows. The wind howls above you like a tormented beast."

rows.original:
You continue to follow the passage worn in the hillside, flanked by tall walls of rock and bathed in a constant cavalcade of dancing shadows. The wind howls above you like a tormented beast.
    
    The passage twists and turns here, eventually snaking off upwards to the east. What remains of a statue lies crumbling and overgrown with scrub brush against the far wall, holding a tremendous stone sword and bearing its ancient, voluptuous breasts at you, worn smooth and featureless over time.
rows.translation:
你继续沿着那条蜿蜒于山坡上的小路前行，两侧是高耸的岩壁，而不断移动的阴影仿佛在为你伴舞。上方的风呼啸着，宛如一头受尽折磨的野兽。
    
    这条小路在这里曲折蜿蜒，最终向东上方延伸而去。在远处的岩壁上，有一座残破的雕像，它已经摇摇欲坠，上面长满了灌木丛。雕像手中握着一把巨大的石剑，而它那古老而丰满的胸部也依然朝向你——经过岁月的侵蚀，那些部位已经变得光滑无棱角了。
rows.raw:
"
    You continue to follow the passage worn in the hillside, flanked by tall walls of rock and bathed in a constant cavalcade of dancing shadows. The wind howls above you like a tormented beast.
    
    The passage twists and turns here, eventually snaking off upwards to the east. What remains of a statue lies crumbling and overgrown with scrub brush against the far wall, holding a tremendous stone sword and bearing its ancient, voluptuous breasts at you, worn smooth and featureless over time."

rows.original: The path takes a sharp turn here, and you see the beginnings of the pink marble stairs that lead up to Cait's temple, the stone veined with red and smoothed to a fine polish. The stairs are covered by a slate roof to keep the elements off the stone's glossy surface, and you note that the bronze railings are open so as to allow wind to sweep across the steps and cleanse them of the dust and grit travelers bring with them. Ingenious, that. There's no sign of the debris and rubble that was once strewn about the place — even the entrance to the place is a work of art.
rows.translation: 这条小路在这里突然转向，你看到了那段通往凯特神庙的粉色大理石楼梯的起点——那些大理石台阶上布满了红色纹理，表面被打磨得十分光滑。楼梯上方覆盖着石板屋顶，这样可以防止风雨侵蚀这些光亮的石面。你还会注意到，那些青铜制成的扶手是敞开的，这样风就可以吹过台阶，帮助清除旅行者们带来的灰尘和污垢。真是太巧妙了。那些曾经散落在各处的碎片和废墟已经消失得无影无踪——就连这个地方的入口都仿佛是一件艺术品。

rows.original: The path takes a sharp turn here, and where you saw hints of old stairs at the bottom of the hill, you now see clearly defined stone stairs leading up a smooth, man-made pathway flanked by the ruins of marble pillars. A roof might once have covered the passage here, but ages of neglect have let it crumble to cobblestones at your feet.
rows.translation: 这条小路在这里突然转向了一个急弯。在山坡下装，你原本只能隐约看到一些古老的楼梯痕迹，而现在，你可以清楚地看到那些由石头砌成的台阶，它们通向一条平坦的人造小道，小道的两旁是大理石柱子的废墟。这里曾经可能有屋顶覆盖着这条通道，但经过漫长的岁月无人照料，那些屋顶早已坍塌，只剩下脚下的碎石。
rows.raw: "The path takes a sharp turn here, and where you saw hints of old stairs at the bottom of the hill, you now see clearly defined stone stairs leading up a smooth, man-made pathway flanked by the ruins of marble pillars. A roof might once have covered the passage here, but ages of neglect have let it crumble to cobblestones at your feet."

rows.translation: 道路两旁是大理石柱的废墟，整洁的石阶通向一条人工铺设的平坦小路。这里曾经可能有屋顶覆盖着这条通道，但经过多年的无人照料，它已经坍塌成你脚下的碎石。
rows.raw: "Clearly defined stone stairs lead up a smooth, man-made pathway flanked by the ruins of marble pillars. A roof might once have covered the passage here, but ages of neglect have let it crumble to cobblestones at your feet."

粉红色的大理石楼梯通向凯特的神殿，这些石头上布满了红色条纹，表面被打磨得十分光滑。楼梯上方覆盖着石板屋顶，这样可以防止风雨侵蚀这些光亮的石面。你还会注意到，青铜制的扶手是敞开的，这样风就可以吹过台阶，帮助清除旅行者们带来的灰尘和污垢。真是太巧妙了。那些曾经散落在这里的碎片和废墟已经消失得无影无踪——就连这个地方的入口也仿佛是一件艺术品。

A roof might once have covered the passage here, but ages of neglect have let it crumble to cobblestones at your feet. You can see the entrance to the abandoned temple looming just ahead, flanked by monstrous stone gargoyles."

rows.original:
The entrance foyer to Cait's temple is nothing but grand. Floored with white and pink marble in a checkerboard pattern, the chamber is suffused with a light, sweet smell, barely perceptible unless one is looking for it; heavy, gold-trimmed draperies hang from the walls, keeping out the cold of the Marches. Save for the couple of braziers doused with aromatic oils and dancing with flame, the rest of the entryway is lit by crystal lamps, no doubt imported all the way from Tychris at great expense; a glass-domed roof lets in the [dayNight|sun|moon]light after suitable filtering. The end result is a softly flickering and extremely sensual luminescence that works with the aforementioned aroma to create the mood one would expect of a Mallachite temple. Whatever one might think, it's clear that Cait knows her stuff and spared no expense to create a good first impression to all who would enter her little demesne.
        
        [dayNight
            |Off by the rear of the entrance Foyer, you can see Salwah lounging around on several heavy cushions, the temple's grand cleric relaxing in an appropriately feline fashion and poised to greet anyone entering the temple. It's clear that the chococat absolutely loves her job — or maybe it's just the spice speaking... 
        ]
rows.translation:
凯特神庙的入口大厅堪称宏伟壮观。地面铺着白色和粉红色的大理石，呈现出棋盘状的图案，室内弥漫着一种淡淡而甜美的香气，除非刻意去留意，否则几乎察觉不到这种气味；墙壁上悬挂着装饰着金色边饰的厚重帷幔，有效地阻挡了来自边境地区的寒风。除了那几盏浇上了芳香油、火焰跳跃的火盆外，入口处的其他地方都是用水晶灯照亮的——这些水晶灯无疑是花费巨资从提克里斯进口而来的；玻璃穹顶的设计使得光线能够自由穿透进来[dayNight|太阳|月亮]经过适当的过滤处理后，光线会呈现出柔和的闪烁效果，这种极其迷人的发光效果与前述的香气共同营造出人们所期望的马拉克信徒神殿应有的氛围。无论人们怎么评价，显而易见，凯特确实非常精通这方面的技艺，她不惜投入大量精力，只为给所有进入她这片小领地的人留下良好的第一印象。
        
        [dayNight
            |在入口大厅的后面，你可以看到萨尔瓦正懒洋洋地躺在几块厚厚的垫子上——这位寺庙的高阶神职人员正以一种十足的“猫样”姿态休息着，随时准备迎接任何进入寺庙的人。显然，这只巧克力猫非常热爱自己的工作……或者说，也许只是她的“香料”属性在起作用吧…… 
        ]

rows.original:
[flags.MALLACH_TEMPLE_TS
            |Day or night, the old temple is being renovated and refurbished at breakneck speed, every free iota of space abuzz with activity. The air is heavy with the scent of stone dust and cement, and several lifts and pulleys have been set up in order to move hefty blocks of marble and stone where they need to be. While much of the structure is still intact, it needs to be shored up in order to last any length of time, and the exterior needs to be completely remodeled from its doom-and-gloom gargoyle motif to something more suiting Jassiran sensibilities.

            Even so, there's a lot of work to be done — debris carted away, pillars reinforced, holes in the roof that need patching up. It's dangerous work, especially on a structure this unstable, and you'd only get in the way of the workmen.
            
            [party.has cait|Even if she doesn't give voice to her thoughts, Cait herself looks particularly pleased at the brisk pace of work. It won't be long now before your pink kitten will have a little slice of home away from home.]
            |You stand at the foot of a pair of huge, sweeping marble stairs leading up to the entrance of an ancient stone temple. The arched entrance is flanked by monstrous stone gargoyles, each holding a barbed trident and shield in its hands; the filigree on the shields has long since been worn away by time, though you think you can vaguely see the outline of a hawk on one of them. The temple's roof seems to have caved in at some point, letting in the fury of the elements; wind howls and whips through the open-standing doorway.
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.MALLACH_TEMPLE_TS
            |无论白天还是夜晚，这座古老的寺庙都在以惊人的速度进行翻修和重建，每一个空闲的地方都充满了忙碌的身影。空气中弥漫着石粉和水泥的气味，为了将那些沉重的大理石和石块运送到需要的地方，人们还安装了几台升降机和滑轮系统。虽然大部分结构仍然完好无损，但为了使其能够长期使用，还是需要对它们进行加固处理；同时，外部装饰也必须进行全面改造，将那些阴森恐怖的石像鬼图案替换成更符合贾西兰审美的设计。

            即便如此，仍有许多工作需要完成——清理掉碎片，加固柱子，修补屋顶上的漏洞。这些工作非常危险，尤其是在如此不稳定的结构上进行，而你只会妨碍工人们的作业。
            
            [party.has cait|即使她没有将自己的想法说出来，但凯特本人看起来也对这种高效的工作节奏感到非常满意。不久之后，你的粉色小猫就会拥有一个属于自己的小家了。]
            |你站在一对巨大的大理石楼梯的脚下，这些楼梯通向一座古老石庙的入口。拱形的入口两侧矗立着巨大的石制怪兽雕像，每个雕像手中都握着带刺的三叉戟和盾牌；尽管岁月无情地侵蚀了盾牌上的花纹，但你还是隐约能辨认出其中一个盾牌上似乎有鹰的轮廓。这座寺庙的屋顶似乎在某个时候坍塌了，使得狂风暴雨得以肆意侵袭；风声呼啸着，从敞开的门口灌了进来。
        ]

            |You stand at the foot of a pair of huge, sweeping marble stairs leading up to the entrance of an ancient stone temple. The arched entrance is flanked by monstrous stone gargoyles, each holding a barbed trident and shield in its hands; the filigree on the shields has long since been worn away by time, though you think you can vaguely see the outline of a hawk on one of them. rows.original:
|You stand in the heart of the abandoned temple, surrounded by collapsed bits of roof and marble pillars. The rubble has been cleared away from the center, however, around the radiant, glowing plane of the portal in the center of the structure. An altar of stone has been erected around the magical gate, stained darkly by sexual fluids of countless dark rituals to the cult's masters. The whole place gives you a disquiet, fearful feeling. 

        South stands the temple's main entrance, giving passage back to Hawkethorne village.]
rows.translation:

rows.original:
The reception chambers beyond the temple's main entrance bear a distinct similarity to the original elven temple architecture; as someone who had seen the latter before it was renovated, the hallmarks are still there if one looks closely. Much of the old structure has been incorporated and repurposed into the new temple, given a fresh coat of paint and plaster to revitalise old pillars and eaves.

        A Mallachite temple is a place of passion and comfort, of warm fragrances, whispered nothings, gentle touches and soothing sights; the reception chambers promise all of those and more while a depiction of Mallach in stained glass, large enough to take up the height of one wall, gazes down upon all who would enter. Soft glowing crystal lamps, brought in all the way from Tychris, hang from chains and hooks, casting a quiet, sensual glow to the hallways that lead away from the main entrance chambers; the echoing of numerous footsteps rings in one's ears and down the passageways.
        
        While there is a sense of grandeur to the place, it brings with it a touch of intimacy and closeness that one wouldn't normally expect from such class. And for all this to be conveyed just by standing in this place... it really sets the mood for what awaits further within.
        
        [flags.RUNE_MET|Rune is [dayNight|trying to seduce temple-visitors and those poking around at the entrance|relaxing on a big cushion with her tail whisking around above her comfy, squishy rear]. [party.has Quin|The taeleer at your side, in particular, keeps shooting those thick thighs of hers a few lustful glances.]]
rows.translation:
寺庙主入口之后的接待厅与原始的精灵神殿建筑风格有着惊人的相似之处；作为一个曾经在神殿翻新之前见过它的人，只要仔细观察，就能发现那些独特的建筑特征依然存在。新寺庙在建造过程中融入了许多原有的建筑元素，并对它们进行了重新设计和使用；那些古老的柱子和屋檐也经过了重新粉刷和修缮，从而焕发了新的生机。

        马拉克信徒寺庙是一个充满激情与舒适的地方——这里有温暖的香气、轻声细语、温柔的触碰，以及令人心旷神怡的景象；接待厅更是满足了人们所有这些期待，而镶嵌在彩色玻璃上的玛拉基特形象，其高度几乎占据了一整面墙，它凝视着每一位走进这里的人。那些从提克里斯远道而来、散发着柔和光芒的水晶灯，悬挂在链条和钩子上，为通往主入口厅室的走廊们投下宁静而迷人的光晕；无数脚步声在走廊中回荡，令人耳畔回响。
        
        虽然这个地方给人一种宏伟的感觉，但它同时也带有一种亲切与亲近的氛围，这种感觉是人们通常不会期望从这样一个高级场所中体验到的。而这一切，仅仅是通过站在这个地方就能感受到……这确实为接下来将会看到的东西营造出了恰当的氛围。
        
        [flags.RUNE_MET|符文就是[dayNight|试图引诱那些参观寺庙的人以及那些在入口处闲逛的人|她躺在柔软的大垫子上，尾巴在身后欢快地摆动着]。 [party.has Quin|尤其是你身边的那位女孩，她不停地用充满欲望的目光盯着她那结实的大腿看个不停。]]

rows.original:
Day or night, the old temple is being renovated and refurbished at breakneck speed, every free iota of space abuzz with activity. The air is heavy with the scent of stone dust and cement, and several lifts and pulleys have been set up in order to move hefty blocks of marble and stone where they need to be. While much of the structure is still intact, it needs to be shored up in order to last any length of time, and the exterior needs to be completely remodeled from its doom-and-gloom gargoyle motif to something more suiting Jassiran sensibilities.

        Even so, there's a lot of work to be done — debris carted away, pillars reinforced, holes in the roof that need patching up. It's dangerous work, especially on a structure this unstable, and you'd only get in the way of the workmen.
        [party.has cait
        |
        
        Even if she doesn't give voice to her thoughts, Cait herself looks particularly pleased at the brisk pace of work. It won't be long now before your pink kitten will have a little slice of home away from home.
        ]
rows.translation:
无论白天还是夜晚，这座古老的寺庙都在以惊人的速度进行翻修和重建，每一个空闲的地方都充满了忙碌的身影。空气中弥漫着石粉和水泥的气味，为了将那些沉重的大理石和石块运送到需要的地方，人们还安装了几台升降机和滑轮系统。虽然大部分结构仍然完好无损，但为了使其能够长期使用，还是需要对它们进行加固处理；同时，外部装饰也必须进行全面改造，将那些阴郁恐怖的石像鬼图案替换成更符合贾西兰审美的设计。

        即便如此，仍有许多工作需要完成——清理掉碎片，加固柱子，修补屋顶上的漏洞。这些工作非常危险，尤其是在如此不稳定的结构上进行，而你只会妨碍工人们的作业。
        [party.has cait
        |
        
        即使她没有把自己的想法说出来，但凯特本人看起来也对这种高效的工作节奏感到非常满意。用不了多久，你的粉色小猫就能拥有一个属于自己的小家了。
        ]

rows.original:
An exquisite, carpeted lounge, made for poetry recitals, musical performances, general appreciation of the arts which lie within Mallach's domain, or simple relaxation. Guests remove their shoes as they step in from the adjoining tiled hallway and take up repose either on one of the many heavy cushions on the ground, or on the padded recliners — both look equally comfortable, if in different ways. The room's designed to allow sound to carry from the raised stage to the rest of the chambers, filling the entire place without needing to be overly loud up front.

        Several musical instruments line a wall, sculptures and other cat-related artwork another. The entire place is very plush and comfortable, a cat's cradle of warm delight. There isn't any show going on here at the moment, but people are nevertheless taking the chance to laze about and relax; the entire place is kept meticulously clean in accordance with feline sensibilities.
        
        There's a dancer's pole near the middle of the temple, positioned to let as many people as possible crowd around it.
rows.translation:
这是一间装饰精美的休息室，铺着地毯，非常适合举办诗歌朗诵会、音乐表演活动，或是用来欣赏属于马拉克领域的各种艺术作品，当然，也非常适合用来放松休息。当客人从相邻的瓷砖铺就的走廊走进来时，他们会脱掉鞋子，然后或是在地上摆放的那些厚实的靠垫上休息，或是在那些带有软垫的躺椅上休息——这两种方式看起来都同样舒适，只不过舒适的感觉略有不同而已。这个房间的设计使得声音能够从高高的舞台上传送到房间的其他区域，从而让整个空间都充满声音，而无需在前方使用过大的音量。

        一面墙上排列着几件乐器，另一面墙上则摆放着雕塑和其他与猫有关的艺术作品。整个地方都非常舒适惬意，简直就是猫咪们享受温暖与愉悦的理想之地。虽然目前这里并没有什么特别的表演活动，但人们依然趁着这个机会悠闲地休息放松；整个环境也根据猫咪的喜好被维护得极为干净整洁。
        
        在寺庙的中间位置有一根舞者用的杆子，它的摆放方式就是为了能让尽可能多的人围在它周围。

rows.original: [flags.AMINA_MET|Amina|A blonde-furred anubian] is showing off on it in the way only a lifelong dancer can, moving her body like water up, down, and all around the stage.
rows.translation: [flags.AMINA_MET|阿米娜|一名金发的阿努比斯族女子]正在台上尽情展示只有终身舞者才能掌握的舞姿，身体如流水般上下起伏，在舞台各处灵活游走。
rows.raw: "[flags.AMINA_MET|Amina|A blonde-furred anubian] is showing off on it in the way only a lifelong dancer can, moving her body like water up, down, and all around the stage."

rows.original: [flags.AMINA_MET|Amina|A blonde-furred anubian] is sitting on the edge of the stage, dangling her feet off the side. Rather than dancing, she's resting a harp on her lap and strumming its chords idly — but even a half-hearted performance as she rests is enough to prove to anyone in the temple that she's a gifted player. Notes flow like honey, sweet and tender, from her fingers to fill the temple. It's almost enough to drown out the constant sounds of moaning and flesh slapping together from the private rooms!
rows.translation: [flags.AMINA_MET|阿米娜|一只金毛色的阿努比斯犬]她坐在舞台的边缘，双脚悬在台外。她并没有跳舞，而是将竖琴放在膝上，漫不经心地拨弄着琴弦——但即便是这种随意的表演，也足以让庙堂里的每一个人看到：她确实是一位天赋异禀的演奏者。她的手指弹奏出的音符如同蜂蜜般甜美而柔和，回荡在整个庙堂之中，几乎盖过了私室里不断传来的呻吟声与肉体碰撞的声音！

Rather than dancing, she's resting a harp on her lap and strumming its chords idly — but even a half-hearted performance as she rests is enough to prove to anyone in the temple that she's a gifted player. Notes flow like honey, sweet and tender, from her fingers to fill the temple. It's almost enough to drown out the constant sounds of moaning and flesh slapping together from the private rooms!"

rows.original:
This egress from the temple's heart is less lavishly decorated than the first, and similarly less often-used — a low flight of steps, far shorter than the grand entrance, and weighted doors with much less fanfare. Where there once was a hole, there's now an actual exit from the temple — a side entryway that leads out to a worn passage along the rocky hillside, leading towards the dark walls of the ruined castle at the top of the hill. The juxtaposition of the Mallachite temple's cheery colors and warm atmosphere against the bleak, forbidding sight of Castle Hawkstone does not go unnoticed.

        Only those with reason to head up to the castle pass through here, and perhaps it's smart to have any petitioners to the castle first have to pass through the temple... a first line of defence in more than the physical sense.
rows.translation:
这座寺庙中央的出口装饰得没有第一个出口那么华丽，使用频率也低得多——只是一段很短的台阶，长度远不及宏伟的正门，而那扇门也没有那么气派。原本那里只有一个洞，现在则真正成为了一条通往寺庙外的通道：一条侧门，通向山坡上一条破败的小路，而这条小路最终会引领人们来到山顶那座废弃城堡的暗影围墙旁。马拉克信徒神庙那欢快的色彩与温馨的氛围，与霍克斯通城堡那阴郁、令人望而却步的外观形成了鲜明的对比，这一对比显然没有被人们忽视。

        只有那些有理由前往那座城堡的人才会经过这里，或许让所有向城堡递交请愿书的人都必须先经过这座神庙，其实是个明智的决定。……在许多方面，它都是一种第一道防线，而这种防线并不仅仅局限于物理层面。

rows.translation:
无论白天还是夜晚，这座古老的寺庙都在以惊人的速度进行翻修和重建，每一个空闲的地方都充满了忙碌的身影。空气中弥漫着石粉和水泥的气味，为了将那些沉重的大理石和石块运送到需要的地方，人们还安装了几台升降机和滑轮系统。虽然大部分结构仍然完好无损，但为了使其能够长期使用，还是需要对它们进行加固处理；同时，外部装饰也必须进行全面改造，将那些阴郁恐怖的石像鬼图案替换成更符合贾西兰审美的设计。

        即便如此，仍有许多工作需要完成——清理掉碎片，加固柱子，修补屋顶上的漏洞。这些工作非常危险，尤其是在如此不稳定的结构上进行，而你只会妨碍工人们的作业。
        [party.has cait
        |
        
        即使她没有把自己的想法说出来，但凯特本人看起来也对这种高效的工作节奏感到非常满意。用不了多久，你的粉色小猫就能拥有一个属于自己的小家了。
        ]

rows.original: The chambers where actual temple life happens — this is where anyone who isn't Cait eats, lives, and sleeps when they're not on duty. The northeastern wing of the temple takes up a good chunk of space, complete with a refectory, communal sleeping quarters and a large courtyard for doing the huge amount of laundry that comes with running a Jassiran Mallachite temple. Unlike the rest of the place, the living spaces are broad and airy, free of scent and smoke and generally fresh and inviting — as pleasant as the dim, relaxing atmosphere of the temple proper is, there's always too much of a good thing. You note that there's a lot more space here for people than actually live in the temple, but that's to be expected given how new the place is. Perhaps as the years go by Cait will manage to draw more adherents to the faith, especially from the pool of catfolk living in the Marches, but for now the emptiness of the acolytes' quarters really gnaws at anyone looking at them.
rows.translation: 这些才是真正用于进行寺庙日常活动的场所——对于那些不是凯特的人来说，他们在值班之外就是在这里吃饭、生活和睡觉的。寺庙的东北侧占据了相当大的空间，那里设有餐厅、集体寝室，还有一个宽敞的庭院，用来处理经营Jassiran 马拉克ite寺庙所产生的大量洗衣工作。与这个地方的其他区域不同，这些生活空间宽敞通风，没有异味和烟雾，整体上显得清新宜人。尽管寺庙本身那种昏暗而宁静的氛围也非常令人愉悦，但凡事过犹不及啊。 你注意到那里有一个很多这里为人们提供的空间其实比真正居住在寺庙里的人数还要多，但考虑到这个地方还非常新，这种情况也是意料之中的。或许随着时间的推移，凯特能够吸引更多信徒加入这一信仰，尤其是那些生活在边境地区的猫族族群。不过目前来看，这些侍僧住所的空荡荡景象确实会让任何看到它们的人感到有些不安。

rows.original:
Cait's private living quarters — this is the only place in the entire temple where some of the original architecture remains, especially about the point where the portal once stood. Of course, all remnants of the cult's presence have been removed, the old altar included, and in its place stand several odd instruments of an arcane nature, no doubt set up by Barney to check if anything happens with that very spot, and to alert him if it does. Otherwise, that little corner of Cait's living arrangements is copiously clear of any clutter, the pink marble floor smoothed to a polish but otherwise left bare.

        Compared to the lavishness possessed of the rest of the temple, Cait's own pad is quite bare — the hallmark of a girl who spent most of her life growing up as a temple acolyte, then lived on the road for a while. It doesn't look any different from a room at the Hound, to be honest, and it's probably better for the acolytes involved that their matron doesn't live too differently from them despite her station. There's a desk and chair, as well as several cupboards and shelves for holding records and the like that come with the running of a place like this.
        
        While there's no throne or anything for her to sit on, several comfy cushions and drapes adorn a corner of the chambers, a feline nest of sorts with enough space for a petitioner to approach — or join, if they so desire — the temple matron in her deity's embrace. It's probably better for Cait that way.
rows.translation:
凯特的私人居所——这是整个寺庙中唯一还保留着部分原始建筑结构的地方，尤其是那个曾经设有传送门的位置。当然，那些与邪教有关的遗迹都已经被清除掉了，包括那个古老的祭坛。现在，那里摆放着几件性质神秘的仪器，这些无疑都是巴尼安装的，目的是监测那个地方是否会发生什么异常情况，一旦有异常发生，就能立即通知他。否则，凯特居住环境中的那个小角落就会整洁得一点杂物都没有，粉红色的大理石地面也被擦得光亮无比，但除此之外，那里什么都没有。

        与寺庙其他地方所拥有的奢华相比，凯特自己的小房间显得相当简朴——这正是一个在寺庙中长大、后来又过了一段时间流浪生活的女孩的典型生活方式。说实话，她的房间和“猎犬旅馆”里的房间没什么两样，而且对于那些和她一起生活的侍女们来说，她的生活环境并没有因为自己的地位而显得与众不同，反而是这样更好。这里配备了一张桌子和一把椅子，还有几个橱柜和架子，用来存放各种文件和资料——这些都是经营这样的场所所必需的。
        
        虽然那里没有王座之类的供她坐的地方，但房间的一个角落里摆放着几块舒适的垫子和帷幔，简直就像一个猫窝一样，空间足够让那些前来祈求的人靠近——或者，如果他们愿意的话，也可以与这位寺庙的女主管一起，坐在她所信仰的神的怀抱之中。对凯特来说，这样的安排或许反而更好。

rows.original:
A half-dozen small, cloistered chambers, sequestered away in a corner of the temple and away from prying eyes. Perfectly situated to give anyone inside a healthy measure of privacy, thick stone walls dampen sound filtering out to the adjoining corridor and from room to room. Each one is compact and no bigger than a storeroom, yet amply furnished with a bed and all the accoutrements expected of such a place.

        Strictly speaking, a Mallachite temple isn't a brothel or even a boudoir, and yet there's a similar atmosphere here — given the nature of what happens, you suppose it's unavoidable. Nevertheless, you can see why others outside of Jassira would make the connection and arrive at said conclusions; it must frustrate Cait's ilk to be seen that way.
        
        Beauty hiding a sordid reality, in a way.
rows.translation:
寺庙的一个角落里，有半打小巧而隐蔽的房间，它们被安置在那里，远离任何窥探的目光。这样的位置为身处其中的人提供了充分的隐私保障——厚实的石墙有效地减弱了声音的传播，使得外界无法听到房间内的任何动静，也无法从一个房间听到另一个房间的声音。每一个这样的场所都十分紧凑，面积不会超过一个储藏室，但里面的设施却一应俱全，包括床铺以及人们期望在这种地方能找到的所有用品。

        严格来说，马拉克信徒神庙既不是妓院，也不是闺房，但这里却营造出了类似的氛围——考虑到这里发生的一些事情，这种氛围似乎也是不可避免的。然而，你也可以理解为什么贾西拉之外的人会做出这样的联想并得出那样的结论；被这样看待，对于凯特这类人来说，肯定是一件令人沮丧的事情。
        
        从某种意义上说，这就像是美丽的外表掩盖了丑陋的现实。

rows.original:
Despite its name, this low-ceilinged room is dominated by the smell of winterstem, rather than spice — while there are a few catfolk indulging in hookahs along with the characteristic clink of spice plates, other peoples simply appreciate being able to indulge in their vices comfortably.

        And what comfort it is. Lush pillows, fine silks, elaborate hookahs — the heavy haze of so many winterstem pipes and cigarettes in one place calms the nerves and numbs the senses even without actively indulging oneself. The low chatter of conversation fills the room, little bubbles of travelers and the like gathering about themselves, glad to have a place of respite on their journey. While Jassiran-style spice bread and spice beer are available on request, there's only any real demand for such by catfolk; the occasional unfortunate who's indulged themselves into an unconscious stupor is quickly whisked away by unseen hands, presumably to the temple's private quarters.
        
        The atmosphere itself is heavy, depressing, calming, the dimly lit environs making one feel sluggish and amicable towards the world at large. A place where one could spend hours in the blink of an eye without any sense of urgency whatsoever.
rows.translation:
尽管这个名字听起来很诱人，但这个天花板较低的房间里弥漫的其实是冬茎的味道，而非香料的香气——虽然有几位猫族正在享受水烟袋的乐趣，耳边也不时传来香料盘碰撞发出的声响，但其他人只是想能够安心地沉溺于自己的嗜好之中罢了。

        这该是多么令人感到舒适啊。柔软的枕头、精美的丝绸、精致的水烟筒——当这么多冬季使用的烟斗和香烟产生的浓重烟雾聚集在同一个地方时，即使不刻意沉溺其中，也会让人的心情变得平静，感官也会变得迟钝。房间里充满了轻声的交谈声，那些旅途中的旅人们三五成群地聚在一起，很高兴能在自己的旅途中找到这样一个可以休息的地方。虽然可以根据要求提供贾西兰风格的香料面包和香料啤酒，但实际上只有猫族会对这类食物有真正的需求；而那些偶尔因贪图美味而陷入昏迷的不幸者，也会很快被无形的手部带往寺庙的私密区域。
        
        这种氛围本身就显得沉闷、压抑，但却能让人感到宁静。昏暗的光线让人们变得懒散，同时也让人们对整个世界产生一种温和的态度。在这样的地方，人们可以花上几个小时，而丝毫不会感到有任何紧迫感。

rows.original:
Day or night, the old temple is being renovated and refurbished at breakneck speed, every free iota of space abuzz with activity. The air is heavy with the scent of stone dust and cement, and several lifts and pulleys have been set up in order to move hefty blocks of marble and stone where they need to be. While much of the structure is still intact, it needs to be shored up in order to last any length of time, and the exterior needs to be completely remodeled from its doom-and-gloom gargoyle motif to something more suiting Jassiran sensibilities.

        Even so, there's a lot of work to be done — debris carted away, pillars reinforced, holes in the roof that need patching up. It's dangerous work, especially on a structure this unstable, and you'd only get in the way of the workmen.
        [party.has cait
        |
        
        Even if she doesn't give voice to her thoughts, Cait herself looks particularly pleased at the brisk pace of work. It won't be long now before your pink kitten will have a little slice of home away from home.
        ]
rows.translation:
无论白天还是夜晚，这座古老的寺庙都在以惊人的速度进行翻修和重建，每一个空闲的地方都充满了忙碌的身影。空气中弥漫着石粉和水泥的气味，为了将那些沉重的大理石和石块运送到需要的地方，人们还安装了几台升降机和滑轮系统。虽然大部分结构仍然完好无损，但为了使其能够长期使用，还是需要对它们进行加固处理；同时，外部装饰也必须进行全面改造，将那些阴郁恐怖的石像鬼图案替换成更符合贾西兰审美的设计。

        即便如此，仍有许多工作需要完成——清理掉碎片，加固柱子，修补屋顶上的漏洞。这些工作非常危险，尤其是在如此不稳定的结构上进行，而你只会妨碍工人们的作业。
        [party.has cait
        |
        
        即使她没有把自己的想法说出来，但凯特本人看起来也对这种高效的工作节奏感到非常满意。用不了多久，你的粉色小猫就能拥有一个属于自己的小家了。
        ]

rows.original:
The inside of the baths is cold and humid, the architecture done up in traditional Jassiran style — they like their cold baths in that sweltering desert sultanate, for obvious reasons, and though it feels a little odd for that tradition to carry on in this chilly part of the world there's also little doubt that the invigorating nature of a cold bath persists no matter where one goes. The water is chill, but not outright uncomfortable, and the marble tiles kept meticulously clean to a polish. A system of culverts and bronzework pipes brings in water from who knows where — with Barney having had a hand in the temple's architecture, much is possible.

        The bathing pools themselves are largely communal, with a heavy yet retractable partition of frosted glass dividing the two, allowing for larger group activities if need be.
rows.translation:
这些浴池的内部环境寒冷而潮湿，其建筑风格采用了传统的贾西兰式——显然，因为在那个酷热的沙漠苏丹国，人们更喜欢洗冷水浴。虽然这种传统在这个寒冷的地区延续下来似乎有些奇怪，但毫无疑问，冷水浴带来的提神效果在任何地方都是相同的。水很凉，但并不会让人感到极度不适。那些大理石瓷砖也被保养得十分干净，表面光亮如新。一套由涵洞和青铜管道组成的排水系统将水从不知从哪里引入这里——既然巴尼参与过这座寺庙的建筑设计，那么一切皆有可能。

        这些游泳池大多是公共使用的，中间用一块厚实但可以移动的磨砂玻璃隔开，这样在需要时就可以进行大规模的集体活动。

The water is chill, but not outright uncomfortable, and the marble tiles kept meticulously clean to a polish. A system of culverts and bronzework pipes brings in water from who knows where — with Barney having had a hand in the temple's architecture, much is possible.\n\n        The bathing pools themselves are largely communal, with a heavy yet retractable partition of frosted glass dividing the two, allowing for larger group activities if need be."

rows.translation: 在那座岩石嶙峋的小山上，人们开凿出了一条小路，这条路从那座废弃的寺庙开始，一直通向山顶上的城堡——那是一座外观古老而雄伟的黑色堡垒。你不禁会想，这个地方该有多古老了……至少也有几个世纪的历史吧。

rows.original: You're standing at the gates to the ancient castle, its mighty stone walls standing impassable before you. The gates are closed, barring your further progress — for now. From here, though, you can see for miles around — the village of Hawkethorne looks like snowy little picture, distant and luminous with its many hearthfires and candlelit windows; beyond it stretches miles of green forest, and the tall grasslands of the south.
rows.translation: 你站在那座古老城堡的门前，它那巍峨的石墙仿佛是一道无法逾越的障碍，将你挡在了门外。大门紧闭，暂时阻止了你继续前进的脚步。然而，从这里望去，四周数英里之内的一切尽收眼底——鹰棘镇村庄宛如一幅被雪覆盖的美丽画卷，远处的房屋在炉火和烛光的照耀下显得格外温馨而明亮；再往前，则是连绵数英里的绿色森林，以及南部那片高大的草原。
rows.raw: "You're standing at the gates to the ancient castle, its mighty stone walls standing impassable before you. The gates are closed, barring your further progress — for now. From here, though, you can see for miles around — the village of Hawkethorne looks like snowy little picture, distant and luminous with its many hearthfires and candlelit windows; beyond it stretches miles of green forest, and the tall grasslands of the south."

rows.original:
You stand in the courtyard of Castle Hawkstone, seat of the marcher barony that you've called your home ever since Kasyrra's appearance. It's a truly ancient castle, at least five centuries old, made of solid stone and massive arches held aloft by engineering you can only guess at. They don't make 'em like this anymore.

        A central keep stands apart from the great palisades, and to the north of you, there's another smaller building where the guards were stationed once upon a time. The stables are next to it, similarly abandoned. Indeed, you don't see much sign of life here...
rows.translation:
你此刻站在霍克斯通城堡的庭院中，这里是你自卡希拉出现以来一直称之为家的领主爵府所在地。这座城堡确实非常古老，至少已有五百年的历史了，它由坚固的石料建造而成，那些巨大的拱门也是通过某种你根本无法想象的工程技术才得以支撑起来的。现在已经不再这样制作它们了。

        在那些高大的栅栏之外，有一座中央瞭望塔；而在你的北方，还有另一座较小的建筑，那里曾经驻扎着守卫。马厩就位于它的旁边，同样也被废弃了。的确，这里几乎看不到任何生命的迹象……

rows.original: You stand in what [pc.bgMulti soldier noblescion|looks like a standard barracks, a little lavish even|seems perfectly normal for a high class guard house|seems fairly standard for a barracks as far as you know], with a number of cleanly made bunks evenly spaced in rows of two going back along each wall. You can make out a vague sign directing you toward the bathing area behind one of the beds at the back. Further into the room the cleanliness changes to an ungodly mess. Bedding and clothing are strewn about in a seemingly random manner, creating a path of chaos you don't feel safe stepping in.
rows.translation: 你正站在一处[pc.bgMulti soldier noblescion|看起来像是一间普通的营房，甚至还有点豪华的地方|对于高级守卫所来说再正常不过的地方|就你所知，对营房来说相当标准的地方]，沿着两面墙排列着多张制作精良的床铺，它们两两成排地摆放着。在房间后面的某张床旁边，你能看到一个模糊的指示标志，指向淋浴区。然而，继续往房间深处走，卫生状况就会变得一团糟：床单和衣物被随意地扔得到处都是，形成了一条混乱不堪的道路，让人踩上去时总觉得不安全。

You can make out a vague sign directing you toward the bathing area behind one of the beds at the back. Further into the room the cleanliness changes to an ungodly mess. Bedding and clothing are strewn about in a seemingly random manner, creating a path of chaos you don't feel safe stepping in."

rows.original: Nestled in the vales between the windy foothills of the east and the vast, fertile fields of the southern heartland stands Hawkethorne. A small, walled village of perhaps three or four hundred souls, Hawkethorne supports the farmers and huntsmen that call the Frost Marches home. Most of the buildings within are wooden homes, or built from the stone of whatever city may have stood here in ages past. Most townsfolk are of human or lupine stock, though sitting on the borderlands as it is, the village sees folk of every description through its heavy gates.
rows.translation: 鹰棘镇坐落在东部多风的山麓与南部肥沃的平原之间的山谷之中。这是一个被围墙环绕的小村庄，居民大概有三四百人。鹰棘镇为那些以霜冻之地为家园的农民和猎人们提供了生活保障。里面的建筑大多是木结构房屋，或者是由数千年前曾坐落于此地的城市的石材建造的。镇上的居民大多是人类或狼族后裔，但由于这个村庄地处边境地区，因此各种身份的人都会经过这扇厚重的大门来到这里。

A small, walled village of perhaps three or four hundred souls, Hawkethorne supports the farmers and huntsmen that call the Frost Marches home. Most of the buildings within are wooden homes, or built from the stone of whatever city may have stood here in ages past. Most townsfolk are of human or lupine stock, though sitting on the borderlands as it is, the village sees folk of every description through its heavy gates."

rows.original:
The crossroads bridge the gap between Hawkethorne, the southern plains, and the towering castle in the hills to the north. You came through here the first time you approached the village, and can see evidence of your second crossing as well: Cait's cart is still tipped over in a ditch aside the road, too damaged to fix and too weather-worn now to be worth salvaging.

            To the east, you can see a foot-worn path leading off the road and towards the sloping foothills beneath the looming coastal mountains. Though it looks like you'd be heading into a network of tunnels, canyons, and vales, it might be worth the risk...
rows.translation:
这座十字路口的桥梁连接着鹰棘镇、南部平原以及北方山丘上那座高耸的城堡。你第一次接近这个村庄时就是从这里经过的，而你第二次经过这里时留下的痕迹也依然可见：凯特的手推车至今还倒在那条路旁的沟里，已经损坏得无法修复，也因为长期风吹日晒而变得毫无修复价值了。

            在东边，你可以看到一条被人们踩得发亮的小路，它从道路上延伸出来，通往那些耸立在海岸山脉脚下的倾斜山坡。虽然这条小路看起来似乎会引领你进入一个由隧道、峡谷和山谷组成的迷宫，但冒险一试或许也是值得的……

"

rows.original:
East of the crossroads lies the entrance to the foothills — a path down a ridge, little more than sand and gravel amidst dry soil and tall grass. The foothills lie before you further to the east, an array of cliffs, ravines, the occasional caldera, and rolling downs and plateaus covered in tall grasses and colorful wildflowers. Constantly battered by winds coming down from the Frost Marches, the few trees that grow in the rocky soil are gnarled and windswept, often huddled together in small groves for the safety of numbers.

            From your vantage point, you can still see the stone pillar where you first met the Harpy Matron, perhaps half an hour's walk down the ridge and into the hills, but there doesn't seem to be any direct path from here to there. How you wandered up to it is a mystery, but then you weren't yourself back then. Harpies do that, apparently.

            To the west lies the path back to the crossroads, and from there, Hawkethorne.
rows.translation:
在十字路口的东侧，是通往山脚的小路——那是一条沿着山脊延伸的道路，路上除了干燥的土壤和高高的草丛，几乎只有沙子和碎石。再往东走，就能看到山脚地带：那里有连绵的悬崖、峡谷，偶尔还能看到破火山口，还有被高草和五彩缤纷的野花覆盖的起伏的山坡和平原。在来自霜冻荒原的狂风不断侵袭下，那些生长在岩石土壤中的为数不多的树木都变得扭曲变形、枝干被风刮得东倒西歪，它们常常成小群生长在一起，依靠群体的力量来抵御风害。

            从你的观察位置出发，仍然可以看到那根你第一次遇见女妖族长的石柱——大概需要沿着山脊走上半个小时，然后进入那些丘陵地带才能到达那里，不过从这里看来，似乎并没有任何直接的路径可以通向那里。你究竟是如何找到它的，实在是个谜……不过那时候的你已经不是原来的你了。显然，女妖就是会做出这种事来。

            向西走，就能找到回到十字路口的路，而从那里再继续前进，就能到达鹰棘镇。

"

How you wandered up to it is a mystery, but then you weren't yourself back then. Harpies do that, apparently.

            To the west lies the path back to the crossroads, and from there, Hawkethorne."

rows.original:
You know you're truly in the foothills when you realize there isn't a single flat inch of ground to be had anywhere. Everywhere in sight is a slope of some sort, from the harsh snow-capped peaks of the Frost Marches to the north to the grass-covered hills that spread out before you — if you placed a ball at your feet, there's little doubt it'd start rolling, and be hard-pressed to stop.

            The path down the ridge aside, though, the going is relatively easy for now. Even though the path has more or less petered out, leaving you to contend with picking a direction amidst an ocean of green and amber, at least the ground underfoot is firm and easy on the feet. A thin layer of soft dirt and the grasses that grow on it cushion your steps, swaying with the winds that are blown down from the mountains.

            The way directly east is blocked by a tall mesa that rises out of the earth and looms over the land, leaving you with two choices for heading deeper into the foothills: northeast towards harder, rockier terrain, or southeast for more of the same rolling downs. Westward lies the path back down towards Hawkethorne.
rows.translation:
当你发现周围根本没有一片平坦的土地时，你就知道自己真正处于山脚下了。视线所及之处，到处都是斜坡——从北方被冰雪覆盖的陡峭山峰，到眼前这些长满草丛的丘陵……如果你在脚边放一个球，它很可能会开始滚动，而且很难停下来。

            不过，沿着山脊走这条小路的话，目前来说行走起来还算比较容易。虽然这条小路已经逐渐消失了，让你不得不在一片绿意盎然、色彩斑斓的景色中自己选择前进的方向，但至少脚下的地面很坚实，行走起来也很舒适。一层薄薄的软土以及生长在上面的草丛为你的脚步提供了缓冲，它们会随着从山上吹下来的风而轻轻摇摆。

            直接向东的道路被一块高大的台地挡住了——这块台地从地面突兀地耸立起来，俯视着周围的景色。因此，如果你想继续深入这些山麓地带，就只有两个选择：向东北方向前进，进入更加崎岖多石的地带；或者向东南方向前进，继续沿着那些连绵起伏的缓坡前行。向西便是通往鹰棘镇的道路。

rows.original:
Further away from the forbidding heights of the Frost Marches, the foothills become more hospitable, taking more after Harvest Valley to the south than anything else. The landscape here is dominated by yet more tall grasses and shrubby plants, the latter short blobs of green and brown that dare not rise too high above the cover of the grasses for fear of being cut down by the winds. There're occasional stands of wild wheat and hill rice, perhaps having escaped from fields about Hawkethorne, enough for passing nomads to supplement their rations but certainly insufficient to support a sedentary individual.

            While the landscape is as bumpy and uneven as the foothills are wont to be, at least the slopes here are somewhat more gentle, the soil a little thicker. There's a general downwards bent to the terrain as the land itself falls away to Harvest Valley to the south and west. Knowing this, it's just a little harder for the observant traveler to lose their way.
rows.translation:
远离冰霜边境那些令人望而却步的高地，山脚地带变得更为宜人，其中最接近南方丰收谷的地区尤为如此。这里的地貌以高大的草丛和灌木丛为主，那些灌木只是些矮小的绿色或棕色丛状植物，它们不敢长得太高，以免被狂风刮倒。偶尔也能看到一些野生小麦和丘陵水稻，这些植物可能是从鹰棘镇附近的田地里蔓延过来的。这些野生植物足以让路过的游牧民族补充他们的食物，但显然不足以让定居下来的人维持生活。

            虽然这里的地形崎岖不平，符合山脚地带的特点，但至少这里的坡度相对平缓一些，土壤也相对较厚。整个地形呈现出向下的倾斜趋势，因为土地本身逐渐向西南方向的丰收谷倾斜下去。知道了这一点，细心的旅行者就不容易迷路了。

"

rows.original:
Perhaps this stretch of ground was one part of a caravan trail, but it's now been abandoned. Recently, though, as you notice the sun-baked remains of wheel ruts and the still-growing grass within them. The trail must have seen much traffic, but your guess is that ever since the troubles began long-distance trade between Hawkethorne and the eastern coast has ground to a halt. With at least a dozen possible reasons all dissuading enterprising salesmen from making the trip, you guess that this was the only possible outcome, really.

            Still, the trail is usable, and as you walk along it you quickly realize how it came to be — simply by travelers following the path of least resistance through the multitude of hills and valleys, like water finding its level. It winds, it bends and you definitely walk a much longer distance than you otherwise might have had traveling in a straight line, but at least it's not uphill or downhill.
rows.translation:
或许这片地带曾经是商队路线的一部分，但现在已经被废弃了。不过最近，你仍然可以看到那些被太阳晒得发白的车辙痕迹，以及那些在车辙中依然生长的草。这条路线曾经一定有过大量的车辆往来，但你可以推测，自从那些麻烦开始以来，鹰棘镇与东海岸之间的长途贸易就已经彻底停止了。有至少十几种可能的原因会阻止那些富有进取心的销售员去进行这次旅行，因此你可能会认为，这其实才是唯一可能的结果。

            不过，这条小路仍然是可以通行的。当你沿着它行走时，你会很快明白它是如何形成的——只不过是那些旅行者们选择了在众多山丘和山谷中阻力最小的路径来前进，就如同水会自然地找到最低点一样。它蜿蜒曲折，因此你走过的距离肯定比沿直线行走时要长得多，但至少不会上坡也不会下坡。
rows.raw:
"
            Perhaps this stretch of ground was one part of a caravan trail, but it's now been abandoned. Recently, though, as you notice the sun-baked remains of wheel ruts and the still-growing grass within them. rows.original: A stout rope bridge across a chasm that runs from north to south — the chasm itself seems like a section of underground caves or tunnels, only that the roof has collapsed here, creating a massive gash in the earth. Peering into the inky blackness the chasm has on offer, one can only imagine how many tunnels run underneath the foothills, waiting to be explored... Whatever the case, the bridge has been carefully maintained. It creaks ominously in the wind, but it looks sturdy enough — it has to be, because there are signs of recent use. Footprints, swept gravel, new nails... the engineers here didn't have access to the best materials, but they clearly did their best with the hand they'd been dealt. Wide enough to allow people traveling in single file to cross with ease, it sways slightly in the wind as it bridges the chasm's wide span. There's a sign on the western side of the bridge, sheltered against the elements and positioned to face any who might approach from that end: King Kelsaz guarantees your safety on this bridge, traveler; his engineers have devised this simple yet sturdy solution for your convenience. Cross without fear, and cause no trouble in our lands. Please note that the maximum safe load on this bridge is the weight of seven adult minotaurs.
rows.translation: 一座结实的绳桥横跨南北走向的深谷。深谷本身似乎是一段地下洞穴或隧道，只因穹顶在此坍塌，才在大地上撕开一道巨大的裂口。望进深谷展露的墨色黑暗，你只能想象山麓下方究竟有多少条隧道正等待探索…… 无论如何，这座桥一直得到悉心维护。它在风中不祥地吱呀作响，但看起来足够结实——也必须结实，因为桥上留有近期使用的痕迹：脚印、被扫开的碎石、新钉上的铁钉……此地的工程师虽没有最好的材料，却显然已竭尽所能、因材施用了。桥面宽得足以让人排成一列轻松通过，横跨宽阔深谷时又会在风中微微摇晃。 桥的西侧立着一块免受风雨侵蚀的告示牌，正对着所有从那一端靠近的人： 旅人，凯尔萨兹国王保证你在这座桥上的安全；他的工程师为方便你通行，设计了这套简单而坚固的方案。请放心过桥，也不要在我国境内惹是生非。 请注意，本桥的最大安全载重相当于七头成年弥诺陶洛斯。

rows.original:
Continuing further up into the foothills, the air seems to get warmer; after all, it's closer to the sun, but not so high up the air begins to thin and chill. Nestled in one of the hillside grottos is a small cave; stepping into it, the separation from the constant winds outside allow the cave to maintain a miraculously tolerable level of warmth in which it's easy to sit down and rest.

            Decorative petroglyphs mark carefully smoothed surfaces — while the cavern itself is unattended to now, it was once evidently well taken care of to create as much of a natural feel as possible while retaining the comforts of the civilized world. Against a wall, you spy a crumbling brick bench, clearly for sitting on; on another, an ancient, corroded sconce has been affixed, any torch it might once have held long since rotted to dust.

            The spring itself has been smoothed and shaped to easy perfection — water continually pours from the roof, clinging to stalactites before dripping into the spring in several steady trickles. The spring itself is in turn drained through several cracks in its sides, and the resultant circulation of water has kept the pool itself largely clean. As for the water... its slightly milky texture suggests that while drinking it might not be the best of ideas, there's always other things one can do in such a place.

            Fancy a dip?
rows.translation:
继续向山脚深处前进，空气似乎变得温暖起来——毕竟这里离太阳更近了。然而，当高度继续增加时，空气变得稀薄，温度也随之下降。在山坡上的一个洞穴中，有一个小小的洞窟；走进去后，由于与外界的强风隔绝，这个洞窟里保持着一种令人惊讶的温暖，让人可以轻松地坐下来休息。

            这些装饰性的岩画被绘制在经过精心打磨的表面上——虽然这个洞穴如今已被废弃，但可以明显看出，人们曾经花费了大量精力来维护它，目的是在保留文明世界带来的便利设施的同时，尽可能地营造出一种自然的环境氛围。在一面墙边，你看到了一张摇摇欲坠的砖砌长凳，显然是用来坐人的；而在另一面墙上，则固定着一个古老的、已经生锈的壁灯架，它曾经用来插火炬，但那些火炬早已腐烂成尘。

            这个喷泉本身也被精心修整过，其形状已经达到了完美的境界——水不断地从屋顶流下来，先在钟乳石上凝结，然后分成几股稳定的水流，最终落入喷泉中。泉水本身也会通过其侧面的几处裂缝流走，而这种水循环机制使得这个水池基本上保持清洁。至于水本身……它略带乳状的质地说明，虽然直接饮用可能不是最好的选择，但在这样的地方，总还有其他用途可以发挥的。

            想游泳吗？
