rows.original: Beyond the original outermost lanterns is [a] [kiyoko.kiyokoHomeStage 0 1 2 3 4 |dirt path leading further into the den. It may be dirt, but at least someone's done their best to pack it down so that it's solid underfoot and resistant to rain and snow. Well, more resistant than loose dirt would be. With nothing to keep them back, the lush grasses of the crater threaten to encroach upon the path, no doubt the constant targets of weeding and trimming |light gravel path leading further into the den. Where there was once but dirt, someone's taken the time to set a light coating of coarse gravel about the path leading into the den, giving anyone traveling along it footing that's a little more sure. It's not perfect, far from it, but you know it's better than nothing and a work in progress to boot. Neither Kiyoko nor Kinu would be content with leaving things at this, you're sure |gravel path winding further into the den. Your ingress is floored with finely crushed gravel from who knows where, plus it's also lined on both sides with water-smoothed pebbles that keep the grasses at bay and the fine gravel from being washed away by rain and melting snow. This [silly|isn't its final form|isn't perfect yet], far from it, but at least it's looking more and more like the kind of place where someone like Kiyoko would live. |generous path of flagstones leading into the den. Cut into perfect squares with the attention to detail kitsune tend to give to everything they do, they're set into the earth and held together with fine mortar. The stone itself is gray and marbled with streaks of white and black, and either side of the path is lined with small bunds of pebbles that keep the wild grasses at bay. Now this is something — everyone's efforts, your included, in putting together Kiyoko's home is showing fruit at last. This is something that you can be proud of, eh? |generous path of flagstones leading into the den. Cut into perfect squares with the attention to detail kitsune tend to give to everything they do, they're set into the earth and held together with fine mortar. The stone itself is gray and marbled with streaks of white and black, and either side of the path is lined with small bunds of pebbles that keep the wild grasses at bay. That isn't all, though. Drainage culverts have been dug just outside of the bunds, and saplings planted to herald your entry into the den. They're nothing much to look at now, it's true, but once enough years have passed they'll shade the path for anyone heading on in. Perhaps in generations, they'll look truly impressive... if Komari is still around, she'll know... ] In the distance, the path passes an archway comprised of... well, it looks like two maple trees, if half of their upper branches were twisted about each other as they reached across the path. These must have been planted more than a century ago — no, two, since you now know the history of this place. You can spot the telltale signs of recent pruning, kitsune taking good care of their shaped artifice, no doubt. Either way, it's quite the impressive entryway, given how while these maples have been bent to the foxes' will, they don't show any sign of being in pain or sickly — quite the opposite, in fact. And even further beyond that, the den Kiyoko has now made her home. [dayNight |[kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |The occasional voice or cry makes it way to you from the den up ahead, too indistinct at this distance for you to make out any more than general emotions. Yet that is enough; the family you've made with your fox-wife is at peace where they are |The soft murmurs and sounds of daily life come to you from up ahead, silence interspersed by the occasional voice or shuffling of something being moved. There's activity in the den, all right — even when going about business as usual, Kiyoko's get knows how to make it music to your ears |The soft, constant chatter of the den at its daily work comes to you from up ahead, a calming but ever-present murmur of Kiyoko's — and yours, of course — get living out their lives by the day. It's not a slice of paradise like the Astral Plane was, but who wants paradise anyway when it's corrosive to body, mind and spirit? This is so much better |A soft, tranquil breeze caresses your face as you stand on the pathway, inviting you into this home sheltered by the crater walls. If you didn't know better, you'd have imagined that your fox-wife has the same kind of control over this place that she had over the Astral Plane ]. |[kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |With night falling over the den, the activity of daytime has quietened, and a soft, sighing breeze continually blows through the trees and grasses, caressing your cheek. There's no malice in this darkness and the wisps of bluish light that play in it, only comfort and security that's made all the more poignant by the high walls of the crater the den's situated in. Come and sleep, the wind whispers into your ear. There are no words, but you understand it anyway. Come and sleep. Such an invitation... is hard to resist. |With nightfall having blanketed the fox den in a muted blanket of calm, most of the day's activity has come to a stop. Even so, the occasional murmur and clatter reaches your ears from up ahead, the sounds of the den settling and stirring in its slumber; wisps of ghostly foxfire dance along the path, lighting your ingress and inviting you in. Fading into existence and fading out again, they dart and dance through the air, the brief manifestations of your fox-children as they dream vulpine dreams. With such a welcome even at this hour, how can one refuse? |Even though dusk has fallen, you hear the occasional soft murmur and creak from up ahead, the sounds of the den settling and shifting in its slumber. Scarcely can you go several paces without seeing wisps of foxfire dancing in the air before winking out again, the dreams of the many kits you've made with Kiyoko manifesting, however briefly it may be. They light your path into the den, obviating the need for lanterns on your ingress; with such a welcome, how could one not accept? |A soft, tranquil breeze caresses your face as you stand on the pathway, inviting you into this home sheltered by the crater walls. Night may have fallen, but foxes are creatures of the night as much as they are of the day; this calming darkness holds no danger for you or for them. The lights ahead invite you in, dim as they are; such a welcome can hardly be refused. ] ]
rows.translation: 在最外层的那些灯笼之后，[kiyoko.kiyokoHomeStage 0 1 2 3 4 |这条土路一直延伸到洞穴的深处。虽然只是泥土铺就的，但至少有人费心地将它压实，使得路面结实，能够抵御雨水和积雪的侵蚀——当然，相比松软的泥土来说，它的抗侵蚀能力确实要好一些。由于没有任何障碍物阻挡，陨石坑里茂盛的草丛不断向这条小路蔓延，毫无疑问，这些草丛一直是人们除草和修剪的对象。 |一条由碎石铺成的小路延伸进洞穴深处。原本那里只是一片泥土，但有人花心思在通往洞穴的小路上铺上了一层薄薄的碎石，这让行走在上面的人能够获得更稳固的支撑。虽然这并不完美，但总比什么都没有要好，而且这显然还只是个开始。你可以肯定，无论是清子还是纪夫，都不会满足于目前这样的状况。 |一条碎石小路蜿蜒深入洞穴之中。入口处铺着不知从哪里采集来的细碎石子，道路两侧还镶嵌着经过打磨的鹅卵石，这些鹅卵石既能防止草类生长，也能确保细碎石子不会被雨水或融雪冲走。 [silly|这还不是它的最终形态吧？|还不够完美]远非如此，但至少它越来越像那种适合像清子这样的人居住的地方了。 |一条由鹅卵石铺成的宽阔小路通向那个藏身处。这些鹅卵石被切割成完美的正方形，这正是狐族在做任何事情时都会注重的细节之处；它们被埋入土中，再用细腻的灰浆固定在一起。这些石头本身呈灰色，上面还分布着黑白相间的条纹，而小路的两旁则堆满了小石子，这些石子能够有效抑制野草的生长。现在，大家的努力终于得到了回报——包括你在内，所有人为打造清子的家所付出的心血终于结出了果实。这是你们可以引以为豪的事情，对吧？ |一条由鹅卵石铺成的宽阔小路通向那个隐蔽的洞穴。这些鹅卵石被切割成完美的正方形，这种对细节的极致追求正是狐族的一贯作风——他们做任何事情都会如此注重细节。这些鹅卵石被埋入地下，再用细腻的灰浆固定在一起。石头本身呈灰色，上面还分布着黑白相间的条纹，而小路的两旁则堆满了小石子，这些石子能够有效抑制野草的生长。 不过，这还不是全部。在堤坝的外侧已经挖好了排水沟，并种上了小树苗，这些小树苗会标志着你即将进入那个“巢穴”。现在来看，这些小树苗确实没什么特别的，但过上几年后，它们就会为那些走进去的人提供荫凉。也许经过几代人的发展，它们会变得真正令人赞叹……如果麻里还在的话，她一定会知道的…… ] 远处，小路旁有一座由……嗯，看起来像是两棵枫树组成的拱门。这两棵树的上半部分树枝互相缠绕着，横跨在小路上。这些树肯定是在一个多世纪前种植的——不，应该说是两棵树，因为现在你知道了这个地方的历史了。你可以轻易看出这些树木最近才被修剪过，毫无疑问，是狐妖们在精心照料这些被它们塑造出来的艺术品。无论如何，这个入口确实相当令人印象深刻——因为尽管这些枫树被强行按照狐妖的意愿弯曲成这样的形状，但它们却丝毫没有表现出痛苦或病弱的迹象，事实上，情况恰恰相反。 更进一步来说，丹·清子现在也已经将那里当作了自己的家。 [dayNight |[kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |前方洞穴中偶尔传来的声音或哭喊声传到了你的耳边，但由于距离太远，你无法分辨出这些声音具体表达了什么情绪。不过，这就已经足够了——你与你的狐狸妻子共同建立的这个家庭，此刻正在那里平静地生活着 |前方的道路上，传来轻柔的低语声与日常生活的种种声响，寂静中偶尔会穿插着人们的谈话声或物品移动时发出的沙沙声。这个藏身处里确实很热闹——即便只是在进行平常的活动，清子的伙伴们也总能让这些声音听起来像美妙的乐章 |前方传来洞穴里那些日常活动的轻柔而持续的声响，那是清泉般的低语——那是清子的话语，当然也是你的话语，它们在一天天地延续着生命。这里虽然不像星界那样是天堂，但当天堂会侵蚀人的身体、心灵与精神时，又有谁会真正渴望天堂呢？这样的生活，反而要好得多 |当你站在小路上时，一阵轻柔而宁静的微风轻拂着你的面庞，仿佛在邀请你走进这个被火山口壁环绕着的庇护所。如果你不了解内情的话，一定会以为你的狐狸妻子对这个地方的控制力，就如同她对星界所拥有的控制力一样 ]。 |[kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |夜幕降临，白天的喧嚣渐渐平息，一阵轻柔的微风不断吹过树林和草地，拂过你的面颊。这份黑暗之中并没有恶意，那些闪烁的蓝光也并不令人恐惧，只有宁静与安详，而这个巢穴所处的陡峭悬崖更是为这种氛围增添了几分凄美。 过来睡觉吧。风在你耳边低语。虽然没有文字，但你依然能理解它的意思。过来睡觉吧。 这样的邀请……实在难以拒绝。 |夜幕降临，为狐狸的洞穴披上了一层宁静的阴影，白天的喧嚣大多已经停止。然而，前方仍偶尔传来一些低沉的声响，那是洞穴里的生物在沉睡中发出的动静；一缕缕若有若无的“狐火”在小路上闪烁，照亮了你前行的道路，仿佛在邀请你走进这个神秘的世界。它们时隐时现，在空中穿梭舞动，这些短暂出现的狐子女灵，正在做着属于它们的狐狸梦。 即便是在这样的时刻，也能得到如此热烈的欢迎，谁又会拒绝呢？ |尽管天色已经暗下来，但你仍能偶尔听到前方传来的轻柔声响和吱嘎声——那些是狐狸们在沉睡中发出的动静。每走几步，你就能看到一缕缕狐火在空气中闪烁，随后又瞬间熄灭。这些，应该是你与清子共同培育出的那些小狐狸们的梦境在显现吧，虽然只是短暂的一瞬。这些狐火为你的前行照亮了道路，因此在你进入狐狸洞穴时，根本不需要携带灯笼。面对这样的欢迎，谁会拒绝呢？ |当你站在小路上时，一阵轻柔而宁静的微风轻拂着你的面庞，仿佛在邀请你走进这个被火山口壁环绕着的庇护所。虽然夜色已经降临，但狐狸们既适合在夜晚活动，也适合在白天活动；这种宁静的黑暗对你们双方来说都不存在任何危险。前方的灯光虽然昏暗，却在无声地邀请你进入其中；这样的邀请，实在难以拒绝。 ] ]
rows.raw: "Beyond the original outermost lanterns is [a] [kiyoko.kiyokoHomeStage 0 1 2 3 4 |dirt path leading further into the den. It may be dirt, but at least someone's done their best to pack it down so that it's solid underfoot and resistant to rain and snow. Well, more resistant than loose dirt would be. With nothing to keep them back, the lush grasses of the crater threaten to encroach upon the path, no doubt the constant targets of weeding and trimming |light gravel path leading further into the den. Where there was once but dirt, someone's taken the time to set a light coating of coarse gravel about the path leading into the den, giving anyone traveling along it footing that's a little more sure. It's not perfect, far from it, but you know it's better than nothing and a work in progress to boot. Neither Kiyoko nor Kinu would be content with leaving things at this, you're sure |gravel path winding further into the den. Your ingress is floored with finely crushed gravel from who knows where, plus it's also lined on both sides with water-smoothed pebbles that keep the grasses at bay and the fine gravel from being washed away by rain and melting snow. This [silly|isn't its final form|isn't perfect yet], far from it, but at least it's looking more and more like the kind of place where someone like Kiyoko would live. |generous path of flagstones leading into the den. Cut into perfect squares with the attention to detail kitsune tend to give to everything they do, they're set into the earth and held together with fine mortar. The stone itself is gray and marbled with streaks of white and black, and either side of the path is lined with small bunds of pebbles that keep the wild grasses at bay. Now this is something — everyone's efforts, your included, in putting together Kiyoko's home is showing fruit at last. This is something that you can be proud of, eh? |generous path of flagstones leading into the den. Cut into perfect squares with the attention to detail kitsune tend to give to everything they do, they're set into the earth and held together with fine mortar. The stone itself is gray and marbled with streaks of white and black, and either side of the path is lined with small bunds of pebbles that keep the wild grasses at bay. That isn't all, though. Drainage culverts have been dug just outside of the bunds, and saplings planted to herald your entry into the den. They're nothing much to look at now, it's true, but once enough years have passed they'll shade the path for anyone heading on in. Perhaps in generations, they'll look truly impressive... if Komari is still around, she'll know... ] In the distance, the path passes an archway comprised of... well, it looks like two maple trees, if half of their upper branches were twisted about each other as they reached across the path. These must have been planted more than a century ago — no, two, since you now know the history of this place. You can spot the telltale signs of recent pruning, kitsune taking good care of their shaped artifice, no doubt. Either way, it's quite the impressive entryway, given how while these maples have been bent to the foxes' will, they don't show any sign of being in pain or sickly — quite the opposite, in fact. And even further beyond that, the den Kiyoko has now made her home. [dayNight |[kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |The occasional voice or cry makes it way to you from the den up ahead, too indistinct at this distance for you to make out any more than general emotions. Yet that is enough; the family you've made with your fox-wife is at peace where they are |The soft murmurs and sounds of daily life come to you from up ahead, silence interspersed by the occasional voice or shuffling of something being moved. There's activity in the den, all right — even when going about business as usual, Kiyoko's get knows how to make it music to your ears |The soft, constant chatter of the den at its daily work comes to you from up ahead, a calming but ever-present murmur of Kiyoko's — and yours, of course — get living out their lives by the day. It's not a slice of paradise like the Astral Plane was, but who wants paradise anyway when it's corrosive to body, mind and spirit? This is so much better |A soft, tranquil breeze caresses your face as you stand on the pathway, inviting you into this home sheltered by the crater walls. If you didn't know better, you'd have imagined that your fox-wife has the same kind of control over this place that she had over the Astral Plane ]. |[kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |With night falling over the den, the activity of daytime has quietened, and a soft, sighing breeze continually blows through the trees and grasses, caressing your cheek. There's no malice in this darkness and the wisps of bluish light that play in it, only comfort and security that's made all the more poignant by the high walls of the crater the den's situated in. Come and sleep, the wind whispers into your ear. There are no words, but you understand it anyway. Come and sleep. Such an invitation... is hard to resist. |With nightfall having blanketed the fox den in a muted blanket of calm, most of the day's activity has come to a stop. Even so, the occasional murmur and clatter reaches your ears from up ahead, the sounds of the den settling and stirring in its slumber; wisps of ghostly foxfire dance along the path, lighting your ingress and inviting you in. Fading into existence and fading out again, they dart and dance through the air, the brief manifestations of your fox-children as they dream vulpine dreams. With such a welcome even at this hour, how can one refuse? |Even though dusk has fallen, you hear the occasional soft murmur and creak from up ahead, the sounds of the den settling and shifting in its slumber. Scarcely can you go several paces without seeing wisps of foxfire dancing in the air before winking out again, the dreams of the many kits you've made with Kiyoko manifesting, however briefly it may be. They light your path into the den, obviating the need for lanterns on your ingress; with such a welcome, how could one not accept? |A soft, tranquil breeze caresses your face as you stand on the pathway, inviting you into this home sheltered by the crater walls. Night may have fallen, but foxes are creatures of the night as much as they are of the day; this calming darkness holds no danger for you or for them. The lights ahead invite you in, dim as they are; such a welcome can hardly be refused. ] ]"

rows.original: This is where Kiyoko has taken up residence, her new home now that she has chosen not to return across the ocean to the land of her birth. The materials used in its construction are typical of kitsune architecture — thick and solid wooden beams, ornate roof tiles, lightweight materials that form the body about the skeleton. Supports and planks are held together with joints and fittings like a puzzle, their weight pressing in on each other and holding them in place. This is further secured by the vines and other plants that grow in several spots, lashing and holding together bits and pieces here and there while adding a bit of eye-calming greenery to the place. It isn't as blatant as the cabin that served as her home on the Astral Plane — that was grown into the side of a tree — but the foxes know how to turn nature to their advantage to make up for a lack of other materials. The building's front is graced by a deck-like structure that serves as a porch of sorts, and several white paper streamers hang from the eaves, fluttering in the breeze.[dayNight|| At this time of night, two paper lanterns have been set out to light the approach to your fox-wife's residence, flickering with the telltale ghostly blue glow of foxfire.] [kiyoko.kiyokoHomeStage 0 2 4 |It's not luxurious, but neither is it uncomfortable. After who knows how many years of dulling comfort in the Astral Plane, Kiyoko certainly is fine with humble accommodations in exchange for being free. There's the old adage about gods giving you what you need and not what you want, but in this case the two have matched up pretty well. |The whole place has been cleaned up a little from what it once was to begin with, exposed boards and framing painted with what looks like a mixture based on black soot and the cracks filled in nicely. It's looking better and cleaner, if nothing else — certainly still far below someone of your fox-wife's station, but given how things have turned out, who cares about that? |Most of the improvements to the den's architecture and buildings appear to have passed by this little shrine — the key word here being appear. Despite it having retained much of its simple, rustic charm, your practiced eye notes that several key pieces of framing are now sturdier with solid timbers, and the roof has been re-tiled at some point when you weren't here. Leaves and flowering vines curl about the building's exterior as they serve as reinforcement and decoration alike, making their presence known but not as much as to be intrusive; nature and artifice blended into one in the signature fashion of the Old Country. Looks are one thing, comfort is another. Kiyoko is clearly keeping her accommodations simple yet exceedingly functional; there's something to be said for a tinge of asceticism regardless of how things are. ]
rows.translation: 这就是清子现在居住的地方，自从她决定不再跨越大洋回到旧国之后，这里就成了她的新家。这座房子所使用的建筑材料完全符合狐族建筑的风格——厚实结实的木梁、精美的屋顶瓦片，以及那些用来构成房屋框架的轻质材料。支撑结构和木板通过各种连接件和配件紧密地结合在一起，就像拼图一样——它们的重量相互挤压，从而保持固定的位置。此外，那些在多处生长的藤蔓和其他植物也为这些结构提供了额外的支撑，它们将各个部分牢牢地绑在一起，同时为这个地方增添了一抹令人赏心悦目的绿色。它并没有像她在星界中使用的那间小屋那样显而易见——那间小屋确实很特别。成长了撞在了一棵树的侧面上——但狐妖们知道如何利用大自然来弥补其他材料的不足。 建筑的前面设有一个类似露台的结构，几条白色的纸条悬挂在屋檐下，在微风中轻轻飘动。[dayNight|| 在夜深人静的时候，两盏纸灯被点燃，照亮了你那位狐妻住所前的道路，它们闪烁着那种特有的、如同狐火般的幽蓝光芒。] [kiyoko.kiyokoHomeStage 0 2 4 |虽然不算豪华，但也不算不舒服。在星界经历了无数年平淡无奇的安逸生活之后，清子显然更愿意用简陋的居住条件来换取自由。有句老话说过：神明给予你的，是你要的，而不是你想要的；但在这个例子中，这两者却相当吻合。 |这个地方已经比之前干净了许多，露出的木板和框架都被涂上了看起来像是由黑烟制成的涂料，裂缝也都被妥善修补好了。至少现在看起来更美观、更整洁了——虽然还是远远比不上你那位狐狸妻子所处的阶层，但考虑到目前的情况，谁还在乎这些呢？ |似乎，对洞穴的建筑结构所进行的绝大多数改进都经过了这座小神龛的“检验”——这里的关键词就是“检验”。出现尽管它依然保留着许多简单而质朴的魅力，但仔细观察就会发现，一些关键的结构部分现在已经用更结实的木材进行了加固，屋顶也在你不在的时候重新铺设了瓦片。树叶和开花的藤蔓缠绕在建筑物的外立面上，既起到了加固作用，也起到了装饰效果。它们的存在显而易见，但并不会显得过于突兀；自然与人工之美在这里巧妙地融合在了一起，这正是老英格兰风格的典型特征。 外观是一回事，舒适度则是另一回事。清子显然将自己的居住环境布置得简单而又极其实用；无论怎样，这种近乎苦行的生活方式确实有其独到之处。 ]

rows.original:
The path into the den ends here, at [kiyoko.kiyokoHomeStage 0 1 2 3 4
        |a simple earthen crossroads at its heart. Someone's gone to the trouble of keeping the grass neat and trimmed to a comfortable fuzz, but that's about as far as things have gotten. This is the kind of crossroads that relies on the feet of people treading upon it to keep the paths clear... not that it's a bad thing, considering how that necessarily entails traffic being there in the first place. There's a certain wild charm to it all, especially with how several wild fruit trees that've cropped up in the intervening centuries have been allowed to remain as they are. Peach trees... ah, of course, that would explain it. Kinu would've fought tooth and nail to keep them as they were, and it looks like there're a couple of foreign plums, too.
        
        To one side of the crossroads stands a well, mossy between the masonry and looking like it's seen better days. Keros didn't restore this bit of the den, you notice, and yet it's clearly in use as evidenced by the presence of several empty buckets by its side. The well doesn't look like it's going to be dangerous or collapse in on itself at any point, but the thought of your fox-wife and daughter drinking from that[kiyoko.numKits 2|, not to mention the rest of the den]... Kiyoko wouldn't allow it to be used if the water was unsafe to drink, but even so. Well, an impetus to get things going, as it were.
        |a simple earthen crossroads at its heart. The surrounding grass has been trimmed to a comfortable fuzz, and someone's packed down the dirt about the central area into a large vaguely rectangular plot. It's looking more and more like a nice, empty space for everyone to gather, if nothing else.
        
        Even the well's received a sprucing up — while the masonry hasn't been replaced outright, at least the old crankshaft's been torn down and a new one installed in its place. Can't have people losing buckets down the well... right?
        |a fine gravel crossroads — the treatment the road leading in received has finally been extended to the heart of the den as well. The contrast between what used to be bare earth and now something that's approaching a central courtyard — well, it would be more apt as a square rather than a courtyard, right? You might be tempted to say plaza, but things haven't gotten to that level yet.
        
        Either way, everything's been spruced up quite well. The fruit trees that surround this central location have been pruned of their dead branches and are looking far better and healthier than they used to be, and several new-ish looking benches have been set in their shade, relying on their crowns to keep off the rain, sun and snow.
        
        They've also finally gotten to tearing the old well down, pulling apart the weathered, mossy masonry that lines the wellshaft in preparation for it to be replaced completely. The going is no doubt slow and dangerous, but it needs to be done, and carefully such that the shaft doesn't collapse in on itself.
        |what can finally be called a square, if a small one. This empty space at the heart of the den has been paved over with carefully worked and fitted stone tiles, each one seamlessly put in place, gray with small splashes of color. It's not huge, but certainly enough for everyone to gather in should the need arise. The quiet attention and detail given to something as simple as paving stones belies the intensity of these foxy people... that, and their fondness for a bit of shrubbery. The fruit trees lining the square are looking fine, and there're even little decorative charms hanging from their branches, swaying in the breeze.
        
        Below the trees, several benches rest in the shade, red and gold cloth draped invitingly across their tops. You have no idea how all this manages to stay dry when it rains or snows, but there it is.
        |a grand, if compact square. Floored with fine stone and lined with masonry brick, well-traveled paths stretch away from the heart of the den to the various places within, straight as an arrow and firm underfoot. The place is about as aesthetically pleasing as it can get while retaining that sense of rustic, countryside simplicity. The peach and plum trees that line the edges are looking fine, their branches reaching out over the paved portion, the charms tied to their branches jingling gently in the breeze. Beneath the trees, the benches are as they've always been, although some enterprising soul's added a handful of parasols, one for each seat.
        
        It really... it really brings you back to the hilltop in the Astral Plane. If you apply just a bit of imagination, you can see in your mind's eye a younger Kinu sprawled out on one of the benches, or perhaps with a bowl of shaved ice or a book... 
        
        Those were simpler times, not just for you but for Kinu and your fox-wife as well. But here and now, the reality of the world beckons with its challenges.
        ]
rows.translation:
通往巢穴的道路在这里结束。 [kiyoko.kiyokoHomeStage 0 1 2 3 4
        |这个十字路口很简单，只是用土堆成的。有人费心地把周围的草修剪得整齐，保持在一个适中的长度，但也就仅此而已了。这种类型的十字路口，只有靠人们不断踩踏，才能保持道路的畅通。……不过，这倒也不是一件坏事，因为这本来就意味着会有交通流量出现在那里。这一切都带有一种野性的魅力，尤其是那些在几个世纪以来自然生长出来的野果树，人们允许它们保持原有的样子，这让这种魅力更加凸显了。桃树……啊，原来如此。小娟肯定会拼命保护这些桃树，让它们保持原来的样子。而且看起来这里还种了几棵外国品种的梅树。

在十字路口的一侧有一口井，井台上的石块上长满了苔藓，看起来这口井已经很久没有被人使用过了。你注意到了吗，凯罗斯并没有修复洞穴的这一部分，然而从旁边摆放着的几个空桶来看，这一区域显然仍在被使用。那口井看起来并不会带来危险，也不会发生坍塌，但一想到你的狐狸妻子和女儿正在用那口井取水[kiyoko.numKits 2|更不用说窝里的其他家伙了……]……如果水不安全、不能饮用的话，清子是不会允许使用它的，但即便如此，这种做法也算是为推动事情进展提供了一定的动力吧。
        |它的中心是一个简单的土制十字路口。周围的草被修剪得恰到好处，形成一层柔软的草丛，而有人还将中央区域的泥土整理成了一块大致呈矩形的空地。不管用来做什么，这个地方看起来都像是一个非常适合大家聚集的、空旷而舒适的空间。
        
        就连那口井也得到了翻新——虽然砖石结构并没有被完全更换，但至少那台旧的手摇曲轴已经被拆掉，换上了一台新的。总不能让人们把水桶掉进井里去吧……对吧？
        |一个由细小砾石铺成的十字路口——原本只对通往入口的道路进行了改造，现在这种改造措施终于延伸到了这个“巢穴”的核心区域。将这里从原本光秃秃的地面变成如今近乎一个中央广场的样子，这种对比啊……其实用“广场”来形容可能比“庭院”更合适吧？你可能会想用“广场”这个词来形容它，但事情还没有发展到那个地步。

无论如何，这里的环境确实得到了很好的改善。环绕这个中心区域的果树已经被修剪掉了枯枝，现在看起来比以前更加茂盛、更加健康了；在树荫下还摆放了几张看起来相当新的长椅，这些长椅的顶盖可以有效地遮挡雨水、阳光和积雪。
        
        他们终于开始拆除那口旧井了，拆除了井壁上那些已经被风化、长满苔藓的砖石，为后续的全面重建做准备。这项工作无疑进展缓慢且充满危险，但必须完成，而且必须格外小心，以确保井筒不会发生坍塌。
        |虽然面积不大，但这个空间终于可以被称为一个“广场”了。洞穴中央的这片空地被铺设上了精心加工过的石板，每一块石板都被巧妙地安放在应有的位置，呈现出灰色基调，上面还点缀着些许彩色斑点。虽然面积不大，但如果有需要的话，确实足以让所有人聚集在一起。人们对如此简单的东西，比如铺路石，都能投入如此细致的心思和精力，这恰恰体现了这些狡黠之人的认真态度……还有，他们显然非常喜欢种植一些灌木丛。广场两旁种着的果树长得很好，树枝上甚至挂着一些小巧的装饰品，在微风中轻轻摇曳。

树荫下，有几张长椅，其顶部覆盖着红金相间的布料，显得十分诱人。你根本无法想象，在下雨或下雪的时候，这些东西是怎么保持干燥的，但事实就是如此。
        |一个宽敞而精致的小广场。地面铺着精美的石材，四周用砖石砌成围墙，笔直的小路从广场的中心延伸出去，通向各个角落，道路平坦而结实。这个地方在保持乡村质朴风格的同时，也具备极高的审美价值。那些种植在路边的桃树和梅树长得很好，它们的树枝伸到了铺好的路面上方，挂在树枝上的小饰品在微风中轻轻摇晃着。树荫下的长椅依然和以前一样，不过有人贴心地为每个座位都加了一把遮阳伞。
        
        它真的……真的能让你重新回到那个位于星界的高地上。只要稍加想象，你就能在脑海中看到年幼的小娟躺在长椅上，或许手里还拿着一碗冰沙或一本书。那些确实是更简单的日子，不仅对你来说如此，对小娟以及你的狐狸妻子来说也是。但如今，现实世界的种种挑战已经摆在了我们面前。
        ]

        Even the well's received a sprucing up — while the masonry hasn't been replaced outright, at least the old crankshaft's been torn down and a new one installed in its place. Can't have people losing buckets down the well... right?
        |a fine gravel crossroads — the treatment the road leading in received has finally been extended to the heart of the den as well. The contrast between what used to be bare earth and now something that's approaching a central courtyard — well, it would be more apt as a square rather than a courtyard, right? You might be tempted to say plaza, but things haven't gotten to that level yet.
        
        Either way, everything's been spruced up quite well. The fruit trees that surround this central location have been pruned of their dead branches and are looking far better and healthier than they used to be, and several new-ish looking benches have been set in their shade, relying on their crowns to keep off the rain, sun and snow.
        
        They've also finally gotten to tearing the old well down, pulling apart the weathered, mossy masonry that lines the wellshaft in preparation for it to be replaced completely. The going is no doubt slow and dangerous, but it needs to be done, and carefully such that the shaft doesn't collapse in on itself.
        |what can finally be called a square, if a small one. This empty space at the heart of the den has been paved over with carefully worked and fitted stone tiles, each one seamlessly put in place, gray with small splashes of color. It's not huge, but certainly enough for everyone to gather in should the need arise. The quiet attention and detail given to something as simple as paving stones belies the intensity of these foxy people... that, and their fondness for a bit of shrubbery. The fruit trees lining the square are looking fine, and there're even little decorative charms hanging from their branches, swaying in the breeze.
        
        Below the trees, several benches rest in the shade, red and gold cloth draped invitingly across their tops. You have no idea how all this manages to stay dry when it rains or snows, but there it is.
        |a grand, if compact square. Floored with fine stone and lined with masonry brick, well-traveled paths stretch away from the heart of the den to the various places within, straight as an arrow and firm underfoot. The place is about as aesthetically pleasing as it can get while retaining that sense of rustic, countryside simplicity. The peach and plum trees that line the edges are looking fine, their branches reaching out over the paved portion, the charms tied to their branches jingling gently in the breeze. Beneath the trees, the benches are as they've always been, although some enterprising soul's added a handful of parasols, one for each seat.
        
        It really... it really brings you back to the hilltop in the Astral Plane. If you apply just a bit of imagination, you can see in your mind's eye a younger Kinu sprawled out on one of the benches, or perhaps with a bowl of shaved ice or a book... 
        
        Those were simpler times, not just for you but for Kinu and your fox-wife as well. But here and now, the reality of the world beckons with its challenges.
        ]
        "

rows.original: This is where the magic happens, as it were. Once a grassy patch of land, the soft, crumbly soil round the back of the kitsune den has been transformed into several fields. A large pool of clear water is snug against the crater wall, no doubt fed from the same stream that creates the waterfall that hides the entrance to this den. An interesting and complex array of sluices, wheels and stone and bamboo culverts controls and directs the flow of water to several flooded rice paddies; the mechanism looks far too complex to have been installed by Kinu herself, as precocious as she is — no doubt she had help from some of Komari's people. As for the fields, rows of tilled earth hold crops, some of which you recognise and others you don't. All are suited to the climate of the Marches, cool at best and frosty at worst — beans, root vegetables, pale leafy greens, what look like leeks and more. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |The sheer size, color and robustness of each and every one of them, without rot or blemish — the sheer affinity Kinu has for agriculture and her ability to coax the earth into bringing forth its fruits is shaping up to be legendary. |They certainly look well-tended for, as far as you understand these things. ] Several charms have been tacked to sticks and lie in the middle of the fields in a manner reminiscent of scarecrows, no doubt with much the same intent where it comes to pests; several lines of ropes with bells attached have been laid out across fields and paddies alike. There's also a small tool storage with a thatched roof alongside an open-air shed, and a storehouse off to the side. [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |The fields have grown somewhat, dirt paths leading between rectangles of dark tilled earth and a network of shallow irrigation ditches. Some things never change, really whether you're seeing them down in Harvest Valley or here in a small slice of a foreign land. Despite the growing number of mouths in this den to feed, the sheer verdance and bounty of the fields suggests a generous surplus to be had. |The fields are rolling and well-tended, about a quarter of the land left to fallow and be replenished in the established planting rotation. The total area of the earth being cultivated has grown a little in absolute size, but it's more correct to say that the planting system has grown denser rather than bigger. With your fox-wife enthusiastically popping out kits, it's a good thing that kitsune have such mastery over plants and agriculture; then again, more mouths also means more hands to work the land. |The fields are rolling and verdant, testament to kitsune skill and technology applied to agriculture. Stretching all the way from the buildings to the water's edge, they're wide enough to give you pause as to how they all get tended, then you realize just how many kits you've put in Kiyoko's womb. When one puts it like that... yeah, it's conceivable as to just why this impressive sight is needed, and how it's maintained. Besides, the ditches, the bamboo and stone culverts, the sluices and more — all those save time and effort spent in tending the fields. Weeding is probably the one thing that can't really be automated here, or can it? |The fields aren't very expansive all things considered, as there aren't that many mouths to feed. Knowing your fox-wife, though, she'll be eager to remedy that little situation as soon as she can, so it's probably good that there's plenty of land left over for expansion. ]
rows.translation: 可以说，正是在这里发生了奇迹。这片曾经只是一片长满草地的土地，现在变成了几块农田。在狐穴后方，那片柔软而易碎的土壤已经被改造成了农田。一个清澈的大水塘紧贴着火山口的边缘，毫无疑问，这些水就是源自那条形成瀑布、隐藏着这个狐穴入口的溪流。一系列巧妙而复杂的水闸、轮子以及石制和竹制的涵洞共同作用，控制着水流的方向，将其引导至几块被淹没的稻田中。这种复杂的机械结构，显然不可能是小娟自己安装的——尽管她年纪很小且聪明伶俐，但毫无疑问，她一定是得到了麻里一些人的帮助才完成这项工作的。 至于那些田地，一排排耕过的土地上种着各种作物，有些你认得，有些则不认识。这些作物都适合边境地区的气候条件——这里的气候最多只能说是凉爽，最糟糕的时候则会下霜：有豆类、根茎类蔬菜、浅绿色的叶类蔬菜，还有看起来像韭菜的植物等等。 [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |它们的体积之大、颜色之鲜艳、质地之坚韧，而且毫无腐烂或瑕疵——小娟对农业的深厚情感，以及她那种能够让大地产出丰硕果实的能力，确实堪称传奇。 |从你的理解来看，这些东西确实被照顾得很好。 ]一些装饰品被挂在木棍上，散布在田野中央，其摆放方式让人联想到稻草人，显然也是为了驱赶害虫；还有一些装有铃铛的绳子被架设在田野和稻田里。此外，那里还有一间盖着茅草屋顶的小工具储藏室、一间露天棚屋，以及一间侧面的仓库。 [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |田野已经有所扩展，泥土小路蜿蜒于那些被翻耕过的黑色土地之间，还有一些浅浅的灌溉沟渠。有些东西其实是永远不会改变的，无论你是在收获谷地看到它们，还是在这里，在这片异国土地的一小片区域内看到它们。尽管这个地方需要养活越来越多的人口，但田野里那茂盛的植被和丰富的产出，显然表明这里还有着充足的资源可供利用。 |这些田野一片连绵，耕作得十分整齐，只有大约四分之一的土地被留作休耕，以便在既定的轮作制度中恢复土壤肥力。虽然实际耕种的面积有所增加，但更准确地说，是耕作方式本身发生了变化。更密集的而不是规模更大。既然你的狐狸妻子总是兴致勃勃地生下小狐狸，那么狐族对植物种植和农业如此精通，倒也是件好事；不过，人口增多也意味着有更多人可以从事农耕工作。 |这些连绵起伏、郁郁葱葱的田野，正是狐族在农业领域所掌握的技艺与技术的体现。从建筑物一直延伸到水边，这些田野的面积之大，实在让人不禁怀疑究竟需要投入多少精力才能照料它们，但当你意识到其实这些土地都是“千代子”的“子宫”里孕育出来的时候，你就会明白其中蕴含的深厚意义了。这么说来……确实，我们能够理解为什么需要这样的设施，以及它们是如何被维护好的。更何况，那些沟渠、竹制和石制的涵洞、水闸等等，所有这些都在很大程度上节省了人们在田地管理上所花费的时间和精力。除草可能是唯一一项真正无法实现自动化的任务，吧？ |考虑到需要养活的人口数量并不多，这些土地其实并不算十分辽阔。不过，以你那位精明的妻子来看，她肯定会尽快想办法解决这个问题，所以幸好还有足够的土地可以用来进一步开发。 ]

rows.original: A torii gate — a tall, imposing archway of red-painted wood, comprised of two cylindrical posts and an equal number of crosswise beams that bridge the posts, one atop the other. As Miko and Mai were so kind as to explain in your first encounter with them, the purpose of these gates in the Kerosite religion is to symbolise the divide between the mundane and profane, as opposed to the sacred and holy. Here, though, a telltale shimmer in the air between the gateposts belies the structure's true nature beneath its unassuming exterior, reality wavering just a little as if just above a heated stove. This gate is but a much smaller version of the grand portal back in the Frostwood kitsune den, but it's still enough to join the two places. This is how Kinu [kiyoko.numKits 2|and your other fox-children get|gets] there without having to traverse much of the Old Forest and Frostwood alike, making what would be a dangerous journey much simpler. Since you know Komari has granted you permission to visit her home, you too could use the gate for the same purpose without trouble.
rows.translation: A 鸟居大门——那是由红色木材制成的高大而庄严的拱门，由两根圆柱形的立柱和数量相同的横木构成，这些横木层层叠叠地连接在立柱之上。正如米可与舞在你初次与她们见面时所解释的那样，在凯罗斯汀宗教中，这些大门象征着世俗与亵渎与神圣与圣洁之间的界限。 然而，在这两根门柱之间的空气中，有一种微妙的光芒在闪烁，这种现象暗示着这个结构其实有着与它那朴素外观截然不同的真实本质——现实本身似乎都在微微颤动，就像位于一个炽热的炉子上方一样。这扇门只不过是霜木林中那只狐妖巢穴里那座宏伟入口的缩小版而已，但它依然足以将这两个地方连接在一起。小娟就是这样的。 [kiyoko.numKits 2|还有你的其他“狐狸孩子们”也一样|得到]这样一来，就无需穿越大片的古林和寒冰林地，原本会十分危险的旅程也因此变得简单了许多。 既然你知道麻里已经允许你前往她家拜访，那么你也可以使用那扇门来达到同样的目的，而不会遇到任何麻烦。

rows.original:
One of the sturdier buildings in the den has been converted into a lumber shed. You're not sure what this might once have been — a home, perhaps — but what it is now is a storage for bulky materials. Lumber, both for building and for firewood, stone, even some brick despite there not being a kiln anywhere in sight. Regardless of how your fox-wife is supposed to be working to rebuild her home under her own strength, her old retainer is pulling out all the stops to aid her in that task, perhaps out of a sense of regret for her past failings. There's a large flat stump by the shed's entrance where firewood is split, and wood shavings litter the floor of an open air-shed where planks and beams are worked into shape.

        The shed itself [kiyoko.kiyokoHomeStage 0 1 2 3 4
            |is fairly basic, a roof and four walls to keep the wind and rain off, ensuring the material stays in good condition. With people taking precedence for comfort, there hasn't been much work put into the lumber shed yet besides ensuring basic functionality.
            |still isn't much of a pretty sight, although you note that several simple pulleys and winches have been added to make loading and stacking the materials easier and more efficient. A little investment into infrastructure goes a long way, as they say.
            |is starting to look a little better now. Several cracks in the walls have now been patched over, and the entryway's been expanded to allow for bigger hauls both ways. Less and less like a makeshift storage by the day, and more and more like a proper warehouse. The going has been slower than the rest of the den, but it's catching up.
            |has lost most of what it originally was and is looking like a proper material storage now. Someone's opened up space near the top for proper air circulation, and the loading mechanisms are strong and sturdy. Rain and snow aren't going to be getting to all these, now, which is especially important given that the storage is at least two-thirds full at any time now.
            |is a small work of art. With function dealt with, the building's been given a few artisanal touches in true kitsune spirit; it's not much, but imbuing a bit of beauty into the mundane is the way of these foxy people. Several fine carvings depicting foxes hauling around beams and planks have been etched into the building supports — a little ironic given all the hauling aids that're around, but it's the spirit of the thing that matters, isn't it?
            
            Most of the building and restoration work on the den has ceased, and so it's mostly maintenance now. With plenty of materials on hand, that shouldn't be any problem, thanks in part to your efforts.
        ]
rows.translation:
巢穴中那座较为坚固的建筑被改成了储木棚。你不确定它原本可能是用来做什么的——也许曾经是一栋住宅——但如今它已经被用来存放那些体积庞大的材料。里面有用于建造房屋的木材，也有柴火，还有石头，甚至还有一些砖块，尽管周围根本看不到任何烧砖的窑炉。无论你的狐妖妻子应该如何依靠自己的力量来重建家园，她那位老仆人都在竭尽全力帮助她完成这项任务——或许，这是出于对自己过去过错的悔恨吧。棚屋入口处有一根很大的扁平树桩，人们就是在那里劈柴的；而在那个用于加工木板和梁材的露天棚屋里，地板上到处都是木屑。

        还有那个棚屋本身[kiyoko.kiyokoHomeStage 0 1 2 3 4
            |这种结构相当简单，只需要有屋顶和四面墙来遮挡风雨，就能确保材料不会受到损坏。由于人们更注重舒适性，因此除了保证其基本功能外，这个木棚并没有再进行过多的改造或装修。
            |虽然看起来还不是特别美观，但你可以看到他们加装了几个简单的滑轮和绞车，这使得材料的装卸变得更加方便和高效。正如人们所说，在基础设施上稍加投资，就能带来显著的成效。
            |现在看起来已经好多了。墙上的几处裂缝都已经修补好了，入口也得到了扩建，这样来回运输大型物品就会更加方便了。渐渐地，这里不再像是一个临时搭建的储藏场所，而更像是一个正规的仓库了。虽然这个改造工作的进度比洞穴的其他部分要慢一些，但现在已经在赶上来了。
            |它已经失去了原本的大部分功能，现在看起来更像是一个普通的物资储存场所。有人还在顶部留出了空间，以确保空气能够正常流通，而且那些用于装载物资的装置也非常结实、耐用。现在，雨水和雪水不会再影响到这些储存物品了，这一点尤其重要，因为目前这个储存场所的储存空间已经有至少三分之二被物品占用了。
            |这是一件精美的小艺术品。在满足功能需求的同时，这座建筑还被添加了一些充满手工艺气息的细节，完全体现了狐狸们的风格；这些细节可能并不复杂，但正是这样的设计，才让平凡的事物变得美丽起来——这正是这些狡黠的狐狸们的做派。在建筑的结构支撑上，还雕刻着一些描绘狐狸搬运梁木和木板的精美图案；考虑到周围其实已经有许多辅助搬运的工具，这样的设计似乎有点讽刺意味，但重要的是这种设计所体现出的精神，对吧？
            
            该巢穴的大部分建造与修复工作已经完成，现在主要处于维护阶段。由于手头有充足的材料，再加上你们的努力，这些维护工作应该不会遇到任何问题。
        ]

rows.original: The pathway leading into your home is eerily tranquil, lanterns doused and darkness reigning here against the backdrop of the burning den's orange glow. It's an uneasy peace, one that could be broken any moment, but you don't think there are any of those invaders lingering about these parts — they're beyond the den's limits, after all. They'd be in your home being up to no good, not lurking about the outskirts to pick off stragglers... would they? Would they? The thought worries you, but you can't let what-ifs paralyze you from action. [flags.KINU_KILLER_SHED |You've just about made a sweep of the entire den and flushed out as many of these invaders as you can with your [kinu.weapon]. [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 3 |With your duties dispensed with, you've got to go and get help |Now that Aya is safe and you've dispensed with your duties, you've got to go and get help |Now that your siblings are safe and you've dispensed with your duties, you've got to go and get help ]. The portal through the torii gate is down, so that means a trek through the woods... |You can't leave now, not when you haven't fully swept out the invaders from your home. [kinu.isInari |You won't forgive them for doing this... you'll show them as much mercy as they would have you. |Someone like you would never allow simple fear dissuade her from the duties of her station, would she? If you won't defend your home... what good are you? ] Like it or not, you were born to this — there is no running away. ]
rows.translation: 通往你家的道路安静得诡异。灯笼尽数熄灭，黑暗笼罩此处，只有燃烧的巢穴投来的橙色火光映在远处。这是一种令人不安的平静，随时都可能被打破；不过，你觉得那些入侵者应该不会还在这一带徘徊——这里毕竟已经超出了巢穴的范围。若真想作恶，他们应该已经进入你的家，而不是埋伏在外围袭击落单者……对吧？ 对吧？ 这个念头令你不安，但你不能因为种种假设而裹足不前。[flags.KINU_KILLER_SHED |你几乎已经搜遍整个巢穴，并用[kinu.weapon]尽可能赶走了所有入侵者。[kiyoko.numKits 1 2 3 |职责已经完成，你现在必须去找援军 |绫已经安全，你也履行了职责；现在必须去找援军 |兄弟姐妹们已经安全，你也履行了职责；现在必须去找援军 ]。穿过鸟居的传送门已经关闭，这意味着你得徒步穿过树林…… |你现在不能离开。入侵者还没有被彻底赶出家园。[kinu.isInari |你绝不会原谅他们的所作所为……你会以他们对待你的方式，毫不留情地回敬他们。 |像你这样的人，绝不会让单纯的恐惧阻碍自己履行职责，对吧？若连自己的家园都不保护……你还有什么用？ ] 无论愿不愿意，你生来就得面对这一切——无处可逃。 ]
rows.raw: "The pathway leading into your home is eerily tranquil, lanterns doused and darkness reigning here against the backdrop of the burning den's orange glow. It's an uneasy peace, one that could be broken any moment, but you don't think there are any of those invaders lingering about these parts — they're beyond the den's limits, after all. They'd be in your home being up to no good, not lurking about the outskirts to pick off stragglers... would they? Would they? The thought worries you, but you can't let what-ifs paralyze you from action. [flags.KINU_KILLER_SHED |You've just about made a sweep of the entire den and flushed out as many of these invaders as you can with your [kinu.weapon]. [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 3 |With your duties dispensed with, you've got to go and get help |Now that Aya is safe and you've dispensed with your duties, you've got to go and get help |Now that your siblings are safe and you've dispensed with your duties, you've got to go and get help ]. The portal through the torii gate is down, so that means a trek through the woods... |You can't leave now, not when you haven't fully swept out the invaders from your home. [kinu.isInari |You won't forgive them for doing this... you'll show them as much mercy as they would have you. |Someone like you would never allow simple fear dissuade her from the duties of her station, would she? If you won't defend your home... what good are you? ] Like it or not, you were born to this — there is no running away. ] "

rows.original:
This is where Mother has taken up residence, her new home now that she has chosen not to return across the ocean to the land of her birth. [kinu.isInari
            |While you know that she used to reside in a sacred tree as a girl and this is humble by comparison, even this was always too fancy for you
            |This is the kind of residence you'd have liked to take up in someday, something quaint and practical, yet refined and elegant
        ]. Now that the roof and walls are ablaze, lanterns fallen to the ground and crushed underfoot... the question rings hollow, doesn't it?
        
        The door lies open, clearly forced open from outside — the mere sight sets your teeth on edge. They will pay for this.
        
        [flags.KINU_KILLER_QUARTERS
            |[kiyoko.numKits 2
                |Aya was supposed to be housesitting today while Mother was out... you have to make sure your sister is okay. The girl may be boisterous, but boisterous doesn't necessarily mean brave.
                |Mother's valuables, and more importantly, her tools of the trade and marks of station... they're in here. While there's no way that you could carry them off with you from the burning building in time, it would be better for them to burn than let these invading things pilfer them for their own purposes. If they dare strike at the sanctity of your home, the least you can do is to ensure they don't profit from it.
            ]
        ]
        
        [flags.KINU_KILLER_ABODE
            |You've already been here and done what's necessary. Time to move on.
        ]
        
        [flags.KINU_KILLER_QUARTERS
            |
            |You're getting ahead of yourself — you need to head back to the den quarters and check if [kiyoko.numKits 4 5
                |Asagiri is fine
                |Asagiri and your other siblings are fine
                |there're any more of the invaders lurking around
            ] before extending your sweep.
        ]

rows.original:
At this time of night, the den crossroads would have been lit with foxfire, but someone has doused the lanterns. You haven't the time to light them — and nor do you want to. The darkness serves you just as well as these invaders... you think. Do they see better in the dark than you do? So many questions unanswered... 

        The path... the well... did they always look this menacing? Or are you just seeing them in a different light — or rather, lack thereof? The benches, broken, the fine cloth used to cover them stolen. Will they stop at nothing?
        
        Lingering here will give you neither answers nor the chance to act. You must move.
rows.translation:
在这样的深夜，这个狐狸窝的十字路口本应该被狐火照亮，但有人把那些灯笼都熄灭了。你没有时间去重新点燃它们——也不想这么做。暗影对你来说，和这些入侵者一样，也是一种帮助。…你这么认为吗？他们在暗影中看得比你更清楚吗？还有太多问题没有得到解答……

        那条小路……那口井……它们本来就是这么令人毛骨悚然的吗？还是说只是你用另一种视角来看待它们——或者说，是因为你缺乏正确的认知罢了？那些长椅已经损坏，用来覆盖它们的精美布料也被偷走了。他们难道真的会无所不用其极吗？
        
        继续留在这里，你既得不到任何答案，也没有机会采取行动。你必须离开。

rows.original: Smoke in your nose, hot ashes on your tongue — bitter and hateful, [kinu.isInari |and the sight awakens a grim determination within you |leaving a foul aftertaste in your mouth ]. Fire dances on the rooftops — while most of the buildings are still derelict, [kiyoko.numKits 16|even with as many siblings as you have, ]the mere sight of your home on fire twists at your heart. [flags.KINU_KILLER_QUARTERS |While the fire rages on — helped along by mineral oil, it's far too widespread for you to have any hope of containing, let alone dousing it — at least you've [kiyoko.numKits 4 5 |made sure that Asagiri's safe and sent her on her way to the den entrance |made sure that your siblings are safe and sent them on their way to the den entrance |swept out the area and made sure there aren't any more invaders lurking around this part of the den. You will not stand for this trespass upon your home ]. It's time to move on. |And it's your heart that leaps into your throat when you realize [kiyoko.numKits 2 |the little side abode where your [kiyoko.numKits 3 |siblings live |sister lives ] is on fire, too, flames leaping from the wooden, tiled roof even as cinders drift to the ground |the enormity of the situation that you're in right now. If it had been merely just your own private quarters... but as the orange glow rises into the sky and cinders drift down to you, the realization hits you like a boulder ]. In that moment, the way forward becomes clear: you have to [kiyoko.numKits 2 |save your family. |repel the invaders until every last one of them is [kinu.isInari |dead. |scattered to the winds. ] ] ]
rows.translation: 鼻子里弥漫着烟雾，舌头上沾满滚烫的灰烬——如此苦涩，如此令人憎恨[kinu.isInari |这一景象在你心中激起了坚定的决心。 |留下难闻的余味 ]屋顶上燃起了火焰——而大多数建筑依然荒废着， [kiyoko.numKits 16|即使你有那么多兄弟姐妹， ]仅仅看到你的家着火了，就会让你的心里感到无比痛苦。 [flags.KINU_KILLER_QUARTERS |虽然大火仍在肆虐——矿物油的添加使得火势更加猛烈，而且火势已经蔓延得如此广泛，你根本不可能指望能够控制住它，更不用说将其扑灭了——但至少你[kiyoko.numKits 4 5 |确保朝雾的安全后，便让她朝着洞穴入口的方向离开了。 |确保你的兄弟姐妹们都安全无恙，然后让他们朝着洞穴入口的方向前进。 |你将彻底清理这一区域，确保这个巢穴的这一部分再也没有任何入侵者潜藏其中。不是无法容忍这种侵犯你家园的行为 ]是时候继续前进了。 |而当你意识到这一点时，你的心脏会猛地跳到喉咙里去[kiyoko.numKits 2 |你那个小小的侧屋[kiyoko.numKits 3 |兄弟姐妹同住 |姐姐住在那里。 ]它也着火了，火焰从木质、铺有瓷砖的屋顶上喷射而出，与此同时，灰烬也纷纷落向地面。 |你现在所处的这种境况的严重性。如果这只是发生在你的私人空间里……但是当那橙红色的光芒升上天空，灰烬纷纷落向你的时候，你才会突然意识到问题的严重性，这种冲击简直就像一块巨石砸在了你的身上。 ]就在那一刻，前行的方向变得清晰了：你必须这么做。 [kiyoko.numKits 2 |拯救你的家人。 |将入侵者全部击退，直到最后一个敌人也被消灭。 [kinu.isInari |死了。 |四散而去。 ] ] ]

rows.original: [kinu.isInari |No... not the fields. You had hoped that their spite would not extend this far, but it has. What these twisted monsters could not hope to steal, they have burned; why did you think the fields would be spared? You had drained the paddies ahead of the rice harvest, and now that is going up in flames, burning on the stalk. The daikon and turnips are trampled, the beans similarly aflame. For several seconds, you stare at the sight, dumbfounded, eyes glassy and mouth agape. And then you realize you are weeping. You, you can understand. [kiyoko.numKits 3|Your siblings|The den buildings], perhaps you can understand. But perhaps it is exactly because the crops are so small and insignificant in the scale of things that the sheer pettiness of these creatures' actions in destroying them truly bites home and sends every muscle in your body coiling and shaking with the fury of the earth itself. At this point, you don't want the invaders dead. You want to drain their bodies of every last drop of blood and water your fields with that so the next crop will grow extra well. As the old saying goes, the grass is always greener where bodies have fallen, after all... everything else be damned. You stand there for another few moments, gasping, heaving until the fit of madness passes and you're able to control your body again. Sometimes, even you scare yourself... |The invaders have been thorough — even the fields are ablaze. While you do not work them yourself — that task is left to [kiyoko.numKits 4|your siblings|the workers you loan from Matron Komari] — you can nevertheless appreciate the effort that went into the rice harvest and the roots, and to see the former burning on the stalk and the latter trampled makes your heart ache. Even so, better them than your family. Their sacrifice may have bought you just that extra bit of time — and you need all that you can get here. ] [flags.KINU_KILLER_FIELDS |This is about the lot of it all — you've swept all the important locations in the den and [kiyoko.numKits 3|made sure everyone's safe|cleared the place out as much as possible]. Since the torii gate isn't working, you'll have to head out the entrance and get help that way... |[flags.KINU_KILLER_ABODE |With the central buildings checked and cleared, you can take the time to move on outward. [kiyoko.numKits 3|Didn't Aya say your brother headed off in this direction to see what was going on? He's still missing, as far as you know...|Maybe some stragglers headed out into the fields... and you have to assess the damage to the sheds, anyway.] |You'll have to circle back to here eventually, but for now, you have more pressing business to deal with in other parts of the den, where more of these miscreants are likely to be. You'll need to continue with your sweep somewhere else, flush them out into the open before returning. ] ]
rows.translation: [kinu.isInari |不……不是那些田地。你原本希望他们的恶意不会蔓延到这个地步，但事实就是如此。那些变态的怪物连偷都偷不走的东西，他们竟然烧掉了；你为什么认为那些田地会幸免于难呢？你在水稻收割之前就已经把水田里的水排干了，现在那些田地正在燃烧，稻草也在一起被烧掉。白萝卜和芜菁被踩得稀烂，豆子也同样被碾得粉碎。有那么几秒钟，你呆呆地望着这一幕，目瞪口呆，双眼呆滞，嘴巴大张。 然后，你突然意识到自己正在哭泣。 你，你应该能理解的。 [kiyoko.numKits 3|你的兄弟姐妹|那些洞穴建筑]也许你能理解这一点。但恰恰因为这些作物在整体规模中显得如此微小、如此不起眼，才使得这种影响显得格外显著。琐事其中这些生物的摧毁它们的行动所带来的冲击力是如此强烈，以至于你全身的每一块肌肉都会因为大地的愤怒而剧烈颤抖。 在这个时候，你并不希望这些入侵者死去。你想要榨干他们体内的每一滴血液和水分，用这些养分浇灌你的田地，这样下一季的作物才能长得更加茂盛。正如那句老话所说，死者的坟墓上总会长出更绿的草……毕竟，其他的一切都无关紧要了。 你站在那里，喘着粗气，不停地颤抖，直到那种疯狂的情绪消退，你才能够重新控制自己的身体。有时候，就连你自己也会吓到自己…… |入侵者来势凶猛，连田野都燃起了大火。虽然你并不亲自去耕种这些土地——这项任务已经交给了别人。 [kiyoko.numKits 4|你的兄弟姐妹|你从麻里女首领那里借来的那些工人] — 尽管如此，你依然能够感受到人们为收割水稻所付出的努力，那些稻秆以及稻根……看到前者在火中燃烧，后者被践踏在脚下，还是会让人感到心痛。 但无论如何，他们总比你的家人要好。他们的牺牲或许为你争取到了那宝贵的时间——而在这里，你确实需要一切可能得到的帮助。 ] [flags.KINU_KILLER_FIELDS |这其实涉及到整个事情的来龙去脉——你已经搜查了巢穴里所有重要的地点，而且[kiyoko.numKits 3|确保每个人都安全无恙|把那个地方清理得尽可能干净]。 自从那以后鸟居大门无法使用，你们必须从入口处出去，然后去寻求帮助…… |[flags.KINU_KILLER_ABODE |一旦中央区域的建筑都检查完毕且没有问题，你就可以继续向外推进了。 [kiyoko.numKits 3|阿亚不是说你哥哥往这个方向去了，想去看看发生了什么吗？据你所知，他至今仍然失踪……|也许有些动物跑到了田野里……无论如何，你都必须检查那些棚屋受到了多大的损坏。] |你最终还是得回到这里来，但现在，你有更紧迫的事情要处理——那些坏蛋很可能还藏在洞穴的其他地方。你得去别的地方继续搜寻，把他们逼到开阔地带，然后再回来。 ] ]

rows.original: At least they haven't managed to damage the torii gate — not physically, at least. While the structure still stands, the portal won't activate no matter how many times you try; the telltale shimmer in the air between the gateposts gone. If the invaders have some way of rendering it useless, these aren't simple brigands, seeking mere plunder — killing you was not incidental to their goals, but the entire point of them being here in the first place. If they know how to do these things, then this is more than what you'd imagined — mere thieves don't know how to jam portals. Once you've made sure your home is clear[kiyoko.numKits 2| and everyone's safe], you have to go and get help. Whatever the bigger picture is here, this is clearly in and over your head.
rows.translation: 至少他们没有损坏鸟居——起码外形上没有。它仍然矗立着，但无论试多少次，传送门都无法启动；门柱间空气中原本可辨的微光已经消失。如果入侵者有办法让它失效，那他们就不是只图抢掠的普通强盗——杀死你并非顺带的目的，而是他们来这里的根本原因。如果他们懂得这些手段，事情就超出了你的想象——普通窃贼可不知道怎么阻断传送门。 确认家中已无敌人[kiyoko.numKits 2|、所有人都平安无事]后，你必须出去求援。无论这背后有什么更大的阴谋，显然都已超出你能应付的范围。

rows.original:
You don't even need to get close to figure out there's nothing left for you here. Given that there was plenty of fuel stored here, all that remains in a burnt-out husk of where the shed once stood, the main support beams the only parts of the old shed that still stand. rows.original:
Just a short ways from the Alraune's garden, the path finds its way back onto the old trade road and the base of a stone bridge fording a rushing river. It's surprisingly sturdy despite its apparent age, with only a few stones out of place. Most of the wear and tear has been repaired with newer work, leaving the surface of the bridge a checkerboard of differently-colored rock.

        On the northern side of the bridge, you can see the crumbling walls of an old wayfort. It likely collected taxes in days past; now it looks to be collecting dust. The south gate is open, at least.
rows.translation:
距离阿尔劳奈的花园仅有一段不长的距离，这条小路便重新汇入了那条古老的商道，最终通向一座横跨湍急河流的石桥桥基。尽管看起来已经很古老了，但这座桥却出奇地坚固，只有少数几块石头有些松动。大部分磨损部分都已经通过新的修复工作得到了处理，因此桥的表面现在呈现出由不同颜色岩石构成的棋盘状图案。

        在桥的北侧，你可以看到一座古老要塞的残垣断壁。它很可能在过去的几天里一直在征收税款；如今，它看起来已经被人遗忘了，落满了灰尘。不过，至少南门还是开着的。

rows.original: You stand beneath a solid stone arch, about 12 feet high, built into the wall of the old Wayfort on the river's edge. Everything you can see inside looks abandoned: crumbling walls and broken towers await you within, and the gate's portcullis has fallen in on itself, making it utterly useless for defending against the south.
rows.translation: 你站在一座高约12英尺的坚固石拱下，这座拱门是建在河岸边那座古老的荒废驿堡城堡的墙体内的。放眼望去，里面的景象一片荒废：摇摇欲坠的墙壁、破损的塔楼，一切都在等待你的到来。而大门上的吊闸已经坍塌，完全无法用来抵御来自南方的攻击。

A huge boulder lies smack in the center of it, where soldiers probably would have drilled in ages past. There looks to be a way into the main keep to the northeast, and back south lie the gates.
rows.translation: 荒废驿堡的主要区域呈扇形分布在你周围，地上遍布着某次古老围攻留下的残骸。在中心位置有一块巨大的巨石，想必在很久以前，士兵们应该在这里进行过训练。往东北方向似乎有一条通往主城堡的通道，而南边则是城门所在的位置。

rows.original: the western door out has been smashed to pieces and rendered impassable. There is a small eastern door near here, though, that leads into the servants' quarters.
rows.translation: 西边的门已经被砸得粉碎，无法通行了。不过，这里附近有一扇小东门，可以通往仆人们的住处。
rows.raw: " the western door out has been smashed to pieces and rendered impassable. There is a small eastern door near here, though, that leads into the servants' quarters.\n        \n        "

rows.original: The great wooden throne has been replaced, but
rows.raw: "The great wooden throne has been replaced, but"

rows.original: Your boreal elven bailiff is standing guard beside the throne. In her dark, dragon-patterned armor and with a two-handed sword at her side, she cuts quite the imposing figure indeed. Daliza can likely keep the roads safe and taxes flowing just by her intimidating demeanor alone. Royal men-at-arms come and go from her side every few minutes, reporting in off patrol or accepting new orders from their commander.
rows.translation: 你的北方精灵执法官正站在王座旁守卫。她身披带有龙纹的深色铠甲，身侧佩着一把双手剑，显得威风凛凛。单凭那股慑人的气势，达莉莎大概就足以维护道路安全，确保税款源源流入。每隔几分钟，就有皇家卫兵来到她身边，汇报巡逻情况或接受这位指挥官的新命令。
rows.raw: "Your boreal elven bailiff is standing guard beside the throne. In her dark, dragon-patterned armor and with a two-handed sword at her side, she cuts quite the imposing figure indeed. Daliza can likely keep the roads safe and taxes flowing just by her intimidating demeanor alone. Royal men-at-arms come and go from her side every few minutes, reporting in off patrol or accepting new orders from their commander."

rows.original: The kitchen that serves the main hall still holds a few empty barrels and rust-worn silverware. There's little of value here, and a particularly rank scent makes the idea of staying here much longer rather distressing.
rows.translation: 为大厅提供餐饮服务的厨房里，仍然摆放着几桶空桶和生锈的银器。这里几乎没有什么有价值的东西，而那种难闻的气味更是让人觉得继续待在这里会非常难受。
rows.raw: "\n        The kitchen that serves the main hall still holds a few empty barrels and rust-worn silverware. There's little of value here, and a particularly rank scent makes the idea of staying here much longer rather distressing."

rows.original: This part of the courtyard is dominated by the remnants of a statue, worn smooth over time and missing one of its arms. It depicts a lupine man holding a bearded axe aloft in triumph, clad in an armor that looks to be made of metal plates. A brooch hanging around his neck is set with a dark blue gemstone[flags.WAYSTONE_GARDEN| which glows faintly as you and your keystone approach]. Beyond it, twenty paces further west, is the crumbling remains of a stone watchtower. The upper floors still seem to be somewhat intact.
rows.translation: 庭院这一带最显眼的是一座残破雕像，岁月已将它磨得光滑，一条手臂也不见了。雕像是一名狼族男子，身穿看似由金属板构成的盔甲，胜利般高举着一柄胡须斧。他脖颈处的胸针镶着一颗深蓝色宝石[flags.WAYSTONE_GARDEN|，在你带着钥石靠近时微微发光]。再往西二十步，是一座崩塌的石制瞭望塔残骸，上面几层似乎还算完整。
rows.raw: "\n        This part of the courtyard is dominated by the remnants of a statue, worn smooth over time and missing one of its arms. It depicts a lupine man holding a bearded axe aloft in triumph, clad in an armor that looks to be made of metal plates. A brooch hanging around his neck is set with a dark blue gemstone[flags.WAYSTONE_GARDEN| which glows faintly as you and your keystone approach]. Beyond it, twenty paces further west, is the crumbling remains of a stone watchtower. The upper floors still seem to be somewhat intact."

rows.original: You stand at the foot of an ancient watchtower. Once part of the riverside fort, it stands apart now, and somewhat isolated. The walls and crenellations have seen better days, but the upper floors still seem to be intact. There's no sign of monstrous occupation, at least.
rows.translation: 你站在一座古老瞭望塔的脚下。这座塔曾经是河畔堡垒的一部分，如今却孤零零地矗立在那里，显得有些荒废。它的墙壁和雉堞早已失去了昔日的辉煌，但上层建筑似乎还完好无损。至少，没有任何迹象表明这里有怪物出没。
rows.raw: "\n        You stand at the foot of an ancient watchtower. Once part of the riverside fort, it stands apart now, and somewhat isolated. The walls and crenellations have seen better days, but the upper floors still seem to be intact. There's no sign of monstrous occupation, at least."

rows.original: The northern courtyard of the Wayfort once housed the stable and a well, but both structures have collapsed to little more than piles of rubble. The north gate is still in remarkably good condition.
rows.translation: 荒废驿堡庄园的北院曾经建有马厩和一口井，但现在这两处建筑都已经倒塌，只剩下了一堆堆的废墟。而北门却依然保存得相当完好。
rows.raw: "\n        The northern courtyard of the Wayfort once housed the stable and a well, but both structures have collapsed to little more than piles of rubble. The north gate is still in remarkably good condition."

rows.original: The north gate of the Wayfort leads out into another forest, much like that you passed through to get here... but you've noticed the temperature changing as you near the gate. It feels much colder here than back across the river, and it's only getting colder.
rows.translation: 荒废驿堡城的北门通向另一片森林，这片森林与你之前穿过来到这里的那一片非常相似……但你会注意到，当你靠近那座大门时，气温会发生变化。这里的天气比河对岸要冷得多，而且这种寒冷还在持续加剧。
rows.raw: "\n        The north gate of the Wayfort leads out into another forest, much like that you passed through to get here... but you've noticed the temperature changing as you near the gate. It feels much colder here than back across the river, and it's only getting colder."

rows.original:
You're just north of the old Wayfort now, all but standing in the shadows of the north gate, and even from this short a distance, you can feel a distinctive chill settling over you — every step northwards brings a more oppressive cold. This is unnatural...

        The remnants of the old dirt road crunches underfoot. Stones are few and far between, becoming scarcer the further north you look. How long has it been since someone maintained any of this?
rows.translation:
你现在位于老荒废驿堡以北，几乎已经站在北门的阴影之中了。即使是从这么近的距离，你也能感受到一种独特的寒意逐渐笼罩全身——每向北走一步，这种寒冷就会变得更加压抑。这种感觉实在很不自然……

        脚下的老土路发出嘎吱嘎吱的声响，石子也变得稀少起来，而且越往北走，石子就越难找到。究竟已经有多久没有人来维护这条路了？
rows.raw:
"
        You're just north of the old Wayfort now, all but standing in the shadows of the north gate, and even from this short a distance, you can feel a distinctive chill settling over you — every step northwards brings a more oppressive cold. This is unnatural...

        The remnants of the old dirt road crunches underfoot. Stones are few and far between, becoming scarcer the further north you look. How long has it been since someone maintained any of this?"

rows.original: The interior chamber is as ruined as the outside, a crumbling mess of old gray stone and thick vines. You can make out rotting chairs and a table inside, and stairs leading up that are missing half the steps. The fireplace opposite the door is dusted with ash and the carcass of a raccoon withered down to a skeleton.
rows.translation: 内部空间和外部一样破败不堪，一片由灰色旧石块和茂密藤蔓构成的废墟。里面可以看到腐烂的椅子和桌子，还有那些缺失了半数台阶的楼梯。门对面的壁炉上积满了灰烬，而一只浣熊的尸体也早已干枯成骨架。
rows.raw: "\n        The interior chamber is as ruined as the outside, a crumbling mess of old gray stone and thick vines. You can make out rotting chairs and a table inside, and stairs leading up that are missing half the steps. The fireplace opposite the door is dusted with ash and the carcass of a raccoon withered down to a skeleton."

rows.original:
Further in, the light from the canyon rapidly fades away into nothing. There were once torches on both walls to each side, but they have long since rotted away and the sconces to hold them rusted into shapeless, brownish lumps. Thankfully, the strange, eerie glow to the air persists — not immensely bright, but certainly enough for you to see a short distance comfortably. A fortunate — inasmuch as this whole situation can be fortunate — byproduct of the ruin's haunting, you suppose.

        The entrance hallway is littered with alcoves and eaves towards the rear — an easily defensible bottleneck in which any invader who managed to break down the portcullis could be countered, making any advance further into the fortress truly perilous. Unsurprisingly, there's not much in the way of decoration in this hallway, only yet more in the way of aged masonry and mortar.
        
        To the south, the gates from which you entered, to the north, the passageway widens. There's also a doorway to the east leading into a small, dark room.
rows.translation:
再往前走，峡谷中的光线迅速消失，陷入一片暗影。曾经在两侧的墙壁上都装有火把，但它们早已腐烂殆尽，而用来固定火把的支架也生锈变形，变成了毫无形状的棕色团块。幸运的是，空气中那种奇怪而诡异的光芒依然存在——虽然并不十分明亮，但足以让你在一定的距离内清晰地看到周围的环境。你可以认为，这是这场灾难带来的一个“幸运的副产品”；毕竟，在这种情况下，能有什么好事呢？

        入口处的走廊向后延伸，两侧分布着许多壁龛和屋檐结构——这些地方构成了天然的防御瓶颈。任何成功突破栅门的入侵者都会在这里遇到阻碍，继续向前推进进入堡垒将变得极其危险。毫不奇怪，这条走廊里几乎没有装饰，只有那些陈旧的砖石和灰浆罢了。
        
        向南望去，是你们进入时使用的那扇门；而向北走，通道会逐渐变宽。东边还有一扇门，通向一个狭小而昏暗的房间。
rows.raw:
"Further in, the light from the canyon rapidly fades away into nothing. There were once torches on both walls to each side, but they have long since rotted away and the sconces to hold them rusted into shapeless, brownish lumps. Thankfully, the strange, eerie glow to the air persists — not immensely bright, but certainly enough for you to see a short distance comfortably. A fortunate — inasmuch as this whole situation can be fortunate — byproduct of the ruin's haunting, you suppose.

        The entrance hallway is littered with alcoves and eaves towards the rear — an easily defensible bottleneck in which any invader who managed to break down the portcullis could be countered, making any advance further into the fortress truly perilous. Unsurprisingly, there's not much in the way of decoration in this hallway, only yet more in the way of aged masonry and mortar.
        
        To the south, the gates from which you entered, to the north, the passageway widens. There's also a doorway to the east leading into a small, dark room.
        "

rows.original:
This hallway is plain and bare, but caked with dust. It covers the floor, coats the walls, and has found its way into the cracks between the mortar. Unsurprisingly, the air is musty and dead still, and you can clearly see the trail that you're leaving in the grit here.

        Yeah, it's probably not a good idea to linger overlong here. Even if there weren't vengeful ghosts wandering the halls, the stale air would probably do you in. It's already getting a little hard to breathe... 
        
        The hallway stretches both east and west from here.
rows.translation:
这条走廊简陋而空荡，上面积满了灰尘。灰尘覆盖了地面，粘在墙壁上，甚至渗进了灰泥的裂缝中。毫不奇怪，这里的空气充满了霉味，一片死寂，而你走动时留下的痕迹在灰尘中清晰可见。

        是啊，在这里待太久恐怕不是个好主意。即使没有复仇的鬼魂在走廊里游荡，这种闷热的空气也会让人难受不堪……呼吸都已经有点困难了……
        
        这条走廊从这里向东西两侧延伸开来。
rows.raw:
"This hallway is plain and bare, but caked with dust. It covers the floor, coats the walls, and has found its way into the cracks between the mortar. Unsurprisingly, the air is musty and dead still, and you can clearly see the trail that you're leaving in the grit here.

        Yeah, it's probably not a good idea to linger overlong here. Even if there weren't vengeful ghosts wandering the halls, the stale air would probably do you in. It's already getting a little hard to breathe... 
        
        The hallway stretches both east and west from here.
        "

rows.original:
This indoor quadrangle forms the heart of the old fort, a large chunk of empty space easily big enough for everyone garrisoned within to muster. By some miracle, the landslide which buried the entire place stopped at the high windows — they might be blocked by tons upon tons of dirt and rock, but the grounds are mostly clear save for several piles of rubble strewn about the floor. 

        The air is almost completely still; there's nary a rat or beetle to break the silence. Exits stretch out in all four cardinal directions, leaving you to decide your next move.
rows.translation:
这个室内庭院构成了这座古老堡垒的核心区域，这片宽敞的空地足以让驻守在此的所有人员聚集在一起。奇迹般的是，那场导致整个地区被掩埋的山体滑坡在那些高大的窗户前停住了——虽然这些窗户可能被成吨的泥土和岩石堵住了，但地面大部分区域都是畅通的，只有几堆碎石散落在地上。 

        空气几乎完全静止，连一只老鼠或一只甲虫都没有，没有任何东西能够打破这份寂静。四个方向都通向出口，接下来该往哪个方向走，完全由你来决定。
rows.raw:
"This indoor quadrangle forms the heart of the old fort, a large chunk of empty space easily big enough for everyone garrisoned within to muster. By some miracle, the landslide which buried the entire place stopped at the high windows — they might be blocked by tons upon tons of dirt and rock, but the grounds are mostly clear save for several piles of rubble strewn about the floor. 

        The air is almost completely still; there's nary a rat or beetle to break the silence. Exits stretch out in all four cardinal directions, leaving you to decide your next move.
        "

rows.original: The eastern hallway leading away from the fortress' heart is in a state of advanced disrepair, even moreso than the rest of the place. It appears that the wraiths' landslide truly did a number on this hallway, for some reason — half of the northern wall is buckled inward, spilling enough stone bricks and dirt to fill half the hallway's width and block any hope of an easy passage. Considering that the original hallway was wide enough for five or six people to march abreast, you can still squeeze through, but it becomes a little claustrophobic at points where the rubble is thickest. The roof itself hasn't fared much better. The mortar is cracked, and in the dim, eerie light you spy a couple of root tips peering through the rents in the masonry. There's a distinct draft flowing down the hallway's length — where is that coming from, when you must be so deep underground? — and it nips at your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] with sharp little teeth of frost, reminding you of the cold tomb this place has become. You shiver and press on.
rows.translation: 从堡垒核心区域延伸出来的东侧走廊，其损毁程度比堡垒的其他部分更为严重。显然，那些幽灵引发的山体滑坡对这条走廊造成了极大的破坏——北侧墙壁有一半已经向内凹陷，大量的石块和泥土堆积在走廊中，几乎占据了整个走廊的宽度，彻底阻断了任何通行的可能。考虑到原来的走廊宽度足以让五六个行人并排通过，现在你们仍然可以勉强通过，但在那些碎石堆积最厚的地方，会让人感到有些压抑、空间狭窄。 至于屋顶本身，情况也好不到哪里去。灰泥已经开裂了，在那昏暗而诡异的光线中，你可以看到有几根根须正从裂缝中探出来。有一股明显的寒风沿着走廊的方向吹着——就在那里是这声音究竟是从哪里传来的？你肯定是在地底下很深的地方吧？——而且这个声音还在不断地刺激着你[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]那些被霜冻冻得尖锐的小齿，让人不禁联想到这个地方已然变成了一座冰冷的坟墓。 你不禁打了个寒颤，但还是继续向前走去。
rows.raw: "The eastern hallway leading away from the fortress' heart is in a state of advanced disrepair, even moreso than the rest of the place. It appears that the wraiths' landslide truly did a number on this hallway, for some reason — half of the northern wall is buckled inward, spilling enough stone bricks and dirt to fill half the hallway's width and block any hope of an easy passage. Considering that the original hallway was wide enough for five or six people to march abreast, you can still squeeze through, but it becomes a little claustrophobic at points where the rubble is thickest. The roof itself hasn't fared much better. The mortar is cracked, and in the dim, eerie light you spy a couple of root tips peering through the rents in the masonry. There's a distinct draft flowing down the hallway's length — where is that coming from, when you must be so deep underground? — and it nips at your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] with sharp little teeth of frost, reminding you of the cold tomb this place has become. You shiver and press on. "

rows.original:
For some reason, the eerie glow in this corridor is completely snuffed out, plunging you into complete and utter darkness. You're forced to carefully hug the walls to find your way around, inching along while you feel your way through the inky blackness. The masonry is not completely unpleasant to the touch, even if it is a bit dusty; you suppose that your main complaint would be that your fingertips are getting numb. It certainly beats some of the other things which could be happening to you right now.

        Faint whispers sound in your hearing, seemingly but inches from your ears, but when you reach for where you think the speaker is, your fingers close in upon empty air.
        
        Thankfully, the corridor seems to be more or less straight in a north-south direction, but it's not good to leave things to chance. Who knows what might be hidden in this darkness...
rows.translation:
不知为何，这条走廊里那种诡异的荧光彻底消失了，让你陷入了彻底的黑暗之中。你不得不小心翼翼地紧贴着墙壁前行，在这种漆黑的环境中摸索着前进。这种砖石材质摸起来其实并不完全令人不适，虽然会带些灰尘；不过你可能会觉得最麻烦的是手指尖会因此变得麻木。不过，相比现在可能发生的其他一些情况来说，这已经算是比较好的了。

        你耳边传来微弱的低语声，似乎就在离你的耳朵几英寸的地方，但当你试图去触摸那些声音似乎发出的地方时，你的手指却只抓到了空空气。
        
        幸运的是，这条走廊大致上是呈南北走向的，直线延伸，但也不能掉以轻心。谁知道在这片黑暗中隐藏着什么……
rows.raw:
"For some reason, the eerie glow in this corridor is completely snuffed out, plunging you into complete and utter darkness. You're forced to carefully hug the walls to find your way around, inching along while you feel your way through the inky blackness. The masonry is not completely unpleasant to the touch, even if it is a bit dusty; you suppose that your main complaint would be that your fingertips are getting numb. It certainly beats some of the other things which could be happening to you right now.

        Faint whispers sound in your hearing, seemingly but inches from your ears, but when you reach for where you think the speaker is, your fingers close in upon empty air.
        
        Thankfully, the corridor seems to be more or less straight in a north-south direction, but it's not good to leave things to chance. Who knows what might be hidden in this darkness...
        "

rows.original:
You're standing in what appears to be part of a large storeroom. The door that connects the room to the southern hallway — well, there are indeed signs that such a thing might have existed at some point in time, considering the doorway and hinges, but it must have collapsed away long before your arrival.

        The way the lupines stored perishables is interesting, to say the least. The northern and western walls are filled with arrays upon arrays of basins, a smaller one within a larger one, with some space in between. Peering into one of the outer basins reveals a slot near the rim for channeling water in, and another near the bottom for draining water out — presumably goods were stored in the inner basin and then sealed, and the outer basin circulated with ice-cold water to keep the goods chilled.
        
        Ingenious. Not perfect, but ingenious all the same. Too bad the landslide must've cut off the channels which supplied fresh snowmelt to the basins, for all of them are bone dry.
        
        What space which isn't occupied by the basins might have once been a gigantic cellar, judging by the huge heaps of rotted dust piled against the walls. Grain? Root vegetables? Who can tell for sure?
        
        Two exits lie before you: the darkened hallway to the south, and another section of the stores to the east.
rows.translation:
你现在站在一个看起来像是大型储藏室的一部分的地方。那扇将这个房间与南侧走廊连接起来的门——嗯，从门框和铰链来看，确实有迹象表明这扇门在过去的某个时候存在过，但它肯定是在你到来之前就已经坍塌了。

        至少可以说，这些狼族储存易腐物品的方式确实相当有趣。房屋的北墙和西墙上排列着一排排盆子，小的盆子放在大的盆子里面，中间还留有空隙。仔细观察那些外层的盆子，会发现盆边有用于引入水液的槽口，而盆底则有用于排出水的槽口——想必是先将货物存放在内层的盆中，然后进行密封处理，而外层的盆则用来循环流动冰冷水，以此保持货物的低温状态。
        
        真是巧妙。虽然并不完美，但确实很巧妙。可惜那场山体滑坡肯定切断了为这些流域输送新鲜融雪的水源，否则这些流域现在应该不会干得如此彻底。
        
        从那些堆积在墙边的大量腐烂灰尘来看，那些没有被这些流域占据的空间，很可能曾经是一个巨大的地窖。谷物？根茎类蔬菜？谁又能说得准呢？
        
        目前你面前有两条路可供选择：向南走，进入昏暗的走廊；或者向东走，继续探索商店的其他区域。

The door that connects the room to the southern hallway — well, there are indeed signs that such a thing might have existed at some point in time, considering the doorway and hinges, but it must have collapsed away long before your arrival.
