rows.original:
This part of the stores appears to have been dedicated to more durable goods — tools, spare parts, utensils, and everyday goods of such stature. In lieu of shelves, the lupines took to carving out cubby-holes in the walls in which implements were stored. 

        Naturally, there's nothing substantial left of the lot — you do spot some odds and ends as you pass by — a rusted hunk of metal, what might once have been a shovel blade, the remains of a bucket, collapsed into a neat little heap. Of such little notes is built the creeping realization of one's own mortality.
        
        Exits from this room stretch out to the east and west.
rows.translation:
商店的这一区域似乎专门用来存放那些更为耐用的商品——工具、零部件、器具，以及各种日常用品。由于没有架子，人们便在墙壁上开凿出小洞来存放这些物品。 

        当然，那些东西已经没有什么有价值的了——当你经过时，只会看到一些零零碎碎的残骸：一块生锈的金属片，或许曾经是一把铲子的刀刃；一个桶的残余部分，塌陷成了一小堆。正是通过这些微小的细节，人们才会逐渐意识到自己的渺小与生命的短暂。
        
        这个房间的出口分别通往东方和西方。
rows.raw:
"This part of the stores appears to have been dedicated to more durable goods — tools, spare parts, utensils, and everyday goods of such stature. In lieu of shelves, the lupines took to carving out cubby-holes in the walls in which implements were stored. 

        Naturally, there's nothing substantial left of the lot — you do spot some odds and ends as you pass by — a rusted hunk of metal, what might once have been a shovel blade, the remains of a bucket, collapsed into a neat little heap. Of such little notes is built the creeping realization of one's own mortality.
        
        Exits from this room stretch out to the east and west.
        "

rows.original:
The northwestern section of the ramparts corridor houses some kind of cylindrical shaft that sinks into the masonry floor and into the ground below — from where you are, you're guessing that the bottom of the shaft would open up somewhere in the fortress' stores. There's a large screw mechanism, some gears, and a crank that looks wide enough for two or three people to comfortably stand astride and turn it together... 

        Knowing where the other end of this contraption probably ends up, it's not too unlikely that this is a lift of some sort, designed to bring weighty and bulky materials up to the fortress' second floor in the most expedient manner possible. It certainly beats having people carry stuff up the stairs, that's for sure.
        
        The entire mechanism is completely inoperable at this point, rendering the whole thing moot — but even so, the knowledge that people two hundred and fifty years ago had the ingenuity to come up with such a thing is enlightening, at the very least.
        
        From here, the passageway stretches out to the east and south.
rows.translation:
城墙走廊的西北部设有某种圆柱形的通道，这种通道一直延伸到砖石地面之下，再深入地底。从你现在的位置来看，可以推测这个通道的尽头应该位于堡垒的储藏区某处。这里有一个大型螺旋装置、一些齿轮，以及一个看起来足够宽大的曲柄，足以让两三个人站在上面一起转动它……

        考虑到这个装置的另一端很可能连接在什么地方，很有可能这是一种升降装置，其设计目的就是以最快捷的方式将那些沉重且体积庞大的材料运送到堡垒的二楼。这总比让人们把东西搬上楼梯要好得多，这一点是肯定的。
        
        不过，目前整个装置已经完全无法使用了，因此这个设计也就失去了实际意义——但即便如此，了解到250年前的人们竟然有这样的创造力，能够设计出这样的东西，至少也是很有启发意义的。
        
        从这里开始，通道向东西两侧延伸开来。
rows.raw:
"The northwestern section of the ramparts corridor houses some kind of cylindrical shaft that sinks into the masonry floor and into the ground below — from where you are, you're guessing that the bottom of the shaft would open up somewhere in the fortress' stores. There's a large screw mechanism, some gears, and a crank that looks wide enough for two or three people to comfortably stand astride and turn it together... 

        Knowing where the other end of this contraption probably ends up, it's not too unlikely that this is a lift of some sort, designed to bring weighty and bulky materials up to the fortress' second floor in the most expedient manner possible. It certainly beats having people carry stuff up the stairs, that's for sure.
        
        The entire mechanism is completely inoperable at this point, rendering the whole thing moot — but even so, the knowledge that people two hundred and fifty years ago had the ingenuity to come up with such a thing is enlightening, at the very least.
        
        From here, the passageway stretches out to the east and south.
        "

rows.original:
Opening out onto this landing, the door from the stairwell to the south creaks softly in the draft that runs down the corridor's length, sounding appropriately ominous in the eerie, eldritch light that suffuses the air. To the north, an archway flanked by two plinths which once held decorative suits of armor — you spy a badly decayed gauntlet lying at the foot of the left one, barely recognizable as such. 

        To the east and west, more corridor, punctuated by juts and hooks for yet more banners and tapestries. This place may have been no palace, but it seems like the lupines tried to give the fort's second floor a more human touch, for lack of a better word to describe it. Gray stone in and out every day must be terrible for morale.
        
        You spy several doorways set into the walls, but those have been sealed off by huge chunks of fallen rubble, rendering them impassable. Guess you're not going to be able to conduct a room-by-room search.
rows.translation:
通往这个平台的门口，连接楼梯井与南侧的那一扇门，在走廊中穿行的微风中轻轻发出吱嘎声，在这种弥漫在空气中的诡异、阴森的光线中，这种声音显得格外不祥。在北侧，有一座拱门，两侧各有一块基座，那些基座上曾经摆放着装饰性的盔甲——你会看到在左侧基座的脚下，有一只严重腐烂的手套，几乎已经无法辨认它的本来面目了。 

        东西两侧都是走廊，走廊中分布着各种突起和钩状结构，用于悬挂更多的旗帜和挂毯。虽然这个地方可能并不是一座宫殿，但可以这么说，那些建造者显然试图让堡垒的二楼显得更加人性化一些——实在找不到更好的词语来形容了。每天都在灰色的废墟中穿梭，这对士气来说肯定是个巨大的打击。
        
        你在墙壁上看到了几处门洞，但那些地方都被巨大的碎石堵住了，根本无法通行。看来你没办法一间一间地搜查了。
rows.raw:
"Opening out onto this landing, the door from the stairwell to the south creaks softly in the draft that runs down the corridor's length, sounding appropriately ominous in the eerie, eldritch light that suffuses the air. To the north, an archway flanked by two plinths which once held decorative suits of armor — you spy a badly decayed gauntlet lying at the foot of the left one, barely recognizable as such. 

        To the east and west, more corridor, punctuated by juts and hooks for yet more banners and tapestries. This place may have been no palace, but it seems like the lupines tried to give the fort's second floor a more human touch, for lack of a better word to describe it. Gray stone in and out every day must be terrible for morale.
        
        You spy several doorways set into the walls, but those have been sealed off by huge chunks of fallen rubble, rendering them impassable. Guess you're not going to be able to conduct a room-by-room search.
        "

rows.original:
A section of the corridors which stretch on outward from Fort Marrok's ramparts. This northeastern section used to have several rooms leading on out from it, but the doorways have collapsed in upon themselves and have been rendered impassable. With how broad it is, it looks like it was a commonly patrolled area, and the large mounds of rust on the walls that used to be torch sconces speak of such tales.

        The corridor stretches outwards to the west and south, the darkness beckoning equally in both directions.
rows.translation:
从马罗克堡垒的城墙向外延伸的走廊中有一段。这一段位于东北方向，原本有几间房间通向外面，但那些门已经坍塌，因此现在无法通行了。这条走廊非常宽阔，看起来应该是人们经常巡逻的区域。墙壁上那些厚厚的铁锈痕迹，曾经是火把架的位置，这些都在诉说着过去发生的故事。

        走廊向西和向南延伸开来，两边的黑暗同样令人望而却步。
rows.raw:
"A section of the corridors which stretch on outward from Fort Marrok's ramparts. This northeastern section used to have several rooms leading on out from it, but the doorways have collapsed in upon themselves and have been rendered impassable. With how broad it is, it looks like it was a commonly patrolled area, and the large mounds of rust on the walls that used to be torch sconces speak of such tales.

        The corridor stretches outwards to the west and south, the darkness beckoning equally in both directions.
        "

rows.original:
This section of the ramparts is distinctly damp and humid — upon closer inspection, you realize that if you stand perfectly still, you can hear the steady drip-drip-drip of water somewhere behind the walls. A small puddle has collected on the eastern side of the corridor, and you carefully step around it before making your way onward.

        Surprising, perhaps, but not out of place when you think about it. Any good holdout location needs its own source of fresh water, and the wraiths' landslide must've done a number on the local water flows and table... 
        
        Pushing that thought out of your mind, you soldier on. The corridor stretches to the north and south, and there's an archway to the west that opens out into a room.
rows.translation:
这段城墙明显潮湿阴冷——仔细观察后，你会发现，如果你站在那里一动不动，就能听到墙壁后面有水滴不断滴落的声音。走廊的东侧已经积了一小滩水，你小心翼翼地绕过它，继续前行。

        或许会让人感到意外，但仔细想想的话，这也并不奇怪。任何理想的据点地点都需要有自己的淡水来源，而那些幽灵引发的山体滑坡肯定对当地的水流和地下水系统造成了严重的破坏…… 
        
        把这个念头从脑海中赶走，你继续前行。走廊向南北两侧延伸，而在西侧有一道拱门，通向一个房间。
rows.raw:
"This section of the ramparts is distinctly damp and humid — upon closer inspection, you realize that if you stand perfectly still, you can hear the steady drip-drip-drip of water somewhere behind the walls. A small puddle has collected on the eastern side of the corridor, and you carefully step around it before making your way onward.

        Surprising, perhaps, but not out of place when you think about it. Any good holdout location needs its own source of fresh water, and the wraiths' landslide must've done a number on the local water flows and table... 
        
        Pushing that thought out of your mind, you soldier on. The corridor stretches to the north and south, and there's an archway to the west that opens out into a room.
        "

rows.original:
This section of corridor stretching away from the eastern ramparts appears to be in better condition than most of the fort — if only marginally so. Perhaps it's because this looks to be a newer addition to the fort, compared to the rest of the place — the rock bricks that form the masonry walls are of a different size and shape, the mortar less crumbled. Presumably, the lupines hollowed out this section when they realized they needed a little more space, or realized that a single corridor joining the ramparts to the rest of the fort was quite the silly architectural decision.

        After all, a hole with only one entrance is known as a trap.
        
        Your path stretches out to the north and south, but there's also a doorway to the east that harbors some sort of room beyond it. Hmm...
rows.translation:
这段从东侧城墙延伸出去的走廊，看起来比堡垒的大部分区域都要完好一些——尽管这种完好也只是相对而言而已。也许是因为这段走廊是堡垒中较新修建的部分，与堡垒的其他区域相比，用来建造墙壁的石砖尺寸和形状都不同，砂浆也几乎没有风化。可以推测，当这些狼族意识到自己需要更多的空间时，或者当它们发现用一条单一的走廊将城墙与堡垒的其他部分连接起来其实是一个相当愚蠢的建筑设计时，它们才挖出了这一段通道。

        毕竟，只有一个入口的洞穴其实就是个陷阱。
        
        你的道路向南北方向延伸，但东边也有一扇门，门后似乎有某个房间。嗯……
rows.raw:
"This section of corridor stretching away from the eastern ramparts appears to be in better condition than most of the fort — if only marginally so. Perhaps it's because this looks to be a newer addition to the fort, compared to the rest of the place — the rock bricks that form the masonry walls are of a different size and shape, the mortar less crumbled. Presumably, the lupines hollowed out this section when they realized they needed a little more space, or realized that a single corridor joining the ramparts to the rest of the fort was quite the silly architectural decision.

        After all, a hole with only one entrance is known as a trap.
        
        Your path stretches out to the north and south, but there's also a doorway to the east that harbors some sort of room beyond it. Hmm... 
        "

rows.original:
This section of the ramparts proper would have once looked over the entrance to the fortress; now, it is cold and buried. A number of grated windows are set into the wall, their shutters fallen off, the grates rusted and corroded; slits for archers to fire through lie interspersed between the windows, now rendered useless beneath the lightless earth. A number of cauldrons sit in holders, and sluices open out onto just directly over the gates; ah, the wonders of boiling oil.

        No doubt this was once the center of bustling activity; now, it lies abandoned. Did the defenders panic when the fortress was buried? Did they stoically accept their fate? Did they keep hope until the last breath of air, or prefer suicide to such an ignoble death?
        
        Perhaps there will be answers for you. Perhaps not.
        
        The ramparts stretch away to the north and west.
rows.translation:
这段城墙原本应该是用来俯瞰要塞入口的；如今，它早已变得冰冷而埋藏在泥土之下。墙上开有一些带栅栏的窗户，窗扇早已脱落，栅栏也锈迹斑斑、腐朽不堪；在窗户之间，还分布着供弓箭手射击的缝隙，但在这片不见天日的泥土之下，这些设施早已失去了作用。许多大锅被安置在专门的支架上，排水管道直接通向城门正上方；啊，煮沸的油真是令人惊叹。

        毫无疑问，这里曾经是热闹繁忙的活动中心；如今，却已变得荒废不堪。当堡垒被埋没时，守卫们一定是惊慌失措了吧？他们是默默地接受了自己的命运吗？还是直到最后一刻都怀揣着希望，还是宁愿选择自杀也不愿遭受如此耻辱的死亡？
        
        也许会有一些答案能解答你的疑问。也许也不会。
        
        城墙向北和向西延伸开来。
rows.raw:
"This section of the ramparts proper would have once looked over the entrance to the fortress; now, it is cold and buried. A number of grated windows are set into the wall, their shutters fallen off, the grates rusted and corroded; slits for archers to fire through lie interspersed between the windows, now rendered useless beneath the lightless earth. A number of cauldrons sit in holders, and sluices open out onto just directly over the gates; ah, the wonders of boiling oil.

        No doubt this was once the center of bustling activity; now, it lies abandoned. Did the defenders panic when the fortress was buried? Did they stoically accept their fate? Did they keep hope until the last breath of air, or prefer suicide to such an ignoble death?
        
        Perhaps there will be answers for you. Perhaps not.
        
        The ramparts stretch away to the north and west.
        "

rows.original:
This section of the ramparts appears to be a small break area where those on guard could catch a breather and refresh themselves. Small heaps of dust lie where furniture might have once stood, and a large stone basin and accompanying fountain have been set into a wall. Bits of old earthenware lie smashed on the ground, remnants of mugs and small plates, dropped in haste. 

        The walls are decorated with old swords and shields — now corroded into oblivion, of course, but they look as if they were likely to be functional in their day. To the south, a set of stairs stretch out up and away into yet a third floor of the fortress — they look appropriately ominous and foreboding. 
        
        The corridor stretches out to the east and west, but there are always the stairs to consider...
rows.translation:
这段城墙似乎被设计成了一个小休息区，守卫们可以在这里稍作休息、恢复精力。那些曾经摆放着家具的地方现在积满了灰尘，而一個巨大的石制水池以及配套的喷泉则被嵌入到了墙体中。地上散落着一些破碎的旧陶器残片，那些应该是匆忙丢弃的杯子和小盘子的残余。

        墙壁上挂满了古老的剑和盾牌——当然，如今它们都已经锈迹斑斑，几乎无法辨认了，但看上去，在它们诞生的时代，这些武器和盾牌肯定是能够发挥作用的。向南，一段楼梯延伸向上，通向堡垒的第三层——那些楼梯看起来确实充满了不祥与阴森的气氛。
        
        走廊向东西两侧延伸，但无论如何，那些楼梯始终是必须考虑的因素……
rows.raw:
"This section of the ramparts appears to be a small break area where those on guard could catch a breather and refresh themselves. Small heaps of dust lie where furniture might have once stood, and a large stone basin and accompanying fountain have been set into a wall. Bits of old earthenware lie smashed on the ground, remnants of mugs and small plates, dropped in haste. 

        The walls are decorated with old swords and shields — now corroded into oblivion, of course, but they look as if they were likely to be functional in their day. To the south, a set of stairs stretch out up and away into yet a third floor of the fortress — they look appropriately ominous and foreboding. 
        
        The corridor stretches out to the east and west, but there are always the stairs to consider...
        "

rows.original:
The southeastern corner of the ramparts is large and spacious, and the reason for such becomes readily apparent: the remains of two large ballistae lie in ruins and rot across the flagstones. There're some barred gates to the south which would presumably have let them out into the open where they could have been used, but it seems like the lupines never managed to get them into action before they were buried alive. 

        Now, the gates are hopelessly crushed, having buckled inwards from the sheer weight of cold earth and stone, and the siege engines will never see the light of day. The metal head of a massive harpoon lies in the rubble, perhaps a desperate attempt by the wolves to pierce their way through to freedom, but their efforts did not avail them.
        
        There's nothing else of interest in this corner of the ramparts, and you doubt any surprises are going to happen upon you if you wait here — pleasant ones, at any rate. You could leave in either a westerly or northerly direction.
rows.translation:
城墙的东南角面积宽敞开阔，其原因一目了然：两座大型投石机的残骸就躺在碎石堆中，早已腐朽不堪。南侧还有一些带栅栏的大门，这些大门本应可以让人将这些投石机运到开阔地带以便使用，但看来那些负责操作这些机器的人在它们被活埋之前，根本就没有机会将它们投入使用。 

        如今，那些大门早已被压得粉碎，它们在冰冷的土地和石块的巨大压力下向内弯曲变形，那些攻城器械也永远无法再见到天日了。在一堆废墟中，有一把巨大的鱼叉的金属头部——或许那些狼群曾试图用它来突破重围，获得自由，但他们的努力终究没有成功。
        
        在城墙的这个角落，再没有什么值得关注的地方了。如果你在这里等待，应该也不会遇到什么意外——至少不会是令人愉快的意外。你可以向西或向北方向离开。
rows.raw:
"The southeastern corner of the ramparts is large and spacious, and the reason for such becomes readily apparent: the remains of two large ballistae lie in ruins and rot across the flagstones. There're some barred gates to the south which would presumably have let them out into the open where they could have been used, but it seems like the lupines never managed to get them into action before they were buried alive. 

        Now, the gates are hopelessly crushed, having buckled inwards from the sheer weight of cold earth and stone, and the siege engines will never see the light of day. The metal head of a massive harpoon lies in the rubble, perhaps a desperate attempt by the wolves to pierce their way through to freedom, but their efforts did not avail them.
        
        There's nothing else of interest in this corner of the ramparts, and you doubt any surprises are going to happen upon you if you wait here — pleasant ones, at any rate. You could leave in either a westerly or northerly direction.
        "

rows.original:
The grotto behind the waterfall doesn't stretch on for too long. It's been perhaps a five-minute walk through the darkness before you find yourself here: near the foot of the mountain on a rocky trail. Given that the Greyvale Ranges are riddled all over with gullies and ravines, the presence of a hidden trail isn't too out of the ordinary... although how Tollus knew to direct his goons here is another matter altogether.

        It doesn't matter. Now that you're here, there's no turning back, not when it's a race between you and Tollus's goons to get... whatever it is Sanders wants.
rows.translation:
瀑布后面的洞穴并不很长。在黑暗中行走大约五分钟后，你就会来到这里：位于山脚处的一条岩石小路上。考虑到灰谷山脉到处都是沟壑和峡谷，因此存在这样一条隐蔽的小路其实也并不奇怪。……不过，托勒斯究竟是怎么知道该派他的打手们来到这里的，这又是另一个问题了。

        没关系。既然你已经来了，就再也没有回头路了——尤其是当你和托勒斯的打手们正在争夺……不管桑德斯到底想要什么东西的时候。
rows.raw: "The grotto behind the waterfall doesn't stretch on for too long. It's been perhaps a five-minute walk through the darkness before you find yourself here: near the foot of the mountain on a rocky trail. Given that the Greyvale Ranges are riddled all over with gullies and ravines, the presence of a hidden trail isn't too out of the ordinary... although how Tollus knew to direct his goons here is another matter altogether.\n\n        It doesn't matter. Now that you're here, there's no turning back, not when it's a race between you and Tollus's goons to get... whatever it is Sanders wants."

rows.original: Even right at the beginning, the ascent is arduous. Even as the path spirals and winds around rocky cliff faces and skirts past dangerous-looking outcroppings, it readily becomes apparent that things are going to get even harder from here on out. Small scrubby bushes and flowers cling to existence in the dry cold, the only way up the mountain being away from the waterfall grotto and to the west.
rows.translation: 甚至从一开始，这段攀登之路就异常艰难。当道路蜿蜒曲折地绕过岩石峭壁，从那些看起来十分危险的岩层旁穿过时，人们很快就会意识到，从现在开始，情况会变得更加棘手。在干燥寒冷的环境中，一些低矮的灌木和花朵艰难地生存着，而通往山顶的唯一路径，却是远离瀑布洞穴、向西延伸的方向。
rows.raw: "Even right at the beginning, the ascent is arduous. Even as the path spirals and winds around rocky cliff faces and skirts past dangerous-looking outcroppings, it readily becomes apparent that things are going to get even harder from here on out. Small scrubby bushes and flowers cling to existence in the dry cold, the only way up the mountain being away from the waterfall grotto and to the west."

rows.original: Here, one finds oneself at a fork in the trail — a particularly treacherous climb directly to the north, with a side trail that continues to the west. The natural erosion of the mountainside has seen fit to carve natural steps of sorts into the trail, making the going marginally easier; trickles of water seep down the sheer face to the south and vanish into the hard-packed, pebbly dirt. Lichens are the only plant life in this section of the pass, clinging tenaciously to any foothold they can find on the rock; you don't know if it's Tollus's goons or just their natural appearance, but they look decidedly unhealthy.
rows.translation: 在这里，人们会遇到一条分岔的小路——直接向北走是一条特别危险的上坡路，而另一条小路则向西延伸。山体的自然侵蚀在路面上形成了一些天然的台阶，使得攀登变得稍微容易一些；一些细流从南面的陡峭山坡上流淌下来，最终消失在那些被压实、布满鹅卵石的泥土中。在这片山隘地带，地衣是唯一的植物形态，它们紧紧地附着在岩石上，抓住一切可以依附的缝隙生存；你不知道这些地衣究竟是托勒斯的爪牙们造成的破坏，还是它们本来就这种模样，但无论如何，它们看起来确实非常不健康。
rows.raw: "Here, one finds oneself at a fork in the trail — a particularly treacherous climb directly to the north, with a side trail that continues to the west. The natural erosion of the mountainside has seen fit to carve natural steps of sorts into the trail, making the going marginally easier; trickles of water seep down the sheer face to the south and vanish into the hard-packed, pebbly dirt. Lichens are the only plant life in this section of the pass, clinging tenaciously to any foothold they can find on the rock; you don't know if it's Tollus's goons or just their natural appearance, but they look decidedly unhealthy."

rows.original:
The westward trail ends here in a small, sheltered grove of scraggly looking trees, their roots dipping into a small pool in their center. Scraggly scrub and grasses have conspired to put together a thin layer of sandy topsoil, which in this mountain ravine is something in and of itself. Looks like the cultists haven't bothered with this place just yet, instead doing... whatever they're doing further north along the trail.

        Most of the walls here are too smooth to climb, but you spy on the western walls enough handholds that it might be possible to gain some kind of height advantage over the cultists entrenched in the pass...
rows.translation:
这条向西延伸的小路在这里结束，尽头是一片由杂乱树木组成的小树林，这些树木的根系延伸到中央的一个小水洼中。杂乱的灌木和草丛共同形成了一层薄薄的沙质表土，在这个山间峡谷里，这层表土本身就已经是一处独特的景观了。看起来那些邪教徒目前还没有注意到这个地方，他们应该是在小路的更北段忙着……做他们正在做的事情吧。

        这里的墙壁大多过于光滑，无法攀爬，但在西侧的墙壁上有一些手抓处，利用这些手抓处或许能够获得一定的高度优势，从而对付那些盘踞在山口处的邪教徒……
rows.raw: "The westward trail ends here in a small, sheltered grove of scraggly looking trees, their roots dipping into a small pool in their center. Scraggly scrub and grasses have conspired to put together a thin layer of sandy topsoil, which in this mountain ravine is something in and of itself. Looks like the cultists haven't bothered with this place just yet, instead doing... whatever they're doing further north along the trail.\n\n        Most of the walls here are too smooth to climb, but you spy on the western walls enough handholds that it might be possible to gain some kind of height advantage over the cultists entrenched in the pass..."

rows.original:
Considerably elevated above the rest of its immediate surroundings, this rocky ledge overlooks much of the mountain trail to the north. While it couldn't be used to bypass the trail — the ledge peters out long before it comes within reach of any other stable ground — it does provide an excellent vantage point and height advantage over the entirety of the northern upward trail. With all approaches to this point sheer and given the lack of harpies around, it's easy to see why Tollus's goons have disregarded it as a potential avenue of attack.

        Oh well, their loss. This would be a great place to get up to shenanigans, if you were planning any.
rows.translation:
这个岩石突起远远高于其周围的地面，从这里可以俯瞰通往北方的大部分山路。虽然无法利用它来绕过这条山路——因为在到达任何其他稳固的地带之前，这个岩石突起就已经逐渐消失了——但它确实为观察整个北侧的上行路段提供了绝佳的视野和高度优势。考虑到到目前为止所采取的所有方法都毫无成效，而且周围也没有任何阻碍，也就不难理解为什么托勒斯的手下会忽略这个可能的攻击途径了。

        唉，反正也是他们的损失。如果你有什么坏主意的话，这里倒是个很好的实施场所。
rows.raw: "Considerably elevated above the rest of its immediate surroundings, this rocky ledge overlooks much of the mountain trail to the north. While it couldn't be used to bypass the trail — the ledge peters out long before it comes within reach of any other stable ground — it does provide an excellent vantage point and height advantage over the entirety of the northern upward trail. With all approaches to this point sheer and given the lack of harpies around, it's easy to see why Tollus's goons have disregarded it as a potential avenue of attack.\n\n        Oh well, their loss. This would be a great place to get up to shenanigans, if you were planning any."

rows.original: As the ravine trail slopes ever more steeply upward, the amount of space with which you have to maneuver steadily decreases. Whether it's because of fallen boulders from the cliff walls and overhangs or potholes and thorny scrub making the ground impassable, you're steadily being funnelled into a natural chokepoint barely wide enough for two or generously, three people to stand abreast. You're reminded why few people actually make the journey through the Greyvale Ranges, even with known passes at one's disposal — taking the long road west and around the mountains is easier even if one foregoes the carriage and travels on foot. Up ahead, things look like impending trouble. The telltale signs of intelligent habitation are strewn about haphazardly, spilling out onto the trail — a scrap of tattered cloth here, a piece of broken glass there. Well, it would have been too much to expect a demon cult to be terribly concerned about not leaving litter lying about. Clearly, they're confident enough in their strength and numbers to not be too terribly concerned about someone figuring that they're present.
rows.translation: 随着峡谷小径的坡度变得越来越陡峭，可供你活动的空间也在逐渐减少。无论是由于悬崖壁上坠落的巨石和悬垂的岩石，还是那些坑洞和带刺的灌木丛使得地面无法通行，你都在逐渐被逼向一个狭窄的通道——这个通道宽度最多只能让两三个人并排通过。这就解释了为什么即使有人知道有可以穿越格雷维尔山脉的路线，实际上却很少有人会选择这条路——即使不乘坐马车而步行，绕道向西穿过山脉，这条路线也同样更加便捷。 前方的情况看起来似乎有些麻烦。那些表明有人类居住过的痕迹散落一地，随意地分布在小路上——这里有一块破布，那里有一片碎玻璃。嗯，其实也不该指望会什么都没有恶魔崇拜他们非常担心会有人留下垃圾。显然，他们对自己的实力和人数有足够的信心，因此并不太担心会有人发现他们的存在。
rows.raw: "As the ravine trail slopes ever more steeply upward, the amount of space with which you have to maneuver steadily decreases. Whether it's because of fallen boulders from the cliff walls and overhangs or potholes and thorny scrub making the ground impassable, you're steadily being funnelled into a natural chokepoint barely wide enough for two or generously, three people to stand abreast. You're reminded why few people actually make the journey through the Greyvale Ranges, even with known passes at one's disposal — taking the long road west and around the mountains is easier even if one foregoes the carriage and travels on foot.\n\n Up ahead, things look like impending trouble. The telltale signs of intelligent habitation are strewn about haphazardly, spilling out onto the trail — a scrap of tattered cloth here, a piece of broken glass there. Well, it would have been too much to expect a demon cult to be terribly concerned about not leaving litter lying about. Clearly, they're confident enough in their strength and numbers to not be too terribly concerned about someone figuring that they're present."

rows.original:
With the barricade smashed and those manning it either dead or fled, there's nothing left here but a smoking ruin. Splinters and the wrecked remains of boulders and palings make travel through this section of the trail much more difficult than it has any right to be. Several of the cultists have dropped their weapons in their haste to flee into the many nooks and crannies of the mountain, but none are really worth looting.[silly| Kayrra should really pay her minions better — or does Tollus handle the financing? Eh, little matter.]

        One way or another, the demon cult's defensive position has been overrun. Time to press onward.
rows.translation:
随着路障被摧毁，守卫路障的人要么死亡，要么逃跑了，这里只剩下一片冒烟的废墟。碎裂的木片以及那些被毁的巨石和栅栏，使得穿过这段小路变得异常困难。有几个邪教徒在慌忙逃往山里的各个角落时丢掉了武器，但这些武器其实根本不值得抢夺。[silly| 凯拉真的应该给她的手下们更高的报酬——还是说这些资金是由托勒斯来负责的？嗯，算了，这也无关紧要吧。]

        无论如何，恶魔邪教的防御阵地已经被攻破。是时候继续前进了。
rows.raw: "With the barricade smashed and those manning it either dead or fled, there's nothing left here but a smoking ruin. Splinters and the wrecked remains of boulders and palings make travel through this section of the trail much more difficult than it has any right to be. Several of the cultists have dropped their weapons in their haste to flee into the many nooks and crannies of the mountain, but none are really worth looting.[silly| Kayrra should really pay her minions better — or does Tollus handle the financing? Eh, little matter.]\n\n        One way or another, the demon cult's defensive position has been overrun. Time to press onward."

rows.original:
This is what passes for the main hub of the cultists' impromptu camp. With the ground as hard as it is, no one's actually bothered to drive stakes and pitch tents; sackcloth bedrolls and sleeping bags lie arranged in rough circles about makeshift firepits and under overhangs. The faint but perceptible scent of sex still lingers in the air, answering any questions about what this lot do to keep out the cold during windy nights on a mountainside.

        It doesn't look like the individual members of the demon cult have much in the way of personal possessions — mostly junk that wouldn't warrant a second glance from anyone at all. It really makes you wonder what kind of people are drawn to join with such groups, and why.[party.has quin| However, Quin is taking a moment to shift through some of their supplies...]
rows.translation:
这里大概就是那些狂热信徒临时搭建的营地的中心地带了。由于地面非常坚硬，根本没人费心去插木桩或搭帐篷；人们只是用麻布床单和睡袋围成粗略的圆圈，铺在临时的火堆周围或岩石的遮蔽处休息。空气中仍然弥漫着那股微弱却清晰可辨的性爱气息，这足以回答关于这些人在山间多风寒冷的夜晚是如何抵御寒冷的疑问。

        看起来，这个恶魔崇拜团体的成员们几乎没有什么个人财产——大多是些根本不值得任何人多看一眼的垃圾。这确实会让人好奇：究竟是什么样的人会被吸引去加入这样的团体，又为什么呢？[party.has quin| 然而，昆因正在花一些时间整理他们的物资……]
rows.raw: "This is what passes for the main hub of the cultists' impromptu camp. With the ground as hard as it is, no one's actually bothered to drive stakes and pitch tents; sackcloth bedrolls and sleeping bags lie arranged in rough circles about makeshift firepits and under overhangs. The faint but perceptible scent of sex still lingers in the air, answering any questions about what this lot do to keep out the cold during windy nights on a mountainside.\n\n        It doesn't look like the individual members of the demon cult have much in the way of personal possessions — mostly junk that wouldn't warrant a second glance from anyone at all. It really makes you wonder what kind of people are drawn to join with such groups, and why.[party.has quin| However, Quin is taking a moment to shift through some of their supplies...]"

rows.original:
This hollowed-out cliff base has been converted into a temporary storehouse, the cultists having stashed their goods here out of the wind and away from any local critters. Bundles and packs tied with rope sit on several flat-topped boulders, all yours for the taking now that their previous owners aren't going to be claiming them any more. Waste not, want not, as they say.

        Judging by quantity of provisioning they've brought, as well as the fact that they've been dug in for a while, you can't help but wonder exactly how long Tollus expected his underlings to have to remain here. It doesn't look like the swipe-and-split job Sanders sold you, that's for sure.
rows.translation:
这个被掏空的悬崖底部被改造成了临时仓库，那些狂热信徒把他们的货物存放在这里，既避开了风雨，也远离了当地的野兽。一些用绳子捆好的包裹堆放在几块平坦的巨石上，既然原来的主人不会再来取走了，这些货物现在都属于你们了。正如人们所说，不浪费就不会缺乏。

        从他们带来的补给数量来看，再加上他们已经在这里驻扎了相当长一段时间，你不禁会想知道：托勒斯究竟预计他的下属们需要在这里待多久。显然， 桑德斯向你描述的那种通过滑动屏幕来分割屏幕的功能，并不是真的存在。
rows.raw: "This hollowed-out cliff base has been converted into a temporary storehouse, the cultists having stashed their goods here out of the wind and away from any local critters. Bundles and packs tied with rope sit on several flat-topped boulders, all yours for the taking now that their previous owners aren't going to be claiming them any more. Waste not, want not, as they say.\n\n        Judging by quantity of provisioning they've brought, as well as the fact that they've been dug in for a while, you can't help but wonder exactly how long Tollus expected his underlings to have to remain here. It doesn't look like the swipe-and-split job Sanders sold you, that's for sure."

rows.original:
The eastern side of the camp borders by a small spring at the foot of a cliff face, an exposed section of one of the underground streams that run beneath the mountains and eventually join to form the river that winds through Harvest Valley. The water is clear, largely free of debris, and fast-flowing under the surface.

        What's more interesting is the portable alchemical apparatus that's been set up on a folding table just by the water's edge. While the glassware is clear, soot marks on the burner suggest that it's been used recently. Whatever Tollus's goons were working on up here, it can't have been good.
rows.translation:
营地的东侧紧邻着悬崖脚下的一处小泉眼，那是那些隐藏在山腹之中、最终汇合成流淌过丰收谷的河流的地下溪流中的一部分。水非常清澈，几乎没有任何杂物，而且在水面下流动得相当快。

        更有趣的是，在水边的一张折叠桌上，还摆放着一套便携式的炼金装置。虽然那些玻璃器皿看起来很干净，但燃烧器上的烟灰痕迹说明这套装置最近被使用过。无论托勒斯的那些打手在这里搞什么名堂，肯定没什么好事。
rows.raw: "The eastern side of the camp borders by a small spring at the foot of a cliff face, an exposed section of one of the underground streams that run beneath the mountains and eventually join to form the river that winds through Harvest Valley. The water is clear, largely free of debris, and fast-flowing under the surface.\n\n        What's more interesting is the portable alchemical apparatus that's been set up on a folding table just by the water's edge. While the glassware is clear, soot marks on the burner suggest that it's been used recently. Whatever Tollus's goons were working on up here, it can't have been good."

rows.original:
The trail turns to the west here, but that's not where you want to go. Set up in the northern rock face is a cave mouth — well, it couldn't have been more than a narrow crack before it wound up significantly enlarged thanks to the prodigious application of picks and shovels. That would explain why the cultists have been here this long — if the altar was buried and needed to be excavated, they'd need to spend considerable time and effort in unearthing it.

        Nice of them to do the work for you, then. You'd certainly be annoyed if you had to dig into tons of earth and rock yourself...
rows.translation:
小路在这里转向西方，但那并不是你想要去的方向。在北侧的岩壁上，有一个洞口——其实最初它只不过是一条狭窄的裂缝，后来人们通过大量的挖掘工作，才将其扩大成现在的规模。这就解释了为什么那些狂热信徒会在这里待这么久——如果那个祭坛被埋藏了起来，需要通过挖掘才能找到，那么他们肯定花费了大量的时间和精力来进行这项工作。

        那么，他们能为你做这些事，真是太好了。如果你自己不得不去挖掘大量的泥土和岩石，那你肯定也会感到非常恼火……
rows.raw: "The trail turns to the west here, but that's not where you want to go. Set up in the northern rock face is a cave mouth — well, it couldn't have been more than a narrow crack before it wound up significantly enlarged thanks to the prodigious application of picks and shovels. That would explain why the cultists have been here this long — if the altar was buried and needed to be excavated, they'd need to spend considerable time and effort in unearthing it.\n\n        Nice of them to do the work for you, then. You'd certainly be annoyed if you had to dig into tons of earth and rock yourself..."

rows.original:
Thankfully, the tunnel leading into the cliff doesn't extend too far — enough light filters in from the entrance that you can still see your surroundings, if not very well. Rough stone turns to tiled granite, worn steps and broken pillars; the entire layout of the chamber gives the impression that this place was once open to the skies. There's a damp smell in the air, and you hear the faint trickle of flowing water...

        The altar you were sent here to find must be up ahead.
rows.translation:
幸运的是，通往悬崖的隧道并没有延伸得太远——从入口处透进来的光线足以让你看清周围的环境，尽管视线并不是很清晰。粗糙的石壁逐渐变成了铺着花岗岩瓷砖的墙面，台阶也变得破旧不堪，柱子更是有些断裂；整个洞室的布局让人觉得，这里曾经是露天场所。空气中弥漫着潮湿的气息，还能听到微弱的流水声……

        你被派来寻找的祭坛，一定就在前方不远的地方。
rows.raw: "Thankfully, the tunnel leading into the cliff doesn't extend too far — enough light filters in from the entrance that you can still see your surroundings, if not very well. Rough stone turns to tiled granite, worn steps and broken pillars; the entire layout of the chamber gives the impression that this place was once open to the skies. There's a damp smell in the air, and you hear the faint trickle of flowing water...\n\n        The altar you were sent here to find must be up ahead."

rows.original:
A packed-dirt road leads north to south here, straight through the middle of the Kervus tribe's war-camp. Dozens of tents line the road, probably for the highest-rank warriors, with those belonging to thralls and junior warriors fanning out to the east and west.

        To the far north of the valley, you can see a huge four-posted pavillion tent. A pair of carved wooden wolves, each bearing racks of demonic horns, are sat at either side of the entrance flap. Alongside them are a pair of burly orcish warriors, each wearing heavy hides and wielding bronze great-axes.
rows.translation:
一条被压实的土路从这里南北延伸，直接穿过克尔维斯部落的军营中央。道路两旁排列着数十顶帐篷，这些帐篷大概是为地位最高的战士们准备的，而那些属于奴隶和低阶战士的帐篷则分布在道路的东侧和西侧。

        在山谷的最北端，你可以看到一座巨大的四柱帐篷。入口两侧各摆放着一对雕刻精美的木制狼像，这些狼像的头上都装饰着恶魔般的角。在它们旁边，还站着两名体格魁梧的兽人战士，他们身披厚重的皮甲，手中挥舞着青铜巨斧。
rows.raw:
"
        A packed-dirt road leads north to south here, straight through the middle of the Kervus tribe's war-camp. Dozens of tents line the road, probably for the highest-rank warriors, with those belonging to thralls and junior warriors fanning out to the east and west.

        To the far north of the valley, you can see a huge four-posted pavillion tent. A pair of carved wooden wolves, each bearing racks of demonic horns, are sat at either side of the entrance flap. Alongside them are a pair of burly orcish warriors, each wearing heavy hides and wielding bronze great-axes."

rows.original:
You're on a small side-path through the camp, leading from the main thoroughfare to the shaman's tent.

        The path east leads back the Hretha's tent; south seems to curve around towards the main part of the camp; north leads into a particularly large hut reinforced with wood and stone. Thick black smoke billows out from the cut top within.
rows.translation:
你正走在营地中的一条小路上，这条小路从主干道延伸出来，通向萨满的帐篷。

        向东走，这条小路会回到赫雷莎的帐篷；向南走，小路似乎会绕到营地的主体区域；而向北走，则会进入一间用木头和石头加固的、规模特别大的小屋，从屋顶的开口处不断冒出浓黑的烟雾。
rows.raw:
"
        You're on a small side-path through the camp, leading from the main thoroughfare to the shaman's tent.

        The path east leads back the Hretha's tent; south seems to curve around towards the main part of the camp; north leads into a particularly large hut reinforced with wood and stone. Thick black smoke billows out from the cut top within."

rows.original: You're on a small side-path through the camp, leading west to east from the main thoroughfare to the shaman's tent.
rows.translation: 你正沿着一条小路穿过营地，这条小路从主干道向西延伸，最终通向萨满的帐篷。
rows.raw: "\n        You're on a small side-path through the camp, leading west to east from the main thoroughfare to the shaman's tent."

rows.original:
There's a narrow path between the backs of several orcish tents, giving you an opportunity to sneak about out of sight of the orc warriors. Between a pair of nearby tents, the warriors have set up a ring of spears all tied together, making a neat stake from which a horned wolf banner flies.

        The well is back to the north, just barely in sight, and to the south, you see a particularly large tent with a flap facing into the back grotto. You can't hear anything from inside...
rows.translation:
在几顶兽人帐篷的后面，有一条狭窄的小路，你可以利用这条路悄悄溜走，从而避开兽人战士的视线。在附近的两顶帐篷之间，战士们将一些长矛绑在一起，搭成了一圈栅栏，上面还飘扬着一面有角狼图案的旗帜。

        水井在北方，勉强能够看到它的位置；而在南方，你会看到一顶特别大的帐篷，它的帐篷门朝向后面的洞穴。从里面却听不到任何声音……
rows.raw:
"
        There's a narrow path between the backs of several orcish tents, giving you an opportunity to sneak about out of sight of the orc warriors. Between a pair of nearby tents, the warriors have set up a ring of spears all tied together, making a neat stake from which a horned wolf banner flies.

        The well is back to the north, just barely in sight, and to the south, you see a particularly large tent with a flap facing into the back grotto. You can't hear anything from inside..."

rows.original: You're standing next to a well, a rough circle in the rocky ground of the hillside, surrounded by tent flaps and crates of supplies stacked haphazardly around. A simple bucket and wheel provides the water to the camp, though the immediate area seems vacant for now. While there are orcs lurking all around, there seems to be a more-or-less clear path to the south.
rows.translation: 你站在一口井旁，这口井是山坡岩石地上一个粗糙的圆洞，周围随意堆放着帐篷的门帘和补给箱。一个简单的水桶和辘轳负责为营地提供水源，不过目前这个区域似乎没有人居住。虽然周围到处都有兽人潜伏着，但往南方向似乎有一条还算清晰的道路可以通行。
rows.raw: "\n        You're standing next to a well, a rough circle in the rocky ground of the hillside, surrounded by tent flaps and crates of supplies stacked haphazardly around. A simple bucket and wheel provides the water to the camp, though the immediate area seems vacant for now. While there are orcs lurking all around, there seems to be a more-or-less clear path to the south."

rows.original:
This wide stretch of flat land is where most of the village's population resides. Yurts and smaller tents have been pitched in a haphazard manner, although upon closer inspection there's a semblance of order to the chaos. At any rate, the marefolk are clearly comfortable with the way their homes have organically sprung up about each other, and the tents themselves clearly haven't moved in a long, long time.

        Marefolk homes are mostly affairs of canvas and leather stretched tight over wooden frames, aimed primarily at keeping the wind out; rain and snow are rare in Harvest Valley, and the architecture of their flat-topped homes reflects that compared to the pointed, steepled roofs of the Marches. The yurts are decorated with streaks of color over cream and brown fabrics, lending a jovial tone to the village atmosphere.
        
        One tent stands out from the others. While there are splashes of color among the rest of the village, this one is decorated far more deliberately compared to the largely drab appearance of the surrounding tents. The material covering the large yurt is dyed into a large mural that flows around the entire structure, extending to the small additional tent attached directly to it. Several extra banners hang around the yurt, each dyed and decorated differently. Clearly whoever lives here has a passion for art or is very bored.
rows.translation:
这片广阔的平坦地带是村里大部分居民的居住地。蒙古包和较小的帐篷被随意地搭建在那里，不过仔细观察的话，会发现这种看似混乱的布局其实也隐含着一定的秩序。无论如何，马人显然对他们的住所自然地分布在彼此周围这种方式感到十分满意，而这些帐篷本身显然也已经很久没有移动过位置了。

        马人的住所大多是由帆布和皮革紧绷在木框架上搭建而成的，其主要作用就是防止风侵入；在丰收谷，雨水和雪水其实非常罕见，因此他们这种平顶房屋的建筑风格，与边境地区那些尖顶房屋的风格形成了鲜明的对比。这些蒙古包在奶油色和棕色的布料上点缀着彩色条纹，为整个村庄的氛围增添了一丝欢乐的气氛。
        
        其中有一顶帐篷格外引人注目。虽然村庄里的其他帐篷也有一些色彩点缀，但这一顶帐篷的装饰显得更为精心细致，与周围那些色彩较为单调的帐篷形成了鲜明的对比。覆盖在大型蒙古包上的布料被染成了巨大的壁画，这些壁画环绕着整个结构延伸开来，甚至覆盖到了直接连接在蒙古包上的小型附属帐篷。在蒙古包周围还悬挂着几面额外的旗帜，每一面旗帜的配色和装饰风格都各不相同。显然，住在这里的人要么对艺术充满热情，要么就是非常无聊。

rows.original:
[flags.CQ_CLEAR
            |Naiyana's tent is a solid affair, and although the scent of a chemically-induced broodmare's ultra-fertile cunt and cock permeates the air it still has a surprising... homeliness to it.
            
            A large desk sits dominantly in the center of the room, stacked with goodies for eating, reading, and drinking, while a series of large trunks rest off to the side full of what is presumably clothes and other belongings. The only other furniture consists of a large number of big fluffy pillows, some nice thick blankets, and a pretty, gold-rimmed standing mirror that's been polished regularly, judging by the way it shines.
            
            At the room's center, sat at her desk with a book in hand, is Asani Naiyana — the Ex-Chieftain — herself. [flags.TAUR_PURE
                |She smiles up at you warmly and tucks away a loose lock of warm copper hair.
                |She gives you a hungry little whinny and sits up straighter at the sight of you.
            ]
            |This open, breezy tent is a little larger and more colorfully decorated than most of the other yurt-like structures that comprise the rest of the marefolk village. Painted in an array of reds and greens, it's clearly meant to draw attention to itself and signal the relative social status of whoever dwells inside; not necessarily a more important figure, perhaps, but a more unorthodox one if nothing else.
            
            A little flag flutters atop the tentpole, although it looks somewhat ragged from the passage of time. The Marefolk aren't exactly one for flags, or are they? Either way, the tent flap is [flags.CQ_REUNION_TS
                |invitingly open, signaling that visitors are presumably welcome
                |drawn for now
            ].
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.CQ_CLEAR
            |奈娅娜的帐篷结构十分结实，尽管空气中弥漫着那种经过化学处理后、具有超强生育能力的母马所散发出的特殊气味，但这个帐篷依然给人一种出乎意料的……温馨感。
            
            房间中央摆放着一张大桌子，上面堆满了各种可供食用、阅读或饮用的物品，而旁边还放着几大箱行李，里面应该装满了衣服和其他个人用品。房间里仅有的其他家具，是一些厚实的枕头、几条柔软的毯子，以及一面装饰着金色边框的立式镜子——从它闪闪发光的样子来看，这面镜子肯定经常被擦拭保养。
            
            在房间的中央，阿萨尼·奈娅娜——那位前酋长——正坐在书桌前，手中拿着一本书。 [flags.TAUR_PURE
                |她温暖地对你微笑，然后将一缕散落的暖铜色头发掖到耳后。
                |它发出一声渴望的轻哼，一看到你就坐得更直了。
            ]
            |这种开放式、通风良好的帐篷，比马人村落中其他大多数类似蒙古包的住所都要大一些，装饰也更加丰富多彩。它被涂成了红色和绿色等多种颜色，显然这样的设计是为了吸引人们的注意，同时也暗示了居住在其中的人所拥有的相对社会地位——或许这个人并不一定地位更高，但至少在某些方面显得与众不同。
            
            一根小旗子在帐篷的支柱顶端飘扬着，尽管经过时间的侵蚀，它看起来已经有些破旧了。不过，马人族人本来就不太喜欢使用旗帜，不是吗？无论如何，帐篷的门帘还是[flags.CQ_REUNION_TS
                |敞开着，仿佛在向访客表示欢迎
                |暂时搁置
            ]。
        ]

rows.original:
This section of the village opens out onto a slightly raised, grassy hillock from which most of the settlement is visible. A large firepit has been dug into the crest, [dayNight|still alive with the embers of last night's fire|a low, steady fire burning in the ring of stones]. Several carved totems stand in a ring, each one anywhere from fifteen to twenty feet tall and depicting the visages of various prairie animals in stylised fashion.
        
        The totems surround an old stone statue, probably left over from whoever built the nearby watchtower. It depicts a lupine ranger, clad in dark leathers and bearing a longbow strapped over one shoulder. The marefolk seem to have made some progress in "converting" that statue from a wolf-man to a marefolk, carving on its face and tail. It's hardly convincing... yet. They haven't yet touched the dark blue gemstone set in a ring on the statue's hand[pc.hasKeyItem WaystoneCharm|, which glows faintly as you approach].

        Split logs lie on their sides, their surfaces smoothed to serve as seats. [dayNight|This, presumably, is where most of the village gathers at night when they're not otherwise occupied|Several marefolk lounge about on the simple benches, passing skins of fermented milk drink and fresh fruit amongst themselves as they gossip].
rows.translation:
村庄的这一区域通向一座略微隆起的草丘，从这里能看见聚落的大部分地方。人们在丘顶挖出了一座巨大的火坑，[dayNight|昨夜篝火的余烬仍在其中闪烁|石圈里燃着一簇低矮而稳定的火焰]。数座雕刻图腾围成一圈，每座都有十五到二十英尺高，以夸张的风格刻画着各种草原动物的面容。
        
        图腾围绕着一座古老石像，可能是建造附近瞭望塔的人所留下的。石像刻的是一名狼族游侠，身穿深色皮甲，一张长弓斜背在肩。马人似乎已经在把这座“狼人”石像改造成马人形象的工程上取得了一些进展，重新雕刻了它的脸和尾巴。目前看起来还不怎么像……他们尚未动过石像手上戒指里镶嵌的深蓝色宝石[pc.hasKeyItem WaystoneCharm|；你靠近时，宝石会发出微光]。

        劈开的原木横倒在地，表面被磨得平滑，用作座椅。[dayNight|想必村民们夜里没有别的事情时，大多会聚集在这里|几名马人懒洋洋地坐在简陋长椅上，一边闲聊，一边传递装有发酵乳饮料的皮囊和新鲜水果]。

rows.original:
Here's Sariel's tent; a surprisingly homely and permanent-looking fixture for someone who's spent most of her life being transient. A rough-surfaced floor-mat rests propped up on thick wooden rails, tough enough to [silly|de-scrung|scour] any mare-hooves, and a little signboard with a brightly-painted carrot on it hangs from the top of the entrance.

        Up close you can see the name 'Sariel <3' has been written inside the carrot, how cute.
        
        Inside the tent is the bunny herself; there's a large hammock that's been stuffed with extra bedrolls at the back, held up on two posts hammered into the floor. Along the left wall is a shelf of old knick-knacks, ancient blades and arrowheads, jars of carefully-preserved herbs and fruits, and a selection of different oils whose purpose you have a pretty good guess for. 
        
        On the opposite side of her tent is a chest full of clothing and blankets... and most likely her toy collection. There's a huge rug that covers the tent floor in the middle of the room, and it looks like it's been regularly — and recently — washed. Probably for the best, or things would get very mare-cummy in here. 
        
        In pride of place, hanging from the tent's roof, is the Golden Carrot... it's not as large as it once was, after being repaired. Instead the offshoots of gold have been turned into little pieces of jewelry; anklets, bracelets, and earrings.
rows.translation:
这就是萨莉尔的帐篷——对于一个一生中大部分时间都在漂泊的人来说，这个帐篷显得格外温馨且结实耐用。一块表面粗糙的地面垫被架在粗厚的木条上，这些木条显然足够结实，能够承受各种重量。 [silly|解开束缚|彻底搜索]入口上方挂着一些马蹄形状的装饰物，还有一块写着用鲜艳颜色画成的胡萝卜图案的招牌。

        仔细看，会发现胡萝卜图案里面写着“萨莉尔 <3”，真是太可爱了。
        
        帐篷里面就是那只兔子本身；在帐篷的后部，用两根钉在地面上的柱子支撑着一张铺满了额外床铺用品的大吊床。在左侧的墙边，摆放着一个架子，上面摆满了各种旧杂物、古老的刀刃和箭头，还有一些精心保存的草药和水果，还有一些不同种类的油类——你应该能猜到这些油的用途吧。 
        
        在她的帐篷另一侧，有一个装满衣物和毯子的箱子……很可能里面还放着她收集的玩具。房间的中间铺着一块巨大的地毯，看起来它是被定期清洗过的，而且最近才清洗过。或许这样反而更好，否则这里的情况会变得一团糟。
        
        最显眼的位置上，悬挂在帐篷的顶架上，是那根金胡萝卜……经过修复后，它已经没有以前那么大了。那些金色的分支已经被制成了一些小饰品：脚链、手镯和耳环。

After being invited to remain in the village, Edessari and Wredi have managed to put up Sariel's tent in a matter of moments.
        
        The buttbunny herself appears absent, with a few bags piled up out front. It looks like most of her belongings have been hidden in bolt-holes... or the bunny's own personal, stretchy little bolt-hole. Perhaps when you come back later she'll have finished moving in.
rows.translation:
在被邀请留在村庄后，埃德萨里和韦尔迪很快就搭好了萨莉尔的帐篷。
        
        不过那只兔子本人似乎不在，只有几袋东西被堆放在帐篷前面。看来它的大部分物品都被藏到了某个隐蔽的地方……或者说是藏在了它自己那个柔软、可以伸缩的“隐蔽空间”里。也许等你们稍后再来的时候，它就已经搬进去住了。

It looks like most of her belongings have been hidden in bolt-holes... or the bunny's own personal, stretchy little bolt-hole. Perhaps when you come back later she'll have finished moving in."

rows.original: A small bend in the path that leads south out and away from the central village grounds. While the road isn't paved in any way, hundreds of hooves have trod the ground into some semblance of packed earth. Someone's planted neat rows of wildflowers to either side of the path, although whether these are useful herbs or just for decoration, you can't quite tell.
rows.translation: 小路在通往南方的方向上有一个小小的转弯，这条小路远离了村庄的中心区域。虽然这条路并没有经过任何铺砌，但成百上千只蹄子反复踩踏，使得路面变得有些像被压实过的泥土。有人在路的两旁种了一排排野花，不过这些花究竟是具有药用价值的草药，还是仅仅为了装饰，就很难分辨了。

rows.original:
Warm, appetising smells rise from this part of the village, a communal kitchen of sorts. Drying racks stand in several closely-packed rows, strips of meat hanging from them to be dried in the sun. Smoking ovens of stone and clay stand nearby, slow-burning wood releasing heat and smoke to preserve the ovens' contents. Meat isn't the only foodstuff to be preserved about these parts — you also spy several kinds of fruit in various stages of dehydration. With wood being at a premium in Harvest Valley, the marefolk have perfected the art of sun-drying.

        [dayNight
            |Marefolk move amongst the various racks, ovens and spreads, sniffing scents and smoke, gathering finished preserves and setting out fresh ones to be processed. It's a rather involved and communal process for all, by the looks of it.
            |The smoking ovens are still running throughout the night, rarely getting any kind of reprieve from their work. Most of the marefolk have retired to their beds, although there're still one or two left to supervise the process through the night.
        ]
rows.translation:
村庄的这一区域散发着温暖而诱人的香气，这里仿佛是一个公共厨房。几排紧密排列的晾晒架上，挂着一些肉片，它们正在阳光下被晾干。附近还有用石头和黏土制成的烤炉，燃烧缓慢的木头不断释放热量和烟雾，从而帮助保存烤炉里的食物。在这些地区，肉类并不是唯一被用来保存的食物——你还能看到几种处于不同脱水阶段的水果。在丰收谷，木材极为珍贵，因此马人族人们已经将晒制食物这项技术发挥到了极致。

        [dayNight
            |那些海洋生物在各式各样的架子、烤箱和摊位间穿梭，嗅着各种气味和烟雾，将已经制作好的腌制品收拢起来，同时把新鲜的食材摆放好准备加工。从这一切来看，这个过程对它们来说显然是一个相当复杂且需要共同协作的事情。
            |那些冒着烟的烤炉整夜都在运转，几乎从未停止过工作。大多数马人已经回到了床上休息，但仍然有一两个人留在那里，整夜监督这个过程。
        ]

rows.original:
A selection of open yurts and food stands dot this section of pathway, with lots of traffic moving through at any given time. Mares of all sizes and colors pass through, either hawking their own goods or buying from others. You see as many mares in varying states of dress in the concourse as well, though none seem to be completely bereft of clothing. Open breasted tops seem to be the most popular, or silks that leave precious little to the imagination.
        
        [flags.LUSINA_MET|[flags.CQ_CLEAR|Lusina certainly fits in well with the village mares, proudly baring her large breasts just as the locals do. She's pitched a tent for herself at the edge of the market, and while it's nowhere near as spacious or comfortable as the marefolk yurts, the mothgirl has made herself at home and happily speaks with any village folk passing her way.]]

        There seems to be no solid lineup of goods available at any given time, and while food is the most plentiful choice it's far from the only option. Some mares sell charms and blankets, or uniquely carved bones for sewing into clothing or tying up hair. The sheer variety of goods is matched only by the variety of the mares making the sales. [dayNight|Enough goes on during the day that you could watch for hours and still find something new.|The bustle is much quieter now, but you still see some business go on in the dim torchlight.]
rows.translation:
这一段小路上分布着一些敞开的蒙古包和食品摊位，随时都有很多人来来往往。各种体型和颜色的母马在这里穿梭，有的在售卖自己的商品，有的则在购买别人的东西。在广场上，你也能够看到许多穿着各式各样衣物的母马，不过没有一只是完全不穿衣服的。敞开的上衣似乎是最受欢迎的，当然，那些几乎完全暴露身体的丝绸衣物也颇受欢迎。
        
        [flags.LUSINA_MET|[flags.CQ_CLEAR|露西娜与村里的母马们相处得非常融洽，她也会像当地人一样，骄傲地展示着自己那丰满的胸脯。她在市场边缘搭了一个帐篷，虽然这个帐篷远没有母马们居住的蒙古包那么宽敞舒适，但这位蛾女还是把这里当作了自己的家，遇到路过的村民，她总会愉快地与他们交谈。]]

        似乎在任何时候，都没有固定的商品供应清单。虽然食物是数量最多的选择，但它远非唯一的选项。有些母马会出售护身符、毯子，或是经过独特雕刻、可以用来缝制衣物或扎头发的骨头。这些商品的种类之多，唯有出售这些商品的母马们的多样性才能与之相媲美。 [dayNight|白天发生的各种事情多得令人目不暇接，即使观看数小时，也总能发现新的内容。|现在这里热闹的气氛已经减弱了许多，但在昏暗的火把光下，仍然可以看到一些商业活动在继续进行。]
rows.raw:
"
        A selection of open yurts and food stands dot this section of pathway, with lots of traffic moving through at any given time. Mares of all sizes and colors pass through, either hawking their own goods or buying from others. You see as many mares in varying states of dress in the concourse as well, though none seem to be completely bereft of clothing. Open breasted tops seem to be the most popular, or silks that leave precious little to the imagination.
        
        [flags.LUSINA_MET|[flags.CQ_CLEAR|Lusina certainly fits in well with the village mares, proudly baring her large breasts just as the locals do. She's pitched a tent for herself at the edge of the market, and while it's nowhere near as spacious or comfortable as the marefolk yurts, the mothgirl has made herself at home and happily speaks with any village folk passing her way.]]

        There seems to be no solid lineup of goods available at any given time, and while food is the most plentiful choice it's far from the only option. Some mares sell charms and blankets, or uniquely carved bones for sewing into clothing or tying up hair. The sheer variety of goods is matched only by the variety of the mares making the sales. [dayNight|Enough goes on during the day that you could watch for hours and still find something new.|The bustle is much quieter now, but you still see some business go on in the dim torchlight.]"

rows.original:
You see a deep, long shaft, ringed with fired clay brick and about three feet wide. The Tarahugan aside, surface water is rare in Harvest Valley, and the village is no exception; those who are willing to make the trip down to the lake aside, groundwater is vital to any community in the locale. Wooden buckets ring the well's lip, ready to be attached to the crude wooden winch; it looks like the marefolk don't use their individual buckets, but like the well, share them for use.

        Peering into the well, it sinks into the darkness and out of sight, but the moist smell rising from below suggests that the groundwater here is as pure as it gets anywhere this far south in the Marches. Only fresh glacial melt could be more pristine...
rows.translation:
你看到了一条深而长的通道，通道的两侧用烧制的黏土砖砌成围墙，宽度大约有三英尺。在“丰收谷”，除了塔拉胡甘人之外，地表水非常稀少，这个村庄也不例外；而对于那些愿意前往湖边取水的人来说，地下水对当地任何一个社区来说都至关重要。木桶排列在井边，随时可以连接到那台简陋的木制绞车上；看来这些马人并不使用自己的私人桶具，而是像使用井水一样，共同使用这些桶。

        凝视着井中，井水仿佛沉入了黑暗之中，看不见底，但从井底散发出来的潮湿气息表明，这里的地下水是这片地区最纯净的。只有新鲜的冰川融水才可能保持如此原始的状态……

rows.original:
This little mound stands atop the edge of the sheer drop to the east of the village, from which one can receive a breathtaking view of the entirety of the lake. Anyone approaching Harvest Valley from the lake's eastern side would be spotted in no time at all, which would explain why the gnolls haven't intruded into marefolk territory until very recently.

        There's a winch and small platform that allows one access to the lake down the vertical cliffside, but while the marefolk place their trust in the rickety mechanism, you're not so sure about it yourself.
rows.translation:
这座小土堆矗立在村庄东侧那处陡峭悬崖的边缘，从这里可以俯瞰整个湖泊，景色令人叹为观止。任何从湖泊东侧接近丰收谷的人，都会立刻被发现，这也解释了为什么那些地精直到最近才侵入马人领地。

        那里有一台绞车和一个小平台，人们可以通过它们沿着垂直的悬崖一侧到达湖边。不过，虽然那些海洋民族对这个摇摇欲坠的装置充满信心，但你自己却对此并不那么放心。

rows.original:
Past the tall, broad entrance lies a spacious passageway, as wide as some of the grandest roads of old Belhar. The main course of egress through this den of foxes, no doubt — although Lady Evergreen mentioned but several hundred kitsune in total lived here, it could very well have been fashioned for thousands.

        And fashioned it is, not built or grown; the former implies too much artifice, the latter too haphazard. Smoothed floors and walls juxtapose with the occasional leafy sprig and all-pervading scent of fresh sap to create the impression of a carefully pruned plant; this tree is a thing of nature, but not given over to it. It's clearly alive... and moreso than most other flora of the Frostwood would warrant.
        
        It looks like there ought to be several other passageways leading off from the main thoroughfare, but they've been sealed shut. You get the distinct impression you're being funnelled ahead...
rows.translation:
高大的入口之后，是一条宽敞的通道，其宽度甚至可以与贝尔哈尔古代一些最宏伟的道路相媲美。这无疑是一条主要的出口通道——尽管常青女士只提到这里生活着几百只狐妖，但实际上这条通道很可能足以容纳成千上万的生物。

        它的形态并非通过建造或生长形成的；前者意味着过多的人为干预，而后者则显得过于随意。光滑的地面和墙壁与偶尔出现的绿叶以及弥漫在空气中的新鲜树液气息形成对比，共同营造出一种仿佛是经过精心修剪的植物的印象——这棵树确实属于大自然，但并非完全顺其自然发展而成。它显然是有生命的……而且它的生命力比霜木林中的大多数其他植物都要强。
        
        看起来，从这条主干道应该还有几条其他通道延伸出去，但它们都被封闭住了。你会有一种明显的感觉，仿佛自己正被引导着朝某个方向前进……

rows.original:
This warden's lodge is sparsely furnished. Azami clearly didn't care much for propriety, having strung up several hammocks instead of going to the trouble of futons; most of what space's available has been dedicated to the tools of the trade. Unstrung bows, half-fletched arrows, a bundle of carefully preserved feathers, rope, a sour-smelling tar-like liquid — these are arranged in perfect order. The little corner that Yuzu's claimed for herself is marked out by her hand mirror and brush, but it's otherwise clear that Azami's underlings have adopted her spartan ethos for their own, eschewing individual material possessions as much as they can.
        
        Perhaps the only thing that makes this an actual home is the low table sitting in the middle of the room, a thick tablecloth draped over it and [
            flags.FLOOF_HAUS_AZAMI_RESOLUTION 1 3
            |the wardens' half-eaten meal still slowly cooling, miraculously untouched by the fight that just took place here.
            |a simple but filling meal laid out on it. Azami and her underlings are very pointedly pretending not to notice you as they sit on their cushions and tuck into their food, although Yuzu steals a guilty glance at you every now and then.
        ]
        
        Either way, there's no one stopping you from heading further into the tree...
rows.translation:
这个看守人的小屋陈设极为简陋。显然，阿兹米并不太在意生活舒适度，他干脆挂了几张吊床，而懒得去准备榻榻米；小屋里的大部分空间都被用来放置工作所需的工具了。未上弦的弓、半装箭矢的箭筒、一捆精心保存的羽毛、绳子，还有那种散发着酸味的焦油状液体——所有这些都被摆放得整整齐齐。柚子为自己划出的那小块空间，用她的手镜和画笔做了标记，但除此之外，很明显阿扎米的下属们也接受了她那种简朴的生活方式，尽可能地摒弃个人拥有的物质财富。
        
        或许，唯一能让这个地方真正成为家的，就是放在房间中央的那张矮桌——上面铺着厚厚的桌布。 [
            flags.FLOOF_HAUS_AZAMI_RESOLUTION 1 3
            |看守们吃了一半却还没吃完的食物仍在慢慢冷却，神奇的是，这里刚刚发生的那场争斗似乎并没有影响到这些食物。
            |桌上摆放着简单却营养丰富的食物。阿兹米和她的手下们故意装作没有注意到你，他们坐在垫子上大口吃着食物，不过柚子偶尔会偷偷瞥你一眼。
        ]
        
        无论如何，没有人能阻止你继续深入这片森林……

rows.original:
This room is an absolute mess. While there's a small circle of order about a workbench laid up against the northern wall, chaos reigns supreme in the rest of the room: screws, wooden slats, lengths of spider silk, a stack of empty bowls. With the ruckus that's just taken place here, the disorder has only grown worse with broken and smashed puppets lying all over; it's a pity what's happened to several of Kazuo's half-finished inventions, but you doubted they were ever going to work in the first place.

        There might be something of use forgotten in all this mess, if one took the time to give it a thorough comb-over... or you could just ignore the lot and head on up.
rows.translation:
这个房间简直是一团糟。虽然靠北墙摆放的工作台周围还有一小块整洁的区域，但房间的其他地方却充满了混乱：螺丝、木条、一缕缕蜘蛛丝，还有一堆空碗。随着刚才这里发生的那一阵混乱，场面变得更加混乱不堪，破碎的木偶到处都是；几件一夫夫尚未完成的发明就这样毁掉了，实在令人惋惜，不过你们本来就怀疑它们是否真的能成功使用吧。

        在这一切混乱中，或许有些有用的东西被遗忘了，只要花点时间仔细寻找一番……当然，你也可以直接忽略这一切，继续前进。

rows.original: Up ahead, the broad hallway narrows and gains a gentle upwards incline; you're definitely getting into the less-traveled parts of this fox den. Screen doors line the wooden walls, their frames grown into this living home and decorated with morning glories, but they refuse to budge when you try them. The feeling that you're being funnelled on ahead is only getting stronger, unsettling your stomach.
rows.translation: 前方，宽阔的走廊逐渐变窄，同时开始微微向上倾斜——你显然正在进入这个“狐狸洞”中人迹罕至的区域。木墙两侧排列着纱门，它们的框架早已与这个生活空间融为一体，上面还装饰着牵牛花，但当你试图推开门时，它们却纹丝不动。这种被引导着继续前进的感觉越来越强烈，令你感到不安。
rows.raw: "Up ahead, the broad hallway narrows and gains a gentle upwards incline; you're definitely getting into the less-traveled parts of this fox den. Screen doors line the wooden walls, their frames grown into this living home and decorated with morning glories, but they refuse to budge when you try them. The feeling that you're being funnelled on ahead is only getting stronger, unsettling your stomach.\n        "

rows.original: Sensing your unease, the amber orb warms against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] once more, sending a comforting sensation through your being. She's here with you... it's going to be alright. You just have to find someone who actually understands what's going on here.
rows.translation: 感受到你的不安，那个琥珀色的光球开始温暖着你[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]再一次，这种令人感到安慰的感觉传遍了你的全身。她就在你身边……一切都会好起来的。你只需要找到一个真正能够理解这里发生的一切的人而已。
rows.raw: "\n        \n        Sensing your unease, the amber orb warms against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] once more, sending a comforting sensation through your being. She's here with you... it's going to be alright. You just have to find someone who actually understands what's going on here."

rows.original: With its guardians fled, the gate-cum-archway lies before you. Odd that they'd need such a thing this deep within their den... you suspect it serves a more ceremonial purpose than anything else. Fashioned from red-painted wood, it's stylised in what you've come to think of as kitsune aesthetics... the donation box that Mai was leaning on is empty, too. Hmm. Does it actually get any use, or is it just for show?
rows.translation: 随着守护者的离去，那扇由门与拱门组合而成的入口就呈现在你面前。奇怪的是，他们在自己的巢穴深处竟然需要这样的东西……你怀疑它更多是具有象征意义，而非实际用途。这扇门是由涂成红色的木头制成的，其设计风格正是你所熟知的“狐妖美学”……而舞刚才靠着的那个捐款箱也是空的。嗯，这东西真的有人会使用吗，还是仅仅用来做做样子而已？
rows.raw: "With its guardians fled, the gate-cum-archway lies before you. Odd that they'd need such a thing this deep within their den... you suspect it serves a more ceremonial purpose than anything else. Fashioned from red-painted wood, it's stylised in what you've come to think of as kitsune aesthetics... the donation box that Mai was leaning on is empty, too. Hmm. Does it actually get any use, or is it just for show?\n\n        "

rows.original: Since those were the matron's successors, there's no doubt you're getting close to the heart of this gargantuan tree. All this for a bag... that tanuki had better make it worth your while, considering the effort you've put into this silly fetch quest.
rows.translation: 既然这些人是女管家的继承人，那么毫无疑问，你正在逐渐接近这棵巨树的核心所在。而这一切，只为了一个袋子……考虑到你为完成这个愚蠢的任务付出了这么多努力，那只狸猫最好真的能让你的付出得到回报。

rows.original: You've definitely seen something like this before, deep in the cave shrine where you found the amber orb and Kiyoko. That feeling... you're rapidly approaching your true goal here.

        You've definitely seen something like this before, deep in the cave shrine where you found the amber orb and Kiyoko. That feeling... you're rapidly approaching your true goal here.
        
        "

rows.original:
This is it, then — the very heart of the kitsune den, both physically and metaphysically. The wooden ground slopes upward towards a quaint shrine in the heart of this chamber, stone statues of foxes lining either side of the approaching path. Burning, golden-orange sap flows through the walls and floor like blood through veins, casting enough light to illuminate the entirety of the place.

        The shrine itself is deceptively simple, little more than a wooden hut with a tiled roof, open on one side. The focus of attention is on an elaborately carved statue of what's commonly considered the trickster god Keros' undisguised form — a kitsune man of the sort so commonly found in these parts, although with nine tails like Komari has. The soft smell of fragrant incense rises into the air, its source a large bronze brazier by the side of the shrine proper.
        
        This is very definitely a place of power, although of what kind...
rows.translation:
这就是它了——无论是从物理意义上还是象征意义上来说，这里都是狐妖巢穴的核心所在。木质地面逐渐向上倾斜，最终通向这个房间中央的一座古朴神龛，而在通往神龛的小路上，两侧排列着石制的狐妖雕像。炽热的、金橙色的汁液如同血液在血管中流动一样，渗透着墙壁和地面，散发的光芒足以照亮整个空间。

        这座神龛本身看起来极为简单，不过是一间盖着瓦片的木屋，其中一侧是敞开的。人们的注意力都被一尊雕刻精美的雕像所吸引。这尊雕像所描绘的，正是人们普遍认为的欺诈之神凯罗斯的真实形态——一个拥有九条尾巴的狐人，这种形象在这片地区极为常见，不过与麻里所拥有的九条尾巴一模一样。淡淡的香炉香气弥漫在空气中，其源头正是神龛旁那个巨大的青铜香炉。
        
        这里无疑是一个充满力量的地方，只不过这种力量究竟属于何种类型……

rows.original:
The entrance to the Kurokawa Kitsune Den is shaded by nature itself. While there's a dirt path leading up to the den's entrance, it vanishes at the threshold between tree and earth, giving way to a raised floor of what looks like solid wood. You know from experience that the arched gateway is perfectly capable of seamlessly melding into the tree without a trace — the fact that you can perceive it at all is proof that you have leave to visit... that, or some silly kit left the door open without closing it on the way out.

        Not all of the tree's roots are sunk into the earth — some of them are raised enough to form arches that shade the approach to the tree's entrance, the mossy bark draped with morning glories and other climbing plants. The grass looks like it's been kept finely trimmed, although it's hard to imagine kitsune with clippers cutting away... they don't seem like the kind of people for that. Or do they?
rows.translation:
黑川狐穴的入口被大自然本身遮挡住了。虽然有一条土路通向洞穴的入口，但那条路在树木与地面的交界处就消失了，取而代之的是一片看起来像是实心木头制成的高台。根据你的经验，你知道那座拱形大门完全能够无缝地融入树木之中，不会留下任何痕迹——而你能够察觉到它的存在，这一事实恰恰证明你有权进入那里……要么就是有人在离开时疏忽了，没有把门关上。

        这棵树的根并不全都埋在土里——其中一些根系高高隆起，形成了拱形结构，为通往树干的道路提供了阴凉的遮蔽，而那些长满苔藓的树皮上，还爬满了牵牛花和其他攀缘植物。草地看起来似乎被修剪得十分整齐，不过很难想象是哪只狐妖用剪刀来修剪这些草的。…他们看起来并不像是会做那种事的人。还是说，其实他们就是这类人呢？
rows.raw:
"The entrance to the Kurokawa Kitsune Den is shaded by nature itself. While there's a dirt path leading up to the den's entrance, it vanishes at the threshold between tree and earth, giving way to a raised floor of what looks like solid wood. You know from experience that the arched gateway is perfectly capable of seamlessly melding into the tree without a trace — the fact that you can perceive it at all is proof that you have leave to visit... that, or some silly kit left the door open without closing it on the way out.

        Not all of the tree's roots are sunk into the earth — some of them are raised enough to form arches that shade the approach to the tree's entrance, the mossy bark draped with morning glories and other climbing plants. The grass looks like it's been kept finely trimmed, although it's hard to imagine kitsune with clippers cutting away... they don't seem like the kind of people for that. Or do they?
        "

rows.original: This wide, broad hallway looks like it's made more with foot traffic in mind, rather than goods or vehicles. Presumably there's another entrance for that... for a pathway that no doubt sees a lot of traffic, the floor is surprisingly clean; clearly kitsune aren't in the habit of tracking dirt wherever they go. The ground is wood, though not of cut planks or boards; it's coarse-grained, seamless wood, smoothed to a polish and yet very much giving the feel of being alive. Not quite wholly natural, and yet at the same time not quite wholly artifice... Folded paper decorations hang from some of the eaves, threaded together with cord and intermingling with the creeping, verdant vines that hug sections of wall. A faint scent of perfumed sap pervades the air, clearing the head and raising one's spirits as one traverses the hallway. The entire thoroughfare is lit by a warm amber glow that emanates from the wood itself, the color of rich, distilled sunlight; [dayNight |it pulses faintly with a steady rhythm, like a faint heartbeat|at this time of night, the light is somewhat muted, but still enough to see clearly by].
rows.translation: 这条宽敞的走廊看起来更像是为人们的行走而设计的，而不是为了搬运货物或车辆。想必还有另一条入口……对于这样一条肯定会有很多人经过的道路来说，地面出奇地干净；显然，狐族并没有把弄脏地面当成他们出门时的习惯。地面是由木材铺成的，不过并不是普通的木板，而是那种纹理粗糙、没有接缝的木材，经过打磨后表面变得光滑，但依然能让人感受到那种独特的材质质感。活着这种景象既不完全是自然形成的，同时又并非完全人为营造的…… 一些屋檐下悬挂着折叠的纸制装饰品，它们用绳子串在一起，与那些攀爬在墙壁上的翠绿藤蔓交织在一起。空气中弥漫着一丝芬芳的树脂气息，让人在走过走廊时感到神清气爽、心情愉悦。整条通道都被木材本身散发出的温暖琥珀色光芒照亮，这种颜色就像浓郁的阳光一样温暖而怡人。 [dayNight |它以稳定的节奏微微跳动，就像微弱的心跳声一样|在这样的深夜，光线虽然有些昏暗，但仍然足以让人看清楚周围的环境]。

rows.original:
The wardens' lodge is situated west of the main entrance hallway, a raised wooden platform and a few steps leading up to an unassuming sliding screen door. Within, a picture of spartan utility awaits — the main feature of the lodge is a large low table that could easily seat six or seven kitsune, draped with a heavy tablecloth. A comfortable warmth emanates from under it, and from the gaps between cloth and floor you can spy the familiar blue of burning foxfire at play — this must be how they keep their abode heated.

        What remains of the lodge is filled with the tools of their trade, neatly stacked against the walls; feathers for fletching, bowstrings, resin and more. By way of saving space, Azami and her subordinates have eschewed futons for hammocks that can be easily strung up between the support beams, stacked and put away as need be. The concierge herself has little need of personal possessions, but those of her subordinates are visible in their own patches of personal space: Yuzu's brush and mirror, an exquisite jewelry box that no doubt belongs to Kurako, a long bamboo fishing rod that looks like it could belong to Hinata. Several screens facing the corners provide a modicum of privacy for those who wish it, although you see no washroom or kitchen nearby — they must use communal facilities elsewhere in the den.
        
        You suppose the extra discomfort is so that this lot doesn't get too used to sleeping with a roof over their heads... harsh, perhaps, but these are supposed to wild foxes.
rows.translation:
看守们的小屋位于主入口走廊的西侧，是一个高出地面的木制平台，需要走上几级台阶才能到达那扇朴实的推拉门。进入小屋后，首先映入眼帘的是极其简洁实用的摆设——这个小屋的核心设施是一张宽大的低矮桌子，足以容纳六七只狐妖，桌上还铺着厚厚的桌布。从它的下方散发出一种舒适的温暖，而透过布料与地板之间的缝隙，你可以看到那熟悉的、代表燃烧的狐火的蓝色光芒——想必这就是他们保持住所温暖的方式吧。

        小屋里剩下的空间里摆满了他们的工具，这些工具都被整齐地堆放在墙壁旁：用于制作箭羽的羽毛、弓弦、树脂等等。为了节省空间，阿兹米和她的下属们没有使用榻榻米，而是选择了吊床——这种吊床可以轻松地挂在支撑梁上，需要时还可以折叠起来收起来。这位礼宾员本人几乎不需要个人物品，但她的下属们的个人空间里却摆放着一些属于他们的东西：柚子的画笔和镜子，那个无疑属于仓子的精致首饰盒，还有那根看起来很适合日向使用的长竹制钓鱼竿。几面朝向角落的屏幕为那些有此需求的人提供了一定的隐私空间，不过附近并没有洗手间或厨房——他们必须使用基地其他地方的公共设施。
        
        你大概认为，这种额外的不适是为了让这些野狐妖不会太习惯有屋顶遮盖的生活吧……虽然听起来可能有些残酷，但它们本来就是野生的狐妖啊。

rows.original:
The end of the entrance hallway connects to a big spiral staircase, somewhat incongruous with typical kitsune architecture but plainly necessary when one considers the shape of the tree and how high the stairwell extends, all the way into the tree's branches. The landing itself is large and circular and serves as a common space of sorts with several benches laid out for any to sit on. [dayNight|The same warm radiance of the tree's insides pervades this vast chamber, too, bringing sunlight to those who need it |At this time of night, several lanterns of mulberry paper hang from the eaves, flickering flames of foxfire dancing in them and casting a pale, eerie light on the scene]. Several kitsune putter and swish past you as they go about their daily lives, [pc.ra kitsune|carefully giving you a wide berth and respectful nods as they pass you by|staring a bit at the sight of an outsider in their home, but soon getting over themselves and studiously ignoring your presence].
           
        Above you lie the branches and most of the kitsunes' living space, northward lie the fields and other more important locations.
rows.translation:
入口走廊的尽头连接着一座巨大的螺旋楼梯，这种设计与典型的狐妖建筑风格有些不符，但考虑到树木的形状以及楼梯延伸的高度——它一直通向树木的枝叶层——这种设计显然是必要的。楼梯平台本身很大，呈圆形，被用作一个公共空间，平台上摆放了几张长椅，供人们休息使用。 [dayNight|那棵树内部散发出的温暖光芒也弥漫到了这个广阔的空间之中，为那些需要阳光的人们带来了光明。 |在夜深人静的时候，几盏桑纸灯笼悬挂在屋檐下，灯笼内跳动的狐火闪烁着幽暗的光芒，为整个场景增添了一股诡异的氛围。]几只狐妖在忙于日常生活时，从你身边匆匆经过。 [pc.ra kitsune|他们经过你时，会小心翼翼地与你保持距离，并向你恭敬点头。|看到有外人进入自己的家，他们起初会稍显不自在，但很快便不再在意，刻意忽略你的存在。]
           
        你的上方是树枝以及狐妖们主要的生活区域；北边则是田野和其他更重要的地点。

"

rows.original:
The western edge of the fields sequestered within the tree's roots. Here, the kitsune grow rice in flooded paddies; flowing outwards from the pool to the north is a complex network of irrigation ditches and bunds, complete with pumps and sluices that look like they could've been designed by a bona fide artificer. It looks like a lot of trouble to go to in order to grow a staple crop and you're certain that no single family could actually maintain the entire irrigation system all on its own... it boggles the mind as to how they're able to coordinate like this without being some kind of insect-folk, to be honest. Must be a cultural thing. Wheat is so much simpler to grow by comparison... 

        Standing out in the fields are several long poles; affixed to them are paper charms with writing on them in the kitsune's native language, broad, flowing strokes in black ink — exquisite calligraphy. [pc.ra kitsune|No matter how you turn it in your mind, it still irks you that you don't really understand the kitsunes' mother tongue despite being one yourself. Sure, you weren't born one and they all are too polite to bring it up, but the feeling of lacking and inadequacy is still there niggling at the back of your mind. Even so, though, your kitsune nature is well aware of the latent power these charms hold, keeping away pests that would threaten the harvest.|[pc.cl blackmage whitemage|Even at a glance, you can tell that these charms of simple paper and ink have low-intensity, long-lasting latent power. Perfect for setting one up, leaving it in the fields, and forgetting about it for a month or two, really. Quite impressive. For them to use it to grow such a staple crop and keep away pests... it really does speak volumes about these foxes. More effective than a scarecrow, at any rate.|[pc.bg arcanist scholar acolyte|Even at a glance, you can tell that these charms of simple paper and ink have low-intensity, long-lasting latent power. Perfect for setting one up, leaving it in the fields, and forgetting about it for a month or two, really. Quite impressive. For them to use them to grow such a staple crop and keep away pests... it really does speak volumes about these foxes.|Even to your layman's eye, it's plainly obvious that there's something magical about the charms, even if you've no idea what they're intended to do. For them to use this sort of thing so casually to grow a staple crop really says something about these foxes.]]]
rows.translation:
这片田野的西侧被树木的根系所环绕。在这里，狐妖们会在被水淹没的田地里种植水稻；从北边的水塘向外延伸，分布着一系列复杂的灌溉沟渠和堤坝，其中还配备了各种泵和水闸，这些设施看起来简直就像是真正由工艺大师设计出来的。种植这种主要农作物似乎需要耗费大量的精力，而且可以肯定，没有任何一个家庭能够独自维护整个灌溉系统……说实话，他们能够如此协调地进行生产活动，实在让人感到难以理解。这肯定与文化有关。相比之下，种植小麦要简单得多……

        在田野里，有几根长杆矗立着；这些杆子上绑着写有狐族母语文字的纸条，那些字迹是用黑色墨水书写而成的，笔划宽大而流畅，真是精美的书法作品。 [pc.ra kitsune|无论你如何思考，这个事实仍然会让你感到恼火——尽管你自己也是 Kitsune 一族的一员，却仍然无法真正理解他们的母语。当然，你并不是天生就是他们的成员，而且他们也都太客气了，从未提起过这个问题，但这种缺乏感和无力感依然萦绕在你的脑海中，不断困扰着你。不过，作为 Kitsune 一族的一员，你的本性很清楚这些护身符所蕴含的潜在力量，它们能够驱赶那些可能威胁到农作物收成的害虫。|[pc.cl blackmage whitemage|仅仅看一眼，就能感受到这些用简单纸墨制成的工具所蕴含的那种低强度却持久的效力。把它们放在田里，然后忘掉它们一两个月，效果确实非常好。真是令人印象深刻。它们能够用来种植这样的主要农作物，还能驱赶害虫……这确实充分证明了这些狐狸的智慧。至少，它们的效果比稻草人要好得多。|[pc.bg arcanist scholar acolyte|仅仅看一眼，就能感受到这些由简单的纸和墨水制成的工具所蕴含的那种柔和而持久的效力。将它们放置在田地里，然后忘掉它们一两个月，效果确实非常好。真是令人印象深刻。这些狐狸能够利用这些工具来种植重要的农作物并驱赶害虫……这确实充分证明了它们的智慧和能力。|即使对于外行来说，也显而易见，这些饰品确实蕴含着某种魔力，尽管你可能完全不清楚它们的真正用途。这些狐狸能够如此随意地使用这类东西来种植主要农作物，这一事实本身就说明了很多问题。]]]
