rows.original: In addition to all this, there's a large flock of ducks wandering about the rice fields, and every now and then you spy movement as fish dart through the shallow water. The kitsune sure are fans of making the most of what little space they have, aren't they?
rows.translation: 除此之外，还有大群鸭子在稻田里游荡，而偶尔你还能看到鱼儿在浅水区穿梭的身影。这些狐妖确实非常善于利用它们所拥有的有限空间，不是吗？
rows.raw: "\n        \n        In addition to all this, there's a large flock of ducks wandering about the rice fields, and every now and then you spy movement as fish dart through the shallow water. The kitsune sure are fans of making the most of what little space they have, aren't they?"

rows.original: Knowing Kinu, she should be around here somewhere, if not in the fields proper then certainly around them. It wouldn't take you long to find her, if you were so minded.
rows.raw: "Knowing Kinu, she should be around here somewhere, if not in the fields proper then certainly around them. It wouldn't take you long to find her, if you were so minded."

rows.original:
Here in the roots of the cherry blossom tree, the kitsune work their enclosed fields. Perhaps it's the sight of root vegetables in neat, raised rows, or the rustling of leaves in the breeze, or maybe it's the constant scent of the tree's sap. [dayNight|Sunlight filters in through|The stars are visible in between] the branching roots that form a protective cage over the agrarian expanse, reminding you that the space within the tree is certainly considerably larger than without, as gigantic as the latter is. The path of packed dirt and pebbles aside, the dirt is loose and loamy, dark and rich. You don't get topsoil like this without plenty of dedicated care — and a bit of cheating, of course.
            
            There's a subtle hint of warmth in the air here, not too much unlike the interior of a greenhouse. It's not extreme, but you can tell the difference between the atmosphere in this place and outside in the Frostwood. Even so, none of the plants are colorful or flashy; as far as you understand, these are almost all what would be considered winter crops back in their native land. Root vegetables, winter cabbages, there's even a stand of what looks to be some kind of citrus off in a corner.
            
            Well, it makes sense. With what limited land they have that's considered relatively safe, the kitsune have had to steward it well or face the consequences. Dressed in simple work clothes, they move amidst their charges, most definitely and pointedly ignoring you as best as they can in that passive-aggressive manner of theirs when they really don't want to be disturbed...
rows.translation:
在樱花的树根之处，这些狐妖们正在照料它们那片被围起来的田地。或许是因为那些整齐排列在垄上的根茎类蔬菜，或许是微风中树叶的沙沙声，又或许是因为那棵树不断散发出的树液香气[dayNight|阳光透过窗户照射了进来。|在这些间隙中，星星依然清晰可见。]那些分支状的根系在广阔的农田上形成了一个保护性的“笼子”，让人意识到：尽管这棵树的体积庞大，但它内部的空间实际上要比外部大得多。除了那些铺满碎石的小路外，其余的土壤都是松软而肥沃的，颜色深沉且养分丰富。没有大量的精心照料，再加上一点“小技巧”，是绝对无法得到这样的表土的。
            
            这里的空气中弥漫着一种微妙的温暖气息，这种氛围与温室内部的环境颇为相似。虽然不算极端，但你可以明显感受到这个地方与外面霜木地区的氛围有所不同。即便如此，这里的植物也没有一种是色彩鲜艳或花哨夺目的；据你了解，这些植物几乎都属于它们原产地的冬季作物。根茎类蔬菜、冬白菜，甚至在一个角落里还摆放着一些看起来像是柑橘类的水果。
            
            嗯，这也情有可原。在他们那些被认为相对安全的有限土地上，狐族必须好好利用这些资源，否则就会面临后果。他们穿着朴素的工作服，在自己的工作区域里忙碌着。当他们真的不想被打扰时，就会以那种消极抵抗的方式，刻意忽略你的存在……

You don't get topsoil like this without plenty of dedicated care — and a bit of cheating, of course.
            
            There's a subtle hint of warmth in the air here, not too much unlike the interior of a greenhouse. It's not extreme, but you can tell the difference between the atmosphere in this place and outside in the Frostwood. Even so, none of the plants are colorful or flashy; as far as you understand, these are almost all what would be considered winter crops back in their native land. Root vegetables, winter cabbages, there's even a stand of what looks to be some kind of citrus off in a corner.
            
            Well, it makes sense. With what limited land they have that's considered relatively safe, the kitsune have had to steward it well or face the consequences. Dressed in simple work clothes, they move amidst their charges, most definitely and pointedly ignoring you as best as they can in that passive-aggressive manner of theirs when they really don't want to be disturbed... 
            "

rows.original: As for the kitsune in question, Takahiro is sitting on a low-hanging hammock with his gourd in hand. It looks like he's getting hammered already.
rows.translation: 至于那位狐族，高广正坐在一张低垂的吊床上，手里拿着他的葫芦。看起来他已经喝得酩酊大醉了。

rows.original: Either too tired from drinking or from having some traditional kitsune fun, Takahiro is knocked the hell out; even though he's facedown in his hammock, you can hear him snoring through its netting.
rows.translation: 要么是因为喝酒喝得太累，要么是因为玩了一些传统的狐妖把戏，贵弘彻底累倒了；尽管他脸朝下躺在吊床上，但透过网眼还是能听到他的鼾声。

rows.original:
Here in a corner of the fields, water cascades down from a knothole in the wooden — well, wall is the best way to describe it. Gushing over the knothole's lip, the cool liquid falls straight into a clear pool perhaps a little larger than a pond, ringed with small rocks and ferns. The air smells moist, and the sound of rushing water is constant. Where the inflow and outflow are in this whole system isn't exactly evident, but one can only assume that both are connected to the tree itself. Either way, the constant flow puts paid to any worries one might have about drinking stagnant water, and you see several colorful, obviously foreign fish swimming about in the pool's depths.

        Presumably, this is the water supply for the entire kitsune den. [dayNight|Several kitsune women and kits are clustered about the pool's edge with wooden buckets, trading gossip and chatter while out fetching water. They fall silent as you approach, [pc.ra kitsune|reverently lowering their gazes and gathering their kits close. Damn it, even after becoming one of them, they still can't be friendly around you, even if it's for very different reasons... |clearly unsettled by an outsider's presence. Even having official permission from Komari to visit doesn't change how wary these people instinctively are of those not their kind... ]|The night air, coupled with the light of paper lanterns ablaze with foxfire and constant gurgling of water all combine to grant you some modicum of peace and tranquility. That'll all change in the daytime when the locals come to draw water, but for now you can stop and savour the peace for a bit.]
rows.translation:
在田野的某个角落，水从那堵由木头搭建的墙上的一个洞口中倾泻而下。清凉的水流从洞口的边缘涌出，直接落入一个面积或许比一个小池塘还要大的清澈水潭中，水潭周围环绕着小石头和蕨类植物。空气中的湿气弥漫开来，潺潺的水流声持续不断。在整个系统中，水源的入口和出口具体位于何处并不清楚，但可以推测，这两者都与那棵树本身相连。无论如何，这种持续不断的水流流动彻底消除了人们对于饮用停滞水可能会带来的担忧。在池塘的深处，还能看到几条色彩斑斓、显然属于外来物种的鱼在游来游去。

        可以推测，这应该是整个狐族巢穴的供水系统。 [dayNight|几只狐狸女和狐狸们聚集在池塘边，拿着木桶取水，一边闲聊着八卦。当你靠近时，她们都安静了下来。 [pc.ra kitsune|他们恭敬地低下头，将工具收拾得整整齐齐。该死，即使已经成为他们中的一员，别人在你面前依然无法表现出友好态度，尽管原因各不相同…… |显然，这些人对外来者的存在感到不安。即使得到了麻里的正式许可前来拜访，这些人依然会本能地对那些与自己不同的人保持警惕…… ]|夜色中的空气，加上那些散发着狐火般光芒的纸灯笼，以及持续不断的流水声，共同营造出一种宁静与平和的氛围。不过，当天亮后当地人前来取水时，这一切都会发生变化。但现在，你完全可以停下来，好好享受这份宁静吧。]

rows.original:
The northern edge of the fields sequestered within the tree's roots. Here, several fields lie fallow, the land being set to rest in between plantings — the kitsune must rotate their fields between crops. A handful of foxen move through the empty land, scattering mulch and ash while others behind them plough it under into the dark, crumbly soil to enrich it.

        The remainder of the fields that aren't resting have been planted with slender bean plants bearing small yellow flowers — adzuki beans, you think, another kitsune staple. From what you can tell here, the way their agriculture is set up is pretty intensive and makes the most of every scrap of land they have. Every now and then you spot a paper charm stuck out in the fields, suspended from cord or hung up on a pole; their casual use of technology for something as mundane as farming is something you'd have expected out of the Belharan Empire of old and not some rural foxes in the colonies...
rows.translation:
这些田野的北缘被树木的根系所环绕。在这里，有几块田地被闲置着，因为在种植新的作物之前，这片土地需要得到休整——这些狐妖们必须轮流种植不同的作物。几只狐妖在空荡荡的田地里活动，它们撒播着覆盖物和灰烬，而其他的狐妖则将这些物质翻入那片松软、呈深色的土壤中，以此来滋养土壤。

        其余那些尚未被利用的土地上都种上了细长的豆苗，这些豆苗开出了小小的黄色花朵——你可能会认为这些是红小豆，又是狐妖们喜爱的食物之一。从你目前看到的情况来看，他们的农业耕作方式相当集约化，充分利用了每一寸土地。偶尔，你会看到田野里插着一些纸质饰品，它们要么用绳子悬挂着，要么被挂在杆子上；这种将先进技术应用于如此平常的农事活动中的方式，你更会期待在古老的贝尔哈兰帝国看到，而不是在殖民地的这些乡村狐妖身上……

rows.original:
A small pavillion sits atop a mound bordering the northeastern portion of the fields, offering anyone inside a good view of the land laid out before it. Built in the architectural style so familiar to the kitsune, its pillars and rails alike have been fashioned from lacquered wood, simple materials made beautiful with care and time. Flowering vines creep along several pillars, although they don't harm the structure in the least.

        Within, a number of comfortable benches have been set out along the sides, draped with red cloth and with a center of empty space. A nice place to unwind for a bit in between stretches in the fields and reflect on the beauty of the natural world, one supposes.
        
        [rand
        |When you arrive, there's a trio of kitsune kits playing some kind of game with wooden toys. They stare at you wide-eyed as you enter the pavillion, then their natural skittishness gets the better of them and they flee, tails streaming behind them as they scamper out into the wilds.
        |As you arrive, you note that you're not alone; there's a trio of middle-aged foxes getting more than a little tipsy on strong-smelling liquor. None of them are in any position to notice you as they laugh amongst themselves; maybe it's best that they stay that way.[pc.ra kitsune| Having people grovel and bow after you all the time can get just a bit tiring...] 
        |The pavillion is empty when you arrive, save for a refreshing breeze. It may be worth it to just sit down and savour it for a bit before moving on... 
        ]
rows.translation:
在田野东北部边缘的一座小土丘上，矗立着一座小亭子。站在亭子里，人们可以清楚地看到眼前这片广阔的土地。这座亭子采用了狐族十分熟悉的建筑风格，它的柱子和栏杆都是由涂了漆的木头制成的——这些简单的材料，经过精心的制作和时间的沉淀，变得如此美观。攀缘植物沿着几根柱子蔓延生长，不过它们丝毫没有损坏这些结构。

        在内部，沿着墙壁摆放着几张舒适的长椅，长椅上覆盖着红色布料，中间还留有空地。大概是一个在田野间劳作休息时，可以好好放松一下，欣赏大自然之美的好地方吧。
        
        [rand
        |当你到达那里时，会看到三只狐狸正在用木制玩具玩某种游戏。当你走进亭子时，它们会睁大眼睛盯着你，但随后它们天性中的胆怯便占了上风，它们立刻逃跑了，尾巴在身后摇摆着，窜进了树林里。
        |当你到达那里时，你发现自己并不孤单——有三只中年狐狸正在喝着气味浓烈的酒，已经有点醉了。她们正互相笑着，根本没有注意到你的存在；或许让她们保持这种状态反而更好。[pc.ra kitsune| 总是让别人对你卑躬屈膝、恭敬有加，其实也会让人感到有些疲惫……] 
        |当你到达时，亭子里空无一人，只有清新的微风在吹拂。或许，坐下来享受这一刻，然后再继续前进，也是值得的…… 
        ]

rows.original: The interior of this large, well-lit room is cool and dry, kept well-ventilated by numerous barred windows set high into the walls. A draft through this room keeps air circulating and as fresh as anywhere else in the kitsune den, and for good reason. Goods of all manners are stacked and sorted in meticulous order by type; earthenware jars, cloth-wrapped bundles and Marches-style boxes and crates side by side in a pleasing, harmonious arrangement. Merely being able to find goods at a moment's notice is insufficient for the smooth running of this place; they must spark joy. Lining the walls are shelves and racks for smaller or miscellaneous goods as will invariably show up over time. The actual nature of the goods varies: rice and preserves sealed in airtight jars, swatches and bolts of various kinds of fabrics, salt and fresh spices, raw materials. Finished goods, earmarked for distribution or barter, items that could conceivably have come from Hawkethorne or even the Winter City itself. Replacement parts for tools, and other sundry items. Where trade takes place, cultures invariably meet, and in more ways than one. Towards the eastern side of the room are large double doors which lead to a loading bay of sorts — a wide thoroughfare where goods can be easily shipped and received in bulk. Presumably, that opens up to the outside world, but you've never actually had any reason to head that way. [rand |A handful of foxen work at the job of loading and unloading, clearly experienced enough at their job to know their roles and positions without needing to ask. |A large, lumbering wooden puppet — undoubtedly one of the artificer's creations — sees to the heavy lifting, picking up massive barrels and crates as if they weighed nothing and stacking them with exacting finesse.[pc.bg arcanist| It seems simple enough at a first glance, but it's really quite impressive — you know from your time as an arcanist that getting a construct to do something as simple as pick up an egg without crushing it is an uphill task.] |It looks like the storehouse's being audited today, actual goods being checked against the paper inventories. The usual low-key bustle's replaced by a deathly silence as the foxen go about their task with mathematical precision. ] Kohaku's small office occupies a corner of the storehouse, a raised platform of sorts that allows her a good overview of the entire room at a glance — and the entrance, of course. Desk, writing materials and ledgers are all that she needs, save for the single decorative piece — a long scroll hung on the wall behind her desk, exquisite calligraphy encased in a frame of protective glass that might have come from Tychris itself. [pc.ra kitsune |The language of the Old Country is still somewhat foreign to you, but you are able to understand the writing: "To my father, who gave me this opportunity to greet the world, and my mother, who taught me to not fear it. Those setting off on a journey, stop by, those coming home from a journey, stop by." |While you don't know what the writing means, it clearly means a lot to Kohaku for her to frame it like this. ] [rand |Kohaku is sitting at her desk, a few of her many ledgers spread out in front of her. The flow of paperwork in the storehouse just never ends, and for good reason: the better the paper trail, the easier it is to trace any discrepancies. It just takes a certain type of mind to stay on top of it all. |Kohaku is taking a small break from her work, chatting with one of her subordinates while fingering a half-eaten taiyaki. She really does love both... |Kohaku is off to one corner, inspecting the latest [rand|batch of liquor|imports from the Old Country|harvest to be brought in|miscellaneous goods] to arrive in the storehouse. She's very hands-on with the appraisal, unafraid to sniff, poke, and ask her subordinates as to the state of the goods. ]
rows.translation: 这个宽敞且光线充足的房间内部十分凉爽干燥，墙上高处安装的许多带栅栏的窗户确保了空气的顺畅流通。这种通风设计使得房间内的空气始终像狐穴的其他地方一样新鲜清新的，而这也是有充分理由的。各式各样的商品都被按照种类整齐地堆放和分类：陶罐、用布包裹的包裹，以及具有马奇风格的箱子和木架，它们并排摆放在一起，形成一种美观而和谐的布局。仅仅能够随时找到所需的商品，还不足以保证这个地方的运作顺畅；这些商品还必须能够带来愉悦感。墙面上排列着架子和储物架，用来放置那些随着时间推移而不断积累起来的小物件或各种杂物。 这些商品的实际种类多种多样：密封在密封罐中的大米和腌制品、各种面料的样品和布料、盐和新鲜香料、原材料、成品——这些成品都是为了分发或交换而准备的，其中有些物品很可能来自鹰棘镇，甚至就是冬城本身。还有工具的替换零件，以及其他各式各样的物品。每当贸易发生时，不同的文化必然会相遇，而且这种相遇会在很多方面体现出来。 房间的东侧有一扇巨大的双开门，通向一个类似货物装卸区的场所——那里有一条宽阔的通道，可以方便地大批量运输货物。想必，那扇门通向外部世界，但你其实从未有过前往那里的理由。 [rand |有几位狐狸负责装卸工作，她们显然经验丰富，完全能够清楚自己的职责和位置，根本不需要别人提醒。 |一个庞大而笨重的木制傀儡——毫无疑问是那位工匠的杰作——承担了所有的重活，它轻而易举地搬起那些沉重的桶和箱子，然后将它们以极其精准的方式堆放起来。[pc.bg arcanist| 乍看之下，这个任务似乎很简单，但实际上却相当具有挑战性——毕竟，以你作为一名奥术师的经验来说，要让一个造物做出像捡起一个鸡蛋而不把它压碎这样简单的动作，其实是一件相当困难的事情。] |看起来今天仓库要接受审计了，实际的货物将会与纸质库存进行核对。往常那种低调的忙碌气氛已经被死一般的寂静所取代，那些工作人员正以极其精确的方式执行他们的任务。 ] 小白的办公室位于仓库的一个角落，那里有一个略微抬高的平台，让她能够一目了然地看到整个房间的情况——当然，也包括入口处。她的办公桌上只有办公桌、书写用品和账本，唯一的一件装饰品就是挂在她办公桌后面的那幅长卷轴，上面精美的书法作品被装在防护玻璃框中，这种玻璃框恐怕就连提克里斯星自己也未必有。 [pc.ra kitsune |那个古老国度的语言对你来说仍然有些陌生，但你能看懂那些文字。致我的父亲，是您给了我向这个世界展示自己的机会；也致我的母亲，是您教会了我不要畏惧这个世界。那些即将踏上旅程的人，请一定要停下来看看；那些刚刚结束旅程归来的人，也请一定要停下来看看。 |虽然你不知道这些文字的含义，但对她来说，以这样的方式呈现它们显然意义重大。 ] [rand |小白坐在书桌前，面前摊开着她众多的账本中的几本。仓库里堆积如山的文件似乎永远也处理不完，而这也有其原因：记录越详尽，就越容易发现任何异常之处。要想妥善管理这一切，确实需要具备特定的能力才行。 |小白暂时暂停了工作，一边和一名下属聊天，一边啃着半个天妇罗。她真的两者都喜欢…… |小白走到一个角落，仔细检查着最新得到的物品。 [rand|一批酒|从旧大陆进口的商品|即将收获的成果|各类杂货]这些货物终于到货了。她在评估这些货物的过程中非常亲力亲为，毫不畏惧去仔细检查、触摸，并向下属们询问这些货物的具体情况。 ]

Where trade takes place, cultures invariably meet, and in more ways than one. Towards the eastern side of the room are large double doors which lead to a loading bay of sorts — a wide thoroughfare where goods can be easily shipped and received in bulk. Presumably, that opens up to the outside world, but you've never actually had any reason to head that way. [rand |A handful of foxen work at the job of loading and unloading, clearly experienced enough at their job to know their roles and positions without needing to ask. |A large, lumbering wooden puppet — undoubtedly one of the artificer's creations — sees to the heavy lifting, picking up massive barrels and crates as if they weighed nothing and stacking them with exacting finesse.[pc.bg arcanist| It seems simple enough at a first glance, but it's really quite impressive — you know from your time as an arcanist that getting a construct to do something as simple as pick up an egg without crushing it is an uphill task.] |It looks like the storehouse's being audited today, actual goods being checked against the paper inventories. The usual low-key bustle's replaced by a deathly silence as the foxen go about their task with mathematical precision. ] Kohaku's small office occupies a corner of the storehouse, a raised platform of sorts that allows her a good overview of the entire room at a glance — and the entrance, of course. Desk, writing materials and ledgers are all that she needs, save for the single decorative piece — a long scroll hung on the wall behind her desk, exquisite calligraphy encased in a frame of protective glass that might have come from Tychris itself. [pc.ra kitsune |The language of the Old Country is still somewhat foreign to you, but you are able to understand the writing: "To my father, who gave me this opportunity to greet the world, and my mother, who taught me to not fear it. Those setting off on a journey, stop by, those coming home from a journey, stop by." |While you don't know what the writing means, it clearly means a lot to Kohaku for her to frame it like this. ] [rand |Kohaku is sitting at her desk, a few of her many ledgers spread out in front of her. The flow of paperwork in the storehouse just never ends, and for good reason: the better the paper trail, the easier it is to trace any discrepancies. It just takes a certain type of mind to stay on top of it all. |Kohaku is taking a small break from her work, chatting with one of her subordinates while fingering a half-eaten taiyaki. She really does love both... |Kohaku is off to one corner, inspecting the latest [rand|batch of liquor|imports from the Old Country|harvest to be brought in|miscellaneous goods] to arrive in the storehouse. She's very hands-on with the appraisal, unafraid to sniff, poke, and ask her subordinates as to the state of the goods. ]"

rows.original: Here, the rough-hewn edges of the fields fall away, replaced by a far more refined aesthetic emphasising the sublime beauty of nature rather than its rugged vitality. The dirt path falls away to be replaced by one of smooth stone tiles, heavy and firm underfoot; stone lanterns rise in pairs along its length, [dayNight|standing like solemn guardians along your ingress. Shafts of sunlight pierce the high roots above you, starkly brilliant against the muted air. |ghostly foxfire flickering within and lighting your way onward in a blue-hued procession.] Beds of delicate pink and white flowers dot the surroundings amidst vibrant green grass, several low bushes that might be tea sporting hearty verdant leaves standing off to one side. The atmosphere of simple tranquility and slowness is even stronger here; time itself practically comes to a stop when one is here. Up ahead, the end of the path is denoted by a stone staircase and a towering red archway of wood — a torii gate, which in the culture of the Old Country denotes where the mundane ends and the sacred begins. [pc.ra kitsune|A warm feeling of comfort washes over you as you pass under the gate, and you feel at ease. Despite not having been born such, you are still one of Keros' own, and the Trickster watches out for his kind. You are welcome here.|Even though you know you have permission to be here, the very nature of the stylised arch itself seems to resent your mere presence as an outsider. You can't shake the feeling that the gate itself is watching your every move, just in case you do decide to start any kind of funny business.]
rows.translation: 在这里，那些粗糙的田地边缘已经消失，取而代之的是一种更为精致的美学风格——这种风格强调的是大自然的崇高之美，而非它那粗犷的生机。那条土路也被光滑的石板所取代，踩在上面既沉重又稳固；沿着路的两旁，成对地矗立着石灯笼。 [dayNight|它们像庄严的守护者一样矗立在入口处。阳光穿透高大的树根，照射在上面，在昏暗的空气中显得格外明亮。 |幽蓝色的狐火在内部闪烁，为你照亮前行的道路，引领你前行。]周围点缀着淡粉色和白色的花朵，翠绿的草地上，几株可能属于茶树的低矮灌木也长满了茂盛的绿叶。这里弥漫着一种宁静与悠闲的氛围，时间仿佛在这里变得缓慢起来，人们置身其中，会真切感受到时间的停滞。 前方，小路的尽头由一段石阶和一座高耸的红色木制拱门标示出来——那是一道鸟居，而在古老国家的文化中，鸟居象征着世俗与神圣的分界线。 [pc.ra kitsune|当你穿过那道大门时，一种温暖而舒适的感觉涌上心头，让你感到无比安心。尽管你并非天生属于这里，但你依然是凯罗斯的一员，而那个狡黠的家伙总会照顾好他的同类。在这里，你是受欢迎的。|尽管你知道自己有权利在这里，但这座风格独特的拱门本身似乎就在排斥你这个外来者的存在。你始终有一种感觉，那就是那扇门正在注视着你的一举一动，就怕你会做出什么不当的行为。做决定开始做一些有趣的事情。]

rows.original:
The path here ends at a small kitsune shrine, dedicated to their patron deity. Slightly raised above its surroundings on a foundation of worked stone, the shrine's approach is flanked by two stylised statues of foxes, each with what looks like a bib of red cloth tied about their necks; lengths of white cord are strung between the eaves of the gently sloping roof, with what looks like bound slips of paper hanging from them. The entire affair is no bigger than a small shed, but as with everything to do with the Trickster, appearances are deceiving. Railings of lacquered wood surround it on all sides, and the only approach to the entrance is a short wooden staircase leading up to the screen doors.

        Said doors are drawn open, giving you a free view of the shrine's interior. Housed within on a dais is a life-sized stone statue of the Trickster himself, true to his likeness down to the smallest detail. There's a sand-filled brass censer for burning of incense; it emits the same eerie blue glow of foxfire even as it emits a warm, pleasing scent about the shrine's surroundings; the only other notable fixture is a wooden donation box that you're not sure sees any use, given how things are run in the colonies. Maybe it's just there for the sake of being there?
rows.translation:
这条小路最终通向一座供奉着它们守护神的小狐妖神社。神社建在经过加工的石基上，略微高于周围的地面，通往神社的道路两侧各立着一座风格独特的狐妖雕像，这些雕像的脖子上似乎系着红色的布围；在神社微微倾斜的屋顶檐口之间，悬挂着一些白色的绳子，上面挂着看起来像是写有文字的纸条。整个建筑看起来不过是一间小棚屋而已，但就像与“骗子”相关的所有事物一样，外表往往具有欺骗性。它的四周都装有漆过的木制栏杆，而通往入口的唯一途径是一条短短的木制楼梯，那些屏风门就设在楼梯的顶端。

        那些门大开着，让你能够清楚地看到神龛内部的景象。在神龛内的高台上，摆放着一尊与真实人物一模一样的石像，甚至连最细微的细节都刻画得惟妙惟肖。那里还有一个装满沙子的黄铜香炉，用来焚烧香火；当香火燃烧时，会散发出与狐火相似的诡异蓝光，同时也会为整个神龛周围带来温暖而怡人的香气。唯一另一个值得注意的物品，是一个木制的捐款箱——不过考虑到殖民地的运作方式，你实在不确定这个箱子到底有什么用处。也许它只是存在于那里，仅仅为了自身的存在而已？

rows.original: A full traditional-style bathhouse lies spread before you, simple yet atmospheric. Lit by mulberry paper lanterns with foxfire dancing within, the reception area is small, but you soon see why — most of the space has been dedicated to the bathing areas, divided by high stone walls and their entrances covered by colorful, flowing curtains. Cubbyholes for possessions and screens for changing behind take up most of the dry space; there are mens', womens', and an additional two much smaller private baths... those probably cost quite a bit more to enter than the communal baths. Still, it may be very well worth it. The bathing areas themselves are open to the air, giving one a good view of the entirety of the Frostwood from high in the branches of the cherry blossom tree; you think you can even spy the Winter City all the way to the northeast across the tundra. Bamboo pipes bring warm water into the pool from holes in the wooden wall and drain it out after — how there's hot water coming out of a tree is best not questioned. There's a reason why the kitsune consider being able to live in one of these sacred trees a glorious luxury... A rather genial-looking older kitsune woman waits behind the counter, ready to assist her guests with anything they might need.
rows.translation: 一座充满传统风格的浴场呈现在你面前，简洁而富有氛围。接待区由悬挂着萤火虫般闪烁的桑纸灯笼照亮，空间虽然不大，但很快你就会明白原因——大部分空间都被用来布置沐浴区了，这些区域被高高的石墙隔开，入口处则挂着色彩鲜艳、垂坠感强的窗帘。用来存放物品的小储物空间以及用于更衣的屏风占据了大部分干燥的空间；这里有男用浴室、女用浴室，还有另外两间面积小得多的私人浴室……使用这些私人浴室的费用，恐怕要比使用公共浴室高得多。不过，这绝对是非常值得的。 这些沐浴区域都是露天的，从樱花树的高枝上，可以一览整个弗罗斯特伍德的景色；你甚至觉得，能够远远地看到东北方向、穿越苔原之后的冬城。竹管通过木墙上的孔洞将温水引入水池，使用完毕后再将水排出——真是太巧妙了。热门的从……流出的水树这种事最好不要质疑。狐族之所以认为能够生活在这些神圣的树木之中是一种无上的奢侈，其中肯定有原因…… 一位看起来相当和蔼的年长狐族女性站在柜台后面，随时准备为顾客提供任何可能的帮助。

rows.original: The interior of this chamber is tastefully decorated in a mixture of reds and whites, but perhaps the most striking feature of it is that the walls are practically covered with scroll paintings of all kinds. Big and small, simple and detailed, each one usually depicting some scene from nature and all with a poem or the other written upon it in fine calligraphy. This is the office of a man who is trying way too hard to be cultured, and it shows. Where there aren't any scroll paintings, weapons are displayed — a curved greatsword still in its scabbard of lacquered wood, an unstrung bow; there's an armor stand but several of the pieces are evidently in use, leaving the remainder to lie in wait for their fellows to return at the end of the day. A large wooden desk sits on the far end of the room, positioned such that anyone entering via the screen door is immediately visible; behind that, several shelves filled with records and paperwork, arranged with military precision and order. There're curtains in a corner that no doubt divide the private quarters from the more public office space, quietly billowing in the breeze.
rows.translation: 这个房间的内部采用了红色和白色的搭配进行装饰，风格十分雅致。但或许最引人注目的地方在于，房间的墙壁上几乎挂满了各式各样的卷轴画。这些画有的大有的小，有的简单有的复杂，每一幅通常都描绘着大自然中的某个场景，而上面还用精美的书法题上了诗句。 这就是一位致力于……的人的办公室。方式这种人根本不具备接受文化熏陶的能力，这一点显而易见。 在没有挂轴画的地方，武器就被陈列了出来——一把插在漆木剑鞘中的弯曲大剑，一把没有上弦的弓；还有一个盔甲架，但其中几件盔甲显然正在被使用中，剩下的那些则被放在那里，等待当天结束时主人把它们取回来。房间的尽头摆放着一张巨大的木制书桌，其位置安排得如此巧妙，以至于任何从纱门进入房间的人都能立刻看到它；书桌的后面，有几排摆满各类文件和记录的架子，这些架子都被整理得井井有条，充满了军事化的严谨与秩序。角落里挂着窗帘，它们无疑将私人区域与较为公共的办公空间分隔开来，微风中轻轻摆动着。

rows.original: These guest quarters are communal, a plain wooden room lit by foxfire lanterns and possessed of several raised platforms on which futons could be spread out upon. There doesn't seem to be any actual concern for privacy, and a communal firepit in the middle of the room offers some measure of warmth. This is clearly a place where people spend the night, get rested, and get back out on the road the next day with a minimum of fuss. Not exactly worthy of dignitaries, but then again, how often do dignitaries from the Old Country actually visit the colonies, let alone stay the night? Even so, there's been some attempt to pretty up the place — a flower arrangement on a corner shelf, a good view of the Frostwood canopy from the window. Even if it isn't stunning, at least the guest room's atmosphere isn't oppressive. [party.comp cait brint brienne arona atugia berwyn einin kiyoko | "I like it," Cait says. "It kind of reminds me of wayfarers' stations back in Jassira. A lot more crowded, though." | "I don't think I'll fit on one of those," Brint says after a glance at the raised platforms. "Think they'll give me extra blankets if I ask nicely?" | "I don't think I'll fit on one of those," Brienne says after a glance at the raised platforms. "Think they'll give me extra blankets if I ask nicely?" | "Oh, Lumia's tits," Arona moans. "Please don't tell me you're going to stop here for the night, [pc.name]. These soul-suckers are so tiny, using anything sized to them is awkward." | "It's nice to spend a night in a somewhat different place," Atugia muses. "But at the end of the day, home's always the best, don't you think?" | "I'm not sure about spending the night here," Berwyn admits. "These foxes have been looking at me like I'm some kind of particularly delicious morsel..." | "They don't have anywhere for us to put our things?" Einin moans as she looks the room over. "How am I supposed to feel safe?" | "It's no honjin, but it'll do," Kiyoko says matter-of-factly. "Komari would fall over herself to give us her own quarters if I asked it of her... but I don't feel like imposing upon my once-retainer. We will make do with simplicity." ]
rows.translation: 这些客房是共用的，只是一间普通的木屋，里面点着狐火灯，屋内还有几处凸出的平台，可以在上面铺上蒲团休息。看来这里根本不注重隐私问题，而房间中央的公共火坑则为人们提供了些许温暖。这显然是一个人们用来过夜、休息，然后第二天再继续赶路的场所。虽然这里并不适合显要人物居住，但话说回来，老国的显要人物到底有多频繁地会来到这些殖民地，更别说在那里过夜了呢？ 即便如此，人们还是做了一些努力来美化这个地方——在角落的架子上摆放了鲜花，从窗户也能欣赏到霜木林树林的美景。虽然不算惊艳，但至少这个客房的氛围还算不错。压迫性的。 [party.comp cait brint brienne arona atugia berwyn einin kiyoko | 我喜欢它。凯特说道。这让我想起了贾西拉地区的旅人驿站，只不过这里要拥挤得多。 | 我觉得我坐那些东西里肯定挤不进去。布林特看了一眼那些高高的平台后说道。我觉得如果我好好请求的话，他们应该会给我多几条毯子吧？ | 我觉得我坐那些东西里肯定挤不进去。布蕾妮看了一眼那些高高的平台后说道。我觉得如果我好好请求的话，他们应该会给我多几条毯子吧？ | 哦，卢米娅的胸部。阿罗娜发出了呻吟声。别告诉我你打算在这里过夜啊[pc.name]这些小东西实在太小了，使用任何对它们来说尺寸合适的东西都会显得很不方便。 | 在一个有点不一样的地方度过一个夜晚，确实是一件很惬意的事情。阿图吉娅陷入了沉思。但归根结底，家永远是最美好的地方，你不觉得吗？ | 我还不确定是否应该在这里过夜。贝尔温承认了。这些狐狸看我的眼神，就好像我是什么特别美味的小点心一样…… | 他们没有地方让我们放置我们的物品吗？艾宁环顾房间，发出一声叹息。我怎么可能感到安全呢？ | 虽然不是真正的本尊，但也还算可以吧。清子若无其事地说道。如果我向麻里提出请求，她肯定会毫不犹豫地把她的住处让给我们……但我觉得没有必要麻烦这位曾经为我效力过的人。我们就简单点住吧。 ]

rows.original: This fork along the branch curves and turns back towards the tree's gargantuan main trunk, numerous landings and tunnels leading off into its upper reaches. Entrances slowly rise along the bark exterior in a slowly spiralling fashion, each one suggesting a separate domicile — at a glance, you guess there might be about a hundred families total living in the cherry blossom tree, stacked up atop each other along the winding path. The ancient Belharans used to have something like this — insulae, you think it was called, a style that was copied in Khor'minos — but the aesthetics of this are very different, even if the basic idea is the same. Cultural differences, once again.
rows.translation: 这条分岔的小路沿着树枝的弯曲轨迹延伸，最终又折返，朝向那棵大树粗壮的主干方向延伸。沿途有许多平台和小隧道通向树的高处。这些入口沿着树皮逐渐向上延伸，形成螺旋状的分布，每一个入口似乎都通向一个独立的居所——乍一看，你会觉得大概有上百户家庭居住在这棵樱花树上，他们沿着蜿蜒的小路层层叠叠地居住在那里。古代的贝拉尔人曾经使用过类似这样的建筑风格——你应该知道它被称作“岛状建筑”，这种风格后来也被科尔米诺斯所借鉴——但它们的美学表现却大相径庭，尽管基本理念是相同的。这又一次证明了文化差异的存在。
rows.raw: "This fork along the branch curves and turns back towards the tree's gargantuan main trunk, numerous landings and tunnels leading off into its upper reaches. Entrances slowly rise along the bark exterior in a slowly spiralling fashion, each one suggesting a separate domicile — at a glance, you guess there might be about a hundred families total living in the cherry blossom tree, stacked up atop each other along the winding path. The ancient Belharans used to have something like this — insulae, you think it was called, a style that was copied in Khor'minos — but the aesthetics of this are very different, even if the basic idea is the same. Cultural differences, once again."

rows.original:
Stepping away from the courtyard and out onto the branches, one is hit by a dizzying sense of vertigo. You're sure the stairwell up from the roots isn't that high, perhaps one or two stories as you climbed it, yet you must be at least a dozen levels up top at this point. Smoothed polished wood forms several broad walkways that follow the forking branches, and ornately carved guardrails of lacquered wood prevent anyone from accidentally plummeting off the sides. A constant cool breeze blows in from the north, [dayNight|contrasting with the gentle warmth of sunlight on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]|setting the foxfire lanterns that light the path to swaying gently].
            
            Living like this, waking up to nature and a great view of the surrounding land every day — it's easy to see why kitsune who're sufficiently privileged to live this way would fall into slow, mellow lives as opposed to other peoples. Elves of all stripes may live longer than these foxes, but there's an unhurried quality to their daily lives that seems to make even time itself run sluggishly.
rows.translation:
离开庭院，踏上树枝搭成的道路，一阵强烈的眩晕感迎面袭来。你确信从树根处向上的楼梯并没有那么高，爬起来大概只有一两层；可此刻你所在的位置至少已有十几层楼高。打磨光滑的木板沿分叉树枝铺成数条宽阔步道，雕饰华丽的漆木护栏则防止行人失足从边缘坠落。清凉的北风不断吹来，[dayNight|与洒在[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]上的温暖阳光形成鲜明反差|吹得照亮道路的狐火灯笼轻轻摇曳]。
            
            每日醒来便能亲近自然、俯瞰周围大地——不难理解，有幸过上这种生活的狐妖为何会比其他族群更加悠缓闲适。各族精灵或许比这些狐狸更长寿，但狐妖日常生活中那种不紧不慢的气息，仿佛连时间本身都被拖慢了。

rows.original:
The staircase's upper landing opens out into a wide, open-air courtyard, formed from the convergence of the tree's many branches. Shaded by broad leaves hanging from the tree's upper branches, this vast, open area serves as a village square, a place where foxes gather like the landing below it — albeit with a much more leisurely and relaxed atmosphere compared to the bustle down below. The courtyard's middle is dominated by a large, grassy garden, crisscrossed with paths of fine gravel and complete with a circular pond with a bridge spanning its length. Meticulously trimmed shrubs ring the garden's edge, providing even more greenery, and the scent of freshness pervades the area, mixing with that of sap.

        [dayNight
        |Soft voices ring out in the packed square — or at least, packed by kitsune standards — speaking in that lilting, foreign language these fox-people have brought with them from an ocean away. Fluffy tails brush against each other as foxes gather and part, somewhere on the other end of the courtyard, a child laughs. Taking advantage of the constant breeze, someone's flying a kite, a speck of color against the clear Marches sky. It's all very idyllic. 
        |Under the cover of evening, the courtyard is hushed and muted, the sound of wind through leaves the loudest noise about. Being the central focus of the kitsune den, it's never completely empty, but the few vulpine silhouettes that stride about their business clearly have no fear of the dark here. Glimmering with foxfire, stone lanterns atop posts cast watery, spectral luminescence, lighting the paths that lead away from the central courtyard.
        ]
rows.translation:
楼梯的上层平台通向一个宽敞的露天庭院，这个庭院是由树木众多树枝交织而成的。宽阔的树叶从树枝的上方垂下来，为这个广阔的空间提供了阴凉，使得这里成为了村庄的广场——就像下方的平台一样，也是狐妖们聚集的地方。不过，与下方的热闹喧嚣相比，这里的气氛要宁静得多，也更加悠闲放松。庭院的中央是一片广阔的草地，小径由细碎的砾石铺成，形成纵横交错的路径；其中还有一个圆形的池塘，池塘上架着一座桥。修剪整齐的灌木环绕着花园的边缘，为这片区域增添了更多的绿意，清新的气息弥漫在空气中，与草木的芳香交织在一起。

        [dayNight
        |在这个拥挤的广场上，柔和的声音回荡着——至少，按照狐族的标准来看，这个广场已经相当拥挤了。那些狐族人们用他们从遥远的大海彼岸带来的那种轻快而陌生的语言交谈着。当狐狸们聚拢又分散时，它们柔软的尾巴会相互轻触。在庭院的另一端，一个孩子的笑声传来。趁着微风，有人正在放风筝，那五彩斑斓的纸鸢在清澈的三月天空中划出一道道美丽的痕迹。这一切，都显得如此宁静而美好。 
        |在夜色的掩护下，庭院变得寂静无声，风穿过树叶发出的声音几乎是这里最响亮的声响。作为狐族居所的中心地带，这里从来不会完全空无一人，但那些忙碌穿梭的狐影显然并不惧怕黑暗。石柱上悬挂的石灯散发着幽淡的光芒，为通往庭院外围的小路提供了照明。
        ]

rows.original:
This section of path away from the central courtyard forks along the branch's natural divergence, leading downwards. While you're still a dizzying height about the ground, at least the walkways are broader and the guardrails of lacquered wood sturdy looking, allaying any fears one might have about falling off and plummeting to the ground far below. Flowering vines hang from higher branches, giving off a warm, sweet scent; more of them crawl along the guardrails, blurring the distinction between nature and artifice. Everything is well-kept and maintained, with nary a board underfoot out of place or scratch on any of the posts. Stone lanterns stand along the path at regular intervals, [dayNight
            |as much aesthetic as they are practical.
            |ablaze with foxfire as they flicker in the night.
            ]
rows.translation:
这段远离中央庭院的小路沿着树枝的自然分岔处向下延伸。虽然你仍然处于令人头晕的高处，但至少这里的通道更为宽阔，而那些漆过的木制护栏也显得十分结实，足以消除人们对于会从高处坠落下去的担忧。开花的藤蔓从较高的树枝上垂下来，散发着温暖而甜美的香气；还有更多的藤蔓沿着护栏蔓延开来，使得自然与人工造物的界限变得模糊不清。一切都保养得非常好，脚下的木板没有一块是摆放不整齐的，任何一根柱子上也没有一丝划痕。道路两旁每隔一段距离就矗立着石灯笼。 [dayNight
            |这些设计既美观又实用。
            |在夜色中闪烁着狐火般的光芒。
            ]

rows.original:
The den matron's residence is slightly bigger than most, a mark of her station both governmental and divine. Past the entryway, guests are ushered into a fine reception area, decorated with a number of fine calligraphy scrolls and flower arrangements by her own hand. Large windows let in plenty of natural [dayNight|sun|moon and star]light, and comfortable seating and a low table form the centerpiece of the reception area.

        Divided from the main area by several carefully placed screens, Komari's office lies towards the back, carefully out of sight yet within easy reach of more business-minded visitors. Shelves and cupboards line the walls, bursting with literal centuries' worth of careful bookkeeping and historical records penned by Komari herself. One might perhaps expect more lavish and exquisite detail for the workspace belonging to the governor of the western colonies, but then again, one does not go to the colonies and expect to find leisure or luxury.
rows.translation:
这位女首领的居所比大多数人的都要宽敞一些，这既体现了她在政府中的地位，也象征着她所拥有的神圣权威。一进入大门，宾客们就会被引入一个装饰精美的接待区，那里挂满了她亲笔书写的书法作品，还摆放着她亲手布置的花卉。大窗户让充足的自然光线洒进室内[dayNight|太阳|繁星与月亮]明亮舒适的座椅以及低矮的桌子构成了接待区的核心元素。 

        通过几块精心摆放的屏风，麻里的办公室与主要区域被隔开了——它位于后方，既不会被来访者看到，同时又方便那些需要进行商务交流的访客使用。墙壁上排列着书架和橱柜，里面存放着由麻里亲自整理的、历经数个世纪积累下来的各种书籍和历史记录。对于一位负责管理西部殖民地的官员来说，他的工作空间本应更加奢华精致才对，但反过来想，去殖民地的人本来就不指望能享受到奢华与舒适。

rows.original: Kinu should be around here somewhere, hanging about the den matron and assisting her in her daily affairs while familiarising herself with the tasks that'll be demanded of her in the future. If you wanted to find her, it wouldn't be a hard matter...
rows.translation: 小娟应该就在附近的某个地方，她正在帮巢穴的女首领处理日常事务，同时也在熟悉将来会要求她完成的任务。如果你想找到她，应该不会太难……
rows.raw: "Kinu should be around here somewhere, hanging about the den matron and assisting her in her daily affairs while familiarising herself with the tasks that'll be demanded of her in the future. If you wanted to find her, it wouldn't be a hard matter..."

rows.original:
Curling downwards along the tree's gargantuan trunk, this length of walkway spirals downwards, supported by knots and woody protrusions on its way down. The balance of nature and artifice is somewhat more tilted towards the latter, but the artisans have clearly endeavored to make up what's lacking in natural beauty with fine craftsmanship. The walkway is a bit narrower than most, perhaps owing to its nature, but at least the wooden guardrails look steady enough to avoid most mishaps.

        Various doors and entrances lead off from the walkway, no doubt the individual homes of the families who live here. You remember that there're supposed to be about a hundred families total residing in this den... amazing when one stops to think about it, really.
rows.translation:
这段蜿蜒曲折的步道沿着树木巨大的树干向下延伸，呈螺旋状盘旋而下，其路径上分布着各种结节和木质突起作为支撑。在这里，自然与人工的结合略显偏向人工设计的一面，但工匠们显然付出了巨大努力，用精湛的技艺弥补了自然之美所欠缺的部分。这条通道比大多数通道都要窄一些，或许这是由于它的设计初衷所致，但至少那些木制的护栏看起来非常结实，足以防止大多数意外事故的发生。

        通道的两侧分布着各种各样的门和入口，这些无疑都是居住在这里的家庭们的住所。你应该还记得，这个地方总共应该住着大约一百户家庭吧……仔细想想，真是不可思议啊。

rows.original: You stand high above the Marefolk Village, watching the equines come and go far beneath your feet. They barely look like horses at all from this angle, so similar to humans aside from the shape of their heads. All around you, the grassy plains of the valley and the rippling waters of the lake stretch to the horizons, converging perfectly around the village. A pillar of light shines up from the middle of the village, emanating from a damaged Lupine statue.
rows.translation: 你站在马人村的上方，俯瞰着脚底下来来去去的马群。从这个角度看，它们几乎完全不像是马，除了头部的形状外，与人类极为相似。周围，山谷中的草地和平原以及湖面上荡漾的波光一直延伸到地平线，将整个村庄完美地环绕在其中。一束光芒从村庄的中心升起，那光芒源自一座受损的狼族雕像。
rows.raw: "\n        You stand high above the Marefolk Village, watching the equines come and go far beneath your feet. They barely look like horses at all from this angle, so similar to humans aside from the shape of their heads. All around you, the grassy plains of the valley and the rippling waters of the lake stretch to the horizons, converging perfectly around the village. A pillar of light shines up from the middle of the village, emanating from a damaged Lupine statue. "

rows.original: Fixing your eyes on one of the distant pillars of light, you start walking through the shadowy clouds and across the plains of glassy crystal beneath your feet. Every step bears you forward by leagues and bounds, traversing miles and miles in the blink of an eye.
rows.translation: 你将目光投向远处那些闪烁的光柱，开始穿过那些阴暗的云层，踏过脚下那些如玻璃般晶莹剔透的平原。每一步都让你向前迈进数里之远，在转瞬之间就能穿越数英里的距离。
rows.raw: "\n        Fixing your eyes on one of the distant pillars of light, you start walking through the shadowy clouds and across the plains of glassy crystal beneath your feet. Every step bears you forward by leagues and bounds, traversing miles and miles in the blink of an eye."

rows.original: Beneath you is a tiny little hamlet, tucked between the sprawling northern forest, the craggy peaks of the eastern mountains, and the vast expanse of valley plains of the south. Hawkethorne seems even more sleepy and peaceful from this height, and its handful of denizens seem like nothing but ants, scurrying about their business. A pillar of light shines up from the town square, where an ancient Marcher-Baron is immortalized in stone near the steps of the church.
rows.translation: 在你脚下，有一个小小的村庄，它被辽阔的北方森林、东部山脉的崎岖山峰以及南部广阔的谷地和平原所环绕。从这个高度望去，鹰棘镇显得更加宁静而安详，那里为数不多的居民就像蚂蚁一样，在自己的小天地里忙碌着。镇中心的广场上，有一道光芒直射而上——在教堂的台阶旁，一位古老的马彻男爵被用石头纪念着，他的形象被永远镌刻在了那里。

Hawkethorne seems even more sleepy and peaceful from this height, and its handful of denizens seem like nothing but ants, scurrying about their business. A pillar of light shines up from the town square, where an ancient Marcher-Baron is immortalized in stone near the steps of the church."

rows.original:
You're standing high above the fast-flowing river that cuts across the northern forests of the Marches. [wayfort.stateABC
            |Beneath you is an old stone fortress, perhaps elven in origin, though it has long crumbled in disrepair. A great pillar of light shines up from its courtyard, where the statue of some forgotten lord stands nobly amongst the ruin of his realm.
            |Beneath you is the old stone fortress that is the Wayfort, looking rennovated to function, if not form.
            |Beneath you is your pride and joy, the Wayfort, a stone building you've had restored to your exacting specification. The glorious [wayfort.statueDrEDL|dragon|elf|demon|lupine] statue stands watch over it all in your absence.
        ]
rows.translation:
你站在高处，脚下是横贯边疆北部森林的湍急河流。[wayfort.stateABC
            |下方是一座古老的石堡，或许出自精灵之手，但早已年久失修，破败不堪。巨大的光柱从庭院升起，一位被遗忘的领主的雕像高贵地矗立在领地的废墟之间。

        ]

rows.original:
You gaze down upon the foothills, surrounding the great eastern mountains like a skirt of stone. Ruins dot the landscape, and valleys and caves pock-mark the hillsides in every direction. You can vaguely see the walls of the orcish warcamp from here, surrounded by smoke. A pillar of light shines up from the hillside nearby, where an ancient Minotaur statue welcomes you.[flags.WC_CLEAR|[kas.romantic|
        
        There is a pathway north from here, shrouded in mist and flecks of falling crystal. It's not like the other roads through the Between, hazy and indistinct. ]|]
rows.translation:
你俯瞰着那些山脚，它们像一条石制的裙摆般环绕着巍峨的东山。废墟散布在大地之上，山谷与洞穴在山坡上随处可见。从这里，你可以隐约看到那些被烟雾笼罩的兽人军营的围墙。附近的山坡上，一道光芒直冲云霄，那里有一座古老的弥诺陶洛斯雕像正在迎接你的到来。[flags.WC_CLEAR|[kas.romantic|
        
        从这里向北有一条小路，道路被迷雾和飘落的晶体碎片笼罩着。它与其他穿过“中间地带”的道路不同，那些道路都是朦胧而模糊的，难以辨认的。 ]|]
rows.raw:
"
        You gaze down upon the foothills, surrounding the great eastern mountains like a skirt of stone. Ruins dot the landscape, and valleys and caves pock-mark the hillsides in every direction. You can vaguely see the walls of the orcish warcamp from here, surrounded by smoke. A pillar of light shines up from the hillside nearby, where an ancient Minotaur statue welcomes you.[flags.WC_CLEAR|[kas.romantic|
        
        There is a pathway north from here, shrouded in mist and flecks of falling crystal. It's not like the other roads through the Between, hazy and indistinct. ]|]"

rows.original: Fixing your eyes on one of the distant pillars of light, you start walking through the shadowy clouds and across the plains of glassy crystal beneath your feet. Every step bears you forward by leagues and bounds, traversing miles and miles in the blink of an eye.
rows.translation: 你将目光投向远处那些闪烁的光柱，开始穿过那些阴暗的云层，踏过脚下那些如玻璃般晶莹剔透的平原。每一步都让你向前迈进数里之远，在转瞬之间就能穿越数英里的距离。
rows.raw: "\n        Fixing your eyes on one of the distant pillars of light, you start walking through the shadowy clouds and across the plains of glassy crystal beneath your feet. Every step bears you forward by leagues and bounds, traversing miles and miles in the blink of an eye."

rows.original: You gaze down upon the sight of the gargantuan cherry blossom tree in the north-western Frostwood, as large as any Belharan keep and many times as tall. There's no pillar of light here, though; you remember that the kitsune are able to control who uses their "borrowed" and improved gate technology. Nevertheless, you know you should be on their whitelist, and indeed, as you step towards where the usual pillar of light should be a torii gate erupts from the ghostly ground of the Ways Between, mists filling the space within the arch.
rows.translation: 你俯瞰着位于弗罗斯特伍德西北部的那棵巨型樱花树——它的规模不亚于任何一座贝尔哈兰的城堡，高度更是远远超过那些城堡。不过这里并没有那道光柱；你记得，那些狐妖能够控制谁可以使用他们“借用”并改进后的传送门技术。不过，你确信自己应该被列入他们的白名单之中。果然，当你走向那个本该有光柱的地方时鸟居大门从“道路之间”那幽暗的地面上突现出来，雾气弥漫在拱门内的空间之中。
rows.raw: '\n You gaze down upon the sight of the gargantuan cherry blossom tree in the north-western Frostwood, as large as any Belharan keep and many times as tall. There\'s no pillar of light here, though; you remember that the kitsune are able to control who uses their "borrowed" and improved gate technology. Nevertheless, you know you should be on their whitelist, and indeed, as you step towards where the usual pillar of light should be a torii gate erupts from the ghostly ground of the Ways Between, mists filling the space within the arch.'

rows.original: Below you is the Winter City, what once was the capitol of a great elven empire. It's high walls and fearsome keep are evidence of the ancient might of the boer'alvar, shielding the city from any that would mean it harm. Above it, and encompassing much of the palace, is a great glacier rising into the arctic north. You can just make out a cloudy plain atop it, stretching on for miles and miles...
rows.translation: 眼前便是这座冬城，它曾是一个伟大精灵帝国的首都。高耸的城墙与令人畏惧的堡垒，无不彰显着这些“布尔阿尔瓦人”昔日的强盛力量，这些防御工事有效地保护着这座城市，使其免受任何潜在的威胁。而在城市的上方，覆盖着大部分宫殿区域的是一片巨大的冰川，它一直延伸到北极的寒冷地带。在冰川的顶部，还能隐约看到一片云雾缭绕的平原，那片平原绵延数英里……
rows.raw: "\n        Below you is the Winter City, what once was the capitol of a great elven empire. It's high walls and fearsome keep are evidence of the ancient might of the boer'alvar, shielding the city from any that would mean it harm. Above it, and encompassing much of the palace, is a great glacier rising into the arctic north. You can just make out a cloudy plain atop it, stretching on for miles and miles..."

rows.original: You stand above the Centaur Village, looking on from the downward slope of the ravine. At this height, the trotting hal-equine folk could easily be mistaken for humans leading a particularly large group of horses. The mountainsides don't look nearly as daunting from this height, looking more like a snug shell that keeps the village safe from any entry barring it's front door. Any entry, that is, besides the pillar of light that emanates from the statue of paired gods in a small, out of the way copse of trees.
rows.translation: 你站在半人马村落落庄的上方，从峡谷的斜坡上向下望去。从这个高度来看，那些骑着矮种马的人们简直就像是一群人类在带领着一群特别庞大的马群。从这里望去，山势似乎并没有那么令人望而生畏，反而更像是一个坚固的屏障，将村庄保护得严严实实，只有从正门才能进入。当然，也还有那道从一片隐蔽的小树林中矗立着的双神雕像那里散发出来的光柱，它是另一条通往村庄的通道。
rows.raw: "\n        You stand above the Centaur Village, looking on from the downward slope of the ravine. At this height, the trotting hal-equine folk could easily be mistaken for humans leading a particularly large group of horses. The mountainsides don't look nearly as daunting from this height, looking more like a snug shell that keeps the village safe from any entry barring it's front door. Any entry, that is, besides the pillar of light that emanates from the statue of paired gods in a small, out of the way copse of trees."

rows.original: From your lofty heights, you behold the great mountains surrounding and overbearing Khor'minos. Despite the shield of stone covering the deeplands, you can make out a faint outline down below — an abandoned caravanserai, from which a pillar of light shines up from the statue of a Tiran bovine protecting her flock.
rows.translation: 从你高耸的位置望去，你可以看到那些环绕着科尔米诺斯、令其显得黯然失色的群山。尽管那些幽深的山谷被石墙覆盖着，你仍然能够隐约看到下方有一处遗迹——一座废弃的商队旅馆，而从那里，一束光芒从守护羊群的蒂拉教会的牛雕像处照射出来。
rows.raw: "\n        From your lofty heights, you behold the great mountains surrounding and overbearing Khor'minos. Despite the shield of stone covering the deeplands, you can make out a faint outline down below — an abandoned caravanserai, from which a pillar of light shines up from the statue of a Tiran bovine protecting her flock."

rows.original: From your lofty heights, you behold the great mountains surrounding and overbearing the deeplands. Despite the shield of stone covering the deeplands, you can clearly see the great city of Khor'minos, shining like a beacon against the darkness. A statue of a minotaur soldier holding up a torch stands at the vanguard, lighting the way for travelers in this world and the one below.
rows.translation: 从你高耸的位置望去，你可以看到那些环绕着低地、仿佛将其压倒的巍峨山脉。尽管低地被石层覆盖，你仍然能够清晰地看到科尔米诺斯这座伟大的城市——它在黑暗中犹如一座明亮的灯塔。在道路的前方，有一座手持火炬的米诺陶尔士兵的雕像，它为这个世界以及下方的世界中的旅行者们指明方向。
rows.raw: "\n        From your lofty heights, you behold the great mountains surrounding and overbearing the deeplands. Despite the shield of stone covering the deeplands, you can clearly see the great city of Khor'minos, shining like a beacon against the darkness. A statue of a minotaur soldier holding up a torch stands at the vanguard, lighting the way for travelers in this world and the one below."

rows.original:
Before you is what could only be described as a palace, a sprawling structure that stretches out to... somewhere, you can't see far through the mist clinging to this otherworldly realm. But the shadow the building casts is deep indeed. Under your feet, beneath the crystalline glass of the realm's floor, you can see the indistinct outline of a crumbling tower[flags.SHAR_MET| — the same one where you first met Shar!]
        
        A stone wall, about Brint-high, surrounds the palace before you. There's a single gate of wood and iron between you and the door, [kas.romantic|currently sitting open and inviting. This must be Kasyrra's dream-realm abode.|shut tight and sealed. Somehow, you know that there is no way to circumvent this seal; that the realm itself will twist and contort to prevent you.]
rows.translation:
呈现在你眼前的是一座堪称宫殿的建筑，它规模庞大，延伸至……某个你看不见的地方，因为迷雾笼罩着这个超凡脱俗的世界。然而，这座建筑投下的阴影确实十分浓重。在你的脚下，在这个世界由水晶般的玻璃构成的地面上，你可以看到一座摇摇欲坠的塔楼模糊的轮廓。[flags.SHAR_MET| 就是你第一次遇到莎尔的那个地方！]
        
        在你面前，有一道大约有布林特高度的石墙环绕着宫殿。在你和那扇大门之间，只有一道由木头和铁制成的门。 [kas.romantic|此刻，它敞开着大门，仿佛在热情邀请人们进入。这肯定就是卡西拉梦中的家园吧。|密封得严严实实。你心里很清楚，根本没有任何办法可以打破这种密封；那个领域本身会做出各种扭曲变形来阻止你。]
rows.raw:
"
        Before you is what could only be described as a palace, a sprawling structure that stretches out to... somewhere, you can't see far through the mist clinging to this otherworldly realm. But the shadow the building casts is deep indeed. Under your feet, beneath the crystalline glass of the realm's floor, you can see the indistinct outline of a crumbling tower[flags.SHAR_MET| — the same one where you first met Shar!]

This must be Kasyrra's dream-realm abode.|shut tight and sealed. Somehow, you know that there is no way to circumvent this seal; that the realm itself will twist and contort to prevent you.]"

rows.original: Matiha’s teleporting fortress stands before you, jutting up from the crystalline glass floor of the Ways Between. The tower still has its little garden in the courtyard, just beyond the fortress’s original front gate. Steps lead up to the door, closed solidly against possible intrusion.
rows.translation: 玛蒂哈的传送堡垒就矗立在你面前，它从“道路之间”的水晶玻璃地面中突兀地耸立起来。这座塔的庭院里仍然有一座小花园，就在堡垒正门的后方。台阶通向大门，大门紧闭着，以防止任何人闯入。
rows.raw: "\n        Matiha’s teleporting fortress stands before you, jutting up from the crystalline glass floor of the Ways Between. The tower still has its little garden in the courtyard, just beyond the fortress’s original front gate. Steps lead up to the door, closed solidly against possible intrusion."

rows.original: Below you is the Palace of Light. Its spires look even more majestic from above, like a radiant gemstone tucked into the glacier. A pillar of light shines straight through the keep's roof, marking the location of its waystone.
rows.translation: 下方便是光明宫殿。从高处望去，它的尖塔显得更加雄伟壮观，宛如一颗镶嵌在冰川中的璀璨宝石。一束光芒直射穿过城堡的屋顶，标示出了那块指引道路的石碑的位置。
rows.raw: "\n        Below you is the Palace of Light. Its spires look even more majestic from above, like a radiant gemstone tucked into the glacier. A pillar of light shines straight through the keep's roof, marking the location of its waystone."

rows.original:
You stand high above the little village of fox-folk on the mountaintop, as though you were on top of the very world itself. You can see for miles around: the deep green of the Old Forest, the sprawling gold of Hawkstone Valley, and the craggy gray of the foothills to one side; on the other, the treacherous coastlands of eastern Khor'minos, and the azure sea beyond. Your adopted home seems so small from here, so insignificant, like nothing more than an errant stain on the gods' own maps. 

        You shake that thought off and move on.
rows.translation:
你站在山顶之上，远远俯瞰着那个狐狸族的小村庄，仿佛自己置身于世界的顶端。目光所及之处，尽收眼底：远处是古古林的深绿色，霍克斯通山谷中蔓延开的金黄色景色，一侧是崎岖的灰色山麓；而另一边，则是科尔米诺斯东部危险的海岸线，以及那片蔚蓝的大海。从这里看，你那个被接纳的家显得如此渺小，如此微不足道，简直就像神明们地图上一个无足轻重的污点罢了。

        你甩开这个念头，继续前行。
rows.raw:
"
        You stand high above the little village of fox-folk on the mountaintop, as though you were on top of the very world itself. You can see for miles around: the deep green of the Old Forest, the sprawling gold of Hawkstone Valley, and the craggy gray of the foothills to one side; on the other, the treacherous coastlands of eastern Khor'minos, and the azure sea beyond. Your adopted home seems so small from here, so insignificant, like nothing more than an errant stain on the gods' own maps. 

        You shake that thought off and move on."

rows.original:
You soar high over even the most adventurous harpies here, a [pc.mf
            |king
            |queen
        ] of the skies second only to Sorra herself. Beneath you is the stronghold of the local harpy clan, a reclaimed Imperial Belharan bath house that's managed to retain a bit of its ancient glory — even if its occupants are a bit feather-brained, it's hard to go wrong with such strong foundations. You can see many-colored birds flying all around the place, hundreds of them coming and going without a care in the world. Even the roaring winds and biting cold of the high mountains can't dampen their songs.
rows.translation:
你甚至比这里最勇猛的鹰身女妖还要飞得更高更远，真是[pc.mf
            |国王
            |女王
        ]在天空之中，只有索拉本人能与之媲美。你的脚下是当地女妖族的据点——那是一座被改造而来的帝国贝拉兰浴场，它依然保留着昔日的辉煌与风采。尽管居住在那里的族人们有些头脑简单，但有了如此坚实的基础，一切都显得顺理成章。你可以看到五颜六色的鸟儿在四周飞舞，成百上千只鸟儿来来去去，无忧无虑。即便是高山上呼啸的风声和刺骨的寒意，也无法抑制它们歌声的传播。
rows.raw:
"
        You soar high over even the most adventurous harpies here, a [pc.mf
            |king
            |queen
        ] of the skies second only to Sorra herself. Beneath you is the stronghold of the local harpy clan, a reclaimed Imperial Belharan bath house that's managed to retain a bit of its ancient glory — even if its occupants are a bit feather-brained, it's hard to go wrong with such strong foundations. You can see many-colored birds flying all around the place, hundreds of them coming and going without a care in the world. Even the roaring winds and biting cold of the high mountains can't dampen their songs."

rows.original: The view from here is breathtaking: the Sea of Sapphires meets the chalk-white cliffs of the eastern Hornpeaks, and stretches out into the distance. You can see the faintest suggestion of islands beyond the coast, the furthest edge of the Sailgrave Archipelago. Beneath you are the outskirts of eastern Khor'minos, a small villa half-protected by the stone with a waterfront view.
rows.translation: 从这里望去，景色简直美得令人窒息：蓝宝石般的海洋与霍恩峰东部那白垩色峭壁相接，一直延伸到远方。在海岸线之外，你可以隐约看到一些岛屿的轮廓，那是赛尔格雷夫群岛的最远边界。而在你脚下，则是科尔米诺斯东部的郊区，有一座被石头半遮半掩的小别墅，它坐落在临海的位置。
rows.raw: "\n        The view from here is breathtaking: the Sea of Sapphires meets the chalk-white cliffs of the eastern Hornpeaks, and stretches out into the distance. You can see the faintest suggestion of islands beyond the coast, the furthest edge of the Sailgrave Archipelago. Beneath you are the outskirts of eastern Khor'minos, a small villa half-protected by the stone with a waterfront view."

rows.original: Beneath you now are the high and proud Greyvale Mountains. Snowmelt runs from the peaks, feeding into the rivers that crosscross the Frost Marches all the way out to the eastern coast of the continent or into the lush lakes of the western plains. From this high vantage, you can see small ruins dotting the mountaintops, coated in thick layers of ice and snow, forgotten by the lowlanders for generations.
rows.translation: 此刻，你脚下便是那巍峨壮丽的格雷瓦尔山脉。融雪从山峰上流淌下来，汇入那些穿越霜冻之地、一直延伸到大陆东海岸的河流，或是注入西部平原上那些郁郁葱葱的湖泊。从这个高处望去，你可以看到山巅上散布着一些小小的废墟，它们被厚厚的冰雪覆盖着，已经被低地的人们遗忘了好几个世代。
rows.raw: "Beneath you now are the high and proud Greyvale Mountains. Snowmelt runs from the peaks, feeding into the rivers that crosscross the Frost Marches all the way out to the eastern coast of the continent or into the lush lakes of the western plains. From this high vantage, you can see small ruins dotting the mountaintops, coated in thick layers of ice and snow, forgotten by the lowlanders for generations."

rows.original: You're standing high above the clouds, staring down at Tychris. It's a beautiful city, no doubt about that, shining in the [dayNight|light|moonlight] like a thousand crystals. So much glass, in so many different colors... you've never seen anything quite like it. In pride of place atop a hill sits the palace, flanked on one side by its Narevan cathedral and on the other by the extensive athletic fields the city's known for, almost as much as it is for its scholarship. Unique among the Ways you've seen so far, though, you aren't actually alone here — not entirely, anyway. There's a statue of the serpent goddess in the Ways Between, seated on the crystal floor as surely as your own two feet, staring at you with obsidian eyes. [pc.ra astrida|You can feel the goddess's presence here... a sentry against invasion from beyond, standing vigil over her precious city for eternity.|Some kind of sentinel, perhaps? Or just a leftover from ancient times, when the magisters of the city could use the Ways as you can. Who knows?]
rows.translation: 你站在云层之上，俯瞰着提克里斯。这座城市确实非常美丽，在阳光下闪闪发光。 [dayNight|光|兼职工作]就像成千上万的水晶一样。如此多的玻璃，呈现出如此多不同的颜色……你绝对从未见过这样的景象。 那座宫殿傲然坐落在山顶上，一侧是纳雷万大教堂，另一侧则是这座城市闻名的广阔运动场——这些运动场几乎与这座城市在学术领域的成就一样令人瞩目。 然而，在你迄今为止所见过的所有建筑中，这座宫殿确实独树一帜，因为它……其实并不是你想象中的那种样子。独自一人这里——至少不是完全如此。这里有一座蛇女神的雕像。在……里面那些存在于两者之间的道路，它们就如同你的双脚一样稳固地坐落在水晶地面之上，用那些黑曜石般的眼睛凝视着你。 [pc.ra astrida|在这里，你能感受到女神的存在……她就像是一道屏障，守护着这片土地，防止外来的入侵者侵犯她那珍贵的城市，永远守卫着它。|也许是一种守卫机制？又或者只是远古时代遗留下来的东西，那时这座城市的法师们也能像你现在这样使用这些通道。谁知道呢？]
rows.raw: "You're standing high above the clouds, staring down at Tychris. It's a beautiful city, no doubt about that, shining in the [dayNight|light|moonlight] like a thousand crystals. So much glass, in so many different colors... you've never seen anything quite like it. In pride of place atop a hill sits the palace, flanked on one side by its Narevan cathedral and on the other by the extensive athletic fields the city's known for, almost as much as it is for its scholarship. Unique among the Ways you've seen so far, though, you aren't actually alone here — not entirely, anyway. There's a statue of the serpent goddess in the Ways Between, seated on the crystal floor as surely as your own two feet, staring at you with obsidian eyes. [pc.ra astrida|You can feel the goddess's presence here... a sentry against invasion from beyond, standing vigil over her precious city for eternity.|Some kind of sentinel, perhaps? Or just a leftover from ancient times, when the magisters of the city could use the Ways as you can. Who knows?]"

rows.original:
Just beyond the vaulted entrance to the hive is a massive hexagonal chamber, extending nearly a hundred yards across each wall. Pillars of gilden wax support the ceiling high above, and great webs of glistening honey are roped across nearly every surface, crystallized and set with candles that illuminate the great hall. 

        [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED
            |Several dozen hornet-girls are coming and going through the chamber. Patrols launch and return, and those that come back with bounty are eagerly handing off the spoils of their adventure to younger women and drone chaperones.
            |Dozens and dozens of bimbofied hornet-girls are lounging around the perimeter of the chamber, gleefully fucking each other and sucking on honey-swollen tits. Better they stay here than go menacing folk in the forest, you suppose...
        ]
        
        Great arches south will take you back to the landing pad. Smaller portals north lead deeper into the hive.
rows.translation:
在通往蜂巢的拱形入口之后，是一间巨大的六边形大厅，每面墙的宽度都接近一百码。金色的蜡柱支撑着高高的天花板，而几乎所有的表面都覆盖着闪闪发光的蜂蜜结晶体，这些结晶体上还插着蜡烛，为整个大厅带来了明亮的光芒。 

        [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED
            |几十名“黄蜂女”在房间里来回穿梭。巡逻队出发又归来，那些带着战利品回来的成员，会迫不及待地将他们的收获交给年轻的女性和负责监督的无人机。
            |成群结队的那些被迷奸后的蜂后般的女子正懒洋洋地躺在房间的周围，开心地互相交配，同时吮吸着那些因性兴奋而肿胀的乳房。我想，让她们待在这里总比让她们去森林里威胁别人要好吧……
        ]
        
        南边的巨大拱门会带你回到着陆平台，而北边那些较小的传送门则会通往蜂巢的更深处。
rows.raw:
"
        Just beyond the vaulted entrance to the hive is a massive hexagonal chamber, extending nearly a hundred yards across each wall. Pillars of gilden wax support the ceiling high above, and great webs of glistening honey are roped across nearly every surface, crystallized and set with candles that illuminate the great hall. 

        [flags.HIVE_PURIFIED
            |Several dozen hornet-girls are coming and going through the chamber. Patrols launch and return, and those that come back with bounty are eagerly handing off the spoils of their adventure to younger women and drone chaperones.
            |Dozens and dozens of bimbofied hornet-girls are lounging around the perimeter of the chamber, gleefully fucking each other and sucking on honey-swollen tits. Better they stay here than go menacing folk in the forest, you suppose...
        ]
        
        Great arches south will take you back to the landing pad. Smaller portals north lead deeper into the hive."

rows.original: You stand in an interior section of the hive, a hexagonal room seeming to serve little purpose besides connecting other chambers. The walls are catacombed with smaller hexes, some filled with honey or baubles, others empty. Several have been waxed over, keeping their contents safe and hidden. Open archways connect to chambers south, north, and west.
rows.translation: 你站在蜂巢的内部区域，这是一个六边形的房间，除了连接其他房间外，似乎并没有其他用途。墙壁上布满了较小的六边形结构，有些里面装满了蜂蜜或小装饰品，而有些则空空如也。其中有几个地方还被涂上了蜡，这样就可以将里面的物品妥善保存起来，避免被发现。敞开的拱门通向南边、北边和西边的各个房间。
rows.raw: "\n        You stand in an interior section of the hive, a hexagonal room seeming to serve little purpose besides connecting other chambers. The walls are catacombed with smaller hexes, some filled with honey or baubles, others empty. Several have been waxed over, keeping their contents safe and hidden. Open archways connect to chambers south, north, and west."

rows.original: You stand in an interior section of the hive, a hexagonal room seeming to serve little purpose besides connecting other chambers. The walls are catacombed with smaller hexes, some filled with honey or baubles, others empty. Several have been waxed over, keeping their contents safe and hidden. Open archways connect to chambers south, north, and east.
