rows.raw: "\n        You stand in an interior section of the hive, a hexagonal room seeming to serve little purpose besides connecting other chambers. The walls are catacombed with smaller hexes, some filled with honey or baubles, others empty. Several have been waxed over, keeping their contents safe and hidden. Open archways connect to chambers south, north, and east."

rows.original: This small chamber branches east off the central hall, and is surrounded on all sides by tiny honeycombs covered with thick layers of hard, dry wax. Inside each chamber is a scroll of parchment, seemingly made of the same rough, papery material as the hive's outer walls — maybe some sort of refined tree bark? Either way, there's a veritable mountain of records in here from throughout the hive's history, and many of the scrolls look truly ancient. Few look recent, as if the bimbofication brought a sudden and complete halt to the hive's writing... which, yeah, that checks out.
rows.translation: 这个小房间从中央大厅向东延伸出来，四周都被覆盖着厚厚一层坚硬干燥蜂蜡的细小蜂窝结构所环绕。每个小房间里都放着一卷羊皮纸，其材质似乎与蜂巢的外壁一样，都是那种粗糙的纸质材料——也许是一种经过加工的树皮吧？无论如何，这里存放着整个蜂群历史上的大量记录，其中许多卷轴看起来确实非常古老。很少有卷轴看起来是近期制作的，仿佛那种“愚蠢化”现象突然彻底中断了蜂群的文字记录活动。…嗯，确实如此。
rows.raw: "\n        This small chamber branches east off the central hall, and is surrounded on all sides by tiny honeycombs covered with thick layers of hard, dry wax. Inside each chamber is a scroll of parchment, seemingly made of the same rough, papery material as the hive's outer walls — maybe some sort of refined tree bark? Either way, there's a veritable mountain of records in here from throughout the hive's history, and many of the scrolls look truly ancient. Few look recent, as if the bimbofication brought a sudden and complete halt to the hive's writing... which, yeah, that checks out."

rows.original: A pair of massive wooden gates studded with iron bands stands imposing at the end of the great stone bridge across the ravine. Beyond them is a long, narrow boulevard of packed stone flanked by tall wooden houses. Folk are going about their business up and down the road, every one of them a boreal elf dressed in heavy furs; they [pc.ra elf|don't give you much mind, as if you're near enough to one of them to fit in.|cut curious, and sometimes wary, glances your way. Not surprising considering how isolated the city is and has been for hundreds of years. You're likely among the first outsiders they've ever seen.]
rows.translation: 跨越峡谷的大石桥尽头，一对箍着铁带的巨大木门威严耸立。门后是一条狭长的石砌大道，两旁立着高大的木屋。来往的人们各忙各的，个个都是穿着厚厚毛皮的极北精灵；他们[pc.ra elf|没怎么注意你，仿佛你和他们足够相似，自然就能融入其中。|朝你投来好奇、有时甚至警惕的目光。考虑到这座城市已与世隔绝数百年，这并不奇怪。你很可能是他们见过的第一批外来者。]
rows.raw: "\n        A pair of massive wooden gates studded with iron bands stands imposing at the end of the great stone bridge across the ravine. Beyond them is a long, narrow boulevard of packed stone flanked by tall wooden houses. Folk are going about their business up and down the road, every one of them a boreal elf dressed in heavy furs; they [pc.ra elf|don't give you much mind, as if you're near enough to one of them to fit in.|cut curious, and sometimes wary, glances your way. Not surprising considering how isolated the city is and has been for hundreds of years. You're likely among the first outsiders they've ever seen.]"

rows.original: A long, narrow boulevard of packed stone leads straight through the Winter City, flanked by tall wooden houses. The towering stone wall and its gates lie to the south, while you can see a beautiful fountain and statue in an open town square to the north. Far beyond that, the walls of the glacier rise up to the heavens, and within it, you see the spires of the city's palace looming over the city itself.
rows.translation: 一条由整齐排列的石块铺成的狭长林荫道笔直穿过冬城，道路两旁是高大的木屋。南边矗立着巍峨的石墙和城门，而北边则有一个开阔的城镇广场，那里有一座美丽的喷泉和雕像。再往远处看，冰川的峭壁直插云霄，在其内部，你可以看到城市宫殿的尖顶耸立在整座城市之上。
rows.raw: "\n        A long, narrow boulevard of packed stone leads straight through the Winter City, flanked by tall wooden houses. The towering stone wall and its gates lie to the south, while you can see a beautiful fountain and statue in an open town square to the north. Far beyond that, the walls of the glacier rise up to the heavens, and within it, you see the spires of the city's palace looming over the city itself."

rows.original:
The heart of the Winter City is an open square and market, surrounding a 15-foot statue of a beautiful elf-maiden in armor and bearing a golden spear. A crown set with an azure gemstone sits proud upon her brow. Water flows from her big, bared breasts into a wide fountain around its pedestal, crisp and clear. Several small side-roads lead off from the square, though the main thoroughfare leads directly south and north, from the Gates of Winter to the spires of the ice palace against the northern glacier.

        The square is [dayNight|packed full of boreal elves browsing the little market stalls, hawking handicrafts or buying up the day's fresh bread and game.|largely empty now, though a few night-owl elves are filtering out of eateries and a bar down the side roads, trailing pipe-smoke and steaming breath behind them.]
rows.translation:
冬城的中心是一片开阔的广场和市集，广场周围矗立着一尊高15英尺的雕像——那位身着铠甲、手持金色长矛的美丽精灵少女。她额头上戴着一顶镶嵌着天蓝色宝石的王冠。清澈的水从她裸露的胸前流淌下来，汇入雕像基座周围的宽阔喷泉中，水花清脆明亮。从这个广场出发，有几条小路向两侧延伸，而主干道则直通南北两侧——从冬之大门一直延伸到北方冰川旁的那座冰宫的尖顶。

        这个广场是[dayNight|市场上挤满了北方精灵，他们有的在摊位前摆弄手工艺品，有的则购买当天的新鲜面包和猎物。|现在这里基本上空无一人，只有少数喜欢熬夜的精灵从附近的餐馆和酒吧里走出来，他们身后飘荡着烟圈和热气。]
rows.raw:
"
        The heart of the Winter City is an open square and market, surrounding a 15-foot statue of a beautiful elf-maiden in armor and bearing a golden spear. A crown set with an azure gemstone sits proud upon her brow. Water flows from her big, bared breasts into a wide fountain around its pedestal, crisp and clear. Several small side-roads lead off from the square, though the main thoroughfare leads directly south and north, from the Gates of Winter to the spires of the ice palace against the northern glacier.

        The square is [dayNight|packed full of boreal elves browsing the little market stalls, hawking handicrafts or buying up the day's fresh bread and game.|largely empty now, though a few night-owl elves are filtering out of eateries and a bar down the side roads, trailing pipe-smoke and steaming breath behind them.]
        
        "

rows.original:
[flags.KUKOLD_INTRO
            |You can see Mary's shop to the East, its sign proudly displaying various colorful alchemical ingredients. Compared to the other houses, its windows appear chock full of color. One might think such a display would look gaudy, but they manage to make it look tasteful. Could always go in to buy a few ingredients, or meet with the cute couple.
            |You notice some activity by the side of the road, to the East. A building seems to be renovating and... the sign above seems to imply this is a shop, though you doubt the hastily written 'shop' is anything more than a temporary measure before they can get the real sign installed. They're clearly in the middle of opening as there are still some crates of goods here and there, but it does seem like you could go in if you like.
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.KUKOLD_INTRO
            |你可以看到玛丽的小店在东边，它的招牌上自豪地展示着各种五颜六色的炼金材料。与其他房屋相比，它的窗户里充满了色彩。有人可能会认为这样的陈列看起来很俗气，但他们却能让它显得很有品味。你随时都可以进去买一些材料，或者去看看那对可爱的夫妇。
            |你注意到道路东侧有些活动。有一栋建筑似乎正在装修中……上面的招牌看起来表明这是一家商店，不过你怀疑那个匆匆写下的“商店”字样，不过是一种临时措施，等他们安装上正式的招牌后再使用吧。显然，这家商店正在筹备开业中，因为现场还散落着一些货物箱，不过如果你想的话，应该是可以进去的。
        ]
rows.raw:
"
        [flags.KUKOLD_INTRO
            |You can see Mary's shop to the East, its sign proudly displaying various colorful alchemical ingredients. Compared to the other houses, its windows appear chock full of color. One might think such a display would look gaudy, but they manage to make it look tasteful. Could always go in to buy a few ingredients, or meet with the cute couple.
            |You notice some activity by the side of the road, to the East. A building seems to be renovating and... the sign above seems to imply this is a shop, though you doubt the hastily written 'shop' is anything more than a temporary measure before they can get the real sign installed. They're clearly in the middle of opening as there are still some crates of goods here and there, but it does seem like you could go in if you like.
        ]"

rows.original: Mary and Kesuk's shop is currently closed.
rows.translation: 玛丽和凯苏克的商店目前处于关闭状态。
rows.raw: "\n        Mary and Kesuk's shop is currently closed."

rows.original: A long, narrow boulevard of packed stone leads straight through the Winter City, flanked by tall wooden houses. The towering stone wall and its gates lie to the south along with the beautiful fountain and statue in the town square. North of here, the walls of the glacier rise up to the heavens, and within it, you see the spires of the city's palace looming over the city itself.
rows.translation: 一条由整齐排列的石块铺成的狭长林荫道笔直穿过冬城，道路两旁是高大的木屋。南边矗立着巍峨的石墙和城门，镇中心还有美丽的喷泉和雕像。而在这里的北边，冰川的峭壁直插云霄，在其内部，你可以看到城市宫殿的尖顶高耸于整个城市之上。
rows.raw: "\n        A long, narrow boulevard of packed stone leads straight through the Winter City, flanked by tall wooden houses. The towering stone wall and its gates lie to the south along with the beautiful fountain and statue in the town square. North of here, the walls of the glacier rise up to the heavens, and within it, you see the spires of the city's palace looming over the city itself."

rows.original:
You stand in the shadows of the great ice-palace of the Winter City, a towering structure of blue spires rising from the face of a glacial wall that shields the northern half of the city, much as the ravine protects the south. There is a solid wood gate here, [flags.WC_QUEEN_DEF|open and guarded by a pair of boreal elves in heavy armor and bearing war-spears. They nod respectfully as you approach.|though it's barred shut and guarded by a half-dozen boreal elven warriors clad up in heavy war-hides and bronze breastplates. Each of them has a two-handed war spear planted in the ground at his or her feet.]

        A small path leads off to the east, through an arch of wood woven-through with ice-blue roses.
rows.translation:
你站在冬城的巨大冰宫阴影之中，那座由蓝色尖塔构成的巍峨建筑从冰川构成的城墙上耸立而起，这道城墙守护着城市的北部，就如同那条峡谷守护着城市的南部一样。这里有一扇用实木制成的大门。 [flags.WC_QUEEN_DEF|由两名身着重甲、手持战矛的北方精灵把守着。当你靠近时，他们恭敬地点了点头。|尽管大门紧闭，还有六名身着厚重战袍、佩戴青铜胸甲的北方精灵战士守卫在那里。他们每个人的脚下都插着一支双手战矛。]

        一条小路向东方延伸，穿过一道由冰蓝色玫瑰编织而成的木制拱门。
rows.raw:
"
        You stand in the shadows of the great ice-palace of the Winter City, a towering structure of blue spires rising from the face of a glacial wall that shields the northern half of the city, much as the ravine protects the south. There is a solid wood gate here, [flags.WC_QUEEN_DEF|open and guarded by a pair of boreal elves in heavy armor and bearing war-spears. They nod respectfully as you approach.|though it's barred shut and guarded by a half-dozen boreal elven warriors clad up in heavy war-hides and bronze breastplates. Each of them has a two-handed war spear planted in the ground at his or her feet.]

        A small path leads off to the east, through an arch of wood woven-through with ice-blue roses."

rows.original: The castle gardens are a beautifully-cultivated offshoot of the courtyard back to the west. Blue roses dominate wooden arches, and bushes of northern berries laden with bounty flank the narrow footpath. It continues to the east of here, near to the castle's outer walls.
rows.translation: 城堡的花园是西侧庭院中一片经过精心培育的附属区域。蓝色的玫瑰盛开在木制拱门下，而那些结满丰富果实的北方灌木丛则排列在狭窄的小径两侧。这条小径一直延伸到东侧，靠近城堡的外墙。
rows.raw: "\n        The castle gardens are a beautifully-cultivated offshoot of the courtyard back to the west. Blue roses dominate wooden arches, and bushes of northern berries laden with bounty flank the narrow footpath. It continues to the east of here, near to the castle's outer walls."

rows.original: The castle gardens are a beautifully-cultivated offshoot of the courtyard back to the west. Blue roses dominate wooden arches, and bushes of northern berries laden with bounty flank the narrow footpath. The outer walls of the castle meet the glacial wall that houses the palace, and now that you've had it pointed you to you, it's easy to see how somebody might climb up the wall and into the windows above... Bit of a design flaw, that.
rows.translation: 城堡的花园是西侧庭院中一片经过精心培育的附属区域。蓝色的玫瑰簇拥在木制拱门之下，而那些结满丰硕果实的北方灌木丛则排列在狭窄的小径两侧。城堡的外墙与那座宫殿所在的冰川峭壁相连，现在有人指给你看了这个位置，你就很容易理解为什么有人会试图攀爬那堵墙，然后进入上面的窗户……这确实是个设计上的缺陷。
rows.raw: "\n        The castle gardens are a beautifully-cultivated offshoot of the courtyard back to the west. Blue roses dominate wooden arches, and bushes of northern berries laden with bounty flank the narrow footpath. The outer walls of the castle meet the glacial wall that houses the palace, and now that you've had it pointed you to you, it's easy to see how somebody might climb up the wall and into the windows above... Bit of a design flaw, that."

rows.original: You stand just outside the palace of ice and blue spires built into the side of the glacial wall. A pair of massive wooden doors, encrusted with frost, stand strong to protect the castle's interior. To the south, the entirety of the Winter City stretches out from the glacier to the ravine, swaddled in walls of stone and ice in every direction.
rows.translation: 你站在那座由冰与蓝色尖塔构成的宫殿外，这些尖塔直接建在冰川的侧壁上。一对巨大的木门上覆盖着霜冻，它们坚固地矗立着，守护着宫殿的内部。向南望去，整个冬城从冰川一直延伸到峡谷，四周都被石墙和冰墙环绕着。
rows.raw: "\n        You stand just outside the palace of ice and blue spires built into the side of the glacial wall. A pair of massive wooden doors, encrusted with frost, stand strong to protect the castle's interior. To the south, the entirety of the Winter City stretches out from the glacier to the ravine, swaddled in walls of stone and ice in every direction."

rows.original:
This chamber dominates an entire section of the city — several massive elevators of wood and bound bronze, drawn by mountain goats collared to axles and driven by pulleys. Clearly meant for heavy cargo, several empty carts lie to the side, waiting to return to the glacier above after being emptied; the shafts must connect to the glacier above. This must be the northward exit from the city, then, out into the icy beyond.

        [flags.WC_CLEAR
            |The elevators move at a steady pace, bringing in all manner of goods — minerals, half a dead whale, disgruntled-looking elves — in and out. You could hitch a ride to the glacier's surface, if that's what you want.
            |Currently, the elevators are not active, the goats milling about in their pens and the ropes and pulleys still. Alissa must have other things on her mind than patronage and industry.
        ]
rows.translation:
这个通道占据了整座城市的这一区域——几台由木头和青铜制成的巨型电梯，通过套在轴上的山羊来拉动，再由滑轮系统来驱动。这些电梯显然是为运输重物而设计的，旁边放着几辆空车，等待在卸完货物后返回上方的冰川；这些电梯的井道肯定与上方的冰川相连。那么，这里应该就是通往城市北部的出口，进而通向那片冰封的世界吧。

        [flags.WC_CLEAR
            |电梯以稳定的速度运行，将各种各样的货物运进运出——矿石、半死不活的鲸鱼，还有那些面带不满表情的精灵们。如果你愿意的话，也可以搭乘这些电梯到达冰川的表面。
            |目前，电梯还处于关闭状态，山羊们在围栏里闲逛，那些绳索和滑轮也依然闲置着。看来，艾莉莎肯定还有其他更重要的事情要处理，而不是关心这些电梯和工业设施。
        ]
rows.raw:
"
       This chamber dominates an entire section of the city — several massive elevators of wood and bound bronze, drawn by mountain goats collared to axles and driven by pulleys. Clearly meant for heavy cargo, several empty carts lie to the side, waiting to return to the glacier above after being emptied; the shafts must connect to the glacier above. This must be the northward exit from the city, then, out into the icy beyond.

        [flags.WC_CLEAR
            |The elevators move at a steady pace, bringing in all manner of goods — minerals, half a dead whale, disgruntled-looking elves — in and out. You could hitch a ride to the glacier's surface, if that's what you want.
            |Currently, the elevators are not active, the goats milling about in their pens and the ropes and pulleys still. Alissa must have other things on her mind than patronage and industry.
        ]"

rows.original: The inner hall of the castle stands just inside its massive wooden doors. Huge tapestries hang from the walls, displaying the river-style symbol of House Ridell and various ancient kings and queens, all highly stylized. A pair of glass windows overlook the doors, allowing in a bit of natural light to complement the torches ensconced on the walls.
rows.translation: 城堡的内厅就位于那扇巨大的木门之后。墙壁上悬挂着巨大的挂毯，上面绘有里德尔家族特有的河流图案，以及各种古代国王和王后的形象，所有这些图案都经过了高度的艺术加工。一对玻璃窗正对着那扇大门，让一些自然光透了进来，为墙壁上点燃的火把增添了些许光亮。
rows.raw: "\n        The inner hall of the castle stands just inside its massive wooden doors. Huge tapestries hang from the walls, displaying the river-style symbol of House Ridell and various ancient kings and queens, all highly stylized. A pair of glass windows overlook the doors, allowing in a bit of natural light to complement the torches ensconced on the walls."

rows.original:
A wide, sweeping hallway connects the southern doors to the throne room north of you. A lush blue carpet sprawls out over the cold stone floor, and heavy tapestries in a myriad of bright colors attempt to add a little warmth to the hall. 

        [flags.WC_CLEAR||A small ground of bronze-and-hide-clad elven guards are here, but they're all bent over the nearby furniture and leaking thick rivers of spunk down their thighs. They're too insensate to try and oppose you coming or going now...]

rows.original:
The palace's throne room is a massive chamber of blue stone, with walls covered in cool-hued tapestries. Stands on either side give room for nobility to view the goings-ons from comfort, while the floor below is covered with carpets made of wild animal hides for standing room. Beneath the stands, Jael'yn constructed a set of stockades, big enough for two at a time. They're currently empty, but had your fight gone another way... 

        A massive throne made of enchanted ice sits atop a tiered dias, overlooking the chamber with regal majesty. 
        
        [flags.WC_CLEAR|Etheryn takes a seat upon her throne, sighing heavily as she sinks into the thin cushions resting over the icy exterior. "I'll never get used to this," she murmurs.|Dozens of elven women are sprawled out on the floor and across the dias, packed full of the fallen captain's spunk or drenched in her effluvia.]

宫殿的王座厅是一间由蓝色石头建造的巨大房间，墙壁上挂满了色调冷峻的挂毯。两侧设置的观景台让贵族们可以舒适地观看厅内的活动，而地面则铺着用野生动物皮制成的地毯，为人们提供了足够的站立空间。在看台下方，杰尔林搭建了一排栅栏，每次可以容纳两个人通过。目前这些栅栏还空着，但要是你的战斗结果有所不同的话…… 

        一座由魔法冰块制成的巨型王座矗立在阶梯状的基座上，从高处俯瞰着整个大厅，显得无比威严。 
        
        [flags.WC_CLEAR|埃瑟琳坐在她的王座上，深深地叹了口气，身体靠在那些覆盖在冰冷王座表面的薄垫子上。“我永远都无法习惯这一切，”她低声说道。|数十名精灵女性躺在地上，或散落在各处，她们身上要么充满了那位阵亡队长的勇气，要么浸透了她的体香。]

A thick golden carpet pads the cold stone floor, stitched with the emblem of a blazing sun every few feet.
rows.translation: 一条宽阔而宏伟的走廊贯穿这里，从西延伸到东，距离冰墙仅有一英尺左右的距离。光线从冰层最薄的地方透了进来，仿佛那些地方本来就被设计成窗户一样。厚厚的金色地毯铺在冰冷的石地上，每隔几英尺就会绣上一轮烈日图案。

rows.original:
A wide, grand corridor runs west and east here, just a foot or so inside the glacial wall. Light streams through the thinnest sections of ice, almost like they're meant to be windows. A thick golden carpet pads the cold stone floor, stitched with the emblem of a blazing sun every few feet.

        A pair of life-sized statues flank the western door, depicting the same woman — a motherly, fertile-figured human with long hair and intricate armor, wielding a greatsword. One statue has her arms open invitingly, as if she wants to give you the sweetest, chestiest hug you've ever had; the other has her blade held aloft in challenge. A golden suburst is affixed over the door, catching the light in such a way that the statues seem to glow.
        
        They must be Lumia, the goddess of the sun.

rows.original: The chapel of Lumia dominates the far western wing of the palace, with a golden-hued altar beneath a truly massive effigy of the sun; each of its fiery tendrils is tipped with a burning candle. [flags.WC_CLEAR|The chapel has been cleaned up considerably since your first encounters here, and a handful of golden-robed acolytes are tending to the myriad candles simulating the sun's shine behind the altar. High priestess Elthara is supervising them, but makes time you give you an inviting smile when she can.|It would surely feel holy here, if not for the gallons upon gallons of wasted cum spattered all over the altar, carpets, and pews... and the curvaceous priestess sitting on the stone's edge, knuckles-deep in her own clunge as she struggles to fight down her own corrupted libido.]
rows.translation: 卢米亚的小教堂位于宫殿的最西端，那里有一座金色的祭坛，祭坛下方矗立着一尊巨大的太阳雕像；太阳雕像的每一条火焰状的触须末端都点着一支燃烧的蜡烛。 [flags.WC_CLEAR|自从你第一次来到这里之后，这个小礼拜堂已经得到了彻底的清理。现在，有一群身穿金色长袍的侍从正在照料那些象征太阳光芒的蜡烛。大祭司艾尔萨拉正在监督他们的工作，但每当有机会时，她都会向你投来亲切的微笑。|要不是祭坛、地毯和长椅上到处都是那些被浪费掉的精液，要不是还有那位身材曲线的优美的女祭司坐在石头边上，手指深处都沾满了自己的精液，而她还在努力抑制着自己那已被腐蚀的欲望……的话，这里确实会给人一种神圣的感觉。]

A relatively small and unadorned corridor of the Palace of Ice run east and west from here, bridging the throne room and the cellar stairs. You'd guess this passage was meant mostly for servants rather than noble guests. 

        [flags.WC_CLEAR||The door to the west has a severely sexual smell radiating from it, and a small pool of white cream is flooding into the hall from under the door.]
rows.translation:
冰宫中有一条相对狭窄且装饰简朴的走廊，它从这里向东延伸至西端，连接着王座厅和地窖的楼梯。可以看出，这条通道主要是为仆人使用的，而非供贵族宾客通行。 

        [flags.WC_CLEAR||西边的那扇门散发出浓重的性暗示气息，有一小滩白色乳状物从门下渗了出来，流到了大厅里。]

rows.original: A narrow set of spiral stairs connect the main floor of the castle to the cellars below. Torches are ensconced on the walls of the stairs, but there's precious little illumination to be found beyond that. A small sub-cellar made for wine casks sits north of here, and a long hall through the heart of the palace drags on to the west.
rows.translation: 一条狭窄的螺旋楼梯将城堡的主楼与地下的地窖连接起来。楼梯的墙壁上安装了火把，但除此之外，几乎没有任何光源。在北边还有一个专门用来存放酒桶的小地窖，而穿过宫殿中心的一条长走廊则延伸向西方。

rows.original: The castle wine cellar is a single large room built into the ice, connected to the southern palace by a flight of broad steps. Several large wooden casks line the frozen walls, filled with rich wines... though considering how isolated the Winter City is, and the climate of the region, you're not sure where they're getting all this wine. Some sort of wintery vineyard hidden away in the tundra?
rows.translation: 这座城堡的酒窖是一个直接建在冰层中的巨大房间，通过一段宽阔的台阶与南侧的宫殿相连。几桶巨大的木桶排列在冰冻的墙壁旁，里面装满了美味的葡萄酒……不过考虑到冬城所处的偏远位置以及该地区的气候条件，人们实在不确定这些葡萄酒是从哪里来的。难道是藏在苔原中的某种冬季葡萄园在酿造这些酒吗？

rows.original:
The grand ballroom sits in the heart of the Palace of Ice, a sweeping stone-floored chambered richly adorned with rugs and regal tapestries. A pair of curving stairs on the north wall lead up towards the second floor, the royal chambers, as well as a second floor that rings the entire ballroom with room for crowds of nobles to gaze down on the dancers below.

        [flags.WC_CLEAR
            |The remnants of Kasyrra's machine are still being disassembled here. Copper wire and strange gems are stuffed into boxes, ready to be stored away while elven servants and mages examine the remaining machinery.
            |Kasyrra's huge summoning machine is looming in the middle of the ballroom, a tower of copper and gemstones that reach nearly to the ceiling. A gate of copper, engraved with bizarre runes of no language you've ever seen, stands in the center of the device, though thankfully it is no longer active.
        ]

Torches are ensconced on the walls of the stairs, but there's precious little illumination to be found beyond that. Thick, dusty cobwebs cling to the old blue stone and ice that make up the cellars, and you're assailed by the scent of rot and stale air."

rows.original: You're in the middle of the castle's catacombs. There's precious little illumination to be found on the long hall east of here, nor down the open steps to the south. A pair of statues adorn the walls, a pair of beautiful stone elf-women with spears crossed across the narrow passage.
rows.translation: 你此刻正处于城堡的地窖之中。这里东侧的长廊里几乎没有光线，南侧那些敞开的台阶下也是一片昏暗。墙壁上装饰着两座雕像——那是两位手持长矛的美丽石像精灵女性，她们矗立在狭窄的通道两侧。
rows.raw: "\n        You're in the middle of the castle's catacombs. There's precious little illumination to be found on the long hall east of here, nor down the open steps to the south. A pair of statues adorn the walls, a pair of beautiful stone elf-women with spears crossed across the narrow passage."

rows.original:
The royal catacombs stand before you, at the bottom of an open set of stairs and guarded by a pair of huge, broad-chested elven warrior-statues. Two large tombs are laid solemnly side by side within the chamber, each with a crowned headstone looming over it. 

        [party.has etheryn|"Mother... father..." Ryn whispers, bowing her head to the tombs.]
rows.translation:
皇家地下墓穴就展现在你面前，它位于一段开阔的楼梯尽头，由两座体型庞大、胸膛宽厚的精灵战士雕像守护着。墓室里，两座巨大的坟墓庄严地并排而立，每座坟墓上方都立着一块刻有王冠图案的墓碑。 

        [party.has etheryn|母亲……父亲……”小琳低声说道，同时低头向着那些坟墓。]
rows.raw:
'
        The royal catacombs stand before you, at the bottom of an open set of stairs and guarded by a pair of huge, broad-chested elven warrior-statues. Two large tombs are laid solemnly side by side within the chamber, each with a crowned headstone looming over it. 

        [party.has etheryn|"Mother... father..." Ryn whispers, bowing her head to the tombs.]'

rows.original: A long, narrow passage leads east to west through the castle undercrofts, connecting the royal tombs back near the stairs with a heavy vault door at the western end of the passage.
rows.translation: 一条狭长的通道从城堡的地底部分东西向延伸，将靠近楼梯处的皇家陵墓与通道西端的厚重拱门连接起来。
rows.raw: "\n        A long, narrow passage leads east to west through the castle undercrofts, connecting the royal tombs back near the stairs with a heavy vault door at the western end of the passage."

rows.original:
A long, narrow passage leads east to west through the castle undercrofts, connecting the royal tombs back near the stairs with a heavy vault door here at the end of the passage. It's a massive, bronze-reinforced slab of stone and wood. 

        The doors are [flags.WC_VAULT|open, unsealed by Etheryn's essence.|sealed tight. You can't see any lock per se, but there is a stone device beside the door etched with a circular rune. Above it, the words "GOLD AND SILVER ARE NOT THE KINGLY ESSENCE" are carved into the stone.
        
        It seems you need... something... to open the door. Maybe Etheryn could help?]
rows.translation:
一条狭长的通道从城堡的地底部分东西向延伸，将位于楼梯附近的皇家陵墓与这条通道尽头的那扇厚重的拱门连接起来。那扇门是由青铜加固的巨大石木结构。

        这扇门[flags.WC_VAULT|已被伊瑟琳的精魂解封并打开。|封得严严实实。表面上看不出有任何锁具，但在门旁边有一个石制装置，上面刻着一个圆形的符文。在符文上方，还用石头刻着这样一句话：“黄金与白银并非王权的本质。”
        
        看来，你需要某种东西才能打开这扇门。也许埃瑟琳能帮上忙吧？]
rows.raw:
"
        A long, narrow passage leads east to west through the castle undercrofts, connecting the royal tombs back near the stairs with a heavy vault door here at the end of the passage. It's a massive, bronze-reinforced slab of stone and wood. 

        The doors are [flags.WC_VAULT|open, unsealed by Etheryn's essence.|sealed tight. You can't see any lock per se, but there is a stone device beside the door etched with a circular rune. Above it, the words "GOLD AND SILVER ARE NOT THE KINGLY ESSENCE" are carved into the stone.
        
        It seems you need... something... to open the door. Maybe Etheryn could help?]"

rows.original:
The interior of the palace's vault is a stark, polished square of ice deep inside the glacier into which the structure was built. 

        The interior of the vault is... surprisingly empty. A few gems and old golden coins are scattered around, but it would seem that the royal family isn't nearly as wealthy as they'd like their subjects to believe. A bare dress stand is in the middle of the chamber, where Etheryn's royal gown had been left waiting for her.
rows.translation:
这座宫殿的地窖内部是一片光秃秃的、经过打磨的冰面，整个地窖深埋在冰川之中，宫殿的结构就是建在这段冰川上的。

        地窖的内部……出人意料地空荡荡的。里面散落着一些宝石和古老的金币，但看来，这个王室家族并不像他们希望臣民们认为的那样富有。房间中央摆放着一个简陋的衣架，伊瑟琳的皇家礼服就放在那里等着她。
rows.raw:
"
        The interior of the palace's vault is a stark, polished square of ice deep inside the glacier into which the structure was built. 

        The interior of the vault is... surprisingly empty. A few gems and old golden coins are scattered around, but it would seem that the royal family isn't nearly as wealthy as they'd like their subjects to believe. A bare dress stand is in the middle of the chamber, where Etheryn's royal gown had been left waiting for her."

rows.original: The curving stairs here connect the upper floors with the great ballroom in the palace's heart. The second floor includes a wrapping balcony around the dancing hall, and curtained halls lead off into the royal chambers. Below you can still see Kasyrra's machine standing in the middle of the ballroom.
rows.translation: 这里弯曲的楼梯将上层楼层与宫殿中央的大舞厅连接起来。二楼设有环绕舞厅的阳台，而装有帘幕的走廊则通向皇家寝室。在下方，你仍然可以看到卡希拉制造的机器矗立在舞厅的中央。
rows.raw: "\n        The curving stairs here connect the upper floors with the great ballroom in the palace's heart. The second floor includes a wrapping balcony around the dancing hall, and curtained halls lead off into the royal chambers. Below you can still see Kasyrra's machine standing in the middle of the ballroom."

rows.original: A richly-decorated corridors runs east to west through the upper floor of the palace, adorned with portraits of former kings and queens, and wall coverings of ice-blue silk that cover the cold stone.
rows.translation: 宫殿上层有一条装饰华丽的走廊，从东延伸到西。走廊两旁挂满了前代国王和王后的肖像，墙壁上则铺着冰蓝色的丝绸，这些丝绸覆盖在冰冷的石壁上，为走廊增添了一分温馨与典雅。
rows.raw: "\n        A richly-decorated corridors runs east to west through the upper floor of the palace, adorned with portraits of former kings and queens, and wall coverings of ice-blue silk that cover the cold stone."

rows.original:
A richly-decorated corridors runs east to west through the upper floor of the palace, adorned with portraits of former kings and queens, and wall coverings of ice-blue silk that cover the cold stone. 

        There's a large window here, granting access to a balcony made of carved ice and topped with wood, overlooking the rest of the Winter City.
rows.translation:
宫殿上层有一条装饰华丽的走廊，从东延伸到西。走廊两旁挂满了前代国王和王后的肖像，墙壁上覆盖着冰蓝色的丝绸，这些丝绸覆盖在冰冷的石壁上，为走廊增添了一丝温馨的气息。

        这里有一扇巨大的窗户，透过它可以看到一个由冰雕制成、顶部覆盖着木料的阳台，从那里可以俯瞰整个冬城。

"

        There's a large window here, granting access to a balcony made of carved ice and topped with wood, overlooking the rest of the Winter City."

Etheryn's personal chambers are open to you.|Considering the wooden bar nailed over the door from the outside, it's pretty obviously Etheryn's room.]

一条装饰华丽的走廊从宫殿的上层贯穿东西两侧，走廊两旁挂满了前代国王和王后的肖像，墙壁上覆盖着冰蓝色的丝绸，使得冰冷的石墙显得更加柔和。

Etheryn's personal chambers are open to you.|Considering the wooden bar nailed over the door from the outside, it's pretty obviously Etheryn's room.]"

A richly-decorated corridors runs east to west through the upper floor of the palace, adorned with portraits of former kings and queens, and wall coverings of ice-blue silk that cover the cold stone. 

        A door to the north leads into the private chambers of one of the royals. The golden sunburst crest over a flowing river painted over the doorframe would indicate this is the queen's royal bedchamber.

一条装饰华丽的走廊从宫殿的上层贯穿东西两侧，走廊两旁挂满了前代国王和王后的肖像，墙壁上覆盖着冰蓝色的丝绸，使得冰冷的石墙显得更加柔和。

rows.original: The royal bedchambers of the elven queen are lavish by any standard, dominated by a veiled bed large enough for a dozen lovers to mingle in, as well as several polar bear-hide rugs to cover the ice-blue floors. Tapestries depicting Alissa herself in various heroic poses adorn the walls, but since the queen's corruption, they've been splattered by unknowable amounts of cum and other sexual fluids, leaving them mere ruins. A truly immense collection of dildos are arranged all over the queen's dressers and desk, wood and glass and bronze modeled after every conceivable type of cock and some that are pure fantasy. They've all been well used, judging by the heady sexual smell emanating from... well, everywhere in the room, if you're being honest. If it weren't for the sheer expense of everything within the chamber, it would look and feel more like a brothel mistress's room instead of a queen's.
rows.translation: 按照任何标准来看，这位精灵女王的寝室都堪称奢华无比。卧室中央摆放着一张巨大的床帘遮盖的床，足以让十几对恋人同时相聚；地板上铺着几块由北极熊皮制成的地毯，为冰蓝色的地面增添了色彩。墙面上挂满了描绘艾莉莎本人处于各种英勇姿态的挂毯，但由于女王堕落后的行为，这些挂毯上被大量精液和其他性分泌物弄得污迹斑斑，早已面目全非。 女王的梳妆台和书桌上摆放着数量庞大的假阳具，这些由木头、玻璃和青铜制成的制品模仿了各种现实中存在的阴茎形态，其中还有一些完全属于幻想中的设计。从它们散发出的浓烈性气味来看，这些假阳具显然都被频繁使用过了。嗯，说实话，房间里到处都是。要不是因为费用在这个房间里，所有的一切都更像是一个妓院老板的房间，而不是女王的房间。
rows.raw: " The royal bedchambers of the elven queen are lavish by any standard, dominated by a veiled bed large enough for a dozen lovers to mingle in, as well as several polar bear-hide rugs to cover the ice-blue floors. Tapestries depicting Alissa herself in various heroic poses adorn the walls, but since the queen's corruption, they've been splattered by unknowable amounts of cum and other sexual fluids, leaving them mere ruins. A truly immense collection of dildos are arranged all over the queen's dressers and desk, wood and glass and bronze modeled after every conceivable type of cock and some that are pure fantasy. They've all been well used, judging by the heady sexual smell emanating from... well, everywhere in the room, if you're being honest. If it weren't for the sheer expense of everything within the chamber, it would look and feel more like a brothel mistress's room instead of a queen's."

rows.original: Etheryn's personal chambers are relatively modest compared to her big sister's lavish sex-palace. She has a simple double bed pressed against one wall,
rows.translation: 与姐姐那奢华的淫乐宫殿相比，伊瑟琳的私人房间显得相当朴素。一张简单的双人床靠墙摆放，
rows.raw: "\n        Etheryn's personal chambers are relatively modest compared to her big sister's lavish sex-palace. She has a simple double bed pressed against one wall, "

rows.original:
.

        A bookshelf and desk fill up the adjacent wall. Several tomes on falconry and bird-care are still open on the desk where she's left them. A brass falcon-cage is hanging from the ceiling beside the desk, [party.has etheryn|which Harrick quickly flies into as soon as Ryn enters the room|currently occupied by Harrick]. The war-bird gives you a screech in acknowledgement. 
        
        [silly|You catch sight of another tome hidden underneath Ryn's bed. The title says something about %"Boy's Love," whatever that means.]
        
        The only other piece of furniture in the room is a small dresser, with a stool in front of it. There are no mirrors anywhere in the room, nor any expensive decorations. While you're sure any peasant from the heartlands would give an arm to live in such comfort, the room seems positively barren compared to her sister's.
rows.translation:
。

        靠墙放着一个书架和一张书桌。桌上摊着好几本关于驯鹰和鸟类养护的书，都是她离开时留下的。书桌旁的天花板上悬挂着一只黄铜鹰笼，[party.has etheryn|哈里克一看到小琳进屋就立刻飞了进去|哈里克正待在里面]。这只战鹰冲你尖啸了一声，算是打过招呼了。
        
        [silly|你瞥见小琳的床底下还藏着一本书，书名好像是叫《耽美》什么的。]

rows.original: covered by a thick fur throw blanket, a nearly human-sized pillow, and her new leothran plushie, Nisse
rows.translation: 上面铺着一张厚实的毛皮毯子、一个几乎与人等身大的枕头，还有她新得的狮子玩偶——尼瑟
rows.raw: "covered by a thick fur throw blanket, a nearly human-sized pillow, and her new leothran plushie, Nisse"

rows.original: with a nearly human-sized pillow and a thick fur throw the only comforts present on it
rows.translation: 上面唯一能带来舒适感的，就是一个几乎有人类大小的枕头和一条厚厚的毛毯。
rows.raw: "with a nearly human-sized pillow and a thick fur throw the only comforts present on it"

rows.original:
A large balcony, carved from the glacial ice, stands proudly over the Winter City. You can see the entire town from up here, and past the walls and into the Frostwood beyond the city's protective ravine. 

        All around you are the icy spires of the palatial roofs. There's a section you could climb to the east, and it seems you're not the only one with that idea — you can see Kasyrra and Alissa up there, though the corrupted queen has collapsed onto her knees.
rows.translation:
一座由冰川冰块雕刻而成的巨大阳台傲然矗立在冬城的上空。从这里，你可以俯瞰整个城镇，甚至能看到城墙之外的霜木地带。

        周围到处都是那些由冰块构成的宫殿式屋顶。在东边有一段地方可以攀登，显然不止你一个人有这个想法——你可以看到卡希拉和艾莉莎也在那里，不过那位被腐蚀的女王已经双膝跪地了。
rows.raw:
"
        A large balcony, carved from the glacial ice, stands proudly over the Winter City. You can see the entire town from up here, and past the walls and into the Frostwood beyond the city's protective ravine. 

        All around you are the icy spires of the palatial roofs. There's a section you could climb to the east, and it seems you're not the only one with that idea — you can see Kasyrra and Alissa up there, though the corrupted queen has collapsed onto her knees."

rows.original: A good section of the village is visible coming down out of the mountain, but much is still obscured by the vast walls of stone. Once you've stepped out into the open the village itself blocks much of the view. The mountain paths, or at least the ones worth following, are much more evident on this side of the range than they are from the valley plains. If you were to wander up from this end it would be much easier to make it back to the village, assuming you didn't travel too far in.
rows.translation: 从山上往下看，村庄的很大一部分是可见的，但仍有许多地方被高大的石墙遮挡住了。一旦你走到了开阔地带，村庄本身就会挡住大部分视线。在这座山脉的这一侧，山路——至少是那些值得走的地路——要比从山谷平原那边看清楚得多。如果你从这一端开始攀登，要回到村庄就会容易得多，当然前提是你不要走得太远。
rows.raw: "\n        A good section of the village is visible coming down out of the mountain, but much is still obscured by the vast walls of stone. Once you've stepped out into the open the village itself blocks much of the view. The mountain paths, or at least the ones worth following, are much more evident on this side of the range than they are from the valley plains. If you were to wander up from this end it would be much easier to make it back to the village, assuming you didn't travel too far in."

rows.original:
[flags.CQ_CLEAR
            |[flags.TAUR_PURE
                |Eubicha's tent is tucked out of the way on the outer edge of the village. With most dwellings cloistered along the inner side of the village ring, the placement of her house looks as out of place as one can get in the ravine. The outer path used to reach the mountain caves travels right by, however, so the place isn't completely private.
                |This part of the village is detached from the rest, and hardly anyone comes out here. The ground is still rough trod from years of visits to the mountains, but nowadays the hoofprints are all old.

                The bondage clad centaur you liberated from Tollus is here, tied to her post. You made a point to make sure some members of the warband fill a nearby trough with food and water regularly, and to only fuck her with your express permission.
            ]
            |Tollus disappeared completely after your fight, and a large wall of discarded timber blocks the path north. You can see a trodden path along the ravine that looks like it loops around the village in the opposite direction, and that might be your best bet to reach the chieftains hut.

            The bondage clad centaur you freed from Tollus remains where you left her. She peeps around the corner of a ruined post and watches you with feigned disinterest.
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.CQ_CLEAR
            |[flags.TAUR_PURE
                |尤比查的帐篷位于村庄的外缘，隐蔽在不太显眼的地方。由于大多数房屋都集中在村庄内侧，她的帐篷显得格格不入，简直就像被丢在了这个山谷里的奇怪物件。不过，通往山洞的外侧小路正好从她帐篷旁边经过，所以这个地方也算不上是完全私密的。
                |这个村庄的这一部分与其他地方隔离开来，几乎没有人会来到这里。由于多年来人们频繁前往山区，地面仍然显得崎岖不平，但如今那些马蹄印都已经变得陈旧了。

                你从托勒斯手中解救出来的那个被束缚着的半人马就在这里，被拴在柱子上。你特意吩咐过，让你的那些战友们定期在附近的水槽里放上食物和水，而且只有得到你的明确许可，才能与她发生关系。
            ]
            |在你与那些生物战斗之后，托勒斯彻底消失了，而一堵由废弃木块堆成的巨大墙阻住了通往北方的道路。你可以看到一条沿着沟壑延伸的小路，它似乎沿着相反的方向绕过了村庄，这或许是你到达酋长小屋的最佳途径。

            你从托勒斯手中解救出来的那个穿着束缚衣的半人马，仍然停留在你离开她的地方。她躲在一片废墟的角落里，装作毫不在意的样子，偷偷注视着你。
        ]

"
        [flags.CQ_CLEAR

                |Eubicha's tent is tucked out of the way on the outer edge of the village. With most dwellings cloistered along the inner side of the village ring, the placement of her house looks as out of place as one can get in the ravine. The outer path used to reach the mountain caves travels right by, however, so the place isn't completely private.
                |This part of the village is detached from the rest, and hardly anyone comes out here. The ground is still rough trod from years of visits to the mountains, but nowadays the hoofprints are all old.

                The bondage clad centaur you liberated from Tollus is here, tied to her post. You made a point to make sure some members of the warband fill a nearby trough with food and water regularly, and to only fuck her with your express permission.
            ]
            |Tollus disappeared completely after your fight, and a large wall of discarded timber blocks the path north. You can see a trodden path along the ravine that looks like it loops around the village in the opposite direction, and that might be your best bet to reach the chieftains hut.

            The bondage clad centaur you freed from Tollus remains where you left her. She peeps around the corner of a ruined post and watches you with feigned disinterest.
        ]"

rows.original: The outlining path bordering the outskirts, this place is mostly empty. You can see a cliffside path in one direction, as well as the twisting road leading back up toward the mountain. As far as crossroads go, this place is a bit too boring for the average adventurer. Thankfully, the age-old footsteps surrounding the place makes it easy to see which ways you can go to get back to important places.
rows.translation: 这条蜿蜒的小路延伸至郊外，这片区域基本上空无一人。你可以看到一条通往悬崖边的小路，还有那条蜿蜒曲折、通向山上的道路。说到十字路口的话，这个地方其实太对于普通的冒险者来说，这些地方实在有些无聊。不过幸运的是，这个地方周围那些古老的足迹让人们很容易就能判断出该往哪些方向走才能回到重要的地方。
rows.raw: "\n The outlining path bordering the outskirts, this place is mostly empty. You can see a cliffside path in one direction, as well as the twisting road leading back up toward the mountain. As far as crossroads go, this place is a bit too boring for the average adventurer. Thankfully, the age-old footsteps surrounding the place makes it easy to see which ways you can go to get back to important places."

rows.original: Besides the massive ravine on the side of the six-foot-wide path, this cliffside area is a lot less perilous than it looks; small stone obelisks are erected along the edge with gnarled ropes connected beneath the uppermost stones to form an impromptu railing or edge-guard. One look over the cliff, however, makes your stomach lurch. Thankfully the path continues from west to east without any seemingly dangerous spots that might send you tumbling to your demise.
rows.translation: 除了这条六英尺宽的小路旁边那条巨大的沟壑之外，这片悬崖地带其实并没有看上去那么危险；沿着边缘竖立着一些小石碑，最上面那些石碑下面还用扭曲的绳子连接起来，形成了临时搭建的栏杆或防护设施。不过，只要往悬崖下方看一眼，就会让人感到一阵恶心。幸运的是，这条小路是从西向东延伸的，沿途并没有任何看起来可能让人坠落身亡的危险之处。
rows.raw: "\n        Besides the massive ravine on the side of the six-foot-wide path, this cliffside area is a lot less perilous than it looks; small stone obelisks are erected along the edge with gnarled ropes connected beneath the uppermost stones to form an impromptu railing or edge-guard. One look over the cliff, however, makes your stomach lurch. Thankfully the path continues from west to east without any seemingly dangerous spots that might send you tumbling to your demise."

rows.original: Just before the village-side path widens into a broader entrance, it makes a wide curve that grants visible access to the winding path that ends with the gate. The ravine that prevents entry is perfectly visible here, and you can see the craggy rocks at its bottom. The occasional small cliff animal darts in and out between the boulders and rubble, hiding from birds of prey that circle just above your reach.
rows.translation: 就在村庄一侧的小路变宽、形成一条更宽阔的入口之前，它会突然形成一个大的弯道，从而让人能够清楚地看到那条最终通向大门的蜿蜒小路。那条阻挡进入的沟壑在这里一览无余，你甚至能够看到其下装那些崎岖的岩石。偶尔，一些小型崖栖动物会穿梭在巨石和碎石之间，躲避那些在你们头顶上空盘旋的猛禽。
rows.raw: "\n        Just before the village-side path widens into a broader entrance, it makes a wide curve that grants visible access to the winding path that ends with the gate. The ravine that prevents entry is perfectly visible here, and you can see the craggy rocks at its bottom. The occasional small cliff animal darts in and out between the boulders and rubble, hiding from birds of prey that circle just above your reach."

rows.original:
[flags.CQ_CLEAR
            |[flags.TAUR_PURE
                |The matron's hut is a few degrees larger than any of the other tents in the village, with an almost perpetually open doorway revealing implements for helping young centaurs feel at home. This is where the village's young learn the ways of the village while their parents go about their daily lives. At night the large building is rather peaceful, but during the day there's always a rambunctious colt or filly that can be found cavorting through the more open spaces.
                |The matron's hut has become run down in the time since the village was corrupted. With how quickly the corrupted centaurs mature there's no real need for histories or teaching. Young centaurs can be taught to hunt first hand, with veterans showing them how not to draw too much negative attention to the village. Still, as one of the few remaining and largest standing structures, the massive tent sees use on the coldest nights as a shelter.
            ]
            |Just behind where you had your fight with the unicorn, a large tent stands as one of the few remaining structures in the village that isn't wrecked in some form. The insides of the building look unused and in some cases trampled, but it seems like the place still gets some use.
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.CQ_CLEAR
            |[flags.TAUR_PURE
                |女管家的小屋比村里的其他帐篷都要大一些，它那几乎始终敞开的门缝中，摆放着一些能让小半人马们感到宾至如归的物品。在这里，村里的孩子们在父母忙于日常事务的时候，学习着村庄的生活规矩。夜晚，这座宽敞的房屋显得十分宁静，但白天的时候，总会有些顽皮的小马驹在宽敞的区域内嬉戏打闹。
                |自从村庄被腐蚀以来，女管家的小屋已经破败不堪了。由于那些被腐蚀的半人马成长得如此迅速，其实并没有必要进行历史教育或传授知识——年轻的半人马可以直接通过实践来学习狩猎技巧，而老手们则会教导他们如何避免引起村庄过多的注意。不过，作为为数不多的仍在使用的、规模较大的建筑之一，在最寒冷的夜晚，这座巨大的帐篷仍然会被用作避难所。
            ]
            |就在你与独角兽发生冲突的那个地方后面，有一顶巨大的帐篷，它是村里为数不多的几座没有遭到任何破坏的建筑之一。帐篷内部看起来没有被使用过，有些地方甚至被踩得乱七八糟，但似乎这个地方仍然被有人使用着。
        ]

rows.original: The path up the ravine winds in a single long curve, arching around till it reaches the gated entrance to the village. The entire stretch is wide enough for several centaurs to walk side by side without threat of falling off the edge, but thin enough for it to be a perfect chokepoint if invaders tried to approach from the ground. The path has been beaten flat by years of use, with hoofprints overlapping till you can't make out any specific details between any given set.
rows.translation: 这条通往村庄的小路沿着峡谷蜿蜒延伸，形成一条长长的弯曲路径，最终通向村庄的入口处。这条小路的宽度足以让几头半人马并排行走而不会有掉落的危险，但宽度又恰好有限，因此如果入侵者试图从地面方向进攻，这里就会成为一个绝佳的咽喉要道。由于多年来人们不断使用这条小路，上面的蹄印已经重叠得密不可分，以至于已经无法分辨出任何具体的痕迹了。

rows.original: The village gates are impressively large, crafted from dark brown wood and lacquered smooth enough to make climbing impossible for even an industrious mecian. From the inside, a planked ramp lets the centaur guards reach the viewing platform above the gates opening mechanism. When the gates are open, the rolling hills of the Harvest Valley can be seen in the distance. At any given time there are usually two to three centaurs on gate duty, and it takes two of them to pull or push the mighty doors open.
rows.translation: 村子的大门规模十分庞大，由深棕色的木材制成，经过打磨后表面变得极为光滑，即便是行动敏捷的机械师也难以攀爬上去。从内部看，有一段木制斜坡可供半人马卫兵们登上位于大门开启装置上方的观景平台。当大门打开时，远处的丰收谷地的连绵起伏的山丘便一览无余。通常情况下，会有两到三名半人马在门口值守，而需要两个人齐心协力才能将那扇沉重的门拉开或推上。

When the gates are open, the rolling hills of the Harvest Valley can be seen in the distance. At any given time there are usually two to three centaurs on gate duty, and it takes two of them to pull or push the mighty doors open."

rows.original:
[flags.CQ_CLEAR
            |[flags.TAUR_PURE
                |The heart of the centaur village has recovered remarkably from the destruction and disuse it suffered during the village's corruption. Tents have been re-established for the centaur population to live in, and the hustle and bustle of daily life seems to have resumed as normal. Here can be found the traders, bakers, clothiers, and other storefronts the centaurs have set up in their village. 

                Most 'stores' are operated directly out of the shopkeeper's home, making setup less of a hassle and eliminating the need for a seperate establishment. The village is set up in a curving ring with homes on either end. Each one consists of two tents, a larger one for running a business or entertaining guests, and a smaller one for sleeping.
                |What obviously once housed the villages homes and businesses is now nothing more than the wide circle of a fighting arena. Centaurs still gather here, but most often its to watch others fight over who gets the first go at a mare in heat or a rutting stud. Nearly all of the tents that were once used for living are trashed, with the remaining homes reduced to private fucking stalls. A set of breeding stocks, with spaces for centaurs and marefolk alike, have been set up near one entrance to the ring.

                If any trade is done here it's done out in the open, and mostly consists of bartering with sex as payment. Many marefolk who weren't returned to fool their village still remain in the village, whether as slaves or equally corrupt allies. It's just as common to see a she-mare guiding a centaur around by her nipple chains as it is to see a centaur with a marefolk over his back for anytime use. 
            ]
            |What obviously once housed the village's homes and businesses is now nothing more than the wide circle of a fighting arena. It's empty now, save a set of breeding stocks[flags.CQ_BEHEMOTH 2|| and the unconscious body of the behemoth]. Another exit, leading toward the back end of the village, can be seen in the distance.
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.CQ_CLEAR
            |[flags.TAUR_PURE
                |半人马村庄的中心区域在经历了村庄衰败时期所遭受的破坏与荒废之后，已经恢复了惊人的活力。人们重新搭建了帐篷，半人马们又开始在其中生活，日常生活的喧嚣与忙碌似乎也恢复了往日的常态。在这里，你可以看到半人马们在他们的村庄里开设的商摊、面包店、布料店等等。

                大多数“商店”都是直接在店主的家中经营的，这样一来，开设店铺就省去了很多麻烦，也不需要另外租用场所了。这个村庄呈弯曲的环形布局，两端都分布着房屋。每栋房屋由两顶帐篷组成：较大的那一顶用于经商或招待客人，较小的那一顶则用于睡觉。
                |这里显然曾经是村庄里人们的住宅和商业场所的所在地，但现在却只不过是一个宽阔的战斗场地罢了。半人马们仍然会聚集在这里，但大多数时候，他们只是来观看其他人为了争夺那些处于发情期的母马或处于交配期的公马而争斗罢了。几乎所有曾经被用来居住的帐篷都已经被毁坏，剩下的那些“住所”也变成了私人的摊位。在竞技场的一个入口附近，人们搭建了一处用于繁殖的场所，那里为半人马和马人提供了合适的生存空间。

                如果这里真的发生了任何交易，那也都是公开进行的，而且大多是以性作为支付手段的物物交换。许多那些没有被送回自己村庄去欺骗乡亲们的女海族，至今仍然留在这个村庄里，要么沦为奴隶，要么成为了同样腐败的盟友。看到母马用乳头链牵着半人马走，与看到半人马背上驮着一位马人女性随时准备使用，这两种场景同样常见。 
            ]
            |这里显然曾经是村庄里人们的住宅和商业场所的所在地，但现在却只是一片宽阔的竞技场空地。除了那一批用于繁殖的动物之外，这里什么也没有。[flags.CQ_BEHEMOTH 2|| 以及那头巨兽无意识的躯体]在远处，可以看到另一条通往村庄后部的出口。
        ]

                大多数“商店”都是直接在店主的家中经营的，这样一来，开设店铺就省去了很多麻烦，也不需要另外租用场所了。这个村庄呈弯曲的环形布局，两端都分布着房屋。每栋房屋由两顶帐篷组成：较大的那一顶用于经商或招待客人，较小的那一顶则用于睡觉。
                |这里显然曾经是村庄里人们的住宅和商业场所的所在地，但现在却只不过是一个宽阔的战斗场地罢了。半人马们仍然会聚集在这里，但大多数时候，他们只是来观看其他人为了争夺那些处于发情期的母马或处于交配期的公马而争斗罢了。几乎所有曾经被用来居住的帐篷都已经被毁坏，剩下的那些“住所”也变成了私人的摊位。在竞技场的一个入口附近，人们搭建了一处用于繁殖的场所，那里为半人马和马人提供了合适的生存空间。

                如果这里真的发生了任何交易，那也都是公开进行的，而且大多是以性作为支付手段的物物交换。许多那些没有被送回自己村庄去欺骗乡亲们的女海族，至今仍然留在这个村庄里，要么沦为奴隶，要么成为了同样腐败的盟友。看到母马用乳头链牵着半人马走，与看到半人马背上驮着一位马人女性随时准备使用，这两种场景同样常见。 
            ]
            |这里显然曾经是村庄里人们的住宅和商业场所的所在地，但现在却只是一片宽阔的竞技场空地。除了那一批用于繁殖的动物之外，这里什么也没有。[flags.CQ_BEHEMOTH 2|| 以及那头巨兽无意识的躯体]在远处，可以看到另一条通往村庄后部的出口。
        ]
rows.raw:
"
        [flags.CQ_CLEAR
            |[flags.TAUR_PURE
                |The heart of the centaur village has recovered remarkably from the destruction and disuse it suffered during the village's corruption. Tents have been re-established for the centaur population to live in, and the hustle and bustle of daily life seems to have resumed as normal. Here can be found the traders, bakers, clothiers, and other storefronts the centaurs have set up in their village. 

                Most 'stores' are operated directly out of the shopkeeper's home, making setup less of a hassle and eliminating the need for a seperate establishment. The village is set up in a curving ring with homes on either end. Each one consists of two tents, a larger one for running a business or entertaining guests, and a smaller one for sleeping.
                |What obviously once housed the villages homes and businesses is now nothing more than the wide circle of a fighting arena. Centaurs still gather here, but most often its to watch others fight over who gets the first go at a mare in heat or a rutting stud. Nearly all of the tents that were once used for living are trashed, with the remaining homes reduced to private fucking stalls. A set of breeding stocks, with spaces for centaurs and marefolk alike, have been set up near one entrance to the ring.

                If any trade is done here it's done out in the open, and mostly consists of bartering with sex as payment. Many marefolk who weren't returned to fool their village still remain in the village, whether as slaves or equally corrupt allies. It's just as common to see a she-mare guiding a centaur around by her nipple chains as it is to see a centaur with a marefolk over his back for anytime use. 
            ]
            |What obviously once housed the village's homes and businesses is now nothing more than the wide circle of a fighting arena. It's empty now, save a set of breeding stocks[flags.CQ_BEHEMOTH 2|| and the unconscious body of the behemoth]. Another exit, leading toward the back end of the village, can be seen in the distance.
        ]"

rows.original:
This thin strip of path leading out of the village center is much less worn than the rest, though it still sports a healthy covering of hoofprints. In the distance, you can see the outline of the chieftain's hut, built against the side of a mountain. Further into the ravine, rocky cliffs and crystal clear lakes reflect the light of the [dayNight|sun|moon]. 

        The view, at least, seems untainted by the demon witch's machinations.
rows.translation:
这条通往村庄中心外的小径十分狭窄，磨损程度远低于其他道路，不过依然覆着不少清晰的蹄印。远处可以看见酋长小屋的轮廓，它依山而建。峡谷更深处，岩石峭壁与清澈湖泊反射着[dayNight|太阳|月亮]的光辉。

        至少眼前的景色似乎尚未受到恶魔女巫阴谋的污染。

rows.original:
[flags.TAUR_PURE
            |This is the house belonging to the current chieftain's family. For now, that's chieftain Taldahs and his daughter, Ahmri. Taldahs is seldom here anymore, leaving Ahmri to get used to how things will be when she becomes chief. The building looks rather humble from without, showing nothing more than a wooden hut built against the mountainside. Looking at it, you wouldn't think such a home would have room for any but the shortest of races, let alone a family of centaurs.
            
            Inside is another story. Carved into the side of the mountain itself is a spacious home with five impressively sized rooms. From the looks of things, there are three rooms with bedding (two of which have personal effects as well), one kitchen, and one room for storage. Each of these stem from a main area with homely rugs and a high table.
            |[ahmri.atVillage
                |The chieftains cabin has been refurbished a little since Ahmri moved back in. The holes have been mended and the bedding restored, but the life it had before has not returned. Everything is clean and proper, but the feeling of home hasn't returned along with the resoration.
                |There is nothing but dust and stale air in the empty chieftains cabin. None of the centaurs seem interested in claiming it, whether out of some clinging sense of respect for the chief or just a desire to not be held down by the traditions that shackled their freedoms. 
                
                The building could probably be considered livable by some standards, but the bedding is torn and the cloths have holes.
            ]
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.TAUR_PURE
            |这就是现任酋长家族的住所。目前，这里住着酋长塔尔达斯和他的女儿艾姆丽。塔尔达斯已经很少来这里了，因此艾姆丽需要逐渐适应自己将来成为酋长后所要面对的一切。从外面看，这座建筑显得相当简陋，只不过是一间依山而建的木屋而已。看着它，你根本不会想到这样的住所里竟然能够容纳除了身材最矮小的生物之外的其他生物，更不用说一个半人马家族了。
            
            里面则是另一番景象。在山体的一侧，有人开凿出了一处宽敞的居所，其中包含了五间面积不小的房间。从目前的状况来看，有三间房间配备了床铺（其中两间还摆放着个人物品），一间厨房，以及一间用于储物的房间。这些元素都源自一个以温馨的地毯和高脚桌为特色的主要空间。
            |[ahmri.atVillage
                |自从阿姆里搬回来之后，酋长的小屋已经进行了一些翻修。那些漏洞已经被修补，床铺也重新整理过，但小屋原本拥有的那种氛围却再也回不来了。虽然一切都变得干净整洁，但那种家的感觉却并没有随着翻修而重新出现。
                |在这间空荡荡的酋长小屋里，只有尘土和陈腐的空气。似乎没有半位半人马愿意占据它——要么是因为他们对这位酋长还怀有一丝敬意，要么只是因为他们不想被那些束缚他们自由的传统所束缚。
                
                按照某些标准来看，这座建筑或许还算可以居住，但床铺已经破旧不堪，布料上也布满了洞洞。
            ]
        ]

rows.original:
[flags.TAUR_PURE
            |A pair of tents stand at the upper edge of the village just before it transitions into evenly spaced rows of garden plots. You see carrots and potatoes, and other vegetables growing depending on the time of year. The hearty plants of the north can grow even in light snowfall, and in the case of heavier snow, the large tents contain smaller plots for growing nutrient-rich, cold-resistant food. Not the tastiest stuff, but better than starving and freezing.
            |The garden tents are in a state of disarray, but root vegetables and some nutritious tubers still grow in the outer garden plots. Despite some misgivings, the corrupt centaurs are planting crops and tending them now. There's no love in the haphazard placement of vegetables, but they provide nutrition nonetheless. The few things that do have some degree of effort put into their growth are carrots and cucumbers. You can only begin to guess why.
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.TAUR_PURE
            |在村庄的上缘，有一对帐篷矗立在那里，就在那里开始延伸出排列整齐的菜园地。你可以看到胡萝卜、土豆以及其他根据季节不同而种植的蔬菜。北方这种耐寒的植物即使在下雪的情况下也能生长；而在降雪量较大的时候，那些大型帐篷里还会搭建出小型的种植区域，用来种植那些营养丰富、耐寒性强的农作物。这些食物可能不是最美味的，但总比挨饿受冻要好得多。
            |花园里的帐篷杂乱无章，但外围的菜地里仍然种着根茎类蔬菜和一些营养丰富的块茎植物。尽管有些顾虑，那些腐败的半人马们现在仍在种植这些作物并照料它们。虽然这些蔬菜的种植方式显得随意而缺乏用心，但它们依然能提供营养。在那些种植过程中确实投入了一定精力的作物，只有胡萝卜和黄瓜。至于为什么会这样种植，那就只能让人去猜测了。
        ]

rows.original:
You stand at the bottom of the stairs leading down into these lower depths of the royal crypt. Before you stretches a long corridor, dark as night, lined with shelf-like hollows where the ancient dead were laid to rest. 

        The skeletons have been preserved remarkably well by the frigid glacier the palace was built into. Thanks to Elthara's light you can, unfortunately, see the ghastly grin of skulls leering down at you from all angles.
        
        [flags.CAT_ATHEL_RES
            |The ghostly wall has vanished. You can leave now, if you're finished.
            |An opaque wall of white ghost-stuff has flooded the arched door over the stairs, solid enough to rebuff Hethia's attempts to push through it. it seems you're trapped down here...
        ]
rows.translation:
你站在通往王室地窖深处的长楼梯下装。前方是一条漆黑如夜的长走廊，走廊两旁排列着类似架子的空槽，那些古老的死者就被安葬在那里。

        由于宫殿建在冰冷的冰川之上，这些骷髅得以完好地保存下来。可惜的是，在艾尔萨拉的光芒照耀下，你可以看到那些骷髅头从各个角度向你露出狰狞的笑容。
        
        [flags.CAT_ATHEL_RES
            |那道幽灵般的墙壁已经消失了。如果你们已经完成了任务，现在可以离开了。
            |一堵由白色幽灵物质构成的不透明墙壁已经将楼梯上方的拱形门完全堵住，其硬度足以阻挡赫西娅试图冲破它的尝试。看来你被困在这里了……
        ]
rows.raw:
"
        You stand at the bottom of the stairs leading down into these lower depths of the royal crypt. Before you stretches a long corridor, dark as night, lined with shelf-like hollows where the ancient dead were laid to rest. 

        The skeletons have been preserved remarkably well by the frigid glacier the palace was built into. Thanks to Elthara's light you can, unfortunately, see the ghastly grin of skulls leering down at you from all angles.
        
        [flags.CAT_ATHEL_RES
            |The ghostly wall has vanished. You can leave now, if you're finished.
            |An opaque wall of white ghost-stuff has flooded the arched door over the stairs, solid enough to rebuff Hethia's attempts to push through it. it seems you're trapped down here...
        ]"

rows.original:
You're inside the royal crypts underneath the Winter City, half-buried under the glacier. Skeletons are set deep into the walls on either side of you, where the honored dead are laid to rest. They leer down at you as if grinning.

        The central corridor through the tomb stretches north and south, back to the stairs.
rows.translation:
你此刻正处于冬城地下的皇家陵墓中，这些陵墓被冰川部分覆盖着。你两侧的墙壁上嵌着许多骷髅，那些受到尊崇的逝者就安葬在这里。那些骷髅仿佛在对你咧嘴微笑。

        穿过墓室的中央走廊南北延伸，最终通向那段楼梯。
rows.raw:
"
        You're inside the royal crypts underneath the Winter City, half-buried under the glacier. Skeletons are set deep into the walls on either side of you, where the honored dead are laid to rest. They leer down at you as if grinning.

        The central corridor through the tomb stretches north and south, back to the stairs."

rows.translation:
你此刻正处于冬城地下的皇家陵墓中，这些陵墓被冰川部分覆盖着。你两侧的墙壁上嵌着许多骷髅，那些受尊敬的逝者就安葬在这里。它们仿佛在向你咧嘴微笑。

        穿过墓室的中央走廊向南延伸，最终会通向楼梯。而在北方，你可以清楚地看到一座雕像矗立在几条通道的交汇处。她的手臂高高举起，其中燃烧着一团火焰，为墓室中的黑暗带来一丝光亮。

rows.original:
You stand before a statue of Lumia, goddess of sunlight... at least, that's the closest approximation you can imagine. It's an elven woman, tall and slender and regal-looking, holding aloft a beacon of flame in one hand, with a scythe couched under her other armor. The goddess's armor has been painted gold, and her hair is flaxen-blonde, but otherwise the stone has worn to colorless gray.

        There are four corridors branching from this central chamber: south leads back to the stairs; east and west branch off into smaller corridors with somewhat less adornment than you've seen so far; to the north the tomb becomes wider and leads up to a set of stairs, maybe five feet high, beneath a vaulted arch. [flags.CAT_WALL_PASS||Another wall of white ghost-matter writhes between the arches, preventing passage.]
rows.translation:
你站在一座名为卢米娅的雕像面前——这位被尊为“阳光女神”的存在……至少，你可以这样理解她。那是一座精灵女性的雕像，高挑纤细，气质高贵，她一手举着燃烧的火把，另一只手则握着一把镰刀。这位女神的铠甲被涂成了金色，她的头发也是亚麻金色的，但除此之外，这块石头已经褪成了无色的灰色。

        从这个中央大厅出发，有四条走廊分支出来：向南走会回到楼梯那里；向东和向西分别延伸出一些装饰较为简朴的小走廊；而向北走，墓室会变得宽敞一些，最终会通向一组楼梯——那些楼梯可能有五英尺高，位于一个拱形结构之下。 [flags.CAT_WALL_PASS||另一堵由白色幽灵物质构成的墙在拱门之间蜿蜒延伸，阻碍了人们的通行。]

rows.original:
You're inside the royal crypts underneath the Winter City, half-buried under the glacier. Skeletons are set deep into the walls on either side of you, where the dead are laid to rest. Those entombed here are adorned in luxurious silks, bangles, and gems... but no crowns or royal shrouds. Perhaps the consorts of the kings and queens of winter are buried here?

        You can still see the guardian statue and her light back east. To the north, there are more tombs[flags.CAT_SYN_RES|.| and... the sound of wailing, a sobbing that howls through the corridors. What poor, damned soul yet lingers here?]
rows.translation:
你此刻正处于冬城的皇家地下墓穴中，这些墓穴被冰川部分覆盖。你两侧的墙壁上嵌着许多骷髅，这些逝者都被安葬在这里。那些被埋葬于此的人身上佩戴着奢华的丝绸、手镯和宝石……但却没有任何王冠或皇家寿衣。或许，冬城的国王和王后的妃子们就被安葬在这里？

        你仍能看见东边的守护神像及其光芒。北边还有更多墓穴[flags.CAT_SYN_RES|。|，还有……哀号声，哭泣的呜咽在走廊间回响。究竟还有哪个可怜的受难灵魂徘徊在这里？]
rows.raw:
"
        You're inside the royal crypts underneath the Winter City, half-buried under the glacier. Skeletons are set deep into the walls on either side of you, where the dead are laid to rest. Those entombed here are adorned in luxurious silks, bangles, and gems... but no crowns or royal shrouds. Perhaps the consorts of the kings and queens of winter are buried here?

        You can still see the guardian statue and her light back east. To the north, there are more tombs[flags.CAT_SYN_RES|.| and... the sound of wailing, a sobbing that howls through the corridors. What poor, damned soul yet lingers here?]"

rows.original: This chamber contains the remains of particularly favored consorts, cherished by the kings and queens of winter.
rows.translation: 这个密室中存放着那些受到冬季之王与王后特别宠爱的妃子的遗骸。
rows.raw: "\n        This chamber contains the remains of particularly favored consorts, cherished by the kings and queens of winter."

        You can still see the guardian statue and her light back west. To the north, there are more tombs stretching on towards a circular chamber whose floor you can't see from here.
rows.translation:
你此刻正处于冬城地下的皇家陵墓中，这些陵墓被冰川部分覆盖着。你两侧的墙壁上嵌着许多骷髅，那些逝者便安葬在这里。被埋葬在这里的人们都佩戴着奢华的丝绸服饰、手镯以及宝石。……但没有王冠或皇室寿衣。或许冬之国王与王后的配偶们就埋葬在这里？

        你仍然可以看到那座守护神像，以及她散发出的光芒，它们位于西边。往北望去，还有更多的坟墓延伸开来，最终通向一个圆形的墓室，但从这里你无法看到那个墓室的地面。
rows.raw:
"
        You're inside the royal crypts underneath the Winter City, half-buried under the glacier. Skeletons are set deep into the walls on either side of you, where the dead are laid to rest. Those entombed here are adorned in luxurious silks, bangles, and gems... but no crowns or royal shrouds. Perhaps the consorts of the kings and queens of winter are buried here?

        You can still see the guardian statue and her light back west. To the north, there are more tombs stretching on towards a circular chamber whose floor you can't see from here."

rows.original:
The harem's grave is a deep circular chamber, with a floor perhaps fifty feet below you. The walls are ringed with stairs, leading down in the dark depths of the ice. All the skeletons here are adorned with rich silk and jewels, proof that once upon a time they were favored and beloved. What silks that have not been eaten by moths have long since rotted away, barely recognisable as the finery they once were, but the jewelry has gained no tarnish in the intervening centuries.

        Behind you, to the south, is the way back.
rows.translation:
后宫女性的坟墓是一个深邃的圆形墓室，其地面距离你大概有五十英尺之远。墓室的墙壁上环绕着楼梯，这些楼梯通向冰层深处那片暗影的区域。这里所有的骷髅都佩戴着华丽的丝绸服饰和珍贵的珠宝，这证明了在过去的某个时候，这些女性曾经受到宠爱与珍视。那些没有被蛾子吃掉的丝绸早已腐烂变质，几乎无法辨认出它们曾经拥有的华丽外观，但这些珠宝在几个世纪以来却丝毫没有失去光泽。

        在你身后，向南的方向，就是回去的路。
rows.raw:
"
        The harem's grave is a deep circular chamber, with a floor perhaps fifty feet below you. The walls are ringed with stairs, leading down in the dark depths of the ice. All the skeletons here are adorned with rich silk and jewels, proof that once upon a time they were favored and beloved. What silks that have not been eaten by moths have long since rotted away, barely recognisable as the finery they once were, but the jewelry has gained no tarnish in the intervening centuries.

        Behind you, to the south, is the way back."

rows.original:
You stand before a rising set of stairs, beneath a vaulted arch of chiseled ice cut away into the heart of the glacier. The weight of the palace bears down on this place, leaving these innermost chambers feeling claustrophobic and oppressive even though the chambers are wider here than elsewhere in the tomb.

        [flags.CAT_WALL_PASS||A wall of ghostly matter, just like that around the tomb's entrance, blocks your path. Hethia huffs in frustration and sends a cracklack lance of flames at it, but the magic just sputters uselessly against the spectral gate. The very spirits of this place gather to bar your passing...]
rows.translation:
你站在一段逐渐上升的楼梯前，这座楼梯位于一座由冰块雕刻而成的拱门之下，而这座拱门正是直接凿刻在冰川的核心部位。宫殿的沉重压迫感让这些最内部的房间显得压抑而狭窄，尽管这些房间的面积其实比陵墓中的其他地方要宽敞许多。

        [flags.CAT_WALL_PASS||一堵由幽灵物质构成的墙，就如同墓穴入口处那道墙一样，挡住了你的去路。赫西娅恼怒地哼了一声，向那道墙射出了一道火焰长矛，但魔法力量在碰到那道幽灵屏障时只是无力地熄灭了。这个地方的所有幽灵似乎都在联合起来，阻拦你的前进……]

"

The weight of the palace bears down on this place, leaving these innermost chambers feeling claustrophobic and oppressive even though the chambers are wider here than elsewhere in the tomb.
