Hethia huffs in frustration and sends a cracklack lance of flames at it, but the magic just sputters uselessly against the spectral gate. The very spirits of this place gather to bar your passing...]"

rows.original:
The burial hollows in the walls of this wide-open chamber are far filled by skeletons adorned in kingly raiment, bedecked in jewels and silken burial shrouds. At the center of the chamber, just north of where you stand, is a raised platform on which sits a row of sarcophagi made entirely of sculpted ice. [flags.CAT_ATHEL_RES||A figure, near translucent and surrounded by wisps of cold mist, kneels on the platform with her back to you. A bow is planted on the floor beside her, and a quiver of arrows sits slung on her hip. Though you can only catch a glimpse of it, you're sure you can see a crown on the ghost's auburn hair, radiant with an inner sunlight. 

        Queen Atheldred, then. It must be.]
rows.translation:
这个宽敞厅室的墙壁上那些埋葬凹槽里，早已堆满了那些身着王室服饰、佩戴着珠宝、覆盖着丝绸寿衣的骷髅。在厅室的中央，就在你站立位置的北侧，有一个高台，上面摆放着一排完全由雕刻过的冰块制成的石棺。 [flags.CAT_ATHEL_RES||一个身影，近乎半透明，周围萦绕着缕缕寒雾，正背对着你跪在平台上。她身旁的地面上放着一把弓，腰间别着一只箭袋。虽然你只能隐约看到一些，但你确信，那幽灵的赤褐色头发上戴着一顶王冠，那王冠仿佛散发着内在的光芒。

        那么，一定是阿塞尔德雷德女王。肯定没有错。]
rows.raw:
"
        The burial hollows in the walls of this wide-open chamber are far filled by skeletons adorned in kingly raiment, bedecked in jewels and silken burial shrouds. At the center of the chamber, just north of where you stand, is a raised platform on which sits a row of sarcophagi made entirely of sculpted ice. [flags.CAT_ATHEL_RES||A figure, near translucent and surrounded by wisps of cold mist, kneels on the platform with her back to you. A bow is planted on the floor beside her, and a quiver of arrows sits slung on her hip. Though you can only catch a glimpse of it, you're sure you can see a crown on the ghost's auburn hair, radiant with an inner sunlight. 

        Queen Atheldred, then. It must be.]"

rows.original:
With the queen's spirit laid to rest, an eerie silence has fallen over the tomb. The hauntings have come to an end, and the wails of the damned no longer assail your ears. 

        "Let's... let's get out of here," Etheryn squeaks, holding her bow to her chest. "All the skeletons are staring at me."
        
        To the south, the catacombs stretch out all the way back to the stairs. Nothing blocks your escape anymore.
rows.translation:
随着女王的灵魂得到安息，坟墓周围笼罩着一片诡异的寂静。那些幽灵的侵扰已经结束，那些受诅咒者的哀嚎也不再回荡在耳边。

        “我们……我们快离开这里吧，”伊瑟琳惊声说道，她将弓紧紧抱在胸前，“所有的骷髅都在盯着我看。”
        
        向南望去，那些地下墓穴一直延伸到楼梯处。现在再也没有什么能阻挡你们的逃路了。
rows.raw:
'
        With the queen's spirit laid to rest, an eerie silence has fallen over the tomb. The hauntings have come to an end, and the wails of the damned no longer assail your ears. 

        "Let's... let's get out of here," Etheryn squeaks, holding her bow to her chest. "All the skeletons are staring at me."
        
        To the south, the catacombs stretch out all the way back to the stairs. Nothing blocks your escape anymore.'

rows.original: The Frost Hound Tavern... you were the one who came up with the name, and it was built to be the heart and soul of the newly-founded Hawkethorne village. Your father taught you to never do anything in half-measures, and you've taken that to heart: at two stories, the building is the tallest around save for Sanders' nearby temple, and that's only because he moved into an ancient ruin already built for him. This, Garth and you raised from the earth together while you were still pregnant, beam by beam, plank by plank. Over the heavy door swings a wooden sign of a big, powerful wolf carrying a dagger in its mouth — not quite as emblematic as the crossed swords of your father's mercenary company, but it's yours. Shouts come from the town square ahead, and through the light snowfall you see shapes moving hurriedly down the dirt paths. There's no time to waste.
rows.translation: 寒霜猎犬酒馆……这个名字是你想出来的，而这座酒馆的建造初衷，正是成为新建鹰棘镇的核心与灵魂。你父亲教过你，做任何事都不能只做一半，而你也把这句话牢记在心：酒馆足有两层，是附近最高的建筑，只有桑德斯的神殿比它更高——但那只是因为他搬进了一座早已建成的古代遗迹。这座酒馆则是你仍怀着孕时，与加斯一起一梁一板地从地面上建起来的。厚重的大门上方悬着一块木招牌，画着一头口衔匕首、强壮威武的巨狼——虽不像你父亲佣兵团的交叉双剑那般醒目，但它是属于你的。 前方镇广场传来阵阵呼喊；透过纷扬的小雪，你看到一些身影正匆忙地沿土路移动。没有时间可以浪费了。
rows.raw: "The Frost Hound Tavern... you were the one who came up with the name, and it was built to be the heart and soul of the newly-founded Hawkethorne village. Your father taught you to never do anything in half-measures, and you've taken that to heart: at two stories, the building is the tallest around save for Sanders' nearby temple, and that's only because he moved into an ancient ruin already built for him. This, Garth and you raised from the earth together while you were still pregnant, beam by beam, plank by plank. Over the heavy door swings a wooden sign of a big, powerful wolf carrying a dagger in its mouth — not quite as emblematic as the crossed swords of your father's mercenary company, but it's yours.\n\n Shouts come from the town square ahead, and through the light snowfall you see shapes moving hurriedly down the dirt paths. There's no time to waste."

rows.original:
The center of the fledgling village sprawls out around you, a packed dirt circle connecting three different roads through the mud-and-thatch homes huddled around a larger-than-life statue of a man holding a war axe aloft over his head, his other hand resting on a shield set beside his feet — the baroness's own father, as she explained to Garth, Sanders, River and you in your first weeks here. The shield, though its once-intricate details have long faded, is still set with a large blue gemstone nearly the size of your head; you don't know why, but River's made sure that no one in town has tried to loot the gemstone despite its obvious value.

        You can hear screams from the east gate; that must be where the fun's happening. Best to hurry up, lest the best parts of the party be over by the time you arrive on the scene.
rows.translation:
这个刚刚建立起来的村庄的中心地带就在你周围延伸开来，一条由泥土铺成的环形道路将三条不同的道路连接起来。这些泥草屋顶的房屋围绕着一座巨大的雕像——雕像中的人物高举战斧，另一只手则放在脚边的盾牌上。正如男爵夫人在你们来到这里的最初几周里向加斯、桑德斯、瑞弗以及你解释的那样，这位雕像其实就是她自己的父亲。虽然那面盾牌上曾经复杂的纹饰早已褪色，但上面仍镶嵌着一颗几乎有你的头那么大的蓝色宝石。你不知道为什么，但瑞弗确保了镇上没有人试图偷走这颗宝石，尽管它的价值显而易见。

        从东门传来尖叫声，看来那里肯定正在发生有趣的事情。最好快点赶过去，否则等你赶到时，派对最精彩的环节可能已经结束了。
rows.raw: "The center of the fledgling village sprawls out around you, a packed dirt circle connecting three different roads through the mud-and-thatch homes huddled around a larger-than-life statue of a man holding a war axe aloft over his head, his other hand resting on a shield set beside his feet — the baroness's own father, as she explained to Garth, Sanders, River and you in your first weeks here. The shield, though its once-intricate details have long faded, is still set with a large blue gemstone nearly the size of your head; you don't know why, but River's made sure that no one in town has tried to loot the gemstone despite its obvious value.\n\n        You can hear screams from the east gate; that must be where the fun's happening. Best to hurry up, lest the best parts of the party be over by the time you arrive on the scene."

rows.original: The eastern gate of the village — or more correctly, an arch, since there isn't a palisade to go with it. You'd hoped to get started on that with Garth and the lads when spring came, maybe there's still time once all this is over. If anything, recent events have convinced you more than ever that Hawkethorne needs a wall...
rows.translation: 村庄的东门——或者更准确地说，应该是一个拱门，因为那里并没有围墙与之配套。你原本打算等到春天到来，再和加斯以及那些小伙子们一起开始修建这个拱门，或许等这一切结束后，现在还有时间去做这件事。事实上，最近发生的一系列事件让你比以往任何时候都更加确信：鹰棘镇确实需要一堵墙……
rows.raw: "The eastern gate of the village — or more correctly, an arch, since there isn't a palisade to go with it. You'd hoped to get started on that with Garth and the lads when spring came, maybe there's still time once all this is over. If anything, recent events have convinced you more than ever that Hawkethorne needs a wall... "

rows.original:
The road — inasmuch as it can be called a road — east of Hawkethorne stretches on to the horizon, fading into the forested foothills. You can see the village gates standing open to the west, and to the north, a narrow path up a rocky hillside — at the top, you can vaguely make out the dark walls of the old pale elf temple sitting high on the peak through the light snowfall. Beyond it stands the high walls of the baroness's home, stark and proud against the grim sky.

        They've formed a line not thirty paces from you, perhaps two dozen of them — which means perhaps half of the village's pups. You know their faces, their voices are familiar to you; the bastard is using them as shields, because he thinks you won't dare to hurt them. He isn't completely wrong, because they've managed to hold back Sanders this long; he's there with his lance at the ready, but can't find it in himself to bring his weapon to bear against any of the kids. 
        
        ...The poor bastard. Guess it's up to you to save his sorry ass.
rows.translation:
那条路——如果它真的能被称为一条路的话——从鹰棘镇以东延伸开来，一直通往地平线，最终消失在那些被森林覆盖的山脚下。你可以看到西边的村庄大门敞开着，而在北边，有一条狭窄的小路蜿蜒着爬上岩石遍布的山坡；在山顶上，透过稀疏的积雪，你可以隐约看到那座坐落在高处的古老苍白精灵神殿的黑色墙壁。在它的背后，是男爵夫人宅邸的高墙，那些冰冷的墙壁在阴沉的天空映衬下显得格外醒目。

        他们排成一行，距离你不到三十步远，大概有二十来个人——这意味着，这可能是整个村庄一半的年轻人。你认识他们的脸，他们的声音你也十分熟悉；那个混蛋正在利用他们作为盾牌，因为他觉得你不敢伤害他们。他并没有完全错，因为这些孩子确实让桑德斯迟迟无法采取行动；桑德斯虽然手持长矛，随时准备出击，但却无法下定决心对这些孩子中的任何一个使用武器。 
        
        …那个可怜的家伙。看来只能靠你来救他了。
rows.raw:
"The road — inasmuch as it can be called a road — east of Hawkethorne stretches on to the horizon, fading into the forested foothills. You can see the village gates standing open to the west, and to the north, a narrow path up a rocky hillside — at the top, you can vaguely make out the dark walls of the old pale elf temple sitting high on the peak through the light snowfall. Beyond it stands the high walls of the baroness's home, stark and proud against the grim sky.

        They've formed a line not thirty paces from you, perhaps two dozen of them — which means perhaps half of the village's pups. You know their faces, their voices are familiar to you; the bastard is using them as shields, because he thinks you won't dare to hurt them. He isn't completely wrong, because they've managed to hold back Sanders this long; he's there with his lance at the ready, but can't find it in himself to bring his weapon to bear against any of the kids. 
        
        ...The poor bastard. Guess it's up to you to save his sorry ass."

rows.original: The great hall of the temple is a deep, vaulted chamber of red brick supported by rows of blackened pillars flanking the entrance — and a set of stone doors to the north, which lead further inside. Empty offering bowls and tattered old prayer rugs are strewn haphazardly about the fringes, reinforcing that this temple has not seen worship in many a year. There is a powerful canid scent lingering in the air, a reminder of the temple's guardian. It's most powerful surrounding a large nest made of old pillows, straw, and shredded rugs.
rows.translation: 寺庙的大厅是一个深邃的拱形空间，墙壁由红砖砌成，入口两侧排列着一排排熏黑的柱子；北侧还有一扇石门，通向更里面的区域。空荡荡的供品碗和破旧的祈祷毯随意散落在大厅的边缘，这一切都表明，这座寺庙已经很多年没有举行过祭祀活动了。空气中弥漫着一种浓烈的犬类气味，这让人不禁联想到这座寺庙的守护者。这种气味在那个由旧枕头、稻草和撕碎的地毯堆成的大巢穴周围最为浓烈。
rows.raw: "\n        The great hall of the temple is a deep, vaulted chamber of red brick supported by rows of blackened pillars flanking the entrance — and a set of stone doors to the north, which lead further inside. Empty offering bowls and tattered old prayer rugs are strewn haphazardly about the fringes, reinforcing that this temple has not seen worship in many a year. There is a powerful canid scent lingering in the air, a reminder of the temple's guardian. It's most powerful surrounding a large nest made of old pillows, straw, and shredded rugs."

rows.original:
The second chamber of the temple is dominated by a huge obsidian statue, depicting a shapely salamander woman in the buff, human in shape save for thick scales covering her forelimbs and a draconic set of ears and a tail glowing with a radiant inner light. The statue is holding up a great bronze bowl in one hand, extending it towards you; in her other, she brandishes a staff of solid black stone, adorned with a flame-red crystal at its peak that glows with an inner light, perhaps fed by the same hidden fires that illuminate her tail.

        The doors to the south stand open, leading back to the exit. Another set to the north [flags.FIRE_DOOR|are now open, leading into a third chamber of the temple.|are sealed shut, and no amount of pushing or shoved against them causes these doors to yield...]
rows.translation:
寺庙的第二层大厅里，最显眼的是一座巨大的黑曜石雕像。这座雕像塑造了一位身材匀称的蝾螈女性，她全身赤裸，除了前肢上覆盖着厚厚的鳞片，以及那对龙一般的耳朵和一条散发着璀璨光芒的尾巴外，其余部分都与人类毫无区别。这座雕像一只手举着一个巨大的青铜碗，正向你伸来；另一只手则握着一根由纯黑色石头制成的权杖，权杖的顶端镶嵌着一颗火焰红色的水晶，那水晶散发着内在的光芒，或许这种光芒正是源自那些为她的尾巴提供照亮的隐藏火源。

        南边的门大开着，通向出口；北边还有另一扇门。 [flags.FIRE_DOOR|这些通道现在已经打开，通向寺庙的第三个房间。|这些门被牢牢关上，无论用多大的力气去推或撞，它们都不会被打开……]
rows.raw:
"
        The second chamber of the temple is dominated by a huge obsidian statue, depicting a shapely salamander woman in the buff, human in shape save for thick scales covering her forelimbs and a draconic set of ears and a tail glowing with a radiant inner light. The statue is holding up a great bronze bowl in one hand, extending it towards you; in her other, she brandishes a staff of solid black stone, adorned with a flame-red crystal at its peak that glows with an inner light, perhaps fed by the same hidden fires that illuminate her tail.

        The doors to the south stand open, leading back to the exit. Another set to the north [flags.FIRE_DOOR|are now open, leading into a third chamber of the temple.|are sealed shut, and no amount of pushing or shoved against them causes these doors to yield...]"

rows.original:
The innermost sanctum of the Temple of Terrestrial Fire is a broad, oval-shaped chamber that was likely once the same red brick as the outer halls, but has long since been scorched black by the abyssal flames contained within this place.

        A southern door leads back to the Terrestrial Flames. A set of sweeping stone stairs lead up from this chamber to a square stone altar at the peak. You must be near to the surface of the hill, as sections of the ceiling have been chipped and cracked away by the passage of years, allowing [dayNight|sun|moon]light to filter in, narrow beams dancing across the stone.
        
        Each corner of the altar bears a flame burning from a small candle, and in the center is a large depression filled with a bronze ritual bowl, much like the one you filled in the outer chambers.
rows.translation:
大地之火神殿最内部的圣所是一个宽敞的椭圆形房间。这些墙壁很可能曾经和外部大厅一样，使用的是红色砖块建造的，但长期以来，这里释放出的深渊之火已将它们烧成了黑色。

        南侧的一扇门通向“大地之焰”。从这个房间开始，有一段宽阔的石阶通向顶端的方形石制祭坛。你应该已经接近山丘的表面了，因为经过多年的侵蚀，天花板的部分区域已经出现裂痕和破损。 [dayNight|太阳|月亮]光线透了进来，狭窄的光束在石面上跳跃着。
        
        祭坛的每个角落都点着一支小蜡烛，发出火焰；而在祭坛的正中央，有一个较大的凹陷处，里面放着一个青铜制的仪式用碗，和你在外层房间里使用的那个碗很相似。
rows.raw:
"
        The innermost sanctum of the Temple of Terrestrial Fire is a broad, oval-shaped chamber that was likely once the same red brick as the outer halls, but has long since been scorched black by the abyssal flames contained within this place.

        A southern door leads back to the Terrestrial Flames. A set of sweeping stone stairs lead up from this chamber to a square stone altar at the peak. You must be near to the surface of the hill, as sections of the ceiling have been chipped and cracked away by the passage of years, allowing [dayNight|sun|moon]light to filter in, narrow beams dancing across the stone.
        
        Each corner of the altar bears a flame burning from a small candle, and in the center is a large depression filled with a bronze ritual bowl, much like the one you filled in the outer chambers."

rows.original:
The deck where you slipped into the ship by, the side lined with gunports and braces for what in the past would have been a number of arbalests for firing upon other ships. Or at least, that's what the stories say... these days, the know-how required to put together crossbows, let alone those of such size, has been lost to much of the world. Some knowledge still lingers, for example in Khor'minos, but in the absence of weapons and the people to man them the deck's been converted into a makeshift cargo hold.

        One, that you note, is empty at the moment. Just how many do Tollus's goons intend to bring back to the rift, or is this just spare capacity? There's nowhere in here to hide, certainly not someone as large as Gweyr. If the demon cultists do decide to make a search of belowdecks, you'll have to beat a quick retreat.
    
        The only exit from here is south and out to the rest of the ship's belly, or you could choose to leave if you think you're running your luck too thin.
rows.translation:
你就是从那片甲板上登上飞船的——甲板的两侧排列着枪口，还有用于固定那些在过去会被用来攻击其他船只的弩的支架。至少，故事上是这么说的……如今，制造这种大型弩所需的技术，在世界上已经几乎失传了。仍然有一些残余的设施存在，比如在科尔米诺斯地区，但由于缺乏武器以及操作这些设施的人员，这些区域已经被改成了临时用的货舱。

        其中有一个货舱，目前是空的。托勒斯的那些打手究竟打算把多少人带回裂隙中，还是说这些人只是多余的劳动力而已？这里根本没有地方可以躲藏，尤其是像格维尔这样体型庞大的人。如果那些恶魔教徒真的决定搜查船舱下方，你们就只能迅速撤退了。
    
        从这里出去的唯一途径是向南，穿过飞船的其他部分；当然，如果你觉得自己的运气已经用得太多了，也可以选择离开。

rows.original:
The ship's cargo hold proper. Unlike the arbalest deck, this space actually has goods in it — over half of which are empty barrels. The rest are wrapped up in hides in an attempt to waterproof them — you'll need to open them up to examine the contents. The lot is clearly the product of an organized mind, with barrels stacked, goods sorted, and plenty of room between each pile so that nothing spontaneously catches fire. You'd have thought that these were provisions and resupply for the cultist outpost, but that doesn't make sense; they'd have been unloaded earlier if that were the case.

        Interesting. You notice that the entire side of the hold is latched and lashed into place, but it presumably could open up for easy access to unload the goods, given the top of the hold is above the waterline — or alternatively, jettison them easily.
    
        The only way out of here is east back to the crew quarters.
rows.translation:
这是这艘船的货舱。与弩炮甲板不同，这个空间里确实装满了货物——其中有一半以上都是空桶，其余的则用皮革包裹起来，以防止水分渗入。你需要将这些包裹打开，才能查看里面的物品。这些货物显然是一个有条理的人整理出来的：桶子被整齐地堆放在一起，货物也分门别类地放置，而且每堆货物之间都留有足够的空间，以防止任何东西意外着火。你可能会认为这些是供给那些邪教前哨站的物资和补给品，但这样想并不合理——如果真是这样的话，这些货物早就应该被卸下了。

        有意思。你会注意到，货舱的整个侧面都被固定住了，但考虑到货舱的顶部高于水线，这些固定装置应该可以打开，以便方便地卸货；或者，也可以将货物直接扔掉。
    
        从这里出去的唯一办法就是向东回到船员宿舍。

rows.original:
Mostly empty crew quarters, with only a couple of bunks showing signs of having been lived in. That there are actual bunks to begin with, and furniture beyond the couple of lockers here and there — old as the fittings may be, it really goes to show how ostentatious the Belharans could afford to be that they could give even their sea dogs comparative luxury even on a warship. There's a ladder and hatch here that leads up to the deck, firmly sealed shut — and a good thing, too, since you'll have plenty of warning should someone decide to make a sweep of the ship's interior.

        Surprisingly enough, the place is not a mess as you might have imagined would have been the case from Tollus's sex cultists; it's actually spotless, and the most clutter around are but a handful of discarded drink bottles. Whoever runs this place at least has other things on his or her mind than just having a good time; demons, after all, can have obsessions other than sex...
rows.translation:
大部分船员宿舍都是空荡荡的，只有几张床铺看起来有人居住过。事实上，这艘船上竟然真的有床铺，还有零星分布的家具——尽管这些家具已经非常陈旧了，但这也充分说明了贝拉尔人有多么富有，他们甚至能够在战舰上为船员提供相对舒适的设施。这里有一架梯子和一个舱口，可以通往甲板，它们都被牢牢地关上了——这也真是件好事，因为如果有人决定搜查船内的话，你肯定会有足够的预警时间。

        令人惊讶的是，这个地方并不像你可能想象的那样，会被托勒斯的那些性崇拜者弄得一片狼藉；实际上，这里非常整洁，唯一有些杂乱的地方就是那几瓶被丢弃的饮料瓶而已。不管是谁在管理这个地方，他或她肯定有其他更重要的事情要处理，而不仅仅是追求享乐；毕竟，恶魔也可能有性之外其他的执念……

rows.original:
This space on the ship boasts a large, wood-grated window that lets what light there is pour in — not much at the moment thanks to the mist conjured up by the harpies, but still enough to see by. Maps, charts, and other navigational materials lie upon shelves, and there's a golden sextant upon the table — of course, upon further inspection, it's just bronze that has a very similar shade to that of gold... 

        It looks like this cabin was used to plot courses for the ship and keep it on track; even without needing to resort to oars or sails to move, getting from one place to another across the open ocean without getting lost is still an important skill. More importantly, maybe this place has some clues as to where this ship has been and where it intends to go next... 
    
        The only exit from here is west back out to the crew quarters.
rows.translation:
船上的这片空间有一扇装着木格栅的大窗，让仅有的光线倾泻而入——拜鹰身女妖召来的迷雾所赐，此刻的光线并不充足，但仍足以视物。架子上摆着地图、海图及其他航海资料，桌上则放着一具金色六分仪；当然，仔细一看，那不过是颜色与黄金极为相近的青铜……

        这间船舱看来是用于规划航线、确保船只不偏离方向的。哪怕移动时无需划桨或扬帆，想在开阔海洋上从一处抵达另一处而不迷路，依旧需要重要的航海技术。更重要的是，这里或许藏着线索，能揭示这艘船去过哪里、接下来又准备驶向何方……
    
        这里唯一的出口在西侧，通回船员舱。

rows.original:
The heart of the ship — a constantly thrumming abomination of pipes fashioned from some kind of silvery metal, the same color as that of Kasyrra's axe. The tubes snake away out from a glass-encased pedestal set in the middle of the chamber before disappearing into the wooden panelling of the room. Arcane symbols ring the dias on which the pedestal sits, and [pc.isMage
            |despite your magical training and background, you have no idea what they mean, or if they even mean anything to begin with. While you may have had an education, this is from a time before even that
            |beginning to even try and comprehend what they mean is a flat no-go for you
        ]. Maybe someone else might know... 
        
        As far as you can tell, there isn't any way of influencing the ship's course from here, not by directly messing with this... thing that's propelling it through the water, at any rate. Still, the imposing sight of a wonder from an era gone by raises more questions than it answers, mostly to do with just what Tollus is capable of now that he has Kasyrra's resources at his disposal... 
        
        The only exits from here are north back to the crew quarters and south further belowdecks.
rows.translation:
这艘船的核心部位，是由某种银色金属制成的管道构成的、不断发出嗡嗡声的装置，其颜色与卡希拉的斧头完全相同。这些管道从房间中央一个玻璃罩住的基座处延伸出去，然后消失在房间的木质墙板中。基座所在的平台周围刻满了奥术符号。[pc.isMage
            |尽管你接受了魔法训练，也拥有相关的背景知识，但你其实并不明白这些词语的含义，甚至不确定它们是否真的有什么意义。虽然你接受过教育，但那也是很久以前的事了。
            |对于你来说，甚至尝试去理解他们的含义都是完全不可能的事情。
        ]也许其他人会知道……
        
        就你目前所知，从这里根本没有任何办法可以改变飞船的航向，至少无法通过直接操控那个推动飞船前进的装置来达到这个目的。然而，这座源自遥远时代的宏伟遗迹所引发的疑问远多于它所提供的答案。尤其是关于在获得了卡希拉的资源之后，托勒斯现在究竟具备了多大的能力……
        
        从这里出发，唯一的出口要么是向北返回船员区，要么是向南继续前往下层甲板。

rows.original: The captain's cabin of this ship — simply furnished, with the same mark of a tightly-run and orderly mind that's dominated the rest of the belowdecks you've explored so far. The wooden bed is perfectly made despite the slightly musky smell rising from the sheets implying that it's been slept in, no book is out of place on the standing desk in a corner, and if what you've seen of the ship so far has been clean, this cabin is absolutely spotless. Clearly someone obsessed with neatness, at any rate... which isn't necessarily a bad thing, but to this degree? The entire room is so perfect despite the constant rocking of the ship, it's unreal. The only exit from here is north, the way you came in.
rows.translation: 这艘船的船长舱陈设极为简单，但其中所体现出的严谨与条理，与你迄今为止参观过的船舱内部一样明显。木制床铺制作得非常精良，尽管床单上散发着一丝淡淡的霉味，这说明这张床确实有人使用过；角落里的书桌上，每一本书都摆放得整整齐齐。如果你之前对这艘船的整体状况有所了解的话，就会知道这个船长舱绝对堪称一尘不染。一尘不染显然，这个人对整洁有着极度的追求……这本身并不一定是坏事，但程度竟然到了这种地步？整个房间都显得太完美尽管船一直在不停地摇晃，但这简直就像是在做梦一样。 从这里出去的唯一路就是向北，也就是你来的那条路。

rows.original: [wayfort.stateABC |Just a short ways from the gardens is the path back onto the old trade road and the base of a stone bridge fording a rushing river. It's surprisingly sturdy despite its apparent age, with only a few stones out of place. Most of the wear and tear has been repaired with newer work, leaving the surface of the bridge a checkerboard of differently-colored rock. On the northern side of the bridge, you can see the crumbling walls of an old wayfort. It likely collected taxes in days past; now it looks to be collecting dust. The south gate mostly stands, at least. |The rebuilt bridge looks brand new, although bare-bones. Any cracked stone has been picked out, and fresh hard gray rock has been re-cut and mortared in — no doubt salvaged from the old broken walls and collapsed buildings from deeper within the Wayfort. The bridge fords a rushing river, from which juts a few simple fishing traps that must have been set up by [wayfort.hasDaliza |a few of Daliza's soldiers |[wayfort.hasFarrah |the entrepreneurial cat-demon |[wayfort.hasMaids |some of your maids |[wayfort.hasJaelyn |Jael'yn |a passing woodsman ] ] ] ]. On the northern side of the bridge, you can see the repaired walls of the Wayfort, with a rudimentarily-constructed tollbooth. [wayfort.hasDaliza |Unfortunately without any soldiers, there's nobody to actually collect any tolls, but having a booth seems appropriate nonetheless. |A couple of Daliza's soldiers sit at the booth, waiting for your eventual approach[wayfort.hasMaids | as a maid buzzes by with a fresh drink ]. ] |The Wayfort's bridge looks like it could stand up to an unbelievable amount of punishment, with braced crenellations along the side featuring hooks holding up fishing traps for the rushing river. Every damaged stone has been carefully picked out and replaced anew, until the entire structure appears to be a dappled combination of pale-and-paler gray. A peek over the edge of the bridge shows baskets of flowers have been put up, of an icy blue color bred to resist wind, rain, and chill. [wayfort.hasMaids |Even as you're considering this, a hornet maid buzzes over to the bridge with a little watering can, brushing up some pollen gently with her fingers and rubbing it onto her fuzzy abdomen for later crafting. ] To the north of the bridge lays the gates and walls of the Wayfort proper, with a[wayfort.hasDaliza | |n empty ] tollbooth of solid lumber. ]
rows.translation: [wayfort.stateABC |距离花园不远处，有一条小路可以通往那条古老的商道，以及一座横跨湍急河流的石桥桥基。尽管这座桥看起来已经很古老了，但它却出奇地坚固，只有少数几块石头的位置有些不对劲。大部分因使用而产生的损坏都已经通过重新修补得到了修复，因此现在桥面上覆盖着由不同颜色岩石构成的棋盘状图案。 在桥的北侧，你可以看到一座古老要塞的残垣断壁。在过去，它很可能曾用于征收税款；如今，它只不过是在积满灰尘罢了。至少，南门还完好地矗立在那里。 |重建后的桥梁看起来宛如新的一样，尽管它的设施还相当简陋。所有出现裂缝的石块都已经被清理掉，新的坚硬灰岩也被重新切割并用来修补——这些材料无疑都是从荒废驿堡一带内部那些古老的破损墙壁和倒塌的建筑物中收集而来的。 这座桥梁横跨着一条湍急的河流，河面上还架着几处简单的捕鱼陷阱，这些陷阱肯定是有人事先设置好的[wayfort.hasDaliza |达莉莎的一些士兵 |[wayfort.hasFarrah |那个具有创业精神的“猫魔 |[wayfort.hasMaids |你的一些女仆 |[wayfort.hasJaelyn |杰琳 |一个路过的樵夫 ] ] ] ]在桥的北侧，你可以看到经过修复的荒废驿堡城墙，以及一个简易建造的收费站。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |不幸的是，由于没有士兵，实际上根本没有人能够执行这些任务。收集虽然可能会有一些额外的开销，但设立一个展位似乎仍然是必要的。 |达莉莎的几名士兵坐在摊位旁，等待着你最终的到来。[wayfort.hasMaids | 这时，一名女仆端着新鲜的饮料走了过来 ]。 ] |荒废驿堡的这座桥看起来仿佛能够承受各种巨大的考验——桥身两侧装有加固的雉堞，上面还装有挂钩，用于固定那些用于捕捉湍急河流中鱼类的陷阱。每一块受损的石头都被仔细地取出并重新更换，最终整个桥体呈现出一种由浅灰色逐渐过渡到更浅灰色的独特色调。 从桥边往下看，会发现那里挂满了花篮，这些花篮采用了冰蓝色材质，这种颜色能够有效抵御风、雨和寒冷。 [wayfort.hasMaids |就在你思考这个问题的时候，一只大黄蜂飞到了桥边，它拿着一个小水壶，用手指轻轻采集一些花粉，然后将其涂抹在自己毛茸茸的腹部，准备稍后用来制作花蜜。 ] 在桥的北侧，便是荒废驿堡城区的城门与城墙。[wayfort.hasDaliza | |空空如也 ]实心木材制成的收费关卡。 ]

rows.translation: [wayfort.stateABC |你站在一座高约12英尺的坚固石拱下，这座拱门是建在河畔老荒废驿堡的墙体内的。放眼望去，里面的景象一片荒废：残破的墙壁和倒塌的塔楼映入眼帘，而大门上的吊闸早已掉落，完全无法用来抵御来自南方的攻击。 |你站在一座高约12英尺的坚固石拱下，这座石拱是直接建在荒废驿堡城墙上的。那扇已经坍塌、生锈且腐烂的吊门已经被完全拆除了，人们将其拆解下来，希望能从中提取出任何可以重新锻造或利用的部件。不过，实际上这些部件仍然没什么用处防守这座堡垒用于抵御来自南方的攻击，入口处矗立着一座庄严的收费站。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |由达莉莎的两名士兵负责操作。他们会向你敬以庄严的礼礼。 [wayfort.hasMaids |在回到那些由你们的女仆们送来的热腾腾的饮品旁之前…… |在将注意力重新转向南方之前 ]。 |虽然它目前没人居住，但也许在你让达莉莎的士兵们离开之前，他们就已经把东西搬进了那里。 ] |在入口处，你只需要稍等片刻即可。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |在收费站，那些守卫还没看清来人就是你之前[party.som | | 以及[companion1.name] | 以及你的同伴 ]他们微笑着向你致意，神情显得十分自在，没有任何威胁之意。[pc.mf |大人 |[silly |女士 |夫人 ] ]。" |怀着对这座建筑构造之精良的自豪之情，他温柔地用手抚摸着内墙。 ] 那扇大门本身是由坚固的石料砌成的拱门，现在你可以确定，它配备了一扇由厚重的木料制成的、经过铆接和青铜加固的升降式门扇。前方的庭院一览无余，道路从它的西侧边缘绕了过去。最终人们认为，在这里安装一扇常规尺寸的大门其实毫无意义，因为升降式门扇已经能够满足使用需求了，尤其是考虑到大门的另一侧还有一座桥的存在。 ]
rows.raw: " [wayfort.stateABC |You stand beneath a solid stone arch, about 12 feet high, built into the wall of the old Wayfort on the river's edge. Everything you can see inside looks abandoned: crumbling walls and broken towers await you within, and the gate's portcullis has fallen in on itself, making it utterly useless for defending against the south. |You stand beneath a solid stone arch, about 12 feet high, built into the wall of the Wayfort. The collapsed, rusted and rotted portcullis has been removed entirely to be salvaged for anything reforgeable and useful, and though it would still be useless for actually defending the fort from attacks from the south, a toll booth sits proudly at the entrance [wayfort.hasDaliza |manned by two of Daliza's soldiers. They give you proud salutes, [wayfort.hasMaids |before returning to warm steaming drinks delivered by your maids |before turning their attention back to the south ]. |although it's unoccupied, perhaps Daliza's soldiers put it up before you told her to shoo. ] |You're stopped only for a moment at the gate [wayfort.hasDaliza |by the guards in their tollbooth, before they see that it's you[party.som | | and [companion1.name] | and your companions ]. They salute you with smiles, looking comfortable and unthreatened. "[pc.mf |My lord |[silly |M'lady |My lady ] ]." |by a sense of pride at how well-built the structure is, running a hand fondly along the inside wall. ] The gate itself is a solid stone arch, and you know for a fact now that it has a functional winching portcullis of heavy, heavy wood that's been riveted and braced with bronze. The courtyard can be seen ahead, with the road wrapping around the western edge of it. Eventually it was decided that a full-sized door to occupy the body of a gate was apparently pointless where a portcullis would function instead, especially with a bridge directly on the other side of it. ]"

rows.original:
[wayfort.stateABC
            |The main grounds of the Wayfort sprawl out around you, covered in debris from some ancient siege. There is space for a road around the western border, where passers-by could likely watch soldiers drill in the past. Unfortunately a huge boulder lies smack in the center of this courtyard, obscuring the majority of the view.
            
            There looks to be a way into the main keep to the northeast, and back south lie the gates.
            |The main grounds of the Wayfort appear to be mostly empty; it's impossible to repair the ruined courtyard with simple renovations, but at least it no longer looks abandoned. The pack-dirt-and-stone-edged road continues around the western border of the courtyard, and where once an impossibly huge boulder had laid in the dead center of this open ground, it has been broken down and masoned into serviceable archstones and replace portions of the collapsed walls.
            
            To the northeast lies the main keep, with the gate and tollbooth to the south.
            |The Wayfort's courtyard is a perfect combination of hard-packed dirt, with tiled-off sections interspersed to make for rudimentary training squares. [wayfort.hasDaliza
                |A couple of soldiers can be seen — dressed in nothing but form-hugging underwear — training with blunted weapons or jogging laps around the perimeter. [wayfort.hasMaids
                    |Much to the delight of your sexy maids, a goodly number of whom are all but feasting on the sight of glistening, sweaty elf-flesh hard at work.
                ] 
            ]Little plots of flowers are dotted here-and-there in order to add some color to the otherwise gray-on-gray; a much appreciated inclusion.
            
            To the northeast lies the main keep, with the gate and tollbooth to the south.
        ]
        
        [QUEST_BEWITCHED.isCompleted|To your west, Viviane appears to have set her house down at the outskirts of the courtyard.]
rows.translation:
[wayfort.stateABC
            |荒废驿堡的主要区域呈扇形分布，周围散布着一些古代围城战留下的残骸。在西部边界有一处可以修建道路的地方，过去路人或许可以在这里观看士兵们的训练。可惜的是，有一块巨大的巨石正好挡在了这个区域的中央，使得大部分视野都被遮挡住了。
            
            在东北方向似乎有一条通往主城堡的道路，而南边则是大门所在的位置。
            |荒废驿堡的主要场地看起来大多已经空无一人；要想通过简单的修缮来修复这片废墟中的庭院，显然是不可能的，但至少现在它不再看起来像是一处被遗弃的地方。那条用碎石和泥土铺成的道路一直延伸到庭院的西侧边界，在这片开阔地面的正中央，曾经有一块大得不可思议的巨石横卧着，现在那块巨石已经被拆解开来，被加工成可用的拱石，用来修补那些坍塌的墙壁。
            
            东北方向是主城堡，而南边则有大门和收费处。
            |荒废驿堡家的庭院将压实的泥土与铺设瓷砖的区域巧妙地结合在一起，这些瓷砖区域被用来划分出简单的训练场地。 [wayfort.hasDaliza
                |可以看到几名士兵——他们只穿着紧身内衣——正在使用钝器进行训练，或者绕着场地慢跑。 [wayfort.hasMaids
                    |令你们那些性感的侍女们欣喜若狂的是，有相当多的人简直是在陶醉于欣赏那些闪闪发光、满身是汗的精灵们努力工作的场景呢。
                ] 
            ]这里零星分布着一些小花丛，为原本单调灰暗的环境增添了一抹色彩——这一设计确实受到了大家的喜爱。
            
            东北方向是主城堡，而南边则设有大门和收费处。
        ]
        
        [QUEST_BEWITCHED.isCompleted|在你的西侧，薇薇安似乎已经在庭院的边缘建起了自己的小屋。]

rows.original: Sitting close to one of the Wayfort's exterior walls is Viviane's walking house. Currently, however, it has taken root, and as such looks like any other home might. [party.has viviane|Shall you take Viv into her home?|Would you like to check in on Viviane?]
rows.translation: 维薇安的移动房屋就坐落在荒废驿堡家族的外墙附近。不过现在，它已经稳稳地“扎根”在那里了，看起来和其他普通的房屋没什么两样。 [party.has viviane|你愿意让薇芙住进你家吗？|你想去看看薇薇安吗？]

rows.original:
[wayfort.stateABC
            |The debris of the courtyard extends further alongside a road, extending into yet more of the main grounds. It looks like a clearing could perhaps have been left for cages or the shattered remnants of a stockade, but the huge boulder obscures much of this half of the grounds too.
            
            Back south you see the gate, and east of here, there's a hole in the keep's wall that should provide ingress.
            |This portion of the grounds looks to be particularly empty without a giant boulder blocking it. Everything shattered and broken from battles long past has been taken away, leaving a large hole in the dirt.
            
            This might once have been the location for stockades... and perhaps in the future could be once more. Back to the south you can see the gate, and to the east is another entryway into the keep[wayfort.hasFarrah
                | that features a sign for %"Farrah's Euphoric Emporium"
            ].
            |This half of the courtyard is dominated by what could enthusiastically be referred to as a piece of art. Sanded, stained, and treated planks of pine have been tightly laid out to form a platform, on which stands a large stockades-pillory. 
            
            The stocks itself is a beautiful affair of stained and lacquered pine, cushioned internally with silk, and hinged and clasped in polished bronze. Currently it's unoccupied, but you're sure some manner of wanton slut will find their way inside it eventually.
            
            [flags.ALISSA_AT_PILLORY
                |The courtyard looks better than ever with Alissa's beautiful body on display right in the middle of it. Her back has been covered in white, and her face and hair are not too far off. On the ground, an ivory puddle keeps growing with every droplet that leaves any of her ravaged holes.
            ]
            
            Back to the south you can see the gate, and to the east is another entryway into the keep[wayfort.hasFarrah
                | that features a sign for %"Farrah's Euphoric Emporium"
            ].
        ]
rows.translation:
[wayfort.stateABC
            |院子的碎片沿着道路延伸开来，一直蔓延到主场地的更远处。看起来这里原本可能是用来放置笼子或者残破的防御工事的，但那块巨大的岩石也遮挡了这片场地的大部分区域。
            
            往南走就能看到大门，而在这个区域的东侧，城堡的墙壁上有一个洞口，应该可以用来进入里面。
            |这片场地看起来格外空旷，因为没有巨石挡住去路。那些在很久以前的战斗中破碎的物品都被清理走了，只留下了一处巨大的坑洞。
            
            这里曾经可能是栅栏的所在地……也许将来还能再次成为那样的地方。往南走，你可以看到大门；往东走，则是通往城堡的另一处入口。[wayfort.hasFarrah
                | 上面有一个写着“法拉的极乐商店”的标志
            ]。
            |这个庭院的这一半区域，真正可以被称得上是一件艺术品。经过打磨、上色和特殊处理的松木板被紧密地铺设成一个个平台，而在这些平台上，矗立着一个个巨大的栅栏状柱子。 
            
            这个支架本身是由经过染色和上漆的松木制成的，内部衬有丝绸，连接处则使用了经过抛光的青铜材质。目前它还没有被使用，但你可以肯定，最终总会有一些放荡的女子找到办法钻进去的。
            
            [flags.ALISSA_AT_PILLORY
                |有了艾莉莎那美丽的身姿矗立在庭院中央，这个庭院看起来比以往任何时候都要美丽。她的背部被涂成了白色，而她的脸和头发也同样被装饰得恰到好处。地面上，一滩象牙色的液体不断扩大着——每一滴从她身上那些被破坏的地方流出来的液体都在不断汇聚成这一滩液体。
            ]
            
            往南走，你会看到那道大门；而往东走，则是进入这座堡垒的另一个入口。[wayfort.hasFarrah
                | 上面有一个写着“法拉的极乐商店”的标志
            ]。
        ]

rows.original: [wayfort.stateABC |You're standing inside the abandoned wayfort, a centuries-old defense against some long-forgotten foe. It's all naked gray stone and scorch marks here; there's no hint of decoration or furniture left, making it hard to tell what this part of the fort might have been used for. The hall you're in runs south and north from here. |You're standing inside the Wayfort — your Wayfort — a centuries-old defense against some long-forgotten foe. The scorch marks have been scrubbed mostly away, the floor have been swept, and any holes in the roof have been replaced. There are still improvements to be made, such as a wooden floor and some heating, but it appears livable, at least. The hall you're in runs south and north from here. |You're standing inside the Wayfort — your Wayfort — a centuries-old defense against some long-forgotten foe. The walls are clean stone, and dark stained wood is laid out down the middle of the hall as an impromptu walkway. Not only is the hallway well-appointed, some enterprising builder[wayfort.hasMaids | or maid ] has laid out a number of tiny wood-burning stoves to keep the hallway warm. The hall you're in runs south and north from here. ] [wayfort.furnishingDescription]
rows.translation: [wayfort.stateABC |你此刻站在这座废弃的防御工事内，这座建筑是几个世纪前为抵御某些早已被遗忘的敌人而建造的。这里到处都是光秃秃的灰色石墙和烧焦的痕迹，没有任何装饰或家具的痕迹，因此很难判断这座防御工事的这一部分原本是用来做什么的。 你现在所在的这条走廊从这里一直延伸到南北两端。 |你此刻正站在荒废驿堡的内部—— 你的荒废驿堡——这是一处有着数百年历史、用于抵御那些早已被遗忘的敌人的防御设施。那些烧焦的痕迹大多已经被清理干净，地面也已经被清扫得干干净净，屋顶上的任何漏洞也都得到了修补。虽然还有一些地方需要进一步完善，比如铺设木地板和安装供暖设施，但至少目前来看，这里已经是可以居住的地方了。 你现在所处的这条走廊是从这里向南延伸，然后又向北延伸的。 |你此刻正站在荒废驿堡的内部—— 你的荒废驿堡——这是一道抵御那些早已被遗忘的敌人的、历经数个世纪的防御工事。城墙由洁净的石材砌成，而走廊中央则铺设着颜色深沉的木板，形成了临时搭建的通道。这条走廊不仅装饰得十分精致，还有一些富有创意的建造者们[wayfort.hasMaids | 或者女仆 ]这里摆放了一些小型木炉，用来为走廊供暖。 你们现在所在的这条走廊是从这里向南北方向延伸的。 ] [wayfort.furnishingDescription]

[wayfort.stateABC
            |You've managed to find yourself in the grand hall of this wayfort without turning an ankle on the stone. A wide open space that might once have been majestic when it was properly furnished and maintained. Now, though, it's full of broken stone and a ruined long table. The heavy wooden front doors are broken inwards, giving some hint that this place must have suffered a vicious siege once upon a time.
            
            There are doors leading east and west from here, and the hall stretches out well over a hundred feet to the south.
            |You are standing in the grand hall of the Wayfort. Right now it's just a wide open space that hints at the majesty it might once have represented. It looks like someone with charcoal or chalk has laid out measurements for rugs in a number of swept spaces, and a ladder rests against one of the walls for later improvement... for now, at least, it looks like a liveable space and not an ancient site of war and destruction.
            
            There are doors leading east and west from here, and the main doorway leading to the north outside has been repaired. To the south the grand hall stretches out well over a hundred feet, where it leads to the mess hall, and eventually the throne room.
            |You are standing in the grand hall of the Wayfort. It is difficult to fill such a space to proper majesty, but in time your conquests, captures, or gifts might fill the hall with evidence of their passing. 
            
            At the very least, deep blue Winter-City-esque rugs fill the empty space, colorfully-stained windows fill the hall with [dayNight
                |sunlight
                |muted moonlight-colors, accentuated by torchlight
            ]. Baskets of flowers complete the look, [wayfort.hasMaids
                |tended to by passing maids
                |taking away the remaining gloom of the gray stone
            ].
            
            There are doors leading east and west from here, and the main doorway leading to the north outside has been repaired. To the south the grand hall stretches out well over a hundred feet, where it leads to the mess hall, and eventually the throne room.
        ]
        
        [wayfort.furnishingDescription]
rows.translation:
[wayfort.stateABC
            |你总算没有在乱石上崴伤脚，一路走进了这座驿堡的宏伟大厅。这里是一片宽阔空间，若曾得到妥善布置与维护，想必一度庄严壮观。可如今到处都是碎石，只剩一张毁坏的长桌。厚重的木制正门被从外向内撞破，暗示此地曾经遭受过一场惨烈围攻。
            
            大厅两侧各有门通往东西方向，南面则一直延伸出一百多英尺。
            |你正站在驿堡的宏伟大厅中。眼下这里只是一片宽阔空地，仍依稀透露着往昔的庄严。有人用木炭或粉笔在几处清扫干净的地面上标出了铺设地毯的尺寸，一架梯子靠在墙边，留待之后继续整修……至少现在，这里看起来已经适合居住，不再像一处古老的战争废墟。
            
            此处有门通往东西两侧，北边通向室外的正门也已经修复。大厅向南延伸出一百多英尺，先通往餐厅，最终抵达王座厅。
            |你正站在驿堡的宏伟大厅中。要让如此宽广的空间恢复应有的庄严并不容易，但随着时间推移，你的征服所得、战利品与受赠之物或许会逐渐填满大厅，成为过往功绩的见证。
            
            至少，深蓝色的冬城风格地毯已经铺满空旷地面，彩色玻璃窗让大厅沐浴在[dayNight
                |阳光中
                |柔和的月色里，又由火把的光芒加以点缀
            ]。一篮篮鲜花让布置更加完整，[wayfort.hasMaids
                |由来往的女仆悉心照料
                |驱散了灰色石墙残留的阴郁
            ]。
            
            此处有门通往东西两侧，北边通向室外的正门也已经修复。大厅向南延伸出一百多英尺，先通往餐厅，最终抵达王座厅。
        ]

rows.original:
[wayfort.stateABC
            |The north-eastern corner of the keep might have been a treasury, or perhaps an armory. The doors are heavy here, still sturdy and serviceable after decades of neglect. [wayfort.hasDaliza
                |At the very least it looks like a portion of the wall has been used to prop up the gear Daliza's soldiers brought with them, but it's in dire need of a separating wall being installed.
                |There's not even an empty chest or armor rack. Shame.
            ]
            
            Outside the vault, there are doors south and west that lead deeper into the fortress.
            |The north-eastern corner of the keep might have been a treasury, or perhaps an armory. It is now most certainly both. The doors are heavy here, still sturdy and serviceable after decades of neglect. It's still not particularly defensible, and there's nothing else in the room but for a single desk and a chair, but it's yours.
            
            [wayfort.hasDaliza
                |One of Daliza's soldiers looks painfully bored, but [rand
                    |he
                    |she
                ] gives you a salute in greeting, gently putting down their cup of tea.
            ]
            
            [wayfort.hasDungeon
                |Nestled in the corner of the vault, is a roughly-excavated portion of floor and wall, which has been turned into a staircase that leads down to the dungeons.Within, enchanted bars can keep some of the more frustratingly-slippery demons and spellcasters from escaping.
            ]
            
            Outside the vault, there are doors south and west that lead deeper into the fortress.
            |The north-eastern corner of the keep houses your treasury and armory, separated by a solid wall with a secure door. [wayfort.hasMimic
                |Your ever-faithful and sleepy mimic snoozes quietly within her chest, the lid casually opening and closing in time with her breaths. 
            ]In an emergency a small portcullis can be dropped to separate the armory from the northern gate, allowing any soldiers or mercenaries to recover the fort without having their supplies absconded with.
            
            [wayfort.hasDaliza
                |One of Daliza's soldiers looks painfully bored, but [rand
                    |he
                    |she
                ] gives you a salute in greeting, gently putting down their cup of tea.
            ]
            
            [wayfort.hasDungeon
                |A carefully-excavated staircase of trimmed stones leads down to the dungeons, which have been meticulously carved in keeping with the rest of your fully-renovated fortress' walls and floors. Within, enchanted bars can keep some of the more frustratingly-slippery demons and spellcasters from escaping.
            ]
            
            Outside the vault, there are doors south and west that lead deeper into the fortress.
        ]
rows.translation:
[wayfort.stateABC
            |这座堡垒的东北角可能曾经是储藏财宝的地方，或者也可能是一个军械库。这里的门非常厚重，尽管经历了数十年的无人照料，依然坚固耐用。 [wayfort.hasDaliza
                |至少，看起来有一部分墙壁被用来支撑达莉扎的士兵们带来的装备，但确实急需加装一道隔墙。
                |连一个空箱子或盔甲架都没有。真可惜。
            ]
            
            金库的外面，南面和西面都有门，这些门可以通向堡垒的更深处。
            |这座堡垒的东北角原本可能是一个储藏室，或者是一间军械库。如今，它肯定同时兼具这两种功能。这里的门非常厚重，尽管经历了数十年的无人照料，依然坚固可用。不过这个地方防御能力并不强，房间里除了有一张桌子和一把椅子之外，什么也没有——但它现在属于你了。
            
            [wayfort.hasDaliza
                |达莉扎的手下中有一个看起来显得极其无聊，不过[rand
                    |他
                    |她
                ]他们轻轻放下手中的茶杯，向你致以问候的礼节。
            ]
            
            [wayfort.hasDungeon
                |在地下室的角落里，有一段被粗略挖掘出来的地面和墙壁，这些被改造成了通往地牢的楼梯。在楼梯内部，使用了魔法装置来防止那些极其滑溜的恶魔和施法者逃脱。
            ]
            
            金库的外面，南面和西面都有门，这些门可以通向堡垒的更深处。
            |城堡的东北角设有你的金库和军械库，两者之间有一面带保险门的坚固墙壁将它们隔开。 [wayfort.hasMimic
                |你那永远忠诚又爱睡觉的模仿者正安静地躺在她的胸腔里，它的眼皮随着她的呼吸有规律地睁开又闭上。 
            ]在紧急情况下，可以放下一个小型的活板门，将军械库与北门隔开，这样士兵或雇佣兵就可以回收堡垒内的物资，而不会让这些物资被抢走。
            
            [wayfort.hasDaliza
                |达莉莎的手下中有一个看起来显得极其无聊，不过[rand
                    |他
                    |她
                ]他们轻轻放下手中的茶杯，向你致以问候的礼节。
            ]
            
            [wayfort.hasDungeon
                |一段用精心切割的石块砌成的楼梯向下延伸，通向地牢。这些地牢也是经过精心雕刻的，其设计与你那经过全面翻新的堡垒的墙壁和地板风格完全一致。在地牢内部，施了魔法的栅栏能够有效地阻止那些极其滑溜的恶魔和施法者逃脱。
            ]
            
            金库的外面，南面和西面都有门，这些门可以通向堡垒的更深处。
        ]

rows.original: [wayfort.stateABC |There is a great stone dais on the south side of the hall, perhaps where a lord once sat over his men. The great wooden throne has been replaced [wayfort.hasDaliza |by Daliza |with a simple chair by someone ], but the western door out has been smashed to pieces and rendered impassable. There is a small eastern door near here, though, that leads into the kitchen and servants' quarters. [wayfort.hasDaliza |Your boreal elven bailiff is standing guard beside the throne. In her dark, dragon-patterned armor and with a two-handed sword at her side, she cuts quite the imposing figure indeed. Daliza can likely keep the roads safe and taxes flowing just by her intimidating demeanor alone. Royal men-at-arms come and go from her side every few minutes, reporting in off patrol or accepting new orders from their commander. |It's woefully lonesome here by your empty throne, particularly with the disheveled state of your Wayfort. ] |Your throne room actually looks like a throne room now, where you can look over the mess hall and receive messengers. [wayfort.hasDaliza |Thanks to Daliza, the large wooden throne sits properly and imperiously in its place. |Thankfully the makeshift chair that had been left there is at least a decently large wooden affair, even if it lacks some imperiality. ] To the west is a repaired door that cuts through the hallways into [wayfort.hasFarrah |Farrah's emporium |some storage ] and the courtyards beyond. To the east is another small door that leads to the kitchen and servants' quarters. [wayfort.hasDaliza |Your boreal elven bailiff is standing guard beside the throne. In her dark, dragon-patterned armor and with a two-handed sword at her side, she cuts quite the imposing figure indeed. She could likely keep the roads safe and taxes flowing just by her intimidating demeanor alone. Royal men-at-arms come and go from her side every few minutes, pausing only to salute you before reporting in off patrol or accepting new orders from their commander. |It's a rather stoic sight, to be sure. ] |Your throne room is a magnificent affair, looking out over the mess hall and made for receiving messengers or visitors.[wayfort.hasVarena | Varena's already set about painting the walls of your great hall, sketching out exaggerated images of you and your friends standing against the tide of darkness rising from beneath the Demon Queen's wings. [flags.KM_SIEGE_REPORT_LOVE |She's drawn you and Kasyrra scandalously close, mirroring your public declaration of desire for the beautiful crimson witch. |You and Kasyrra are painted in direct opposition across the battlefield, even if the Demon Queen herself was missing from the siege she's depicting. A little artistic liberty doesn't hurt, you suppose. It certainly makes you look heroic. ] ] [wayfort.hasDaliza |The throne Daliza and her entourage brought you has even been upgraded with some blue silk and silver runes. [pc.bg scholar |You're fairly sure they're blessings for health and vitality. ] |The makeshift throne you'd had installed has similarly been upgraded to reflect the finished room, chased in silver and scarved with silk. ] To the west is a door that cuts through the hallways into [wayfort.hasFarrah |Farrah's emporium |some storage ] and the courtyards beyond. To the east is another small door that leads to the kitchen and servants' quarters. [wayfort.hasDaliza |Your boreal elven bailiff is standing guard beside the throne. In her dark, dragon-patterned armor and with a two-handed sword at her side, she cuts quite the imposing figure indeed. She could likely keep the roads safe and taxes flowing just by her intimidating demeanor alone. Royal men-at-arms come and go from her side every few minutes, pausing only to salute you before reporting in off patrol or accepting new orders from their commander. |It's a rather stoic sight, to be sure. ] ] [wayfort.furnishingDescription] [flags.WFF_DISP |[flags.DISP_WEAP |A wooden display occupies a position of prominence above the throne, bearing [a] [wayfort.dispWeapon] as your symbol of authority here. |A wooden display occupies a position of prominence above the throne, although it's empty at the moment. ] ]
rows.translation: [wayfort.stateABC |大厅的南侧有一座巨大的石制高台，或许曾经有一位领主在这里坐镇，统辖他的子民。那座巨大的木制王座早已被替换掉了。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |由达莉莎创作 |有人拿了一把普通的椅子放在那里。 ]但是通往西边的门已经被砸得粉碎，无法通行了。不过，这里附近有一扇小门，可以通往厨房和仆人的住处。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |你的北方精灵侍卫正站在王座旁站岗。她身着带有龙纹的黑色铠甲，手中握着一把双刃剑，整个人看起来确实非常威严。单凭她那令人胆寒的气势，达尔iza就足以维持道路的安全与税收的征收。每隔几分钟，就有皇家卫兵来到她身边，或是汇报巡逻情况，或是接受指挥官的新命令。 |在你那空荡荡的王座旁，这里显得格外寂寞，尤其是考虑到你的荒废驿堡现在所处的这种混乱状态。 ] |你的王座厅其实看起来现在这里就像一座王座厅，你可以从这里俯瞰整个餐厅，同时也能接收来信。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |多亏了达莉扎，那座巨大的木制王座才能够稳稳当当地、威严地摆放在它该在的位置上。 |幸好，被留在那里的那把临时制作的椅子至少是一把体积相当大的木椅，虽然它确实缺乏一些“皇室风格”的气息。 ] 在西侧，有一扇经过修复的门，它通向走廊的那一端。 [wayfort.hasFarrah |法拉的商品店 |一些存储空间 ]还有那片后面的庭院。东边还有另一扇小门，通向厨房和仆人的住处。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |你的北方精灵侍卫正站在王座旁站岗。她身着那身带有龙纹的黑色铠甲，手中握着一把双刃剑，整个人看起来确实非常威武。单凭她那令人胆寒的气势，就足以维持道路的安全与税收的征收了。每隔几分钟，就会有皇家卫兵来到她身边，他们只会停下来向你敬礼，然后报告巡逻情况或接受指挥官的新命令。 |的确，这一景象显得相当冷峻、肃穆。 ] |你的王座厅极为宏伟，可以俯瞰整个餐厅区域，非常适合接待信使或访客。[wayfort.hasVarena | 瓦蕾娜已经开始在你的宏伟大厅的墙壁上作画了，她正在描绘出这样一幅夸张的画面：你和你的朋友们站在那里，共同抵抗着从恶魔女王的翅膀下涌出的黑暗势力。 [flags.KM_SIEGE_REPORT_LOVE |她将你和卡西拉拉得如此之近，简直令人震惊——这与你公开表达对这位美丽的深红色女巫的倾慕之情如出一辙。 |在战场上，你和卡西拉被描绘成完全对立的角色，尽管她所描绘的这场围攻战中，恶魔女王本人其实并不存在。我想，稍微发挥一点艺术创意也没关系吧？这样至少能让你们看起来更加英勇。 ] ] [wayfort.hasDaliza |达莉扎和她的随从为您准备的王座，甚至还添加了一些蓝色丝绸和银色符文作为装饰。 [pc.bg scholar |你相当确信，它们是带来健康与活力的恩赐。 ] |你之前安装的临时王座也经过了升级，现在它的装饰与整个房间风格相匹配，座椅框架为银色材质，边缘则镶嵌着丝绸。 ] 在西侧，有一扇门，它直接通向那些走廊。 [wayfort.hasFarrah |法拉的商品店 |一些存储空间 ]还有那几片庭院。东边还有另一扇小门，通向厨房和仆人的住处。 [wayfort.hasDaliza |你的北方精灵侍卫正站在王座旁站岗值守。她身着那身印有龙纹的深色铠甲，手中握着一把双刃剑，整个人显得威风凛凛。单凭她那令人胆寒的气势，就足以维护道路的安全，确保税收的征收。每隔几分钟，就会有皇家卫兵来到她身边，他们只是短暂地向你敬礼，然后便去执行巡逻任务或接受指挥官的新命令。 |的确，这一景象显得相当冷峻、肃穆。 ] ] [wayfort.furnishingDescription] [flags.WFF_DISP |[flags.DISP_WEAP |一个木制展品被放置在王座上方显眼的位置，上面陈列着[wayfort.dispWeapon]，象征着你在这里的权威。 |一个木制展品被放置在王座上方显眼的位置，不过目前它还是空着的。 ] ]

rows.original: [wayfort.stateABC |This part of the courtyard is dominated by the remnants of a statue, worn smooth over time and missing one of its arms. It depicts a lupine man holding a bearded axe aloft in triumph, clad in an armor that looks to be made of metal plates. A brooch hanging around his neck is set with a dark blue gemstone. [flags.WAY_GARDEN |It glows with inner light, evidence of its passage as a Waystone. ] Beyond it, twenty paces further west, is the crumbling remains of a stone watchtower. The upper floors still seem to be somewhat intact... but climbing up there is sure to be a hazard. |This part of the courtyard is dominated by the remnants of a statue, worn smooth over time and missing one of its arms. It depicts a lupine man holding a bearded axe aloft in triumph, clad in an armor that looks to be made of metal plates. A brooch hanging around his neck is set with a dark blue gemstone. There's been some scrubbing of the mossy stone, but almost the whole statue will likely need replacing one day... [flags.WAY_GARDEN |The brooch itself glows with inner light, evidence of its passage as a Waystone. ] Beyond it, twenty paces further west, is the stone watchtower. |What had once been a time-worn, one-armed, headless lupine man with a bearded axe, is now a statue depicting [wayfort.statueDrEDL |a proud dragon. A brooch hangs around its neck set with a dark blue gemstone; the only original remainder from the previous one, and the only piece required to enter the Ways Between. |an incredibly curvaceous elf reminiscent of Ryn, if she had perhaps indulged in a little extra chest-and-butt alchemy. She holds in her hand the brooch with a dark blue gemstone; the only piece actually required to enter the Ways Between. [party.comp ryn |Ryn stands at your side; as usual, she's blushing at the sight of it. "[etheryn.lnhConfidence |I — n-no, it can't be... sh-she looks like a real queen, n-not like me..." [pc.dcb |Yeah, maybe so, but Ryn can at least have the same curves, right? |There, there. [etheryn.crowned |She'll grow into it. |Maybe someday. ] |Aw, poor widdle thing! Don't worry; she[etheryn.crowned |'s definitely |'ll be ] a real queen! ] |That's — n-no way, [pc.name]! It can't be me!" Oh, you don't know; she really does seem to bear a pretty significant resemblance... |Gods, you're such a tease, [pc.name]! That's definitely not me!" It so is. ] ] |a figure unmistakable as Kasyrra, if dressed in a chaste evening gown to hide her more erotic assets. In one outstretched hand the statue holds the brooch to the Ways Between, dark blue gemstone gleaming. |a lupine hero holding aloft his restored weapon, a circular shield resting beneath his other hand. The chiseled face brings to mind a younger Garth, perhaps in his final years of adventuring. A brooch bearing a blue gemstone hangs from the statue’s neck, where it has always belonged. ] Beyond the statue, twenty paces further west, is the stone watchtower. ]
rows.translation: [wayfort.stateABC |庭院的这一部分，最显眼的是一座雕像的残余部分——经过长时间的侵蚀，这些残余部分已经变得光滑无比，而且其中一只手臂已经不见了。这座雕像描绘的是一个手持长斧、胜利在望的男子，他身穿似乎由金属板制成的盔甲，脖子上还戴着一枚镶嵌着深蓝色宝石的胸针。 [flags.WAY_GARDEN |它散发着内在的光芒，这正是它曾经作为道路标记存在过的证明。 ] 在它的西边二十步远的地方，有一座摇摇欲坠的石制瞭望塔残骸。上面的几层似乎还保存得相对完好……但想要爬上去肯定充满危险。 |庭院的这一区域，最显眼的是那座残缺的雕像。经过长时间的侵蚀，雕像的表面已经变得光滑，而且其中一条手臂也已经不见了。这座雕像描绘的是一个手持长斧、胜利在望的男子，他身穿似乎由金属板制成的盔甲，脖子上还戴着一枚镶嵌着深蓝色宝石的胸针。人们虽然清理过那些长满苔藓的石头，但几乎整个雕像都可能需要在未来某一天被重新制作…… [flags.WAY_GARDEN |这款胸针本身会散发内在的光芒，这正是它曾经作为道路指引符使用过的证据。 ] 在它的西边二十步远的地方，有一座石制瞭望塔。 |那个曾经是一个饱经风霜、只有一只手臂、没有头、手持斧头的狼族形象，如今已经变成了一座雕塑。 [wayfort.statueDrEDL |一条骄傲的龙。它的脖子上挂着一枚胸针，上面镶嵌着一颗深蓝色的宝石——这是前一代龙留下的唯一遗物，也是进入“道路之间”所必需的唯一物品。 |这位身材曲线极为优美的精灵，让人不禁联想到小琳——只不过如果她再稍微丰满一些的话，那就更加完美了。她手中握着那枚镶着深蓝色宝石的胸针，而这正是进入“幽径”所必需的唯一物品。 [party.comp ryn |小琳站在你身边；像往常一样，看到这一幕，她的脸又红了。[etheryn.lnhConfidence |不，不可能……她看起来简直像一位真正的王后，而我……完全不是那样 [pc.dcb |嗯，也许吧，但至少小琳的曲线应该是一样的，对吧？ |好了，好了。 [etheryn.crowned |她长大后自然会适应的。 |也许有一天吧。 ] |哎，可怜的小东西！别担心，她[etheryn.crowned |肯定是的 |会 ]真正的女王！ ] |那不可能……绝对不可能。 [pc.name]不可能是我！” 哦，你不知道的……她确实和那个人长得非常像…… |天啊，你真会逗人玩啊。 [pc.name]那绝对不是我！所以是。 ] ] |那个身影分明就是卡希拉——只不过她穿着一件端庄的晚礼服，以此掩盖自己那些更具诱惑力的身姿。在伸出的手中，她握着那枚象征“道路之间”的胸针，那颗深蓝色的宝石在灯光下闪闪发光。 |一位狼族英雄高高举着他修复后的武器，另一只手下则托着一块圆形盾牌。他那轮廓分明的面容让人联想到年轻时的加斯，或许是他冒险生涯的最后几年。雕像的脖子上挂着一枚镶嵌着蓝色宝石的胸针，它本来就应该在那里。 ] 在雕像的西侧，再向前走二十步，就能看到那座石制瞭望塔。 ]

rows.original: [wayfort.stateABC |The upper floor of the old watchtower is crumbling — while it doesn't look prone to utter collapse, thank the gods, some of the masonry looks unstable and the mortar is definitely past its prime. One shouldn't wander out to the middle of the chambers — there are several large holes in the floor where it's given way, presumably sending whatever furniture once might have existed here crashing onto the tower's ground level. The entire place smells of must and mold, but at least it's intact, even if one needs to be generous with the word. |The watchtower's upper floors have been renovated and reinforced: mold cleared, fresh mortar reapplied, rotting wood torn out and replaced along with the crumbling masonry. With the floor now much sturdier now that it's been completely replaced, at least it won't send you crashing down the ground below. With the windows open now that the slats have been replaced and the vines cleared, a cool breeze constantly drifts through the upper floors, and you can see quite a distance down the River Ridell both ways. A fine vantage point, as it were. [wayfort.hasAileh |The red dragon-general Aileh currently occupies the upper-floor, living on a simple two-person bedroll with her belongings propped up against the wall. She glances over at you, [rand |brushing her hair |polishing her axe |scrubbing her tail-scales |mid-push up |hurriedly tugging her underwear on and licking glistening fingers clean ]. "Something you wanted to bug me about?" ] |The watchtower's upper floors look as good as new — mostly because they are. All of the rotting wood and crumbling stone have long since been torn out, replaced with fresh support beams and well-mortared masonry. While the renovations were underway, the builders also took the opportunity to put in additional supports to the ground floor, allowing the watchtower's upper levels to bear more weight; you could station a minotaur arbalest here, if the Minoans would loan you one. As things stand, though, the space could even be called luxurious, with all the small touches and finishes; with this kind of vantage point, one can see quite the distance both up and down the River Ridell. [wayfort.hasAileh |[aileh.isMom |[freja.isInfant |Once inside, you can see that the roof has been rebuilt too, with a large opening hatch that can be used for certain winged dragon-women to enter and exit without even touching down. Aileh's bedroom itself has the usual enchanted bathtub, richly-appointed wardrobe, and incredibly impact-resistant double bed. Along with this, is the cradle belonging to [freja.name], your precious little dragon-daughter. The wooden frame has a beautiful inscription of incredibly complicated copper runes on it, and a gentle nudge allows it to rock softly from side-to-side. Aileh smiles at you, [rand |looking up from the sleeping scaly potato |gently bouncing [freja.name] on her hip |softly brushing [freja.name]'s tufty mop of hair |sat on the bed and cradling [freja.name] in her arms as she breastfeeds ]. "Welcome back, dear heart." |Once inside, you can see that the roof has been rebuilt too, with a large opening hatch that can be used for certain winged dragon-women to enter and exit without even touching down. Aileh's bedroom itself has the usual enchanted bathtub, richly-appointed wardrobe, and incredibly impact-resistant double bed. Your daughter's cradle has been dismantled, and a beautiful hanging annex with a ladder to the floor has been built into the roof. She's even got some pretty flowerpots to look after. For privacy, a heavy curtain can be pulled along, and a copper rune plate has been stamped into the lip of the annex that can be activated to block out the sounds of the outside world. [rand |Aileh and [freja.name] are both sat at a little table, having what appears to be a tea party. Your daughter notices you first, smiling brightly and putting down her teacup with surprising softness before becoming a lightning bolt that charges into your legs. "Ah! [pc.mf |Daddy! |Mommy! ]" Aileh grins and stretches, giving you a view of her curvaceous body in the process. "Welcome back, dear heart." |[freja.name] is napping in her annex, curtain open and tail flopped out over the edge. A stuffed warg doll is hugged tightly to her chest, and one of her legs occasionally twitches. Aileh smiles and looks up from where she's sat, brushing her fiery locks after a bath. "She just conked out after playing in the field." |Aileh and [freja.name] are both exercising; or at least, Aileh is doing pushups, while the dragonling's sat on her shoulders. Unbeknownst to your daughter, each time she lowers to the ground, there's a cheeky squirt of milk from your girlfriend's heaving tits. "Be right... there," Aileh gasps. "Couple more!" "Hi [pc.mf |Daddy |Mommy ]! I luff yoouuu!" [freja.name] squeals happily, wingies flapping. She half leaps, half-flaps her way up into your arms and squeezes your head in a hard hug. Eventually Aileh pulls herself up, smiling with satisfaction. "Always glad to see you in the doorframe, dear heart." |[freja.name], your little dragon-daughter, looks down at you from a blackboard that's resting on her lap, chalk-smudges all over her cheeks and claws. Her feet kick over the edge of the annex, swaying in in time with a tune she'd been softly humming. It looks like [freja.name] has been trying to draw [wayfort.hasDaliza |Daliza, judging by the pale blue skin and red hair. |a flapping bird ], and it's not a bad job! "Hiiii [pc.mf |Daddy |Mommy ]!" She smiles brightly. Aileh looks up from polishing her axe and winks at you. "Quietest she's been all day. Welcome back, dear heart." ] ] |Once inside, you can see that the roof has been rebuilt too, with a large opening hatch that can be used for certain winged dragon-women to enter and exit without even touching down. [aileh.friendLover |Since bringing in a craftsman specifically to cater to Aileh's rich tastes, there has been an enchanted bathtub, a richly-appointed wardrobe, and an incredibly impact-resistant double bed installed. |Since bringing in a craftsman specifically to cater to Aileh's rich tastes, there has been an enchanted bathtub, a richly-appointed wardrobe, and an incredibly impact-resistant double bed installed. |Aileh, the red dragon-general currently occupies the upper-floor, living on a simple two-person bedroll with her belongings propped up against the wall. ] She glances over at you, [rand |brushing her hair |polishing her axe |scrubbing her tail-scales |mid-push up |hurriedly tugging her underwear on and licking glistening fingers clean ]. "Something you [aileh.friendLover |needed, [pc.name] |had on your mind, dear heart |wanted to bug me about ]?" ] ] ]
rows.translation: [wayfort.stateABC |那座古老的瞭望塔的上层正在逐渐坍塌——虽然谢天谢地，它看起来还不至于彻底倒塌，但有些砖石结构确实已经不稳固了，砂浆也早已失去了原有的黏性。人们绝对不应该走到那些房间中间去，因为地板上有多处大的洞洞，那些地方的地板已经塌陷了，可以想象，原本放在那里的家具肯定都已经掉到了塔的底部。 整个地方都弥漫着霉味和臭味，但至少它的结构还算完好，尽管用“完好”这个词来形容可能有点夸张。 |瞭望塔的上层已经进行了翻新和加固：清理了霉菌，重新涂抹了砂浆，将腐烂的木头拆掉并更换掉，同时也修复了那些破损的砖石结构。现在这些楼层已经得到了彻底的修复，变得更加坚固了，至少不会再让你从上面掉到下面的地面上去了。 现在窗扇已经更换完毕，藤蔓也被清理干净，窗户大开着，一阵阵凉爽的微风不断从上层楼层吹进来，你可以清楚地看到里德尔河两岸相当远的地方。可以说，这是一个非常不错的观景位置。 [wayfort.hasAileh |红龙将军艾蕾目前住在楼上，她用一张简单的两人用床铺休息，将自己的物品靠在墙上摆放。她瞥了你一眼[rand |梳头发 |磨炼自己的技能 |拼命摇动着自己的尾鳍 |中距离俯卧撑 rows.raw: " [wayfort.stateABC |The upper floor of the old watchtower is crumbling — while it doesn't look prone to utter collapse, thank the gods, some of the masonry looks unstable and the mortar is definitely past its prime. One shouldn't wander out to the middle of the chambers — there are several large holes in the floor where it's given way, presumably sending whatever furniture once might have existed here crashing onto the tower's ground level. The entire place smells of must and mold, but at least it's intact, even if one needs to be generous with the word. |The watchtower's upper floors have been renovated and reinforced: mold cleared, fresh mortar reapplied, rotting wood torn out and replaced along with the crumbling masonry. With the floor now much sturdier now that it's been completely replaced, at least it won't send you crashing down the ground below. With the windows open now that the slats have been replaced and the vines cleared, a cool breeze constantly drifts through the upper floors, and you can see quite a distance down the River Ridell both ways. A fine vantage point, as it were. [wayfort.hasAileh |The red dragon-general Aileh currently occupies the upper-floor, living on a simple two-person bedroll with her belongings propped up against the wall. As things stand, though, the space could even be called luxurious, with all the small touches and finishes; with this kind of vantage point, one can see quite the distance both up and down the River Ridell. rows.original: [wayfort.stateABC |You stand at the foot of an ancient watchtower. Once part of the riverside fort, it stands apart now, and somewhat isolated. At the bottom of the watchtower is what should be an isolated room, and there are scattered remnants of what looks like a summoning circle.[flags.TOWER_CIRCLE | It's now activated, and should allow you to bring forth spirits you've previously attuned to. ] The walls and crenellations have seen better days, but the upper floors still seem to be intact. There's no sign of monstrous occupation, at least. It doesn't look like you have any way to ascend it, unfortunately. |You stand at the foot of an ancient watchtower. The entryway has been cleared and a curtain has been nailed over it, and a simple stone stairway rises to a cleared-out upper floor. The bottom of the tower has its own room; it's a rudimentary, dusty heap, but there's a summoning circle in place that [flags.TOWER_CIRCLE |should still work just fine for bringing forth creatures and spirits you've attuned to |could work with the right tools ]. |You stand at the foot of an ancient watchtower. Every broken stone has been replaced and washed, the vines have been taken away and the crumbling mortar replaced— there's even an incredibly sturdy door in place. Once locked, this tower alone could probably hold out against a serious threat. The bottom of the tower has its own room, the summoning circle within repaired to pristine condition and all but buzzing with an eagerness to be used. ]
rows.translation: [wayfort.stateABC |你站在一座古老瞭望塔的脚下。这座塔曾经是河畔堡垒的一部分，如今却孤零零地矗立在那里，显得有些与世隔绝。在瞭望塔的底部，有应该那是一个与世隔绝的房间，里面散落着一些看起来像是召唤阵的遗迹。[flags.TOWER_CIRCLE | 它现在已经激活了，应该能够让你召唤出之前已经与之建立联系的灵魂。 ]墙壁和雉堞已经失去了往日的辉煌，但上层建筑似乎仍然完好无损。至少，没有任何迹象表明这里被怪物占领过。 遗憾的是，看起来你没有任何办法能够登上那里。 |你站在一座古老瞭望塔的脚下。入口处已经被清理干净，上面还钉着一块布帘；一条简单的石阶通向塔内清理出来的上层空间。 塔的下装有一个小房间——虽然那里环境简陋且布满灰尘，但那里已经设置好了一个召唤阵。 [flags.TOWER_CIRCLE |它仍然可以很好地用来召唤那些你已经与之建立起共鸣的生物与精灵 |有了合适的工具，就能顺利完成工作了 ]。 |你站在一座古老瞭望塔的脚下。每一块碎石都已被重新修补并清洗干净，攀爬的藤蔓也被清除，腐朽的灰浆也被替换掉——甚至还安装了一扇极其坚固的门。一旦锁上，仅这座塔本身或许就能抵御任何严重的威胁。 塔的下装有一间独立的房间，其中的召唤阵也已经被修复得完好无损，几乎迫不及待地等待被使用起来了。 ]

rows.original:
[wayfort.stateABC
            |Much like the southernmost gate entrance, the stone arches here are in a crippling state of disrepair, unlike the southernmost gate however, there is a destroyed stable, and a well that has collapsed perilously in on itself... both will no doubt need to be cleared if you want to draw water without getting terribly ill.
            
            The packed-dirt road passing around the courtyard meets here, although there's no sign of groups traveling through that you can see.
            |The stone arches have had a harder time of repair here, particularly with half a broken portcullis stuck inside of the gate. The worst of the damage has been thankfully covered up, at least, and the road continues safely through where it leads northward.
            
            There's a[wayfort.hasDaliza
                | stables inhabited by a couple of elven mounts
                |n uninhabited stables that's been cleared out, ready to be occupied at a moment's notice by travelers in need
            ]. There is a freshly-repaired well full of crisp, clean water, although it still needs a decent bucket-pulley to be put in place.
            |The entire northern gate had to be pulled down in order to remove the broken portcullis trapped within, but the end result is a brand new arch of solid stone, and a powerful wheel-pulley capable of protecting the Wayfort from any surprise northern aggression.
            
            There's a[wayfort.hasDaliza
                | stables inhabited by a couple of elven mounts
                |n uninhabited stables that's been cleared out, ready to be occupied at a moment's notice by travelers in need
            ]. 
            
            Right beside the stables is a hooded and protected well, capable of providing the entire Wayfort with clean, crisp water.
        ]
rows.translation:
[wayfort.stateABC
            |和最南端的城门入口一样，这里的石拱也已严重失修。不过与南门不同，这里还有一座被毁的马厩和一口危险地向内坍塌的水井……如果你还想打水而不至于染上重病，这两处无疑都得清理。
            
            环绕庭院的夯土路在此交会，不过你看不见有任何队伍从这里经过。
            |这里的石拱修复起来更加困难，尤其是半截损坏的吊闸还卡在城门里。幸好至少最严重的破损已经处理完毕，道路如今可以安全穿过城门，继续向北延伸。
            
            这里有一座[wayfort.hasDaliza
                |住着几匹精灵坐骑的马厩
                |已经清理干净的空马厩，随时可以供有需要的旅人使用
            ]。一口刚修好的水井中盛着清冽干净的井水，不过还需要安装一套像样的提桶滑轮。
            |为了取出卡在门内的损坏吊闸，整座北门都不得不拆除；最终建成的则是一道崭新而坚固的石拱，以及一套强力绞盘吊闸，足以保护驿堡免遭北方的突然袭击。
            
            这里有一座[wayfort.hasDaliza
                |住着几匹精灵坐骑的马厩
                |已经清理干净的空马厩，随时可以供有需要的旅人使用
            ]。
            
            马厩旁边是一口带顶盖、保护严密的水井，足以为整座驿堡供应清冽干净的水。
        ]

[wayfort.stateABC
            |The north gate of the Wayfort leads out into another forest, much like that you passed through to get here... but you've noticed the temperature changing as you near the gate. It feels much colder here than back across the river, and it's only getting colder.
            
            It looks like someone hauled the largest chunks of gate-rubble off of the packed dirt road as they passed through, but there's no sign of passage here now.

rows.translation:
[wayfort.stateABC
            |荒废驿堡的北门通向另一片森林，这片森林与你之前穿过到达这里的那片森林非常相似……但你会注意到，当你靠近那座大门时，气温会发生变化。这里的天气比河对岸要冷得多，而且这种寒冷还在持续加剧。
            
            看起来，在人们穿过这里时，有人把那些最大的门残骸从那条被压实的土路上清理掉了，但现在这里已经没有任何通行痕迹了。
            |荒废驿堡的北门通向一片更加寒冷、更为古老的森林。一旦走出城门，气温便会立刻发生变化，你甚至可以想象，任何落下的雨水都会在这条由泥土和石块铺成的道路上凝结成霜冻。
            |荒废驿堡的北门通向一片更加寒冷、更为古老的森林。一旦走出大门，气温便会明显下降，但石铺的道路表面似乎被仔细地清理过，以防止结冰从而避免滑倒的风险。
        ]

            |The north gate of the Wayfort leads out into another forest, much like that you passed through to get here... but you've noticed the temperature changing as you near the gate. It feels much colder here than back across the river, and it's only getting colder.
            
            It looks like someone hauled the largest chunks of gate-rubble off of the packed dirt road as they passed through, but there's no sign of passage here now.
            |The north gate of the Wayfort leads out into the far colder, older forest reaches. There's a distinct shift in temperature once you're out on the road, and you suspect any rain would turn to rimefrost on the packed dirt and stone-edged road.
            |The north gate of the Wayfort leads out into the far colder, older forest reaches. There's a distinct shift in temperature once you're out on the road, but the stone pavement appears to have been carefully gritted to prevent any ice from forming and proving a slipping risk.

rows.original:
You're just north of the old Wayfort now, all but standing in the shadows of the north gate, and even from this short a distance, you can feel a distinctive chill settling over you — every step northwards brings a more oppressive cold. This is unnatural...

        The remnants of the old dirt road crunches underfoot. [wayfort.renovated
            |There aren't any stones on the road out here, but your hirelings have taken care to pack in the ground and clear away the underbrush. Things are looking up already.
            |Stones are few and far between, becoming scarcer the further north you look. How long has it been since someone maintained any of this?
        ]
rows.translation:
你现在位于老荒废驿堡以北，几乎站在北门的阴影之中，即便距离如此之近，你也能感受到一种独特的寒意逐渐笼罩全身——每向北走一步，这种寒冷就会变得更加压抑。这种感觉实在很不自然……

        脚下的老土路发出嘎吱嘎吱的声响。 [wayfort.renovated
            |这条路上并没有任何石头，不过你的雇员们已经把地面的杂物清理干净，还除掉了灌木丛。情况正在逐渐好转呢。
            |石头十分稀少，越往北走，它们就越难得。究竟已经有多久没有人来维护这些地方了？
        ]

rows.original: The other side of the King's Gate is far less imposing than the exterior — while the black stone that gives it is nickname of the Black Gate is as imposing as ever, there aren't any statues proclaiming the great deeds of minotaur kings past, presumably because people leaving the mountain don't need to be intimidated into keeping their heads down. In place of the statues are large braziers on plinths, fueled by clear oil and burning with a steady smokeless flame. Providing light for travelers on the road aside, the fires serve another purpose as evidenced by the constant inwards draft from the gates; this close to the entrance, hot air rising from natural chimneys in the rock draws in fresh air from outside, granting this small outpost adequate ventilation. Cut into the south side of the cavern wall is a small guardpost, able to hold far more Chargers but now only occupied by the skeleton crew of the gate guard when they get bored of camping under the open air. Peering in through the windows, the barracks and armory are kept spick and span with a military exactness to be expected of the Marches' greatest soldiers, but their sheer emptiness can't be understated. With the entirety of the minotaur king's domain under quarantine and travel forbidden, this can be the only result...
rows.translation: 国王之门的另一侧远没有外部那么壮观——虽然赋予它“黑门”这一别名的黑色石材依然显得十分庄严，但那里并没有任何雕像来纪念那些昔日的弥诺陶洛斯国王们的伟大事迹，大概是因为人们离开这座山并不需要因为外来的威胁而低头屈服。取代那些雕像的，是那些安置在基座上的大型火盆，它们使用清澈的油作为燃料，燃烧时会产生稳定的无烟火焰。除了为路上的旅人提供光源之外，这些火堆还有另一个作用——从大门处不断向内流动的空气就证明了这一点。由于这些火盆位于靠近入口的地方，岩层中天然的通风通道使得热空气上升，从而将外部的新鲜空气引入其中，使得这个小小的前哨站能够保持良好的通风条件。 洞穴南侧的墙壁上开有一个小岗亭，原本可以容纳更多的守卫，但现在只有少数守卫会在露天露营感到无聊时才会来到这里驻守。透过窗户望去，营房和军械库都保持着整洁有序的状态，这完全符合边境地区最精锐士兵应有的严谨作风，但那里的空荡荡景象确实十分明显。由于弥诺陶洛斯国王的整个领地都被置于隔离状态，旅行也被禁止，因此，这可能是唯一的结果……

rows.original:
Moving away from the gate, the braziers eventually cease to exist, as does any remnants of light from outside. The walls of the tunnel-road grow rough-hewn, but the ground underfoot is as smooth and solid as ever. Though worn by time and the passage of innumerable feet over their surface, the cobblestones are as firm as ever; you could march an army or drive chariots down this grand tunnel without issue.

        [party.comp brint brienne
            |"Grandest engineering in the world, designed by our womenfolk," Brint proudly proclaims, stomping a foot on the road to emphasize his point. "After the floor's been dug up, it's a layer of mortar of sand and lime, then stone, then gravel, sand and finally the flagstones. Repairs made every year without fail, regardless of whether it looks fine or not. It's the only way to be sure."
            |"Grandest engineering in the world, designed by our womenfolk," Brienne proudly proclaims, stomping a foot on the road to emphasize her point. "After the floor's been dug up, it's a layer of mortar of sand and lime, then stone, then gravel, sand and finally the flagstones. Repairs made every year without fail, regardless of whether it looks fine or not. It's the only way to be sure."
        ]
        
        Light is not an issue, either — stone sconces hold fist-sized crystals that burn with an inner radiance, shedding light the color of molten rock. The equivalent of street lamps, then; so long as you stay close to the main thoroughfares, you won't have any problem having light to see by.
rows.translation:
远离大门之后，那些火盆逐渐消失了，外界的光线也完全消失了。隧道道路的墙壁变得粗糙不堪，但脚下的地面却依然如往常一样平坦而坚实。尽管这些鹅卵石在时间的侵蚀以及无数人脚步的踩踏下已经变得有些磨损，但它们依然非常结实——你可以让一支军队或战车从这条宏伟的隧道中通过，而不会有任何问题。

        [party.comp brint brienne
            |这是世界上最伟大的工程，是由我们的女性们设计的，”布林特自豪地宣称，同时用脚踩在路面上以强调自己的观点。“在挖出路面后，会先铺设一层由沙子和石灰混合而成的砂浆，然后是石块，接着是碎石和沙子，最后才是铺路石。无论路面看起来是否完好，每年都会进行维修，因为只有这样才能确保它的长期耐用性。
            |这是世界上最伟大的工程，是由我们的女性们设计的，”布蕾妮自豪地宣称，同时用脚踩在路面上以强调自己的观点。“在挖出路面后，会先铺上一层由沙子和石灰混合而成的砂浆，然后是石块，接着是碎石和沙子，最后才是铺路石。无论路面看起来是否完好，每年都会进行维修，因为只有这样才能确保它的长期耐用性。
        ]
        
        光线也不是问题——那些石制壁灯里装着拳头大小的晶体，这些晶体会发出内部光芒，散发出熔岩般的色彩。也就是说，它们的作用就相当于街道上的路灯；只要你待在主要道路附近，就不会有任何看不清路的问题。

rows.original:
A small settlement used to be here — no more than a half-dozen hovels and shacks cobbled together from thatch, planks and other materials brought in from outside the mountain. Used, in the sense that the doors are barred and the windows shuttered, with their interiors completely devoid of anything at all. Signs in crude Belharan declare the availability of porter and guide services as well as travelers' supplies for those venturing to the grand city of Khor'minos, but the abandoned state of these crude entreprises only serves to highlight how absolutely miserable they are. Without the traffic coming and going from the gates to provide them with their livelihoods, there's no reason for these people to be here anymore — if they weren't forcibly evacuated to Khor'minos proper to begin with. 

        There used to be a large passage to the north beneath a grand archway, but a cave-in has rendered the road impassable, leaving only paths to the east and west. While it looks like it could be cleared out by a team of determined workmen over a week or so, evidently no one's bothered to try...
rows.translation:
这里曾经有一个小定居点——不过是由茅草、木板以及其他从山外运来的材料搭建起来的六间简陋的小屋而已。那些房屋已经被人使用过了，门上装着门闩，窗户也关上了，屋内什么也没有。在贝尔哈兰，一些简陋的告示牌上写着，为那些前往宏伟的科尔米诺斯城的旅行者提供搬运和导游服务，以及各种旅行用品。然而，这些简陋服务设施的破败状况，反而凸显出它们是多么的不完善、多么糟糕。如果没有那些往来于城门的车辆为他们提供生计，这些人就没有理由继续留在这里了——除非他们一开始就被强制迁移到了科尔米诺斯城本身。 

        过去，在那座宏伟的拱门下方，有一条通往北方的长通道，但由于山体坍塌，这条道路已经无法通行了，现在只剩下通往东方和西方的小路。虽然看起来只要有一支意志坚定的施工队伍花上大约一周的时间，就应该能够清理出这条通道，但显然没有人愿意去尝试这么做……

rows.original:
The quiet of the tunnel-road presses in heavily on you, making you keenly aware of the crowds that should be coming and going from the great minotaur city but are now distinctly absent. With how high the roof is, it feels like you're walking into the maw of some massive beast... which may not be too far off the mark.

        Still, you're not the only one up and about under the mountain. Soft whispers, the occasional thump, the echoes of something creaking — all of these linger on the edge of your hearing, barely perceptible but leaving no doubt that there are those who call this place home, too. With the minotaur king's quarantine in effect, who knows how they'll react to your presence.
rows.translation:
隧道里一片死寂，这种寂静让人感到无比压抑，同时也让人清楚地意识到：那些本应该在这座巨大的弥诺陶洛斯城市里来来去去的行人，此刻却全都不见了踪影。由于隧道顶部的高度极高，走在这里，你会有一种自己正在走进某种巨兽的口中般的感觉。这个猜测或许并不太离谱。

        不过，山底下并不是只有你一个人在活动。轻柔的低语声、偶尔传来的重击声、以及某些东西发出嘎吱声的回响——所有这些声音都萦绕在你的耳边，虽然几乎听不见，但却清楚地表明，也有人在把这里当作自己的家。由于弥诺陶洛斯国王实施了隔离措施，谁也不知道他们会如何对待你的出现。

rows.original: A short offshoot from the main tunnel-road takes you into a large, domed chamber perhaps a hundred yards across on a side. Several %"buildings" have been chiseled out of the walls, including what's unmistakably a stable and a warehouse, both now empty — their doors have been left hanging open, as if to advertise their abandonment for the world to see. In the center of the chamber is a statue of a beautiful cowgirl maiden, clad in loose black robes that are nearly falling off her curvy figure. She carries a two-bladed axe under one arm, and a lantern is held aloft in the other. Within the lantern is a [flags.WAY_UNDER |radiant blue gemstone, glowing brightly enough to illuminate the whole chamber. You could swear the statue's smiling now, when it wasn't before... |hanging blue gemstone. While it lies inert for now, you can feel the draw of power bleeding off of it, as if begging to be reawoken. ] [flags.UM_CHEST||There could be something interesting left behind here, if you're willing to take the opportunity to explore...]
