rows.original:
The remnants of a crude defense mounted by the outlying inhabitants of the Undermountain against the demonic invasion — carts and furniture have been dragged out of nearby hovels to barricade several sections of the road into a funnel, with results that don't look encouraging. By the complete mess that's been made of the hastily erected wall and several old stains that look suspiciously familiar, the position was easily overrun. Whether the people who lived here were taken by the imps or were eventually evacuated by the Chargers is anyone's guess... 

        Even though this is smack on the main road into the mountain, no one's bothered to clear away the piles of splintered wood and other broken trash that obstruct the way. Then again, there's no reason to do so when there aren't any travelers on the road.
rows.translation:
这里残留着山腹深域外围居民抵御恶魔入侵时仓促布置的简陋防线。马车与家具被从附近的破屋中拖出来，堵住道路的数个部分，将其收束成一条狭窄通道；可结果显然不容乐观。那堵匆忙搭起的障壁已经彻底散架，附近还有几处令人不安地眼熟的陈旧污迹，看来这个阵地轻易便被攻破了。曾住在这里的人究竟被小恶魔掳走，还是最终由冲锋者撤离，谁也说不准……

        尽管这里正位于进山的主路上，却始终无人清理挡路的碎木堆和其他破烂。话说回来，既然路上已经没有旅人，也就没有清理的必要。

rows.original:
This section of tunnel-road is lopsided, with one side notably wider than the other. Scaffolding on the narrow side denotes that the path was being widened when work was abruptly halted — support columns have been built, but the paving is but half-finished, as is a portion of aqueduct.

        Given the scope and state of public works throughout the minotaurs' domain, constructing and maintaining them must form the livelihoods of so many people. With virtually all work halted by the lockdown in response to the demonic threat, one can only wonder how many of the king's subjects have suddenly found themselves with idle hands...
rows.translation:
这段隧道道路是不对称的，其中一侧明显比另一侧宽。狭窄那一侧搭建的脚手架说明，当时工程在进行中突然被中断了——支撑柱已经建好，但铺路工作只完成了一半，部分引水渠的施工也处于中途状态。

        考虑到弥诺陶洛斯领地内公共工程的规模及现状，建造和维护这些工程必然关系到许多人的生计。然而，由于恶魔威胁导致封锁措施的实施，几乎所有的工程工作都被迫暂停了。人们不禁会想，国王的子民中有多少人突然陷入了无事可做的境地……

rows.original:
Here, the tunnel slopes down into a wide, dish-shaped depression vast cavern held up by pillars of stone formed from stalactites and stalagmites joining together over decades. The ground must lie below some kind of water table or the other — numerous puddles dot the ground here, stagnant, rust-colored water that gathers in small pools and teems with all sorts of small insect life. Numerous gigantic mushrooms grow here, some of them reaching just short of the ceiling — tall with broad stalks and narrow caps, their flesh possessed of the consistency and strength of hardwood.

        This must be what passes for a forest down here, then, or a swamp. Despite the winding path that takes you through several islands of raised ground, there's no shortage of undergrowth to be had in the form of smaller fungi clusters and mosses; even the mushroom-trees themselves press in upon you, growing ever more thickly now that there's been no one to keep the path clear for some time.
rows.translation:
在这里，隧道逐渐向下延伸，最终进入了一个宽阔的、呈碟状的凹陷地带——一个巨大的洞穴，其顶部由经过数十年时间逐渐连接在一起的钟乳石和石笋构成的石柱支撑着。这片区域的地面下面肯定存在着某种地下水源，因为地上分布着许多水洼，那些停滞不流动的、呈锈色的水在那些小水坑里积聚着，其中生活着各种各样的小昆虫。这里生长着许多巨大的蘑菇，其中一些的菌柄高得几乎触到天花板——它们菌柄粗壮，菌盖狭小，菌肉的质地坚硬且富有弹性，就像硬木一样。

        那么，这里应该就是所谓的森林，或者说是一片沼泽地吧。尽管这条蜿蜒的小路要穿过几片隆起的地面，但沿途依然有大量的低矮植物可供观赏——那些小型的真菌群落和苔藓就是很好的例子；就连那些蘑菇树本身，也似乎在逐渐挤压着你，因为已经有一段时间没有人来清理这条小路了，所以它们长得越来越茂密。
rows.raw:
"
        Here, the tunnel slopes down into a wide, dish-shaped depression vast cavern held up by pillars of stone formed from stalactites and stalagmites joining together over decades. The ground must lie below some kind of water table or the other — numerous puddles dot the ground here, stagnant, rust-colored water that gathers in small pools and teems with all sorts of small insect life. Numerous gigantic mushrooms grow here, some of them reaching just short of the ceiling — tall with broad stalks and narrow caps, their flesh possessed of the consistency and strength of hardwood.

        This must be what passes for a forest down here, then, or a swamp. Despite the winding path that takes you through several islands of raised ground, there's no shortage of undergrowth to be had in the form of smaller fungi clusters and mosses; even the mushroom-trees themselves press in upon you, growing ever more thickly now that there's been no one to keep the path clear for some time."

rows.original:
What remains of a logging camp — the stumps of several cut mushrooms lead into a clearing where a shack sits, accompanied by several stacks of cut mushroom-wood ready to be delivered. With the way things are, they may never reach their destination before rotting away completely... 

        The loggers who were here clearly beat an organized retreat, carefully boarding up the doors and windows of their little mushroom-wood shack and shed, removing all their personal possessions, and draping everything else under hide tarpaulins against the moist. Yet one gets the impression that they didn't plan to be away for so long...
rows.translation:
一个伐木营的遗迹——几根被砍下的蘑菇残株通向一片空地，那里有一间简陋的小屋，还有几堆准备被运走的蘑菇木料。以目前的状况来看，这些木料很可能在完全腐烂之前就永远到不了目的地了。

        在这里的伐木工们显然进行了有组织的撤离行动：他们仔细地封住了自己那些用蘑菇木搭建的小屋和棚舍的门窗，带走了所有个人物品，然后将剩下的东西都用防水布盖起来，以防受潮。然而，人们会觉得他们原本并没有打算离开这么长时间……

rows.original:
The trail here continues westward from the logging camp and through the very bottom of the saucer-shaped sinkhole; despite the intermittent puddles, there isn't any lake or body of water bigger than a bed. Instead, a heavy mist shrouds the ground here, rising up all the way to your knees; coupled with the uneven ground, this makes wandering off the path treacherous. And speaking of paths, you can't see it proper if you stand; it's instead marked by guiding stones set every few dozen steps amidst the mushroom-trees. For the minotaurs to have built a path through this place and maintained it for so long must have been a work of perseverance as much as it was of genius.

        Still, needs are as needs must. The way all of this is set up, it reminds you of a logging trail, and given the camp just to the west of here it's a reasonable guess that this is exactly what it is, a trail for moving mushroom-wood from where it's felled to where it's to be shipped.
rows.translation:
这条小路从伐木营地开始，向西延伸，穿过那个碟形天坑的最下装；尽管路面上偶尔会有一些水坑，但这里并没有任何面积大于水坑的湖泊或水域。相反，一片浓重的雾气笼罩着地面，雾气的高度甚至能达到你的膝盖；再加上地面崎岖不平，因此一旦偏离小路，就会变得非常危险。说到这些小路，如果你站在那里的话是根本看不到的；这些小路其实是用每隔几十步就放置的一块块指示石来标记的，而这些指示石就埋藏在那些蘑菇状的树木之中。弥诺陶洛斯能够在这片地方修建出这样的小路，并且长期维护它，这无疑既体现了他们的智慧，也展现出了他们的毅力。

        不过，需求就是需求，必须得到满足。从整个布局来看，这条道路确实像是一条伐木小道；而考虑到西边不远就有营地，那么可以合理推测，这条道路的确就是用来将采伐下来的蘑菇木运送到运输地点的。

rows.original:
The tunnel narrows here, rows of enormous mushrooms pressing close together in clumps to create an impassable wall and natural chokepoint. Cut off from easy retreat towards the city to the north, the people here have erected palings and sharpened stakes of mushroom-wood pointing out to the west, either to make a stand or to buy time to escape via the river. Claw and scorch marks alike mar several sections of the mushroom-wood barricade, but the defenses have held — the gate, you note, has not been forced open and is still on its hinges. Be it from the muggy atmosphere or some inherent property of the mushroom-wood, it doesn't seem to burn well at all.

        The question, then, is if everyone made their escape, who would have remained to open the gates from the inside, and why? Convenient for you that you don't have to force your way past in order to explore further... but troubling in thought.
rows.translation:
这里的隧道变得狭窄起来，一排排巨大的蘑菇紧密地生长在一起，形成了无法通过的障碍墙和天然的瓶颈。由于被切断了通往北方城市的退路，这里的居民便用蘑菇木搭建起了栅栏，并将那些削尖的蘑菇木桩指向西方，要么是为了坚守阵地，要么是为了争取时间通过河流逃走。蘑菇木制成的路障的多个部分都留下了爪痕和烧焦的痕迹，但这些防御措施依然有效——你注意到，大门并没有被强行打开，依然固定在铰链上。无论是由于潮湿的环境，还是因为蘑菇木本身具有某种特性，这种材料似乎根本不容易燃烧。

        那么，问题就在于：如果所有人都逃走了，那么究竟会有人留下来从内部打开大门呢？为什么呢？对你来说，这倒是一件方便的事——因为你不必强行闯过去才能继续探索……但仔细想想，这个问题还是挺令人困扰的。

rows.original:
A set of docks on the western shores of the underground lake, a trio of jetties stretching out over vast, dark waters. Here, the flow of the river pauses to gather strength before moving out of the mountain, creating an eerily still body of water that is as unassuming as it is broad. Several posts for securing boats stand along the jetties' length, but none are present; presumably the locals all fled upstream to the city over the river. If anyone can paddle against that current, still as it is, it's got to be a minotaur.

        A single lakeside shack stands by the water's edge, lit by a lone lantern of lava crystal that sways ominously in the drafts swept downriver. Piles upon piles of cut mushroom-wood lie stacked against and upon each other, each log as thick as a minotaur and easily five times as tall as they wait to be towed upriver to Khor'minos itself. The shack is empty, devoid of anything but the simplest furniture which the previous owners considered expendable, but given the defenses erected just outside it's still serviceable shelter for anyone seeking to spend the night in relative comfort and safety.
rows.translation:
在地下湖泊的西岸，有一组码头，三座突伸入广阔而幽暗水面的防波堤矗立于此。在这里，河流的流动暂时停滞下来，积蓄力量之后才继续冲出山涧，从而形成一片表面看似平静、实际上却十分宽阔的水域。沿着防波堤的长度，摆放着几根用于固定船只的支柱，但现在一根也不见了；想必是当地的居民都逃到了河对岸的城市去了。如果真有人能在这种逆流中划船前进，那他肯定是个力大无穷的人。

        湖边矗立着一间简陋的小屋，屋边水中悬着一盏由熔岩水晶制成的灯笼，在顺流而下的风中摇曳着，散发着阴森的气息。一堆堆被切割好的蘑菇木堆叠在一起，每一根木柱都厚如弥诺陶洛斯，高度更是这些木柱的五倍之多——这些木材都在等待被拖往上游的科尔米诺斯城。这个小棚屋空无一人，里面只有最简单的家具，那些前主人认为这些家具完全可以舍弃。不过，考虑到棚屋外设置的防御设施，对于那些想要在相对舒适和安全的环境中过夜的人来说，它仍然是一个可以使用的庇护所。

rows.original:
As wide as the road is here, the ceiling itself grows low, adding only to the inherent claustrophobic feeling of these tunnels. Several stalactites brush your [pc.hair] as you pass by under them — that they were low enough to do so is concerning, but even moreso is the fact that you didn't notice until it was too late. There's something about the way moisture glitters off the rock here that makes the mind wander... one can only imagine the circumstances that led to a busy road being built through this place. Maybe it isn't as mesmerizing when you've got throngs of people at your side... 

        A small stream flows by the cavern wall here, and several fungal bulbs and pods grow from the moisture, each one bearing large, pearlescent fruit. Almost all of it is half-eaten either by the beetles that swarm about the fungal plants but never harm them, or by the looks of several much larger fang-toothed bites, the more recent imps that are infesting the tunnels.
        
        The road would have continued to the north, but that tunnel has been collapsed as well, forcing one to take a detour to the west and circle around a smaller, narrower route. [party.comp brint brienne
            |
            
            "Never thought I'd see the day," Brint mutters.
            
            The day when?
            
            "If the city were to come under assault, the royal engineers would collapse certain sections of the tunnels, funnel our enemies into a more harrowing path while leaving our own avenues of passage open," Brint explains. "When I was young, that always seemed impossible when I heard about it from passing Chargers... and yet here we are."
            |
            
            "Never thought I'd see the day," Brienne mutters.
            
            The day when?
            
            "If the city were to come under assault, the royal engineers would collapse certain sections of the tunnels, funnel our enemies into a more harrowing path while leaving our own avenues of passage open," Brienne explains. "When I was young, that always seemed impossible when I heard about it from passing Chargers... and yet here we are."
            |Sure, the Undermountain is riddled with enough holes and passages that fully cutting off any enemy advance towards Khor'minos would be impossible, but at least the most obvious and direct approaches have been made impassible, funneling the imps and forcing them to split up.
        ]
rows.translation:
尽管这里的通道非常宽阔，但天花板的高度却很低，这进一步加剧了这些隧道所带来的压抑感。几根钟乳石在你从下方经过时擦过了你的[pc.hair]——它们的高度竟然低到这种程度，这一点确实令人担忧；但更令人不安的是，你直到为时已晚才注意到这一点。这里的湿气在岩石表面上闪烁着微光，这种景象实在会让人陷入沉思。人们只能想象，究竟是怎样的情况才导致人们选择在这片地方修建一条繁忙的道路。当周围挤满了人群时，这种景象或许就不再那么令人着迷了……

        在这里，有一条小溪从洞壁旁流过，由于湿润的环境，几株真菌在这里生长起来，它们结出了许多珍珠般闪亮的大型果实。几乎所有这些食物都被两种生物吃掉了一半：一种是那些在真菌植物周围飞来飞去的甲虫，它们虽然会靠近这些植物，但并不会伤害它们；另一种则是那些体型较大、长着锋利獠牙的生物，它们最近才开始侵扰这些隧道。
        
        这条道路本来可以继续向北延伸，但那条隧道也已经坍塌了，因此人们不得不绕道向西，通过一条更小、更狭窄的路线来行进。 [party.comp brint brienne
            |
            
            从没想过会有这么一天，”布林特低声说道。
            
            “哪一天呢？”
            
            “如果这座城市遭到攻击，皇家工程师会炸毁隧道的某些部分，把敌人引向更加危险的道路，而我们自己的通道则保持畅通，”布林特解释道，“我小时候，每次听到那些经过这里的士兵们讲这件事，都觉得这根本是不可能的事……然而现在，这一切真的发生了。
            |
            
            从没想过会有这么一天，”布蕾妮低声说道。
            
            “哪一天呢？”
            
            “如果这座城市遭到攻击，皇家工程师会炸毁隧道的某些部分，把敌人引向更加危险的道路，而我们自己的通道则保持畅通，”布蕾妮解释道，“小时候，每次从路过的士兵那里听到这种说法，我都觉得这根本是不可能的……然而现在，这一切真的发生了。
            |的确，幽暗山脉中布满了众多的洞穴与通道，要想完全阻止任何敌人向科尔米诺斯进发几乎是不可能的。但至少，那些最明显、最直接的进攻路线已经被彻底封锁，这使得那些敌人不得不分散力量、改变进攻路线。
        ]

rows.original: Another section of tunnel, as quiet and nondescript as can be. An abandoned crane and several pallets of cut stone to the side imply that some kind of construction was slated to take place here, but was halted before any progress could be made. A draft blows in from the eastern side of the long, cylindrical passageway, bringing with it the faint smell of moisture...
rows.translation: 又一段隧道，安静而毫无特色。旁边有一台废弃的起重机以及几堆切割好的石料，这些迹象表明这里原本计划进行某种施工，但工程在尚未取得任何进展时就被中止了。一阵微风从这条长长的圆柱形通道的东侧吹进来，带来了淡淡的潮湿气息……
rows.raw: "\n        Another section of tunnel, as quiet and nondescript as can be. An abandoned crane and several pallets of cut stone to the side imply that some kind of construction was slated to take place here, but was halted before any progress could be made. A draft blows in from the eastern side of the long, cylindrical passageway, bringing with it the faint smell of moisture..."

rows.original:
Waterfalls dominate this stretch of tunnel, small curtains of clear water that pour out from holes in the walls and cascade into small pools by the roadside before draining into the ground. Several of them have been fashioned into public drinking fountains comprised of decorated stone basins carried on the backs of kneeling minotaurs; these have escaped the attention of the imps marauding through the tunnels, or simply cleaned themselves out over time. It's rather ingenuous, the way the basin lip is designed such that water runs over its edge just so, flushing out the basin periodically and ensuring proper hygiene without anyone needing to swab it down occasionally.

        There used to be an open passage to the south here passing under a grand archway, but it's been cleanly and methodically caved in to create a chokepoint of the bend in the road. This has to be the other side of the archway you saw to the south, then. So this was just a side path, and the main road had been collapsed...
rows.translation:
这段隧道中，瀑布随处可见——清澈的水流从墙壁上的孔洞中倾泻而出，形成细小的水帘，然后汇入路边的小水池中，最终渗入地下。其中几处瀑布被改造成了公共饮水设施，那些装饰精美的石制水槽被安置在跪着的弥诺陶洛斯的背上，供人们取水饮用。这些饮水设施似乎没有引起在隧道中活动的那些小妖精的注意，或者它们只是随着时间的推移而被清理干净了。这种设计其实相当巧妙：盆口的边缘被设计成这样，使得水会自动从边缘流走，从而定期清洁盆子，确保卫生状况良好，而人们根本不需要定期去擦拭它。

        这里曾经有一条通往南方的通道，它从一座宏伟的拱门下方穿过，但现在，这条通道已经被有条不紊地凿平，从而在道路的拐弯处形成了一个障碍点。那么，这里应该就是你之前在南方看到的那座拱门的另一侧了。原来这条路只是条侧道，而主干道早就被毁掉了……

rows.original:
Evidence of a previous battle lies on the road here — low fortifications fashioned from bags of sand and gravel lie across the length of the tunnel-road, about waist-height for a minotaur. At a glance, the intent here is clear: to funnel an enemy towards the obvious, tempting opening in the middle, making for an efficient kill zone in the middle. 

        Ingenious, but it clearly didn't work well enough. Either there were simply too many imps to handle, or the fact that they could fly made the plan untenable even given the low ceiling in this part of the caves... whatever the case, this position was overrun and the minotaurs forced to fall back, leaving their fortifications to gather dust.
rows.translation:
这里道路上留有之前发生过战斗的痕迹——一排由沙袋和碎石堆砌而成的简易防御工事横贯整个隧道道路，其高度大约与弥诺陶洛斯的腰部相当。一眼就能看出，这样的布置目的很明显：就是将敌人引向中间那个显而易见、极具诱惑力的入口，从而在中间形成一处高效的击杀区域。 

        这个办法确实很巧妙，但显然效果并不理想。要么是因为这些小妖的数量实在太多，难以应对；要么就是因为它们会飞行，即使洞穴这一区域的天花板很低，这个计划也根本行不通……不管是什么原因，这个据点最终还是被攻占了，弥诺陶洛斯被迫撤退，他们的防御工事也就从此荒废了。
rows.raw:
"
        Evidence of a previous battle lies on the road here — low fortifications fashioned from bags of sand and gravel lie across the length of the tunnel-road, about waist-height for a minotaur. At a glance, the intent here is clear: to funnel an enemy towards the obvious, tempting opening in the middle, making for an efficient kill zone in the middle. 

        Ingenious, but it clearly didn't work well enough. Either there were simply too many imps to handle, or the fact that they could fly made the plan untenable even given the low ceiling in this part of the caves... whatever the case, this position was overrun and the minotaurs forced to fall back, leaving their fortifications to gather dust."

rows.original:
A grand crossroads, important enough for its heart to have been turned into a plaza proper, decorated with fine mosaic tiles instead of the cobble that paves the minotaurs' solid roads. Finely carved pillars hold up the ceiling here, each one as stout as an ancient pine as it disappears upwards into the darkness. Milestone markers and signs written in Belharan and presumably the minotaur tongue helpfully point travelers to where they need to be: east to the city, south to the lake and mushroom forest, west to the local temple of Tira and north to the unclaimed tunnels of the Undermountain.

        A wayhouse, a small garrison, market stalls, even a bakery — this confluence of roads was important enough to warrant its own population, and like everything else you've seen on the road to Khor'minos, completely abandoned thanks to the Minotaur King's evacuation of his peoples. Anything that hasn't been pilfered by looters has long since been purloined by the imps; even the ovens in the bakery are crumbling from plain vandalism. Even when all this is over, it's unlikely that the people who lived here are going to be able to return to any semblance of their old lives.
rows.translation:
一个重要的十字路口，其重要性足以使这里被改造成一个真正的广场，广场上铺着精美的马赛克瓷砖，而不是那些用于铺设弥诺陶洛斯们道路的鹅卵石。这里的天花板由雕刻精美的柱子支撑着，每一根柱子都像古老的松树一样粗壮，它们向上延伸，最终消失在黑暗之中。用贝尔哈兰语以及很可能也是米诺陶斯语写成的里程碑标志和指示牌，为旅行者们指明了方向：向东就是城市，向南则是湖泊和蘑菇森林，向西是当地的蒂拉神庙，而向北则通向那些尚未被开发的地下山洞。

        一个驿站、一小支驻军、一些市场摊位，甚至一家面包店——这条道路的交汇处之所以如此重要，正是因为它足以支撑自己发展出独立的人口。而就像你在前往科尔米诺斯的路上所见到的所有地方一样，由于弥诺陶洛斯国王下令民众撤离，这里也早已被彻底废弃了。凡是没有被掠夺者抢走的东西，早就被那些小妖精们偷走了；就连面包店里的烤箱也因为被人故意破坏而快要毁掉了。等到这一切都结束之后，那些曾经在这里生活过的人们，也很不可能能够恢复到他们以前的生活状态了。

rows.original:
This side path leading west from the crossroads is littered with broken statues of busty cowgirls, shattered remains of marble lying across the sides of the tunnel-road. Claw marks on the plinths and ugly stains upon the statues' gentle features and beatific expressions make clear the vandals' identity — not content with merely tearing down works of art, the imps had to defile them as well. Of course.

        There's nothing here that doesn't make one all the more depressed the longer one lingers in this spot. Perhaps moving on might be for the best.
rows.translation:
这条从十字路口向西延伸的小路上，散落着许多破碎的胸脯丰满的牛仔女像，大理石碎片遍布在隧道两侧。基座上的爪痕以及那些毁坏了雕像优美轮廓和宁静表情的污痕，清楚地揭示了破坏者的身份——这些家伙不仅满足于毁坏艺术品，还非要对其进行玷污才肯罢休。当然。

        在这个地方待得越久，人们只会感到越沮丧。或许，离开才是最好的选择。

rows.original:
At the end of the tunnel-road here is a solid facade of stone into which has been carved a pair of minotaur-sized doors and several windows that still have fragments of shattered glass within them. The rest of the colored shards are scattered around the courtyard, all the way to the base of the fountain in the middle of the courtyard. 

        The statue standing over the fountain depicts an extremely top-heavy cowgirl, wearing dark robes and cloth wrappings that barely contain her voluptuous figure. A labrys axe is planted between her feet, but her arms are wide open invitingly. Water streams down from her breasts, pooling between her feet.

        ...Pooling along with a myriad of other substances. The temple has clearly been defiled, and streaks of white are splattered all over the statue, especially between and atop her chest and all over her thighs. They're set just wide enough apart that somebody could thrust between them, and clearly that's exactly what's been happening. The fountain itself is near to overflowing thanks to the sheer volume of seed that's been spilling into it, plugging up whatever drainage the minotaurs might have had. More concerning, though, are the streaks of black ichor also clinging to the edge of the stone, with more of the stuff streaking towards the doors in thick, slimy trails.
rows.translation:
这条隧道路的尽头是一面由石头砌成的坚固墙体，上面雕刻着一对弥诺陶洛斯大小的门，还有几扇窗户，其中仍残留着破碎的玻璃碎片。其余的玻璃碎片散落在庭院的各处，一直延伸到庭院中央的喷泉底部。 

        矗立在喷泉旁的这座雕像描绘了一位身材极为丰满的牛仔女孩，她身着深色长袍和布制包裹物，但这些衣物几乎无法掩盖她那诱人的身形。她的双脚之间插着一把双刃斧，而她的双臂则张开，仿佛在热情地邀请着人们靠近。水流从她的胸前淌下，在她的双脚间汇聚成水洼。

        ……这些水洼中还混杂着无数其他物质。这座神庙显然已经被玷污了：雕像的各个部位，尤其是她的胸部、大腿以及那些部位之间，都溅满了白色的污迹。它们的间距被设置得恰到好处，足以让人从它们之间穿过，而显然，现在正是有人这样做的。由于有大量的种子不断涌入其中，这个喷泉几乎快要溢出来了，这些种子堵塞了弥诺陶洛斯原本可能拥有的任何排水通道。更令人担忧的是，那些黑色的黏液也附着在石头的边缘，还有更多的黏液正以浓稠、黏腻的痕迹朝着大门方向流淌而去。

rows.original: As one ventures away from the main road that leads to the grand city of Khor'minos, the finely paved road terminates abruptly, giving way to a path of packed gravel and sand. It's still just as wide, but gives off the same air as a countryside path rather than the main thoroughfare that connects the King's Gate to the city. Various stacks of stone piled up by the wayside implies that the minotaurs were working on extending the paved roads when the demons invaded, but they've laid there for so long now that moss has started to grow on them. Like so many winding countryside paths, you might not get anywhere useful, but the path is nevertheless sure to be long and scenic.
rows.translation: 当人们离开通往宏伟城市科尔米诺斯的主路时，这条铺设整齐的道路突然结束了，取而代之的是一条由碎石和沙子铺成的小路。这条小路的宽度与之前的道路差不多，但它给人的感觉更像是一条乡村小路，而不是连接国王之门与城市的主干道。路旁堆放的那些石堆表明，在恶魔入侵之前，弥诺陶洛斯一直在修建这些铺好的道路，但这些石块已经放置了太久，上面甚至已经开始长苔了。 就像许多蜿蜒曲折的乡村小路一样，你可能会走得一无所获。有用不过，这条路无疑会充满艰辛，但沿途的风景一定十分美丽。

rows.original:
The tunnel-road here starts to meander, the rigid exactness and uniformity of minotaur engineering starting to fade the further one goes off the beaten path, to be replaced with something that's more organic. A stolid stonework building sits off to the path's side, letters carved into the doorway declaring it to be "Waystation Stenn." However, the place has long since been abandoned, its inhabitants no doubt long since evacuated to the city proper. Not a moment too soon, too — barred and chained as they are, the walls and door bear the claw-marks of numerous imp depravities, the frustration of the little demons evident.

        A ruined well and several scattered cordwood stacks aside, there's nothing for you here. The sight is melancholic, like the other abandoned buildings you've seen while in the Undermountain, but there's nothing you can reasonably do about it...
rows.translation:
这条隧道道路开始蜿蜒曲折，随着人们逐渐偏离常规路线，弥诺陶洛斯工程所特有的严格精确性与整齐划一性逐渐消失，取而代之的是一种更为自然、有机的形式。在小路的一侧，有一座坚固的石砌建筑，门楣上刻着文字，表明这里就是“斯坦恩中转站”。然而，这个地方早已被废弃，它的居民无疑早就被转移到了城市里。这样的结局其实再及时不过了——那些被锁上铁链的墙壁和门上，布满了那些小恶魔残暴破坏的痕迹，它们那无处发泄的愤怒和挫败感由此可见一斑。

        一口废弃的井和几堆散落的木柴，除此之外，这里什么也没有。这一景象显得十分凄凉，就像你在山腹深域中看到的那些被遗弃的建筑一样，但你也无能为力，无法改变这种状况……

rows.original:
The north-south path here runs over a series of wide chasms that open up over arches of stone that bridge it. The minotaurs have helpfully added mushroom-wood guardrails along the sides to prevent travelers from accidentally falling in, and heated air rises from the darkness below, bringing with it a constant wailing keen and sulphurous stench.

        There used to be a road here leading to the east, but the tunnel's been caved in, rendering it impassable from mounds of rock and other debris. The support columns of stone that had been left to hold the roof up have been methodically demolished, with the natural result being what it is.
rows.translation:
这条南北向的道路跨越了一系列宽阔的峡谷，这些峡谷通过石桥上的拱门与道路相连。弥诺陶洛斯还贴心地在道路两侧安装了蘑菇木制的护栏，以防止旅行者不慎坠入峡谷。而从下方的黑暗中升起的暖空气，带来了持续不断的尖锐刺鼻的硫磺气味。

        这里曾经有一条通往东方的道路，但隧道已经坍塌，大量的岩石和其他碎片使得道路无法通行。那些原本用来支撑隧道的石柱也被人为地拆除了，自然而然，就形成了现在这样的景象。

"
        The north-south path here runs over a series of wide chasms that open up over arches of stone that bridge it. The minotaurs have helpfully added mushroom-wood guardrails along the sides to prevent travelers from accidentally falling in, and heated air rises from the darkness below, bringing with it a constant wailing keen and sulphurous stench.

        There used to be a road here leading to the east, but the tunnel's been caved in, rendering it impassable from mounds of rock and other debris. The support columns of stone that had been left to hold the roof up have been methodically demolished, with the natural result being what it is."

rows.original:
At ground level, this section of tunnel-road is completely unremarkable. High up above, though, little pinpricks of light glimmer in the darkness, light shed by a multitude of crystals embedded in the cavern roof. The sight is reminiscent of stars in the night sky — red, angry stars to be sure, but stars nevertheless. The roiling of the lava-light within the crystals even makes them appear to twinkle!

        Judging by the presence of several smoothed surfaces and firepits, this was a fairly popular spot with locals. A pity this had to happen... at least the crystals are too high up for any imps to get at them, although you note that several of the milestones and campsites have been vandalized in their fashion.
rows.translation:
从地面上看，这段隧道道路确实没有什么特别之处。然而，在高高的洞顶上，许多嵌入其中的晶体散发着微弱的光芒，这些光芒在黑暗中闪烁着，看起来就像夜空中的星星——虽然是红色的，充满能量，但终究还是星星。晶体内部熔岩光芒的闪烁，使得这些晶体看起来仿佛真的在发光！

        从这里存在几处被打磨光滑的表面以及火坑来看，这个地方显然很受当地人的欢迎。真可惜，这样的悲剧竟然发生了。至少那些水晶位于太高处的地方，根本不可能有小妖精能够拿到它们；不过你也注意到，有几处里程碑和露营地已经被那些小妖精破坏过了。

rows.original:
Here the path winds past a small grove of ferns, centered about several minotaur-sized crystal outcroppings. The crystals constantly pulse and throb with a radiant red glow, giving the ferns the light they need to survive; it's not hard to draw the connection between these crystals and those that serve to light the roads of this underground domain. Tracked in by travelers gods know how long ago, these plants have been here long enough for soil to form under them... it's a small but poignant reminder that people bring all sorts of things, wittingly or unwittingly, when they travel.
        
        [kalysea.isFollower
            |"I don't dislike this place as much as I thought I might," Kalysea muses, gazing at the ferns. "Underground though it may be, this is nature too."

            "No forests around, though," you say.
            
            "No forests," she agrees. "That is true."
        ]
rows.translation:
这条小路蜿蜒穿过一片蕨类植物丛，丛中分布着几块大小与牛头怪相当的晶体。这些晶体不断发出炽热的红光，为蕨类植物提供了生存所需的光芒；不难看出，这些晶体与那些为这个地下世界照亮道路的晶体有着相同的来源。不知是哪位旅行者将这些植物带到了这里，也不知道是在多久以前。这些植物在这里生长了如此之久，以至于它们的根部下方已经形成了土壤……这一细节虽然微小，但却深刻地提醒我们：无论人们是有意还是无意，在旅行过程中总会带走各种各样的东西。
        
        [kalysea.isFollower
            |其实我并没有那么讨厌这个地方，”卡莉希娅望着那些蕨类植物沉思道，“虽然它位于地下，但这里依然是大自然的一部分。”

            “不过周围并没有森林，”你说道。
            
            “确实没有森林，”她同意道，“这一点没错。
        ]

rows.original: This section of tunnel-road swerves up and down, up and down as the path follows the bands of hard and soft rock as reflected in the tunnel walls. The constantly uneven ground makes for hard traveling, but it was presumably easier to do it this way than bore a straight, level line through the mountain. While someone's helpfully carved out a roadside boulder into the vague shape of a chair — a minotaur-sized chair to boot — respite is hard to come by in this neck of the mountain...
rows.translation: 这段隧道道路蜿蜒曲折，时高时低，因为道路的走向会随着隧道墙壁上显现出的坚硬与柔软岩层的变化而改变。这种崎岖不平的地形使得行进十分艰难，但想必，与在山体中开凿一条笔直平坦的道路相比，这种方式还是要容易一些。虽然有人贴心地将路边的巨石雕刻成了大致类似椅子的形状——而且那椅子竟然有弥诺陶洛斯那么大——但在这个山腹地带，想要找到片刻的休息还是相当困难的……
rows.raw: "\n        This section of tunnel-road swerves up and down, up and down as the path follows the bands of hard and soft rock as reflected in the tunnel walls. The constantly uneven ground makes for hard traveling, but it was presumably easier to do it this way than bore a straight, level line through the mountain. rows.original: While the road is solid and firm, the cavern faces up near the ceiling are honeycombed with holes and side tunnels from which squeaks and chitters emerge, accompanied by a disagreeable and pungent but nevertheless earthy smell. So long as you keep close to the ground, you're ignored by the occasional dark shape that flies overhead by the darkened cavern roof; thanks to the height of their homes, the people who inhabit this part of the tunnels can afford to avoid the mess that's going on down below. Not that the smell helps any...
rows.translation: 虽然这条道路坚固平整，但洞穴靠近顶部的地方布满了洞穴和侧隧道，从中传出吱吱声和嘁嘁声，同时还弥漫着一种难闻而刺鼻、但却带着泥土气息的气味。只要你紧贴地面飞行，那些偶尔从昏暗的洞穴顶部飞过的黑色身影就不会注意到你；由于他们居住的地方距离地面较高，居住在这段隧道中的人们就能够避开下面发生的那些混乱场面。其实这种气味根本没什么帮助……
rows.raw: "\n        While the road is solid and firm, the cavern faces up near the ceiling are honeycombed with holes and side tunnels from which squeaks and chitters emerge, accompanied by a disagreeable and pungent but nevertheless earthy smell. So long as you keep close to the ground, you're ignored by the occasional dark shape that flies overhead by the darkened cavern roof; thanks to the height of their homes, the people who inhabit this part of the tunnels can afford to avoid the mess that's going on down below. Not that the smell helps any..."

rows.original:
A north-south stretch of tunnel, slightly darkened by the fact that several of the crystal sconces have been ripped from the walls and lie shattered on the roadway. The work of imps, presumably, and without engineers and architects to come out from the city to fix them the area's been shrouded in darkness ever since. Public works are the first to go in any war... 

        The rush of flowing water catches your attention, though, distinct as it comes from the northeast. Even with only dim light to navigate by, it's not too hard to follow the sound to its source, which is the only way to go anyway... unless one wishes to turn back to Khor'minos, that is.
rows.translation:
这条隧道呈南北走向，由于有几盏水晶吊灯被从墙上拆下来，摔得粉碎后散落在道路上，因此光线变得有些昏暗。这些破坏行为很可能是小妖精们干的。由于没有工程师和建筑师从城里赶来修复这些设施，自从那以后，这一区域就一直处于黑暗之中。在任何战争中，公共设施总是最先遭到破坏的……

        然而，那股从东北方向流来的湍急水流立刻吸引了你的注意。尽管周围光线昏暗，但沿着水流的声音追踪其源头也并非难事——毕竟，这也是唯一的出路……除非有人愿意回到科尔米诺斯，当然。
rows.raw:
"
        A north-south stretch of tunnel, slightly darkened by the fact that several of the crystal sconces have been ripped from the walls and lie shattered on the roadway. The work of imps, presumably, and without engineers and architects to come out from the city to fix them the area's been shrouded in darkness ever since. Public works are the first to go in any war...

rows.original: An abandoned prospecting venture — while you notice beams and scaffolding of some kind of mushroom-wood propping up an abortive attempt to carve out some parts of the tunnel's western wall, there isn't anyone around and dust and cobwebs have gathered on the support structures. Whoever dug this out has clearly struck something — you spy streaks of silver and brown in the otherwise uniform gray stone in this part of the tunnels — but didn't hang around to take advantage of their find or even stake a proper claim. Hmm. Odd.
rows.translation: 一个被废弃的勘探工程——你可以看到，一些用蘑菇木制成的梁架和脚手架被用来尝试挖掘隧道西墙的某些部分，但周围却没有人，这些支撑结构上也积满了灰尘和蜘蛛网。当初挖掘这里的人显然挖到了什么东西——这段隧道原本均匀灰暗的岩石中，能看见银色与棕色的矿脉——却没有留下来开采，甚至没有正式圈定矿权。 嗯，真奇怪。

Hmm. Odd."

rows.original:
This close to the river, the air is perceptibly moist; you can taste the tang of water on your tongue, coupled with the slight chill of its source. It's a distinct sensation on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]: mixing with the dust and grit of the tunnels, the humid air creates the most unpleasant feeling that turns one's thoughts to running water and steaming bathhouses. Certainly a boon for anyone seeking to head to the river for a dip... but absolutely agonizing otherwise. Even the ground feels slightly slippery underfoot as you make your way forward, picking past clumps of mushrooms that sprout from the sides of the road.
        
        [party.comp brint brienne
            |Brint shakes his head at the sight. "Ugh. Plump helmets, no doubt escaped from some farm or the other; we plant them because they grow quickly, but let them get out of hand and this is what you get. Neglect a stretch of tunnel for a month or two, and these start popping up to ruin the roads. With all this wet, I'm surprised they haven't already overrun the place."
            |Brienne shakes her head at the sight. "Ugh. Plump helmets, no doubt escaped from some farm or the other; we plant them because they grow quickly, but let them get out of hand and this is what you get. Neglect a stretch of tunnel for a month or two, and these start popping up to ruin the roads. With all this wet, I'm surprised they haven't already overrun the place."
        ]
rows.translation:
在这里，靠近河流的地方，空气明显显得湿润起来；你甚至能在舌头上感受到水的清凉味道，以及它源自源头所带来的那丝微寒。这种感觉确实非常独特。 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]潮湿的空气与隧道里弥漫的灰尘混合在一起，营造出一种极其不适的氛围，让人不由得想要想象流动的水和热气腾腾的浴室……对于那些打算去河边泡澡的人来说，这无疑是个天大的福音……但除此之外，这种环境实在让人难以忍受。当你向前行走时，就连地面也会显得有些湿滑，你需要小心翼翼地避开那些从道路两侧生长出来的蘑菇丛。
        
        [party.comp brint brienne
            |布林特看到这一幕，摇了摇头：“唉，这些圆胖的头盔，肯定是从某个农场逃出来的吧。我们种植它们是因为它们生长得很快，但要是任其肆意生长，就会变成现在这个样子。如果有一两个月不去照料某段隧道，这些植物就会冒出来，把道路都破坏掉。这么潮湿的环境下，我真奇怪它们还没把整个地方都覆盖掉。

        ]

            |Brienne shakes her head at the sight. "Ugh. Neglect a stretch of tunnel for a month or two, and these start popping up to ruin the roads. With all this wet, I'm surprised they haven't already overrun the place."

rows.original: A huge, arched stone bridge connects the two halves of the minotaur kingdom east to west, spanning the rapids nearly a hundred feet below you. It's just possible to make out a pinprick of light to the north, where the water flows into the mountain from the River Ridell. The arches themselves are carved to represent a glorious winged woman, supporting the bridge on her bowed back. On the eastern side of the bridge, rather than a smoothly carved tunnel-road like most of the Undermountain you've explored thus far, the cavern gives way to a winding set of curved stairs nearly twenty feet across and so tall that you can't see the tops.
rows.translation: 一座巨大的拱形石桥将弥诺陶洛斯王国的东西两部分连接起来，它横跨下方近一百英尺高的急流。在北方，你可以隐约看到一道微弱的光芒——那里是里德尔河汇入山脉的地方。这些拱门本身就被雕刻成一位拥有华丽翅膀的女神的形象，她用弯曲的背部支撑着这座桥。在桥的东侧，与你们迄今为止探索过的地下山脉中大多数平滑雕刻的隧道道路不同，这个洞穴通向一段蜿蜒曲折的楼梯——这段楼梯的宽度接近二十英尺，高度也极高，以至于你们根本看不到楼梯的顶端。
rows.raw: "\n        A huge, arched stone bridge connects the two halves of the minotaur kingdom east to west, spanning the rapids nearly a hundred feet below you. It's just possible to make out a pinprick of light to the north, where the water flows into the mountain from the River Ridell. The arches themselves are carved to represent a glorious winged woman, supporting the bridge on her bowed back. On the eastern side of the bridge, rather than a smoothly carved tunnel-road like most of the Undermountain you've explored thus far, the cavern gives way to a winding set of curved stairs nearly twenty feet across and so tall that you can't see the tops."

rows.original:
You stand at the foot of a huge, curving array of stairs carved into the mountain's heart. They stretch upwards further than it's possible to see, twisting out of sight around and around themselves. Every few yards, there's a statue of a beautiful winged woman, glorious in her nudity and bearing a thunderbolt spear. 

        The stairs lean vaguely northward going up. Back to the west, there's a bridge spanning the River Ridell that will return you to the caverns of the minotaurs.
rows.translation:
你站在一片巨大的、蜿蜒曲折的楼梯脚下，这些楼梯仿佛是直接雕刻在山体之中。它们向上延伸，远远超出了视线所能及的范围，不断地盘旋、缠绕着向上延伸。每隔几码，就会有一座美丽的女神雕像矗立在那里——这些女神们身披羽翼，裸露着身体，手中握着雷电之矛，显得无比庄严而美丽。

        楼梯大致朝着北方倾斜着向上延伸。而在西边，有一座桥横跨着里德尔河，这条桥会带你回到弥诺陶洛斯的洞穴之中。
rows.raw:
"
        You stand at the foot of a huge, curving array of stairs carved into the mountain's heart. They stretch upwards further than it's possible to see, twisting out of sight around and around themselves. Every few yards, there's a statue of a beautiful winged woman, glorious in her nudity and bearing a thunderbolt spear. 

        The stairs lean vaguely northward going up. Back to the west, there's a bridge spanning the River Ridell that will return you to the caverns of the minotaurs."

rows.original:
You have come about halfway through the Steps of Sorra, a monumental climb from the depths of the Undermountain abyss to the top of the mountain into which the minotaurs built their crown city. Stairs stretch up and down from here far out of sight, twisting around themselves over and over. Every few yards, there's a statue of a beautiful winged woman, glorious in her nudity and bearing a thunderbolt spear.

        The stairs lean vaguely northward here going up, and southward down.
rows.translation:
你现在已经走到了索拉之路的中途——这是一段从幽暗的地底深渊通往米诺陶尔们建立王都的那座山顶的漫长旅程。阶梯从这里向上延伸，向下延伸，远远地伸向远方，一路上不断蜿蜒曲折。每隔几码，就会有一座美丽的有翼女性的雕像，她赤裸着身体，手持雷电之矛，显得无比庄严而美丽。

        这段阶梯在向上延伸时略微偏向北方，在向下延伸时则偏向南方。
rows.raw:
"
        You have come about halfway through the Steps of Sorra, a monumental climb from the depths of the Undermountain abyss to the top of the mountain into which the minotaurs built their crown city. Stairs stretch up and down from here far out of sight, twisting around themselves over and over. Every few yards, there's a statue of a beautiful winged woman, glorious in her nudity and bearing a thunderbolt spear.

        The stairs lean vaguely northward here going up, and southward down."

rows.original:
At the top of the vast, winding Steps of Sorra is a tremendous gate of stone embellished with the face of the Queen of Storms. Sorra's snarling visage is flanked by thunderbolts on either side, and countless flying harpies make up the background of the mural. The gates thankfully have heavy ropes and pulleys attached to their handles, making it possible to open them even if you lack a team of minotaurs to do the deed.

        Back south are the great winding Steps, heading back down into the minotaur kingdom.
rows.translation:
在那蜿蜒曲折的索拉阶梯的最顶端，有一座巨大的石门，其上雕刻着风暴女王的面容。索拉那张狰狞的面孔两侧各饰有雷电图案，而无数飞翔的哈比鹰则构成了这幅壁画的背景。幸运的是，这些石门的把手上安装了粗重的绳索和滑轮，因此即使没有弥诺陶洛斯团队的帮助，人们也能够将它们打开。

        向南望去，那些蜿蜒曲折的阶梯再次将人们引向弥诺陶洛斯王国的内陆深处。
rows.raw:
"
        At the top of the vast, winding Steps of Sorra is a tremendous gate of stone embellished with the face of the Queen of Storms. Sorra's snarling visage is flanked by thunderbolts on either side, and countless flying harpies make up the background of the mural. The gates thankfully have heavy ropes and pulleys attached to their handles, making it possible to open them even if you lack a team of minotaurs to do the deed.

        Back south are the great winding Steps, heading back down into the minotaur kingdom."

rows.original:
Eastward, the grand road to the glorious city of Khor'minos continues, with milestones and waymarkers counting out the distance before one reaches its vaunted gates. The stone sconces have been replaced with lampposts instead, still lit by those same roiling lava crystals; the ground slowly rises, interspersing stretches of flat ground with flights of stairs. The entire design of the broad throughway is made to give one the impression of being on a grand pilgrimage — which for many of the people who would be traveling to Khor'minos, not too far off from the truth... 

        Even so, the vast emptiness is unsettling, the knowledge that there should be hordes of people at your side along this road, coming and going... and now all you have is the eerie silence of empty tunnels and the groanings of the earth.
rows.translation:
向东延伸，通往辉煌之城科尔米诺斯的宏伟道路继续延伸着，路旁的里程碑和指示标志不断标示着距离，引领人们走向那备受赞誉的城门。原本的石制路标已被灯柱取代，而这些灯柱依然由那些旋转的熔岩晶体提供光源；地面逐渐升高，平缓的地段与一段段楼梯交替出现。这条宽阔通道的整个设计旨在让人产生置身于一场盛大朝圣之旅中的感觉——对于许多即将前往距离科尔米诺斯并不遥远的那些人来说，这种感觉其实与现实相差无几……

        然而，这种广袤的空旷依然会让人感到不安，因为人们知道，这条道路上本应该有成群结队的人来来去去。现在，周围只剩下空荡荡的隧道里传来的诡异的寂静，以及大地发出的阵阵呻吟声。
rows.raw:
"
        Eastward, the grand road to the glorious city of Khor'minos continues, with milestones and waymarkers counting out the distance before one reaches its vaunted gates. The stone sconces have been replaced with lampposts instead, still lit by those same roiling lava crystals; the ground slowly rises, interspersing stretches of flat ground with flights of stairs. The entire design of the broad throughway is made to give one the impression of being on a grand pilgrimage — which for many of the people who would be traveling to Khor'minos, not too far off from the truth... 

        Even so, the vast emptiness is unsettling, the knowledge that there should be hordes of people at your side along this road, coming and going... and now all you have is the eerie silence of empty tunnels and the groanings of the earth."

rows.original: As one emerges from the connecting tunnels, one feels the first twinges of sweltering heat in the air. Held back by a thick dome of transparent crystal, molten rock roils in the cavern walls, the magma chamber of some volcano or the other. No one in Hawkethorne has actually seen the mountain erupt, so hopefully all this is vented harmlessly somewhere... hopefully. It can't be dangerous, though, since the minotaurs went and built an impressive and major roadway through the cavern for no apparent purpose other than impressing everyone coming and going from their city. ...Right? That you're so close to molten rock and are merely sweating a bit instead of being roasted alive, that's got to be saying something for this natural wonder. Even the angry red glow that illuminates the vast chamber makes the place feel alive. Is this where the lava crystals that light so much of the minotaurs' underground kingdom come from? No, no, that's can't be right. If the walls were to be breached and magma come flooding in... surely engineering minds as brilliant as the minotaurs' would realize the folly in such a thing.
rows.translation: 当人们从那些相连的隧道中走出来时，首先感受到的是空气中弥漫的酷热。在一层厚厚的透明水晶穹顶的阻挡下，熔岩在洞壁中翻滚着——这应该是某座火山的岩浆室吧。在鹰棘镇，实际上没有人亲眼见过那座山爆发过，所以希望这一切只是无害地释放到了某个地方……但愿如此。不过，这肯定不会有什么危险，因为那些弥诺陶洛斯专门在洞穴中修建了一条规模宏大、令人惊叹的道路，而这样做的目的，显然只是为了给进出他们城市的所有人留下深刻印象罢了。 ……对吧？你明明离熔岩那么近，却只是稍微出点汗，并没有被烤死，这一事实本身就足以说明这个自然奇观的非凡之处了。就连那照亮整个巨大洞室的红光，也让人感受到这个地方的活着难道这些能够照亮弥诺陶洛斯地下王国的熔岩晶体就是从这里产生的吗？不，不，那肯定不对。如果墙壁被破坏，岩浆涌入其中……那些像弥诺陶洛斯一样聪明的工程专家们，肯定能意识到这种做法是多么愚蠢。
rows.raw: " As one emerges from the connecting tunnels, one feels the first twinges of sweltering heat in the air. Held back by a thick dome of transparent crystal, molten rock roils in the cavern walls, the magma chamber of some volcano or the other. No one in Hawkethorne has actually seen the mountain erupt, so hopefully all this is vented harmlessly somewhere... hopefully. It can't be dangerous, though, since the minotaurs went and built an impressive and major roadway through the cavern for no apparent purpose other than impressing everyone coming and going from their city. ...Right? That you're so close to molten rock and are merely sweating a bit instead of being roasted alive, that's got to be saying something for this natural wonder. Even the angry red glow that illuminates the vast chamber makes the place feel alive. Is this where the lava crystals that light so much of the minotaurs' underground kingdom come from? No, no, that's can't be right. If the walls were to be breached and magma come flooding in... surely engineering minds as brilliant as the minotaurs' would realize the folly in such a thing."

rows.original: Evidence of an old mining operation, now converted to part of the roadway. Signs of the old excavations still linger, shafts and digs where miners got at the seams, but when the ore was exhausted the infrastructure was given over for public use. Waste not, want not — the fact that minotaur industry still leaves breathtaking sights in its wake is something remarkable. Functional and aesthetic. Nature has begun to reclaim parts of the old mine, strange fungi and other plants growing on the crags and in the pits, lending a picturesque air to the whole affair. It may be different from what's to be found on the surface, but this world beneath the earth is no less lively.
rows.translation: 这些痕迹证明这里曾经有过采矿活动，如今这些场地已被改造成道路的一部分。那些古老的挖掘痕迹依然存在：矿井和挖掘坑就是矿工们开采矿石的地方。然而，当矿石被采尽后，这些基础设施就被改作公共用途。“物尽其用”——矿工们留下的这些遗迹依然令人叹为观止，这一点确实非常了不起。这些设施至今依然具有实用价值。以及这种美感令人陶醉。大自然已经开始重新占据那些废弃的矿井，奇特的真菌和其他植物在岩壁和坑洞中生长，为整个场景增添了一抹别样的风景。虽然这与地表上的景象有所不同，但这个地下世界同样充满生机与活力。
rows.raw: "\n Evidence of an old mining operation, now converted to part of the roadway. Signs of the old excavations still linger, shafts and digs where miners got at the seams, but when the ore was exhausted the infrastructure was given over for public use. Waste not, want not — the fact that minotaur industry still leaves breathtaking sights in its wake is something remarkable. Functional and aesthetic. Nature has begun to reclaim parts of the old mine, strange fungi and other plants growing on the crags and in the pits, lending a picturesque air to the whole affair. It may be different from what's to be found on the surface, but this world beneath the earth is no less lively."

rows.original:
This section of the caverns is dominated by several large pits of gray sand off to the side, fenced off from the main road to Khor'minos. The pits are large and deep enough for you to get a good look over the area, which for all intents and purposes are sand quarries. By the looks of it, they've been in use for a long, long time, although as far as you can tell the sand shows no sign of nearing exhaustion.

        Unlike the sand you'd find on a beach, this stuff is clearly of volcanic origin; the hard, black-gray specks are reminiscent of dust and ash than they are of sea and sand. Whatever process that happened to create these pits has long since stopped, leaving the minotaurs to exploit this expanse for building material.
rows.translation:
这个洞穴区域的一侧分布着几处巨大的灰色沙坑，这些沙坑被围栏隔开，与通往科尔米诺斯的主道路相隔离。这些沙坑规模庞大且深度足够，你可以从那里清楚地观察到周围的景象——实际上，这些地方就是沙矿。从外观上看，这些沙子显然已经被使用了很长时间，不过从表面来看，这些沙子丝毫没有耗尽的迹象。

        与海滩上的沙子不同，这些沙子显然是火山喷发产生的；那些坚硬的、黑灰色的颗粒更像是灰尘和火山灰，而不是海沙。无论是什么过程导致了这些坑洞的形成，那个过程早已停止了，因此弥诺陶洛斯们就可以利用这一大片区域来获取建筑材料。
rows.raw:
"
        This section of the caverns is dominated by several large pits of gray sand off to the side, fenced off from the main road to Khor'minos. The pits are large and deep enough for you to get a good look over the area, which for all intents and purposes are sand quarries. By the looks of it, they've been in use for a long, long time, although as far as you can tell the sand shows no sign of nearing exhaustion.

        Unlike the sand you'd find on a beach, this stuff is clearly of volcanic origin; the hard, black-gray specks are reminiscent of dust and ash than they are of sea and sand. Whatever process that happened to create these pits has long since stopped, leaving the minotaurs to exploit this expanse for building material."

rows.original:
As the tunnel bends to the east, the sound of flowing water catches your attention — a section of the cavern wall has been carved away, and a bronze grating installed into the rock face. Etched into a bronze plaque in both Belharan and minotaur script are the words %"authorized engineers only, by order of the king."

        Peering through it into the chamber beyond, you realize that water's being diverted away from the river into several culverts, flowing away and into the rock to be carried elsewhere. While Khor'minos is still a goodly distance away, it's not hard to infer that this is part of the city's water supply — there must be many more stations like these along the river's run. No wonder it's locked up tight; any city worth its salt isn't going to let just anyone mess with the water supply. As for the chamber itself... maintenance? Inspection? Who knows?
        
        There used to be a passageway to the west, but it's been collapsed and blocked with rubble. Maybe it was to protect this very water station from the imps? Who knows?
rows.translation:
隧道向东弯折时，流水声引起了你的注意。洞壁的一部分被凿开，岩面上装着一道青铜栅栏。旁边的青铜牌同时以贝尔哈兰文字和弥诺陶洛斯文字刻着：“奉国王之命，仅限授权工程师进入。”

        透过栅栏望向后方的房间，你发现一部分河水被引入数条涵洞，随后流进岩层，输送至别处。尽管科尔米诺斯离这里还有相当一段距离，却不难推断这正是城市供水系统的一部分；沿河肯定还有许多类似设施。难怪这里锁得如此严实——任何像样的城市都不会允许外人随意干预水源。至于房间本身……用于维护？检查？谁知道呢？
        
        这里原本有一条向西的通道，如今已经坍塌，被碎石封死。也许是为了保护这座供水站不受小恶魔侵袭？谁知道呢？
rows.raw:
"
        As the tunnel bends to the east, the sound of flowing water catches your attention — a section of the cavern wall has been carved away, and a bronze grating installed into the rock face. Etched into a bronze plaque in both Belharan and minotaur script are the words %"authorized engineers only, by order of the king."

        Peering through it into the chamber beyond, you realize that water's being diverted away from the river into several culverts, flowing away and into the rock to be carried elsewhere. While Khor'minos is still a goodly distance away, it's not hard to infer that this is part of the city's water supply — there must be many more stations like these along the river's run. No wonder it's locked up tight; any city worth its salt isn't going to let just anyone mess with the water supply. As for the chamber itself... maintenance? Inspection? Who knows?
        
        There used to be a passageway to the west, but it's been collapsed and blocked with rubble. Maybe it was to protect this very water station from the imps? Who knows?"

rows.original:
A huge, arched stone bridge connects the two halves of the minotaur kingdom, spanning the slowly-flowing waters of a river some fifty feet below you. Several wooden barricades have been erected across the expanse of the stone crossing, soiled with blood and seed from countless prior engagements between the city's defenders and the imp hordes ravaging the Undermountain.

        You can just make out a handful of small boats and rafts below that, abandoned in the evacuation, came loose and crashed against the pillars holding up the bridge. At this point, the river is perhaps thirty feet wide and largely placid.
rows.translation:
一座巨大的拱形石桥将弥诺陶洛斯王国的两部分连接在一起，这座桥横跨着下方约五十英尺处缓缓流淌的河流。在这段石桥上，人们设置了几道木制路障，这些路障上沾满了鲜血，还有无数次城市守军与那些肆虐在地下山脉中的怪物们交战后留下的残骸。

        在下方，你能看到几艘小船和筏子，它们在撤离时被遗弃在那里，后来松开了固定绳索，撞到了支撑桥梁的柱子上。此时，这条河的宽度大概有三十英尺，水流也比较平静。

rows.original:
A great aqueduct runs parallel to the tunnel here — held up near the cavern ceiling by columns, it's effectively another roadway, only for water instead of people. From where you're standing on the ground, you estimate that it's wide and deep enough for you to swim in, gallons upon gallons of water funneled from the river and towards the great city of Khor'minos. This section is exposed as it rounds a bend, but the aqueduct eventually connects back into the cavern wall after running for a mile or two, disappearing into the rock. 

        One can only imagine how many minotaurs worked for how many years to carve out and build the waterways that would supply their city and its outskirts with water... all with nothing but the natural flow of the river to drive it great distances. Unsurprising, then, that the womenfolk of Khor'minos are regarded as the greatest engineers of this land.
rows.translation:
一条巨大的引水渠与这条隧道并行延伸——它由柱子支撑着，架在洞穴的天花板上，实际上也是一条通道，只不过它输送的是水，而不是人。从你现在站立的位置来看，这条引水渠的宽度和深度都足以让你在里面游泳。成千上万加仑的水从河流中被引过来，最终流向那座伟大的城市——科尔米诺斯。在这个拐弯处，这段引水渠暴露在空气中；但它在流淌了一两英里之后，最终又会重新融入洞穴的墙壁中，消失在岩石之中。

        人们只能想象，究竟有多少弥诺陶洛斯耗费了多少年的时间，才开凿出这些为他们的城市及其周边地区提供水源的引水渠道。这一切都依靠河流的自然流动来推动物体行驶漫长的距离。因此，也就不足为奇了，为什么科尔米诺斯的女性会被视为这片土地上最伟大的工程师。

rows.original:
Past the bridge, the true approach to Khor'minos begins; with the River Ridell forming a natural barrier against the imps' advance, this portion of the Undermountain feels safer, for lack of a better word to put it. You don't see any cave-ins from the minotaurs attempting to frustrate the imps' advance, and the fortifications on this side of the river are still intact. Low walls, sharpened stakes, tents and firepits denote a semi-permanent forward camp on this side of the bridge; Calise's party is not the only expedition from Khor'minos out hunting imps.

        While you still have to be on your toes, at least the road doesn't feel so desolate from this point onwards — the northwards approach is a fairly straight tunnel without many branching paths or cubbyholes that could hide imps or other ambushers. No doubt the road was designed this way to force anyone approaching the city out into the open for a direct fight where the minotaur legionnaires would have an advantage.
rows.translation:
过了这座桥，真正通往科尔米诺斯的道路就开始了。里德尔河形成了天然的屏障，阻挡了那些小妖的进攻，因此这片地下山脉的区域显得更加安全——至少用这个词来形容还算合适。你不会看到任何由于弥诺陶洛斯试图阻碍小妖的进攻而导致的山体坍塌，而且河流这一侧的防御工事也依然完好无损。低矮的围墙、尖锐的木桩、帐篷以及火坑标志着桥这侧有一个半永久性的前哨营地；卡莉丝的队伍并不是唯一一支从科尔米诺斯出发去猎杀那些小妖怪的探险队。

        虽然仍然需要保持警惕，但至少从这里开始，道路不再那么荒凉了——向北的道路是一条几乎笔直的隧道，没有太多分支小路或可能隐藏小妖怪或其他埋伏者的隐蔽处。毫无疑问，这条道路的设计目的就是将任何接近这座城市的人逼到开阔地带，从而进行正面交锋——在这种情况下，弥诺陶洛斯军团的战士们就会占据优势。

rows.original:
The road to Khor'minos continues, flanked by numerous statues of bovine-featured women. The colossal likenesses stand tall to the cavern ceiling, beatific expressions upon their chiseled faces; the road winds beneath their outstretched arms, forcing all who come or go from the city to gaze upon them as they pass by their feet. The amount of work that must have gone into each one, a recreation of the finest detail and most prodigious size — it boggles the mind especially when there are no less then three dozen of the statues spaced along the road.

        [party.comp brint brienne
            |"The ancient mothers of the city," Brint helpfully points out as you pass under the colossuses' outstretched arms. "It's a bit of history that even I don't remember that well, but they're supposed to be the minds who oversaw the construction of Khor'minos and all the infrastructure that supports it."
            
            All of it?
            
            He nods. "The aqueducts and reservoirs, the sewerage systems, the milestones, torchposts and roads, the hippodrome and colosseum, the king's palace... you name it, they planned it out on the drawing board."
            
            Wow. What does one have to do to get up on there? Presumably not just any old building will do... 
            
            "You have to design some kind of landmark, something impressive. Something that will truly reflect the glory of the king and his strength. " Brint scratches his chin at that. "And be a woman, of course; they're called the ancient mothers for a reason. There's not much space about for really big things in the city center these days, and each ancient mother is expected to surpass the previous one in her works... I think the last one to have that title conferred upon her was in my grandmother's time."
            
            No men at all?
            
            "No." A shrug. "It's just the way it is."
            |"The ancient mothers of the city," Brienne helpfully points out as you pass under the colossuses' outstretched arms. "It's a bit of history that even I don't remember that well, but they're supposed to be the minds who oversaw the construction of Khor'minos and all the infrastructure that supports it."
            
            All of it?
            
            She nods. "The aqueducts and reservoirs, the sewerage systems, the milestones, torchposts and roads, the hippodrome and colosseum, the king's palace... you name it, they planned it out on the drawing board."
            
            Wow. What does one have to do to get up on there? Presumably not just any old building will do... 
            
            "You have to design some kind of landmark, something impressive. Something that will truly reflect the glory of the king and his strength. " Brienne scratches her chin at that. "And be a woman, of course; they're called the ancient mothers for a reason. There's not much space about for really big things in the city center these days, and each ancient mother is expected to surpass the previous one in her works... I think the last one to have that title conferred upon her was in my grandmother's time."
            
            No men at all?
            
            "No." A shrug. "It's just the way it is."
            
            Hey, she has a chance now... 
            
            "The thought is nice, [pc.name], but I'm really not cut out for that kind of work. Can you see me in fine silks doing all kinds of numbers? I can't."
            |For these women to be immortalized so in this absolutely ostentatious manner, they must have done the minotaur kings of the past and their rule a great service. No names are present anywhere, you notice — these legends must be recognizable from their features alone.
        ]
rows.translation:
通往科尔米诺斯的道路继续延伸，道路两旁矗立着许多以牛头为特征的女性雕像。这些巨大的雕像高耸在洞穴的天花板上，她们雕刻精致的脸上带着幸福的表情；道路从这些雕像伸展开来的手臂下方蜿蜒前行，因此所有进出这座城市的人，在经过这些雕像时都不得不注视着它们。每一座雕像都耗费了大量的心血，它们细致入微地再现了各种细节，体积也庞大惊人。尤其是当沿着道路排列着不下三十座这样的雕像时，这种匠心独运确实令人惊叹不已。

        [party.comp brint brienne
            |这座城市的古老缔造者们，”当你从那些巨像伸出的臂膀下穿过时，布林特热心地为你解释道，“这段历史就连我也有点记不清了，但据说正是他们策划并监督了霍尔米诺斯的建设，以及所有支撑这座城市的基础设施的建设。全部吗？”

他点了点头。“引水渠和水库、排水系统、里程碑、路标和道路、赛马场和斗兽场、国王的宫殿……只要你能想到的，他们都在图纸上规划好了。哇，要想登上那里，究竟需要做些什么呢？显然，不是随便哪座建筑都能胜任的……”

“你必须设计出一座具有标志性的建筑，一些令人印象深刻的东西。这样才能真正体现出国王的荣耀与他的强大实力。布林特听到这里，挠了挠下巴说道：“当然，还得是女性才行；她们被称为‘古代母亲’，肯定是有着原因的。如今在市中心，已经没有太多空间可以容纳那些庞大的建筑了，而且每一位‘古代母亲’都必须在自己的作品中超越前人。我想，上一次有人获得这个称号，应该是在我祖母的时代。”

“完全没有男性获得过这个称号吗？”

“没有。”她耸了耸肩，“就是这样的。
            |这座城市的古老缔造者们，”当你从那些巨像伸出的臂膀下穿过时，布蕾妮耐心地解释道，“这段历史就连我也有点记不清了，但据说正是他们策划并监督了科尔米诺斯的建造，以及所有支撑这座城市的基础设施的建设。
            
            全部这些？

她点了点头：“引水渠和水库、排水系统、里程碑、路标和道路、赛马场和斗兽场、国王的宫殿……只要你能想到的，他们都在图纸上规划好了。”

哇，要成为他们中的一员，究竟需要做些什么呢？显然，不是随便什么建筑都能满足条件的…… 
            
            你必须设计一些具有标志性的建筑，一些令人印象深刻的东西。那些真正能够体现国王的荣耀与威力的建筑。”布蕾妮若有所思地挠了挠下巴，“当然，这些建筑也必须体现出女性的特质——它们被称为‘古代母亲’，肯定是有着原因的。如今市中心已经没有太多空间可以建造那些庞大的建筑了，而且每一座‘古代母亲’的建筑都必须在前一座的基础上有所创新……我想，上一次获得这个称号的建筑，应该是我祖母那个时代建造的。
            
            一个男人都没有吗？

“没有。”她耸了耸肩，“就是这样的。”

嘿，现在她有机会了……

“这个想法挺好的，[pc.name]，但我真的不适合做那种工作。你能想象我穿着华丽的丝绸衣服，忙着处理各种数字吗？我根本做不到。
            |为了让这些女性以如此炫目的方式被永远铭记，她们必定为过去的弥诺陶洛斯国王们及其统治做出了巨大的贡献。你会发现，这些传说中没有任何名字被提及——人们一定是根据她们的外貌来识别她们的。
        ]

rows.original:
The road to Khor'minos continues along a north-south direction, milestones by the side of the tunnel faithfully marking the remaining distance to the great city. Every now and then, you pass by a small guard house — these are clearly meant for a duo, perhaps to keep order on the road and help travelers with difficulties, but as many as half a dozen to eight bovine bodies are crammed inside one of these small stationhouses, peering out at you with wary expressions. While travel to and from the city by civilians has been stopped, the troops fighting the imps on the front lines have to be supplied from the city, and as such the roads still have to be kept clear.

        Still, none of the soldiers stationed inside any of the waystations step out to accost you. Whether you're already so well-known that everyone recognizes you on sight, or they simply don't want to leave the safety of the stationhouse, that's anyone's guess, but the end result is still the same.
rows.translation:
通往科尔米诺斯的道路始终呈南北走向，隧道两侧设置的里程碑准确地标示着距离这座伟大城市的剩余距离。偶尔，你会经过一些小型警卫室——这些警卫室显然是为两人使用的，可能是为了维护道路秩序或帮助遇到困难的旅行者，但有时候，会有六到八头牛被关在这些小屋里，它们会用警惕的眼神盯着你。虽然平民往返该城市的交通已被中断，但前线与那些怪物作战的军队仍需要从该城市获得补给，因此道路必须保持畅通。

        不过，驻扎在各个补给站中的士兵们并没有出来打扰你。无论你是已经如此有名，以至于人们一见到你就能认出来，还是他们只是不想离开警局的安全环境，这些我们都无从得知，但最终的结果却是一样的。

rows.original: A side path running east-west over a wide expanse of cavern floor, intermittently held up by natural stone columns. Long, thin pinhead fungi sprout from the thin layer of muck that coats the floor here, giving the impression of blades of grass, or perhaps stalks of wheat were they a bit higher. With no one to clear them out, they've begun to overrun the dirt path, edging in from the sides; if the quarantine continues for too much longer there won't be a path through this section of the Undermountain anymore. You notice that the fungi grow all the more vigorously where the slime is thickest; presumably there's some sort of symbiotic relationship at play here.
rows.translation: 一条横贯洞穴地面的东西向小径，沿途不时有天然石柱作为支撑。在这层覆盖在地面上的薄薄淤泥中，生长着细长如针的真菌，它们看起来就像草叶，或者如果再高一些的话，就仿佛是麦穗。由于没有人来清理这些菌类，它们已经开始蔓延到这条土路上，从两侧逐渐侵占道路；如果隔离措施再持续太久，这段地下山脉的道路就将无法通行了。你注意到，在黏液最密集的地方，这些真菌的生长势头尤为旺盛；想必这里存在着某种共生关系。
