Something thick, slick, and glistening in what little light you have, running down and down like some kind of corrupted waterfall before disappearing into the masonry again.
        
        Down, down, down...
        "

rows.original: More of the span of the western bridge that connects the two sides of the moat. This one has been patched up somewhat with fresh bricks and mortar, although with it being giant-sized like everything else is the work has been slow. Judging by the extent of the reconstruction, the cult has been down here for a while now. Months? Longer? It's hard to tell exactly, but some work and effort has clearly gone into this, belying the fact that they intended to stay down here for a while. The water that lies beneath the bridge is dark, still, and no doubt deep; a giant-sized bridge no doubt has a giant-sized moat. Staring into its inky depths gives you a distinctly unsettling sensation in the pit of your stomach and an aching in the back of your mind, encouraging you to look away as quickly as possible. Even so, there's little doubt that there are things alive in the water; every now and then a darker patch of inky blackness flits about under the water's surface, followed by a bubble floating to the top. You don't want to fall in, that's for sure.
rows.translation: 西侧桥梁的跨度更大，它连接着护城河的两侧。虽然人们已经用新的砖块和砂浆对这座桥梁进行了一些修补，但由于它的规模巨大，维修工作进行得相当缓慢。从重建工作的规模来看，这个邪教组织在这里已经存在有一段时间了。是几个月？还是更久？很难准确判断，但显然他们投入了大量的精力和时间来进行这些工作，这说明他们确实打算在这里长期停留。 桥下的水显得幽暗、静止，而且无疑非常深邃；一座如此巨大的桥，必然也会有一条同样巨大的护城河。凝视着那漆黑的深渊，你会感到胃里一阵发紧，脑海中也会浮现出不安的感觉，这会促使你尽快移开视线。即便如此，几乎可以肯定的是，仍然存在各种物品水中充满了生机；偶尔，一些深沉的黑色阴影会在水面下闪动，随后会有气泡浮到水面上来。你肯定不会想掉进水里的……
rows.raw: "More of the span of the western bridge that connects the two sides of the moat. This one has been patched up somewhat with fresh bricks and mortar, although with it being giant-sized like everything else is the work has been slow. Judging by the extent of the reconstruction, the cult has been down here for a while now. Months? Longer? It's hard to tell exactly, but some work and effort has clearly gone into this, belying the fact that they intended to stay down here for a while. The water that lies beneath the bridge is dark, still, and no doubt deep; a giant-sized bridge no doubt has a giant-sized moat. Staring into its inky depths gives you a distinctly unsettling sensation in the pit of your stomach and an aching in the back of your mind, encouraging you to look away as quickly as possible. Even so, there's little doubt that there are things alive in the water; every now and then a darker patch of inky blackness flits about under the water's surface, followed by a bubble floating to the top. You don't want to fall in, that's for sure. "

rows.original: The moment you set foot onto the landing, you feel ill. Your body is fine, but your mind is telling your body it is not, and the paradox only makes the matter all the worse. The air has turned humid once again, and there's a metallic salt tang to it that you can't quite place but is unsettling all the same. And what is that ringing in your ears? Parts of the castle masonry have broken off, the shards cleared away... or dissolved; bare rock glistens and glimmers even as ominous noises sound from the passageway up ahead, teasing at the edges of your hearing. Madness...
rows.translation: 你一踏上那个平台，就立刻感到不适。你的身体并没有什么问题，但你的意识却告诉你的身体情况并不妙，这种矛盾只会让这种不适感更加严重。空气再次变得潮湿起来，其中还带着一种金属盐的刺鼻味道，你一时想不起这种味道是从哪里来的，但它确实让人感到非常不安。 而你耳边的鸣响，究竟是什么？ 城堡的砖石有的已经脱落，那些碎片要么被清理掉了，要么已经融化了；裸露的岩石闪烁着微光，而前方通道里传来的不祥声音，却在你的听觉边缘不断徘徊、挑逗着你…… 疯狂……
rows.raw: "The moment you set foot onto the landing, you feel ill. Your body is fine, but your mind is telling your body it is not, and the paradox only makes the matter all the worse. The air has turned humid once again, and there's a metallic salt tang to it that you can't quite place but is unsettling all the same. And what is that ringing in your ears? Parts of the castle masonry have broken off, the shards cleared away... or dissolved; bare rock glistens and glimmers even as ominous noises sound from the passageway up ahead, teasing at the edges of your hearing. Madness..."

rows.original:
A fork in the hallway, no less virulent than the landing that preceded it. Water gathers here in large pools, but unlike those which you've seen by the castle's entrance, these are completely devoid of life beneath the thin film of gray gunk that coats their surface. It looks oily, rainbow colors dancing across the sheen it creates on the surface... colors that dance in quite the disquieting fashion and maze your senses when you look too closely at them for too long.[silly
            | One might even say... the color of madness.
        ]
        
        The masonry is giving way to natural ground here, something which clearly was not part of the castle's original architecture. Almost as if whatever happened to sink the jotun castle this far beneath the waves also sheared off its bottom half...
rows.translation:
走廊里的一个岔路口，其危险性丝毫不亚于前一个拐角。这里会有大量的水积聚成水洼，但与你在城堡入口处看到的那些水洼不同，这些水洼表面覆盖着一层灰色的黏稠物，下面却完全没有任何生物存在。那层黏稠物看起来像油一样，表面还会闪烁着彩虹般的色彩……但这些色彩在阳光下跳动的方式实在令人不安，如果你长时间仔细观察，它们会扰乱你的感官。[silly
            | 甚至可以说……那是疯狂的颜色。
        ]
        
        这里的砌体结构已经逐渐被自然地层取代，这显然不属于这座城堡最初的建筑设计。仿佛是某种力量将这座巨型城堡沉入海底，同时也将其下装结构彻底破坏了……
rows.raw:
"A fork in the hallway, no less virulent than the landing that preceded it. Water gathers here in large pools, but unlike those which you've seen by the castle's entrance, these are completely devoid of life beneath the thin film of gray gunk that coats their surface. It looks oily, rainbow colors dancing across the sheen it creates on the surface... colors that dance in quite the disquieting fashion and maze your senses when you look too closely at them for too long.[silly
            | One might even say... the color of madness.
        ]
        
        The masonry is giving way to natural ground here, something which clearly was not part of the castle's original architecture. Almost as if whatever happened to sink the jotun castle this far beneath the waves also sheared off its bottom half..."

rows.original:
What looks to be a private bedroom, with three simple cots of canvas stretched over wooden frames laid side by side. The last embers of a charcoal fire burn in a brazier, a luxury in this air-starved place; the warmth of the dying flames provide at least a miniscule amount of respite from the cold and dark.

        Looking at the personal effects laid upon several crates, you'd guess that at least one of the room's occupants is Whisper. The other two... well, no points for guessing correctly. The cots look like they've been hardly slept in. Do demons sleep?
rows.translation:
那似乎是一间私人卧室，里面并排摆放着三张简单的帆布床，床架都是木制的。火盆中还燃烧着炭火的最后几缕余烬，在这个缺乏空气的地方，这无疑是一种奢侈；这些即将熄灭的火焰带来的温暖，至少能让人们暂时摆脱寒冷与暗影的侵袭。

        从那些放在几个箱子里的个人物品来看，你很有可能会猜测这个房间里至少有一个人是Whisper。至于另外两个人……嗯，想猜对的话可就难了。那些简易床看起来几乎没人睡过。恶魔会睡觉吗？
rows.raw: "What looks to be a private bedroom, with three simple cots of canvas stretched over wooden frames laid side by side. The last embers of a charcoal fire burn in a brazier, a luxury in this air-starved place; the warmth of the dying flames provide at least a miniscule amount of respite from the cold and dark.\n\n        Looking at the personal effects laid upon several crates, you'd guess that at least one of the room's occupants is Whisper. The other two... well, no points for guessing correctly. The cots look like they've been hardly slept in. Do demons sleep?"

rows.original:
A chamber of worship, apparently, to whatever gods the jotuns used to honor in ancient times. You don't recognize any of the symbols that adorn the walls here, but the fountains and altar, though worn with salt and age, still have an air about them that lingers despite the sanctity of this place having long been fouled. Murals line the walls here, depicting jotuns of all walks of life going about their daily business — cooking, sewing, fishing, counting coin — all the simple acts of life that together add up to the daily grind. It's interesting that the jotuns would honor such simple acts like these in so grand a fashion, but then you're no expert in [pc.bg acolyte|their particular brand of ]theology.

        You linger a moment, perhaps seeking some spark of the fire that used to animate this place, but there's none to be had. Even so, the brief respite this abandoned shrine allows in the face of the pressing madness up ahead is welcome.
rows.translation:
显然，这是一个用于祭祀的场所，用来供奉那些朱顿人在远古时代所崇拜的神明。你无法认出墙上装饰的那些符号，但那些喷泉和祭坛，尽管已经被盐分和岁月侵蚀得变得破旧不堪，依然散发着一种特殊的氛围。尽管这个地方的神圣性早已被玷污，这种氛围依然存在。这里的墙壁上绘满了壁画，描绘了各行各业的侏儒们正在从事着他们的日常活动——做饭、缝纫、钓鱼、数钱——所有这些看似平凡的生活琐事，共同构成了他们每天的生活。有趣的是，侏儒们会以如此隆重的方式来纪念这些平凡的行为，不过，你毕竟也不是这方面的专家罢了。 [pc.bg acolyte|他们特有的那种风格/方式 ]神学。

        你在这里停留片刻，或许试图寻找那些曾经让这个地方充满生机的元素，但早已无处可寻。即便如此，面对前方迫在眉睫的疯狂与混乱，这个被遗弃的神殿所提供的短暂宁静，依然令人感到欣慰。
rows.raw: "A chamber of worship, apparently, to whatever gods the jotuns used to honor in ancient times. You don't recognize any of the symbols that adorn the walls here, but the fountains and altar, though worn with salt and age, still have an air about them that lingers despite the sanctity of this place having long been fouled. Murals line the walls here, depicting jotuns of all walks of life going about their daily business — cooking, sewing, fishing, counting coin — all the simple acts of life that together add up to the daily grind. It's interesting that the jotuns would honor such simple acts like these in so grand a fashion, but then you're no expert in [pc.bg acolyte|their particular brand of ]theology.\n\n        You linger a moment, perhaps seeking some spark of the fire that used to animate this place, but there's none to be had. Even so, the brief respite this abandoned shrine allows in the face of the pressing madness up ahead is welcome."

rows.original: The gargantuan cavern that lies before you is slick — with water, with cum from the sapphic orgy that until recently was taking place here, with more gray goo and other unsavory things that coat the walls, the floor, the stalagmites. It pervades the air, drips down from the ceiling, sticks to your skin and coats the insides of your nose and mouth, madness given physical form and invading your flesh, permeating your bone and turning your organs inside-out. Though the selkies have long fled the chamber, constant whispers echo in the dark eaves, clearly words but never distinct enough to make out what they're saying... In the midst of it all, a large pool of dark water, its surface completely smooth with nary a ripple, its depths infinite, stretching beyond the mere physical into... into... something that cannot be expressed with your limited language alone. There is absolutely no light here — you are certain of that, and yet against all sense you're able to see. How is this possible? What madness is this? How can you trust that your senses are telling you the truth, or that your thoughts are even your own? It's not so much a sense of wrongness than it is a sense of alienness, of something from a world that is not yours, as foreign to you as you are to it.
rows.translation: 你眼前这座巨大的洞穴十分潮湿——洞壁上、地面上，甚至钟乳石上，都沾满了水、以及不久前在这里发生的女同性恋狂欢活动中留下的精液，还有许多灰色的黏稠物以及其他令人作呕的物质。它弥漫在空气中，从天花板上滴落下来，粘附在你的皮肤上，覆盖你的鼻腔和口腔内部——这种疯狂以物质的形式侵袭你的身体，渗透到你的骨骼里，甚至将你的内脏彻底颠覆。尽管那些海妖早已离开了那个房间，但持续的低语声仍在暗影的角落中回荡——那些显然是一些话语，但却始终无法分辨出它们在说些什么…… 而在这一切的中央，有一片巨大的暗影水域，它的表面平静得毫无波澜，深度仿佛无穷无尽，甚至超出了物理意义上的范围。这些事物最终会变成一些仅凭你有限的语言是无法表达的东西。 这里绝对没有任何光线——你对此非常确定，然而却违背常理地能够看到东西。这怎么可能呢？这是什么疯狂的行为？你怎么能相信自己的感官告诉你的都是真相，又怎么能确定自己的想法真的是属于自己的呢？这种感觉与其说是对错的感觉，不如说是一种陌生感那些来自另一个世界的事物，对你来说，就像你对于它们一样陌生。
rows.raw: "The gargantuan cavern that lies before you is slick — with water, with cum from the sapphic orgy that until recently was taking place here, with more gray goo and other unsavory things that coat the walls, the floor, the stalagmites. It pervades the air, drips down from the ceiling, sticks to your skin and coats the insides of your nose and mouth, madness given physical form and invading your flesh, permeating your bone and turning your organs inside-out. Though the selkies have long fled the chamber, constant whispers echo in the dark eaves, clearly words but never distinct enough to make out what they're saying... In the midst of it all, a large pool of dark water, its surface completely smooth with nary a ripple, its depths infinite, stretching beyond the mere physical into... into... something that cannot be expressed with your limited language alone. There is absolutely no light here — you are certain of that, and yet against all sense you're able to see. How is this possible? What madness is this? How can you trust that your senses are telling you the truth, or that your thoughts are even your own? It's not so much a sense of wrongness than it is a sense of alienness, of something from a world that is not yours, as foreign to you as you are to it."

rows.original: What has to be Tollus's makeshift laboratory, tucked away to the side for easy access to the lureling's... by-products. The bare essentials, as it were — the glassware of an alchemy set on a wooden table, several tomes stacked atop each other away from the damp, and a single lantern swinging from a hook in the ceiling. Even so, there doesn't seem to be anything that Tollus hasn't tried with the lureling's goop, not with the scorch marks that adorn one wall and great vats of the stuff lying in a corner. He appears to have been particularly desperate to put the ancient beast's distilled madness to good use somehow, and clearly hasn't left a single rock unturned in his quest. The man's clearly spent long hours in this place, a definite method to his madness; for all his derangement and evil, it won't do to underestimate Tollus...
rows.translation: 这应该就是托勒斯临时搭建的实验室了，它被安置在角落里，这样就能方便地获取那些诱饵产生的副产品。实验室里只有最基本的东西——一些放在木桌上的炼金器具，几本堆放在一旁、远离潮湿环境的书籍，以及一盏挂在天花板钩子上的灯笼。即便如此，这个实验室看起来还是相当简陋的。任何东西很明显，托勒斯曾经用过那些黏液，也试过用那些烧焦的痕迹来吸引那头古老的野兽；甚至把大量这种物质存放在角落里。他似乎迫切地想要利用这种野兽所散发出的疯狂力量来达到自己的目的，显然在寻找方法的过程中没有遗漏任何可能的线索。 这个人显然在这个地方耗费了大量时间，他的这种行为方式其实也是一种固定的模式……尽管他精神错乱、心怀邪恶，但绝对不能低估托勒斯的实力……
rows.raw: "What has to be Tollus's makeshift laboratory, tucked away to the side for easy access to the lureling's... by-products. The bare essentials, as it were — the glassware of an alchemy set on a wooden table, several tomes stacked atop each other away from the damp, and a single lantern swinging from a hook in the ceiling. Even so, there doesn't seem to be anything that Tollus hasn't tried with the lureling's goop, not with the scorch marks that adorn one wall and great vats of the stuff lying in a corner. He appears to have been particularly desperate to put the ancient beast's distilled madness to good use somehow, and clearly hasn't left a single rock unturned in his quest.\n \n The man's clearly spent long hours in this place, a definite method to his madness; for all his derangement and evil, it won't do to underestimate Tollus..."

rows.original:
A dead end here — save for a pillar of blue crystal shaped by giant hands, emitting the same resonance as all the other entrances to the Ways Between that you've encountered on your travels. This must be how Tollus, Leold and Whisper managed to escape — and you too, if you don't want this place coming down around your ears.

        Cracks are already spidering their way across the crystal's surface. You don't have much time left if you actually want to use the waystone.
rows.translation:
这里是一条死路——除非有一根由巨手塑造而成的蓝色水晶柱，它散发着与你在此途中遇到的所有通往“道路之间”的入口相同的共振能量。想必托勒斯、利奥尔德和惠瑟就是通过这条通道逃走的——如果你不想让这个地方瞬间崩塌的话，你也必须利用这条通道。

        水晶表面已经出现了裂缝，这些裂缝正在迅速蔓延。如果你真的想使用这块通道石，那么你剩下的时间已经不多了。
rows.raw: "A dead end here — save for a pillar of blue crystal shaped by giant hands, emitting the same resonance as all the other entrances to the Ways Between that you've encountered on your travels. This must be how Tollus, Leold and Whisper managed to escape — and you too, if you don't want this place coming down around your ears.\n\n        Cracks are already spidering their way across the crystal's surface. You don't have much time left if you actually want to use the waystone."

rows.original: The long road continues on, winding towards civilization. You can see fields on either side, though they don't appear to be actively farmed. Long wild grass grows along its edges, harboring any number of insects and animals.
rows.translation: 这条漫长的道路继续延伸，蜿蜒向着文明的方向前进。道路两侧都是田野，但看起来并没有有人在那里耕作。田野的边缘长满了野草，那里栖息着各种各样的昆虫和动物。
rows.raw: "\n            The long road continues on, winding towards civilization. You can see fields on either side, though they don't appear to be actively farmed. Long wild grass grows along its edges, harboring any number of insects and animals."

rows.original: You're standing in the mining camp. The smell of soot and charcoal wafts across your face as you take in the sights: blast furnaces, water-powered pulverizers, work-horses and, of course, booze distilleries. It's a place of work.
rows.translation: 你此刻正站在这个采矿营地中。熏焦的气味和木炭的味道扑面而来，同时你也将眼前的景象尽收眼底：高炉、水力粉碎机、勤劳的工人，当然还有那些酿酒厂。这里确实是一个充满忙碌与工作的地方。
rows.raw: "\n            You're standing in the mining camp. The smell of soot and charcoal wafts across your face as you take in the sights: blast furnaces, water-powered pulverizers, work-horses and, of course, booze distilleries. It's a place of work."

rows.original: The road is broadening a little, and you can see activity in the distance. Looks like you're drawing close to a crossroads and maybe even a village.
rows.translation: 道路逐渐变宽了，远处可以看到一些活动迹象。看来你正在接近一个十字路口，甚至可能是一个村庄。
rows.raw: "\n            The road is broadening a little, and you can see activity in the distance. Looks like you're drawing close to a crossroads and maybe even a village."

rows.original:
The crossroad is a bustling hive of activity at all hours, carriages and people traveling to who-knows-where carrying loads of tradable goods and weapons. Not many take the road leading out of the outskirts, and those that do are heavily armed or accompanied by what looks like mercenaries. You can hardly blame them.

            The other roads stretch to the east and west, containing the vast majority of goings-on. The crossroads are overseen by a towering statue of a Khor'minoan soldier, girded in his heroic panoply and plumed helm, but holding up a stone torch instead of the traditional sword of the legions. [flags.WAY_KMO|A radiant blue light shines from the torch like a beacon, illuminating the caves nearby.|The 'flames' of that torch are made of glass, and inside you can just make out a blue gemstone.]
rows.translation:
这个十字路口无论何时都热闹非凡，马车和行人络绎不绝，他们带着各种可交易的商品和武器，前往不知何处。很少有人会选择那条通往郊外的道路，而那些选择这条路的人，要么全副武装，要么身边跟着看起来像雇佣兵的人。你几乎无法责怪他们。

            其他道路向东西两侧延伸，那里发生了绝大多数的活动。这个十字路口处矗立着一座高大的霍尔米诺士兵雕像，这位士兵身着英勇的战装，头戴羽饰头盔，但他手持的却是石制火炬，而不是军团传统的剑。 [flags.WAY_KMO|一支火炬散发着耀眼的蓝光，如同信号灯一般，照亮了附近的洞穴。|那支火炬的“火焰”实际上是由玻璃制成的，仔细观察的话，可以看到里面有一颗蓝色的宝石。]
rows.raw:
"
            The crossroad is a bustling hive of activity at all hours, carriages and people traveling to who-knows-where carrying loads of tradable goods and weapons. Not many take the road leading out of the outskirts, and those that do are heavily armed or accompanied by what looks like mercenaries. You can hardly blame them.

            The other roads stretch to the east and west, containing the vast majority of goings-on. The crossroads are overseen by a towering statue of a Khor'minoan soldier, girded in his heroic panoply and plumed helm, but holding up a stone torch instead of the traditional sword of the legions. [flags.WAY_KMO|A radiant blue light shines from the torch like a beacon, illuminating the caves nearby.|The 'flames' of that torch are made of glass, and inside you can just make out a blue gemstone.]"

rows.original:
You walk down the dusty road, noting the sheer abundance of deserted farms surrounding it. There must be miles of what you presume would have been lush, fertile land only months beforehand. Now the grass is yellowing, and there are no livestock to be seen. What has the populace so spooked that they'd desert their livelihood like this?
        
        [kalysea.isFollower
            |"Reclaimed by nature soon enough," Kalysea murmurs.
        ]
rows.translation:
你沿着这条布满灰尘的道路前行，注意到周围有大量被遗弃的农场。这里原本应该是肥沃的土地，几个月前还应该是郁郁葱葱的，但现在草已经变黄了，也看不到任何牲畜的踪迹。究竟发生了什么，才会让人们如此惊慌失措，以至于抛弃自己的生计离开这里呢？
        
        [kalysea.isFollower
            |很快就会被大自然重新吸收吧，”卡莉希娅轻声说道。
        ]
rows.raw:
'
        You walk down the dusty road, noting the sheer abundance of deserted farms surrounding it. There must be miles of what you presume would have been lush, fertile land only months beforehand. Now the grass is yellowing, and there are no livestock to be seen. What has the populace so spooked that they'd desert their livelihood like this?
        
        [kalysea.isFollower
            |"Reclaimed by nature soon enough," Kalysea murmurs.
        ]'

rows.original:
[flags.NASH_GONE
            |You approach the worn-down shack, Nash's former marketplace. The inside is bare save for remnants of strewn-about hay, and even the sign outside is gone. There's nothing here.
            |You don't see Nash as you approach the shack, and a cursory inspection of the inside confirms your suspicion. He's gone, and you doubt he's coming back. [flags.NASH_CONFRONT 5|Looks like he's opted not to keep paying you to operate his business. You'll have to see what you can do about that if you run into him again...|Some small part of you is optimistic about it.]
            
            Either way, there's nothing to be done here.
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.NASH_GONE
            |你走近那间破败的小屋——那曾是纳什用来进行交易的场所。里面什么也没有，只有零散散落的干草残渣，就连外面的招牌也不见了。这里确实什么都没有。
            |当你走近那间小屋时，你并没有看到纳什。粗略地检查了一下内部，你的怀疑得到了证实——他已经离开了，而且你认为他不会再回来了。 [flags.NASH_CONFRONT 5|看起来他决定不再继续付钱给你来帮他打理生意了。如果你以后再遇到他，就得想想该怎么做才行……|你内心深处有一部分是对此抱有乐观态度的。]
            
            无论如何，这里也没有什么可以做的了。
        ]
rows.raw:
"
        [flags.NASH_GONE
            |You approach the worn-down shack, Nash's former marketplace. The inside is bare save for remnants of strewn-about hay, and even the sign outside is gone. There's nothing here.
            |You don't see Nash as you approach the shack, and a cursory inspection of the inside confirms your suspicion. He's gone, and you doubt he's coming back. [flags.NASH_CONFRONT 5|Looks like he's opted not to keep paying you to operate his business. You'll have to see what you can do about that if you run into him again...|Some small part of you is optimistic about it.]
            
            Either way, there's nothing to be done here.
        ]"

rows.original: The crossroads to the north are some way away but you can see the enormous gates to the west from here, looming over the rolling landscape like a fortress. The gleaming white walls of Khor'minos seem to challenge any would-be attacker — not that you can imagine a fighting force besieging the inside of a mountain. There are carts and carriages on the sides of the road, presumably owned by merchants. None of them seem to be selling anything right now, though.
rows.translation: 北面的岔路还在远处，但从这里你可以看到西边的那座巨大的城门，它耸立在连绵的风景中，宛如一座堡垒。科尔米诺斯那闪闪发光的白色城墙似乎在向任何想要进攻的敌人发起挑战——不过，你也很难想象会有哪支军队能够围攻一座位于山体内的城堡。道路两旁停着一些马车和货车，想必都是商人的财产。不过，现在看来，似乎没有一辆车在售卖任何商品。
rows.raw: "\n        The crossroads to the north are some way away but you can see the enormous gates to the west from here, looming over the rolling landscape like a fortress. The gleaming white walls of Khor'minos seem to challenge any would-be attacker — not that you can imagine a fighting force besieging the inside of a mountain. There are carts and carriages on the sides of the road, presumably owned by merchants. None of them seem to be selling anything right now, though."

rows.original: There's an alarming amount of signage on the side of the road. West — Khor'minos City South — Outskirt Territory East — Telduum Village Then a bunch of others pointing vaguely at what you think are residential and farming areas, long since deserted... [party.comp brint brienne|"Least the village's sign is still there," Brint grunts.|"Least the village's sign is still there," Brienne mutters.]
rows.translation: 路边的标识实在多得惊人。 西侧 — 科尔米诺斯城 南侧 — 郊区地带 东侧 — 特尔杜姆村 然后，还有其他人指着那些你认为应该是住宅区和农田的地方——那些地方早就被遗弃了…… [party.comp brint brienne|至少村子的标志还在那儿，”布林特嘟囔道。|至少村子的标志还在那里，”布蕾妮低声说道。]
rows.raw: " There's an alarming amount of signage on the side of the road. West — Khor'minos City South — Outskirt Territory East — Telduum Village Then a bunch of others pointing vaguely at what you think are residential and farming areas, long since deserted... [party.comp brint brienne|"Least the village's sign is still there," Brint grunts.|"Least the village's sign is still there," Brienne mutters.]"

rows.original: There's still a few merchants and the like out here, presumably waiting for their entry to be granted while they laze about on their carriages. You're glad you're not in their situation, especially given that most of them look bored out of their minds. A pity the goings-on in the colosseum can't be relayed out here.
rows.translation: 这里仍然有一些商贩之类的家伙，他们大概正在马车上无所事事地等待着被允许进入吧。你真庆幸自己没有处于他们的境地，尤其是看到他们中的大多数人都显得无聊至极。可惜，竞技场里发生的事情无法传到这里来。
rows.raw: "\n        There's still a few merchants and the like out here, presumably waiting for their entry to be granted while they laze about on their carriages. You're glad you're not in their situation, especially given that most of them look bored out of their minds. A pity the goings-on in the colosseum can't be relayed out here."

rows.original: You approach the gates of Khor'minos, tall and almost shining with radiance. [flags.KM_TOKEN |The guard captain gives you a nod of recognition — you can go through. You suppose the 'Champion of Winter City' moniker probably stuck in his head. |A guard-captain is standing here, his plumed helm marking him out from the other soldiers around. You’d need to get a token of entry by way of aiding Winter City to get in. ] You glance up, all the way to the top of the wall where you can see a couple of minotaur men carrying greatbows. It's hard to imagine an outward threat ever toppling the underground city.
rows.translation: 你走近了高耸入云、几乎散发着光芒的科尔米诺斯城门。 [flags.KM_TOKEN |卫队长向你点了点头表示认可——你可以通过了。你猜想，“冬城冠军”这个头衔大概让他印象深刻吧。 |这里站着一位卫队队长，他那饰有羽毛的头盔使他在周围的士兵中显得与众不同。 你需要通过帮助冬城来获得进入的资格。 ] 你抬头望去，视线一直延伸到墙的顶端，在那里你看到了几个手持巨弓的弥诺陶洛斯。很难想象有什么外部威胁能够摧毁这座地下城市。
rows.raw: " You approach the gates of Khor'minos, tall and almost shining with radiance. [flags.KM_TOKEN |The guard captain gives you a nod of recognition — you can go through. You suppose the 'Champion of Winter City' moniker probably stuck in his head. |A guard-captain is standing here, his plumed helm marking him out from the other soldiers around. You’d need to get a token of entry by way of aiding Winter City to get in. ] You glance up, all the way to the top of the wall where you can see a couple of minotaur men carrying greatbows. It's hard to imagine an outward threat ever toppling the underground city."

rows.original: You're at another crossroads, people bustling this way and that. It doesn't seem like anyone's going west, though — in fact, it doesn't look like much is over that way at all. Some fenced-in farmland is about it.
rows.translation: 你又来到了一个十字路口，周围人们来来往往，熙熙攘攘。不过，似乎没有人往西走——事实上，往那个方向望去，似乎什么也没有。那里只有一片被围起来的农田而已。
rows.raw: "\n            You're at another crossroads, people bustling this way and that. It doesn't seem like anyone's going west, though — in fact, it doesn't look like much is over that way at all. Some fenced-in farmland is about it."

rows.original:
"You [party.som|again|two again|lot again]," the farmer notes, giving you a nod from his post leaned up against the fence. "Still takin' the scenic route, huh?"

            "How's things?" you ask.
            
            "Same as always," he says, shrugging.
            
            The homestead seems same as ever, indeed.
rows.translation:
你[party.som|再次|又来两次|又一次]还是走这条风景优美的路线啊，”农夫一边说，一边从靠在篱笆上的位置向你点了点头。“情况怎么样？”

            “最近怎么样？”你问道。
            
            “还是一如既往，”他耸了耸肩说道。
            
            的确，这个农家庭院看起来还和以前一样。
rows.raw:
'
            "You [party.som|again|two again|lot again]," the farmer notes, giving you a nod from his post leaned up against the fence. "Still takin' the scenic route, huh?"

            "How's things?" you ask.
            
            "Same as always," he says, shrugging.
            
            The homestead seems same as ever, indeed.'

rows.original:
You're passing through a residential area, a cobbled path beneath your [pc.feet] and houses on either side of the street. It's likely only been a few months that the inhabitants have been away, but there are vines growing over fences and walls already. [flags.KM_SOLDIERS|The voices of the gambling minotaurs down the road occasionally reach you on the wind.|You think you can hear voices from down the road.]
        
        It looks like you can walk further into the residential district to the east, or back towards a real road to the west.
rows.translation:
你正穿过一片居民区，[pc.feet]下是鹅卵石小路，街道两侧都是房屋。虽然居民们离开才短短几个月，但篱笆和墙壁上已经长满了藤蔓。 [flags.KM_SOLDIERS|远处那些赌博的弥诺陶洛斯们的声音，偶尔会随着风传到你的耳边。|你似乎能听到远处传来的声音。]
        
        看起来你可以往东继续走进居民区，或者往西回到真正的道路上。
rows.raw: "You're passing through a residential area, a cobbled path beneath your [pc.feet] and houses on either side of the street. It's likely only been a few months that the inhabitants have been away, but there are vines growing over fences and walls already. [flags.KM_SOLDIERS|The voices of the gambling minotaurs down the road occasionally reach you on the wind.|You think you can hear voices from down the road.]\n        \n        It looks like you can walk further into the residential district to the east, or back towards a real road to the west."

rows.original: The road is flanked on either side by houses, a lot of them — and all of them overgrown with thin, grasping vines. It can't have been that long since people left their homes behind but nature is apparently very much intent on reclaiming them, and quickly. There's some noise from down the path.
rows.translation: 道路两旁排列着许多房屋，全都爬满了细长而四处攀附的藤蔓。人们离开家园应该还没有那么久，但大自然显然急着夺回这些房子。小路前方传来一些声响。
rows.raw: "The road is flanked on either side by houses, a lot of them — and all of them overgrown with thin, grasping vines. It can't have been that long since people left their homes behind but nature is apparently very much intent on reclaiming them, and quickly. There's some noise from down the path."

rows.original: The road transitions here like a river flowing out to sea, clunky cobbled stones giving way to a wide, well-paved pathway. It's mundane but you can't help but marvel at how much easier transport must be on such a surface. Little wonder Khor'minos is a miracle of logistics if their roads are built like this. [flags.KMO_E2 | |[party.has brint brienne |[brint.isBrienne |"What is this road made of?" you ask Brienne. "Do you know?" She smiles. "It's called 'concrete.' It's Khor'minoan history — we discovered how to make it. There's several layers of material below the top to kind of brace the road." That's a principle of road construction you'd [pc.bg scholar |only read about in books |never even considered ]. "That's impressive." Brienne seems to be happy you're praising her culture. "Isn't it? The roads are a big part of why we're in the position we're in! Or, well, were in. I dunno what's going on these days." She stares down the road. "Won't take long for the paths out of the city to degrade without engineers coming to fix them." |"What is this road made of?" you ask Brint. "Do you know?" "Yeah, s'called 'concrete'," he says. "Big reason behind Khor'minos' development 'n all that stuff. It's what the important roads get made out of — lots of layers beneath the top, too, to keep it all solid." That is a principle of construction you'd [pc.bg scholar |only read about in books |never even considered ]. "That's impressive." "Yeah, pretty crazy how something as simple as a road can be complicated under the surface," Brint says, looking down at it. "Guess that's why they leave it to the engineers." ] |You idly wonder what the surface is made from. It looks unlike anything you've known — like they poured liquid rock across the top of it. ] ]
rows.translation: 这条道路在这里发生了变化，就像一条流入大海的河流——原本粗糙的鹅卵石路面被宽阔而平整的道路所取代。虽然这种变化看似平凡，但人们不禁会惊叹：在这样的路面上行驶，交通必定会变得无比便捷。难怪如果科尔米诺斯的道路都是这样修建的，那么这个地方才会成为物流领域的奇迹。 [flags.KMO_E2 | |[party.has brint brienne |[brint.isBrienne |这条路是用什么材料建造的？”你问布蕾妮，“你知道吗？” 她微笑着回答：“这种材料叫做‘混凝土’。这是霍尔米诺人的智慧——我们掌握了制造这种材料的方法。在道路的表面下面，还铺设了几层其他材料，这些层结构能够为道路提供额外的支撑。” 这确实是一种非常先进的道路建造技术啊[pc.bg scholar |只在书中读到过 |甚至从未考虑过 ]真是令人印象深刻。” 布蕾妮似乎很高兴你对她们的文化表示赞赏。“不是吗？这些道路正是我们能够取得如今成就的重要原因之一！或者说，嗯是唉，这些天真是发生什么事了……”她望着前方道路说道，“如果没有工程师来维修，那些通往城外的小路很快就会变得无法通行了。 |这条路是用什么材料建造的？”你问布林特，“你知道吗？” “知道，这种材料叫做‘混凝土’，”他回答，“这也是科尔米诺斯得以发展的主要原因之一。所有重要的道路都是用这种材料建造的——在表面之下还会铺设很多层，以确保道路的稳固性。” 这种建造方式确实是一种非常实用且有效的工程技术。 [pc.bg scholar |只在书中读到过 |甚至从未考虑过 ]真是令人印象深刻。” “是啊，像道路这样简单的东西，其内部结构却可能变得如此复杂，真是不可思议，”布林特低头看着道路说道，“我想这就是为什么这种工作要交给工程师来做的原因吧。 ] |你不禁好奇，这个表面究竟是由什么材料构成的。它的外观完全不同于你以往所见过的任何东西——就好像有人把液态岩石倾倒在了它的表面一样。 ] ]
rows.raw: " The road transitions here like a river flowing out to sea, clunky cobbled stones giving way to a wide, well-paved pathway. It's mundane but you can't help but marvel at how much easier transport must be on such a surface. Little wonder Khor'minos is a miracle of logistics if their roads are built like this. The roads are a big part of why we're in the position we're in! Or, well, were in. I dunno what's going on these days." She stares down the road. 你已经来到了一个转折点。向北是一条漫长而孤独的道路，而向东则是通往外围地区的道路。有几个人从你身边经过，他们正朝着这两个方向中的某个方向前进。
        
        [flags.CENTAUR_REHOMED
            |曾经在这里的马车已经不见了，那些半人马们也一起消失了。它们现在正幸福地生活在一起。

rows.original: Nottia now, further up the road.
Marilla now, over the other side of the outskirts.
rows.translation: 现在，玛丽拉已经在郊区的另一边了。
rows.raw: "Marilla now, over the other side of the outskirts."

rows.original: The road here is dusty and well-used, grooves worn into its stones by wagons and the like. Its surface is still somewhat even, a fortune in a city occupied primarily by a hooved race.
rows.translation: 这条路布满灰尘，也被频繁使用，马车等交通工具在路面上留下了深深的车辙。尽管如此，它的表面仍然还算平整——对于一个主要由有蹄类动物居住的城市来说，这已经算是非常幸运了。
rows.raw: "The road here is dusty and well-used, grooves worn into its stones by wagons and the like. Its surface is still somewhat even, a fortune in a city occupied primarily by a hooved race."

rows.original:

        There's a trail off the side of the road that leads to Nottia's farm. You could go pay her

你面前的道路蜿蜒延伸，一侧是环绕着科尔米诺斯的巨大城墙，另一侧则是起伏的平原。你可能会猜测这些地方曾经是牲畜的牧场，但显然已经有一段时间没有被使用了——现在的草已经长到了几英寸高。[flags.NOTTIA_FARM|

Good thing you've spent a lot of time reading their literature]].

        The south road takes you back towards the outer regions of the outskirts.

You doubt he's looking forward to your company this time either|leads towards a crumbling section of the wall around Khor'minos. This entire side of the place looks neglected — surely they have the craftsmen to take care of it. Maybe you could check what's going on].
rows.translation:
你又一次站在了十字路口。通往北方的道路通向[flags.ROOH_MET|霍尔米诺斯的后门|根据这个标志上的文字——至少你是这么认为的，因为这些文字是用米诺斯文字写成的——这里应该是霍尔米诺斯的后门。[pc.bg scholar|幸好你花了很多时间阅读他们的相关资料。]]

        南边的道路会带你回到郊外的外围地区。
        
        而那条东边的破旧道路[flags.KMO_H2|正如你所知，这条路会通往贫民区，以及那里那位脾气暴躁的守卫。你肯定也觉得，这次他应该也不太希望见到你吧|这条路通向霍尔米诺斯周围那段正在坍塌的墙壁。这一整面墙看起来都被忽视了——他们肯定有工匠来维护它吧。或许你可以去看看到底发生了什么]。

rows.translation: 宫殿之门

rows.original:
The huge palatial doors separating the interior of Khor'minos's palace from the city at large are truly works of art in and of themselves, tremendous artifices of wood and brass sized for a castle. A pair of huge bronze braziers stand to either side of them, warming your bones against the coolness of the subterranean realm. 

        The literal red carpet's been rolled out from the doors to the throne all the way north of you, and there are several noteworthy peers of the kingdom gathered before you. Here, though, it's mostly royal guards from the Chargers, the king's elite bodyguard, as well as the pretty royal page standing by to announce important events.
rows.translation:
将科尔米诺斯宫殿内部与外部城市分隔开的那些巨大宫殿大门，本身就是真正的艺术杰作——这些用木材和黄铜制成的巨型工艺品，完全适合用于一座城堡。大门的两侧各摆放着一对巨大的青铜火盆，在地下世界的寒冷环境中，这些火盆能够温暖人们的身体。 

        从你所在的位置向北延伸，一路上都铺着红色的地毯，此刻，王国中几位地位显赫的贵族已经聚集在你面前。不过在这里，主要是由“冲锋者”皇家卫队组成的卫兵们——这是国王的精英保镖队伍，还有那位负责宣布重要事件的漂亮皇家侍女也在场。

rows.translation: 主展厅

rows.original: The main hall of the royal palace is wide and open, with regular marble pillars supporting the roof above and braziers offering warmth and light. Most of the city's peers are gathered here, talking amongst themselves. Tapestries hang heavily along the walls to either side of you, depicting the past kings and queens of the realm in highly-stylized, blocky stitch. The colors, though, are vibrant despite some tapestries likely being centuries old, captivating you with the wealth of dyes and gold thread used in their craftsmanship.
rows.translation: 皇家宫殿的主厅宽敞开阔，规整的大理石柱子支撑着头顶的天花板，而火盆则散发着温暖的光芒。城中的大多数贵族都聚集在这里，彼此交谈着。你的两侧墙壁上悬挂着厚重的挂毯，这些挂毯以风格夸张、线条粗犷的刺绣手法，描绘了这片土地上历任国王和王后们的形象。尽管这些挂毯可能已有数百年的历史，但它们的色彩依然鲜艳夺目，那些丰富的颜料和金线在制作过程中被巧妙地运用，从而让这些挂毯充满了魅力，令人无法抗拒。

rows.translation: 壁画艺术馆

rows.original: A long side hall of the palace has been opened up for the party, with a pair of long covered tables covered in snack dishes and pitchers of imported wine to sate the guests before the main meal. The walls here are the real attraction, though[party.has arona| — at least for everyone except Arona, who's busily filling a platter]. They're covered from end to end, top to bottom, in vibrantly-colored murals. Heroic scenes from Minoan mythology, legendary creatures from the mountains and the sea, even shadowy god-beasts from the cataclysm are all gloriously memorialized across the stone.
rows.translation: 宫殿中的一条长侧厅被专门用来举办这场聚会。那里摆放着一对长条形的覆盖着桌布的桌子，桌上摆满了各种小吃和进口葡萄酒，以便在主餐之前让宾客们先品尝一些食物。不过，这里的墙壁才是真正吸引人的地方[party.has arona|——至少对阿罗娜以外的人来说如此，她正忙着往盘子里装食物]。这些石壁从上到下、从左到右都被色彩鲜艳的壁画所覆盖。米诺斯神话中的英雄事迹、来自山川海洋的传说生物，甚至那些源自灾难中的神秘神兽，都被一一生动地记录在这些石壁上。

rows.translation: 奖杯室

rows.original:
The end of the side hall is given over to a display of trophies claimed by the kings of Khor'minos across the centuries. There are several taxidermied heads of dire wolves and bears lining the walls, and even the full stuffed body of a pouncing snow leopard so overgrown that its muscles would give any of the Chargers cause for shame. About two dozen stands form a broken circle in the middle of the room, displaying foreign swords and crowns from conquered lands and vanquished invaders alike, but the centerpiece of them all is by far the most impressive: a dragon's skull, easily the size of [brint.isBrienne|Brienne|Brint] with horns twice as long jutting back from its skull. Teeth like a hundred razor-sharp swords are bared in a perpetual snarl within its open muzzle.
        
        [flags.KMPL_R4||[ashe.around|"Oh, I'd recognize those chipped fangs anywhere," Ashe murmurs into your mind. "Old Saltmantle. He used to nest on the coast near here, until he grew too big for his britches and tried to tax the minotaurs for living near his domain. I tried to warn him that was a fool's endeavor but he was centuries my senior and assured me he knew better. Rather grisly to see my kin put up as a display of prowess like this, I must say..."]]
rows.translation:
侧厅的尽头陈列着几个世纪以来科尔米诺斯国王们获得的战利品。墙壁上挂着几只经过标本处理的凶狼和熊的头部，甚至还有一只被制成标本的雪豹的完整身体——它的肌肉发达程度足以让任何“冲锋者”成员都感到羞愧。房间中央，大约有二十多个展台围成了一个不规则的圆圈，上面陈列着从被征服的地区以及被击败的入侵者手中缴获的外国剑刃与王冠。然而，其中最引人注目的无疑还是那个位于中心的展品：一个巨龙的头骨，其大小显然远超常人想象。 [brint.isBrienne|布蕾妮|布林特]它的头骨上长着两倍于普通长度的角，向后突出。当它的嘴巴张开时，里面会露出上百把锋利如剃刀的牙齿，始终处于紧咬的状态。
        
        [flags.KMPL_R4||[ashe.around|哦，那些有缺口的獠牙，我在任何地方都能认出来，”阿什在你的脑海中低声说道。“老盐毯兽。它以前经常在这附近的海岸边活动，直到它长得太大，觉得自己有资格向那些生活在它领地附近的牛头人征税。我曾试图警告它，这种做法简直是愚蠢至极，但它比我年长几个世纪，坚信自己知道该怎么做。说实话，看到我的同类以这样的方式来展示自己的‘实力’，实在是一件令人不忍直视的事情……]]
rows.raw:
"
        The end of the side hall is given over to a display of trophies claimed by the kings of Khor'minos across the centuries. There are several taxidermied heads of dire wolves and bears lining the walls, and even the full stuffed body of a pouncing snow leopard so overgrown that its muscles would give any of the Chargers cause for shame. About two dozen stands form a broken circle in the middle of the room, displaying foreign swords and crowns from conquered lands and vanquished invaders alike, but the centerpiece of them all is by far the most impressive: a dragon's skull, easily the size of [brint.isBrienne|Brienne|Brint] with horns twice as long jutting back from its skull. Teeth like a hundred razor-sharp swords are bared in a perpetual snarl within its open muzzle.
        
        [flags.KMPL_R4||[ashe.around|"Oh, I'd recognize those chipped fangs anywhere," Ashe murmurs into your mind. "Old Saltmantle. He used to nest on the coast near here, until he grew too big for his britches and tried to tax the minotaurs for living near his domain. I tried to warn him that was a fool's endeavor but he was centuries my senior and assured me he knew better. Rather grisly to see my kin put up as a display of prowess like this, I must say..."]]


"

rows.translation:
侧厅的尽头陈列着几个世纪以来科尔米诺斯国王们获得的战利品。墙壁上挂着几只经过标本处理的凶狼和熊的头部，甚至还有一只被制成标本的雪豹，它的体型如此庞大，以至于它的肌肉体积会让任何“冲锋者”成员都感到羞愧。房间里大约有二十多个展台围成了一个不规则的圆圈，上面陈列着从被征服的地区以及被击败的入侵者手中缴获的外国剑刃和王冠，但其中最引人注目的无疑还是那个位于中心的展品：一个巨龙的头骨，其大小显然远超常人想象。 [brint.isBrienne|布蕾妮|布林特]它的头骨上长着两倍于普通长度的角，向后突出。当它的嘴巴张开时，里面会露出上百把锋利如剃刀的牙齿，始终处于紧咬的状态。
        
        [flags.KMPL_R4||[ashe.around|哦，那些有缺口的獠牙，我在任何地方都能认出来，”阿什在你的脑海中低声说道。“老盐毯兽。它以前经常在这附近的海岸边活动，直到它长得太大，觉得自己有资格向那些生活在它领地附近的牛头人征税。我曾试图警告它，这种做法简直愚蠢至极，但它比我年长几个世纪，坚信自己知道该怎么做。说实话，看到我的同类以这样的方式来展示自己的‘实力’，实在让人感到有些悲哀……]]

rows.translation: 火坑

rows.original: A circular fire pit dominates the space just before the kingly throne, shedding both brilliant light and soothing warmth throughout the palace. Stakes have been driven into the coals, on which hang chickens, pigs, and flanks of beef. A rich crust of herbs clings to the meat, and there are platters of vegetables on racks beneath them soaking up heat and dripping juices alike. The smell here's incredible, almost overwhelming. Gods, when was the last time you ate?
rows.translation: 在王座前的空地上，一个圆形的火坑占据了中心位置，它散发出耀眼的光芒，同时也为整个宫殿带来了温暖的氛围。人们将木桩插入炭火中，鸡、猪和牛肉都被悬挂在上面烤制。肉的表面覆盖着一层浓郁的香草调味料，而在火坑下方的架子上，还摆放着装满蔬菜的盘子，这些蔬菜也在吸收着热力，不断滴落着汁液。这里的气味实在令人难以抗拒，几乎让人窒息……天啊，你上一次吃东西是什么时候呢？

rows.translation: 贵宾席

rows.original: While there are several trestle tables set up around the fire pit to cater to the city's lower nobility and military elite, but above them sits a great oakwood crescent on a raised platform. A prodigious chair sits at the center, flanked by a pair of equally regal ones — sized for a man and woman — and several others spreading out to the ends. Beautiful candelabras and glistening silverware are arrayed for the king and his most honored guests, a small fortune left casually on display.
rows.translation: 虽然火坑周围摆放了几张供城市低阶贵族和军事精英使用的折叠桌，但在它们上方，有一个建在高台上的巨大橡木月形结构。月形结构的中央摆放着一把华贵的椅子，两侧各有一把同样奢华的椅子——分别是为男性和女性准备的——此外还有几把椅子分布在月形结构的边缘。精美的烛台和闪闪发光的银器为国王和他最尊贵的宾客们准备好了，这些珍贵的物品被随意地陈列在那里，显得格外引人注目。

rows.translation: 皇家王座

rows.original:
The king's throne looms above you, black as midnight and draped over with the pelt of a fearsome dire bear. Cushions have been laid out on the bare wood, but they're clearly a more recent addition; the throne itself has a gravitas to it that speaks of passing centuries, its arms worn down where the fingers of countless monarchs have held it through crises stretching back to the world-shattering Godswar. 

        There's a curtained arch behind the throne, through which the royal family can come and go as they please.
rows.translation:
国王的宝座高悬在你头顶上方，通体漆黑，如同午夜般幽暗，其座椅表面覆盖着一只凶猛的恐熊的皮毛。光秃秃的木制座椅上铺着软垫，但这些软垫显然是后来添加的；而宝座本身所散发出的庄严气息，无疑诉说着它历经了数个世纪的风雨沧桑——无数君王在面对那些足以改变世界的危机时，都曾紧紧握住它的扶手。 

        王座后面有一道帘幕遮住的拱门，王室成员可以通过那里自由进出。

rows.original:
The palace's grand foyer is palatial indeed, all marble flooring and pillars and crystal chandeliers with flickering candles casting a brilliant glow across it all. Plinths line the walls, adorned with lifelike marble busts of the men and women that once might have occupied this palace, or at least its owner's thoughts. Indeed, if you didn't know better, just looking at this room you'd be forgiven for thinking you were in ancient Belhar rather than a demon's boudoir. 

        A cracked door to the west hints at further wings of the palace — a grand dining room, and more beyond that, but you've no need to trek there now. The bulk of the living space is directly ahead of you.
rows.translation:
这座宫殿的宏伟门厅确实堪称富丽堂皇，大理石地面、圆柱以及水晶吊灯上闪烁的烛光为整个空间增添了绚丽的光彩。墙壁上排列着基座，上面摆放着那些曾经居住在这座宫殿中的人们的大理石半身像，这些雕像栩栩如生，仿佛能够再现那些人的容貌与风采。至少，这些雕像一定反映了宫殿主人的某些想法与回忆。的确，如果你不了解内情，仅仅看着这个房间，你也很可能会误以为自己身处古老的贝尔哈尔，而不是某个恶魔的闺房。

        西边那扇裂开的门暗示着宫殿中还有其他区域——一座宏伟的餐厅，以及更多的地方，但你现在没有必要去那里探查。大部分的生活空间就在你正前方。

rows.original: The palatial foyer carries on from the southern entrance, here occupied by a grand staircase that stretches up towards the higher floors. A small, almost hidden, door behind the marble steps leads down beneath the main floor. Off to the east is a lavishly decorated sitting room, from which emanates the alluring smell of tea and cookies.
rows.translation: 这座宏伟的大厅从南侧入口延伸开来，那里有一座宏伟的楼梯，通向更高的楼层。在大理石台阶后面有一扇小巧的门，几乎隐藏在视线之外，这条门通向主楼层的下方。往东走，会看到一间装饰华丽的客厅，从那里飘来诱人的茶香和饼干味。

rows.original:
Kasyrra's little sitting room would itself be a fine manor back in Hawkethorne: there's gold and marble everywhere, with mahogany tables and chairs surrounding a fireplace in which flickers a flame without fuel. Perhaps it's been burning since before the demoness found this place. There are two plinths in this room, flanking the mantle, but whatever busts might once have adorned them are long gone now. Instead, Kas has shifted them up so they can serve to display her massive two-headed axe, addings its faintly-glowing runes to the light of the fire.
        
        [flags.DREAM_KAS_ACTIVE|The demon queen herself is lounging in front of the fire, enjoying a glass of red wine. She smiles when you draw near, patting the couch invitingly.

        There's a plate of fresh cookies laid out on her coffee table, piping hot.]
rows.translation:
在鹰棘镇，卡希拉的那个小客厅本身就可以被视为一座豪华的宅邸：到处都是黄金和大理石，红木制的桌椅环绕着一个壁炉，而壁炉里燃烧的火焰其实并没有燃料。或许，从那个女恶魔发现这个地方之前，这火焰就已经在燃烧了。这个房间里有两块基座，它们位于壁炉的两侧，但原本装饰在上面的半身像早已不见了。卡丝把它们搬了上来，用来展示她那把巨大的双头斧；斧头上那些微微微发光的符文，在火光的映照下显得更加醒目。
        
        [flags.DREAM_KAS_ACTIVE|恶魔女王正坐在火堆前，悠闲地品着一杯红葡萄酒。当你靠近时，她露出了微笑，还邀请性地拍了拍沙发。

        她的咖啡桌上还放着一盘热气腾腾的新鲜饼干。]

rows.original:
A broad, crystal-illuminated hall stretches out to either side from the top of the grand stairs. Tapestries hang from the wall, displaying coats of arms: you recognize the Belharan hawks most prominently[pc.bg scholar
            |, but there's also the crests of the last royal family, the college of Estelore, the family crest of House Demitresca — a famed military lineage — and the ice-white wolves of the Gunvaldsen jarldom. Oh, and the hawk rising above a tower that represents the Hawkstone Barony too!
            |[pc.isCunning
                |, but there's also the crests of the last royal family, the college of Estelore, the family crest of House Demitresca — a famed military lineage — and the ice-white wolves of the Gunvaldsen jarldom. Oh, and the hawk rising above a tower that represents the Hawkstone Barony too!
                |, and what looks like the crest of Hawkstone Barony as well. The rest, though, you have no idea.
            ]
        ]
rows.translation:
一条宽阔的、被水晶灯光照亮的走廊从宏伟楼梯的顶部向两侧延伸开来。墙上悬挂着各种挂毯，上面绘有各种纹章；其中，贝尔哈兰家族的鹰徽最为显眼，一眼就能辨认出来。[pc.bg scholar
            |还有最后一位王室的族徽、埃斯托洛学院、德米特雷斯卡家族的族徽——这个著名的军事世家——以及冈瓦尔德森伯爵领地中那些冰白色的狼。哦，还有那只翱翔在塔楼之上的鹰，它代表着霍克斯通男爵领地呢！
            |[pc.isCunning
                |还有最后一位王室的族徽、埃斯托洛学院、德米特雷斯卡家族的族徽——这个著名的军事世家——以及冈瓦尔德森伯爵领地中那些冰白色的狼。哦，还有那只翱翔在塔楼之上的鹰，它代表着霍克斯通男爵领地呢！
                |还有那些看起来像是霍克斯通男爵领地的徽章图案。不过，其余的部分，你根本一无所知。
            ]
        ]

rows.original: Beyond the guest rooms along the upper hall is a grand balcony. You're sure it might have a truly grand view, too, were this palace back in the world below; as it is now, all you see is swirling mist and faint, distant glimmers of crystal from this strange plane. You can make out some of the Foothills down below, though, including the crumbled tower directly below you and the huge black gates leading to Khor'minos. If you squint, you can even see the walls of Hawkethorne in the distance.
rows.translation: 沿着上层大厅延伸的客房之后，是一处宽敞的阳台。如果你想象这座宫殿还位于下方的世界中，那么这里肯定能展现出令人叹为观止的景色；然而如今，在这个奇异的位面中，你所能看到的只有缭绕的迷雾以及远处那些若隐若现的水晶光芒。不过，你还是能够辨认出下方的一些山丘，包括正下方那座摇摇欲坠的塔楼，以及通向科尔米诺斯的巨大黑色大门。如果仔细凝视，甚至还能隐约看到鹰棘镇的城墙。

You're sure it might have a truly grand view, too, were this palace back in the world below; as it is now, all you see is swirling mist and faint, distant glimmers of crystal from this strange plane. You can make out some of the Foothills down below, though, including the crumbled tower directly below you and the huge black gates leading to Khor'minos. If you squint, you can even see the walls of Hawkethorne in the distance."

rows.original: The master bed sits alone at the far eastern end of the house, up a short flight of stairs from the other living spaces. You should hardly be surprised it's as gaudy as it is: the bed's huge and heart-shaped, and while it has the structure for a canopy, there's a mirror held aloft by that wood that lets whoever's on bottom see all the action like a spectator. You could easily fit a dozen lovers into that thing at once, and the rugs around it are so plush that a whole orgy would be comfortable. And that's before you take into account the enormous bath tub in the en-suite...
rows.translation: 主卧室位于房子的最东端，需要爬上一段短楼梯才能到达，与其他生活区域是分开的。它的装饰如此华丽，其实也不足为奇：这张床非常大，呈心形设计，虽然它的结构上是可以安装床幔的，但实际上那里装了一面镜子，当有人躺在床上时，就可以像观众一样看到周围发生的一切。那个空间里一次可以轻松容纳十几对恋人，周围的地毯也非常柔软，即使是一场大规模的群交活动也能让人感到非常舒适。当然，这还没有包括套间里那个巨大的浴缸……

rows.original: Kasyrra keeps a fully-equipped sex dungeon under the palace. Ropes and chains hang all over, along with dozens of contraptions meant to trap submissives in sexual bliss — or sexual torture, looking at some of these things. You're not alone down here, of course: there's perhaps two dozen women chained up down here, mostly elves and cowgirls from Kasyrra's conquests, but a few humans and catfolk too. They're all bound and left on devices that can keep them stimulated while their mistress is busy with you: either with magical sextoys vibrating away inside them, or resting with their twats splayed over sharp-angled wooden horses. All of the girls are pregnant, and a few are enormously gravid. They each have a collar around their necks, set with a name tag and a thumb-sized blue gemstone, similar to the one Kasyrra first gave you when you met, and which now forms the basis of your waystone charm. A pair of succubi clad in latex domme-wear are strutting around between the girls, tending to their needs. The demons nod to you defferentially, and while they have whips on their belts, they don't stray their hands to their weapons of torment even for a moment when you wander by. Well trained, these ones.
rows.translation: 卡希拉在宫殿的地下建造了一个设施齐全的性爱地牢。那里挂满了绳索和链条，还有数十种专门用来将顺从者囚禁在性欢愉之中——或者说是性折磨之中的装置，看看那些东西就知道了。当然，你在这里并不孤单：这里大概有二十来名女性被锁在这里，她们大多是卡希拉在征战过程中俘获的精灵和女牛仔，但也有一些人类和猫族。她们都被固定在这些特殊的装置上，这样当她们的主人忙于与你相处时，这些装置就能持续让她们保持兴奋状态——要么是那些会振动的魔法性玩具在她们体内发挥作用，要么就是让她们的阴部紧贴在那些角度尖锐的木制装置上。 所有的女孩都怀孕了，其中还有几人极大地她们都怀孕了。每个人的脖子上都戴着项圈，项圈上挂着名牌，还镶嵌着一颗拇指大小的蓝色宝石——这颗宝石与卡希拉在你们初次见面时送给你的那颗宝石相同，而如今，这颗宝石也成为了你那枚“路石护符”的核心组成部分。 一对穿着乳胶制束缚衣的女恶魔在那些女孩们中间来回走动，满足她们的各种需求。这些恶魔恭敬地向你点头致意，虽然她们腰间别着鞭子，但每当你经过时，她们甚至不会有一刻将手伸向那些折磨人的武器。这些家伙训练有素啊。

rows.original:
The bottom of a dusty spiral stairwell leading away from the rear of the temple's courtyard. While the central pillar is still sturdy, several of the steps' flagstones have come loose and shift precariously underfoot as you pass by. The air is musty, but there are clearly ventilation channels in the walls as you descend. Maybe the goos stopped them up with all their proliferation about these parts? At least the stairs are reasonably wide, which makes sense if minotaur bodies were to be moved down them all the time... 

        Running parallel to the stairs is a lift shaft, but all that remains of the mechanism are the platform itself and a bunch of pulleys. The ropes must either have frayed away in the intervening time, or more likely been devoured by the goos that plague the temple grounds. Not that you'd have been willing to trust a lift under these circumstances...
rows.translation:
这是通往神殿庭院后方的落满灰尘的螺旋楼梯底部。中央立柱依然牢固，但好几级台阶的石板已经松动，你经过时，它们会在脚下危险地晃动。越往下走，空气越显霉闷，不过墙上显然设有通风孔。也许是这一带四处繁殖的黏液怪把它们堵住了？至少楼梯还算宽敞；若是经常需要把弥诺陶洛斯的身躯运下来，这样的设计倒也合理…… 

        与楼梯并行的是一条升降梯井，但整套机构如今只剩平台和一组滑轮。绳索或许早已在漫长岁月中磨损腐烂，更可能是被肆虐神殿庭院的黏液怪吃掉了。反正这种情况下，你也不会愿意相信这台升降梯……

rows.original:
A well-decorated chamber, most likely the part of the catacombs which was open to the public. Frescoes line the walls here depicting the goddess of death, time and empires in various well-known legends — that, and her accompanying symbols of skulls, hourglasses and moons. That and the stone seats and altar were clearly built to impress, as well as the statue of the goddess herself, not that there's anyone but you to gaze upon her likeness, or at least as the minotaurs perceive her. Rows of mushrooms grow in planters that line the walls, withered from lack of tending, their fungal bodies dry adding to the musty smell that pervades the air.

        A place for funerals, then? It looks like some kind of rite was going on here before it was so rudely interrupted, a brass candlestick upon the altar now knocked over, a dusty bowl upended at its feet. There isn't any body around, though, not even skeletal remains... maybe the goos ate that?
        
        Despite the faded beauty of this place, there's still a distinct sense of foreboding danger and the faint chill of the restless dead — which emanates from a set of heavy granite doors set in the northern wall, covered with the seal of an hourglass and moon.
rows.translation:
这个装饰精美的房间很可能是墓穴中向公众开放的部分。墙壁上绘有壁画，描绘了死亡女神、时间以及各种著名传说中的帝国——还有象征她的骷髅、沙漏和月亮等图案。那些石制座椅和祭坛显然是为了给人留下深刻印象而建造的，就连女神的雕像也是如此。当然，除了你之外，应该没有其他人会去注视她的形象吧——至少按照弥诺陶洛斯的认知方式来说是这样。墙壁两侧的花盆里长着一排排蘑菇，但由于缺乏照料，它们都已经枯萎了，干枯的菌体使得空气中弥漫着一股霉味。

        那么，这里应该是用来举行葬礼的地方吧？看起来在葬礼被粗暴地打断之前，这里正在举行某种仪式——祭坛上的黄铜烛台现在已经倒了下来，脚边还有一个积满灰尘的碗也被打翻了。不过，这里并没有任何尸体，甚至连骨骼的残骸都没有……也许那些鹅把那些东西吃掉了？
        
        尽管这个地方已经失去了昔日的繁华与美丽，但这里依然弥漫着一种令人不寒而栗的危险气息，以及那些不安宁的死者所散发出的阴冷气息——这种气息源自北墙上一扇由花岗岩制成的重型大门，大门上刻着沙漏和月亮的图案。

rows.original:
As one descends into the Tiran catacombs, its humble origins become clear; while the floor and to some extent the walls have been smoothed out, mushroom-wood beams bound with bronze form supports for the walls and ceiling, and while the minecart tracks may be gone the grooves they've left in the ground remain. Soft moaning and the sounds of wetness and fluid echo to you faintly down the tunnels, reminding you that you're not alone here.

        Several trowels and small bags of plaster lie abandoned on a bench not too far from the entrance; it looks like the Tirans had been intending to perform some repairs on the walls. Guess that's on indefinite hold now, huh...
rows.translation:
当人们走进蒂拉教会的地窖时，它的朴素起源便变得清晰可见。虽然地面以及部分墙壁已经被打磨得平整，但用青铜绑扎的蘑菇木梁仍然为墙壁和天花板提供了支撑。虽然矿车轨道可能已经消失，但它们在地面留下的沟槽依然存在。隧道中传来微弱的呻吟声，以及潮湿和液体的声响，这些声音提醒着你，这里并不只有你一个人。

        在离入口不远的长椅上，放着几把铲子和几小袋石膏粉，看来那些暴君原本是打算修补这些墙壁的。看来这个计划现在要无限期地推迟了，是吧……

Guess that's on indefinite hold now, huh..."

rows.original: Here, the city of the sleeping begins in earnest — numerous recesses are carved into the walls, absolutely overflowing with yellowed, crumbling bones as the Tirans filled the foremost tunnels first for ease fo access. Most of them are minotaur, some not, but all of them certainly belonged to people at some point. Each one gives the feeling of — no, each one is a mass grave, a macabre mess of the unnamed who were brought to the Tirans, people who no one cared to come forward and identify after their passing. Nameless in life, nameless in death; the only epitaph these poor souls have in the end are single lines in the minoan language etched in between each recess. The bones rattle and stir in their repose... but the air is still.
rows.translation: 在这里，沉睡之城才真正展开：墙壁上凿出无数壁龛，里面堆满了泛黄、碎裂的骨头，因为蒂拉教徒为了方便取用，先填满了最靠前的隧道。大部分骨头属于牛头人，也有一些不是，但它们曾经无疑都属于活生生的人。每处壁龛都让人觉得像是——不，每处壁龛就是一座集体坟墓，埋着那些被送到蒂拉教徒手中、死后无人愿意出面辨认的无名之人。生前无名，死后也无名；这些可怜的灵魂最终只有壁龛之间用米诺斯语刻下的短短一行铭文。 骨头安放在那里，却发出细碎的碰撞声、微微动了起来……然而空气一丝不动。
rows.raw: "Here, the city of the sleeping begins in earnest — numerous recesses are carved into the walls, absolutely overflowing with yellowed, crumbling bones as the Tirans filled the foremost tunnels first for ease fo access. Most of them are minotaur, some not, but all of them certainly belonged to people at some point. Each one gives the feeling of — no, each one is a mass grave, a macabre mess of the unnamed who were brought to the Tirans, people who no one cared to come forward and identify after their passing. Nameless in life, nameless in death; the only epitaph these poor souls have in the end are single lines in the minoan language etched in between each recess.\n\n The bones rattle and stir in their repose... but the air is still."

rows.original: A combined break and storage room for those who mind the tunnels, a single beacon of life in this domain of death. Boxes of various sundry materials line the walls — mushroom-wood, stone, coal — and a single cot, stool and low table reveal the room's purpose, an empty plate and tin mug lying forlornly on the latter. Given the smell of oil redolent in the air, it's a small wonder nothing's actually spontaneously caught fire yet; there's supposed to be ventilation as evidenced by the presence of a grate high in the wall, but that's all stopped up with slimy gunk.
rows.translation: 这间房兼作负责照看隧道者的休息室和储藏室，是这片死亡之地仅有的一点生气。墙边摆满了装着各种材料的箱子——蘑菇木、石料、煤炭——而一张简易床、一把凳子和一张矮桌也说明了房间的用途；桌上孤零零地放着一个空盘子和一只锡杯。空气中弥漫着浓重的油味，竟然还没有东西自燃，实在令人惊讶。墙壁高处有一道格栅，表明这里原本设有通风口，可如今已被黏糊糊的污物堵死了。

Boxes of various sundry materials line the walls — mushroom-wood, stone, coal — and a single cot, stool and low table reveal the room's purpose, an empty plate and tin mug lying forlornly on the latter. Given the smell of oil redolent in the air, it's a small wonder nothing's actually spontaneously caught fire yet; there's supposed to be ventilation as evidenced by the presence of a grate high in the wall, but that's all stopped up with slimy gunk."

rows.original:
A crossroads deeper into the catacombs. Several tunnels branch away from this point, but most of them are either barred or look too small and narrow to be important; Nihara did say that this was going to be a quick in-and-out, after all, so there's no point in chasing quite literal dead ends. That leaves the paths to the east and west, then — fairly wide passageways leading away from this hub that look promising. More and more remains line the walls — it looks like full citizens of Khor'minos, of which minotaurs naturally make up a majority, get nicer resting places for their bones than others. Privileges in death as in life, in exchange for service, as it were.

        The floor here is smooth tile, the Tiran symbol of an hourglass laid out upon the flagstones in gold against black granite; just standing in the middle of the pattern makes the chamber look much, much larger than it is, even though by all reason there should be no way your senses could be telling you that...
rows.translation:
在地下墓穴的深处，有一处十字路口。从这个地方有几条隧道分岔出去，但其中大多数要么被封闭了，要么看起来太狭窄、太不起眼，因此不太可能有什么重要意义。毕竟妮哈拉说过这次行动只需要快速进出而已，所以没有必要去追究那些根本没有意义的死路。这样一来，就只剩下通往东方和西方的道路了——那些从这个中心点延伸出去的、相当宽阔的通道看起来都很有前景。墙壁上还残留着越来越多的痕迹，看来科尔米诺斯的全体居民（其中当然以弥诺陶洛斯占大多数）都为他们的祖先们准备了比其他人更好的安息之地。生死之间，特权依然存在——这仿佛是对某种服务的回报。

        这里的地面铺着光滑的瓷砖，黑色花岗岩上用金色纹饰描绘着蒂拉教会的沙漏符号；只要站在这个图案的中间，这个房间就会显得比实际要大得多，尽管从逻辑上来说，你的感官根本不可能产生这种错觉……
rows.raw: "A crossroads deeper into the catacombs. Several tunnels branch away from this point, but most of them are either barred or look too small and narrow to be important; Nihara did say that this was going to be a quick in-and-out, after all, so there's no point in chasing quite literal dead ends. That leaves the paths to the east and west, then — fairly wide passageways leading away from this hub that look promising. More and more remains line the walls — it looks like full citizens of Khor'minos, of which minotaurs naturally make up a majority, get nicer resting places for their bones than others. Privileges in death as in life, in exchange for service, as it were.\n\n        The floor here is smooth tile, the Tiran symbol of an hourglass laid out upon the flagstones in gold against black granite; just standing in the middle of the pattern makes the chamber look much, much larger than it is, even though by all reason there should be no way your senses could be telling you that..."

rows.original:
A large antechamber. Apparently, minoan Tirans don't believe that you can take it with you beyond the veil, so all the unclaimed possessions of the dead have been stored here, gathering dust while they await either donation to the living or being repurposed for the temple as fees for maintaining this grand ossuary. There's a lot of junk, most of it non-perishable, but if the air was stagnant before it positively reeks of mold at this point, and the infestation of goos in and around the temple has just made matters worse. Gray, gelatinous stuff seeps from the walls, running down the mortar in long, ugly streaks — it looks like everything that could've been vaguely construed as organic has long since been devoured.

        This is where Nihara said they'd kept the ward she was looking for, right? Perhaps it's somewhere in that large pile of junk? That being said, the closer you get to the heap of gold, bronze and other inorganic stuff, the worse the sense of foreboding you have grows...
rows.translation:
一间宽敞的前厅。显然，米诺斯的蒂拉教徒不相信人死后还能带走财物，因此所有无人认领的死者遗物都存放在这里，积着灰尘，等待捐给生者，或作为维护这座宏伟藏骨堂的费用，供神庙另作他用。这里堆着许多杂物，大多不会腐坏；但如果说此前的空气已经滞闷，现在更是霉味冲天。神庙内外的黏液怪泛滥成灾，更是雪上加霜。灰色的胶状物从墙壁渗出，沿灰浆留下长长的丑陋痕迹——一切勉强称得上有机物的东西，恐怕早已被吞噬殆尽。

        妮哈拉说过，他们把她要找的防护物存放在这里，对吧？也许就在那堆杂物里？可话说回来，越靠近那堆金器、青铜器和其他无机物，你心中的不祥预感就越强……

Apparently, minoan Tirans don't believe that you can take it with you beyond the veil, so all the unclaimed possessions of the dead have been stored here, gathering dust while they await either donation to the living or being repurposed for the temple as fees for maintaining this grand ossuary. There's a lot of junk, most of it non-perishable, but if the air was stagnant before it positively reeks of mold at this point, and the infestation of goos in and around the temple has just made matters worse. Gray, gelatinous stuff seeps from the walls, running down the mortar in long, ugly streaks — it looks like everything that could've been vaguely construed as organic has long since been devoured.\n\n        This is where Nihara said they'd kept the ward she was looking for, right? Perhaps it's somewhere in that large pile of junk? That being said, the closer you get to the heap of gold, bronze and other inorganic stuff, the worse the sense of foreboding you have grows..."

rows.original:
The interior of the underground temple complex is warm as a summer's day, though the earthen walls leave it more than a little humid. A lack of care over the decades, perhaps centuries, since it was last in common use has left ample time for the roots of the forest overtop the hill to begin piercing through the ceiling, creating a canopy of twisting, drooping wood... and yet even still, you have several feet of clearance. This was once a magnificently large chamber, twelve feet from rocky floor to earthen ceiling, supported by carefully arranged pillars of rough-hewn stone. 

		The doors of the temple are still open, if only just. There's a long, wide corridor to the west, a straight shot deeper into the hill and what appears to be an even larger room. You can see a warm, inviting light from within, bright enough to keep even the entrance hall illuminated. There's no flickering to it like a flame, just a constant, brilliant radiance.
rows.translation:
这座地下寺庙建筑群的内部温暖如盛夏之日，不过土墙使得空气显得相当潮湿。由于在数十年甚至数个世纪以来再未有人使用过这里，森林的树根有了足够的时间从山丘上方开始穿透天花板，形成了一片由扭曲下垂的树枝构成的遮蔽层。……然而，即便如此，你仍然有几英尺的间距。这里曾经是一个规模宏大的大厅，从岩石铺就的地面到泥土制成的天花板有十二英尺高，整个大厅由精心排列的粗糙石柱支撑着。

		寺庙的大门依然敞开着，尽管只是微微敞开而已。向西有一条长长的、宽阔的走廊，这条走廊笔直地延伸进山体内部，尽头似乎还有一个更大的房间。你可以看到从里面透出来的温暖而诱人的光线，那光线亮度足以照亮整个入口大厅。它并没有像火焰那样闪烁，而是散发着持续而明亮的光芒。
rows.raw: "The interior of the underground temple complex is warm as a summer's day, though the earthen walls leave it more than a little humid. A lack of care over the decades, perhaps centuries, since it was last in common use has left ample time for the roots of the forest overtop the hill to begin piercing through the ceiling, creating a canopy of twisting, drooping wood... and yet even still, you have several feet of clearance. This was once a magnificently large chamber, twelve feet from rocky floor to earthen ceiling, supported by carefully arranged pillars of rough-hewn stone. \n\n\t\tThe doors of the temple are still open, if only just. There's a long, wide corridor to the west, a straight shot deeper into the hill and what appears to be an even larger room. You can see a warm, inviting light from within, bright enough to keep even the entrance hall illuminated. There's no flickering to it like a flame, just a constant, brilliant radiance."

rows.original: This room is isolated from the rest of the temple by heavy stone doors, and the walls are covered with the tattered remains of tapestries. Thick, soft carpets lie across the stone floor, and even in their state of decay you can see... questionable stains still darkening parts of the fabric. Gods know when this room was last used, but you could swear you still smell something musky, something that makes your heart quicken and cheeks flush, just below the surface.
rows.translation: 这个房间被厚重的石门与寺庙的其他部分隔开，墙壁上覆盖着破旧不堪的挂毯残片。厚厚的软地毯铺在石地上，即便已经破败不堪，你仍然能看到……那些令人怀疑的污渍，它们仍然使地毯的某些部分呈现出暗色。天知道这个房间最后一次被使用是在什么时候，但你可以肯定地感觉到，在空气的深处，还弥漫着某种芬芳的气息——那种能让人的心跳加速、让脸颊泛红的气味。

Thick, soft carpets lie across the stone floor, and even in their state of decay you can see... questionable stains still darkening parts of the fabric. Gods know when this room was last used, but you could swear you still smell something musky, something that makes your heart quicken and cheeks flush, just below the surface. \n\n\t\t"

rows.original:
Several small alcoves are dug into the earthen walls at regular intervals. Each has a small votive statue within, depicting pregnant marefolk, lupines, cowgirls, and sheepfolk. The absence of humans and elves is almost glaring. 
		
		Back south you can still see the altar room through the open door. Another, closed door leads east.

在土墙上，每隔一段距离就开凿出几个小壁龛。每个壁龛里都摆放着一座小型供奉雕像，这些雕像描绘的是怀孕的母马人、狼族、女牛仔以及羊人。值得注意的是，这些雕像中完全没有人类和精灵的形象。
		
		继续向南走，透过敞开的门，仍然可以看到祭坛所在的房间。而另一扇紧闭的门则通向东方。

rows.original: The heart of the subterranean temple is a single massive room, still covered in carpets and cushions that haven't been entirely eaten away by the passage of years, surrounding a central altar in a circle. The altar, too, is rounded; the statue that stands atop it is nearly just as curvy, though it only faces one way, towards the entrance through which you first came. It is crude, the product of ancient peoples working with simple tools, but the passion that went into it is evident — perhaps too much so for decency in some places. The statue depicts a marefolk woman with excessively fertile proportions: thick thighs, a pregnant belly overhanging to her thighs, and a callipygian rear beneath a lifted tail. She's bent forward at the waist, one arm lifted invitingly and holding a glowing orb of warm light, while the other cradles a bare breast. No matter where you stand in the chapel, the view of her body is clearly meant to be overtly enticing. The walls in here have been painted with scenes of galloping horses and grazing cattle; of goats and sheep and chickens being tended to by marefolk and centaur herdsmen. For as erotic as the central statue is, the outer edges of the chapel seem wholesomely mundane. There is another chamber north of here, separated from the chapel by another set of stone-slab doors. To the south winds a smaller, narrow passage. The cave paintings around it depict large flowers and ripe fruit trees.

rows.original: The top of the cave has been carved away here, letting the [dayNight|day|moon]light spill down across what is still a bountiful garden beneath the soil. You can imagine that, once, this was a carefully-tended wonder, with fruit-bearing bushes and small trees surrounded by beds of cultivated flowers, filling the temple with their wonderful fragrance; now, though, it's gone to riot, overgrown with the fertility magic running through the very soul of this place. Vines run wild across the floor and walls, and the fruit trees have bent their trunks to seek the sun, rising through the hole above to create a canopy that near-totally hides the garden from the overworld.
rows.translation: 洞穴的顶部在这里被凿开了，从而形成了一个通道。 [dayNight|天|月亮]光芒洒落在这片依然繁茂的花园之上。你可以想象，曾经这里是一处被精心照料的美景：结满果实的灌木和小树周围种满了精心培育的花朵，它们的芬芳充满了整个庭院；然而如今，这一切都已失去了秩序，这片土地在蕴含着神奇生机的滋养下肆意生长，彻底失去了原有的模样。藤蔓疯狂地蔓延在地面和墙壁上，那些果树也弯曲了树干，试图朝向阳光生长，它们从上方的洞口中延伸出来，形成了一片茂密的遮蔽层，几乎将整个花园完全隐藏了起来，使其与外界隔绝开来。

rows.original:
This seems to be a small living space, separated from the rest of the temple by smaller stone doors and a curtain of thick, heavy cloth. 

		The floor is covered by a shaggy old carpet, and the walls still bear tapestries that depict geometric patterns in deep strawberry-reds. A bed is shoved into one corner, surrounded by stone tablets gouged with [pc.bg scholar|an ancient wedge-press script|strange wedges] and the remnants of old candles. A firepit with a chimney sits opposite, in which ashes are still visible. 
		
		Some monk or priest might have lived here full time, but you doubt more than one, maybe a married couple at most. 
		
		Back west is that orgiastic chamber. To the south you see another small stone door, adorned with gemstones.

rows.original: Crowds swirl around you in every direction, horned minotaurs traveling this way and that. It looks like all the men are being careful about what their horns might come in contact with.[flags.KMMS_B6 | The struggle of being a [pc.ra minotaur |minotaur. You've come to understand it well — this does feel a bit more like home, now... |tall race with horns. No wonder they like it here with everything built to size. ] |[party.has brint | "Good thing I've hardly got to deal with that any more, eh?" Brint quips. "These buildings are huge," you remark, looking up and down the central street. "That entrance must be twelve feet high." "Yep," he says. "Gotta make allowances for those of us unlucky enough to have horns pointing straight up, y'know. Man, that's underrated. Bumping my head on every doorframe sucked.[pc.heightRange 0 96 | | Prolly gonna be ducking through every door just out of habit for a while. ]" [pc.heightRange 0 96 |"I'll bet," you say, glancing up at him. |"Tell me about it," you grouse. "I'll be glad to not have to duck while I'm here." ] ][party.has brienne | "Haha, good thing I don't have to bother with that any more," Brienne says, smiling. "These buildings are huge," you remark, looking up and down the central street. "That entrance must be twelve feet high." "Oh yeah. If you're unlucky enough that your horns grow straight up you're gonna be bumping your head a lot if you venture outside of Khor'minos. In some places you have to almost crawl through doors," she says, shaking her head.[pc.heightRange 0 96 | | I'm not even that badly off and I'll probably still be ducking through doorways out of habit for a while. ]" [pc.heightRange 0 96 |"I'll bet," you say, glancing up at her. |"Tell me about it," you grouse. There's a silhouette of the horse's head on the sign. It's seen better days. Actually, the text is pretty close to illegible. [flags.KMINN_ROSE|Maybe you should tell Rose about that sometime.|It does seem loud and lively inside, though.]
rows.translation: 人群从四面八方涌向你，那些长着角的弥诺陶洛斯们也四处游荡。看起来，所有的人都在小心翼翼地避免让自己的角碰到什么东西。[flags.KMMS_B6 | 身为[pc.ra minotaur |弥诺陶洛斯……你已经很好地理解它了——这个做现在，这里感觉更像家了…… |一种高大的、长着角的生物。难怪它们喜欢这里，因为这里的一切都是按照它们的体型来设计的。 ] |[party.has brint | 还好我现在几乎不用再处理那种麻烦事了，对吧？”布林特开玩笑地说。 “这些建筑物真是大得惊人，”你边说边沿着中央街道上下打量，“那个入口的高度肯定有十二英尺吧。” “没错，”他回答，“对于我们那些运气不好、脑袋上长着直直的‘角’的人来说，确实得考虑这些因素。说真的，这种设计被严重低估了——每次撞到门框都真是太难受了。[pc.heightRange 0 96 | | 可能一时还会出于习惯，习惯性地穿过每一扇门吧。 ]" [pc.heightRange 0 96 |我敢打赌，”你说道，同时抬头望了他一眼。 |你倒是说说看啊，”你抱怨道，“在这里的话，我就不用总是躲来躲去了，真是太好了。 ] ][party.has brienne | 哈哈，还好我再也不用操心那种事了，”布蕾妮笑着说。 “这些建筑物真是大得惊人，”你一边说着，一边上下打量着中央大街。“那个入口肯定有十二英尺高吧。” “哦，没错。要是你运气不好，角长得笔直向上，那你每次进门的时候肯定都会撞到头很多如果你敢离开科尔米诺斯，有些地方你甚至得爬着才能通过门，”她摇着头说道。[pc.heightRange 0 96 | | 我的经济状况其实也没那么糟糕，不过出于习惯，可能还会有一段时间继续在进门时低头弯腰。 ]" [pc.heightRange 0 96 |我敢打赌，”你说道，同时抬头看了她一眼。 |你倒是说说看，”你抱怨道，“在这里的话，我就不用总是躲来躲去了，真是太好了。 ] ][party.has brint brienne || 你大概觉得，这样四处走动应该是很平常的事吧。 ] ] 这里有家客栈，名叫“野马客栈”。招牌上还有马头的图案，不过现在看起来已经有些破旧了。实际上，那些字几乎已经无法辨认了。 [flags.KMINN_ROSE|也许你应该找个机会把这件事告诉罗斯。|不过，里面的确显得很热闹、很充满活力。]

rows.original:
A small side street leads off from the Khor'minoan thoroughfare and into a familiar residential neighborhood. Several small children are running around playing under the watchful eyes of mothers looking out from windows or hanging up laundry to dry between homes. One of the buildings here is a small two-story apartment painted in a vibrant orange, with bioluminescent fungus all around its windows. 

        [calise.hog|Isadora is standing guard outside the door, and a couple of other troops from the Royal Legion are posted up at the streetcorners.|A couple of minotaur guards are posted up outside Calise's house, even while she and Isadora are back on normal duty outside the city.|The guards are gone, but Isadora's still here, looking rather lost outside her mentor's abode.]
rows.translation:
一条狭窄的小巷从霍尔米诺安大道分岔出来，通向一个熟悉的居民区。几个小孩子在母亲的注视下奔跑玩耍，那些母亲有的正从窗户里看着他们，有的则把洗好的衣物挂在房屋之间的晾衣绳上晾干。这里的其中一栋建筑是一栋两层的小公寓，外墙被涂成了鲜艳的橙色，而窗户周围则长满了会发光的真菌。 

        [calise.hog|伊莎多拉正站在门外站岗，而皇家军团的另外几名士兵则分布在街道的拐角处。|即使在卡莉丝和伊莎多拉已经回到城外的正常岗位上，卡莉丝的家外仍然有几名弥诺陶洛斯卫兵站岗值守。|守卫们已经离开了，但伊莎多拉仍然在这里，在她的导师的住所外显得有些迷茫。]

Several small children are running around playing under the watchful eyes of mothers looking out from windows or hanging up laundry to dry between homes. One of the buildings here is a small two-story apartment painted in a vibrant orange, with bioluminescent fungus all around its windows. \n\n        [calise.hog|Isadora is standing guard outside the door, and a couple of other troops from the Royal Legion are posted up at the streetcorners.|A couple of minotaur guards are posted up outside Calise's house, even while she and Isadora are back on normal duty outside the city.|The guards are gone, but Isadora's still here, looking rather lost outside her mentor's abode.]"

rows.original:
The interior of Calise's apartment shares the same warm orange paint as the exterior, with marble floors covered in thick Minoan carpets. Luminescent fungal blooms are woven around the two front-facing windows, as well as packing a chandelier hanging from the ceiling. A pair of couches and a small table make up the primary furniture here, gathered around the fireplace. Calise[calise.recovering|'s axe hangs above the mantle in pride of place| has a pair of rungs over the mantle for her axe, but she's taken it with her for now].

        There's a door to the east leading into Calise's bedroom, and one east into the small kitchen. There's a stairway up to a second floor, where Isadora's been crashing since the paladin's near-assassination.

        [calise.recovering|Against her doctor's orders, Calise is sitting up in the foyer, dressed in a slim toga and bandages. She gives you a wan smile and a wave.|[calise.hog|Calise's sitting in the foyer, one leg crossed over the other, digging through a book. She gives you a radiant smile and a finger-wave.|There's a note left on the couch, presumably for you: "Back to work. Out with my men if you need me."|]]
rows.translation:
卡莉丝的公寓内部与外部一样，都采用了温暖的橙色色调作为墙面装饰，大理石地板上铺着厚厚的米诺斯风格地毯。在两扇朝前的窗户周围，缠绕着发光的真菌装饰物，天花板上还悬挂着一盏吊灯。这里的主要家具是一张双人沙发和一张小桌子，它们都被摆放在了壁炉周围。卡莉丝[calise.recovering|那把斧头被骄傲地挂在壁炉架上。| 她的斧头装有一对横档，方便使用，不过目前她还是带着它一起行动。]

        东边有一扇门通向卡莉丝的卧室，还有一扇门通向小厨房。有一条楼梯可以通往二楼，自从那位圣骑士差点被暗杀之后，伊莎多拉就一直住在那里。

        [calise.recovering|尽管医生嘱咐她卧床休息，卡莉丝还是坐在门厅里，身上穿着一件紧身的托加袍，身上还缠着绷带。她朝你露出一个苍白的微笑，然后挥了挥手。|[calise.hog|卡莉丝坐在门厅里，一条腿交叉在另一条腿上，正在翻阅着一本书。她向你露出了灿烂的笑容，还挥了挥手指。|沙发上留了一张便条，应该是给你的：“回去工作吧。如果需要我的帮助，就和我的伙伴们一起行动。|]]

rows.original: The master bed sits alone at the far eastern end of the house, up a short flight of stairs from the other living spaces. The chamber is dominated by an opulent canopied bed shrouded by curtains. A standing mirror faces the foot of it from the far wall, framed by gilded dragons entwining around each other.
rows.translation: 主卧室位于房子的最东端，需要穿过一段短楼梯才能到达，与其他生活区域隔开。卧室里最显眼的是那张装饰华丽的床架，床罩被窗帘遮盖着。在房间的远端墙壁上，有一面立式镜子，镜框上雕刻着互相缠绕的金色龙纹，镜子正对着床脚的位置。
rows.raw: "The master bed sits alone at the far eastern end of the house, up a short flight of stairs from the other living spaces. The chamber is dominated by an opulent canopied bed shrouded by curtains. A standing mirror faces the foot of it from the far wall, framed by gilded dragons entwining around each other."

rows.original: Candelabras sit at each corner of the room, bathing it in a dim, sultry light and a faint scent of honey.
rows.translation: 房间的每个角落都摆放着烛台，它们散发着昏暗而闷热的光芒，同时还带着一丝淡淡的蜂蜜香气。
rows.raw: " Candelabras sit at each corner of the room, bathing it in a dim, sultry light and a faint scent of honey. "

rows.original:
The main thoroughfare continues to wind through the city, passing under several beautifully-decorated triumphal arches, each one commemorating some past victory or other of the minotaur monarchs. Guardhouses have been built into a few of them, giving them good vantage points from which to observe the flow of traffic, and perhaps watch for those who would vandalize the arches and adjoining statues.
        
        You walk past all manner of common stores. Quite a few citizens seem to be coming in and out of grocers — though more than a few buildings are shuttered and closed. Not every industry is thriving in such a situation, you suppose.
        
        One of the shops on the street here has a sign hanging over it, depicting a fox carrying a bladed staff in its mouth. Khor'minoan, Belharan, and Jassiran characters are etched below the picture in sharp, clear lines: "Vixen's Arcane Arsenal."
        
        [party.has cait
            |Cait smiles up at the signage. "I still can't get over people all the way over here writing signs in my native language. It's so nice!"
        ]
rows.translation:
这条主干道继续蜿蜒穿过城市，经过几座装饰精美的胜利拱门，每一座拱门都纪念着弥诺陶洛斯君主们过去的某场胜利或其他重要事件。在其中的几座拱门上还建有警卫室，这些警卫室为观察交通流量提供了绝佳的视野，同时也有助于及时发现那些可能会破坏这些拱门及周围雕像的人。
        
        你走过各种各样普通的商店。有不少市民似乎正在进出杂货店——不过也有不少店铺紧闭着门，处于关闭状态。在这种情况下，想必并不是所有行业都能蓬勃发展吧。
        
        这条街上的某家商店挂着一个招牌，上面画着一只嘴里叼着带刃法杖的狐狸。在图案下方，用清晰锐利的线条刻着科尔米诺人、贝尔哈兰人和贾西兰人的名字：“狐狸的秘藏武器库”。"
        
        [party.has cait
            |凯特看着那些标语笑了起来。“我还是无法习惯这里的人们用我的母语来写标语，真是太好了！
        ]
