rows.original: [flags.RANNA_EMP |The inside of Ranna's Emporium has a distinctly earthy smell. Not the mineshaft staleness of the deeprealms but rather a richness that's so full of life it threatens to make your eyes water. Or maybe that's just allergies. Either way, the walls are resplendent with small growers and troughs filled with earth, in which grow all manner of medicinal herbs and alchemical reagents. You can't begin to imagine how expensive the sun-filled lanterns hanging over them must be, as they're clearly quite capable of stimulating at least small-scale crop growth. The pharmacist herself is sitting by the counter, trying to stay off her feet as much as possible. [km.isCorrupted |While the worst of the corruption hasn't set in here, you can still catch some of Ranna's customers giving her playful gropes or asking for a little of her milk to help wash down their pills. How's a girl to resist... |Her many customers are happy to come to her, fetching herbs from the planters so she can grind them up or helping to get things off the higher shelves she has no chance to reach even if she weren't so gravid. ] |You step inside the pharmacy and find quite the collection of Khor'minoan citizenry already inside — mostly young minotaur women, but plenty of humans, catfolk, salamanders... just about every race common to the city has at least one or two representatives in the large shop trying to get medicine. A young bunny-woman seems to be trying to manage the chaos. You [pc.isDK |almost feel bad for the little shrimp |immediately feel for the poor thing ]: she's very, very pregnant, almost absurdly so for her size, and clearly struggling to get around much less run the place. The customers are doing their best to help out, but there's so damn many of them and so few other girls behind the counter to lighten the load. "Hey there! Sorry, I'll be right with you!" the girl calls over. "Oh, you're new, too. How'd you even get in with all this nonsense going on outside? Did you see an officer at the Black Gates with a big plume? Nose ring out to here?" "I did," you say. That captain that let you in, right? The woman beams proudly. "That's my husband! This is all his fault!" She gives her gravid tummy an affectionate rub. "Really, the nerve, leaving me like this to go back to the Legion... but that's why I love him. Oh, sorry, I'm Ranna. This is my place! Me and my husband, and soon to be a whole mess of little ones. If you need medicine or healing salves or whatever alchemy goop we can scrounge up, just... well I'd say take a placard number but those have all wandered out the door. Just, please be patient with me!" In her condition, you'll just have to forgive a bit of slow service. ]
rows.translation: [flags.RANNA_EMP |兰娜商行的内部弥漫着一种浓郁的泥土气息。这种气息并非深境中矿井那种阴冷潮湿的味道，而是一种充满生机的气息，浓烈到几乎会让人流泪。当然，也许这只是过敏反应罢了。无论如何，这些墙壁上布满了小型种植盆，还有装满土壤的槽槽，里面种着各式各样的药材和炼金所需的原料。你根本无法想象，悬挂在那些墙壁上的那些充满阳光的灯笼该有多昂贵——因为它们显然具备促进作物生长的作用，哪怕只是在小规模范围内。 药剂师本人正坐在柜台旁，尽量减少走动。 [km.isCorrupted |虽然这里还没有出现最严重的腐败现象，但你仍然会看到一些拉娜的顾客对她调皮地动手动脚，或者请求她挤一点奶出来，用来帮助吞服药片。一个女孩子，怎么可能抵抗得住呢…… |她的许多顾客都很乐意来找她，他们会从种植箱里采摘草药，让她能够将这些草药研磨成粉；或者帮忙从那些高高的架子上取下她根本够不到的东西——即使她没有怀孕，也很难拿到那些东西。 ] |你走进药店，发现里面已经有不少科尔米诺亚城的居民了——大多是年轻的弥诺陶洛斯女性，但也有很多人类、猫族、火蜥蜴……这座城市里常见的几乎每一个种族，都至少有一两个代表在这家药店里排队购买药品。 看起来，有一位年轻的兔女郎正在努力维持这里的秩序。 [pc.isDK |简直有点为那只小虾感到心疼了…… |立刻对这只可怜的动物产生了同情。 ]她真的很非常她怀孕了，以她的体型来说，这种情况几乎有些荒谬。显然，她行动起来非常困难，更别提在店里四处忙碌了。顾客们都在尽力帮忙，但顾客的数量实在太多，而柜台后面帮忙的女孩却太少，根本无法分担这些工作。 嘿！不好意思，马上就来找你！”女孩喊道。“哦，你也是新来的吗？外面这么乱，你是怎么进来的呢？在黑门那里有没有看到戴着大羽饰、鼻环的管理员？是我做的，”你说道。就是那个让你进来的船长，对吧？ 这位女士骄傲地笑了起来：“那可是我的丈夫！这一切都是他的错！”她满怀爱意地抚摸着自己隆起的腹部。真是的，他怎么敢这样让我回去军团……但正因为这样，我才会爱他。哦，对不起，我是兰娜。这是我的家！我和我的丈夫，还有不久之后就会出生的好多小宝宝们。如果你需要药品、治疗药膏，或者任何我们能搞到的炼金材料，尽管开口吧。嗯，我本想拿个号码牌的，但那些都已经被人拿走了。请大家耐心一点，好吗？” 以她现在的状况，你们也只能原谅她服务速度有点慢了。 ]
rows.raw: " [flags.RANNA_EMP |The inside of Ranna's Emporium has a distinctly earthy smell. Not the mineshaft staleness of the deeprealms but rather a richness that's so full of life it threatens to make your eyes water. Or maybe that's just allergies. Either way, the walls are resplendent with small growers and troughs filled with earth, in which grow all manner of medicinal herbs and alchemical reagents. You can't begin to imagine how expensive the sun-filled lanterns hanging over them must be, as they're clearly quite capable of stimulating at least small-scale crop growth. The pharmacist herself is sitting by the counter, trying to stay off her feet as much as possible. [km.isCorrupted |While the worst of the corruption hasn't set in here, you can still catch some of Ranna's customers giving her playful gropes or asking for a little of her milk to help wash down their pills. How's a girl to resist... |Her many customers are happy to come to her, fetching herbs from the planters so she can grind them up or helping to get things off the higher shelves she has no chance to reach even if she weren't so gravid. ] |You step inside the pharmacy and find quite the collection of Khor'minoan citizenry already inside — mostly young minotaur women, but plenty of humans, catfolk, salamanders... just about every race common to the city has at least one or two representatives in the large shop trying to get medicine. A young bunny-woman seems to be trying to manage the chaos. You [pc.isDK |almost feel bad for the little shrimp |immediately feel for the poor thing ]: she's very, very pregnant, almost absurdly so for her size, and clearly struggling to get around much less run the place. The customers are doing their best to help out, but there's so damn many of them and so few other girls behind the counter to lighten the load. "Hey there! Sorry, I'll be right with you!" the girl calls over. "Oh, you're new, too. How'd you even get in with all this nonsense going on outside? Did you see an officer at the Black Gates with a big plume? Nose ring out to here?" "I did," you say. That captain that let you in, right? The woman beams proudly. "That's my husband! This is all his fault!" She gives her gravid tummy an affectionate rub. "Really, the nerve, leaving me like this to go back to the Legion... but that's why I love him. Oh, sorry, I'm Ranna. This is my place! Me and my husband, and soon to be a whole mess of little ones. If you need medicine or healing salves or whatever alchemy goop we can scrounge up, just... well I'd say take a placard number but those have all wandered out the door. Just, please be patient with me!" In her condition, you'll just have to forgive a bit of slow service. ] "

[flags.KMMS_E6
            |The Passion Pasture, and the cute cowgirl up-front is as warm and inviting as the first time you passed it; the scent of musk coupled with faint perfume-sweetness tickles your nostrils and sends a familiar shiver down your spine.
            
            [party.comp brint brienne cait
                |It certainly catches your bull-[silly
                    |daddy
                    |boy
                ]'s attention, judging by the flare of his own nostrils. 
                |Brienne simply waves and smiles at the young gothic moo on the outside bench, hugging your arm. 
                |Cait bounces on her heels, looking half-tempted to split away and dive right into the building. 
            ]

            |There's a peculiar... musk, and sweetness to the air as you go past the next building. You're brought almost immediately to a halt by the sight of the brothel; sat outside on a little bench is a cute cowgirl with black makeup, wavy hair, and a pretty black silk dress. It's a rather modest affair, despite the sexual nature of the building behind her, and the sated bull sauntering out behind her.
            
            She gives you a tiny smile and a wave, gesturing you inside. 
            
            [party.randComp brint brienne cait
                |Your bovine companion smiles and gently elbows you, pointing at the door once your attention has been sufficiently grabbed. "That there is one of the finest brothels in Khor'minos. You should ask them about their motto."
                |Brienne smiles brightly and hops a little on her hooves — nearly encouraging a passing bull to topple over into someone else — before she takes your arm. "Head empty, heart full! Want to take a look inside?"
                |Cait's eyes go wide and she's all but dashing ahead of you to stick a head in the door, ears twitching. "Ah! If ever there were a place of worship."
            ]
            
            It looks perfectly open to outsiders, and the gothically-dressed young cowgirl is certainly inviting despite the moodiness of her makeup.

        ] 
        A dusky cowgirl with flaming red hair is sitting on the stoop leading up to the brothel with a harp sat in her lap, accompanying a recitation of a Khor'minoan epic with occasional strums. A dozen or so cowgirls are sitting around her on the stairs in various states of undress, in addition to the guests coming and going from the cathouse itself. Even the working girls can enjoy a little intellectual stimulation around here, it seems.
        
        On the other side of the road there's a shop with tremendous arches protecting a veranda, on which several small tables have been set up. A handful of minotaur youths and young women are hanging around the porch, but most of the traffic seems to be content to come and go with small bags loaded down with glass and pouches. Must be the local pharmacist.

            |激情牧场”，以及站在前方那位可爱的牛仔姑娘，依然像你第一次经过那里时那样温暖而诱人；麝香的气息与淡淡的香水甜味交织在一起，刺激着你的嗅觉，让你不自觉地感到一阵熟悉的颤栗。
            
            [party.comp brint brienne cait
                |这确实抓住了你的要点——[silly
                    |爸爸
                    |男孩
                ]从他鼻孔张大的样子来看，他的注意力确实被吸引了。 
                |布蕾妮只是朝坐在长椅上的那位年轻女孩微笑着挥了挥手，然后挽住了她的手臂。 
                |凯特踮起脚尖，似乎有点想立刻跑进那栋建筑里去。 
            ]

            |当你走过下一栋建筑时，空气中会弥漫着一种独特的……麝香气息，同时还带着一丝甜味。很快，你的目光就被那家妓院吸引住了：在门外的小长椅上，坐着一个可爱的牛仔女孩，她化了黑色的妆容，拥有一头波浪形的头发，穿着一件漂亮的黑色丝绸连衣裙。尽管她身后那栋建筑具有明显的性意味，也有一头满足地走出来的公牛，但这家妓院的外观却显得相当朴素。
            
            她向你微微一笑，然后招了招手，示意你进去。 
            
            [party.randComp brint brienne cait
                |你的牛头伙伴微笑着，轻轻用肘子碰了你一下，等你的注意力完全被吸引过来后，便指向那扇门说道：“那就是霍尔米诺斯最著名的妓院之一。你应该去问问他们那句口号是什么。
                |布蕾妮灿烂地笑了起来，用蹄子轻轻跳了几下——差点把路过的公牛撞倒，让它摔到别人身上——然后才握住你的手臂。“脑袋空空，心却满满当当的！想进去看看里面吗？
                |凯特的眼睛瞪得大大的，几乎是冲到你前面去把头探进门里，耳朵还不停地动着。“啊！这简直就是个礼拜的地方啊！
            ]
            
            它给外人看起来完全敞开大门，而那位穿着哥特风格服装的年轻女牛仔，尽管她的妆容显得有些忧郁，却依然散发着迷人的魅力。

        ] 
        一位拥有火红头发的暗色皮肤女牛仔坐在通往妓院的台阶上，她将竖琴放在膝头，一边轻轻拨弄琴弦，一边朗诵着科尔米诺人的史诗。在她周围，还有十几位女牛仔半裸着身体坐在台阶上；与此同时，也有顾客不断地进出这家妓院。看来，就连那些在职的女孩们也能在这里享受到一些智力上的刺激吧。
        
        马路对面有一家商店，巨大的拱门为门廊提供了保护，门廊上摆放着几张小桌子。有几位弥诺陶洛斯青年和年轻女子在门廊处闲逛，但大多数来来往往的人似乎都是提着装满玻璃制品和小袋子的袋子。肯定是当地的药剂师们吧。

rows.original:
The road here passes under an aqueduct, the scent of water and the roar of its passing lending a temporary reprieve from the stifling air of the city proper. Street vendors peddling snacks and drinks crowd beneath its pillars, hoping to make a sale; they're doing brisk business given that this appears to be a residential area. Somewhere off in the distance, you hear the laughter of children playing, quickly drowned out by the general hubbub of the grand minoan city.
        
        What stands out is that the homes aren't just closely packed together, but also stacked upon each other anywhere between three to five high like bricks atop one another. Open space must be a premium in the city, but clearly the minotaurs have leveraged their engineering expertise to the problem, building up as high as their materials will bear the weight.
rows.translation:
这条道路从一座高架桥下方穿过，水的气息与水流经过时发出的轰鸣声，让人们暂时摆脱了城市里闷热的空气。街头小贩们在这些桥墩下摆摊售卖零食和饮料，希望能卖出东西；考虑到这里似乎是一个居民区，他们的生意似乎相当红火。在远处的某个地方，你能听到孩子们玩耍的笑声，但这些笑声很快就被这座宏伟的米诺斯城市的喧嚣声所淹没。
        
        最引人注目的是，这些房屋不仅紧密地排列在一起，而且有的还层层叠叠地堆放在那里，高度有时甚至达到三到五层，就像一层层砖块堆叠起来一样。在城市中，开阔的空地无疑是非常珍贵的资源。而显然，弥诺陶洛斯人充分利用了他们的工程技术来解决这个问题，他们建造的建筑高度完全取决于他们所使用的材料能够承受的多重负荷。

The interior of the taphouse is warm in every respect: a great firepit dominates the center of the main room, surrounded by trestle tables on all four sides. Round tables with red coverings cluster around a small stage where [km.isCorrupted
            |a stripper pole has been installed, and a curvy cowgirl is strutting her stuff for the adoring patrons
            |one of the local minstrels is plying her trade, singing [rand
                |a local epic
                |a hymn to Mallach
                |a song in praise of the monarch
                |the praises of the city's soldiers
            ] and strumming a lyre
        ]. The far wall is dominated by a bar flanked by crimson tapestries, each embroidered with gold thread and depicting images of Khor'minoan heroes and mythic beasts brawling — imagery straight from local legend. The other walls are decorated with frescoes, huge illustrations of salamanders wielding flaming spears and hammers[km.isCorrupted
            |, though most have been defiled since the riots, adding grotesquely large penises and greatly exaggerated breasts to them
        ].
        
        Vitra, the proprietor, is behind the bar. There's no shortage of customers [km.isCorrupted
            |lined up to take turns filling their mugs straight from the tap. One of the bolder bulls is giving the 'mander a very meaty tip for her efforts; he's just finishing when you glance their way, leaving Vitra leaned over the bar with a flushed, utterly-satisfied look.
            |lined up to enjoy the taphouse's specialty. Vitra's constantly hefting up those mammoth mammaries and to fill out-stretched mugs, flushing or biting a lip every time she squeezes out a little more wine.
        ]
        
        [serena.atEmbers
            |[serena.met
                |Serena, the dark-haired cowgirl teacher, is sitting at her side table with a closed book in front of her and a drink in her hand. [serena.relationshipRange 1 2
                    |When your eyes meet hers, she raises the cup to you and grins before turning back to the entertainment.
                    |Now that she knows that you're here, though, the book is forgotten, and she waves happily at you every time your gaze drifts her way.
                    |Although she seems to be writing something down, as soon as she looks up from her paper and notices you, the stylus stops moving. She looks like she'd enjoy your company again.
                ]
                |A cowgirl with dark hair and glasses sits at one of the tables off to the side. Unusually for a place like this, her table bears not only a drink but also a well-organized array of books and scrolls. Instead of reading, though, the cowgirl is twirling a stylus around her elegant fingers, sipping her drink, and quietly taking in the exotic clientele, the bartender, and the entertainment. She puts down the cup and gives you a cheerful wave when she notices your gaze.
            ]

酒馆内部在各个意义上都很温暖：一座巨大的火坑占据主厅中央，四面围着长条桌。铺着红色桌布的圆桌聚在一个小舞台周围，那里[km.isCorrupted
            |装上了一根脱衣舞钢管，一个曲线丰润的牛女正在为热情观众展示身段
            |一名本地吟游诗人正在献艺，唱着[rand
                |一首本地史诗
                |一首献给马拉克的圣歌
                |一首赞颂君主的歌曲
                |对城中士兵的赞美
            ]，并拨动里拉琴
        ]。远墙被一座吧台占据，两侧挂着深红挂毯，每幅都以金线绣着霍尔米诺英雄与神话野兽搏斗的画面——完全是本地传说中的意象。其他墙面装饰着湿壁画，上面是巨大的插图，画着手持火焰长矛和战锤的火蜥蜴[km.isCorrupted
            |，不过自骚乱以来，大多数都被玷污了，被添上 grotesque 巨大的阴茎和极度夸张的乳房
        ]。
        
        店主薇特拉正在吧台后面。顾客一点也不少，[km.isCorrupted
            |排着队轮流直接从“龙头”把酒杯灌满。一个更大胆的公牛正为这位火蜥蜴的服务给出一份非常肉感的小费；你看过去时他刚刚结束，留下薇特拉趴在吧台上，脸颊潮红，神情彻底满足。
            |排着队享用酒馆的特色。薇特拉不断托起那对巨硕乳房，为伸来的酒杯倒满，每次挤出更多酒液时都会脸红或咬住嘴唇。
        ]
        
        [serena.atEmbers
            |[serena.met
                |黑发牛女教师塞蕾娜坐在她旁边的小桌前，面前放着一本合上的书，手里端着一杯饮品。[serena.relationshipRange 1 2
                    |当你的目光与她相遇时，她向你举杯并咧嘴一笑，随后又转回去看表演。
                    |不过既然她已经知道你在这里，那本书就被忘在一旁；每当你的视线飘向她，她都会开心地向你挥手。
                    |虽然她似乎正在写些什么，但她一从纸上抬头注意到你，手中的笔便停了下来。她看起来会很乐意再次与你作伴。
                ]
                |一个黑发戴眼镜的牛女坐在一张靠边的桌旁。对这种地方来说有些少见的是，她桌上不仅有饮品，还整齐摆放着书本和卷轴。不过她并没有阅读，而是用优雅的手指转着书写笔，啜饮饮品，安静观察异国客人、酒保和表演。注意到你的目光后，她放下杯子，愉快地向你挥手。

rows.original:
As one gets closer to the heart of the common district and the colosseum, the thicker the crowds grow, and the more common the guard posts. As the residential district fades away, statues of tastefully nude minotaur men in various intimidating and noble poses line the thoroughfare leading up to the circuses, all of them engaged in some form of sport or the other. This must be what passes for the richer part of the common district, then.
        
        Here, the merchants take a distinctive change, too: instead of sundry goods and daily necessities, the storefronts are better decorated and filled with luxuries, with not a single one closed to business. The quarantine hasn't decreased the citizens' appetite for distraction any — if anything, it's quite the opposite. Restaurants and eateries spill out onto the streets, with bull-men gathered on benches and about tables, animatedly discussing this or that in their native language.
        
        One of the buildings on the street radiates light and warmth through its open windows far beyond that than any of the others you've encountered on your traversal of the city thus far. On occasion, loud, metallic clangs ring out from it, telling you even before you see the sign over its doorway that the building houses a metalsmith of some sort. 

        Upon reaching it, however, you're able to see a sign just above the door, the words "Salamander Smithing" written on it in Khor'minoan and Belharan. On one side of the lettering, a crossed hammer and chisel stand out, while on the other is the tip of a tail with the shape of a flame atop it
rows.translation:
当人们逐渐接近普通居民区与竞技场的中心地带时，人群会变得越来越密集，守卫岗亭也会随处可见。而当住宅区逐渐远离后，那些以各种威武而高贵的姿态塑造的、裸体但造型精美的弥诺陶洛斯雕像，就会沿着通往竞技场的道路两旁排列起来——它们全都仿佛正在参与着某种体育运动。看来，这里应该就是普通居民区中较为富裕的区域了吧。
        
        在这里，商人们也发生了显著的变化：他们的店铺不再出售各种商品和日常用品，而是进行了更加精心的装饰，里面摆满了奢侈品，而且没有一家店铺关闭营业。隔离措施丝毫没有减弱市民们寻求娱乐的欲望——事实上，情况恰恰相反。餐馆和饮食摊位延伸到了街道上，那些身材魁梧的男子们聚集在长椅旁或桌旁，用他们自己的语言热烈地讨论着各种各样的事情。
        
        这条街上的某栋建筑，通过它敞开的窗户散发出光芒与温暖，这种气息远远超过了你迄今为止在这座城市里见过的任何其他建筑。偶尔，从那里会传来响亮的金属碰撞声，甚至在你看到门楣上的标志之前，这些声音就已经告诉你：这栋建筑里肯定有一位铁匠在从事工作。 

        然而，当你到达那里时，会看到门上方有一块标志，上面用科尔米诺语和贝尔哈兰语写着“火蜥蜴锻造”。在文字的左侧，有一个交叉的锤子和凿子图案；而在右侧，则画着一条尾巴的末端，其顶端呈火焰形状。

rows.original: A public waterworks, fenced off from the street by a high wall. Here, the roar of an aqueduct rises over the hustle of the city as it pours into a large granite building, the smell of clean water rising heavily into the air; the myriad of bronze pipes running out from the building's base and under the street imply the building's purpose of splitting the torrential flow into several water mains which then serve this district's needs. No doubt there are several other buildings like these scattered about the city, the flows feeding homes, public fountains, and more as they speak to the ingenuity of the city's womenfolk.
rows.translation: 这是一座公共供水设施，周围被高墙与街道隔开。在这里，引水渠的轰鸣声超越了城市喧嚣，水流涌入一座巨大的花岗岩建筑之中，清新的水气弥漫在空气中；从建筑底部延伸出来的无数青铜管道穿过街道下方，这些管道清楚地表明了这座建筑的功能：它将湍急的水流分成几条主干道，从而满足这一区域的用水需求。毫无疑问，这座城市还有许多类似的建筑分布在各处，这些供水系统为居民家庭、公共喷泉等提供了水源，充分体现了这座城市女性们的聪明才智。

rows.original:
An upper-middle-class residential district for the well-to do plebian, just outside of the shadow of the colosseum. Individual homes instead of the stacked insulae of the common citizen, yet not quite amounting to the villas of the patricians, this part of town is home to those who have the means to live comfortably outside of the inner city. The roads are wide and clean, the street lights well-spaced, and the residents have tried to pretty the place up with planters of decorative mushrooms facing the street.
        
        This part of town is conspicuously absent of patrols — partially because of able-bodied minotaurs being all with the legion, and partially because the riff-raff's stopped long before it gets here. It's certainly a reprieve from the constant activity of this city...
        
        [rixx.tileUnlocked|And, if you remember Rixx's directions correctly, her house should be the third one down from the block's start. The house in question at least looks the part of a summoner's abode, with the occasional runes and symbols carved into its stone. [pc.isMage|You even have enough magical training to make out what they do. Most of them are simple charms that reduce wear and tear, or conduct heat in a certain way– simple things like that. But the fact that her house is the only one with them makes you wonder if her neighbours don't trust her magic, or if they simply can't afford her services.|You don't have enough magical training to know what they mean or do, but that certainly seems like something a mage would do.]

        Either way though, if you want to get Rixx's attention, all you have to do is knock on her front door.]
rows.translation:
这是一个为中上层阶级富人设计的住宅区，位于竞技场的外围。与普通市民拥挤居住的联排房屋不同，这里的住宅是单独建造的，但也不属于贵族的别墅。这个区域居住着那些有能力在市中心以外享受舒适生活的人。道路宽阔而整洁，路灯间距恰当，居民们还在街道两旁种植了装饰性蘑菇，使这个地方看起来更加美观。
        
        这个区域的巡逻活动明显很少——部分原因是那些身体健全的弥诺陶洛斯们都去加入了军团，另一部分原因则是那些不良分子在到达这里之前就已经被制止了。这确实让人们从这座城市繁忙的生活节奏中得到了一些喘息的机会……
        
        [rixx.tileUnlocked|如果你还记得里克斯给出的指示，那么她的房子应该就在这个街区的第三个房子。那栋房子看起来确实像是一个召唤师的居所，石头上还刻着一些符文和符号。 [pc.isMage|你的魔法修炼程度已经足以理解它们究竟起到了什么作用。其中大多数都是些简单的咒语，用来减少物品的磨损，或者让热量以某种特定的方式传递——就是这类简单的功能而已。但她的房子是唯一一个使用了这些魔法的房子，这就让人不禁怀疑：是她的邻居们不信任她的魔法，还是他们根本负担不起她的服务费用呢？|你的魔法修炼还不够深入，因此不明白它们的含义或作用，但这种行为确实很像法师会做的事情。]

        无论如何，如果你想引起里克斯的注意，只需要去敲她的前门就可以了。]

rows.original:
The crowds thin as one steps away from the colosseum along this side street, although street hawkers continue to work the edges of the crowd draws by it. So close to where the games are held, a whole host of industries have sprung up to support the spectacle — chariot-makers, armorers, stonemasons and more. There's even a business which advertises its sole product — sand fine enough to floor the arena — and despite the advertisement, it's not open to the public.

        The air hums with activity, a transition from the furtive business of main street to the quieter residential areas, industries deemed inoffensive enough to be situated near the residential districts for easy access to the plebian workers.
rows.translation:
一旦沿着这条小街离开竞技场，人群就会变得稀少起来，不过那些街头小贩仍然会在竞技场周围的人群聚集地附近摆摊经营。由于这里距离比赛场地非常近，因此各种各样支持这场盛事的产业也应运而生——有制造战车的工匠，有制作盔甲的铁匠，还有石匠等等。甚至还有这样一家企业，它宣传自己的唯一产品——那种细度足以用来铺设竞技场地面的沙子——然而尽管有这样的宣传，这家企业却并不对公众开放。

        空气中充满了忙碌的气息，这种繁忙的氛围标志着人们正在从主街上的喧嚣忙碌中过渡到较为宁静的居民区。那些被认为不会对居民造成干扰的行业，往往会被安排在居民区附近，这样就可以方便地为普通劳动者提供服务。

So close to where the games are held, a whole host of industries have sprung up to support the spectacle — chariot-makers, armorers, stonemasons and more. A huge number of wagons clog the streets here, merchant caravans that managed to get into the city early. They've been picked almost clean by now, but a few peddlers still are trying to hawk their wares.

        Further to the east you can see another of the city's great gates and walls.
rows.translation:
一旦沿着这条小街离开竞技场，人群就会变得稀少起来，不过那些街头小贩仍然会在竞技场周围的人群聚集地附近摆摊经营。由于这里距离比赛场地非常近，因此各种各样支持这场盛事的产业也应运而生——有制造战车的工匠，有制作盔甲的铁匠，还有石匠等等。大量的马车堵塞了这里的街道，这些都是那些早早进入城市的商队。这些商品早就被抢购一空了，但仍然有一些小贩在试图兜售他们的货物。

        再往东走，你就能看到这座城市另一座宏伟的城门和城墙。
rows.raw:
"
        The crowds thin as one steps away from the colosseum along this side street, although street hawkers continue to work the edges of the crowd draws by it. So close to where the games are held, a whole host of industries have sprung up to support the spectacle — chariot-makers, armorers, stonemasons and more. A huge number of wagons clog the streets here, merchant caravans that managed to get into the city early. They've been picked almost clean by now, but a few peddlers still are trying to hawk their wares.

        Further to the east you can see another of the city's great gates and walls.
        "

rows.original: You're standing at the closest point between the colosseum and the city's eastern walls. The crush of merchant wagons gives way to those belonging to poorer refugees, unable to find anywhere else to park their belongings but the street. Some of them have been pushed together into makeshift barricades, covered with nettings to protect the soldiers patrolling here from imps. To the east looms one of the city's great gates,
rows.translation: 你正站在竞技场与城市东墙之间最近的位置。商队的车马拥挤渐渐让位于那些贫穷难民的车辆——他们无处可去，只能把家当停放在街道上。其中一些车辆已经被推到一起，组成了临时路障，上面覆盖着防网，以保护在此巡逻的士兵免受小鬼的侵扰。东边，城市的一座巨大城门巍然耸立，
rows.raw: "\n        You're standing at the closest point between the colosseum and the city's eastern walls. The crush of merchant wagons gives way to those belonging to poorer refugees, unable to find anywhere else to park their belongings but the street. Some of them have been pushed together into makeshift barricades, covered with nettings to protect the soldiers patrolling here from imps. To the east looms one of the city's great gates, "

rows.original: warily opened, but still under heavy guard
rows.translation: 谨慎地开着，但仍有重兵把守
rows.raw: "warily opened, but still under heavy guard"

rows.translation: 紧闭着，且有重兵把守

rows.original: Now that the the worst of the siege has been broken, the gates to the Coastlands have opened under the king's orders. Few folk are coming and going through them now, and from here, you can only see another imposingly long, dimly-illuminated Undermountain tunnel. This is, however, your connecting point to the east of the continent: the coast of the Sapphire Sea.
rows.translation: 如今，这场围城战的最艰难阶段已经过去，在国王的命令下，通往海岸地区的通道终于被打开了。不过现在通过这些通道来来往往的人并不多。从这里，你只能看到另一条漫长而昏暗的地下山道。然而，这条通道正是你通往大陆东部的关键途径——蓝宝石海沿岸地区。
rows.raw: "Now that the the worst of the siege has been broken, the gates to the Coastlands have opened under the king's orders. Few folk are coming and going through them now, and from here, you can only see another imposingly long, dimly-illuminated Undermountain tunnel. This is, however, your connecting point to the east of the continent: the coast of the Sapphire Sea."

rows.original: You stand on a stretch of even ground on the mountainside, maybe twenty feet across, dominated by a pair of enormous marble statues that stand proudly on either side of a vaulted door. One statue depicts the nude, slender figure of Sorra, her feathered wings outstretched and spear held high; the other, the curvaceous body of the human deity Tira, wearing little besides funerary wrappings and a robe, and presenting a headsman's axe. Their weapons touch at the tips, and from that point hangs a single copper lantern lit with a flickering green flame. [pc.bg acolyte |A guiding flame for lost souls. ] The entrance to the Grave of Saints stands solemnly to the east.
rows.translation: 你站在山坡上一片平坦的地面上，这片地面的宽度大概有二十英尺，两侧各立着一座巨大的大理石雕像，它们傲然地矗立在拱形大门的两旁。其中一座雕像塑造的是索拉那裸露而纤细的身姿，她的羽毛翅膀展开，手中高举着长矛；另一座雕像则刻画了人类女神蒂拉那曲线优美的身形，她身上几乎只穿着丧服和一件长袍，手中握着一把刽子手的斧头。他们的武器在剑尖处相触，而在那一点上，悬挂着一盏铜灯笼，里面燃烧着闪烁的绿色火焰。 [pc.bg acolyte |为迷失的灵魂指引方向的光芒。 ] 圣徒墓地的入口庄严地坐落在东侧。
rows.raw: " You stand on a stretch of even ground on the mountainside, maybe twenty feet across, dominated by a pair of enormous marble statues that stand proudly on either side of a vaulted door. One statue depicts the nude, slender figure of Sorra, her feathered wings outstretched and spear held high; the other, the curvaceous body of the human deity Tira, wearing little besides funerary wrappings and a robe, and presenting a headsman's axe. Their weapons touch at the tips, and from that point hangs a single copper lantern lit with a flickering green flame. [pc.bg acolyte |A guiding flame for lost souls. ] The entrance to the Grave of Saints stands solemnly to the east."

rows.original: The entrance hall to the minoan mausoleum is a tremendous vaulted chamber of stone, semi-circular in shape and decorated with upwards of two dozen marble statues — likely made in the image of those buried within. Half-burned candles and dusty pottery remain from grave offerings left by mourners long ago, stretching on further east to the chamber's terminus.
rows.translation: 米诺斯陵墓的入口大厅是一座巨大的石制拱形大厅，呈半圆形结构，厅内装饰着二十多座大理石雕像——这些雕像很可能是为纪念墓中安葬的人而制作的。那些早已熄灭的半烧蜡烛和积满灰尘的陶器，都是昔日的送葬者留下的祭品，它们一直延伸到大厅的尽头。
rows.raw: "\n        The entrance hall to the minoan mausoleum is a tremendous vaulted chamber of stone, semi-circular in shape and decorated with upwards of two dozen marble statues — likely made in the image of those buried within. Half-burned candles and dusty pottery remain from grave offerings left by mourners long ago, stretching on further east to the chamber's terminus."

rows.original: The terminal wall of the entrance chamber is devoted to a tremendous mural, perhaps twenty feet to a side, depicting the mountain's patron goddesses. Where the paint on the exterior statues has long since been worn away by the biting winds, here you can see the pair in all their glory. Sorra stands resplendent and nude, bronze skin and dark hair contrasted against iridescent wings with feathers all the colors of the rainbow outstretched. Her gaze lies to the south, stern but devoted. Beside her stands the welcoming, open-armed Tira, ghostly-pale, clad in midnight-colored robes and funerary wrappings. She is posed extending a hand to the north, and in her palm you can just make out a jade-green ring.
rows.translation: 入口厅的终端墙壁上绘有一幅巨大的壁画，每边大概有二十英尺长，上面描绘了这座山的守护女神们。虽然外部雕像上的颜料早已被凛冽的风吹蚀得面目全非，但在这幅壁画上，你仍然能够看到这两位女神那辉煌的形象。索拉站在那里，全身赤裸，她那古铜色的肌肤与深色的头发与那对闪耀着彩虹般七彩光芒的翅膀形成了鲜明的对比。她的目光投向南方，神情肃穆而坚定。站在她身旁的是蒂拉，她热情地张开双臂欢迎着人们，皮肤苍白如幽灵，身披午夜般的黑袍与丧服。她的姿势是向着北方伸出手，而在她的手掌中，可以隐约看到一枚翠绿色的戒指。
rows.raw: "\n        The terminal wall of the entrance chamber is devoted to a tremendous mural, perhaps twenty feet to a side, depicting the mountain's patron goddesses. Where the paint on the exterior statues has long since been worn away by the biting winds, here you can see the pair in all their glory. Sorra stands resplendent and nude, bronze skin and dark hair contrasted against iridescent wings with feathers all the colors of the rainbow outstretched. Her gaze lies to the south, stern but devoted. Beside her stands the welcoming, open-armed Tira, ghostly-pale, clad in midnight-colored robes and funerary wrappings. She is posed extending a hand to the north, and in her palm you can just make out a jade-green ring."

rows.original: Following Tira's outstretched arm leads you north through a narrow corridor. There are many small chambers branching off on the east side, each one home to several horizontal burial plinths. Though there's no light to speak of in here, you can just make out skeletons and funeral shrouds by the light of Calise's arcane torch.
rows.translation: 沿着蒂拉伸出的手臂，你向北穿过一条狭窄的走廊。在走廊的东侧，有许多小房间分支出来，每个房间里都摆放着几块用于水平埋葬的石板。虽然这里一片漆黑，但在卡莉丝那把神秘火炬的光芒下，你还是能够隐约看到那些骷髅和葬礼用的寿衣。
rows.raw: "\n        Following Tira's outstretched arm leads you north through a narrow corridor. There are many small chambers branching off on the east side, each one home to several horizontal burial plinths. Though there's no light to speak of in here, you can just make out skeletons and funeral shrouds by the light of Calise's arcane torch."

rows.original: Following Tira's outstretched arm leads you north through the Grave, following the narrow corridor. The passage curves eastwards here, towards another vaulted door, and back south towards the entrance.
rows.translation: 沿着蒂拉伸出的手臂所指的方向，你向北穿过墓地，沿着狭窄的走廊前行。这条通道在这里转向东方，通向另一扇拱形大门，然后又折返向南，回到入口处。
rows.raw: "\n        Following Tira's outstretched arm leads you north through the Grave, following the narrow corridor. The passage curves eastwards here, towards another vaulted door, and back south towards the entrance."

rows.original: The royal mausoleum is dominated by a stone dias, itself surrounded by small minotaur cherubs bearing green lanterns just like Tira's. Countless other dead are buried in this chamber, too, given stone sarcophagi that flank the walls as far as the eye can see in the gloom — but the first Tiran shaman of the city, Persenne, is given precedence over all the other clergy and nobles buried here. The covering of her sarcophagus has been replaced after you and Calise opened it.
rows.translation: 这座皇家陵墓的中心是一座石制棺床，周围环绕着许多手持绿色灯笼的小弥诺陶洛斯天使，这些天使与蒂拉手中的灯笼一模一样。在这个墓室里，还安葬着无数其他逝者，墙壁两侧摆满了石制棺材，在昏暗的光线下，这些棺材一直延伸到视线所能及的地方——然而，这座城市第一位蒂拉教会的萨满佩尔森娜，其地位高于所有其他被安葬在这里的神职人员与贵族。在你和卡莉丝打开她的棺材之后，她的棺盖已经被重新安装好了。
rows.raw: "\n        The royal mausoleum is dominated by a stone dias, itself surrounded by small minotaur cherubs bearing green lanterns just like Tira's. Countless other dead are buried in this chamber, too, given stone sarcophagi that flank the walls as far as the eye can see in the gloom — but the first Tiran shaman of the city, Persenne, is given precedence over all the other clergy and nobles buried here. The covering of her sarcophagus has been replaced after you and Calise opened it."

rows.original: Following Sorra's imperious gaze leads you south through a narrow corridor. There are many small chambers branching off on the east side, each one home to several horizontal burial plinths. Though there's no light to speak of in here, you can just make out skeletons and funeral shrouds by the light of Calise's arcane torch.
rows.translation: 沿着索拉那威严的目光所指引的方向，你向南穿过一条狭窄的走廊。在走廊的东侧，有许多小房间分支出来，每个房间里都摆放着几块用于水平埋葬的石板。虽然这里一片漆黑，但在卡莉丝那神秘火炬的光芒下，你还是能够隐约看到那些骷髅和葬礼用的寿衣。
rows.raw: "\n        Following Sorra's imperious gaze leads you south through a narrow corridor. There are many small chambers branching off on the east side, each one home to several horizontal burial plinths. Though there's no light to speak of in here, you can just make out skeletons and funeral shrouds by the light of Calise's arcane torch."

rows.original: Following Sorra's imperious gaze leads you south through a narrow corridor. There are many small chambers branching off on the east side, each one home to several horizontal burial plinths. The entire tunnel curves east from here[flags.RING_ROBBERS||, and though the path ahead is shrouded in gloom, you can definitely hear women giggling and the sound of bones shattering from ahead].
rows.translation: 循着索拉威严的目光，你向南走过一条狭窄走廊。东侧分出许多小墓室，每间都有数座横置的葬台。整条隧道在这里转向东边[flags.RING_ROBBERS||，尽管前路笼罩在幽暗中，你仍能清楚听见前方女人的窃笑声，以及骨头碎裂的声音]。
rows.raw: "\n        Following Sorra's imperious gaze leads you south through a narrow corridor. There are many small chambers branching off on the east side, each one home to several horizontal burial plinths. The entire tunnel curves east from here[flags.RING_ROBBERS||, and though the path ahead is shrouded in gloom, you can definitely hear women giggling and the sound of bones shattering from ahead]."

rows.original: You're in the southmost annex of the Grave of Saints now, at the end of a long east-west corridor. There are countless small private crypts on either side of the wall, honoring the city's noble dead.
rows.translation: 你现在位于圣徒墓地的最南端，处于一条东西走向的长走廊的尽头。墙壁的两侧分布着无数小型私人墓穴，这些墓穴都是为了纪念这座城市中那些贵族逝者而建造的。
rows.raw: "\n        You're in the southmost annex of the Grave of Saints now, at the end of a long east-west corridor. There are countless small private crypts on either side of the wall, honoring the city's noble dead."

rows.original:
You're in the southmost annex of the Grave of Saints now, following a long east-west corridor. There are countless small private crypts on either side of the wall, honoring the city's noble dead.

        There are a pair of murals on the eastern wall, accompanying a T-branch that leads north and south. The southern mural depicts a tremendous, barrel-chested minotaur wearing a golden mask and richly clad in gold and silks — no doubt an ancient king of some kind. The northern mural depicts an uncharacteristically slender cowgirl in a rainbow robe, her hands clasped over her chest. There's a hint of a green light painted as shining out between her fingers, curled closed around some unseen object.
rows.translation:
你现在位于圣徒墓地的最南端，正沿着一条东西走向的长走廊前行。墙壁两侧分布着无数小型私人墓穴，这些墓穴都是为了纪念这座城市中那些贵族逝者而建造的。

        在东侧的墙壁上，有一对壁画；而在这条T形走廊的分岔处，则分别通往北方和南方。南侧的壁画描绘了一头体型庞大、胸膛宽厚的弥诺陶洛斯，它戴着金色面具，身披华丽的金色与丝绸服饰——毫无疑问，这是一位古代国王。而北侧的壁画则描绘了一位身材异常纤细的牛仔姑娘，她身着彩虹色的长袍，双手交叠放在胸前。在她紧握的指缝间，似乎有一道微弱的绿光正在闪烁，那光芒仿佛源自某个看不见的物体。
rows.raw:
"
        You're in the southmost annex of the Grave of Saints now, following a long east-west corridor. There are countless small private crypts on either side of the wall, honoring the city's noble dead.

        There are a pair of murals on the eastern wall, accompanying a T-branch that leads north and south. The southern mural depicts a tremendous, barrel-chested minotaur wearing a golden mask and richly clad in gold and silks — no doubt an ancient king of some kind. The northern mural depicts an uncharacteristically slender cowgirl in a rainbow robe, her hands clasped over her chest. There's a hint of a green light painted as shining out between her fingers, curled closed around some unseen object.
        "

rows.original: The halls of this passage are much larger in every dimension than those previously, meant for the largest of minotaurs to comfortably stride through with horns held high. The mural of the minoan king back north extends down this hall, depicting a host of noble princes each crowned and gilded in finery. They appear to be marching south, towards the terminal chamber in this wing of the Grave.
rows.translation: 这条通道的走廊在各个维度上都要比之前的那些宽敞得多，这样的设计是为了让体型最大的弥诺陶洛斯也能轻松地行走其中，同时还能将它们高高的角举得高高在上。在北边的地方，有一幅描绘米诺斯国王的壁画，这幅壁画一直延伸到这条走廊的尽头，画面上描绘了一群头戴王冠、身着华丽服饰的贵族王子们。他们似乎正在向南行进，朝着这座墓穴这一侧的最后一间房间前进。
rows.raw: "\n        The halls of this passage are much larger in every dimension than those previously, meant for the largest of minotaurs to comfortably stride through with horns held high. The mural of the minoan king back north extends down this hall, depicting a host of noble princes each crowned and gilded in finery. They appear to be marching south, towards the terminal chamber in this wing of the Grave."

rows.original: This passage is somewhat smaller than those that came before, sized for a cowgirl rather than a towering minotaur. Statuary resting in alcoves near the ceiling depict Sorra the Stormsinger in all her avian glory. The first statues depict her as nothing but a bird with rainbow feathers, but by the time you reach the westward curve, she's depicted as a beautiful woman garbed for war with spear and hoplon in hand.
rows.translation: 这段文字的篇幅比之前的那些要短一些，大小也更适合一位女牛仔，而不是一个高大的弥诺陶洛斯。位于天花板附近壁龛中的雕像将“风暴歌手索拉”展现出了她那充满鸟类特质的美丽形象。最初的雕像只是将她描绘成一只拥有彩虹色羽毛的鸟，但当你走到向西延伸的部分时，就会看到她被刻画成一位身着战装、手持长矛和盾牌的美丽女性。
rows.raw: "\n        This passage is somewhat smaller than those that came before, sized for a cowgirl rather than a towering minotaur. Statuary resting in alcoves near the ceiling depict Sorra the Stormsinger in all her avian glory. The first statues depict her as nothing but a bird with rainbow feathers, but by the time you reach the westward curve, she's depicted as a beautiful woman garbed for war with spear and hoplon in hand."

rows.original: This chamber is dominated by a huge statue of Sorra, wings outstretched and spear in hand but gloriously nude. Beneath her wings are several dozen stone caskets, each bearing the Stormsinger's thunderbolt sigil upon it. Her clergy, no doubt. Her spear is stretched out towards the north, where the statue looks with a smile on its face down another passage.
rows.translation: 这个大厅的正中央矗立着一座巨大的索拉雕像，她双翼展开，手中握着长矛，但却完全裸露着身体。她的双翼下方摆放着几十个石棺，每个棺盖上都刻着风暴歌手的闪电纹章——毫无疑问，这些都是她的神职人员。她的长矛指向北方，在那里，另一条通道的尽头，也有一座面带微笑的雕像。
rows.raw: "\n        This chamber is dominated by a huge statue of Sorra, wings outstretched and spear in hand but gloriously nude. Beneath her wings are several dozen stone caskets, each bearing the Stormsinger's thunderbolt sigil upon it. Her clergy, no doubt. Her spear is stretched out towards the north, where the statue looks with a smile on its face down another passage."

rows.original:
The air here is cooler than that of the teyarium, and it's a welcome change. You feel refreshed as you walk inside and take a look around, noting the pools of varying sizes and depths. The construction is fairly impressive – you can't help but wonder how much work went into this.

    It looks like there's a smaller, unaccompanied changing room here so you can put proper swimwear on.
rows.translation:
这里的空气比温室里的要凉爽许多，这种变化真是令人感到愉悦。当你走进去环顾四周时，会注意到那些大小和深度各不相同的泳池。这里的建筑风格相当令人印象深刻——你不禁会想，建造这样一个地方究竟耗费了多少人力和物力。

    看起来这里还设有一个较小的更衣室，你可以在那里换上合适的泳装。
rows.raw: "The air here is cooler than that of the teyarium, and it's a welcome change. You feel refreshed as you walk inside and take a look around, noting the pools of varying sizes and depths. The construction is fairly impressive – you can't help but wonder how much work went into this.\n\n    It looks like there's a smaller, unaccompanied changing room here so you can put proper swimwear on."

rows.original:
Steam billows around you from the moment you step foot in the saldarium, the air several degrees hotter than the mild room you just came from and noticeably muggy. It's quite a plain room, the intended purpose obvious. [flags.KM_BATHS_SALDARIUM
            |
            |[party.has brint
                |
                
                "Whew. This'll be the room directly above the furnace," Brint says. "Love spending an hour or two in here on days I didn't do much. Nothing better."
                
                [pc.isBimbo
                    |"All I wanna do in here is like, lie back and be a vegetable," you say, happily imagining some broccoli simmering in hot water. "Mmm."
                    
                    Brint chuckles and pats your head. "That's what it's for, [brint.isDaddy
                        |[pc.mf
                            |babe
                            |babygirl
                        ]
                        |
                        [pc.name]
                    ], so enjoy."
                    |"Feels like it'd be conducive to lying back and doing absolutely nothing for a while," you say.
                    
                    Brint chuckles. "Yeah, pretty much."
                ]
            ][party.has brienne
                |
                
                "Woo, that's warm," Brienne says. "I used to spend an hour or two in here on days I didn't get much done. Great for your skin, I hear."
                
                [pc.isBimbo
                    |"All I wanna do in here is like, lie back and be a vegetable," you say, happily imagining some broccoli simmering in hot water. "Mmm."
                    
                    Brienne giggles. "That's what it's for."
                    |"Feels like it'd be conducive to lying back and doing absolutely nothing for a while," you say.
                    
                    "Yup!" Brienne says, smiling. "That's what it's for."
                ]
            ]
        ]
        
        There's a basin here containing what you deem to be cold water, and a chiselled depiction next to it of a minotaur dumping it over his head as he leaves. Looks like it's for cooling yourself off when you've had enough... that's handy.
        
        At the other end of the room is a great four-sided pool with stairs leading down into it. There's people relaxing all over – some with just their legs in, some sitting on the stairs, and others up to their heads. Looks like there's no wrong way to enjoy this place.
rows.translation:

rows.original:
You're standing in a secret tunnel, hidden behind the wall of a sauna chamber in the bath house's lower level. There's an unconscious bull wearing nothing but a bath towel spilling halfway through the wall to reveal what was hidden. On your side of the divide, there's a small switch mechanism that would have opened a hidden door if given the chance — you imagine there's a hidden counterpart to it in the sauna. Not that you needed it. 

        The corridor stretches off to the east. Plush Jassiran carpets have been laid across the warm stone, and lumen-moss torches hang from sconces on the walls. You can hear the sound of running water from up ahead, around the corner.
rows.translation:
你此刻正站在一条秘密的隧道中，这条隧道隐藏在浴室底层的一个桑拿房墙壁后面。有一头不省人事的公牛，身上只裹着一条浴巾，半截身体露在墙壁外面，正好暴露了这里原本隐藏的东西。在你们这一侧，有一个小开关装置，如果有机会被触发的话，它会打开一扇隐藏的门——你可以想象，在桑拿房里也应该有与之对应的隐藏装置。不过，其实你并不需要它。

        走廊一直延伸到东边。柔软的贾西兰地毯铺设在温暖的石地上，墙壁上的壁灯上悬挂着发光的苔藓火炬。前方转角处，传来流水声。

rows.translation: 你站在一段楼梯的顶端，这些楼梯通向一个私人游泳池。水面上铺满了花瓣，而游泳池的水源则来自墙上一幅壁画中的喷泉——那幅壁画描绘了维伦将一个双耳瓶扛在肩上，而许多美丽的少女们则对他那牛头般的半身充满了倾慕之情。

rows.original: The secret corridor connects the sauna back west to a wide-open chamber to the east. There's a chandelier hanging over a sitting room ahead, and a number of fancy cushioned seats and divans. For something so hidden, so deep underground... this place looks positively cozy.
rows.translation: 这条秘密通道将西侧的桑拿房与东侧的一间宽敞房间连接起来。前方的客厅里悬挂着一盏吊灯，还有许多装饰精美、配有软垫的座椅和长沙发。对于这样一个隐藏在地下深处的地方来说……这里显得格外舒适惬意。
rows.raw: "The secret corridor connects the sauna back west to a wide-open chamber to the east. There's a chandelier hanging over a sitting room ahead, and a number of fancy cushioned seats and divans. For something so hidden, so deep underground... this place looks positively cozy."

A beautiful oakwood desk sits facing the door, behind which is a throne-like chair with a golden bullhead mounted over the back. Books and scrolls are scattered across the desk itself, a mad mess of information at its owner's fingertips. At a glance, most of the books are on architecture and engineering, but the scrolls laid out over them... those are [pc.isMage|magic, dark magic, the sort of thing that gets you burned at the stake even today. Mind-control, involuntary transformation, Wraith-touched shit that twists the body and soul.|witchcraft, covered in runes and darkness that makes your head throb when you look at them. Gods...] The [flags.V_BATHS_CAEDLAN_KILLED|dead incuboy's body is still here, next to Radmus's unconscious form|two villains are both fast asleep here, entranced by Livrea's slumbering spell].

The heart of this hidden estate beneath the bath house could fit in nicely in any city patrician's manse. Crystal filled with arcane, smokeless fire hangs from the ceiling, illuminating a circular chamber decorated with heroic frescoes and warm tapestries of the Iavari can's rolling wave sigil. Comfortable, heavily-cushioned chairs and divans line the walls, surrounding a central table laden with sweet treats and wine bottles. 

        There are arches in all four cardinal directions, leading into other chambers: a heavy wooden door to the south and east, and long stone corridors to the north and west. From the north, you can hear the sounds of running water — and a glance in that direction reveals a fountain bubbling away from the breasts of a stone cowgirl.
rows.translation:
这座隐藏在浴场下面的庄园，其内部装潢完全适合任何城市中贵族的宅邸。天花板上悬挂着充满神秘力量的水晶，这些水晶散发着无烟的火焰，照亮了这个圆形房间。房间里装饰着描绘英雄事迹的壁画，以及印有雅瓦里家族象征图案的温暖挂毯。墙壁上排列着舒适、垫料厚实的椅子和长沙发，将一张摆满甜点和葡萄酒瓶的中央桌子围在中间。 

        在四个方向上都设有拱门，这些拱门通向其他房间：南面和东面是厚重的木门，而北面和西面则连接着长长的石制走廊。从北方传来流水声，朝那个方向望去，你会看到一座喷泉正从一座石制“牛仔姑娘”的胸前喷涌而出。

This is Ramien Iavari's private chamber, a small armory-chapel with weapon racks on its walls and a small cot pushed up against the wall — at least, small by the standards of a nearly eight-foot-tall man who's as broad around the shoulders as a kobold is tall. A painting of Velun arrayed in the garb and weapons of a Minothan warrior dominates the far wall. 

        Honors from his legion's campaigns are hung from just about every empty surface, immortalizing a glorious history of martial prowess in service to the kingdom.
        
        [flags.RAMIEN_BATHS_COMBAT|The soldier himself is still passed out, face down in the bed. His armor is a shambles after your fight, scattered haphazardly across the floor when his true nature revealed itself.]
rows.translation:
这是拉米恩·贾瓦里的私人房间，一间小型军械室兼礼拜堂，墙壁上装有武器架，还有一张靠在墙边的小床——至少，对于一个身高接近八英尺、肩膀宽度相当于一个狗头人身高的男人来说，这张床已经算很小的了。远处的墙上挂着一幅描绘维尔伦身着米诺萨战士的服饰、手持武器的画像。 

        他所在的军团在各种战役中获得的荣誉奖章几乎被挂在了所有的空墙上，这些奖章永远记载着他们为王国献身、展现卓越战斗才能的光荣历史。
        
        [flags.RAMIEN_BATHS_COMBAT|那名士兵仍然昏迷不醒，面朝下躺在床上。在你们交战之后，他的盔甲早已破烂不堪，当他真正的身份暴露出来时，那些盔甲散落在地板上，一片狼藉。]

rows.original: Sealed off from the rest of the humid estate by heavy wooden doors to the north, south, and west is a small private library. There's a single long shelf full of tablets and scrolls running through the center of the room, and a few cozy reading chairs against the far wall. [flags.V_BATHS_G5||"These are ancient," Livrea says, tracing her fingers over some of the tablets. "Wow." "Anything interesting?" you ask. She shakes her head. "Couldn't tell you. I see texts in... Laltyrin, pre-Alvarin wedges, Eld Draconic, some Goetish... I recognize the languages, but hell if I can read any of it. I doubt anybody can." [ashe.around|You hear Ashe murmur in your mind. "That draconic script is so old even I can't make sense of it..."] [pc.bg scholar|You peer at them too, and come to the same conclusion. These are examples of the world's earliest writing. Indecipherable to anyone alive now. ]"What the hell is Iavari doing with something like this? And hiding it down here?" Varena shakes her head. "I don't even know the names of those languages, but I can recognize magic runes when I see them." She indicates one of the tablets Livrea's holding. "Not just primitive writing, but primitive magic. Wild stuff. Dangerous."] [flags.V_BATHS_LIBRARY_UNLOCKED||The door to the south has been carved on with a knife, etching runes directly into the wood that has taken on a pale blue glow. You reach out, but can't even put your hand on the door — a shell of magical power rebuffs your touch inches from the handle.]

"I don't even know the names of those languages, but I can recognize magic runes when I see them." She indicates one of the tablets Livrea's holding. "Not just primitive writing, but primitive magic. Wild stuff. Dangerous."] [flags.V_BATHS_LIBRARY_UNLOCKED||The door to the south has been carved on with a knife, etching runes directly into the wood that has taken on a pale blue glow. You reach out, but can't even put your hand on the door — a shell of magical power rebuffs your touch inches from the handle.]'

rows.original:
This dark and foreboding chamber is home to a massive circle of arcane runes etched directly into the stone. Interlocking pentacles and hexagrams scrawl over every inch of floor and wall space, save for a perfect circle six feet in diameter dead center of the room. In the center of the circle rest a pair of thorny roses, freshy cut and fragrant. 

        Looking upon the occult symbols too closely makes your head throb.
        
        "I hate being in here," Varena groans. "Let's leave. Please."
rows.translation:
这个阴暗而令人不寒而栗的房间里，有一圈巨大的神秘符文直接刻在石头上。交错的五角星和六角星图案遍布了地板和墙壁的每一寸空间，唯有房间正中央那处直径六英尺的完美圆形区域除外。在那个圆圈的正中央，摆放着一朵朵新鲜采摘、散发着芳香的带刺玫瑰。

        如果仔细观察这些神秘的符号，会让人感到头痛不已。
        
        “我讨厌待在这里，”瓦蕾娜呻吟道，“我们走吧，求你了。

rows.original: Once the air 'clears,’ you’re in the familiar, shadowy dimension of the Ways Between. You’ve gotten used to the crystals of the dimension burning your eyes as they adjust from the gloom. Beneath your feet is the usual sheen of a gem protecting an image of the world you had just left – although, usually, when you enter the Ways Between, you ostensibly see a 'map’ of the Marshes, but now, the world beneath you is something different. A valley of mountains, some of them with exposed tops billowing pillars of smoke and lava, bordering an ocean in the midst of a terrible storm, the waves beating relentlessly against the shore of the mountain range. You aren’t certain if it’s from the same world you had just left, and if it is, you couldn’t begin to guess where it could be. Behind you is a pillar of light, as usual, but when the light pierces the gem, the streak bends and twists as it’s drawn to the earth below, before it fires off in some other direction, heading across the roiling ocean beneath you. Heading in would probably take you back to Hawkethorne, but... there’s no way to be certain. Berwyn[party.hasCompanions | and [comp1.name] ] are with you – Berwyn’s hand is still in yours once you leave the pillar of light. Sprawled out before you is the expanse of Matiha’s fortress: a stout building, save for the tower in the back, with four thick, sturdy stone walls surrounding an open-air courtyard. The fortress is surrounded by black clouds that haze your vision of its architecture. Thanks to the glassy 'surface’ of the Ways Between, you can see underneath the fortress: there’s an imposing, fiery-red glow beneath the base of the building. And most of the tower is obscured by the moving black clouds that swirl around the fortress, but... the tallest room of the tower shines like a lighthouse through the fog with a piercing, eerie, bluish-green light. The outward shape of the building looks exactly like how you had last seen it when you encountered Matiha – down to the heavy wooden posts that comprise the entrance to the fortress proper.
rows.translation: 当空气变得清澈之后，你便进入了那熟悉的、充满阴影的“道路之间”维度。你已经习惯了这个维度中的水晶会刺痛你的眼睛，因为你的眼睛还在适应那里的昏暗环境。 你的脚下，是那熟悉的宝石光泽——这种光泽保护着你刚刚离开的那个世界的景象。不过，通常情况下，当你进入“道路之间”时，眼前出现的应该是一张代表沼泽地的“地图”；而这一次，你脚下的世界却有所不同。一片群山环绕的山谷，其中一些山峰的顶端裸露在外，不断有烟雾和熔岩喷涌而出。这片山谷位于一片狂暴的风暴之中，海浪无情地拍打着山脉的海岸。你不确定这里是否属于你刚刚离开的那个世界，即便属于，你也完全无法猜出它究竟位于何处。 在你身后，有一道光柱，和往常一样。但当这道轻型穿透那颗宝石时，光束会蜿蜒曲折地向下延伸，最终朝着你脚下的汹涌海洋方向射去。如果继续这样下去的话大概吧这将带你回到鹰棘镇，但是……我们无法确定这一点。 贝林[party.hasCompanions | 以及[comp1.name] ]你并没有孤单——当你离开那道轻型之柱后，贝尔温的手依然紧握着你的手。展现在你眼前的是玛蒂哈堡垒的广阔景象：这是一座坚固的建筑，只有后方的塔楼稍显不同；四面厚实坚硬的石墙将一个露天庭院围了起来。这座堡垒被乌云笼罩，使得人们无法清楚地看到它的建筑结构。 然而，由于“通道”那玻璃般的表面，人们能够看到堡垒的下方：在建筑的底部，有一片令人震撼的火红色光芒在闪烁。塔的大部分结构都被那些在堡垒周围盘旋的黑色云朵所遮挡，但是……塔顶最高的那个房间，却像一座灯塔一样，在迷雾中散发着刺眼而诡异的蓝绿色光芒。 这座建筑的外观与你上次遇到玛蒂哈时所看到的一模一样——甚至连构成堡垒入口的那些粗重木柱也都完全相同。

rows.original:
Berwyn says nothing as he approaches the posts. Once he’s close enough to touch the tip of his staff to the wood, his staff’s tip begins to glow a bright ruby-red; he lifts it into the air (if there is, indeed, air in the Ways Between) and traces an intricate rune into the wood. Once he’s done, the massive wooden doors swing open, just like before.

        Just as before, the wooden posts lead into a wide-open courtyard, with plenty of space given between the center of the yard and the sturdy stone walls of the fortress. Last time you had entered, the place had been converted from whatever it was before into an herb garden: now, it’s still a garden, but the flora it’s home to is... not something that you recognize.
        
        Long, thick ivy vines sprawl across whatever ground is beneath the fortress, wriggling their way through the loam and tearing the paths up as they go. Sections of the vines sport buds; others sport flowers; others sport fruit, fully ripened and matured; and others sport dead flowers, dried leaves, and rotten fruits that weigh the rest of the vine down. Green veins pulsate throughout the lengths of the ivy; the white-and-blue petals of the flowers are punctuated by thin lines of green coursing through them, and the fruits on the stem glow with the brightness of a torch, displaying their innards through their skin – and revealing that they each only have a single, massive seed inside them. Their lights gently pulsate, but they quicken when you approach, and the vine ever-so-slightly shifts away from you... and towards Berwyn.
        
        At the other end of the overgrown and mutated herb garden is another pair of doors sitting at the base of the tower comprising most of the fortress.
rows.translation:
贝尔温一言不发地走向那些木柱。当他靠近到足以用法杖尖端触碰到木头时，法杖的尖端突然发出了鲜艳的红宝石色光芒；他将法杖举到空中（如果“幽冥之路”中真的存在空气的话），然后在木头上刻出了一个复杂的符文。完成这些动作后，那扇巨大的木门就像之前一样，缓缓打开了。

        和上次一样，那些木柱通向一个宽敞的庭院，庭院中央与堡垒坚固的石墙之间留有足够的空间。上次你进入这里时，这个地方已经被改造成了一座药草园；而现在，它依然是一座花园，但其中生长的植物……你已经无法认出了。
        
        长长的、粗壮的常春藤藤蔓蔓延在堡垒下方的每一寸土地上，它们在泥土中蜿蜒生长，将原本的小路也破坏得面目全非。有些藤蔓上还挂着花蕾，有些已经绽放出花朵，还有一些结出了成熟的果实；而还有一些藤蔓上则只剩下枯萎的花朵、干枯的叶子和腐烂的果实，这些沉重的负担使藤蔓难以继续生长。常春藤的茎干中布满了绿色的脉络；那些白蓝相间的花瓣上，也有细绿色的线条贯穿其中；而茎秆上的果实则散发着火炬般的光芒，果皮透明，让人能够看到里面的果实——每个果实里面都只有一颗巨大的种子。它们的光芒会轻轻闪烁，但当你靠近时，这种闪烁会变得更快；而那些藤蔓也会微微偏离你的方向……转向贝尔温。
        
        在那片杂草丛生、发生变异的药草园的另一端，有一扇门矗立在堡垒主体部分的塔基处。

rows.original:
You enter the common room of the tower. There are a few tables, each with their own chairs surrounding them; there’s a small bookshelf sitting against the far wall of the room, its books rife with glowing-green cobwebs; and there’s even a stove and a countertop sitting in the corner.

        It’s almost exactly as you remember it. And, just as you remember it, there is no Matiha to be found.
        
        The ambience of the room has a starkly different attitude to it than before. Berwyn’s mission hasn’t changed: he’s still here to stop Matiha from whatever she’s planning. But now... you can’t help but ask yourself if this is the same woman you had agreed to help Berwyn stop.
        
        Being in the Ways Between, there’s very little natural light within the fortress. There are windows, but neither the light of day nor the gloom of night comes through their windows. Whatever light permeates the room is provided almost entirely by the glowing veins that coarse through the fortress’s bricks.
        
        Berwyn approaches one of the tables and gently lays his fingers on its wooden surface. He drags them across the top, shifting the dust that had settled on them – a nuisance, normally, but the thought that there’s something as mundane and boring as dust in a place like the Ways Between is weirdly comforting.
        
        He sighs through his nose with a quiet hum, staring down at the dinged, dirty wood of the table. It’s far too dirty for him to see his reflection in the wood, but... you imagine that’s not what he’s looking at.
rows.translation:
你走进了塔楼的公共房间。房间里有几张桌子，每张桌子周围都摆放着椅子；房间最远的墙壁上靠着一排小书架，书架上的书籍上覆盖着闪闪发光的绿色蜘蛛网；角落里还有一台炉子和一个操作台。

        这里的一切几乎和你记忆中的一模一样。但正如你所记得的，这里已经没有玛蒂哈了。
        
        房间的氛围与以前相比已经发生了巨大的变化。贝尔温的任务并没有改变：他仍然在这里，试图阻止玛蒂哈实施她的计划。但是现在……你不禁会问自己：这个女人，真的是你当初同意帮助贝尔温去阻止的那个女人吗？
        
        由于位于这些通道之中，堡垒内部几乎没有自然光。虽然有窗户，但无论是白天的阳光还是夜晚的黑暗都无法透过窗户照进来。房间里所能看到的光线，几乎全部来自于那些贯穿堡垒砖墙的发光脉络。
        
        贝尔温走到其中一张桌子旁，轻轻地将手指放在木制桌面上。他的手指在桌面上来回滑动，那些积聚在上面的灰尘被搅动了起来——通常来说，这确实是一件烦人的事，但想到在像“道路之间”这样的地方，竟然也会存在如此平凡而无聊的东西，这种想法反而让人感到一丝莫名的安慰。
        
        他通过鼻子轻轻叹了口气，目光凝视着那张有着凹痕、布满污垢的木桌。桌面太脏了，他根本无法在上面看到自己的倒影，但是……你大概能猜到，他并不是在看这个吧。

rows.original:
This cave is, as promised, full of air; a hole in stone likely created by some shifting underwater. The salty scent of the sea is surprisingly faint down here, as though the raw chill of your surroundings were suppressing it. The only things here are a few body-sized seaweave pillows, and thankfully a large pile of blankets for [party.yall].

        Imora perches on a pillow of her own, brushing her hair and granting you some space to rest.
rows.translation:
正如承诺的那样，这个洞穴里充满了空气；洞壁上的那个洞很可能是由于水下的地质变化而形成的。在这里，海水的咸腥味出奇地淡薄，仿佛周围刺骨的寒意压制了这种气味。这里唯一的物品就是一些大小与人体相当的海浪形状的“枕头”，而值得庆幸的是，这里还有一大堆毯子[party.yall]

        伊莫拉独自坐在枕头上，梳理着自己的头发，同时也给你留出一些休息的空间。
rows.raw: "This cave is, as promised, full of air; a hole in stone likely created by some shifting underwater. The salty scent of the sea is surprisingly faint down here, as though the raw chill of your surroundings were suppressing it. The only things here are a few body-sized seaweave pillows, and thankfully a large pile of blankets for [party.yall].\n\n        Imora perches on a pillow of her own, brushing her hair and granting you some space to rest."

rows.original: The front door to this building is an incredible feature; they're made of ancient wood, which — despite what must be similarly-incredible age — only recently started to rot. Huge metal rings hang from them like regular door-knockers, as though sized for a giant man. [pc.bg acolyte scholar|Thinking about it... that's exactly the case. You're definitely looking at an old jotun fort that must have sunk, or broken off from the rock shelf it was built upon. Perhaps at the same time the air-cave came into being? An earthquake would certainly do the job.] Two siorcanna stand guard, a man and a woman with easy smiles and weighty tridents... and judging by the fact that the woman's thighs are glued together, you're pretty sure you know how they like to pass the time.
rows.translation: 这栋建筑的前门设计得非常独特：它们由古老的木材制成，尽管这些木材的年代肯定也非常久远，但直到最近才开始腐烂。巨大的金属环悬挂在门上，就像普通的门环一样，不过这些金属环的尺寸似乎是为巨人设计的。 [pc.bg acolyte scholar|仔细想想……确实是这样。正是如此情况确实如此。你眼前看到的肯定是一座古老的巨人之堡，它要么已经沉没，要么从原本建造它的岩架上断裂下来。也许就在那个时候，这个空气洞穴也形成了？地震肯定能够造成这样的现象。] 两名女战士站岗守卫，一名男子和一名女子，他们面带轻松的笑容，手中握着沉重的三叉戟……而从那名女子紧贴在一起的大腿来看，你大概能猜到发生了什么他们用来消磨时间。
