You're definitely looking at an old jotun fort that must have sunk, or broken off from the rock shelf it was built upon. Perhaps at the same time the air-cave came into being? An earthquake would certainly do the job.]\n\n Two siorcanna stand guard, a man and a woman with easy smiles and weighty tridents... and judging by the fact that the woman's thighs are glued together, you're pretty sure you know how they like to pass the time."

rows.original: The foyer is much as you left it, although the door has now been forced open, and what remains of the stone arch above them has collapsed into a heap. Still; you can at least crawl through and continue your progress.
rows.translation: 门厅依然保持着你离开时的样子，只不过门已经被强行打开了，他们头顶上那座石拱也已经坍塌成了一堆废墟。不过，至少你还可以爬过去，继续前进。
rows.raw: "The foyer is much as you left it, although the door has now been forced open, and what remains of the stone arch above them has collapsed into a heap. Still; you can at least crawl through and continue your progress."

rows.original:
With the door caved in, what remains of the foyer looks thoroughly trashed. A combination of stone-chips, dirt, and dust, has been kicked up into the water where it obscures your vision. It's uncanny, having to 'hold your breath' underwater to get through, but the way is clear to the east.

        The west, however, is a mess of smashed stone columns; nothing up there but ruin to inspect.
rows.translation:
门被撞得粉碎，门厅剩下的部分看上去一片狼藉。石块碎片、泥土和灰尘混在水中，使得视线变得模糊不清。在水下前进时，不得不“屏住呼吸”，不过往东的方向倒是畅通无阻。

        然而，西侧一片狼藉，石柱都被撞得粉碎；那里只剩下一片废墟，什么也看不到了。
rows.raw: "With the door caved in, what remains of the foyer looks thoroughly trashed. A combination of stone-chips, dirt, and dust, has been kicked up into the water where it obscures your vision. It's uncanny, having to 'hold your breath' underwater to get through, but the way is clear to the east.\n\n        The west, however, is a mess of smashed stone columns; nothing up there but ruin to inspect."

rows.original:
Now that the eel has been defeated, you get a chance to take in your surroundings; this room is clearly the fort's foyer, with some kind of viewing platform to the west. It's possible to make out the worn sleeves and columns for holding man-sized arrows with, perhaps for taking out anyone strong enough to break in the front door.

        The eel itself must have done a great deal of damage to this particular room, however... A cursory inspection of the eastern door shows that the handles have been smashed off, and the cracked stonework arch above it has collapsed inward, sticking the door fast.
rows.translation:
现在这条鳗鱼已经被击败，你可以仔细观察周围的环境了——这个房间显然是堡垒的入口处，西边似乎还有一个观景平台。可以清楚地看到那些磨损的袖子状结构，以及用来固定那些足以射中入侵者的人身大小的箭矢的柱子，这些设施可能是用来对付那些能够强行突破前门入侵的敌人吧。

        这条鳗鱼肯定对这个房间造成了严重的破坏……不过，粗略检查东门后发现，门把手已经被砸掉了，门上那块裂开的石制拱门也向内坍塌了，导致门被牢牢卡住无法打开。
rows.raw: "Now that the eel has been defeated, you get a chance to take in your surroundings; this room is clearly the fort's foyer, with some kind of viewing platform to the west. It's possible to make out the worn sleeves and columns for holding man-sized arrows with, perhaps for taking out anyone strong enough to break in the front door.\n\n        The eel itself must have done a great deal of damage to this particular room, however... A cursory inspection of the eastern door shows that the handles have been smashed off, and the cracked stonework arch above it has collapsed inward, sticking the door fast."

rows.original:
From this platform you have a perfect view of the foyer below. Up here are a number of large stone columns with empty torch-sconces, and an old, rotten longbow that indicates the foyer below was probably a rather terrifying killing floor for invaders.

        [pc.isCunning|Now that you look at it again, you're fairly sure one of these huge support columns would be large enough to reach the door if you pushed it over.]
rows.translation:
从这个平台上，你可以清楚地看到下方的门厅。这里有几根巨大的石柱，柱子上安装着空荡荡的火炬架，还有一把老旧而腐朽的长弓——这些元素都表明，下方的门厅很可能曾经是入侵者们面临的最大威胁之地。

        [pc.isCunning|现在再仔细想想，你差不多可以肯定，这些巨大的支撑柱中有一根的长度足以够到那扇门，只要把它们推倒就可以了。]
rows.raw: "From this platform you have a perfect view of the foyer below. Up here are a number of large stone columns with empty torch-sconces, and an old, rotten longbow that indicates the foyer below was probably a rather terrifying killing floor for invaders.\n\n        [pc.isCunning|Now that you look at it again, you're fairly sure one of these huge support columns would be large enough to reach the door if you pushed it over.]"

rows.original:
The other side of the stone door is... 'dusty.' Old sediment clings to the floor beneath you, where every swimming step[party.comp agni| — or awkward, frustrated flap from Agni —] kicks up clouds of dirt. 

        It's unsettlingly quiet after the roar of monsters, or the grating sounds of tumbling stone... the only thing out of the ordinary is a faint current, eddies and swirls kicked up by your [pc.feet] are lifted away and down the corridor.
rows.translation:
石门另一边……“尘土飞扬”。陈旧的沉积物附着在你下方的地面上，每划水前进一步[party.comp agni|——或者阿格尼懊恼又笨拙地扑腾一下——]，都会扬起团团泥沙。  

        怪物的咆哮声和石块翻滚的刺耳声过后，四周安静得令人不安……唯一不同寻常的是一股微弱的水流，它将[pc.feet]搅起的涡流卷走，带向走廊深处。
rows.raw: "The other side of the stone door is... 'dusty.' Old sediment clings to the floor beneath you, where every swimming step[party.comp agni| — or awkward, frustrated flap from Agni —] kicks up clouds of dirt. \n\n        It's unsettlingly quiet after the roar of monsters, or the grating sounds of tumbling stone... the only thing out of the ordinary is a faint current, eddies and swirls kicked up by your [pc.feet] are lifted away and down the corridor."

rows.original:
Further signs of collapse and destruction mark this portion of the fort, although you can make out hints of stone-carvings in the wall... it's hard to parse them however.

        Three large figures with their hands up in the air, holding axes.
        One smaller figure, with axe in one hand, and a horn in the other, playing into a sunbeam.
        Three figures sleeping, with a fourth, smaller figure sneaking past.
        
        It looks like you're still missing a few carvings and details; without context it's impossible to say what's going on.
        
        Further north there appears to a clearer wall, covered in instruments.
rows.translation:
这座要塞的这一部分同样遍布坍塌与破坏的痕迹，不过墙上仍能隐约看见一些石刻……只是很难解读。

        三个高大的身影双手高举，握着斧头。
        一个较小的身影，一手持斧，一手持号，在一道阳光中吹响号角。
        三个身影沉睡着，第四个较小的身影则悄悄从旁溜过。
        
        看来这里仍缺少几幅雕刻和一些细节；没有上下文，根本无从判断发生了什么。
        
        更北边似乎有一面保存得更清楚的墙，上面刻满乐器。
rows.raw:
"Further signs of collapse and destruction mark this portion of the fort, although you can make out hints of stone-carvings in the wall... it's hard to parse them however.

        Three large figures with their hands up in the air, holding axes.
        One smaller figure, with axe in one hand, and a horn in the other, playing into a sunbeam.
        Three figures sleeping, with a fourth, smaller figure sneaking past.
        
        It looks like you're still missing a few carvings and details; without context it's impossible to say what's going on.
        
        Further north there appears to a clearer wall, covered in instruments."

rows.original: To the east is a wood-and-bronze door, surprisingly intact and un-rotted despite the salt water of the rift... and to the north is a series of collapsed roof supports that you'd have to crawl through to progress. More important than those entryways, however, is a selection of three drums made of glass. They're see-through, shallow tubs with scuffs and marks across their glass surfaces. Surely if the drums are scuffed they've been struck despite their fragile appearance, and when you press a hand up against the side of one you can feel subtle vibrations. On the wall, above these drums, clearly painted — and re-painted, from the look of it — are a series of dots and dashes, an image of a skull, and an image of a closed eye.
rows.translation: 东边有一扇由木头和青铜制成的门，尽管裂隙中的海水不断侵蚀，但它却出奇地完好无损，丝毫没有腐烂……而北边则有一排倒塌的屋顶支撑结构，要想继续前进，就必须从这些结构下面爬过去。 然而，比这些入口更为重要的是那三面由玻璃制成的鼓。它们是透明的、浅形的容器，玻璃表面布满了划痕和痕迹。毫无疑问如果这些鼓虽然外观脆弱，但被敲击后仍会发出声响；当你将手放在其中一只鼓的侧面时，能够感受到微弱的震动。 在墙壁上，这些鼓的正上方，清晰地画着——从痕迹来看，应该是被重新绘制过的——一系列点划符号、一个骷髅的形象，以及一只闭着的眼睛的图案。
rows.raw: "To the east is a wood-and-bronze door, surprisingly intact and un-rotted despite the salt water of the rift... and to the north is a series of collapsed roof supports that you'd have to crawl through to progress. More important than those entryways, however, is a selection of three drums made of glass. They're see-through, shallow tubs with scuffs and marks across their glass surfaces. Surely if the drums are scuffed they've been struck despite their fragile appearance, and when you press a hand up against the side of one you can feel subtle vibrations. On the wall, above these drums, clearly painted — and re-painted, from the look of it — are a series of dots and dashes, an image of a skull, and an image of a closed eye."

rows.original:
With the jotun defeated, and your 'prize' claimed, the pulpit waits empty, and quiet. You could swear there's a shaft of sunlight crossing the plinth, but only ever out of the corner of your eye.
        
        ...No doubt this wasn't the first time, nor will it be the last time that terrifying skald faces defeat to some hopeful.
rows.translation:
随着那个巨人的被击败，以及你“夺得的战利品”被收走，那个讲坛此刻空荡荡的，一片寂静。你甚至敢发誓，有一缕阳光从基座上照射过来，但那只是你眼角的余光所看到的而已。
        
        ……毫无疑问，这既不是第一次，也不会是最后一次，那些可怕的怪物最终会被一些满怀希望的人击败。
rows.raw: "With the jotun defeated, and your 'prize' claimed, the pulpit waits empty, and quiet. You could swear there's a shaft of sunlight crossing the plinth, but only ever out of the corner of your eye.\n        \n        ...No doubt this wasn't the first time, nor will it be the last time that terrifying skald faces defeat to some hopeful."

rows.original:
Thank the gods you're underwater; climbing through this hallway would be awful, due to a collapsed roof. You can just barely swim over the obstruction in order to get deeper into the temple.

        To the west you can hear soft singing, [flags.CHALLENGE_TEMPLE_AMETHYSTA|although it's somewhat weary after your confrontation with Amethysta.|and it tugs eerily on your heartstrings.] The cause of all of this damage... including the temperament of the Eel you'd fought in the foyer, becomes obvious to [party.yall]. 
        
        Although now drained empty, the large barrel sticking out of the ceiling — lid cracked open and long drained — undoubtedly belonged to the kind the cultists were dumping into the ocean. Although you and Gweyr put a stop to this, the impact is going to be seen for a while yet. In this case, the impact was all too literal.
        
        Puddling near the door, heavier than the water around it, is a puddle of glowing goop, from which seems to be sprouting some quite-healthy seaweed. Perhaps drinking from the corrupt brew might ease your tired humors?
rows.translation:
谢天谢地你现在在水中；如果要从这条走廊爬过去的话，由于屋顶已经坍塌，那肯定非常危险。你只能勉强游过那些障碍物，才能继续往寺庙的深处前进。

        在西方，你能听到轻柔的歌声。 [flags.CHALLENGE_TEMPLE_AMETHYSTA|尽管在与阿玛泽斯塔对峙之后，你感到有些疲惫。|而且，它还会以一种令人不安的方式触动你的心弦。]所有这些破坏……连同你在门厅交战的那条鳗鱼性情异常的原因，都已在[party.yall]眼前显而易见。
        
        虽然现在已经空空如也，但那个从天花板上伸出来的大桶——盖子已经裂开，里面的液体早已被倒光——毫无疑问，就是那些邪教徒用来把东西倒入海洋中的桶。尽管你和格维尔阻止了他们的行为，但其影响仍然会在一段时间内显现出来。在这种情况下，这种影响简直再形象不过了。
        
        在门附近积聚的那滩水，比周围的水要浓稠得多，那是一滩发光的黏稠物，从中似乎还长出了一些相当茂盛的海藻。或许喝下这种被污染的水，能让你的情绪变得好一些吧？
rows.raw:
"Thank the gods you're underwater; climbing through this hallway would be awful, due to a collapsed roof. You can just barely swim over the obstruction in order to get deeper into the temple.

        To the west you can hear soft singing, [flags.CHALLENGE_TEMPLE_AMETHYSTA|although it's somewhat weary after your confrontation with Amethysta.|and it tugs eerily on your heartstrings.] The cause of all of this damage... including the temperament of the Eel you'd fought in the foyer, becomes obvious to [party.yall]. 
        
        Although now drained empty, the large barrel sticking out of the ceiling — lid cracked open and long drained — undoubtedly belonged to the kind the cultists were dumping into the ocean. Although you and Gweyr put a stop to this, the impact is going to be seen for a while yet. In this case, the impact was all too literal.
        
        Puddling near the door, heavier than the water around it, is a puddle of glowing goop, from which seems to be sprouting some quite-healthy seaweed. Perhaps drinking from the corrupt brew might ease your tired humors?"

rows.original:
With Amethysta defeated, the monstrous tentacle-shark-abomination is laid out peacefully, with eyes glazed over and a soft echoing song in her chest. Now that you're aware her singing is something psionic, you're careful to distract yourself by humming a different tune.

        What had been a rack of useful arms, has been worn away to nothing or looted in challenges past... instead an impromptu bed appears to have been made from several-dozen seaweave cloaks and robes. Arcane lanterns set into the walls cast the room in a pale blue light. Amethysta has made quite the quaint little fuck-den out of her underwater haunt, all she really needs is a reliable food source.
        
        Back the way you've come is a ruined corridor between you and what might well be your final test.
rows.translation:
随着紫水晶被击败，那只拥有触手、外形像鲨鱼的怪物终于安静了下来，它的眼睛失去了神采，胸腔中传来轻柔的回响声。现在你知道它的这种“歌唱”其实是一种灵能现象，于是你便刻意哼起另一首曲子，以此来转移自己的注意力。

        那些原本可以派上用场的武器，要么在过去的挑战中被消耗殆尽，要么被抢走了……取而代之的是，人们似乎用几十件海浪带来的斗篷和长袍临时搭成了一张床。墙壁上安装的神秘灯笼将房间照成了淡蓝色的光亮。紫水晶把她的水下藏身处打造成了一个相当古朴的小天地，她真正需要的只是一种可靠的食物来源。
        
        沿着你来时的路返回，你会看到一条被毁坏的走廊，而那走廊的尽头，很可能就是你最终需要面对的考验。
rows.raw:
"With Amethysta defeated, the monstrous tentacle-shark-abomination is laid out peacefully, with eyes glazed over and a soft echoing song in her chest. Now that you're aware her singing is something psionic, you're careful to distract yourself by humming a different tune.

        What had been a rack of useful arms, has been worn away to nothing or looted in challenges past... instead an impromptu bed appears to have been made from several-dozen seaweave cloaks and robes. Arcane lanterns set into the walls cast the room in a pale blue light. Amethysta has made quite the quaint little fuck-den out of her underwater haunt, all she really needs is a reliable food source.
        
        Back the way you've come is a ruined corridor between you and what might well be your final test."

rows.original: This otherwise nondescript corridor is unsettling in how fresh it looks. The ground has been swept, the walls have been scrubbed... at least at some point, and there's a large, oil-treated cauldron besides a collection of jars and smaller, electrum cauldrons that the siorcs use to perform alchemy underwater. It's a long corridor, completely empty, but everything about this setup screams danger.
rows.translation: 这条原本平平无奇的走廊看起来竟如此崭新，让你感到不安。地面扫过，墙壁也刷洗过……至少曾经如此。旁边有一口经过油处理的大锅，还有一些罐子和几口较小的琥珀金锅，供西奥克人在水下炼金时使用。 走廊很长，空无一人，但眼前的布置无处不透着危险。
rows.raw: "This otherwise nondescript corridor is unsettling in how fresh it looks. The ground has been swept, the walls have been scrubbed... at least at some point, and there's a large, oil-treated cauldron besides a collection of jars and smaller, electrum cauldrons that the siorcs use to perform alchemy underwater.\n\n It's a long corridor, completely empty, but everything about this setup screams danger."

rows.original: With the Hydra gone, this is nothing but an empty room. The exit awaits you, doors already open, and the sparkly figure of Imora just barely visible petting said hydra's massive form.
rows.translation: 随着九头蛇的消失，这里只不过是一间空荡荡的房间。出口就在前方，门已经敞开，而伊莫拉那闪烁着光芒的身影，正轻轻抚摸着那巨大的九头蛇躯体。
rows.raw: "With the Hydra gone, this is nothing but an empty room. The exit awaits you, doors already open, and the sparkly figure of Imora just barely visible petting said hydra's massive form."

rows.original: Here on the northern street, you can see Seastone's home at the town's edge, although it's set a little lower into the ground than you'd expect. Out here on the outskirts there are only residentials ahead; large houses of rounded stone and colorful coral. [dayNight||With nightfall, you can see the streets are lit by a beautiful array of lanterns; that same light bounces off of the ice shelves above, giving Starhome its iconic name.]
rows.translation: 在北边的这条街上，你可以看到海石的家，它位于城镇的边缘，不过它的地基比你想象中要低一些。在这个郊区，前方只有一排排住宅，那些都是用圆石建造的宽敞房屋，外墙还涂着五彩斑斓的珊瑚色。 [dayNight||夜幕降临时，你会发现街道上挂满了各式各样的灯笼，它们散发出的光芒照亮了整个街道；而同样的光线也会反射在上方的冰架上，正是这种光芒为“星之家园”这个地方赋予了它那标志性的名称。]
rows.raw: "Here on the northern street, you can see Seastone's home at the town's edge, although it's set a little lower into the ground than you'd expect. Out here on the outskirts there are only residentials ahead; large houses of rounded stone and colorful coral. [dayNight||With nightfall, you can see the streets are lit by a beautiful array of lanterns; that same light bounces off of the ice shelves above, giving Starhome its iconic name.]"

rows.original: Seastone's throne dominates the Starhome square, surrounded by colorful foliage to help keep out any noise. You could swear the [silly|derpy|gormless] fish-faces that make up the weighty marble throne's arms are watching you as you walk by. From here you can reach everywhere of importance in the town, at least according to the signpost nearby. To the east is the street towards the 'Gym and Fuckhouse', to the west is the street leading to a large chapel, and south is the gate leading to 'The Shark Park', from which even here you can see siorcanna walking actual sharks, and a few particularly large-looking crabs.
rows.translation: 海石王座占据主导地位星之家广场被五彩斑斓的植被环绕，这些植被仿佛能帮助隔绝一切噪音。你甚至会觉得[silly|愚蠢的|gormless]当你走过时，那些构成那座沉重的大理石王座扶手的“鱼脸”似乎都在注视着你。 从这里，至少根据附近的指示牌来看，你可以到达镇上的所有重要地点。 向东是通往“健身房与妓院”的街道，向西是通往一座大型小教堂的道路，而向南则是通往“鲨鱼公园”的大门。即使从这里，你也能看到那些巫师们正在带着真正的鲨鱼以及一些看起来特别大的螃蟹四处走动。
rows.raw: "Seastone's throne dominates the Starhome square, surrounded by colorful foliage to help keep out any noise. You could swear the [silly|derpy|gormless] fish-faces that make up the weighty marble throne's arms are watching you as you walk by. From here you can reach everywhere of importance in the town, at least according to the signpost nearby. To the east is the street towards the 'Gym and Fuckhouse', to the west is the street leading to a large chapel, and south is the gate leading to 'The Shark Park', from which even here you can see siorcanna walking actual sharks, and a few particularly large-looking crabs."

rows.original: The eastern street is a spotless row of luminous red-and-white-glowing street lamps, with neat hedges of seaweed and brightly-colored coral. Further east is the entrance to a large two-section building; one is a gym, the other appears to have simply been labelled 'Fuckhouse.' Go figure that watching muscular sharks work out could well count for foreplay in this town.
rows.translation: 东街上一排排红白相间的路灯亮着，海藻修剪得整整齐齐，五彩斑斓的珊瑚也点缀其间。再往东走，就能看到一座由两部分组成的大型建筑的入口——其中一部分是健身房，而另一部分则被简单地标上了“妓院”二字。想想看，在这个小镇上，观看肌肉发达的鲨鱼进行锻炼，或许也算是一种前戏吧……
rows.raw: "The eastern street is a spotless row of luminous red-and-white-glowing street lamps, with neat hedges of seaweed and brightly-colored coral. Further east is the entrance to a large two-section building; one is a gym, the other appears to have simply been labelled 'Fuckhouse.' Go figure that watching muscular sharks work out could well count for foreplay in this town."

rows.original:
Even underwater, it's possible to work up a sweat... at least that's what your own body is telling you; the temperature rises a few degrees in this stone building, and the scent of [silly|sexercise|sex and exercise] is strong enough to taste. The weight benches are instead tension-benches, with increasing numbers of rubbery vines to match the challenge. It makes sense; your capacity for lifting weight is a lot higher once you're underwater. 

        Men and women ogle lithe siorcs performing gymnastics, muscular siorcs lifting hauling tension-weights, and big-bummed Alphas and Betas both squatting their way to a fantastic ass. At the back of the gym is the perfectly-toned form of Bloodfavor, the owner of this gym. His valkyrie Beta-wife, Helena, sits beside him, soaking in the sexual atmosphere with a comfortable smile.
        
        A door separates the gym from the associated 'Fuckhouse', where siorcanna who have gotten a bit too hot under the collar can blow off some steam.
rows.translation:
即使在水下，也可能运动到出汗……至少你的身体是这么告诉你的。这座石砌建筑里的温度高了几度，[silly|性爱健身|性爱与运动]的气味浓得仿佛能尝到。这里的训练凳并非用来举重，而是用来训练拉力；为增加难度，凳上装有数量不等的弹性藤蔓。这很合理：在水下，你能举起的重量本就大得多。 

        男女们欣赏着身形轻盈的西奥克人做体操、肌肉发达的西奥克人拉动阻力器材，还有臀部丰满的阿尔法和贝塔通过深蹲练出诱人的翘臀。健身房后方站着身材匀称的馆主布洛德费弗。他的女武神贝塔妻子海伦娜坐在一旁，面带舒心的微笑，沉浸在这暧昧的氛围中。
        
        一扇门隔开了健身房和附设的‘性爱屋’，那些欲火中烧的西奥卡娜人可以到那里尽情发泄。

rows.original: The 'Fuckhouse' is not a witty name; this is a place where horny people come to fuck and get fucked; just looking around the room you can see some of the public-use bitches on their hands and knees, assholes and cunts leaking thick siorc seed, a large siorc being almost constantly sucked off, and the owner — Dior — with her two Betas comfortably splayed out in the center of the room on a bed of pillows, playing with eachother. If the scent of sex and sweat were strong in the gym, in here it's so deliciously sweet that it would make your mouth water if you weren't... already underwater. Eila smiles from her pillow-den and beckons you over, but there are plenty of willing harlots to entertain you, all desperate to impregnate or become pregnant.

rows.raw: "The 'Fuckhouse' is not a witty name; this is a place where horny people come to fuck and get fucked; just looking around the room you can see some of the public-use bitches on their hands and knees, assholes and cunts leaking thick siorc seed, a large siorc being almost constantly sucked off, and the owner — Dior — with her two Betas comfortably splayed out in the center of the room on a bed of pillows, playing with eachother. \n\n If the scent of sex and sweat were strong in the gym, in here it's so deliciously sweet that it would make your mouth water if you weren't... already underwater. Eila smiles from her pillow-den and beckons you over, but there are plenty of willing harlots to entertain you, all desperate to impregnate or become pregnant."

rows.original: The 'Shark Park' appears to be a place for people to "walk" their pets, get some exercise, and socialize with others... perfectly normal, except for the fact that pets in Starhome consist of actual nurse sharks, and particularly large crabs. There's also a little building that reads 'bathing hut', where siorcs enter and leave with pet sharks in tow.
rows.translation: “鲨鱼公园”似乎是供人们“遛”宠物、锻炼身体和社交的地方……再正常不过了，除了星之家的宠物是真正的护士鲨，以及体型特别大的螃蟹。 这里还有一座标着“洗浴小屋”的小建筑，希奥克人牵着宠物鲨鱼进进出出。

rows.original: The western street looks as though it should be the quietest; homes are more spread out, the streets are wider, and up ahead is a quaint-looking chapel... but even from here you can hear the singing. A glorious statue of a winged siorc, whose glorious gothic hair is lifted up like the center of a storm stands on one side of the pathway — a siorcanna rendition of Sorra — while a perfect representation of the glorious and curvaceous Lumia stands opposite her.
rows.translation: 西街看起来这里本该是最宁静的地方：房屋分布得较为分散，街道也更为宽阔，前方还有一座外观古朴的小教堂……但即便从这里，也能听到传来的歌声。小路的一侧矗立着一座巍峨的雕像，那是一位长着翅膀的女巫，她那华丽的哥特式长发仿佛被风暴卷起般高高飘扬——这其实是女巫萨拉的形象；而在她的对面，则矗立着一位形象完美、身形婀娜的女神卢米娅。
rows.raw: "The western street looks as though it should be the quietest; homes are more spread out, the streets are wider, and up ahead is a quaint-looking chapel... but even from here you can hear the singing. A glorious statue of a winged siorc, whose glorious gothic hair is lifted up like the center of a storm stands on one side of the pathway — a siorcanna rendition of Sorra — while a perfect representation of the glorious and curvaceous Lumia stands opposite her."

rows.original: The chapel is a beautiful slate-and-marble combination, with tall, vaulted ceilings. The majority of the space is standing room, apart from some very well-cushioned, quite wide chairs constructed for those who may be expecting parents. The head priestess stands proudly at the pulpit, humming a pleasant tune with her eyes closed; the massive, powerfully-built siorcanna-valkyrie is practically glowing. [pc.pregStage 1|Her eyes snap open in the presence of your pregnant belly, and she gives you a winsome, pleased smile.]
rows.translation: 这座小教堂采用了美丽的板岩与大理石相结合的建筑材料，天花板高耸且呈拱形结构。除了为即将成为父母的准父母们准备的一些座椅外，其余空间都可供人们站立活动。 首席女祭司骄傲地站在讲坛前，闭着眼睛轻声哼着悦耳的曲调；这位身材高大、体格强健的希奥卡纳-女武神，简直发光的。 [pc.pregStage 1|看到你隆起的孕肚，她的目光立刻被吸引住了，然后她露出了一个甜美而愉悦的笑容。]
rows.raw: "The chapel is a beautiful slate-and-marble combination, with tall, vaulted ceilings. The majority of the space is standing room, apart from some very well-cushioned, quite wide chairs constructed for those who may be expecting parents. \n\n The head priestess stands proudly at the pulpit, humming a pleasant tune with her eyes closed; the massive, powerfully-built siorcanna-valkyrie is practically glowing. [pc.pregStage 1|Her eyes snap open in the presence of your pregnant belly, and she gives you a winsome, pleased smile.]"

rows.original:
The High Shaman's home is a beautiful combination of working laboratory, tasteful curtains, and a gigantic bed upon which lay a colorful assortment of sleepy shaman Betas. The air — and it is indeed air, considering you have to enter through an air-lock — is rich with the scent of sex and various lightly-perfumed oils. Seastone herself is sat in a chair that looks a lot more comfortable than her throne outside.
        
        Doubtless the Seastone family's home has to remain dry considering it stores all of their shamanistic, alchemical supplies, but it still proves unsettling to look outside of a glass window and see citizens swimming lazily through the 'air.' Your [seastone.isABN
            |Alpha looks up from her seat and smiles toothily, waiting to see if you'll approach.
            |Beta grins and blushes faintly when your eyes fall on her, and she waits to see if you'll approach.
            |massive muscular shark-friend smiles from where she sits, waiting to see if you'll approach.
        ] Off to the left is the entrance to Imora's room, easily identified by curtains that look as sparkly and star-filled as she is.
rows.translation:
高等萨满的住所将实验室、高雅的窗帘以及一张巨大的床完美地结合在了一起。床上躺着一些色彩斑斓、看起来昏昏欲睡的萨满贝塔们。空气——确实就是空气，因为你必须通过一个气锁才能进入这个空间——中弥漫着性爱的气息以及各种带有淡淡香味的精油。海石本人坐在一把看起来比她外面的王座要舒适得多的椅子上。
        
        毫无疑问，考虑到海石家族家中存放着他们所有的萨满仪式用品和炼金材料，这个房子必须保持干燥，但当透过玻璃窗看到市民们懒洋洋地在“空气中”游来游去时，还是会让人感到不安。你的[seastone.isABN
            |阿尔法从座位上抬起头，露出一口灿烂的笑容，等着看你是否会主动走向她。
            |当你的目光落在她身上时，贝塔会微微露出笑容，脸颊也会泛起红晕。而她，则在等待着看你是否会主动走向她。
            |她坐在那里，露出灿烂的笑容，仿佛是一只肌肉发达的鲨鱼朋友，正在等待看看你是否会主动靠近她。
        ]往左边走就是伊莫拉的房间入口，那扇装饰着闪烁星辰的窗帘，让人一眼就能认出来——它们和她本人一样，都充满了璀璨的光芒。

rows.original:
Imora's room continues the theme of Seastone's house; a sex-den-turned-lab. Stacks of clay tablets with observation notes cover a large desk of wood you're amazed even got down here under the water, and a stack of ingredients hang to dry beside them. Two heavy, porcelain-lined cauldrons bubble over magical stones that glow red-hot, carefully crafted to prevent them from reacting as they would in the siorc's usual self-sealing electrum cauldrons. 

        The star-spangled shaman is laid out in a great big couch of seaweave pillows, practicing designs on a chalk-board. When Imora notices you inspecting her room she places the chalkboard down, fluffing out her lengthy locks and checking her soft white lashes.
rows.translation:
伊莫拉的房间延续了海石之屋的风格——一个原本用于私密的场所，如今被改造成了实验室。一堆堆写满观察记录的泥板堆放在一张巨大的木桌上，你甚至会惊讶于这张桌子是如何被安置在水下的；旁边还有一堆正在晾干的食材。两个内壁贴有瓷层的重型大锅，放置在炽热发红的魔法石上；这些大锅经过精心设计，能够防止它们像在萨奥克通常使用的自密封电银大锅中那样发生反应。

        那位身披星辰图案服饰的萨满躺在铺满海藻枕头的巨大长椅上，在粉笔板上练习着各种法术图案。当伊莫拉注意到你在检查她的房间时，她把黑板放了下来，整理了一下自己那长长的秀发，然后检查了自己那柔软洁白的睫毛。

Two heavy, porcelain-lined cauldrons bubble over magical stones that glow red-hot, carefully crafted to prevent them from reacting as they would in the siorc's usual self-sealing electrum cauldrons. \n\n        The star-spangled shaman is laid out in a great big couch of seaweave pillows, practicing designs on a chalk-board. When Imora notices you inspecting her room she places the chalkboard down, fluffing out her lengthy locks and checking her soft white lashes."

rows.original: [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|The grand entrance to the palace glimmers in the light of several hundred torches and, and the whole stretch is toasty and warm despite the perpetual arctic conditions just outside. A host of braziers illuminate the flags of different societies. Some are recognizable, including Belhar and the boer'alvar, but some have completely faded to the point of being unintelligible pale cloth. The room stretches much wider than it is long, with a slight curve that connects it to the other parts of the castle. The primary way deeper in is wide open, but most of the other doors are closed. Valkyries occasionally enter and exit the side doors, but more often they can be seen using the main thoroughfare on their way to other parts of the castle.|Your escorts are here, waiting for you to at least meet with Lumia. You came here, so you might as well at least see her before leaving.]
rows.translation: [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|宫殿的宏伟入口在数百支火炬的光芒中闪烁着光芒，尽管外界仍处于严寒的北极环境中，但这一整个区域却充满了温暖与舒适。许多火盆照亮了代表着不同社会的旗帜。其中一些仍然可以辨认出来，比如贝尔哈尔和那些布尔阿尔瓦人，但也有一些已经完全消失了，变得难以辨认，就像一些褪了色的布片一样。这个房间的宽度要比长度大得多，它呈轻微的弯曲状，与城堡的其他部分相连。通往更深处的那扇大门是敞开的，但其他大多数门都紧闭着。女武神们偶尔会从侧门进出，但更常见的情况是，人们会看到她们通过主通道前往城堡的其他区域。|你的随从已经到来了，他们在等着你至少去见见卢米娅。既然你来到了这里，那么在离开之前至少见她一面也是应该的。]

rows.original: [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|The first northern wing of the palace contains the baths. The natural glacial ice provides plenty of water for a full set of baths, and some of the pools are even marked as containing aqueous tunnels that lead all the way to the sea. This allows selkies and siorcana as well as valkyries in relation with such beings free access to the castle. There are warm water and cold water baths, as well as a number of specialty options including honey and incense infused waters. Though there are a couple closed off rooms for private bathing, the vast majority of the baths are both public and visible from the center of the room. The private baths usually end up being used for non-bathing endeavors. In keeping with the size of the halls, the largest bath looks more like a small lake, and may well have been an underground reservoir before the palace was built. The other baths are smaller, but constitute a variety of depths for races of differing size.|Just more gloom, no different from the rest.]
rows.translation: [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|宫殿的北侧第一翼区域设有浴场。天然的冰川冰为这些浴场提供了充足的用水，其中一些浴池还被标示出含有通向大海的水下隧道。这使得人鱼、西奥卡娜以及与这些生物相关的女武神能够自由进入这座城堡。城堡内设有温水浴和冷水浴，同时还提供多种特殊选项，比如加入蜂蜜或香薰成分的水浴。虽然有几间封闭的房间可供私人沐浴使用，但绝大多数浴室都是公共的，而且从房间的中央就能看到。那些私人浴室往往会被用于其他非沐浴用途。考虑到这些大厅的规模，最大的那个浴缸看起来更像是一个小湖泊，而且很可能真的就是这样的。已经在宫殿建成之前，这里原本是一个地下蓄水池。其他那些浴池规模较小，但它们的深度各不相同，因此可以满足不同体型人群的需求。|只不过是更多的阴郁罢了，与其他地方并没有什么不同。]

rows.original: [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|The main hall of the castle is wide and spacious, with enough room for a whole legion to fit through with room to spread their arms. There aren't nearly that many Valkyries in the area at any given time, but there are several filtering about to different parts of the castle at any given time. Some are in groups, and others are all by their lonesome. The hall contains doors that lead to all parts of the keep, so it's common to need to travel through it even for those who aren't entering through the main doors. This space is the swiftest method of getting from one side of the palace to another. Here the ceilings are high enough that one could fly through them without much effort or danger, and some of the adjoining halls are high enough to match.[flags.WAY_LIGHTP| An elegant statue in this section of the hall depicts the sun's rays curling like protective wings around an ornately carved gemstone. This work of art serves as an entrance to the Ways Between from inside the palace.]|Just more gloom, no different from the rest.]
rows.translation: [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|城堡的主厅宽敞明亮，空间足够大，整个军团都能轻松通过，而且每个人都有足够的活动空间。虽然任何时候这个区域里的女武神数量都远没有那么多，但总有几名女武神在前往城堡的不同区域执行任务。有些成群结队，而有些则独自行动。大厅里有许多门，这些门通向城堡的各个角落，因此即使那些不是从主门进入的人，也常常需要穿过这个大厅。这个空间确实是从宫殿的一侧快速到达另一侧的最便捷途径。这里的天花板高度足够高，人们可以毫不费力地从它们上方穿过，也不会有任何危险；而一些相邻的厅堂也同样具有这样的高度。[flags.WAY_LIGHTP| 大厅的这一区域里，有一座精美的雕像，它将太阳的光芒描绘成仿佛保护性翅膀般环绕着一颗雕刻精美的宝石。这件艺术作品实际上成为了从宫殿内部进入“幽径”的入口。]|只不过是更多的阴郁罢了，与其他地方并没有什么不同。]

This work of art serves as an entrance to the Ways Between from inside the palace.]|Just more gloom, no different from the rest.]"

rows.original:
[flags.LUMIA_QUEST|The southern portion of the outer halls is devoted to training rooms, lecture halls, and obstacle courses. Everything is helpfully labeled with easy numerals, and a large tome at the main entrance from the hall explains which rooms correspond to which numerals in [pc.bg arcanist scholar courtesan|just about every language you can imagine|multiple languages both local and foreign]. According to the tome, the rooms are divided into sections, with the obstacle courses being the largest rooms. The lecture halls and training rooms vary in size between having room for large companies and single squadrons. Even the largest obstacle course lists a maximum occupancy of twenty, however, and the smallest is listed as single person.
        
        [flags.HJORR_MET|Hjörr can usually be found in one of the training rooms when she's in the palace, teaching valkyries how best to adapt to using their new found abilities in combat.]|Just more gloom, no different from the rest.]
rows.translation:
[flags.LUMIA_QUEST|外厅的南部区域被用作训练室、讲堂以及障碍训练场。所有设施都配有便于识别的数字标识，在通往大厅的主入口处还有一本厚厚的手册，详细说明了哪些房间对应着哪些数字标识。 [pc.bg arcanist scholar courtesan|几乎你能想到的每一种语言|多种语言，包括本地语言和外语]根据这本典籍的记载，这些房间被划分成了不同的区域，其中障碍训练场是面积最大的房间。讲堂和训练室的规模各不相同，有的能够容纳大型团队，有的则只适合单个小队使用。即便面积最大的障碍训练场，其最大容纳人数也只有二十人，而最小的房间则明确标明仅限单人使用。
        
        [flags.HJORR_MET|当希约尔在宫殿里的时候，她通常会待在某间训练室里，教导女武神们如何最好地运用她们新获得的能力进行战斗。]|只不过是更多的阴郁罢了，与其他地方并没有什么不同。]

rows.original: [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|The northern portion of the central palace is devoted to the order's sleeping quarters. The bed chambers contain six to ten beds each in combinations of bunks and various sizes of single bed, enough for whole squads to sleep together in the same rooms. There aren't enough rooms to fit every Valkyrie in the order, but there are enough for how many need sleep at any given time. The section also contains the nursery, where petitioners are brought to either receive assistance with difficult pregnancies that require the goddesses touch, or where blessed non valkyries who are sterile or otherwise incapable of having children stay while awaiting the birth of their blessings.|Just more gloom, no different from the rest.]
rows.translation: [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|中央宫殿的北部区域被专门用作该组织的休息区。这些卧室里每间都配备了六到十张床，这些床既有双层床，也有不同尺寸的单人床，因此足以让整个小队成员共同居住在同一个房间里。虽然没有足够的房间来容纳所有的女武神，但至少有足够的空间满足那些在任何时候需要休息的女武神的需求。这个区域还设有育婴室：那些在怀孕过程中遇到困难、需要女神们的帮助的女武神会被带到这里；而那些无法生育或因其他原因不能生育的、受到祝福的女武神们，也会在这里等待自己所怀的“祝福”降生。|只不过是更多的阴郁罢了，与其他地方并没有什么不同。]
rows.raw: "[flags.LUMIA_QUEST|The northern portion of the central palace is devoted to the order's sleeping quarters. The bed chambers contain six to ten beds each in combinations of bunks and various sizes of single bed, enough for whole squads to sleep together in the same rooms. There aren't enough rooms to fit every Valkyrie in the order, but there are enough for how many need sleep at any given time. The section also contains the nursery, where petitioners are brought to either receive assistance with difficult pregnancies that require the goddesses touch, or where blessed non valkyries who are sterile or otherwise incapable of having children stay while awaiting the birth of their blessings.|Just more gloom, no different from the rest.]"

rows.original:
[flags.LUMIA_QUEST
            |The castle's main hall continues deep into the center of the mountain, and narrows significantly near its end. There are still large passages on either side that lead to other parts of the palace proper, and it's still wide enough to fit a hundred people, but it tapers to a point at the throne room doors. That point is still tall enough for the largest of valkyries to fit through, and is emblazoned with Lumia's crest on both sides. Anyone flying would have to land once they got that far in. There's less traffic the deeper in it gets, but there are still people around.
rows.translation:
[flags.LUMIA_QUEST
            |城堡的主厅一直延伸到山脉的中心深处，在接近尽头的地方逐渐变窄。两侧仍然有宽敞的通道，这些通道通向宫殿的其他区域，其宽度仍然足以容纳一百人，但在通往王座厅的门口处，通道已经变得非常狭窄了。 那个入口的高度足以让最大的女武神通过，而且两侧都印有卢米娅的徽章。任何飞过去的人在飞到那里之后都必须降落。越往里面走，人迹就越稀少，但仍然会有人在那里活动。
rows.raw:
"
        [flags.LUMIA_QUEST
            |The castle's main hall continues deep into the center of the mountain, and narrows significantly near its end. There are still large passages on either side that lead to other parts of the palace proper, and it's still wide enough to fit a hundred people, but it tapers to a point at the throne room doors. That point is still tall enough for the largest of valkyries to fit through, and is emblazoned with Lumia's crest on both sides. Anyone flying would have to land once they got that far in. There's less traffic the deeper in it gets, but there are still people around. 
        
            "

rows.original:
|Just more gloom, no different from the rest.
        ]
rows.translation:
|只不过是更多的阴郁罢了，与其他地方并没有什么不同。
        ]
rows.raw: "\n            |Just more gloom, no different from the rest.\n        ]"

rows.original: The seneschal's space near the entrance to the throne room is occupied by a desk, copious amounts of well-sorted paperwork, a few nice plants, aaaand no seneschal. You guess Annika's busy at the moment — which is fair enough, since she has a whole fortress to look after.
rows.translation: 在王座室入口附近，那原本属于总管的空间里，现在放着一张办公桌、大量整理整齐的文件、几盆漂亮的植物……不过，总管本人却不见踪影。想必安妮卡现在很忙吧——这也情有可原，毕竟她还得负责管理整个堡垒呢。
rows.raw: "The seneschal's space near the entrance to the throne room is occupied by a desk, copious amounts of well-sorted paperwork, a few nice plants, aaaand no seneschal. You guess Annika's busy at the moment — which is fair enough, since she has a whole fortress to look after."

rows.original: It's been some time since Annika had to leave for her meeting, but you aren't sure where she's gone. Her desk is empty, and instead, Halima, the dark-skinned human valkyrie, is standing anxiously next to it, paging through some of the paperwork [pc.isCunning|in a fairly transparent attempt to seem busy|that she doesn't really seem to be paying much attention to]. If you want to find Lumia's seneschal, maybe you should try asking her.
rows.translation: 安妮卡离开去参加会议已经有一阵子了，你却不知道她去了哪里。她的办公桌空着，取而代之的是皮肤黝黑的人类女武神哈利玛，她焦虑地站在桌旁，翻阅着文件[pc.isCunning|，显然只是想装出一副忙碌的样子|，却似乎根本没把心思放在上面]。若想找到卢米娅的总管，或许该问问她。
rows.raw: "It's been some time since Annika had to leave for her meeting, but you aren't sure where she's gone. Her desk is empty, and instead, Halima, the dark-skinned human valkyrie, is standing anxiously next to it, paging through some of the paperwork [pc.isCunning|in a fairly transparent attempt to seem busy|that she doesn't really seem to be paying much attention to]. If you want to find Lumia's seneschal, maybe you should try asking her."

rows.original: [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|The palatial dining hall is big enough to fit two hundred people for a feast, and it sees about that many throughout the day. The food is mostly seafood, given the locale, but there's plenty of meat and cheese, and a bit of dried fruit sneaks it's way into the mix. Valkyries in the field hunt or forage their own meals, so it gets a lot less stress testing than it could. The more lush rooms and portions of the castle have been converted into rest and recreation areas for the Valkyries to burn off steam when they aren't training or in the field. This is a rare occasion on a day to day basis, but it also serves as a way for Valkyries to help their injured wingmates recuperate.|Just more gloom, no different from the rest.]
rows.translation: [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|这座宏伟的餐厅空间足够大，可以容纳两百人同时用餐，而实际上一天当中也有差不多这么多人在这里用餐。考虑到这个地方所处的地理位置，餐厅提供的食物主要以海鲜为主，但也会提供大量的肉类和奶酪，偶尔还会有一些干果被加入菜单中。女武神们在野外狩猎或采集食物，因此它们所承受的压力其实远低于理论上的最大值。城堡中那些环境较为舒适、空间较为宽敞的区域，都被改造成了休息娱乐场所，让女武神们在没有进行训练或外出执行任务时可以放松身心。在日常生活中，这种情况其实相当罕见，但这也正是女武神们帮助受伤的同伴恢复健康的一种方式。|只不过是更多的阴郁罢了，与其他地方并没有什么不同。]
rows.raw: "[flags.LUMIA_QUEST|The palatial dining hall is big enough to fit two hundred people for a feast, and it sees about that many throughout the day. The food is mostly seafood, given the locale, but there's plenty of meat and cheese, and a bit of dried fruit sneaks it's way into the mix. Valkyries in the field hunt or forage their own meals, so it gets a lot less stress testing than it could. The more lush rooms and portions of the castle have been converted into rest and recreation areas for the Valkyries to burn off steam when they aren't training or in the field. This is a rare occasion on a day to day basis, but it also serves as a way for Valkyries to help their injured wingmates recuperate.|Just more gloom, no different from the rest.]"

rows.original: [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|Through the royal doors, the throne room is a surprisingly spartan affair. There are no tapestries on the wall, and the throne itself is a simple piece of carved blue marble, and most often sits abandoned at the center of the room. Lumia spends most of her time up and about, and when she's not interacting with her Valkyries, she's in her inner sanctum. The rare occasions where she is sitting on the throne are usually when she needs to meet with someone about a matter of importance outside the palace, and doesn't have time to intercept them before they reach the throne-room. There are two other doors out of the throne room. One leads to a small waiting room that leads in turn to her inner sanctum, and the other [flags.LUMIA_SEX|leads to the goddess's personal bedchambers|leads somewhere you've never been].|An imposing throne rises near the back of this modest room. The thick gloom is harder here than elsewhere, and seems to be emanating from a darker stairway at the back that leads deeper into the palace.]
rows.translation: [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|穿过那扇皇家大门，王座厅的内部布置出人意料地简朴。墙上没有任何挂毯，王座本身也只是由蓝色大理石雕刻而成的简单物件，大多数时候都闲置在厅室的中央。卢米娅大部分时间都在四处活动，当她没有与自己的女武神们互动时，就会待在她的私人空间里。只有在一些极为罕见的情况下，她才会坐在王座上——通常是因为她需要与某些人讨论一些宫外的重要事务，而没有时间在这些人到达王座厅之前与他们会面。王座室里还有另外两扇门。其中一扇通向一个小等候室，而那个等候室又可以通往她的私人密室；另一扇门[flags.LUMIA_SEX|通往女神的私人寝室|会带你前往一个你从未去过的地方]。|在这个朴素的房间后方，摆放着一座庄严的王座。这里的黑暗比其他地方更加浓重，似乎源自后方那条通向宫殿深处的昏暗楼梯。]
rows.raw: "[flags.LUMIA_QUEST|Through the royal doors, the throne room is a surprisingly spartan affair. There are no tapestries on the wall, and the throne itself is a simple piece of carved blue marble, and most often sits abandoned at the center of the room. Lumia spends most of her time up and about, and when she's not interacting with her Valkyries, she's in her inner sanctum. The rare occasions where she is sitting on the throne are usually when she needs to meet with someone about a matter of importance outside the palace, and doesn't have time to intercept them before they reach the throne-room. There are two other doors out of the throne room. One leads to a small waiting room that leads in turn to her inner sanctum, and the other [flags.LUMIA_SEX|leads to the goddess's personal bedchambers|leads somewhere you've never been].|An imposing throne rises near the back of this modest room. The thick gloom is harder here than elsewhere, and seems to be emanating from a darker stairway at the back that leads deeper into the palace.]"

rows.original: The dream version of Castle Hawkstone's entryway is [flags.HAWK_AG8|similar to the one from reality, but kind of... scrunched? Anywhere that would have empty space in the real world is tightened for the quickest possible entry into the dining hall beyond.|a very simple affair. The whole thing is condensed into a single room with one door that leads to the dining room beyond. On a real castle something like this would look silly, but here the effect is disconcerting.] Any other doors are gone, leaving you with only one place to go. The courtyard is visible through the doors, but it's entirely empty and dark. Only the bit of cobbled path and grass that lead up to the door are lit now, leading off into an endless shadow.
rows.translation: 鹰石城堡入口处的理想化版本是[flags.HAWK_AG8|和现实中的情况类似，但有点……被压缩了？在现实世界中本来会有空隙的地方，都被压缩得严严实实，只是为了让人能尽快进入餐厅而已。|这件事其实非常简单。整个场景被浓缩在一个只有一个门的房间里，这个门通向另一边的餐厅。在真正的城堡里，这样的设计可能会显得很滑稽，但在这里，这种布局却会产生一种令人不安的效果。]其他所有的门都已经消失，只剩下一个地方可以前往。透过那些门，可以看到庭院，但那里一片空荡荡的，一片暗影。现在只有那条铺着鹅卵石的小路以及通往大门的草地被照亮了，而它们通向的，是一片无边的暗影。
rows.raw: "The dream version of Castle Hawkstone's entryway is [flags.HAWK_AG8|similar to the one from reality, but kind of... scrunched? Anywhere that would have empty space in the real world is tightened for the quickest possible entry into the dining hall beyond.|a very simple affair. The whole thing is condensed into a single room with one door that leads to the dining room beyond. On a real castle something like this would look silly, but here the effect is disconcerting.] Any other doors are gone, leaving you with only one place to go. The courtyard is visible through the doors, but it's entirely empty and dark. Only the bit of cobbled path and grass that lead up to the door are lit now, leading off into an endless shadow."

rows.original: The large banquet hall is as richly adorned as it is decked with exotic dishes. Heavy tapestries hang from the balconies, and lifelike statues flock the archways that would usually lead to doors. Said exits are notably not present, with the open castle appearing to consist only of this banquet hall and its two balconies. Something is subtly off about the decorations here, too, adding to the sense of disquiet in the castle. A close examination reveals that the tapestries' colors are faded reflections of brighter counterparts, and the statuary frowns or sheds stone tears that trail down their cheeks.
rows.translation: 这个巨大的宴会厅装饰得极为华丽，各种异国风味的菜肴也摆满了餐桌。厚重的挂毯悬挂在阳台上，而那些通常通向门道的拱门处则摆满了栩栩如生的雕像。然而，那些出口却不见了踪影，整个城堡似乎只由这个宴会厅及其两个阳台组成。这里的装饰也有些细微之处不太对劲，这让整个城堡显得更加阴森不安。仔细观察就会发现，那些挂毯上的颜色其实是原本鲜艳色彩的褪色痕迹，而那些雕像要么面带怒容，要么流下了石制的泪水，这些泪水顺着它们的脸颊流淌下来。
rows.raw: "The large banquet hall is as richly adorned as it is decked with exotic dishes. Heavy tapestries hang from the balconies, and lifelike statues flock the archways that would usually lead to doors. Said exits are notably not present, with the open castle appearing to consist only of this banquet hall and its two balconies. Something is subtly off about the decorations here, too, adding to the sense of disquiet in the castle. A close examination reveals that the tapestries' colors are faded reflections of brighter counterparts, and the statuary frowns or sheds stone tears that trail down their cheeks."

rows.original: An impossibly large fireplace dominates the wall at the end of the banquet hall. Rather than being tall, it's disproportionately wide, reaching from one end of the wall to the other and leaving only five feet or so of space on either end. Directly in the middle, a decorative dueling sword with a rose patterned crossguard is sheathed in a thorny scabbard. A large bronze hawk grips the scabbard in its talons, letting the whole ensemble represent the Reverran crest. Spaced evenly at the sword's sides are a matching set of shields. A little further than that, twin paintings of knights facing in mirrored directions.
rows.translation: 在宴会厅的尽头，有一座大得不可思议的壁炉占据了整面墙。它的高度并不高，而是宽度异常宽敞，从墙的一端延伸到另一端，只在两侧各留下了大约五英尺的空间。正中央，一把装饰性的决斗剑被插在带刺的剑鞘中，其护手上印有玫瑰图案。一只巨大的青铜鹰用爪子握住剑鞘，整个造型象征着“Reverran”家族的徽章。剑的两侧均匀地排列着一对配套的盾牌。再往远处一些，还挂着两幅描绘骑士们朝相反方向站立的画作。
rows.raw: "An impossibly large fireplace dominates the wall at the end of the banquet hall. Rather than being tall, it's disproportionately wide, reaching from one end of the wall to the other and leaving only five feet or so of space on either end. Directly in the middle, a decorative dueling sword with a rose patterned crossguard is sheathed in a thorny scabbard. A large bronze hawk grips the scabbard in its talons, letting the whole ensemble represent the Reverran crest. Spaced evenly at the sword's sides are a matching set of shields. A little further than that, twin paintings of knights facing in mirrored directions."

rows.original: The stair leading up to the southern balcony deposits you straight into a corner dominated by one massive painting. It's a picture of a castle on a seabound island. The waters surrounding the castle are shrouded in mist, throughout which are a series of colorful lights. A wrecked boat lies in the port, undergoing repairs to a massive hole that looks like it should have sunk the ship long before it could reach the docks. The castle itself is a marvel on its own, one that would require more thorough scrutiny to truly appreciate.
rows.translation: 通往南侧阳台的楼梯将你直接带入一个被一幅巨大的画作占据的角落。那幅画描绘的是一座位于海滨岛屿上的城堡。城堡周围的水面被迷雾笼罩，而在迷雾中闪烁着一连串五彩斑斓的灯光。一艘损毁严重的船只停放在港口中，人们正在修理它上面那个巨大的洞洞——那个洞看起来足以让这艘船在抵达码头之前就沉没。而那座城堡本身也是一件令人惊叹的奇迹，要想真正领略它的壮丽，还需要更加仔细地观察和欣赏。
rows.raw: "The stair leading up to the southern balcony deposits you straight into a corner dominated by one massive painting. It's a picture of a castle on a seabound island. The waters surrounding the castle are shrouded in mist, throughout which are a series of colorful lights. A wrecked boat lies in the port, undergoing repairs to a massive hole that looks like it should have sunk the ship long before it could reach the docks. The castle itself is a marvel on its own, one that would require more thorough scrutiny to truly appreciate."

rows.original: Tucked neatly into this corner of the upper balcony is a pile of soft pillows stacked in roughly the shape of a chair, and a wooden bookcase stocked to the brim with thick tomes. Almost none of them are labeled, and some look so old that they might crumble to dust if handled roughly. What few books do have titles on the spines are historical accounts of specific years or accounting ledgers for the town of Hawkethorne. [flags.DHAWK_BOOK|None of these books seem all that important or informative.|One unlabeled book in particular has something glinting between one of the pages.]
rows.translation: 在上层阳台的这个角落里，整齐地堆着一堆柔软的枕头，这些枕头被摆成了大致类似椅子的形状；还有一个木制书架，里面塞满了厚厚的书籍。几乎没有任何一本书带有标签，有些书看起来年代太过久远，如果处理不当，可能会立刻散成碎片。为数不多的几本在书脊上标有书名的书籍，要么是记录特定年代的历史文献，要么是鹰棘镇镇的账本。 [flags.DHAWK_BOOK|这些书似乎都没有什么特别重要的意义或提供太多有用的信息。|有一本没有标签的书，它的某一页之间似乎有什么东西在闪烁。]
rows.raw: "Tucked neatly into this corner of the upper balcony is a pile of soft pillows stacked in roughly the shape of a chair, and a wooden bookcase stocked to the brim with thick tomes. Almost none of them are labeled, and some look so old that they might crumble to dust if handled roughly. What few books do have titles on the spines are historical accounts of specific years or accounting ledgers for the town of Hawkethorne. [flags.DHAWK_BOOK|None of these books seem all that important or informative.|One unlabeled book in particular has something glinting between one of the pages.]"

rows.original: The steps up to this portion of the balcony lead to a pair of cornered walls that each hold an elaborate painting. The first, on the wall to the right of the stairs, is of a woman dressed in resplendent war regalia plunging a sparkling constellation of stars into a writhing multitude of shadows. The woman is so small that [flags.DHAWK_TRIO|it's hard to make her out, but she bears an uncanny resemblance to Iveryn|it's impossible to make out any details of her features]. The title card hanging from the painting is too scuffed to read from afar.
rows.translation: 通往阳台这一区域的台阶两侧各有一面墙壁，墙上都挂着一幅精美的绘画。第一幅画位于楼梯右侧的墙面上，画中是一位身着华丽战袍的女性，她将一颗闪耀的星辰投入了那些蜿蜒曲折的阴影之中。这位女性的身形显得非常渺小[flags.DHAWK_TRIO|很难分辨她到底是谁，但她和艾薇琳有着惊人的相似之处。|根本无法分辨出她面部的任何细节。]挂在画作上的标题牌已经磨损得太严重了，远远看去根本无法辨认上面的文字。
rows.raw: "The steps up to this portion of the balcony lead to a pair of cornered walls that each hold an elaborate painting. The first, on the wall to the right of the stairs, is of a woman dressed in resplendent war regalia plunging a sparkling constellation of stars into a writhing multitude of shadows. The woman is so small that [flags.DHAWK_TRIO|it's hard to make her out, but she bears an uncanny resemblance to Iveryn|it's impossible to make out any details of her features]. The title card hanging from the painting is too scuffed to read from afar."

rows.original: Lady Iveryn is staring at the picture intently, a puzzled look on her face.
rows.translation: 艾薇琳女士正困惑地紧盯着那幅画。
rows.raw: " Lady Iveryn is staring at the picture intently, a puzzled look on her face."

rows.original: The other painting is of Castle Hawkstone itself, but bathed in the light of the sunset instead of the perpetual dim of this place. A tiny hamlet that must be the beginnings of Hawkethorne sits in the bottom corner. There's no title on the painting, but there is a stylized capital R in one corner.
rows.translation: 另一幅画描绘的是霍克斯通城堡本身，只不过它沐浴在夕阳的余晖之中，而非这个地方常年笼罩的昏暗光线。在画面的右下角，有一个小小的村庄，那应该就是霍克斯通的起源之地。这幅画没有标题，但在其中一个角落里有一个风格化的大写字母“R”。
rows.raw: " The other painting is of Castle Hawkstone itself, but bathed in the light of the sunset instead of the perpetual dim of this place. A tiny hamlet that must be the beginnings of Hawkethorne sits in the bottom corner. There's no title on the painting, but there is a stylized capital R in one corner."

rows.original: This portion of the castle has a good view of the banquet hall from above, but there isn't much else around. An expensive looking painting of a waterfall made of gold hangs on the one available wall. There's a boat made of craggy stone sailing up the waterfall, but it's crew is too small to make out in any detail. A title card dangles beneath the painting, labeling it "No riches are won without toil."
rows.translation: 这座城堡的这一部分从上方可以很好地看到宴会厅的景象，但周围并没有其他什么特别的设施。唯一的一面墙上挂着一幅用黄金绘制的瀑布画，看起来非常昂贵。画中有一艘由崎岖的石头制成的船正在逆流而上冲向瀑布，不过船上的船员人数太少，因此无法看清他们的细节。画下方悬挂着一张标题牌，上面写着“不劳而获，一无所获”。
rows.raw: "This portion of the castle has a good view of the banquet hall from above, but there isn't much else around. An expensive looking painting of a waterfall made of gold hangs on the one available wall. There's a boat made of craggy stone sailing up the waterfall, but it's crew is too small to make out in any detail. A title card dangles beneath the painting, labeling it \"No riches are won without toil.\""

rows.original: This elaborate sitting room is tucked away from the rest of the banquet hall, though there is technically no door to separate it from the balcony. The furniture here is sparse, and there isn't much taking up the room at all besides a pair of single person reclining chairs and a small end table between them. Atop the end table is an ornate looking music box with an inscribed plaque and a letter marked combination lock. Barring those fixtures, the room is empty, without even a painting to liven up the walls.
rows.translation: 这个布置精致的客厅被隔离在宴会厅的其他区域之外，不过严格来说，并没有门将它与阳台分隔开来。这里的家具非常简朴，除了两把单人躺椅以及它们中间的一张小茶几外，几乎没有什么其他物品占据这个空间。茶几上放着一个外观华丽的音乐盒，上面刻着铭文，还有一把标有密码锁的锁。除了这些物品外，房间里空荡荡的，甚至连一幅画都没有，墙壁显得十分单调。
rows.raw: "This elaborate sitting room is tucked away from the rest of the banquet hall, though there is technically no door to separate it from the balcony. The furniture here is sparse, and there isn't much taking up the room at all besides a pair of single person reclining chairs and a small end table between them. Atop the end table is an ornate looking music box with an inscribed plaque and a letter marked combination lock. Barring those fixtures, the room is empty, without even a painting to liven up the walls."

rows.original:
It stands testament to the elves' need for metal that they would sink shafts into a bog to get it — while the old abandoned mine stands in a more stable spot in the bogmire, it nevertheless is quite miserable. Ancient timber and stones shore up the entrance with no expense spared for the section expected to bear the most traffic, but somehow one doubts that it was done with the well-being of the convicts in mind. It's a small mercy that the roof won't come crashing down upon your head any time soon, at the very least.

        Broken bits and pieces lie strewn about the place, indecipherable bits of rusted metal that've somehow managed to survive the two centuries of disuse since the Godswar. The light filtering in from the entrance quickly diminishes with each step you take into the mine, the darkness heavy and oppressive, or at least moreso that what one might expect from simply being under the earth. To be perfectly honest, the atmosphere is more befitting a barrow than a mine.
rows.translation:
这一事实充分证明了精灵们对金属的迫切需求——他们甚至不惜在沼泽地中挖掘竖井来获取金属。虽然那座废弃的旧矿井位于沼泽地中较为稳固的位置，但它依然显得十分破败不堪。人们不惜耗费大量资源，用古老的木材和石头加固矿井入口，尤其是那些预计会承受最大负荷的部分，但无论如何，人们都不禁怀疑，这些措施究竟是不是出于对囚犯们福祉的考虑而实施的。至少，屋顶暂时还没有掉下来压在你的头上，这已经算是小小的幸运了。

        碎片散落在各处，那些生锈的金属残片根本无法辨认，但它们竟然在经历了神战之后长达两个世纪的无人使用中依然存活了下来。每当你走进矿井，从入口处透进来的光线会迅速减弱，黑暗变得浓重而压抑，至少比人们想象中在地下时所感受到的黑暗要更加浓厚。说实话，这种氛围更像是一个地牢，而不是一个矿井。

To be perfectly honest, the atmosphere is more befitting a barrow than a mine."

rows.original:
A large chamber, presumably where ore was gathered before being shipped out of the mine en masse — the desiccated remains of several carts lie against a rock wall, victims of dry rot, while tarnished golem husks stand against the other, awaiting power sources and commands that will never come. Corroded pick heads and reinforcements for beams fill one of the rotting boxes, and several heaps of stone speckled with green and brown suggest that this is what the elves of centuries ago were digging for. Was it worth it? They certainly thought so.

        At the very least, there aren't any elven remains around — the ordered manner in which the mine's been abandoned suggests that the convicts and their keepers left, rather than fled. Certainly an outpost this far from the Winter City would've been overlooked in the first rush of the Godswar... certainly. One can only hope that whoever these people were, they made it to safety.
rows.translation:
这是一个巨大的房间，显然在这里，矿石在被大量运出矿山之前会被收集起来——几辆马车的干枯残骸靠在岩壁上，它们已经遭到了干腐病的侵袭；而那些生锈的魔像外壳则矗立在另一侧，等待着永远不会到来的能源和指令。其中一个腐烂的箱子里装满了腐蚀后的镐头以及用于加固梁柱的材料；而几堆布满绿色和棕色斑点的石头，显然表明几个世纪前，精灵们正是在寻找这些东西。那么，这一切究竟是否值得呢？他们当然是这么认为的。

        至少，周围没有任何精灵的遗迹——这座矿井被废弃的方式如此有条理，这说明那些囚犯和看守人是主动离开的，而不是逃走的。毕竟，像这样一个距离冬城如此遥远的前哨站，在神战初期肯定会被忽视掉。当然。人们只能希望，无论这些人是谁，他们都能平安无事地到达安全的地方。

"
        A large chamber, presumably where ore was gathered before being shipped out of the mine en masse — the desiccated remains of several carts lie against a rock wall, victims of dry rot, while tarnished golem husks stand against the other, awaiting power sources and commands that will never come. Corroded pick heads and reinforcements for beams fill one of the rotting boxes, and several heaps of stone speckled with green and brown suggest that this is what the elves of centuries ago were digging for. rows.original:
Deeper into the mine, the passageways twist and turn; the air's becoming more oppressive, harder to breathe. You find your lungs heaving with each step you take, yet you don't smell anything foul in the air... maybe it's all in your mind. It probably is, given that you don't feel light-headed at all; for all that one might've worried about stagnant bog air in a deep mine, your thoughts are surprisingly clear and sharp.

        Just nerves, then.
        
        Here and there the miners have dug out exploratory shafts, terminating when nothing of interest was to be found; other passageways have collapsed upon themselves, preventing you from straying. The only path open to progression, alas, is that which Nina pointed out to you all the way back in the Wayfort — north, and then to the west.
rows.translation:
越往矿井深处走，通道就越曲折蜿蜒；空气也变得越来越闷热，呼吸变得愈发困难。每走一步，你的肺部都会感到剧烈的不适，但空气中却没有任何难闻的气味……也许这一切都只是你的想象而已。很可能确实如此，因为你完全没有感到头晕；尽管人们可能会担心深矿里闷热的空气会让人产生不适，但你的思维却出奇地清晰敏锐。

        那么，应该只是紧张而已吧。
        
        在某些地方，矿工们挖掘了探查巷道，但当发现没有值得探索的东西时，这些巷道就被废弃了；还有一些通道发生了坍塌，使得人们无法继续前进。遗憾的是，目前唯一可行的前进路线，就是妮娜在荒废驿堡时指给你们的那条路——先向北走，然后再向西转。

"
        Deeper into the mine, the passageways twist and turn; the air's becoming more oppressive, harder to breathe. You find your lungs heaving with each step you take, yet you don't smell anything foul in the air... maybe it's all in your mind. rows.original:
A large, hollowed-out chamber with two exposed seams of ore running horizontally along the walls. There clearly was more in here at some point, as evidenced by the pillars of ore-bearing rock left to hold up the ceiling, but the elves have mined that all out in ages past. The vastness of the chamber can't be understated — it'd take you a good ten minutes to walk from one end of the dig site to the other in a straight line, something that'd be impossible due to the sinkholes in the rocky ground.
        
        And speaking of the sinkholes... they're certainly a sight. Some are small enough to be stepped over, while others yawn as chasms; you're pretty sure that a good chunk of the still-extant floor is unstable enough that it'd crumble under your weight. A continuous updraft wells from beneath, rushing out into the tunnel you entered by, and you can hear the faint sound of rushing water coming from far below. No doubt traversing the chamber is a perilous prospect...
rows.translation:
一个巨大的、被挖空的腔室，墙壁上有两处水平延伸的矿脉。显然，这里曾经蕴藏着更多的矿产资源，因为那些用于支撑天花板的含矿岩石柱就是明证——但很久以前，精灵们就已经把所有的矿石都开采殆尽了。这个厅室的规模之大实在难以形容——如果你试图沿着直线从挖掘现场的一端走到另一端，的话，至少需要十分钟的时间；不过由于岩石地面上存在着许多坑洞，这样的行走方式其实是根本不可能实现的。
        
        说到这些天坑……它们的确是一道独特的风景。有些小到可以跨过去，而有些则像巨大的裂口一样张开；你可以肯定，那些仍然存在的地面中，有很大一部分其实并不稳固，一旦踩上去，很可能会瞬间坍塌。一股持续上升的气流从下方涌出，冲进了你进入的那个隧道，你能听到远处有水流湍急流动的微弱声音。毫无疑问，穿越这个洞室绝对是一件充满危险的事情……

"
        A large, hollowed-out chamber with two exposed seams of ore running horizontally along the walls. There clearly was more in here at some point, as evidenced by the pillars of ore-bearing rock left to hold up the ceiling, but the elves have mined that all out in ages past. The vastness of the chamber can't be understated — it'd take you a good ten minutes to walk from one end of the dig site to the other in a straight line, something that'd be impossible due to the sinkholes in the rocky ground.
        
        And speaking of the sinkholes... they're certainly a sight. rows.original:
The western end of the main dig — judging by the remains of a makeshift shelter, the miners used this as a break room in between shifts. Empty bottles stand by rotting stools, collecting the dust of centuries; it's strange given how this place was supposed to be manned by convicts, but if there's an explanation for all of this it's been lost to time. A spot of levity in this oppressive atmosphere, if nothing else...

        There's no way forward — the tunnel leaning on through this end of the chamber has been buried in debris. Whatever it is that Nina sent you here to collect, it ought to be around.
rows.translation:
主挖掘道的西端——从那里残存的简易避难所来看，矿工们曾在换班间隙将这里用作休息室。空瓶子堆放在腐烂的凳子旁，积满了几个世纪的灰尘；考虑到这个地方本应由囚犯们来值守，这种情况实在有些奇怪，但倘若这一切有什么解释的话，恐怕也已经随着时间的流逝而被遗忘了。至少，在这种压抑的氛围中，需要一些轻松的时刻……

        根本没有前进的路——从这个房间尽头延伸出来的隧道已经被碎石掩埋了。无论妮娜让你来这里取什么，应该就在这里附近吧。
rows.raw:
"
        The western end of the main dig — judging by the remains of a makeshift shelter, the miners used this as a break room in between shifts. Empty bottles stand by rotting stools, collecting the dust of centuries; it's strange given how this place was supposed to be manned by convicts, but if there's an explanation for all of this it's been lost to time. A spot of levity in this oppressive atmosphere, if nothing else...

        There's no way forward — the tunnel leaning on through this end of the chamber has been buried in debris. Whatever it is that Nina sent you here to collect, it ought to be around."

rows.original:
You stand among the crumbling battlements of Dracia Castle. Once these mighty walls would have been an impregnable bulwark against the savages of the Sailgraves[party.has arona
            |, one of whom is currently shoving white granite into her pack as a souvenir
        ], but now they lay shattered and broken. With time and effort, they could be repaired, but for now the rubble gives you and your companions ample cover to slip into the castle.
        
        [party.has arona
            |"Even elf buildings are meant for gettin' fucked," Arona leers. You're too busy rolling your eyes to see Daliza slapping her, but you certainly hear it.
        ]
        
        The cliffs are back west; the castle's courtyard, and the base of the massive tower that reaches to the clouds, lie east.
rows.translation:
你站在达拉西亚城堡那摇摇欲坠的城墙旁。这些曾经坚固的壁垒，本应能够有效地抵御那些来自赛尔格雷夫斯的野蛮人。[party.has arona
            |其中一个人正在把白色花岗岩块塞进她的背包里，作为纪念品。
        ]然而现在，它们已经支离破碎、不堪重用。只要付出时间和精力，这些残骸还是可以修复的，但眼下，这些废墟为你们和你的同伴提供了绝佳的掩护，让你们能够顺利潜入城堡。
        
        [party.has arona
            |就连精灵的建筑也是用来让人倒霉的，”阿罗娜坏笑着说。你当时正忙着翻白眼，所以没看到达莉扎打了她一耳光，不过你肯定听到了那声响。
        ]
        
        悬崖位于西侧；而城堡的庭院以及那座高耸入云的巨塔的基座，则位于东侧。

"

            |, one of whom is currently shoving white granite into her pack as a souvenir
        ], but now they lay shattered and broken. With time and effort, they could be repaired, but for now the rubble gives you and your companions ample cover to slip into the castle.

rows.original:
You stand in the westernmost reach of Dracia Castle's courtyard. The yard is wide open enough to marshal a full regiment of soldiers in, with small support buildings hugging the walls in every direction. The courtyard is dominated, however, by a massive white tower that quite literally stretches to the heavens — or at least into the clouds — and seems utterly flawless, unmarred by battle or the passage of years. Frost glistens from its sheer sides, making the whole thing seem as if aglow.

        The keep looms at the easternmost end of the courtyard as well, better preserved than the rest of its outer buildings. 
        
        The cliffs are back west of here. The Cloudreach Tower is directly east, though piles of strewn rubble and debris block your way. The court stretches north and south.
rows.translation:
你站在达拉西亚城堡庭院的最西端。这个庭院宽敞得足以容纳一整个团的士兵，四周还有各种辅助建筑紧贴着围墙而建。然而，整个庭院的最显眼之处，是一座巨大的白色塔楼——它简直直插云霄，看上去毫无瑕疵，仿佛从未经历过战争，也未曾被岁月侵蚀。冰霜在它的陡峭侧面上闪烁着光芒，使得整个结构看起来仿佛都在发光。

        这座堡垒也坐落在庭院的最东端，与其他外围建筑相比，它的保存状况要好得多。
        
        而那些悬崖则位于这里的西侧。 Cloudreach塔就在正东方，不过路上堆满了散落的碎石和残骸，挡住了去路。那个庭院南北延伸，面积很大。

rows.original:
You stand at the foot of Cloudreach Tower, by far the most recognizable landmark of the legendary Dracia Castle. It's truly enormous, stretching all the way into the clouds high above, with its flawless white walls crusted with frost that catches the light such that the whole tower seems to glow. A set of winding stairs wrap from the castle courtyard up to the tower's single door, sized just right for Daliza to walk through unperturbed; [party.oneComp arona brint brienne
            |Arona is going to have to duck hard.
            |Brint is going to have to duck hard.
            |Brienne is going to have to duck hard.
            |anyone larger would have to duck to gain entry.
        ]

        At the very top of the tower, if you crane your neck enough to look, you can just make out a stone balcony that overhangs perhaps ten feet all the way around the tower.
        
        Barricades and strewn debris protect the tower from the east and west. You can imagine the castle's defenders falling back to it in the old days, desperately making their last stand here. 
        
        You can return to the courtyard proper via the north or south.
rows.translation:
你站在云达塔的脚下，这座塔无疑是传说中达拉西亚城堡最醒目的标志。它实在庞大得惊人，高耸入云，洁白的墙壁上覆盖着霜花，这些霜花在阳光下闪闪发光，使得整座塔仿佛都在散发着光芒。一条蜿蜒的楼梯从城堡的庭院通向塔门，那门的大小正好适合达莉莎毫无障碍地通过。 [party.oneComp arona brint brienne
            |阿罗纳得赶紧躲开了。
            |布林特得赶紧躲开了。
            |布蕾妮这次可得赶紧躲开了。
            |任何体型较大的人都必须弯下腰才能进入。
        ]

        在塔的最高处，如果你把脖子伸得足够长，就能隐约看到一个石制阳台，它环绕着整座塔，向外延伸了大约十英尺。
        
        东侧和西侧设有路障，地上散落着碎片，这些设施都在保护着这座塔。可以想象，在过去，城堡的守卫们一定是退到了这里，拼命地进行最后的抵抗。
        
        你可以从北侧或南侧回到主庭院。

The yard is wide open enough to marshal a full regiment of soldiers in, with small support buildings hugging the walls in every direction.         The keep looms directly east of you from here. Wide, steep steps lead up to its massive wooden doors — which seem to have been recently repaired, if you're any judge. 
        
        The Cloudreach Tower is directly west from here, though what looks like a barricade has been set up to divide it from you.
        
        The court stretches north and south from here.

        Cloudreach塔就位于这里的正西方方向，不过似乎有人设置了路障，将它与你们分隔开了。
        
        这片庭院从这里向南北方向延伸开来。

rows.original:
You stand at the outer doors of Dracia Keep, the inner sanctum of the castle and the seat of its ancient jarls. The keep is in clear disrepair, but not so much as to be indefensible like the outer castle: indeed, you have little doubt a garrison could hold out in there for quite a while even against Khor'minoan siege specialists. 

        Lucky for you, the door's not locked.
        
        The courtyard stretches back to the west, including the vast Cloudreach Tower.
rows.translation:
你站在达拉西亚城堡的外门前，这里既是城堡的核心区域，也是古代领主们的居所。这座城堡虽然已经破败不堪，但还不至于像外部的城堡那样无法防御——事实上，你毫不怀疑，如果有守军驻守其中，即使面对科尔米诺人的围攻专家，也能坚持相当长的时间。

        幸运的是，门并没有上锁。
        
        庭院向西延伸，其中还包括那座高耸的云达塔。
rows.raw:
"
        You stand at the outer doors of Dracia Keep, the inner sanctum of the castle and the seat of its ancient jarls. The keep is in clear disrepair, but not so much as to be indefensible like the outer castle: indeed, you have little doubt a garrison could hold out in there for quite a while even against Khor'minoan siege specialists. 

        Lucky for you, the door's not locked.
        
        The courtyard stretches back to the west, including the vast Cloudreach Tower."

rows.original: You stand on the docks beneath Dracia Castle, in the shadow of its ruined great walls and cloud-scraping tower. You can see the succubus-crewed trireme that escaped you in the distance, mostly by the flickering flames of its burning sails. The occasional, distant rumble of thunder across the water suggests that the Vigil has found her quarry and engaged. There's a set of stairs back west, leading up to the keep.
rows.translation: 你站在达拉西亚城堡下的码头旁，周围是那座城堡残破的城墙和高耸入云的塔楼。远处，你还能看到那艘由女妖们驾驶的三列桨船——它正是之前从你手中逃脱的。那艘船的帆上，闪烁的火焰清晰可见。偶尔，远处的雷声也会在水面上回荡，暗示着守望者号已经找到了目标并展开了行动。 在西北方向有一段楼梯，可以通往堡垒。
rows.raw: " You stand on the docks beneath Dracia Castle, in the shadow of its ruined great walls and cloud-scraping tower. You can see the succubus-crewed trireme that escaped you in the distance, mostly by the flickering flames of its burning sails. The occasional, distant rumble of thunder across the water suggests that the Vigil has found her quarry and engaged. There's a set of stairs back west, leading up to the keep."

rows.original:
The doors of the great tower let out into a surprisingly long corridor, dominated by runic etchings inked in blue all over its arching walls. [pc.isMage
            |You recognize these runes, at least in part — they're some kind of warding spell writ large all throughout the tower. Perhaps they're why it's withstood the ravages of time so well?
        ]
        
        The hall leads north, where it lets out into a large open chamber. The echoes of your footfalls alone tell you that the opening is truly massive, perhaps extending all the way to the top of the tower.
rows.translation:
那座高塔的大门通向一条出人意料地长的走廊，走廊的拱形墙壁上遍布着用蓝色墨水刻制的符文。 [pc.isMage
            |你至少部分认识这些符文——它们其实是遍布整座塔楼的某种防护咒语。或许正是这些符文让这座塔得以如此完好地经受住时间的侵蚀吧？
        ]
        
        走廊向北延伸，最终通向一个巨大的开放空间。仅凭你脚步声的回响，就能感受到这个空间的规模之庞大——它可能一直延伸到塔的顶部。
rows.raw:
"
        The doors of the great tower let out into a surprisingly long corridor, dominated by runic etchings inked in blue all over its arching walls. [pc.isMage
            |You recognize these runes, at least in part — they're some kind of warding spell writ large all throughout the tower. Perhaps they're why it's withstood the ravages of time so well?
        ]
        
        The hall leads north, where it lets out into a large open chamber. The echoes of your footfalls alone tell you that the opening is truly massive, perhaps extending all the way to the top of the tower."

rows.original: A lengthy hallway connects the interior of the tower to its outer doors, lined with countless blue runes etched into the stone. A number of crates have been piled up here, just like those you saw the imps trying to smuggle into the Undermountain — they're maker-marked with the Dracian crest, and a casual inspection reveals that they're full of elvish bronze, swords honed to razor edges and perfectly balanced. [flags.RQ2_TGUARDS | |From this position, you can hear voices and footsteps up ahead, in the open chamber at the heart of the tower. You're pretty sure they're speaking Boer'alvarin, laughing between labored grunts while they work. ]
rows.translation: 一条长长的走廊将塔内的空间与外门连接起来，走廊的两侧刻着无数蓝色的符文。这里堆放着一些箱子，那些你之前看到小妖精们试图偷运进地底山的箱子正是这类——它们上都印有达拉西亚家族的徽章，粗略一看就能发现，这些箱子里装满了精灵青铜、打磨得锋利无比且平衡性极佳的剑。 [flags.RQ2_TGUARDS | |从这个位置来看，在前方，塔心中那间敞开的房间里，你可以听到有人说话和有人走动的声音。你很确定他们在说博尔阿尔瓦林语，一边工作，一边一边费力地哼哼着，一边哈哈大笑。 ]
rows.raw: " A lengthy hallway connects the interior of the tower to its outer doors, lined with countless blue runes etched into the stone. A number of crates have been piled up here, just like those you saw the imps trying to smuggle into the Undermountain — they're maker-marked with the Dracian crest, and a casual inspection reveals that they're full of elvish bronze, swords honed to razor edges and perfectly balanced. [flags.RQ2_TGUARDS | |From this position, you can hear voices and footsteps up ahead, in the open chamber at the heart of the tower. You're pretty sure they're speaking Boer'alvarin, laughing between labored grunts while they work. ]"

rows.original:
The first floor of the tower has been modestly fortified against assault, though that proved no proof against you and your companions. The corrupted elf-women that had been working behind the barricades, unloading arms from the elevator, are [flags.RQ2_TGUARDS 1 2
            |groaning, half-conscious from the aftermath of battle
            |still cooling on the stone floor
        ]. They're no threat to anyone. 

        Stairs on the north wall lead up to a second floor, on which you can see a circular platform elevated from the marble beneath it and suspended on chains of undulating golden runes. This is old magic, powerful enough that you can feel it in your teeth — a dull ache that only grows more noticeable as you near the base of the lift.
rows.translation:
塔楼的一层虽然做了些简单的防御加固，但这对你和你的同伴来说根本不是障碍。那些藏在路障后面、负责从电梯里卸下武器的堕落精灵女性们[flags.RQ2_TGUARDS 1 2
            |在战斗的余波中，他呻吟着，几乎失去了意识。
            |还在石地上冷却着
        ]它们对任何人来说都不构成威胁。

        北墙上的楼梯通向二楼，在那里你可以看到一个圆形平台，该平台高出下方的大理石地面，由一串串波浪状的金色符文悬挂着。这是一种古老的魔法，其威力之大足以让你感觉到——那种隐隐作痛的感觉会随着你逐渐靠近这个平台的底部而变得越来越明显。
rows.raw:
"
        The first floor of the tower has been modestly fortified against assault, though that proved no proof against you and your companions. The corrupted elf-women that had been working behind the barricades, unloading arms from the elevator, are [flags.RQ2_TGUARDS 1 2
            |groaning, half-conscious from the aftermath of battle
            |still cooling on the stone floor
        ]. They're no threat to anyone. 

        Stairs on the north wall lead up to a second floor, on which you can see a circular platform elevated from the marble beneath it and suspended on chains of undulating golden runes. This is old magic, powerful enough that you can feel it in your teeth — a dull ache that only grows more noticeable as you near the base of the lift."

rows.original:
You stand on the elevator that connects the various floors of Cloudreach Tower together. It is a solid circular platform of marble, suspended off the ground on undulating chains made not of metal, but of undulating golden runes. This is old magic, powerful enough that you can feel it in your teeth and behind your eyes. 

        There's wheel-shaped circle of runes against the north wall that controls the elevator's magic.
        
        To the south, there's a passage leading into the tower's outer chambers.
rows.translation:
你站在连接Cloudreach塔各层楼的电梯上。这是一个由大理石制成的圆形平台，整个平台悬挂在由金色符文构成的波浪形链条上，而非金属链条。这种古老的魔法力量如此强大，以至于你能真切地感受到它的存在——无论是牙齿还是后脑勺，都能感受到它的影响。

        在北侧的墙壁上，有一个由符文组成的轮状图案，正是这个图案在操控着电梯的魔法功能。
        
        而在南侧，则有一条通道通向塔的外层房间。
rows.raw:
"
        You stand on the elevator that connects the various floors of Cloudreach Tower together. It is a solid circular platform of marble, suspended off the ground on undulating chains made not of metal, but of undulating golden runes. This is old magic, powerful enough that you can feel it in your teeth and behind your eyes. 

        There's wheel-shaped circle of runes against the north wall that controls the elevator's magic.
        
        To the south, there's a passage leading into the tower's outer chambers."

rows.original: A smaller, human- (or more likely, elf-) sized workshop adjoins the great Cloudreach Forge. The outer chamber was dominated by bronzesmithing apparati and the golem's massive hammer; this one however has countless small tools laid hap-hazardly across wooden tables that have largely rotted away across the centuries. Several chests and drawers have survived, at least in part, and Daliza can't help herself but to peruse their contents while you explore.
rows.translation: 在巨大的Cloudreach锻造炉旁边，还有一个规模较小的工作间，其大小大概与人类——或者更确切地说，与精灵——相当。外部空间里，青铜铸造用的设备和那个魔像巨大的锤子占据了主要位置；而这个工作间里，各种小型工具则杂乱无章地摆放在那些早已腐朽的木桌上。尽管有些箱子和抽屉还保留着部分完好，但当你在那里探索时，达莉莎忍不住会仔细查看它们里面的物品。
rows.raw: "\n        A smaller, human- (or more likely, elf-) sized workshop adjoins the great Cloudreach Forge. The outer chamber was dominated by bronzesmithing apparati and the golem's massive hammer; this one however has countless small tools laid hap-hazardly across wooden tables that have largely rotted away across the centuries. Several chests and drawers have survived, at least in part, and Daliza can't help herself but to peruse their contents while you explore."

rows.original:
You stand in the midst of the great Cloudreach Forge, the beating heart of the old jarldom's arsenal. A tremendous bronzesmithing apparatus surrounds the chamber, with bellows and burning coals liquifying the metal and sending it running through purifying filters made of strange crystal lattices. Uncounted hundreds of swords, spears, maces, and axes have piled up in the armory, overflowing from their storage racks and into piles on the floor. 

        Without directive from Daliza, the golem is sitting immobile at its forge.
        
        A door south leads into a second, smaller chamber — too small for the forge golem to have any hope of accessing.
rows.translation:
你站在那巨大的Cloudreach锻造炉之中，这里正是这座古老领地军火库的核心所在。周围环绕着一系列庞大的青铜铸造设备，鼓风机与燃烧的煤炭将金属熔化，然后使其流经由奇异晶体结构制成的净化过滤器。数以百计的剑、长矛、钉头锤和斧头堆积在军械库里，早已从储存架上溢出来，散落在地板上。

        在达莉莎没有下达任何指令的情况下，那个魔像就静静地坐在它的锻造台前，一动不动。
        
        南侧的一扇门通向另一个更小的房间——那个房间太小了，连锻造魔像也根本无法进入。

rows.original:
You stand on the elevator that connects the various floors of Cloudreach Tower together. It is a solid circular platform of marble, suspended off the ground on undulating chains made not of metal, but of undulating golden runes. This is old magic, powerful enough that you can feel it in your teeth and behind your eyes. 

        There's wheel-shaped circle of runes against the north wall that controls the elevator's magic.
        
        To the south, there's a passage leading into the tower's outer chambers.
rows.translation:
你站在连接Cloudreach塔各层楼的电梯上。这是一个由大理石制成的圆形平台，整个平台悬挂在由金色符文构成的波浪形链条上，而非金属链条。这种古老的魔法力量如此强大，以至于你能真切地感受到它的存在——无论是牙齿还是后脑勺，都能感受到它的影响。

        在北侧的墙壁上，有一个由符文组成的轮状图案，正是这个图案在操控着电梯的魔法功能。
        
        而在南侧，则有一条通道通向塔的外层房间。
