rows.original:
You stand now on the balcony overlooking not just Dracia Castle, but the entire island and much of the northern archipelago. The clouds sit just above your head, mingling with the roof of the tower, and the air is brutally cold. There must be some enchantment on the stone to keep you safe, as there's no breeze at all. 

        The balcony is stone, and extends several feet from the tower's edge. The door back inside is quite a bit larger than any other in the tower — perhaps meant for one of the legendary Dracian dragons to enter through? They could certainly have flown up here. 
        
        You see the remnants of potted plants, mostly herbs by your guess rather than flowers, in long growers all along the balcony railing. Though the plants have died of neglect, their source of water is still here: a small fountain built into the wall, depicting a topless, horned salamander woman with arms outstretched. Her pendulous breasts seep cool, clear water down into a basin beneath her scaly toes. There's just enough paint left on the bust to indicate green scales, azure hair, and copper-colored skin.
rows.translation:
你现在站在阳台上，不仅能俯瞰达拉西亚城堡，还能看到整个岛屿以及北部大部分群岛。云层就在你的头顶上方，与塔楼的屋顶融为一体，空气寒冷刺骨。这块石头上肯定蕴含着某种魔力，才能让你保持安全，因为这里根本没有任何微风。

        阳台是由石头建造的，它从塔楼边缘延伸出去好几英尺。里面的那扇门比塔楼里其他任何门都要大得多——或许是为了让那些传说中的达拉西亚巨龙能够通过吧？他们完全可以选择飞到这里来。
        
        你可以看到，沿着阳台的栏杆，摆放着一排排长形的花盆，其中种植的大多是草本植物，而不是鲜花。虽然这些植物因为无人照料而枯死了，但它们的水源依然存在——那是一个嵌入墙壁中的小喷泉，喷泉上雕刻着一个没有上衣、长着角、双臂伸开的蝾螈女性形象。她那悬垂的乳房会渗出清凉透明的液体，这些液体会流到她那长满鳞片的脚趾下方的盆子里。她的胸膛上还残留着足够的颜料，这些颜料呈现出绿色的鳞片、天蓝色的头发以及铜色的皮肤。

rows.original:
You stand now in the highest reaches of Cloudreach Tower — the sanctum of the Estelorean magisters that once called the tower home. Where the lower levels of the tower are split into rooms hugging the outer walls, the sanctum is a single, open floor with the elevator in an enclosed platform. There were doors sealing it off, able to be barred from the inside, but those have shattered from some great impact long ago. 

        The walls of the sanctum are surrounded by shelves laden with scrolls and stone tablets on all sides save the doors leading north onto the elevator platform, and south out onto the great balcony you saw from below. There must be thousands of rolls on the racks; a quarter of the room alone would make any Heartlander scholar salivate.
        
        The middle of the sanctum has a canopied bed, surrounded by standing screens in wooden frames that have somehow endured the passage of years better than the stone walls outside. A quite generously-cupped blue bra and night robe are still draped over one. There's a chest at the foot of the bed, and a writing table beside it. A blue crystal, carved with clawmarked runes, sits in a copper wire sconce atop it.
rows.translation:
你现在站在云达塔的最高层——这里曾是埃斯特洛瑞安法师们的圣地。塔的较低层被划分成许多紧邻外墙的房间，而这个圣地则是一片开阔的空间，电梯被安置在一个封闭的平台上。那里有门将空间封闭起来，可以从内部用门闩锁住，但很久以前，那些门就已经被某种巨大的冲击力撞碎了。

        圣所的墙壁四面都摆满了书架，上面堆满了卷轴和石板，只有通往北边电梯平台的门以及通往南边那个你从下面看到的巨大阳台的门除外。那些架子上肯定摆放着成千上万的卷轴；仅仅是房间四分之一的卷轴数量，就足以让任何一位“心灵之地”的学者垂涎三尺了。
        
        圣所的正中央有一张有顶篷的床，床的四周环绕着木制框架制成的屏风，这些屏风似乎在历经岁月沧桑之后，依然比外面的石墙保存得更好。一件杯口相当宽大的蓝色胸罩和睡袍仍然披在她的身上。床脚放着一个梳妆台，旁边则是一张写字台。在写字台的顶部，有一个用铜线制成的灯座，里面放着一颗刻有爪痕般图案的蓝色水晶。

rows.original:
You stand in the great hall of Dracia Keep, a long entrance flanked by pillars of marble and countless blue dragon banners still hanging from its walls. Ancient spears are crossed over shields hung up behind suits of old black bronze armor and horn helms, relics from Dracia's warrior past. Some have been looted in the intervening years, possibly by Alissa's own goons, but there's still a treasure-trove of historic arms here that were old before even the Godswar.

        The hall continues eastward from here, deep into unlit shadows.
rows.translation:
你站在达拉西亚城堡的宏伟大厅中，长长的入口两侧矗立着大理石柱子，墙上还悬挂着无数条蓝色龙旗。古老的长矛交叉着架在盾牌上，而这些盾牌则被挂在那些古老的黑色青铜盔甲和角状头盔后面——这些都是达拉西亚昔日战士们留下的遗物。在这些年间，其中一些物品可能已经被阿莉莎的手下抢走了，但这里仍然珍藏着许多历史悠久的武器——这些武器的年代甚至可以追溯到神战之前。

        大厅从这里继续向东延伸，通向一片漆黑的阴影之中。

rows.original: You stand in the great hall of Dracia Keep, a long entrance flanked by pillars of marble and countless blue dragon banners still hanging from its walls. Above you is a balcony overlooking the hall, and before you are several long tables before a throne on a dias. A small door behind the throne leads into the keep's inner demesne, to the east, while the great doors are back west.
rows.translation: 你站在达拉西亚城堡的大厅中，长长的入口两侧矗立着大理石柱子，墙上还悬挂着无数蓝色龙旗。你的上方有一个可以俯瞰整个大厅的阳台，而前方则有几张长桌，桌子前方是一张高脚宝座。宝座后方有一扇小门，通向城堡东侧的内院，而大门则位于西侧。
rows.raw: "\n        You stand in the great hall of Dracia Keep, a long entrance flanked by pillars of marble and countless blue dragon banners still hanging from its walls. Above you is a balcony overlooking the hall, and before you are several long tables before a throne on a dias. A small door behind the throne leads into the keep's inner demesne, to the east, while the great doors are back west."

rows.original:
The galleries and ballrooms and servants' quarters dominate the first floor of Dracia Keep, spiderwebbing off from a central corridor running north to south here. 

        The main hall is back west. You can see stairs in the distance to the south, leading up into the noble quarters.
rows.translation:
达拉西亚要塞的一楼主要分布着画廊、舞厅与仆役住处，它们如蛛网般从这条南北走向的中央走廊向外延伸。

        主厅在西边。南方远处可以看见一段楼梯，向上通往贵族居所。

        在南方远处，你可以看到通往贵族住所的楼梯。
        
        你正东方的地方有一条拱形的石制通道，通道的尽头是向下蜿蜒的楼梯。

The barrow beneath Castle Dracia is a massive, vaulted thing connected to the realm above by a collapsing door in the ceiling[flags.RQ2_V_DAL1
            | — perhaps beneath the legendary lake-temple whence the first dragons of this island met Jarl Eldred
        ]. The small stairway you came in lies west, behind you, curling up around a shaft and back into the castle. 

        You can see no way to access the barrow from here: there is a titanic slab of solid granite before you, engraved with the images of skeletal dragons lording over countless prostrated salamanders and boreal elves. The stone is etched with leycrystal, forming swirling runic patterns that cover it nearly from tip to bottom. You suppose the dragons must have cared a great deal about protecting their dead.
rows.translation:
位于达拉西亚城堡下方的那个手推车，实际上是一个巨大的拱形结构，它通过天花板上那扇会自动关闭的门与上方的世界相连。[flags.RQ2_V_DAL1
            | ——或许就在那座传说中的湖中神庙之下，这座岛上最早出现的巨龙们就是在那里与贾尔·埃尔德雷德相遇的。
        ]你进入来的那段小楼梯位于西侧，就在你身后，它沿着一条通道蜿蜒向上，最终通向城堡内部。

        从这里你根本看不到任何通往那辆手推车的途径：在你面前有一块巨大的花岗岩板，上面雕刻着骷髅龙俯视着无数俯首称臣的蝾螈和极北精灵的图案。这块石头上刻着莱水晶纹路，那些旋转状的符文几乎覆盖了它的整个表面，从顶端一直延伸到下装。你可以想象，那些龙一定非常重视保护他们的死者。

rows.original: You stand at the bottom of the grand stairs sweeping up and around to give access to the nobles' private quarters high above. The far wall on the landing between the two floors is dominated by a fresco on the stone depicting a tall, bearded elf man surrounded by three lovely women: an armored amazonian elf-maiden that could pass herself off as Daliza if she lost a little muscle, a smaller brunette halfsex with not much in the bustline but a quite prodigious ass, and a third woman that looks like an azure-haired salamander with horns and a pair of cute little wings sprouting from her back.
rows.translation: 你站在那座宏伟楼梯的下装，这些楼梯呈螺旋状向上延伸，通向高处的贵族私人居所。在两层楼之间的楼梯平台上，远处的墙壁上有一幅壁画：画中是一位高大的、留着胡子的精灵男子，周围围绕着三位美丽的女性：一位身披铠甲的亚马逊精灵少女，如果她稍微减掉一些肌肉，简直可以被误认为是达莉莎；另一位则是身材较为娇小的深色头发半性别生物，她的胸部并不丰满，但臀部却非常迷人；第三位女性则长得像一只蓝色的、长着角、背部还长着一对可爱小翅膀的蝾螈。

rows.original: The upper gallery stretches the width of the castle, from the grand stairs to your south to the chambers of the jarl and his family at the north end. The hall is flanked on its east side by a dozen doors leading into private chambers, many of which show signs of recent occupation.
rows.translation: 上层走廊贯穿整个城堡的宽度，从南端的宏伟楼梯一直延伸到北端的伯爵及其家人的居室。大厅的东侧分布着十几扇门，这些门通向私人房间，其中许多房间显然有人近期居住过。

To the east is a curtained passage, leading into a small chapel.
rows.translation: 穿过堡垒第二层的中央走廊的尽头，是一扇巨大的西侧大门，通向上层走廊——在那里，酋长或女性酋长或许曾私下招待过那些声名显赫的宾客。而东侧则是一条被帘子遮住的通道，通向一间小礼拜堂。

rows.original: The mock throne room Alissa kept in the upper gallery is a riotous wreck in the aftermath of your battle: the demonic harem-mimics of Etheryn are sprawled out here and there insensate, while her impish courtiers have been laid low around them, now unmoving.
rows.translation: 在你那场战斗之后，艾莉莎保存在上层走廊里的模拟王座室已经变得一片狼藉：那些模仿后宫风格的恶魔们四散倒地，失去了意识；而她那些调皮捣蛋的朝臣们也全都倒下了，再也无法动弹。

rows.original: You stand in a small, veiled chapel set apart from the rest of the castle. The goddess is depicted standing atop a small marble fountain in the aspect of a horned salamander. She carries a staff in one hand and an open tome in the other, wrapped tightly in a sheer robe that hugs her broad hips and ample bosoms.
rows.translation: 你站在一座与城堡其他部分隔离开来的小礼拜堂里。那里供奉着一位女神，她的形象被描绘成站在一座小型大理石喷泉之上，呈现出角状蝾螈的外形。她一手持权杖，另一手捧着一本打开的书卷，全身穿着一件紧贴身形的透明长袍，这件长袍将她宽大的臀部与丰满的胸部完美地衬托了出来。

rows.original:
The entryway to the druidic temple is old and cracked, leaf litter from the Frostwood swept in by the wind and left to molder away into rot. Once, this might have been artistically and beautifully kept, but the pink and white marble has long since lost its shine and turned cloudy, if not outright eroded from elements and nature alike. Roots and tendrils peek out from not just cracks in the mortar, but from holes in the walls where the masonry has crumbled away; some of them are pretty thick and scraggly, and you wonder if the ruins are stable enough to not collapse on you as you make your way down the wide hallway.

        Tiny shafts of light filter in through the massed roots and rubble that lie strewn about the floor, affording the most marginal lightning into the gloom beyond. The ground gradually slopes upward, ancient tiling shattered and overgrown; rotting leaf litter steadily gives way to small threads of fungus that sprout from the mortar, long, spindly filaments with round, pin-like heads. Inscriptions ply the walls aplenty, and [pc.ora elf
        |while the language shares enough similarities with wyld elf script for you to be able to make out a word here and there, ancient pale elf writing is different enough that you can't truly make any sense of it. Pity
        |[pc.bg acolyte scholar noblescion arcanist
        |though you've had some measure of education, ancient boreal elf writing isn't a subject covered in many classes these days
        |though you give them a good, hard look, ancient boreal elf writing is beyond your means to parse from simple observation alone
        ]
        ]. Presumably it's something important, but as things stand you're not deciphering this alone.
        
        You peer further on into the gloom, and as far as you can see there's a faint blue glow in the air, a chill that only intensifies along with the heavy, musty smell and sheds just a bit of light. Not enough to see well by, but enough to avoid stumbling around completely blind.
rows.translation:
德鲁伊神庙的入口已经变得陈旧而开裂，风从寒冰森林中吹来，将落叶带了进来，这些落叶在那里腐烂变质。曾经，这里或许被精心维护，显得十分美观，但那些粉白相间的大理石早已失去了光泽，变得浑浊不堪，甚至被自然环境侵蚀得面目全非。那些根须和藤蔓不仅从灰浆的裂缝中伸出，还从墙壁上那些砖石已经脱落形成的洞孔中钻出来；其中一些根须相当粗壮且杂乱无章，当你沿着宽阔的走廊前行时，不禁会怀疑这些废墟是否足够稳固，不会在你们经过时突然坍塌下来。

        微弱的光线从那些散落在地面的树根和碎石中透了进来，为那片昏暗的区域带来了一丝微光。地面逐渐向上倾斜，古老的瓷砖已经破碎不堪，上面还长满了杂草；腐烂的落叶逐渐被从灰浆中生长出来的细小真菌取代——那些长长的、纤细的菌丝，末端长着圆形的、针状的菌盖。墙上到处都贴满了铭文， [pc.ora elf
        |虽然这种语言与野精灵文字有足够的相似之处，让你能够偶尔辨认出一些单词，但古老的苍白精灵文字却差异太大，根本无法让人真正理解其含义。真是遗憾啊。
        |[pc.bg acolyte scholar noblescion arcanist
        |虽然你接受过一定的教育，但古老的北方精灵文字如今已不是许多课程会涉及的内容了。
        |尽管你仔细观察了很久，但古代北方精灵的文字还是超出了你仅凭观察就能解读的范围。
        ]
        ]大概这是件很重要的事情，但就目前的情况来看，你并不是独自在尝试破解它。
        
        你进一步凝视着那片黑暗，视线所及之处，空气中弥漫着淡淡的蓝光，那种寒意也随之愈发强烈。伴随着浓重的霉味，这种蓝光虽然只能提供微弱的光线，但至少能让你不会在完全黑暗中跌跌撞撞地行动。

rows.original:
This antechamber might once have been for resting, waiting, relaxing — you're not exactly sure, and it's hard to tell under the fine carpet of pinhead fungus that coats the ruined marble floor. Granite benches made for reclining line the walls, their occupants moldy bones lying in eternal repose. Tall, broad shoulders, solidly built, male and female alike — with one or two smaller, much finer skeletons. Yep, there's little doubt that these are the remains of pale elves, the quiet dark giving the entire room a sepulchral atmosphere.

        Judging by the contorted positions of the skeletons, they do not appear to have died peacefully; the bones appear twisted and misshapen, abnormally and disproportionately grown in random places; other skeletons lie strewn on the ground or at the feet of the benches, caught in positions that with a little imagination, could be construed as compromising were they still alive. The cold blue aura only intensifies here, the masonry itself radiating a chill that makes your skin pucker and spine crawl.
        
        A large fountain forms the centerpiece of the room, but it's long since run dry, the entire structure choked with bracken and pinhead fungus. Not too far off from where you entered, there're several barred windows to either side of an archway; that means of ingress is blocked off by aforementioned archway having collapsed into a mess of brick glued together by mold. There's still the passageway to the north on the other end, so this little adventure isn't brought to an early, anticlimactic end, but even so...
rows.translation:
这个前厅或许曾经是用来休息、等待或放松的——不过你也说不太确定，因为那层覆盖在破损的大理石地面上的细小霉菌地毯，使得一切都难以分辨了。墙壁上排列着用于休息的花岗岩长凳，而那些曾经坐在上面的人，他们的骨头早已发霉，陷入了永恒的沉寂。高大、肩膀宽阔、体格结实，无论是男性还是女性都是如此——只不过有一两具骨骼要小一些，也精致一些。毫无疑问，这些就是苍白精灵的遗骸，那种阴郁的氛围让整个房间都充满了墓地的感觉。

        从这些骷髅扭曲的姿势来看，它们显然并非死于自然；骨骼明显发生了变形，有些部位异常地、不成比例地生长在了一些奇怪的位置；其他的骷髅散落在地上或长椅的脚下，它们所处的姿势……稍加想象，就能让人觉得，如果它们还活着的话，肯定处于非常尴尬的境地。这里的寒冷蓝光愈发浓烈，就连石砌的墙壁本身也在散发着令人不寒而栗的寒意，让人的皮肤不由自主地收缩，脊背也发麻起来。
        
        房间中央矗立着一座巨大的喷泉，但它早已干涸，整个结构被蕨类植物和微小的真菌覆盖得严严实实。在你进入房间的不远处，有一处拱门，拱门两侧有几扇装有铁栅栏的窗户；不过，这条入口通道已经被那座坍塌的拱门堵住了——那些砖块都被霉菌粘在了一起，变得乱七八糟。不过，另一端仍然有一条通往北方的通道，所以这次小小的冒险并没有过早地以一种令人失望的方式结束……不过，即便如此……

rows.original:
You've fallen into into the remains of a deep wine cellar — only the metal bits of the casks and presses remain, their wood long eaten away into nothingness by the ever-present fungus; the racks and shelves have long since collapsed, leaving bottles to shatter on the ground. Even the corks have been consumed by the mold, leaving only rot and dust in its wake. It's probably not constructive to consider exactly what broke your fall, both on your way down and upon your landing.

        Mold-covered marble flagstones heave and crack under some force pressing upwards from below, and sap — golden-orange, thick and stinking, oozes from the walls like filthy discharge from an infected wound. With spores drifting down in thick clouds from above and the calming, deathly blue glow in the air having turned that same shade of virulent golden-orange, staying here overlong isn't a good idea; instead of being calming, the sense of serenity that pervades the old wine cellar is disquietingly alien.
        
        There's no way to return from whence you came — even if the ceiling weren't too high for you to reach, the slick, oozing walls coated with mushy detritus don't exactly inspire confidence in one's ability to make the climb. The only way, it would appear, is forward.
rows.translation:
你掉进了一个废弃的深酒窖里——那里只剩下酒桶和压榨机的金属残骸，那些木头早已被无处不在的真菌腐蚀得荡然无存；架子和搁板也早就倒塌了，那些酒瓶散落在地上，全都摔得粉碎。就连软木塞也被霉菌侵蚀得面目全非，留下的只有腐烂和尘埃。试图弄清楚是哪些因素在下降过程中或着陆时阻碍了你的下落，恐怕并无太大意义。

        那些被霉菌覆盖的大理石铺路石在受到来自下方的压力时会变形甚至开裂，而一种金橙色、浓稠且散发着恶臭的液体则像是从感染的伤口中流出的污物一样，从墙壁上渗出来。当孢子如浓云般从上方飘落，空气中原本令人宁静的死寂蓝光也变成了那种充满毒性的金橙色时，再在这里待太久显然不是个好主意。这个古老的酒窖里原本弥漫着的宁静氛围，反而给人一种令人不安的异样感。
        
        根本不可能从你来的地方重新回去——即使天花板的高度不会让你无法触及，但那些覆盖着黏糊糊杂物的光滑墙壁，实在让人对能否成功攀爬失去信心。看来，唯一的办法就是向前迈进。

rows.original:
A workshop to support the winery — the remains of benches and chairs lie in ruin, just about everything organic consumed by the spreading fungus. Ceramic jugs for holding finished wine, wine casks and must vats for fermenting it in, bits and pieces needed to keep the juice presses in working condition. It doesn't look like the bottles were locally made, though — perhaps they were sourced from Tychris in better times?

        Mold-covered elven skeletons remain at their benches where they died, several brittle remains smashed to pieces on the floor amidst the fungus. It doesn't look like they died from the creeping mold, but it's nevertheless greedily claimed their bodies. The orange glow in the air only brightens the further you go, and gentle clouds of spores continually drift down from the ceiling like a fine mist. It's a wonder that the air here is still breathable...
        
        Large double doors to the north leading outside have caved in, providing an easy means of egress.
rows.translation:
为支持这家酒庄而举办的研讨会——那些长凳和椅子的残骸早已沦为废墟，几乎所有有机材料都被蔓延的真菌消耗殆尽。用于盛放成品葡萄酒的陶瓷罐子、用于储存葡萄酒的橡木桶以及用于发酵葡萄汁的大桶，还有那些维持压榨设备正常运转所需的零配件，全都不见了踪影。不过，这些瓶子看起来并不像是本地制造的——或许在过去的繁荣时期，它们是从提克里斯地区采购来的吧？

        那些被霉菌覆盖的精灵骷髅仍然躺在它们死亡时的位置上，其中一些脆弱的遗骸已经碎裂成片，散落在地板上，周围还长满了霉菌。看起来它们并不是死于那种蔓延的霉菌，但这种霉菌依然贪婪地占据了它们的身体。空气中的橙色光芒会随着你前进的距离而变得更加明亮，而细小的孢子云则会像薄雾一样不断地从天花板上飘落下来。真奇怪，这里的空气居然还能呼吸……
        
        通往北面的那扇巨大的双开门已经坍塌了，这反而为人们提供了一条便捷的逃生通道。

rows.original:
Old vineyards that presumably supplied the adjacent winery. Thanks to the dark, choked river that flows along its southern and western borders, the soil is still soft and moist; alas, nothing wholesome grows there these days. The trellises have long since collapsed, but the plants themselves appear to have survived, running rampant as they cling to the marble fencing that divides the fields from the stream's bank.

        Oh, they've survived... if one can call this existence survival. The grapevines are barely recognizable as such anymore, the stems akin more to bundled filaments than vines; bunches of egg-sized fruit clusters hang heavy and ripe, each individual berry growing unstoppably until it splits and oozes its vile contents all over the place. You're pretty sure that grapes shouldn't be pulsating like that... no doubt the druidic magics that made mirrorwine so special served to make the grapes susceptible to fungal attack, too.
rows.translation:
那些曾经为附近的酿酒厂提供葡萄的古老葡萄园。由于有一条幽暗、狭窄的河流从它的南部和西部边界流过，这里的土壤依然保持着柔软和湿润的状态；可惜的是，如今那里已经再也长不出任何有营养的植物了。那些棚架早就倒塌了，但那些植物似乎依然存活了下来，它们紧紧攀附在将田野与溪流岸边分隔开来的大理石围栏上，疯狂地生长着。

        哦，它们确实活下来了。…如果这种生存状态还能被称为生存的话。这些葡萄藤已经几乎无法被认出是葡萄藤了，它们的茎更像是缠在一起的细丝；一串串鸡蛋大小的果实悬挂着，显得既沉重又成熟，每一颗果实都在不断生长，直到最终裂开，将其中恶心的汁液洒得到处都是。你肯定觉得葡萄不应该有那样的脉动……毫无疑问，那些让镜像酒变得如此特别的德鲁伊魔法，也使得这些葡萄容易受到真菌的侵袭。

You're pretty sure that grapes shouldn't be pulsating like that... no doubt the druidic magics that made mirrorwine so special served to make the grapes susceptible to fungal attack, too."

A bridge of once pink-and-white marble over a pool that could, in the distant past, have been conceivably clear. Now, though, the surface is choked with a bloom of brown scum, lumpy vegetative matter reminiscent of particularly odious vomit and with a stench to match; the fact that a stream sloughs through it does nothing to move any of the gunk away, the flow is too sluggish for that. To say that the air here is humid would be an understatement — moisture clings to every conceivable surface, forming droplets on the few open spaces and otherwise mixing with the sap, fungus and other matter to create a slippery, disgusting mess.

        No wonder none of the fountains or water features in the ruins are running. What's more interesting, though, is that your surroundings look like they were once open to the air — the winery that you just left sits as a shed, instead of being built into the cavern wall. Did this entire place get subsumed into the earth? [pc.bg soldier
        |You remember campfire stories about campaigns down in the Heartlands, where entire ancient villages, consumed during the Godswar, could appear and disappear in the span of days thanks to the earth's constant and violent shifting in the dangerous areas. Did the entirety of the temple's surrounding lands wind up swallowed by the earth?
        ]
rows.translation:
曾经是一片粉白大理石砌成的桥，横跨着一个在远古时期或许还能保持清澈的池塘。然而如今，池塘表面覆盖着一层棕色的浮渣，还有那些块状的植物残渣，看起来简直就像令人作呕的呕吐物，散发着难闻的气味。即使有溪流从其中流过，也无法将这些污物冲走——水流实在太慢了，根本无能为力。说这里的空气潮湿，其实还是轻描淡写了——湿气附着在每一个可以想到的表面，在为数不多的开阔处形成水滴，否则就会与树液、真菌以及其他各种物质混合在一起，形成一种黏腻、令人作呕的混合物。

        难怪这些废墟中的喷泉或水景都没有水流动。不过，更有趣的是，你周围的环境看起来似乎曾经是露天结构——你刚刚离开的酒窖现在只是一间棚屋，并没有建在洞穴的墙壁上。难道整个地方都沉入地下了吗？ [pc.bg soldier
        |你还记得那些关于腹地战役的篝火故事吗？在那些危险的区域，由于地壳不断剧烈移动，整个古老的村庄在神战期间会突然出现，然后又在几天之内消失不见。那么，那座寺庙周围的整个地区，最终是不是也被大地吞没了呢？
        ]

rows.original: Having defeated Lanniere and temporarily beaten back the infested dryad's corrupted libido, no matter how temporarily, you're free to take in the sights of her grove. Aside from her — well, plant would be the only correct description for it — that houses the dryad, the rest of the grove is now merely rotted stumps, most of them already completely subsumed by the towering fungal spires that loom all the way to the cavern ceiling. At least they've stopped stopped spewing spores all over, which is a good start. [flags.XADARON_R7 2||You're not exactly sure if anything can be done for Lanniere — like her grove, the dryad is still beautiful, only in a twisted way. That's something for the Lumians to sort out, you suppose.]
rows.translation: 在击败了兰尼埃，并暂时抑制住了那些被侵蚀的干尸精灵那扭曲的欲望之后，无论这种抑制效果能持续多久，你都可以自由地欣赏她那片树林的景色了。当然，除了她本人之外……嗯，也就是除了她本人之外。植物这确实是对其最准确的描述——那里居住着树精，而树林的其他部分如今都只剩下腐烂的树桩，其中大部分已经被那些高耸入云的真菌尖塔完全吞没，这些真菌尖塔一直延伸到洞穴的天花板。至少它们不再向四周释放孢子了，这已经是一个好的开始。 [flags.XADARON_R7 2||你其实并不确定是否能为兰妮尔做些什么——比如她的树林，那位树精依然很美，只不过那种美已经变得扭曲了。我想，这应该是卢米安人需要去解决的问题吧。]

rows.original:
The fence on the western side of the vineyard falls away and opens up to a garden — instead of the vineyards, which were for work, the carved stone and fine trellises suggest that the plants grown in these now-moldy beds were for pleasure. Granite and marble benches line the low walls, and there's scarcely an inch of bare dirt that isn't carpeted with fungal growths of different shapes like scabs over wounds. 

        Elven skeletons lie strewn about this garden, the dead lying where they fell, their bones partially consumed by the orange-red carpet; bigger growths of bracket and cup fungus sprout from the bones themselves, vultures fighting over long-dead remains. A light rain of spores drifts down through the air, noticeably thicker than the fine mist you've almost become accustomed to at this point at the expense of your sense of smell; the orange glow that pervades the air also appears to grow more intense off the west.

        And speaking of the west...yes, that's where the glow and spores are coming from, across a bridge that spans the dark river.
rows.translation:
葡萄园西侧的围栏逐渐消失，通向一片花园——与那些用于劳作的葡萄园不同，这里雕刻精美的石雕和精致的棚架表明，这些如今已经长满苔藓的苗床里种植的植物，是用来欣赏和享受的。花坛的低矮墙面上排列着花岗岩和大理石制成的长椅，几乎没有任何一块裸露的泥土是没有被各种形状的真菌覆盖的——那些真菌看起来就像伤口上的结痂一样。 

        精灵的骨架散落在这个花园里，死者就倒在他们倒下的地方，他们的骨头已经被那种橙红色的真菌部分侵蚀了；一些较大的菌类则从这些骨头上生长出来，而秃鹫们则在争夺那些早已死去的生物的残骸。一阵轻柔的孢子随风飘落，这些孢子的密度明显要比你此时已经几乎习以为常的细雾要高得多——这种雾气已经严重影响了你的嗅觉；而弥漫在空气中的橙色光芒，在西边似乎变得更加浓烈了。

        说到西方……没错，光芒和孢子就是从那里散发出来的，它们穿过一座横跨那条暗影河流的桥梁。

rows.original:
A central plaza that looks like it once was open to the sky — here and there, parts of the original mosaic tiling peek through from the fungal floor. The remains of broken arches lie strewn about the plaza, only a few pillars standing to hint at their past glory. To the west, the dark stream continues to flow unabated, eventually disappearing into the temple.

        This, then, would be what's left of the main concourse. What rituals were once performed here, what festivities were held? It's certainly wide enough for more than a conclave of druids, perhaps comfortably able to accommodate a thousand or so — you remember that these temples were supposed to have surrounding villages and people who supplied the druids with what they didn't produce themselves. Xadaron Temple was supposed to be the grandest of them all...
        
        To the west lies a bridge spanning the sluggish stream, to the north lie the huge stone doors that mark the entrance to the temple. One of them's been knocked ajar, while the other has been torn clean off its hinges; warm orange-amber light seeps from within, inviting yet virulent at the same time, like a trap laced with honey.
rows.translation:
这个中央广场仿佛曾经是露天场所——在这里和那里，原始的马赛克瓷砖碎片从长满真菌的地面中若隐若现。破碎的拱门残骸散落在广场各处，只有寥寥几根柱子还矗立着，暗示着它们昔日的辉煌。在西方，那条幽暗的溪流持续不断地流淌着，最终消失在了那座寺庙之中。

        那么，这里应该就是主厅剩下的部分了吧。曾经在这里举行过哪些仪式？又举办过哪些庆典活动呢？这个空间确实足够容纳不止一群德鲁伊，甚至可以轻松容纳大约一千人——你应该还记得，这些神庙周围本来应该有村庄，还有人们为德鲁伊提供他们自己无法生产的东西。扎达隆神庙本应是其中最宏伟的建筑……
        
        西边有一座横跨那条缓缓流淌的小溪的桥梁，北边则是那扇标志着神庙入口的巨石大门。其中一扇大门已经被撞得半开，而另一扇则完全从铰链上被扯了下来；温暖的红橙色光芒从神庙内部透了出来，这种光芒既具有吸引力，同时又充满危险，就像一个裹着蜂蜜的陷阱。

rows.original: The northeastern corner of the vineyard, a ruined marble fence running along its eastern border and disappearing into the temple proper. Large mushrooms with a wood-like consistency sprout from the moldy carpet, each one perhaps twice as tall as you are; overrun as it is, there are scant few remains of the grapes that were once planted here. A metal strut here and there, the husk of a wheelbarrow that couldn't be consumed — all quiet reminders that this wasn't always a fungal grove. The foundations of sheds litter the northern edge of the ancient vineyard, perhaps once used for storage... not that anything useful could've survived this long. And beyond that, a section of temple wall — all this really gives the impression that it used to be above ground at some point... You can understand a fungal infection taking hold and leaving this place in ruins, but there had to be another force in play here for a good chunk of the temple to be subsumed by the earth. Surely a mere disease couldn't do this, right?
rows.translation: 葡萄园的东北角，有一道破损的大理石围栏沿着其东侧边界延伸，最终消失在寺庙的主体建筑中。发霉的地面上长出了那些质地类似木头的巨大蘑菇，每一朵的高度或许都有你的两倍；由于这片区域已经完全被这些蘑菇覆盖，曾经在这里种植的葡萄，如今几乎已经所剩无几了。这里那里散布着金属支柱，还有那些无法被销毁的独轮车的车架——所有这些都在无声地提醒人们：这里并不总是这片真菌丛生的林地。 那些储藏棚的基架散布在这片古老葡萄园的北缘，它们或许曾经被用来储存物品。…不过，恐怕没有什么有用的东西能在这漫长的岁月里保存下来吧。更何况，寺庙的某段墙壁——所有这些真的吗给人的感觉是，这个地方在过去的某个时候应该是露在地面上的…… 可以理解真菌感染会逐渐蔓延，最终将这个地方毁坏，但要想让寺庙的绝大部分区域都被土壤覆盖，肯定还有其他力量在起作用。毕竟，仅仅是一种疾病，应该不可能造成这样的后果吧？

The foundations of sheds litter the northern edge of the ancient vineyard, perhaps once used for storage... not that anything useful could've survived this long. And beyond that, a section of temple wall — all this really gives the impression that it used to be above ground at some point... You can understand a fungal infection taking hold and leaving this place in ruins, but there had to be another force in play here for a good chunk of the temple to be subsumed by the earth. Surely a mere disease couldn't do this, right?"

rows.original: The passageway here opens up into a broad atrium — the opening that was once open to the sky is now choked with a lattice-like network of roots and woody tendrils. Clusters of mold act as glue to bind the entire mess together so the earth doesn't rush in and bury the chamber wholesale; larger clusters of trumpet-like mushrooms occupy the corners, sprouting from shapes you'd rather not investigate too closely. This would appear to be a dormitory for the lower-ranked druids who lived in the temple, those who tended the vineyards, worked the winery and painstakingly gathered nectar from the razorcup flowers. Numerous doorways line many of the walls, all of them leading to identical living quarters, each one cramped and fit for an ascetic, perhaps no bigger than twice the size of a broom closet, perhaps. Anything organic has been consumed by rot long ago, leaving moldering skeletons lying in the stone frames of their beds. More gashes in the walls and that same roiling orange-amber glow within them, like an eye peering out into the room beyond — and you get the feeling that its gaze is searching for you. Hurriedly carved inscriptions line the walls, several obscured by mold, but most are still legible — if it's any consolation, the pulsing glow within the walls that this horrible substance produces as it flows through the mortar like blood gives you plenty of light to read them by. Silence, save for the constant drip-drip-drip of disgusting sap into the atrium's central pool from the roots above: slow, squishy and bound to drive one insane if listened to for too long. Mushrooms as tall as you are grow out of the pool in colors of white and brown, looking as dreary, bleak and yet unsettling as everything else about these ruins from the moment you stepped in. The muck at the bottom, all spores and rot and sap... the overpowering noxious stench that rises from it is enough to make you gag. [party.has azyrran |"It's like amber," Azzyran says, a grimace on her lips. "Or... like honey. Only a lot less wholesome. I daresay the vile substance feeds the fungus and makes it grow so rampantly." ] This is not a good place.
rows.translation: 这条通道通向一个宽阔的中央空间——原本能够直通天空的开口，如今已被根系和木质藤蔓构成的网状结构所堵塞。成群的霉菌就像胶水一样，将这一切杂乱的物质黏在一起，防止土壤涌入并将整个空间彻底掩埋；而在角落里，那些形状怪异、看起来让人不敢靠近的地方，还生长着大型、形状像喇叭的蘑菇。 这似乎是供那些居住在寺庙里、负责照料葡萄园、在酿酒厂工作、以及辛苦采集剃刀花花蜜的低阶德鲁伊们使用的宿舍。许多墙壁上排列着众多的门扉，而这些门扉都通向完全相同的居住空间——每个空间都极其狭小，恐怕连一个扫帚柜的两倍大小都不到。所有有机物质早就腐烂掉了，只剩下发霉的骨架躺在石制的床架中。 墙壁上布满了更多的裂痕，那些橙琥珀色的光芒依然在其中闪烁，仿佛有一只眼睛正从那些裂痕中窥视着房间里的景象——你会觉得那目光正在寻找着你。墙壁上刻满了匆忙写下的铭文，其中一些已经被霉菌覆盖，但大多数仍然可以辨认出来。如果这能让你感到些许安慰的话，那么这种可怕物质在砂浆中流动时所产生的光芒，确实为阅读这些铭文提供了足够的光线。 只有从上方根部不断滴落到中央水池里的那黏稠汁液发出的滴答声打破了这份寂静——这种声音缓慢而黏腻，如果长时间聆听，真的会让人发疯。从水池中长出的蘑菇有你的身高那么高，颜色或是白色或是棕色，它们看起来同样阴郁、凄凉，而且与这片废墟里的其他一切一样，让人感到不安。水池下装的淤泥里满是孢子、腐烂物和汁液……从那里散发出来的浓烈恶臭足以让人作呕。 [party.has azyrran |它就像琥珀一样。阿兹兰说着，嘴角露出一丝苦涩的表情。或者……就像蜂蜜一样。只不过它的危害要大得多。我敢说，这种有害物质正是滋养那些真菌、让它们疯狂生长的原因。 ] 这里可不是个好地方。

rows.original:
The entrance of the temple proper lies in a state of utter disrepair. Stained glass, no doubt painstakingly imported all the way from Tychris, has been smashed from the windows it once adorned, and the ever-present carpet of orange mold and pinhead mushrooms continues to test your footing. At least the spores are thinner in the air here, which is a small relief. Long passageways lead off to the east and west, disappearing deeper into the temple.

        What's disturbing, though, is the fact that gashes line several sections of the walls, torn into the marble as if made by a massive beast. The orange glow is more virulent here, though, and it soon becomes apparent why — they're filled with yet more of the orange pulsating material, weeping stinking sap onto the walls like pus from a wound. Fungal clusters gather around spots where the sap pools, their growth clearly more pronounced than the general carpeting on most surfaces in the ruins.
        
        For now, the air is still, the halls silent but for your breathing and footsteps. For now.
rows.translation:
寺庙的正门早已破败不堪。那些无疑是从提克里斯精心进口的彩绘玻璃，早已从曾经装饰窗户的位置被砸得粉碎；而那些遍布各处的橙色霉菌和针头大小的蘑菇，更是不断考验着人们的脚步。至少这里的空气中孢子浓度较低，这还算是个小小的安慰。长长的通道向东西两侧延伸，最终消失在寺庙的深处。

        然而，真正令人不安的是，墙壁的几处地方都出现了裂痕，那些大理石表面被撕裂得仿佛是某种巨大的野兽所为。然而，这里的橙色光芒显得更加凶猛，很快人们就明白了原因——这些物体内部充满了那种橙色的、会脉动的东西，那些黏稠而发臭的汁液正像伤口流出的脓液一样，不断地渗出并附着在墙壁上。在那些汁液积聚的地方，真菌开始聚集生长，它们的生长速度明显快于废墟中大多数表面的其他微生物。
        
        目前，空气中依然寂静无声，走廊里也只有你的呼吸声和脚步声在回荡。至少现在是这样。
rows.raw:
"The entrance of the temple proper lies in a state of utter disrepair. Stained glass, no doubt painstakingly imported all the way from Tychris, has been smashed from the windows it once adorned, and the ever-present carpet of orange mold and pinhead mushrooms continues to test your footing. At least the spores are thinner in the air here, which is a small relief. Long passageways lead off to the east and west, disappearing deeper into the temple.

        What's disturbing, though, is the fact that gashes line several sections of the walls, torn into the marble as if made by a massive beast. The orange glow is more virulent here, though, and it soon becomes apparent why — they're filled with yet more of the orange pulsating material, weeping stinking sap onto the walls like pus from a wound. Fungal clusters gather around spots where the sap pools, their growth clearly more pronounced than the general carpeting on most surfaces in the ruins.
        
        For now, the air is still, the halls silent but for your breathing and footsteps. For now."

rows.original:
A larger room leading away from the entrance. A refectory of sorts, it looks like — a communal area for the druids, judging by the granite and marble wreckage of furniture the fungus was unable to consume. The ruins of long benches and trestle tables laid out in thin slate; in the corner, piles of old clay crockery which the fungal growths were unable to consume. There aren't any gashes in the walls here, but sap nevertheless oozes from the mortar, and instead of spores, motes of glimmering light drift down from some unseen source in the high ceiling.

        Has something changed?
        
        Even if this was a communal dining area for the lower-ranked druids, it would still have been pleasant to the eye in his heyday, you guess. Everything of Xadaron Temple that you've seen so far has suggested that the druids were into open and beautiful living spaces, and would certainly find the streets of today's Njorhaalt quite cramped, especially if they were all to move in with the existing population. No wonder they've been content to stay outside the walls in tents...
rows.translation:
从入口处延伸出去的一间较大的房间。看起来像是某种餐厅——根据那些被真菌未能侵蚀的花岗岩和大理石家具残骸来判断，这里应该是德鲁伊们的公共活动区域。长条形的长凳和折叠桌的残骸散落在薄石板上；角落里还堆放着那些被真菌生长物忽略的旧陶器。这里的墙壁上没有任何裂痕，但灰浆中仍然在渗出汁液；而从高高的天花板上的某个看不见的地方，掉落下来的不是孢子，而是些闪烁着微光的小颗粒。

        是什么发生了变化吗？
        
        即使这是一个为地位较低的德鲁伊们准备的公共用餐区，在他鼎盛时期，这样的环境想必也会让人感到赏心悦目。到目前为止，你所看到的萨达隆神庙的一切都表明，德鲁伊们非常喜欢宽敞而美观的生活空间；如果他们真的与现今的Njorhaalt居民共同生活在一起，他们肯定会觉得那里的街道太过拥挤了。难怪他们一直满足于住在墙外的帐篷里……

rows.original:
Past the initiates' dormitories is a greenhouse — bronze frames once supported thick, wide panels of glass which now lie shattered amidst the carpet of orange mushrooms that sprouts from beds of heavy, dry earth. In place of the glass ceiling is a multitude of gnarled roots that dangle in mid-air, some of them low enough that you have to weave your way through them while making your way through the chamber. 

        If the original impact when the temple was buried hadn't already shattered the panels to pieces, the roots would've smashed their way through eventually; to make things worse, all of them drip that vile orange sap, which given the differences in the thickness of the fungal carpet seems to be stimulating the mushrooms' growth. The stream that you saw at the temple's exterior flows through the greenhouse, weaving its way amidst the fungal beds before disappearing into another sluice set in the wall.
        
        "Razorcup," Etheryn muses as she examines the scene, crouching down to examine the fungal beds closer. "Stands to reason."
        
        Oh? She can tell?
        
        Ryn nods. "Look at the stone trellises that still stand. We have those in the royal gardens, too, but the razorcups there are just for show. If every single flowerbed in the greenhouse were to be filled, they would have produced perhaps a half-dozen shots over a growing season. No wonder the druids went to the expense of buying so much glass from Tychris and shipping it all the way here, [pc.name] — razorcup arguably brought in more money to the temples than mirrorwine did. To be able to control growing conditions for the blooms to grow year-round, with as much nectar as each one could hold, it's simply amazing."
rows.translation:
穿过新手的宿舍，就会看到一座温室——原本由青铜框架支撑着厚厚的玻璃窗，但现在那些玻璃早已破碎，散落在那些从干燥的泥土中生长出来的橙色蘑菇丛中。原本的玻璃天花板已经被无数盘根错节的根系取代，这些根系悬在半空中，有些甚至低到人们必须从它们中间穿行才能继续前进。 

        如果当初寺庙被掩埋时所产生的冲击力没有把那些面板震得粉碎，那些菌根最终也会把它们彻底破坏掉；更糟糕的是，这些菌根会分泌出那种恶臭的橙色汁液，而由于菌类覆盖层的厚度不同，这种汁液似乎还在促进这些蘑菇的生长。你在寺庙外部看到的那条小溪，实际上流经了整个温室，在那些菌类丛中蜿蜒流淌，最后消失在墙壁上设置的另一个排水口里。
        
        剃刀杯……”伊瑟琳一边观察着现场，一边蹲下来仔细查看那些真菌丛，喃喃道，“确实有这个可能。”
        
        “哦？她能看出来吗？”
        
        小琳点了点头：“看看那些仍然矗立在当地的石制棚架吧。我们的皇家花园里也有那些植物，但那里的那些“切割杯”只是用来做装饰的。如果温室里的每一个花坛都种上这些植物，那么在一个生长季里，它们最多也只能产出半打左右的果实而已。难怪德鲁伊们不惜花费大量精力，从提克里斯那里购买这么多玻璃，然后将其运送到这里来。 [pc.name] — 毫无疑问，剃刀杯为这些神庙带来的收入比镜酒还要多。能够控制这些植物的生长环境，让它们全年都能开花，并且每朵花都能结出最多的花蜜，这确实是一件了不起的事情。

rows.original:
The bottom of a staircase landing, grander than what you've seen of the lower temple. While the hard marble tiles have weathered time and corrosion decently well, they're slowly but surely losing the fight against the fungi seeping through their cracks; fibrous threads blaze an incandescent gold as they pulse and throb ominously, even after you've dealt with the fungal core.

        The northern wall holds several alcoves in which statues of pale elves stand — tall, muscular and imposing, as the boer'alvar are wont to do. They don't wear druidic garb like that you've seen depicted in the temple so far, but certainly are people whom the druids thought worth honoring — warriors dominate a fair proportion of those so revered, but there are those from other callings, too. The statues themselves are quite solidly built to be still standing despite the fungal infestation — all save for one that's clearly been deliberately vandalised, chunks torn out of the marble as if someone had taken a sledgehammer to it. 
        
        You recognize it well enough: Atheldred, her decapitated head lying at her feet, the statue defaced as it stands next to one of Synneva. Yet the athletic statue of the elvenqueen's body remains, defaced as it is. Swallowing hard, Ryn looks down at the statue's head, lying on a soft carpet of spongy mold that's sprung up in its cover, then back up at the statue, smashed and broken. Clenching her fists, she shakes her head and heads back to you.
        
        "It's all in the past," she whispers. "They're already at rest. Come on, [pc.name], we still need to get out of here."
rows.translation:
楼梯平台的下装，比你在下层神庙里见到的任何地方都要宏伟。虽然那些坚硬的大理石瓷砖在时间的侵蚀和腐蚀作用下依然保持着较好的状态，但它们却正在逐渐被从裂缝中渗入的真菌侵蚀。那些纤维状的菌丝在跳动着，散发着炽热的金色光芒，显得十分诡异。即使你已经消灭了那些真菌的核心，这种威胁依然存在。

        北墙上有几处壁龛，里面矗立着苍白精灵的雕像——这些精灵身材高大、肌肉结实、气势凛凛，完全符合布尔阿尔瓦人的特征。他们并没有穿着你在寺庙里见过的那种德鲁伊服饰，但显然，这些精灵是被德鲁伊认为值得尊敬的人。在这些受到尊崇的雕像中，战士占了相当大的比例，但也有一些属于其他职业的人。这些雕像本身的构造相当坚固，因此即便受到了真菌的侵蚀，依然能够屹立不倒——唯一例外的是那一座，显然有人故意对它进行了破坏，大理石上被敲掉了许多碎片，就好像有人用大锤子猛击过它一样。 
        
        你太熟悉这一幕了：阿瑟德雷德，她的头颅被砍下，躺在她的脚边；那座雕像也被毁坏了，就矗立在辛妮瓦的雕像旁边。然而，那位精灵女王那充满运动美感的雕像身体部分依然完好无损，只不过也被破坏得面目全非。小琳艰难地咽了口唾沫，低头看着雕像的头部——它躺在那层柔软的、由霉菌形成的覆盖物上，然后又抬头望向那座被砸得支离破碎的雕像。她紧握双拳，摇了摇头，然后转身朝你走来。
        
        这一切都已经过去了，”她轻声说道，“他们已经安息了。来吧， [pc.name]，我们还是得离开这里。

rows.original: The corridor from the south opens up into the main body of the temple — or at least, what you assume is the main body of the temple for the more senior druids. The ceiling is high and vaulted, but that only means more space for roots to grow down, enough of them hanging perilously close to the marble floor that your have to weave your way through them. It's like navigating a forest... from the underside, that is. Stinking sap beads from the root-tips, dripping into puddles on the floor; in some places you're forced to walk through them, shallow as they are, and they leave a most unsettling sensation on your feet even if they're not obviously harmful. This wing of the temple is brilliantly decorated with colorful murals — or at least, was. Sap constantly flows down the walls and over the murals in a slick, oozing waterfall , gathering at the feet of the walls and seeping into the mortar to presumably be carried odd to the chambers that lie below. If it weren't so vile, it would be beautiful — liquified sunshine pouring away, only twisted and corrupted. The steady pulsing of the ever-present orange glow is strongest here, reminding you ever so bluntly that this place is, for some meaning of the word, alive. The constant flow has dissuaded fungi from sprouting on the walls, but at the same time it's also leached the pigments from the murals, leaving but a few streaks of blotted-out color at this point. Pale elves of all walks of life are depicted doing mundane things — cooking, sewing, tilling the land, counting coin — all the simple acts of life that together add up to the daily grind. It's interesting that the druids would honor such simple acts like these in so grand a fashion, but then you're no expert in [pc.bg acolyte |their particular brand of ]theology. Perhaps touting simple living as being in tune with nature, perhaps? It's clear that this used to be a storehouse, or even a treasury. The ornate amphorae and pottery lying near the back presumably wouldn't have been used to store anything but valuables... although all of them lie smashed on the ground, their contents long since rotted away.
rows.translation: 从南侧延伸出来的走廊通向寺庙的主体部分——至少，对于那些地位较高的德鲁伊来说，你们认为这里才是寺庙的主体区域。天花板很高，呈拱形结构，但这反而意味着有更多的空间让那些藤蔓生长下去，有些藤蔓甚至危险地悬在大理石地面上方，人们不得不小心翼翼地从它们中间穿行。这就像在森林中穿行……只不过是从森林的底部开始。树根顶端渗出的黏稠汁液在地面汇成水洼，有些地方你不得不从这些水洼中走过。虽然这些水洼并不深，但它们会在你的脚上留下一种令人不安的感觉，即使它们显然并不会造成伤害。 这座寺庙的这一侧装饰着色彩斑斓的壁画，简直美轮美奂——至少是如此。是树液不断从墙壁上流淌下来，从壁画上渗出，形成一道滑腻而黏稠的“瀑布”，最终聚集在墙壁的脚下，渗入灰浆之中，或许会被带到下方的那些房间里去。如果这种液体不是如此令人作呕的话，它反而会显得非常美丽——就像是液态的阳光在流淌，只不过被扭曲和污染了而已。这里，那种持续不断的橙色光芒的脉动最为强烈，它以最为直接的方式提醒着你：在这个地方，从某种意义上来说，生命是真实存在的。 这种持续不断的光芒使得真菌无法在墙壁上生长，但与此同时，它也使壁画上的颜料逐渐褪色，如今只剩下一些模糊的色痕。画中的苍白精灵们从事着各种平凡的工作——做饭、缝纫、耕种土地、数钱——这些看似简单的日常活动，其实共同构成了他们每天的生活。有趣的是，德鲁伊们会以如此隆重的方式来纪念这些平凡的行为，不过，这也不是我的专长所在[pc.bg acolyte |他们特有的那种风格/方式 ]神学。或许，他们是在宣扬简朴的生活方式才是与自然相协调的吧？ 显然，这里曾经是一个仓库，甚至是一个宝库。那些放在后面的华丽双耳瓶和陶器，肯定不是用来存放普通物品的，而是用来珍藏贵重之物的……不过现在，它们全都被打碎在地面上，里面的东西也早已腐烂变质了。

rows.original: Setting foot into the temple's second floor, one's struck by the sudden change in decor even at the upper landing — while it isn't an inner sanctum per se, you nevertheless get the impression that the initiates didn't come up here that much. [flags.XADARON_R7 | |"Phew," Ryn mutters, leaning on Elthara for support. "Climbing up those stairs took it out of me." The stairwell wasn't that high, but you're feeling it, too. The exhaustion... if the lower reaches of the temple were filled with spores and musty air, the upper temple is absolutely redolent — no, choking — with the stuff. Aching weariness and exertion are setting into your bones, and you have the dark suspicion that if you stopped to rest, you'd fall asleep and never wake up again.[party.randComp brint brienne arona | Even Brint's starting to look worn and ragged, trying to control the raging erection he's sporting despite being all tuckered out. | Even Brienne's starting to look worn and ragged, trying to control her obvious lusts despite being all tuckered out. | Even Arona's starting to look worn and ragged, trying to control the raging erection she's sporting despite being all tuckered out. ] You might be impervious to direct infection by the fungus, but that doesn't mean it can't find other ways to get to you. You can press on forcibly, but it will be at a considerable disadvantage. Perhaps it would be wiser to return to the lower reaches and find a means of thinning the spores before exploring the upper temple. ] A reception hall, perhaps? It would explain the sudden shift in luxuriousness — metal bars and rings over broken windows imply places where curtains might once have been hung, while a stylized symbol of a grand tree in a circle is still visible through the mushrooms and other fungi that litter the floor, said symbol etched into the marble tiles. Bits of gold still glint in the light of the otherworldly, glowing sap, tempting but embedded in spongy growths of very unfriendly-looking fungus; the remains of past opulence still survive amidst the rot and ruin. These druids certainly had taste, didn't they? Elthara looks around the hall, taking it all in. "Ever since the negotiations began, I've had to learn much about their beliefs by necessity. According to Hethia, there was nothing in their creed that required asceticism; the Old Wyld and its spirits did not demand that of them. With their knowledge of how to coax bounties from living creatures, they indeed grew very rich." Hm. "They used to be powerful amongst the boer'alvar, and money flows to those with power. I've little doubt that like everyone else, the druids of the Old Wyld were not wholly above temptation or corruption. And even if they were, the tithes and sales of mirrorwine, razorcup and other luxuries they had the time to produce would have brought more than enough money in to justify what this would have been in its time." Perhaps if you strain your hearing enough, you can catch echoes of the conversation and merriment that would have taken place here in centuries past... which, here and now, doesn't seem that far away...
rows.translation: 一踏入寺庙的二楼，人们就会立刻注意到装饰风格的突然变化，就连这个上层平台也是如此。虽然这里并非真正的神圣之地，但仍然给人一种这样的感觉：那些接受过入会仪式的人似乎并不经常来到这里。 [flags.XADARON_R7 | |呼……”小琳靠在埃尔塔拉身上，低声说道，“爬上那些楼梯真的让我精疲力竭。” 楼梯的高度其实并不高，但你能感受到那种疲惫感——如果寺庙的低层充满了孢子和霉味，那么上层更是充满了这种令人窒息的气体。那种剧烈的疲劳感已经渗透到你的骨子里，你甚至有一种不安的预感：如果现在停下来休息，你可能会立刻睡着，而且再也不会醒来。[party.randComp brint brienne arona | 就连布林特也显得疲惫不堪，尽管已经筋疲力尽，却仍在努力控制着自己那根勃起的阴茎。 | 就连布蕾妮也显得疲惫不堪、衣衫褴褛，尽管已经筋疲力尽，却仍在努力抑制自己那些显而易见的欲望。 | 就连阿罗娜也显得疲惫不堪，尽管已经筋疲力尽，却仍在努力控制着自己那根勃起的阴茎。 ]你可能对这种真菌的直接感染具有抵抗力，但这并不意味着它无法找到其他途径来影响你。 你可以强行推进，但这样会处于相当不利的地位。或许，先回到下游地区，想办法减少孢子的数量，然后再去探索上游的神庙会更为明智。 ] 或许是一个接待厅？这就能解释那种突然出现的奢华氛围了——破碎的窗户上装着金属栏杆和环状装置，这说明这些地方原本可能挂着窗帘；而地板上散落的蘑菇和其他真菌中，仍然可以看到一个象征着宏伟树木的图案，这个图案被刻在了大理石瓷砖上。那些金色的碎片依然在那种超凡脱俗的、发光的树液中闪烁着光芒，它们十分诱人，但却埋藏在那些外观极为凶险的真菌丛中；过去辉煌的遗迹依然在腐朽与毁灭之中留存着。 这些德鲁伊确实很有品味，不是吗？ 艾尔萨拉环顾大厅，将这一切尽收眼底。“自从谈判开始以来，我不得不被迫去了解他们的信仰。据赫希娅说，他们的信条中并没有要求他们过苦行僧般的生活；古老的荒野及其精灵们也并没有这样要求他们。由于他们懂得如何从生物身上获取各种资源，因此他们的确变得非常富有。 嗯。 “他们在布尔阿尔瓦人中曾经拥有强大的影响力，而金钱总是流向那些拥有权力的人。我毫不怀疑，就像其他人一样，古老荒野中的德鲁伊们也难以完全抵挡诱惑和腐败。即便他们能够做到，那么他们通过征收什一税以及出售镜酒、剃刀杯等其他奢侈品所获得的收入，也足以让他们的行为在当时的背景下显得合理。 或许，如果你仔细聆听，就能听到几个世纪前在这里发生的对话与欢声笑语的回声……而此刻，这些往事似乎并不那么遥远……
rows.raw: "Setting foot into the temple's second floor, one's struck by the sudden change in decor even at the upper landing — while it isn't an inner sanctum per se, you nevertheless get the impression that the initiates didn't come up here that much. [flags.XADARON_R7 | |"Phew," Ryn mutters, leaning on Elthara for support. "Climbing up those stairs took it out of me." The stairwell wasn't that high, but you're feeling it, too. The exhaustion... if the lower reaches of the temple were filled with spores and musty air, the upper temple is absolutely redolent — no, choking — with the stuff. Aching weariness and exertion are setting into your bones, and you have the dark suspicion that if you stopped to rest, you'd fall asleep and never wake up again.[party.randComp brint brienne arona | Even Brint's starting to look worn and ragged, trying to control the raging erection he's sporting despite being all tuckered out. | Even Brienne's starting to look worn and ragged, trying to control her obvious lusts despite being all tuckered out. | Even Arona's starting to look worn and ragged, trying to control the raging erection she's sporting despite being all tuckered out. ] You might be impervious to direct infection by the fungus, but that doesn't mean it can't find other ways to get to you. You can press on forcibly, but it will be at a considerable disadvantage. Perhaps it would be wiser to return to the lower reaches and find a means of thinning the spores before exploring the upper temple. ] A reception hall, perhaps? It would explain the sudden shift in luxuriousness — metal bars and rings over broken windows imply places where curtains might once have been hung, while a stylized symbol of a grand tree in a circle is still visible through the mushrooms and other fungi that litter the floor, said symbol etched into the marble tiles. Bits of gold still glint in the light of the otherworldly, glowing sap, tempting but embedded in spongy growths of very unfriendly-looking fungus; the remains of past opulence still survive amidst the rot and ruin. These druids certainly had taste, didn't they? Elthara looks around the hall, taking it all in. "Ever since the negotiations began, I've had to learn much about their beliefs by necessity. According to Hethia, there was nothing in their creed that required asceticism; the Old Wyld and its spirits did not demand that of them. With their knowledge of how to coax bounties from living creatures, they indeed grew very rich." Hm. "They used to be powerful amongst the boer'alvar, and money flows to those with power. I've little doubt that like everyone else, the druids of the Old Wyld were not wholly above temptation or corruption. And even if they were, the tithes and sales of mirrorwine, razorcup and other luxuries they had the time to produce would have brought more than enough money in to justify what this would have been in its time." Perhaps if you strain your hearing enough, you can catch echoes of the conversation and merriment that would have taken place here in centuries past... which, here and now, doesn't seem that far away..."

rows.original:
A small room, unadorned save for silver sconces on the walls and patterning in small green, blue and white tiles. A cloister or meditation chamber, perhaps? There's a tall window in the eastern wall, but like all the other windows you've seen on your way through the ruins, it's buried and offers no means of escape. No, wait — scroll casings on the walls and a desk for writing... a scriptorium, then. A small room to leave the world for a moment so one can concentrate on one's writing.

        Musty as the chamber is, there's a sense of sanctuary about it — not surprising since the door held. The air might be foul from being stagnant for so long, but it's still better and easier to breathe than the spore-filled air of the ruins. The reason for the door being locked, too, soon becomes clear as you spy the bony, half-crumbled remains of an elf slumped against the wall, the skeleton too far gone for any kind of meaningful identification. A key much like the one you used to enter the chamber lies amongst its fingerbones; whoever this was must have sealed themselves into this closet and eventually succumbed to thirst or suffocation. Who knows? 
        
        Alas, the lock itself has rotted clean off the door, which is why you had to force your way in to begin with. A decade or two more, perhaps, and it would be unrecognizable from the rest of the ruins, covered from floor to ceiling in fungus and oozing sap.
        
        This place... for the first time since you've entered the ruins, you have a sense of peace and respite, no matter how faint. While there's no true rest to be had here, there's nothing preventing you from savoring it for a moment before moving on.
        
        The only exit from here is the way you came in — east.
rows.translation:
一个简朴的小房间，墙上仅装饰着银色的壁灯，以及那些由绿色、蓝色和白色小瓷砖组成的花纹。这或许是一间修道院或冥想室吧？东墙上有一扇高窗，但和你在废墟中看到的其他窗户一样，这扇窗也被堵住了，根本无法用来逃生。等等——墙上有卷轴架，还有一张用于书写的桌子……原来这是一间书房啊。这样一个安静的小空间，让人能够暂时远离外界的喧嚣，专心致志地进行写作。

        尽管这个房间充满了霉味，但它却给人一种宁静与庇护的感觉——这也并不奇怪，毕竟那扇门将外界隔绝在了外面。空气因为长期不流通而变得浑浊，但比起废墟里充满孢子的空气，这里还是要清新许多，呼吸起来也更加顺畅。门被锁上的原因很快也就明白了——当你看到那具骨头嶙峋、几乎已经腐烂的精灵骨架瘫倒在墙上时，一切就都清楚了。那具骨架已经腐烂到无法辨认身份的程度了。在那具精灵的指骨旁，放着一把与你用来进入那个房间的钥匙一模一样的钥匙；看来，这个人一定是把自己锁在了这个壁橱里，最终因为缺水或窒息而死。谁知道呢？ 
        
        唉，那把锁早就从门上腐烂掉了，所以你们当初才不得不强行闯进去。再过个一二十年，它恐怕就会和其他废墟完全融为一体了——从地面到天花板都会被霉菌覆盖，还会不断渗出树液来。
        
        这个地方……自从你走进这片废墟以来，第一次感受到了片刻的宁静与安宁，尽管这种感觉很微弱。虽然这里并没有真正的休息空间，但也没有什么能阻止你暂时享受这份宁静，然后再继续前进。
        
        从这里出去的唯一途径，就是你进来时走的那条路——向东。

rows.original:
A long corridor, stretching in a single direction as far as the eye can see. Numerous doorways branch off it along its length, but roots, rubble and fungus conspire to block off most of them, and the few rooms you're able to squeeze through to explore are largely empty and devoid of anything but the same horrible mess, a perversion of life and decay all at once. From the few bits of stone furniture that the mold's been unable to devour, you figure that these might've been prayer rooms or the elder druids' personal quarters.

        The sap here doesn't ooze from the walls like a weeping wound, but flows through it in veins; warm amber reminiscent of condensed twilight runs through the stone in a network, glowing in a steady pulsing beat.
        
        One thing that's struck you throughout your journey through the temple is that there's been absolutely no animal life at all. Perhaps not bigger animals, but you'd have expected rats, bugs, worms, and other creatures that would thrive in such conditions; animals that would use the fungi for food and shelter. There's none of those here, and despite the effusive overgrowth of everything about you it only serves to highlight the fact that the entirety of this fungal bloom isn't in the least bit natural. It's a jealous creature, and wants everything for itself.
rows.translation:
一条长长的走廊，笔直延伸，视线所及之处皆是一片无边无际。沿着走廊，有许多门道分支出来，但树根、碎石和霉菌共同将这些门道大多堵塞住了。而那些你勉强能够挤进去探索的房间，大多空无一物，里面只有同样令人作呕的混乱景象——那是生命与腐朽的扭曲结合。从那些被霉菌侵蚀却未能完全破坏的石制家具来看，这些地方很可能曾经是祈祷室，或者是年长德鲁伊们的私人居所。

        这里的汁液并不是像伤口渗出的液体那样从墙壁上流淌出来，而是像血管中的血液一样在岩石内部流动；那些温暖而呈琥珀色的汁液在岩石中形成了复杂的脉络，以稳定的节奏闪烁着微光。
        
        在你穿越这座寺庙的过程中，有一件事让你印象深刻：那里竟然完全没有动物踪迹。也许没有体型较大的动物，但你本应该期待看到老鼠、昆虫、蠕虫之类的生物——那些在这种环境中能够生存下来的生物；那些会以这些真菌为食、以此作为栖息地的动物。这里根本没有这些东西，而你身上那些过度生长的东西，反而更加凸显出一个事实：这种真菌的生长完全不是自然现象。它是一种贪婪的生物，想要把一切都据为己有。

rows.original:
A length of western hallway — more ruin, this time caused by branches breaking through the high end of the wall and ramming straight through the other side. There's absolutely no reason for leaves to sprout this far from any sunlight, but that's what's happening: the fallen leaves create a nice rotting carpet of mulch for the fungi to take advantage of. The growth on display here is much like that in the rest of the temple: growth for its own sake, rather than being directed to a purpose, running rampant and quickly falling into senescence.

        Admittedly, something primal in the subconscious back of your mind finds it very beautiful, if only in a sick, twisted fashion.
        
        If there was any special purpose to this section of hallway, it's been long since buried...
rows.translation:
一段西侧的走廊——这里同样是一片废墟，而造成这种破坏的原因，是树枝穿透了墙壁的上部，然后直接穿到了另一侧。树叶根本没有任何理由在远离阳光的地方生长，但事实就是如此：那些掉落的树叶形成了一层腐烂的覆盖物，为真菌提供了理想的生长环境。这里所展现出的这种生长现象，与寺庙其他地方的情况如出一辙：这种生长纯粹是为了自身而存在，并没有特定的目的，因此它肆意蔓延，很快就会进入衰老阶段。

        诚然，你潜意识中的某种原始本能会认为这种景象非常美丽——尽管这种美是一种病态而扭曲的美。
        
        如果这段走廊有什么特殊的用途的话，那早就被遗忘了……

rows.original: Away from the landing, this looks like the commons that the senior druids shared — a grand atrium with a bathing pool and fountain built into its middle. Although both have long since dried up and filled with a mixture of amber sap, leaf litter and fungus, it's not hard to infer that water would've flowed right from the fountain and into the bathing pool for the enjoyment of all. There're several copper frames strewn about which once might have held drapes, but they seem to be more for decoration than any kind of modesty. The glass-panelled ceiling is shattered, branches protruding from the walls and thrusting themselves back upwards into the dirt; leaves sprout from rough-hewn bark, yet they will never see sunlight. Empty spots amongst the benches where tapestries would have hung are now overrun with creeping mold, while the remnants of low tables and empty plant pots lie strewn about, barely recognizable for what they are now. A picture of ruined opulence, yet with a sense of exotic mysticism and mystery to it that persists through the ravages of time and rot alike. [party.has cait |"Marble, gold, furniture, drapes — doesn't really fit into the whole idea of druids living amongst the trees and being all nature-y. If anything, it kind of reminds me of the luxury suites back at the temple..." Cait sighs. "A piece of history: I didn't know the pale elves accumulated Belharan coinage before the Godswar, but it makes sense when you think about how relations on both sides of the River Ridell went." There is nothing that requires druids to eschew material wealth. "I don't know, the image I always had when Dad spoke of the culture in these parts of the world was of... well, people who wouldn't have electrum coins stacked up in silver-bound boxes in their temple. More ascetic, perhaps? Well, I guess that's all on me." And many people have images in their heads of how Mallachite temples run, so that's a parallel that she ought to be familiar with. Imagine the dismay when the moonlight orgies are only once a month and not every day. On a more serious note, though: it really does seem like no matter where you go or what people you're amongst, some things hold true. The druids of the Old Wyld had power within boer'alvar society at one point, and where power lies, wealth flows towards it one way or the other. ]
rows.translation: 在降落点之外，这里看起来就像是那些资深德鲁伊们共同使用的公共区域——一个宏伟的中庭，中间建有游泳池和喷泉。虽然如今那里的水早已干涸，只剩下琥珀色的树液、落叶和真菌，但仍然可以想象，水原本应该是从喷泉中流出，流入游泳池，供所有人使用的。地上散落着几副铜框，这些框架原本可能是用来悬挂窗帘的，但如今看来，它们更多是用于装饰，而非为了营造某种私密氛围。 玻璃制成的天花板已经破碎，树枝从墙壁中伸出，重新插入泥土之中；粗糙的树皮上长出了叶子，但这些叶子永远也见不到阳光。那些原本应该挂有挂毯的长椅上，如今空出的位置上长满了霉菌，而那些低矮的桌子和空花盆的残骸则散落在各处，几乎已经无法辨认出它们原本的用途了。 一幅展现奢华尽毁的景象，然而其中却蕴含着一种异国情调的神秘感与诡秘氛围，这种感觉历经时间的侵蚀与腐朽依然得以保留。 [party.has cait |大理石、黄金、家具、窗帘——这些元素其实并不符合德鲁伊隐居在森林中、与大自然融为一家的观念。相反，这些反而让我想起了神庙里的豪华套房……”凯特叹了口气，“这是一段历史：我之前并不知道苍白精灵在神战之前就已经积累了贝拉兰硬币，但仔细想想里德尔河两岸之间的关系，这也说得通。 确实没有什么规定要求德鲁伊们放弃物质财富。 “我不知道，每当父亲谈到这个世界这些地区的文化时，我脑海中浮现出的画面总是……嗯，那些在寺庙里并没有把琥珀金币堆放在银制箱子里的人。或许应该更加苦行一些吧？嗯，我想这都得靠我自己来决定了。 很多人心中都应该对马拉克信徒神庙的运作方式有所想象，所以这个比喻她应该能够理解。想象一下，当那些月光下的狂欢活动仅仅每月举行一次，而不是每天都有时，人们该会感到多么失望吧。不过，说正经的：似乎无论你走到哪里，无论与什么样的人为伍，有些道理都是成立的。在过去的岁月里，古老荒野中的德鲁伊们在布尔阿尔瓦社会中拥有着强大的影响力，而凡是拥有权力的人，财富总会自然而然地流向他们手中。 ]

A hospital, by the looks of it — there are plenty of beds all arrayed in rows, perhaps two dozen of them judging by the stone frames, but you doubt that the elder druids would've lived in such a cramped barracks. There's an empty basin by the door, filled with nothing but reeking muck, and the decaying remnants of a desk and several shelves in a corner. Examining the latter reveals several shattered clay jars amidst the remains, and a box with several scattered coins glinting dully amidst the dross.

        And of course, overgrown skeletons in the beds, some of them with fine chains about their wrists and ankles; the links are thin enough to at least not strip their bearers of all dignity, yet heavy enough to restrain a patient... in the end, the healers who attended to the ills of the boer'alvar could not work their arts on themselves, not that they were to blame for it.
rows.translation:
这显然是一家医院——那里排列着许多床铺，根据那些石制床架来看，大概有二十多张。不过，你很难相信那些年长的德鲁伊会住在如此狭小的环境中。门口有一个空盆，里面只装满了恶臭的污物；在角落里，还有一张腐烂的桌子和几排破损的架子。在残骸中，人们发现了几个破碎的陶罐，还有一个盒子里散落着一些硬币，它们在杂物中黯淡地闪烁着光芒。

        当然，还有那些在床铺中发现的骷髅——其中一些人的手腕和脚踝上戴着细链；这些链条虽然足够细，不会让佩戴者失去尊严，但力度也足以束缚住一个人。最终，那些致力于治疗“布尔阿尔瓦”所带来种种问题的治疗者们，却无法将自己从这些疾病中拯救出来——当然，这并不是他们的过错。

rows.original:
An apothecary's workshop — laboratory doesn't feel like the appropriate word, given the scene that lies before you. The wooden racks lining the walls have long since rotted away, leaving the porcelain jars they were holding up to smash on the floor; fuzzy mold has overrun several sets of mortars and pestles in differing sizes and weights. Anything useful the room in general might've held has long rotted away; you scan the remains, but there don't seem to be any jars that might've survived the fall.

        What dominates the chamber, though, is a giant alchemy furnace large enough to hold perhaps three or even four people at once — massive iron chains suspend it over a firepit dug into the floor. Was this for decoration? No, judging by the blackened stains on the furnace's underside, it wasn't just for decoration and impressing visitors. Tarnish may have crept upon its surface, but the furnace remains clear of mold; sure, there's nothing there for fungus to feed upon, but does it have any innate antiseptic properties?
        
        Well, it's not like you're going to be cutting it down and carrying it out of here — weight aside, the furnace is far too large to fit through the door. It must've been carried here in pieces and assembled on the spot, like a ship in a bottle.
rows.translation:
在这个场景面前，用“药剂师的工作室”或“实验室”来形容这个地方似乎并不恰当。墙边那些木架早已腐烂殆尽，原本用来支撑的瓷罐也摔得粉碎，散落在地上；几套大小不一、重量不同的研钵和杵上也长满了绒毛状的霉菌。房间里原本可能存在的任何有用的物品早就腐烂变质了；你仔细检查了残余物，但似乎没有任何罐子能够在那次坠落中幸存下来。

        然而，这个房间里最显眼的是一台巨大的炼金炉，它的体积足以同时容纳三到四个人——沉重的铁链将这座炼金炉悬挂在地面挖出的火坑上方。这是用来装饰的吗？不，从炉子底部那些变黑的痕迹来看，它显然不仅仅是为了装饰或给来访者留下深刻印象。虽然它的表面可能已经出现了锈迹，但并没有长霉；当然，这里也没有什么东西可以让霉菌生长，但这种炉子是否本身就具有某种抗菌特性呢？
        
        嗯，你总不可能把它砍掉然后搬出去吧——先不说重量的问题，这个炉子实在太大了，根本无法通过门搬出去。它肯定是被分成了几部分运到这里，然后再在现场组装起来的，就像“瓶中船”一样。

rows.original:
Yet another staircase landing — was the original temple built on a hill before being buried? Several chunks of debris lie strewn on the marble tiles, resting where they were knocked out of the ceiling by gnarled, pointed roots; clumps of small mushrooms spread across their surfaces and grow in between them.

        "The sap of the wyld trees was well-known for being a legendary panacea, a cure-all for everything that could ail the body and sometimes even the mind," Ryn says, more to herself than to you. "Still is to this day. Rare and treasured, only given in small measures... not bursting from the walls and welling up from the floor."
        
        You were only told of the effects of the fungal infection upon the elven druids, but what about the trees that they worshipped?
        
        Ryn just shakes her head slowly.
        
        A long staircase rises to the east — perhaps it was once whole, but entire sections of steps have broken off, pushed outwards by the same pulsating, amber matter that lies in the walls as growth continues to run rampant. What hasn't outright crumbled away has buckled outwards, jagged marble edges and spiked roots that stick out from the stone making for a perilous ascension despite their stairs still being, well, stairs if the term were to be applied generously.
rows.translation:
又一处楼梯平台——这座古老的寺庙最初是不是建在山丘上，后来才被掩埋的呢？几块碎石散落在大理石地面上，它们正是被那些扭曲、尖锐的树根从天花板上撞落下来的；一些小蘑菇在碎石的缝隙中生长，它们的菌丛遍布在这些碎石的表面。

        那些野生树木的树液被誉为传说中的万能药，能够治愈身体上的一切疾病，有时甚至还能缓解精神上的困扰，”小琳自言自语道，仿佛是在对别人说，又仿佛只是在思考这些。“直到今天，这种树液依然备受珍视。它非常稀有，因此只会少量提供。……并没有从墙里冲出来，也没有从地面里冒出来。”
        
        你们只被告知了这种真菌感染对精灵德鲁伊们的影响，但他们所崇拜的那些树木又该如何呢？
        
        小琳只是缓缓地摇了摇头。
        
        一条长长的楼梯向东延伸——或许它曾经是完整的，但如今有许多台阶已经断裂，被那种充满活力的琥珀色物质向外挤压，而这些物质也正在墙壁中不断蔓延，导致结构进一步损坏。那些没有完全崩塌的台阶也发生了变形，大理石边缘变得参差不齐，还有那些从石头中伸出来的尖锐“根状物”，使得攀登这条楼梯变得极其危险。不过，如果非要称它为楼梯的话……的话，它确实还是楼梯吧。

rows.original:
A grand chamber of worship, complete with stage, lectern and altar all on the north side, looking down upon what would be the faithful masses on the floor below. The silver symbol of the wyld tree still shines through the mulch in places — you guess that this might've been able to hold perhaps five hundred pale elves in the congregation, perhaps a hundred more if they squeezed. High, arched windows in the south side would've let in a lot of light were the temple not buried, and give you a lovely view of the arboretum to the south.

        That's it! That's what you saw on your way in — you've got to be close to the surface now!
        
        That being said, it's not going to be easy, is it? All of your journey through Xadaron Temple has been dogged by a sense that the sanctity of the place has been fouled... and it's particularly strong in this chamber. A restless, sticky sensation that lingers in the air and clings to your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]... lust and hatred rolled up into a tight, virulent bundle, hateful gazes boring into the back of your neck. You're so close now, but surely the greatest danger is at hand.
rows.translation:
这是一座宏伟的礼拜堂，北侧设有舞台、讲坛和祭坛，从高处俯瞰，下方便是那些虔诚的信徒们。那些象征着荒野之树的银色符号仍零星地显露在覆盖物之下——想必这座礼拜堂能够容纳大约五百名苍白精灵，如果人们挤得再紧一些，或许还能再多容纳一百人。如果这座寺庙没有埋在地下，南侧那些高高的拱形窗户一定会让大量的光线照进来，同时还能让你欣赏到南边植物园的美景。

        就是这个！你进来时看到的就是这个景象——现在你肯定已经接近地表了！
        
        话虽如此，但这肯定不会是一件容易的事，对吧？在你们穿越夏达隆神庙的整个过程中，一直有一种感觉萦绕在心头——那就是这个地方的神圣性已经被亵渎了……而这种感觉在这个密室里尤为强烈。一种令人不安、黏腻的感觉，弥漫在空气中，紧紧附着在你的[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]上……欲望与仇恨交织成一股强烈而致命的力量，那些充满憎恨的目光紧紧地盯着你的后颈。你现在已经离目标如此之近了，但毫无疑问，最危险的时刻才刚刚开始。

rows.original:
A staircase landing that slopes up steeply — with its structure, the temple would've had to be built on a hill to avoid its third storey from jutting sharply out over open air. Yes, that makes the most sense — a temple on a defensible hill, with the supporting elven village ringed about it. That makes its burial under the surface all the more startling, and explains why there were so little of the ruins at a first glance when Hethia made it out to be some great bastion of the old druidic faith.

        The south wall of this chamber is conspicuously blank save for several nodules of spongy fungus clinging to it; large corroded hooks on the walls suggest that decorations may once have been hung there, but anything that might have been displayed has long since rotten away. Planters line the foot of the wall, perhaps for the display of flowers and the like; of course, long strands of yellow pinhead fungi have overrun them long since, thriving on the sap and other gunk that's collected in them.
        
        Here and there, you can see the glint of gold from amidst the rubble — something the rot was unable to digest — but the particular fungal growths that sprout from those particular piles of debris look particularly vicious. Probably not worth it.
        
        [party.has arona
        |"Shit," Arona growls, eyeing the heaving, pulsating, slithering fungus and the glint of gold in them. "I'm not going to say I'm afraid of mushrooms, but a smart chieftain knows a trap when she sees one. It's tempting, sure... but those things are going to grab me and turn me into some kind of horrible mushroom monster or something if I so much as try, aren't they? Gold is nice, but a good chieftain knows when a fort's too well-defended to be worth the cost in lives."
        
        That's actually... pretty smart and probably not something the Arona you first met would've said. Hretha's made the right choice by sending her out adventuring with you, and not just to keep Arona out of her hair while she runs the tribe.
        
        "Yeah, well, with all the ghosts we've met so far, I think I'm feeling a little better about them these days. That feeling when you realize you're not as afraid of them as you used to be... it's pretty great."
        ]
rows.translation:
一处坡度陡峭的楼梯平台——从结构来看，这座神殿必定建在山丘上，否则三楼就会突兀地悬在半空。没错，这最说得通：一座建在易守山丘上的神殿，周围环绕着为其提供支持的精灵村落。这样一来，它竟会被埋到地表之下就更令人震惊了，也解释了为何赫希娅把这里说成古老德鲁伊信仰的宏伟堡垒时，你第一眼却几乎看不到多少遗迹。

        房间南墙显得格外空白，只有几团海绵般的真菌附着其上。墙上那些严重锈蚀的大挂钩说明这里或许曾悬挂着装饰品，可所有展品都早已腐烂殆尽。墙脚排列着一排花盆，或许过去用于陈列花卉之类的植物；当然，一簇簇细长的黄色针头菌早已侵占花盆，靠其中积聚的树液和其他污物茁壮生长。
        
        瓦砾间偶尔闪烁着金光——那是腐菌无法消化的东西——可那些特定废墟堆上长出的真菌看起来格外凶恶。大概不值得冒险。
        
        [party.has arona
        |“操，”阿罗娜低吼着，盯着那些起伏、搏动、扭动的真菌，以及藏在其中的金光。“我倒不会说自己害怕蘑菇，但聪明的酋长看得出陷阱。确实很诱人……可我只要敢去碰，那些东西就会抓住我，把我变成某种可怕的蘑菇怪物，对吧？黄金是好东西，但好酋长也知道，什么时候一座堡垒守得太严，不值得拿人命去换。”
        
        这话其实……相当聪明，大概也不是你初遇时的阿罗娜说得出口的。赫蕾莎让她跟你出来冒险，显然作出了正确选择；不只是为了自己管理部落时能少受阿罗娜烦扰。
        
        “是啊，不过我们一路碰到这么多鬼魂，我觉得最近已经没那么怕它们了。发现自己不再像从前那样害怕……那感觉真的很棒。”
        ]

rows.original:
Marble tiles give way to soft, moist dirt as you step into the arboretum's entrance. Light filters in from above — not the pustulent orange-brown glow that's dominated the ruins since they awoke and sent you tumbling deep into the earth, but gods-to-honest [dayNight|sun|moon]light that cuts through the shattered glass dome above in beams, illuminating the scene before you. The remains of once-mighty trees lie fallen all over the earth, fungus feasting on their remains and yet still not managing to consume them after two centuries' worth of rot; the soil might have once been adorned with grass and flowers, but all you have now is coral fungus and enormous puffballs.
        
        Ahead, the twisted shape of the largest tree you may have ever seen in all your adventures looms, gnarled and corrupted to extreme lengths; even at this distance, you can see the enormous gashes in its trunk, pulsing orange light emanating from its wounds and weeping pus-like sap much in the same way as the walls of the ruins do. Its massive roots sink deep into the earth, overgrown with fungus of every shape and kind, each and every one colored that same sickly shade of orange-brown.
        
        This must be it.
        
        "Are you ready?" Ryn says, gripping her [etheryn.weapon] with whitened knuckles as she half-turns to give you a [etheryn.highConfidence|steely|worried] glance. "Once we make ourselves known, there'll be no retreat."
rows.translation:
当你走进这座植物园的入口时，大理石地面立刻被柔软湿润的泥土所取代。光线从上方照射进来——那并不是自那些废墟苏醒以来一直笼罩着它们的、那种脓黄色的光芒，而是真正明亮的光线。说真的[dayNight|太阳|月亮]光芒从上方破碎的玻璃穹顶中穿透下来，照亮了你眼前的景象。那些曾经巍峨参天的树木如今都已倒在地上，真菌在它们的残骸上滋生，但即便经过了两个世纪的腐烂，这些真菌仍然无法完全分解这些树木；这片土地或许曾经长满青草和鲜花，但现在这里只有珊瑚菌和巨大的马勃菌。
        
        前方，那棵你在这次冒险中见过的最大的树木，以其扭曲的形态矗立在那里——它的树干早已变得扭曲变形，甚至在这种距离上，你也能看到树干上那些巨大的裂口，从那些伤口中渗出的橙色光芒正在闪烁，而那些像脓液一样的汁液正不断地流淌出来，这一切都与那些废墟的墙壁上的景象如出一辙。它的巨大根系深深扎入地下，上面长满了各种各样形状的真菌，每一株都呈现出那种病态的橙棕色。
        
        这里肯定就是了。
        
        “你准备好了吗？小琳紧握着她的手说道[etheryn.weapon]她手指因紧张而变得发白，半转身朝你说道[etheryn.highConfidence|钢铁般的|担心]一旦我们暴露了自己的存在，就再也没有退路了。

rows.original:
A wind-worn Sorran shrine, ancient enough to predate even Imperial influence in the Marches. Despite the tempestuous weather of the peaks battering it for dozens of decades, the minotaur make of the shrine has stood the test of time, partially built into the mountain as it is. The exterior is largely plain save for a statue of the winged goddess herself — a more top-heavy minoan interpretation of Sorra's appearance than the other depictions you've come across so far, you notice. Curiously raised bumps on the stonework imply there might once have been runes and reliefs carved into the shrine's exterior, but snow and wind have ground them into illegibility if they ever existed.
        
        Despite the minoan make of the shrine, the only worshippers who come here these days are harpies. Their offerings have piled up upon an altar within, spilling over and gathering at its base; the way the bird-brains take worship of their patron goddess is fittingly lackadaisical. The offerings themselves appear to be whatever the harpies find to have personal value — shiny trinkets, empty bottles, dented legionnaire helmets and the like make up the pile, strangely reverent in their disorder. No doubt the goddess of freedom finds such creative interpretation pleasing...
rows.translation:
这是一座历经风霜的索拉神殿，其历史之久远，甚至可以追溯到帝国势力尚未影响这些边境地区的时候。尽管数十年来，山峰上的恶劣天气不断冲击着它，但这座由弥诺陶洛斯建造的神殿依然经受住了时间的考验，甚至有一部分已经与山体融为了一体。外观上，除了那座象征着有翼女神的雕像外，几乎没有什么装饰。你会发现，这种对索拉外貌的米诺斯式诠释，与其他你见过的描绘方式相比，更加侧重于突出她的翅膀特征。石雕上那些奇怪的凸起部分暗示，这座神龛的外壁上可能曾经刻有符文和浮雕，但经过长时间的风吹雪打，这些图案早已变得无法辨认了。
        
        尽管这座神殿具有米诺斯风格，但如今前来朝拜的只有哈比人。他们的祭品堆积在神殿内的祭坛上，甚至溢出了祭坛，散落在其周围；这些头脑简单的人类以如此敷衍的方式来崇拜他们守护的女神，实在再合适不过了。这些祭品似乎都是那些女妖们认为具有个人价值的东西——闪亮的小饰品、空瓶子、有凹痕的军团士兵头盔等等，这些杂乱无章的物品被摆放在一起，却显得格外庄严。毫无疑问，自由女神一定会觉得这种富有创意的诠释令她感到满意……

rows.original:
As one leaves the warmth and shelter of the mountain's interior, the miserable weather that comes with the altitude makes itself known. You aren't facing outright gales and howling blizzards as of yet, but the wind is strong enough to send any of your loose clothing aflutter and nip at your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. There's a cool, crisp taste to the air that wicks the moisture from your lips; as air's forced to rise higher and higher by the mountain slope, the water it bears is forced out as snow and frost.

        Nevertheless, several scraggly shrubs cling to existence by the wayside, eking out some kind of existence in the cracks between the stones. You aren't quite high up enough for the mountain to be barren... yet.
rows.translation:
当人们离开山脉内部的温暖与庇护时，高海拔带来的恶劣天气便立刻显现出来。虽然目前还没有遭遇猛烈的暴风或呼啸的暴风雪，但风已经大到足以让任何松散的衣服飘动起来，还会让人感到阵阵刺骨的寒意。 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]空气中弥漫着一种清凉、干燥的气息，这种气息会吸走你嘴唇上的水分；当空气被山坡逼迫着不断上升时，其中所含的水分就会以雪或霜的形式析出。

        然而，在路旁还是有一些稀疏的灌木顽强地存活着，它们在岩石的缝隙中艰难地维持着自己的生命。你目前所处的位置还不算太高，因此这座山还没有变得完全荒芜……至少现在还没有。

rows.original:
This mountain path continues spiraling its way up towards the peak — what would have been a steep, perilous climb directly up the slope has been made marginally more manageable by turning it into a long, winding trek about its circumference. Not that it's any less draining — the price one pays for an easier road is that there's much, much more of it. On one side, a sheer cliff with multiple overhangs, on the other, a perilous drop down into the foothills far below. It's enough to constantly remind one of the importance of keeping on the straight and narrow.

        As a small mercy, multiple tunnels are set into the cliffside, conveniently placed level with the path; it's possible to duck into one of them for a rest if one needs respite from the climb. Given how some of them draw in air and others expel it, they must be interconnected. The end result, though, is an ungodly cacophony of noise from the constant rushing of air through said tunnels, less eerie like the mountain wind is and more a constant grating on one's sanity. What kind of creature bores through the mountainside like this, to riddle it with holes like a worm pushing through dirt?
rows.translation:
这条山路继续蜿蜒向上，最终通向山顶——如果直接沿着山坡攀登，那将会是一条陡峭而危险的路线，但通过将其改成一条环绕山体周长的漫长而曲折的小径，这条路就变得容易攀登多了。这并不意味着这样的路线会少些艰辛——为了获得一条更为平坦的道路，人们必须付出的是：这条路会长得长得多。一边是布满悬岩的陡峭悬崖，另一边则是通往下方山脚的险峻下坡路。不断提醒人们坚持走正道的重要性，就已经足够了。

        作为一种小小的便利，人们在悬崖峭壁上开凿了许多隧道，这些隧道的位置恰好与小路处于同一水平面上；如果有人在攀爬过程中需要休息，就可以躲进其中一条隧道里稍作休憩。鉴于其中一些结构会吸入空气，而另一些则会排出空气，这些结构之间必定存在着某种联系。然而，最终结果就是：空气在这些通道中不断流动，从而产生了一种极其刺耳的噪音。这种噪音并不像山风那样带有某种神秘气息，而更像是一种持续不断地折磨人神经的声音。究竟是什么生物会以这样的方式钻穿山体，让山体上布满洞孔，就像虫子在泥土中挖洞一样？

rows.original:
The remains of an elevator landing by the side of the trail — the pulleys are still intact, but whatever ropes that held the cars are long gone at this point, rendering it inoperable. This looks to be of imperial Belharan make, timber bound with metal to create a sturdy and relatively inexpensive frame — given the size of the landing and turnstiles complete with spots to hitch animals to, this must have been a mechanism of some import for shifting loads of considerable weight up and down the mountain. You note the imperial engineering design which the minotaurs in the mountain beneath have copied — the two cars are joined together by their pulley systems, with several ratchets to control their movement. The weight of things going down the mountain helped provide lifting power for things coming up, making the lift's job easier.

        The Belharans clearly put a lot of effort into this miserable mountainside, given there's an adjoining warehouse and guard post built into the nearby cliffs. Not that they're anything more than empty shells at this point, picked clean by harpies decades ago, but still. Leading directly north from the elevator landing is a much broader and well-built road leading up the mountain, leading directly to whatever the Ancient Belharans thought was worthwhile on this peak. Unfortunately for you, the road's made impassable by several heavy rockfalls along its breadth, which means it's the winding mountain path for you.
rows.translation:
小路旁有一部电梯的残骸——滑轮依然完好无损，但用来固定电梯厢的绳索早已消失不见，因此这部电梯已经无法使用了。从外观来看，这部电梯应该是贝尔哈兰帝国制造的，其框架采用木材与金属结合的方式制成，既坚固又相对便宜。考虑到电梯的规模以及那些用于拴住动物的装置，可以推测，这部电梯肯定是用来在山上运送重物的重要设施。你可以看到那些居住在山下的弥诺陶洛斯们模仿了这种帝国工程设计——那两辆车辆通过滑轮系统连接在一起，同时还配备了几个棘轮装置来控制它们的运动。那些向下运送物品的重量，实际上也为向上运输的物品提供了所需的动力，从而使这种升降装置的工作变得更加高效。

        贝拉人显然在这片荒凉的山坡上投入了大量精力，因为附近悬崖上还建有仓库和哨所。不过现在这些地方早已空无一物，几十年前就被女妖们洗劫一空了，但还是可以看出他们当初的努力。从电梯厅直接向北延伸，有一条宽阔而修建精良的道路，这条道路通向山顶，直通古贝尔哈兰人认为这座山峰上值得探索的任何地方。不幸的是，由于沿途发生了多次严重的山体滑坡，这条道路已经无法通行了，因此你们只能走那条蜿蜒曲折的山路了。

"
        You're standing in the remains of a small encampment, no doubt set up by the remnants of the prospecting crew. Shredded tents and broken tools lay strewn about, and a small pile of jagged stone appears blasted and scorched nearby– doubtless the aftermath of some desperate battle. [pc.isMage
            |The lingering energy of dark magic still stains the area
            |An unpleasant sensation seems to permeate the whole area
        ] as you look around, but you're certain the destroyed camp is abandoned. [party.solo
            |You are left deeply uneasy all the same, and being alone does not allay this
            |Despite having company, you feel deeply unsettled by the devastation of the area, a sentiment which [party.compNames] [party.oneCompanion
                |shares
                |both share
            ].
        ]"

rows.original: The trail widens here, broad enough for five minotaurs to walk abreast and a relief after being sandwiches between a steep cliff and sheer drop for so long. The air here is warmer, too, and with a faint sulfurous stench to it; several vents in the cliff's eastern wall periodically billow out gases from the mountain's insides, keeping this portion of the path relatively ice-free. Tales of noxious volcanic gases come to mind, but you're probably far enough away from the source that it shouldn't be a problem... nevertheless, not lingering overlong is probably a good idea.
rows.translation: 小路在这里变宽了，宽度足以让五头弥诺陶洛并排行走。在长时间被陡峭的悬崖和绝壁夹在中间之后，这种开阔感实在让人感到舒畅。这里的空气也更加温暖，还带着一丝淡淡的硫磺味——悬崖东侧有几处裂缝，不时会有山体内部释放出的气体从中喷出，因此这条路路的这一段相对而言没有积冰。虽然会让人联想到那些有害的火山气体的故事，但你应该已经距离源头足够远了，所以应该不会有什么问题……不过，最好还是尽快离开那里为妙。

rows.original:
At last, the trail pulls away from the cliff edge and into the peaks proper, rising sharply as one continues the ascent. The air's starting to get thinner in addition to the chill — you find yourself breathing harder despite the dryness in the air, the strain of exertion starting to set in [pc.toughnessRange 70|despite your tough nature|from the climb]. Even the last of the scrubby vegetation has petered away at this point, leaving mostly bare rock and gravel with a thin sheen of snow and ice.

        The peaks' natural inhospitality, though, provides protection for those adapted to its environs — every two dozen steps you sight yet another harpy nest amongst the peaks. They're thicker here in their home than even in the foothills and stronger too, no doubt having pushed their weaker sisters away from prime nesting spots. Every now and then, you catch a flicker of movement in the eaves of the cliffs and overhangs that might just have been the shadows... or maybe not.
rows.translation:
终于，小径离开了悬崖边缘，进入了真正的山峰地带。继续向上攀登，道路会变得越来越陡峭。空气变得稀薄起来，寒冷也随之加剧——尽管空气很干燥，你还是发现自己呼吸变得越发困难，体力消耗也在逐渐增加。 [pc.toughnessRange 70|尽管你性格强硬|在攀登过程中]此时，就连那些稀疏的植被也早已消失殆尽，留下的主要是光秃秃的岩石和碎石，表面覆盖着一层薄薄的雪和冰。

        然而，这些山峰天然的恶劣环境反而为那些能够适应这里的环境的生物提供了保护——每隔二十步，你就能在山峰间看到另一个女妖的巢穴。在它们的栖息地，这些昆虫的体毛甚至比在山脚地带还要浓密，也更加结实有力——毫无疑问，正是这种优势使它们将那些较弱的同类赶出了最佳的筑巢地点。偶尔，你会在悬崖的屋檐下或悬垂的岩石上看到一些微弱的动静，但那些很可能只是阴影罢了…… 或者也可能不是这样。

rows.original:
The path turns around an old minotaur quarry dug into the ground and cliff alike. Starting from the top, the minotaurs supported the cliff face with scaffolding and cut away the stone they needed; that scaffolding has been preserved by the dry cold, and how the quarry is home to dozens upon dozens of harpies, their screams and calls filling the air. Nests gather in groups upon choice perches, while those bullied by their stronger sisters into submission have to settle for nesting on the edges of the pit. With plenty of space and defensible terrain from the perspective of an aerial people, the quarry is quite a stronghold of harpies.

        That being said, one doesn't need to bother with them at all. The road the minotaurs used to transport the quarry's produce circles around its edges and disappears out of sight from around several rock outcroppings too sharp for the harpies to nest on. Sure, you wouldn't be able to get close to the harpies without being immediately spotted when trying to cross the pit, but you can just pass by unnoticed so long as you don't bother them. Which is a good thing, one supposes...
rows.translation:
这条小路绕过了一处古老的米诺陶尔采石场，该采石场既开凿在地面之上，也延伸到悬崖之中。从顶部开始，米诺陶尔们用脚手架支撑着悬崖壁，然后开采出他们所需的石头；那些脚手架在干燥寒冷的环境中得以保存下来，而这个采石场里还栖息着成群的鹰身女妖，她们的尖叫声充斥着整个空气。那些地位较高的雌性会成群结队地选择合适的栖息地筑巢，而那些被更强壮的姐妹欺负、被迫屈服的雌性，则只能将巢穴建在巢穴群的边缘。对于这种以飞行为主的生活方式来说，这里有着充足的空间以及易于防御的地形，因此这个地区成为了鹰头狮身女妖们的理想据点。

        话虽如此，其实根本没必要去理会它们。那些弥诺陶洛斯用来运输采石场产物的道路环绕着矿场的边缘延伸，而在几处岩石突兀的地方，道路会消失在视线之外——那些岩石太过陡峭，连鹰身女妖也无法在上面筑巢。当然，如果你试图穿过那个坑洼地带，肯定会被那些女妖立刻发现，从而无法靠近它们。不过，只要你不去打扰它们，就可以悄悄地从旁边经过，而不会引起它们的注意。我想，这倒也是件好事……
