Mold and rot has consumed much of the wood, but you can still identify that this was a statue to Velun. The worst act of vandalization, however, is the fact that — in place of where his penis should be — there's nothing but air and hewn splinters. It's as if someone grabbed onto his dick and then snapped it off without mercy.
        
        Exploring the true depths of these tunnels would mean you'd be leaving the [silly
            |knot cave
            |lupine mine
        ]. There's no telling where they lead to. Without a map, and no desire to get lost in the uncomfortably cramped network of labyrinthine corridors, you listen to your better judgment and turn around. Besides, there's still a job to be done."

rows.original:
Embedded in the ceiling are glittering crystals which catch light, reflecting it back to create the impression of a starry night sky. Stalactites and stalagmites crowd this twenty-foot-high chamber, and there's a particularly large one rising from the middle of the room.
        
        Passages lead out of this area to the north and south-west.
rows.translation:
天花板中镶嵌着闪闪发光的水晶，它们能够捕捉光线并将其反射出来，从而营造出宛如繁星点点的夜空般的景象。这个高达二十英尺的洞室里，钟乳石和石笋密布，其中有一根特别大的钟乳石从房间中央竖立着。
        
        从这个区域，有通道向北和西南方向延伸出去。
rows.raw:
"
        Embedded in the ceiling are glittering crystals which catch light, reflecting it back to create the impression of a starry night sky. Stalactites and stalagmites crowd this twenty-foot-high chamber, and there's a particularly large one rising from the middle of the room.
        
        Passages lead out of this area to the north and south-west."

rows.original: Red satin curtains hang over rough-hewn archways at both tunnels, permitting access to and from this generously lit chamber. Sweet smells waft from this room, masking the overt musk which pollutes this entire cave. A gash in the rocky ceiling allows a curtain of rainwater from outside to pour in to where a spring forms a large pool of water. Opened crates of clothes, trinkets, and baubles line the eastern wall. You see the head of a wooden horse penis sticking out from underneath a pile of shredded cloth — a toy... or a trophy.
rows.translation: 两条隧道处的粗糙拱门上悬挂着红色缎面帷幕，这些帷幕为人们提供了进入这个光线充足的房间的通道。从房间里飘散出来的芬芳气息掩盖了弥漫在整个洞穴中的浓烈麝香味。岩石天花板上的一个裂隙让外界的雨水倾泻而入，在那里形成了一处巨大的水潭。打开的箱子里装满了衣物、小饰品和各种小玩意儿，这些物品排列在东侧的墙上。你看到一匹木制马的阴茎模型从一堆碎布下面露了出来——这是个玩具……还是个战利品呢？
rows.raw: "\n        Red satin curtains hang over rough-hewn archways at both tunnels, permitting access to and from this generously lit chamber. Sweet smells waft from this room, masking the overt musk which pollutes this entire cave. A gash in the rocky ceiling allows a curtain of rainwater from outside to pour in to where a spring forms a large pool of water. Opened crates of clothes, trinkets, and baubles line the eastern wall. You see the head of a wooden horse penis sticking out from underneath a pile of shredded cloth — a toy... or a trophy."

rows.original: Ten-foot ledges with rough-hewn stairs leading up to them divide this chamber into three sections — upper floors at both ends, and a lower section which runs down the center. A handful of turned over carts lie scattered around the room, and heaps of unrefined ore are piled up on the upper floors.
rows.translation: 这个房间被十英尺高的壁架和通往壁架的粗糙楼梯分成了三个部分——两端是较高的区域，中间则是较低的部分。房间里散落着几辆被翻倒的手推车，而上层的区域则堆满了未经加工的矿石。
rows.raw: "\n        Ten-foot ledges with rough-hewn stairs leading up to them divide this chamber into three sections — upper floors at both ends, and a lower section which runs down the center. A handful of turned over carts lie scattered around the room, and heaps of unrefined ore are piled up on the upper floors."

rows.original:
The cart tracks end here. In the center of this artificially expanded chamber is a ravine with two sluice gates which regulate the flow of water. At the far end of the reservoir is a large yet still water wheel. Wooden ramps on either end of the ravine lead to and from a wooden, multi-tiered structure which contains an inactive lift.
        
        You know that, if you pull the lever and return motion to the mechanism, the lift will no doubt take you to the heart of this mine and you'll be face-to-face with the corrupted leader of these wolfmen.
rows.translation:
马车的小路在这里结束。在这个人工扩建的腔室中央，有一条沟壑，那里设有两扇用于调节水流的闸门。水库的尽头有一座大型但已经停止运转的水轮机。沟壑的两端都设有木制斜坡，这些斜坡通向一座由多层木结构搭建的建筑，而那座建筑里也有一台已经不再使用的升降机。
        
        你知道，只要拉动那个杠杆，让机械装置恢复运转，升降机肯定会带你来到这座矿井的中心，然后你就能与那些狼人的堕落首领面对面了。
rows.raw:
"
        The cart tracks end here. In the center of this artificially expanded chamber is a ravine with two sluice gates which regulate the flow of water. At the far end of the reservoir is a large yet still water wheel. Wooden ramps on either end of the ravine lead to and from a wooden, multi-tiered structure which contains an inactive lift.
        
        You know that, if you pull the lever and return motion to the mechanism, the lift will no doubt take you to the heart of this mine and you'll be face-to-face with the corrupted leader of these wolfmen."

rows.original:
This part of the cave is big enough to contain a freestanding structure. Numerous passages branch out from this cavern, but most of them end in partially excavated rock faces. This must be as far as the workers got before they fell to corruption.

        The storehouse itself is a cramped and uncomfortable place, but it's stocked with things like flour, casks of salted meat, torches, pickaxes, shovels, and other gear. What more could a busy laborer need? There's also dusty kegs tucked neatly against the wall opposite of the door. It's a miracle that this place hasn't been completely ransacked.
rows.translation:
这个洞穴的区域足够大，可以容纳一座独立的建筑。从这个洞穴中延伸出了许多通道，但大多数通道都通向那些仅被部分挖掘过的岩壁。想必工人们在遭遇腐败势力之前，就已经探索到了这里为止了。

        这个仓库本身空间狭小且环境不佳，但里面堆满了面粉、装满咸肉的桶、火把、鹤嘴锄、铲子以及其他工具。对于一个忙碌的劳动者来说，还需要什么呢？在门的对面，墙壁上还整齐地摆放着一些积满灰尘的桶。这个地方居然没有被彻底洗劫一空，真是奇迹。
rows.raw:
"
        This part of the cave is big enough to contain a freestanding structure. Numerous passages branch out from this cavern, but most of them end in partially excavated rock faces. This must be as far as the workers got before they fell to corruption.

        The storehouse itself is a cramped and uncomfortable place, but it's stocked with things like flour, casks of salted meat, torches, pickaxes, shovels, and other gear. What more could a busy laborer need? There's also dusty kegs tucked neatly against the wall opposite of the door. It's a miracle that this place hasn't been completely ransacked."

rows.original: You feel the sharp drop in temperature when you step into the circular room, and you begin to see your own breath whenever you breathe. Upon the walls you see carved reliefs of a tale with no beginning or end, but you cannot make out its significance. Below them, a two-foot deep blanket of cold air creeps across the floor, chilling your [pc.hasHooves |hooves |ankles ], but also obscuring a pair of skeletal remains. One thing's for certain, though: [silly |you're not in Kansas anymore |this chamber must've been here long before the miners were ]. [flags.KQ_RIMESCORE |With the removal of Rimescore, this chamber is as silent as the grave. |In the center of this frigid room, a crystal shard the size of your head gently floats above a rime-covered pedestal upon a raised dais, spewing out its frozen mist in droves. As you stare at it, you get the feeling that someone — or perhaps something — is watching you. ]
rows.translation: 当你走进那个圆形房间时，会立刻感受到气温的急剧下降，每次呼吸时，都能看到自己呼出的白气。墙面上雕刻着一些没有开头也没有结尾的故事浮雕，但你无法理解其中蕴含的含义。在那些浮雕下方，一层厚达两英尺的冷空气在地板上蔓延开来，让你感到无比寒冷。 [pc.hasHooves |蹄子 |脚踝 ]但同时也掩盖了一具骨骼残骸。不过，有一件事是肯定的： [silly |你已经不在堪萨斯州了 |这个矿井在矿工们出现之前就已经存在很久了 ]。 [flags.KQ_RIMESCORE |随着霜刻的消失，这个房间变得寂静得如同坟墓一般。 |在这个冰冷的房间中央，有一块有着你头部大小的水晶碎片，它轻轻地漂浮在一个被霜覆盖的基座上，而那个基座则位于一个凸起的平台上。这块水晶不断释放出冰冷的雾气，形成一片片细小的水滴。当你凝视着它的时候，你会有一种感觉——仿佛是有人……或者说，可能是某个东西 — 正在看着你。 ]
rows.raw: " You feel the sharp drop in temperature when you step into the circular room, and you begin to see your own breath whenever you breathe. Upon the walls you see carved reliefs of a tale with no beginning or end, but you cannot make out its significance. Below them, a two-foot deep blanket of cold air creeps across the floor, chilling your [pc.hasHooves |hooves |ankles ], but also obscuring a pair of skeletal remains. One thing's for certain, though: [silly |you're not in Kansas anymore |this chamber must've been here long before the miners were ]. [flags.KQ_RIMESCORE |With the removal of Rimescore, this chamber is as silent as the grave. |In the center of this frigid room, a crystal shard the size of your head gently floats above a rime-covered pedestal upon a raised dais, spewing out its frozen mist in droves. As you stare at it, you get the feeling that someone — or perhaps something — is watching you. ]"

rows.original:
This part of the warehouse has been stacked almost to the roof with round barrels. At first, you think they might be wine, but the smell is downright rank; bitter and rotten. The barrels have an emblem of a green fish on them.

        [party.has brint|"Garum," Brint says, slapping one of the barrels. "Salty fish sauce. Good for dipping."]
        
        [party.has brienne|"Garum!" Brienne says, affectionately patting one of the barrels. "It's dipping sauce!"]
rows.translation:
仓库的这一区域堆满了几乎顶到天花板的圆桶。乍一看，你可能会以为这些桶里装的是葡萄酒，但闻起来却浓烈得令人作呕——那种味道既苦又腐烂。这些桶上还印着一条绿色鱼形的图案。

        [party.has brint|加鲁姆，”布林特说着，拍了一下其中一个桶。“咸鱼酱，用来蘸着吃非常不错。]
        
        [party.has brienne|加鲁姆！”布蕾妮轻声说道，满怀喜爱地拍了拍其中一个桶。“这是蘸酱啊！]
rows.raw:
'This part of the warehouse has been stacked almost to the roof with round barrels. At first, you think they might be wine, but the smell is downright rank; bitter and rotten. The barrels have an emblem of a green fish on them.

        [party.has brint|"Garum," Brint says, slapping one of the barrels. "Salty fish sauce. Good for dipping."]
        
        [party.has brienne|"Garum!" Brienne says, affectionately patting one of the barrels. "It's dipping sauce!"]'

rows.original:
There's only a narrow walkthrough here, with rows of chunky chests stacked up on either side. Each has a small maker's mark on the latch, a sparrow holding a hammer. 

        There are dark red stains on the ground between the stacks. At first you think they might be blood... but a closer look reveals flecks of herbs and a few strands of noodles lying on the floor too. Somebody spilled part of their lunch, maybe?
rows.translation:
这里只有一条狭窄的小路可供通行，道路两侧堆放着一排排笨重的箱子。每个箱子的锁扣上都有一个小小的标记——一只手持锤子的麻雀。

        在箱子堆放处的地面上，有一些深红色的污渍。起初你会以为那些可能是血迹……但仔细观察后，你会发现地上还散落着一些草药碎片和几缕面条。大概是有人不小心把午餐弄洒了吧？
rows.raw: "There's only a narrow walkthrough here, with rows of chunky chests stacked up on either side. Each has a small maker's mark on the latch, a sparrow holding a hammer. \n\n        There are dark red stains on the ground between the stacks. At first you think they might be blood... but a closer look reveals flecks of herbs and a few strands of noodles lying on the floor too. Somebody spilled part of their lunch, maybe?"

rows.original:
This section of the warehouse has been given over to storing stone bricks. Each is pretty damn perfectly identical, cut to be about a foot and a half long and a third of one wide and tall. There's a wooden placard stuck into the middle of the stack, reading "Property of Lujan Ronn, Lot No. XXIV."

        Someone has preemptively carved a fat, drooping horsedick on one of the stones facing the aisle.
rows.translation:
仓库的这一区域被专门用来存放石砖。这些石砖每一块都长得一模一样，长度大约为一英尺半，宽度和高度均为三分之一英尺。在那一堆石砖的中间，还粘着一块木牌，上面写着：“属于卢詹·罗恩，编号为XXIV的货物。”

        在那些面向通道的石砖中，有人特意在其中一块上刻了一个胖乎乎的、下垂的阴茎图案。
rows.raw: 'This section of the warehouse has been given over to storing stone bricks. Each is pretty damn perfectly identical, cut to be about a foot and a half long and a third of one wide and tall. There\'s a wooden placard stuck into the middle of the stack, reading "Property of Lujan Ronn, Lot No. XXIV."\n\n        Someone has preemptively carved a fat, drooping horsedick on one of the stones facing the aisle.'

rows.original:
There's a single, massive wine cask dominating the warehouse floor here. There's a brand of a red grapevine on its side, followed by a proofmark from the Kingdom of Sartanni. [livrea.met|Livrea would love this.]

        There are a few drops of red on the floor under the cask. Some naughty worker might have already tapped the goods. Hard to blame them, given the times.
rows.translation:
在这个仓库的地面，有一个巨大的酒桶占据了整个空间。它的侧面印有某种红葡萄品种的标志，后面还标有萨塔尼王国的检验印记。 [livrea.met|利夫雷亚肯定会喜欢这个的。]

        在酒桶下方的地板上，有几滴红色的液体。可能是某个调皮的员工提前打开了酒桶。考虑到现在的形势，也难怪他们会这么做。
rows.raw: "There's a single, massive wine cask dominating the warehouse floor here. There's a brand of a red grapevine on its side, followed by a proofmark from the Kingdom of Sartanni. [livrea.met|Livrea would love this.]\n\n        There are a few drops of red on the floor under the cask. Some naughty worker might have already tapped the goods. Hard to blame them, given the times."

rows.original: About twenty open-faced crates are stacked up here, filled to the brim with bronze arrowheads. You guess these are probably earmarked for the civil militia rather than the royal military, given the lax security around them. The boxes are marked with a blue labrys surrounded by flames, likely a smith's mark.
rows.translation: 这里堆放着大约二十个敞开的箱子，里面都装满了青铜箭头。从这些箱子周围松懈的安保措施来看，这些箭头很可能是为民间民兵准备的，而不是皇家军队用的。箱子上标有被火焰环绕的蓝色双刃斧图案，这很可能是铁匠的标记。
rows.raw: "About twenty open-faced crates are stacked up here, filled to the brim with bronze arrowheads. You guess these are probably earmarked for the civil militia rather than the royal military, given the lax security around them. The boxes are marked with a blue labrys surrounded by flames, likely a smith's mark."

rows.original: Sacks upon fat, burgeoning sacks are laid up here in neat little pyramids. Each of them has a blue hammer mark on it, with "SEA SALT" written over it in finger-drawn ink. Even if they weren't marked, the contents can still be smelled from a few feet away, made potent by the sheer volume in one place.
rows.translation: 这些装满脂肪的袋子被整齐地堆成小金字塔状。每个袋子上都有蓝色的锤痕，上面用手指画的墨水写着“海盐”二字。即使没有这些标记，从几英尺外也能闻到袋子里散发出来的气味——由于这些脂肪被集中存放在一起，气味显得更加浓烈。
rows.raw: 'Sacks upon fat, burgeoning sacks are laid up here in neat little pyramids. Each of them has a blue hammer mark on it, with "SEA SALT" written over it in finger-drawn ink. Even if they weren\'t marked, the contents can still be smelled from a few feet away, made potent by the sheer volume in one place.'

rows.original: A single tall box is standing apart here, given about two feet of empty floor space in every direction. Something expensive and precious, you imagine. There's a handwritten bill of sale attached to the side of the box; a brief glance at it shows that it was imported by one Senator Khaius for the princely sum of one thousand two hundred and twenty five Belharan Hawks. What's inside, though, isn't stated.
rows.translation: 这里有一个高高的箱子，周围留有大约两英尺的空地。你可以想象，里面肯定装着一些昂贵而珍贵的东西。箱子的侧面附有一张手写的销售凭证，粗略一看，就能知道这是由一位名叫凯乌斯的参议员以1225贝拉兰鹰这样的巨额代价进口而来的。不过，箱子里究竟装着什么，并没有在凭证上写明。
rows.raw: "A single tall box is standing apart here, given about two feet of empty floor space in every direction. Something expensive and precious, you imagine. There's a handwritten bill of sale attached to the side of the box; a brief glance at it shows that it was imported by one Senator Khaius for the princely sum of one thousand two hundred and twenty five Belharan Hawks. What's inside, though, isn't stated."

rows.original: Spare oars are racked up against the wall here, bound up into clusters of a dozen each with thick naval rope. You aren't sure if these are meant for the Royal Navy or for private ships, but it's hardly a surprise that so many spares would be necessary — the water here's doubtless all kinds of rocky.
rows.translation: 这里的备用桨被整齐地靠在墙上，每十几把用粗厚的海军绳索绑在一起。你不确定这些桨是专为皇家海军准备的，还是用于私人船只，但考虑到这里的水域中肯定布满了各种岩石，需要这么多备用桨也就不足为奇了。
rows.raw: "Spare oars are racked up against the wall here, bound up into clusters of a dozen each with thick naval rope. You aren't sure if these are meant for the Royal Navy or for private ships, but it's hardly a surprise that so many spares would be necessary — the water here's doubtless all kinds of rocky."

rows.original: There's a neat stack of heavy wooden crates here, six in total, all branded with the crest of the Kingdom of Sartanni and with a blood-red labrys. They've all been nailed shut, though there is a crowbar hanging from a support beam nearby. A small Lumian totem — at least that's what you assume the pewter statue of an obscenely pregnant cowgirl — is attached to it by a thin cord.
rows.translation: 这里有一堆整齐的重木箱，总共有六个，每个箱子上都印有萨塔尼王国的徽章以及一朵血红色的双刃斧图案。这些箱子都被钉得严严实实，不过附近的一根支撑梁上挂着一把撬棍。还有一个小小的卢米安图腾——至少你会这么认为，因为那个用白镴制成的雕像看起来就像一个怀孕到了极点的牛仔姑娘——用一根细绳系在箱子上面。
rows.raw: "There's a neat stack of heavy wooden crates here, six in total, all branded with the crest of the Kingdom of Sartanni and with a blood-red labrys. They've all been nailed shut, though there is a crowbar hanging from a support beam nearby. A small Lumian totem — at least that's what you assume the pewter statue of an obscenely pregnant cowgirl — is attached to it by a thin cord."

rows.original: You're standing on the deck of a cargo barge, fresh from uptown with the princess's cargo. It's low and flat, tied up to a short pier sticking out into the river. To your north is a warehouse, flat and broad and made of stone, squatting on the waterfront with its back doors left open in the workers' haste to go and greet the princess.
rows.translation: 你正站在一艘货船的甲板上，这艘船刚刚从市区运来公主所需的货物。船身低矮而扁平，被系在伸入河中的短码头上。你的北边是一座仓库，它由石头建造，结构平坦宽阔，坐落在滨水区，由于工人们急于去迎接公主，仓库的后门被敞开着。
rows.raw: "You're standing on the deck of a cargo barge, fresh from uptown with the princess's cargo. It's low and flat, tied up to a short pier sticking out into the river. To your north is a warehouse, flat and broad and made of stone, squatting on the waterfront with its back doors left open in the workers' haste to go and greet the princess."

rows.original:
Connecting Khor'minos City to the eastern coast of the kingdom is vast, straight tunnel wide enough for a score of fully-armored legionnaires to walk down abreast. But here, that connecting tunnel ends with a towering stone gate, so heavy that even the burly natives have brought in pack animals to heave it open. Being so close to the city itself, no expense has been spared on security: dozens of soldiers stand to either side, in the shadow of a pair of wooden guard towers each capped with a heavy scorpion that could skewer a dragon. Barricades were constructed around the gates in the shadow of war, wood and stone stacked high enough to shield the troops' bowmen from harm while they funnel whatever demons might come into their arrows. 

		Despite the dark scars of black magic and countless projectile pockmarks marring the once-polished stone, these gates certainly were never breached. 
		
		To the east, the tunnel widens out after a few dozen paces, opening up into what might once have been a bazaar, a last gathering of merchants before making the journey into the city itself. Now, though, there're only a few scant souls to be seen...
rows.translation:
将科尔米诺斯城与王国的东海岸连接起来的，是一条宽阔而笔直的隧道，其宽度足以让二十名全副武装的军团士兵并排通行。然而，在这条隧道的尽头，矗立着一扇巨大的石门——它的重量如此之大，以至于就连那些体格强壮的当地人也不得不动用驮畜来帮助将其打开。由于该地点距离城市中心非常近，因此在安全措施上投入了大量资金：在两座木制瞭望塔的阴影下，数十名士兵站岗值守，而这些瞭望塔的顶端还装有重型的弩炮，其射出的箭矢足以刺穿任何巨龙。在战争的阴影下，人们在这些城门周围筑起了路障，用木材和石头堆成的屏障高得足以保护军队中的弓箭手免受伤害，同时也能将任何可能袭来的敌人引入他们的箭矢范围。

		尽管那些曾经光洁的石墙上留下了黑色魔法的痕迹以及无数弹丸留下的坑洞，但这些城门却从未被攻破过。 
		
		向东走几十步后，隧道逐渐变宽，最终通向一个曾经可能是集市的地方——那些商人们在进入城市之前，会在这里最后一次聚集。然而现在，这里却只有寥寥几个人影……
rows.raw:
"Connecting Khor'minos City to the eastern coast of the kingdom is vast, straight tunnel wide enough for a score of fully-armored legionnaires to walk down abreast. But here, that connecting tunnel ends with a towering stone gate, so heavy that even the burly natives have brought in pack animals to heave it open. 		To the east, the tunnel widens out after a few dozen paces, opening up into what might once have been a bazaar, a last gathering of merchants before making the journey into the city itself. Now, though, there're only a few scant souls to be seen..."

rows.original:
You're standing in the middle of a circular chamber cut into the mountainside, close enough to the entrance that you can smell the sea salt in the distance. Once, dozens of merchants gathered here amidst wagons and cloth tents, hawking their wares to folk coming and going from the city to the sea; now, it's been almost entirely abandoned. Only a few of the guards' camp followers are still out and about, sewing tattered capes and cooking on communal fires built on the torn-down ruins of merchant stalls. 

		To the north, the cave winds towards the coast, illuminated by natural light as much as by torches. To the south, there's still some sign of civilian life — a few larger buildings surrounding a statue, with flickering lights visible inside.
rows.translation:
你站在一个位于山腰上的圆形洞室中，距离入口如此之近，以至于能闻到远处海风的咸腥味。曾经，有数十名商贩在这里聚集，他们推着马车、搭着布帐篷，向那些往返于城市与海边的人们兜售商品；如今，这个地方已经几乎被完全废弃了。只有少数守卫们的追随者还在外面活动，他们正在修补破烂的斗篷，也在那些被拆毁的商摊废墟上生火做饭。

		在北方，这条洞穴一直延伸向海岸，其中既有自然光，也有火把的光芒照亮着道路。在南方，仍然能看到一些平民生活的迹象——有几座较大的建筑环绕着一座雕像，建筑物内部有灯光闪烁着。
rows.raw: "You're standing in the middle of a circular chamber cut into the mountainside, close enough to the entrance that you can smell the sea salt in the distance. Once, dozens of merchants gathered here amidst wagons and cloth tents, hawking their wares to folk coming and going from the city to the sea; now, it's been almost entirely abandoned. Only a few of the guards' camp followers are still out and about, sewing tattered capes and cooking on communal fires built on the torn-down ruins of merchant stalls. \n\n\t\tTo the north, the cave winds towards the coast, illuminated by natural light as much as by torches. To the south, there's still some sign of civilian life — a few larger buildings surrounding a statue, with flickering lights visible inside."

rows.original:
Only one estate in this neighborhood seems to still be occupied, and you can hear a bevy of voices spilling out from the open windows. A single soldier stands at attention outside, dressed in the royal purple and red of the king's own house, with a poleaxe held firmly at his side. 
		
		[flags.TODO_VRANNUS_TAKEN_DOWN|Several royal soldiers are moving around inside now, still trying to pick up the pieces.|There's a heavy scent of wine, sweat, and sex pouring from the windows, accompanied by laughter and the occasional moan.]
rows.translation:
这个街区似乎只有一栋房子还有人居住，从敞开的窗户里传出来一阵嘈杂的声音。外面站着一名士兵，他穿着国王家族特有的紫色和红色制服，手中紧握着一把长柄斧。 
		
		[flags.TODO_VRANNUS_TAKEN_DOWN|现在有几名皇家士兵正在里面忙碌着，他们仍在努力收拾残局。|从窗户里传出来浓重的酒味、汗味以及性爱的气息，同时还伴随着笑声和偶尔发出的呻吟声。]
rows.raw: "Only one estate in this neighborhood seems to still be occupied, and you can hear a bevy of voices spilling out from the open windows. A single soldier stands at attention outside, dressed in the royal purple and red of the king's own house, with a poleaxe held firmly at his side. \n\t\t\n\t\t[flags.TODO_VRANNUS_TAKEN_DOWN|Several royal soldiers are moving around inside now, still trying to pick up the pieces.|There's a heavy scent of wine, sweat, and sex pouring from the windows, accompanied by laughter and the occasional moan.]"

rows.original:
The path winds through the eastern outskirts of Khor'minos, a sprawling suburb that once housed those who serviced and supplied the bazaar and villas to the south. Unlike the undermountain approach, though, these homes haven't had the benefit of maze-like tunnels to protect them. As a result, the entire locale's been abandoned: farms, small workshops and cottage industries, civil servant posts all lie empty and forlorn. 

		The drinking fountains and one minor aqueduct still function, testament to the resilience of minoan engineering to have continued without maintenance for so long, but that only adds to the eerieness that pervades the neighborhood. At least by all appearances the withdrawal into the city seems to have been an orderly one, with minimal looting; doors and windows are boarded up in the hopes that their former inhabitants will return someday to resume their former lives.
		
		The only signs of life are at rest stops that've been cobbled together by patrols rotating to and from the gate and mountain's exit — legionnaires huddle together on stools about firepits thrown together near the public fountains, looking glum and grim in equal measure. Even when resting, none dare drop their guard, although a few throw you salutes as you pass by.
rows.translation:
道路蜿蜒穿过科尔米诺斯东部的郊区。这里曾是一片广阔的住宅区，居民们为南方的集市与别墅提供服务和物资。然而，与山下通道不同，这些房屋没有迷宫般的隧道可供庇护。因此，整片区域都已被遗弃：农场、小作坊与家庭手工业场所，还有公务人员的驻点，全都空空荡荡，显得无比凄凉。

		饮水喷泉和一条小型输水渠仍在运作，证明米诺斯人的工程即使长期无人维护也依然坚韧可靠；可这反而让弥漫在街区里的诡异感更加强烈。至少从表面来看，居民撤入城内时还算井然有序，几乎没有发生劫掠；门窗都被木板封死，盼望着昔日的住户有朝一日能够归来，重新过上从前的生活。
		
		唯一的生命迹象来自几处由往返城门与山口的巡逻队临时拼凑起来的休息点——军团士兵们挤坐在公共喷泉旁临时火坑周围的凳子上，神情既阴沉又严峻。即使是在休息，也没人敢放松警惕，不过当你经过时，仍有几人向你敬礼。
rows.raw:
"The path winds through the eastern outskirts of Khor'minos, a sprawling suburb that once housed those who serviced and supplied the bazaar and villas to the south. Unlike the undermountain approach, though, these homes haven't had the benefit of maze-like tunnels to protect them. As a result, the entire locale's been abandoned: farms, small workshops and cottage industries, civil servant posts all lie empty and forlorn. 

		The drinking fountains and one minor aqueduct still function, testament to the resilience of minoan engineering to have continued without maintenance for so long, but that only adds to the eerieness that pervades the neighborhood. At least by all appearances the withdrawal into the city seems to have been an orderly one, with minimal looting; doors and windows are boarded up in the hopes that their former inhabitants will return someday to resume their former lives.
		
		The only signs of life are at rest stops that've been cobbled together by patrols rotating to and from the gate and mountain's exit — legionnaires huddle together on stools about firepits thrown together near the public fountains, looking glum and grim in equal measure. Even when resting, none dare drop their guard, although a few throw you salutes as you pass by."

rows.original:
This cave path was once well-travelled and maintained, but now has fallen into disrepair — by minoan standards, anyway. Hobgoblin porter stations stand to one side of the dusty stone-paved trail, slowly succumbing to the dry rot that's been eating away at them for months; reinforced beams set into a wall suggest the tunnel was being widened before the siege commenced. 

		In lieu of the street lights that have yet to be re-seeded with luminescent fungus, the patrols have put up fresh torches; wood and oilcloth that will last but several hours at most before burning out. Though everything feels calm at the moment, the locals are clearly reluctant to sink time and effort into reclaiming any territory beyond the eastern gate until the threat to the Marches has been conclusively dealt with.
		
		Mid-path, one scent in the air gives way to another as a draft's sucked into the mountain: the heavy, earthy smell of rock, mushrooms and minotaur slowly replaced by that of fresh ocean air and the promise of [dayNight|sun-lit warmth|lunar serenity]. After the hustle and bustle of Khor'minos, even this slight change in atmosphere is striking.
rows.translation:
这条洞穴道路曾经车马频繁、维护良好，如今却已经失修——当然，是以米诺斯人的标准而言。尘封的石板路旁排列着地精搬运工的驿站，数月来侵蚀它们的干腐正缓慢将其吞噬；墙中嵌入的加固横梁则表明，在围城开始前，这条隧道本来正在进行拓宽。

		街灯还未来得及重新播种发光真菌，巡逻队便改为架起新火把；木料和油布最多只能燃烧几个小时。虽然此刻一切平静，当地人显然仍不愿投入时间和精力，去收复东门之外的任何土地——至少在边境的威胁得到彻底解决之前不会。
		
		走到半途，随着气流被吸入山中，空气中的一种气味逐渐被另一种取代：岩石、蘑菇和弥诺陶洛斯混合而成的浓重土腥味，慢慢让位于清新的海风，以及[dayNight|阳光温暖|月夜宁静]的许诺。经历过科尔米诺斯的喧嚣繁忙后，哪怕只是这样轻微的氛围变化，也显得格外鲜明。
rows.raw:
"This cave path was once well-travelled and maintained, but now has fallen into disrepair — by minoan standards, anyway. Hobgoblin porter stations stand to one side of the dusty stone-paved trail, slowly succumbing to the dry rot that's been eating away at them for months; reinforced beams set into a wall suggest the tunnel was being widened before the siege commenced.

rows.original:
You've finally reached the dividing line between the Undermountain and mountainside. The [dayNight|light shining through the tunnel exit is blinding compared to the darkness to your west|starlight is barely better than the darkness of the tunnel back west, but it's refreshing all the same]. To your east lies the sea, an endless expanse of azure that glitters in the light... and yet, as close as it is, taking a dive from here would surely be fatal. 

		You're several hundred feet up from the coast itself, separated from the strand by sheer, pale white cliffs that seem to stretch on forever. Just looking down is enough to give you a sense of vertigo. 
		
		[party.has ryn|Ryn's ears tuck down. "C-can we get away from the edge, please?"]
		
		The brave defenders of Khor'minos have set up a serious set of defenses here: layers of barricades covered in spikes, protecting about fifty heavy infantry and archers all pressed into the tunnel entrance. From the amount of flame-scoring and blood on the ground, and the barricades themselves, you guess these defenses were well tested during the worst of the war. Now, though, the demons lack the organization to make a direct offensive against a strongpoint like this, but the soldiers seem no more relaxed than ever. Several of them watch you warily, hands on their weapons, [flags.KM_SIEGE_CALISE_REVEAL|all too aware of demons' capacity for deception now|ready for any sign of treachery, even from a champion].
rows.translation:
你终于来到了山腹深域与山腰之间的分界线处。 [dayNight|与你西侧的那片黑暗相比，从隧道出口射进来的光线简直亮得刺眼。|星光其实并不比西方那条隧道里的黑暗有什么区别，但至少它让人感到些许清爽。]在你的东边是大海，一片无边无际的蔚蓝海域，在阳光下闪闪发光……然而，尽管它离你如此之近，但从这里跳下去无疑会是致命的。

		你目前距离海岸还有几百英尺的高差，与陆地之间被一道道陡峭的、洁白无瑕的悬崖隔开，这些悬崖似乎一直延伸到天边。仅仅往下看一眼，就会让你感到一阵眩晕。 
		
		[party.has ryn|小琳的耳朵耷了下来。“可、可以让我们远离边缘吗？]
		
		科尔米诺斯的勇敢守卫们在这里构筑了一道严密的防御工事：层层叠叠的障碍物上布满了尖刺，大约五十名重装步兵和弓箭手都聚集在隧道入口处。从地面上遍布的火焰痕迹和鲜血，以及那些障碍物本身的状况来看，可以推测这些防御措施在战争最激烈的时期经历过严峻的考验。然而，现在这些恶魔缺乏足够的组织能力，无法对这样的坚固据点发动直接进攻，但那些士兵们却丝毫没有放松警惕。其中有几个人正警惕地注视着你，手中紧握着武器。 [flags.KM_SIEGE_CALISE_REVEAL|现在，我太清楚恶魔们欺骗他人的能力了|随时准备应对任何背叛的迹象，哪怕是来自一位英雄]。
rows.raw:
"You've finally reached the dividing line between the Undermountain and mountainside. The [dayNight|light shining through the tunnel exit is blinding compared to the darkness to your west|starlight is barely better than the darkness of the tunnel back west, but it's refreshing all the same]. To your east lies the sea, an endless expanse of azure that glitters in the light... and yet, as close as it is, taking a dive from here would surely be fatal. 

		You're several hundred feet up from the coast itself, separated from the strand by sheer, pale white cliffs that seem to stretch on forever. Just looking down is enough to give you a sense of vertigo.

From the amount of flame-scoring and blood on the ground, and the barricades themselves, you guess these defenses were well tested during the worst of the war. Now, though, the demons lack the organization to make a direct offensive against a strongpoint like this, but the soldiers seem no more relaxed than ever. Several of them watch you warily, hands on their weapons, [flags.KM_SIEGE_CALISE_REVEAL|all too aware of demons' capacity for deception now|ready for any sign of treachery, even from a champion]."

rows.original:
You're standing at the very end (or start, depending on your perspective) of a long, winding road. From here you can see old stones, now largely broken by the wear of centuries, meandering north along the sheer white cliff, only to turn around and come back your way at a downward angle. Over hundreds upon hundreds of yards, the road descends slow and sure towards the shore. 

		To your immediate east, though, is a solid-looking structure made from stone and wood, right up on the edge of the cliff.
rows.translation:
你正站在一条漫长而蜿蜒的道路的尽头（或者说是起点，这取决于你的观察角度）。从这里你可以看到那些古老的石块——经过几个世纪的侵蚀，它们已经大多破碎不堪了。这些石块沿着陡峭的白色悬崖向北延伸，然后又突然转向，以倾斜的角度重新回到你的视线范围内。在长达数百码的距离里，这条道路缓缓而坚定地向着海岸方向延伸。

		然而，在你的正东方向，有一座由石头和木材建造的坚固建筑，它就矗立在悬崖的边缘上。
rows.raw: "You're standing at the very end (or start, depending on your perspective) of a long, winding road. From here you can see old stones, now largely broken by the wear of centuries, meandering north along the sheer white cliff, only to turn around and come back your way at a downward angle. Over hundreds upon hundreds of yards, the road descends slow and sure towards the shore. \n\n\t\tTo your immediate east, though, is a solid-looking structure made from stone and wood, right up on the edge of the cliff. "

rows.original: Thanks to your efforts, the lift is back in service. A number of mountain goats are hitched up to the wheel and are ready to work; a single young salamander is sitting inside to manage them.
rows.translation: 多亏了你们的努力，电梯已经恢复使用了。现在有几只山羊被套在轮子上，准备开始工作了；而有一只小蝾螈坐在电梯内部，负责控制这些山羊的动作。
rows.raw: "Thanks to your efforts, the lift is back in service. A number of mountain goats are hitched up to the wheel and are ready to work; a single young salamander is sitting inside to manage them."

rows.original:
A number of ropes are suspended from a pulley system in the structure's rafter, connected to a wheel that has harnesses for pack animals... but there's no sign of the beasts up here, nor the actual lift that they must have once serviced. 

		You peer over the cliff's edge, down a smoothed section of white stone, to see there's another, roofless structure at the bottom. The ropes connect place to place, but again, you see no sign of any life down there to make this thing work. Damnation!
rows.translation:
结构的椽条上安装了一套滑轮系统，多根绳子从那里悬挂下来，这些绳子连接着一个装有驮畜背带的轮子……但这里却看不到任何驮畜的踪迹，也没有任何表明这些装置曾经被使用过的痕迹。

		你俯身看向悬崖边缘，顺着那一段光滑的白色岩石往下看，发现下装还有另一座没有屋顶的建筑。那些绳子把不同的地方连接在一起，但同样，你也看不到下面有任何生命迹象，这些装置似乎根本没人使用过。该死！
rows.raw: "A number of ropes are suspended from a pulley system in the structure's rafter, connected to a wheel that has harnesses for pack animals... but there's no sign of the beasts up here, nor the actual lift that they must have once serviced. \n\n\t\tYou peer over the cliff's edge, down a smoothed section of white stone, to see there's another, roofless structure at the bottom. The ropes connect place to place, but again, you see no sign of any life down there to make this thing work. Damnation!"

rows.original:
This close to the mountain entrance and its defenses, the scars of battle are still plain and evident. The once-paved road has been thoroughly torn up and churned into muck by the drawn-out conflict on this side of the mountain, enormous potholes that could've been made by some siege engine or devastating spell blasting the cliffside road into an uneven mess. The charred stumps of several scraggly trees still stand, testament to the battles recently fought here, while debris and refuse from the demons' makeshift fortifications lie churned into an unstable, muddy mess.

		It will be a long, long time before this stretch of road will be fit for foot traffic, let alone vehicles; the section of cliffside needs to be shored up against the abuse it's suffered, the worst of the debris extracted from the clinging muck, and proper foundations laid and paved over. In the meantime, though, the legion has spread copious amounts of gravel that at least firm up the surface somewhat and prevents the muck from claiming one's shoes. It's not a perfect solution — and won't be until work crews can safely get to business — but it makes the road traversable, if nothing else. The Belharans are gone, and so the road's original architecture as a joint venture between Khor'minos and the empire is lost forever, but hopefully what comes after will be better.
rows.translation:
如此接近山口及其防线，战斗留下的伤痕依然清晰可见。原本铺设平整的道路已在山脉这一侧旷日持久的冲突中被彻底撕裂，搅成泥泞；巨大的坑洞仿佛由攻城器械或毁灭性法术轰击而成，把临崖道路炸得高低不平。几棵瘦弱树木烧焦的残桩依旧矗立，见证着最近发生的战斗；恶魔临时防御工事留下的残骸与废物则被踩进了松软不稳的泥浆中。

		要过很久、很久，这段路才能重新适合步行，更别说让车辆通行了；临崖路段必须先得到加固，以承受它已经遭受的破坏，还要从黏稠泥泞中清除最严重的废墟，重新铺设坚实的地基与路面。眼下，军团只能撒下大量碎石，至少让地面稍微稳固一些，免得泥浆吞掉行人的鞋子。这不是完美的解决办法——在施工队能够安全开工之前也不可能完美——但至少让道路勉强可以通行。贝尔哈人已经离去，这条道路作为科尔米诺斯与帝国共同工程的原始设计也永远失传了；但愿后来建成的一切能够更加出色。

The Belharans are gone, and so the road's original architecture as a joint venture between Khor'minos and the empire is lost forever, but hopefully what comes after will be better."

rows.original:
The rear of the front, one might say — relatively calm for the demons' fallback positions during the siege. The occasional wrecked palisade is all that remains of their presence, and though the road has suffered some abuse it's still recognizable for what it is.

		Away from the road, though, towards the mountainside — that's where things change. The minoan legions have dug huge pits and trenches in the loose soil that's gathered on this crook of the mountain, dumping and burning the refuse of war, of which you'd rather not investigate too deeply if the stench is any indication. Some of them have already been filled in, but the charnel atmosphere still seeps out from the soil and unsettles the stomach. Sure, it's preferable to leaving everything to rot into a foul miasma, but even so choosing the lesser of two evils is still choosing evil.

		Maybe it's best not to linger overlong — a sentiment shared by the miserable-looking legions set to this task.
rows.translation:
可以说，这是前方后方相对平静的区域——在围攻期间，这些地方成为了恶魔的退守之地。偶尔能看到的毁坏的栅栏，便是它们曾经存在过的痕迹。虽然道路也遭受了一些破坏，但仍然可以辨认出它原本的样貌。

		然而，离开道路，朝着山腰方向走去——就在那里，情况发生了变化。米诺斯军团在这片山腰堆积的松软土壤中挖掘出了巨大的坑洞和沟渠，将战争产生的废弃物倾倒在里面并焚烧掉。如果那些恶臭能够说明什么的话，那么你肯定不会想要深入探究这些废弃物的来历。其中一些地方已经填好了，但那种阴森的气氛依然从土壤中渗出来，让人感到不安。当然，让一切都腐烂成恶臭的瘴气或许反而更好，但即便如此，在两个坏选择中挑选较不坏的那个，终究还是属于选择坏事。

		或许最好不要拖延太久——那些被派去执行这项任务的、看起来满脸愁容的人们也都持有这种想法。
rows.raw:
"The rear of the front, one might say — relatively calm for the demons' fallback positions during the siege. The occasional wrecked palisade is all that remains of their presence, and though the road has suffered some abuse it's still recognizable for what it is.

		Away from the road, though, towards the mountainside — that's where things change. The minoan legions have dug huge pits and trenches in the loose soil that's gathered on this crook of the mountain, dumping and burning the refuse of war, of which you'd rather not investigate too deeply if the stench is any indication. Some of them have already been filled in, but the charnel atmosphere still seeps out from the soil and unsettles the stomach. Sure, it's preferable to leaving everything to rot into a foul miasma, but even so choosing the lesser of two evils is still choosing evil.

		Maybe it's best not to linger overlong — a sentiment shared by the miserable-looking legions set to this task."

rows.original:
Evidence of the demons' march upon the final ascent to the eastern gate lies aplenty: while the legions have cleaned away the worst of the debris and refuse, the sorry state the Highcliff Road's in speaks for itself. Even in what would have been the relatively peaceful rear in the siege, weeks of occupation has done what decades of use has not: stones torn up from the road's surface, guardrails broken, its surface rutted and uneven from what looks like something wheeled and very heavy being dragged up the mountainside. No doubt keeping the path of their advance smooth was the last thing on the demons' minds.

		Even the gazebos by the roadside for travelers to rest their feet have been taken apart for what little in materials they have to offer, no doubt finding a new if short-lived existence as one of the now-broken barricades that litter the side of the road. The stone benches have survived, if only by virtue of having being carved into shape from rock outcroppings.
rows.translation:
恶魔向东门最后一段上坡路进军的痕迹随处可见：尽管军团已经清走最严重的残骸与垃圾，高崖路如今的惨状仍足以说明一切。即便是在围城期间本应相对安稳的后方，数周占领造成的破坏也超过了几十年的使用：路面石块被掀起，护栏折断，地表遍布车辙、崎岖不平，看起来像有什么装着轮子且极其沉重的东西曾被拖上山坡。恶魔进军时显然根本没心思保持道路平整。

		就连供旅人歇脚的路边凉亭也被拆掉，只为了利用其中少得可怜的材料；它们无疑曾短暂化作路旁那些如今已经破碎的路障。石凳倒是幸存了下来，不过也只是因为它们直接由突出的岩石雕刻而成。
rows.raw: "Evidence of the demons' march upon the final ascent to the eastern gate lies aplenty: while the legions have cleaned away the worst of the debris and refuse, the sorry state the Highcliff Road's in speaks for itself. Even in what would have been the relatively peaceful rear in the siege, weeks of occupation has done what decades of use has not: stones torn up from the road's surface, guardrails broken, its surface rutted and uneven from what looks like something wheeled and very heavy being dragged up the mountainside. No doubt keeping the path of their advance smooth was the last thing on the demons' minds.\n\n\t\tEven the gazebos by the roadside for travelers to rest their feet have been taken apart for what little in materials they have to offer, no doubt finding a new if short-lived existence as one of the now-broken barricades that litter the side of the road. The stone benches have survived, if only by virtue of having being carved into shape from rock outcroppings."

rows.original:
The Highcliff Road turns around on itself here, one of many bends as the path snakes its way through the cliffs. Thin scrub clings to a precarious existence amongst limestone gravel, while a now-defaced minoan road marker declares the distance to the glorious gates of Khor'minos. What trees once stood in the soil collected by the cliffs have been hewn for the little wood they had to offer, forlorn stumps now rotting in the befouled dirt.

		The remains of a demon encampment lie here, long abandoned now that the siege on the city has broken and the attackers have withdrawn. No more than a half-dozen shelters ranging from lean-tos to actual tents are now but so much wreckage, the forward staging point thoroughly trampled underfoot by the chargers' wrath. Anything usable has long since been taken, with the remainder being left for the wind, sun and rain to claim for themselves.
rows.translation:
高崖路在这里折返回转；道路蜿蜒穿行于峭壁之间，这只是诸多弯道之一。稀疏的灌木在石灰岩碎石间勉强求生，一块已经遭到毁坏的米诺斯路标仍宣示着此处距科尔米诺斯辉煌城门的距离。悬崖间积土上曾经生长的树木，早已为了那一点点可用木材而被砍伐，只剩凄凉的树桩在污秽泥土中逐渐腐烂。

		这里留有一座恶魔营地的残骸。随着城市之围被打破、进攻者撤退，它早已遭到废弃。不到六座的住处从简陋棚屋到真正的帐篷不等，如今都只剩一片狼藉；这处前沿集结点已被冲锋者的怒火彻底踏平。所有还能利用的东西早被取走，剩余残骸则任由风吹、日晒和雨淋。
rows.raw: "The Highcliff Road turns around on itself here, one of many bends as the path snakes its way through the cliffs. Thin scrub clings to a precarious existence amongst limestone gravel, while a now-defaced minoan road marker declares the distance to the glorious gates of Khor'minos. What trees once stood in the soil collected by the cliffs have been hewn for the little wood they had to offer, forlorn stumps now rotting in the befouled dirt.\n\n\t\tThe remains of a demon encampment lie here, long abandoned now that the siege on the city has broken and the attackers have withdrawn. No more than a half-dozen shelters ranging from lean-tos to actual tents are now but so much wreckage, the forward staging point thoroughly trampled underfoot by the chargers' wrath. Anything usable has long since been taken, with the remainder being left for the wind, sun and rain to claim for themselves."

rows.original:
This old lighthouse sits to the west of the road, prominent enough to be an oddity — so high up that the structure itself doesn't need to be very tall, yet so close to the shoreline. The sharp spar of rock that's its perch is dark and craggy, some kind of igneous rock in stark contrast to the pale limestone of the sea cliffs.

		[party.has cait
		|"Right!" Cait perks up at the sight of the lighthouse. "This is one of the things Dad wanted to see! It's more a curiosity at this point than anything else, but..."
		
		It's got a lot of history behind it, no doubt. Does it have a special name or something?
		
		Cait shakes her head. "It may have, but if it did it's long since been lost. All the old Estelorean records Dad managed to get his hands on and we read together, they just refer to it as 'the lighthouse'. Like... it's as if such things were so commonplace for them, they didn't think much of it.
		
		"Estelore and Khor'minos worked together on this." The pink kitten points at the stark difference between the lighthouse's base and the surrounding cliffs. "The minoan engineers couldn't find a suitable place to situate the lighthouse just where the Belharans wanted, so a gaggle of mages were summoned from the academy. They supposedly cut open the earth and thrust out a spire of stable rock from deep within... and doesn't that match up with what we're seeing now?"
		]
		
		You sweep your eyes up to the lighthouse approach, a twisting set of steps cut into the slope without handrails or supports, where a single misstep could easily send one tumbling all the way to the bottom. And at the top of the stairs, a lighthouse in the shape of a hand thrusting from the earth, a giant crystal orb clutched in its grasp. Even at this distance, you can make out faint shapes within the weathered, clouded crystal, mechanisms of some sort.
		
		[party.has cait
		|Cait follows your gaze and grins apologetically. "Rather melodramatic, isn't it? That's Estelore for you."
		
		They went through all this for a lighthouse?
		
		Her grin widens. "It brought together the two most obsessive groups in this part of the world at the time. Dad wanted to see this for a reason."
		]
		
		A sorcerous beacon, then — you don't see the remains of any lift, and getting fuel up those steps would be perilous. A hand from the earth, thrusting a beam of light from its palm over the ocean, all for the simple sake of a lighthouse... a tremendous waste of power and effort today, but trivial to the peoples of the past. And for it to have survived as long as it has without falling into complete disrepair... it's a small miracle the demons didn't bother very much with it on their advance.
rows.translation:
这座老灯塔坐落在道路西侧，显眼得近乎怪异——它所处的位置如此之高，建筑本身根本不必太高，却又如此贴近海岸线。承托灯塔的尖锐岩柱黝黑而嶙峋，似乎是某种火成岩，与海崖苍白的石灰岩形成鲜明对比。

		[party.has cait
		|“对了！”凯特看到灯塔，顿时精神起来。“这就是爸爸想来看的东西之一！如今它更多只算一处奇观，不过……”
		
		它背后肯定有不少历史。它有特别的名字之类的吗？
		
		凯特摇摇头。“或许曾经有过，但就算有，也早已失传了。爸爸设法弄到、又和我一起读过的所有古代埃斯特洛尔记录，都只把它称作‘那座灯塔’。就好像……这种东西对他们来说太过寻常，根本不值得特别在意。
		
		“埃斯特洛尔与科尔米诺斯共同建造了它。”粉色小猫指向灯塔基座与周围峭壁之间的鲜明差异。“米诺斯工程师没能在贝尔哈人指定的地点找到适合安置灯塔的位置，于是学院召来了一群法师。据说他们劈开大地，从地底深处推出了一根坚固的岩柱……这不正好与我们眼前所见吻合吗？”
		]
		
		你的目光沿着通往灯塔的道路向上移去。那是一组在斜坡上凿出的曲折台阶，没有扶手，也没有支撑，稍有失足就可能一路滚到最底下。阶梯顶端的灯塔形似一只从大地伸出的手，掌中紧握着一颗巨大的水晶球。即使相隔这么远，你也能在饱经风霜、混浊不清的水晶中隐约看见一些轮廓，似乎是某种机械装置。
		
		[party.has cait
		|凯特顺着你的视线望去，带着歉意笑了笑。“很夸张，对吧？埃斯特洛尔就是这种风格。”
		
		他们为了一个灯塔就大费周章到这种地步？
		
		她笑得更灿烂了。“它把当时这片地区最执着的两个群体凑到了一起。爸爸想来看它是有原因的。”
		]
		
		这么说，这是一座魔法信标——你看不到任何升降机的遗迹，而沿那些台阶运送燃料未免太过危险。一只从大地伸出的手，从掌心向海面投射光束，而这一切仅仅是为了一座灯塔……放到今天，这是对力量与精力的惊人浪费；对过去的人们而言，却不过举手之劳。它竟能延续至今而未彻底荒废……恶魔进军时没有怎么破坏它，简直算得上一场小小的奇迹。

rows.original: The road continues winding down — or up — the mountainside, this section of cliff more exposed as the coast draws ever closer. Here, the winds pick up speed as one leaves the shelter of the mountain, heading inland from the sea and bringing with them all matter of chill rain. The roar of waves breaking against the limestone cliffs is still distant, but now audible. An triumphal arch spans the road, a minotaur and cowgirl on either side; the former holds up his side of the arch in an exaggerated pose of burden while the latter measures and smooths down the pillar on her side with some kind of hand grinder. Of course, both sides of the arch bear stains you'd rather not take too close of a look at. Carvings on the mountainside base state the arch was erected in commemoration of minoan triumph over coastal orcish raiders, with a protracted conflict over a decade finally seeing them off. [party.has arona |"Hey, don't give me that stink-eye," Arona grunts, folding her arms. "Plenty of other tribes than the Kervus in these seas. It wasn't us, and if it was it certainly was before my, Argoth's, or anyone else's time. As much as I'd like it, we can't be everywhere fighting everyone all the time." ]
rows.translation: 道路继续蜿蜒着，或是向下延伸，或是向上攀登，穿过山坡。当海岸线逐渐临近时，这一段的悬崖就变得更加陡峭了。在这里，一旦离开了山脉的庇护，风速就会加快。这些从海洋吹向内陆的风，会带来阵阵寒冷的雨滴。海浪撞击石灰岩悬崖发出的轰鸣声虽然还很遥远，但现在已经可以听到了。 一座胜利拱门横跨道路两侧，拱门的两侧分别雕刻着弥诺陶洛斯和女牛仔的形象；前者以一种夸张的姿势支撑着自己那一侧的拱门，而后者则用某种手工磨具仔细地打磨着自己那一侧的柱子，使其表面变得光滑平整。当然，拱门的这两侧都有一些你根本不想仔细看的污渍。 山体基部上的雕刻记载着，这座拱门是为了纪念米诺斯人战胜沿海的兽人袭击者而建立的。这场持续了十多年的漫长战争，最终将那些兽人赶出了这片地区。 [party.has arona |嘿，别用那种眼神看着我，”阿罗娜嘟囔着，双臂交叉抱在胸前。“在这片海域里，除了克尔维斯族，还有很多其他的部落。不是我们干的；如果真是我们，那肯定发生在我的时代之前，也发生在阿尔戈斯的时代之前，甚至发生在任何人的时代之前。尽管我非常希望如此，但我们不可能总是到处奔波，与所有人战斗。 ]
rows.raw: "The road continues winding down — or up — the mountainside, this section of cliff more exposed as the coast draws ever closer. Here, the winds pick up speed as one leaves the shelter of the mountain, heading inland from the sea and bringing with them all matter of chill rain. The roar of waves breaking against the limestone cliffs is still distant, but now audible. An triumphal arch spans the road, a minotaur and cowgirl on either side; the former holds up his side of the arch in an exaggerated pose of burden while the latter measures and smooths down the pillar on her side with some kind of hand grinder. Of course, both sides of the arch bear stains you'd rather not take too close of a look at. Carvings on the mountainside base state the arch was erected in commemoration of minoan triumph over coastal orcish raiders, with a protracted conflict over a decade finally seeing them off. [party.has arona |"Hey, don't give me that stink-eye," Arona grunts, folding her arms. "Plenty of other tribes than the Kervus in these seas. It wasn't us, and if it was it certainly was before my, Argoth's, or anyone else's time. As much as I'd like it, we can't be everywhere fighting everyone all the time." ]"

rows.original:
The remains of a small — by minotaur proportions, anyway — inn lie here, the business itself cut into the cliffside. A small courtyard by the road leads into a series of repurposed caverns, the walls smoothed and lined with masonry to give it that feel of civilization; hitching posts for carts and animals lie smashed and broken by the entrance. In more peaceful times, such an establishment would have been close enough to the bazaar and gates to shelter those waiting the night for the latter to open, yet distant enough to have its own footprint. 

		Now, what was a piece of minoan ingenuity and resourcefulness is just a sad footnote — the boarded-up door's been broken into and anything remaining long since plundered. To add insult to injury, the demons billeted their numbers in the abandoned inn, with predictable results. Perhaps the place is still salvageable, but until someone sufficiently enterprising and diligent shows up to clean up the place and air out the stench — along with foot traffic up the cliffs — things are what they are.
rows.translation:
这里残存着一间规模极小的客栈——至少以弥诺陶洛斯的标准来看是如此。这家客栈本身就是开在悬崖边上。道路旁有一个小庭院，通向一系列被改造过的洞穴。这些洞穴的墙壁经过修整，用石料砌成，从而营造出一种文明的气息；用于拴住马车和牲畜的木桩在入口处被撞得粉碎。在更为平静的年代，这样的建筑本应位于靠近集市和城门的地方，这样就能为那些整夜等待城门开放的人们提供庇护；同时，它也应该保持一定的距离，以便拥有属于自己的空间和功能。

		然而如今，这一充满米诺斯人智慧与巧思的建筑，只不过成了一个令人惋惜的遗迹罢了——那些用木板封住的门早已被破拆，里面剩下的东西也早就被洗劫一空。更糟糕的是，那些恶魔把他们的据点设在了那家废弃的客栈里，结果自然可想而知。也许这个地方还有恢复的可能，但除非有某个足够有魄力且勤奋的人出现，来清理这个地方、消除那些恶臭——同时还要有人愿意沿着悬崖攀登上去，让这些地方重新恢复生机——否则现状就是这样的。

A small courtyard by the road leads into a series of repurposed caverns, the walls smoothed and lined with masonry to give it that feel of civilization; hitching posts for carts and animals lie smashed and broken by the entrance. In more peaceful times, such an establishment would have been close enough to the bazaar and gates to shelter those waiting the night for the latter to open, yet distant enough to have its own footprint. \n\n\t\tNow, what was a piece of minoan ingenuity and resourcefulness is just a sad footnote — the boarded-up door's been broken into and anything remaining long since plundered. To add insult to injury, the demons billeted their numbers in the abandoned inn, with predictable results. Perhaps the place is still salvageable, but until someone sufficiently enterprising and diligent shows up to clean up the place and air out the stench — along with foot traffic up the cliffs — things are what they are."

rows.original:
The winding road continues along the cliffside, its slope gradual and measured; the path may be long, but it is not taxing. The time spent traversing it gives one time to savor the sights — and for any defenders watching from above to have adequate time to prepare. One notes that this stretch of road and many others like it are well within sight of anyone watching from the mountain entrance far above.

		Perhaps the truly remarkable thing about your surroundings is how unremarkable they are — considering the demon host that recently passed through, for this stretch of road to be more or less untouched is notable in and of itself. How it's managed to avoid being despoiled isn't immediately apparent, but there has to be some reason for it, right?
rows.translation:
这条蜿蜒的小路沿着悬崖边缘延伸，坡度平缓而有序；虽然路程可能较长，但并不会让人感到疲惫。在行走的过程中，人们有足够的时间欣赏沿途的风景——而对于那些从上方监视的防御者来说，也足以让他们有充分的时间做好准备。可以注意到，这条道路以及许多类似的道路，从高高的山口处望去，全都清晰可见。

		或许，你周围环境真正值得注意的地方，恰恰在于它们显得如此平凡无奇——考虑到最近有恶魔大军经过这里，这条道路几乎未受任何影响，这一事实本身就已经很引人注目了。目前还不清楚它是如何避免被破坏的，但肯定存在某种原因，对吧？
rows.raw: "The winding road continues along the cliffside, its slope gradual and measured; the path may be long, but it is not taxing. The time spent traversing it gives one time to savor the sights — and for any defenders watching from above to have adequate time to prepare. One notes that this stretch of road and many others like it are well within sight of anyone watching from the mountain entrance far above.\n\n\t\tPerhaps the truly remarkable thing about your surroundings is how unremarkable they are — considering the demon host that recently passed through, for this stretch of road to be more or less untouched is notable in and of itself. How it's managed to avoid being despoiled isn't immediately apparent, but there has to be some reason for it, right?"

rows.original:
The middle bend in the road leads you under a series of high, vertical cliffs, and right into a squawking mess. The area's prime nesting ground for a massive, mixed colony of gulls and pigeons, and though their numbers have thinned thanks to the demons if the empty nests are any indication, there're still enough of the winged rats that they kick up a cacophony of an alarm at your approach, however far below their perches you may be.

		Thankfully, the road doesn't take you directly under their nests — and a good thing too, as the rock below their overhang is absolutely coated with their droppings to the point it's formed a layer akin to guano. The remains of a couple shacks with several barrels and shovels nearby suggest that collecting the stuff for use as fertilizer in undermountain farms was taking place, but the demons certainly put a stop to that.
rows.translation:
道路中间的那个弯道会让你穿过一系列高耸的垂直悬崖，然后立刻进入一片嘈杂喧闹的区域。这里是一大群海鸥和鸽子的理想筑巢地，虽然由于那些恶魔的影响，它们的数量已经有所减少，但从那些空荡荡的巢穴来看，仍然有足够的这些“有翼老鼠”存在。因此，无论你距离它们的栖息地有多远，当你靠近时，它们都会发出一阵嘈杂的警报声。

		幸运的是，这条路并不会直接经过它们的巢穴下方——这也真是件好事，因为它们悬岩下方的岩石上覆盖着它们排泄的废物，这些废物堆积起来，形成了一层类似于鸟粪的沉积物。附近还有一些简陋的小屋遗迹，以及几桶和几把铲子，这些迹象表明，人们曾经在这里收集这些废物，用来作为山脚下的农场的肥料，但那些恶魔显然阻止了这种行为。

The remains of a couple shacks with several barrels and shovels nearby suggest that collecting the stuff for use as fertilizer in undermountain farms was taking place, but the demons certainly put a stop to that."

rows.original:
The road's incline suddenly grows at this bend — from here on out, it's a straight line all the way down to the beach just below. Nevertheless, even this forward stretch of cliff face towers over the rocky sands, greyish-white limestone worn away to expose a craggy facade comprised of alternating layers of light and dark rock. It may take centuries, but eventually the road itself will collapse, undermined by the constant pounding of wind and surf.

		From this point in the road, you're as high up as one can get while also being so close to the sea. Evidently, you're not the only one who's found merit in the view, for guardrails have been put up about the bend's eastern edge, with a warning in Belharan and minoan alike warning of unstable footing and to not cross that point.
rows.translation:
在这个弯道处，道路的坡度突然加剧了——从这里开始，道路是一条笔直的下坡路，一直延伸到下方的海滩。即便如此，这段连续的悬崖峭壁依然高出那些岩石遍布的沙滩许多，灰白色的石灰岩在长期的风化作用下被侵蚀得千疮百孔，形成了由浅色和深色岩石层交替构成的崎岖地貌。虽然这可能需要几个世纪的时间，但最终，这条道路终究会在风和海浪的持续侵蚀下坍塌。

		从这条道路的这一段开始，你将处于尽可能高的位置，同时也会非常接近大海。显然，不止你一个人认为这种观点有道理，因为在那个弯道的东侧边缘已经设置了护栏，而且无论是贝尔哈兰人还是米诺斯人，都在那里设置了警告标志，提醒人们那里的地面不稳定，千万不要跨越那个位置。
rows.raw: "The road's incline suddenly grows at this bend — from here on out, it's a straight line all the way down to the beach just below. Nevertheless, even this forward stretch of cliff face towers over the rocky sands, greyish-white limestone worn away to expose a craggy facade comprised of alternating layers of light and dark rock. It may take centuries, but eventually the road itself will collapse, undermined by the constant pounding of wind and surf.\n\n\t\tFrom this point in the road, you're as high up as one can get while also being so close to the sea. Evidently, you're not the only one who's found merit in the view, for guardrails have been put up about the bend's eastern edge, with a warning in Belharan and minoan alike warning of unstable footing and to not cross that point."

rows.original: The cliffs facing this stretch of road are pockmarked with indentations and even outright tunnels, the softer, lighter rock having been worn away by sun and wind to leave its darker, more resilient cousin behind. The end result is a honeycomb-like structure in the cliff face that emits all kinds of melancholy moans and wails — soft and on the edge of one's hearing in the usual sea breeze, but rising into a much louder ghastly howl when a storm rolls inland and breaks itself against the mountain. An instrument of the gods, albeit with music no one appreciates; if there were any other way up the mountain that didn't pass by these cliff faces, surely the road would've taken that instead. Unsurprisingly, the local harpies have taken these wailing tunnels as a sacred site — or took, anyway. Empty harpy nests, torn feathered fetishes, and now-defaced holy symbols are all that remain; the rust-brown stains of old blood suggest that the feathered fiends fought with fanatical fervor to defend holy ground, but were eventually overwhelmed by the demons' advance. Whether they retreated up the mountain or met another end... well, who knows. Perhaps with the demons having fallen back, the harpies will return.
rows.translation: 这段道路旁的崖壁布满凹坑，甚至还有贯通的隧洞；质地较软、颜色较浅的岩层经年遭受日晒风蚀，只留下了颜色更深、更坚韧的岩石。最终，崖壁形成了蜂巢般的结构，发出种种忧郁的呻吟与哀号——平日海风吹拂时，那声音轻得几乎听不见；可一旦风暴自内陆席卷而来、撞上山体，它便会升为响亮而骇人的嚎叫。这是众神的乐器，只可惜无人欣赏它奏出的音乐；如果还有别的上山道路不必经过这些崖壁，这条路肯定早就改走那条路了。 毫不意外，当地的鹰身女妖曾将这些哀号不止的隧洞视为圣地。如今只剩空荡荡的巢穴、撕裂的羽毛祭物和遭到毁坏的神圣符号；锈褐色的陈年血迹表明，这些羽族恶徒曾以狂热的意志守卫圣地，却最终被恶魔的攻势压垮。她们究竟是退往山上，还是遭遇了别的结局……谁知道呢。也许随着恶魔撤退，鹰身女妖还会回来。

The end result is a honeycomb-like structure in the cliff face that emits all kinds of melancholy moans and wails — soft and on the edge of one's hearing in the usual sea breeze, but rising into a much louder ghastly howl when a storm rolls inland and breaks itself against the mountain. Empty harpy nests, torn feathered fetishes, and now-defaced holy symbols are all that remain; the rust-brown stains of old blood suggest that the feathered fiends fought with fanatical fervor to defend holy ground, but were eventually overwhelmed by the demons' advance. rows.original:
A bridge over a pool — water pours out from the cliff face from some underground stream, collects in a pond atop the mountain shelf, then flows past the bridge and careens all the way down to the sea below in a massive shower of spray that glints in the [dayNight|sun|moon]light. Brought straight down from its snowmelt source in the windy peaks, the water's as clear and sweet as any one can get in all the mountain, and it feels a shame that it would have such a short life in the sun before joining the sea.

		A good place for travelers to take on water before facing the rest of the climb: several benches rest by the water in the shade of a small grove. In their middle is a statue of an elf and a minotaur, arms outstretched towards each other in friendship as they overlook the road from their plinth. The bronze plaque may have weathered over the centuries to the point of illegibility, but the statue's meaning is clear.
		
		It's a welcome respite from the harsh, melancholy cliffs, if nothing else.
rows.translation:
一座横跨水塘的桥——山体表面的悬崖处有地下溪流涌出，水流在山脊上汇聚成一片水塘，然后从桥下流过，最终以巨大的水花倾泻而下，那些水花在阳光下闪烁着光芒[dayNight|太阳|月亮]这清泉从风雪交加的山峰中流淌下来，其水质清澈甘甜，是整个山区最优质的水源。可惜，它在阳光下仅仅停留片刻，就不得不汇入大海，真是令人惋惜。

		对于旅行者来说，在继续攀登之前在这里补充水分是个不错的选择：几张长椅架设在小树林的荫凉处，旁边有水源。在这些长椅的中间，矗立着一座精灵与弥诺陶洛斯的雕像，他们伸出双臂，彼此友好地相望，从基座上俯瞰着道路。虽然那块青铜牌匾在几个世纪的风雨侵蚀下已经变得难以辨认，但这座雕像所表达的意义却依然清晰可见。
		
		至少，它为人们提供了一种远离那些崎岖而阴郁的悬崖的惬意方式。

"A bridge over a pool — water pours out from the cliff face from some underground stream, collects in a pond atop the mountain shelf, then flows past the bridge and careens all the way down to the sea below in a massive shower of spray that glints in the [dayNight|sun|moon]light. 		A good place for travelers to take on water before facing the rest of the climb: several benches rest by the water in the shade of a small grove. In their middle is a statue of an elf and a minotaur, arms outstretched towards each other in friendship as they overlook the road from their plinth. The bronze plaque may have weathered over the centuries to the point of illegibility, but the statue's meaning is clear.
		
		It's a welcome respite from the harsh, melancholy cliffs, if nothing else."

rows.original:
Here on out, this section of road winds towards the coast in earnest, leaving the safety of the mountainside via passing through what can only be described as a miniature valley. What started off as a quarry has widened as remaining viable stone deposits were to be found further and further away from the mountainside, resulting in a road that's now to one side of said quarry instead of cutting through it.

		There's little doubt the quarried limestone was processed on the spot to produce cement and other materials for the road's upkeep; built into the quarry walls, the minotaurs' crushers and mixers are far too heavy and cumbersome for the demons to have pilfered. Judging by the scuffing and stains on some of the gargantuan devices, the demons attempted to operate them for their own purposes, but lacked the patience to see the grueling task through.
rows.translation:
从这里开始，这条道路开始真正地蜿蜒向着海岸方向延伸，它在穿过一个只能被形容为微型山谷的地方后，便离开了山体的庇护。最初这里只是一个采石场，但随着可开采的石料逐渐向远离山体的地方转移，这个采石场也不断扩大，最终这条道路并没有穿过它，而是从它的一侧绕了过去。

		几乎可以肯定，这些从采石场开采出来的石灰石是在现场就被加工成了水泥以及其他用于道路维护的材料；那些安装在采石场墙壁上的粉碎机和搅拌机体积庞大、十分沉重，恶魔根本不可能将它们偷走。从那些巨型设备上留下的擦痕和污渍来看，那些恶魔试图将这些设备用于自己的目的，但他们缺乏耐心，无法坚持完成这项艰巨的任务。

What started off as a quarry has widened as remaining viable stone deposits were to be found further and further away from the mountainside, resulting in a road that's now to one side of said quarry instead of cutting through it.\n\n\t\tThere's little doubt the quarried limestone was processed on the spot to produce cement and other materials for the road's upkeep; built into the quarry walls, the minotaurs' crushers and mixers are far too heavy and cumbersome for the demons to have pilfered. Judging by the scuffing and stains on some of the gargantuan devices, the demons attempted to operate them for their own purposes, but lacked the patience to see the grueling task through."

rows.original:
This section of road inclines sharply, enough for steps to be cut into one half along its middle, while the other sports a series of winches and pulleys for heavy vehicles to be dragged up or down a steep ramp. One wonders what it is about this stretch that the minoans and belharans alike couldn't terraform it into a gentler incline, given that such a feat should have been within their power; one can only assume there was a very good reason, now lost to time. Heavyset carts and wagons sit abandoned under the eave of the cliffs; with enough time, they would have been able to make the climb with the mechanisms' aid, but time was no doubt in short supply for those being evacuated towards Khor'minos.

		The constant whisper of the sea breeze only adds to the sense of desolation that's most intense amongst these cliffs. Several hardy trees cling to existence in addition to the scrub that thrives in the cracks of the cliffs, but somehow the relative flourishing of life only adds to the melancholic atmosphere. It's as if something great and terrible once happened at this spot, and left such a deep impression that mental echoes still linger long after the fact.
rows.translation:
这段道路坡度陡然升高，以至于中间一半被凿成台阶，另一半则装有一系列绞盘与滑轮，用来把重型车辆拖上或放下陡坡。米诺斯人与贝尔哈人都拥有改造地形的力量，却为何没能把这里变成较为平缓的斜坡，实在令人疑惑；只能假定其中曾有一个充分理由，只是如今早已被时间遗忘。沉重的马车与货车被遗弃在峭壁檐下；只要时间充足，它们本可借助机械爬上这段坡道，但对于那些撤往科尔米诺斯的人而言，时间无疑十分紧迫。

		海风不间断的低语，只让这些峭壁间本就强烈的荒凉感更加深重。除了在崖缝中茁壮生长的灌木，还有几棵坚韧的树木勉强存活；可不知为何，这些相对繁盛的生命反而让氛围更加忧郁。仿佛这里曾经发生过某件宏大而可怕的事情，留下了无比深刻的印记，以至于精神上的回响在许久之后仍未消散。
rows.raw: "This section of road inclines sharply, enough for steps to be cut into one half along its middle, while the other sports a series of winches and pulleys for heavy vehicles to be dragged up or down a steep ramp. One wonders what it is about this stretch that the minoans and belharans alike couldn't terraform it into a gentler incline, given that such a feat should have been within their power; one can only assume there was a very good reason, now lost to time. Heavyset carts and wagons sit abandoned under the eave of the cliffs; with enough time, they would have been able to make the climb with the mechanisms' aid, but time was no doubt in short supply for those being evacuated towards Khor'minos.\n\n\t\tThe constant whisper of the sea breeze only adds to the sense of desolation that's most intense amongst these cliffs. Several hardy trees cling to existence in addition to the scrub that thrives in the cracks of the cliffs, but somehow the relative flourishing of life only adds to the melancholic atmosphere. It's as if something great and terrible once happened at this spot, and left such a deep impression that mental echoes still linger long after the fact."

rows.original:
There's an alcove here. The entrance is unremarkable, but the odor of death lingers.

		You turn away.
rows.translation:
这里有一处凹穴。入口毫不起眼，却萦绕着死亡的气息。

		你转身离开。
rows.raw: "There's an alcove here. The entrance is unremarkable, but the odor of death lingers.\n\n\t\tYou turn away."

rows.original:
This section of road is home to an engineers' outpost — testament to how much maintenance the Highcliff Road constantly needed, and without which is slowly falling into disrepair, the demons' depredations notwithstanding. An affair of masonry cut from the limestone cliffs, the outpost is perhaps enough to station a half-dozen minotaurs responsible for the inspection and upkeep of the road's structural integrity. Given the spartan state of the lodgings and the equally miserable distance from either Khor'minos or Khor'elthos, the assignment seems to be punitive in spirit if not in fact.

		Now it stands abandoned, the materials in the yard long since pilfered, leaving only depressions in the earth where pallets of cement, gravel and reinforced supports were stacked. The engineers' duty schedule, flapping forlornly in the sea breeze, dates the last road inspection at quite some time ago — and the hurried truncation of said schedule suggests the timing of the demons' advance.
rows.translation:
这段道路旁设有一处工程师哨所——足以证明高崖路一直需要大量维护；即便不考虑恶魔的破坏，失去维护后它也正在缓慢失修。哨所由石灰岩峭壁中切出的石材砌成，大概足以驻扎六名负责检查和维护道路结构完整性的弥诺陶洛斯。住处如此简陋，而它与科尔米诺斯和科尔艾尔索斯之间的距离又同样令人绝望，这项任命就算名义上不是惩罚，精神上也差不了多少。

		如今哨所已经荒废，院中的材料早被洗劫一空，只在地面留下曾经堆放水泥、碎石和加固支撑架的凹痕。工程师的值勤表孤零零地在海风中拍打，上面记录的最后一次道路检查已是很久以前——日程被仓促中止的痕迹，也暗示了恶魔进军的时间。

rows.original:
The seaside end of the Highcliff Road houses an abandoned hobgoblin village; the simple homes and ramshackle fishing jetties once formed a natural gathering spot for those travelling from Khor'elthos into the mountain before making the ascent. Sun-bleached and now thoroughly defaced signs advertise porter services at reasonable prices — with how many of them there are, this was likely the hobgoblins' sole outside source of income before this entire mess began. The hobgoblin houses are too small to billet anything but imps and not worth the wood and rope they're built of, so they still stand despite the demons having swept over it in their advance. A cozy inlet and flight of wooden stairs allows for a small jetty at which a couple simple fishing boats are moored, bobbing forlornly as they await owners who may well never return.

		Past the final marker, the paved road gives way to sharp gravel that crunches underfoot. After the constant incline of the Highcliff Road, it's good to finally have some stable footing. There's still a little way to go before one's finally at sea level, but at least there isn't any further risk of fatal falls.
rows.translation:
Highcliff Road的海滨段有一座被废弃的地精村庄；那些从Khor'elthos出发、准备攀登山脉的人，曾经会来到这些简陋的房屋和破败的渔船码头，这里曾是他们自然的聚集地。那些被阳光晒得褪了色的、如今早已破败不堪的告示牌，上面写着以合理的价格提供搬运服务。考虑到这类告示牌的数量之多，在这场混乱之前，这些服务很可能是地精们唯一的外部收入来源。地精们的小屋太小了，根本无法容纳除了小妖精之外的其他生物，而且建造这些小屋所消耗的木材和绳索也实在不值那个价，因此尽管恶魔们在这片地区肆虐，这些小屋依然矗立在那里。一条舒适的小湾和一段木制楼梯通往一个小码头，那里停着几艘简单的渔船，它们孤独地摇晃着，等待着可能永远也不会回来的主人。

		穿过最后一个标志牌后，铺设好的道路变成了坚硬的碎石路，走在上面会发出刺耳的声响。在经历了Highcliff Road那段持续不断的陡峭路段之后，终于能够踏上一些较为平坦的地面，真是让人感到欣慰。虽然距离海平面还有那么一段距离要走，但至少不会再有致命坠落的风险了。

rows.original: You're perhaps a hundred feet above the rest of the road now, connected to it only by a narrow path that you had to walk sideways to ascend, assisted by handholds improvised from plant roots and craggy rocks. Where you're standing now is a flattened stretch of ground, home to a few scraps of cloth flapping in the wind from wooden stakes driven into the ground. There are a number of circular marks on the ground where the stone's been worn almost smooth, and here you see the most scraps of cloth and tanned hide concentrated. Evidence of tents, or small huts? Very small. The only thing actually standing here now, though, is a totem in the middle of the plain. It is crude, but the shape of a dragon with its wings curled around its body is unmistakable. Streamers of cloth are tied around its horns, claws, and tail like ribbons, all bleached white by years spent under the hammering sun. All of this is simple, small, almost childlike in its reverence of an impossibly large creature rendered by tiny hands: the work of kobolds. Looming above you is a yawning black chasm in the mountainside, too big to really be called just a cave. The wind howls as it passes by the entrance... or maybe roars.[flags.GOAT_WRANGLED|| Between you and there, though, seemingly unconcerned with the menacing void in the stone are about thirty large goats, merrily plucking grass out from the rocky outcroppings away from the road below.]
rows.translation: 你现在大概位于道路其他部分的百英尺之上，与下方道路仅通过一条狭窄的小路相连。要想登上这个高处，你必须侧着身子行走，同时还要借助那些用植物根茎和崎岖的岩石临时制作的扶手来辅助攀登。你现在站立的地方是一片平坦的地面，地上有几块布片被插在地面上的木桩固定着，在风中飘动。地面上有许多圆形的痕迹，那些地方的石头已经被磨得几乎光滑了。在这里，你可以看到最多的布片和鞣制过的皮革残渣。这些难道是帐篷或小棚屋的痕迹吗？非常很小。 然而，现在这里唯一剩下的，就是平原中央那座图腾。它虽然粗糙，但那条身体周围盘绕着翅膀的龙的形象却十分明显。布条被系在它的角、爪子和尾巴上，就像彩带一样，而这些布条都因为在烈日的照射下经历了多年的时间，已经变成了白色。这一切都显得如此简单、朴素，甚至带着几分孩童般的纯真——那些微小的双手塑造出了这样一个庞大而不可思议的生物，而这一切，都是狗头人们的杰作。 在你头顶上方，山体上裂开了一道巨大的黑色深渊，它的规模实在太大，根本不能称之为普通的洞穴。风呼啸着掠过入口……或许也是如此。咆哮声。[flags.GOAT_WRANGLED|| 不过，在你和我之间的这片区域，似乎有大约三十只大山羊，它们毫不在意石头上那令人胆寒的裂口，而是在远离下方道路的岩石丛中开心地啃食着青草。]

rows.original: You've climbed back up to a point even higher than the entrance back to Khor'minos now, soaring high above the sheer coastal cliffs. Technically you're up in the mountains again, though the exact point where that transition began is hard to pinpoint — and looking down makes your head swim with alarm. The sight ahead isn't much more reassuring. Facing you from the mountainside is a black void in the stone, cold and dank in a way that makes you shiver before you've even set foot inside. And then there's the skeletons... there's a lot of skeletons strewn around the cavern's mouth. Humans, orcs, kobolds, minotaurs and other beastkin, all lain low by that which lurks within the darkness and left to bake in the sun. Scattered scraps of armor and shattered bronze blades are strewn amongst the dead, bearing signs of origin from far beyond Khor'minos. Jassiran curved blades intermingled with Minoan labryses and Old Belharan short swords; some you don't recognize at all. This is a legacy of death that spans the known world, and the depths of time.
rows.translation: 你现在已经爬到了一个比进入科尔米诺斯入口处还要高的位置，高高耸立在陡峭的海岸悬崖之上。从技术上来说，你又回到了山区，不过这种转变究竟从哪里开始，其实很难确定——而往下看的话，只会让你感到一阵头晕目眩、心生恐惧。 前方的景象同样令人不安。从山坡上望去，那里有一处被岩石构成的黑色空洞，那里寒冷而潮湿，甚至在你还未踏入其中之前，就会让你不寒而栗。更何况，那里还有那些骷髅…… 有很多洞穴入口处散落着无数的骷髅。人类、兽人、狗头人、弥诺陶洛斯以及其他各种野兽种族的尸体，都被隐藏在黑暗中的某种怪物杀害，随后被丢弃在这里，在阳光下曝晒。散落的盔甲碎片和破碎的青铜剑刃中，有些明显来自遥远的科尔米诺斯之外。贾西兰式的弯刀与米诺斯的战斧、古老的贝尔哈兰短剑混杂在一起——其中有些武器，你甚至根本无法辨认出它们的来历。这些，都是跨越已知世界与漫长岁月的死亡遗迹。

This is a legacy of death that spans the known world, and the depths of time."

rows.original:
The seaward approach is more gradual than the Highcliff Road, but harsher on the feet: sharp, angular gravel crunches underfoot, constantly shifting ever so slightly as opposed to the firm footing of a paved road. Once, this terrain might have been part of the cliffs, but the constant pounding of the waves has collapsed them into gravel-strewn... well, %"hills" would be a generous way to describe them. Over time, these too will be worn down, turn into the rough grey sand and soil that you see ahead in the distance.

		Dislodged from the cliff face, limestone boulders lie gathering moss and providing shelter for what passes for life in this not exactly desolate, but very depressing landscape — a little green here and there does wonders to break up the dreariness of constant whites and greys.
		
		The beachward trail, inasmuch as it exists, was pioneered first by the evacuees from Khor'elthos and cemented later by the demons that came in their wake. Winding amidst the boulders, the going is easier than if you'd chosen to hoof it any old how, if marginally so.
rows.translation:
通往海边的道路比高崖路平缓，却更折磨双脚：尖锐而棱角分明的碎石在脚下嘎吱作响，与铺砌道路的稳固落脚点不同，它们始终在轻微滑动。这里或许曾是峭壁的一部分，但海浪持续不断的冲击令其坍塌成铺满碎石的……嗯，称之为%“丘陵”都算十分慷慨。随着时间推移，它们也会继续受到磨蚀，最终变成你在远方看见的粗糙灰沙与土壤。

		从崖面脱落的石灰岩巨石静静长着苔藓，也为这片不算彻底荒芜、却格外压抑的景观中勉强存在的生命提供庇护——这里那里点缀的一抹绿色，多少能打破无尽白色与灰色带来的沉闷。
		
		这条勉强称得上道路的海滩小径，最初由撤离科尔艾尔索斯的人们踏出，后来又被尾随而来的恶魔走得更加坚实。道路在巨石间蜿蜒；与随意找个方向埋头前进相比，沿它行走确实轻松一点，尽管也只是一点。
