rows.raw: "\n            You've met Liaden, a warrior-priestess of Lumia, who's agreed to help you. Meet her back in Azzy's part of the grove to begin the purification."

rows.original: You've introduced Liaden to Azzy, and the three of you are ready to tackle the hive as soon as you're ready.
rows.translation: 你已经把李亚登介绍给了阿齐，现在你们三个人已经准备好了，随时可以开始对付那个蜂巢了。
rows.raw: "\n            You've introduced Liaden to Azzy, and the three of you are ready to tackle the hive as soon as you're ready."

rows.original: You've made it into the hornet hive. You'll need to find Queen Nyzerrah and subdue her. That will allow Liaden to actually get into the hive.
rows.translation: 你已经进入了黄蜂的巢穴。你必须找到奈泽拉女王并将其制服，这样莉娅登才能真正进入这个巢穴。
rows.raw: "\n            You've made it into the hornet hive. You'll need to find Queen Nyzerrah and subdue her. That will allow Liaden to actually get into the hive."

rows.original: You've defeated Queen Nyzerrah. You should help Liaden purify the hornets' honey reserves, back on the 1st floor.
rows.translation: 你已经击败了奈泽拉女王。现在你应该去一楼，帮助莉娅登清理黄蜂储存的蜂蜜。
rows.raw: "\n            You've defeated Queen Nyzerrah. You should help Liaden purify the hornets' honey reserves, back on the 1st floor."

rows.original: You've completed the ritual, but the changes will take some time to process. Come back after 24 hours to see the hive restored to its former glory and debrief with the queen.
rows.translation: 你已经完成了这个仪式，但这些变化需要一些时间才能显现效果。24小时后再来查看，那时蜂巢一定会恢复往日的辉煌，你也可以与蜂后进行交流。
rows.raw: "\n            You've completed the ritual, but the changes will take some time to process. Come back after 24 hours to see the hive restored to its former glory and debrief with the queen."

rows.original: You've resolved the hive's problems, and now Azzy has sworn herself to your cause.
rows.translation: 你已经解决了蜂巢面临的问题，现在阿齐也宣誓要支持你的事业了。
rows.raw: "\n            You've resolved the hive's problems, and now Azzy has sworn herself to your cause."

rows.translation: 狐妖巢穴

rows.original: Lady Evergreen's asked you to retrieve her bountiful bag from the kitsune who filched it. She imagines that you ought to be able to find it in their den to the northwest of the Frostwood. It should be just a little round trip and some talking, right?[flags.KIYOKO_ENCOUNTER| Besides, you know the true reason why you're heading into such a place, and it's got nothing to do with Evergreen. This might be your best bet for helping Kiyoko out of her predicament.]
rows.translation: 常青女士请求你从那个偷走她财袋的狐妖手中把她的财袋取回来。她认为你应该能够在霜木镇西北方向的狐妖巢穴里找到它。不过，这应该只是趟短途的行程，再加上一些简单的交涉而已，对吧？[flags.KIYOKO_ENCOUNTER| 此外，你心里很清楚自己之所以要去那个地方，真正的原因与常青女士毫无关系。这或许才是帮助清子摆脱困境的最佳办法。]
rows.raw: "\n            Lady Evergreen's asked you to retrieve her bountiful bag from the kitsune who filched it. She imagines that you ought to be able to find it in their den to the northwest of the Frostwood. It should be just a little round trip and some talking, right?[flags.KIYOKO_ENCOUNTER| Besides, you know the true reason why you're heading into such a place, and it's got nothing to do with Evergreen. This might be your best bet for helping Kiyoko out of her predicament.]"

rows.original: Since this is where the people most likely to be able to help Kiyoko live, it might be a smart idea to turn back and pick up her amulet before heading on in; you have the suspicion that matters might change significantly in your favor were you to do so. Considering your promise to her, backtracking and returning with the amulet in your possession would be highly advisable.
rows.translation: 既然这里是最有可能有人能够帮助清子生存的地方，那么在继续前进之前回去取回她的护身符或许是个明智的决定；你怀疑，如果那样做，情况很可能会朝着对你有利的方向发展。考虑到你对她的承诺，回去并把护身符带回来确实是十分明智的选择。
rows.raw: "\n            Since this is where the people most likely to be able to help Kiyoko live, it might be a smart idea to turn back and pick up her amulet before heading on in; you have the suspicion that matters might change significantly in your favor were you to do so. Considering your promise to her, backtracking and returning with the amulet in your possession would be highly advisable."

rows.original: With the amulet and its amber orb in your possession, you feel secure in its ability to protect you from any terrible fate that might await you inside the cherry blossom tree. It's time to enter.
rows.translation: 当你拥有这件护身符以及它那琥珀色的球体时，你会感到安心，因为相信它一定能保护你免受樱花树内可能降临的任何可怕命运。是时候进入去了。
rows.raw: "\n            With the amulet and its amber orb in your possession, you feel secure in its ability to protect you from any terrible fate that might await you inside the cherry blossom tree. It's time to enter."

rows.original: Thanks to you having Kiyoko's amulet on you, you've been able to avoid an altercation with the Shrine Mother and retrieve Evergreen's bountiful bag from her great-great-granddaughter. All you have to do now is deliver the goods to their rightful owner and collect your payment for services rendered.
rows.translation: 多亏你身上带着清子的护身符，你才得以避免与神社的女祭司发生冲突，并从她的高曾孙女手中取回了常青女士的丰厚奖励。现在你只需要将这些东西交给它们的合法主人，然后收取你应得的报酬即可。
rows.raw: "\n            Thanks to you having Kiyoko's amulet on you, you've been able to avoid an altercation with the Shrine Mother and retrieve Evergreen's bountiful bag from her great-great-granddaughter. All you have to do now is deliver the goods to their rightful owner and collect your payment for services rendered."

rows.original: It's been a long trip, but you've beaten the Shrine Mother and forced her great-great-granddaughter to cough up Evergreen's bountiful bag. All you have to do now is deliver the goods to their rightful owner and collect your payment for services rendered.
rows.translation: 这一路走来确实颇为艰辛，但你们终于打败了神殿之母，迫使她的玄孙女交出了常青女士留下的丰厚奖励。现在，你们所要做的就是将这些奖励交给它们的合法主人，然后领取应得的报酬。
rows.raw: "\n            It's been a long trip, but you've beaten the Shrine Mother and forced her great-great-granddaughter to cough up Evergreen's bountiful bag. All you have to do now is deliver the goods to their rightful owner and collect your payment for services rendered."

rows.original: You've successfully returned Evergreen's bag to her. Considering its contents, it's little wonder why she was rather pleased to have it back. All's well that ends well, right?
rows.translation: 你已经成功地把常青女士的包还给了她。考虑到包里的东西，也就不难理解她为什么会这么高兴能把包拿回来。结果好总归是好事，对吧？
rows.raw: "\n            You've successfully returned Evergreen's bag to her. Considering its contents, it's little wonder why she was rather pleased to have it back. All's well that ends well, right?"

rows.original: Quintillus, the taeleer cultist you rescued, mentioned that he was going to try and get back on his feet. It's been a few days, yet nothing seems to have changed. Why not check in on him?
rows.translation: 你救下的泰勒族邪教徒昆蒂卢斯说过，他打算重新振作起来。几天过去了，情况却似乎毫无变化。何不去看看他？
rows.raw: "\n            Quintillus, the taeleer cultist you rescued, mentioned that he was going to try and get back on his feet. It's been a few days, yet nothing seems to have changed. Why not check in on him?"

rows.original:
After another quick chat, Quintillus mentioned needing a few extra supplies but is unable to obtain them himself. You need to gather the following items:<ul>
                  <li>A
rows.translation:
再次简短交谈后，昆蒂卢斯说他还需要一些额外物资，却无法自己取得。你需要收集以下物品：<ul>
                  <li>一
rows.raw: "\n                 After another quick chat, Quintillus mentioned needing a few extra supplies but is unable to obtain them himself. You need to gather the following items:<ul>\n                  <li>A "

rows.translation: 和
邪教护符
巫师戒指

rows.original: You have the items you need; bring them to Quintillus so he can join you!
rows.translation: 你已经收集齐所需物品；把它们交给昆蒂卢斯，他就能加入你了！
rows.raw: "\n            You have the items you need; bring them to Quintillus so he can join you!"

rows.original: You recruited Quintillus the taeleer; now that Quin is your companion, why not get to know him a little more?
rows.translation: 你招募了泰勒族的昆蒂卢斯；既然昆因已经成为同伴，何不多了解他一些？
rows.raw: "You recruited Quintillus the taeleer; now that Quin is your companion, why not get to know him a little more?"

rows.original: You declined to help Quintillus; the taeleer decided to try his luck elsewhere and has left.
rows.translation: 你拒绝帮助昆蒂卢斯；这名泰勒族人决定去别处碰碰运气，已经离开了。
rows.raw: "You declined to help Quintillus; the taeleer decided to try his luck elsewhere and has left."

rows.translation: 见面与问候

rows.original:
Owing to the circumstances in which you first entered the kitsune den, you may have gotten off on the wrong foot with these people. Before she has any further dealings with you, Den Matron Komari would like you to properly introduce yourself to the following people and ensure that all's right with them:<ul>
                <li>
rows.translation:
由于你最初进入狐妖窝时的那些情况，你可能与这些人产生了误会或矛盾。在麻里窝主进一步与你打交道之前，她希望你能向以下这些人好好做一下自我介绍，确保你们之间的关系没有问题。<ul>
                <li>
rows.raw: "\n            Owing to the circumstances in which you first entered the kitsune den, you may have gotten off on the wrong foot with these people. Before she has any further dealings with you, Den Matron Komari would like you to properly introduce yourself to the following people and ensure that all's right with them:<ul>\n                <li>"

rows.original:
, who is in charge of the storehouse,
  • Her heirs
rows.translation:
，负责仓库的管事，
  • 她的继任者们
rows.raw:
", who is in charge of the storehouse,\n
  • Her heirs "

rows.original:
, who can be usually found at the shrine by the fields,
  • And her great-great-grandson
rows.translation:
，通常可以在田野边的神殿找到她，
  • 以及她的玄孙
rows.raw:
", who can be usually found at the shrine by the fields,\n
  • And her great-great-grandson "

rows.original: , whose office sits on the other side of the courtyard. While there are many more foxes who live in this place, these are the ones she'd like you to get good with. Once you've properly familiarised yourself with everyone, you can return to her and get down to business.
rows.translation: ，她的办公室位于庭院另一侧。 尽管还有更多狐族居住于此，但这些都是她希望你好好熟悉的对象。一旦你与所有人都熟络起来，就可以回去找她谈正事了。
rows.raw: ", whose office sits on the other side of the courtyard.\n While there are many more foxes who live in this place, these are the ones she'd like you to get good with. Once you've properly familiarised yourself with everyone, you can return to her and get down to business.\n "

rows.original:
Owing to the circumstances in which you first entered the kitsune den, you may have gotten off on the wrong foot with these people. Before she has any further dealings with you, Den Matron Komari would like you to properly introduce yourself to the following people and ensure that all's right with them:<ul>
                <li>
rows.translation:
由于你最初进入狐妖窝时的那些情况，你可能与这些人产生了误会或矛盾。在麻里窝主进一步与你打交道之前，她希望你能向以下这些人好好做一下自我介绍，确保你们之间的关系没有问题。<ul>
                <li>
rows.raw: "\n            Owing to the circumstances in which you first entered the kitsune den, you may have gotten off on the wrong foot with these people. Before she has any further dealings with you, Den Matron Komari would like you to properly introduce yourself to the following people and ensure that all's right with them:<ul>\n                <li>"

rows.original:
, who is in charge of the storehouse,
  • Her heirs
rows.translation:
，负责仓库的管事，
  • 她的继任者们
rows.raw:
", who is in charge of the storehouse,\n
  • Her heirs "

rows.original:
, who can be usually found at the shrine by the fields,
  • And her great-great-grandson
rows.translation:
，通常可以在田野边的神殿找到她，
  • 以及她的玄孙
rows.raw:
", who can be usually found at the shrine by the fields,\n
  • And her great-great-grandson "

rows.original: , whose office sits on the other side of the courtyard. Happily, you have been such the good socialite that you actually managed to introduce yourself to everyone, working your way up the chain of command to Komari herself. Schooled in it or not, having lived it or not, you may just have a natural knack for kitsune etiquette.
rows.translation: ，她的办公室位于庭院另一侧。 尽管还有更多狐族居住于此，但这些都是她希望你好好熟悉的对象。一旦你与所有人都熟络起来，就可以回去找她谈正事了。
rows.raw: ", whose office sits on the other side of the courtyard.\n Happily, you have been such the good socialite that you actually managed to introduce yourself to everyone, working your way up the chain of command to Komari herself. Schooled in it or not, having lived it or not, you may just have a natural knack for kitsune etiquette.\n "

rows.translation: 因小失大

rows.original:
Interested by new and exciting possibilities in the field of metallurgy — for them, anyway — the kitsune have asked you to see if you can't find a strange metal relic. To be precise, it's the broken hilt of a weapon last seen in the possession of [flags.GIANNA_CARAVAN_MET|Svern, the junkrat accompanying Gianna's wandering caravan. Since you know these folks already, finding them shouldn't be too hard.|what can only be described as a magical, mechanical caravan. A bit incredulous, but stranger things have happened and if you're going to be finding any relics of the past there's no better place to be, is there?] Once you've retrieved this one way or another, deliver the goods to Kohaku, who will make sure they go where they need to be.
            
            Alternatively, since the material to be studied is metal infused with ley-crystal, if you have any items that fit the bill you could give that away instead and skip this entire business altogether.
rows.translation:
对于那些对冶金领域中那些新颖而令人兴奋的可能性感兴趣的人来说，狐妖们请求你帮忙寻找一件奇怪的金属遗物。具体来说，那是一把武器的断裂刀柄，最后一次有人见到它时，它还在某个人的手中[flags.GIANNA_CARAVAN_MET|斯文恩，这位跟随吉安娜四处游荡的车队中的“废品回收者”。既然你已经认识这些人了，找到他们应该不会太难吧。|这简直可以被形容为一支充满魔力的机械车队。虽然有点难以置信，但世上确实发生过许多离奇的事情；如果你想寻找过去的遗迹，那么没有比这里更合适的地方了，不是吗？]无论你通过何种方式获取到这些物品，都必须将它们交给琥珀，她会确保这些物品被送到该去的地方。
            
            或者，既然需要研究的材料是掺入了ley-crystal的金属，如果你手头有任何符合要求的物品，也可以直接将这些物品送给琥珀，这样就完全不必再进行这一系列的操作了。
rows.raw:
"
            Interested by new and exciting possibilities in the field of metallurgy — for them, anyway — the kitsune have asked you to see if you can't find a strange metal relic. To be precise, it's the broken hilt of a weapon last seen in the possession of [flags.GIANNA_CARAVAN_MET|Svern, the junkrat accompanying Gianna's wandering caravan. Since you know these folks already, finding them shouldn't be too hard.|what can only be described as a magical, mechanical caravan. A bit incredulous, but stranger things have happened and if you're going to be finding any relics of the past there's no better place to be, is there?] Once you've retrieved this one way or another, deliver the goods to Kohaku, who will make sure they go where they need to be.
            
            Alternatively, since the material to be studied is metal infused with ley-crystal, if you have any items that fit the bill you could give that away instead and skip this entire business altogether."

rows.original: Now that you've managed to get Svern to cough up the antique weapon hilt in his possession, you should get it to Kohaku posthaste. She'll put it away safely until it can get where it needs to be.
rows.translation: 既然你已经让斯文交出了他手中那把古董武器柄，你应该尽快把它交给小花。她会把它安全地保管起来，直到它被送到该去的地方。
rows.raw: "\n            Now that you've managed to get Svern to cough up the antique weapon hilt in his possession, you should get it to Kohaku posthaste. She'll put it away safely until it can get where it needs to be."

rows.original: Having handed over the weapon hilt over to Kohaku, you've learned that the colonies are hoping to attract a skilled metalworker over to this side of the ocean with a major discovery, and this whole milk run has been part of that. Hopefully, your actions here will have been enough to tip the scales enough for something good to happen — guess you'll find out sooner or later!
rows.translation: 将武器的柄交给了小花后，你了解到那些殖民地希望通过一项重大发现，吸引一位技艺高超的金属工匠来到这片海洋的对岸，而这次运送牛奶的行动正是其中的一部分。希望你在这里所做的一切能够起到关键作用，让好事发生——想必你迟早会知道结果的！
rows.raw: "\n            Having handed over the weapon hilt over to Kohaku, you've learned that the colonies are hoping to attract a skilled metalworker over to this side of the ocean with a major discovery, and this whole milk run has been part of that. Hopefully, your actions here will have been enough to tip the scales enough for something good to happen — guess you'll find out sooner or later!"

rows.original:
Instead of running out and finding that caravan, you've elected to instead hand over the spiraled weapon you found in Matiha's tower; that should work better for their research purposes than a centuries-old broken hilt. It's not like you were using it anyway, and it's better that you give it to someone who can use and appreciate its value instead of just selling or tossing it.
            
            In addition, you've learned that the colonies are hoping to attract a skilled metalworker over to this side of the ocean with a major discovery, and this whole business has been part of that. Hopefully, your actions here will have been enough to tip the scales enough for something good to happen — guess you'll find out sooner or later!
rows.translation:
你没有跑去寻找那支商队，而是选择将你在玛蒂哈的塔楼里找到的那把螺旋形武器交出去；对他们来说，这把武器比一把有着数百年历史却已经损坏的剑柄要有用得多。反正你也没在用它，把它交给能够理解并珍惜其价值的人，总比把它卖掉或者扔掉要好得多。
            
            此外，你已经了解到，那些殖民地希望通过一项重大发现，吸引一位技术娴熟的金属工匠来到大洋的这一边，而你所做的这一切，也正是这一计划的一部分。希望你在这里所采取的行动，能够起到关键作用，让好事发生——不过，你迟早会知道结果的！
rows.raw:
"
            Instead of running out and finding that caravan, you've elected to instead hand over the spiraled weapon you found in Matiha's tower; that should work better for their research purposes than a centuries-old broken hilt. It's not like you were using it anyway, and it's better that you give it to someone who can use and appreciate its value instead of just selling or tossing it.
            
            In addition, you've learned that the colonies are hoping to attract a skilled metalworker over to this side of the ocean with a major discovery, and this whole business has been part of that. Hopefully, your actions here will have been enough to tip the scales enough for something good to happen — guess you'll find out sooner or later!"

rows.translation: 寒冰恶魔

rows.original: Queen Alissa escaped when you engaged her on the palace rooftops, flying southwards. She seemed to be heading somewhere separate from Kasyrra. The Winter City has branded their former queen an outlaw, but Etheryn cannot ascend the throne while the former queen lives. Perhaps there will be clues to Alissa's whereabouts southwards, near the mountains.
rows.translation: 当你在宫殿的屋顶上与艾莉莎女王交战时，她成功逃脱了，向南飞去。她似乎正前往一个与卡希拉不同的地方。冬城已经将他们的前女王列为通缉犯，但只要前女王还在世，伊瑟琳就无法登上王位。或许在南方、靠近山脉的地方，会有一些关于艾莉莎下落的线索。
rows.raw: "\n            Queen Alissa escaped when you engaged her on the palace rooftops, flying southwards. She seemed to be heading somewhere separate from Kasyrra. The Winter City has branded their former queen an outlaw, but Etheryn cannot ascend the throne while the former queen lives. Perhaps there will be clues to Alissa's whereabouts southwards, near the mountains."

rows.original: You've discovered that Alissa has fled to the island ruins of Dracia, a former boreal elf holding. She has a new court of demons there, and they are producing arms and armor for the cult's forces attacking Khor'minos and beyond. Destroying their forges and capturing the demon will surely help the effort to stifle the spread of demons.
rows.translation: 你发现艾莉莎已经逃到了达拉西亚的岛屿废墟上。达拉西亚曾是一位极北精灵的领地。她在那里建立了一个新的恶魔宫廷，那些恶魔正在为袭击科尔米诺斯及其周边地区的邪教势力制造武器和盔甲。摧毁他们的铁匠铺并抓住那个恶魔，肯定有助于遏制恶魔势力的蔓延。
rows.raw: "\n            You've discovered that Alissa has fled to the island ruins of Dracia, a former boreal elf holding. She has a new court of demons there, and they are producing arms and armor for the cult's forces attacking Khor'minos and beyond. Destroying their forges and capturing the demon will surely help the effort to stifle the spread of demons."

rows.original: Having discovered that Alissa has retreated to the boreal island of Dracia, Calise has arranged for a Khor'minoan ship to support your quest to bring the demon to justice. The captain is waiting in the Palace of Ice to pick you and your comrades up.
rows.translation: 在发现艾莉莎已经逃到了达拉西亚这座北方岛屿上之后，卡莉丝安排了一艘霍尔米诺尼亚的船只来协助你们将那个恶魔绳之以法。船长正在冰之宫殿等候，准备接你们和你的同伴们上船。
rows.raw: "\n            Having discovered that Alissa has retreated to the boreal island of Dracia, Calise has arranged for a Khor'minoan ship to support your quest to bring the demon to justice. The captain is waiting in the Palace of Ice to pick you and your comrades up."

rows.original: You've met Captain Livernon at the Palace of Ice's temple. Whenever you're ready, he'll take you to Dracia.
rows.translation: 你在冰之宫殿的神庙里见过利弗农上尉。一旦你准备好了，他就会带你前往达拉西亚。
rows.raw: "\n            You've met Captain Livernon at the Palace of Ice's temple. Whenever you're ready, he'll take you to Dracia."

rows.original: Despite some setbacks, you've arrived on the island of Dracia. You must find Queen Alissa and defeat her — one way or another...
rows.translation: 尽管遇到了一些挫折，你终于来到了达拉西亚岛。你必须找到艾莉莎女王，并且无论如何都要击败她……
rows.raw: "\n            Despite some setbacks, you've arrived on the island of Dracia. You must find Queen Alissa and defeat her — one way or another..."

rows.original: Something wicked lurks in Dracia's shadows. Daliza seems deeply unstable after your encounter with the motherine dreamwalker in the depths; you should hurry to the throne room above and defeat Alissa!
rows.translation: 在达拉西亚的阴影中，潜藏着某种邪恶的力量。在你与深处的“母梦行者”相遇之后，达莉莎的状态似乎变得非常不稳定——你必须立刻前往上面的王座厅，击败艾莉莎！
rows.raw: "\n            Something wicked lurks in Dracia's shadows. Daliza seems deeply unstable after your encounter with the motherine dreamwalker in the depths; you should hurry to the throne room above and defeat Alissa! "

rows.original: You've defeated Queen Alissa, and she's been incarcerated in a cell warded against demonic shapeshifting. It's unlikely that you'll find a way to redeem her in your quest, but she will live to regret her decisions. The island of Dracia will no longer support the demons' war effort.
rows.translation: 你已经击败了艾莉莎女王，她现在被关在一个能够防止恶魔变形的牢房里。在你的冒险过程中，恐怕很难找到办法救她出来，但她将会为自己的决定而后悔。达拉西亚岛再也不会支持恶魔的战争行动了。
rows.raw: "\n            You've defeated Queen Alissa, and she's been incarcerated in a cell warded against demonic shapeshifting. It's unlikely that you'll find a way to redeem her in your quest, but she will live to regret her decisions. The island of Dracia will no longer support the demons' war effort."

rows.original: You've slain Queen Alissa, ending her reign of terror. The island of Dracia will no longer support the demons' war effort.
rows.translation: 你已经杀死了艾莉莎女王，终结了她的恐怖统治。德雷西亚岛再也不会支持恶魔的战争行动了。
rows.raw: "\n            You've slain Queen Alissa, ending her reign of terror. The island of Dracia will no longer support the demons' war effort."

rows.translation: 忍者风范

rows.original: After asking Kura about her outfit, it looks like you need to meet [flags.FHAUS_STOREHOUSE_ENTERED|Kohaku|someone named Kohaku] at the kitsune's den. [flags.FHAUS_STOREHOUSE_ENTERED|Thankfully for you, you already met Kohaku once before. She's probably still down at her storehouse.|The girl supposedly acts as a merchant for the kitsune and says %"nojya" or something. Apparently a lot.]
rows.translation: 询问小仓的服装后，看来你得去狐妖巢穴找[flags.FHAUS_STOREHOUSE_ENTERED|琥珀|一个叫琥珀的人]。[flags.FHAUS_STOREHOUSE_ENTERED|幸好你已经见过琥珀一次了，她大概还在仓库那里。|据说那个女孩是狐妖们的商人，说话时会带着%“nojya”之类的口头禅，而且相当频繁。]
rows.raw: "After asking Kura about her outfit, it looks like you need to meet [flags.FHAUS_STOREHOUSE_ENTERED|Kohaku|someone named Kohaku] at the kitsune's den. [flags.FHAUS_STOREHOUSE_ENTERED|Thankfully for you, you already met Kohaku once before. She's probably still down at her storehouse.|The girl supposedly acts as a merchant for the kitsune and says %\"nojya\" or something. Apparently a lot.]"

rows.original: Kohaku says that she can get an outfit for you, but it only comes in the same style as Kura's. If you're still interested, she seems pretty open-minded about selling it as long as you can cover the steep price. 2000 EC should cover it.
rows.translation: 小白说她可以为你准备一套服装，但它的样式只能和小仓的那一套一样。如果你还是感兴趣的话，她似乎很愿意出售这套服装，只要你愿意支付那个较高的价格。2000点EC应该足够支付这个费用了。
rows.raw: "Kohaku says that she can get an outfit for you, but it only comes in the same style as Kura's. If you're still interested, she seems pretty open-minded about selling it as long as you can cover the steep price. 2000 EC should cover it."

rows.original: You've placed your order but Kohaku mentioned coming back in a few days to pick it up. That was
rows.translation: 您已经下了订单，但小红说几天后会回来取货。就是这么回事。
rows.raw: "You've placed your order but Kohaku mentioned coming back in a few days to pick it up. That was "

rows.original: days ago. Maybe checking in with her wouldn't hurt...
rows.translation: 天前。也许去看看她也无妨……
rows.raw: " days ago. Maybe checking in with her wouldn't hurt..."

rows.original: yesterday, so there's no way she has it in by now. You should wait a bit longer.
rows.translation: 昨天才交给她，所以她现在不可能已经做好了。你应该再等一阵。
rows.raw: "yesterday, so there's no way she has it in by now. You should wait a bit longer."

rows.original: today, so there's no way she has it in by now. You should wait a bit longer.
rows.translation: 今天才寄出，所以现在她肯定还拿不到。你再等一会儿吧。
rows.raw: "today, so there's no way she has it in by now. You should wait a bit longer."

rows.original: Now that you've got your outfit, Kohaku can't get you another. It was costly but now even you can be a sexy ninja. That bracer of knives she gave you is just icing on the cake!
rows.translation: 既然你已经买了这套服装，小红就再也不能为你准备其他衣服了。虽然花费不菲，但现在看来就连你也不例外。你可以成为一名性感的忍者哦！她送给你的那副刀刃护手，简直是锦上添花啊！
rows.raw: "Now that you've got your outfit, Kohaku can't get you another. It was costly but now even you can be a sexy ninja. That bracer of knives she gave you is just icing on the cake!"

rows.translation: 奇械测试

rows.original: For some reason, Rindo's asked you to see her down in the shrine gardens while she's on duty, and very specifically asked for you, too. Perhaps you should go down and see what this is all about.
rows.translation: 不知为何，林多在值班期间特意要求你在神社的花园里与她见面，而且明确指名要见你。或许你应该去看看到底发生了什么。
rows.raw: "\n            For some reason, Rindo's asked you to see her down in the shrine gardens while she's on duty, and very specifically asked for you, too. Perhaps you should go down and see what this is all about."

rows.original: Rindo's asked you to test the effectiveness of her creations by fighting and breaking as many of her puppets as you can. Once you're ready, let her know and she'll take you to a more suitable location for this.
rows.translation: 林多要求你通过尽可能多地与她的木偶战斗并破坏它们来测试她的创作是否有效。当你准备好了，告诉她，她会带你去一个更适合进行这项测试的地方。
rows.raw: "\n            Rindo's asked you to test the effectiveness of her creations by fighting and breaking as many of her puppets as you can. Once you're ready, let her know and she'll take you to a more suitable location for this."

rows.original: You finished the field testing Rindo requested of you. However, you can continue asking her to let you run the gauntlet until you've stretched the limits of your abilities.
rows.translation: 你已经完成了林多要求你进行的实地测试。不过，你完全可以继续请她让你继续接受这些挑战，直到将自己的能力极限完全挖掘出来为止。
rows.raw: "\n            You finished the field testing Rindo requested of you. However, you can continue asking her to let you run the gauntlet until you've stretched the limits of your abilities."

rows.original: You finished the field testing Rindo requested of you, and she's satisfied with the complete destruction you wrought upon her creations. As far as you're concerned, your involvement in the development process is over.
rows.translation: 你已经完成了林多要求你进行的现场测试，而她对你对她的作品所造成的“彻底破坏”也非常满意。对你来说，你在这个开发过程中的角色已经结束了。
rows.raw: "\n            You finished the field testing Rindo requested of you, and she's satisfied with the complete destruction you wrought upon her creations. As far as you're concerned, your involvement in the development process is over."

rows.translation: 冬狼

rows.original: Having heard Gweyr's tale on how she got herself banished from Hawkethorne, it's time to help her fulfill her vengeance against Tollus here in the rift. Talk to her again when you're ready to rumble.
rows.translation: 在听完了格维尔讲述自己是如何被逐出鹰棘镇的经过后，现在是时候帮助她在这里的裂隙中为复仇而战了。当你准备好大干一场的时候，再去找她谈谈吧。
rows.raw: "\n            Having heard Gweyr's tale on how she got herself banished from Hawkethorne, it's time to help her fulfill her vengeance against Tollus here in the rift. Talk to her again when you're ready to rumble."

rows.original: Now that you're ready to take action, Gweyr wants you to meet her in the rift by the northeastern edge of the permafrost where it borders the sea ice. Together, you'll attack their camp and sabotage their stockpile of gray goo — she'll let you decide what role you want to take in the attack when you're able to survey the situation for yourself. If you want to create the diversion yourself, you should be prepared for an extended combat. If you would rather perform the sabotage, you should bring along items and companions that will help you destroy as many barrels as you can in the time Gweyr's able to buy you.
rows.translation: 现在你已经准备好采取行动了，格维尔希望你在永冻土层东北边缘与海冰交界处的裂缝处与她会面。在那里，你们将一起攻击他们的营地，并破坏他们储存的灰色粘稠物——当你能够亲自观察情况后，她会让你决定自己在这次攻击中扮演什么角色。 如果你想亲自制造这种干扰，那么你就必须做好长时间战斗的准备。而如果你选择进行破坏行动，那么你就需要携带一些道具和同伴，这些道具和同伴能够帮助你在格维尔给你规定的时间内摧毁尽可能多的桶。
rows.raw: " Now that you're ready to take action, Gweyr wants you to meet her in the rift by the northeastern edge of the permafrost where it borders the sea ice. Together, you'll attack their camp and sabotage their stockpile of gray goo — she'll let you decide what role you want to take in the attack when you're able to survey the situation for yourself. If you want to create the diversion yourself, you should be prepared for an extended combat. If you would rather perform the sabotage, you should bring along items and companions that will help you destroy as many barrels as you can in the time Gweyr's able to buy you."

rows.original: With the stockpile damaged, it's only a matter of time before the demon cult has to send for more corruptive goo from the source, wherever that might be. Head back to Gweyr at her cave when you're ready to pick up the trail.
rows.translation: 由于库存已经受损，恶魔教派迟早不得不从源头获取更多的腐蚀性黏液，无论那个源头究竟在哪里。当你准备好继续追踪线索时，就回到格维尔的洞穴中去吧。
rows.raw: "\n            With the stockpile damaged, it's only a matter of time before the demon cult has to send for more corruptive goo from the source, wherever that might be. Head back to Gweyr at her cave when you're ready to pick up the trail."

rows.original:
In the wake of your sabotage on the cultist outpost and the goo stockpile, Tollus's underlings have called for fresh supplies to be brought — not from afar, but from somewhere within the rift. Gweyr intends to trail the ship and see where the source is, as well as any other information she can get her hands on.

            Since she does not intend to fight on this expedition, you should take that in mind and bring items and people with you who might make subterfuge easier on you. Once you've finished your preparations, rendezvous with Gweyr on the eastern side of the sea ice, close to where it meets the land.
rows.translation:
在你破坏了那些邪教徒的前哨基地以及他们的粘液储备之后，托勒斯的手下们要求运送新的补给物资——这些物资并非从远方获取，而是来自裂隙内部的某个地方。格维尔打算跟踪那艘运送补给的船只，查明这些物资的真正来源，同时尽可能收集其他相关的信息。

            既然她并不打算在这次远征中参与战斗，你就应该考虑到这一点，带上那些能够帮助你采取迂回策略的物品和人员。一旦准备就绪，就在海冰的东侧、靠近其与陆地相连的地方与格维尔会合吧。
rows.raw:
"
            In the wake of your sabotage on the cultist outpost and the goo stockpile, Tollus's underlings have called for fresh supplies to be brought — not from afar, but from somewhere within the rift. Gweyr intends to trail the ship and see where the source is, as well as any other information she can get her hands on.

            Since she does not intend to fight on this expedition, you should take that in mind and bring items and people with you who might make subterfuge easier on you. Once you've finished your preparations, rendezvous with Gweyr on the eastern side of the sea ice, close to where it meets the land."

rows.original: Working together, Gweyr and you have pinned down the source of the goop barrels which are plaguing the Rift — a deep, dark abyssal trench far below the ocean's surface. The question, then, is how you're going to get down there in one piece. Gweyr has an idea: Imora, a siorcanna shaman she knows, has the power to imprint tattoos that protect land-dwellers from the hazards of the icy ocean. She'd like you to check in with Imora and secure her cooperation in the matter so that you can head down and confront Tollus, whom you have discovered to have fled here from Harvest Valley and is mucking about in the depths right now, doing gods-knows-what. You can find Imora in the northwestern part of the rift, out over the sea ice.
rows.translation: 通过共同努力，格维尔和你终于找到了那些困扰着“裂隙”的黏稠液体的来源——那个位于海洋表面深处、幽暗而暗影的海底沟壑。那么现在的问题就是：你们要如何才能安全地到达那里呢？ 格维尔有个主意：她认识一位名叫伊莫拉的女萨满，这位女萨满拥有在人们身上纹上特殊纹身的能力，这些纹身能够保护陆地居民免受冰冻海洋中的危险。她希望你能联系伊莫拉，争取得到她的合作，这样你们就可以前往那里对付托勒斯了。你们已经发现托勒斯是从收获谷逃到这里来的，现在正在海洋深处胡作非为，天知道他在搞什么名堂。 你可以在裂隙的西北部、海冰覆盖的区域找到伊莫拉。
rows.raw: " Working together, Gweyr and you have pinned down the source of the goop barrels which are plaguing the Rift — a deep, dark abyssal trench far below the ocean's surface. The question, then, is how you're going to get down there in one piece. Gweyr has an idea: Imora, a siorcanna shaman she knows, has the power to imprint tattoos that protect land-dwellers from the hazards of the icy ocean. She'd like you to check in with Imora and secure her cooperation in the matter so that you can head down and confront Tollus, whom you have discovered to have fled here from Harvest Valley and is mucking about in the depths right now, doing gods-knows-what. You can find Imora in the northwestern part of the rift, out over the sea ice."

rows.original: Instead of fucking her, you've agreed to supply Imora with three purple harpy eggs in exchange for the deep-sea tattoos you'll need to descend to the bottom of the ocean trench Tollus is hiding out in. You should be able to find purple eggs off harpies or in their abandoned nests all over the foothills... or if you're daring, lay some yourself. Regardless, Imora would like three of them for, uh, purposes, so hop to it.
rows.translation: 你本应该和她发生关系，却反而同意向伊莫拉提供三颗紫色哈比鸟蛋，作为交换，你就能得到那些深入海洋沟壑、寻找托勒斯藏身之处的必备纹身。你应该能在山脚各处找到哈比鸟或它们废弃的巢穴中获取这些紫色鸟蛋……当然，如果你有胆量，也可以自己捕捉一些。总之，伊莫拉需要这三颗鸟蛋，所以快去把它们弄来吧。
rows.raw: "\n Instead of fucking her, you've agreed to supply Imora with three purple harpy eggs in exchange for the deep-sea tattoos you'll need to descend to the bottom of the ocean trench Tollus is hiding out in. You should be able to find purple eggs off harpies or in their abandoned nests all over the foothills... or if you're daring, lay some yourself. Regardless, Imora would like three of them for, uh, purposes, so hop to it."

rows.original: Now that you've managed to secure Imora's cooperation, it's almost time for you to head down into the depths after Tollus. You should check in with Gweyr to let her know of the good news, and to wait for your next move.
rows.translation: 既然你已经成功获得了伊莫拉的合作，那么现在差不多是时候跟随托勒斯深入那些黑暗之地了。你应该去告诉格维尔这个好消息，同时等待下一步的行动安排。
rows.raw: "\n            Now that you've managed to secure Imora's cooperation, it's almost time for you to head down into the depths after Tollus. You should check in with Gweyr to let her know of the good news, and to wait for your next move."

rows.original:
It's about time you went down into the depths and confronted Tollus, Leold, and any of his other henchmen whom he may have with him. It's going to be a difficult trip and you won't be able to turn back once you set off, so consider everything you've learned about the cult's operations in preparation for what lies ahead.
            
            When you've made your preparations, return to Gweyr and ask her about the cult.
rows.translation:
是时候深入黑暗，去面对托卢斯、利奥尔德以及他可能带来的其他手下们了。这将是一次艰难的旅程，一旦出发就再也无法回头，因此请仔细回顾你所了解的关于这个邪教组织运作方式的种种信息，为即将面临的一切做好准备。
            
            当你做好一切准备后，再回到格韦尔那里，向她询问有关这个邪教组织的情况。
rows.raw:
"
            It's about time you went down into the depths and confronted Tollus, Leold, and any of his other henchmen whom he may have with him. It's going to be a difficult trip and you won't be able to turn back once you set off, so consider everything you've learned about the cult's operations in preparation for what lies ahead.
            
            When you've made your preparations, return to Gweyr and ask her about the cult."

rows.original:
Is... is it over? You've defeated Tollus and the lureling deep beneath the frozen ocean, and as far as you can tell, the gray goo polluting the rift should eventually come to a stop. Yet there's still the matter of Gweyr. After hunting Tollus for roughly two decades and having decided to pass on the torch to the younger generation, she feels like she's finished her purpose in life, and there's nothing left for her to do.
        
            Maybe you should check in with her family. There may be only one person left in the world who may be able to convince her to come home, as opposed to accepting her end.
rows.translation:
难道……真的结束了吗？你们已经击败了托勒斯，也消除了那些潜伏在冰封海洋深处的威胁，而且从目前的情况来看，那些污染裂隙的灰色粘稠物也应该会逐渐消失。不过，格维尔这个问题仍然存在。在追捕托勒斯大约二十年之后，当她决定将这一使命交给年轻一代时，她觉得自己已经完成了人生中的使命，再也没有什么事情需要去做了。
        
            或许你应该去看看她的家人。在这个世界上，或许只有一个人有能力说服她回家，而不是让她接受自己的命运。
rows.raw:
"
            Is... is it over? You've defeated Tollus and the lureling deep beneath the frozen ocean, and as far as you can tell, the gray goo polluting the rift should eventually come to a stop. Yet there's still the matter of Gweyr. After hunting Tollus for roughly two decades and having decided to pass on the torch to the younger generation, she feels like she's finished her purpose in life, and there's nothing left for her to do.
        
            Maybe you should check in with her family. There may be only one person left in the world who may be able to convince her to come home, as opposed to accepting her end."

rows.original:
Sure, Garret might be the only person in the world who might be able and willing to give Gweyr meaning to her life at this point, but you don't think he's presentable to his mother as-is. Maybe digging further into the history of Garth's family will give his idiot son the impetus he needs in order to realize the epiphany he needs.

            Return to Garret and try again when you think he's finally ready to accept the truth about his mother without doing something silly in the bargain.
rows.translation:
当然，在目前这个阶段，加勒或许是这个世界上唯一一个有能力也有意愿为格薇尔的生活带来意义的人，但你觉得他现在的样子还不适合见他的母亲。或许深入探究加斯家族的历史，能给他这个愚蠢的儿子带来所需的动力，让他终于明白自己应该明白的事情。

            等你觉得加勒终于准备好接受关于他母亲的真相，同时又不会做出什么愚蠢的行为时，再回到他身边，再试一次吧。
rows.raw:
"
            Sure, Garret might be the only person in the world who might be able and willing to give Gweyr meaning to her life at this point, but you don't think he's presentable to his mother as-is. Maybe digging further into the history of Garth's family will give his idiot son the impetus he needs in order to realize the epiphany he needs.

            Return to Garret and try again when you think he's finally ready to accept the truth about his mother without doing something silly in the bargain."

rows.original: After a tense standoff with his father, Garret's agreed to accompany you into the rift and convince his mother to come home. He's asked you to go ahead first while he deals with a couple of matters back in Hawkethorne, and meet him at the elevator in the Winter City.
rows.translation: 与父亲紧张对峙后，加雷特同意陪你进入裂谷，说服母亲回家。他请你先走一步，自己留在鹰棘镇处理几件事，之后在冬城的升降梯处与你会合。
rows.raw: "\n After a tense standoff with his father, Garret's agreed to accompany you into the rift and convince his mother to come home. He's asked you to go ahead first while he deals with a couple of matters back in Hawkethorne, and meet him at the elevator in the Winter City."

rows.original:
Looks like everything went well, with Garret managing to convince Gweyr that her family needed her, and to come home with him; it might've been a close thing considering his approach, but he did come through in the end.

            All that's left is for you to head back to Hawkethorne and wait for mother and son to make their appearance, which should take two or three days since you left them; the town square should give you plenty of advance warning of their approach just in case something happens.
rows.translation:
看起来一切都很顺利，加雷特成功说服了格维尔，让她明白自己的家人需要她，于是她便跟着他回到了家中。考虑到加雷特当时的处理方式，这个结果其实已经相当不错了，最终他确实做到了自己的目标。

            现在剩下的就是你回到鹰棘镇，等待母子二人出现吧。既然你离开他们已经有两三天了，他们应该很快就会到。镇上的广场应该能让你及时收到他们到来的消息，以防万一发生什么意外。
rows.raw:
"
            Looks like everything went well, with Garret managing to convince Gweyr that her family needed her, and to come home with him; it might've been a close thing considering his approach, but he did come through in the end.

            All that's left is for you to head back to Hawkethorne and wait for mother and son to make their appearance, which should take two or three days since you left them; the town square should give you plenty of advance warning of their approach just in case something happens."

rows.original:
And that's the end of the tale, or at least where you're concerned. With Garth's family reunited at last, Gweyr can spend the rest of her life repairing her relationships with her kin and hopefully guiding her kids into a better place for the future. It's not going to be easy — it may even be more of a challenge than everything she or you have faced up to this point — but by the gods, is it worth doing. That, and you realize you never quite did discover what dark, deep-rooted fear of hers the lureling tried to use against her... 

            If you still have business with Gweyr, she'll be in the nursery, trying to build bridges with a daughter who resents her. Like what was said... not going to be easy.
rows.translation:
故事到这里便告一段落——至少与你有关的部分是如此。随着加斯一家终于团聚，格维尔可以用余生修复自己与亲人的关系，也希望能引导孩子们走向更好的未来。这绝不会容易，甚至可能比她或你至今经历的一切都更具挑战；但诸神在上，这件事值得去做。此外，你意识到自己始终没有弄清，那个诱惑怪曾试图利用她内心哪一种根深蒂固的黑暗恐惧……

            如果你还想找格维尔，她会待在育儿室里，努力与那个怨恨自己的女儿重修关系。正如刚才所说……这绝不会容易。
rows.raw:
"
            And that's the end of the tale, or at least where you're concerned. With Garth's family reunited at last, Gweyr can spend the rest of her life repairing her relationships with her kin and hopefully guiding her kids into a better place for the future. It's not going to be easy — it may even be more of a challenge than everything she or you have faced up to this point — but by the gods, is it worth doing. That, and you realize you never quite did discover what dark, deep-rooted fear of hers the lureling tried to use against her... 

            If you still have business with Gweyr, she'll be in the nursery, trying to build bridges with a daughter who resents her. Like what was said... not going to be easy."

rows.original: The cult's schemes in the Glacial Rift were left to fester long enough that Gweyr was no longer able to stick around and manage them by herself. She's gone, and with her, the chance to stop whatever evil they were plotting here.
rows.translation: 那个邪教在冰川裂谷中的阴谋逐渐发展恶化，以至于格薇尔再也无法独自阻止它们。她离开了，而随着她的离去，也失去了阻止他们在这里策划的种种邪恶计划的机会。
rows.raw: "\n            The cult's schemes in the Glacial Rift were left to fester long enough that Gweyr was no longer able to stick around and manage them by herself. She's gone, and with her, the chance to stop whatever evil they were plotting here."

rows.original: You've descended to the bottom of the ocean trench in your pursuit of Tollus and his cult, discovering that the trail ends at a sunken jotun castle far beneath the surface. The hunt, as they say, is on; it's your task here to get to the bottom of matters and wreck whatever scheme Tollus has cooking up.
rows.translation: 为了追捕托勒斯和他的邪教组织，你潜入了海洋沟壑的最深处，发现这条线索最终通向了一座沉没在海底深处的巨魔城堡。正如人们所说，这场追捕行动已经开始了；你的任务就是查明真相，摧毁托勒斯正在策划的任何阴谋。
rows.raw: "\n        You've descended to the bottom of the ocean trench in your pursuit of Tollus and his cult, discovering that the trail ends at a sunken jotun castle far beneath the surface. The hunt, as they say, is on; it's your task here to get to the bottom of matters and wreck whatever scheme Tollus has cooking up."

rows.original: Based on your actions in the previous leg of this quest, you've obtained the following knowledge which could be helpful: <ul>
rows.translation: 根据你在本任务前一段中的表现，你已经获得了以下可能对你有帮助的信息： <ul>
rows.raw: "\n\nBased on your actions in the previous leg of this quest, you've obtained the following knowledge which could be helpful: <ul>"

rows.original: • Water seepage has weakened the mortar on the eastern bridge. In general, locations where water has gathered should be avoided lest the masonry crumble.
rows.translation: • 水渗漏已经侵蚀了东侧桥梁上的灰浆。一般来说，应该避免那些被水积聚的地方，否则砌体结构可能会发生崩解。
rows.raw:
"
  • Water seepage has weakened the mortar on the eastern bridge. In general, locations where water has gathered should be avoided lest the masonry crumble.
    • "

rows.original: • There's a treasury within this castle that the cultists have been trying to crack for a while now. Apparently the password is "Issal Saal Craa Gas Iskar", some kind of ophidian phrase invented by Narevans.
rows.translation: • 这座城堡里有一座宝库，邪教徒已经尝试破解它很久了。据说密码是“伊萨尔·萨尔·克拉·加斯·伊斯卡尔（Issal Saal Craa Gas Iskar）”，这是纳雷瓦人创造的某种蛇族短语。
rows.raw:
'
  • There\'s a treasury within this castle that the cultists have been trying to crack for a while now. Apparently the password is "Issal Saal Craa Gas Iskar", some kind of ophidian phrase invented by Narevans.
    • '

rows.original: • You've acquired a number of metal circlets used by the avanai that shield their wearers from psychic influences; they're currently in Gweyr's possession. This should prove useful given the shenanigans you're suspecting Tollus to be up to down here.
rows.translation: • 你获得了一些阿瓦奈人使用的金属环，这些环可以保护佩戴者免受精神力量的影响；目前这些金属环由格维尔保管。考虑到你怀疑托勒斯在这里正在策划一些不轨行为，这些金属环应该会派上用场。
rows.raw:
"
  • You've acquired a number of metal circlets used by the avanai that shield their wearers from psychic influences; they're currently in Gweyr's possession. This should prove useful given the shenanigans you're suspecting Tollus to be up to down here.
    • "

rows.translation: 最甜蜜的高潮

rows.original:
You've still got the Complete Honey Core from cleansing the corruption of Queen Nyzerrah's hive. It still seethes with the curious combination of Lumia's light and Kasyrra's demonic magics.

            Undoubtedly, it could make for a powerful magic item; perhaps if you had it made into jewelry then Azyrran could make use of it? Ogrish is known to work with jewelry, perhaps he could make it.
rows.translation:
你在清除奈泽拉女王蜂巢中的腐败物质后，仍然得到了那颗完整的“蜂蜜核心”。它依然蕴含着卢米娅的光芒与卡希拉的恶魔魔法所形成的奇妙能量。

            毫无疑问，这颗核心可以被制成一件强大的魔法物品；或许如果你把它制成首饰，阿兹兰会能够利用它吧？众所周知，奥格里什擅长制作首饰，也许他能够将其加工成实用的物品。
rows.raw:
"
            You've still got the Complete Honey Core from cleansing the corruption of Queen Nyzerrah's hive. It still seethes with the curious combination of Lumia's light and Kasyrra's demonic magics.

            Undoubtedly, it could make for a powerful magic item; perhaps if you had it made into jewelry then Azyrran could make use of it? Ogrish is known to work with jewelry, perhaps he could make it."

rows.original: Ogrish gave you some gold chain to work with, and suggested having the gem made into a choker instead. You should see Nelia about that.
rows.translation: 奥格里什给了你一些金链子让你使用，同时还建议把那颗宝石制成项圈。你应该去找内莉娅商量这件事。
rows.raw: "\n            Ogrish gave you some gold chain to work with, and suggested having the gem made into a choker instead. You should see Nelia about that."

rows.original: Looks like Nelia is going to charge you 400 Electrum Coins before she'll make a choker for Azzy.
rows.translation: 看来内莉娅会向你收取400枚琥珀金币，才会为你为阿齐制作那条项圈。
rows.raw: "\n            Looks like Nelia is going to charge you 400 Electrum Coins before she'll make a choker for Azzy."

rows.original: Azzy has been gifted the Honey Gem, in the form of a pretty maid choker! With it, she can transform into a magical [silly|combat-bimbo|honey maiden].
rows.translation: 阿齐收到了一颗蜂蜜宝石，它被制作成了一条漂亮的少女颈链！有了它，她就可以变身成为一名拥有魔力的[silly|战斗型花瓶|蜂蜜少女]。
rows.raw: "\n            Azzy has been gifted the Honey Gem, in the form of a pretty maid choker! With it, she can transform into a magical [silly|combat-bimbo|honey maiden]."

rows.translation: 父亲，你在哪？

rows.original: Solveig Karisdóttir is looking for her father; perhaps you can ask a few of the lupines or half-lupines you know?
rows.translation: 索尔维格·卡里斯多蒂尔正在寻找她的父亲；或许你可以问问你认识的一些狼族或半狼族，看看他们能否提供帮助？
rows.raw: "Solveig Karisdóttir is looking for her father; perhaps you can ask a few of the lupines or half-lupines you know? "

rows.original: - You know first hand that June can't possibly be the father, and he had no leads.
rows.translation: - 你亲自确认过，琼绝不可能是孩子的父亲，而且他也没有任何线索。
rows.raw: "- You know first hand that June can't possibly be the father, and he had no leads."

rows.original: - Garth has no idea; he was probably the first person Solveig asked.
rows.raw: "- Garth has no idea; he was probably the first person Solveig asked."

rows.original: - You've asked Anna and Morwen for any information they might have, and Morwen gave you her father's company knife... It's at least a piece of the puzzle, but you'll have to ask a few more lupines.
rows.translation: - 你已经向安娜和莫玟询问过她们掌握的情报；莫玟还把她父亲所属商团的刀交给了你……这至少是拼图的一块，但你还得再问问其他狼族。
rows.raw: "- You've asked Anna and Morwen for any information they might have, and Morwen gave you her father's company knife... It's at least a piece of the puzzle, but you'll have to ask a few more lupines."

rows.original: - Garret reckons it could be any old wolf; perhaps you could try Gwyn?
rows.raw: "- Garret reckons it could be any old wolf; perhaps you could try Gwyn?"

rows.original: - Gwyn recommended going to Sanders, who has given you the location to a raider camp in the North-Eastern Old Forest. Hopefully it's the very same one Solveig was conceived in.
rows.translation: - 格温建议你去找桑德斯；他向你透露了旧森林东北部一处劫掠者营地的位置。希望那里正是索尔维格受孕的地方。
rows.raw: "- Gwyn recommended going to Sanders, who has given you the location to a raider camp in the North-Eastern Old Forest. Hopefully it's the very same one Solveig was conceived in."

rows.original: - You've located a gigantic orcish bra. It's a stretch, but perhaps it's a clue when combined with a few other findings? [flags.GRETTEL_MET|There's a chance Grettel has more insight.|Perhaps there's another orc in the Foothills who might know more...]
rows.translation: - 你发现了一件巨大的兽人胸罩。虽然有点牵强，但如果再结合其他一些发现，或许它能成为线索吧？ [flags.GRETTEL_MET|格雷特尔或许能提供更多有价值的见解。|也许在山脚地带还有其他兽人，他们可能会知道更多……]
rows.raw: "- You've located a gigantic orcish bra. It's a stretch, but perhaps it's a clue when combined with a few other findings? [flags.GRETTEL_MET|There's a chance Grettel has more insight.|Perhaps there's another orc in the Foothills who might know more...]"

rows.original: - Grettel is pretty sure the giant bra belongs to Solveig's family. That might narrow down a time and place.
rows.translation: - 格蕾特尔相当确信，那件巨大的胸罩属于索尔维格的家人。这也许能缩小时间与地点的范围。
rows.raw: "- Grettel is pretty sure the giant bra belongs to Solveig's family. That might narrow down a time and place."

rows.original: - Unfortunately, Drifa doesn't know who Solveig's father is, but she did tell you to check with either Garth or the girls at the Pupperidge Farm for answers.
rows.translation: - 遗憾的是，德莉法不知道索尔维格的父亲是谁，但她建议你去问加斯或帕珀里奇农场的姑娘们。
rows.raw: "- Unfortunately, Drifa doesn't know who Solveig's father is, but she did tell you to check with either Garth or the girls at the Pupperidge Farm for answers."

rows.original: You've found everything you think you can. Now all that's left is bringing the clues to Solveig for her to make heads or tails of them.
rows.translation: 你已经找到了你认为能找到的所有线索。现在，剩下的就是把这些线索交给索尔维格，让她来整理和分析它们。
rows.raw: "You've found everything you think you can. Now all that's left is bringing the clues to Solveig for her to make heads or tails of them."

rows.original: You've successfully introduced Solveig to her papa: it was Garth all along... Poor bastards.
rows.translation: 你成功地把索尔维格介绍给了她的父亲——原来他就是加斯……这可怜的家伙。
rows.raw: "You've successfully introduced Solveig to her papa: it was Garth all along... Poor bastards."

rows.translation: 为奥蕾拉采集冬茎

rows.original:
It looks like in order to get a little more 'closely acquainted' to Aurera and her wife, they'll need some winterstem to blend into compost, or fertilizer, in order to grow some of the produce they need for dyes in-house.
            
            <b>
rows.translation:
看来，要想更“深入地了解”奥雷拉和她的妻子，他们就需要一些冬茎，将这些冬茎制成堆肥或肥料，这样才能在自己家里种植出所需的染料原料。
            
            <b>
rows.raw:
"
            It looks like in order to get a little more 'closely acquainted' to Aurera and her wife, they'll need some winterstem to blend into compost, or fertilizer, in order to grow some of the produce they need for dyes in-house.
            
            <b>"

rows.curatedReason: 内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。
内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。

rows.original: Aurera has been given the winterstem she needs, now you can freely sample her delights.
rows.translation: 奥蕾拉现在已经获得了她所需的冬季养分，现在你可以尽情体验她的魅力了。
rows.raw: "\n            Aurera has been given the winterstem she needs, now you can freely sample her delights."

rows.original: I Ain't Afraid of No Ghost
rows.translation: 我可不怕鬼

rows.original: Arona's approached you about wanting some way to deal with spectral foes. Maybe you should [flags.VIVIANE_MET|talk to Viviane about an enchantment of some sort that'll help|find someone skilled in enchanting to help with this].
rows.translation: 阿罗娜找你商量对付幽灵敌人的办法。也许你应该[flags.VIVIANE_MET|找薇薇安谈谈，看看能否用某种附魔帮忙|找个擅长附魔的人帮忙]。
rows.raw: "\n            Arona's approached you about wanting some way to deal with spectral foes. Maybe you should [flags.VIVIANE_MET|talk to Viviane about an enchantment of some sort that'll help|find someone skilled in enchanting to help with this]."

rows.original: Viv's willing to make something for Arona, but at a price: something at the center of the forest has been agitating the wolves. She wants you to deal with it and bring back its body for her to use to enchant whatever it is she's making.
rows.translation: 薇芙愿意为阿罗娜制作某样东西，但有一个条件：森林深处有某种东西一直在扰乱狼群的生活。她希望你能去处理掉那个麻烦，把它的尸体带回来，这样她就可以用它来为正在制作的物品施加魔法了。
rows.raw: "\n            Viv's willing to make something for Arona, but at a price: something at the center of the forest has been agitating the wolves. She wants you to deal with it and bring back its body for her to use to enchant whatever it is she's making."

rows.original: You've successfully defeated the dire wolf spirit that's been haunting the den and acquired its body. Now you just have to bring it back to Viviane.
rows.translation: 你已经成功击败了那个一直困扰着这个巢穴的凶狼幽灵，并夺取了它的身体。现在，你只需要把它带回给薇薇安。
rows.raw: "\n            You've successfully defeated the dire wolf spirit that's been haunting the den and acquired its body. Now you just have to bring it back to Viviane."

rows.original: The witch put the materials to good use, crafting an axe and cloak for your orcish companion to wield against spectral foes.
rows.translation: 女巫巧妙地利用了这些材料，为你的兽人伙伴制作了一把斧头和一件斗篷，让他们能够用来对抗那些幽灵般的敌人。
rows.raw: "\n            The witch put the materials to good use, crafting an axe and cloak for your orcish companion to wield against spectral foes."

rows.translation: 神圣之穴

rows.original: [flags.CARMEN_KILLED|Cait's explained her intentions of setting up a temple to Mallach, right on the site of the ruins where her sister was kidnapped. There's a lot to be done to make her dream a reality, but your first step is to get someone's permission to use the land. With the baroness deposed, Garth is the de facto leader of Hawkethorne and should be a good place to start|Cait's explained her intentions of setting up a temple to Mallach, right on the site of the ruins where her sister was kidnapped. There's a lot to be done to make her dream a reality, but your first step is to visit the baroness up at Castle Hawkstone and seek her permission to use the land.]
rows.translation: [flags.CARMEN_KILLED|凯特解释了她为何要在妹妹被绑架的废墟所在地为玛拉赫建立一座寺庙。要将这个梦想变为现实，还有许多工作要做，但第一步就是获得使用这块土地的许可。既然女男爵已经被罢免，加斯实际上已经成为霍克索恩的领导者，因此向他寻求帮助应该是个不错的开始。|凯特解释了她为何要在妹妹被绑架的废墟所在地为马拉赫建立一座寺庙。要将这个梦想变为现实，还有许多工作要做，但你们首先要去霍克斯通城堡拜访那位女男爵，争取得到她允许使用这块土地。]
rows.raw: "[flags.CARMEN_KILLED|Cait's explained her intentions of setting up a temple to Mallach, right on the site of the ruins where her sister was kidnapped. There's a lot to be done to make her dream a reality, but your first step is to get someone's permission to use the land. With the baroness deposed, Garth is the de facto leader of Hawkethorne and should be a good place to start|Cait's explained her intentions of setting up a temple to Mallach, right on the site of the ruins where her sister was kidnapped. There's a lot to be done to make her dream a reality, but your first step is to visit the baroness up at Castle Hawkstone and seek her permission to use the land.]"

rows.original:
After consultation with the baroness, she's agreed to let Cait build her temple. However, it's best to survey the site first and make sure it's safe for settling down on. Bringing Cait and her father to the ruins of the old temple where this all began should give the two of them a good sense of what's up with the place to begin with, and why it's attracted so many crazies over the years.

            You should probably speak to Barnaphous to see what he has to say about the matter of his daughter's ambitions.
rows.translation:
在与女男爵商讨之后，她同意让凯特在那里建造她的寺庙。不过，最好先对场地进行勘察，确保那里确实适合居住。把凯特和她的父亲带到这座古老寺庙的废墟处，让他们亲眼看看这个地方的情况，或许就能明白为什么这些年来会有这么多疯子被这里吸引。

            你或许应该去和巴纳福斯谈谈，听听他对女儿这个抱负有什么看法。
rows.raw: "After consultation with the baroness, she's agreed to let Cait build her temple. However, it's best to survey the site first and make sure it's safe for settling down on. Bringing Cait and her father to the ruins of the old temple where this all began should give the two of them a good sense of what's up with the place to begin with, and why it's attracted so many crazies over the years.\n\n            You should probably speak to Barnaphous to see what he has to say about the matter of his daughter's ambitions."

rows.original:
After consultation with Garth, it doesn't look like the people of Hawkethorne have a problem with her setting up shop up on the hillside. However, it's best to survey the site first and make sure it's safe for settling down on. Bringing Cait and her father to the ruins of the old temple where this all began should give them a good sense of what's up with the place to begin with, and why it's attracted so many crazies over the years.

            You should probably speak to Barnaphous to see what he has to say about the matter of his daughter's ambitions.
rows.translation:
在与加斯商讨之后，似乎鹰棘镇的居民们并不反对她在山坡上开店。不过，最好还是先勘察一下那个地点，确保那里确实适合居住。把凯特和她的父亲带到这一切起源的老寺庙废墟中，应该能让他们清楚地了解这个地方究竟发生了什么，以及为什么这些年来它会吸引这么多疯狂的人。

            你或许应该去和巴纳弗斯谈谈，听听他对女儿的这些抱负有什么看法。
rows.raw: "After consultation with Garth, it doesn't look like the people of Hawkethorne have a problem with her setting up shop up on the hillside. However, it's best to survey the site first and make sure it's safe for settling down on. Bringing Cait and her father to the ruins of the old temple where this all began should give them a good sense of what's up with the place to begin with, and why it's attracted so many crazies over the years.\n\n            You should probably speak to Barnaphous to see what he has to say about the matter of his daughter's ambitions."

rows.original: Barnaphous has agreed to survey the site of Cait's new temple with you; speak with him again after you've made preparations. It's likely that there will be some danger involved in stabilising any residue from what happened on the night of the blizzard, so you ought to be prepared for combat.
rows.translation: 巴纳福斯已经同意与你一起勘察凯特新建神庙的选址；在你做好相关准备之后，再与他联系。由于稳定那些在暴风雪那晚留下的残留物可能会带来一定的危险，因此你最好做好应对战斗的准备。
rows.raw: "Barnaphous has agreed to survey the site of Cait's new temple with you; speak with him again after you've made preparations. It's likely that there will be some danger involved in stabilising any residue from what happened on the night of the blizzard, so you ought to be prepared for combat."

rows.original:
Now that you've stabilised the remnants of the portal that Kasyrra came through, Cait can start refurbishing the ruined temple to her own ends without worrying about it exploding all over her.

            Given that Garth's the person to speak to when it comes to construction projects about town, you should discuss the matter of the temple with him.
rows.translation:
既然你已经稳定了卡希拉通过的那个传送门留下的残余部分，凯特就可以开始按照自己的想法修复那座被毁的寺庙了，而不用担心它会突然爆炸把她炸伤。

            既然加斯是镇上所有建筑项目的相关负责人，你应该和他讨论一下修复寺庙这件事。
rows.raw: "Now that you've stabilised the remnants of the portal that Kasyrra came through, Cait can start refurbishing the ruined temple to her own ends without worrying about it exploding all over her.\n\n            Given that Garth's the person to speak to when it comes to construction projects about town, you should discuss the matter of the temple with him."

rows.original:
Garth's ready to supply the men and materials needed to refurbish the old temple into something more suitable for Cait's purposes, but these things don't come for free; while everyone involved has agreed to work at cost as a sign of gratitude for what you've done for the village, it's still going to put you out of five thousand hawks.

            Return to Garth once you've amassed the funding required to get the job under way.
rows.translation:
加斯愿意提供所需的人力和物资，将这座古老的寺庙修复成更适合凯特使用的地方，但这些费用并非免费。虽然所有相关人士都表示愿意无偿参与这项工作，以表达对你们为村庄所做贡献的感激之情，但这一切仍然需要花费五千霍克斯的资金。

            在筹集到开始这项工作所需的资金后，请尽快回到加斯那里。
rows.raw: "Garth's ready to supply the men and materials needed to refurbish the old temple into something more suitable for Cait's purposes, but these things don't come for free; while everyone involved has agreed to work at cost as a sign of gratitude for what you've done for the village, it's still going to put you out of five thousand hawks.\n\n            Return to Garth once you've amassed the funding required to get the job under way."

rows.original: You've coughed up the money Garth needs to get the temple construction underway. There's nothing left for you now but to enjoy the fruits of your labor when the time comes.
rows.translation: 你已经筹集到了加斯所需的资金，这样寺庙的建设就可以开始了。现在，你所能做的就是等待时机到来，然后享受自己辛勤劳动带来的成果吧。
rows.raw: "You've coughed up the money Garth needs to get the temple construction underway. There's nothing left for you now but to enjoy the fruits of your labor when the time comes."

rows.original: The temple should be complete at this point. All that's left is to head on down and see the results of your handiwork.
rows.translation: 这个时候，寺庙应该已经建好了。剩下的就是去看看你自己努力的成果了。
rows.raw: "The temple should be complete at this point. All that's left is to head on down and see the results of your handiwork."

rows.translation: 荒野狩猎

rows.original:
Etheryn has asked you to inquire into the circumstances of her father's death while on a boar hunt, not so much as to learn anything new about a matter that occurred decades ago, but to let Elyon know that someone cares about the source of the guilt Ryn knows is tormenting him.

            She's tasked you with asking the following people about the old king dowager's death: <b>
rows.translation:
伊瑟琳请求你调查她父亲在猎野猪时死亡的具体情况。她并非想了解几十年前发生的那件事的新的细节，而是想让埃利昂知道，有人正在关心那个一直困扰着小琳的罪责根源。

            她委托你向以下这些人了解关于那位已故王太后的死因：<b>
rows.raw:
"
            Etheryn has asked you to inquire into the circumstances of her father's death while on a boar hunt, not so much as to learn anything new about a matter that occurred decades ago, but to let Elyon know that someone cares about the source of the guilt Ryn knows is tormenting him.

            She's tasked you with asking the following people about the old king dowager's death: <b>"

rows.original: . Once you're done, return to Ryn when she's at her throne and see what she has to say about the matter.
rows.translation: 等你完成这些事情后，回到王座上的小琳那里，看看她对此事有什么看法。
rows.raw: ". Once you're done, return to Ryn when she's at her throne and see what she has to say about the matter.\n "

rows.original: Etheryn was rather troubled by what Hethia had to say about her father's death, opening another possibility in this decades old affair. Even though it's certainly far too late and you're not going to be the one to spot what dozens of others missed, she'd still like you to go out into the Frostwood to the site of her father's disastrous hunt, by the western edge of the old broken bridge. Maybe you'll find something... or far more likely, someone there.
rows.translation: 赫希娅关于伊瑟琳父亲之死的话，让伊瑟琳颇为不安，也为这桩几十年前的旧事带来了另一种可能。尽管现在肯定为时已晚，你也不太可能发现几十位调查者都遗漏的线索，她仍希望你去霜木林，看看父亲那次不幸狩猎的现场，就在旧断桥的西边。也许你会找到什么……或者更有可能，遇到某个人。
rows.raw: "\n Etheryn was rather troubled by what Hethia had to say about her father's death, opening another possibility in this decades old affair. Even though it's certainly far too late and you're not going to be the one to spot what dozens of others missed, she'd still like you to go out into the Frostwood to the site of her father's disastrous hunt, by the western edge of the old broken bridge. Maybe you'll find something... or far more likely, someone there.\n "

rows.original: After confronting Elyon in the Frostwood, you've a clearer picture of what happened to Ryn's dad on the day he suffered the wound that eventually killed him. Though this is a mystery that will likely never be solved, getting to the bottom of matters isn't what you were after to begin with. Hopefully your conversation will have spurred him to reconsider his position, not just on his role in the whole matter but also on you and the attitude he's going to be taking towards the future. Hopefully. It all remains to be seen...
rows.translation: 在冰原森林与埃利昂对峙之后，你终于更加清楚地了解了小琳的父亲在遭受那场最终导致他死亡的伤害那天究竟发生了什么。虽然这个谜团很可能永远无法解开，但事实上，你从一开始追求的也并不是弄清事情的真相。希望你们的谈话能促使他重新考虑自己的立场，不仅是他在这整件事中的角色，还包括你以及他未来会采取的态度。当然，这一切还有待观察……
rows.raw: "\n            After confronting Elyon in the Frostwood, you've a clearer picture of what happened to Ryn's dad on the day he suffered the wound that eventually killed him. Though this is a mystery that will likely never be solved, getting to the bottom of matters isn't what you were after to begin with. Hopefully your conversation will have spurred him to reconsider his position, not just on his role in the whole matter but also on you and the attitude he's going to be taking towards the future. Hopefully. It all remains to be seen..."

rows.original: I’ll Make a Man out of You
rows.translation: 我要把你锻造成男子汉
rows.raw: "I’ll Make a Man out of You"

rows.original:
Liulfr has asked you to turn him into a male herm using alchemy. Bring him all the potions he needs to complete his transformation, after which, he’ll begin his move to Hawkethorne.
                
                <ul>
                  <li>
rows.translation:
利乌尔弗请求你通过炼金术将他变成雄性半人半兽。请为他准备完成转变所需的所有药剂，之后他就会动身前往鹰棘镇。
                
                <ul>
                  <li>
rows.raw:
"
                Liulfr has asked you to turn him into a male herm using alchemy. Bring him all the potions he needs to complete his transformation, after which, he’ll begin his move to Hawkethorne.
                
                <ul>
                  <li>"

rows.curatedReason: 内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。

rows.translation: 蓝蛋（肿胀蘑菇）
蓝蛋（栗子）
蓝蛋（软泥）
蓝蛋（原始）

rows.original: Liulfr had sought out your help in transforming his body fully to fit his male form. With your generous help, he now not only feels more comfortable in his body, but he also has moved down to Hawkethorne to escape the warmongering ways of his family.
rows.translation: 柳弗曾请求你的帮助，帮助他将自己的身体完全转变成适合男性的形态。在你的慷慨帮助下，他不仅感觉自己的身体更加舒适了，还搬到了鹰棘镇，以此远离自己家族好战的作风。
rows.raw: "Liulfr had sought out your help in transforming his body fully to fit his male form. With your generous help, he now not only feels more comfortable in his body, but he also has moved down to Hawkethorne to escape the warmongering ways of his family."

rows.original:
Liulfr has asked you to fully feminize her using alchemy. Bring her all the potions she needs to complete her transformation, after which, she’ll begin her move to Hawkethorne.
                
                <ul>
                  <li>
rows.translation:
利乌尔弗请求你通过炼金术将她完全转化为女性。为她准备所有所需的药剂，帮助她完成这一转变，之后她就会动身前往鹰棘镇。
                
                <ul>
                  <li>
rows.raw:
"
                Liulfr has asked you to fully feminize her using alchemy. Bring her all the potions she needs to complete her transformation, after which, she’ll begin her move to Hawkethorne.
                
                <ul>
                  <li>"

rows.curatedReason: 内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。

rows.original: Liulfr was a rarity amongst the Jotuns for her tomboyish looks and ways, however, with your help, she is now a beautiful maiden; if not one still prone to outbursts. More importantly though, she has followed you down to Hawkethorne to live out her exile by your side.
rows.translation: 在乔顿人中，利乌尔弗因为她那男孩气的外表和行为方式而显得与众不同。然而，在你的帮助下，她现在已经变成了一位美丽的少女——虽然偶尔还是会情绪失控。更重要的是，她跟随你来到了鹰棘镇，愿意在你的身边度过这段流放生活。
rows.raw: "Liulfr was a rarity amongst the Jotuns for her tomboyish looks and ways, however, with your help, she is now a beautiful maiden; if not one still prone to outbursts. More importantly though, she has followed you down to Hawkethorne to live out her exile by your side."

rows.translation: 科尔米诺斯围城战

rows.original:
You've saved the Winter City, and become the Champion of Frost. With this accolade spreading across the Marches, you have the clout necessary to enter Khor'minos. Talk to one of the gate guards to receive a token of admittance. [flags.KM_TOKEN|
            
            You've gained admittance to Khor'minos. Take some time to see what the city has to offer. When you are ready to proceed with its defense, speak with Calise again.]
rows.translation:
你拯救了冬城，也因此成为了霜之冠军。这一荣誉在各地广为传颂，使你拥有了进入科尔米诺斯的资格。只需与守门人中的任何一位交谈，就能获得进入的凭证。 [flags.KM_TOKEN|
            
            你已被允许进入科尔米诺斯。请花些时间看看这座城市能为你提供什么。当你准备好开始保卫它时，再与卡莉丝联系吧。]
rows.raw:
"
            You've saved the Winter City, and become the Champion of Frost. With this accolade spreading across the Marches, you have the clout necessary to enter Khor'minos. Talk to one of the gate guards to receive a token of admittance. [flags.KM_TOKEN|
            
            You've gained admittance to Khor'minos. Take some time to see what the city has to offer. When you are ready to proceed with its defense, speak with Calise again.]"

rows.original: Calise suspects that the imps are getting their weapons and armor from a source outside the Undermountain. She's suggested that you check the docks in the south of the tunnels — a likely spot for smugglers helping the demons.
rows.translation: 卡莉丝怀疑那些小妖精是从地底山以外的某个地方获取武器和盔甲的。她建议你去检查隧道南端的码头——那很可能是那些帮助恶魔的走私者藏匿物品的地方。
rows.raw: "\n            Calise suspects that the imps are getting their weapons and armor from a source outside the Undermountain. She's suggested that you check the docks in the south of the tunnels — a likely spot for smugglers helping the demons."

rows.original: You found a distressed minotaur boatman at the docks directly south of Khor'minos, complaining about strange lights and winged creatures across the underground lake.
rows.translation: 你在科尔米诺斯正南方向的码头发现了一名处境艰难的弥诺陶洛斯船夫，他正在抱怨地下湖中出现了奇怪的光芒以及有翼生物。
rows.raw: "\n            You found a distressed minotaur boatman at the docks directly south of Khor'minos, complaining about strange lights and winged creatures across the underground lake."

rows.original: You encountered a demonic knight overseeing the transport of weapons and armor from upriver. It seems the impish arms are coming from the Frostwood or beyond. Perhaps somebody in the Winter City would know more...
rows.translation: 你在上游发现了一名恶魔骑士，他正在监督武器和盔甲的运输工作。看来这些邪恶的武器是来自霜木林或者更远的地方。或许冬城里有人会知道更多的信息……
rows.raw: "\n            You encountered a demonic knight overseeing the transport of weapons and armor from upriver. It seems the impish arms are coming from the Frostwood or beyond. Perhaps somebody in the Winter City would know more..."

rows.original: Bailiff Daliza recognized the proofmarks on the bronze being used in these weapons: they're from her ancestral homeland, Dracia, an elven colony off the east coast. Her rangers will work to disrupt the shipments, but you'll have to sail to the source of the weapons and put a stop to them eventually. For now: return to Calise.
rows.translation: 法警达莉莎认出了这些武器上使用的青铜所具有的特殊标记：这些青铜来自她的祖籍之地——达拉西亚，那是位于东海岸的一个精灵殖民地。她的护林员们会设法干扰这些武器的运输，但最终你还是需要亲自前往这些武器的来源地，将其运输路线彻底切断。目前的话：还是先返回卡莉塞吧。
rows.raw: "\n            Bailiff Daliza recognized the proofmarks on the bronze being used in these weapons: they're from her ancestral homeland, Dracia, an elven colony off the east coast. Her rangers will work to disrupt the shipments, but you'll have to sail to the source of the weapons and put a stop to them eventually. For now: return to Calise."

rows.original: Calise has agreed to speak to King Kelsaz and deploy the Khor'minoan navy. This will stop the demonic smugglers, and she'll put a vessel at your command. You'll find it in the Frostwood's fjord. This act should also put you in the king's good graces. In the meantime, if you intend to further pursue the demonic corruption in the Undermountain, you should talk to Calise again.
rows.translation: 卡莉丝已经同意与凯尔萨兹国王会面，并出动霍尔米诺安海军。这样就能阻止那些恶魔走私者了，她还会派一艘船由你指挥使用。你可以在霜木林的峡湾里找到那艘船。这样的举动应该会让你赢得国王的青睐。不过，如果你还想继续调查山腹深域中的恶魔势力，那就需要再与卡莉丝谈谈。
rows.raw: "\n            Calise has agreed to speak to King Kelsaz and deploy the Khor'minoan navy. This will stop the demonic smugglers, and she'll put a vessel at your command. You'll find it in the Frostwood's fjord. This act should also put you in the king's good graces. In the meantime, if you intend to further pursue the demonic corruption in the Undermountain, you should talk to Calise again."

rows.original: Calise's gone off on her own, so you'll need to wait a while before your next change to work together.
rows.translation: 卡莉丝已经独自行动去了，所以你们需要再等一段时间，才能再次一起合作。
rows.raw: "\n            Calise's gone off on her own, so you'll need to wait a while before your next change to work together."

rows.original: Without you to help her, Calise sustained serious injuries and will need some time to recover.
rows.translation: 如果没有你的帮助，卡莉丝就会受到严重的伤害，需要一段时间才能恢复。
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tWithout you to help her, Calise sustained serious injuries and will need some time to recover."

rows.original: Calise sustained serious injuries and will need some time to recover.
rows.translation: 卡莉丝受了重伤，需要一段时间才能恢复。
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tCalise sustained serious injuries and will need some time to recover."

rows.original: Calise should have had enough time to recover now. Speak with her to catch up on what your next steps in the city should be.
rows.translation: 卡莉丝现在应该已经有足够的时间恢复过了。和她谈谈，了解一下你在城里接下来应该采取哪些行动。
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tCalise should have had enough time to recover now. Speak with her to catch up on what your next steps in the city should be."

rows.original: You've arrived at a feast thrown for you and Calise in celebration of your achievements in the fight against the demonic army. Though you could just enjoy the party, Calise's also suggested thris would be a fine time to search for new allies, and to sniff out traitors, in the city while you have access to the high and mighty. You can speak to the court's herald to advance the party's progress.
rows.translation: 你们来到了这场专为庆祝你们在对抗恶魔军队的战斗中取得的成就而举办的盛宴。虽然你们可以尽情享受这场派对，但卡莉丝也建议，趁现在有机会接触那些权贵人士，正是寻找新盟友、揪出内奸的好时机。你们可以去找宫廷的传令官，以便让这场派对顺利进行。
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tYou've arrived at a feast thrown for you and Calise in celebration of your achievements in the fight against the demonic army. Though you could just enjoy the party, Calise's also suggested thris would be a fine time to search for new allies, and to sniff out traitors, in the city while you have access to the high and mighty. You can speak to the court's herald to advance the party's progress."

rows.original: You've finished up at the party, and with it, your chances to get to know the major players before the final act. Speak to Calise again to continue your preparations.
rows.translation: 你在派对上已经完成了自己的任务，也因此获得了在最终阶段之前了解那些重要角色的机会。再与卡莉丝谈谈，继续你的准备工作吧。
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tYou've finished up at the party, and with it, your chances to get to know the major players before the final act. Speak to Calise again to continue your preparations."

rows.original: A huge battle is on the horizon. With it, your chance to end the demonic siege of the city. Gather allies, prepare yourself, and when you're ready, tell Calise to marshal the troops.
rows.translation: 一场大规模的战役即将爆发。这场战役将为你提供终结恶魔对这座城市围攻的机会。召集盟友，做好充分准备，当一切就绪时，告诉卡莉丝组织军队出发吧。
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tA huge battle is on the horizon. With it, your chance to end the demonic siege of the city. Gather allies, prepare yourself, and when you're ready, tell Calise to marshal the troops."

rows.original: You and Calise have broken through the demons' lines. You must destroy the demonic breeding pits before a new army of imps rises to overwhelm you — the castle keep is the most likely spot!
rows.translation: 你和卡莉丝已经突破了恶魔的防线。必须在新的小恶魔军队崛起并压倒你们之前摧毁那些恶魔的繁殖地——城堡的地下室很可能是那些繁殖地的所在之处！
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tYou and Calise have broken through the demons' lines. You must destroy the demonic breeding pits before a new army of imps rises to overwhelm you — the castle keep is the most likely spot!"

rows.original: The breeding pits have been destroyed, but you have an opportunity now that will never come again, to defeat the demon army's leaders. Find them and bring them down.
rows.translation: 那些用于繁殖的坑洞已经被摧毁了，但现在你有一个再也不会出现的机会——击败恶魔军队的首领们。找到他们，将他们彻底消灭。
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tThe breeding pits have been destroyed, but you have an opportunity now that will never come again, to defeat the demon army's leaders. Find them and bring them down."

rows.original: Victory! The demons have been dealt a crippling blow, but so too have you learned Calise's real identity, and what befell the real Calise. For now, Kasyrra remains in her disguise, though now that her rival for mastery of the cult has been so severely weakened, what is stopping her from pursuing your soul with all her strength...?
rows.translation: 胜利了！恶魔确实受到了沉重的打击，但你们也发现了卡莉丝的真实身份，以及真正的卡莉丝所遭遇的一切。目前，卡希拉仍然保持着她的伪装，不过既然她在争夺这个邪教控制权的竞争中的对手已经受到了如此沉重的打击，那么还有什么能阻止她用尽全力去夺取你们的灵魂呢……？
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tVictory! The demons have been dealt a crippling blow, but so too have you learned Calise's real identity, and what befell the real Calise. For now, Kasyrra remains in her disguise, though now that her rival for mastery of the cult has been so severely weakened, what is stopping her from pursuing your soul with all her strength...?"

rows.original: Victory! The demons have been dealt a crippling blow, and you exposed Calise for what she truly is: a demon. She has fled the kingdom, but now that her rival has been so severely weakened you doubt there'll be anything to stop her from pursuing your soul with all her might...
rows.translation: 胜利了！那些恶魔受到了沉重的打击，而你也揭露了卡莉丝的真面目——她其实就是一名恶魔。她已经逃离了王国，但既然她的竞争对手已经被削弱到这种地步，你肯定相信，没有什么能够阻止她用尽全力去夺取你的灵魂……
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tVictory! The demons have been dealt a crippling blow, and you exposed Calise for what she truly is: a demon. She has fled the kingdom, but now that her rival has been so severely weakened you doubt there'll be anything to stop her from pursuing your soul with all her might..."

rows.original: Having heard a divine proclamation and Kasyrra's confession both, you realize now that it may be possible — somehow — to reverse demonhood. But it's not something you can hope to achieve alone. Such soul-sorcery is entirely in the domain in the gods, it seems... Perhaps you should seek an audience with one of the Seven and see what they have to say about souls and demonhood. Alternatively, Kas mentioned Tollus was looking into matters of the soul for her. While you doubt he'll share his research willingly, perhaps the cult's leader has some notes on the matter?
