rows.translation: 在听到了那神圣的宣告以及卡希拉的坦白之后，你现在意识到：或许存在着某种方法，能够逆转恶魔的身份。但这一点，单靠自己是无法实现的。这种涉及灵魂深处的魔法，显然完全属于神明的领域。或许你应该去拜访七大人物中的某一位，听听他们对灵魂与恶魔本质有何看法。或者，卡丝提到托勒斯正在为她研究灵魂相关的问题。虽然你怀疑他不会主动分享自己的研究成果，但也许那个教派的领袖会有一些相关的记录或见解吧？
rows.raw: "Having heard a divine proclamation and Kasyrra's confession both, you realize now that it may be possible — somehow — to reverse demonhood. But it's not something you can hope to achieve alone. Such soul-sorcery is entirely in the domain in the gods, it seems... Perhaps you should seek an audience with one of the Seven and see what they have to say about souls and demonhood. Alternatively, Kas mentioned Tollus was looking into matters of the soul for her. While you doubt he'll share his research willingly, perhaps the cult's leader has some notes on the matter?\n            \n            "

rows.original: - Having consulted with a divinity, it seems that implanting a Lethicite shard into Kasyrra is possible, and would restore her lost soul — but would destroy the woman you've come to love in the process. Obliterating your demonic paramour's personality and memories is... a last resort, if you'd even consider it. There must be better options.
rows.translation: 在征询了一位神明的意见后，我们发现将一块莱西石碎片植入卡希拉体内是可行的，这样就能恢复她失去的灵魂——但同时也会毁掉你渐渐爱上的这个女人。抹去你那位恶魔情人的个性与记忆，实在是一种最后的手段，前提是你甚至愿意考虑这种选择。肯定还有更好的办法吧。
rows.raw: "\n                - Having consulted with a divinity, it seems that implanting a Lethicite shard into Kasyrra is possible, and would restore her lost soul — but would destroy the woman you've come to love in the process. Obliterating your demonic paramour's personality and memories is... a last resort, if you'd even consider it. There must be better options."

rows.original: - You found the earliest of Tollus's notes regarding Kasyrra. She doesn't seem to have been the mistress he was expecting. Was Kas even the demon he'd been communing with all these years, or was that Lethice? Even the madman himself doesn't seem sure.
rows.translation: - 你找到了托勒斯关于卡希拉的最早笔记。她似乎并不是他想象中的那个情人。那么，卡斯真的是这些年来他一直在与之交流的恶魔吗？还是说，那个恶魔其实是莱西丝？就连这个疯子自己似乎也不确定。
rows.raw: "\n                - You found the earliest of Tollus's notes regarding Kasyrra. She doesn't seem to have been the mistress he was expecting. Was Kas even the demon he'd been communing with all these years, or was that Lethice? Even the madman himself doesn't seem sure."

rows.original: - You found the middle entry of Tollus's notes, confirming that the cult's master has indeed been looking into implanting a soul into Kasyrra... to restrict her demonic power. He's mentioned a Faceless Blade as a source of inspiration, herself soulbound to one of the gods. Tollus seems keen on experimenting on the Faceless Blade's altered soul. But his notes do not give any specific details of the experiment here.
rows.translation: - 你找到了托勒斯笔记中的那条记录，从中可以确认，这个邪教的头目确实一直在研究将灵魂植入卡希拉体内……以此来限制她的恶魔力量。他提到过“无面之刃”作为这一计划的灵感来源，而那把剑本身的灵魂也与某位神明紧密相连。托勒斯似乎很热衷于对这种被改造过的灵魂进行实验，但他的笔记中并没有提供关于这些实验的具体细节。
rows.raw: "\n                - You found the middle entry of Tollus's notes, confirming that the cult's master has indeed been looking into implanting a soul into Kasyrra... to restrict her demonic power. He's mentioned a Faceless Blade as a source of inspiration, herself soulbound to one of the gods. Tollus seems keen on experimenting on the Faceless Blade's altered soul. But his notes do not give any specific details of the experiment here."

rows.original: - You found the final entry in Tollus's research notes. His experiment with the Faceless Blade created a facsimile of a soulbinding out of Lethicite, a pale mockery of what Keros himself wrought within the Blade. While you doubt the result was quite what Tollus wanted, it certainly worked. Tollus's route isn't going to help Kasyrra, but it's given you new insight into the mechanisms of the soul.
rows.translation: 你在托勒斯的研究笔记中找到了最后一条记录。他使用“无面之刃”进行的实验，成功地用莱西塞特制造出了某种类似“灵魂束缚”的物质——但这只不过是凯罗斯用那把刃创造出的力量的苍白模仿罢了。虽然你怀疑这个结果并非托勒斯所期望的，但它确实起到了作用。托勒斯的探索路径或许无助于卡希拉，但它确实让你对灵魂的运作机制有了新的认识。
rows.raw: "\n                - You found the final entry in Tollus's research notes. His experiment with the Faceless Blade created a facsimile of a soulbinding out of Lethicite, a pale mockery of what Keros himself wrought within the Blade. While you doubt the result was quite what Tollus wanted, it certainly worked. Tollus's route isn't going to help Kasyrra, but it's given you new insight into the mechanisms of the soul."

rows.original: This is as far as this quest progresses for now.
rows.translation: 目前，这个任务就进展到这个阶段了。
rows.raw: "\n This is as far as this quest progresses for now."

rows.original: Perhaps you should take this revelation before one of the Seven Divines and hear what they have to say on the matter. After all, the gods seemingly have an incredibly mastery of soul-sorcery.
rows.translation: 或许你应该将这一发现告知七神中的一位，听听他们对此事有何看法。毕竟，这些神明似乎对灵魂魔法有着极其深入的了解。
rows.raw: "Perhaps you should take this revelation before one of the Seven Divines and hear what they have to say on the matter. After all, the gods seemingly have an incredibly mastery of soul-sorcery."

rows.original: Having heard the wisdom of the gods, your path forward is now clear: your soul really is the key to saving Kasyrra. If you reach the height of your power as Kasyrra has been goading you towards this entire time, your soul will be big enough for the both of you to share — and in so doing, inexorably bind you and Kasyrra together for the rest of your lives. Will you still be [pc.race]? Will she return to human, or become something in between? Even a god cannot answer questions that have never been asked before. Either way, if you wish to save Kasyrra from demonhood without becoming one yourself, you've now been granted the power to try. The only obstacle left is to gain the power needed to tame the demoness herself. This quest cannot be advanced further until the final confrontation...
rows.translation: 在聆听了众神的智慧之后，你前行的道路已经变得清晰：你的灵魂确实才是拯救卡希拉的关键。如果你能够像卡希拉一直以来一直在激励你那样，将自己的力量发挥到极致，那么你的灵魂将会变得足够强大，足以让你们两人共享——而这样一来，你和卡希拉的生命将会永远紧密地联系在一起。你，还会坚持原来的选择吗？ [pc.race]她会重新变回人类，还是会变成介于人类与恶魔之间的存在呢？就连神明也无法回答那些从未被提出过的问题。无论如何，如果你想拯救卡希拉，让她摆脱恶魔的身份，同时又不想自己变成恶魔，那么你现在已经被赋予了尝试的力量。唯一剩下的障碍，就是获得能够驯服这位恶魔少女所需的力量。 在最终对决之前，这个任务无法继续进行……
rows.raw: "Having heard the wisdom of the gods, your path forward is now clear: your soul really is the key to saving Kasyrra. If you reach the height of your power as Kasyrra has been goading you towards this entire time, your soul will be big enough for the both of you to share — and in so doing, inexorably bind you and Kasyrra together for the rest of your lives. Will you still be [pc.race]? Will she return to human, or become something in between? Even a god cannot answer questions that have never been asked before. Either way, if you wish to save Kasyrra from demonhood without becoming one yourself, you've now been granted the power to try. The only obstacle left is to gain the power needed to tame the demoness herself. \n\n This quest cannot be advanced further until the final confrontation..."

rows.original: You've acquired the silk and money you'll need for Nelia to make your fishnets, all that's left is to return it to her!
rows.translation: 你已经获得了内莉娅制作渔网所需的丝绸和钱，现在所要做的就是把它们还给她了！
rows.raw: "\n            You've acquired the silk and money you'll need for Nelia to make your fishnets, all that's left is to return it to her!\n            "

rows.original: Nelia says the process will take 2 days. You can either wait around Hawkethorne or come back to retrieve it later.
rows.translation: 内莉娅说这个过程需要两天的时间。你可以选择在鹰棘镇这里等待，或者稍后再来取取它。
rows.raw: "\n            Nelia says the process will take 2 days. You can either wait around Hawkethorne or come back to retrieve it later."

rows.original: Your fishnets should be fully crafted! Time to check in with Nelia and get your hands on them!
rows.translation: 你的渔网已经制作完成了！是时候去找内莉娅领取它们了！
rows.raw: "\n            Your fishnets should be fully crafted! Time to check in with Nelia and get your hands on them!"

rows.original: You've acquired a set of strong fishnets that stretch to fit your body. They provide zero coverage, but they do show off your body in all the best ways.
rows.translation: 你获得了一套弹性极佳的渔网装，它们可以完美贴合你的身形。虽然这种服装几乎不提供任何遮盖效果，但却能以最完美的方式展现你的身材。
rows.raw: "\n            You've acquired a set of strong fishnets that stretch to fit your body. They provide zero coverage, but they do show off your body in all the best ways."

rows.translation: 家事

rows.original: Brienne wants you to win over her family — by fucking them into submission. Start with her sister, Rina.
rows.translation: 布蕾妮希望你能通过某些手段让她的家人屈服，从而赢得他们的信任。先从她的妹妹莉娜开始吧。
rows.raw: "\n            Brienne wants you to win over her family — by fucking them into submission. Start with her sister, Rina."

rows.original: Brienne will be a little disappointed when she learns you're keeping her sister as a friend rather than a romantic prospect, but she'll get over it if you fuck Cassia into submission.
rows.translation: 当布蕾妮得知你将她的妹妹视为朋友而非恋爱对象时，她可能会感到有些失望，但如果你能让卡茜娅屈服于你，她就会释怀的。
rows.raw: "\n            Brienne will be a little disappointed when she learns you're keeping her sister as a friend rather than a romantic prospect, but she'll get over it if you fuck Cassia into submission."

rows.original: Brienne couldn't be happier with the way things are going in her home, and especially Rina's bedroom. If the two of you keep smothering Rina with so much love and attention, you're going to have your hands full keeping her satisfied every time you're around! Keep up the 'dates' and see where this leads you.
rows.translation: 布蕾妮对家里目前的状况，尤其是莉娜的卧室布置，感到非常满意。如果你们俩继续用这么多的爱和关怀来呵护莉娜，每次见到她的时候，你们肯定都会忙得不可开交，生怕不能满足她的所有需求！继续坚持这样的“约会”吧，看看这会把你们引向何方。
rows.raw: "\n            Brienne couldn't be happier with the way things are going in her home, and especially Rina's bedroom. If the two of you keep smothering Rina with so much love and attention, you're going to have your hands full keeping her satisfied every time you're around! Keep up the 'dates' and see where this leads you."

rows.original: You turned Rina down, but you've seized upon the chance to have sex with the girls' exceptionally fertile mother. Brienne'll be thrilled. All three of the cowgirls are happy and content with the current state of affairs.
rows.translation: 你拒绝了莉娜，但却抓住了机会，与那些女孩们极其多产的母亲发生了关系。布蕾妮也会兴奋不已这三位女牛仔对目前的状况都感到满意和满足。
rows.raw: "\n You turned Rina down, but you've seized upon the chance to have sex with the girls' exceptionally fertile mother. Brienne'll be thrilled. All three of the cowgirls are happy and content with the current state of affairs."

rows.original: Just like you promised your faithful [bri.isMarried|wife|girlfriend], you've had sex with both her beautiful sister and her outrageously fertile mother. She'll be thrilled, no doubt. Now you'll have to contend with keeping all three of your wonderful lovers happy — [pc.hasCock|[pc.isImpotent|though it doesn't seem like that'll be too difficult, really.|and you've got just the idea.]|though it doesn't seem like that'll be too difficult, really.]
rows.translation: 正如你向你的忠实粉丝们所承诺的那样[bri.isMarried|妻子|女朋友]你和她那美丽的妹妹，还有她那生育能力极强的母亲都发生过关系。她现在肯定会兴奋不已毫无疑问，现在你将不得不努力让你的三位出色的恋人都能保持开心[pc.hasCock|[pc.isImpotent|虽然看起来这并不会太难，但实际上也是如此。|你正是想到了这个点子。]|虽然看起来这并不会太难，但实际上也是如此。]
rows.raw: "\n Just like you promised your faithful [bri.isMarried|wife|girlfriend], you've had sex with both her beautiful sister and her outrageously fertile mother. She'll be thrilled, no doubt. Now you'll have to contend with keeping all three of your wonderful lovers happy — [pc.hasCock|[pc.isImpotent|though it doesn't seem like that'll be too difficult, really.|and you've got just the idea.]|though it doesn't seem like that'll be too difficult, really.]"

rows.original: Brienne's going to be sad that you promised to indulge her only to spurn the chance at a relationship with her sister and mother — but you've made the decision you believe in, and she'll come around to it eventually.
rows.translation: 布蕾妮一定会感到难过的，因为你当初承诺会满足她的要求，却最终放弃了与她姐姐和母亲建立关系的机会——但你也做出了自己认为正确的决定，她最终也会理解这一点的。
rows.raw: "\n            Brienne's going to be sad that you promised to indulge her only to spurn the chance at a relationship with her sister and mother — but you've made the decision you believe in, and she'll come around to it eventually."

rows.original: You turned Cassia down, opting not to interfere in the woman of the house's affairs, though her two daughters are more than happy to hang off your arm. Brienne's already excited enough about the current situation — she'll forgive you for not going all the way.
rows.translation: 你拒绝了卡茜娅的邀请，选择不干涉这位家庭主妇的事务，不过她的两个女儿却非常乐意挽着你的手臂。布蕾妮对目前的状况已经感到十分兴奋了——她一定会原谅你没有更进一步。
rows.raw: "\n            You turned Cassia down, opting not to interfere in the woman of the house's affairs, though her two daughters are more than happy to hang off your arm. Brienne's already excited enough about the current situation — she'll forgive you for not going all the way."

rows.original: With all the cows very much in hand, this can only be called a success of the highest order.
rows.translation: 既然所有事情都已经得到了妥善处理，那么这次行动无疑可以被称为是一次极其成功的尝试。
rows.raw: "\n            With all the cows very much in hand, this can only be called a success of the highest order."

rows.original: You've taken a different path than you originally planned, but you're sure this is a happy end in itself.
rows.translation: 你选择的道路与最初计划的有所不同，但你相信，这样的结局本身就已经很美好了。
rows.raw: "\n            You've taken a different path than you originally planned, but you're sure this is a happy end in itself."

rows.original:
Agnimitra, an immortal phoenix that can conjure fire on a whim, is willing to join you as a companion on your adventures, but because of how hot her body can get, she can't wear normal clothing and she needs clothes that are flame-resistant. She mentioned that someone in Hawkethorne sells flame-resistant capes: all she needs is three of those brought back to her, and she can sew her clothing herself.
            
            <b>
rows.translation:
阿格尼米特拉是一只拥有永生之力的凤凰，她可以随心所欲地释放火焰。她愿意成为你冒险旅程中的伙伴，但由于她的身体会散发出极高的热量，她无法穿着普通的衣物，因此需要一些防火的服装。她提到，在鹰棘镇有地方出售防火斗篷：你只需要带回三件这样的斗篷，她就可以自己制作所需的服装了。
            
            <b>
rows.raw:
"
            Agnimitra, an immortal phoenix that can conjure fire on a whim, is willing to join you as a companion on your adventures, but because of how hot her body can get, she can't wear normal clothing and she needs clothes that are flame-resistant. She mentioned that someone in Hawkethorne sells flame-resistant capes: all she needs is three of those brought back to her, and she can sew her clothing herself.
            
            <b>"

rows.translation: 火焰披风：

rows.original: Agnimitra, the immortal phoenix, is willing to join with you, but she asked you to retrieve three Flame Capes before she could. You now have three Flame Capes to bring to her – return to the Temple of Terrestrial Fire with them!
rows.translation: 不朽的凤凰阿格尼米特拉愿意与你并肩作战，但她要求你在她加入之前先找到三件火焰披风。你现在有三件火焰斗篷可以带给她了——带着它们回到大地之火神庙吧！
rows.raw: "\n Agnimitra, the immortal phoenix, is willing to join with you, but she asked you to retrieve three Flame Capes before she could. You now have three Flame Capes to bring to her – return to the Temple of Terrestrial Fire with them!"

rows.original: Agnimitra asked you to bring her three Flame Capes so that she could sew herself a flame-resistant outfit to make herself presentable to the world before she was willing to travel with you. Throughout her lifetimes, she's learned how to become a modest seamstress, and now, she just needs one day to sew her own outfit. Return to her in twenty-four hours, and she ought to be ready to leave!
rows.translation: 阿格尼米特拉请求你为她拿来三件火焰斗篷，这样她就可以缝制一套防火的服装，让自己在愿意与你一同旅行之前看起来得体一些。在她的一生中，她学会了如何成为一名娴熟的缝纫师，现在，她只需要一天的时间来为自己缝制这套服装。24小时后回到她身边，那时她应该已经准备好出发了！
rows.raw: "Agnimitra asked you to bring her three Flame Capes so that she could sew herself a flame-resistant outfit to make herself presentable to the world before she was willing to travel with you. Throughout her lifetimes, she's learned how to become a modest seamstress, and now, she just needs one day to sew her own outfit. Return to her in twenty-four hours, and she ought to be ready to leave!"

rows.original: It's been a day since you gave Agnimitra the Flame Capes, like she had asked. She must be done with her outfit by now — go and give her a visit!
rows.translation: 自从你按照阿格尼米特拉的请求将火焰披风送给她之后，已经过去了一天。她应该已经完成了自己服装的搭配工作了——快去看看她吧！
rows.raw: "It's been a day since you gave Agnimitra the Flame Capes, like she had asked. She must be done with her outfit by now — go and give her a visit!"

rows.original: Agnimitra has taken the three Flame Capes she asked you to get and she's sewn herself a flame-resistant outfit to make herself presentable enough to the world that she wouldn't be seen as 'indecent.' Agnimitra can now travel with you!
rows.translation: 阿格尼米特拉已经拿走了你帮她取来的那三件火焰斗篷，然后自己缝制了一套防火服装，这样她就能以得体的形象出现在世人面前，而不会被人认为“不得体”。阿格尼米特拉现在可以与你一起旅行了！
rows.raw: "Agnimitra has taken the three Flame Capes she asked you to get and she's sewn herself a flame-resistant outfit to make herself presentable enough to the world that she wouldn't be seen as 'indecent.' Agnimitra can now travel with you!"

                |[wayfort.hasFarrah

                    |Jael'yn is in way over her head, perhaps you could pay some workers from Hawkethorne to come up and help clear out your decrepit Wayfort?
                ]

rows.translation:
驿堡简直一团糟，[wayfort.hasDaliza
                |达莉莎和她的士兵需要些时间才能清理干净，也许你可以雇些鹰棘镇的工人？
                |[wayfort.hasFarrah
                    |法拉只有一个人，驿堡却有那么多地方要清理；也许可以雇些鹰棘镇的工人帮忙？
                    |杰尔因实在应付不过来，也许可以雇些鹰棘镇的工人来帮忙清理破败的驿堡？
                ]
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            The Wayfort is in an absolute state, [wayfort.hasDaliza
                |Daliza and her soldiers will require some time clearing everything out, perhaps you could pay some workers from Hawkethorne?
                |[wayfort.hasFarrah
                    |Farrah is just one woman, and there is a lot of Wayfort to clear out; perhaps you could pay some workers from Hawkethorne to help out?
                    |Jael'yn is in way over her head, perhaps you could pay some workers from Hawkethorne to come up and help clear out your decrepit Wayfort?
                ]
            ]"

rows.original: Garth has taken some money off of your hands and rounded up some lumberjacks and carpenters. You should go and check on the place after a week has passed.
rows.translation: 加斯从你手里拿了一些钱，然后召集了一些伐木工和木匠。一周后，你应该去那里看看情况如何。
rows.raw: "\n            Garth has taken some money off of your hands and rounded up some lumberjacks and carpenters. You should go and check on the place after a week has passed."

rows.original: It's been a week since Garth sent some workers up to the Wayfort for you, you should go and check the place out!
rows.translation: 自从加斯派了一些工人去荒废驿堡为你处理那些事情之后，已经过去了一周，你应该去那里看看情况吧！
rows.raw: "\n            It's been a week since Garth sent some workers up to the Wayfort for you, you should go and check the place out!"

rows.original: You've been shown around the Wayfort, and it's a huge improvement on its previously-decrepit state... but perhaps there's more that can be done?
rows.translation: 你们已经参观过荒废驿堡了，它确实比之前破败的状态有了巨大的改善……但或许还能做得更多吧？
rows.raw: "\n            You've been shown around the Wayfort, and it's a huge improvement on its previously-decrepit state... but perhaps there's more that can be done?"

rows.translation: 荒废驿堡升级

rows.original:
The Wayfort is looking habitable and passable, but in order to take things up to the next level you're going to need to find some professional craftsmen and get together a lot of resources and money. Not to mention the roads are going to need to be a lot safer. <ul>
              <li><b>
rows.translation:
荒废驿堡这个地方看起来倒是适合居住，也便于通行，但要想让它真正达到更好的状态，你就需要找到一些专业的工匠，同时筹集大量的资源和资金。更不用说，道路的安全性也必须得到进一步的保障。 <ul>
              <li><b>
rows.raw: "\n            The Wayfort is looking habitable and passable, but in order to take things up to the next level you're going to need to find some professional craftsmen and get together a lot of resources and money. Not to mention the roads are going to need to be a lot safer. <ul>\n              <li><b>"

rows.translation: 是
木材：
石材：
金属：
是
是
是
是

rows.original: - The girls of Pupperidge and Atani's marefolk are going to supply food.
rows.translation: - 帕珀里奇的姑娘们和阿塔妮的马族将会供应食物。
rows.raw: " - The girls of Pupperidge and Atani's marefolk are going to supply food."

rows.original: - The girls of Pupperidge are going to supply food, but you need to secure more.
rows.translation: - 帕珀里奇的姑娘们将会供应食物，但你还得确保有更多来源。
rows.raw: " - The girls of Pupperidge are going to supply food, but you need to secure more."

rows.original: - Atani and the marefolk are going to supply food, but you need to secure more.
rows.translation: - 阿塔妮和马族将会供应食物，但你还得确保有更多来源。
rows.raw: " - Atani and the marefolk are going to supply food, but you need to secure more."

rows.original:
Now that you've secured all of the supplies and specialists you need, it's time to return to [wayfort.hasDaliza
                |Daliza
                |[wayfort.hasFarrah
                    |Farrah
                    |Jael'yn
                ]
            ].
rows.translation:
所需物资和专业人员都已找齐，该回去找[wayfort.hasDaliza
                |达莉莎
                |[wayfort.hasFarrah
                    |法拉
                    |杰尔因
                ]
            ]了。
rows.raw:
"
            Now that you've secured all of the supplies and specialists you need, it's time to return to [wayfort.hasDaliza
                |Daliza
                |[wayfort.hasFarrah
                    |Farrah
                    |Jael'yn
                ]
            ]."

rows.original: The great undertaking has begun, with hornets flying around doing the manual labor, and some enthusiastic craftsmen on your side, it shouldn't take more than two weeks. It's going to look like a brand new Wayfort by the time they're done!
rows.translation: 这项伟大的工程已经开始了，有黄蜂在四处忙碌着进行体力劳动，还有你们这边一些热心的工匠帮忙，应该用不了两周时间。等他们完工后，那个地方一定会变成一座崭新的荒废驿堡！
rows.raw: "\n            The great undertaking has begun, with hornets flying around doing the manual labor, and some enthusiastic craftsmen on your side, it shouldn't take more than two weeks. It's going to look like a brand new Wayfort by the time they're done!"

rows.original: Your Wayfort is looking both respectable and defendable, with solid walls, a beautiful courtyard, well-stocked armory, kitchen, and bar... It would appear that you've succeeded in quickly raising up some land to be proud of.
rows.translation: 你的荒废驿堡庄园看起来既庄严又易于防御，有坚固的城墙、美丽的庭院、设施齐全的军械库、厨房和酒馆……看来你确实很快就建立起了一片值得骄傲的领地。
rows.raw: "\n            Your Wayfort is looking both respectable and defendable, with solid walls, a beautiful courtyard, well-stocked armory, kitchen, and bar... It would appear that you've succeeded in quickly raising up some land to be proud of."

rows.translation: 苍白火焰

rows.original:
According to Nakano, Mai would like to contribute more to the kitsunes' understanding of the local lay of the land. To that effect, she's looking for certain elementally-infused rocks that may be found in certain locations in and around the Marches in order to better comprehend the geomantic features of what lies underground.
            
            Before beginning, you should probably consult with Mai as to exactly what you're looking for and where you might find it.
rows.translation:
根据中野的说法，真希望自己能为狐族更好地了解当地的地理环境做出更多的贡献。为此，她正在寻找某些蕴含元素力量的岩石——这些岩石可能分布在边境地区及其周边的特定地点，通过研究这些岩石，她才能更深入地了解地下地貌的特征。
            
            在开始行动之前，你最好先咨询真，弄清楚自己究竟在寻找什么，以及应该去哪里寻找这些岩石。
rows.raw:
"
            According to Nakano, Mai would like to contribute more to the kitsunes' understanding of the local lay of the land. To that effect, she's looking for certain elementally-infused rocks that may be found in certain locations in and around the Marches in order to better comprehend the geomantic features of what lies underground.
            
            Before beginning, you should probably consult with Mai as to exactly what you're looking for and where you might find it."

rows.original:
Mai has asked you to retrieve some elementally-infused items to help her better understand the geomantic lay of the land when it comes to the Marches.<ul>
                <li><b>
rows.translation:
舞要求你去找一些蕴含元素力量的物品，这些物品能帮助她更深入地了解边境地区的地理格局。<ul>
                <li><b>
rows.raw: "\n            Mai has asked you to retrieve some elementally-infused items to help her better understand the geomantic lay of the land when it comes to the Marches.<ul>\n                <li><b>"

rows.translation: 这些可以在山腹深域找到。

rows.original: You turned the Hellhound down, so you'll have to look elsewhere.
rows.translation: 你拒绝了地狱犬，所以只能另寻他处。
rows.raw: "You turned the Hellhound down, so you'll have to look elsewhere."

rows.original: Alternatively, the Temple of Terrestrial Fire may have some.
rows.translation: 或者，也可以选择地火神殿可能有一些。
rows.raw: "Alternatively, the Temple of Terrestrial Fire may have some."

rows.original: The golem has collapsed the tunnel leading to it following its victory. You'll have to complete Mai's request some other way.
rows.translation: 魔像获胜后弄塌了通往它所在之处的隧道。你只能另想办法完成舞的请求。
rows.raw: "The golem has collapsed the tunnel leading to it following its victory. You'll have to complete Mai's request some other way."

rows.original: Instead of gathering the stones, you may instead acquire a Molten Core from the Magma Golem in Northern Undermountain, near the Windy Peaks exit.
rows.translation: 与其去收集这些石头，你不如直接获取一个熔融核心来自熔岩魔像北方地下山脉在风啸峰出口附近。
rows.raw: "Instead of gathering the stones, you may instead acquire a Molten Core from the Magma Golem in Northern Undermountain, near the Windy Peaks exit."

rows.translation: 你应该回到舞的身边。

rows.original: You have defeated the magma golem and acquired a fire jade.
rows.translation: 你已经击败熔岩魔像，并获得了一块火焰玉。
rows.raw: "You have defeated the magma golem and acquired a fire jade."

rows.original: You have collected all the elementally-infused stones.
rows.translation: 你已经收集了所有蕴含元素力量的宝石。
rows.raw: "You have collected all the elementally-infused stones."

rows.original: One way or the other, you've enabled Mai's studies on the local lay of the land. Let's just hope that she uses this knowledge for good and not mischief.
rows.translation: 不管怎样，你确实为舞的研究提供了关于当地地形情况的宝贵信息。我们只希望她能将这些知识用于好事，而不是用来搞恶作剧。
rows.raw: "One way or the other, you've enabled Mai's studies on the local lay of the land. Let's just hope that she uses this knowledge for good and not mischief."

rows.original: Dye-ing to Get to Know You
rows.translation: 以染结缘

rows.original: Serena, the cowgirl refugee, has mentioned a particular kind of expensive purple pigment that comes from the sea snails near her village. It's the stuff of kings and queens, and would help make a lovely garment... if you had any. You might be able to find some out in the Undermountain somewhere; while the overturned carts and refugee caravans have been very well picked over, perhaps one of the various marauding groups looted some that you can use.
rows.translation: 那位名叫塞蕾娜的牛仔女孩难民曾经提到过一种价格昂贵的紫色颜料，这种颜料来源于她村庄附近的海螺。这种颜料简直是王室贵族才用的珍品，用它制作出来的衣物一定会非常漂亮……当然，前提是你能弄到这种颜料。也许你在山腹深域的某个地方能找到一些；虽然那些被翻倒的马车和难民队伍留下的物品早就被洗劫一空了，但说不定有些劫掠者留下了你需要的颜料呢。
rows.raw: "\n            Serena, the cowgirl refugee, has mentioned a particular kind of expensive purple pigment that comes from the sea snails near her village. It's the stuff of kings and queens, and would help make a lovely garment... if you had any. You might be able to find some out in the Undermountain somewhere; while the overturned carts and refugee caravans have been very well picked over, perhaps one of the various marauding groups looted some that you can use."

rows.original: While fighting in the Undermountain, you found something that could be the expensive purple dye Serena mentioned. She can probably tell you whether it's the right stuff.
rows.translation: 在山腹深域战斗时，你发现了一种可能就是塞蕾娜提到的那种昂贵紫色染料的物品。她应该能够帮你确认这是否就是你要找的东西。
rows.raw: "\n            While fighting in the Undermountain, you found something that could be the expensive purple dye Serena mentioned. She can probably tell you whether it's the right stuff."

rows.original: The dye you found in the Undermountain was indeed the right stuff: murex, as pungent as it is expensive. Serena told you to hold onto it for now, but it sounds like she's going to talk to her fellow villagers and try to hook you up with something nice. Getting to know her and her students well ought to make that easier. Alternatively, you could sell the dye to someone in Hawkethorne with expertise in making clothes; it's undoubtedly worth a great deal of coin.
rows.translation: 你在山腹深域找到的那种染料确实正是你所需要的：那种价格昂贵且气味刺鼻的紫草染料。塞蕾娜之前让你暂时先留着它，不过听起来她打算和村里的其他人商量一下，想办法帮你弄到一些更好的东西。如果你能更好地了解她以及她的学生们，这件事应该会更容易办到。当然，你也可以把这种染料卖给鹰棘镇那些擅长制作服装的人，它无疑能换来很多钱。
rows.raw: "\n            The dye you found in the Undermountain was indeed the right stuff: murex, as pungent as it is expensive. Serena told you to hold onto it for now, but it sounds like she's going to talk to her fellow villagers and try to hook you up with something nice. Getting to know her and her students well ought to make that easier. Alternatively, you could sell the dye to someone in Hawkethorne with expertise in making clothes; it's undoubtedly worth a great deal of coin.\n            "

rows.original: Serena's asked you to let her students try to make a gift for you with the murex dye: a beautiful enchanted purple cloak in the style of a high-ranking military commander or Minoan noble[pc.mf||wo]man. You've accepted, but it'll take about three days for them to finish.
rows.translation: 塞蕾娜请你让她的学生们尝试用骨螺染料制作一份礼物：一件漂亮的紫色魔法披风，款式仿照高级将领或弥诺陶洛斯贵族[pc.mf|男士|女士]的服饰。你已经答应，但他们大约需要三天才能完成。
rows.raw: "\n            Serena's asked you to let her students try to make a gift for you with the murex dye: a beautiful enchanted purple cloak in the style of a high-ranking military commander or Minoan noble[pc.mf||wo]man. You've accepted, but it'll take about three days for them to finish."

rows.original: It's been three days since Serena and her students started their little class project for you. Visit her at Ember's Taphouse and see if she's got the goods.
rows.translation: 自从塞蕾娜和她的学生们开始为你开展这个小项目以来，已经过去了三天。你去“Ember’s Taphouse”找她吧，看看她是否已经完成了准备工作。
rows.raw: "\n            It's been three days since Serena and her students started their little class project for you. Visit her at Ember's Taphouse and see if she's got the goods."

rows.original: Serena presented you with a lovely gift: a gorgeous purple cloak, made as a class project with the dye you recovered from the Undermountain. [serena.relationshipRange 2|Not only that, but you and the cowgirl teacher seem to have made a genuine connection through the whole affair.|You've picked up a sweet outfit and a sweet friend to boot!]
rows.translation: 塞蕾娜送了你一份精美的礼物：一件华丽的紫色斗篷，这是大家共同完成的一个班级项目，所用的染料就是从山腹深域中提取的。 [serena.relationshipRange 2|不仅如此，你和那位女牛仔老师似乎在整个过程中建立了一种真挚的情感联系。|你不仅获得了一套漂亮的服装，还交到了一位可爱的朋友呢！]
rows.raw: "\n            Serena presented you with a lovely gift: a gorgeous purple cloak, made as a class project with the dye you recovered from the Undermountain. [serena.relationshipRange 2|Not only that, but you and the cowgirl teacher seem to have made a genuine connection through the whole affair.|You've picked up a sweet outfit and a sweet friend to boot!]"

rows.original: You decided to sell the murex dye to Nelia for something close to its street value. Thanks to that, you've pocketed a hefty amount of electrum for your trouble.
rows.translation: 你决定以接近其在市场上实际价值的价格将这种紫红色染料卖给了内莉娅，因此你为自己所付出的努力赚到了相当可观的电银。
rows.raw: "\n            You decided to sell the murex dye to Nelia for something close to its street value. Thanks to that, you've pocketed a hefty amount of electrum for your trouble."

rows.translation: 安置半人马

rows.original: You've agreed to help the centaurs in the outskirts find a new home on a farm.
rows.translation: 你已经同意帮助那些生活在郊外的半人马们在某个农场里找到新的家园。
rows.raw: "\n            You've agreed to help the centaurs in the outskirts find a new home on a farm. "

rows.original:
[flags.NOTTIA_FARM
                |Nottia's farm is apparently north of the centaur girls' usual hangout.
                |Nottia's farm is north of the centaur girls' usual hangout, not too far from the guard posts up the road.
            ]
            
            [flags.MARILLA_MET
                |Marilla's farm is just where you left it — to the south-east, on the far end of the outskirts.
                |You're not entirely sure where the other farm would be, but you could try looking south-east...
            ]
rows.translation:
[flags.NOTTIA_FARM
                |诺蒂亚的农场显然位于半人马女孩们常去的那个地方以北。
                |诺蒂亚的农场位于半人马女孩们常去的地点以北，距离路途上那些守卫哨所也不算太远。
            ]
            
            [flags.MARILLA_MET
                |玛丽拉的农场依然在原来的地方——位于东南方向，郊区的最远端。
                |你并不完全确定另一座农场会在哪里，但你可以试着朝东南方向寻找……
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            
            [flags.NOTTIA_FARM
                |Nottia's farm is apparently north of the centaur girls' usual hangout.
                |Nottia's farm is north of the centaur girls' usual hangout, not too far from the guard posts up the road.
            ]
            
            [flags.MARILLA_MET
                |Marilla's farm is just where you left it — to the south-east, on the far end of the outskirts.
                |You're not entirely sure where the other farm would be, but you could try looking south-east...
            ]"

rows.original:
Nottia's, specifically, though you[flags.MARILLA_MET
                | could also ask Marilla if she were okay with it
                |'re reasonably certain there's at least one more farm you could look for
            ].
rows.translation:
具体来说，是诺蒂娅的农场，不过你[flags.MARILLA_MET
                |也可以问问玛丽拉是否愿意
                |觉得至少还有另一座农场可以找找
            ]。
rows.raw:
"Nottia's, specifically, though you[flags.MARILLA_MET
                | could also ask Marilla if she were okay with it
                |'re reasonably certain there's at least one more farm you could look for
            ]."

rows.original: Marilla's, specifically, though you could also see if Nottia wanted to house them.
rows.translation: 尤其是玛丽拉的，不过你也可以看看诺蒂娅是否愿意收留它们。
rows.raw: "Marilla's, specifically, though you could also see if Nottia wanted to house them."

rows.original:
You've talked it over with both Nottia and Marilla. They're equally excited to have the centaurs around for different reasons — Nottia wants to have them help out around the farm a bit to get everything back to normal, and Marilla wants them to provide %"entertainment" for the slimes — and, you suspect, herself.

            Return to the centaurs to discuss the decision.
rows.translation:
你已经和诺蒂娅以及玛丽拉商量过了。她们出于不同的原因，都对有半人马在身边感到非常兴奋——诺蒂娅希望他们能帮忙打理农场，让一切恢复正常；而玛丽拉则希望他们能为那些史莱姆们提供“娱乐”，当然，你怀疑她自己也很喜欢这些半人马。

            现在，回去和半人马们讨论这个决定吧。
rows.raw: "You've talked it over with both Nottia and Marilla. They're equally excited to have the centaurs around for different reasons — Nottia wants to have them help out around the farm a bit to get everything back to normal, and Marilla wants them to provide %\"entertainment\" for the slimes — and, you suspect, herself.\n\n            Return to the centaurs to discuss the decision."

rows.original: You've talked it over with Nottia and she was thrilled at the prospect of having the centaur girls around. You could return to inform them, or you could [flags.MARILLA_MET|go ask Marilla if she's as willing as Nottia is|go look for that other farm].
rows.translation: 你已经和诺蒂娅讨论过了，她对于能有那些半人马女孩在身边感到非常兴奋。你可以回去告诉她们这个好消息，或者也可以[flags.MARILLA_MET|去问问玛丽拉，她是否像诺蒂亚那样愿意|去把那另一个农场找出来吧]。
rows.raw: "You've talked it over with Nottia and she was thrilled at the prospect of having the centaur girls around. You could return to inform them, or you could [flags.MARILLA_MET|go ask Marilla if she's as willing as Nottia is|go look for that other farm]."

rows.original: You've talked it over with Marilla and she was very interested in the idea of having centaur girls around for the slimes — and, you suspect, her — to fuck for entertainment. You could return to inform them, or you could go look for Nottia to see if she'd be willing to put the 'taurs up.
rows.translation: 你已经和玛丽拉讨论过这个想法了，她对让半人马女孩们陪伴那些史莱姆们——当然，你怀疑也是为了她自己的娱乐——这个主意非常感兴趣。你可以回去告诉他们这个决定，或者去找诺蒂娅，看看她是否愿意让那些半人马女孩们参与其中。
rows.raw: "You've talked it over with Marilla and she was very interested in the idea of having centaur girls around for the slimes — and, you suspect, her — to fuck for entertainment. You could return to inform them, or you could go look for Nottia to see if she'd be willing to put the 'taurs up."

rows.original: The five of you came to a group decision that they'd stay at
rows.translation: 你们五个人共同决定继续留在那里。
rows.raw: "The five of you came to a group decision that they'd stay at "

rows.original: Nottia's farm, helping her with physical tasks around the place and keeping her company. It's a win-win scenario, and you don't see the need to intervene further.
rows.translation: 诺蒂娅的农场；她们会帮诺蒂娅分担农场里的体力活，也能陪伴她。这是双赢的安排，你认为无需再作干预。
rows.raw: "Nottia's farm, helping her with physical tasks around the place and keeping her company. It's a win-win scenario, and you don't see the need to intervene further."

rows.original: Marilla's farm, helping her take care of the slimes. You've fixed two problems at once — there's no need to intervene further.
rows.translation: 玛丽拉的农场，帮助她照料那些黏液生物。你已经同时解决了两个问题，再不需要进一步干预了。
rows.raw: "Marilla's farm, helping her take care of the slimes. You've fixed two problems at once — there's no need to intervene further."

rows.translation: 劳逸平衡

rows.original: After you brought the centaurs to Marilla's farm, Nottia is still struggling to make any headway on her farm without any extra labor. There's got to be some way to help her —[flags.KM_SOLDIERS| maybe those gambling soldiers you met in the middle of the Outskirts can offer some assistance.| maybe you can try looking for some idle soldiers in the Outskirts and paying them for labor.]
rows.translation: 在你把半人马们带到玛丽拉的农场之后，诺蒂娅仍然在为如何在没有额外劳动力的情况下经营她的农场而苦恼。肯定有办法可以帮助她的[flags.KM_SOLDIERS| 也许你在郊外遇到的那些喜欢赌博的士兵能提供一些帮助。| 也许你可以试着在郊区找一些闲散的士兵，然后付钱让他们干活。]
rows.raw: "\n            After you brought the centaurs to Marilla's farm, Nottia is still struggling to make any headway on her farm without any extra labor. There's got to be some way to help her —[flags.KM_SOLDIERS| maybe those gambling soldiers you met in the middle of the Outskirts can offer some assistance.| maybe you can try looking for some idle soldiers in the Outskirts and paying them for labor.]"

rows.original: After having sent the centaurs to Marilla's farm, Nottia was left without labor. You've managed to employ some minotaur soldiers to help her get back on her feet, and her farm is thriving. It'll take some time for it to really pay off but for now, the cowgirl is overjoyed that you've helped her achieve something she's been lacking for years — free time.
rows.translation: 在把半人马们派往玛丽拉的农场之后，诺蒂娅就再也没有劳动力可用了。你设法雇了一些弥诺陶洛斯士兵来帮助她重新恢复生产，她的农场现在也渐渐兴旺起来。虽然要过一段时间才能真正看到成效，但此刻，这位女牛仔简直欣喜若狂——因为你帮助她获得了多年来一直缺失的东西：闲暇时光。
rows.raw: "\n            After having sent the centaurs to Marilla's farm, Nottia was left without labor. You've managed to employ some minotaur soldiers to help her get back on her feet, and her farm is thriving. It'll take some time for it to really pay off but for now, the cowgirl is overjoyed that you've helped her achieve something she's been lacking for years — free time."

rows.translation: 巢中之龙

rows.original:
Aileh the Dragon General has moved into your watchtower, and apparently swears no allegiance to either yourself or Kasyrra. She could prove to be an ally in defeating the demon queen... or winning her over, perhaps?

            Aileh's Opinion of you: [aileh.opinionRange 0 50
                |It looks like you've got a long way to go in order to win the dragon over, however. Spending some time with her might help.
                |Aileh likes you — or at least tolerates you — a lot more, maybe there's something else you can do that would make her feel at home?
            ]
rows.translation:
龙将艾莉赫已经入驻了你的瞭望塔，显然她既不效忠于你，也不效忠于卡希拉。她或许可以成为我们击败恶魔女王的盟友……或者，我们甚至有可能说服她站到我们这边来？

            艾莉赫对你的评价： [aileh.opinionRange 0 50
                |不过，看起来你还需要花很多时间才能赢得她的信任。多花一些时间陪在她身边，或许会有帮助。
                |艾莉其实更喜欢你，或者至少能容忍你。或许你可以做些什么，让她感到更加自在、更加像在家里一样？
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            Aileh the Dragon General has moved into your watchtower, and apparently swears no allegiance to either yourself or Kasyrra. She could prove to be an ally in defeating the demon queen... or winning her over, perhaps?

            Aileh's Opinion of you: [aileh.opinionRange 0 50
                |It looks like you've got a long way to go in order to win the dragon over, however. Spending some time with her might help.
                |Aileh likes you — or at least tolerates you — a lot more, maybe there's something else you can do that would make her feel at home?
            ]"

rows.original: Aileh has confessed her home could use a more personal touch; she's used to living in the lap of luxury. She wants an enchanted bathtub, a big strong bed, and some storage space... not the most unreasonable of requests, if a little expensive. You'll need to find an enchanter, put an order in with Garth for some carpentry, and pay a tailor for the necessary goods.
rows.translation: 艾莉承认，她的家确实需要一些更加个性化的装饰；她已经习惯了奢华的生活环境。她想要一个带有魔法的浴缸、一张宽大结实的床，还有一些储物空间……这些要求还算不上最不合理的，只是有点贵。你得去找一位法师，让加斯帮忙安排一些木工工作，同时还得付钱给裁缝来获取所需的材料。
rows.raw:
"\n Aileh has confessed her home could use a more personal touch; she's used to living in the lap of luxury. She wants an enchanted bathtub, a big strong bed, and some storage space... not the most unreasonable of requests, if a little expensive. You'll need to find an enchanter, put an order in with Garth for some carpentry, and pay a tailor for the necessary goods.
    \n
  • "

rows.translation: 是
是
- 你已雇用加斯。
是
- 你已雇用内莉娅。

rows.original: You've collected everything you need, it's time to surprise Aileh.
rows.translation: 你已经收集到了所有需要的物品，是时候给艾莱赫一个惊喜了。
rows.raw: "\n            You've collected everything you need, it's time to surprise Aileh."

rows.original: Aileh is a happy-looking dragon, and thinks of you as her [aileh.friendLover|friend|lover]. Who knows what this will mean for you in the future? For now she seems content to live here in the Wayfort, and play nice with its inhabitants.
rows.translation: 艾莱赫是一条看起来很快乐的龙，将你视为她的[aileh.friendLover|朋友|恋人]。谁知道这对你的未来意味着什么？目前她似乎很满足于住在驿堡，与这里的居民友好相处。
rows.raw: "\n            Aileh is a happy-looking dragon, and thinks of you as her [aileh.friendLover|friend|lover]. Who knows what this will mean for you in the future? For now she seems content to live here in the Wayfort, and play nice with its inhabitants."

rows.translation: 制高点

rows.original: Looks like you're not fully done with the miserable saga of Hawkethorne's dark past just yet. Sanders has invited you to the chapel to hear his side of the story — hear him out when you're willing and able.
rows.translation: 看来你还没有完全读完关于鹰棘镇那段暗影过去的这段故事吧。桑德斯邀请你去小教堂，听听他自己的说法——当你有时间和精力的时候，去听听他的故事吧。
rows.raw: "\n            Looks like you're not fully done with the miserable saga of Hawkethorne's dark past just yet. Sanders has invited you to the chapel to hear his side of the story — hear him out when you're willing and able."

rows.original:
Sanders has sat you down and told you about the Dawnsword, an artifact he hid away after his crisis of faith following Gweyr's exile from Hawkethorne. It's up somewhere in the mountains to the east of Harvest Valley, a search that could take weeks if not months and still turn up fruitless; he claims that if you're worthy of wielding it, the artifact will reveal itself to you.

            While you have no idea if it's even still up there, Sanders sounds earnest and he's not lying to you. If anyone knows anything about town lore, though, it'll be River. Maybe you can ask him if there's any light he can shed on the story.
rows.translation:
桑德斯已经跟你讲过了那把晨曦剑——那件他在格维尔被放逐出鹰棘镇后，因信仰危机而藏起来的神器。它应该就在收获谷以东的那些山脉中某个地方，寻找它可能需要数周甚至数月的时间，但最终也可能一无所获；他声称，如果你真的有资格使用那把剑，那么这件神器自然会出现在你面前。

            虽然你根本不知道那东西是否还存在于那里，但桑德斯听起来很认真，他并没有在骗你。不过，如果有人真正了解这个小镇的传说，那一定是瑞弗。或许你可以问他，是否能为这个故事提供一些线索。
rows.raw:
"
            Sanders has sat you down and told you about the Dawnsword, an artifact he hid away after his crisis of faith following Gweyr's exile from Hawkethorne. It's up somewhere in the mountains to the east of Harvest Valley, a search that could take weeks if not months and still turn up fruitless; he claims that if you're worthy of wielding it, the artifact will reveal itself to you.

            While you have no idea if it's even still up there, Sanders sounds earnest and he's not lying to you. If anyone knows anything about town lore, though, it'll be River. Maybe you can ask him if there's any light he can shed on the story."

rows.original:
It looks like Liaden's roped you into her search for the Dawnsword, an artifact Sanders hid away after his crisis of faith. It's up somewhere in the mountains to the east of Harvest Valley, a search that could take weeks if not months and still turn up fruitless, but Liaden claims she's got something that might narrow down the search.

            Either way, you're invited to come along and she's promised to make it worth your while. Talk to her again in the chapel when you're ready to head off.
rows.translation:
看来莉娅登把你拉入了她寻找“晨曦剑”的行动中。这把神器是桑德斯在信仰危机之后藏起来的，现在应该藏在收获谷东边的某座山上。这次搜寻可能需要数周甚至数月的时间，而且结果也可能一无所获，但莉娅登声称她掌握了一些线索，或许能缩小搜索范围。

            无论如何，她邀请你一同参与这次行动，并保证会让你的参与有所收获。等你准备好出发的时候，再去小教堂和她谈谈吧。
rows.raw:
"
            It looks like Liaden's roped you into her search for the Dawnsword, an artifact Sanders hid away after his crisis of faith. It's up somewhere in the mountains to the east of Harvest Valley, a search that could take weeks if not months and still turn up fruitless, but Liaden claims she's got something that might narrow down the search.

            Either way, you're invited to come along and she's promised to make it worth your while. Talk to her again in the chapel when you're ready to head off."

rows.original: Upon arriving in the eastern side of Harvest Valley, you were quickly accosted by a gnoll princess and her entourage who took immense offense at your perceived trespass upon her little kingdom. Unable to overcome her, you were quickly sent packing back home; it's a small mercy they didn't do worse. If the Dawnsword's still around there somewhere, you're clearly not strong enough to be worthy of wielding it given that you lost to a pack of mangy furballs.
rows.translation: 当你抵达收获谷的东侧时，立刻有一名地精公主和她的随从们找上了你。他们认为你侵犯了他们的小王国，因此感到极为愤怒。由于你无法战胜他们，只好被迅速赶了回去；至少他们没有对你做出更过分的事情，这也算是一种幸运吧。如果晨曦剑还在那里的某个地方，那么很明显，你的实力还不够强，根本不配拥有它——毕竟你连一群脏兮兮的毛球都打不过。
rows.raw: "\n            Upon arriving in the eastern side of Harvest Valley, you were quickly accosted by a gnoll princess and her entourage who took immense offense at your perceived trespass upon her little kingdom. Unable to overcome her, you were quickly sent packing back home; it's a small mercy they didn't do worse. If the Dawnsword's still around there somewhere, you're clearly not strong enough to be worthy of wielding it given that you lost to a pack of mangy furballs."

rows.original:
You've seen the story of the Dawnsword to its end, and hopefully with it the last chapter of Hawkethorne's ugly past. With it now in [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER
                |Liaden's possession, perhaps some good will come of all this.
                |[flags.DARK_LIGHTSABER
                    |a fallen state, Sanders wants nothing to do with the weapon. Perhaps its bloodthirstiness can be put to use, if not good use...
                    |your hands, perhaps some good will come of all this.
                ]
            ]
rows.translation:
你见证了晨曦剑故事的结局，希望鹰棘镇丑陋的过去也就此画上句号。如今这把剑[flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER
                |归莉娅登所有，或许这一切终究能带来些好事。
                |[flags.DARK_LIGHTSABER
                    |已然堕落，桑德斯不想与它有任何瓜葛。或许它嗜血的本性仍有用武之地，哪怕并非用于善事……
                    |在你手中，或许这一切终究能带来些好事。
                ]
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            You've seen the story of the Dawnsword to its end, and hopefully with it the last chapter of Hawkethorne's ugly past. With it now in [flags.LIADEN_LIGHTSABER
                |Liaden's possession, perhaps some good will come of all this.
                |[flags.DARK_LIGHTSABER
                    |a fallen state, Sanders wants nothing to do with the weapon. Perhaps its bloodthirstiness can be put to use, if not good use...
                    |your hands, perhaps some good will come of all this.
                ]
            ]"

rows.translation: 龙族茶会

rows.original:
Kaina has asked you to get some tea for her, and paid you with a tremendous ruby. There are a few people you could go to for resources; the only issue would be sourcing it reliably, and getting supplies to Kaina.
            
            Likely she would appreciate some food, too. [flags.GIANNA_CARAVAN_MET
                |Perhaps Gianna's Caravan can help you?
                |Surely someone out there can make the trek to icy lands.
            ]
rows.translation:
凯娜让你去为她买些茶，并给了你一颗价值连城的红宝石作为报酬。有几个人你可以去找他们获取这些所需的物品；唯一的问题在于如何可靠地获取这些资源，并将它们送到凯娜手中。
            
            或许，她也会喜欢一些食物的。 [flags.GIANNA_CARAVAN_MET
                |也许吉安娜的商队能帮助你呢？
                |肯定有人愿意前往那些冰封之地吧。
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            Kaina has asked you to get some tea for her, and paid you with a tremendous ruby. There are a few people you could go to for resources; the only issue would be sourcing it reliably, and getting supplies to Kaina.
            
            Likely she would appreciate some food, too. [flags.GIANNA_CARAVAN_MET
                |Perhaps Gianna's Caravan can help you?
                |Surely someone out there can make the trek to icy lands.
            ]"

rows.original: You've asked Gianna and Tamarind to source you some tea, and they have assured you that there will be no problems making your delivery up to Kaina. You've even managed to assure some extra trade and travel for Kohaku.
rows.translation: 你让吉安娜和塔玛琳德帮你采购一些茶叶，她们也向你保证，将茶叶送到凯娜那里肯定不会有任何问题。而且，你还因此为科哈库争取到了一些额外的贸易机会和出行机会。
rows.raw: "\n            You've asked Gianna and Tamarind to source you some tea, and they have assured you that there will be no problems making your delivery up to Kaina. You've even managed to assure some extra trade and travel for Kohaku."

rows.original: Though you've not crossed ways with a kitsune trader for any green tea, you're sure Kaina will be happy when her delivery arrives regardless.
rows.translation: 虽然你从未与那些贩卖狐妖相关物品的商人有过任何交集，但你可以肯定，当凯娜收到的货物最终到达时，她一定会很高兴的。
rows.raw: "\n            Though you've not crossed ways with a kitsune trader for any green tea, you're sure Kaina will be happy when her delivery arrives regardless."

rows.original: Kaina has thanked you for sourcing her some tea, and requested you bring some to her auntie: Ashelander, the gold dragon. As unlikely a request as this might be, apparently the mighty dragon was injured a great many years ago and has been sitting alone in a mountain to the west of Harvest Valley.
rows.translation: 凯娜感谢你为她找到了那些茶叶，同时还请你帮她把一些茶叶带给她的阿姨——灰烬使者，那条金龙。虽然这个请求听起来有些不可思议，但据说这条强大的龙在很多年前受了伤，之后就一直独自生活在丰收谷西边的那座山上。
rows.raw: "\n            Kaina has thanked you for sourcing her some tea, and requested you bring some to her auntie: Ashelander, the gold dragon. As unlikely a request as this might be, apparently the mighty dragon was injured a great many years ago and has been sitting alone in a mountain to the west of Harvest Valley."

" You've delivered Kaina's tea to Ashe... but the poor dragon isn't in a position to enjoy it; she has a debilitating injury, and only royalty can withdraw the spear pinning her wings. [flags.ASHE_SPEAR_CHOICE 1 2 |This could be done by Azzy, all you have to do is bring her back to Ashe. |Evelyn's a princess; perhaps she can help? |Unfortunately you don't know any qualifying royalty... [flags.HIVE_CORRUPT |[flags.EVELYN_INTRO_LEFT |This is as far as this quest progresses for now. ] ] ]"

rows.original: Although you can't be convinced this is a happy ending, the matter is resolved.
rows.translation: 虽然你可能无法相信这真的是一个幸福的结局，但事情终究已经得到了解决。
rows.raw: "Although you can't be convinced this is a happy ending, the matter is resolved. "

rows.original: carries the Amazon Princess' spear, and has been transformed into something... greater.
rows.translation: 手持亚马逊公主的长矛，如今已经蜕变成某种……更强大的存在。
rows.raw: " carries the Amazon Princess' spear, and has been transformed into something... greater."

rows.original: Ashe herself... has passed away, apparently unprepared to face her end. Now what remains of the golden dragon resides in a mace.
rows.translation: 艾什本人……已经离世了，显然她并没有准备好面对生命的终结。如今，那条金色巨龙的残余部分被封存在一根权杖之中。
rows.raw: " Ashe herself... has passed away, apparently unprepared to face her end. Now what remains of the golden dragon resides in a mace."

rows.original: At the very least your honey-hornet seems to be able to change herself back and forth.
rows.translation: 至少，你的蜜糖黄蜂姑娘似乎能在两种形态之间自由切换。
rows.raw: " At the very least your honey-hornet seems to be able to change herself back and forth."

rows.translation: 荒废驿堡的女仆

rows.original: [jaelyn.isDemon|Jael'yn wants a little more eye-candy buzzing around the Wayfort, and thinks that if you want to elevate yourself from the realms of peasant nobility, you need maids.|Rumie confesses that the mess hall is missing a little something, and that considering you've got so many cuties wandering around, perhaps they'd like employment as maids?] Perhaps the seamstress back in Hawkethorne would be willing to do a bulk order of sexy maid outfits? [jaelyn.isDemon|Jael can figure out the rest, you're sure.|Hopefully with a uniform in place, Rumie will be able to teach them the rest.]
rows.translation: [jaelyn.isDemon|杰尔因想让驿堡里多些养眼的美人来回忙碌，认为你若想摆脱乡下贵族的层次，就需要女仆。|露米坦言，食堂还缺了点什么，而既然这里有这么多可爱姑娘四处闲逛，或许她们愿意受雇当女仆？] 也许鹰棘镇的女裁缝愿意接一份性感女仆装的大订单？[jaelyn.isDemon|剩下的事杰尔因会安排好，你对此很确信。|希望有了制服，露米就能教会她们其余的事情。]
rows.raw: " [jaelyn.isDemon|Jael'yn wants a little more eye-candy buzzing around the Wayfort, and thinks that if you want to elevate yourself from the realms of peasant nobility, you need maids.|Rumie confesses that the mess hall is missing a little something, and that considering you've got so many cuties wandering around, perhaps they'd like employment as maids?] Perhaps the seamstress back in Hawkethorne would be willing to do a bulk order of sexy maid outfits? [jaelyn.isDemon|Jael can figure out the rest, you're sure.|Hopefully with a uniform in place, Rumie will be able to teach them the rest.]"

rows.original: You're going to need a massive 5,000 electrum coins in order to produce enough clothing for all of the hornets [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED||and alraune-effigies ]who want to work for you.
rows.translation: 你需要足足5,000枚琥珀金币，才能为所有愿意替你工作的黄蜂[flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED||和阿尔劳妮的魔像]制作足够的衣服。
rows.raw: "\n            You're going to need a massive 5,000 electrum coins in order to produce enough clothing for all of the hornets [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED||and alraune-effigies ]who want to work for you."

rows.original: Nelia has assured you that she'll get to work straight away on producing enough maid clothing to outfit a small, adorable army. It just might take a week.
rows.translation: 内莉娅向你保证，她会立刻开始着手制作足够的 maid clothing，以便为那支小巧而可爱的“军队”提供服装。不过，这可能需要一周的时间。
rows.raw: "\n            Nelia has assured you that she'll get to work straight away on producing enough maid clothing to outfit a small, adorable army. It just might take a week."

rows.original: A week has passed, you should go back to Nelia and collect your dresses for your Wayfort.
rows.translation: 一周的时间已经过去了，你应该回去找内莉娅，取回你为参加荒废驿堡活动准备的礼服。
rows.raw: "\n            A week has passed, you should go back to Nelia and collect your dresses for your Wayfort."

rows.original: Now that you've got your dress order completed, it's time to deliver them to [wayfort.hasJaelyn|Jael'yn|Rumie].
rows.translation: 服装订单已经完成，该将衣服送给[wayfort.hasJaelyn|杰尔因|露米]了。
rows.raw: "\n            Now that you've got your dress order completed, it's time to deliver them to [wayfort.hasJaelyn|Jael'yn|Rumie]."

rows.original: It's done! Your hornets [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED||and effigies ]are all dressed up in adorable maid outfits, doing good work around the Wayfort.
rows.translation: 完成了！你的黄蜂们[flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED||以及各种象征物 ]他们都穿着可爱的女仆装，在荒废驿堡庄园里忙得不可开交。
rows.raw: "\n            It's done! Your hornets [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED||and effigies ]are all dressed up in adorable maid outfits, doing good work around the Wayfort."

rows.translation: 玛蒂哈的复仇

rows.original: Astraea, a magehunter from the Order Astrida, has located Matiha's teleporting tower – and it’s gotten itself wedged in the Ways Between, the extra-dimensional pocket space that can send you throughout Savarra within the blink of an eye. Matiha’s power has grown large enough that two magehunters failed to bring her down, and Astraea has no way to contact the Order from where she is. It's up to you and Berwyn to put a stop to whatever Matiha's been doing, once and for all.
rows.translation: 来自阿斯特里达组织的法师猎手阿斯特莱娅已经找到了玛蒂哈的传送塔——而那座传送塔此刻被卡在了“通道之中”——这个能够让你在瞬间穿越整个萨瓦拉的跨维度空间里。玛蒂哈的力量已经强大到连两名法师猎手都无法将其击败，而阿斯特莱娅目前所处的位置也让她无法与组织取得联系。现在，就由你和贝尔温来彻底阻止玛蒂哈的所作所为了。
rows.raw: "\n            Astraea, a magehunter from the Order Astrida, has located Matiha's teleporting tower – and it’s gotten itself wedged in the Ways Between, the extra-dimensional pocket space that can send you throughout Savarra within the blink of an eye. Matiha’s power has grown large enough that two magehunters failed to bring her down, and Astraea has no way to contact the Order from where she is. It's up to you and Berwyn to put a stop to whatever Matiha's been doing, once and for all."

rows.original: Matiha's teleporting fortress has stopped in the Ways Between. You've finally managed to enter the building — but as soon as you did, the fortress's very bricks came apart and rearranged themselves with you and Berwyn still inside. Now, every time you enter a new room, the entire fortress changes shape to confuse and disorient you. Keep a keen eye and watch for the littlest details: there's bound to be a way out of this fortress!
rows.translation: 玛蒂哈的传送堡垒已经停在了“道路之间”。你终于成功进入了这座建筑——但就在你进入的瞬间，堡垒的砖块开始分解并重新排列，而你和贝尔温仍然被关在里面。现在，每当你进入一个新的房间，整个堡垒都会改变形状，以此来迷惑你、让你迷失方向。一定要保持警惕，留意每一个细微的线索：肯定有办法从这个堡垒里逃出去的！
rows.raw: "\n            Matiha's teleporting fortress has stopped in the Ways Between. You've finally managed to enter the building — but as soon as you did, the fortress's very bricks came apart and rearranged themselves with you and Berwyn still inside. Now, every time you enter a new room, the entire fortress changes shape to confuse and disorient you. Keep a keen eye and watch for the littlest details: there's bound to be a way out of this fortress!"

rows.original:
Matiha had been corrupted by long-term exposure to a rune stone that had absorbed thousands of years of ambient mana. After defeating her and destroying the stone, [flags.MATIHA_RES 1 2 3 4
                |Matiha came to her senses, and, after a brief reunion with [berwyn.name], has decided to stay with [berwyn.himHer] inside the fortress, itself still inside the Ways Between.
                |you decided that it may be best for Matiha and [berwyn.name] to spend some time apart. You sent her to the Waystone Portal within the Wayfort — hopefully, it's there that she can recuperate and rehabilitate.
                |you decided that Matiha might be best left in the hands of a fellow witch — so you sent her to live with Lady Evergreen. Hopefully Matiha will find a friend in her as she rehabilitates from the effects of the stone.
                |you decided that Matiha needed to answer for her crimes and her disregard for the safety of the world around herself, and you sent her unconscious body to Tychris. What the Order Astrida do with her there is none of your business now.
            ]

            [berwyn.name] has also learned how to teleport the fortress [berwyn.himHer]self, just as Matiha could. Now, you can summon the whole fortress anywhere you can set up camp!
rows.translation:
玛蒂哈由于长期接触一块吸收了数千年环境魔力的符文石而遭到腐化。击败她并摧毁符文石后，[flags.MATIHA_RES 1 2 3 4
                |玛蒂哈恢复了神智，并在与[berwyn.name]短暂重聚后，决定和[berwyn.himHer]一起留在那座仍处于界间之路中的堡垒里。
                |你认为最好让玛蒂哈和[berwyn.name]暂时分开一段时间。你将她送往驿堡内的界石传送门，希望她能在那里休养康复，摆脱符文石的影响。
                |你认为最好把玛蒂哈交给另一位女巫照顾，于是将她送到了常青女士那里。希望玛蒂哈在摆脱符文石影响、逐渐康复的过程中，能与她成为朋友。
                |你认为玛蒂哈必须为自己的罪行，以及罔顾周遭世界安危的行为负责，于是将她昏迷的身体送往提克里斯。如今阿斯特里达教团会如何处置她，已经与你无关。
            ]

            [berwyn.name]也学会了像玛蒂哈那样，凭[berwyn.himHer]自己传送整座堡垒。现在，你可以在任何能够扎营的地方召唤整座堡垒！
rows.raw:
"
            Matiha had been corrupted by long-term exposure to a rune stone that had absorbed thousands of years of ambient mana. After defeating her and destroying the stone, [flags.MATIHA_RES 1 2 3 4
                |Matiha came to her senses, and, after a brief reunion with [berwyn.name], has decided to stay with [berwyn.himHer] inside the fortress, itself still inside the Ways Between.
                |you decided that it may be best for Matiha and [berwyn.name] to spend some time apart. You sent her to the Waystone Portal within the Wayfort — hopefully, it's there that she can recuperate and rehabilitate.
                |you decided that Matiha might be best left in the hands of a fellow witch — so you sent her to live with Lady Evergreen. Hopefully Matiha will find a friend in her as she rehabilitates from the effects of the stone.
                |you decided that Matiha needed to answer for her crimes and her disregard for the safety of the world around herself, and you sent her unconscious body to Tychris. What the Order Astrida do with her there is none of your business now.
            ]

            [berwyn.name] has also learned how to teleport the fortress [berwyn.himHer]self, just as Matiha could. Now, you can summon the whole fortress anywhere you can set up camp!"

rows.translation: 换个想法

rows.original: Quin is getting along with you well enough, but his role in battle could be more... practical. Given he uses a shield and Atugia is the best one at using armor, maybe you can convince the taeleer to train under the redhead. If he agrees, the gym should provide ample space to get him up-to-speed. The two of them get along well enough.[flags.QUIN_TALK_TUI|| You think.]
rows.translation: 昆因和你相处得还不错，但他在战斗中的表现还可以更加……实用一些。既然他使用盾牌，而阿图吉娅又是最擅长运用护甲的战士，或许你可以说服那位泰勒尔去向这位红发战士学习。如果他同意的话，训练场应该有足够的空间让他尽快掌握相关技能。他们两个人相处得也挺不错的。[flags.QUIN_TALK_TUI|| 你这么认为吗？]
rows.raw: "\n            Quin is getting along with you well enough, but his role in battle could be more... practical. Given he uses a shield and Atugia is the best one at using armor, maybe you can convince the taeleer to train under the redhead. If he agrees, the gym should provide ample space to get him up-to-speed. The two of them get along well enough.[flags.QUIN_TALK_TUI|| You think.]"

rows.original: Quin agreed but he thinks you aren't serious: [flags.QUIN_PAY|the taeleer says he'll pay for it but you need to|you'll need to foot the bill and] have him custom-fitted over at [flags.OGRISH_MET|Ogrish's shop|the blacksmith's]. [flags.QUIN_PAY|Quintillus agreed to pay for the whole thing, after all, so now it's just up to you.|The taeleer mentioned he'll need 500 hawks to pay for the whole thing. If you're serious, you'd better show him just how deep your pockets go.] Once you're ready, go with Quintillus to get the fitting done.
rows.translation: 昆因答应了，但他觉得你不是认真的：[flags.QUIN_PAY|这位泰勒族男子说他愿意付钱，不过你得|你得自掏腰包，再]带他去[flags.OGRISH_MET|奥格里什的店铺|铁匠铺]量身定制。[flags.QUIN_PAY|毕竟昆蒂卢斯答应支付全部费用，现在就看你了。|这位泰勒族男子说，整套东西需要500鹰币。如果你是认真的，最好让他见识一下你的财力。]准备好后，就带昆蒂卢斯去量尺寸吧。
rows.raw: "\n            Quin agreed but he thinks you aren't serious: [flags.QUIN_PAY|the taeleer says he'll pay for it but you need to|you'll need to foot the bill and] have him custom-fitted over at [flags.OGRISH_MET|Ogrish's shop|the blacksmith's]. [flags.QUIN_PAY|Quintillus agreed to pay for the whole thing, after all, so now it's just up to you.|The taeleer mentioned he'll need 500 hawks to pay for the whole thing. If you're serious, you'd better show him just how deep your pockets go.] Once you're ready, go with Quintillus to get the fitting done."

rows.original: [flags.QUIN_PAY|Quintillus, thanks to your friendship, footed the bill|You paid for the armor]. Ogrish will need a day to get everything ready. In the meantime, you should continue adventuring and taking care of whatever you need to do. Once Quintillus and Atugia start training, you'll probably have your hands full helping out.
rows.translation: [flags.QUIN_PAY|昆蒂卢斯，多亏了你的帮助，这笔费用才得以支付。|你是花了钱才买到这套盔甲的。]奥格里什需要一天的时间来准备一切。在此期间，你们应该继续冒险，处理自己需要做的事情。等昆蒂卢斯和阿图吉娅开始训练后，你们可能会忙得不可开交，需要帮忙照顾他们。
rows.raw: "\n            [flags.QUIN_PAY|Quintillus, thanks to your friendship, footed the bill|You paid for the armor]. Ogrish will need a day to get everything ready. In the meantime, you should continue adventuring and taking care of whatever you need to do. Once Quintillus and Atugia start training, you'll probably have your hands full helping out."

rows.original: The armor should be done by now: if you're ready, go pick it up from Ogrish.
rows.translation: 这件盔甲现在应该已经做好了：如果你准备好了，就去奥格瑞什那里取吧。
rows.raw: "\n            The armor should be done by now: if you're ready, go pick it up from Ogrish."

rows.original: You've picked up Quin's heavy armor. Time to deliver it to him in the Frost Hound so he can start his training. You will be busy for a few days with his training: make sure you don't have anything else going on!
rows.translation: 你已经拿起了昆因的重型盔甲。现在该把它送到冰寒霜猎犬那里，让他开始训练了。在接下来的几天里，你将忙于他的训练工作：一定要确保自己没有其他事情要处理！
rows.raw: "\n You've picked up Quin's heavy armor. Time to deliver it to him in the Frost Hound so he can start his training. You will be busy for a few days with his training: make sure you don't have anything else going on!"

rows.original: After a few days of training, Atugia gave Quintillus a passing grade in his defensive training. The taeleer is impressed at how it all turned out but is even happier now that he has the ability to keep you and the party safer in battle, should the need arise.
rows.translation: 经过几天的训练，阿图吉娅给昆蒂卢斯在防御训练方面的表现打了及格分数。这位导师对训练结果感到十分满意，而更令他高兴的是，现在自己终于有能力在战斗中保护你和整个团队，确保你们的安全。
rows.raw: "\n            After a few days of training, Atugia gave Quintillus a passing grade in his defensive training. The taeleer is impressed at how it all turned out but is even happier now that he has the ability to keep you and the party safer in battle, should the need arise."

rows.original:
You've spoken to [wayfort.hasDaliza|Daliza|[wayfort.hasJaelyn|Jael'yn|Farrah]] about having a dungeon constructed in the Wayfort. As always, you need supplies... but you also require the assistance of an enchanter who'd know how to keep a spellcaster or demon from slipping out. <ul>
              <li><b>
rows.translation:
你已和[wayfort.hasDaliza|达莉莎|[wayfort.hasJaelyn|杰尔因|法拉]]谈过在驿堡建造地牢的事。像往常一样，你需要物资……不过，还需要一位附魔师帮忙，知道如何防止施法者或恶魔逃脱。<ul>
              <li><b>
rows.raw: "\n            You've spoken to [wayfort.hasDaliza|Daliza|[wayfort.hasJaelyn|Jael'yn|Farrah]] about having a dungeon constructed in the Wayfort. As always, you need supplies... but you also require the assistance of an enchanter who'd know how to keep a spellcaster or demon from slipping out. <ul>\n              <li><b>"

rows.translation: 木材：
石材：
金属：
是

rows.original: You have everything you need, just go back to [wayfort.hasDaliza|Daliza|[wayfort.hasJaelyn|Jael'yn|Farrah]] and get everything put together.
rows.translation: 所需的一切都齐了，只要回去找[wayfort.hasDaliza|达莉莎|[wayfort.hasJaelyn|杰尔因|法拉]]，把事情安排妥当就行。
rows.raw: "\n            You have everything you need, just go back to [wayfort.hasDaliza|Daliza|[wayfort.hasJaelyn|Jael'yn|Farrah]] and get everything put together."

rows.original: It'll just take a week for construction to be completed, and then you'll have your very own dungeon.
rows.translation: 施工只需要一周的时间就能完成，到时候你就能拥有属于自己的地下城了。
rows.raw: "\n            It'll just take a week for construction to be completed, and then you'll have your very own dungeon."

rows.original: Your Wayfort dungeon is completed! Yay.
rows.translation: 你的荒废驿堡地下城任务已经完成了！太棒了。
rows.raw: "\n            Your Wayfort dungeon is completed! Yay."

rows.translation: 命运之戒

rows.original: Calise asked you to help her find an artifact from Khor'minos' history, but you turned her down.
rows.translation: 卡莉丝请求你帮助她寻找一件与科尔米诺斯历史相关的文物，但你拒绝了她的请求。
rows.raw: "\n            Calise asked you to help her find an artifact from Khor'minos' history, but you turned her down."

rows.original: Calise has asked you to help her find an artifact from Khor'minos' history. Meet her at the Steps of Sorra, in the northwestern-most part of the Undermountain, to begin your expedition.
rows.translation: 卡莉丝请求你帮助她寻找一件与科尔米诺斯历史相关的文物。请在地下城最西北端的索拉台阶处与她会面，然后开始你们的探险吧。
rows.raw: "\n            Calise has asked you to help her find an artifact from Khor'minos' history. Meet her at the Steps of Sorra, in the northwestern-most part of the Undermountain, to begin your expedition."

rows.original: You've arrived in the Grave of Saints. The Ring of Fate must be here somewhere...
rows.translation: 你已经来到了圣徒墓地。命运之戒肯定就在这里的某个地方……
rows.raw: "\n            You've arrived in the Grave of Saints. The Ring of Fate must be here somewhere..."

rows.original: You've acquired the Ring of Fate, the artifact in question. Time to leave!
rows.translation: 你已经获得了那件重要的神器——命运之环，是时候离开了！
rows.raw: "\n            You've acquired the Ring of Fate, the artifact in question. Time to leave!"

rows.original: Despite the best efforts of an assassin from Tollus's cult, you and Calise have returned to the city — though the paladin was gravely injured in the attack. The Ring of Fate is now in your hands.
rows.translation: 尽管托勒斯教派的刺客付出了全力，你和卡莉丝还是成功回到了城市——不过那位圣骑士在那次袭击中受了重伤。现在，命运之环已经落在了你的手中。
rows.raw: "\n            Despite the best efforts of an assassin from Tollus's cult, you and Calise have returned to the city — though the paladin was gravely injured in the attack. The Ring of Fate is now in your hands."

rows.translation: 大坏狼
任务失败
任务已接受
完成！
着魔

rows.original: You've found a strange vial that's contents look like milk in the hands of a demon. You should take one to an alchemist for further inspection.
rows.translation: 你在一个恶魔的手中发现了一个奇怪的小瓶子，里面的液体看起来像牛奶。你应该把它拿给炼金术士进一步检查。
rows.raw: "\n            You've found a strange vial that's contents look like milk in the hands of a demon. You should take one to an alchemist for further inspection."

rows.original: You took the vial to Ivris, but she wanted nothing to do with it. Maybe another alchemist?
rows.translation: 你把那个小瓶子带给了艾薇莉丝，但她根本不想碰它。或许应该找别的炼金术士试试？
rows.raw: "\n            You took the vial to Ivris, but she wanted nothing to do with it. Maybe another alchemist?"

rows.original: Evergreen didn't care about the vial's contents but suggested you take it to another %"witch in the woods" that she's heard about. [flags.VIVIANE_MET|You'd be willing to bet she's talking about Viviane.]
rows.translation: 常青女士并不关心那个小瓶子里装的是什么，但她建议你把它带到森林里另一位她听说存在的“女巫”那里去。 [flags.VIVIANE_MET|你可以打赌，她说的肯定是指薇薇安。]
rows.raw: "\n            Evergreen didn't care about the vial's contents but suggested you take it to another %\"witch in the woods\" that she's heard about. [flags.VIVIANE_MET|You'd be willing to bet she's talking about Viviane.]"

rows.original:
Viviane has agreed to study the vial and its contents even with your warning about its origins, but will require more for proper study. 
            
            <b>
rows.translation:
尽管你提醒过她关于这个样本的来历，薇薇安仍然同意研究这个样本及其所含物质，但为了进行彻底的研究，她还需要更多的信息。 
            
            <b>
rows.raw:
"
            Viviane has agreed to study the vial and its contents even with your warning about its origins, but will require more for proper study. 
            
            <b>"

rows.curatedReason: 内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。

rows.translation: 魅魔乳汁：

rows.original:
Viviane has agreed to study the vial and its contents, but will require more for proper study.
            
            <b>
rows.translation:
薇薇安同意研究这个小瓶子及其内部的内容物，但为了进行彻底的研究，她还需要更多的资料。
            
            <b>
rows.raw:
"
            Viviane has agreed to study the vial and its contents, but will require more for proper study.
            
            <b>"

rows.curatedReason: 内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。

rows.translation: 魅魔乳汁：

rows.original: You have enough materials for Viv. You should return to her.
rows.translation: 你已经有足够的材料来制作薇芙了，应该回去找她吧。
rows.raw: "\n            You have enough materials for Viv. You should return to her."

rows.original: You've delivered all the material she needs for study. Now you just have to wait for her to be done with her research. [QUEST_IN_HER_FOOTSTEPS.stateRange 0 6|She's suggested that you investigate its source in the meantime.|It'll probably be another
rows.translation: 你已经为她提供了所有学习所需的资料。现在，你只需要等待她完成研究就可以了。 [QUEST_IN_HER_FOOTSTEPS.stateRange 0 6|她建议你先调查一下它的来源。|很可能会是另一个吧……
rows.raw: "\n            You've delivered all the material she needs for study. Now you just have to wait for her to be done with her research. [QUEST_IN_HER_FOOTSTEPS.stateRange 0 6|She's suggested that you investigate its source in the meantime.|It'll probably be another "

rows.original: Viviane should have had enough time to complete her research. You should check in with her.
rows.translation: 薇薇安应该有足够的时间来完成她的研究。你应该去看看她的情况。
rows.raw: "\n            Viviane should have had enough time to complete her research. You should check in with her."

rows.original: Viviane, upon finishing her research and discovering more on the nature of corruption, has offered to join you.
rows.translation: 薇薇安在完成她的研究后，对腐败的本质有了更深入的了解，因此她主动提出要加入你们的团队。
rows.raw: "\n            Viviane, upon finishing her research and discovering more on the nature of corruption, has offered to join you."

rows.original: Viviane's research and experimentation resulted in her turning into a demon. Additionally, she's offered to join your party.
rows.translation: 薇薇安通过研究和实验，最终变成了一名恶魔。此外，她还主动提出要加入你们的队伍。
rows.raw: "\n            Viviane's research and experimentation resulted in her turning into a demon. Additionally, she's offered to join your party."

rows.original: Upon discovering that Viviane had transformed into a demon as a result of her experiments, you slew her.
rows.translation: 当你发现薇薇安因为自己的实验而变成了恶魔时，你杀死了她。
rows.raw: "\n            Upon discovering that Viviane had transformed into a demon as a result of her experiments, you slew her."

rows.original: Upon discovering that Viviane had transformed into a demon as a result of her experiments, you attacked her. While you failed to kill her, you don't expect you'll be seeing her again.
rows.translation: 当你发现薇薇安因为自己的实验而变成了恶魔时，你便向她发起了攻击。虽然你没有成功杀死她，但你也预料到自己再也不会见到她了。
rows.raw: "\n            Upon discovering that Viviane had transformed into a demon as a result of her experiments, you attacked her. While you failed to kill her, you don't expect you'll be seeing her again."

rows.translation: 灵视追寻

rows.original: Nina, a perpetually smashed harpy at your wayfort's bar, had a vision in which you entered an old abandoned mine in the southeastern Frostwood and brought back something she claims as really important, even if she isn't sure exactly what it is. Whether you believe that her words are any more than the drunken ramblings of a crazy harpy is up to you, but she did say that she'd be grateful if she could get her hands on this important item.
rows.translation: 妮娜，那个总是醉醺醺地出现在你们路标酒吧里的女妖，做了一个梦：你在弗罗斯特伍德的东南部进入了一座废弃的旧矿井，然后带回了一些她认为非常重要的东西，尽管她并不清楚那到底是什么。你是否相信她的话，只是个疯狂女妖的醉言疯语，这由你决定；但她说，如果能够得到这件重要的物品，她一定会非常感激的。
rows.raw: "\n            Nina, a perpetually smashed harpy at your wayfort's bar, had a vision in which you entered an old abandoned mine in the southeastern Frostwood and brought back something she claims as really important, even if she isn't sure exactly what it is. Whether you believe that her words are any more than the drunken ramblings of a crazy harpy is up to you, but she did say that she'd be grateful if she could get her hands on this important item."

rows.original: It looks like Nina wasn't wrong about there being an abandoned mine where she said there'd be one. Maybe going into its depths and picking up the item she's so enamored of, whatever it is, isn't going to be a wild goose chase after all.
rows.translation: 看来尼娜所说的那座废弃矿井确实存在。或许，深入矿井去取回她如此渴望得到的那个东西，并不会是徒劳无功的。
rows.raw: "\n            It looks like Nina wasn't wrong about there being an abandoned mine where she said there'd be one. Maybe going into its depths and picking up the item she's so enamored of, whatever it is, isn't going to be a wild goose chase after all."

rows.original: Having retrieved this extremely valuable item that Nina mentioned, it's turned out to be a crate of ice wine. Extremely valuable booze, perhaps, but still booze. In retrospect, this shouldn't be surprising given the crazy harpy's priorities, but perhaps it's time to return to her and give the silly bird-brain a good talking-to.
rows.translation: 在找到了妮娜提到的那个极其珍贵的物品后，发现它竟然是一箱冰酒。虽然这种酒确实非常珍贵，但归根结底还是酒而已。回想起来，考虑到那个疯狂的哈比人的喜好，这件事其实也不足为奇。不过，也许是时候去找她谈谈了，好好训斥一下那个愚蠢的家伙。
rows.raw: "\n            Having retrieved this extremely valuable item that Nina mentioned, it's turned out to be a crate of ice wine. Extremely valuable booze, perhaps, but still booze. In retrospect, this shouldn't be surprising given the crazy harpy's priorities, but perhaps it's time to return to her and give the silly bird-brain a good talking-to."

rows.original: Having returned an entire crate of elven ice wine to Nina, you've been subsequently invited by the crazy harpy to share a drink with her and possibly go on some kind of journey to boot. You have absolutely no idea what it might entail and neither does she, but she thinks it'll take a little while, so you ought to prepare before returning to share drinks.
rows.translation: 将一整箱精灵冰酒归还给妮娜后，这个疯狂的哈比女妖邀请你与她一起共饮，甚至可能还会一起踏上某种旅程。你完全不知道这会意味着什么，她也不清楚，但她认为这个过程需要一些时间，所以你在回去共饮之前最好先做好准备。
rows.raw: "\n            Having returned an entire crate of elven ice wine to Nina, you've been subsequently invited by the crazy harpy to share a drink with her and possibly go on some kind of journey to boot. You have absolutely no idea what it might entail and neither does she, but she thinks it'll take a little while, so you ought to prepare before returning to share drinks."

rows.original: Answer Gerry's questions as best as you can. An alien entity just wishes to gain insight into how you think — no pressure, man, no pressure at all.
rows.translation: 尽你所能回答杰里的问题吧。这个外星生物只是想了解你的思维方式而已——完全没有压力，真的，完全不需要紧张。
rows.raw: "\n            Answer Gerry's questions as best as you can. An alien entity just wishes to gain insight into how you think — no pressure, man, no pressure at all."

rows.original: Convince Ma Siorc by any means necessary to let you into her home and search for whatever it is Nina's looking for.
rows.translation: 想尽一切办法说服玛·希奥克，让她允许你进入她的家，从而找到妮娜正在寻找的东西。
rows.raw: "\n            Convince Ma Siorc by any means necessary to let you into her home and search for whatever it is Nina's looking for."

rows.original: The time has come for Nina and you to embark on the final and most perilous leg of your journey, wherever it may be. Once you're done with preparations, speak to her again and you can be on your way.
rows.translation: 现在，是尼娜和你一起开始这段最终也是最为危险的路途的时候了，无论这段旅程会将你们带到哪里。当你完成所有的准备工作后，再与她联系，然后你们就可以出发了。
rows.raw: "\n            The time has come for Nina and you to embark on the final and most perilous leg of your journey, wherever it may be. Once you're done with preparations, speak to her again and you can be on your way."
