rows.original: Something's gone horribly wrong in your pursuit of Nina's visions, and you've been plucked out of transit through the Ways and plopped straight into the non-euclidean geometry of the Wayfort, only it's not. Whatever's behind this, it wields strong enough psionic force to prevent Nina from simply opening another rift, so it looks like you'll have to get to the bottom of this.
rows.translation: 在你追寻尼娜所看到的那些景象的过程中，出了严重的麻烦。你被从“通道”中强行拉了出来，直接被抛入了荒废驿堡这个充满非欧几里得几何结构的空间里——但实际上情况并非如此。无论背后隐藏着什么，它所拥有的灵能力量实在太过强大，以至于尼娜根本无法再次打开通道。因此，你似乎必须弄清楚这一切的真相。
rows.raw: "\n            Something's gone horribly wrong in your pursuit of Nina's visions, and you've been plucked out of transit through the Ways and plopped straight into the non-euclidean geometry of the Wayfort, only it's not. Whatever's behind this, it wields strong enough psionic force to prevent Nina from simply opening another rift, so it looks like you'll have to get to the bottom of this."

rows.original:
Navigating the chaotic maze of twisting corridors, you've made it out of your vault and emerged into the rest of the Wayfort. It's mostly as you remember how it should be, although you've already seen several notable differences...

            Your first priority is to find a way out of this psychic cage you're trapped in, but there are different approaches to that end that aren't necessarily a straight line. Figuring out what's up with this mirror image of the Wayfort might warrant some exploration, as well as finding a safe place so Nina and you can sit down and pick each others' minds as to what's going on here. The more you know, the better your chances will be.
rows.translation:
你穿过纵横交错、宛如迷宫的混乱走廊，终于离开自己的地窖，来到驿堡的其他区域。这里大体仍是你记忆中应有的模样，不过你已经注意到了几处显著差异……

            你的首要目标是逃出这座囚禁自己的精神牢笼，但通往目标的方法不止一种，也未必都沿着直线展开。这个驿堡的镜像究竟出了什么问题，值得你四处探索；你还需要找到一个安全地点，好让自己与妮娜坐下来，交换彼此对现状的看法。掌握得越多，成功的机会便越大。
rows.raw:
"
            Navigating the chaotic maze of twisting corridors, you've made it out of your vault and emerged into the rest of the Wayfort. It's mostly as you remember how it should be, although you've already seen several notable differences...

            Your first priority is to find a way out of this psychic cage you're trapped in, but there are different approaches to that end that aren't necessarily a straight line. Figuring out what's up with this mirror image of the Wayfort might warrant some exploration, as well as finding a safe place so Nina and you can sit down and pick each others' minds as to what's going on here. The more you know, the better your chances will be."

rows.original:
Exploring the Wayfort past, you've come across the only sane soul in this entire place: an Astrida named Thalia, one of the first of her godsworn order. After hearing her tale, you learned a little more about what happened to reduce your Wayfort to the state you found it, and the predicament Nina and you find yourselves in.

            While Thalia's spirit is bound to the great hall, it may be possible to tether her to her remains instead — assuming that you can find them in this Wayfort — and let her come with you that way. Not leaving [pc.swornGod nareva
                |another Astrida
                |someone in need
            ] in the lurch aside, she might be useful to Nina and you in escaping this place. Clues as to how to proceed are probably around the entire wayfort, but you should probably begin by talking to her again.
rows.translation:
在探索荒废驿堡的过去过程中，你遇到了这个地方上唯一一个神志清醒的人：一位名叫塔莉娅的阿斯特里达，她是她所属的神圣组织中的首批成员之一。在听完她的故事后，你对导致荒废驿堡变成如今这副模样的事情，以及你和妮娜目前所处的困境，有了更多的了解。

            虽然塔莉娅的灵魂被束缚在那个大厅里，但或许可以将她与她的遗骸联系在一起——前提是你们能在这座荒废驿堡城中找到她的遗骸——这样她就能跟随你们一起离开了。总不能让她一直留在那里吧。 [pc.swornGod nareva
                |另一个阿斯特丽达
                |有需要的人
            ]她虽然现在处境艰难，但或许能帮助妮娜和你逃离这个地方。关于如何继续行动的线索应该遍布整个Fort 荒废驿堡，不过你们最好先试着再和她谈谈。
rows.raw:
"
            Exploring the Wayfort past, you've come across the only sane soul in this entire place: an Astrida named Thalia, one of the first of her godsworn order. After hearing her tale, you learned a little more about what happened to reduce your Wayfort to the state you found it, and the predicament Nina and you find yourselves in.

            While Thalia's spirit is bound to the great hall, it may be possible to tether her to her remains instead — assuming that you can find them in this Wayfort — and let her come with you that way. Not leaving [pc.swornGod nareva
                |another Astrida
                |someone in need
            ] in the lurch aside, she might be useful to Nina and you in escaping this place. Clues as to how to proceed are probably around the entire wayfort, but you should probably begin by talking to her again."

rows.original: You've correctly identified and retrieved Thalia's remains; with something significant to her that her spirit can tether to, the Astrida is finally able to leave the grand hall and accompany you in your escape. No doubt having someone around who actually knows what's going on will be of use.
rows.translation: 你成功找到了塔莉娅的遗骸；有了对她来说至关重要的东西，她的灵魂终于能够依附于此，阿斯特里达也因此得以离开那座宏伟的大厅，与你一同逃走。毫无疑问，有一个真正了解发生了什么的人在身边，一定会派上大用场的。
rows.raw: "\n            You've correctly identified and retrieved Thalia's remains; with something significant to her that her spirit can tether to, the Astrida is finally able to leave the grand hall and accompany you in your escape. No doubt having someone around who actually knows what's going on will be of use."

rows.original:
Despite your harrowing experience in the Ways Between, both you and Nina have reemerged into reality in one piece. That's got to count for something, but while Nina processes everything that's happened so far and tries to make some sense out of it, maybe you could go get a drink or something and talk to her later.

            As far as the adventuring bit is concerned, though, you're pretty sure that you're done here and there aren't going to be any more free-form trips through the Ways again.
rows.translation:
尽管你在“通道之中”经历了那些令人痛苦的经历，但你和妮娜最终都平安地回到了现实世界。这一点总该算是一些积极的成果吧。不过，当妮娜还在努力梳理这些发生的事情、试图理解其中的意义时，你或许可以去喝点东西，等会儿再和她聊聊。

            至于那些冒险经历，你其实很确定自己已经受够了，以后应该不会再有那些自由探索“通道”的机会了。
rows.raw:
"
            Despite your harrowing experience in the Ways Between, both you and Nina have reemerged into reality in one piece. That's got to count for something, but while Nina processes everything that's happened so far and tries to make some sense out of it, maybe you could go get a drink or something and talk to her later.

            As far as the adventuring bit is concerned, though, you're pretty sure that you're done here and there aren't going to be any more free-form trips through the Ways again.
            
            "

rows.original: There's still one last thing to do, though. Having rescued Thalia from that memory of the Wayfort's past, you still have to bring her home to Nareva in Tychris. [pc.swornGod nareva |One of the younger generation proving [pc.himHer]self and bringing back one of the first... your goddess will be getting quite the heartwarming surprise when you next report in. |No doubt you'll be well-compensated for your efforts... it's not every day that you can bring a goddess a pleasant surprise. ] This is as far as this quest progresses for now.
rows.translation: 不过，还有一件事需要完成。在将塔莉娅从荒废驿堡家族过去的那些记忆中解救出来之后，你还需要把她带回提克里斯的娜瑞瓦。 [pc.swornGod nareva |属于年轻一代中那些取得了成功的人之一[pc.himHer]你自己也能做到这一点，而且还能带回最早的那些物品之一……当你下次汇报时，你的女神一定会收到一个非常温馨的惊喜。 |你的付出肯定会得到应有的回报……毕竟，能给一位女神带来如此愉快的惊喜，这样的机会可并不多见。 ] 目前，这个任务就进展到这个阶段了。
rows.raw: " There's still one last thing to do, though. Having rescued Thalia from that memory of the Wayfort's past, you still have to bring her home to Nareva in Tychris. [pc.swornGod nareva |One of the younger generation proving [pc.himHer]self and bringing back one of the first... your goddess will be getting quite the heartwarming surprise when you next report in. |No doubt you'll be well-compensated for your efforts... it's not every day that you can bring a goddess a pleasant surprise. ] This is as far as this quest progresses for now."

rows.original: There's still one last thing to do. Having found no way to untether Thalia from that memory of the Wayfort's past, she's still languishing in the Ways; you ought to report the matter to Nareva in Tychris. [pc.swornGod nareva |Your goddess will want to know what happened, and [flags.VISION_SERPENT 2 |while you've dealt with the shadowlith a cleanup crew is warranted. Perhaps they can figure out some way to help Thalia that wasn't open to you. |the shadowlith is a problem that can't be allowed to fester. A single Astrida caught up in matters might not have been able to overpower it, but surely a prepared task force would be more than an even match. That, and there's the matter of Thalia — perhaps they can figure out some way to help Thalia that wasn't open to you. ] |You didn't have the ability to destroy the shadowlith, and it's a problem that can't be allowed to fester. No doubt she'll want to do something about it, and figure out a way to help Thalia in the process. Let the Astrida take care of their own... ] This is as far as this quest progresses for now.
rows.translation: 还有一件事需要处理。由于找不到办法让塔莉娅摆脱与荒废驿堡家族过去有关的那些记忆，她仍然被困在那些记忆之中；你应该把这件事报告给提克里斯的娜瑞瓦。 [pc.swornGod nareva |你的女神一定会想知道发生了什么，而且[flags.VISION_SERPENT 2 |既然你已经处理了那些影石，现在确实需要一组清理队伍来收拾残局。也许他们能找到一些你之前想不出来、能够帮助塔莉娅的方法。 |Shadowlith这个问题绝对不能任其发展下去。如果只有一名阿斯特里达去处理这个问题，或许她无法将其解决，但一个准备充分的特别行动小组肯定能够胜任这项任务。另外，还有塔莉娅的问题——也许他们能找到一些你之前没有想到的方法来帮助塔莉娅。 ] |你并没有能力摧毁那块暗影石，而这个问题绝对不能被搁置不管。毫无疑问，她会想方设法来解决它，同时也会在这个过程中找到帮助塔莉娅的方法。就让阿斯特里达她们自己处理吧…… ] 目前，这个任务就进展到这个阶段了。
rows.raw: " There's still one last thing to do. Having found no way to untether Thalia from that memory of the Wayfort's past, she's still languishing in the Ways; you ought to report the matter to Nareva in Tychris. [pc.swornGod nareva |Your goddess will want to know what happened, and [flags.VISION_SERPENT 2 |while you've dealt with the shadowlith a cleanup crew is warranted. Perhaps they can figure out some way to help Thalia that wasn't open to you. |the shadowlith is a problem that can't be allowed to fester. A single Astrida caught up in matters might not have been able to overpower it, but surely a prepared task force would be more than an even match. That, and there's the matter of Thalia — perhaps they can figure out some way to help Thalia that wasn't open to you. ] |You didn't have the ability to destroy the shadowlith, and it's a problem that can't be allowed to fester. No doubt she'll want to do something about it, and figure out a way to help Thalia in the process. Let the Astrida take care of their own... ] This is as far as this quest progresses for now."

rows.translation: 日影

rows.original: Brother Sanders, worried about the demon threat, has suggested gaining the assistance of the valkyries, Lumia's faithful winged warriors. Journey to the Glacial Rift and try to locate them there.
rows.translation: 桑德斯修士担心恶魔的威胁，因此建议寻求卢米娅那些忠诚的、有翼的战士——女武神的帮助。请前往冰川裂谷，尝试在那里找到她们。
rows.raw: "\n            Brother Sanders, worried about the demon threat, has suggested gaining the assistance of the valkyries, Lumia's faithful winged warriors. Journey to the Glacial Rift and try to locate them there."

rows.original: Brother Sanders has suggested that you ally with Lumia's valkyries against the demons, but you'll have to put looking for them on hold until after you and Gweyr deal with the Cult in the Glacial Rift.
rows.translation: 桑德斯修士建议你与卢米亚的英灵们联手对抗那些恶魔，但在你和格维尔解决冰川裂谷中的邪教组织之前，暂时先搁置寻找他们的任务吧。
rows.raw: "\n            Brother Sanders has suggested that you ally with Lumia's valkyries against the demons, but you'll have to put looking for them on hold until after you and Gweyr deal with the Cult in the Glacial Rift."

rows.original: Brother Sanders, worried about the demon threat, has suggested gaining additional assistance in the far north. Although you were interrupted by Tollus and his minions, you've dealt with them for now, and the way should be clear to find Lumia and her valkyries. Search for them in the open spaces of the Glacial Rift.
rows.translation: 桑德斯修士担心恶魔的威胁，因此建议从极北地区寻求额外的援助。虽然你曾被托勒斯和他的手下干扰，但你现在已经解决了他们，应该可以顺利找到卢米娅和她的女武神们了。在冰川裂谷的开阔地带寻找她们吧。
rows.raw: "\n            Brother Sanders, worried about the demon threat, has suggested gaining additional assistance in the far north. Although you were interrupted by Tollus and his minions, you've dealt with them for now, and the way should be clear to find Lumia and her valkyries. Search for them in the open spaces of the Glacial Rift."

rows.original: Lumia's sun warriors are itching to join the fight against the demon cult, but they're stuck fighting a much older and more dangerous war that's sapping their goddess's strength... and which may very well threaten the fabric of this world's reality. Only Lumia herself can allow you into the Keep to help them, but unfortunately, she's in seclusion somewhere in the Rift, recuperating from her fight against the Wraiths. Annika, one of the goddess's valkyries, has offered to bring you to her so that you can make your case in person.
rows.translation: 卢米娅的太阳战士们迫切想要加入这场对抗恶魔邪教的战斗，但他们却陷入了另一场更为古老、更为危险的战争之中——这场战争正在消耗他们女神的力量……而这场战争很可能威胁到这个世界的现实结构本身。只有卢米娅本人才能允许你进入那座城堡去帮助他们，但不幸的是，她目前正在裂隙地区的某个地方隐居，正在从与那些幽灵们的战斗中恢复过来。安妮卡，这位女神的英灵之一，提出可以带你去见她，这样你就可以当面向她说明你的来意了。
rows.raw: "\n            Lumia's sun warriors are itching to join the fight against the demon cult, but they're stuck fighting a much older and more dangerous war that's sapping their goddess's strength... and which may very well threaten the fabric of this world's reality. Only Lumia herself can allow you into the Keep to help them, but unfortunately, she's in seclusion somewhere in the Rift, recuperating from her fight against the Wraiths. Annika, one of the goddess's valkyries, has offered to bring you to her so that you can make your case in person."

rows.original: You've met the goddess of light[flags.LUMIA_SEEN| again] while she was bathing in a magical grove. She's asked you to come to the palace of light with some haste, but not told you why.
rows.translation: 你[flags.LUMIA_SEEN|又一次]在一片魔法林地中遇见光明女神，她当时正在沐浴。她请你尽快前往光明宫殿，却没有说明原因。
rows.raw: "\n            You've met the goddess of light[flags.LUMIA_SEEN| again] while she was bathing in a magical grove. She's asked you to come to the palace of light with some haste, but not told you why.\n            "

rows.original: Lumia has told you about a terrifying monster sealed in the depths of the palace. She's also informed you of something in Hawkstone Castle that eludes her divine senses, and may be able to help in the battle with the monster. She can't leave without giving the thing a chance to escape, so she's given you the option of investigating. [flags.ATUGIA_MET|Maybe Atugia knows something.|Maybe someone who lives in the castle will be willing to help you out.]
rows.translation: 卢米娅告诉你，宫殿深处封印着一头可怕的怪物。她还说，霍克斯通城堡里有某样东西避开了她的神性感知，或许能在对抗怪物时派上用场。她若离开，就可能给那怪物逃脱的机会，因此让你自行决定是否去调查。[flags.ATUGIA_MET|也许阿图吉娅知道些什么。|也许城堡里的住客愿意帮你。]
rows.raw: "\n            Lumia has told you about a terrifying monster sealed in the depths of the palace. She's also informed you of something in Hawkstone Castle that eludes her divine senses, and may be able to help in the battle with the monster. She can't leave without giving the thing a chance to escape, so she's given you the option of investigating. [flags.ATUGIA_MET|Maybe Atugia knows something.|Maybe someone who lives in the castle will be willing to help you out.]\n            "

rows.original: Atugia told you she had no idea about any object that would have been carried between the village and Castle Hawkstone. She's asked to come with and ask some questions to see if she can get any extra info about the object.
rows.translation: 阿图吉娅告诉你，她完全不知道有什么物品可能在村庄和霍克斯通城堡之间被运送过。她被邀请一起来，尝试通过提问来获取一些关于那个物品的额外信息。
rows.raw: "\n            Atugia told you she had no idea about any object that would have been carried between the village and Castle Hawkstone. She's asked to come with and ask some questions to see if she can get any extra info about the object.\n            "

rows.original: Lumia is ready to face the monster in her palace once and for all. You have some time to prepare, but urgency has been requested, so you shouldn't waste too much time.
rows.translation: 卢米娅已经准备好，要一劳永逸地消灭她宫殿里的那个怪物了。你有一些时间来准备，但形势紧迫，所以最好不要浪费太多时间。
rows.raw: "\n            Lumia is ready to face the monster in her palace once and for all. You have some time to prepare, but urgency has been requested, so you shouldn't waste too much time.\n            "

rows.original: You've begun a contest of will with the monster. The battle appears to be taking the form of a dinner party at a familiar castle, but you don't know what exactly the conflict will be.
rows.translation: 你与这个怪物展开了一场意志的较量。这场战斗似乎是在一座熟悉的城堡里举行的晚宴会上进行的，但你并不清楚这场冲突最终会以什么形式呈现。
rows.raw:
"
            You've begun a contest of will with the monster. The battle appears to be taking the form of a dinner party at a familiar castle, but you don't know what exactly the conflict will be.
            
            "

rows.original: - You found a shard of a broken sword in the grass outside the castle. Perhaps there are more to find.
rows.translation: - 你在城堡外的草丛里找到了一块断剑碎片。附近也许还有更多碎片。
rows.raw: "- You found a shard of a broken sword in the grass outside the castle. Perhaps there are more to find."

rows.translation: /5) 一把断剑的碎片。

rows.original: - Your false accusation has led to another guest being murdered. Be careful, as you'll probably only get one more chance at this.
rows.translation: - 你的错误指控害得另一名宾客遇害。务必谨慎，因为你可能只剩最后一次机会。
rows.raw: "- Your false accusation has led to another guest being murdered. Be careful, as you'll probably only get one more chance at this."

rows.original: Your accusation locked the wraith in its place for long enough that
rows.translation: 你的指控让那个幽灵长时间地被束缚在原地，使得
rows.raw: "\n            Your accusation locked the wraith in its place for long enough that "

rows.original: . The monster is dead, and the world is better and brighter for it.
rows.translation: 。怪物已死，世界因此变得更加美好、更加光明。
rows.raw: ". The monster is dead, and the world is better and brighter for it."

rows.original: Atugia was able to skewer it with the shattered blade
rows.translation: 阿图吉亚得以用那把碎裂的剑刃将它刺穿
rows.raw: "Atugia was able to skewer it with the shattered blade"

rows.original: you and Lumia were able to destroy it for good
rows.translation: 你和卢米娅得以将它彻底摧毁
rows.raw: "you and Lumia were able to destroy it for good"

rows.translation: 潮汐号角

rows.original: You have the beautiful Horn of Tides! But something's missing. A gentle blow produces no sound at all, and at your best, your lungs can produce only the weakest 'doot.' You would assume the horn to require jotun-sized lungs to blow on, if not for the fact that it's sized for your hands. That attempt to blow on it does have another effect, however; you know, as though you always have, that this is a horn of summoning... it just needs some kind of summoning circle to attune to you with. [flags.TOWER_CIRCLE |Luckily you have the summoning circle you need for this horn; the base of the Wayfort Tower[wayfort.hasAileh| where Aileh makes her home]. It can't hurt to try. |[pc.hasKeyItem SummoningBook |You'll need to activate the book of summoning you have, perhaps you could do that in the Wayfort tower? |Unfortunately you don't have a summoning circle, perhaps Evergreen could help? ] ]
rows.translation: 你得到了美丽的潮汐号角！但它似乎缺了什么。轻轻一吹，号角没有发出半点声音；即使竭尽肺活量，也只能挤出最微弱的一声“嘟”。若不是它的尺寸恰好适合你的双手，你几乎会以为必须拥有约顿巨人般的肺才能将其吹响。 不过这次尝试确实产生了另一种效果：你就是知道，仿佛一直都知道，这是一件召唤号角……只不过还需要某种召唤阵，才能与你完成调谐。 [flags.TOWER_CIRCLE |幸运的是，你正好拥有这支号角所需的召唤阵：驿堡高塔的底层[wayfort.hasAileh|，也就是艾蕾安家的地方]。试一试总不会有什么损失。 |[pc.hasKeyItem SummoningBook |你需要激活手中的召唤之书；也许可以在驿堡高塔里完成？ |遗憾的是，你没有召唤阵。也许常青女士能帮忙？ ] ]
rows.raw: " You have the beautiful Horn of Tides! But something's missing. A gentle blow produces no sound at all, and at your best, your lungs can produce only the weakest 'doot.' You would assume the horn to require jotun-sized lungs to blow on, if not for the fact that it's sized for your hands. That attempt to blow on it does have another effect, however; you know, as though you always have, that this is a horn of summoning... it just needs some kind of summoning circle to attune to you with. [flags.TOWER_CIRCLE |Luckily you have the summoning circle you need for this horn; the base of the Wayfort Tower[wayfort.hasAileh| where Aileh makes her home]. It can't hurt to try. |[pc.hasKeyItem SummoningBook |You'll need to activate the book of summoning you have, perhaps you could do that in the Wayfort tower? |Unfortunately you don't have a summoning circle, perhaps Evergreen could help? ] ]"

rows.original: You have summoned your very own water elemental; the cat-bard Cassidy. [cassidy.HesShes] able to be brought forth in combat, or lain any time you feel the thirst in range of the summoning circle.
rows.translation: 你召唤出了属于自己的水属性精灵——猫人吟游诗人卡西迪。 [cassidy.HesShes]可以在战斗中召唤出来，或者在任何你觉得口渴的时候，在召唤圈的范围之内使用它。
rows.raw: "\n            You have summoned your very own water elemental; the cat-bard Cassidy. [cassidy.HesShes] able to be brought forth in combat, or lain any time you feel the thirst in range of the summoning circle."

rows.translation: 萨达隆遗迹

rows.original: Hethia and Elthara have asked for your help in retaking a druidic temple from a fungal infestation. When you're ready, you can talk to Hethia again to ask for more details, or set off if you so please.
rows.translation: 赫希娅和艾尔萨拉请求你的帮助，共同将一座被真菌侵袭的德鲁伊神庙夺回来。当你准备好了，可以再次与赫希娅联系以获取更多细节，或者直接出发前往行动地点。
rows.raw: "Hethia and Elthara have asked for your help in retaking a druidic temple from a fungal infestation. When you're ready, you can talk to Hethia again to ask for more details, or set off if you so please."

rows.original: Having arrived at the rather underwhelming remains of the ancient druidic temple, it's up to you to explore and the report back to Hethia once you've surveyed the ruins.
rows.translation: 当你来到这座早已破败不堪的古代德鲁伊神庙遗址时，你的任务就是探索这些遗迹，并在完成调查后向赫希娅汇报结果。
rows.raw: "Having arrived at the rather underwhelming remains of the ancient druidic temple, it's up to you to explore and the report back to Hethia once you've surveyed the ruins."

rows.original:
Laying low Archdruid Xadaron's spirit hasn't resolved the problem of the temple — if anything, it's made things worse. Another malevolent force that possesses these once hallowed halls of marble has made itself known, and the temple is far, far larger than its exterior would've suggested.

            Buried only the gods know how deep beneath the earth, it's up to you and your companions to figure out the truth behind the temple and escape this place alive.
rows.translation:
潜伏在地下的大德鲁伊扎达隆的灵魂并未解决这座神庙所隐藏的谜团——事实上，情况反而变得更糟了。又有另一种邪恶势力占据了这些曾经神圣的大理石殿堂，而这座神庙的实际规模，远比它的外观所显示的要庞大得多。

            它被埋藏在连众神也不知道的深处，现在，就由你和你的同伴来揭开这座神庙背后的真相，并活着逃离这个地方。
rows.raw: "Laying low Archdruid Xadaron's spirit hasn't resolved the problem of the temple — if anything, it's made things worse. Another malevolent force that possesses these once hallowed halls of marble has made itself known, and the temple is far, far larger than its exterior would've suggested.\n\n            Buried only the gods know how deep beneath the earth, it's up to you and your companions to figure out the truth behind the temple and escape this place alive."

rows.original:
Everything's worked out well for all parties involved. The druids have something to look forward to and are willing to let go of the past, Ryn and Elthara have the agreement that they wanted, and you came out of this with a whole bunch of loot. 

            The last thing that remains is to show up at Ryn's throne room in a couple of days for a presentation ceremony; the druids wish to bestow some kind of gift upon her.
rows.translation:
对所有相关方来说，这一切都进展得很顺利。德鲁伊们有了值得期待的东西，也愿意放下过去；小琳和艾尔萨拉也得到了他们想要的协议；而你则从中获得了大量的战利品。

            现在剩下的唯一事情，就是在几天后前往小琳的王座厅参加一场颁奖仪式——德鲁伊们打算送给她一些礼物。
rows.raw: "Everything's worked out well for all parties involved. The druids have something to look forward to and are willing to let go of the past, Ryn and Elthara have the agreement that they wanted, and you came out of this with a whole bunch of loot. \n\n            The last thing that remains is to show up at Ryn's throne room in a couple of days for a presentation ceremony; the druids wish to bestow some kind of gift upon her."

rows.original:
Thanks to you, the situation with the druidic faction within boreal elf society has been resolved: an agreement has been reached with regards to their reintroduction to the fold that everyone is content, if not happy with. Resettling the old temple village and running it under the auspices of the crown will let the druids mix with the rest of Ryn's subjects comfortably, and serve the larger goal of reclaiming lands lost during the Godswar.

            There's still work to be done, and your venture into the ruins of Xadaron Temple has opened up more questions to be answered, but it looks like things are out of your hands now and others are picking up where you left off. The future's looking bright for the boreal elves.
rows.translation:
多亏了你的努力，极北精灵社会中德鲁伊派系的问题终于得到了解决：就他们重新融入社会这一事项，各方都达成了令所有人满意的协议。将那个古老的寺庙村落重新安置起来，并在王室的庇护下进行管理，这样德鲁伊们就能与小琳的其他子民们和谐地生活在一起，共同为实现收复在神战期间失去的土地这一宏伟目标而努力。

            还有许多工作需要完成，你进入夏达隆神庙的废墟后，反而引发了更多需要解答的问题。不过现在看来，这些事情已经超出了你的控制范围，其他人正在接手你留下的工作。极北精灵的未来一片光明。
rows.raw: "Thanks to you, the situation with the druidic faction within boreal elf society has been resolved: an agreement has been reached with regards to their reintroduction to the fold that everyone is content, if not happy with. Resettling the old temple village and running it under the auspices of the crown will let the druids mix with the rest of Ryn's subjects comfortably, and serve the larger goal of reclaiming lands lost during the Godswar.\n\n            There's still work to be done, and your venture into the ruins of Xadaron Temple has opened up more questions to be answered, but it looks like things are out of your hands now and others are picking up where you left off. The future's looking bright for the boreal elves."

rows.translation: 怪物裁缝

rows.original: Leanore and Anisette have confided that they'd like some clothes for their day-to-day lives. Surely you can find a tailor willing to make some special adjustments to fit the three elves' unique circumstances.
rows.translation: 蕾诺尔和阿妮塞特都表示，她们需要一些日常穿着的衣服。想必你能找到一位裁缝，愿意根据这三位精灵的独特情况做出一些特别的调整吧。
rows.raw: "Leanore and Anisette have confided that they'd like some clothes for their day-to-day lives. Surely you can find a tailor willing to make some special adjustments to fit the three elves' unique circumstances."

rows.original: You've asked Nelia to make some clothing for the fungal elf trio, and should return in
rows.translation: 你让妮莉亚为那三个真菌精灵制作一些衣物，应该很快就会回来吧。
rows.raw: "You've asked Nelia to make some clothing for the fungal elf trio, and should return in "

rows.original: Nelia should have finished the outfits for the fungal elf trio, pay her a visit.
rows.translation: 内莉娅应该已经为那个由真菌精灵组成的三人组准备好了服装，去她那里看看吧。
rows.raw: "Nelia should have finished the outfits for the fungal elf trio, pay her a visit."

rows.original: You've acquired outfits for the fungal elf trio! All that's left is delivering them.
rows.translation: 你已经为那三个真菌精灵获得了相应的服装了！现在剩下的就是把它们送过去而已。
rows.raw: "You've acquired outfits for the fungal elf trio! All that's left is delivering them."

rows.original: You've delivered the dresses to a very thankful trio of elves.
rows.translation: 你把裙子交给了那三位精灵，她们感激不已。
rows.raw: "You've delivered the dresses to a very thankful trio of elves."

rows.translation: 金胡萝卜

rows.original: Sariel the Taeleer Ranger is on a quest for 'The Golden Carrot.' After being introduced to the Marefolk, she's gone on a hunt for carrot patches. Perhaps you can come back later to see how she's doing?
rows.translation: 身为泰勒尔游荡者的萨莉尔正在寻找“金胡萝卜”。在结识了马雷族人之后，她便开始四处寻找种植胡萝卜的地方。或许你可以稍后回来看看她进展如何？
rows.raw: "Sariel the Taeleer Ranger is on a quest for 'The Golden Carrot.' After being introduced to the Marefolk, she's gone on a hunt for carrot patches. Perhaps you can come back later to see how she's doing?"

rows.original: Sariel's probably finished searching around the Mares' known carrot patches by now; perhaps you could see how she's doing?
rows.translation: 萨莉尔应该已经搜遍了马儿们所知道的那些胡萝卜地了；或许你可以去看看她现在进展如何？
rows.raw: "Sariel's probably finished searching around the Mares' known carrot patches by now; perhaps you could see how she's doing?"

rows.original: Sariel's given you the location to a promising patch in Harvest Valley to find 'The Golden Carrot,' supposedly guarded by [silly|BIGGUS PIGGUS, the mega-hog.|a titanic wild boar.] Perhaps you could go help her? She might have a reward for you.
rows.translation: 萨莉尔告诉了你丰收谷中一处有希望找到“金胡萝卜”的地方，据说由[silly|超级巨猪BIGGUS PIGGUS守卫。|一头巨大的野猪守卫。]也许你可以去帮她？她或许会给你奖励。
rows.raw: "Sariel's given you the location to a promising patch in Harvest Valley to find 'The Golden Carrot,' supposedly guarded by [silly|BIGGUS PIGGUS, the mega-hog.|a titanic wild boar.] Perhaps you could go help her? She might have a reward for you."

rows.original: Sariel's gotten the Golden Carrot — albeit damaged — and now she's moving into the Marefolk Village. You should come back later once Zuzaan's had a chance to craft your reward.
rows.translation: 萨莉尔已经得到了那根金胡萝卜——尽管它已经有些损坏了——现在她正准备搬到马雷福克村去。等祖赞有时间为你制作奖励之后，你再回来吧。
rows.raw: "Sariel's gotten the Golden Carrot — albeit damaged — and now she's moving into the Marefolk Village. You should come back later once Zuzaan's had a chance to craft your reward."

rows.original: It's been a few hours; Sariel and Zuzaan should be ready for you to come visit again.
rows.translation: 已经过去几个小时了，萨莉尔和祖赞应该已经准备好迎接你的到访了。
rows.raw: "It's been a few hours; Sariel and Zuzaan should be ready for you to come visit again."

rows.original: Sometimes the golden carrot is the friends you've made along the way... and also a really sweet magical bracelet. The bunny's quest is complete, and now she's moved into Atani's Village.
rows.translation: 有时候，那些真正的奖励其实就是你在旅途中结交的朋友们……还有那条真正可爱的魔法手镯。小兔子的任务已经完成了，现在她已经搬到了阿塔妮村。
rows.raw: "Sometimes the golden carrot is the friends you've made along the way... and also a really sweet magical bracelet. The bunny's quest is complete, and now she's moved into Atani's Village."

rows.translation: 卡莉希娅的供品

rows.original: The druid Kalysea wants you to bring her unique arms, armor, and items made of metal in order to help her protect the land from the demons. She's promised you a decidedly unsubtle 'reward' for doing so...
rows.translation: 德鲁伊卡莉希娅希望你能够为她带来那些由金属制成的独特武器、盔甲以及其他物品，这样她就能帮助保护这片土地，抵御恶魔的侵袭。她承诺，如果你能做到这一点，她将会给予你一份相当丰厚的“奖励”……
rows.raw: "The druid Kalysea wants you to bring her unique arms, armor, and items made of metal in order to help her protect the land from the demons. She's promised you a decidedly unsubtle 'reward' for doing so..."

rows.original: Kalysea wants you to bring her more unique arms, armor, and items made of metal. She certainly came through with the reward, though it left you somewhat dazed in its wake... she did promise more if you brought her additional unique metal items, however.
rows.translation: 卡莉希娅希望你能为她带来更多由金属制成的独特武器、护甲和物品。她确实给了你相应的奖励，不过那份奖励确实让你有些措手不及……不过，她确实承诺过，如果你再为她带来更多的独特金属制品，她会给予更多的奖励。
rows.raw: "Kalysea wants you to bring her more unique arms, armor, and items made of metal. She certainly came through with the reward, though it left you somewhat dazed in its wake... she did promise more if you brought her additional unique metal items, however."

rows.original: Kalysea wants you to bring her more unique arms, armor, and items made of metal, and you're happy to deliver them. She's going to need at least one more, and then you'll surely get a big reward courtesy of the beautiful centauress herself.
rows.translation: 卡莉希娅希望你能为她带来更多由金属制成的独特武器、盔甲和物品，而你也很乐意满足她的这个请求。她至少还需要再得到一件这样的物品，到时候，这位美丽的半人马女一定会给予你丰厚的奖励。
rows.raw: "Kalysea wants you to bring her more unique arms, armor, and items made of metal, and you're happy to deliver them. She's going to need at least one more, and then you'll surely get a big reward courtesy of the beautiful centauress herself."

rows.original: Kalysea has amply rewarded you for your services and left her house in your care with a promise to return. You're not entirely sure what she's leaving for, but it seems very easy to recall the time spent with her when you're looking at that pool behind her home...
rows.translation: 卡莉希娅拥有充分地她感谢你的帮助，将她的房子托付给你照顾，并承诺会回来。你并不完全清楚她要去哪里，但每当看到她家后面的那个游泳池，那些与她共度的时光就会浮现在你的脑海中……
rows.raw: "Kalysea has amply rewarded you for your services and left her house in your care with a promise to return. You're not entirely sure what she's leaving for, but it seems very easy to recall the time spent with her when you're looking at that pool behind her home..."

rows.original: Your thoughts tend to wander when you spend so much time traveling, and you find yourself drifting towards someone you've been privately thinking of for a while: Kalysea. That big friendly centaur druid you've become so enamored with. Truth be told, you often find yourself considering her during downtime. Maybe it's about time you go and check on her house. Just in case she's back now. She might need taking care of...
rows.translation: 当你花费这么多时间在旅途中时，思绪往往会开始飘忽不定，而你也会发现自己逐渐被那个你暗自惦记已有一段时间的人所吸引卡莉希娅那个巨大的友好那个你如此迷恋的半人马德鲁伊……说实话，你在空闲时间经常会想起她。 或许现在是时候去看看她的情况了。万一她现在已经回来了呢？她可能需要一些照顾……
rows.raw: " Your thoughts tend to wander when you spend so much time traveling, and you find yourself drifting towards someone you've been privately thinking of for a while: Kalysea. That big friendly centaur druid you've become so enamored with. Truth be told, you often find yourself considering her during downtime. Maybe it's about time you go and check on her house. Just in case she's back now. She might need taking care of..."

rows.original: Kalysea has not only returned, she's now traveling with you! It's hard to imagine a better outcome, even if that magic ring she has around her gorgeous cock makes you wonder a little...
rows.translation: 卡莉希娅不仅回来了，现在还和你一起踏上旅程呢！真的很难想象还有比这更完美的结果了……不过，她手指上那枚神奇的戒指，还是让人不禁有些好奇……
rows.raw: "\n            Kalysea has not only returned, she's now traveling with you! It's hard to imagine a better outcome, even if that magic ring she has around her gorgeous cock makes you wonder a little..."

rows.translation: 维伦之剑

rows.original: Brother Sanders has asked you to look into the disappearance of a girl named Eryka, a young paladin under his care. She should be somewhere in the Old Forest north of Hawkethorne, along with a pack of three young lupine boys.
rows.translation: 桑德斯修士要求你调查一名名叫艾瑞卡的女孩的失踪案。她是他负责照顾的一名年轻圣骑士，应该就在鹰棘镇北部的古林里，和三只年轻的狼族男孩在一起。
rows.raw: "Brother Sanders has asked you to look into the disappearance of a girl named Eryka, a young paladin under his care. She should be somewhere in the Old Forest north of Hawkethorne, along with a pack of three young lupine boys."

rows.original: You've bumped into Eryka, who was most definitely not in her right mind. No sign of the lupine lads, though.
rows.translation: 你遇到了艾瑞卡，她当时显然已经神志不清了。不过，那些狼族男孩们却一点踪迹都没有。
rows.raw: "You've bumped into Eryka, who was most definitely not in her right mind. No sign of the lupine lads, though."

rows.original: You helped Eryka back to town, much to Brother Sanders' relief. Unfortunately, nobody knows what happened to the lupine boys after she told them to flee. Hopefully they turn up someday.
rows.translation: 你帮助艾瑞卡回到了小镇，这让桑德斯修士松了一口气。可惜，在她命令那些狼族男孩逃走之后，没有人知道他们究竟发生了什么。希望有一天他们能重新出现。
rows.raw: "You helped Eryka back to town, much to Brother Sanders' relief. Unfortunately, nobody knows what happened to the lupine boys after she told them to flee. Hopefully they turn up someday."

rows.translation: 追求牛女

rows.original: The easiest way to get a ring would probably be to visit Ivris in Hawkethorne and see about melting down some electrum into their constituents – namely silver and more importantly, gold. Then you can talk to Ogrish about using a mold.
rows.translation: 获得这枚戒指最简单的方法，可能是前往鹰棘镇的艾薇莉丝，将一些电银熔化，提取出其中的成分——也就是银，而更重要的是黄金。之后，你可以与奥格瑞什商量，看看是否可以使用模具来制作这枚戒指。
rows.raw: "The easiest way to get a ring would probably be to visit Ivris in Hawkethorne and see about melting down some electrum into their constituents – namely silver and more importantly, gold. Then you can talk to Ogrish about using a mold."

rows.original: Visit Ogrish to see about getting [pc.bri3|a ring mold|some ring molds] made.
rows.translation: 去找奥格里什，问问能否制作[pc.bri3|一个戒指模具|一些戒指模具]。
rows.raw: "Visit Ogrish to see about getting [pc.bri3|a ring mold|some ring molds] made."

rows.original: Wait for Ogrish to finish his work.
rows.translation: 等奥格瑞什完成他的工作吧。
rows.raw: "Wait for Ogrish to finish his work."

rows.translation: 从奥格瑞什那里获取那份工作。

rows.original: With your ring[pc.bri3|s] secured, propose to Brienne at the family house.[pc.bri3| The others can wait until you've figured out details about the marriage.]
rows.translation: 备好戒指[pc.bri3|]后，去家族宅邸向布蕾妮求婚。[pc.bri3|其他人的事，可以等你弄清这场婚姻的细节后再谈。]
rows.raw: "With your ring[pc.bri3|s] secured, propose to Brienne at the family house.[pc.bri3| The others can wait until you've figured out details about the marriage.]"

rows.original: Talk to Brienne about your upcoming marriage.
rows.translation: 和布蕾妮谈谈你即将到来的婚事吧。
rows.raw: "Talk to Brienne about your upcoming marriage."

rows.original: Choose a type of marriage ceremony with Brienne.
rows.translation: 与布蕾妮一起选择一种婚姻仪式的类型。
rows.raw: "Choose a type of marriage ceremony with Brienne."

rows.translation: 向卡茜娅和莉娜求婚。

rows.original: Talk to Brienne about the upcoming ceremony then wait seven days to start the event at her family's home.
rows.translation: 与布蕾妮讨论即将举行的仪式，然后等待七天，在她家中开始这场活动。
rows.raw: "Talk to Brienne about the upcoming ceremony then wait seven days to start the event at her family's home."

rows.original: Your journey continues, but now you're sure to never be apart from [pc.bri3|those who mean the most to you|the one who means the most to you] — all's well that ends well.
rows.translation: 你的旅程继续前行，但现在你一定会与[pc.bri3|对你来说最重要的人|对你来说最重要的人]永远相伴。  ——只要结局好，一切就都值得。
rows.raw: "Your journey continues, but now you're sure to never be apart from [pc.bri3|those who mean the most to you|the one who means the most to you] — all's well that ends well."

rows.translation: 追求公牛

rows.original: Talk to Brint about your feelings for him.
rows.translation: 跟布林特谈谈你对他的感受吧。
rows.raw: "Talk to Brint about your feelings for him."

rows.original: Now that you've realized your mutual feelings for each other, it's time to talk about your upcoming marriage.
rows.translation: 现在你们已经意识到了彼此之间的感情，是时候讨论即将到来的婚姻事宜了。
rows.raw: "Now that you've realized your mutual feelings for each other, it's time to talk about your upcoming marriage."

rows.original: Choose a type of marriage ceremony with Brint.
rows.translation: 与布林特一起选择一种婚姻仪式类型吧。
rows.raw: "Choose a type of marriage ceremony with Brint."

rows.original: Talk to Brint about the upcoming ceremony then wait seven days to start the event at his family's home.
rows.translation: 与布林特讨论即将举行的仪式，然后等待七天，在他家中开始这场活动。
rows.raw: "Talk to Brint about the upcoming ceremony then wait seven days to start the event at his family's home."

rows.original: Your journey continues, but now you're sure to never be apart from the one who means the most to you — all's well that ends well.
rows.translation: 你的旅程还在继续，但现在你可以确定，再也不会与那个对你来说最重要的人分开——结局好的事情，总归是好的。
rows.raw: "Your journey continues, but now you're sure to never be apart from the one who means the most to you — all's well that ends well."

rows.translation: 水晶般清澈

rows.original: You've met Kailani, a vulperine huntress with white fur that's on the hunt for a specific beast. You ruined the trap that she had set up to capture it, and no other hunter in the village is brave enough to join her on the hunt. You offered to accompany her as her spotter, and she accepted, but only if you first defeat fifteen vulperine hunters within the Windy Peaks.
rows.translation: 你已经遇到了凯拉尼——这位拥有白色毛发的狐族女猎手，她正在追捕某只特定的野兽。你破坏了她设下的陷阱，导致她无法捕捉到那只野兽，而村子里也没有其他猎人有足够的勇气与她一起狩猎。你主动提出担任她的观察员，协助她进行这次追捕，她同意了，但前提是你必须先在风啸峰地区击败十五名狐族猎手。
rows.raw: "\n            You've met Kailani, a vulperine huntress with white fur that's on the hunt for a specific beast. You ruined the trap that she had set up to capture it, and no other hunter in the village is brave enough to join her on the hunt. You offered to accompany her as her spotter, and she accepted, but only if you first defeat fifteen vulperine hunters within the Windy Peaks."

rows.original: You've defeated fifteen vulperine hunters since speaking with Kailani; if she's right, your reputation ought to have reached her by now. Return to her.
rows.translation: 自从你与凯拉妮交谈后，你已经击败了十五名猎狐人；如果她说的没错，你的名声现在应该已经传到她那里了。回去找她吧。
rows.raw: "\n            You've defeated fifteen vulperine hunters since speaking with Kailani; if she's right, your reputation ought to have reached her by now. Return to her."

rows.original: You've met Kailani, a vulperine huntress with white fur that's on the hunt for a specific beast. You ruined the trap that she had set up to capture it, and no other hunter in the village is brave enough to join her on the hunt. After completing her task of defeating fifteen of her fellow hunters in combat, she's been forced to acknowledge your skill, and she's allowed you to join her in her hunt for whatever beast is lurking in the caves of Windy Peaks – you and you alone. Return to the place you two first met to begin the hunt.
rows.translation: 你已经见过凯拉妮了，她是一位身披白色毛皮的雌性猎手，目前正在追捕一只特定的野兽。你破坏了她为捕捉那只野兽而设下的陷阱，而村子里没有其他猎人有足够的勇气跟她一起去狩猎。在完成击败十五名其他猎人的任务后，她不得不承认你的实力，因此允许你加入她的搜寻行动，一起去寻找潜藏在风啸峰洞穴中的那只野兽——只有你，才能跟她一起行动。回到你们第一次相遇的地方，开始这次搜寻吧。
rows.raw: "\n            You've met Kailani, a vulperine huntress with white fur that's on the hunt for a specific beast. You ruined the trap that she had set up to capture it, and no other hunter in the village is brave enough to join her on the hunt. After completing her task of defeating fifteen of her fellow hunters in combat, she's been forced to acknowledge your skill, and she's allowed you to join her in her hunt for whatever beast is lurking in the caves of Windy Peaks – you and you alone. Return to the place you two first met to begin the hunt."

rows.original:
You've ventured into the cave near the top of Windy Peaks with Kailani, where you encountered a large, bipedal, hairy creature that had been terrorizing her and her family for a generation. After a hard-fought hunt, you two emerged victorious, and shortly after, [flags.KAILANI_BACK
                |Kailani propositioned you to elevate your relationship, but you had refused. Although it embarrassed her, she hasn't removed you from her life, and is willing to advance when you are.
                |you and Kailani consummated your relationship as she named you as her mate. But while you may be her mate, you're still not quite a family – you'll have to get Inaya's approval for that.
            ]
rows.translation:
你与凯拉妮一起进入了风啸峰顶附近的洞穴，在那里你们遇到了一种体型庞大、两足行走且浑身长满毛发的生物——这种生物已经威胁她和她的家人整整一代人了。经过一场激烈的追逐，你们最终取得了胜利，不久之后[flags.KAILANI_BACK
                |凯拉妮曾向你提出过进一步发展你们的关系，但你拒绝了。尽管这让她感到有些尴尬，她并没有将你从自己的生活中剔除，而且也愿意等待你准备好后再继续前进。
                |你和凯拉尼正式确定了关系，她也将你认定为自己的伴侣。不过，尽管你是她的伴侣，但你们仍然算不上真正的家人——还需要得到伊娜雅的认可才行。
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            You've ventured into the cave near the top of Windy Peaks with Kailani, where you encountered a large, bipedal, hairy creature that had been terrorizing her and her family for a generation. After a hard-fought hunt, you two emerged victorious, and shortly after, [flags.KAILANI_BACK
                |Kailani propositioned you to elevate your relationship, but you had refused. Although it embarrassed her, she hasn't removed you from her life, and is willing to advance when you are.
                |you and Kailani consummated your relationship as she named you as her mate. But while you may be her mate, you're still not quite a family – you'll have to get Inaya's approval for that.
            ]"

rows.translation: 挺身而出

rows.original: You've been spending so much time with Inaya and Kailani, and you've made such a big impact on Inaya in particular, that she learned just enough Belharan to ask you to go back to the cave you and Kailani had gone inside to hunt that hairy, bipedal beast from before. She said something about 'finding what made Kailani start to act so differently' (or so you can gather from her limited Belharan).
rows.translation: 你花了这么多时间与伊奈亚和凯拉妮在一起，尤其是对伊奈亚产生了深远的影响，以至于她学会了足够的贝尔哈兰语，专门请你再去你们之前一起进入过的那个洞穴，去捕捉那种长满毛发的两足野兽。她说了些什么关于“找到让凯拉妮行为变得如此不同的原因”的话（至少从她那有限的贝尔哈兰语表达能力来看，她是这个意思）。
rows.raw: "\n            You've been spending so much time with Inaya and Kailani, and you've made such a big impact on Inaya in particular, that she learned just enough Belharan to ask you to go back to the cave you and Kailani had gone inside to hunt that hairy, bipedal beast from before. She said something about 'finding what made Kailani start to act so differently' (or so you can gather from her limited Belharan)."

rows.original: You had bonded with Inaya well enough that she went out of her way to learn just enough Belharan to ask you to return to the cave you and Kailani had hunted that tall, hairy, bipedal beast in and retrieve something from it. An old, tattered, rotten stick that's still wrapped with faded, dyed leathers. Whatever Inaya has in mind, she wants you to bring that stick back to her.
rows.translation: 你与伊奈亚的关系已经变得如此亲密，以至于她特意学习了足够的贝尔哈兰语，只是为了请你回到你和凯拉尼曾经一起猎杀那种高大的、有毛的、两足生物的洞穴里，去取回某样东西。那是一根破旧、腐朽的木棍，上面还缠着已经褪色的、染过的皮革。无论伊奈亚有什么打算，她都希望你能把那根木棍带回来给她。
rows.raw: "\n            You had bonded with Inaya well enough that she went out of her way to learn just enough Belharan to ask you to return to the cave you and Kailani had hunted that tall, hairy, bipedal beast in and retrieve something from it. An old, tattered, rotten stick that's still wrapped with faded, dyed leathers. Whatever Inaya has in mind, she wants you to bring that stick back to her."

rows.original: After retrieving the old, tattered stick inside of that cave that you and Kailani had hunted the beast in, Inaya finally found the courage to see Kailani for what she really is: her mother. Kailani and Inaya had a tenuous relationship that had stalled before you came along, and now, thanks to you and your efforts, their relationship is stronger than ever. You'll always have a home with the Ibulim family.
rows.translation: 在从那个你们和凯拉尼曾经一起猎杀野兽的洞穴里找回了那根破旧不堪的棍子之后，伊奈亚终于鼓起了勇气，去认清凯拉尼的真实面目——她的母亲。在你出现之前，凯拉尼和伊奈亚之间的关系就已经十分脆弱，而如今，多亏了你和你的努力，她们的关系比以往任何时候都要紧密。在伊布利姆家族，你永远都有一个家。
rows.raw: "\n            After retrieving the old, tattered stick inside of that cave that you and Kailani had hunted the beast in, Inaya finally found the courage to see Kailani for what she really is: her mother. Kailani and Inaya had a tenuous relationship that had stalled before you came along, and now, thanks to you and your efforts, their relationship is stronger than ever. You'll always have a home with the Ibulim family."

rows.translation: 品味龙之力

rows.original: You returned from Dracia with a crystal seemingly made of magically-charged blood, perhaps descended from dragons. A skilled enchantress such as Viviane might be able to turn it into something truly special...
rows.translation: 你从达拉西亚带回了一块似乎由蕴含魔力的血液制成的水晶，或许它源自龙族。像薇薇安这样技艺高超的女巫，或许能够将它变造成真正特别的东西……
rows.raw: "\n            You returned from Dracia with a crystal seemingly made of magically-charged blood, perhaps descended from dragons. A skilled enchantress such as Viviane might be able to turn it into something truly special..."

rows.original: You returned from Dracia with a crystal seemingly made of magically-charged blood, perhaps descended from dragons. A skilled enchantress might be able to turn it into something truly special, if you happened to know one. Perhaps one might be found in the Old Forest — witches love forests.
rows.translation: 你从达拉西亚带回了一块似乎由充满魔力的血液构成的水晶，或许它源自龙族。如果你能找到一位技艺高超的女巫，她或许能够将这块水晶变成真正特别的东西。也许在古林里就能找到这样的女巫——女巫们总是喜欢森林的。
rows.raw: "\n            You returned from Dracia with a crystal seemingly made of magically-charged blood, perhaps descended from dragons. A skilled enchantress might be able to turn it into something truly special, if you happened to know one. Perhaps one might be found in the Old Forest — witches love forests."

rows.original: Unfortunately, you saw the most talented enchantress in the Marches removed. The Dracian blood gem will likely remain nothing but a curiosity now.
rows.translation: 不幸的是，你们看到边境地区最有天赋的女巫被撤走了。现在，那颗拥有达拉西亚血脉的宝石恐怕只会成为一个令人好奇的物件罢了。
rows.raw: "\n            Unfortunately, you saw the most talented enchantress in the Marches removed. The Dracian blood gem will likely remain nothing but a curiosity now."

rows.original:
You dropped the Dracian blood gem off with Viv for study, but she's asked you to help her gather some reagents: nine clippings of cinderleaf should be enough to help her synthesize the transformative.
            
            <b>
rows.translation:
你把那颗达拉西亚血宝石交给了薇芙让她进行研究，但她现在请求你帮忙收集一些炼金材料：九片烬叶碎片应该就足够她合成那种转化物质了。
            
            <b>
rows.raw:
"
            You dropped the Dracian blood gem off with Viv for study, but she's asked you to help her gather some reagents: nine clippings of cinderleaf should be enough to help her synthesize the transformative.
            
            <b>"

rows.curatedReason: 内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。

rows.translation: 烬叶：
灰烬叶：

rows.original: You brought the goods to Viv. She needs
rows.translation: 你把东西带给了薇芙，她需要这些东西。
rows.raw: "\n            You brought the goods to Viv. She needs "

rows.translation: 结束吧。

rows.original: You brought ashenleaf to Viv instead of cinderleaf. Should be just as good, right? She needs
rows.translation: 你给薇芙带来了烬叶草，而不是炭叶草。应该也差不多吧？她需要的是
rows.raw: "\n            You brought ashenleaf to Viv instead of cinderleaf. Should be just as good, right? She needs "

rows.translation: 结束吧。

rows.original: Viv should be ready now. Check back with her to see what she's cooked up.
rows.translation: 薇芙现在应该已经准备好了。去看看她准备了什么吧。
rows.raw: "\n            Viv should be ready now. Check back with her to see what she's cooked up."

rows.original: You've checked in with Viv and seen what fruit her work has yielded. You can purchase Dragonsblood from her at your leisure from now on.
rows.translation: 你已经与薇芙取得了联系，也看到了她的努力所带来的成果。从现在开始，你可以随时从她那里购买龙血了。
rows.raw: "\n            You've checked in with Viv and seen what fruit her work has yielded. You can purchase Dragonsblood from her at your leisure from now on."

rows.translation: 拯救塔拉

rows.original: You've learned from Kavi that Tarah has left home in search of a hero in the Marches she's heard news of. That hero might very well just be you... Kavi said that she might be some place nearby the large river that runs through the valley. There have to be some places near there you can check.
rows.translation: 你从卡维那里得知，塔拉已经离开家，去寻找那些在边境地区传说的英雄。而那个英雄，很可能就是你……卡维说，塔拉应该会在流经山谷的那条大河附近的某个地方。附近肯定有些地方可以你去寻找。
rows.raw: "\n            You've learned from Kavi that Tarah has left home in search of a hero in the Marches she's heard news of. That hero might very well just be you... Kavi said that she might be some place nearby the large river that runs through the valley. There have to be some places near there you can check."

rows.original: You found Tarah and talked her into a romance that involves less fighting. She was totally into it.
rows.translation: 你找到了塔拉，并说服她参与了一段战斗较少的恋爱关系。她对此非常感兴趣。
rows.raw: "\n            You found Tarah and talked her into a romance that involves less fighting. She was totally into it."

rows.original: You found Tarah and battled her into submission before carrying her back to Kavi's place.
rows.translation: 你找到了塔拉，与她激战一番，最终迫使她屈服，然后将她带回了卡维的住处。
rows.raw: "\n            You found Tarah and battled her into submission before carrying her back to Kavi's place."

rows.original: You somehow managed to let Tarah win, and she let you carry her back to Kavi's anyway?
rows.translation: 你究竟是怎么让塔拉获胜的，而且她最终还让你把她带回了卡维那里？
rows.raw: "\n            You somehow managed to let Tarah win, and she let you carry her back to Kavi's anyway?"

rows.original: You helped Tarah find a friendly shaman who was more than interested. Now all that's left is to tell Kavi.
rows.translation: 你帮助塔拉找到了一位非常热情、友善的萨满。现在剩下的就是告诉卡维这件事了。
rows.raw: "\n            You helped Tarah find a friendly shaman who was more than interested. Now all that's left is to tell Kavi."

rows.original: You wound up helping Tarah yourself, and now she considers you married! Regardless of the actual logistics of that, she is quite adorable.
rows.translation: 你最终还是帮助了塔拉，现在她竟然认为你们已经结婚了！不管实际情况如何，她实在太可爱了。
rows.raw: "\n You wound up helping Tarah yourself, and now she considers you married! Regardless of the actual logistics of that, she is quite adorable."

rows.original: You helped Tarah out by finding her a mate! Maybe you'll catch up with them again some time...
rows.translation: 你帮助塔拉找到了伴侣，真是帮了大忙！也许以后还有机会再见到他们……
rows.raw: "\n            You helped Tarah out by finding her a mate! Maybe you'll catch up with them again some time..."

rows.translation: 渺茫的希望

rows.original: Katya has asked you to go check on her brother, after receiving a possible lead. She's told you that her brother's crew likely made their way towards the Windy Peaks, after heading north of the old waystation.
rows.translation: 卡蒂亚在得到了一条可能的线索后，让你去看看她的弟弟。她告诉你，她弟弟的同伴们很可能在离开旧驿站后向风啸峰方向去了。
rows.raw: "\n            Katya has asked you to go check on her brother, after receiving a possible lead. She's told you that her brother's crew likely made their way towards the Windy Peaks, after heading north of the old waystation."

rows.original: You've seen the old waystation, abandoned after some sort of attack. Knowing this, the miners likely evacuated towards the Windy Peaks.
rows.translation: 你应该见过那座被废弃的旧驿站，它在遭受某种袭击后就被遗弃了。了解到这一情况，矿工们很可能会向风啸峰方向撤离。
rows.raw: "\n            You've seen the old waystation, abandoned after some sort of attack. Knowing this, the miners likely evacuated towards the Windy Peaks."

rows.original: The camp was utterly destroyed when you found it. It seems the prospectors thought they had made it to safety before something presumably ambushed them, and the devastation of the site seems to confirm the worst. You may as well return to Katya.
rows.translation: 当你找到那个营地时，它已经彻底被毁了。看来那些探矿者原本以为自己已经安全了，但后来他们很可能遭遇了埋伏，而营地的惨状也证实了最糟糕的情况。你还不如回去找卡蒂亚吧。
rows.raw: "\n            The camp was utterly destroyed when you found it. It seems the prospectors thought they had made it to safety before something presumably ambushed them, and the devastation of the site seems to confirm the worst. You may as well return to Katya."

rows.original: Katya was pretty torn up over the news, but thanked you for your efforts. There's nothing more you can do.
rows.translation: 卡蒂亚听到这个消息后心情非常低落，但还是感谢了你为她所做的一切。你已经无能为力了。
rows.raw: "\n            Katya was pretty torn up over the news, but thanked you for your efforts. There's nothing more you can do."

rows.original: While you didn't get around to following Katya's lead regarding her missing brother, it doesn't take a genius to realize who Auren is... [flags.AUREN_KILLED|or rather, was|at the very least, he's in custody now].
rows.translation: 虽然你没有按照卡蒂亚的建议去寻找她失踪的弟弟，但谁是奥伦，这一点其实并不难猜…… [flags.AUREN_KILLED|或者更准确地说，是|至少，他现在已经被拘留了]。
rows.raw: "\n            While you didn't get around to following Katya's lead regarding her missing brother, it doesn't take a genius to realize who Auren is... [flags.AUREN_KILLED|or rather, was|at the very least, he's in custody now]."

rows.translation: 黑骑士

rows.original:
The knight in black – Tay, she said her name was – is interested in seeing you. She said she'd be in the slum district, at the Whore's Bosom inn. The only problem is that getting into the slums is apparently a matter of discretion, and the guards in the city aren't interested.

            Maybe you could try talking to that guard in the city outskirts – just outside the wall, sitting by his lonesome on the way to the rear entrance. That seems like your best bet for now.
rows.translation:
那个黑衣骑士——她说她的名字叫泰——想要见你。她说她会出现在贫民区，就在“妓女之胸”酒馆里。唯一的问题是，进入贫民区似乎需要一些特别的办法，城里的守卫们对此并不感兴趣。

            或许你可以试着和城郊外的那个守卫谈谈——就在城墙外，他在去后门的路上独自坐着。目前来看，这似乎是你的最佳选择。
rows.raw:
"
            The knight in black – Tay, she said her name was – is interested in seeing you. She said she'd be in the slum district, at the Whore's Bosom inn. The only problem is that getting into the slums is apparently a matter of discretion, and the guards in the city aren't interested.

            Maybe you could try talking to that guard in the city outskirts – just outside the wall, sitting by his lonesome on the way to the rear entrance. That seems like your best bet for now."

rows.original: You've found the Black Knight, Octavia. There might be more to her than it seems...
rows.translation: 奥克塔维娅，你已经找到了那位黑骑士。她或许并不像表面上看起来的那么简单……
rows.raw: "You've found the Black Knight, Octavia. There might be more to her than it seems..."

rows.original:
You've witnessed one of Atugia's nightmares, a flashback to the moment she was cursed while her village was decimated around her. Atugia's neck released some sort of pulse that could be seen for miles around, and you have no direct way to tell whether it was a signal to someone or something.
            
            Perhaps if you knew an oracle, you could ask them to read Tui's future. That way you could confirm whether she's being hunted, and maybe even what by!
rows.translation:
你刚刚目睹了阿图吉娅的一场噩梦——那是一段关于她被诅咒、同时她的村庄也在周围被摧毁的回忆。阿图吉娅的脖子上散发出某种脉冲，这种光芒在数英里外都能看到，但你根本无法判断这种信号是发给某个人还是某物的。
            
            或许，如果你能找到一位先知，就可以请他们来预测图伊的未来。这样你就能确定她是否真的正在被人追捕，甚至还能知道是哪些人在追捕她！
rows.raw:
"You've witnessed one of Atugia's nightmares, a flashback to the moment she was cursed while her village was decimated around her. Atugia's neck released some sort of pulse that could be seen for miles around, and you have no direct way to tell whether it was a signal to someone or something.
            
            Perhaps if you knew an oracle, you could ask them to read Tui's future. That way you could confirm whether she's being hunted, and maybe even what by!
            
            "

rows.original: Visit Hretha in the orc camp to have her look for omens.
rows.translation: 去兽人营地拜访赫蕾莎，请她为你解读征兆。
rows.raw: "Visit Hretha in the orc camp to have her look for omens."

rows.original: Visit Ihzalti in the foothills to see if she can read Atugia's future.
rows.translation: 前往山麓拜访伊扎尔蒂，看看她能否预见阿图吉娅的未来。
rows.raw: "Visit Ihzalti in the foothills to see if she can read Atugia's future."

rows.translation: 你已经来过

rows.original: , and confirmed that something is lurking in Hawkethorne. It will get the jump on Atugia eventually, unless you and her seek it out in town first.
rows.translation: ，并确认某种东西正潜伏在鹰棘镇。它迟早会偷袭阿图吉娅，除非你和她先在镇里把它找出来。
rows.raw: ", and confirmed that something is lurking in Hawkethorne. It will get the jump on Atugia eventually, unless you and her seek it out in town first."

rows.original:
Your pursuers are a trio of miniature satyrs, and they're currently making a mess of Hawkethorne! You'll have to deal with each in turn: <ul>
                <li>
rows.translation:
你的追捕者是一群三个小型的萨提尔，他们现在正在把鹰棘镇弄得一片混乱！你将不得不依次对付他们每一个人。 <ul>
                <li>
rows.raw: "Your pursuers are a trio of miniature satyrs, and they're currently making a mess of Hawkethorne! You'll have to deal with each in turn: <ul>\n                <li>"

rows.curatedReason: 内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。
内部属性、赋值/比较值或 colorText() 的颜色参数；翻译会破坏逻辑或样式。

rows.original: You dealt with the satyr gang by setting them free. They couldn't give you much information, but gave Atugia some advice.
rows.translation: 你通过将那些半人半羊的怪物放走，从而解决了他们带来的麻烦。他们虽然无法提供太多有用的信息，但还是给阿图吉娅提供了一些建议。
rows.raw: "You dealt with the satyr gang by setting them free. They couldn't give you much information, but gave Atugia some advice."

rows.original: You dealt with the satyr gang by [wayfort.renovated|letting them stay at your wayfort|offering them a place once you have one]. They couldn't give you much information, but gave Atugia some advice.
rows.translation: 你通过[wayfort.renovated|让那帮萨堤尔留在你的驿堡|答应有了自己的住处后就给那帮萨堤尔一个容身之所]，解决了他们的事情。他们没能提供多少情报，不过给了阿图吉娅一些建议。
rows.raw: "You dealt with the satyr gang by [wayfort.renovated|letting them stay at your wayfort|offering them a place once you have one]. They couldn't give you much information, but gave Atugia some advice."

rows.original: While on your [atugia.fucked|date|outing], Atugia followed the satyrs' advice with some help from you, and felt the presence of something greater approaching. All you can do now is prepare for its arrival.
rows.translation: 在你与阿图吉娅[atugia.fucked|约会|外出]期间，在你的帮助下，她听从了那些萨提尔的建议，并感受到某种更强大的存在正在接近。现在你能做的，就是为它的到来做好准备。
rows.raw: "While on your [atugia.fucked|date|outing], Atugia followed the satyrs' advice with some help from you, and felt the presence of something greater approaching. All you can do now is prepare for its arrival."

rows.translation: 名誉遗物

rows.original: Liresh and Syrish are offering to take you on an adventure to capture a relic back from some orcish raiders.[party.has arona||[arona.recruited| Perhaps having Arona along will help?]] Simply talk to the twins to head out.
rows.translation: 利雷什和赛里什邀请你一同参加一场冒险，从那些兽人掠夺者手中夺回那件遗物。[party.has arona||[arona.recruited| 也许让阿罗娜一起来帮忙会比较好吧？]]只需和那对双胞胎谈谈，然后就可以出发了。
rows.raw: "Liresh and Syrish are offering to take you on an adventure to capture a relic back from some orcish raiders.[party.has arona||[arona.recruited| Perhaps having Arona along will help?]] Simply talk to the twins to head out."

rows.original: You've met some aggressive orcs, [party.comp Arona|[arona.isChief|and they're refusing to listen to Arona|and Arona thinks something's wrong with them]|and there's nothing for it but to fight your way through].
rows.translation: 你遇到过一些好斗的兽人[party.comp Arona|[arona.isChief|他们拒绝听取阿罗娜的意见。|而阿罗娜认为他们身上有些不对劲的地方。]|除了奋力拼搏之外，别无他法]。
rows.raw: "You've met some aggressive orcs, [party.comp Arona|[arona.isChief|and they're refusing to listen to Arona|and Arona thinks something's wrong with them]|and there's nothing for it but to fight your way through]."

rows.original: The girls have split up and left you to look for clues in the southern part of the camp. Maybe there's something here?
rows.translation: 那些女孩已经分头行动了，现在让你去营地的南部寻找线索。也许那里会有什么发现吧？
rows.raw: "The girls have split up and left you to look for clues in the southern part of the camp. Maybe there's something here?"

rows.original: There's evidence of someone traversing the bluff, but you can't find the way...
rows.translation: 有证据表明有人曾经穿过那片悬崖地带，但你就是找不到通往那里的路……
rows.raw: "There's evidence of someone traversing the bluff, but you can't find the way..."

rows.original: You have Liresh, but Syrish has gone off ahead and gotten into trouble near the bluff.
rows.translation: 你还有利雷什，但西里什已经先走了，在悬崖附近遇到了麻烦。
rows.raw: "You have Liresh, but Syrish has gone off ahead and gotten into trouble near the bluff."

rows.original: The orcs have been dispatched, now you only need to find the relic.
rows.translation: 兽人已经被派出去了，现在你只需要找到那件遗物就可以了。
rows.raw: "The orcs have been dispatched, now you only need to find the relic."

rows.original: The relic has been located, and the culprits have had their Very Happy Ending, as have Liresh and Syrish. All's well that ends well.
rows.translation: 那件遗物已经被找到了，那些犯人也得到了他们应得的“幸福结局”，李雷什和西里什也是如此。一切都有好的结局，那就是最好的结果了。
rows.raw: "The relic has been located, and the culprits have had their Very Happy Ending, as have Liresh and Syrish. All's well that ends well."

rows.translation: 黑暗中的嚎叫

rows.original: Garth has asked you to look into the recent disappearances. Furthermore, he has requested you to find Drifa — a local who took it upon herself to investigate the matter. He reckons that she couldn't have gone far. That means both she and the missing people are likely still in the Old Forest.
rows.translation: 加斯请你调查最近的失踪事件。另外，他还请你找到德莉法——这位当地姑娘自告奋勇去调查此事。他认为她走不了多远，也就是说，她和那些失踪者很可能都还在古林里。
rows.raw: "\n Garth has asked you to look into the recent disappearances. Furthermore, he has requested you to find Drifa — a local who took it upon herself to investigate the matter. He reckons that she couldn't have gone far. That means both she and the missing people are likely still in the Old Forest."

rows.original: You found and rescued Drifa from a pack of corrupted lupines that ambushed her. After talking with the shy half-lupine, you sent her [wayfort.hasDrifa|to the Wayfort, letting her stay there while she gathers|back to Hawkethorne, but that's not going to stop her from gathering] information about the beastmen. Nevertheless, you should probably go and talk to her...
rows.translation: 你找到了德莉法，将她从伏击她的腐化狼族手中救出。与这位害羞的半狼族姑娘谈过后，你把她送[wayfort.hasDrifa|到了驿堡，让她住在那里，继续搜集|回了鹰棘镇，但这并不会阻止她继续搜集]关于兽人的情报。不过，你或许该去和她谈谈……
rows.raw: "\n            You found and rescued Drifa from a pack of corrupted lupines that ambushed her. After talking with the shy half-lupine, you sent her [wayfort.hasDrifa|to the Wayfort, letting her stay there while she gathers|back to Hawkethorne, but that's not going to stop her from gathering] information about the beastmen. Nevertheless, you should probably go and talk to her..."

rows.original: By Drifa's estimate, it should only take her a few days before she returns with tangible information on the feral beastmen.
rows.translation: 根据德莉法的估计，她只需要几天的时间，就能带回关于那些野性兽人的确切信息。
rows.raw: "\n            By Drifa's estimate, it should only take her a few days before she returns with tangible information on the feral beastmen."

rows.original: It's been a few days. You should check on Drifa and see if she's made any progress on the investigation.
rows.translation: 已经过去几天了。你应该去看看德莉法，看看她在调查中是否有任何进展。
rows.raw: "\n            It's been a few days. You should check on Drifa and see if she's made any progress on the investigation."

rows.original:
[flags.CLUPINES_DEFEAT
                |The corrupted lupines are becoming too much of a problem to ignore. Since you know the whereabouts of their lair, you should discuss the matter with Drifa and settle this problem once and for all.
                |Drifa now knows where the corrupted lupines' lair is. Whenever you're ready, return to Drifa and she'll lead you there.
            ]
rows.translation:
[flags.CLUPINES_DEFEAT
                |这些被污染的狼人已经成了一个不容忽视的严重问题。既然你知道它们藏身的地方，就应该和德莉法商量一下，彻底解决这个麻烦。
                |德莉法现在已经知道那些被污染的狼人的藏身处在哪里了。当你准备好的时候，回到德莉法身边，她会带你去那里的。
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            [flags.CLUPINES_DEFEAT
                |The corrupted lupines are becoming too much of a problem to ignore. Since you know the whereabouts of their lair, you should discuss the matter with Drifa and settle this problem once and for all.
                |Drifa now knows where the corrupted lupines' lair is. Whenever you're ready, return to Drifa and she'll lead you there.
            ]"

rows.original:
[drifa.captured|You witnessed a pack of horned lupines kidnap a young woman|You found and rescued Drifa. However, with how dangerous the endeavor is, you told her to go home and get lost — this mission isn't meant for her]. It's clear that these marauding beastmen are a serious problem and that they need to be stopped. To do that, though, you'll need to know where their domain is. Randomly exploring the Old Forest and fighting every corrupted lupine you see won't do you much if you don't have any actionable information to help stamp out the problem at its source.

            You could either let yourself get captured by a roaming hunting party (this might not be a good idea) or you could capture one of the mad brutes and then extract the information you need. Either way, you'll have to run into them again.
rows.translation:
[drifa.captured|你亲眼看到了一群角狼绑架了一名年轻女子。|你找到了德莉法并将其救了出来。然而，考虑到这次行动的危险性，你还是劝她回家去吧——这个任务根本不适合她。]很明显，这些四处劫掠的兽人是一个严重的威胁，必须加以制止。然而，要想做到这一点，首先需要弄清楚它们的活动范围。如果在没有任何有助于从源头上解决这个问题的信息的情况下，只是随意在古古林里搜寻，然后与遇到的每一只被腐蚀的狼族战斗，那么根本无济于事。

            你要么让自己被那些四处游荡的狩猎队抓住（这可能不是个好主意），要么抓住其中一只那些疯狂的野兽，然后从中获取你需要的信息。无论如何，你最终都得再次与它们相遇。
rows.raw:
"
            [drifa.captured|You witnessed a pack of horned lupines kidnap a young woman|You found and rescued Drifa. However, with how dangerous the endeavor is, you told her to go home and get lost — this mission isn't meant for her]. It's clear that these marauding beastmen are a serious problem and that they need to be stopped. To do that, though, you'll need to know where their domain is. Randomly exploring the Old Forest and fighting every corrupted lupine you see won't do you much if you don't have any actionable information to help stamp out the problem at its source.

            You could either let yourself get captured by a roaming hunting party (this might not be a good idea) or you could capture one of the mad brutes and then extract the information you need. Either way, you'll have to run into them again."

rows.original: You now know where the wolfmen's lair is — it should be on the northeastern side of the Old Forest. Whenever you're ready, make your way to the old mine and deal with the problem at its source.
rows.translation: 你现在知道狼人的巢穴在哪里了—— 它应该位于古林的东北侧。一旦你准备好了，就前往那座旧矿场，从根源上解决这个问题吧。
rows.raw: "\n You now know where the wolfmen's lair is — it should be on the northeastern side of the Old Forest. Whenever you're ready, make your way to the old mine and deal with the problem at its source."

rows.original: Enter the belly of the beast and face the fury of the corrupted alpha, Asgeir.
rows.translation: 深入虎穴，直面腐化首领阿斯盖尔的怒火。
rows.raw: "\n Enter the belly of the beast and face the fury of the corrupted alpha, Asgeir."

rows.original: You've dealt a heavy blow against the corrupted lupines by dealing with all three of Asgeir's captains. With the defeat of the jarl's triumvirate, the challenge ahead has been greatly reduced. If there's nothing left you want to do in the mine, you should make your way into the belly of the beast and finish this fight!
rows.translation: 你通过消灭阿斯盖尔的三位队长，给那些堕落的狼族势力造成了重型的打击。随着这位酋长领导的三人联盟的覆灭，我们未来面临的挑战已经大大减少了。如果在这个矿井里你已经没有其他事情想做了，那么你就应该深入这个“巨兽”的内部，完成这场战斗吧！
rows.raw: "\n You've dealt a heavy blow against the corrupted lupines by dealing with all three of Asgeir's captains. With the defeat of the jarl's triumvirate, the challenge ahead has been greatly reduced. If there's nothing left you want to do in the mine, you should make your way into the belly of the beast and finish this fight!"

rows.original: [flags.KQ_RESOLUTION 3 |True to his word, Tharsus defeated Asgeir and assumed control as the new jarl, giving you a score of the corrupted lupines to use as you see fit before leaving the cave with the rest of his new followers. Since the old warlock has revealed his loyalties to the Cult of Tollus, you will no doubt run into him again. |[flags.KQ_EPILOGUE 1 2 3 4 |The corrupted lupines are now under your command. As their new leader, you can put their skills to better use as a standing force at the Wayfort. As far as you're concerned, this is the end of the corrupted lupine threat. |The corrupted lupines will remain locked up in the Wayfort's dungeons until further notice. This way, they won't cause any problems and you can still interact with them. As far as you're concerned, this is the end of the corrupted lupine threat. |As the victor, you invoked marcher law and banished the corrupted lupine to Walk the Ice. Despite being craven beasts, they still cling to a sense of honor and duty. Regardless, the beastmen shall live the rest of their lives in exile, away from civilization. They shall never trouble Hawkethorne or the nearby settlements ever again. As far as you're concerned, this is the end of the corrupted lupine threat. |The corrupted lupines are now under your command. As their new leader, you can put their skills to better use as a standing force at the Wayfort. Using the mutagen basin and the warlock-captain's alchemical notes, you were able to turn the wolfmen into sexy wolf-babes. They're still just as horny as they were before, but they're at least loyal to you. As far as you're concerned, this is the end of the corrupted lupine threat. ] ]
rows.translation: [flags.KQ_RESOLUTION 3 |他果然言出必行，塔苏斯击败了阿斯盖尔，成为了新的酋长。在带着他的新追随者们离开洞穴之前，他给了你一些被腐蚀的狼人作为奖励，你可以随意使用这些狼人。既然那个老巫师已经公开表示自己效忠于托勒斯教派，你肯定还会再遇到他的。 |[flags.KQ_EPILOGUE 1 2 3 4 |这些被腐蚀的狼人现在已受你的指挥。作为他们的新领袖，你可以更好地利用他们的能力，让他们成为荒废驿堡一带的一支重要力量。对你来说，这意味着被腐蚀的狼人所带来的威胁已经结束了。 |这些被污染的狼人将会被关在荒废驿堡的地牢里，直到另行通知。这样一来，它们就不会造成任何麻烦，你们仍然可以与它们进行互动。对你们来说，这意味着被污染的狼人所带来的威胁已经结束了。 |作为胜利者，你依据“行军者法则”将那头堕落的狼人放逐到了在冰上行走。尽管他们是怯懦的野兽，但他们依然保持着某种荣誉感和责任感。无论如何，这些兽人将在流放中度过余生，远离文明社会。他们再也不会打扰霍克索恩或附近的定居点。对你来说，这意味着那些被腐蚀的狼人所带来的威胁已经结束了。 |这些被改造的狼人现在已听命于你。作为他们的新领袖，你可以更好地利用他们的能力，让他们成为荒废驿堡一带的一支重要力量。借助突变基因池以及那位巫师船长的炼金笔记，你成功地将这些狼人变成了性感迷人的狼女。她们依然保持着以往的欲望，但至少现在她们对你忠心耿耿。对你来说，这些被改造的狼人所带来的威胁，已经彻底结束了。 ] ]
rows.raw: " [flags.KQ_RESOLUTION 3 |True to his word, Tharsus defeated Asgeir and assumed control as the new jarl, giving you a score of the corrupted lupines to use as you see fit before leaving the cave with the rest of his new followers. Since the old warlock has revealed his loyalties to the Cult of Tollus, you will no doubt run into him again. |[flags.KQ_EPILOGUE 1 2 3 4 |The corrupted lupines are now under your command. As their new leader, you can put their skills to better use as a standing force at the Wayfort. As far as you're concerned, this is the end of the corrupted lupine threat. |The corrupted lupines will remain locked up in the Wayfort's dungeons until further notice. This way, they won't cause any problems and you can still interact with them. As far as you're concerned, this is the end of the corrupted lupine threat. |As the victor, you invoked marcher law and banished the corrupted lupine to Walk the Ice. Despite being craven beasts, they still cling to a sense of honor and duty. Regardless, the beastmen shall live the rest of their lives in exile, away from civilization. They shall never trouble Hawkethorne or the nearby settlements ever again. As far as you're concerned, this is the end of the corrupted lupine threat. |The corrupted lupines are now under your command. As their new leader, you can put their skills to better use as a standing force at the Wayfort. Using the mutagen basin and the warlock-captain's alchemical notes, you were able to turn the wolfmen into sexy wolf-babes. They're still just as horny as they were before, but they're at least loyal to you. As far as you're concerned, this is the end of the corrupted lupine threat. ] ]"

rows.translation: 奇异同盟

rows.original: You've managed to negotiate an uneasy alliance with the bard-captain, Olivia. She and her lackeys won't attack you, but you have to deal with the other captains first. Furthermore, she'll be allowed to come and go from the Wayfort as she pleases, but only after you deal with Asgeir. [flags.KQ_THARSUS_DEF |Luckily, you've already dealt with Tharsus, that just leaves the warden, Refnir. |[flags.KQ_REFNIR_DEF |Luckily, you've already dealt with Refnir, that just leaves the warlock, Tharsus. |You now have a task to defeat both Tharsus and Refnir. ] ]
rows.translation: 你成功与那位吟游诗人出身的船长奥利维亚达成了一个并不稳固的联盟。她和她的手下不会攻击你，但你必须先解决其他船长们的问题。此外，在你解决阿斯盖尔的问题之后，她才能自由地进出荒废驿堡。 [flags.KQ_THARSUS_DEF |幸运的是，你已经解决了塔苏斯的问题，现在只剩下狱长雷夫尼尔了。 |[flags.KQ_REFNIR_DEF |幸运的是，你已经解决了雷夫尼尔这个麻烦，现在就只剩下那个术士塔苏斯了。 |现在你的任务是击败他们两个。塔尔苏斯以及雷夫尼尔。 ] ]
rows.raw: " You've managed to negotiate an uneasy alliance with the bard-captain, Olivia. She and her lackeys won't attack you, but you have to deal with the other captains first. Furthermore, she'll be allowed to come and go from the Wayfort as she pleases, but only after you deal with Asgeir. [flags.KQ_THARSUS_DEF |Luckily, you've already dealt with Tharsus, that just leaves the warden, Refnir. |[flags.KQ_REFNIR_DEF |Luckily, you've already dealt with Refnir, that just leaves the warlock, Tharsus. |You now have a task to defeat both Tharsus and Refnir. ] ]"

rows.original: Much to your surprise, the warlock-captain made you a similar proposal — deal with the other captains and they'll lend you their support. Since Tharsus' task and Olivia's task are mutually exclusive, it's one or the other. You can't work with them both. If you want the help of a captain, you must side with either Tharsus or Olivia.
rows.translation: 令你惊讶的是，那位巫师队长也向你提出了类似的建议——与其他的队长们合作，他们就会支持你。由于塔尔苏斯的任务和奥利维亚的任务是相互排斥的，你必须二选一，不可能同时与他们俩合作。 如果你想得到一位队长的帮助，就必须选择站在塔苏斯或奥利维亚这一边。
rows.raw: " Much to your surprise, the warlock-captain made you a similar proposal — deal with the other captains and they'll lend you their support. Since Tharsus' task and Olivia's task are mutually exclusive, it's one or the other. You can't work with them both. If you want the help of a captain, you must side with either Tharsus or Olivia."

"
            [flags.KQ_THARSUS_DEF
                |Unfortunately, the warlock-captain escaped before you could defeat. Nevertheless, you don't think you'll be seeing Tharsus again any time soon. That just means Refnir is the last remaining captain you have to deal with.
                |[flags.KQ_REFNIR_DEF
                    |The warden-captain has been dealt with, that just leaves Tharsus.
                ]
            ]"

rows.original: You've successfully dealt with the other two captains. You should return to Olivia and tell her the news.
rows.translation: 你已经成功处理了另外两位队长的事情，现在应该回去告诉奥利维亚这个消息。
rows.raw: "\n            You've successfully dealt with the other two captains. You should return to Olivia and tell her the news."

rows.original:
Olivia was pleased to hear you completed her task. [flags.OLIVIA_WF
                |You now have a tainted bard to look forward to having at the Wayfort.
                |You don't have to worry about her when you face the corrupted lupine leader.
            ]
rows.translation:
奥利维亚听到你完成了她的任务，感到非常高兴。 [flags.OLIVIA_WF
                |现在，在荒废驿堡，你将有机会体验一位“被污染”的吟游诗人了。
                |当你面对那个被腐蚀的狼人首领时，你不必担心她。
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            Olivia was pleased to hear you completed her task. [flags.OLIVIA_WF
                |You now have a tainted bard to look forward to having at the Wayfort.
                |You don't have to worry about her when you face the corrupted lupine leader.
            ]"

rows.original: You've managed to negotiate an uneasy alliance with the warlock-captain, Tharsus. He will overthrow Asgeir for you under the condition that he assumes his position afterwards. As an additional offer, he'll give you some of his notes, allowing you to genderbend the corrupted wolfmen if you're so inclined. However, for this to happen, you must deal with the other captains first. [flags.KQ_OLIVIA_DEF |Luckily, you've already dealt with Olivia, that just leaves the warden, Refnir. |[flags.KQ_REFNIR_DEF |Luckily, you've already dealt with Refnir, that just leaves the bard, Olivia. |You now have a task to defeat both Olivia and Refnir. ] ]
rows.translation: 你成功与那位巫师队长塔苏斯达成了一个并不稳固的联盟。他愿意为你推翻阿斯盖尔，但前提是他自己能够继承他的位置。作为额外的优惠，他还会将一些笔记交给你，这样如果你愿意的话，就可以利用这些笔记来改变那些被腐蚀的狼人的性别。不过，要想实现这一目标，你首先必须解决其他队长的问题。 [flags.KQ_OLIVIA_DEF |幸运的是，你已经处理过奥利维亚的事情了，现在就只剩下典狱长雷夫尼尔了。 |[flags.KQ_REFNIR_DEF |幸运的是，你已经解决了雷夫尼尔这个麻烦，现在就只剩下奥利维亚这个吟游诗人了。 |现在你的任务是击败他们两个。奥利维亚以及雷夫尼尔。 ] ]
rows.raw: " You've managed to negotiate an uneasy alliance with the warlock-captain, Tharsus. He will overthrow Asgeir for you under the condition that he assumes his position afterwards. As an additional offer, he'll give you some of his notes, allowing you to genderbend the corrupted wolfmen if you're so inclined. However, for this to happen, you must deal with the other captains first. [flags.KQ_OLIVIA_DEF |Luckily, you've already dealt with Olivia, that just leaves the warden, Refnir. |[flags.KQ_REFNIR_DEF |Luckily, you've already dealt with Refnir, that just leaves the bard, Olivia. |You now have a task to defeat both Olivia and Refnir. ] ]"
