rows.original: Much to your surprise, the bard-captain made you a similar proposal — deal with the other captains and they'll lend you their support. Since Olivia's task and Tharsus' task are mutually exclusive, it's one or the other. You can't work with them both. If you want the help of a captain, you must side with either Olivia or Tharsus.
rows.translation: 令你惊讶的是，那位吟游诗人队长也向你提出了类似的建议——与其他的队长们合作，他们就会支持你。由于奥利维亚的任务和塔苏斯的任务是相互排斥的，你必须二选一，不可能同时进行这两项任务。 如果你想得到一位队长的帮助，就必须选择站在奥利维亚或塔苏斯这一边。
rows.raw: " Much to your surprise, the bard-captain made you a similar proposal — deal with the other captains and they'll lend you their support. Since Olivia's task and Tharsus' task are mutually exclusive, it's one or the other. You can't work with them both. If you want the help of a captain, you must side with either Olivia or Tharsus."

"
            [flags.KQ_OLIVIA_DEF
                |The bard-captain has been dealt with, that just leaves Refnir.
                |[flags.KQ_REFNIR_DEF
                    |The warden-captain has been dealt with, that just leaves Olivia.
                ]
            ]"

rows.original: You've successfully dealt with the other two captains. You should return to Tharsus and tell him the news.
rows.translation: 你已经成功处理了另外两位队长的事情，现在应该回到塔苏斯那里，把这个消息告诉他。
rows.raw: "\n            You've successfully dealt with the other two captains. You should return to Tharsus and tell him the news."

rows.original: Tharsus was pleased to hear you defeated the other two captains. All that's left for you to do now is make your way down to the belly of the beast and witness the fruits of your labor. If all goes according to plan, Tharsus will honor his end of the bargain.
rows.translation: 塔苏斯很高兴听到你击败了另外两位队长。现在你所要做的，就是深入到那个“巨兽”的内部，亲眼见证自己努力的成果。如果一切按计划进行，塔苏斯一定会履行他的承诺。
rows.raw: "\n            Tharsus was pleased to hear you defeated the other two captains. All that's left for you to do now is make your way down to the belly of the beast and witness the fruits of your labor. If all goes according to plan, Tharsus will honor his end of the bargain."

rows.original:
[flags.KQ_THARSUS_DEF
                |Tharsus has revealed his loyalties to the Cult of Tollus, and you decided to end your partnership there after you got your hands on his alchemical notes. No way were you going to let him indoctrinate a bunch of corrupted lupine into the cult. Unfortunately, before you could deliver the finishing blow, he used a leananstone and got away.
                |True to his word, Tharsus defeated Asgeir and assumed control as the new jarl, giving you a score of the corrupted lupines to use as you see fit before leaving the cave with the rest of his new followers. Since the old warlock has revealed his loyalties to the Cult of Tollus, you will no doubt run into him again.
            ]
rows.translation:
[flags.KQ_THARSUS_DEF
                |萨鲁斯公开表示自己效忠于托勒斯教派，而在你得到他的炼金笔记后，你决定结束与他的合作。你绝不能让他用那些思想控制手段让那些被腐蚀的狼人加入这个教派。不幸的是，在你能够给予他最后一击之前，他利用了莱纳石逃走了。
                |他果然言出必行，塔苏斯击败了阿斯盖尔，成为了新的酋长。在带着他的新追随者们离开洞穴之前，他给了你一些被腐蚀的狼人作为奖励，你可以随意使用这些狼人。既然那个老巫师已经公开表示自己效忠于托勒斯教派，你肯定还会再遇到他的。
            ]
rows.raw:
"
            [flags.KQ_THARSUS_DEF
                |Tharsus has revealed his loyalties to the Cult of Tollus, and you decided to end your partnership there after you got your hands on his alchemical notes. No way were you going to let him indoctrinate a bunch of corrupted lupine into the cult. Unfortunately, before you could deliver the finishing blow, he used a leananstone and got away.
                |True to his word, Tharsus defeated Asgeir and assumed control as the new jarl, giving you a score of the corrupted lupines to use as you see fit before leaving the cave with the rest of his new followers. Since the old warlock has revealed his loyalties to the Cult of Tollus, you will no doubt run into him again.
            ]"

"
            With [flags.KQ_OLIVIA_DEF
                |Olivia
                |Tharsus
            ] having been defeated, you've lost a potential ally for this expedition. Hopefully [flags.KQ_REFNIR_DEF
                |[flags.KQ_OLIVIA_DEF
                    |Tharsus
                    |Olivia
                ] is
                |one of the other captains are
            ] amenable to negotiations."

rows.original: Negotiations have failed. There's no other captains left who are willing to aid you on your quest. You need to do this on your own now.
rows.translation: 谈判已经失败了。再也没有其他船长愿意帮助你完成这次任务了。现在你必须独自面对这一切。
rows.raw: "\n            Negotiations have failed. There's no other captains left who are willing to aid you on your quest. You need to do this on your own now."

rows.translation: 翻越波涛

rows.original: Varena has asked you to help her catch someone that's been stalking her. She thinks the best chance will be when she's taking possession of a shipment, down in the west side of town. Her cargo will have her house's emblem on it, a red axe.
rows.translation: 瓦蕾娜请求你的帮助，她想要抓住那个一直在跟踪她的人。她认为，在她去镇西边接收一批货物的时候，将是抓住那个人的最佳时机。那批货物的包装上会印有她家的徽章——一把红色的斧头。
rows.raw: "Varena has asked you to help her catch someone that's been stalking her. She thinks the best chance will be when she's taking possession of a shipment, down in the west side of town. Her cargo will have her house's emblem on it, a red axe."

rows.original: You caught a spy in the act, a taeleer working for the patrician house Iavari. You should talk to Varena about this discovery — perhaps she's learned more?
rows.translation: 你当场抓到一个间谍，一个为贾瓦里贵族家族工作的间谍。你应该把这一发现告诉瓦蕾娜——也许她已经掌握了更多的信息？
rows.raw: "You caught a spy in the act, a taeleer working for the patrician house Iavari. You should talk to Varena about this discovery — perhaps she's learned more?"

rows.original: You didn't manage to find Varena's stalker, if he or she even existed at all. Disappointed, the princess has had to explain her misadventure to her royal estate.
rows.translation: 你根本没能找到瓦蕾娜的跟踪者，甚至都不确定那个人是否存在。公主感到非常失望，只好向她的王室成员们解释这次失败的尝试。
rows.raw: "You didn't manage to find Varena's stalker, if he or she even existed at all. Disappointed, the princess has had to explain her misadventure to her royal estate."

rows.original: You've spoken to Varena about opening an investigation into Radmus Iavari. She's suggested that her friend Livrea might have information about where he is. You can find her outside the Passion Pasture in the city.
rows.translation: 你已经与瓦蕾娜谈过，让她对拉德穆斯·贾瓦里展开调查。她建议，她的朋友莉维娅可能掌握有关他下落的线索。你可以去城市里的“激情牧场”外找到她。
rows.raw: "You've spoken to Varena about opening an investigation into Radmus Iavari. She's suggested that her friend Livrea might have information about where he is. You can find her outside the Passion Pasture in the city."

rows.original: Livrea doesn't know where Radmus Iavari is, but his son Ramien is holed up with a bard, Carebella, in Telduum Village outside the city. Livrea and Varena will meet you there.
rows.translation: 莉维娅不知道拉德穆斯伊瓦里在哪里，不过他的儿子拉米恩正与吟游诗人卡雷贝拉一起躲在城外的泰尔杜姆村。莉维娅和瓦蕾娜会在那里与你会合。
rows.raw: "Livrea doesn't know where Radmus Iavari is, but his son Ramien is holed up with a bard, Carebella, in Telduum Village outside the city. Livrea and Varena will meet you there."

rows.original: Something was deeply wrong with Ramien, and he attacked you in a frenzy. You've got information now that his father is at the city's bath house. Livrea and Varena will meet you outside it.
rows.translation: 拉米恩显然出了严重的问题，他才会疯狂地攻击你。你现在知道他的父亲正在城里的公共浴场里。莉维娅和瓦蕾娜会在浴场外与你会合。
rows.raw: "Something was deeply wrong with Ramien, and he attacked you in a frenzy. You've got information now that his father is at the city's bath house. Livrea and Varena will meet you outside it."

rows.original: You stole a letter to Ramien from his sisters, indicating that they'll be in the city bath house. Livrea and Varena will meet you outside it.
rows.translation: 你从拉米恩的姐妹们手中偷走了一封信，信中说明她们会去城里的公共浴场。莉维娅和瓦蕾娜会在浴场外与你见面。
rows.raw: "You stole a letter to Ramien from his sisters, indicating that they'll be in the city bath house. Livrea and Varena will meet you outside it."

rows.original: You've arrived in the bath house with Livrea and Varena. Now you just need to find Radmus Iavari...
rows.translation: 你已经和莉维娅、瓦蕾娜一起来到了浴场。现在，你只需要找到拉德穆斯·亚瓦里……
rows.raw: "You've arrived in the bath house with Livrea and Varena. Now you just need to find Radmus Iavari..."

rows.original: You abandoned Livrea and Varena in the bath house; perhaps they'll have some luck on their own. If you care, you can go check in on them later.
rows.translation: 你把莉维娅和瓦蕾娜丢在了浴场里；也许她们自己能遇到一些好运。如果你在意的话，之后可以去看看她们怎么样。
rows.raw: "You abandoned Livrea and Varena in the bath house; perhaps they'll have some luck on their own. If you care, you can go check in on them later."

rows.original: Livrea doesn't remember a thing about Varena going missing, but the princess has been seen with Ramien Iavari in the palace. There's whispers the two are in a relationship now. What did you miss...
rows.translation: 莉维娅完全不记得瓦蕾娜失踪这件事，但有人看到这位公主在宫殿里与拉米恩·亚瓦里在一起。有传言称他们现在正在交往。你究竟遗漏了什么……
rows.raw: "Livrea doesn't remember a thing about Varena going missing, but the princess has been seen with Ramien Iavari in the palace. There's whispers the two are in a relationship now. What did you miss..."

rows.original: It turned out that Radmus was in league with Master Tollus, attempting to poison the city with corrupted water. You've arrested him, but there is still corrupted water flowing into the city...
rows.translation: 原来拉德穆斯与托勒斯大师合谋，企图用被污染的水来毒害整座城市。你们已经逮捕了他，但被污染的水仍然在不断流入城市……
rows.raw: "It turned out that Radmus was in league with Master Tollus, attempting to poison the city with corrupted water. You've arrested him, but there is still corrupted water flowing into the city..."

rows.original: You've closed off the water valve from the corrupted waterhead, slowing the corruption in the city.
rows.translation: 你关闭了受污染水源处的水阀，从而减缓了城市中污染的蔓延速度。
rows.raw: "You've closed off the water valve from the corrupted waterhead, slowing the corruption in the city."

rows.original: You've opened all the water valves, diluting the corruption flowing into the city to manageable levels. At least, you hope.
rows.translation: 你打开了所有的水阀，将流入城市的污染物浓度稀释到了可以控制的范围内。至少，你是这么希望的。
rows.raw: "You've opened all the water valves, diluting the corruption flowing into the city to manageable levels. At least, you hope."

rows.original: You and Varena have had a chance to debrief and discuss what your investigation turned up. You believe there may be a way to infiltrate the demons' main base in the region via the waterways they were using. Come back and talk to Varena when you're ready for a covert sneaking mission that might finally end the Siege of Khor'minos!
rows.translation: 你和瓦蕾娜已经有机会总结讨论你的调查结果。你们认为，或许可以通过恶魔所使用的水路潜入他们在该地区的主要基地。当你准备好执行这次秘密潜入任务、从而最终结束对科尔米诺斯的围攻时，再来找瓦蕾娜谈谈吧！
rows.raw: "You and Varena have had a chance to debrief and discuss what your investigation turned up. You believe there may be a way to infiltrate the demons' main base in the region via the waterways they were using. Come back and talk to Varena when you're ready for a covert sneaking mission that might finally end the Siege of Khor'minos!"

rows.original: You've taken Varena to the demons' fort. Now you just need to find the demons' breeding pits and destroy them.
rows.translation: 你已经把瓦蕾娜带到了恶魔的堡垒里。现在你只需要找到恶魔的繁殖地并将其摧毁即可。
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tYou've taken Varena to the demons' fort. Now you just need to find the demons' breeding pits and destroy them."

rows.original: The breeding pits have been destroyed, but you have an opportunity now that will never come again, to defeat the demon army's leaders. Find them and bring them down.
rows.translation: 那些用于繁殖的坑洞已经被摧毁了，但现在你有一个再也不会出现的机会——击败恶魔军队的首领们。找到他们，将他们彻底消灭。
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tThe breeding pits have been destroyed, but you have an opportunity now that will never come again, to defeat the demon army's leaders. Find them and bring them down."

rows.original: The demon army has been dealt a crippling blow. Varena was sidelined, but you can hope she'll recover.
rows.translation: 恶魔军队遭受了沉重的打击。瓦蕾娜暂时无法参与战斗，但希望她能够恢复过来。
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tThe demon army has been dealt a crippling blow. Varena was sidelined, but you can hope she'll recover."

rows.original: You and Varena did it! The demons have been dealt a crippling blow, and all that's left to do now is celebrate.
rows.translation: 是你和瓦蕾娜一起做到了！恶魔已经受到了沉重的打击，现在剩下的就是庆祝了。
rows.raw: "\n\t\t\tYou and Varena did it! The demons have been dealt a crippling blow, and all that's left to do now is celebrate."

rows.original: You chose not to pursue Varena's inquiry to its conclusion.
rows.translation: 你选择没有将瓦蕾娜的调查进行到底。
rows.raw: "\n            You chose not to pursue Varena's inquiry to its conclusion."

rows.original: You chose to follow Calise's plan rather than Varena's.
rows.translation: 你选择了遵循卡莉丝的计划，而不是瓦蕾娜的。
rows.raw: "\n            You chose to follow Calise's plan rather than Varena's."

rows.translation: 命途多舛的救援

rows.original: Tollus has challenged you to find Ahmri in the Undermountain
rows.translation: 托勒斯已经向你发起挑战，要求你在山腹深域中找到艾姆里。
rows.raw: "Tollus has challenged you to find Ahmri in the Undermountain"

rows.original: , or you could just ask Calise if the army can help
rows.translation: ，或者直接问问卡莉丝军队能否帮忙
rows.raw: ", or you could just ask Calise if the army can help"

rows.original: Calise is currently gathering info from her men.
rows.translation: 卡莉丝目前正在收集她手下的信息。
rows.raw: "Calise is currently gathering info from her men."

rows.original: Calise's men must have found something by now. Return to her to see what she's learned.
rows.translation: 卡莉丝的手下应该已经找到了一些线索了。回去告诉她，看看她掌握了什么信息。
rows.raw: "Calise's men must have found something by now. Return to her to see what she's learned."

rows.original: Calise pointed towards the abandoned crossroads in the western tunnels of the Undermountain.
rows.translation: 卡莉丝指向了地下山脉西部隧道中那条被废弃的十字路口。
rows.raw: "Calise pointed towards the abandoned crossroads in the western tunnels of the Undermountain."

rows.original: You dispelled Tollus's illusion and Ahmri is currently at the [flags.DEMON_AHMRI_WF|wayfort|village].
rows.translation: 你驱散了托勒斯的幻象，阿赫米目前在[flags.DEMON_AHMRI_WF|驿堡|村子]里。
rows.raw: "You dispelled Tollus's illusion and Ahmri is currently at the [flags.DEMON_AHMRI_WF|wayfort|village]."

rows.original: Find the Yvennese paladin in Hawkethorne. [evelyn.dragon|The Frost Hound seems like a good place to start.|Maybe Garth will know where she's been.]
rows.translation: 在鹰棘镇找到那位伊文尼斯圣骑士。 [evelyn.dragon|霜冻猎犬”似乎是个不错的起点。|也许加斯会知道她去过了哪里。]
rows.raw: "Find the Yvennese paladin in Hawkethorne. [evelyn.dragon|The Frost Hound seems like a good place to start.|Maybe Garth will know where she's been.]"

rows.original: The situation involving the Yvennese paladin has been handled. Alice will be in the Frost Hound.
rows.translation: 涉及耶文恩圣骑士的那件事已经得到了处理。爱丽丝将会加入霜犬酒馆队。
rows.raw: "The situation involving the Yvennese paladin has been handled. Alice will be in the Frost Hound."

rows.translation: 大公牛，小衣橱

rows.original: There's something clearly troubling Foreman Odoacer. Maybe [flags.NIKOL_MET|Nikol has an idea|there's that Nikol guy he mentioned]. You bet he's helped beginners through their first times, and it could come in handy when pulling a bull out of the closet.
rows.translation: 显然，有些事情让奥多亚塞尔警长感到非常困扰。也许吧[flags.NIKOL_MET|尼科尔有个主意。|就是他提到的那个叫尼科尔的人。]他肯定帮助过新手们度过他们的初次尝试，而在遇到一些棘手的问题时，这些经验也会派上大用场。
rows.raw: "There's something clearly troubling Foreman Odoacer. Maybe [flags.NIKOL_MET|Nikol has an idea|there's that Nikol guy he mentioned]. You bet he's helped beginners through their first times, and it could come in handy when pulling a bull out of the closet."

rows.original: Let's try Nikol's idea. Get Odoacer into the bedroom and force the foreman out of him.
rows.translation: 让我们试试尼科尔的想法。把奥多亚塞弄进卧室，然后把那个工头从他体内赶出来。
rows.raw: "Let's try Nikol's idea. Get Odoacer into the bedroom and force the foreman out of him."

rows.original: You made some progress, but you could use the help of a professional: Nikol. You better have the money for his service.
rows.translation: 你确实取得了一些进展，但最好能得到专业人士尼科尔的帮助。你得准备好支付他的服务费用才行。
rows.raw: "You made some progress, but you could use the help of a professional: Nikol. You better have the money for his service."

rows.original: Odo is growing less embarrassed about his preferences. Maybe it's time to push him even further by doing it in the open? Nothing says 'the boss' like getting fucked in the middle of your camp.
rows.translation: 奥多越来越不再为自己的这些偏好感到难为情了。或许现在是时候公开地这么做，进一步推动他做出改变了？没有什么比在你的营地正中央被人干掉更能体现“老板”的威严了。
rows.raw: "Odo is growing less embarrassed about his preferences. Maybe it's time to push him even further by doing it in the open? Nothing says 'the boss' like getting fucked in the middle of your camp."

rows.original: The secret is out, and Odo couldn't be happier. It's time for the rest of the camp to meet the new and improved foreman!
rows.translation: 秘密已经公开了，奥多开心极了。是时候让营地里其他的人来认识这位经过改进、变得更出色的工头了！
rows.raw: "The secret is out, and Odo couldn't be happier. It's time for the rest of the camp to meet the new and improved foreman!"

rows.original: You pulled Odo the foreman out of the closet. You can now return to his camp and see how he and his crew are getting along. They might even put on a show for you!
rows.translation: 你把工头奥多从“隐居状态”中带了出来。现在你可以回到他的营地，看看他和他的团队过得怎么样。他们甚至可能会为你表演一场节目呢！
rows.raw: "You pulled Odo the foreman out of the closet. You can now return to his camp and see how he and his crew are getting along. They might even put on a show for you!"

rows.translation: 魔法恶作剧

rows.original:
Viv has asked you to take her to Khor'minos to make a couple of orders for a %"project" of hers. 

            Marilla:
rows.translation:
薇芙请你带她前往科尔米诺斯，为她的某个“项目”下几份订单。

            玛丽拉：
rows.raw:
'
            Viv has asked you to take her to Khor'minos to make a couple of orders for a %"project" of hers. 

            Marilla: '

rows.translation: 维特鲁维乌斯：

rows.original: Now that Viv's got everything she needs, you should check in on your witchy companion at the Frost Hound.
rows.translation: 既然薇芙已经得到了她所需的一切，你应该去“霜犬酒馆”那里看看你的那位女巫伙伴了。
rows.raw: "\n            Now that Viv's got everything she needs, you should check in on your witchy companion at the Frost Hound."

rows.original: Viviane's picked up the garb and skillset she's needed to become capable of mixing stealth, shadow magic, and her typical enchantment spells to great effect in combat.
rows.translation: 薇薇安掌握了那些必要的技能与装备，这使得她能够在战斗中巧妙地将隐身技巧、暗影魔法以及她常用的法术结合起来，从而取得出色的战斗效果。
rows.raw: "\n            Viviane's picked up the garb and skillset she's needed to become capable of mixing stealth, shadow magic, and her typical enchantment spells to great effect in combat."

rows.translation: 尚未拜访
尚未拜访
纳什遗失的货物

rows.original: Nash's delivery has gone missing somewhere in Undermountain and he's asked you to investigate.
rows.translation: 纳什的包裹在山腹深域的某个地方失踪了，他请你去调查这件事。
rows.raw: "Nash's delivery has gone missing somewhere in Undermountain and he's asked you to investigate."

rows.original: You've found and retrieved the goods from the imp band that had taken them and the lust-addled delivery driver. Now to return them to Nash.
rows.translation: 你已经找到了那些被抢走的货物，并从那些抢走它们的盗贼以及那个贪得无厌的送货司机手中把货物夺了回来。现在，你需要把它们归还给纳什。
rows.raw: "You've found and retrieved the goods from the imp band that had taken them and the lust-addled delivery driver. Now to return them to Nash."

rows.original: The delivery of tainted alcohol has been returned to Nash, and you've been given quite the offer.
rows.translation: 那些被污染的酒精已经退回给了纳什，而你也得到了一份相当不错的提议。
rows.raw: "The delivery of tainted alcohol has been returned to Nash, and you've been given quite the offer."

rows.translation: 科尔米诺斯的危机

rows.original: According to Garth and Sanders, there's been rising trouble in the eastern Marches. The Kingdom of Khor'minos lies in that direction: through the Foothills and the Undermountain roads. You should investigate the state of the city.
rows.translation: 根据加斯和桑德斯的说法，东部边境地区的局势日益紧张。科尔米诺斯王国就位于那个方向：需要穿过山麓以及地下山脉的道路才能到达那里。你应该去调查一下那座城市的现状。
rows.raw: "\n                According to Garth and Sanders, there's been rising trouble in the eastern Marches. The Kingdom of Khor'minos lies in that direction: through the Foothills and the Undermountain roads. You should investigate the state of the city."

rows.original: Something's definitely amiss in the Undermountain! You've met Calise, the Champion of Velun, alongside a group of heavy infantry from the kingdom fighting hordes of imps. If things are this bad, you need to get to the city as quickly as you can. It should be in the far north-east of the Undermountain.
rows.translation: 在山腹深域里，肯定出了什么问题！你已经遇到了维伦的冠军卡莉丝，还有来自王国的重装步兵们，他们正在与成群的邪魔战斗。如果情况真的这么糟糕，你就必须尽快赶到那座城市。它应该位于山腹深域的极东北方向。
rows.raw: "\n                Something's definitely amiss in the Undermountain! You've met Calise, the Champion of Velun, alongside a group of heavy infantry from the kingdom fighting hordes of imps. If things are this bad, you need to get to the city as quickly as you can. It should be in the far north-east of the Undermountain."

rows.original: You've gotten entrance to the city of Khor'minos, heart of the kingdom, and earned the trust of Calise. The two of you working together could be a bulwark against the demonic menace, and the best chance to end of the Siege of Khor'minos...
rows.translation: 你已成功进入这座王国的中心城市——科尔米诺斯，并赢得了卡莉丝的信任。你们两人携手合作，必将成为抵御恶魔威胁的坚强屏障，也是结束科尔米诺斯之围的最佳希望……
rows.raw: "\n                You've gotten entrance to the city of Khor'minos, heart of the kingdom, and earned the trust of Calise. The two of you working together could be a bulwark against the demonic menace, and the best chance to end of the Siege of Khor'minos..."

rows.original: At the Edge of the World
rows.translation: 世界边缘

rows.original: You have heard of rising cult activity on the eastern coast of the continent, a region benighted by the lingering trauma of the Godswar. Tollus may be looking for some forgotten power out there that will finally allow him to realize ambitions — he can't be allowed to succeed. You must travel to the coastlands and find evidence of the cult's plans. The tunnels leading to the coast are in the east side of Khor'minos, near the arena. Where the cult can be found, though, is anyone's guess. This is as far as this quest progresses for now.
rows.translation: 你肯定听说过，这片大陆的东海岸上，邪教活动日益猖獗。那个地区至今仍深受“神战”留下的创伤影响。托勒斯或许正在寻找某种被遗忘的力量，这种力量最终能够帮助他实现自己的野心——但我们绝不能让他得逞。 你必须前往那些海岸地区，寻找邪教阴谋的证据。通往海岸的隧道位于科尔米诺斯的东侧，靠近竞技场。不过，邪教到底藏身在哪里，目前还无人知晓。 目前，这个任务就进展到这个阶段了。
rows.raw: "You have heard of rising cult activity on the eastern coast of the continent, a region benighted by the lingering trauma of the Godswar. Tollus may be looking for some forgotten power out there that will finally allow him to realize ambitions — he can't be allowed to succeed. You must travel to the coastlands and find evidence of the cult's plans. The tunnels leading to the coast are in the east side of Khor'minos, near the arena. Where the cult can be found, though, is anyone's guess. This is as far as this quest progresses for now."

rows.translation: 还牛以角

rows.original:
Though the sweet northern minotaur couple wanted you as their bull, you think Kesuk could become one himself. While they told you the boy was too resistant to regular alchemical concoctions, and that they only wanted to grow his dick at most, you're sure you can find a solution. All you need is three bottles of a transformative from a race known to be expert at transforming others, maybe one that could give him more... confidence, and infuse it to focus on his cock.
            
            <b>
rows.translation:
虽然那对来自北方、性格温顺的“弥诺陶洛斯夫妇”希望你能成为他们的“公牛”，但你认为凯苏克自己完全有可能成为那个“公牛”。虽然他们说过这个男孩对普通的炼金药剂反应不佳，他们最多也只是想让他的阴茎变大一些，但你相信自己一定能找到解决办法。你所需要的，只是三瓶由那些以改变他人外貌而闻名的种族制造的药剂——也许这种药剂能让凯苏克更有自信，从而帮助他实现自己的愿望。
            
            <b>
rows.raw:
"
            Though the sweet northern minotaur couple wanted you as their bull, you think Kesuk could become one himself. While they told you the boy was too resistant to regular alchemical concoctions, and that they only wanted to grow his dick at most, you're sure you can find a solution. All you need is three bottles of a transformative from a race known to be expert at transforming others, maybe one that could give him more... confidence, and infuse it to focus on his cock.
            
            <b>"

rows.translation: 肿胀蘑菇浸泡的魅魔精液：

rows.original: You've delivered the Turgid-Mushroom Infused Incubus Cum to Kesuk, and given him a horn to be confident in.
rows.translation: 你已经将那种注入了苔藓蘑菇香气的魅魔之液送给了凯苏克，并且还给了他一根角，让他能够更加自信。
rows.raw: "You've delivered the Turgid-Mushroom Infused Incubus Cum to Kesuk, and given him a horn to be confident in."

rows.original:
Sanders needs your help to heal the gnoll spellblade. To do so, he needs you to brew [silly|some Claritea|a potion of clarity]. You need to gather its ingredients across the Marches.
            
            <b>
rows.translation:
桑德斯需要你帮忙治疗那位豺狼人魔剑士。为此，他需要你调制[silly|一些清灵茶|一剂清醒药水]。你得去边疆各处收集原料。
            
            <b>
rows.raw:
"
            Sanders needs your help to heal the gnoll spellblade. To do so, he needs you to brew [silly|some Claritea|a potion of clarity]. You need to gather its ingredients across the Marches.
            
            <b>"

rows.translation: 狐莓：
霜叶：
奶茶：

rows.original: You have all the ingredients for the [silly|Claritea|potion of clarity]. Bring them to Ivris.
rows.translation: 你已集齐[silly|清灵茶|清醒药水]所需的全部原料，把它们带给艾薇莉丝吧。
rows.raw: "\n            You have all the ingredients for the [silly|Claritea|potion of clarity]. Bring them to Ivris."

rows.original: The [silly|Claritea|potion of clarity] is ready. Bring it back to Sanders.
rows.translation: 那个[silly|清灵茶|清醒药剂]准备好了。把它还给桑德斯吧。
rows.raw: "\n            The [silly|Claritea|potion of clarity] is ready. Bring it back to Sanders."

rows.original: You prepared the [silly|Claritea|potion of clarity] for Kira. Thanks to your help, Sanders snapped Kira out of her torpor. However, the daemonic taint still runs in her veins. She'll stay in Hawkethorne to heal her mind and body.
rows.translation: 你给基拉准备好了[silly|清灵茶|清醒药剂]。多亏了你的帮助，桑德斯才让基拉从那种恍惚状态中清醒过来。然而，那种恶魔的污秽依然流淌在她的血液之中。她将留在鹰棘镇，以治愈身心。
rows.raw: "\n            You prepared the [silly|Claritea|potion of clarity] for Kira. Thanks to your help, Sanders snapped Kira out of her torpor. However, the daemonic taint still runs in her veins. She'll stay in Hawkethorne to heal her mind and body."

rows.translation: 维伦的女儿们

rows.original: Having talked with Calise, you've taken an interest in finding out if Velun wants his Champion back, even after all she's done. Finding an older dryad in the Old Forest would be a good first step. This is as far as this quest progresses for now.
rows.translation: 在与卡莉丝交谈之后，你开始想要弄清楚：尽管维伦做了那么多事，他是否仍然希望自己的冠军能够回来。在古老的森林里寻找一位年长的干树精，或许会是第一步好的尝试。 目前，这个任务就进展到这个阶段了。。
rows.raw: "Having talked with Calise, you've taken an interest in finding out if Velun wants his Champion back, even after all she's done. Finding an older dryad in the Old Forest would be a good first step.\n\n This is as far as this quest progresses for now."

rows.original: There's a cargo lift connecting the top and bottom of the cliffs that mark the eastern edge of the kingdom. Unfortunately, it seems to be out of commission. Maybe there's someone you could talk to back in the villa?
rows.translation: 在标志着王国东边的那些悬崖上，有一部货梯连接着悬崖的顶部和下装。可惜，它似乎已经无法使用了。或许你可以去别墅里找个人聊聊？
rows.raw: "There's a cargo lift connecting the top and bottom of the cliffs that mark the eastern edge of the kingdom. Unfortunately, it seems to be out of commission. Maybe there's someone you could talk to back in the villa?"

rows.original: The lift's operator is willing to come back to work, now that the area's no longer under constant siege by demons, but says that the ropes connected to the bottom of the lift have been damaged, and the animals are missing.
rows.translation: 既然该地区不再受到恶魔的持续侵袭，电梯的操作员也愿意回来工作了，但他表示，连接电梯下装的绳索已经损坏，而且那些动物也失踪了。
rows.raw: "The lift's operator is willing to come back to work, now that the area's no longer under constant siege by demons, but says that the ropes connected to the bottom of the lift have been damaged, and the animals are missing."

rows.original: You've found some heavy-duty rope to repair the lift! Now you just need to find the animals to pull them...
rows.translation: 你找到了一些结实的绳子来修理升降机了！现在只需要找到那些能够拉动这些绳子的动物就可以了……
rows.raw: "You've found some heavy-duty rope to repair the lift! Now you just need to find the animals to pull them..."

rows.original: You've located the herd of working goats that should be hitched to the lift. Now you just need to find some heavy-duty rope to hook the wheel and lift together.
rows.translation: 你已经找到了那些应该被套上升降装置的役用山羊。现在你只需要找一些结实的绳子，把轮子固定起来，然后一起把它们抬上去就可以了。
rows.raw: "You've located the herd of working goats that should be hitched to the lift. Now you just need to find some heavy-duty rope to hook the wheel and lift together."

rows.original: You have both heavy ship's rope and pack animals, and now just need to go to the lower control house for the lift to put it all together.
rows.translation: 你既有结实的船用绳索，也有驮运动物，现在只需要前往下方的控制室，利用升降设备将所有这些东西组装起来就可以了。
rows.raw: "You have both heavy ship's rope and pack animals, and now just need to go to the lower control house for the lift to put it all together."

rows.original: You've repaired the lift between Khor'minos and Khor'elthos, allowing you easy traversal between the top and bottom of the cliffs. What meager trade still remains along the coast is in your debt.
rows.translation: 你已经修复了科尔米诺斯与霍尔埃尔托斯之间的通道，因此现在可以轻松地在悬崖的上下两侧之间往来。沿岸那些稀少的贸易活动，其实都欠着你的人情债。
rows.raw: "You've repaired the lift between Khor'minos and Khor'elthos, allowing you easy traversal between the top and bottom of the cliffs. What meager trade still remains along the coast is in your debt."

rows.translation: 公主的困境

rows.original: You've received a missive from the Principality of Tychris, located several days west of Hawkethorne, inviting you to the palace. There will be a coach waiting for you at the Caravanserai in northwestern Harvest Valley.
rows.translation: 你收到了来自位于鹰棘镇以西数日路程处的蒂克里斯公国的邀请函，邀请你前往他们的宫殿。在丰收谷西北部的商队旅馆，会有一辆马车在等待你。
rows.raw: "You've received a missive from the Principality of Tychris, located several days west of Hawkethorne, inviting you to the palace. There will be a coach waiting for you at the Caravanserai in northwestern Harvest Valley."

rows.original: Arriving in Tychris, you were met by a strange proposition from the royal family — a desperate plea to help control their cursed daughter without ruining her for marriage.
rows.translation: 当你抵达提克里斯时，王室向你提出了一个奇怪的请求——他们迫切希望你能帮助他们控制那个被诅咒的女儿，同时又不能破坏她未来的婚姻。
rows.raw: "Arriving in Tychris, you were met by a strange proposition from the royal family — a desperate plea to help control their cursed daughter without ruining her for marriage."

rows.original: You chose not to indulge to royal family's requests. In desperation, they have turned to Magister Vasko's solution for their daughter's plight.
rows.translation: 你选择不满足王室的请求。在绝望之中，他们只好求助于瓦斯科大师提出的解决方案，来帮助他们的女儿摆脱困境。
rows.raw: "You chose not to indulge to royal family's requests. In desperation, they have turned to Magister Vasko's solution for their daughter's plight."

rows.original: You managed to calm Princess Kythie down long enough to at least hold a conversation. It's a step in the right direction — real progress! Now to find out who caused this curse.
rows.translation: 你成功让凯西公主平静下来，至少让我们能够进行对话。这是朝着正确方向迈出的一步——真正的进展！现在，我们要找出是谁引发了这个诅咒。
rows.raw: "You managed to calm Princess Kythie down long enough to at least hold a conversation. It's a step in the right direction — real progress! Now to find out who caused this curse."

rows.original: You betrayed the royal family's trust and vaginally penetrated Princess Kythie. You're no longer welcome in the royal palace...
rows.translation: 你辜负了王室的信任，还与凯西公主发生了关系。你再也不被允许进入皇宫了……
rows.raw: "You betrayed the royal family's trust and vaginally penetrated Princess Kythie. You're no longer welcome in the royal palace..."

rows.original: Piecing together the puzzle of Tychris Palace, you've come to realize Kythie's curse is coming from something, or someone, within the palace. You just need to figure out who...
rows.translation: 拼凑提克里斯宫殿的谜团时，你逐渐意识到，凯西的诅咒源于宫殿中的某样东西，或是某个人。你只需查明是谁……
rows.raw: "Piecing together the puzzle of Tychris Palace, you've come to realize Kythie's curse is coming from something, or someone, within the palace. You just need to figure out who..."

rows.original: You found an odd receipt of goods from Magister Vasko's office, something to do with a grail found in an old temple down in southern Harvest Valley. Might be worth looking into?
rows.translation: 你在瓦斯科大师的办公室里发现了一张奇怪的货物收据，上面似乎与在收获谷南部的一座古老寺庙中发现的圣杯有关。或许值得深入调查一下？
rows.raw: "You found an odd receipt of goods from Magister Vasko's office, something to do with a grail found in an old temple down in southern Harvest Valley. Might be worth looking into?"

rows.original: You sipped something brewing in Vasko's lab and found yourself put into heat by it! What kind of madness is he cooking up in there, and why?
rows.translation: 你喝下了瓦斯科实验室里调制的一种饮料，结果立刻感到身体开始发热！他到底在实验室里搞什么名堂，又是出于什么目的呢？
rows.raw: "You sipped something brewing in Vasko's lab and found yourself put into heat by it! What kind of madness is he cooking up in there, and why?"

rows.original: You fingered Magister Vasko as the culprit, which triggered an all-out confrontation in his library. He's been neutralized now, and the royal family are very grateful.
rows.translation: 你指认魔导师瓦斯科是罪魁祸首，并因此在他的图书馆里引发了一场全面冲突。如今他已被制服，王室对此万分感激。
rows.raw: "You fingered Magister Vasko as the culprit, which triggered an all-out confrontation in his library. He's been neutralized now, and the royal family are very grateful."

rows.original: You fingered Magister Vasko as the culprit but heard him out and decided to help him. You've convinced Lady Tethys that there's no hope but to give her daughter to the heir of Maidenbridge, Lord Theodane, sabotaging Tychris for generations to come.
rows.translation: 你指认魔导师瓦斯科是罪魁祸首，但听完他的解释后决定帮助他。你说服了泰西斯王妃，让她相信除了把女儿嫁给梅登布里奇的继承人西奥丹领主外别无选择，这将让提克里斯在未来数代都深受其害。
rows.raw: "You fingered Magister Vasko as the culprit but heard him out and decided to help him. You've convinced Lady Tethys that there's no hope but to give her daughter to the heir of Maidenbridge, Lord Theodane, sabotaging Tychris for generations to come."

rows.original: You REALLY fucked up with Tethys, making her think you — a commoner — were trying to manipulate her into letting you marry her daughter. You've been banished from the palace; the crown will have to find a way to help her without you.
rows.translation: 你把与泰西斯的关系彻底搞砸了，让她以为你这个平民企图操纵她，好让她同意你迎娶自己的女儿。你已被逐出宫殿；王室只能在没有你的情况下另寻办法帮助公主。
rows.raw: "You REALLY fucked up with Tethys, making her think you — a commoner — were trying to manipulate her into letting you marry her daughter. You've been banished from the palace; the crown will have to find a way to help her without you."

rows.original: You fingered Magister Vasko as the culprit but heard him out and decided to side with him against the royal family. You tricked Tethys into letting you take Kythie's hand, ruining the principality's political alliance with Felurze.
rows.translation: 你指认魔导师瓦斯科是罪魁祸首，但听完他的解释后决定与他联手对抗王室。你哄骗泰西斯答应让你迎娶凯西，破坏了这个公国与费卢尔泽之间的政治联盟。
rows.raw: "You fingered Magister Vasko as the culprit but heard him out and decided to side with him against the royal family. You tricked Tethys into letting you take Kythie's hand, ruining the principality's political alliance with Felurze."

rows.original: You accused Count Thore of Maidenbridge as being behind the cursing. Tethys has set a scheme in motion to take revenge, while Magister Vasko's mysteriously disappeared. Still, though, the princess should be safe now at least, and the royal family is in your debt.
rows.translation: 你指控梅登布里奇的托雷伯爵是诅咒事件的幕后黑手。泰西斯已经布下复仇之局，而魔导师瓦斯科则神秘失踪了。不过，至少公主现在应该安全了，王室也欠了你一份人情。
rows.raw: "You accused Count Thore of Maidenbridge as being behind the cursing. Tethys has set a scheme in motion to take revenge, while Magister Vasko's mysteriously disappeared. Still, though, the princess should be safe now at least, and the royal family is in your debt."

rows.translation: 不育症疗法

rows.original: Lusamine is sterile and has tried a great many number of things to fix it, without success. Maybe someone you know can lend a hand?
rows.translation: 露萨敏已经尝试了很多方法来解决这个问题，但都没有成功。也许你认识的人中有人能够帮忙吧？
rows.raw: "Lusamine is sterile and has tried a great many number of things to fix it, without success. Maybe someone you know can lend a hand?"

rows.original: You went to Lumia for assistance. Armed with a charm blessed by the Goddess of Fertility herself, if this doesn't work, you aren't sure what else will.
rows.translation: 你去找卢米娅寻求帮助了。手中握着一位生育女神亲自赐予的护身符，如果这个方法都不起作用，那就真的不知道还有什么办法能用了。
rows.raw: "You went to Lumia for assistance. Armed with a charm blessed by the Goddess of Fertility herself, if this doesn't work, you aren't sure what else will."

rows.original: You went to Hretha for assistance. After a couple hours, she returned to you with some foul smelling concoction. You don't know if it'll work, but it won't hurt to try.
rows.translation: 你去找赫蕾莎寻求帮助。几个小时后，她回来给了你一种散发着恶臭的混合物。你不知道这东西是否有效，但试试总没有坏处。
rows.raw: "You went to Hretha for assistance. After a couple hours, she returned to you with some foul smelling concoction. You don't know if it'll work, but it won't hurt to try."

rows.original: You gave Lusamine the cure. Only time will tell if it worked.
rows.translation: 你给了露萨敏治愈方法。只有时间才能证明这种方法是否有效。
rows.raw: "You gave Lusamine the cure. Only time will tell if it worked."

rows.original: You told Lusamine about Evergreen. For better or for worse, she'll have her cure.
rows.translation: 你把关于常青女士的事告诉了露萨敏。无论结果如何，她最终都会找到治愈方法。
rows.raw: "You told Lusamine about Evergreen. For better or for worse, she'll have her cure."

rows.original: The illustrious harlot-slash-professional thief, Jessie, has invited you to join her on a heist. Now that you've accepted, you can go and make your preparations, gather any belongings you might need, and return to her at Vitra's Bar when you're ready.
rows.raw: "The illustrious harlot-slash-professional thief, Jessie, has invited you to join her on a heist. Now that you've accepted, you can go and make your preparations, gather any belongings you might need, and return to her at Vitra's Bar when you're ready."

rows.original: You've entered the party; it appears that the majority of the guests are in disguise, although Jessie has joined as your 'Plus One' arm-candy. In order to steal this giant art-piece, you're going to need to prepare the floor.<ul>
rows.translation: 你已经进入宴会；大多数宾客似乎都乔装打扮过，而杰西则作为你的“随行伴侣”，挽着你的手臂一同入场。想偷走这件巨大的艺术品，你们必须先在现场做好准备。<ul>
rows.raw: "You've entered the party; it appears that the majority of the guests are in disguise, although Jessie has joined as your 'Plus One' arm-candy. In order to steal this giant art-piece, you're going to need to prepare the floor.<ul>"

rows.original: It's time to begin the plan; get out of the ballroom, and into the rest of the manor.
rows.translation: 是时候开始执行计划了；离开舞厅，进入庄园的其他区域。
rows.raw: "It's time to begin the plan; get out of the ballroom, and into the rest of the manor."

rows.original: A bunch of city guards have broken in after reports of drunk and disorderly conduct, throwing your plans into disarray.
rows.translation: 有人举报这里醉酒闹事，一群城市卫兵已经破门而入，彻底打乱了你们的计划。
rows.raw: "A bunch of city guards have broken in after reports of drunk and disorderly conduct, throwing your plans into disarray."

rows.original: Jessie's insider was a bust, and they're trying to squeeze you for money. Now you have to fix things before your actions start a riot.
rows.translation: 杰西的内应根本靠不住，对方还想敲你们一笔钱。现在必须在自己的行动引发暴乱之前把事情处理好。
rows.raw: "Jessie's insider was a bust, and they're trying to squeeze you for money. Now you have to fix things before your actions start a riot."

rows.original: With the house guard locked out of the armory, you're free to finish the heist, but it's going to be a close one.
rows.translation: 宅邸守卫被关在军械库外，你们终于可以完成这场劫案了，不过时间已经十分紧迫。
rows.raw: "With the house guard locked out of the armory, you're free to finish the heist, but it's going to be a close one."

rows.original: You're done, and out! Home stretch...
rows.translation: 事情办完，你们也逃出来了！只差最后一段路……
任务完成，你和杰西

rows.original: have stolen the artwork and dropped it off to the client
rows.raw: "have stolen the artwork and dropped it off to the client"

rows.original: had to destroy the artwork in the end, but you've kept your lives and some of the pay
rows.translation: 最终不得不毁掉艺术品，但你们保住了性命，也拿到了一部分报酬
rows.raw: "had to destroy the artwork in the end, but you've kept your lives and some of the pay"

rows.original: Livrea has agreed to throw up a great big dancing number when you're ready to make your move.
rows.raw: "Livrea has agreed to throw up a great big dancing number when you're ready to make your move."

rows.original: Livrea, the minotaur-bard is here at the party.
rows.translation: 弥诺陶洛斯吟游诗人莉维娅正在参加宴会。
rows.raw: "Livrea, the minotaur-bard is here at the party."

rows.original: You have gotten the foreign countess very drunk, and pointed her towards the captain of the guard.
rows.raw: "You have gotten the foreign countess very drunk, and pointed her towards the captain of the guard."

rows.original: There's a foreign countess making eyes at the captain of the guard.
rows.translation: 一位异国女伯爵正含情脉脉地盯着卫队长。
rows.raw: "There's a foreign countess making eyes at the captain of the guard."

rows.original: You have met the host of the party, and been invited to her room at the afterparty, so long as you bring that salacious salamander along and don't mind her husband's honking big bull-dick.
rows.raw: "You have met the host of the party, and been invited to her room at the afterparty, so long as you bring that salacious salamander along and don't mind her husband's honking big bull-dick."

rows.original: You've met the host of the party, but it looks like diplomacy has failed you... there are quite a few more unwelcome eyes on the two of you now.
rows.raw: "You've met the host of the party, but it looks like diplomacy has failed you... there are quite a few more unwelcome eyes on the two of you now."

rows.original: Perhaps it's worth meeting the host of this party.
rows.translation: 也许值得去见见这场宴会的主人。
rows.raw: "Perhaps it's worth meeting the host of this party."

rows.original: You've learned the art piece will be wheeled out; it's going to be obscured by a huge curtain, which is perfect.
rows.raw: "You've learned the art piece will be wheeled out; it's going to be obscured by a huge curtain, which is perfect."

rows.original: You have no idea where the heist's target even is, yet.
rows.translation: 你甚至还不知道这场劫案的目标究竟在哪里。
rows.raw: "You have no idea where the heist's target even is, yet."

rows.original: There is nothing more you think you could do...
rows.translation: 你觉得已经没有别的事可做了……
rows.raw: "There is nothing more you think you could do..."

rows.original: There’s been reports of possible food spoilage at the Wayfort. Before examining anything else, eliminate the most obvious possibility by talking to Renia.
rows.translation: 据报告，驿堡的食物可能正在变质。在检查其他原因之前，先与雷妮亚交谈，排除最显而易见的可能性。
rows.raw: "There’s been reports of possible food spoilage at the Wayfort. Before examining anything else, eliminate the most obvious possibility by talking to Renia."

rows.original: Renia tampered with the guards' food, and clearly doesn't regret it. You'll have to decide how to handle the situation going forward.
rows.translation: 雷妮亚在守卫的食物里动了手脚，而且显然毫无悔意。你必须决定今后该如何处理此事。
rows.raw: "Renia tampered with the guards' food, and clearly doesn't regret it. You'll have to decide how to handle the situation going forward."

rows.original: You’ve prevented the succubi mixture from being applied to the elven soldiers in your fort, and ensured any further experiments of Renia’s will be run with your knowledge.
rows.translation: 你阻止了魅魔混合物被加入堡垒中精灵士兵的食物，也确保雷妮亚今后的任何实验都会在你知情的情况下进行。
rows.raw: "You’ve prevented the succubi mixture from being applied to the elven soldiers in your fort, and ensured any further experiments of Renia’s will be run with your knowledge."

rows.original: You decided Renia's additions to the food should continue, and your elven soldiers are getting curvier by the day. You told her not to add the dickgirl formula to the mix.
rows.translation: 你决定允许雷妮亚继续往食物里添加东西；你的精灵士兵一天比一天更加丰腴。你吩咐她不要把扶她配方加入混合物。
rows.raw: "You decided Renia's additions to the food should continue, and your elven soldiers are getting curvier by the day. You told her not to add the dickgirl formula to the mix."

rows.original: You decided Renia's additions to the food should continue, as well as adding the dickgirl formula to the mix. Your elven soldiers are getting curvier and hornier by the day.
rows.translation: 你决定允许雷妮亚继续往食物里添加东西，并把扶她配方也加入混合物。你的精灵士兵一天比一天更加丰腴、更加欲火焚身。
rows.raw: "You decided Renia's additions to the food should continue, as well as adding the dickgirl formula to the mix. Your elven soldiers are getting curvier and hornier by the day."

rows.original: "When your body's half-covered in armored scales, and you've got a tail that slaps as hard as a warhammer, what else are you going to become but a warrior? Apparently, 'manders decided on brilliant scholars and craftsmen... but fearsome warriors, too. Plenty of them to go around."
rows.translation: 当你的身体被坚硬的鳞甲覆盖，还拥有一条能像战锤一样用力挥击的尾巴时，你还能变成什么别的角色呢？显然，‘统治者们’需要的不仅是杰出的学者和工匠……也需要强大的战士。而且这样的战士，他们需要大量的。
rows.raw: "\n        \"When your body's half-covered in armored scales, and you've got a tail that slaps as hard as a warhammer, what else are you going to become but a warrior? Apparently, 'manders decided on brilliant scholars and craftsmen... but fearsome warriors, too. Plenty of them to go around.\"\n        "

rows.original: —Albus Zethra Name: Salamander (pl. Salamanders) Sexes: Male and Female Height: Ranges from between 6' and 7', with males standing slightly taller than females. Weight: Roughly 30% heavier than a human of the same height. Skin: Salamanders have human skin over most of their bodies, with tones ranging from pale to bronze or black depending on region. All salamanders additionally have hard, leathery scales completely encasing their forelimbs and tails, always of blue or red coloration; some individual salamanders may have additional scales, manifesting in freckle-like patterns over the cheeks, shoulders, and chest. Hair: Much as humans. Salamanders usually have red or blue hair, though some shades of gray or brown are not unheard of. Eyes: Salamanders have large, reptilian eyes, typically with golden irises and black slits. Orange, red, green, and blue eyes are uncommon but not unheard of. Ears: Frilled, reptilian ears are universal. Lifespan: About 80 years. Maturity: 18 years.
rows.translation: —阿尔布斯·泽特拉 名称：火蜥蜴（复数：火蜥蜴们） 性别：男性和女性 高度：身高在6英尺到7英尺之间，雄性个头通常比雌性稍高一些。 重量：其重量大约是同身高人类的30%。 皮肤：火蜥蜴的身体大部分覆盖着类似人类的皮肤，其颜色会根据所处地区的不同而从淡色到青铜色或黑色不等。所有火蜥蜴的前肢和尾巴都覆盖着坚硬的革质鳞片，这些鳞片始终呈蓝色或红色；某些个体火蜥蜴的身体上还会长出额外的鳞片，这些鳞片会在脸颊、肩膀和胸部形成类似雀斑的图案。 头发：和人类一样，蝾螈的体色通常为红色或蓝色，不过偶尔也会出现灰色或棕色的个体。 眼睛：火蜥蜴拥有较大的爬行动物式眼睛，通常虹膜为金色，瞳孔呈黑色狭长形状。橙色、红色、绿色或蓝色的眼睛虽然较为罕见，但也确实存在。 耳朵：带有褶边的、类似爬行动物的耳朵是所有生物共有的特征。 使用寿命：大约80年。 到期日： 18年。

rows.original:
Salamanders are tall and athletically-built hybrids, straddling the difference between men and dragons — so much so that many scholars have long theorized that salamanders were created by dragons, or were once the product of dragons mating with humans. Either way, the result is the same: the race bears thickly-scaled armored limbs and a powerful tail capped with either roiling flame or a veil of aurora light.

        There are two great clans of salamanders, called the Cinderscale and Frostscale. Salamanders of the Cinderscale tribe have flame-red scales, burning tails, and typically have darker skin. They make their home in the southlands and as far east as Jassira. In the north, including the Frost Marches, the Frostscale tribe has dominance. These salamanders tend to be pale-skinned, with blue scales and a strange, cold veil of multi-colored light that wraps around their tails. 
        
        Typically, salamanders are muscular and broad of build. Females have large hips and stretchy sexes, speaking to their egg-laying ancestry; males typically have large, ribbed reptilian phalluses of the same color as their scales.
rows.translation:
火蜥蜴是一种身材高大、体格健壮的混合生物，它们处于人类与龙之间的中间状态。因此，许多学者长期以来一直推测，火蜥蜴要么是由龙创造出来的，要么就是龙与人类交配后产生的后代。无论如何，结果都是一样的：这种生物拥有覆盖着厚厚鳞片的装甲状四肢，以及一条强有力的尾巴，尾巴的末端要么喷射着熊熊火焰，要么散发着绚丽的极光光芒。

        蝾螈一共有两个强大的氏族，分别被称为“灰鳞氏族”和“霜鳞氏族”。炭鳞族的火蜥蜴拥有火焰红色的鳞片、会燃烧的尾巴，皮肤颜色通常也比较深。它们栖息在南部地区，最东边甚至延伸到贾西拉。而在北部，包括霜冻边境地区，则是由霜鳞族占据主导地位的。这些蝾螈通常拥有浅色的皮肤，身上覆盖着蓝色的鳞片，它们的尾巴上还环绕着一层由多种颜色光线构成的、看起来十分奇异且冰冷的光环。
        
        一般来说，蝾螈的身体结构较为粗壮，肌肉发达。雌性蝾螈的臀部较大，生殖器官也具有较好的弹性，这一特征反映了它们以产卵为繁殖方式的习性；而雄性蝾螈的生殖器官则较大，表面有肋状突起，其颜色与它们的鳞片相同。

rows.original:
Much like other races, salamanders reproduce after a male of the species leaves his seed in the womb of a female. Salamanders are noted to have relatively low fertility, perhaps owing to their draconic ancestry; most families have only one or two children at most, and even the largest salamander settlements cannot compare to an average human city without immigration from other races.

        After conception, a salamander pregnancy will typically last about ten months, during which time the mother's stomach will grow quite gravid, and her breasts will swell with milk. First-time mothers usually experience a slight but permanent enlargement of the hips and buttocks during the later stages of pregnancy. Salamanders have live births, almost always to single children, and must nurse their newborns for at least a year before they can begin consuming solid food. 
        
        Salamanders come of age at about 18 years, and remain in their reproductive prime until their thirties.
rows.translation:
与其他种族类似，蝾螈也是通过雄性将精子注入雌性的子宫内来实现繁殖的。值得注意的是，蝾螈的繁殖能力相对较低，这或许与它们拥有龙的血统有关；大多数蝾螈家庭最多只有一两个后代，即便规模最大的蝾螈聚居地，如果没有其他种族的移民加入，其人口数量也远远无法与普通的人类城市相媲美。

        在受精后，蝾螈的妊娠期通常约为十个月。在这段时间里，母亲的腹部会变得明显隆起，乳房也会因为乳汁的积聚而肿胀。初次怀孕的蝾螈母亲，在妊娠后期通常会出现髋部和臀部的轻微但永久性的增大。火蜥蜴属于胎生动物，每次通常只产下一只幼崽，而且它们必须为新生幼崽哺乳至少一年，之后幼崽才能开始食用固体食物。
        
        火蜥蜴在大约18岁时达到性成熟，其生育能力也会持续到30岁左右。

rows.original:
Salamanders are speculated to be scions of dragon-kind, though any records of such were doubtless lost in the Godswar, and dragons themselves are notoriously tight-lipped about just about everything. On their own merits, salamanders have existed for thousands of years, living in small cities on the edge of Belharan territory such as the Frost Marches. 

        The most famous Frostscale city is Tychris, a marcher principality located two days' journey west of Khor'minos. The city was renowned for its glasswork in days gone by, producing mirrors and windows for lords across the world. Even the great cathedrals did business with Tychris, commissioning great works of color-stained glass that would stream rainbows of light across images taken from holy text and sagas. 
        
        For the Cinderscale, most live as nomadic hunters among the dunes and plains of the east and south. These salamanders are renowned as mercenaries, lending their great curved blades — called falxes — to any with the gold to pay for their services. These warriors were so fierce that even at its height, the Belharan Empire failed to subjugate their lands entirely.
rows.translation:
有人推测，火蜥蜴其实是龙族的后裔，不过关于这一点的任何记录恐怕都在那场神战中被毁掉了，而龙族本身也对几乎所有事情都守口如瓶。单从自身特性来看，火蜥蜴已经存在了数千年，它们生活在贝尔哈兰领土边缘的一些小城镇里，比如霜冻边境地区。 

        最著名的霜之鳞城市是提克里斯，这是一个位于科尔米诺斯以西两日路程处的侯国。在过去，这座城市以其玻璃制品而闻名，为世界各地的贵族们生产镜子和窗户。即便是那些宏伟的大教堂，也会与提克里斯进行交易，委托他们制作那些精美的彩绘玻璃作品——这些玻璃在描绘着神圣经文与传奇故事的画面中，会绽放出绚丽的彩虹光芒。
        
        而对于“灰烬之鳞”一族来说，他们中的大多数人都生活在东部和南部的沙丘与平原上，以游牧猎人的身份为生。这些蝾螈以雇佣兵的身份而闻名，只要有人愿意支付足够的金钱，他们就会将自己的那把弯曲的大刀——被称为“法尔克斯”——交给对方使用。这些战士凶猛异常，即便在贝尔哈兰帝国最强大的时期，也未能完全征服他们的领地。
rows.raw:
"
        Salamanders are speculated to be scions of dragon-kind, though any records of such were doubtless lost in the Godswar, and dragons themselves are notoriously tight-lipped about just about everything. On their own merits, salamanders have existed for thousands of years, living in small cities on the edge of Belharan territory such as the Frost Marches. 

        The most famous Frostscale city is Tychris, a marcher principality located two days' journey west of Khor'minos. The city was renowned for its glasswork in days gone by, producing mirrors and windows for lords across the world. Even the great cathedrals did business with Tychris, commissioning great works of color-stained glass that would stream rainbows of light across images taken from holy text and sagas. 
        
        For the Cinderscale, most live as nomadic hunters among the dunes and plains of the east and south. These salamanders are renowned as mercenaries, lending their great curved blades — called falxes — to any with the gold to pay for their services. These warriors were so fierce that even at its height, the Belharan Empire failed to subjugate their lands entirely.
        
        "

rows.original:
There is no one culture that defines all salamanders, even among Cinderscale or Frostscale. Many in Jassira believe them to be a race of uncouth barbarians, raging and battling senselessly all their lives, while in the Marches, salamanders are first and foremost thought of as scholars and as priests dedicated to the goddess of knowledge, Nareva. 

        The Frostscales of Tychris, especially, have a strong connection to their goddess. The principality has produced several notable archmages, Prince Philander II perhaps most famous among them, said to have invented an entirely new school of magic — though it was lost along with the prince during the Godswar.
        
        It is generally believed, at least, that most salamanders have a strong sense of pride and honor. Most put a great value on their own accomplishments, and those of their family. Salamanders tend to be clannish and insular, but fiercely defensive of their relatives and loved ones. Common wisdom dictates that Frostscales are calmer and more logical, approaching problems with cool heads, while Cinderscales have a reputation for headstrong willfulness and fiery passion. No doubt those dispositions have affected their cultural development.
rows.translation:
没有任何一种文化能够定义所有火蜥蜴，即便是在“灰鳞族”或“霜鳞族”中也是如此。在贾西拉，许多人认为火蜥蜴是一群粗野的野蛮人，他们终其一生都在疯狂地争斗；而在边境地区，人们首先会将火蜥蜴视为学者，或是那些虔诚地侍奉知识女神娜瑞瓦的祭司。 

        尤其是提克里斯的霜之鳞族，他们与自己的女神有着紧密的联系。这个公国诞生过几位杰出的大法师，其中菲兰德二世王子或许最为著名——据说他创立了一种全新的魔法流派，然而这种魔法在神战期间与王子一同消失了。
        
        至少，人们普遍认为，大多数蝾螈都具备强烈的自豪感和荣誉感。它们非常重视自己以及家族所取得的成就。蝾螈往往具有很强的群体意识，且倾向于与外界保持距离，但会坚决保护自己的亲人和所爱的人。根据普遍的看法，霜之鳞族更为冷静、理性，面对问题时总能保持冷静的头脑；而烬之鳞族则以固执的意志和炽热的激情著称。毫无疑问，这些性格特点对他们的文化发展产生了深远的影响。

rows.original: "Used to be, people in the empire loved us. We were nobility, mages, courtiers... sometimes thieves and spies, too, but always in service to the throne. Then Belhar crumbled, and what was left for us but to cling to her embers as long as we could?"
rows.translation: 曾经，帝国的人民都喜爱我们。我们是贵族、法师、朝臣……有时也会成为窃贼或间谍，但我们的目的始终是为王权服务。然而当贝尔哈尔崩塌之后，我们还能做的，就是尽可能长久地紧紧抓住它残余的余火罢了。

rows.original: —Lusina en Errion, Heir to Maidenbridge Name: Mothfolk Sexes: Male and Female Height: Ranges from between 5'5 ft. to 6'6 ft., with males and females standing at roughly the same stature. Weight: Roughly 20% lighter than a human of the same height. Skin: Mothfolk have human-typical skin, though they additionally grow layers of thick, downy "fluff" along their forelimbs and around the neck. Hair: Much as humans. Typical coloration ranges include whites, reds, pinks, and browns. Eyes: Human in shape and size, though mothfolk eye color typically ranges from black to red and brown. Ears: Mothfolk have long, tapered ears similar to elves. Some individuals may have a thin coating of fuzz along their ears. Lifespan: About 60 to 70 years. Maturity: 16 years.
rows.translation: ——露西娜·恩·埃里恩，梅登布里奇的女继承人 名称：蛾人 性别：男性和女性 高度：身高在5英尺5英寸到6英尺6英寸之间，男性和女性的身高大致相同。 重量：与身高相同的人类相比，它的重量大约轻了20%。 皮肤：蛾人拥有与人类相似的皮肤，但他们的前肢以及颈部还会长出一层厚厚的、柔软的“绒毛”。 头发：与人类一样，它们的典型体色包括白色、红色、粉色和棕色。 眼睛：它们的外形和体型与人类相似，不过蛾人的眼睛颜色通常介于黑色、红色和棕色之间。 耳朵：蛾人拥有与精灵相似的细长耳朵。有些个体的耳朵上可能会覆盖着一层细软的绒毛。 使用寿命：大约60到70年。 到期日： 16年。

rows.original:
Mothfolk are winged humanoids, generally considered to be of elven ancestry. They typically have slender or bottom-heavy figures, long legs, and flawless elven features, including tapered ears. Unlike their groundborne cousins, mothfolk have large and sensitive feelers atop their heads, giving them greatly enhanced perception, as well as large gossamer wings that appear delicate and nearly translucent — belying the great strength and agility those wings possess.

        Mothfolk females tend to have large hips and buttocks, though males are also considerably wider of hip than men of other races. Both sexes grow thick, soft coats of fuzzy down around their forelimbs and shoulders, though males tend to have much larger manes and archetypally grow quite large beards, often becoming indistinguishable from their shoulder fluff. Females' average breast size ranges from B to C-cups, and males have human-style and sized phalluses.
        
        Mothfolk have a notable, and apparently involuntary, fascination with fire. Bright flashes of light or eruptions of fire can leave mothfolk stunned and confused for several seconds, and subconsciously, they find themselves drawn to even smoldering campfires or dazzled by the moon glistening on a placid lake.
        
        Fire is hypnotic to them in all its forms, and mothfolk must take care to limit their exposure to sudden lights and open flames.
rows.translation:
蛾人是一种有翼的人形生物，通常被认为具有精灵的血统。他们的身形通常较为纤细，或者下半身较为粗壮，拥有修长的双腿以及完美的精灵特征，包括逐渐变细的耳朵。与那些生活在地面上的同类不同，蛾人的头顶上长着大型而敏感的触角，这些触角使他们的感知能力得到了极大的提升；此外，他们还拥有薄如蝉翼、看起来极为脆弱的翅膀，但实际上这些翅膀蕴含着巨大的力量与敏捷性。

        蛾人女性通常拥有较大的臀部，而男性也是如此，他们的臀部宽度也明显超过其他种族的男性。无论男女，它们的前肢和肩膀部位都会长出一层浓密柔软的绒毛，不过男性的绒毛通常更为茂密，而且他们还会长出相当大的胡须，这些胡须往往与他们肩膀上的绒毛难以区分。女性乳房的大小通常在B到C杯之间，而男性的生殖器则与人类的形状和大小相当。
        
        蛾人似乎对火焰有一种难以抑制的迷恋。明亮的闪光或火焰的迸发会让蛾人陷入几秒钟的茫然与困惑，而在潜意识里，他们会被燃烧的篝火吸引，也会被平静湖面上反射的月光所震撼。
        
        对于蛾人来说，无论以何种形式呈现的火焰都具有令人着迷的魅力，因此他们必须格外注意避免长时间暴露在突然出现的强光或明火之中。

rows.original:
Mothfolk are an oviparous race, meaning that after copulation, a female moth's belly will begin to swell with growing, fertilized eggs. A mothgirl's pregnancy will typically last about three months, whereupon she'll lay a clutch of between two and six eggs, each about fist-sized and sheened with a delicate waxy covering. The eggs must be tended to for an additional month, whereupon they will begin to disintegrate, and the newborn moths will claw their way into the world by eating their own shells.

        Around the time she lays her eggs, a new mother will begin to lactate. Newborn mothfolk must be breastfed for six to nine months before they can eat solid food. During this stage of their lives, infant mothfolk have much of their bodies covered with thick scales, including over their backs where their wings will someday be. Around six years of age, young mothfolk will molt off their scales, revealing soft skin and new, gossamer wings beneath — and can begin flying shortly thereafter.
rows.translation:
蛾人是一个卵生种族，这意味着在交配之后，雌性蛾人的腹部会开始因逐渐发育的受精卵而膨胀。蛾女的妊娠期通常约为三个月，在此期间她会产下两到六枚卵，每枚卵的大小大约与拳头相当，并且表面覆盖着一层细腻的蜡质保护层。这些卵还需要再被照料一个月，之后它们就会开始分解，而新生的蛾子则会通过啃食自己的卵壳来破壳而出。

        当一只新妈妈产下卵的时候，它也会开始分泌乳汁。新生的蛾人婴儿必须接受六到九个月的母乳喂养，之后才能开始进食固体食物。在生命的这个阶段，婴儿蛾人的身体大部分部位都覆盖着厚厚的鳞片，包括他们未来会长出翅膀的背部区域。在大约六岁的时候，这些年轻的蛾类会蜕去身上的鳞片，露出柔软的皮肤和崭新的、如薄纱般的翅膀——之后不久，它们就可以开始飞行了。

rows.original:
The history of mothfolk and the Belharan Empire are virtually inseparable. The Imperial heartland was also where the first primitive mothfolk settlements were located, and they quickly became subjects of the human-elven hegemony. Because mothfolk are, by and large, a peaceful and loyal people, they found life within the empire to be relatively prosperous and rewarding, and as they provided more soldiers and workers for the young Belharan Empire, so too were they rewarded with greater privilege and power. 

        Several cities and provinces were ruled by mothfolk nobles, and Belharan history is replete with stories of moth generals and wizards earning great victories through their cunning and guile.
        
        When the empire broke apart following the Godswar, many mothfolk-controlled provinces became de facto states of their own, giving rise to a loose chain of city-states to the west of what's left of Belhar now controlled by mothfolk. The naturally gentle disposition of these mothfolk has reportedly not been of great help to them as barbarians and marauders rampage across the countryside.
rows.translation:
蛾人族与贝尔哈兰帝国的历史几乎是密不可分的。帝国的核心地区也正是最早的原始蛾人族聚居地，而这些蛾人族很快便成为了人类与精灵共同统治下的子民。由于蛾人总体而言是一个和平且忠诚的民族，他们在帝国中找到了相对繁荣且富有意义的生活。随着他们为年轻的贝拉兰帝国提供更多的士兵和劳动力，他们也因此获得了更多的特权和权力作为回报。 

        许多城市和省份都由蛾人贵族统治，贝尔哈兰的历史中充满了这样的故事：那些蛾人将军和巫师们凭借他们的狡猾与诡计取得了辉煌的胜利。
        
        当神战之后帝国分崩离析时，许多由蛾人控制的省份实际上已经成为了独立的国家，于是，在贝尔哈兰剩余领土的西部，出现了一系列由蛾人统治的城市国家。据说，这些蛾人天性温和的性格，在野蛮人和掠夺者肆意破坏乡村的时候，并没有为他们带来太大的帮助。

rows.original:
While the Belharan Empire was predominantly human and elven, mothfolk remained one of the most civilized and peaceful of the demi-human races living within its borders. Because of this, mothfolk aren't likely to have ever had a developed culture or society entirely their own, but rather were shaped and molded by their place within the empire.

        Mothfolk of the empire typically belonged to large blood-tied clans, such as the Hawkwing or Rosetree, living in and around a certain Belharan settlement. Those of noble rank adopted Imperial stylings and surnames, such as the knightly Errion family of Maidenbridge. In either case, mothfolk regularly contributed to the ranks of the empire's magicians, and were widely regarded as being among the best enchanters and mage-smiths in Belhar.
        
        It is generally believed that mothfolk once possessed a great cult dedicated to elemental fire, and several prehistoric ruins from this worship can be found scattered across the rolling plains and forests of the heartland. This faith was almost entirely subsumed into the Church of Lumia during the imperial supremacy, though as Belhar continues to fracture and its churches have lost much of their power, perhaps the old faith of the fires will emerge once again.
rows.translation:
虽然贝尔哈兰帝国的主要居民是人类和精灵，但蛾人仍是生活在该帝国境内的半人类种族中最为文明、最为和平的种族之一。正因如此，蛾人很可能从未发展出完全属于他们自己的独特文化或社会体系，而是他们的文化与社会形态是在帝国的框架内逐渐形成的。

        帝国的蛾人通常属于一些规模庞大的、有血缘关系的氏族，比如鹰翼氏族或玫瑰树氏族，他们居住在贝拉兰的某些特定地区及其周边。那些拥有贵族身份的蛾人则会采用帝国的礼仪规范和姓氏，比如梅登布里奇的埃里恩骑士家族。无论在哪种情况下，蛾人始终都是帝国法师队伍中的重要成员，他们被广泛认为是贝尔哈尔地区最优秀的施法者和法师工匠之一。
        
        人们普遍认为，蛾人曾经拥有一座专门崇拜火元素的伟大神庙，而在这片内陆地区的平原和森林中，至今仍散布着一些与这种崇拜相关的史前遗迹。在帝国统治时期，这种信仰几乎完全被纳入了卢米亚教会之中。然而，随着贝哈尔逐渐分裂，各教会也失去了原有的势力，或许那种与火焰相关的古老信仰会再次重新浮现出来。

半人马

rows.original: "The idea of the pillaging centaur is the product of childish paranoia, and holds about as much merit. Perhaps in the distant past some tribes did commit the acts so fondly attributed to the race as a whole, but the average centaur is no more compelled to act on their lusts than the common citizenry of Savarra."
rows.translation: 将半人马视为掠夺成性的生物，这种观点纯粹是幼稚的偏执心理的产物，根本没有任何事实依据。或许在遥远的过去，确实有一些部落会做出这种被归咎于整个半人马种族的行为，但普通的半人马和萨瓦拉的普通民众一样，并没有那种无法抑制的欲望驱使他们去犯罪。

rows.original:
Centaurs are quadrupedal monstrous humanoids native to the world of Savarra. From a fair distance they could easily be mistaken for human men and women riding horses, but such imagery falls apart upon closer inspection. Where human waists would transition to a pair of legs, centaurs instead have the entire body of a horse. Given only the image of a face, one would be hard pressed to guess whether a person were a centaur or a human.

        Female centaurs tend to have larger chests than humans on average, but not unbelievably so, ranging from DD-F cups, with outliers on both ends. Male centaurs are fully equipped with equine penises, averaging two feet in length.
rows.translation:
半人马是一种四足的怪物状人形生物，原产于萨瓦拉世界。从远处看，它们很容易被误认为是骑在马背上的人类男女，但仔细观察就会发现其中的区别——在人类的腰部位置，半人马拥有的是一整匹马的躯体。仅仅根据一张脸的图片，人们很难判断这个人是半人马还是人类。

        一般来说，女性半人马的胸部通常会比人类更大，但这种差异也不会大到令人难以置信的程度，胸围大小通常在DD到F杯之间，当然也存在个别例外情况。雄性半人马拥有完整的马形阴茎，其长度平均为两英尺。

rows.original:
Breeding among centaurs is a relatively simple affair, taking place in the usual manner. That said, for most of the year centaurs have extremely low virility and fertility, requiring a painstaking amount of effort to conceive. Female centaurs go into heat naturally once a year, for a period of about a week. During this time their fertility rates are flipped, with pregnancy becoming all but a guarantee. The musk produced by female centaurs during their heat period causes a boost in male centaur virility to rival their partners. Some centaurs hoard this musk, both to enjoy the high it brings, and to sell to other races desperate for a higher chance at conception.

        Centaurs can be pregnant for up to a year before birth occurs. This, combined with the low rate of conception outside of heat periods, prevents overpopulation in areas occupied by centaurs. Centaurs rarely have more than one child at a time, with twin births being exceptionally rare and possibly dangerous to a first time mother. 
        
        Centaur mothers stay closely involved with their children, but not to the point of jealousy. Foals begin walking quickly, so raising children is a tribe effort. For the first few months, centaur foals nurse from the mother's horse half, transitioning to the human breasts when they grow tall enough to reach them. A centaur's teats generally remain very small, hardly noticeable for some, but particularly prolific mothers or wet nurses may see theirs grow and remain engorged with milk.
        
        Fully grown centaurs are encouraged to stay within their birth-tribe, but it is not all that uncommon to find a free spirited centaur in the midst of a larger town or city, or plumbing the unexplored reaches of Savarra. Such adventurers are welcomed back with open arms should they decide to visit their homes.
        
        Centaurs are fully capable of breeding with most of the races that populate the Frost Marches. Most interracial couples find it tougher to conceive, even during a female's heat period, or with the aid of a females musk, but this is rarely seen as a problem. Marefolk who desire more than violent breeding often take male centaurs they deem fit as lovers, preferring their company to their race's bestial males.
rows.translation:
半人马的繁殖过程相对简单，遵循常规方式即可完成。不过，在一年中的大部分时间里，半人马的生育能力和活力都会处于非常低的水平，因此要成功受孕需要付出相当大的努力。雌性半人马每年会自然进入发情期，持续时间约为一周。在这段时间里，她们的受孕能力会显著提升，怀孕几乎成为必然。雌性半人马在发情期分泌的麝香会大幅提升雄性半人马的性欲，使其在与伴侣交配时的表现更加出色。有些半人马会囤积这种麝香，既为了享受它带来的愉悦感，也为了将其卖给那些迫切希望提高受孕几率的其他种族。

        半人马在分娩前可能会怀孕长达一年的时间。再加上在发情期之外受孕的概率很低，这些因素共同作用，使得半人马栖息的地区不会出现人口过剩的情况。半人马很少会一次生育多个孩子，双胞胎的情况极为罕见，而且对于初次生育的半人马母亲来说，生产双胞胎可能会带来危险。 
        
        半人马的母亲会与自己的孩子保持密切的联系，但这种关系并不会发展成嫉妒。半人马的马驹很快就能学会行走，因此抚养孩子是整个部落共同的责任。在最初的几个月里，半人马的马驹会吸食母亲的奶水，等到它们长得足够高、能够接触到人类的乳房时，就会开始改喝人类的母乳。半人马的乳房通常很小，有些人的乳房几乎看不出来，但那些生育能力较强的母亲或者代乳的母亲，她们的乳房可能会变得较大，并且会持续充满乳汁。
        
        成年半人马通常被鼓励留在自己出生的部落中，但在较大的城镇或城市里，也能经常看到那些自由奔放的半人马；他们甚至会前往萨瓦拉那些尚未被探索的区域。如果这些冒险者决定回到自己的家园，人们会热情地欢迎他们回来。
        
        半人马完全能够与冰原边境地区的大多数种族进行交配。不过，大多数跨种族伴侣都会发现，即使在雌性半人马的发情期，或者借助雌性半人马的麝香辅助，怀孕也会变得更加困难。不过，这种情况很少被视为真正的问题。那些不满足于仅仅进行纯粹的交配行为的雌性半人马，往往会选择那些她们认为合适的雄性半人马作为伴侣，她们更喜欢与这些雄性半人马在一起，而不是与自己种族中那些野性的雄性成员在一起。

rows.original: Centaurs have existed since before the recording of history became a commonality. Their exact longevity as a race is hard to gauge, as their histories are often oral, and any recordings are the result of stories taken down by human or elvish scholars. Centaur civilization extends to a number of tribes across the world, with numerous subcultures being mapped by historians to this day.
rows.translation: 半人马这一种族的存在，可以追溯到有文字记载的历史之前。要准确判断他们作为一个种族存在了多久，其实相当困难，因为他们的历史大多是以口述的形式流传下来的，而任何被记录下来的历史，也都是由人类或精灵学者们整理编撰而成的故事。如今，半人马的文明遍布世界各地，不同的部落形成了众多的亚文化，这些亚文化至今仍被历史学家们所研究记录着。

rows.original:
Centaurs group themselves into tribes of varying size. Tribes are governed by a ruling pair, a chief and chieftess. Tribal chief pairs are elected from pre-existing couples, usually pairs with the healthiest relationship. Disputes occasionally occur regarding a chief or chieftess' standing, but most govern until their deaths. 

        Once every 5 years, ruling chiefs of both genders may choose a willing member of the tribe to mate with during their heat periods. Refusal is an option, but being chosen to birth or sire a chief or chieftess' child is a boastable honor that can garner standing amongst the tribe. The current youngest child, or any who have come of age but have yet to secure a mate. of a governing pair often receive the most attention, with tribe members vying to match their children with those of the chiefs.
rows.translation:
半人马们会按照不同的规模组成不同的部落。每个部落都由一对首领共同管理，即一位男首领和一位女首领。这些部落首领通常是从那些关系最为稳固的伴侣中选出的。偶尔会有关于酋长或女酋长地位的争议，但大多数情况下，他们都会在位直至去世。

        每五年一次，男女统治酋长都可以选择部落中自愿的成员，在他们的发情期与之交配。拒绝也是一种选择，但被选中来为族长或女族长生育后代，这是一项值得骄傲的荣誉，也能让一个人在部落中获得相应的地位。无论是目前最年幼的孩子，还是那些已经成年却尚未找到伴侣的人，都是这样的选择对象。在部落中，统治者的子女往往会受到最多的关注，其他部落成员也会争相让自己的孩子与这些首领的子女结为伴侣。

rows.original:
The centaurs of the Frost March plains are the most commonly known around the world. Tall, commonly fair of skin, and possessing varying degrees of shaggy hair. They are far from the only variety of centaur in the world, but tend to be the most social.

        The iron coast of Jassira is home to a race of more lithe centaurs with dark skin and darker hair. These desert faring centaurs travel mostly for trade purposes, staying in towns or cities that see lots of traffic. They will remain anywhere from a matter of days to extended stays of a year or more. 
        
        Centaur troupes with the lower bodies of moose or elk can rarely be spotted in the forested regions of Savarra. These scarce offshoots don't often interact with other civilized society, but can be genial to hunters who respect the land, or to races like the wyld elves from the Frost Marches.
        
        Small herds of incredibly short centaurs with the bodies of goats can be found atop many of Savarra's tall mountain ranges, higher than most civilized races dare to tread. Adventurous climbers often find these herds to be good company, and can find food and warm shelter where there would otherwise be none.
rows.translation:
冰原地区的半人马是全世界最为人熟知的一种半人马。他们身材高大，皮肤通常呈白色，毛发也长短不一、形态各异。虽然世界上存在多种半人马种类，但这类半人马往往是最喜欢群居的。

        贾西拉的铁色海岸栖息着一种体态更为灵活、皮肤黝黑、头发深色的半人马。这些生活在沙漠中的半人马主要为了贸易而四处游历，他们会停留在那些交通繁忙的城镇或城市中。他们的停留时间从短短几天到长达一年或更久不等。 
        
        在萨瓦拉的森林地带，那些下半身形似麋鹿或驼鹿的半人马部队极为罕见。这些稀有的种族分支通常不与其他文明社会发生接触，但他们对那些尊重这片土地的猎人，或是像霜冻边境的野精灵这样的种族，往往会表现出友善的态度。
        
        在萨瓦拉许多高耸的山脉之上，可以找到那些体型极小、外形像山羊的半人马群。这些山脉的高度远远超出了大多数文明种族敢于攀登的范围。喜欢冒险的登山者们常常会发现，这些半人马是他们绝佳的伙伴——在那些原本一无所有的地方，它们不仅能提供食物，还能提供温暖的庇护所。

rows.original: "Harpies are just birdbrained scavengers, looting and stealing whatever they need. That includes men... or anyone with a manhood. Nothin' matters to a harpy more than her next egg."

rows.original:
Harpies are feathery females native to the mountains of the Frost Marches. Though their stature is much like that of a human woman, the difference is immediately visible in their taloned, scaled feet and the feathered wings that stretch from their underarms to wrists. In addition to these obvious features, harpies have tapered ears similar to those of elves, and large eyes with hawk-like vision. Their hands are clawed and, along with their arms, are covered in down the same color as their wings.

        Traditionally, harpies have small breasts (from flat-chested to C-cups), but exceptionally wide hips and plush rumps that they are all too happy to use in enticing men to mate with them.
rows.translation:
鹰身女妖是一种生息在霜冻边境山脉地区的羽毛覆盖的女性生物。虽然她们的体型与人类女性相似，但她们那长着爪子和鳞片的足部，以及从腋下延伸到手腕的羽毛翅膀，立刻就能让人分辨出她们的与众不同。除了这些显而易见的外貌特征外，女妖还具有与精灵相似的锥形耳朵，以及拥有鹰一般视力的大眼睛。它们的手部长有爪子，手臂和手上都覆盖着与翅膀颜色相同的绒毛。

        传统上，女妖们的胸部通常较小（从平胸到C罩杯不等），但臀部却异常宽大丰满，她们非常乐意利用这些优势来吸引男性与自己交配。

As an all-female species, harpies rely on other races' menfolk to reproduce — and they are voracious breeders, rarely content to go without an egg in their bellies for more than a few days. The higher in status a harpy is, the more likely she is to be pregnant at any given time, as she is able to effectively hoard captured (or seduced) men to herself to ensure her own line's supremacy, and keep her flock-mates in line based in their own growing desperation to breed.

        A harpy pregnancy takes twelve to fifteen days from conception until the egg is laid. Once a harpy lays her egg, she will jealously guard it from all comers, including her own flock-mates and sisters. The only individual she will allow near her nest is the egg's father, and even then, only if she has built up some measure of trust with him.
        
        Harpies will tend to their eggs by bodily holding for warmth and decorating them with stolen coins, jewelry, and cosmetics. This process will last for roughly a month, whereupon the harpy's egg will hatch into a small, defenseless little chick. Harpy chicks grow quickly, reaching maturity in just three years. During their youth, the chicks will rely on their mothers for food, but harpies only lactate a vestigial amount; they feed their chicks with soft foods and meats until they are able to handle full meals after a few months.
        
        When a harpy reaches maturity, she will usually remain with her mother's flock as a neophyte thief and fighter. When a flock grows too large the sustain itself in one place, the youngest members of the group will often wing off to form their own new clan, with better prospects of finding mates.
rows.translation:
作为纯雌性物种，女妖们依赖其他种族的男性来繁衍后代——而且她们的繁殖欲望极其强烈，很少能忍受连续几天没有怀孕的状态。女妖的地位越高，她处于怀孕状态的可能性就越大。因为她们能够将捕获或诱骗到的男性据为己有，从而确保自己后代的繁盛，并通过让其他同类因迫切想要生育而乖乖听命，来维持群体内部的秩序。

        雌鹰在受孕后需要十二到十五天的时间才能产下蛋。一旦产蛋，它就会嫉妒地保护这个蛋，不让任何生物接近，包括自己的同伴和姐妹。唯一被允许靠近它巢穴的，只有这只蛋的“父亲”——而即便如此，也只有在她对他建立起一定程度的信任之后才会允许他靠近。
        
        女妖会用自己的身体为蛋保暖，并用偷来的硬币、珠宝和化妆品来装饰这些蛋。这个过程会持续大约一个月，之后这些蛋就会孵化出一只弱小无助的小鸟。鹰身女妖的幼崽生长速度很快，只需三年就能达到性成熟。在幼年时期，这些幼崽会依赖母亲获取食物，但鹰身女妖的乳汁分泌量非常少，因此它们会用柔软的食物和肉类来喂养幼崽，直到几个月后这些幼崽能够自行进食为止。
        
        当一只女妖达到性成熟时，她通常会继续留在母亲的群体中，作为一名初出茅庐的小偷和战士。当一个群体变得过于庞大，难以在一个地方维持生存时，群体中最年轻的成员往往会飞离出去，组建自己的新家族，这样他们找到伴侣的机会也会更大。

rows.original:
Harpies typically divide themselves into blood-related clans, centered around a single matriarch who leads the flock on raids and directs their scavenging efforts. Her eldest and strongest daughters take up sub-leader roles under their mother, leading their own sisters and daughters in smaller groups to find men and treasure to return to their nests in the highest reaches of the mountains.

        As far as folk understand, harpies have no true culture of their own: no literature or poems, and only crude art drawn on the stone near their nests. Most of what would pass for culture, including their language, is taken directly from other races.
rows.translation:
女妖们通常会按照血缘关系划分不同的族群，每个族群都由一位女族长领导。这位女族长会带领族群成员进行袭击行动，并指导她们寻找食物和珍宝。她那些最年长、最强壮的女儿们会在她之下担任副领导角色，带领自己姐妹们组成小队，去寻找雄性动物和珍宝，然后将这些战利品带回位于高山之巅的巢穴中。

        据人们所知，哈皮族并没有属于自己的真正文化：没有文学作品或诗歌，只在巢穴附近的石头上绘制一些粗糙的图案。他们所拥有的一切可以被称为文化的元素，包括他们的语言，都是直接从其他种族那里借鉴而来的。

rows.original: —Phyaxos of Tychris, salamander adventurer, moments before his death. Name: Jotun(s). More commonly known as Frost Giants. Sexes: Males, females, and hermaphrodites. Height: Jotuns stand 13 to 15 ft. tall, with males averaging about a foot taller than females. Weight: Jotuns are massive beings, with weights to match. Scholars estimate they must weigh at least 2,000 pounds if not more. Skin: Most jotuns have skin in shades of deep blue or cobalt, though ice-blue individuals and on rare occasion even purple giants are known to exist. Hair: Typically black, with less common shades of gray or dark blue. Very rarely, red or blonde. Whatever their coloration, jotun hair is thick, shaggy. Males are able to grow prodigious beards, and have dense body. Eyes: Red. Ears: Jotun ears are human-like, though it isn't too unusual to find individuals with pointed or even frilled ears, indicating mixed-race ancestry. Lifespan: It is believed that jotuns live for about one hundred and fifty to two hundred years, though elder giants are rarely if ever encountered. Maturity: 30 years.
rows.translation: ——提克里斯的菲亚克斯，这位蝾螈冒险家，在死前最后的时刻。 名称：约顿巨人。更常见的称呼是霜巨人。 性别：雄性、雌性以及雌雄同体生物。 高度：巨魔的身高在13到15英尺之间，雄性巨魔的平均身高比雌性高出大约1英尺。 重量：约顿巨人是体型庞大的生物，它们的体重也相应地非常巨大。学者们估计，它们的体重至少有2000磅，甚至可能更重。 皮肤：大多数尤顿人的皮肤呈现出深蓝色或钴蓝色，不过也存在着冰蓝色的个体，而极为罕见的情况下，还会出现紫色巨人的存在。 头发：通常为黑色，偶尔也会出现灰色或深蓝色的变种。极少数情况下，也会出现红色或金色的毛发。无论呈现出何种颜色，尤顿族的毛发都十分浓密且蓬松。雄性尤顿族能够长出极为浓密的胡须，身体也显得十分魁梧。 眼睛：红色。 耳朵： 女性约顿巨人族的耳朵外形与人类相似，不过也确实存在一些个体的耳朵呈尖状，甚至带有褶边，这些特征表明他们具有混血血统。 使用寿命：据信，这些巨魔的寿命约为150到200年，不过那些年迈的巨魔却极为罕见，几乎从未有人见过它们。 到期日： 30年。

rows.original:
Jotuns are titanic humanoids native to the world's polar reaches, both north and south, where they live in relative isolation in tribes of semi-nomadic hunters. The stereotypical jotun ranges from four to five yards tall, is broad-shouldered and well muscled regardless of sex, and girded in the hides of polar bears and walruses, wielding weapons of stone and bone. 

        They are a primitive folk, living beyond even the reach of Belhar in its height, and theirs is a land desolate of resources. Yet the giants rarely stray far from the frigid poles. Scholars speculate that the sheer size of the bodies means that they require cold climates to keep from overheating... though others point to dragons and centaurs as proof to the contrary. Regardless of the reasons, frost giants have spent most of history on the very fringes of the known world, and display little inclination to change their ways in that matter. Even during the Godswar, the jotuns answered the appearance of otherworldly terrors by simply going further north, where the Wraiths' minions would freeze to death before having a chance to harm the giants.
        
        The one region where the jotuns were once studied and examined was the glacial region north of the old Boreal Elven kingdom. Here, the giants ranged south far enough to interact with boer'alvar and frostscale salamander hunters, and eventually Belharan scholars interested in researching the world's largest humanoids.
rows.translation:
尤顿人是原生于世界南北极地带的巨型类人生物，他们以半游牧的生活方式生活在相对偏远的部落中。典型的尤顿人身高在四到五码之间，无论男女都具有宽厚的肩膀和强健的肌肉，他们身披北极熊和海象的皮毛，使用石制和骨制的武器进行狩猎。 

        他们是一个原始的民族，居住在连贝尔哈尔鼎盛时期也无法到达的地方，他们的家园是一片资源匮乏的荒芜之地。然而，这些巨人很少离开寒冷的极地地区。学者们推测，他们庞大的体型意味着他们需要寒冷的气候来避免体温过高。尽管也有人认为龙和半人马就是相反的证据。无论原因如何，霜巨人几乎在历史上的大部分时间里都生活在已知世界的边缘地带，而且他们也没有表现出任何改变这种生活方式的倾向。即使在神战期间，那些巨魔们也只需向更北的方向迁徙，就能避开那些超自然的恐怖存在。因为在那些地方，幽灵们的爪牙们还没来得及伤害巨魔们，就会冻死在冰天雪地之中。
        
        唯一一个曾经有人对那些巨型生物进行过研究与考察的地区，是位于古老北方精灵王国以北的冰川地带。在这里，这些巨人向南迁徙的范围之广，足以与那些猎捕“博尔阿尔瓦”和“霜鳞蝾螈”的猎人们发生接触；最终，一些对研究世界上最大的类人生物感兴趣的贝尔哈兰学者，也选择了在这个地区开展他们的研究工作。
