rows.original:
Frost giant reproduction is carried out in the human-standard means: males and females copulate, and the female carries a child to term for about a year. Jotuns have sexual organs similar in shape and function, if not in size, to humans. About 10% of the jotun population is believed to be hermaphroditic: that is to say, female in figure but possessing both sets of genitalia. Hermaphrodite jotuns are believed by their kin to be both more virile and fertile than mono-sexed giants, perhaps nature's answer to the race's low birth rate. 

        The harsh conditions and scarce resources of the polar regions means that jotun fertility is rather low at the best of times, but certainly not from lack of trying. Owing to the severe cold of their natural habitats, jotuns are quite keen to share their blankets and body heat whenever and where-ever the opportunity presents itself. Stories abound of smaller hunters nearly freezing to death in the arctic, only to be swept up and saved by vigorous warming-up from a frost giantess.
        
        Jotun pregnancies almost always result in single births, as the child's size causes significant strain to the mother; twins and triplets aren't unheard of, but they are dangerous and taxing pregnancies. When a female jotun falls pregnant, she withdraws to her tribe's village where the community will work together to support her. Jotuns don't tend to form mated pairs, and given their promiscuity, it's often a total unknown who the father is — but with children being so rare, young jotuns are given the attention of their entire tribe from even before their born.
        
        Perhaps surprisingly, given their stature, jotuns are capable of breeding with smaller races. Boreal elves and frostscale salamanders are the most common partners taken by the frost giants, and in almost all cases (for the obvious reason of survivability), it's a pairing of a female giant and a smaller sire. Halfbreed pregnancies are much faster, safer, and more comfortable for the mother in these cases, and the resultant giants lose little in the way of stature by the time they are adults, even if they are somewhat scrawny-looking as children.
rows.translation:
霜巨人的繁殖方式与人类相同：雄性和雌性进行交配，雌性会怀胎约一年才能分娩。尽管体型不同，但尤顿人的生殖器官在结构和功能上与人类相似。据信，约10%的约顿族成员属于雌雄同体：也就是说，他们外表上看起来是女性，但却拥有男女两性的生殖器官。他们的族人认为，这种雌雄同体的特征使得这些约顿族成员比单一性别的巨人们更具阳刚之气，也更加多产——这或许是大自然为了解决该种族较低的出生率而做出的一种安排。 

        极地地区恶劣的环境和稀缺的资源意味着，即使在最好的情况下，巨人的生育能力也相当低下，但这绝不是因为他们不努力。由于他们自然栖息地的严寒环境，巨人们总是乐于在任何机会出现的时候，与别人分享他们的毯子和体热。有很多故事讲述，那些较小的猎人在北极地区几乎冻死，而正是巨人们通过为他们提供温暖，才挽救了他们的生命。
        
        朱顿女性怀孕后，几乎总是会生下单个孩子，因为孩子的体型会对母亲造成巨大的负担；虽然也有双胞胎或三胞胎的情况，但这些妊娠对母亲来说既危险又极其耗费体力。当一位朱顿女性怀孕时，她会回到自己的部落村落，而整个部落会齐心协力来照顾她。巨魔通常不会形成固定的配对关系，由于它们具有随意交配的习惯，因此孩子的父亲往往无从知晓。但由于幼年巨魔极为罕见，因此在整个部落中，其他成员甚至会在这些幼崽出生之前就给予它们无微不至的关怀。
        
        或许会让人感到惊讶的是，考虑到它们的体型，霜巨人竟然能够与体型较小的种族繁衍后代。极北精灵和霜鳞蝾螈是最常被霜巨人选择的伴侣对象，而在几乎所有情况下（出于生存的考虑），都是雌性霜巨人与体型较小的雄性生物结合。在这种情况下，杂种动物的妊娠过程会快很多，对母体来说也更加安全、舒适。而且，这些杂种动物在成年后，体型也不会有太大差异——尽管它们在幼年时期可能会显得有些瘦弱。

rows.original:
Jotuns appear only rarely in actual recorded history. Most mentions of them that Belharan Heartlanders would know come from ancient mythology, where it is said that the world was once much colder and the jotuns ranged far further afield from their polar homes. Certain scholars even speculate that there might once have been an empire of the giants stretching across the northern continent and into the Sailgrave Archipelago, reigning long before the great human and elven kingdoms first arose before falling as the world warmed. If true, these prehistoric giants left no trace of themselves that modern sages have uncovered.

        Like other polar races, jotuns record their own history in oral tradition and epic sagas rather than as written word. Indeed, writing is quite rare in the poles: there are few trees for paper-making, and what stone is found is better purposed towards weapons and tools than tablets. The giants, too, sing of forgotten glories and fallen kingdoms; of a great war with the dragons in the days when the world was cold and the sky was darkened by draconic prides. Their sagas speak of innumerable heroes, and a pantheon of gods bearing different names than those of the mainland races.
rows.translation:
在有记载的历史中，巨魔出现的机会其实非常罕见。贝尔哈兰地区的人们所熟知的大部分关于它们的记载，都来源于古代神话。在这些神话中，人们提到当时世界的气温要低得多，巨魔们也会离开它们极地家园，四处游荡。一些学者甚至推测，或许曾经存在一个由巨人建立的帝国，它的疆域横跨北部大陆，一直延伸到赛尔格雷夫群岛。这个帝国在人类和精灵的伟大王国建立之前就已经存在了，但随着全球气候变暖，这个帝国最终也消失了。如果这些说法属实，那么这些史前巨兽确实没有留下任何现代学者能够发现的痕迹。

        与其他极地种族一样，约顿人也是通过口述传统和史诗般的传说来记录自己的历史，而不是以书面形式。的确，在极地地区，书写活动极为罕见：那里几乎没有适合造纸的树木，而能够找到的石头，也更适合用来制造武器和工具，而不是用来制作石板。那些巨人也会吟唱那些已被遗忘的辉煌与覆灭的王国；他们会讲述在那个世界还寒冷、天空被巨龙的翼影笼罩的时代，人类与巨龙之间爆发过的那场伟大战争。他们的传说中记载着无数英雄，以及一群名字与大陆上的种族不同的神明。

If true, these prehistoric giants left no trace of themselves that modern sages have uncovered.

Indeed, writing is quite rare in the poles: there are few trees for paper-making, and what stone is found is better purposed towards weapons and tools than tablets. The giants, too, sing of forgotten glories and fallen kingdoms; of a great war with the dragons in the days when the world was cold and the sky was darkened by draconic prides. Their sagas speak of innumerable heroes, and a pantheon of gods bearing different names than those of the mainland races.
        
        "

rows.original:
Frost giants maintain a society organized into small filial tribes of semi-nomadic hunters. The jotuns follow herds of great hairy mammoths, or go whaling from aboard titanic longships — often with the help of selkie guides and outriders, with whom they frequently share hunting grounds. Jotuns are gregarious with the other polar races, freely cooperating when the opportunity arises: while they may share territory, what feeds a selky or siorc is rarely of interest to a jotun, and what beasts a jotun clan might stalk are far too mighty for any other race to risk facing. It's said that in the distant past, jotuns even hunted dragons. Those tribes that could fell a great firebeast would eat like kings for a month, and come to battle clad in scale armor and bearing dragonbone arms that made them nigh invincible.

        Jotuns are much less welcoming to outlanders, though different tribes may take approaches in their interactions with their warmer neighbors ranging from secretive to openly hostile. Boer'alvar history tells of several conflicts between their warg-mounted warriors and the great jotuns of the Rift, bitter blood-feuds over hunting ground and water sources. Encountering a group of jotuns is much more likely to result in conflict than finding a single individual, as among their own kind, is considered the greatest shame to back down from the slightest perceived challenge or disrespect.
        
        Still, those adventurers who learn the giantish languages and customs will find that frost giants have a deep sense of honor and hold their word, once given, to be the most important bond that can be given.
        
        Jotuns have their own pantheon of gods they worship, centered around their goddess of blizzards and the tundra they merely call the Maiden of Frost. Belharan clerics posited that this was an aspect of Sorra, turning the wrath of her storms and howling winds to a colder mein. The jotun gods are worshipped by nowhere and by no one else known today.
rows.translation:
霜巨人建立的社会是由一些半游牧性质的狩猎部落组成的。这些巨人会跟随庞大的毛茸茸猛犸象群活动，或者乘坐巨大的长船出海捕鲸——他们常常会得到海豹女向导的帮助，也会与这些向导共享狩猎区域。尤顿人与其他极地种族关系融洽，一旦有机会便会自愿展开合作：虽然他们可能会共享同一片领地，但那些能够满足海豹精或希奥克人需求的猎物，往往对尤顿人来说并无吸引力；而那些被尤顿氏族追捕的凶猛野兽，其威力也远远超出了其他任何种族敢于挑战的范围。据说在遥远的过去，巨魔甚至会猎杀龙。那些能够猎杀这种巨型火兽的部落，可以连续一个月像国王一样享用美食，而且他们会穿着覆盖着龙鳞的铠甲，手持由龙骨制成的武器上战场，这些装备使他们几乎变得无懈可击。

        对于外来者而言，约顿人表现得远没有那么热情好客。不过，不同的部落在与这些邻近部落的互动中采取了不同的态度，这些态度从隐秘谨慎到公然敌对不等。根据博尔阿尔瓦的历史记载，他们的骑兵战士与裂谷地区的那些强大约顿人之间发生过多次冲突，这些冲突都是因为狩猎场和水源而引发的激烈争斗。遇到一群巨魔，引发冲突的可能性要比遇到单个巨魔大得多，因为在他们自己的族群中，对于任何看似微小的挑战或无礼行为退缩，都被视为最可耻的行为。
        
        然而，那些学习了这些巨型生物的语言和习俗的冒险者们会发现，霜巨人拥有深厚的荣誉感，他们认为一旦做出了承诺，就必须严格遵守，因为这才是最珍贵的纽带。
        
        尤顿人拥有自己信仰的神祇体系，其中心是他们的暴风雪女神，而他们将那片苔原简单地称为“霜之少女”。贝拉兰的牧师们认为，这是索拉的特性之一——她将风暴与狂风的怒力转化为更为寒冷的能量。而那些巨灵神明，如今已无人崇拜，也再没有任何其他族群信仰它们。

rows.original: "Wyverns are predators. Dangerous on the hunt, moreso if you catch them off guard. Best thing you can do if one sets her eyes on you is just relax and let her do what she wants. If you don't, her venom will make sure you're her plaything whether you like it or not."
rows.translation: 翼龙是掠食者。在狩猎时它们非常危险，尤其是当你让它们措手不及的时候。如果有一只翼龙盯上了你，最好的做法就是放松下来，让它做它想做的事。如果你不这样做，它的毒液会让你成为它的玩物，无论你愿不愿意。

If you don't, her venom will make sure you're her plaything whether you like it or not.\"\n        "

rows.original: —Leorah Name: Wyvern (pl. Wyverns) Sexes: Male, Female (roughly equal proportions) Height: Ranges from 6'0 to 7'2 on average. Weight: Wyverns weigh considerably more than their human counterparts. Skin: Heavy scale plates cover much of the wyvern's body, though some specimens also have significant amounts of smooth skin. Hair: Wyverns grow hair only on their heads, ranging in color from black to blue and gray. Eyes: Slitted, golden eyes are the norm. Ears: Wyverns possess large, frilled ears similar to those of salamanders. Lifespan: Though wyverns can easily live for up to 200 years, most specimens encountered in the wild are between twenty and fifty years of age. Maturity: 20 years

rows.original:
Wyverns are a race of heavily-scaled, winged humanoids native to the various mountain ranges of the world. Though most common in the warmer southlands, their race can be found in just about any part of the world that provides suitable living space for them: somewhere high up, secluded, and rich in game. It is commonly believed that wyverns are descendants of dragons that coupled with mortals, though the scholars of ancient Belhar generally concluded that wyverns had more in common with salamanders than with proper dragons.

        Regardless of their origin, it is well known that there are two "sub-races" of wyverns. While all wyvern-folk have heavy, thick scales over much of their bodies, and leathery wings under their arms which allow for limited flight, the degree of bestial features vary between wyverns. Some are covered head-to-toe in scales and sport draconic muzzles, while others are much closer in appearance to humans. What caused this racial split is unknown, but is assumed to be related to the amount of human blood versus that of dragons in the individual wyvern.
        
        Rather than draconic breath, wyverns possess a powerful venom that they use to capture prey. While in most creatures, this venom is a potent paralytic, is is known to, in some victims, produce an aphrodisiac-like effect. Because of this, distilled wyvern venom is a valuable commodity among alchemists in the southlands.
        
        Older wyverns are rarely encountered in the wild, as with age, their species grows considerably more lethargic and easy-going. Elder wyverns have behavior reminiscent of their draconic ancestors, preferring to roost on their accumulated coin and treasure, only venturing out to find food and mates once every few months.
        
        Wyverns are an intelligent race, able (though rarely inclined to) wear clothing and use weapons. However, few if any members of the race have ever been known to speak — either in Belharan or Wyrmtongue. The reason for the race's silence are unknown. Some scholars of ancient Estelore conjectured that a great curse had been levied against their race, while others insist that the wyvern's unique amalgam of draconic and humanoid traits simply render them mute.
rows.translation:
翼龙是一种身披厚甲、拥有翅膀的人形生物，它们原生于世界各地的山脉地区。虽然这类生物在温暖的南方地区最为常见，但只要环境适合它们生存，几乎在世界上的任何地方都能找到它们的踪迹——那些地势高耸、环境幽静且猎物丰富的地区，往往是它们的栖息地。人们普遍认为，翼龙是龙与人类结合后诞生的后代；不过，古代贝尔哈尔的学者们普遍认为，翼龙与蝾螈的亲缘关系更为密切，而非与真正的龙有更多的共同点。

        无论其起源如何，众所周知，翼龙这一物种存在两个“亚种”。虽然所有翼龙族群的成员身体大部分部位都覆盖着厚重坚硬的鳞片，手臂下方也长有可以用于短距离飞行的革质翅膀，但它们在野性特征的表现程度上存在差异。有些全身覆盖着鳞片，还长着类似龙的嘴部结构，而另一些则在外观上与人类更为相似。导致这种种族分化的原因尚不清楚，但人们推测，这可能与每只翼龙体内人类血液与龙之血液的比例有关。
        
        与那种致命的吐息不同，翼龙拥有强大的毒液，它们利用这种毒液来捕捉猎物。在大多数生物体内，这种毒液都具有强烈的麻痹作用，但据知，在某些受害者身上，它还会产生类似催情剂的效果。正因如此，提纯后的双足飞龙毒液在南方地区的炼金术士们眼中堪称珍贵的商品。
        
        年老的翼龙在野外极为罕见，因为随着年龄的增长，它们会变得愈发懒散、随和。这些年老的翼龙的行为举止与它们的龙类祖先颇为相似，它们更喜欢把自己积攒的金钱和财宝当作栖息之地，只有每隔几个月才会外出寻找食物或配偶。
        
        翼龙是一个智慧的种族，他们能够（尽管很少愿意）穿戴衣物和使用武器。然而，据我们所知，这个种族中几乎没有成员会说话——无论是用贝尔哈兰语还是翼龙的语言。造成他们沉默的原因至今仍然未知。一些研究古代埃斯托洛的学者推测，可能是某种可怕的诅咒降临在了他们的种族身上；而另一些学者则认为，翼龙那种龙人与人类的独特混合特性，使得他们天生就无法说话。

rows.original:
Wyverns are an egg-bearing race, with typical sexual reproduction. Due to their solitary nature and territoriality, wyverns rarely breed with each other; rather, they typically "hunt" for mates among the local population under their mountainous homes. Their venomous bites are particularly useful in this endeavor, preventing their prey from escaping once mounted and ensuring that males remain rigid for repeated couplings.

        Wyvern females carry eggs for roughly one month before depositing them in the nest. Once laid, an egg must be meticulously tended to for the next six months before hatching into a small, hairless, and flightless child. Wyvern females produce breast milk starting shortly after their egg-laying, and feed their children thusly for between six months and a year, when the hatchling is able to begin eating solid food.
        
        Young wyverns remain with their mothers for roughly twenty years before being strong and skilled enough to become independent. Unlike harpies — the wyvern's common neighbor — wyvern have no "flock mentality" and will usually leave to find their own hunting grounds shortly after reaching majority.
rows.translation:
翼龙是一种需要通过产卵进行繁殖的生物，它们遵循典型的有性繁殖方式。由于它们天性独居且具有领地意识，因此翼龙很少会彼此交配；相反，它们通常会在自己居住的山脉周边地区，从当地的生物群体中“寻找”配偶。它们的毒咬在这一过程中起到了至关重要的作用：一旦咬住猎物，就能防止其逃脱；而对于雄性来说，这种毒咬还能确保它们在多次交配过程中保持僵硬的状态。

        翼龙雌性会将卵携带在体内大约一个月的时间，之后才会将它们产在巢穴中。一旦产下蛋，接下来六个月里就必须细心照料这些蛋，直到小幼崽破壳而出——那时它们还很小，没有毛发，也无法飞行。雌性翼龙在产蛋后不久就会开始分泌乳汁，通过这种方式喂养幼崽，这个喂养过程会持续六个月到一年，直到幼崽能够开始进食固体食物为止。
        
        年轻的翼龙会与母亲共同生活大约二十年，直到它们变得足够强壮且具备足够的生存能力，从而能够独立生活。与翼龙的近邻——鹰身女妖不同，翼龙并没有“群体意识”，通常在达到性成熟后就会离开母亲，去寻找属于自己的狩猎场。

rows.original: Wyverns have existed as long as anybody can remember, and probably long before that. The origins of their race are unknown, and before the Godswar put an end to much of civilization, was a topic of much debate among Belharan scholars.
rows.translation: 翼龙的存在，可以追溯到人类有记忆以来的很久以前，甚至可能更早。关于它们这一种族的起源，至今仍然是个未知之谜。在“神战”摧毁了大部分文明之前，这个话题一直是贝拉兰学者们热议的话题。
rows.raw:
"
        Wyverns have existed as long as anybody can remember, and probably long before that. The origins of their race are unknown, and before the Godswar put an end to much of civilization, was a topic of much debate among Belharan scholars.
        
        "

rows.original: Wyverns have no society or culture to speak of, as they are largely independent hunters and, as far as anybody knows, make no art or crafts of their own. On rare occasion, wyverns have been known to salvage weapons and armor from human settlements, or to inhabit ruins, but most simply rely on their natural physique and make their homes in caves and other natural formations.
rows.translation: 翼龙并没有真正意义上的社会或文化，因为它们基本上都是独立的猎手，据目前所知，它们也不会制作任何手工艺品。偶尔会有翼龙从人类聚居地那里捡拾武器和盔甲，或者栖息在废墟中，但大多数情况下，它们还是依靠自身的天然体魄，在洞穴或其他自然环境中筑巢安家。
rows.raw: "\n        Wyverns have no society or culture to speak of, as they are largely independent hunters and, as far as anybody knows, make no art or crafts of their own. On rare occasion, wyverns have been known to salvage weapons and armor from human settlements, or to inhabit ruins, but most simply rely on their natural physique and make their homes in caves and other natural formations."

rows.original: A dryad is a four-legged spirit of nature, not unlike cervine animals such as deer. Indeed, great racks of antlers sprout from each their heads in much the same fashion as a male deer, though sizes and shapes vary wildly. Their animalistic halves are covered in brown fur and their legs end in hooves, their humanoid halves sprouting from the front of their bodies. Skin color varies among each individual, much like many of the races of Savarra.
rows.translation: 树精是一种拥有四条腿的自然精灵，它们的外形与鹿等动物颇为相似。事实上，它们的头部都会长出巨大的鹿角，其形状和大小也会因个体而异，与雄鹿的鹿角颇为相像。它们的动物形态部分覆盖着棕色的毛皮，腿部也长有蹄子；而它们的人形部分则从身体前方长出。与萨瓦拉大陆上的许多种族一样，每个树精的皮肤颜色也都各不相同。

"
        A dryad is a four-legged spirit of nature, not unlike cervine animals such as deer. Indeed, great racks of antlers sprout from each their heads in much the same fashion as a male deer, though sizes and shapes vary wildly. Their animalistic halves are covered in brown fur and their legs end in hooves, their humanoid halves sprouting from the front of their bodies. Skin color varies among each individual, much like many of the races of Savarra.

        "

rows.original: |Not much is known about the sexual habits of the secretive dryads, the mere sight of which a rarity that occurs once every fifty years or so. Presumably, owing to the fact no males have ever been sighted, the hermaphroditic individuals breed with the females to produce offspring. rows.original: Almost nothing is known of the history of dryads save that they have been sighted and depicted in literature as well as paintings for many hundreds, possibly even thousands of years. It is likely they are long-lived, enduring as long as the forest they inhabit. [flags.DOIREANN_TALK|You've jotted down a little addendum. It's possible dryads are immortal as long as their sacred tree stays alive within their grove, and the likelihood of them being discovered as long as they don't deliberately reveal themselves is low. Some, of course, get curious — but you have to be invited to a grove to find it, presumably.]
rows.translation: 关于干尼亚德们的历史，人们所知甚少。只知道在数百年，甚至数千年的时间里，它们一直被人们看到，并在文学作品与绘画中被描绘出来。很可能它们具有很长的寿命，其生存时间与它们所栖息的森林一样长久。 [flags.DOIREANN_TALK|你写了一个小附录。 只要干女树的圣树在她的树林中存活，她就可能永生不灭；而只要她不主动暴露自己的存在，被人发现的可能性也相当低。当然，也会有一些人感到好奇——但想必，你必须被邀请进入那片树林，才能找到她。]

rows.original: [flags.GRAINNE_TALK_ALONE|Sadly, nothing is known of the undoubtedly spiritual culture of the dryads, nor of their society. We can only make guesses at whether they are so rare as to only appear once every few decades or whether they simply keep themselves hidden from outsiders at all times. You've made your own entry after talking to Grainne. Dryads form strong bonds with each other both romantic and platonic, befriending individuals from nearby forests and groves. Polygamous relationships are the norm due to the relative rarity of Seed-Blessed, with one hermaphrodite involving herself with many other females. Owing to the forest itself wanting to expand, the Seed-Blessed often has her hands full with her duties. An emphasis is placed on secrecy and hiding from the mortal races. You stopped writing here. You could go into further detail but maybe it's better that people don't know all of their secrets in the event your journal is ever lost and someone picks it up.|Sadly, nothing is known of the undoubtedly spiritual culture of the dryads, nor of their society. We can only make guesses at whether they are so rare as to only appear once every few decades or whether they simply keep themselves hidden from outsiders at all times.]

rows.translation: 树精

rows.original: Not much is known about the sexual habits of the secretive dryads, the mere sight of which a rarity that occurs once every fifty years or so. Presumably, owing to the fact no males have ever been sighted, the hermaphroditic individuals breed with the females to produce offspring. The birthing method is unknown, and conjecture is pointless when it comes to the matter of spirits. You've crossed out the previous information and updated it yourself after your conversation with Grainne. Dryads seem to be part of nature itself. Initially born from the desire of a forest to grow, they act as guardians and caretakers after coming into existence as fully-grown adults, deriving their knowledge from the forest itself. Reproduction takes place between a 'Seed-Blessed' dryad and another dryad, either a female or another Seed-Blessed. Seed-Blessed dryads possess male genitalia taken from the aspect of an animal, such as an equine or canine. A lot of mana has to be pooled together to induce the growth of a seed in the carrying dryad, and each one seems to have differing levels of fertility. You've continued your writing after your first-hand experience with the matter of dryad reproduction. The recipient of the Seed-Blessed's desires experiences a pooling of magic inside them until, as time passes, it coalesces into a singular seed. The seed can then be buried anywhere, though naturally the dryads prefer to bury it in their respective forests. In the far future — decades or longer, seemingly — the tree that grows can obtain a spirit of its own, becoming a dryad. Dryads can also, rarely, breed with non-dryads...
rows.translation: 关于这些神秘莫测的干尸精灵的性习，人们所知甚少。事实上，能够见到它们的机会极为罕见，大概每五十年才会出现一次。由于从未有人见过雄性干尸精灵，因此可以推测，这些雌雄同体的个体是通过与雌性交配来繁衍后代的。至于它们的生育方式，目前仍然是个谜；而对于涉及精灵这类超自然生物的话题，猜测也是毫无意义的。 你在与格兰妮交谈之后，将之前的信息划掉了，并自己进行了更新。 干树精似乎是大自然本身的一部分。它们最初源于森林生长的一种渴望，当真正成长成熟后，便成为了森林的守护者与管理者，它们所拥有的知识全都来源于这片森林本身。繁殖过程发生在一只“受神恩庇佑”的干树精与另一只干树精之间，后者可以是雌性干树精，也可以是另一只受神恩庇佑的干树精。这些受神恩庇佑的干树精拥有从动物身上获取的雄性生殖器官，这些器官通常来源于马或狗等动物。 需要汇集大量的魔力，才能促使承载种子的干树苗开始生长，而且每棵干树的繁殖能力似乎也各不相同。 在亲身体验了干树精繁殖的相关过程之后，你继续进行了相关的写作。 获得“种子祝福”的人，其体内会聚集魔力，随着时间的推移，这些魔力会凝聚成一颗独特的种子。这颗种子可以被埋在任何地方，不过自然地，树精们更喜欢将它们埋在自己的森林里。在遥远的未来——似乎需要几十年甚至更长的时间——从这颗种子生长出来的树木将会拥有自己的灵魂，从而变成一棵树精。 此外，树精们偶尔也会与非树精生物进行交配……

rows.translation: 哥布林

rows.original: "Goblins are one of the most peculiar races in all of Savarra, if simply for their natural variability. Their race's gift of sampling the traits of any other race they mate with has resulted in such a wide variety of physical features that it can sometimes be hard to identify a goblin on sight."
rows.translation: 哥布林是整个萨瓦拉地区最为奇特的神族之一，这主要源于他们与其它种族交配后所展现出的自然变异特性。他们的种族拥有这样的能力：在与其他种族交配时，会吸收对方的各种特征，因此他们的体型和外貌呈现出极其多样的变化，有时候甚至很难通过外观来辨认出哥布林的身份。
rows.raw: '\n        "Goblins are one of the most peculiar races in all of Savarra, if simply for their natural variability. Their race\'s gift of sampling the traits of any other race they mate with has resulted in such a wide variety of physical features that it can sometimes be hard to identify a goblin on sight." \n        '

rows.original: —Herodos Naso, Acclaimed Historian Name: Goblin (pl. Goblins) Sexes: Male/Female/See Reproduction Height: 3' to 4'6" on base specimens of the race Weight: 50 to 80lbs on average Skin: The majority of Goblins have skin of varying shades of green, ranging from yellow-green to a deep forest green. Hair: Goblin hair is normally roughly the same as a human's, though largely limited in natural color to blacks and browns. Eyes: Goblins' eyes tend to look similar to those of humans or elves. Ears: Goblins tend to have long, pointed ears that jut out from the side of their head. Lifespan: 40 to 60 years Maturity: 8 years
rows.translation: —赫罗多德·纳索斯，这位备受赞誉的历史学家 名称：哥布林（复数：哥布林们） 性别：男性/女性/详见繁殖系统介绍 身高：该种族的基线样本中，身高在3英尺到4英尺6英寸之间。 重量：平均体重在50到80磅之间 皮肤：大多数哥布林的皮肤呈现出不同的绿色色调，从黄绿色到深森林绿都有。 头发：哥布林的头发通常与人类的头发大致相同，不过其自然颜色主要局限于黑色和棕色。 眼睛：哥布林的眼睛通常与人类或精灵的眼睛相似。 耳朵：哥布林通常拥有从头部两侧伸出来的长而尖的耳朵。 寿命： 40到60年 成熟年龄： 8岁

rows.original:
Goblins are short, bipedal humanoids who inhabit Savarra. While the standard image of what makes a goblin a goblin—their height, skin coloration, and love of breeding—remains largely constant throughout the world, they're also prone to a larger variety of traits than just about any other race. As such, any description is more a generalization than a determining factor.

        Normal goblin females have relatively proportional hips and breasts that average around B-cup before any children are born, but both rapidly gain size, up to F cups and especially large hips after several sets of children. Male goblins are usually thin, if often fit, and have human-like penises, and generally follow the same phallus size range of humans.
rows.translation:
哥布林是一种身材矮小、双足行走的人形生物，他们居住在萨瓦拉地区。虽然哥布林的典型特征——他们的身高、肤色以及繁衍习性——在世界各地基本上都是一样的，但与其他种族相比，他们所具有的特征种类要丰富得多。因此，任何描述都更像是一种概括，而非决定性因素。

        普通的哥布林女性在生下孩子之前，她们的臀部与胸部的比例通常较为协调，胸围平均在B罩杯左右；但生下几个孩子之后，她们的胸部和臀部都会迅速变大，胸围可能会达到F罩杯，尤其是臀部会变得格外丰满。雄性哥布林通常体型瘦削，但往往肌肉结实，他们的阴茎与人类相似，其大小也通常处于与人类相同的范围内。

rows.original:
Goblins, much like harpies, frequently reproduce with members of other races, and those offspring always end up goblins. Unlike harpies, however, the goblin children with a parent of a different race may gain one or two of their non-goblin parent's racial traits, such as fur, genders beyond male and female, height, phallus type, and more. As such, many goblins will seek to reproduce with members of other races instead of those of their own. It's not uncommon for a goblin to stay with a mate out of a mix of love and a want to pass on as many different traits from the other parent as possible, though goblin/goblin pairings do occur and are generally the result of a love between the two.

        The usual gestation period for a goblin is three months, during which time the physical changes to the mother occur. Goblins tend to have one to two offspring at a time, with triplets being a rare occurrence often hailed as a sign of a particularly virile mate or a blessing from the gods.

        The raising of goblin children tends to fall upon the goblin parent, though this is not always the case. When the goblin parent remains with the other parent, or when both parents are goblins, for example, both parents are usually involved in the raising of the child, much as it would be for humans.
rows.translation:
哥布林与女妖类似，经常会与其他种族的成员交配，而他们的后代也总是哥布林。不过与女妖不同的是，那些父母中有一方属于其他种族的哥布林子女，可能会继承父母中非哥布林那一方的某些种族特征，比如毛发颜色、除了男性和女性之外的其他性别、身高、生殖器的形态等等。因此，许多哥布林会选择与其他种族的成员交配，而不是与同种族的成员结合。哥布林与伴侣在一起，往往既出于爱情，也为了尽可能地将对方种族的多种特征遗传给后代；当然，哥布林之间也会出现配对现象，而这些情况通常都是出于双方之间的爱情。

        哥布林的常规妊娠期为三个月，在此期间，母体会经历一系列生理变化。哥布林通常每次只生育一到两只幼崽，而三胞胎则属于极为罕见的情况，人们往往将这种现象视为雄性哥布林实力强健的象征，或是神灵的恩赐。

        通常情况下，抚养哥布林孩子的责任会落在哥布林父母身上，但也不总是如此。例如，当其中一位哥布林父母与另一位父母共同抚养孩子，或者当父母双方都是哥布林时，他们通常也会共同参与孩子的养育工作，这一点与人类的情况类似。

rows.original: While much of the history of the goblin race was lost during the Godswar, some records and accounts of their race prior to the fall remain. It is known that they joined the Belharan Empire at its peak and rapidly spread through the empire. The quick dissemination of goblins throughout Savarra helped increase the variance among goblins as they mated with new races and allowed them to survive the Godswar. They were able to join the remote communities that survived, or take residence in some of the less insular cities. Unfortunately, where they came from prior to the empire has been largely lost to history, a fact that irks many of the naturally curious goblins to no end and has resulted in a fair share of their people to go out and become varying forms of archaeologists in search of their histories.
rows.translation: 虽然在神战期间，哥布林种族的许多历史都遗失了，但仍然有一些关于他们在衰落之前情况的记录和描述。据记载，他们在贝拉兰帝国最鼎盛的时期加入了该帝国，并迅速在其境内扩散开来。哥布林们在萨瓦拉地区的迅速扩散，使得它们在与其他种族交配的过程中产生了基因变异，这也帮助它们在神战之中存活下来。它们既可以加入那些幸存下来的偏远社区，也可以定居在一些不太与世隔绝的城市中。不幸的是，这些哥布林在建立帝国之前的起源已经大部分被历史所抹去，这一事实让许多天生好奇的哥布林感到十分恼火，也因此有相当一部分哥布林开始投身于考古事业，试图寻找自己族群的起源与历史。
rows.raw:
"

It is known that they joined the Belharan Empire at its peak and rapidly spread through the empire. The quick dissemination of goblins throughout Savarra helped increase the variance among goblins as they mated with new races and allowed them to survive the Godswar. They were able to join the remote communities that survived, or take residence in some of the less insular cities. Unfortunately, where they came from prior to the empire has been largely lost to history, a fact that irks many of the naturally curious goblins to no end and has resulted in a fair share of their people to go out and become varying forms of archaeologists in search of their histories.
        
        "

rows.original:
Although goblins are an incredibly disjoint race, families of goblins still maintain remnants of their prewar culture, though what is remembered is often corrupted or differs from what is remembered by other groups of goblins that survived the Godswar. 

        Goblin families are typically ruled democratically, with each member voting on any large —or sometimes even medium—decisions that affect the family. That said, the oldest among them typically have the de facto power, with the others often following the motions of the elders they favor. Whenever members of other races join goblin families, the family typically attempts to assist the new member in getting used to this system of voting, but when a goblin joins another system, they're quick to adapt to the new family's way of life. 
        
        Goblins as a race tend to be naturally curious, resulting in a plethora of fields influenced by goblins. It's not uncommon to run into goblin alchemists, mages, and explorers, in addition to the aforementioned archeological tendencies.

        哥布林家族通常采用民主制度进行管理，家族中的每个成员都会对那些影响整个家族的重大决策——有时甚至是中等规模的决策——进行投票表决。不过，实际上最有发言权的是家族中最年长的人，其他成员往往也会追随他们所青睐的长辈们的意见。每当其他种族的成员加入哥布林家族时，这个家族通常会尽力帮助新成员适应这种投票制度。然而，当哥布林自己加入另一个种族的家族时，他们也能很快适应新家庭的生活方式。

rows.original: Because goblins take traits from non-goblin parents, families of goblins that have lived amongst another race will gradually take on more and more traits as generations pass. Because of this, it's not uncommon to see goblins with cat ears and a tail in Jassira or ones with scales and fin ears in Tyria, for example. Researchers have theorized that after long enough, goblins merge with the races around them, but thus far no proof of this happening is known to exist. Others believe that they'll end up diverging and becoming separate from both races.
rows.translation: 由于哥布林会从非哥布林的父母那里继承各种特征，因此那些与其他种族共同生活的哥布林家族，随着世代的更迭，会逐渐拥有越来越多的这类特征。正因如此，在贾西拉地区，我们经常会看到长着猫耳和尾巴的哥布林；而在泰瑞亚，则会看到那些长着鳞片和鳍状耳朵的哥布林。研究人员推测，经过足够长的时间，哥布林会与周围的其他种族融合在一起，但迄今为止，还没有任何证据能够证明这一现象确实存在。也有人认为，哥布林最终会与其他种族分道扬镳，成为完全独立的种族。

Most people seem to think Fusata bear a resemblance to the primates and great ape of the southern jungles and forests, but maybe it is the other way around. Regardless, the Fusata do share many similar features with the macaque that makes its home in both the north and south. Though similar to humans in many ways as well, fusata are normally much shorter than the average human. Their eyes are identical to humans, while their noses are normally flatter, their ears larger, and their faces in general more pronounced.

        Again, fusata genitals are identical to humans in almost every way aside from a slightly shorty average length in the penis and a more sizable foreskin. Female fusata possess smaller breasts than the average human of similar stature would.
        
        The fusata possess somewhat fur of a medium length that covers their limbs, sides, and backs. This fur is soft and an excellent insulator against cold and excess heat, and longer hair on the top of their heads.

rows.original:
Most Fusata hail from the north eastern country of Macah, which was once that seat of an empire that stretched eastward until Uni-uni, the twice blessed prince of Macah, halted the empire's expanse and left his throne to pursue 3 years of meditation. Uni-uni returned to his empire and ended its institution of slavery and pulled his military from his currently occupied countries. Uni-uni taught his new philosophy to his people which is still practiced to this day. 
        
        Macacian philosophy teaches discipline and respect to your fellow above all else, which is reflected in their society and government, especially in the Spring Order monkhood, a group of martial artists who strive for discipline and perfection in their bodies and pugilistic skills. No emperor has been crowned since Uni-Uni, instead, the All-Clans Council dictates important decisions that will affect Macah, with each participating clan sending a number of representatives to meet under the mediation of three judges. Macacian government has had a long standing tradition of having no term limits on public offices after the death of Uni-uni left the empire with no heir, but anyone who has held any position in the government to date has stepped down from power after three years.
        
        Surprisingly, the fusata have a phonetic language for which a written version was only recently invented. Fusata naming conventions are a good example of their language, normally consisting of a word once repeated. %"Uni," for instance, means snow, while %"Uni-uni" means fallen snow, and %"Uni-uni-uni" means fresh fallen snow, and so on.

        猕猴的哲学强调纪律性与对同伴的尊重，这一理念在他们的社会结构与政府体系中得到了体现，尤其是“春令僧侣”这一群体——他们是一群致力于追求身体素质与格斗技巧的完美化的武术家。自“Uni-Uni”事件之后，再也没有任何皇帝被加冕。相反，所有氏族组成的议会来决定那些会影响到Macah的重要事务，每个参与议事的氏族都会派出一定数量的代表，这些代表会在三位仲裁者的主持下进行讨论。自“Uni-uni”去世后，该帝国再也没有继承人，因此马卡西安政府长期以来一直保持着公共职务没有任期限制的传统。然而，迄今为止，所有在政府中担任过职务的人都在任职三年后主动辞去了权力。
        
        令人惊讶的是，富萨塔人使用一种只有最近才被发明出书面形式的音标语言。富萨塔人的命名规则就是这种语言的典型例子——通常由一个单词重复若干次构成。例如，“%Uni”表示雪，“%Uni-uni”表示落下的雪，“%Uni-uni-uni”则表示新落下的雪，以此类推。

rows.original: —Dragovic Flanders, Ancient Belharan General Name: Taeleer Sexes: Male and Female Height: Ranges from between 4'0" and 6", with males standing slightly larger than females. Skin: Taeleer have human-typical skin; additionally they grow soft, thick fur along their arms and legs. These dramatically smaller ears will perk, fall, wiggle and utilize various movements and behavioral tells to sync with a taeleer's emotion. rows.translation:
作为兔女郎与兔男的典型代表，泰勒尔人在外表上与人类毫无区别，除非人们注意到他们的毛皮和耳朵。无论是纤细的腰肢还是丰满的臀部，普通泰勒尔人的体型通常都符合人类的比例和特征。大多数泰勒尔体型纤瘦，四肢上覆盖着浓密的毛发，它们要么长着毛茸茸的尾巴，要么拥有球形、蓬松的尾巴。虽然所有泰勒尔都长着兔耳，但雌性泰勒尔在怀孕期间，臀部和大腿的脂肪会增多，这样它们的臀部就会变得更丰满，也更适合进行长时间的交配活动。由于它们与人类有着密切的联系，因此在已知世界范围内人类身上存在的许多特征，在当地的泰勒尔群体中也以不同的形式表现出来——比如各种肤色、眼色以及身体上的标记。尤其是那些类似人类的突起结构，其长度通常在1英尺左右，而阴囊的体积也大于平均水平，这些特征都进一步体现了它们更为强烈的性欲。许多泰勒尔在身体素质上远胜人类，它们的奔跑速度更快，跳跃能力也更强，有些泰勒尔甚至能够垂直跳跃达到10英尺的高度。

        虽然它们并不被视为完全不同的物种，但它们最显著的生理区别在于耳朵的长度。据说，这种最常见的特征其实源于它们懒散的生活方式——那就是短耳朵。这些耳朵又软又长，有时会垂到泰勒背部的中间位置，甚至会延伸到离地面几英寸的地方；而那些耳朵较短的泰勒，甚至会把耳朵绕在脖子上或腰间，这样在行走时就不会碰到东西了。它们耳朵的巨大体积和重量使得它们无法通过动作来表达情绪，或者这种表达效果极为有限。然而，短耳泰勒尔的耳朵长度可以达到一英尺，但通常也只有六英寸左右。这些体积小得多的耳朵会通过各种动作和姿态变化，来配合泰勒尔的情绪表达。与那些耳朵较长的同类不同，这些泰勒族的耳朵对触碰非常敏感。
        
        然而，异常情况下，有些泰勒尔出生时耳朵就会长得非常长，甚至会拖在地上。这是那些耳朵较软的泰勒尔家族中较为少见的体型缺陷。因此，耳朵较短的泰勒尔被认为更加健康，或者属于那些更为活跃的家族分支。

Slim to thick waists or plump butts to flush cunts, the common taeleer 's body can be commonly matched to human proportions and features. Most taeleer are lean-built and enjoy thick fur along the length of their limbs — sporting either brush or spherical-fluffy tails. While all taeleer have bunny ears, their women will often maintain pregnancy weights in their ass and thighs to make them thicker and suited to long breeding sessions. Their close connection with humanity, many of the traits found in humans across the known world pop-up in local groups of taeleer in the form of various skin tones, eye colors, and body markings; in particular, this showcases in various sizes of humanlike pricks out to the average of 1 foot and heavier-than-average ballsacks to facilitate their more ramped up libido. Many taeleer physically are superior to humans, with greater running speeds and a jump that allows some to leap vertically up to 10 ft. high.

        Although not considered a different species entirely, their most well-known divisionary physical trait is the difference in ear length. The most common trait is said to have originated from lackadaisical lifestyles: lop ears. Floppy and long, these ears can run to the middle of a taeleer's back or even all the way to inches above the ground — shorter taeleer have even been known to wrap their ears around their neck or waist to keep them from bumping into things as they walk. Their ears' massive sizes and weight make moving them with emotions minimal or not possible. Short-eared taeleer however can have their ears reach a foot in length but often they reach out six inches. These dramatically smaller ears will perk, fall, wiggle and utilize various movements and behavioral tells to sync with a taeleer's emotion. Unlike their longer eared cousins, many of these taeleer's ears are sensitive to the touch.
        
        Unusually, however, a taeleer can be born with ears so long that they drag. This is one of the few appearance defects found in floppy-ear families. Shorter eared taeleer as a result is considered more healthy or from more active lineages.

        "

rows.original:
Commonly believed to have been part of the expression "breeding like rabbits," taeleer enjoy a promiscuous and well-established libido a notch above standard humans. Coupled with a common attraction to become adventurers — and their ancestral history as pleasure slaves — young taeleer will actively hook up with fellow adventuring taeleer and other races to keep this under control. Many communities featuring adventurers that pass through or even retire find themselves stacked with handfuls of taeleer that normally knocked up a partner and settled down to raise their children. As one might expect, a taeleer is highly compatible with other races, allowing many "half-taeleer" to be born.

        A taeleer pregnancy — as the mother — often lasts 6 months and will commonly result in twins or triplets when between two taeleer. An interspecies coupling will result in twins rarely but never triplets; barring goblin pregnancies and races that generate litters, this has been consistently proven. Pregnancies for taeleer women are exhausting but relatively safer than other species, thanks to their stronger lower body. Their pregnancy attributes have led to taeleer becoming prominent surrogate parents and greatly desired for rebooting populations in the waning periods of wars or disaster.
        
        Childhood is traditionally standard in comparison to humans for a taeleer; the sole exception is that puberty and their budding leg strength causes them to become profoundly more active. Many taeleer parents call this the "jump-off point," as non-taeleer parents are grieved at the sight of their children launching themselves into the air when happy, flopping over when they get a nice gift, or crashing into things before bouncing away while playing. Various scholars associate this in comparison to a "rabbit binky," observed in the wild when younger rabbits simply throw themselves around in joy. This is the highest recorded reason that interspecies relationships end, as the non-taeleer parent doesn't find this normal or acceptable whilst most taeleer simply consider it as "kids being kids." Oddly enough, taeleer do not find it mocking but rather a testament to their streaks of happiness. Suffice to say, this commonly betrays when they have their first sexual experience.
rows.translation:
人们普遍认为，泰勒族这一种族与“繁殖如兔子”这一说法有关，他们确实拥有远超普通人类的强烈性欲。再加上他们天生就喜欢冒险，以及他们祖先曾作为享乐奴隶的生活经历，年轻的泰勒族们往往会主动与其他冒险者或其他种族的人发生关系，以此来控制自己的欲望。许多以冒险者为主体的社区中，那些曾经在这些社区中生活过或最终选择在这里安家的冒险者们，往往都会拥有几位伴侣。这些伴侣通常会与冒险者结为伴侣，共同生活并抚养孩子。正如人们所预料的那样，泰勒族人与其他种族之间具有很高的兼容性，因此也诞生了许多“半泰勒族人”。

        泰勒人的妊娠期——作为母亲来说——通常持续6个月，而且当两次妊娠间隔时间较短时，很可能会生下双胞胎或三胞胎。而跨物种之间的结合则很少会产下三胞胎，但绝不会生下双胞胎；除非是哥布林的妊娠情况，或者某些会一胎多产的种族，否则这一规律始终得到了验证。对于泰勒女性来说，怀孕会让人感到非常疲惫，但得益于她们更强壮的下半身，这种怀孕过程相对其他物种来说要安全一些。正是由于这些生理特点，泰勒女性成为了理想的代孕者，在战争或灾难导致人口锐减的时期，她们更是被人们迫切需要，用来帮助恢复人口数量。
        
        对泰勒人来说，他们的童年阶段通常与人类相似；唯一的例外是，青春期的到来以及他们逐渐发展的腿部力量使得他们变得异常活跃。许多泰勒人的父母将这一阶段称为“成长起点”，因为非泰勒人的父母看到自己的孩子开心时会跳到空中，收到礼物时会兴奋地乱蹦乱跳，或者在玩耍时撞到东西后又弹开，往往会感到十分困惑。许多学者将这一现象比作“兔子们的欢闹行为”——在野外，幼小的兔子们常常会开心地蹦跳玩耍。事实上，这正是导致物种间关系破裂的最常见原因：那些不属于“泰勒族”的动物父母认为这种行为并不正常、不可接受，而大多数“泰勒族”动物则认为这只是“孩子们在玩耍罢了”。说来也怪，泰勒族并不认为这是一种嘲笑，反而认为这是他们幸福生活的证明。可以说，这种情况通常发生在他们第一次经历性行为的时候。

rows.original:
Originating in the land of Taelia near the heart of the long-defunct Belharan Empire, taeleer were one of the first races to fall into servitude beneath ancient humans. Many suggest they may have been far more animalistic but their softness and number made them ideal for the fledgling empire's expanding borders to turn into pleasure slaves, scouts, and personal servants. Regardless of whether or not you subscribe to this idea, taeleer were enslaved until the collapse of Belhar. Taelia itself remained as part of its remnants for centuries with many taeleer residing deep within the heart of the nation with no other options of their own. It wasn't until a group of taeleer on the fringes of Taelia left their nation behind that the first lop-eared taeleer showed up in the fledgling and the much smaller nation of Taelineya. A war broke out between the two for a short time but ultimately ended when Taelia and Taelineya brokered a peace to combat the other successors of Belhar. Their bloody war sounded one of the first disgraces of the failing Belhar in what led to the creation of the modern Tael Alliance with both kingdoms promising their military might to both defend and retaliate against any who would enslave them.

        Since those days, modern taeleer are often proud of both nations and seen across most of the known world. Though the Tael Alliance is old, taeleer often consider it young in comparison to less modern and more ancient lands such as those still claiming to be Belhar or its servant states. Swathes of taeleer searched for something to do with their newfound respect but many still turned to become brothel owners; this all changed when a century ago the Tael Alliance created the Taelian Adventurer's Guild. In almost one-hundred years, countless taeleer have set off taking on fantastical adventures and expeditions to help various races both explore and chart the world. Many new maps — rather than ancient ones long-established and maintained since Belhar's collapse — are the product of a taeleer-escorted researcher's work. Though their history was more based in laying on their backs and tending to the interests of Belhar, their name drifts faster and faster toward one of respect.
rows.translation:
泰勒人起源于早已灭亡的贝尔哈兰帝国中心附近的泰利亚地区。他们是最早沦为古代人类奴役的种族之一。许多人认为，他们可能原本更具动物性，但由于他们性格温顺且数量众多，因此非常适合这个新兴帝国用来扩充边疆势力——他们可以被用作享乐奴隶、侦察兵或私人仆从。无论你是否认同这一观点，泰勒人在贝尔哈尔帝国崩溃之前一直处于被奴役的状态。泰利亚本身也在帝国的残余势力中存续了几个世纪，许多泰勒人被迫生活在国家的中心地带，他们没有其他选择。直到一群来自泰利亚边缘地区的泰勒人离开自己的国家，第一批长着短耳朵的泰勒人才出现在这个新兴的、面积较小的国家——泰莱尼亚。两国之间爆发了一场短暂的战争，但最终在泰利亚和泰莱尼亚的调解下达成了和平协议，以便共同对抗贝尔哈尔的其他继承者。他们那场血腥的战争，堪称贝尔哈尔帝国衰落过程中的首批耻辱之一。正是这场战争，促使现代的泰尔联盟得以成立——两个王国都承诺会动用自己的军事力量，来防御任何企图奴役他们的敌人，并对那些侵略者进行反击。

        从那时起，现代的泰勒人常常为自己的国家感到自豪，他们的身影也出现在已知世界的大部分地区。虽然泰勒联盟历史悠久，但与那些仍自称为贝尔哈尔或其附庸国的、更为古老、不够现代的地区相比，泰勒人往往认为自己的联盟还属于年轻的一派。许多泰勒人试图寻找与这种新获得的尊重相称的方式来度过自己的生活，但仍有很多人选择成为妓院的老板。然而，这一切在一个世纪前发生了改变——当时泰勒联盟创立了泰勒冒险者协会。在过去的近一百年里，无数泰勒人踏上了奇幻的冒险之旅，帮助各种种族探索并绘制世界的地图。许多新的地图，并非源自那些自贝尔哈尔灭亡以来就一直存在并得到维护的古老地图，而是由在泰勒尔的保护下进行研究的学者们创作出来的。虽然这些新地图的诞生初衷更多是服务于贝尔哈尔的利益，但它们的名字却逐渐被人们赋予了更多的尊重与意义。

rows.original:
Culture to taeleer is often a direct mirror of Belhar but their societies and minor communities are family driven — parents enjoy pumping out kids regardless of the amount and almost always want to live in big hovels. One of the few cultural enigmas as a result of this was the creation of burrows in Taelineya when the lop-eared taeleer wanted to make the most out of their flat spaces — by digging down. A burrow or home's safety and well-being are highly valued by taeleer that settle down and as a result, many taeleer will choose to never move once they've found and lived somewhere long enough. This leads to them being highly nomadic and trying to find a "perfect home" to attract others.

        Taeleer may not be too difficult or different than their ex-masters but many of them have found these little differences and are proud to be taeleer. Prides in their features and their decisions can lead to them being either a source of profound good in their communities or a source of disaster; it's simply a matter of ensuring a taeleer has a nice home and kids to keep them busy.
rows.translation:
泰勒人的文化往往直接反映了贝尔哈尔的文化特征，但他们的社会结构以及各个小型社区都以家庭为单位进行运作——父母们总是不遗余力地生育子女，而且几乎总是希望居住在宽敞的大房子里。因此，由此产生的一种文化现象就是：在泰莱尼亚地区，那些耳朵短小的泰勒人为了充分利用那里平坦的地形，便开始挖掘洞穴来居住。对于那些选择定居下来的泰勒尔来说，洞穴或家园的安全与舒适性至关重要。因此，许多泰勒尔一旦找到了合适的居住地并在此生活了足够长的时间，就会选择永远不再搬家。这也使得它们具有很强的迁徙习性，总是试图寻找一个“完美的家园”来吸引其他同类。

        泰勒尔或许并不比他们的前主人们更难相处，或者有太多不同之处，但许多人正是注意到了这些细微的差别，才会为自己是泰勒尔人而感到自豪。这种对自身特点与决策方式的骄傲，有时会让他们成为社区中带来巨大益处的力量，有时却也会酿成灾难；关键就在于要确保每个泰勒尔人都能拥有一个温馨的家，以及一些事情让他们忙碌起来。

rows.original: Something else ejaculated from Queen Alissa's breast, straight into Kasyrra's waiting hand. It was small and smooth, not much bigger than my thumb, a beautiful pink gem that glistened in the light. "Oh! That was fast," Kas chuckled, curling her fingers around the gem and turning her full attention down to Alissa as the elf began to... to change. "I really thought you'd hold out a while longer. Disappointing."

rows.original: The legends about demons painted them as black, oily, formless beings of nightmare; shadows drawing forth from the abyss, the void between worlds. Yet the things calling themselves demons now? They're nothing like the legends! The first of them we encountered was Kasyrra, their so-called new queen: a statuesque crimson woman with traits mixing bovine, dragon, and fiend. She appeared to [pc.name] alone, tearing her way into our world through the portal in Hawkstone's temple... the same one my sister was flung through moments before. She'd almost be beautiful if it wasn't for the black pit in her heart where her soul ought to be. Kasyrra was the first and only of her kind in Savarra for a time, but now that we've seen what she did to Alissa... how many more broken souls has she torn from people? There will only be more demons across the Marches as we progress. One more reason we have to stop them! After seeing Queen Alissa's transformation, there's clearly no consistent way to identify a demon... Kasyrra and her broken elven queen were wholly different beasts, though both were cloven-legged and had tails and horns. It seems evident that there's quite a bit of variety in what constitutes a demon's physical form. We can't be complacent in assuming we understand what demons look like... they may even be shapeshifters, as they can clearly change other peoples' bodies!
rows.translation: 关于恶魔的传说将它们描绘成那些漆黑、油腻、形态不清的噩梦生物——仿佛是从深渊、从世界之间的虚无中涌现出来的阴影。然而，如今那些自称为恶魔的生物，却与那些传说中的形象毫无相似之处！我们遇到的第一个这样的生物，就是他们所谓的“新女王”卡希拉：一个身材高挑、皮肤呈深红色的女人，她的容貌中融合了牛、龙以及恶魔的特征……她出现的时候[pc.name]独自一人，穿过霍克斯通神庙中的传送门，闯入了我们的世界……正是同一个传送门，我的姐姐也在不久前被强行送到了那里。 如果她的心中没有那个应该容纳她灵魂的黑色空洞，她几乎可以说是美丽的。 卡希拉曾是萨瓦拉地区唯一一个这样的存在，但如今我们看到了她对艾莉莎做了什么……她还夺走了多少人的灵魂？随着我们的行动不断推进，边境地区的恶魔只会越来越多。这就是我们必须阻止他们的另一个原因！ 在目睹了艾莉莎女王的变化之后，我们显然已经无法用任何固定的标准来识别恶魔了……卡希拉和她那已经堕落的精灵女王，完全是两种截然不同的生物，尽管她们都长着分趾蹄、尾巴和角。显然，恶魔的外形形态有着相当大的多样性。我们绝不能自以为已经了解了恶魔的真实样子……它们甚至可能具有变形能力，因为它们显然能够改变自己的外形。其他人民团体！

rows.original:
It seems that demons don't reproduce naturally. Kasyrra herself, and all her victims too, birth imps when impregnated — apparently they're some form of degenerated life form, what happens when a child's born without a soul. So much for the stories about vampires dad used to tell me! I think I'd have preferred spirit-sucking beautiful psychopaths instead, though, because imps are just horrid little balls of lust that attack damn near anything dick-first! Gathering evidence from Kasyrra's actions and words, it would seem that even two demons breeding together don't result in more of their kind.
        
        So how does the Corruption spread? Well, dear reader, it seems to do so in a truly corrupted fashion of course! It appears that demons create more of their own kind by causing such overwhelming physical pleasure (doubtless coupled with acute moral decay or an outright mental break!) in a victim, which in turn causes the soul to violently ejaculate itself from the body, forming a pinkish crystal. I've heard them be called soul-stones in lore, but I thought such things were only made from the departed souls of great beasts and dragons! 
        
        The departure of the soul from the body seems to cause immediate mutation, turning the soulless husk into a demon. The new being is granted an immense boost of physical and magical power, though it likely takes some time to manifest judging for Regent Etheryn's dealing with her demon-ified sister with a few well-placed arrows! Personality and memory seem to survive the process, though empathy and compassion are almost entirely purged. 
        
        Can Kasyrra even comprehend the damage she's causing — the lives she's ruining? Only Mallach knows.
rows.translation:
看来恶魔并不会通过自然方式繁衍后代。卡希拉本人，以及她所有的受害者，在受孕后都会生下小恶魔——显然，这些小恶魔是一种退化的生命形态，它们就是那些没有灵魂的婴儿。原来那些关于吸血鬼的故事都是我爸爸编出来的啊！说实话，我反而更喜欢那些会吸走人灵魂的美丽心理变态者呢，因为那些小妖精简直就是一群充满欲望的可怕生物，它们会不加选择地攻击任何东西！从卡希拉的行为和言语中收集到的证据来看，似乎即使是两只恶魔交配，也不会产下更多的同类。
        
        那么，这种“腐败”究竟是如何传播的呢？亲爱的读者，显然，它的传播方式本身就充满了腐败与堕落！看来，恶魔是通过带来极其强烈的肉体快感来繁衍后代的——而这些快感无疑伴随着严重的道德沦丧，甚至可能是精神上的崩溃！这种力量会侵入受害者的身体，从而导致灵魂猛烈地从体内脱离，形成一颗粉红色的晶体。在传说中，这些晶体被称为“灵魂之石”，但我原本以为这种东西只能由那些伟大的野兽和巨龙的逝去灵魂形成的啊！ 
        
        灵魂离开身体后，似乎会立即发生变异，使得这个失去灵魂的空壳变成恶魔。这种新的存在会获得巨大的身体力量和魔法能力，不过从瑞金特·伊瑟琳用几支精准射出的箭来对付她变成恶魔的妹妹这一情况来看，这些能力可能需要一段时间才能完全显现出来！似乎性格和记忆在这一过程中能够得以保留，但同情心和怜悯心却几乎完全消失了。 
        
        卡希拉是否能够意识到自己正在造成的伤害，以及自己正在毁掉多少人的生活？只有马拉克知道答案。

rows.original:
Impossible to tell! We know they come from another world... I believe Kasyrra called her home plane "Mareth," whatever that is. It must be some kind of hellscape to breed creatures such as she. 

        I have to wonder how long demons like Kasyrra have been around. Forever? I don't know... the demons of legend are so different than she is. Even first-hand accounts from the Godswar, rare as they are, paint such a radically different picture. I wish I had access to the Great Temple's library. Perhaps the lords of Tychris or Khor'minos might have better access to information, if I can get access to their palaces. But even then, reliable information about the demons of the Godswar is rare indeed.
rows.translation:
根本无法判断！我们知道它们来自另一个世界……我记得卡希拉把她所在的母星称为“玛瑞斯”，不管那到底是什么地方。能孕育出像她这样的生物，那里肯定是一片地狱般的景象。

        我不禁想知道，像卡希拉这样的恶魔究竟存在了多久。永远吗？我不确定……传说中的那些恶魔与她截然不同。即便是来自《神战》的第一手资料，尽管这些资料极为罕见，所描绘的画面也与她完全不符。真希望我能使用大圣殿的图书馆。如果我能进入提克里斯或科尔米诺斯的宫殿，或许那些贵族们能掌握更多信息。但即便如此，关于神战恶魔的可靠情报也实在十分稀少。

rows.original:
I'm not sure demons have a culture, per se, though Kasyrra has repeatedly mentioned some kind of original Demon Queen in Mareth. Are there demon courts and castles somewhere? They must overflow with sexual effluvia if so... I can't imagine demons like Kasyrra being able to maintain a society beyond constant orgy and excess. Even Mallach understands that moderation is a virtue. One mustn't overindulge in her passions, lest corruption invariably take hold.

        Wait, was Mallach talking about demons? Did the Lord of Song know, even centuries ago...? 
        
        Maybe our demons and Mareth's aren't so different after all.
rows.translation:
我不确定恶魔是否真的拥有某种文化，不过卡希拉确实多次提到过玛瑞斯有一位原始的恶魔女王。那么，恶魔是否也有自己的宫廷和城堡呢？如果有的话，那里肯定充满了各种淫秽的气息吧。我无法想象像卡希拉这样的恶魔能够维持一个不是充斥着无节制的行为与放纵的社会。就连马拉赫也明白，节制是一种美德。人不能过分沉溺于自己的欲望之中，否则腐败必将随之而来。

        等等，马拉克是在谈论恶魔吗？难道“歌之主”在几个世纪前就已经知道了这件事……？
        
        也许，我们的恶魔和马雷斯的恶魔其实并没有那么大的区别。

rows.original: —Unknown manticore to Lady Avara, as reported by her disgraced squire ] Name: Manticore (pl. Manticores) Sexes: Female and Hermaphrodite Height: Ranges between 7 ft. and 9 ft. Weight: Manticores have more densely-packed muscle than humans, due to their size and the strength needed to carry them aloft. Some specimens can weigh up to 350lbs of sheer muscle and fluff. Skin: Manticores have typical human skin over a good deal of their bodies. They generally tend to be fair to tanned in appearance. Hair: While having the same pattern of hair as humans atop their heads, manticores also have a layer of soft, downy fur on their lower arms and legs, as well as thick fuzz above the cleavage, ringing the shoulders like a cloak's trimmings. As with many venomous species, however, manticores can have a range a bright coloration to warn of their potency, with hues ranging from a white-pink to blazing red. Eyes: Manticores have dangerous-looking slitted felinid eyes, typically red, yellow, or gold. However, there have been cases of pink or even sunburst irises that have been seen among their kind. Ears: Large, fluffy cat ears adorn the top of their heads, typically with large, fluffy tufts protruding from their centers. Reportedly, they're extremely sensitive, but few have dared to make the attempt at confirming this rumor. Lifespan: Around 100 years. Maturity: 5 years.

rows.original:
Manticores are an extremely tall and universally feminine race of arrogant amazons that seem to have at the same time features of a great cat, a scorpion, a bat, and a human female. Each towers above most races, and their sexual dichotomy exists solely of females and hermaphrodites. While possessing humanoid upper torsos and upper extremities, the similarity ends there. Their oversized forearms and lower legs are covered in thick layers of fur, their hands and feet adorned with supple, leathery pads, and where fingertips and toes should be, there are instead deadly daggerlike retractable claws that make a distinctive %"snikt" sound when splayed.

        On top of these intimidating features, great batlike wings sprout from their backs, allowing for quick and agile flight that lets them easily outmaneuver the rare creature that can't be felled by their wicked claws. The final odd feature that sets them apart from other races is a long, plated scorpion-like tail that sprouts just above their chiseled rears. However, strangely, instead of ending in a stinger, the end appears to be a fleshy peach. This secondary sexual orifice produces extremely potent pheromones which allow the manticore to easily bring even the strongest-willed foes quivering to their knees.
rows.translation:
蝎狮是一个身高极高、且完全由女性组成的种族，这些傲慢的女战士们同时拥有猫、蝎子、蝙蝠以及人类女性的特征。她们中的每一个都比其他大多数种族的人都要高大，而这个种族也只存在女性和雌雄同体两种性别形态。虽然它们的上半身和上肢与人类相似，但相似之处仅此而已。它们过长的前臂和下肢覆盖着厚厚的毛发，手和脚上长有柔软的皮质垫状物，而原本应该是手指和脚趾的地方，却长着致命的、像匕首一样的可伸缩爪子，当这些爪子张开时，会发出特有的“嘶尼克”声。

        除了这些令人畏惧的特征之外，它们背部还长着巨大的蝙蝠状翅膀，这使得它们能够快速而灵活地飞行，从而轻松避开那些无法被它们锋利的爪子击倒的稀有生物。最后一个使它们与其他种族区分开来的奇特特征，是那条长而带甲的、类似蝎子的尾巴——这条尾巴正好生长在它们棱角分明的臀部上方。然而，奇怪的是，它的末端并非刺状，而像是一块多肉的桃子。这个第二性征器官能够释放出极其强烈的信息素，使得蝎狮能够轻易地让那些意志最为坚定的敌人也屈服投降。

rows.original:
Manticore copulation happens much the same as humans, with the caveat of hermaphroditic members of their race being able to both be the dam and the sire. However, reproduction itself is much accelerated as compared to the race of Man. Pregnancy lasts a mere three months, where afterwards the mother births a live young manticore.

        The race seems to breed true, a fact that fuels their natural arrogance even further. No true half-breed has ever been reported, with the spawn simply taking minor characteristics of the non-manticore parent instead, such as eye, skin, or hair color. Manticore children also grow up nearly four times faster than the human norm, and children raised outside of a manticore harem have been observed to have an innate grasp of combat and pride, speculated by scholars to be a type of hereditary instinct. Thankfully, it seems manticores have a rather low fertility and are sparse as a rule, else the world would quickly be threatened by a race of fiery amazonian she-beasts bent on collecting expansive harems.
rows.translation:
蝎狮的交配过程与人类大致相同，只不过该种族中的雌雄同体个体既可以担任雌性角色，也可以担任雄性角色。不过，与人类相比，它们的繁殖速度要快得多。妊娠期仅持续三个月，之后母体便会产下一只活生生的小蝎狮兽。

        这种生物似乎具有稳定的遗传特性，这一事实进一步加剧了它们与生俱来的傲慢。迄今为止，从未有过关于半血后代的报道；那些所谓的“半血后代”只不过是非蝎狮兽父母的一些次要特征在后代身上得到了体现，比如眼睛、皮肤或头发的颜色而已。蝎狮族的孩子成长速度也是人类正常速度的近四倍，而那些在蝎狮后宫之外长大的孩子，被观察到天生就具备战斗能力和自豪感。学者们推测，这种特性可能属于一种遗传本能。幸运的是，蝎狮似乎繁殖能力较低，数量也相对稀少，否则这个世界很快就会受到这些热衷于组建庞大后宫的火红亚马逊雌性野兽的威胁了。
rows.raw:
"
        Manticore copulation happens much the same as humans, with the caveat of hermaphroditic members of their race being able to both be the dam and the sire. However, reproduction itself is much accelerated as compared to the race of Man. Pregnancy lasts a mere three months, where afterwards the mother births a live young manticore.

        The race seems to breed true, a fact that fuels their natural arrogance even further. No true half-breed has ever been reported, with the spawn simply taking minor characteristics of the non-manticore parent instead, such as eye, skin, or hair color. Manticore children also grow up nearly four times faster than the human norm, and children raised outside of a manticore harem have been observed to have an innate grasp of combat and pride, speculated by scholars to be a type of hereditary instinct. Thankfully, it seems manticores have a rather low fertility and are sparse as a rule, else the world would quickly be threatened by a race of fiery amazonian she-beasts bent on collecting expansive harems.

        "

rows.original: Perhaps the most odd part of this august race is their almost non-existent history. While there have been pictograms found from the oldest civilizations depicting manticore women stealing men and women away from their homes, manticores have never founded great cities or created their own tongue. Rather, they seem content to live out their long lives collecting lovers and trinkets, and ignoring the world at large. Perhaps their very nature of isolationism is to blame, as they do not seem to enjoy the company of their fellows.
rows.translation: 或许这场庄严的竞争中最奇怪的一点，就是它们几乎没有任何历史记载。虽然人们在最古老的文明遗迹中发现了描绘蝎狮女性将男女从家中劫走的象形图，但蝎狮人从未建立过伟大的城市，也没有创造出属于自己的语言。相反，它们似乎乐于过上这样的生活：漫长的寿命中不断寻找伴侣和收集小玩意儿，而对周围的世界充耳不闻。或许，这种与世隔绝的天性才是原因所在，因为它们似乎并不喜欢与其他同类为伴。

rows.original: Manticores are individualists in the extreme, being that when they come of age, they gleefully abandon their mother's nests and seek out territory of their own. Indeed, adventuring heroes have defeated powerful manticores whose nests contained near 200 harem members, none of which have been other members of her race. Any recordings of manticores being sighted together outside of a mother/daughter coupling have just been ones of violence and strife, where one will beat the other into the ground. However, it seems no manticore has ever been seen killing another, simply throwing the cowed victor out of her territory with threats of worse punishment should she ever return. It seems manticores are a violently territorial race, with members of other races seen as simple playthings and sources of amusement, and members of their own as annoying threats to their domain.
rows.translation: 蝎狮是极端意义上的个体主义者，一旦成年，它们就会高兴地离开母亲的巢穴，去寻找属于自己的领地。事实上，一些勇敢的冒险者曾经击败过那些巢穴里居住着近200只雌性蝎狮的强大个体，而这些雌性蝎狮的伴侣，无一例外都是同种的成员。迄今为止，所有关于雌雄双角兽在非配对状态下共同出现的记录，都显示着它们之间的暴力与争斗——其中一方总会将另一方击倒在地。然而，似乎从未有人见过双角兽杀死另一只同类，它们只会将受惊的失败者赶出自己的领地，并威胁对方如果再敢回来，就会受到更严厉的惩罚。看来蝎狮是一个极具领地意识的种族，他们将其他种族的成员视为简单的玩物和娱乐对象，而将自己族群中的同类则视为对自己领地构成威胁的存在。

弥诺陶洛斯

rows.original: "A noble race if there ever was one. Great both in the bar and in the bedroom. But woe betide you if you ever find yourself facing one down on the battlefield."
rows.translation: 如果说有什么种族堪称高贵的话，那就是他们了。他们在战场上的表现同样出色，而在私生活方面也同样优秀。但是，如果你在战场上遇到了他们，那可就麻烦了。

rows.original: —Unknown Name: Minotaur (pl. Minotaurs) Sexes: Male, female. Height: Ranges from 6'0" to 8'8" (182 to 265 cm). Weight: Ranges from 180 lb to 480 lb (82 to 218 kgs). Hair: Various shades of brown, black, red, white, gray. Eyes: Blue, green, brown, hazel. Lifespan: 80 to 90 years. Maturity: 18 years.

rows.original:
As a race, minotaurs display obvious sexual dimorphism. The males possess far more bestial traits, the most prominent of which is their cow-like snout, often adorned with decorations such as a golden ring. Their bodies are far larger and more muscular than their female counterparts, affectionately termed 'cowgirls.' Whereas the men have a fur covering all over their bodies, the women have fur only on their tails, ears, and from the midpoint of their thighs downwards.

        Both sexes have full digitigrade legs which end in black hooves, horizontally oriented cow ears, horns of varying lengths, and a long, furred tail with a tuft at the end. The latter is often evident of their emotional state; when excited, the tail will appear quite animated. There are some important differences to note between the two sexes, as well — males sport the genitalia of equines, no doubt having had a common ancestor in the past, where the females have no such thing. They do, however, possess exceptionally fertile bodies.
rows.translation:
作为一种生物种族，弥诺陶洛斯存在明显的性别差异。雄性弥诺陶洛斯具有更为强烈的野性特征，其中最显著的就是它们那类似牛的鼻子，鼻子上通常会佩戴着金环之类的装饰物。与体型较小、肌肉不那么发达的雌性弥诺陶洛斯相比，雄性的身体要大得多，也更加健壮，而雌性弥诺陶洛斯则被人们亲切地称为“女牛仔”。虽然雄性动物的全身都覆盖着毛发，但雌性动物的毛发仅分布在尾巴、耳朵以及大腿中部以下的位置。

        雌雄两性都具有完全适应直立行走的腿部结构，腿的末端长有黑色的蹄子；它们的耳朵呈水平状；角的长短各不相同；而尾巴则很长，表面覆盖着毛发，末端还有一簇毛。后一种特征往往能反映它们的情绪状态；当它们兴奋时，尾巴会显得非常活跃。另外，雄性和雌性之间也存在一些显著的差异——雄性拥有类似马类的生殖器，这无疑说明它们在进化史上拥有共同的祖先；而雌性则没有这样的结构。然而，他们的身体确实具有极其强大的生育能力。

rows.original:
The body of a cowgirl is necessarily very robust, with wide hips to facilitate easy childbirths as well as extremely large breasts to ensure they can feed such large children. Minotaur infants are generally born one or two at a time, though as many as four has been recorded. Puberty is generally reached at ages ten to twelve, during which both sexes experience periods of massive intermittent growth until they are in their late teens.

        Over time, the gargantuan size of minotaur penises relative to the vaginas of cowgirls has caused a shift towards extreme stretchiness to accommodate their counterparts. Additionally, a cowgirl begins lactating at some point after reaching sexual maturity — this acts as both a signal to males and as an impetus for her to begin breeding lest she have to milk herself. Many minotaur women act as wet nurses for others, as male children need an extraordinary amount of sustenance while they grow.
rows.translation:
牛仔女孩的身体必然非常结实，她们拥有宽大的臀部，这有助于顺利分娩；同时，她们的胸部也异常丰满，这样就能够为那些体型庞大的婴儿提供足够的奶水。弥诺陶洛斯婴儿通常一次只会出生一两个，不过也有记录显示一次会出生四个。通常在十到十二岁期间，青少年会进入青春期，在此期间，男女双方都会经历一段快速生长的阶段，这种生长会持续到他们十几岁末期。

        随着时间的推移，由于牛女郎的阴道相对于弥诺陶洛斯的阴茎来说体积较小，这种差异导致弥诺陶洛斯的阴茎逐渐发展出了极强的伸展能力，以便能够适应这种结构上的差异。此外，女牛仔在达到性成熟后的一定阶段会开始分泌乳汁——这一现象既是对雄性动物的信号，也促使她开始繁殖活动，否则她就不得不自己挤奶了。许多弥诺陶洛斯身的女子还会为其他幼崽担任奶妈，因为男婴在成长过程中需要摄入大量的营养物质。

rows.original:
At one time, minotaurs were a singular race of beast-like men and women. However, over a long period of raiding, breeding, and eventual mutual intermingling, a schism appeared. Two tribes split apart, one formed from the men of Khor'minos we know today and the human women with which they had taken as partners, and the other of beastwomen and the few human men that stayed with them. The underlying cause for minotaur men preferring interspecies partners has never truly been unearthed, though many theories have been put forth.

        Over a long period of time, cowgirls have gradually taken on some minotaur-like traits such as their legs, tails, and ears, but they remain mostly human in appearance. The men have remained mostly as they were according to records, though the same cannot be said for the men of the second, smaller tribe — which by now has diverged so entirely as to be called a separate species. After traveling, the minotaurs built their new home inside a mountain: Khor'minos.
        
        Settled roughly 570 years ago by the beastmen and their women, Khor'minos is now the home to almost the entire minotaur race. It has never suffered a successful invasion thanks to numerous tunnels and twisting mines by way of entry, and tensions between minotaurs and orcs remain high to this day.
rows.translation:
曾经，弥诺陶洛斯是一支由类人野兽组成的独特种族。然而，在经历了长时间的掠夺、繁衍以及最终的种族融合之后，这个族群内部出现了分裂。两个部落就此分离：其中一个部落由我们今天所熟知的科尔米诺斯地区的男性以及与他们结为伴侣的人类女性组成；而另一个部落则由那些野兽女性以及少数选择留在她们身边的男性人类构成。虽然有许多理论被提出，但牛女郎们为何更倾向于选择跨物种的伴侣，这一根本原因至今仍未被真正揭示。

        在漫长的进化过程中，牛女郎们逐渐形成了一些类似弥诺陶洛斯的特征，比如腿、尾巴和耳朵，但它们的外貌总体上仍然更接近人类。根据记录，那些男人们的样貌基本上没有发生变化，但第二个、规模较小的部落的情况却并非如此——那个部落已经发生了如此巨大的变化，以至于完全可以被视作一个独立的物种了。在经过长途迁徙之后，弥诺陶洛斯人在一座山中建立了他们的新家园：科尔米诺斯。
        
        大约570年前，兽人族与他们的女性成员在此定居，如今，科尔米诺斯已经成为几乎整个弥诺陶洛斯种族的家园。由于这里布满了众多的隧道和曲折的矿道，因此从未有过任何入侵者能够成功攻入这座城市。时至今日，弥诺陶洛斯族与兽人族之间的紧张关系依然十分激烈。

rows.original:
Khor'minos is largely monocultural, with minotaurs making up the vast majority of its inhabitants. However, they welcome newcomers to the bustling city and as a result, there is a large spread of differing races making up a diverse labor force and other non-essential positions. Religion is not nearly as uniform — a temple of each of the seven gods can be found within their city, with the majority of followers worshipping Lumia or Velun.

        The minotaurs are led by a king which as of this writing is King Kelsaz, third of his line. Naturally, due to their suitability to combat roles, the legions of Khor'minos are comprised almost entirely of minotaur men. It falls to the women to inhabit the upper echelons of society, taking positions of leadership and management to guide the minotaurs in academic and cultural pursuits.
        
        Minotaurs abide by the adage "it takes a village to raise a child." All children are raised in tight-knit groups, eventually splitting into gendered units to be taught the applicable trades. Men are taught to hunt and fight and women are taught to care for children as well as how to best grow into society's required roles. Both sexes are taught how to read and write, mathematics, and history during their schooling, with continuing private tutelage being the norm for the wealthy.
        
        Monogamy and polygamy are equally accepted among the minotaurs; it is not uncommon for a female to couple with multiple males or for a male to have a 'harem' of multiple females, though many pair and remain monogamous for life.
rows.translation:
科尔米诺斯基本上是一个单一文化的城市，其居民绝大多数都是米诺陶人。然而，他们热情欢迎新来者，因此这个繁华的城市中居住着许多不同种族的人，这些不同种族的人构成了多元化的劳动力队伍，也担任着其他各种非核心职位。在宗教信仰方面，这里的状况则远没有那么统一——在这座城市里，每一位七神都有一座寺庙，而大多数信徒都崇拜卢米娅或维伦。

        这些弥诺陶洛斯由一位国王领导，截至本文撰写时，这位国王是凯尔萨兹，他是这个世系的第三代君主。由于弥诺陶洛斯天生适合担任战斗角色，因此科尔米诺斯的军队几乎完全由男性弥诺陶洛斯组成。而女性弥诺陶洛斯则负责在社会的高层担任领导和管理职务，引导弥诺陶洛斯们在学术和文化领域取得发展。
        
        弥诺陶洛斯人遵循“养育一个孩子需要整个村庄的共同努力”这一传统。所有孩子都在紧密团结的群体中成长，随后会按照性别被分成不同的小组，以便学习相应的技能。男性被教导如何狩猎和战斗，而女性则被教导如何照顾孩子，以及如何更好地承担社会赋予她们的责任。无论男女，在接受基础教育期间都会学习读写、数学和历史知识；对于富人来说，私人辅导更是普遍存在的现象。
        
        在弥诺陶洛斯族中，一夫一妻制和一夫多妻制同样被接受；雌性与多只雄性结伴，或者雄性拥有多只雌性作为“后宫”，这种情况并不少见，不过也有很多个体选择终生保持一夫一妻的关系。

rows.translation: 弥诺陶洛斯
豺狼人

rows.original: "Nasty, stupid things. Don't let the fact that they're idiots fool you, though — gnolls may have tiny brains and thick skulls, but every ounce of their minds is crammed full of murderous thoughts. When they don't outright kill you, it's only so that they can rob you again. Best they stay on their side of the lake, and I intend to keep it that way."
rows.translation: 这些讨厌又愚蠢的家伙。不过，别被他们愚蠢的外表所迷惑——虽然这些豺狼人的脑子很小，头骨也很厚，但他们的脑子里满都是杀戮的念头。除非他们直接杀了你，否则他们只会为了再次抢劫你而留你一命。最好让他们待在湖的那一边，而我也会确保这一点。

rows.original: —Chief Taldahs Name: Gnoll (pl. Gnolls) Sexes: Male and Female Height: Ranges from between 5' and 5'5", with females standing slightly taller than males on average. Hunched postures, digitigrade feet and loping gaits often make them seem shorter than their actual body length; they could be quite a bit taller if they stood up straight. Weight: Gnolls are light compared to many other Marcher races. General range is from 100lbs to 130lbs. Skin: Gnolls are covered in a layer of pale to dark skin, and have a coat of tawny, golden fur over that. Their fur is often adorned with brown to black markings that vary by individual. It is said that no two gnolls have the same patterning. Their fur is often mangy and disheveled, and may be lacking in places over old scars or recent wounds. Hair: Being largely animalistic, gnolls do not have hair as humans do, but some do let the fur atop their head grow out a little. rows.original:
Gnolls are rabid, fast-breeding and quick-dying beastkin. Appearing like bipedal hyenas, they are generally, thin, bony and lanky, with what muscle they have wiry and stringy instead of thick. Muzzled and with paw-like hands and feet, these savage creatures generally settle in wide expanses with tall grasses; their preferred method of ambushing prey is to surround it in hiding and erupt from cover with little to no warning. Their dappled coats camouflage them well in foliage and grasses, lending further advantage to their surprise attacks.

        Gnolls inhabit much of the continent which Old Belhar once spanned, largely plaguing the heartlands; however, they have spread as far as they can in search of plunder and easy resources. Stationary banditry and mobile banditry are of little difference to them; they see all who are not their own and oftentimes even rival packs as suitable prey. Their thin, wiry bodies are made for hounding and passing without notice alike, and only the few prize specimens of their kind have the ability and circumstance alike to put on any sort of weight.
        
        Gnolls have an innate ability to simply not feel very much pain. They're certainly aware of their injuries and hurts, but it doesn't hinder them very much if they don't choose to be bothered with it. This isn't so much like a battle fury or adrenaline surge some warriors experience when confronted with injury or danger; it's more that their nerves are deadened when it comes to pain. Given this strange tolerance, it's unsurprising to find gnolls that fight on suicidally until their bodies finally give out, or for them to be walking around with wounds that would cripple someone of another race.
rows.translation:
豺狼人是一种狂暴、繁殖迅速且寿命短暂的兽人。它们外形类似两足鬣狗，通常体形瘦弱、骨骼突出、四肢细长，所拥有的肌肉也呈纤维状而非粗壮结实。这些凶残的生物通常栖息在长满高草的广阔地带，它们伏击猎物的惯用手段就是隐藏在周围，然后在毫无征兆的情况下突然发起攻击。它们那斑驳的外皮使它们在树叶和草丛中能够很好地进行伪装，这也为它们的突然袭击提供了更大的优势。

        豺狼人们占据了奥尔德·贝拉尔曾经统治过的这片大陆的大部分地区，主要在内地地区肆虐；然而，为了寻找掠夺物和容易获取的资源，它们也向更远的地方扩散开来。对于它们来说，固定驻地的强盗行为与流动性的劫掠行为并没有什么区别——只要不是同类的，甚至是那些与它们竞争的族群，都成了它们理想的猎物。它们那瘦长而坚韧的身体，既适合快速追逐，也适合悄无声息地移动；只有少数被列为珍品的个体，才具备增加体重的能力和条件。
        
        豺狼人天生就几乎感觉不到疼痛。他们当然能够意识到自己受到了伤害，但只要他们选择不去理会这些疼痛，这些伤害就不会对他们造成太大的影响。这与某些战士在面对伤害或危险时所产生的战斗狂怒或肾上腺素激增的感觉有所不同——对于豺狼人来说，他们的神经对疼痛已经变得麻木了。鉴于这种奇怪的耐受力，那些会拼命战斗直到身体彻底垮掉，或者带着那些会让其他种族的人瘫痪的伤势继续战斗的豺狼人，也就不足为奇了。

rows.original:
Usually, only the alpha female of a gnoll pack gets to breed; any of her daughters or sisters still in her pack will be hard-pressed to find a mate under the alpha's jealous eye. It's only when resources are absolutely abundant that other females get to breed, and even so the alpha will commandeer the lion's share of the goods for her own brood. The defining feature of a gnoll female's genitalia is the existence of a pseudopenis — an organ through which she engulfs a male's phallus and sucks out his seed. In terms of sexual acts, it's capable of being used in a similar fashion to the penis of other races, and females have been known to engage rivals in what can only be described as combative sex to establish dominance over the other.

        Gnolls will only breed when there are adequate resources to do so; not that they stop having sex in the meantime. Usually thin and wiry, a gnoll female has to accumulate a certain minimum of body fat before becoming fertile, and this usually coincides with some external factor that precludes resource availability, such as the seasons. Once successfully bred, the gestation is short, being about three months, and two to three gnoll pups may be born in a litter. The young grow quickly, are always hungry and must be constantly fed, even after being weaned.
rows.translation:
通常情况下，只有狼群中的阿尔法雌性才有资格繁殖；她那些仍留在狼群中的女儿或姐妹们，在阿尔法雌性的嫉妒目光下，几乎不可能找到配偶。只有当资源极其丰富时，其他雌性才有机会繁殖，但即便如此，阿尔法雌性也会将大部分资源据为己用，用来抚养自己的后代。雌性豺狼人的外生殖器的显著特征是存在一个假阴茎——这种器官使它们能够将雄性的阴茎吞入体内并吸出精液。在性行为方面，这种器官的使用方式与其他种族的阴茎类似。据观察，雌性豺狼人会与竞争对手进行一种可以称之为“争斗性性行为”的活动，以此来确立自身的支配地位。

        只有当资源充足时，豺狼人才会开始繁殖；不过在这段时间里，它们依然会进行交配活动。通常体型瘦弱而坚韧的豺狼人雌性，必须积累一定量的体脂才能具备生育能力，而这一时机往往恰好与某些导致资源匮乏的外部因素相吻合，比如季节的变化。一旦成功繁殖，妊娠期很短，大约为三个月，每胎可以产下两到三只幼崽。这些幼崽生长迅速，总是处于饥饿状态，因此即使断奶后也必须持续喂食。

rows.original:
Gnolls have been a constant menace throughout the continent for much of history, dating back to time immemorial. Packs primarily attempt to raid lone farmsteads and people living in seclusion, preferring targets that they can overwhelm with their numbers alone; other easy prey include small groups of travelers and merchants. Larger numbers are usually enough to dissuade gnolls from aggression, which shaped societal development in areas where gnolls were particularly rampant as people clustered together for protection.

        During the era of the Belharan Empire, a concerted effort was made to eliminate gnolls from imperial lands and make empty areas suitable for settlement. While the gnolls were as much, if not more ruthless than the imperials were, coordination, intelligence and superior equipment on the part of the latter soon saw the savage race mostly driven to the harsh wildlands on the edges of the empire. It would be a long time before the empire fragmented, leaving pickings on which the gnolls could once again feast.
        
        In the Marches, the land east of Lake Tarahugan in Harvest Valley is considered infested with gnolls, and marefolk and centaurs alike have shielded the local farmers from being preyed upon in exchange for sharing in the farmers' produce. With both parties now preoccupied with other matters, the ever-hungry gnolls have begun creeping in again and are up to their old shenanigans.
rows.translation:
在漫长的历史中，豺狼人一直是这片大陆上持续存在的威胁，其存在可以追溯到远古时代。这些群体通常会袭击那些孤立的农庄以及与世隔绝的居民，因为他们更倾向于选择那些能够凭借数量优势轻易击败的目标；此外，一些小型旅行队伍和商人也常常成为它们的猎物。通常，较大的数量就足以阻止豺狼人发动攻击，这种生存方式也影响了那些豺狼人肆虐地区的社会发展——人们为了寻求保护而聚居在一起。

        在贝尔哈兰帝国的时代，人们齐心协力地将那些豺狼人从帝国的领土上清除干净，将这些荒芜的地区改造成适合人类居住的地方。尽管豺狼人们和帝国军队一样残忍，甚至更为凶残，但帝国方面凭借着良好的协调能力、情报收集工作以及更先进的武器装备，最终将这些野蛮的种族逼迫到了帝国边境的荒凉地带。直到帝国分裂之后，豺狼人们才又得到了重新扩张领地、肆意破坏的机会。
        
        在边境地区，丰收谷中塔拉胡甘湖以东的那片土地被认为被豺狼人侵扰了。为了保护当地农民免受豺狼人的侵害，马人族和半人马族都与这些农民达成了协议——农民们愿意分享自己的农产品，作为交换，这些种族会保护他们免受豺狼人的攻击。然而现在，由于双方都忙于处理其他事务，那些永远饥渴的豺狼人们又开始悄悄逼近，重新开始他们的恶作剧了。

rows.original:
Gnolls typically live in packs of four to ten that may range about a claimed piece of territory or migrate in a nomadic fashion. Each pack is led by an alpha female, who serves as the matriarch; the rest consist of her mates, sons, and the few sisters or daughters who have yet to leave the pack. A gnoll female will typically strike out on her own at about the age of twelve to fourteen; if she has particularly impressed her mother, she may even take a couple of her mother's pack along to help her get started. Packs which meet often exchange young males to avoid excessive inbreeding, which is often unavoidable to some extent; nomadic gnolls often serve to transfer males between territorial gnoll packs. Larger packs may have two or three females as a whole, but who is matriarch is never in doubt.

        Gnolls are generally thought to be capricious and opportunistic — when there are no outsiders to prey on, gnoll packs often fall to infighting over limited hunting and gathering resources. Sometimes, a weak, injured or elderly alpha of a pack may face usurpation by a female relative dissatisfied with her lot; this is usually how gnoll packs change leadership, by dint of a daughter's matricide.
        
        Gnolls rarely produce their own tools, weapons, or other possessions; it's much easier to steal such items from others. They're able to create simple and crude versions of implements such as flint spears and knives, but little more than that. Pelts may be tied together with gut and sinew to form some protection against the elements, but gnolls prefer not to wear anything if they can get away with it. They create no permanent shelter, but are able to put together simple lean-tos in short order and seeking natural relief from the elements.
        
        Gnolls have their own language, which generally involves a lot of yipping, barking and grunting, but some particularly bright individuals — or at least, bright for gnolls — have learned small snippets of the Belharan trade tongue.
rows.translation:
豺狼人通常以四到十只为一群活动，它们可能会在某片领地内活动，也会以游牧的方式迁徙。每个群体都由一只雌性首领领导，她扮演着族长的角色；其余成员包括她的配偶、儿子们，以及那些尚未离开群体的姐妹或女儿们。雌性豺狼人通常在十二到十四岁左右开始独自行动；如果她让母亲特别满意，甚至可能会带上母亲的一些背包来帮助自己开始新的生活。经常相聚的部落之间会交换年轻的雄性豺狼人，以避免近亲繁殖——尽管在某种程度上这种现象难以避免。游牧生活的豺狼人群体往往起到了在不同领地之间的雄性豺狼人调配作用。较大的群体中可能一共有两到三只雌性个体，但谁才是群体中的首领，这一点从来都不会有疑问。

        通常认为，豺狼人是一种反复无常且机会主义生物——当没有外部猎物可供捕食时，豺狼人群体往往会因为有限的狩猎和采集资源而发生内斗。有时，一个体弱、受伤或年老的豺狼人首领，可能会遭到对其处境不满的雌性亲属的篡位；豺狼人群体的领导权更替，往往就是通过这种女儿弑父的行为来实现的。
        
        豺狼人们很少自己制作工具、武器或其他物品；从他人那里偷取这些东西要容易得多。他们虽然能够制造出一些简单粗糙的器具，比如燧石制的长矛和刀具，但也就仅限于此而已。毛皮可以通过内脏和肌腱绑在一起，以此来抵御自然环境的影响，但豺狼人们如果可以不穿任何东西的话，通常会选择不穿戴任何衣物。它们不会建造永久性的庇护所，但能够迅速搭建简单的遮蔽物，从而在自然环境中获得必要的保护。
        
        豺狼人有自己的语言，这种语言主要由各种吠叫、嗥叫和咕哝声组成。不过，也有一些特别聪明的豺狼人——至少在豺狼人的标准来看是聪明的——学会了少量贝尔哈兰商语。

rows.original: "For everything you take, give back something of equal value. For every prank you play, help in equal measure. For each favor you receive, repay it as soon as you can. This is the Law of Equivalent Exchange, which forms the basics of Reciprocity. It will keep you safe in an existence where you have to take from others to live."
rows.translation: 对于你所获取的一切，都要回馈同等价值的东西；对于你开的每一个玩笑，也要以同样的方式给予帮助；对于别人给予你的每一个帮助，都要尽快予以回报。这就是等价交换法则，也是互惠原则的基础。在这个你必须依靠从他人那里获取东西才能生存的世界里，这个法则会保护你的安全。

rows.original: —Keros Name: Kitsune Sexes: Male, female. Height: Ranges from 4'5" to 6'3". Weight: Ranges from 88lbs. to 176lbs. Hair: Various shades of yellow are most common, followed by orange, red and black. Gray and silver are rare, but exist. White is evidence of being high nobility; being either from the head or main branch families of the twelve Divine Houses. Eyes: Kitsune have slitted, vulpine eyes with black pupils. Green, blue, brown and gold are the most common colors encountered. Red irises and white pupils are uncommon and considered attractive. Ears: Two vulpine ears atop head, with some variation of size and shape. Often highly sensitive; in certain individuals, can be erogenous. Lifespan: 80 to 150 years. Kitsune with more tails tend to live longer. Those particularly favored by Keros can have much longer lifespans. Maturity: As per humans, 18 years.

rows.original:
Most kitsune look much like the average catfolk does, perhaps easily mistaken for one at a distance. Fox ears sit on top of their heads; these are capable of independent movement, and often continually twitch and swivel without any conscious input on their owner's part. Combine that with the fact that all of them have at least two fluffy fox tails, a number that only increases with age and ability up to a maximum of nine, and they tend to look not that much different from the races of beast-kin which inhabit Savarra.

        Kitsune tend to be diminutive and feminine in appearance — at least, when compared to the races of the Marches. Males can easily tend towards being androgynous at best; their women tend to be slender, agile and finely formed rather than voluptuous, and while A-cup angst is uncommon, most don't go above a high B, with the exception of den mothers/matrons.
        
        Kitsune tails are long — generally as much as their owner is tall — prehensile, and often stronger than their actual limbs. They're not just extremely sensitive, but feel intensely good to pet and fondle on the part of both giver and receiver due to how fluffy they are. Tail number is a shorthand for one's age, experience, power and favor with Keros; the more one has, the higher one's standing in kitsune society. For example, a newborn fox kit might be expected to have two tails, a young adult three or four; most don't reach the upper limits over the course of their lifetimes.
rows.translation:
大多数狐妖的外貌与普通的猫族并无太大区别，从远处看或许很容易被误认成猫族。它们的头顶长着狐妖耳朵，这些耳朵能够自主活动，而且经常会在主人毫无意识的情况下不停地抽动或转动。再加上它们全都至少拥有两条蓬松的狐尾，而且这个数量会随着年龄和能力的增长而增加，最多可达九条；此外，它们的外观与居住在萨瓦拉地区的那些兽人种族也并没有太大区别。

        狐妖一族在外形上通常显得娇小而柔美——至少与边境地区的其他种族相比是这样。雄性狐妖最多也只能算是具有中性特征；而雌性狐妖则往往身形纤细、动作敏捷、体态优美，而非丰满性感。虽然A罩杯的体型在她们当中并不常见，但大多数女性的胸围也不会超过高B罩杯，当然，那些担任族群领袖的雌性狐妖除外。
        
        狐妖的尾巴很长，通常与它们的主人身高相当，而且具有很强的抓握能力，其力量往往甚至超过了它们的四肢。这些尾巴不仅极其灵敏，而且由于质地蓬松柔软，无论是抚摸者还是被抚摸者，都会感受到无比的愉悦。尾数是用来表示一个人的年龄、经验、实力以及在凯罗斯心目中的地位的简称；这些数值越多，那个人在狐族社会中的地位就越高。例如，一只刚出生的小狐妖通常会有两条尾巴，而一只年轻的成年狐妖则会有三条或四条尾巴；大多数狐妖在它们的一生中都无法达到这些数值的上限。
