rows.original:
Most kitsune are similar to humans when it comes to breeding — sex followed by twelve months of gestation, which in turn is usually followed by a single kit. Like harpies, kitsune are dominant breeders, with their children being full-blooded kitsune instead of half-breeds — this allows for their race to propagate without excessive inbreeding despite comparatively small numbers. Kitsune kits are quite proportionally large in the womb compared to other races, especially considering the generally petite nature of their womenfolk. While not usually dangerous, the rare occurrence of multiples can be considerably draining on a mother's body; most will choose to sleep away the latter stages of their pregnancy and be doted on by their family.

        Most kitsune consciously limit their breeding, careful not to outstrip their food supply. Most families often have two kits, and sometimes three is warranted in populous areas. Wanton breeding by commoners is often met with social disapproval.
        
        Den mothers are an exception, though. These women are reputedly directly descended matrilineally from Keros' twelve concubines — of which one of their tasks was to bring forth the kitsune race as a people. These gifted individuals are practically kit factories, having gestation durations of one and a half months and a host of other idiosyncrasies suited to producing and raising kits. Obvious to say, den mothers are extremely rare, form the base of the twelve Divine Houses, and there have been no more than twelve at any one time in history. The capability to become one is passed on from mother to firstborn daughter; new bloodlines only arise through direct divine intervention. Being as they are in this day and age, though, they usually don't exercise their capabilities any more, or at least as egregiously as they could have otherwise even if they have bigger families than most.
rows.translation:
大多数狐妖在繁殖方式上与人类相似——先进行交配，随后是十二个月的妊娠期，最终通常会生下一只幼崽。与鹰身女妖一样，狐妖也是占主导地位的繁殖者，它们的后代都是纯血的狐妖，而非混血儿。这种特性使得尽管狐妖的数量相对较少，但它们的种族仍能够持续繁衍下去，而不会出现过度近亲繁殖的问题。与其他种族相比，狐族胎儿在母体中的体积通常要大一些，尤其是考虑到狐族女性普遍身材娇小的特点。虽然这种情况通常不会带来危险，但偶尔出现多胎妊娠的情况时，会对母亲的身体健康造成相当大的负担；因此，大多数狐族女性会选择在怀孕后期多休息，依靠家人的照顾来度过这段艰难时期。

        大多数狐妖都会自觉地控制自己的繁殖数量，以免超过可获取的食物供应。通常情况下，一个家族会生下两只幼狐；而在人口密集的地区，有时也会生下三只。如果普通民众肆意繁殖，往往会遭到社会的反对。
        
        然而，母狐们是个例外。据说这些女性是通过母系直接继承了凯罗斯的十二位妃子的血脉——其中一位妃子的职责就是繁衍出狐族这一种族。这些天资特殊的雌性几乎就是“狐崽制造机”：她们的妊娠期仅为一个半月，同时还具备许多其他适合生育和抚养狐崽的特殊特征。显而易见，这样的“母神”极为罕见，她们构成了十二个神圣家族的基础，而在历史上，任何时候这些“母神”的数量都不会超过十二位。成为“母神”的能力是由母亲传给长女们的；只有通过神的直接干预，才会产生新的血脉传承。然而，在当今这个时代，他们通常已经不再运用这些能力了，或者至少不再像以前那样过分地使用它们了。尽管他们的家庭规模比大多数人都要大。

rows.original:
According to their own tales, kitsune were fashioned by their patron deity Keros, in the early days when the gods first walked freely upon the world. Curious and partly inspired by the rather vigorous activities of Lumia at the time, he made for himself a wife and twelve concubines in his image; according to legend, it's from this first harem that the Imperial Family and the twelve Divine Houses claim descent. Other kitsune came later, the trickster god's hands moulding foxes of the field into human shapes, but only the first thirteen can claim to have been fashioned from nothing but sheer divine intent and a few strands of tail fluff.

        Satisfied that his efforts were sufficient, Keros placed his creations on a fairly remote island chain, stepped back and watched them bumble and mess about trying to go about their lives. According to the deity himself, this has been an endless and fascinating source of entertainment ever since.
        
        In that time, they've developed something approaching a civilization in accordance with their nature and environment. The tanuki, the other major culture inhabiting the same island chain, has integrated with the kitsune over generations to form a mutually beneficial social contract which has lasted for centuries, if not longer.
        
        After the Godswar, a fresh surge of emigration from the Old Country occurred, spurred on by several happenstances:
        
        Firstly, Kitsune who represented Keros' involvement in the wars and were sent abroad to support the larger forces belonging to Sorra and Lumia decided they liked these new lands and sought to settle down in unclaimed territory. The Cherry Blossom Throne was more than willing to lend imperial support and funding to the colonization efforts.
        
        Secondly, the acquisition, duplication and refinement of Estelore's warpstone technology made crossing the great distances over the ocean much easier.
        
        Thirdly, Kitsune who desired large families, but who were unable to do so without meeting social disapproval decided to head for the frontier where there was supposedly plenty of "food" to be had from numerous robust natives.
        
        Finally, the islands of the kitsune homeland have no tin to make bronze with, and what iron there is to be had is of poor quality. With iron largely overlooked by the bronze-using natives and imperial edicts promising material wealth and precious social status to those who are able to discover and exploit the metal, many have gone abroad in search of valuable hematite.
        
        The ultimate end result is that despite being thoroughly foreign in nature, there are several kitsune dens scattered about the Marches and other places around the world, each populated by a small number of expatriates.
rows.translation:
根据他们自己的传说，狐妖是由他们的守护神凯罗斯在众神最初自由行走于世间的那些日子里创造出来的。凯罗斯出于好奇，同时也受到当时卢米娅活跃活动的启发，按照自己的形象为自己打造了一位妻子和十二位妃子；传说中，皇室家族以及那十二个神族世家正是源自这个最初的后宫。后来，其他的狐妖也出现了——这位狡黠的神明将田野间的狐妖们塑成了人类的形态，但只有最初的十三只狐妖，才能真正声称自己是完全凭借神的力量与几缕狐尾毛创造出来的。

        看到自己的努力已经足够，凯罗斯将这些被他创造出来的生物放置在一处偏远的群岛上，然后退后一步，观察它们笨手笨脚地尝试过着自己的生活。据这位神明自己所说，从那以后，这一幕就成了他无穷无尽的娱乐来源。
        
        在那个时期，它们根据自身的天性与所处的环境，发展出了某种类似于文明的社会形态。而同样生活在这一群岛上的另一种主要生物——狸猫，经过数代与狐族的融合，形成了一种互利共生的社会关系，这种关系已经持续了几个世纪，甚至更久。
        
        在诸神之战之后，由于一系列事件的影响，来自旧国的移民潮再次加剧：
        
        首先，那些代表凯罗斯参与战争、并被派往国外去支援索拉和卢米娅军队的狐族，发现这些新大陆非常适合居住，于是决定在无人开发的土地上安家落户。樱花王座也非常乐意为这些殖民活动提供皇室的支持和资金援助。
        
        其次，通过获取、复制并改进埃斯特洛尔的传送石技术，人们跨越海洋跨越漫长的距离变得容易多了。
        
        第三，那些渴望拥有大家庭，但又担心会遭到社会非议的狐妖，决定前往边境地区——因为据说那里有大量的强壮原住民，可以提供“食物”。
        
        最终，狐族旧国的那些岛屿上根本没有可以用来制造青铜的锡矿，而那里所拥有的铁质资源质量也很差。由于使用青铜的当地人普遍忽视了铁的价值，再加上朝廷颁布的法令承诺，那些能够发现并开发这种金属的人将会获得丰厚的物质财富和崇高的社会地位，因此许多人纷纷前往国外去寻找那些有价值的赤铁矿。
        
        最终的结果是，尽管这些地方在本质上是完全异国的，但在边境地区以及世界各地的其他地方，仍然分布着几处狐族聚居地，而这些聚居地中都居住着为数不多的异乡人。

rows.original:
Most Marcher kitsune still adhere to the culture of their homeland in dress, mannerisms and architectural style, partly due to the isolation in which they live their lives. Some adaptations do occur to better suit life in foreign lands when they move, but by and large the vast majority of their style remains unchanged. In their own homeland, they live as much as other races do; it is, after all, a place where their natures are considered everyday and humdrum. Even in the Old Country, though, they are not alone or even the dominant group by way of numbers; kitsune share their society with tanuki and other races in the position of a dominant minority. In foreign lands, they are often considered more akin to monsters than civilized peoples by the native folk, and much energy and concern is directed towards getting sustenance without provoking the locals into driving them out.

        Kitsune social organization is generally a theocracy centered around their patron deity Keros, with those involved with clerical magic given great reverence; claiming direct patrilineal descent from Keros himself. The God-Emperor is viewed as a living divinity in the Old Country, and all authority and power flows outwards from him. The oddity of the Imperial Family aside, kitsune are matriarchal in nature, in keeping with the twelve concubines Keros kept in addition to the wife he made for himself.
        
        Due to their natures and the need to keep themselves in check, their culture is highly rigid and hierarchical, obsessive about etiquette in the only way that bloodthirsty vampires who need to live peacefully together can effect. Everything from how to address another of the same, lower or higher station, to which napkin to wipe away spilled water during the tea ceremony is designed to smooth over potential arguments that could turn ugly.
        
        Most kitsune enjoy many hobbies and artistic pursuits originating in their homeland ranging from poetry, scroll painting, flower arrangement, music and martial arts. Instruction and education are often the function of the priests and priestesses of Keros when they are not otherwise occupied.
        
        Kitsune who have moved away from the Old Country can feel awkward, especially later-generation immigrants. While isolationism does help, the culture of their parents can easily come into conflict with the expectations of the local culture of wherever they're living. It is the challenge of individuals to find ways to cope with their situation of being split between worlds.
rows.translation:
大多数游荡的狐妖在服饰、举止以及建筑风格上仍然保持着他们旧国的文化传统，这部分原因在于他们生活的环境相对封闭。当他们迁移到异国他乡后，确实会做出一些适应性的改变，以便更好地融入当地的生活，但总体而言，他们的大部分风格依然没有发生变化。在他们自己的旧国，他们的生活方式与其他种族并无不同；毕竟，在那里，他们的特性被视为理所当然、平凡无奇的事物。然而，即使在旧国，他们也并非唯一的族群，更不是数量上占优势的群体；狐族与其他种族如狸猫等共同生活在社会中，只不过处于占优势的少数群体的地位罢了。在异国他乡，当地人往往认为这些外来者更像是怪物，而非文明的人类。因此，人们会投入大量的精力和精力来确保自己能够获得生存所需的食物，同时尽量避免激怒当地人，以免被驱逐出境。

        狐族的社会组织通常是以他们的守护神凯罗斯为中心的神权制度，那些从事神职魔法的人受到极高的尊崇，因为他们被认为与凯罗斯有着直系的血缘关系。在古国，这位神皇被视为活生生的神明，所有的权力与权威都源自他。尽管皇室存在一些特殊性，但狐族本质上还是母系社会——这与凯罗斯除了正妻之外还拥有十二位妃嫔的事实是一致的。
        
        由于他们的天性以及需要自我约束，他们的文化具有极强的严格性和等级制度，对礼仪的重视也是唯一一种能让这些嗜血的吸血鬼们和平共处的方式。从如何称呼地位相同、较低或较高的人，到在茶道仪式中该使用哪块餐巾纸来擦拭洒出的水，所有这些细节都旨在避免可能引发争执的事情发生。
        
        大多数狐妖都热衷于各种源于他们旧国的爱好与艺术活动，这些活动包括诗歌创作、卷轴绘画、插花艺术、音乐演奏以及武术练习。当凯罗斯的神职人员没有其他事务需要处理时，他们通常会承担这些教导与培训的工作。
        
        那些离开旧国的狐族会感到有些格格不入，尤其是那些后来才移民过来的后代。虽然孤立主义确实能在一定程度上帮助他们，但他们的父母所传承的文化，很容易与他们所在地区的当地文化产生冲突。对于这些人来说，如何应对这种处于两个截然不同世界之间的处境，确实是一个巨大的挑战。

In their own homeland, they live as much as other races do; it is, after all, a place where their natures are considered everyday and humdrum. Even in the Old Country, though, they are not alone or even the dominant group by way of numbers; kitsune share their society with tanuki and other races in the position of a dominant minority. In foreign lands, they are often considered more akin to monsters than civilized peoples by the native folk, and much energy and concern is directed towards getting sustenance without provoking the locals into driving them out.

        Kitsune social organization is generally a theocracy centered around their patron deity Keros, with those involved with clerical magic given great reverence; claiming direct patrilineal descent from Keros himself. The God-Emperor is viewed as a living divinity in the Old Country, and all authority and power flows outwards from him. The oddity of the Imperial Family aside, kitsune are matriarchal in nature, in keeping with the twelve concubines Keros kept in addition to the wife he made for himself.
        
        Due to their natures and the need to keep themselves in check, their culture is highly rigid and hierarchical, obsessive about etiquette in the only way that bloodthirsty vampires who need to live peacefully together can effect. Everything from how to address another of the same, lower or higher station, to which napkin to wipe away spilled water during the tea ceremony is designed to smooth over potential arguments that could turn ugly.
        
        Most kitsune enjoy many hobbies and artistic pursuits originating in their homeland ranging from poetry, scroll painting, flower arrangement, music and martial arts. Instruction and education are often the function of the priests and priestesses of Keros when they are not otherwise occupied.
        
        Kitsune who have moved away from the Old Country can feel awkward, especially later-generation immigrants. While isolationism does help, the culture of their parents can easily come into conflict with the expectations of the local culture of wherever they're living. It is the challenge of individuals to find ways to cope with their situation of being split between worlds.

        "

rows.original:
Kitsune are the closest and foremost servants of the trickster god, possessing a metaphysical connection with him inasmuch as Astrida do with Nareva, or valkyries with Lumia. As such, they possess a strange resistance to corruptive influences. Their deity's direct patronage also means that they can't hold extreme artificially-induced changes to their physiology, nor are there half-breeds of any sort. It's a strange state of affairs, but other such favored races like harpies do exhibit similar traits, so it's not without precedent.

        The biggest quirk of being a kitsune is their vampiric nature; each kitsune must periodically drain life-force from other sapient beings. Regular feedings would be considered two weeks or less apart, a frugal lifestyle might be once a month, and bare survival might be a single feeding every six to eight weeks. While one can subsist on mundane food much like other races, going too long between feedings is exponentially detrimental to one's physical and mental health; gnawing hunger easily causes one to snap long before the body gives out, leading to potentially dangerous situations.
        
        Copulation is the most common method of soliciting vitality from others — travelers will speak of being lost in the woods, coming across strangely attractive foxy men and women, and being dragged into extremely exhilarating orgies from which they emerge considerably drained. Keros' teachings on such are extremely strict: reciprocity — for what you take, always give back something of equal value, and sustainability — never drain someone to death, so they keep coming back for more. Those who wantonly and unabashedly flout this divine law are declared renegade and outlaws, and hunted down by their own kin without mercy. Sex is the simplest way to offer payment for vitality taken, so many resort to such; other kitsune may offer favors or goods in equivalent value to what they take from another.
        
        It is possible, but undesirable at the least for one kitsune to drain another; doing so is much akin to eating another's vomit, being highly distasteful both physically and socially. Parents will feed their kits what they need to keep them going, but it is otherwise largely unheard of. One does not need to engage in sexual activity to feed; simple physical contact is enough, and the trained can even rip at another's energies from a distance.
        
        It's said that kitsune can transform themselves into actual bestial foxes, but no one has yet to give a proven account of such. What is known is that they're inherently magical creatures, with a particularly affinity for fire magic. As opposed to the staves, wands and totems of the Frost Marches, Kitsune favor specially prepared scrolls for working magic, although the basics of magic do still require the presence of a focusing gem somewhere, which is traditionally set on the scroll rod(s).
rows.translation:
狐妖是欺骗之神最亲密、最忠实的仆从，它们与这位神明之间存在着一种超越物质层面的联系，就如同阿斯特里达与娜瑞瓦之间的关系，或者女武神们与卢米娅之间的关系一样。正因如此，它们对那些会引发堕落的影响具有某种特殊的抗性力。他们的神明直接庇护着他们，这也意味着他们的生理结构无法发生任何人为造成的极端变化，也不存在任何杂交后代。这种状况确实有些奇怪，但像哈比这样的其他受宠种族也表现出类似的特征，因此这种情况并非没有先例。

        作为狐妖最大的特性，就是它们那种吸血的习性；每一只狐妖都必须定期从其他智慧生物身上吸取生命力。如果进食频率较高，那么每两周或更短的时间内就需要进食一次；如果生活方式较为节制，可能一个月才需要进食一次；而如果只是为了维持基本生存，那么可能每六到八周才需要进食一次。虽然其他种族也可以靠普通食物维持生存，但如果长时间不进食，对身心健康造成的危害将会呈指数级增长。强烈的饥饿感很容易使人失去理智，而在这种状态下，身体往往还未完全垮掉，这就可能导致非常危险的情况发生。
        
        交配是获取他人能量的最常见方式——旅行者们会讲述自己在森林中迷路时，遇到那些异常迷人的狐人男女，然后被卷入那些令人兴奋至极的狂欢之中，最终身心俱疲地从中走出来。凯罗斯关于这些原则的教导极为严格：互惠性——你得到了什么，就必须回馈同等价值的东西；可持续性——永远不要把别人榨干，否则他们就会不再回来寻求更多。那些肆无忌惮地违背这些神圣法则的人，会被视为叛徒和逃犯，他们会遭到自己族人的无情追杀。性行为是弥补消耗的生命力最直接的方式，因此许多人会选择这种方式；而其他狐妖则可能会提供相当于它们从他人那里获取的东西的恩惠或财物作为补偿。
        
        虽然这是可能的，但至少对一只狐妖来说，让另一只狐妖为自己提供能量并不是什么可取的行为；这种行为就好比吃掉别人的呕吐物，无论从生理上还是从社会角度来看，都极其令人反感。父母会为自己的幼崽提供所需的食物，以确保它们能够生存下去，但除此之外，这种行为基本上是闻所未闻的。其实，并不一定需要通过性行为来获取能量；单纯的身体接触就已经足够了，而那些受过训练的狐妖甚至可以从远处吸取另一只狐妖的能量。
        
        据说狐妖能够变身为真正的野狐，但至今还没有人能够提供确凿的证据来证明这一点。已知的是，狐妖本质上是具有魔力的生物，尤其擅长火系魔法。与霜冻边境地区的法杖、魔杖和图腾不同，狐妖更喜欢使用专门制作的卷轴来施展魔法。不过，施展魔法的基本条件仍然是需要一块聚焦宝石，而这种宝石传统上会被镶嵌在卷轴的轴上。

rows.original:
"I've been to many places. Vast, rolling fields as far as the eye can see, enormous cities that never sleep and shine and bustle all night. Enormous ships that should by all rights sink, people who didn't even speak a single word of Belharan. Each new place was fun at first, and yet got old fast... thrills only last a moment.

        In the end, Lupines belong here in the Marches, and going away only made that even clearer."
rows.translation:
我去过很多地方。一望无际的广阔田野，永不入眠、整夜灯火通明、热闹非凡的巨型城市，那些本应沉没的巨轮，还有那些根本不会说贝尔哈兰语的人们。每一个新地方起初都让人感到新鲜有趣，但很快就会变得乏味……那些刺激感也只会持续片刻而已。

        最终，狼族属于这片边境地区，离开这里只会让这一点更加清晰。

rows.original: —Magna Hegan Name: Lupine (pl. Lupines) Sexes: Male, female Height: Ranges from 6'0" to 7'0" Weight: Ranges from 178lbs. to 300lbs. Hair: Brown, Gray, Silver, Black. Shades exist, but they are always dull colors. May be splashed with white on muzzle, neck, torso. Eyes: Lupines have humanlike eyes. Blue, green, brown, black, gray and gold are all common colors. Ears: Two canine ears atop head, with some variation of size and shape. Lifespan: 55 to 80 years. Lupines have slightly shorter average lifespans than humans. Maturity: As per humans, 18 years.

rows.original:
Lupines are tall and solidly-built beast-kin, possessed of considerable physical prowess from generations in the cold wilds. They are the native race of the Marches and are adapted to life there, possessed of thick bodies that range from muscular to stocky, a heavy coat of fur to keep out the cold, and keen eyes and muzzles for the Marches' cold, lightless nights. Lupines stand on a pair of digitigrade feet and tend to be considerably taller than most of the newer arrivals in the Marches. Each lupine is possessed of a soft, fluffy tail, which helps them keep their balance while walking.

        Lupines have keen senses of sight, hearing and smell when compared to humans or orcs, to the point where they can hunt and track by scent with relative ease. Since lupine pups are born blind, their first experience of the wider world is, most fittingly, their mother's scent. Like many other beast-kin, lupines play to the stereotype of being strong and fast, but with thick skulls and brash attitudes; of course one must always be wary of relying on stereotypes when judging individuals.
rows.translation:
狼族是一种身材高大、体格结实的野兽种族，由于世代在寒冷的荒野中生活，他们拥有出色的身体素质。他们是边境地区的原住民，完全适应了那里的环境：他们拥有结实粗壮的身体，有的肌肉发达，有的则体格魁梧；厚厚的毛皮能够帮助他们抵御严寒；而敏锐的视力和嗅觉则使他们能够在边境地区那些寒冷而黑暗的夜晚中生存。狼族用一双趾行足站立，通常比那些新来到边境地区的生物要高大许多。每只狼族都拥有一条柔软、蓬松的尾巴，这条尾巴在行走时能够帮助它们保持平衡。

        与人类或兽人相比，狼族拥有更为敏锐的视觉、听觉和嗅觉，这使得它们能够通过气味来轻松地进行狩猎和追踪。由于狼族幼崽出生时是失明的，因此它们对这个广阔世界的最初认知，最恰当的来说，就是通过母亲的气味来建立的。和许多其他兽人种族一样，狼族也被人们刻板地认为是强壮、迅捷，而且性格鲁莽、行事大胆；不过，当然了，在评价个体时，我们永远都应该警惕不要仅仅依赖这些刻板印象。

rows.original: Lupine fertility runs on a three week heat cycle for their womenfolk, two weeks off, one week on. When a lupine female is in heat, her libido and fertility drastically spike; at the same time, she exudes pheromones that lets potential suitors and rivals alike easily scent her condition. Skin and fur may become considerably more sensitive, and one's thoughts continually drift back towards being bred. Traditionally, lupine womenfolk who go into heat but don't want to end up with a belly full of puppies engage in hard physical labor in order to take their minds off their animal urges; this behavior has resulted in a number of quips and sayings amongst the people. When a lupine woman does get bred with puppies, gestation runs its course over the next six months. Usually, two to four puppies are born in a litter, but sizes numbering up to nine have been recorded. Lupine pups are born blind and completely helpless; their eyes open after about two weeks, before which they do little more than snuffle around, sleep, and suckle.
rows.translation: 狼族女性的生育能力遵循三周一次的发情周期：两周不发情，一周发情。狼族女性进入发情期时，性欲和生育能力都会急剧上升；与此同时，她会释放信息素，让潜在的求偶者和竞争对手都能轻易嗅出她的状态。皮肤与毛发可能变得格外敏感，思绪也会不断飘向受孕繁殖。传统上，进入发情期却不想怀上一肚子幼崽的狼族女性，会以繁重体力劳动转移注意力、压制兽性冲动；这种习惯也在族人中催生了不少俏皮话与俗语。 当狼族女性真的怀上幼崽后，妊娠期约为六个月。每胎通常产下两至四只幼崽，但也有一胎多达九只的记录。狼崽出生时双目紧闭、完全无法自理；大约两周后才会睁眼，在此之前只会四处嗅探、睡觉和吃奶。

rows.original:
Descended from lycans, lupines have lived in the Marches since time immemorial as its first inhabitants. Life was generally slow and idyllic across the generations, with few actually interested in the poor, inhospitable wilds they made their homes in. Empire must expand or die, though, and in time the frontiers of Belhar found their way to the cold forests and rugged mountains slopes of the northlands.

        The natives initially put up some resistance to the newcomers, but despite their physical prowess could not stand up to the tactics, coordination and sheer numbers the empire could bring to bear. With many scattered tribes facing a unified foe, they melted away into the background while Belhar paved roads, opened mines and built palaces atop hot springs.
        
        Neither did the Godswar bring any relief. This singular event may have been the one time in all of lupine history that every single tribe cast a unanimous vote to do something about the situation; they entered a brief mutual protection agreement with the minotaurs of Khor'minos to guard the hinterland while the minotaurs would look out towards the eastern seaboard. Constructed and armed with minotaur engineering and staffed with the finest warriors the tribes could bring to bear, mountainside fortresses were built to guard against the advance of the wraith host out from the heartlands. 
        
        The exact details are fuzzy, but this turned out to be an unmitigated disaster for both parties involved. Both the lupines and minotaurs blamed each other for the humiliating defeat and massive casualties involved; since the Jarl who negotiated had been killed in the fighting, his family was ousted by the tribes and relations with the minotaurs have been chilly at best for the last couple of centuries.
        
        Since then, a tenuous peace has prevailed. What wildling tribes of lupines are left have gone to ground, hoping to avoid further violence; others have settled in mixed-race settlements and societies and accepted this as the new order of things, if it will mean protection from raids by islander orcs from the east. An ignoble existence, some might argue, but better than no existence.
rows.translation:
作为狼族的后裔，狼族族自古以来就居住在边境地区，成为那里的第一批居民。世代以来，他们的生活节奏缓慢而宁静，几乎没有人会去关心那些荒凉而恶劣的野外环境。然而，帝国必须不断扩张，否则就会灭亡。于是，随着时间的推移，贝尔哈尔帝国的疆域逐渐扩展到了北方那些寒冷的森林和崎岖的山脉之中。

        当地居民起初对新来者表现出一定的抗性，但尽管他们体力强健，却无法抵挡帝国所拥有的战术手段、协调能力以及庞大的兵力。当众多分散的部落面对一个统一的敌人时，他们纷纷退缩了，而贝尔哈尔则继续修建道路、开凿矿山，并在温泉之上建造宫殿。
        
        神战”也未能带来任何缓解。在卢皮恩的历史上，或许只有这一次，所有部落都一致同意采取行动来应对这一危机；他们与科尔米诺斯的弥诺陶洛斯达成了短暂的互助协议——卢皮恩部落负责守护内陆地区，而弥诺陶洛斯则负责监视东部海岸线。这些建在山腰上的要塞，采用了弥诺陶洛斯的工程技术进行建造和武装，而且配备了各部落所能提供的最精锐的战士，其目的就是抵御那些从内陆地区涌来的幽灵军队的进攻。 
        
        具体细节已经模糊不清，但这件事对涉及的双方来说都是一场彻头彻尾的灾难。狼族族和弥诺陶洛斯族都将这场惨败以及由此造成的巨大损失归咎于对方；由于负责谈判的酋长在战斗中阵亡，他的家族也被部落驱逐，因此在过去几个世纪里，双方的关系充其量也只能说是冷淡而已。
        
        从那以后，一种脆弱的和平得以维持。那些残存的野性狼族部落要么躲藏起来，试图避免进一步的暴力冲突；要么则融入了多种族混居的社区中，接受了这种新的生存秩序——只要这样能让他们免受来自东部岛民兽人的袭击。有些人可能会认为这种生存方式很卑微，但总比没有生存机会要好。

This singular event may have been the one time in all of lupine history that every single tribe cast a unanimous vote to do something about the situation; they entered a brief mutual protection agreement with the minotaurs of Khor'minos to guard the hinterland while the minotaurs would look out towards the eastern seaboard. Constructed and armed with minotaur engineering and staffed with the finest warriors the tribes could bring to bear, mountainside fortresses were built to guard against the advance of the wraith host out from the heartlands. 
        
        The exact details are fuzzy, but this turned out to be an unmitigated disaster for both parties involved. Both the lupines and minotaurs blamed each other for the humiliating defeat and massive casualties involved; since the Jarl who negotiated had been killed in the fighting, his family was ousted by the tribes and relations with the minotaurs have been chilly at best for the last couple of centuries.
        
        Since then, a tenuous peace has prevailed. What wildling tribes of lupines are left have gone to ground, hoping to avoid further violence; others have settled in mixed-race settlements and societies and accepted this as the new order of things, if it will mean protection from raids by islander orcs from the east. An ignoble existence, some might argue, but better than no existence.
        
        "

rows.original:
Lupines generally live in settlements numbering anywhere from a hundred to a few thousand. Their ancestral lands are too inhospitable to allow for truly large settlements, so the stereotypical village hidden in the woods or at the foot of a mountain is very much a reality. Many live as hunters, fishermen and gatherers; those closer to civilization may wind up as craftsmen or laborers. Many lupines choose to join mercenary groups formed by and for their own kind, as unlike some other races, being a mercenary is not looked down upon.

        Following the encroachment of the Belharan Empire's borders, lupines have acclimatized well to what happens to pass for civilization in their corner of the world; most have no issue mingling with many of the other common races in their daily lives. They don't have strange needs, reputations or habits that would have been considered strange or repulsive in Behlaran society, found a societal niche to slide into, and did it well.
        
        Lupine history and culture has been orally handed down for generations in the form of mnemonic poems and rhymes, whole sagas committed to memory by dint of sheer will. Runic script did not emerge until serious contact with other races was established a few centuries ago; almost all lupine runes are bastardized phonemes of Old Belharan. Some of the more isolated tribes still eschew runic script and rely on their memories.
        
        Being vast and disparate, lupines have no truly unified voice or culture; as with humans, the habits of one tribe or village may differ considerably from those on the other side of the mountain. However, on occasion, various tribes do come together to produce an elective leader — a Jarl of sorts — when collective bargaining with a larger power is required, and to serve as the face of the race as a whole, or at least portion that lives in the Marches.

        [flags.HELLHOUND_MET|
rows.translation:
狼族通常居住在百余人至数千人规模的聚落中。其祖地环境恶劣，难以供养真正的大型城市，因此藏在林间或山脚下的典型村落并非刻板印象，而是常态。许多人以狩猎、捕鱼和采集为生；靠近文明地区者也可能成为工匠或劳工。许多狼族会加入由同族建立、专为同族服务的佣兵团；与某些种族不同，他们并不鄙视佣兵这个行当。

        随着贝尔哈兰帝国的边界逐渐逼近，狼族很好地适应了当地勉强称得上文明的生活；大多数人都能在日常生活中与其他常见种族相处。他们没有会被贝尔哈兰社会视作怪异或恶心的特殊需求、名声或习惯，因而顺利找到了自己的社会位置。
        
        狼族的历史与文化世代以助记诗和韵文口耳相传，整部史诗全凭惊人的意志铭记于心。直到数百年前与其他种族建立密切接触后，他们才发展出卢恩文字；几乎所有狼族卢恩都源自古贝尔哈兰语音符的变体。一些最为闭塞的部族至今仍拒绝使用文字，只依靠记忆传承。
        
        狼族分布广阔、彼此疏远，因此没有真正统一的声音或文化；与人类一样，一座村落或部族的习俗可能与山另一边的同族截然不同。不过，当他们需要与更强大的势力集体交涉时，各部族偶尔会共同推举一位类似领主的领袖，对外代表整个种族——或至少代表生活在边境的那一部分狼族。

rows.original: Throughout history there have been reports of what scholars call %"Primordial Hounds," or half-lupines that exhibit a supernatural affinity for one of the four primeval elements: earth, fire, wind, or water. The most common of these by far have been fire-infused lupines, often called Hellhounds. The exact origin of these halfbreeds is unknown, for no births have ever been recorded, only their appearances near druidic temples and sites historically connected with those mad invokers of the Primordial Chaos, such as the cult of the Terrestrial Fire. Often as not, the primordial hound acts as a guardian of the site, mimicking the legendary hounds of ill omen that are said to protect the graves of Belharan lords from would-be desecrators. The prevailing theory among Belharan scholars was that primordial hounds are conceived through a druidic rite, binding an elemental spirit into the womb of a lupine womb (whether the spirit inhabits the child or merely changes it in utero remained hotly debated well into the empire's fall). A second, less popular, theory espoused that the hounds were instead half-dragons, explaining their less wolf-like appearance and greatly increased stature and physical might. Regardless of origin, it is plain to see that primordial hounds take on the appearance of half-lupines — human-like with furred limbs, tails, and canid ears — of great physical size and musculature, both immune to harm from whichever element they are bound to and able to harness and command it as easily as archmagi do their spells: hellhounds, for example, can wreathe their claws in fire or conjure fiery combustions, while galehounds can summon stormwinds and lightning bolts.]
rows.translation: 历史上曾有学者记载所谓的“始源猎犬”：对土、火、风、水四种原初元素之一具有超自然亲和力的半狼族。其中最常见的是与火焰相融、通常被称为地狱犬的狼族。无人知道这些混血生物究竟从何而来，因为从未有人记录过它们的诞生；人们只在德鲁伊神殿，以及历史上与那些疯狂召唤原初混沌之力的人有关的地点见过它们，例如“大地之火”教派的遗址。始源猎犬往往会守护这些地点，恰如传说中保护贝尔哈兰领主陵墓、驱逐亵渎者的凶兆之犬。 贝尔哈兰学界的主流理论认为，始源猎犬由德鲁伊仪式孕育而生：元素精灵被束缚进狼族女性的子宫。至于精灵是寄宿在胎儿体内，还是仅仅在子宫中改变了胎儿，直到帝国覆灭时仍争论不休。另一种较少人支持的理论认为，这些猎犬其实是半龙；这可以解释她们较不似狼的外貌，以及远超普通狼族的身材与力量。 无论起源如何，始源猎犬显然具有半狼族的基本外形——近似人类，却长着覆毛的四肢、尾巴和犬耳——但体格和肌肉异常庞大。她们不但免疫与自身结合之元素造成的伤害，还能像大法师施法一样轻松驾驭它：例如地狱犬可以让利爪裹上烈焰，或凭空引发爆燃；风暴猎犬则能召来狂风与闪电。]

rows.original: "At last, in the salt-soaked crags beneath the lowest foundations we unearthed that damnable creature of ancient evil, a ravening beast from before not merely the Godswar, but time itself. We were in a realm of death and madness, the horror its maleficent lord; its presence was strong enough to reshape not merely our minds, but reality altogether!"
rows.translation: 终于，在那些被盐分浸透的峭壁中，在最底层的基础之下，我们找到了那个该死的、源自远古的邪恶生物——一种诞生于神战之前，甚至早于时间本身的凶残怪物。我们所处的这个地方充满了死亡与疯狂，而它的邪恶主人才是真正的恐怖根源；它的存在力量如此强大，足以重塑我们的思想，甚至彻底改变整个现实！
rows.raw: '\n        "At last, in the salt-soaked crags beneath the lowest foundations we unearthed that damnable creature of ancient evil, a ravening beast from before not merely the Godswar, but time itself. We were in a realm of death and madness, the horror its maleficent lord; its presence was strong enough to reshape not merely our minds, but reality altogether!"\n        '

rows.original: —Unknown Name: Lureling(s) Sexes: Unknown. Perhaps hermaphroditic. Height: 16'0"-17'4" at the shoulders. Roughly 18' from tip to tail. Weight: Unknown, as no one has actually weighed one. Likely immense. Skin: Bluish-green, perpetually moist and secreting a gray goo that sloughs off its body. Eyes: Large, featureless white orbs. Ears: No visible ears, but they are clearly able to sense sound. Lifespan: Unknown, but certainly ancient. Maturity: Unknown.

rows.original: Lurelings are ancient beasts from a time beyond reckoning, and are one of the most dangerous creatures encountered on Savarra — when they wish to be. With powers that match those of most major spirits, the remaining lurelings in this day and age thankfully dwell in solitude not just physically in the deepest marine trenches and underground freshwater lakes, but also mentally as they spend much of their time in the Dreamscape, which they are far more at home in as opposed to the realm of the material. While known to possess exceptional intelligence matching or surpassing that of most known races, their deep-sea origins and cultural refusal to make contact make their motivations and goals all but unknowable. Lurelings are perfectly capable of communication via psychically imposing their thoughts upon the minds of others, yet refuse to make their presence known to, much less discourse with, even marine races such as siorcanna and selkies unless the given lureling is in immediate and overwhelming distress. What is known about them, however, is that lurelings are very large, very ugly amphibians resembling something between a frog, a snake and an angler fish, with four stubby legs propelling a sinuous body that supports an immense head. Their heads play home to a large, circle-shaped mouth filled with concentric rows of teeth that rotate like a drill, allowing the lureling to tunnel through ice and stone alike with ease. Lurelings often carve out lairs in which they can rest their physical bodies undisturbed while their minds wander the Dreamscape, wholly absorbed in their fugue state. While lurelings prefer to use telekinesis to interact with the material, owing in part to their ungainly bodies, numerous tentacles extrude from their sides which allow for fine manipulation of objects in the physical sense should they desire.
rows.translation: 迷雾兽是源自远古时代的神秘生物，也是萨瓦拉上最危险的生物之一——当然，前提是它们愿意如此。这些拥有与大多数强大精灵相当力量的生物，如今大多选择隐居生活。它们既生活在最深的海洋沟壑和地下淡水湖泊中，也在精神层面与世隔绝，因为它们大部分时间都沉浸在梦境世界中。对于它们来说，梦境世界才是真正属于它们的家园，而非物质世界。尽管人们知道它们拥有与大多数已知种族相当甚至更高的智慧，但由于它们起源于深海，且其文化传统使它们拒绝与他人建立联系，因此人们几乎无法了解它们的动机与目标。这些生物完全有能力通过精神力量将自己的思想强行灌输到其他生物的脑海中，但除非它们处于极度困境之中，否则它们既不会向诸如希奥卡纳或人鱼族这样的海洋种族表明自己的存在，也不会与它们进行交流。 什么？是然而，人们所知道的是，这种生物体型庞大、外形丑陋，是一种介于青蛙、蛇和钓鱼鱼之间的两栖动物，它有四条短粗的腿，用来推动它那弯曲的身体，而它的头部则显得格外巨大。它们的头部长着一个巨大的圆形嘴巴，里面排列着同心圆的牙齿，这些牙齿可以像钻头一样旋转，因此它们能够轻松地在冰层或岩石中挖出通道。这种生物通常会挖掘出自己的巢穴，在那里它们的身体可以安静地休息，而它们的意识则会进入梦境世界，完全沉浸在这种恍惚的状态之中。虽然这些生物更倾向于利用心灵力量来与周围物质进行互动，但这主要是因为它们那笨拙的身体结构；不过，它们的身体两侧也会伸出许多触手，这样一来，如果它们真的有这样的需求的话，就可以通过这些触手来精确地操控物理物体了。

rows.original:
One of a lureling's most important abilities is the fact that it continually secretes a gelatinous gray goo that covers all of its body and continually sloughs off its monstrous form, eventually occluding whatever water its physical body rests in. The goo serves many purposes: firstly, it prevents the lureling from drying out on land; like many other amphibians, a lureling must keep its skin moist in order to survive. If separated from water for too long, the exterior of the goo coating forms a tough, leathery crust that locks in moisture about the beast, preventing it from dehydrating.
        
        The second purpose the gray goo serves is as a physical barrier to blunt blows from would-be attackers, a protective shield to give the lureling time to react should its body be assailed while it wanders the Dreamscape.
        
        The final, and most iconic property of the gray goo is that anyone who comes into contact with even so much as a trace amount has their minds touched by the lureling's psychic presence. Usually, this is imperceptible, perhaps no more than the occasional uneasy feeling in the back of one's mind, and many so unwittingly influenced go about their lives with no more harm than the occasional nightmare. However, should the lureling turn its baleful dominance upon anyone touched by it, the vulnerability created by this contact allows the beast to reach through the Dreamscape and suborn the weak-willed to its demands.
rows.translation:
鱼饵鱼最重要的能力之一，就是它会不断分泌一种胶状灰色的黏液，这种黏液会覆盖它的整个身体，同时它还会不断蜕去自己那丑陋的外形，最终使得它的身体所处的水域被这种黏液完全堵塞。这种黏性物质具有多种作用：首先，它能防止这种两栖动物在陆地上干燥。与许多其他两栖动物一样，这种动物必须保持皮肤湿润才能生存。如果长时间脱离水环境，覆盖在体表的黏性物质会形成一层坚韧的皮状外壳，从而锁住体内的水分，防止其脱水。
        
        灰色粘液的第二个作用是作为物理屏障，减轻潜在攻击者的冲击力，为这种生物在漫游梦境空间时提供保护，使其有足够的时间作出反应。
        
        这种灰色粘液的最后也是最具标志性的特性在于：任何与它哪怕是微量接触的人，都会受到它那神秘的精神力量的影响。通常，这种影响是难以察觉的，或许只是让人偶尔感到一阵不安而已。而许多在不知不觉中受到这种影响的人，他们的日常生活并不会因此受到什么实质性的伤害，最多也就是会做做一些噩梦而已。然而，如果这种诱惑将其邪恶的控制力施加在任何与其接触的人身上，那么这种接触所造成的脆弱性就会让这种生物得以穿透梦境世界，从而迫使意志薄弱的人屈从于它的要求。

rows.original:
This ability to dominate and control others has been stuff of legends amongst seafaring and aquatic folk, and the subject of study for the exceptionally foolhardy. Once a lureling asserts its mental dominance, the bond is usually permanent, and the victim will spend the rest of his or her life as a puppet — called "marions" by aquatic races in the know — to their lureling master, unwittingly doing anything the beast demands of them. Lureling influence can be hard to detect, since where the creatures do interfere with events in the material world, they are careful to not have their marions act in ways that would arouse suspicion unless the need is great. Since the Dreamscape envelopes the whole of Savarra, there is no distance too vast for the lureling to reach in order to pull the strings of its puppet; fleeing its influence is not an option.
        
        Once identified, driving a lureling's influence from a marion is a difficult task owing to the beast's formidable mental prowess. Yet it is not an impossible prospect, for peoples with similar capabilities — the greatest of the avanai hierophants, perhaps — have succeeded in doing so. Even then, the victim must be watched constantly for signs of relapse, and examined periodically to ensure that the beast's influence is no longer upon his or her mind. It should be noted that even after separation, ex-marions remain extraordinarily weak-willed, easy to influence, and remarkably trusting. They are also, however, eager to please and hard-working. Perhaps the surest way to be free of a lureling's influence, once entrenched, is to slay the beast; a dangerous proposition, but it is also the only way to be certain.
        
        The number of marions a lureling is capable of handling is dependent both on the beast's mental acuity and the degree of influence exerted: as a lureling's mental powers grow and it becomes more adept at walking the Dreamscape, it becomes capable of simultaneously directing an increasing number of marions. Similarly, the mental effort required to fully subsume a marion's personality and suborn its will might be better put to use only lightly touching the minds of a dozen individuals, prompting its victims to take actions they were already inclined towards to begin with. A lureling that attempts to control more marions than it can handle easily becomes confused and dull as its attention is divided too finely; this may be the one state in which the beasts are vulnerable, if not outright docile.
rows.translation:
这种支配和控制他人的能力，在航海民族与水生生物中一直被视为传说中的神奇力量，同时也是那些敢于冒险进行研究的人们的研究对象。一旦一条“引诱者”鱼类确立了其对另一条鱼类的精神支配地位，这种关系通常就会永久持续下去。被支配的鱼将会余生都作为“傀儡”生活在它的主人身边——那些了解内情的水生种族将这种被支配的鱼称为“马里恩”——它们会不自觉地执行主人的一切命令。这种潜移默化的影响往往很难被察觉，因为当这些生物确实干预现实世界中的事件时，它们会格外小心，确保自己的行为不会引起怀疑——除非确实有必要的情况。由于梦境景观覆盖了整个萨瓦拉地区，因此没有任何距离是如此遥远，以至于“欲魔”无法伸出手来操纵它的傀儡；想要逃离它的影响，根本就是不可能的。
        
        一旦确定了目标，要想通过操纵某种手段来削弱这种生物的影响力，是一项极其艰巨的任务，因为这种生物拥有极其强大的精神能力。然而，这并非完全不可能做到，因为那些拥有类似能力的人——或许就是那些最杰出的阿瓦奈祭司们——已经成功地做到了这一点。即便如此，也必须持续观察受害者是否出现复发的迹象，并定期进行检查，以确保那种邪恶的影响已经完全从他们的头脑中消失。需要注意的是，即使已经分开，前配偶们依然会表现出极弱的意志力，容易受到他人影响，而且他们的信任心理也依然非常明显。然而，他们也同样渴望取悦他人并且工作勤奋。或许，要想彻底摆脱那种一旦扎根就会产生持久影响的诱惑，唯一的办法就是彻底消灭这个“祸根”；虽然这是一个危险的做法，但也是确保能够摆脱困境的唯一途径。
        
        一条幼龙能够同时操控的幻影数量，既取决于这种生物的智力敏锐度，也取决于操控者所施加的影响力：随着幼龙智力能力的提升，以及它越来越熟练地驾驭梦境世界，它就能够同时操控越来越多的幻影了。同样，那种完全融入一个角色的性格、操控其意志所需的精神力量，或许可以用来轻轻影响十几个人的想法，促使他们去做那些他们本来就倾向于去做的事情。那种试图控制超出自身能力范围的多个目标的生物，往往会因为注意力被过度分散而陷入混乱，甚至变得迟钝无力；在这种状态下，这些生物即便不会变得完全温顺，也会变得脆弱不堪。
rows.raw:
"
        This ability to dominate and control others has been stuff of legends amongst seafaring and aquatic folk, and the subject of study for the exceptionally foolhardy. Once a lureling asserts its mental dominance, the bond is usually permanent, and the victim will spend the rest of his or her life as a puppet — called "marions" by aquatic races in the know — to their lureling master, unwittingly doing anything the beast demands of them. Lureling influence can be hard to detect, since where the creatures do interfere with events in the material world, they are careful to not have their marions act in ways that would arouse suspicion unless the need is great. Since the Dreamscape envelopes the whole of Savarra, there is no distance too vast for the lureling to reach in order to pull the strings of its puppet; fleeing its influence is not an option.
        
        Once identified, driving a lureling's influence from a marion is a difficult task owing to the beast's formidable mental prowess. Yet it is not an impossible prospect, for peoples with similar capabilities — the greatest of the avanai hierophants, perhaps — have succeeded in doing so. Even then, the victim must be watched constantly for signs of relapse, and examined periodically to ensure that the beast's influence is no longer upon his or her mind. It should be noted that even after separation, ex-marions remain extraordinarily weak-willed, easy to influence, and remarkably trusting. They are also, however, eager to please and hard-working. Perhaps the surest way to be free of a lureling's influence, once entrenched, is to slay the beast; a dangerous proposition, but it is also the only way to be certain.
        
        The number of marions a lureling is capable of handling is dependent both on the beast's mental acuity and the degree of influence exerted: as a lureling's mental powers grow and it becomes more adept at walking the Dreamscape, it becomes capable of simultaneously directing an increasing number of marions. Similarly, the mental effort required to fully subsume a marion's personality and suborn its will might be better put to use only lightly touching the minds of a dozen individuals, prompting its victims to take actions they were already inclined towards to begin with. A lureling that attempts to control more marions than it can handle easily becomes confused and dull as its attention is divided too finely; this may be the one state in which the beasts are vulnerable, if not outright docile.
        
        "

rows.original:
Thankfully, lurelings are surprisingly non-violent despite their psychic powers; our minds are as unknowable to them as theirs are to ours. Most recorded instances of harm to surfacers are a result of self-defense due to people breaking into their lairs; the natural psychic fields lurelings project through the Dreamscape are usually sufficient to deter would-be adventurers, so this does not happen often. When provoked to retaliation, though, the initial response is intense and overwhelming; jaws made for boring through stone and ice tear apart flesh and bone with equal ease. Any survivors are dominated and transformed into helpless marions, made to serve the beast for the short remainder of their lives. 
        
        On rare occasion, though, a lureling provoked to action may turn extremely vindictive, turning its attention to the destruction of not just those whom it feels has wronged it, but anything and everything remotely related to the interlopers — families, friends, hometowns, nations. It is not known what exactly triggers such a disproportionate response from the usually reclusive beasts, but the spiteful rage results in anything from blasted lands to mass hysteria and broken courts. Such a rampage, though immaterial in the nature of all things related to the Dreamscape, is no less destructive and is only ended by the complete annihilation of everything tangentially connected to those who incited its ire, or the beast itself.
rows.translation:
幸运的是，尽管拥有超自然能力，但这些生物实际上并不具有攻击性；对我们来说，它们的思维方式与我们一样难以理解。所有记录在案的针对这些生物的伤害案例，其实都是因为有人闯入了它们的巢穴，导致它们出于自卫而采取行动；而它们通过梦境空间释放出的自然精神能量，通常足以吓退那些敢于冒险接近它们的人，因此这类事件发生得并不频繁。然而，当遭到挑衅而不得不进行反击时，最初的反应会异常激烈且势不可挡；那些原本用于咬穿岩石和冰块的强大力量，同样能够轻易地撕裂肉体和骨骼。任何幸存者都会被这种力量压制，被迫变成无助的傀儡，在余下的生命中为这种野兽服务。 
        
        然而，在极少数情况下，当一只被激怒的掠食者决定采取行动时，它会变得异常报复心强，其攻击目标不仅会包括那些它认为伤害过它的人，还会包括任何与这些入侵者有关联的事物——无论是他们的家人、朋友、家乡，还是整个国家。目前尚不清楚究竟是什么因素引发了这些通常独居的野兽如此激烈的反应，但这种充满怨恨的愤怒所造成的后果可谓多种多样——从土地被毁到群体性恐慌，甚至包括宫廷秩序的崩溃。虽然这类暴行在“梦境世界”中属于无关紧要的事件，但其破坏力却丝毫不减。只有当那些激怒了这些野兽的人或野兽本身被彻底消灭时，这种暴行才会结束。

rows.original: As lurelings themselves are secretive and averse to contact with people save their marions, little is known about their habits. What is known has been gleaned through the memories of rehabilitated marions — visions of seeking mates through the Dreamscape, plays for dominance, alien recollections of what might be copulation in a sense they could not comprehend despite being touched by the beast. The stories suggest that lurelings may be hermaphroditic in the nature of some amphibians, or that they may switch sexes at will, but it is hard to piece together anything concrete from the shattered and broken minds of ex-marions. The most disturbing implication of the tales is that lurelings are said amongst themselves to be "born" in the Dreamscape before their physical bodies manifest, which raises more questions than it answers.
rows.translation: 由于这些诱饵生物本身性格隐秘，且除了与自己的配偶之外，极不愿意与他人接触，因此关于它们的生活习性，人们所知甚少。是这些信息都是通过那些被治愈的玛丽恩们的回忆获得的——她们描述了如何在梦境世界中寻找伴侣，为了争夺主导权而展开的各种行为，还有那些外星生物对于交配行为的模糊记忆，尽管它们亲身经历过这些行为，却仍然无法真正理解其含义。这些故事暗示，某些两栖动物中的“迷情者”可能具有雌雄同体的特性，或者它们可以随意改变自己的性别。但是，从那些精神错乱的前妻们口中，我们很难获得任何确凿的信息。这些故事最令人不安的地方在于，据说那些被称为“欲魔”的生物，在他们的肉体诞生之前，就已经“存在于”梦境之中了。这一说法引发的疑问远多于它所提供的答案。

rows.original: "But do allow me to introduce myself! Why, I am Raphael — previously adventurer extraordinaire, redistributor of misplaced wealth and connoisseur of all things fine in life. I will say, for demons, you people have such exotic and exquisite wares and such beautiful aesthetic; it truly brings me back to my younger days."
rows.translation: 不过，请允许我先做个自我介绍！我叫拉斐尔——曾经是一位出色的冒险家，专门帮助那些失去财宝的人重新获得它们，同时也是生活中一切美好事物的鉴赏家。说实话，对于恶魔来说，你们人类拥有的这些奇异而精美的物品，以及那种令人赞叹的美学风格，真的让我回想起了我年轻时的时光。

rows.original: —Raphael, the Russet Rogue Name: Vulperine(s). More commonly known Foxen or Foxfolk. Sexes: Males, females, and hermaphrodites. Height: 5ft. to 6 ft. on average, with males typically being a bit taller than females. Weight: Roughly the same as humans. Skin: While rarely seen beneath their full-body coats of fur, vulperine skin is usually pale or lightly tanned. Hair: Red, gray, or shades of blue and white are most common. Hair color differs from body-fur colors. Eyes: Vulperine eyes have black, slitted pupils similar to a cat's. Their irises are typically gold or red in coloration, but shades of dark blue, green, and pink are not unheard of, especially among northern tribes. Ears: Tall, alert fox-like ears. Lifespan: Vulperine have lifespans roughly the same as humans. Maturity: 18 years.
rows.translation: ——拉斐尔，那个红发浪人 名称：狐族。更常见的称呼是福克森或狐人族。 性别：雄性、雌性以及雌雄同体生物。 身高：平均身高在5英尺到6英尺之间，雄性通常比雌性稍高一些。 重量：与人类大致相同。 皮肤：虽然很少能看到它们全身覆盖的毛皮之下，但狐类的皮肤通常呈淡色或略微晒黑的状态。 头发：红色、灰色，或是蓝白相间的色调最为常见。头发的颜色与身体毛发的颜色通常是不同的。 眼睛：这些生物的眼睛拥有如同猫一般的黑色、狭长的瞳孔。它们的虹膜通常是金色或红色的，但偶尔也会出现深蓝色、绿色或粉红色的虹膜，尤其是在一些北方部落中。 耳朵：高而灵敏的、类似狐狸的耳朵。 寿命：狐人的寿命与人类大致相同。 成熟年龄： 18岁。

rows.original:
Vulperine are fox-like beastkin, similar in body structure to lupines though smaller in stature and slighter of build on average. The largest populations of vulperine are found in the south of the former Belharan empire, and typically have reddish or dark gray coloration; smaller tribes of hunter-gatherer vulperines also live in the Frost Marches and beyond, where individual fur patterns have adapted white and blue tones to better blend into the often-snowy environs.

        Male vulperine stand a bit taller and broader-shouldered than females. Female vulperine tend to have much wider hips and more distinctively fur-patterning on their forelimbs, reminiscent of stockings and gloves. They have breasts averaging at C-cups, and after pregnancy both the breast and the mother's middle tend to remain permanently heavier.
rows.translation:
狐人是一种外形类似狐狸的兽人种族，其身体结构与狼族相似，但平均而言体型更为娇小，体格也更为纤细。数量最多的狐人族群分布在前贝尔哈兰帝国的南部地区，它们的毛色通常呈红色或深灰色；而在霜冻边境地区，也生活着一些规模较小的狩猎采集型狐人部落，这些部落成员的毛色会呈现出白色和蓝色，以便更好地融入那些经常被积雪覆盖的环境中。

        雄性狐类通常比雌性体型更高大，肩部也更宽。雌性狐类的臀部通常更为宽大，前肢上的毛纹也更为明显，这些毛纹看起来很像长筒袜和手套。她们的胸部大小通常为C罩杯，怀孕后，她们的胸部和腰部会持续变得更为丰满。

rows.original:
Reproduction among vulperines is fundamentally lupine-like: males have knotted phalluses six to eight inches long, and females have dark-lipped vaginas into which the knots securely tie during mating. Pregnancy lasts seven months, in the latter stages of which expectant mothers will begin to lactate. Litters of newborn kits are born blind, and number between two and four per pregnancy. Kits remain helpless for their first six months, during which time they must be breastfed and tended to meticulously. Shortly after their eyes open, kits can begin to eat soft foods and will quickly learn to crawl. After this point, raising them is fundamentally human-like.

        Having been former subjects of the human- and elf-dominated Belhar, vulperines of the south have a long history of interbreeding successfully with humanoid races. Half-vulperine have human features with foxen ears and tails, and may have fur patterns on their forelimbs; males will have fox-like genitals.
rows.translation:
狐属动物的繁殖方式与狼属动物基本相同：雄性拥有长度为6到8英寸的结节状阴茎，而雌性则拥有深色阴唇，在交配过程中，雄性的结节会牢固地卡在雌性的阴道内。妊娠期持续7个月，在妊娠的最后阶段，雌性会开始分泌乳汁。每胎产下的幼崽都是失明的，数量通常在2到4只之间。在出生后的前6个月里，这些幼崽完全无助，必须依靠母乳喂养，并且需要人们细心照料。一旦它们的眼睛能够睁开，就可以开始食用软质食物了，而且也会很快学会爬行。从这一点来看，它们这种养育后代的方式本质上与人类相似。

        作为曾经受人类和精灵统治的贝尔哈尔地区的居民，南方的狐族长期以来一直能够与类人种族成功地进行杂交繁衍。半狐人拥有人类的外貌特征，但长着狐狸般的耳朵和尾巴，前肢上可能还带有毛色花纹；雄性半狐人的生殖器也会呈现狐狸的特征。

rows.original:
Vulperines have been a part of Imperial history almost as long as it has been recorded. The species is native predominantly to the southern reaches of the continent, where their towns and villages are widespread along the coast. The vulperines put up a protracted fight against the first Imperial legions to arrive in the region, and rebellions continued for the better part of a century. They were quick to raise arms against their masters during the first Tronarii-Belhar war, joining en-mass with the first Tronarii forces to arrive on the continent such that the largely-mercenary force nearly doubled in size before it reached its first battles with Belhar. 

        The chaos of the invasion continued at length until Emperor Edivus II personally lead a fleet to reconquer the region. He returned to the Holy City triumphant with thousands of foxen in chains and the head of the Tronarii king on a pike; soon after, the former vulperine lands became among the most prosperous Imperial colonies, its rich reserves of tin and gold made to fill the Imperial treasuries and arm its legions. From that day until the empire's end, vulperine lands were ever-after closely monitored by Imperial governors, and occupied by Belhar's most elite soldiers. To command Legio Vulperinus was considered one of the highest honors a Belharan soldier could be granted — and one of the most profitable.
rows.translation:
自人类有记载以来，狐人族这一物种就一直存在于帝国的历史之中。它们主要分布在大陆的南部地区，那里的沿海地带分布着它们众多的城镇和村落。这些女战士与首批抵达该地区的帝国军团展开了持久的抵抗，叛乱活动持续了将近一个世纪。在第一次特洛纳里-贝尔哈尔战争期间，她们迅速举起了反抗的旗帜，大量加入了首批抵达这片大陆的特洛纳里军队，使得这支主要由雇佣兵组成的部队在与贝尔哈尔交战之前，其规模几乎增加了一倍。 

        这场入侵带来的混乱持续了很长时间，直到埃迪弗斯二世皇帝亲自率领舰队重新征服了这片地区。他胜利归来，带着数千只被锁链束缚的狐狸，以及被插在长矛上的特洛纳里国王的头颅；不久之后，这片曾经属于狐狸族的土地便成为了帝国最繁荣的殖民地之一。那里丰富的锡矿和金矿为帝国的国库带来了巨额财富，也为帝国的军团提供了充足的武器装备。从那天起，直到帝国灭亡，那些被称为“狐人之地”的地区始终受到帝国总督的严密监视，而且这些地方一直由贝尔哈尔最精锐的士兵驻守。能够指挥“狐人军团”，被视为贝尔哈尔士兵所能获得的最高荣誉之一——同时也是最有利可图的荣誉之一。

From that day until the empire's end, vulperine lands were ever-after closely monitored by Imperial governors, and occupied by Belhar's most elite soldiers. To command Legio Vulperinus was considered one of the highest honors a Belharan soldier could be granted — and one of the most profitable.
        
        "

rows.original:
Even after Belhar's collapse, the southern vulperines remain deeply shaped by its centuries of influence upon their lands. Their cities are eminently Belharan in shape and construction, protected by Imperial walls and supplied by its aqueducts. Vulperines have a reputation among humans for being attractive and charming (and also deeply prone to thieving and other mischief); while during Imperial times this made slave and whore the leading occupations of the region, since the Godswar the region has had a minor resurgence of the arts and, particularly, in architecture. Vulperines are a deeply religious people, dominated by the Velunite faith, and great cathedrals interwoven with magically-grown oak trees acting as buttresses are becoming a common sight in the south. The church of Sorra also took root during the Belharan occupation in her guise as goddess of freedom and liberty; many mountaintop shrines were built in secret to her worship, and after the Godswar they have been greatly expanded into sprawling temple complexes.

        The ample quality stone from the shielding mountains in the north of the region, combined with what's left of its reserves of tin and gold, have lead to the region being quite quick to rebuild from the wars, though the population was severely depleted by the Wraiths — and even to this day, many coastal cities and mining towns are largely abandoned, their inhabitants consolidating what remained of their civilization into a few scattered settlements that they can properly defend and reconstruct.
        
        Southern vulperines share a great deal of contact with humans, elves, harpies, and taeleer. Naga and centaurs are common on the grassy plains inland from their domain, as well. It's not uncommon to see adventurous vulperines as far north as Yvennes, carried by the winds of trade and exploration.
        
        In the far north, however, is another population of vulperines entirely — those with winter-colored fur, native to the Frost Marches. These boreal vulperine are scattered and tribal, amounting to little more than hunter-gatherers surviving in the nordic tundra. Most of the boreal vulperine in the Marches were chased off from their ancestral lands by the arrival of kitsune colonists from overseas during the Godswar, but some small groups still persist west of the Greyvales and north-east of the old elven kingdom. These vulperine often trade with jotuns and frostscale salamanders, amongst whom their craft at scrimshaw is near legendary. Little is known of their culture behind their crafts and hunting prowess, for they care little to interact with scholars and bards.
rows.translation:
即使在贝尔哈尔帝国覆灭之后，南方的那些地区依然深受其几个世纪以来对这片土地所施加的影响。这些地区的城市在布局与建造风格上明显带有贝尔哈尔的特色，它们被帝国修建的城墙所保护，水源也依赖于贝尔哈尔的引水系统。在人类眼中，狐族女性以美丽迷人著称（同时也极其喜欢偷窃和搞些恶作剧）；而在帝国时代，这使得奴隶和妓女成为该地区的主要职业。然而自“神战”之后，这一地区的艺术，尤其是建筑艺术，又迎来了一次复兴。沃普琳人是一个极度虔诚的民族，他们的信仰主要受维伦尼特教义的影响。在南部地区，那些以魔法培育的橡树作为支撑结构、与宏伟的大教堂相互交织的建筑已成为常见的景象。在贝拉兰人占领期间，索拉女神以自由与解放的象征身份在人们心中扎根；许多山顶神龛都是为了崇拜她而秘密建造的，而在神战之后，这些神龛都被扩建成了规模庞大的寺庙建筑群。

        该地区北部防护山脉中出产的优质石材，再加上那里剩余的锡矿和金矿资源，使得该地区在战争过后能够迅速恢复重建。然而，幽灵们的侵袭导致当地人口锐减——直到今天，许多沿海城市和矿业小镇仍然基本处于废弃状态，只有少数居民聚集在少数几个能够得到有效防御和重建的定居点中，延续着残存的文明。
        
        南方的狐族与人类、精灵、女妖以及泰勒尔族有着频繁的接触。在他们领地内陆的草地上，娜迦族和半人马也十分常见。那些喜欢冒险的狐族，常常会随着贸易和探索的浪潮，被风带到遥远的伊文尼斯地区。
        
        然而，在最北方的地区，还存在着另一类狐族——那些拥有冬季色毛皮、原生于霜冻边境地区的狐族。这些生活在北方苔原地区的狐族分布较为分散，过着部落生活，基本上就是一些在北方冻原中生存的狩猎采集者。在神战期间，来自海外的狐人殖民者的到来使得边境地区的大部分北方狐族被迫离开了他们的祖传土地，但仍然有一些小群体在灰谷以西、古老的精灵王国东北部地区存活了下来。这些狡黠的生物经常与巨魔以及霜鳞蝾螈进行交易，在雕刻技艺方面，他们的造诣几乎堪称传奇。关于他们的文化背景以及狩猎能力，人们所知甚少，因为它们并不热衷于与学者或吟游诗人交流。

rows.translation: 狐人族
蝙蝠族

rows.original: Name: Batfolk. Sexes: Male and Female. Height: Ranges from between 4'4" and 6'2. Their average, however, is often below 5 feet tall. Weight: Lighter than humans; comparable to harpies, the weight distribution for batfolk tends to be in their hips with lithe builds to emphasize flight. Roughly 100-140 lbs. Skin: Batfolk have smooth skin and are almost entirely known for their pale and pinkish hues. Hair: Batfolk have both hair and fur; all hair and fur on their body is often one or two colors at most, with the common ranges being black, gray, brown, and blonde. Eyes: Batfolk eyes are all black; these black eyes are able to reflect low-light and give them uncharacteristically good night-vision in moonlit locations. However, sunlight or bright lights will cause the black to lighten and reveal their true eye color. Batfolk true eye colors can be any bright shading of colors, such as turquoise, yellow, red, and emerald. Ears: Batfolk can have one of two types of ears, depending on their lineage; some of them have triangular ears that stand up tall, whilst others have round ears comparable to a mecian's. Neck: Batfolk, depending on their heritage, can have either a smooth or fur-wreathed neck; these furry "wreathes" are often in colder climates and batfolk with ancestry in furrier interspecies partnering, while smoother necks are warmer and more "pure-blooded" batfolk. Tails: Batfolk traditionally have tiny short-furred and mostly non-functional tails; some batfolk, however, have furless prehensile spade-tipped tails. Spaded tails are always black-skinned, while furred tails generally match the batfolk's hair color. Lifespan: About 100 years. Maturity: 14 years.
rows.translation: 名称：蝙蝠族。 性别：男性和女性。 身高：身高范围在4英尺4英寸到6英尺2英寸之间，但他们的平均身高通常低于5英尺。 重量：蝙蝠人的体重比人类轻，其体重分布类似于鹰身女妖，主要集中在臀部，这样的身体构造使得他们更加适合飞行。他们的体重大约在100到140磅之间。 皮肤：蝙蝠族拥有光滑的皮肤，其肤色主要以淡粉色为主。 头发：蝙蝠族既有毛发也有皮毛；他们身体上的所有毛发和皮毛通常最多只有一种或两种颜色，常见的颜色有黑色、灰色、棕色和金色。 眼睛：蝙蝠族成员的眼睛都是黑色的；这种黑色的眼睛能够反射微弱的光线，因此他们在月光照射的环境中拥有异常出色的夜视能力。然而，当阳光或强光照射时，这种黑色会变淡，从而暴露他们真正的瞳色。蝙蝠族成员真正的瞳色可以是各种明亮的色彩，比如绿松石色、黄色、红色或翡翠色。 耳朵：蝙蝠族根据其血统不同，可以拥有两种类型的耳朵：有些蝙蝠族的耳朵呈三角形，且会高高竖立；而另一些蝙蝠族的耳朵则呈圆形，与机械族的耳朵相似。 颈部：蝙蝠族根据其血统不同，脖子上可能会覆盖着柔软的皮毛，也可能会有一圈浓密的毛环；这种毛环通常出现在气候较寒冷的地区，那些拥有与毛皮较多的其他物种有交配历史的蝙蝠族身上。而那些脖子上没有毛环的蝙蝠族，则生活在气候较温暖的环境中，它们通常被认为是“纯血统”的蝙蝠族。 尾巴：传统上，蝙蝠人拥有短小、毛发稀疏且几乎不起任何作用的尾巴；不过，也有一些蝙蝠人的尾巴上没有毛发，而是呈铲状结构，且末端呈尖刺状。那些具有铲状尾巴的蝙蝠人皮肤总是呈黑色，而那些拥有毛发尾巴的蝙蝠人，其尾巴的颜色通常与他们头发的颜色相匹配。 寿命：大约100年。 成熟年龄： 14岁。

rows.original:
One of Savarra's more reclusive residents, the batfolk are found generally throughout the world in any cavernous sections of hospitable temperate mountains. Batfolk commonly act as workers, messengers, and prostitutes thanks to their generally pleasant looks and sometimes bottom-heavy figures. Most batfolk have membranous skin that fits close to the arm, unfolding when they extend their arms to act as wings. Batfolk have their own local variations of ears, furs, and eyes.
        
        Depending on where they're from and who their parents are, batfolk are identified in two categories: tippers and rounders. Batfolk that live in warmer locales often have triangular ears whilst the colder natives have round ears with thicker fur backing to them. Short and long-furs exist, with trimming and growing out allowing them to easily relocate as-needed. Additional traits vary but may include longer tongues in some individuals or an exceptionally rarer ability to overcome their sunlight sensitivity. Without the shackle of sunlight sensitivity, batfolk not only live and function in a modern daytime society but always have their true eye color visible. However, these batfolk tend to have poorer night vision than others and as such are more prone to living and interacting near the surface.
rows.translation:
萨瓦拉地区那些较为隐居的居民中，蝙蝠族是其中之一。他们通常分布在世界各地那些气候温和、多洞穴的山脉地区。由于蝙蝠族的外表通常较为出众，有时体型也较为丰满，因此他们常常担任工人、信使或妓女的角色。大多数蝙蝠人拥有紧贴手臂的膜状皮肤，当他们伸展手臂时，这些皮肤会展开并充当翅膀。蝙蝠人在耳朵、毛发和眼睛的形态上也存在地域性差异。
        
        根据他们的出身地以及父母的基因特征，蝙蝠人被分为两大类：尖耳型与圆耳型。生活在温暖地区的蝙蝠族通常拥有三角形的耳朵，而生活在寒冷地区的蝙蝠族则拥有圆形的耳朵，而且这些耳朵上覆盖着较厚的毛发。它们既有短毛也有长毛，通过修剪或让毛发自然生长，它们可以轻松地根据需要改变自己的外形。其他特征因个体而异，有些个体的舌头可能会更长，而还有一种极为罕见的能力，使他们能够克服对阳光的敏感反应。由于不再受阳光敏感性的束缚，蝙蝠人不仅能够在现代的日间社会中正常生活与活动，他们的真实眼睛颜色也会清晰可见。然而，这些蝙蝠人通常夜视能力较差，因此更倾向于生活在地表附近，并在靠近地面的地方活动与交流。

rows.original:
Male and female batfolk, despite their traditionally effeminate and light build mirroring harpies, exhibit traditional reproductive capacities seen in humans; the males have dicks that achieve an average of between 8" to 12", and the females have wide hips and supple chests. It isn't uncommon for a batfolk household to be large due to their fast reproductive cycle featuring five-month pregnancies and seasonal rutting and heats that hits them twice a year. Further still, their similarities in builds are shared further in a lack of a refractory period for males; this grants them tremendous stamina, allowing for particularly long breeding sessions that often ensure impregnation.
        
        Adequate cross-species couplings have revealed that batfolk are a "dominant" partner with most races; this means that when impregnating and being impregnated, their children are almost exclusively born as full-blooded batfolk. The exceptions most well-documented are harpies and goblins, as harpies lay eggs that hatch as more harpies whilst goblins inherit their traits.
rows.translation:
无论是雄性还是雌性蝙蝠人，尽管他们的外形通常较为纤细柔弱，与鹰身女妖相似，但他们仍具备与人类相同的生殖能力；雄性蝙蝠人的阴茎平均长度在8到12英寸之间，而雌性蝙蝠人则拥有宽大的髋部和柔软的胸部。对于蝙蝠族来说，由于它们的繁殖周期较短——妊娠期仅为五个月，而且每年会有两次发情期，因此一个家庭中拥有较多的后代并不罕见。此外，雄性蝙蝠族没有所谓的“不应期”，这一生理特征使得它们拥有极高的耐力，从而能够进行持续较长时间的交配行为，这也大大增加了它们成功受孕的概率。
        
        充分的跨物种交配实验表明，蝙蝠族与大多数种族结合时，都能成为“主导方”；这意味着当他们进行交配时，他们的后代几乎都会是纯种的蝙蝠族。记录最为详尽的例外情况是哈比人和哥布林：哈比人产下的蛋会孵化出更多的哈比人，而哥布林则会继承它们的特性。

rows.original: Unique to batfolk is an extremely evolved ability: echolocation. Generations beneath the surface, traveling the dark night's sky, and sneaking around to their lovers' beds in pitch black have allowed batfolk to use noise for navigation. All batfolk are born with the ability to use low, all-but-inaudible thumps of their longer tongues against their cheeks; batfolk instinctively learn to use this at about a year old, with the pitch lowering the older they get as their tongue grows in size and weight. Younger batfolk in turn have a shorter-ranged thump, making it better for communal navigation while the older batfolk can use it to lead flights and detect objects within two miles. Though this thumping echolocation is effective for their own navigation, batfolk learn overtime to use any noise to assist their movements in the dark; some of the best thieves have been batfolk, able to hear the pitter-patter of a mouse and use its noise to map out the routes ahead. This legend started from, in fact, not a thief but a mage: a Sound Mage. One of the least known variations of magic, Resonance Magic combines both White and Black magic schools into a magic that can disorient, guide, and damage. Mages among the batfolk in this school are considered its founders due to their natural evolution for using it, with every student who walks this path choosing one of three focuses: Shrieker, Listener, and Thumpers. Shriekers, true to their name, use their voice to disorient and disrupt enemies. Listeners use their magic to improve their hearing, allowing them abilities to identify whatever they hear with near-perfect accuracy. Thumpers are able to use magical reinforcement in their mouth to create even louder bangs; these can create minor shockwaves or even powerful enough sound blasts to knock warriors off their feet. The diversity in this school of magic has made most sound mages highly flexible and unpredictable, making them a fairly common asset in organized, large-scale armies that can recruit and train them.
rows.translation: 蝙蝠族拥有一种极为进化过的能力：回声定位。在地下生活了数代之后，它们在漆黑的夜空中穿梭移动，也在完全暗影的环境中悄悄接近自己的爱人，这些经历使蝙蝠族能够利用声音来进行导航。所有蝙蝠人天生就具备这样一种能力：他们可以用自己较长的舌头轻轻敲击自己的脸颊，发出几乎听不见的低沉声响。蝙蝠人们在大约一岁的时候就会本能地学会使用这种能力，而随着年龄的增长，他们的舌头会变得更大更重，因此发出的声音的音调也会随之降低。年轻的蝙蝠族使用的回声定位技能作用范围较短，因此更适合群体行动时的导航；而年长的蝙蝠族则可以利用这一技能来引领飞行队伍，并探测两英里范围内的物体。 尽管这种回声定位方式对它们自身的导航非常有效，但蝙蝠族经过长时间的进化，已经学会了如何灵活运用这一能力。任何这些声音有助于他们在暗影中行动；一些最出色的窃贼其实就是蝙蝠人，他们能够听到老鼠的活动声，并利用这些声音来规划前行的路线。事实上，这个传说最初并不是关于窃贼的，而是关于一位法师——一位音波法师。共振魔法是魔法体系中最为鲜为人知的一种变体，它将白魔法与黑魔法的力量融合在一起，这种魔法既能使人迷失方向，也能引导目标，同时还能造成伤害。在蝙蝠族中，那些擅长运用这种魔法的法师们被视为其创始人，因为他们天生就适合使用这种魔法。每一位选择这条道路的学生都必须选择三种发展方向中的一种：尖叫者、倾听者或震击者。名副其实的“尖叫者”们会利用自己的声音来扰乱敌人的注意力、使他们迷失方向。而“倾听者”们则借助魔法增强自己的听力，从而能够以近乎完美的精准度识别自己所听到的任何声音。至于“重击者”，他们能够利用口腔中的魔法力量制造出更加剧烈的声响——这些声响既能引发轻微的冲击波，也能产生强大到足以将战士震倒的声音冲击波。这种魔法体系的多样性使得大多数资深法师都具备了极高的灵活性与不可预测性，因此，在那些能够招募并训练他们的规模庞大的正规军队中，他们往往成为非常宝贵的力量。
rows.raw: " Unique to batfolk is an extremely evolved ability: echolocation. Generations beneath the surface, traveling the dark night's sky, and sneaking around to their lovers' beds in pitch black have allowed batfolk to use noise for navigation. All batfolk are born with the ability to use low, all-but-inaudible thumps of their longer tongues against their cheeks; batfolk instinctively learn to use this at about a year old, with the pitch lowering the older they get as their tongue grows in size and weight. Younger batfolk in turn have a shorter-ranged thump, making it better for communal navigation while the older batfolk can use it to lead flights and detect objects within two miles. Though this thumping echolocation is effective for their own navigation, batfolk learn overtime to use any noise to assist their movements in the dark; some of the best thieves have been batfolk, able to hear the pitter-patter of a mouse and use its noise to map out the routes ahead. This legend started from, in fact, not a thief but a mage: a Sound Mage. One of the least known variations of magic, Resonance Magic combines both White and Black magic schools into a magic that can disorient, guide, and damage. Mages among the batfolk in this school are considered its founders due to their natural evolution for using it, with every student who walks this path choosing one of three focuses: Shrieker, Listener, and Thumpers. Shriekers, true to their name, use their voice to disorient and disrupt enemies. Listeners use their magic to improve their hearing, allowing them abilities to identify whatever they hear with near-perfect accuracy. Thumpers are able to use magical reinforcement in their mouth to create even louder bangs; these can create minor shockwaves or even powerful enough sound blasts to knock warriors off their feet. The diversity in this school of magic has made most sound mages highly flexible and unpredictable, making them a fairly common asset in organized, large-scale armies that can recruit and train them. "

rows.original:
The cultural roots of batfolk are that of nomads. All recorded knowledge about their culture is sparse due to their ancient migrations across Savarra, dating back as one of the few pieces of information prior to the fall of Belhar. Most modern batfolk have abandoned this in light of settling near settlements of other species, where they propagate in higher numbers until they form their own districts that serve as sources for brothels and cheap labor. It isn't uncommon for the Mallachite faith to find a home among these populations, but traditionally the batfolk that still migrate practice a dual-worship of Velun and Sorra. Velun's guidance grants them havens when between mountains, whilst Sorra is prayed to whenever they take flight.
        
        In this modern age, there are two societies of batfolk currently thriving: the Grue Clan and the Inva Clan. The Grue live in the north, where their contact with the minotaurs has made them profitable merchants whilst preserving their culture in migratory flights using the vast Deeprealms. Meanwhile, the Inva Clan use the seas north of Jassira and Tronarii as their migratory grounds. Ancient spires in the sea have been found holding the clan from time to time, where they sell their services as navigators and scouts to passing ships. Some scholars theorize that their location and the lack of conflict with orcs means that batfolk have struck deals with them, possibly even granting the orcs maps that allow them to find ripe spots for raiding.
rows.translation:
蝙蝠族的文化根源可以追溯到游牧民族的生活方式。由于他们自古以来就在萨瓦拉地区迁徙流动，关于他们文化的记载极为稀少。这些零星的信息，是贝尔哈尔帝国灭亡之前为数不多的相关资料之一。大多数现代蝙蝠族已经放弃了这种生活方式，因为他们逐渐在其他物种的聚居地附近安家落户。在那里，他们的数量不断增加，最终形成了属于自己的聚居区，而这些聚居区后来成为了妓院和廉价劳动力的来源地。在这些群体中，人们信仰玛拉奇特教并不罕见。但传统上，那些仍然进行迁徙的蝙蝠族会同时崇拜维伦与索拉。当他们在山间穿行时，会祈求维伦的指引以获得庇护；而每当他们展翅飞翔时，也会向索拉祈祷。
        
        在这个现代时代，目前有两大蝙蝠族社群正在蓬勃发展：灰暗氏族与入侵氏族。灰暗氏族居住在北方，由于他们与弥诺陶洛斯的往来，他们成为了腰缠万贯的商人，同时也在利用广袤的深境空间进行迁徙活动，从而保留了自己的文化传统。与此同时，英瓦氏族以贾西拉和特洛纳里以北的海域作为他们的迁徙地。人们偶尔会在海中发现一些古老的尖塔，这些地方正是英瓦氏族驻扎的地方——他们会向路过的船只提供导航和侦察服务，以此换取报酬。一些学者推测，由于蝙蝠人所处的地理位置以及他们与兽人之间没有发生冲突，这意味着蝙蝠人很可能与兽人达成了某种协议，甚至可能向兽人提供了地图，这些地图帮助兽人找到了适合进行袭击的目标地点。

rows.translation: 蝙蝠族
维帕鲁斯族

rows.original: Name: Veparus, Veparii. Sexes: Male, female. Height: Ranges from 6'0" (183cm) or 12'0" (366cm) end to end to 9'0" (274cm) or 16'0" (488cm) end to end. Weight: Ranges from roughly 350lb to 900lb (159kg to 408kg). Hair: Black, brown, gray, white. Eyes: Blue, amber, green, brown, purple. Lifespan: 120-130 years. Maturity: 25 years.
rows.translation: 名称：维帕鲁斯族， 维帕鲁斯族。 性别：男性、女性。 身高：长度范围从6英尺0英寸（183厘米）或12英尺0英寸（366厘米）到9英尺0英寸（274厘米）或16英尺0英寸（488厘米）不等。 重量：重量范围大约在350磅到900磅之间（即159公斤到408公斤）。 头发：黑色、棕色、灰色、白色。 眼睛：蓝色、琥珀色、绿色、棕色、紫色。 寿命： 120到130年。 成熟年龄： 25岁。

rows.original:
Veparii are by and large hunters that inhabit mildly cold territories, preferring to remain in temperatures not outright hostile. They have some tufts of fur around their wrists and a bigger one in the center of their chests to help insulate against the worst of the chill and aid in circulation. Their usual environments tend to be snowy and as such, their scale and fur coloration ranges from white to various shades of gray.
        
        The Veparus travels by way of slithering — their humanoid upper bodies are conjoined to that of an enormous snake, and as predatory hunters they are capable of surprising rapidity when the need strikes. Their heights and weights tend to vary enormously depending on the individual and the season. The heaviest Veparus ever recorded was a village chieftain right before his seasonal hibernation at 903lb.
        
        Though they habitually hibernate through the deepening of winter, they are capable of staving it off — though not without struggle. They are prone to insomnia and narcolepsy both should they maintain their wakefulness for too long. When they eventually fall asleep in such a situation it is likely they will not rise for several days, making it a very dangerous prospect to be alone in such circumstances.
rows.translation:
维帕鲁斯族人主要是生活在气候较为寒冷地区的猎手，他们更喜欢待在温度不会过于严寒的环境中。他们的手腕处长有一些绒毛，胸部中央也有一块较大的绒毛，这些绒毛有助于抵御极端的寒冷，并促进血液循环。它们通常生活的环境都是多雪的，因此，它们的体型和毛色从白色到各种深浅不一的灰色都有。
        
        维帕鲁斯族这类生物是通过滑行来移动的——它们的人形上半身与一条巨大的蛇身相连，作为捕食者，当需要迅速行动时，它们能够以惊人的速度移动。它们的身高和体重会因个体差异以及季节变化而产生很大的差异。有记录以来最重的维帕鲁斯族是一位在季节性冬眠前的村庄首领，他的体重达到了903磅。
        
        虽然它们通常会在冬季来临时进入冬眠状态，但它们也具备抵御严寒的能力——尽管这一过程会带来一定的困难。如果他们长时间保持清醒状态，就很容易出现失眠或嗜睡症。在这种情况下，当他们最终入睡后，很可能会连续几天都不会醒来，因此如果独自处于这种环境中，将会面临非常危险的情况。

rows.original: The male Veparii possess a singular reptilian penis between eight and twelve inches long, in contrast to the hemipenes of many similar races. Mating occurs at any convenience — Veparii are not bound by estrus cycles or the like, and as such breeding is a possibility at any given time. It is not unheard of for a female Veparus to give birth during hibernation as a result. Adult female Veparii are generally very choosy about their partners owing to the race's territorial nature, and fights for the right to mate one — between the males and the female — are common. They have a human vagina right before their skin melds into their scales lower halves, enabling frontal penetration. A usual litter of children is anywhere between one and four, with childcare being taken care of by the mother. Veparii give birth to live young, with each pregnancy lasting 10 months.
rows.translation: 雄性维帕鲁斯族族的生殖器官为一条长度在8到12英寸之间的蛇形器官，这与许多同类种族的半阴茎结构截然不同。维帕鲁斯族族不会受到发情周期等生理因素的约束，因此它们可以在任何方便的时候进行交配，繁殖活动随时都有可能发生。因此，雌性维帕鲁斯族在冬眠期间分娩的情况也并非罕见。 由于该种族具有领地性，成年雌性维帕鲁斯族通常会对伴侣的选择非常挑剔，雄性们也会为争夺交配权而发生争斗。以及雌性个体较为常见。在它们的皮肤与下半身的鳞片融合之前，会形成类似人类的阴道结构，这使得雄性能够从正面进行交配。每胎通常会产下1到4只幼崽，母亲会负责照顾这些幼崽。维帕鲁斯族属于胎生动物，每次妊娠期长达10个月。

rows.original:
The roots of the Veparus are unknown but most scholars suspect they are a branch species sharing a common ancestor with other nagas, adapting to a new, colder environment over time until the blood link was broken. It is unknown whether they can interbreed. The Veparii do not have their own alphabet but have shown no problems in learning that of another's culture — they are proficient learners, as is necessary for predators.
        
        A wild theory, oft-criticized by experts in the field, is that Veparii are a creation of Nareva, the goddess of secrets herself, pointing to their talent in arcanery and magic as proof. In truth, their roots are somewhat of a mystery. Asking a Veparus themselves is likely to result in an indifferent shrug.
rows.translation:
维帕鲁斯族这一物种的起源尚不明确，但大多数学者认为，它们属于与其他纳加族生物共享共同祖先的分支物种。随着时间的推移，这些生物逐渐适应了新的、更加寒冷的环境，最终导致了它们与其它纳加族成员之间的血缘联系中断。目前还不清楚它们是否能够相互交配。维帕鲁斯族人并没有自己的字母系统，但他们学习其他文化的字母时从未遇到过任何困难——作为捕食者，他们具备出色的学习能力，这一点是必不可少的。
        
        有一种大胆的理论经常受到该领域专家的批评，那就是维帕鲁斯族人其实是秘密女神娜瑞瓦创造的，而他们在这方面的神秘学与魔法天赋正是这一理论的证据。事实上，它们的起源至今仍是个谜。如果直接去询问维帕鲁斯族本身，它们很可能只会漠然地耸耸肩而已。

rows.original:
From birth a Veparus is incapable for the first few years, with the mother and father protecting them until they're old enough to hunt. When adulthood comes the family tends to break apart, with the children leaving to find territory of their own and the parents seeking new mates. The more civilized of Veparii seem to have no problems with remaining together with their mates as they age, however.
        
        Both males and females are excellent hunters in their own rights, utilizing whatever weapons they fashion from the land or buy from traders. They usually hunt large animals owing to their dietary needs, such is their size.
        
        As a mostly solitary race, it is not uncommon for individuals to find some measure of comfort in accompanying travelers through their territory or as mercenaries.
rows.translation:
从出生起，在最初的几年里，维帕鲁斯族一族的后代们是无法独立生存的，因此它们的父母会一直保护它们，直到它们长大到可以自行捕猎为止。当它们成年后，这个家庭往往会分裂——孩子们会离开去寻找属于自己的领地，而父母则会去寻找新的伴侣。然而，维帕鲁斯族族中较为文明的那部分人似乎并不介意随着年龄的增长而继续与自己的伴侣生活在一起。
        
        无论是雄性还是雌性，他们都是非常出色的猎手，会利用自己从自然界中获取的武器，或是从商人那里买来的武器来进行狩猎。由于它们的体型缘故，出于生存需求，它们通常会捕猎大型动物。
        
        作为一种主要以独居为生活方式的种族，个体们选择跟随旅行者穿越它们的领地，或者担任雇佣兵，以此来获得某种心理上的慰藉，这种情况并不少见。

rows.translation: 维帕鲁斯族
阿努比亚人

rows.original: "An interesting race, the anubians. Dog people with big ears and always-moving tails. Hotter than hells where they come from, but spend any time in their oases scattered through their homeland, and you just may willingly throw yourself into one of the harems and never leave."
rows.translation: 真是个有趣的种族——阿努比亚人。那些长着大耳朵、尾巴总是摇个不停的‘狗人’。他们来自比地狱还要炎热的地方，但只要在他们故乡那些零星分布的绿洲里待上一段时间，你很可能会自愿加入他们中的某个后宫，然后永远不再离开。
rows.raw: '\n        "An interesting race, the anubians. Dog people with big ears and always-moving tails. Hotter than hells where they come from, but spend any time in their oases scattered through their homeland, and you just may willingly throw yourself into one of the harems and never leave."\n        '

rows.original: —Overheard in a tavern from a far-wandering trader Name: Anubian (pl, Anubians) Sexes: Male, Female, and Shemale Height: Range from 5'5" and 6'3" Weight: Much the human norm, even when one factors in their immaculately-presented tails. Skin: Skin typical of humans, ranging from bronze to a dusky hue. Hair/Fur: Dark hair colorations are the most common with this race, and their hair is typically interlaced with precious metals and stones. Eyes: Typical eye colorations of this lupine race are gold and a warm brown, but the normal human range can apply Ears: Anubians have large, jackal-like ears perched atop their heads. Lifespan: About 80 years Maturity: 18 years
rows.translation: —在一家酒馆里，从一个漂泊不定的商人口中听到的 名称：阿努比安人 性别：男性、女性和跨性别者 身高：身高范围在5英尺5英寸到6英尺3英寸之间。 重量：这与人类的普遍行为并无二致，即便考虑到它们那整洁美观的尾巴。 皮肤：人类的典型肤色，从青铜色到深棕色不等。 毛发/皮毛：这个种族最常见的发色是深色，他们的头发通常会镶嵌珍贵的金属和宝石。 眼睛：这种狼族种族的典型眼色是金色和暖棕色，但人类的正常眼色范围也适用于他们。 耳朵：阿努比亚人的头顶上长着一对像豺狼一样的大耳朵。 寿命：大约80年 成熟年龄： 18岁
rows.raw: "—Overheard in a tavern from a far-wandering trader Name: Anubian (pl, Anubians) Sexes: Male, Female, and Shemale Height: Range from 5'5" and 6'3" Weight: Much the human norm, even when one factors in their immaculately-presented tails. Skin: Skin typical of humans, ranging from bronze to a dusky hue. Hair/Fur: Dark hair colorations are the most common with this race, and their hair is typically interlaced with precious metals and stones. Eyes: Typical eye colorations of this lupine race are gold and a warm brown, but the normal human range can apply Ears: Anubians have large, jackal-like ears perched atop their heads. Lifespan: About 80 years Maturity: 18 years "

rows.original:
Anubians are the exotic neighbors of catfolk in the great shifting dunes of that far-off place. They interbreed often with humans, and are said to have once been much closer to the Lupine race in resemblance than they are now.

        The average anubian stands between five and six feet of height, and tend to be lithe. They are almost completely human in appearance, with the exception of a pair of huge jackal ears on their heads and a long, seemingly always wagging, dog tail. 
        
        On average, anubian females are slightly taller than their male counterparts, and have typically between C-D cup breasts, with only a few cases of even larger naturally-occurring ones. 
        
        Anubian males, stand a few inches shorter on average than the women, and are lean on average. Male members are about the same size as average on a human, however, are generally bright red and tapered like a dog's, with a thick knot at the base for ensuring conception when lodged in a female.
rows.translation:
在遥远异域那片不断变幻的浩瀚沙丘中，阿努比斯人与猫人毗邻而居。他们经常与人类通婚，据说其外貌曾经比现在更接近狼族。

        阿努比斯人的平均身高在五到六英尺之间，体型通常较为轻盈。他们看起来几乎与人类无异，唯独头顶长着一对巨大的胡狼耳朵，身后还拖着一条似乎永远在摇晃的犬尾。
        
        阿努比斯女性平均比男性略高，乳房通常介于C到D罩杯之间，只有少数人的天生尺寸会更大。
        
        阿努比斯男性平均比女性矮几英寸，体型大多精瘦。他们的阳物尺寸与普通人类男性相近，但通常呈鲜红色，像犬根一样前端渐尖，根部还有一处粗大的结，用于在插入雌性体内时确保受孕。

rows.original:
While fertile year-round, anubian women experience a period of heat one week out of every four, with the males entering rut along a similar cycle. 
        
        After copulation, an anubian's pregnancy will last about eight-nine months before typically giving birth to a %"litter" of two-three. Pups are wholly reliant on their mother's milk for about 2-3 years before being weaned on solid foods. 
        
        Having large harems is typical of the race, and the pups are raised to adulthood among many %"aunts" or %"uncles", and typically enjoy the attentions of many older siblings.
rows.translation:
虽然阿努比亚的女性全年都能生育，但她们每四周中会有一个星期进入发情期，雄性动物也会按照类似的周期进入发情状态。
        
        交配后，阿努比亚女性的妊娠期大约为八到九个月，通常会产下两到三只幼崽。幼崽在大约2到3年的时间里完全依赖母乳为生，之后才会开始食用固体食物。
        
        这一物种的一个典型特征就是拥有庞大的后宫群体，幼崽们在许多“阿姨”或“叔叔”的照料下长大成人，通常也会受到许多年长兄弟姐妹的关爱。

rows.original:
Neighbors to the sphinx-born catfolk in the warm and level deserts of Jassira, the anubians have long lived under the scorching heat of the desert sun, taking refuge in many oases scattered across that desolation. It is said that in ancient times the catfolk and anubians once shared the same empire and gods, but much history has been lost since the Godswar, and the jackal-like people have retreated to their isolated paradises for now. 

        Anubians trade often with the catfolk, and indeed, many catfolk can be found in or even the alpha of an anubian harem. Most trade comes from the harvest of honey and strange desert plants that grow only in the heart of the sands, and are viewed as delicacies by the upper crust of Jassiran nobility.
rows.translation:
在贾西拉那温暖而平坦的沙漠中，与斯芬克斯出生的猫族族为邻的阿努比亚人长期以来一直生活在沙漠烈日的炙烤之下，他们躲藏在那些遍布沙漠中的绿洲之中。据说在远古时期，猫族族和阿努比亚人曾共同属于同一个帝国，也信奉着相同的神明，但在那场神战之后，许多历史资料已经遗失，而这些外形如同豺狼的民族也就暂时退回到了他们与世隔绝的家园之中。 

        阿努比亚人经常与猫族进行贸易，事实上，在许多阿努比亚人的后宫中都能找到猫族。他们的贸易主要依赖于采集蜂蜜以及那些仅生长在沙漠腹地的稀有植物，这些植物被贾西兰贵族阶层视为珍馐。
