rows.original: —Carrick Dreamwright, Master of Riverstride Orchard Name: Mecian (pl. mecians) Sexes: Male and Female Height: Mecians range from 4'0 to 4'10 with almost no outlier. Skin: Mecians can be born with or without fur, but never without their signature ears and tails. Males have a higher probability of being born with long muzzles and full coats of fur, standing on digitigrade legs, while Females tend to have furred limbs or no fur at all. Skin colors range from light to umber. Fur colors are similarly plain, the most common colors being brown, gray, and black. Hair: Regardless of whether or not they have bodies of fur, all mecians have hair that typically finishes growing at their shoulders, usually a plain contrast to their skin or fur color. Eyes: Mecian eyes are round and non-distinct, identical to any human's. They share the same colors: blues, greens, browns, etc. Ears: Two round, circular ears atop the head, filled with a little fuzz. Mecian ears are large, with very little if any difference in size and shape. Lifespan: 75 to 85 years. Due in part to their uncanny vitality, some mecians may live for much longer periods. Maturity: 18 years.
rows.translation: ——卡里克·德雷姆赖特，河步果园的主人 名称：米西亚人（复数：米西亚人） 性别：男性与女性 身高：米西亚人的身高通常在4英尺0英寸到4英尺10英寸之间，几乎没有例外。 皮肤：米西亚人出生时可能带有毛发，也可能没有，但他们特有的耳朵和尾巴肯定是会有的。雄性米西亚人更有可能出生时就有长吻部、浓密的毛发，并且会用趾行方式行走，而雌性米西亚人的四肢要么有毛发，要么完全没有毛发。他们的皮肤颜色从浅色到棕褐色不等，毛发的颜色也相对较为单一，最常见的颜色是棕色、灰色和黑色。 头发：无论是否拥有毛茸茸的身体，所有的米西亚人都会长出毛发，这些毛发通常会长到他们的肩膀处，其颜色往往与他们的皮肤或毛发的颜色形成鲜明的对比。 眼睛：米西亚人的眼睛呈圆形，外观并不特别明显，与人类的眼睛没有任何区别。他们的眼睛也拥有各种颜色：蓝色、绿色、棕色等等。 耳朵：头顶上长着两只圆圆的耳朵，上面覆盖着一层细软的绒毛。米西亚人的耳朵很大，而且它们的大小和形状几乎没有任何差别。 寿命： 75到85年。由于某些米西亚人拥有惊人的生命力，他们中的一些人可能会活得更久。 成熟年龄： 18岁。

rows.original:
Mecians are diminutive humanoids possessed of features found on common rodentia. Apart from lengthy bald tails and dish-shaped ears, the mousefolk have the unique quirk of being born with or without fur. Fully furred individuals walk on digitigrade legs while others walk plantigrade. All mecians have claws on their hands and feet perfect for climbing. If left untrimmed, they become dangerously pronounced, turning an advantage into a sharp distraction. Additionally, all mecians have mousey buckteeth: two incisors either small or oversized. Those with the latter tend to grind their teeth on stale foodstuffs until a desired length or edge is achieved.

        The mousefolk are a lithe, slender, and endurant race with superlative hearing and long, prehensile tails. Their tails are as long as they are tall, functioning as an extra limb in their own right. Mecians have full control over their rear appendages, possessing enough strength to effectively wield tools or weapons attached to the ends. Some are known to be able to support their entire body weight with it.

        In spite of their small stature, all mecians are surprisingly tolerant of hardship, possessed of an almost supernatural vitality. Many common ailments, and indeed most poisons and toxins, are known not to affect them. Their bodies may look thin at a distance, but each mouse is a fit creature for their size, traveling great distances without need for rest or sustenance. These inborn qualities tend to steer the mousefolk towards stringent fieldwork like agriculture or construction where their uncompromising physiology truly shines. Rarer, and equally noteworthy, is the mecian who chooses the life of a trader or merchant, leading great and profitable caravans.
rows.translation:
米西亚人是一种体型较小的类人生物，他们拥有许多常见啮齿类动物所具有的特征。除了长长的光秃尾巴和碟形耳朵外，这些鼠人还有一个独特的特点：他们出生时可能会带有毛发，也可能会没有毛发。那些全身长满毛发的米西亚人用趾行方式行走，而那些没有毛发的米西亚人则用跖行方式行走。所有机械族生物的手脚上都长有非常适合攀爬的爪子。如果这些爪子不进行修剪，它们会变得过于明显，从而将这一优势变成一种妨碍行动的障碍。此外，所有机械族生物还都长着类似老鼠的獠牙：两颗门牙，要么很小，要么特别大。那些属于后者的人，往往会反复咀嚼那些已经变硬的食物，直到达到他们想要的长度或边缘效果。

        鼠人是一个身形敏捷、纤细且耐力极强的种族，他们拥有出色的听觉能力，以及长长的、具有抓握功能的尾巴。这些尾巴的长度与他们的身高相当，完全可以作为他们的第二条肢体来使用。鼠人能够完全控制自己的这些后肢，它们拥有足够的力量，使他们能够有效地使用绑在尾巴末端的工具或武器；有些鼠人甚至能够用尾巴来支撑自己的整个体重。

        尽管体型娇小，但这些机械族生物却出奇地能够忍受各种艰苦环境，拥有近乎超自然的生命力。许多常见的疾病，以及几乎所有的毒物和毒素，似乎都对它们毫无影响。从远处看，它们的身体可能显得很瘦弱，但实际上，以它们的体型而言，每一只机械鼠都是非常健康的生物——它们可以长途跋涉，而无需休息或补充能量。这些与生俱来的特质往往使鼠人倾向于从事农业或建筑这类需要严谨劳动力的工作，在这些领域中，他们那毫不妥协的生理条件确实能够发挥出最大的优势。而更为罕见、同样值得关注的是那些选择从事贸易或商业活动的鼠人——他们能够带领规模庞大、利润丰厚的商队，取得辉煌的成就。

rows.original:
Tales gathered from tight-lipped mecians all tell a similar origin story: that none know from whom they are descended. At no point in history have the mecians ever controlled great tracts of land nor fashioned themselves rulers of any demesne. Two reasons have been bandied back and forth for many years, but scholars argue that neither explain the rigid adherence to increasingly outdated tribal standards. The first is that most mecians tend to wander the greater world for much of their life before choosing to settle down in extant homesteads, or banding together to establish a new home. The second is that mecians are a rare sight, and that there have never been enough of the mousefolk in a single area to lead to civilizational evolution. A third, unsubstantiated reason suggests that the mice simply do not desire great families.

        Homesteads, villages, and even the unique walled town were found all across Savarra before the Godswar, chiefly in lowland plains, hills, valleys, and sometimes in the mountains. Even the wildest orcs could be persuaded into leaving them alone in exchange for valuable trade goods and copious foodstuffs. Devoted to the simplest forms of economy, backed by a desire for peace, the mecians became known for their agrarian society.

        While they maintained a strong relationship with the Belhar Empire and all its constituents, and indeed a fair presence within its borders, even the desolation wrought by the Godswar did not unite these people into one cohesive faction; their natural skittishness and eagerness to please those of other races who could inspire them as leaders meant they never quite coalesced into a single racial identity. Their numbers dwindled after the collapse. Whether or not that's because they chose to flee, go into hiding, or were caught by the wraiths is unknown.

        Nobody noticed when they gradually began to reappear, reconnecting with scattered settlements and Belharan remnants attempting to eke out the living they once had. Where other races had come to rely on their advancements in the sciences or the magics, the mecians were able to cope with simple needs, simple goals, and once again contribute their resourcefulness to the slow rebuilding.
rows.translation:
那些从守口如瓶的机械师们口中听来的故事，都讲述着相似的起源：没有人知道自己的祖先究竟是谁。在历史上，这些机械师们从未控制过广袤的土地，也从未自封为任何领地的统治者。多年来，人们一直争论着两个原因，但学者们认为，这两个原因都无法解释人们为何会如此固执地遵循那些日益过时的部落准则。第一个原因是，大多数机械师在决定在现有的定居点安家落户或联合建立新的家园之前，往往会在大千世界中漂泊许久。其次，机械族极为罕见，而且在任何一片地区，鼠人的数量都从未多到足以促成文明的进化。第三个、缺乏依据的说法认为，老鼠们根本就不愿意建立庞大的家族。

        在神战之前，萨瓦拉各地都分布着家园、村庄，甚至那些设有围墙的独特城镇，它们主要位于低地平原、丘陵地带、山谷之中，有时也会出现在山区。即便是最凶猛的兽人，也能被珍贵的贸易物品和丰富的食物所吸引，从而放弃对这些定居点的侵扰。机械族人们秉持着最朴素的经济理念，同时也渴望和平，因此他们的农业社会逐渐闻名于世。

        尽管他们与贝尔哈尔帝国及其所有成员保持着密切的关系，也在该帝国的疆域内占据了重要的地位，但即便是神战所带来的种种灾难，也未能将这些民族团结成一个紧密的整体；他们天性中的多疑与那种渴望取悦那些能够激励他们、成为他们领袖的其他种族的倾向，使得他们始终无法形成一个统一的民族认同。在崩溃之后，他们的数量急剧减少。究竟是因为他们选择了逃跑、躲藏起来，还是被那些幽灵抓住了，目前还不得而知。

        当它们逐渐重新出现，与那些分散的定居点以及那些仍在努力维持往日生活的贝尔哈兰残余势力重新建立联系时，没有人注意到这一变化。与其他依靠科技进步或魔法力量的种族不同，机械族能够依靠自己的聪明才智来满足最基本的需求，实现最简单的目标，从而再次为这一缓慢的重建进程贡献自己的力量。

rows.original:
Mecian society is odd in that it runs on a single, simple hierarchy befitting small hamlets numbering no more than a hundred at any given time. There are captains of the guard, there are village elders, but no one member of a thorpe ever has more say than any other. Titles are important only insofar as the need for delegation is matched, but beyond that, they're a respectful nod to the experience or skill of the epithet-bearer.

        Freedom is the most prized trait among them, almost fanatically so. Anything that hampers the individual is frowned upon, even names, hence why no mecian carries a family surname, and all children are given temporary names until they themselves are old enough to choose one. Mecians living together often append the name of their home to their birth names. To the cynical eye, the desire for free-will shown by the mice relies too much on trust, for no domicile they construct is locked. After all, anyone who would steal from another would quickly be found out and punished. Through mutual vulnerability, a unique and strange communal confidence is assured.

        Families are no larger than two children, and there is no formal marriage in mecian society. A male and female simply come together and declare their intentions to have children, allowing their neighbors to expect the new additions. Children are only conceived during the bumper years when food stores allow for the feeding of babies possessed of deep hunger and high metabolism.
rows.translation:
米西亚的社会结构颇为奇特，它依靠一种简单而统一的等级制度来运作，这种制度显然适合那些人口不超过一百人的小村庄。那里有卫队队长，也有村长，但任何一个村庄的成员，其发言权都不会比其他人更高。这些头衔只有在确实需要有人来负责具体事务时才会发挥作用；除此之外，它们仅仅是对持有这些头衔的人所拥有的经验或技能的一种尊重而已。

        自由是他们最为珍视的品质，几乎可以说是狂热地追求这一价值。任何阻碍个人自由的事物都会遭到他们的反对，甚至连名字也不例外。因此，米西亚人都不使用家族姓氏，所有孩子都会被赋予临时名字，直到他们自己长大到可以选择属于自己的名字为止。共同生活的米西亚人通常会在自己的本名后加上他们所居住的聚居地的名称。在那些持怀疑态度的人看来，这些老鼠表现出的对自由意志的追求过于依赖信任，因为它们建造的任何住所都不会上锁。毕竟，任何试图偷窃他人财物的人很快就会被发现并受到惩罚。通过彼此的脆弱，一种独特而奇妙的集体信任感便得以建立。

        在米西亚社会中，每个家庭的孩子数量最多不超过两个，而且并没有正式的婚姻制度。男女双方只需共同生活，并表明他们有生育孩子的意愿，这样邻居们就会知道他们即将迎来新成员。孩子们只会在食物供应充足的年份出生，因为只有在这种时候，婴儿才能获得足够的食物来满足他们强烈的食欲和高代谢率的需求。

After all, anyone who would steal from another would quickly be found out and punished. Through mutual vulnerability, a unique and strange communal confidence is assured.

        Families are no larger than two children, and there is no formal marriage in mecian society. A male and female simply come together and declare their intentions to have children, allowing their neighbors to expect the new additions. Children are only conceived during the bumper years when food stores allow for the feeding of babies possessed of deep hunger and high metabolism.

        "

rows.original: Mecians are functionally identical to humans in a number of ways, and that's no more obvious than their breeding — with one caveat. Following ovulation, insemination, and four months of gestation, a young mouse will be birthed. Mecians are not dominant breeders, and they have been recorded as having successful pregnancies with most known races. However, the child will always possess a feature of rodentia, be it the signature ears, the long tail, or both. The folk of the field always mate in pairs and usually only have children as the possibility opens up. Reckless propagation carries a stigma and is seen as the signing of a child's death warrant in mecian villages, where resources are carefully managed and maintained for months in advance. Obviously, this is in contrast to how quickly they can grow a large family tree. Though extremely rare, mecians have settled in with other races where they've produced more offspring in their lifetimes than have ever been produced in many villages combined. Love is not a foreign concept to the mousefolk, but settling down long enough to mate is difficult enough for a race of such high energy and boundless wanderlust. The most children a mouse-mom-to-be can bear is two at any time: double conceptions are considered to be a sign of good fortune. Mecians also observe the stars at the time of a baby's birth, identifying astrological formations to predict the future of their young. Only four star signs have been traced: the Serpent, the Hound, the Spider, and the Eagle, and, respectively, they represent the traits of cunning, diligence, patience, and determination.
rows.translation: 在许多方面，米西亚人与人类在生理功能上是完全相同的，这一点在它们的繁殖方式上表现得最为明显——不过也有一点需要注意。在排卵、受精以及四个月的妊娠期之后，就会有一只幼崽出生。米西亚人并不是占主导地位的繁殖者，而且有记录显示，它们能与大多数已知的种族成功进行繁殖。然而，所诞生的后代总是它们具备啮齿类动物特有的特征，无论是那标志性的耳朵，还是长长的尾巴，或者两者兼有。 在那些重视资源管理的乡村里，野外生物总是成对交配，而且通常只有当条件允许时才会生育后代。肆无忌惮地繁殖会被视为一种耻辱，甚至会被认为意味着孩子的死亡——因为在那里，人们会提前数月就开始精心规划和管理资源。显然，这与他们能够如此迅速地繁衍出庞大的家族树这一事实形成了对比。虽然极为罕见，但有些机械族确实与其他种族共同生活，在他们的有生之年内所生育的后代数量，甚至超过了许多村庄几十年来的总和。 对鼠人来说，爱情并不是一个陌生的概念；但对于这样一个充满活力、热衷于四处游荡的种族来说，要安定下来结婚其实是一件相当困难的事情。 对于即将成为母亲的鼠人来说，她一次最多只能生下两只幼崽：人们认为同时怀上两只幼崽是吉祥的征兆。米西亚人也会在婴儿出生时观察星辰，通过分析星象组合来预测这个孩子的未来。目前只发现了四种星象：蛇形星象、猎犬星象、蜘蛛星象和鹰形星象，它们分别象征着狡猾、勤奋、耐心和决心这些性格特征。

马人族

rows.original: "Marefolk? They're beautiful, statuesque... dangerous. Don't let their jewelry and colorful silks fool you, these girls are real powerhouses! I've got a feeling that when they march into the valley to find a man, the farmer folk are lining up to get dragged off for the night!"
rows.translation: 玛瑞族女子？她们美丽动人，身形高挑……但也极其危险。别被她们的珠宝和色彩斑斓的丝绸所迷惑，这些女孩可是真正的强者！我有预感，当她们走进山谷去寻找伴侣时，那些农夫们肯定会排着队，等着被她们带走过夜呢！

rows.original: —Caitriss Zethra[silly|, Bicycle] Name: Marefolk (s./pl.) Sexes: Male, Female. Note Society and Culture below. Height: From 6'9" to 7'9". Weight: Marefolk weigh considerably more than a similarly-sized human. Skin: Marefolk are covered in a short coat of silky fur, ranging in color from white and black to chestnuts and roans. Hair: Marefolk have additional, shaggy hair atop their heads and around their hooves. They have human hair colorations. Eyes: Equine in shape and color. Ears: Equine. Lifespan: Marefolk have roughly human lifespans, tending towards slightly shorter. Maturity: 18 years.
rows.translation: —凯特丽丝·泽特拉[silly|自行车] 名称：马人族（单数/复数） 性别：男性、女性。请注意以下内容涉及社会与文化背景。 身高：从6英尺9英寸到7英尺9英寸。 重量：马人族体的体重明显超过体型相仿的人类。 皮肤：马人族身上覆盖着一层柔软的丝状毛皮，其颜色从白色和黑色到栗色和红棕色不等。 头发：马人种类的头部和蹄子周围都长着浓密的毛发，这些毛发的颜色与人类的毛发相同。 眼睛：外形与颜色都如同马一般。 耳朵：马科动物。 寿命：马人族的平均寿命与人类大致相当，但略短一些。 成熟年龄： 18岁。

rows.original:
When you say %"marefolk," most Marchers think of a statuesque bipedal equine-morph, a woman with broad hips and weighty breasts wearing little but a band of silks around her hips and wielding a mighty hunting spear.

        Gifted with solid hooves, powerful muscles, and fertile physiques, it's no wonder that marefolk have been synonymous with the sensual female warrior since time immemorial. While they are most commonly seen on the wide-open savannahs and rolling plains of the southlands, the hardiest of all marefolk make their homes here in the Frost Marches. This is a tribe of women who are tough as the mountains that surround their lakeside village.
rows.translation:
当人们提到“马人女性”时，大多数人会想到这样一种形象：身材高挑、双足行走、拥有马一般的形态，拥有宽大的臀部与丰满的胸部，身上仅佩戴着一条丝带，手中握着一根强大的猎矛。

        由于她们拥有结实的蹄子、强健的肌肉以及充满魅力的体态，从远古时代起，马人女性就被视为象征性感与战斗力的女性战士。虽然它们最常见于南部广阔的草原和连绵的平原上，但所有马人族群中最坚韧的一支却选择在霜冻边境地区安家。这是一个由女性组成的部落，她们坚韧不拔，就像环绕着她们湖边村庄的高山一样坚固。

rows.original: Marefolk tribes have been around since the beginning of recorded history, struggling to survive in the dark ages before Belhar alongside primitive human and elven tribes. While many of the civilized races joined the holy empire, marefolk staunchly refused to surrender their independence and remained as scattered groups of hunter-gatherers. Their society has changed little in the intervening centuries, as they suffered little from the Godswar or Belhar's fall. The marefolk have a rich oral history that likely contains stories rooted in histories long forgotten by other races, though they fiercely guard their skalds and songs from outsiders.
rows.translation: 马人部落自有文字记载的历史之初就已存在，在贝尔哈尔出现之前，他们与原始的人类和精灵部落一同在暗影时代中艰难求生。虽然许多文明种族都加入了神圣帝国，但马人始终坚决拒绝放弃自己的独立性，依然以分散的狩猎采集群体形式存在。在过去的几个世纪里，他们的社会几乎没有什么变化，因为他们几乎没有受到“神战”或“贝哈尔的陷落”所带来的影响。马人拥有丰富的口述历史，其中可能包含一些其他种族早已遗忘的故事，不过他们会严加保护自己的吟游诗人和那些歌曲，不让外人知晓。
rows.raw:
"
        Marefolk tribes have been around since the beginning of recorded history, struggling to survive in the dark ages before Belhar alongside primitive human and elven tribes. While many of the civilized races joined the holy empire, marefolk staunchly refused to surrender their independence and remained as scattered groups of hunter-gatherers. Their society has changed little in the intervening centuries, as they suffered little from the Godswar or Belhar's fall. The marefolk have a rich oral history that likely contains stories rooted in histories long forgotten by other races, though they fiercely guard their skalds and songs from outsiders. 
        
        "

rows.original:
Marefolk typically organize themselves into tribes, and may live in either nomadic groups or in small fortified villages depending on the environment. Their society is almost entirely female, owing to male marefolk becoming violent and lust-crazed during puberty; only young males remain with the tribe.

        The continual struggle within marefolk culture is the dangerous volatility of the race's males. Some tribes have been known to keep one or two males chained for the women's use, but most throw young males out of the tribe to let them live as feral %"wild stallions," which makes securing them again for reproduction problematic.

        This sexual dichotomy has forced the marefolk women to become skilled warriors, as they are required both to find and then secure a wild stallion if they are to continue their family lines. When stallions aren't forthcoming, or the tribe needs %"new blood", marefolk have a reputation for marching out in armed warbands to find males of other races to mate with; some tribes take males by force if necessary, though in more modern times these reproductive expeditions are more likely to end in more amicable exchanges of gold or goods for sexual service.

        In regions in which a permanent marefolk settlement has been established, there almost always evolves an annual ritual of local men allowing themselves to be %"captured" for a night of wild mating with the entire tribe of mares. In the same way that a young mare must secure her first stallion as a rite of passage into adulthood, some human communities consider it a young man's first foray into maturity that he must satisfy a randy warrior-mare. 

        [flags.KAVI_TALK_MALES|Marefolk know all too well the fate of their men-folk come puberty, and some tribes have sought out some way to stop their sons from going mad with lust. The Frost Marches tribe has found a way to keep young stallions from going mad, but it's a terrible choice to ask a boy on the cusp of puberty to make: several generations of shamans have developed an alchemical admixture which, when taken, causes the stallion to stop developing as a man and begin to do so as a woman — the new [silly|she]mare will grow into womanly breasts and hips and in all other ways save for a still-functional penis and testicles.

        This, at least, allows the tribe to reliably reproduce without relying on dangerous stallion hunts.]
rows.translation:
马人通常以部落的形式组织生活，根据所处的环境，他们可能会以游牧群体的形式生活，也会建造小型防御工事来定居。由于雄性马人在青春期会变得暴躁且充满欲望，因此他们的社会几乎完全由女性组成；只有年幼的雄性才会留在部落中。

        在马人文化中，持续存在的矛盾与冲突源于该种族男性天生的危险性。有些部落会将一两只雄性马人锁起来，供女性使用，但大多数部落会将年轻的雄性马人赶出部落，让它们在野外像“野公马”一样生活，因此要想再次将这些雄性马人捉回来用于繁殖，就变得非常困难。

        这种性别分工迫使马人女性成为技艺高超的战士，因为她们必须亲自寻找并捕获野马才能延续家族血脉。当野马难以获得，或者部落需要“新鲜血液”时，马人女性往往会组成武装队伍，去寻找其他种族的男性进行交配；有些部落甚至在必要时会强行夺取男性。不过在现代，这类繁衍行为更有可能以用黄金或货物换取性服务这种较为友好的方式结束。

        在那些人类建立了永久性定居点的地区，几乎总会形成这样一种传统：每年都会有当地的男性自愿“被捕获”，与整个雌性群体进行一夜的疯狂交配。就如同雌性马匹必须通过与第一匹雄性马交配来标志自己已经成年一样，一些人类社区也认为，对于年轻男性来说，与一位好色的雌性战士发生关系，是他们走向成熟的象征。 

        [flags.KAVI_TALK_MALES|马人族群非常清楚自己的男性在进入青春期后会遭遇什么命运，因此一些部落试图找到办法来阻止自己的儿子们因欲望而发狂。霜冻行军部落找到了一种方法，可以让年轻的公马避免这种悲剧，但让一个即将进入青春期的男孩做出这样的选择，实在是一个极其艰难的决定：几代萨满们研制出了一种炼金药剂，一旦服用，这种公马就会停止向男性方向发育，而是开始向女性方向转变——这种变化是永久性的。 [silly|她]母马会逐渐发育出女性般的胸部、臀部，其他方面也会发生相应的变化，唯一不同的是它的阴茎和睾丸依然能够正常发挥作用。

        至少，这一特征使得这个部落能够可靠地繁衍后代，而无需去进行危险的高风险猎捕公马的活动。]

rows.original:
Marefolk reproduction is quite standard by all accounts. Males and females couple, and an eight-month pregnancy ensues that ends in the live birth of one or two children. Marefolk children are voracious, and their mothers are second only to minotaurs in terms of the sheer volume of their lactation. The size of the females' breasts is quite large to accommodate the amount of nursing newborns require. 

        Whether it's because of the marefolk's much vaunted strength or their warrior heritage, marefolk milk was considered to be a valuable aphrodisiac and fertility enhancer among old Belhar.

        Young marefolk are cared for by their entire tribe in a sort of communal childrearing, though they still are most closely bonded to their own parents. Male marefolk are usually evicted from their tribe during the onset of puberty, while females continue to remain in their mother's care until they reach adulthood.
rows.translation:
据各种说法，马人族的繁殖方式其实相当常规。雄性和雌性会交配，随后雌性会进入为期八个月的妊娠期，最终会生下一到两个孩子。马人族的孩子食欲极大，而她们的母亲在哺乳量方面，仅次于弥诺陶洛斯。雌性马人的乳房尺寸相当大，这正是为了满足哺育新生幼崽所需的奶量。

        无论是因为马人族群备受推崇的力量，还是因为他们作为战士的传承，马人的母乳在古老的贝尔哈尔地区一直被视为一种极具效力的催情剂和增强生育能力的物质。

        年轻的雌性马人会由整个部落共同抚养，这种养育方式其实属于集体抚养的形式，不过她们与自己的父母之间的亲密关系依然最为紧密。而雄性马人通常在进入青春期时就会被逐出部落，而雌性马人则会继续在母亲的照料下成长，直到成年。

rows.original: —Fortunate Traveler Name: Leothran (pl. Leothrans) Sexes: Male, female. Height: From 5'8" to 8'0". Weight: From 150lb to 320lb. Hair: Gray, white. Eyes: Brown, blue, green, hazel. Lifespan: 60 to 70 years. Maturity: 18 years.
rows.translation: —幸运的旅人 名称：莱奥特兰（复数：莱奥特兰们） 性别：男性、女性。 身高：从5英尺8英寸到8英尺0英寸。 重量：从150磅增加到320磅。 头发：灰色，白色。 眼睛：棕色、蓝色、绿色、榛色。 寿命： 60到70年。 成熟年龄： 18岁。
rows.raw: "—Fortunate Traveler Name: Leothran (pl. Leothrans) Sexes: Male, female. Height: From 5'8" to 8'0". Weight: From 150lb to 320lb. Hair: Gray, white. Eyes: Brown, blue, green, hazel. Lifespan: 60 to 70 years. Maturity: 18 years. "

rows.original:
The average leothran is large, covered in an insulating coat of fur, and deceptively muscular. As their sizeable bodies are usually concealed beneath their warm fur coat, it can be difficult to tell just how strong they are until they demonstrate as much. The males are generally taller, stronger, and more eager to fight than the female leothrans, though both are devilishly quick and make for excellent hunters.

        Standing on digitigrade legs that end in large paws, your average leothran is somewhere between six and eight feet tall. The women tend towards the lower half — with only the true outliers reaching seven feet — and the men usually range between seven and eight. They both have similar features, with furred, four-fingered hands that have pads on them for grip, and oval snouts that conceal long, protruding fangs. The men of the race have longer and thicker 'saberteeth', with the women's being closer to needle-like.

        Both the men and women have soft, curved ears atop their heads that are sensitive to changes in the wind, touch, and heat.
rows.translation:
普通的利奥斯兰人体型庞大，身上覆盖着一层隔热性的毛皮，看起来肌肉也非常发达。由于他们庞大的身躯通常被温暖的毛皮遮盖起来，因此很难判断他们到底有多强壮，直到他们真正展示出自己的力量时才能明白。雄性莱奥特兰通常比雌性更高大、更强壮，也更热衷于战斗，不过它们俩的速度都快得惊人，因此都是非常出色的猎手。

        莱奥特兰平均身高在六到八英尺之间，它们用带有大爪子的趾行足站立行走。女性的身高通常处于较低的范围——只有极少数个体的身高能够达到七英尺——而男性的身高一般介于七英尺到八英尺之间。两性在体型特征上有着相似之处：她们都拥有长满毛发的四指手，手指上还有用于增加抓握力的肉垫；她们的吻部呈椭圆形，而这种形状能够隐藏她们那些长长的獠牙。这种生物的雄性个体拥有更长、更粗的“剑齿”，而雌性的剑齿则更接近针状。

        无论是雄性还是雌性，它们的头顶都长着柔软、弯曲的耳朵，这些耳朵能够敏锐地感知风的变化、触觉以及温度的变化。
rows.raw:
"
        The average leothran is large, covered in an insulating coat of fur, and deceptively muscular. As their sizeable bodies are usually concealed beneath their warm fur coat, it can be difficult to tell just how strong they are until they demonstrate as much. The males are generally taller, stronger, and more eager to fight than the female leothrans, though both are devilishly quick and make for excellent hunters.

        Standing on digitigrade legs that end in large paws, your average leothran is somewhere between six and eight feet tall. The women tend towards the lower half — with only the true outliers reaching seven feet — and the men usually range between seven and eight. They both have similar features, with furred, four-fingered hands that have pads on them for grip, and oval snouts that conceal long, protruding fangs. The men of the race have longer and thicker 'saberteeth', with the women's being closer to needle-like.

        Both the men and women have soft, curved ears atop their heads that are sensitive to changes in the wind, touch, and heat.
        
        "

rows.original:
The males of the leothran tribes invariably have large, spined penises that range between nine and thirteen inches long. The spines themselves are, in direct contrast to some felinids, very fine and even non-intrusive to the point they can enhance the pleasure in a particularly sensitive mate rather than cause them pain. Close inspection reveals that they are extremely small, but stiffen up when being dragged back and forth over an opposing surface.

        Leothrans regard sex as both entertainment and necessary to their way of life, and mating can last for hours if their interest is aroused. Kittens are delivered in packs of sizes one to six after a pregnancy of roughly eight months, and the women of the species usually possess very large breasts to handle the demands of their children. In cases where supply is outstripped by demand, tribeswomen will freely lend their aid to the children of another.

        对于莱奥特兰人来说，性既是一种娱乐方式，也是他们生活方式中不可或缺的一部分；如果他们的兴趣被激发，交配过程甚至可能会持续数小时之久。母猫在怀孕大约八个月后，会一胎产下1到6只幼崽。这一物种的雌性动物通常拥有非常大的乳房，以便能够满足幼崽的需求。在供应无法满足需求的情况下，部落中的雌性动物会自愿帮助其他雌性动物抚养她们的幼崽。

rows.original:
Leothrans are a race of nomads. Their ilk spread wide across the Frost Marches and, indeed, anywhere host to cold weather. Hundreds of settlements have been recorded in the past, yet attempts at investigating them lead mostly to uninhabited sites. Direct questioning has led to the same conclusion any explorer might draw — traditionally, they only stick to a location for a few years at a time.

        Thus far, efforts at finding a solid point of origin have proven unsuccessful. Each tribe has a differing history and without much in the way of a written language, all that remains are fractured legends and myths that tell of a great progenitor that once stood astride the earth. At best, you can get an oral history of a select tribe by asking their elders.
rows.translation:
利奥特兰人是一个游牧民族。他们的部落遍布霜冻之地，实际上，任何气候寒冷的地区都有他们的踪迹。过去曾记录过数百个他们的聚居地，但当人们试图去调查这些地方时，却发现大多数地方都已经无人居住了。直接的询问得出了任何探索者都可能得出的结论——传统上，它们每次只会在一个地方停留几年时间。

        到目前为止，所有试图找到这个确切起源地的努力都未能成功。每个部落都有自己独特的历史，由于缺乏书面语言，人们所能留下的只有那些零散的传说和神话，这些故事讲述了一位曾经站在大地之上的伟大祖先。至多，你可以通过向某些部落的长者请教，来了解他们口述的历史。

rows.original: As a race of traveling, tribalistic nomads, leothran culture emphasizes the sharing of resources for the betterment of the tribe. Foragers will hunt for edible herbs and mushrooms while hunters obtain meat from the local wildlife. Childcare is traditionally performed by the least able members of the tribe — usually elder members, or those who have been injured in fights. It is widely understood amongst even the strongest of males that rearing children is important for continued survival, and there is no shame in a former warrior taking care of kittens. Each tribe has a vastly different reaction to outsiders. Those that live in highly populous areas generally take keen interest in those foreign to them, with traders reporting extreme popularity in certain villages. Of course, at the opposite end of the spectrum there are tribes that attack and rob on sight — a learned method in the harshness of the Marches. Of note is that they often forgo clothes, especially in their own village, as their thick coats leave garments mostly unneeded. Monogamy and polygamy both seem to occur in roughly equal proportions among all tribes, and upon reaching a certain level of population a segment of the tribe will split off to go their own way. This seems intended to better everyone's lives and maintain the way of life inherent to leothrans, as the larger a population grows the more settled in place they get. Not long after the split, the original tribe will move on from their location, as well.

希奥卡纳

rows.original: "When I defeated the raiding tribe's alpha in single combat, I expected her submission, for hers are an honorable folk. Yet I was utterly unprepared for how deep, or long, that surrender would drive her. Three beautiful children later and I'm still in awe of how consuming my bedmate's worship of strength really is."
rows.translation: 当我单枪匹马击败了那个掠夺部落的首领时，我本以为她会屈服，因为他们的民族向来以崇尚荣誉而闻名。然而，我完全没预料到，这种屈服会让她如此深陷其中、持续如此之久。如今我们有了三个可爱的孩子，我依然惊叹于我的伴侣对力量的这种狂热崇拜究竟有多强烈。

rows.original: —Lady Ceridwen of Castle Hornwatch Name: Siorcanna, Siorcs Sexes: Male, Female, Hermaphroditic. Height: Ranges from 5'8" to 8 foot even. Weight: 150lb to 325lb. Hair: The hair of the Siorcanna can come in every color, often with diverse highlighting or gradients that naturally form as their hair gains length. Although it is unknown when this began, It is assumed to be for attracting potential mates. Eyes: The majority of Siorcs have eyes matching the color of their hair; those who lack this matching theme will have the deep black of the ocean-dwelling creatures they're named for. Lifespan: The average lifespan of a Siorcanna is 70-100 years, commonly on the longer end for shamans or well-cared-for betas. Maturity: Although considered independent at age 15, Siorcanna do not reach true adulthood for another 3-4 years.

rows.original:
Siorcanna look a lot like their sharp-toothed, fishy namesake the sharks. They have long, broad, and flexible finned tails that meet their tailbone and spine, which allow for finer directional turning underwater during a forward stroke. They have five-fingered hands much like the average human, although they end in claw-tips and are joined by fins that reach up to the first knuckle. Their feet on the other hand are four-toed, and similarly finned. All Siorcs have gills, often shut tightly and seamlessly at their neck when out of the water, but are capable of breathing air through their nostrils via a secondary set of lungs. 
        
        Their faces are shark-like muzzles (or snouts) ranging in lengths from short to long, and full of razor-sharp, carnivorous teeth. Their ears are long and pointed in an elfin fashion, although some variations are known to be finned. Lastly their skin and hair colors vary wildly; hair color can be found anywhere in the color spectrum, with a skin coloration that's often complimentary in tone but tends towards blues, greens, and grays.
        
        As far as body-type and build are concerned, Siorcanna body types are based on their role as opposed to gender. Warriors exhibit large bodies with heavy musculature, large breasts, and genitals, Hunters are often lithe, tall, and quick, and Shaman usually fall somewhere between the two in body height, weight, and genitalia.
rows.translation:
希奥卡纳与那些长着锋利牙齿、名字中也带有“鲨鱼”字样的生物非常相似。它们拥有长而宽、柔韧的尾鳍，这些尾鳍与它们的尾骨和脊椎相连，这使得它们在向前游动时能够更加精确地调整方向。他们的手有五根手指，与人类的手相似，不过手指的末端呈爪状，手指之间还长有鳍状结构，这些鳍状结构一直延伸到第一节指关节。而他们的脚则有四根脚趾，脚上同样长有鳍状结构。所有的西奥克人都有鳃，当他们不在水中时，鳃通常会紧密地闭合在脖子上，但他们也可以通过第二套肺部通过鼻孔呼吸空气。 
        
        它们的面部呈现出类似鲨鱼的吻部结构，长度从短到长不等，上面布满了锋利无比的肉食性牙齿。它们的耳朵呈细长尖锐的形状，具有精灵般的特征；不过也有一些变种个体的耳朵上长有鳍状结构。最后，它们的皮肤和毛发的颜色多种多样——毛发的颜色可以涵盖整个色谱范围，而皮肤的颜色则通常与毛发的颜色形成和谐的搭配，但常见的是蓝色、绿色或灰色。
        
        就体型与构造而言，希奥卡纳的体型划分是基于他们的职业角色，而非性别。战士们通常体格魁梧，肌肉发达，胸部和生殖器也较为粗壮；猎人往往身形矫健、身材高大且行动敏捷；而萨满的体型则在高度、体重以及生殖器特征上介于两者之间。

rows.original:
Siorc history is recorded primarily in carvings — being underwater for your day-to-day lives doesn't leave much room for book-reading — and reiterated orally by shamans. What is known of the Siorcanna is that they were made up of many, many small tribes scattered across the ocean and some inland spring-fed lakes.
        
        Admittedly few, if any, races outside of the Siorcanna know anything about them; merely a series of legends about exceptional alphas and their cunning or powerful betas. Perhaps the occasional master craftsman. If any were to ask a Siorc what they as a people have accomplished, they'd be told it's 'fighting and fucking'.
        
        To be fair, that response is roughly all the average member of Siorcanna society knows, as much of their history reads more like sagas of grandeur from the perspectives of their leaders— often High Shamans or Warrior's are powerful and charismatic to sway the smarter, more magically-inclined girls.
        
        It is only in recent history that Siorcanna and Elven relations have grown strained; although they respect the might of any Valkyries strong enough to overcome them, they consider the elves' non-combative leaders and workers as undeserving of any. It is much more likely that some defeated Valkyries are claimed as betas of their own, treated with transformatives or magical tattoos to allow for a life undersea.
rows.translation:
希奥克人的历史主要通过雕刻记录下来——由于他们每天大部分时间都在水下生活，因此几乎没有时间读书——同时也通过萨满们的口述得以传承。关于西奥卡纳人，我们知道他们由许多分散在海洋上以及一些内陆泉水湖泊附近的小型部落组成。
        
        诚然，除了西奥卡纳族之外，几乎没有其他种族真正了解这些事情；人们所知道的，不过是一些关于那些卓越的“阿尔法”个体以及他们那些狡猾或强大的“贝塔”同伴的传说罢了。或许还有偶尔出现的那些技艺高超的工匠。如果有人问西奥卡纳族人他们这个民族究竟取得了什么成就，他们只会回答：“不就是不断地战斗和繁衍后代罢了。
        
        公平地说，希奥卡纳社会的普通成员所了解的也大致就是这些内容。因为他们的历史大多是从领导者的角度来叙述的——这些领导者往往是高阶萨满或武士，他们拥有强大的力量和魅力，能够吸引那些更聪明、更热衷于魔法的女孩们。
        
        直到近代，希奥卡娜与精灵族之间的关系才开始变得紧张起来；虽然她们尊重那些强大到足以战胜她们的女武神，但她们认为精灵族那些不热衷于战斗的领袖和普通民众根本不配获得这样的尊重。事实上，更有可能的是，一些被击败的女武神会被精灵族收为宠物，通过变形术或魔法纹身让它们能够在海底生活。

rows.original:
The Siorcanna have two languages; one of underwater sign-gestures and throat intonations (higher pitched humming indicates joy, while deeper pitches and lower tones can indicate dissatisfaction or perhaps sarcasm when used in conjunction with signs), and the spoken common language. Their bodies are incredibly emotive as a result of this, as such it's considered incredibly rare for a Siorc to lie. 
        
        Most importantly for the Siorc is their 'Might makes Right' culture, which ties closely with 'Alpha and Beta' families. Everything about them revolves around the idea that the strong care for the weak; the stronger and smarter you are, the stronger and smarter your betas can be. Your children will be strong and smart, you can secure food for them and care for them, and there is no shame in being a beta... as who knows when an Alpha might collide with someone stronger?
        
        There aren't many laws outside of the common sense rules such as not murdering, not stealing — although you aren't stealing when you're strong enough to take — and no harming betas. A culture based around strength tends to police itself, although this has probably helped contribute to the ending of smaller tribes, and congregation into larger, underwater villages and towns.
rows.translation:
希奥卡纳使用两套语言：一套由水下手势和喉音构成（高亢的哼声表示喜悦，低沉音调配合手势时则可能表示不满或讽刺），另一套是通用口语。正因如此，他们的身体语言极富表现力，希奥卡纳人说谎也被认为极其罕见。 
        
        希奥卡纳最重视“强者为尊”的文化，这与其“首领与从属者”式家庭紧密相连。一切都围绕强者照顾弱者的理念展开：你越强大、越聪明，你的从属者便能越强大、越聪明；你的子女也会健康聪慧，而你有能力为他们取得食物并加以照料。成为从属者并不可耻……毕竟，谁知道一位首领何时会遇上更强的人呢？
        
        除了不得杀人、不得偷盗——当然，强到足以直接夺取便不算偷——以及不得伤害从属者等常识外，他们没有多少成文法律。以力量为本的文化往往能够自行维持秩序，不过这或许也促使较小部落消失，人口逐渐汇聚进更大的水下村镇。
rows.raw:
"
        The Siorcanna have two languages; one of underwater sign-gestures and throat intonations (higher pitched humming indicates joy, while deeper pitches and lower tones can indicate dissatisfaction or perhaps sarcasm when used in conjunction with signs), and the spoken common language. Their bodies are incredibly emotive as a result of this, as such it's considered incredibly rare for a Siorc to lie. 
        
        Most importantly for the Siorc is their 'Might makes Right' culture, which ties closely with 'Alpha and Beta' families. Everything about them revolves around the idea that the strong care for the weak; the stronger and smarter you are, the stronger and smarter your betas can be. Your children will be strong and smart, you can secure food for them and care for them, and there is no shame in being a beta... as who knows when an Alpha might collide with someone stronger?
        
        There aren't many laws outside of the common sense rules such as not murdering, not stealing — although you aren't stealing when you're strong enough to take — and no harming betas. A culture based around strength tends to police itself, although this has probably helped contribute to the ending of smaller tribes, and congregation into larger, underwater villages and towns.

        "

rows.original:
Siorcanna appear to present even odds of being born with either male, female, or the characteristics of both. Although their rate of successful reproduction isn't especially high (quickening has a roughly 1/20 chance), it's made up for with regular, vigorous copulation. They have human cocks with protective foreskins, albeit with slightly wider and more textured glans. Siorc vaginas are similar in their human-like features, the lubricants they produce are much thicker and have even been known to speed up the healing of minor cuts and abrasions.
        
        Siorc [silly
            |pergante
            |pregnancy
        ] takes roughly seven months — with usually one child at a time — and they produce a thick, sweet milk high in nutrients and proteins early in their second month of pregnancy. It is not uncommon for the Siorcanna to conduct large orgies lasting many hours, although these are ironically considered private affairs kept within the alpha and betas of a family. It is rare for two different alphas to couple, thanks to an in-bred need to establish dominance in their day-to-day relationships.
        
        Lastly, Siorcanna are known to enter a rut every lunar cycle... not that it actually increases their virility in any appreciable manner; it does however encourage an even greater degree of passionate sex. It is yet unproven, but generally believed that hermaphroditic Shaman have a slightly higher success rate for both siring and carrying children to term.

        希奥克[silly

        ]这一过程大约需要七个月的时间，通常每次只生育一个孩子。在怀孕的第二个月初期，母兽会分泌出一种营养丰富、蛋白质含量高的浓稠甜奶。对于希奥卡纳来说，举行持续数小时的大型聚会并不罕见，然而具有讽刺意味的是，这些活动被视为家族内部成员之间的私事，外人并不了解其中的具体情况。由于它们在日常生活中有着建立支配地位的本能，因此两种不同的“阿尔法个体”结合在一起的情况实属罕见。

阿瓦奈族

rows.original: "We beheld them, resplendent in their crystalline feathers, and as they tore through the sky on their steeds we believed them in that moment to be masters of all things that flew. The harpies with us, of course, disagreed most vociferously and vocally."
rows.translation: 我们看到它们，它们那晶莹剔透的羽毛在阳光下闪闪发光，当它们骑着坐骑划破天空时，我们在那一刻相信，它们确实是所有会飞生物中的霸主。当然，与我们同行的那些鹰身女妖们，却发出了最激烈的反对声。
rows.raw: '\n "We beheld them, resplendent in their crystalline feathers, and as they tore through the sky on their steeds we believed them in that moment to be masters of all things that flew. The harpies with us, of course, disagreed most vociferously and vocally."\n '

rows.original: —Sebeck, scout, Taelia's Talons Name: Avanai (singular and plural.) Sexes: Male and Female Height: Ranges from between 6 ft. and 7 ft. on average, with males standing slightly taller than females. Weight: Owing to their hollow bones and fine feathers, avanai are light creatures, despite their stature. Adults usually weigh no more than a quarter of a human of equivalent size. Skin: It is rare that people see their bare skin, but those suffering from illness may lose their feathers, or be plucked as ritual humiliation and punishment. In such cases, their skin may be seen to be mottled blue. Hair: Avanai do not have hair, but rather colorless feathers of extremely fine crystal. These catch light and break it up into a myriad of icy hues tinged at the edges with rainbow colors. Plumage upon one's head may be styled in a fashion similar to the way a human might, but do not really count as such. Eyes: Avanai eyes are wide with dark pupils, like most birds. They have a clear third eyelid akin to some reptiles and birds that helps protect their eyes in-flight and shields their vision from snow blindness. Ears: None visible, but they have ear-holes on the sides of their heads akin to birds. Lifespan: About 150 years. Maturity: 40 years.
rows.translation: —西贝克，侦察兵，塔莉娅之爪 名称：阿瓦奈（单数形式及复数形式均为“阿瓦奈”）。 性别：男性和女性 身高：平均身高在6英尺到7英尺之间，雄性个头通常比雌性稍高一些。 重量：由于骨骼中空且羽毛轻盈，尽管体型较大，阿瓦奈人实际上属于体重较轻的生物。成年个体的体重通常不会超过同等体型人类的四分之一。 皮肤：人们很少能看到自己的裸露皮肤，但那些生病的人可能会失去身上的羽毛，或者被人为拔掉羽毛作为仪式上的羞辱和惩罚。在这种情况下，他们的皮肤可能会呈现出斑驳的蓝色。 头发：阿瓦奈人并没有头发，而是拥有由极其细腻的水晶构成的无色羽毛。这些羽毛能够折射光线，将其分解成无数种冰冷的色调，而这些色调的边缘还带有彩虹般的色彩。他们头上的羽毛可以像人类一样被梳理成各种造型，但实际上并不能真正被视为头发。 眼睛：像大多数鸟类一样，阿瓦奈的眼睛很大，瞳孔呈深色。它们还拥有一层透明的第三眼睑，这一结构与某些爬行动物和鸟类相似，能够在飞行过程中保护它们的眼睛，同时防止雪盲症影响它们的视线。 耳朵：虽然看不出来，但它们的头部两侧有类似鸟类的耳洞。 寿命：大约150年。 成熟年龄： 40岁。

rows.original:
Avanai are one of the four major native peoples of the glacial rift, alongside the jotuns, siorcanna and selkies, and have claimed the peaks of the valley mountains for themselves. Because of their avian appearance, some may mistake them for harpies at a first glance, a mistake that soon becomes apparent upon closer observation: instead of being quadrupeds with their wings upon their arms, avanai are hexapods with their wings upon their backs, leaving their hands free for fine manipulation while in flight. They are also far less human in appearance than harpies are, being feathered from head to toe, and have beaks, which hinders their ability to speak Belharan somewhat.

        The average avanai stands between six and seven feet and may seem imposing from a distance, but weigh very little; this is owing to their hollow bones and the fact that their feathers are loosely packed, making them appear larger than they are. Their bodies are aerodynamically shaped, with strong chest muscles powering their flight, and hands and feet alike end in grasping talons. When it comes to flight, they are possessed of a wingspan roughly twice to two and a half times as long as they are tall; when not in use, the wings are folded neatly across one's back.
        
        When their feathers are drawn in preparation or during flight, avanai appear sleek and lithe; they poof out considerably when relaxed or still. Coupled with their sometimes androgynous appearance, and avian biology leading to a lack of visible breasts on females, it can be hard for an outsider more used to humanlike sexual characteristics to distinguish avanai men from women.
rows.translation:
阿瓦奈人是冰川裂谷地区四大原住民族之一，与约顿人、西奥卡纳人和海豹精齐名。他们将山谷中的群山据为己有。由于他们的外形类似于鸟类，初次见到他们的人可能会误将他们认作鹰身女妖，但仔细观察后就会发现真相：阿瓦奈人并非四肢着地、翅膀长在手臂上的生物，而是六足生物，翅膀长在背部，这样他们在飞行时双手就可以自由活动，进行各种精细的操作。它们的外形也与鹰身女妖截然不同，全身覆盖着羽毛，还长着喙，这些特征在某种程度上限制了它们使用贝尔哈兰语进行交流的能力。

        平均而言，这些生物的身高在六到七英尺之间，从远处看可能会显得十分威武，但实际上它们的体重非常轻。这是因为它们的骨骼是中空的，而且羽毛的排列也比较松散，因此才会让它们看起来比实际更大。它们的身体具有流线型结构，强健的胸肌为飞行提供动力，手脚末端都长有用于抓握的利爪。在飞行时，它们的翼展长度大约是身高的两倍到两倍半；在不飞行的时候，翅膀会整齐地折叠在背部。
        
        当它们的羽毛在准备飞行或飞行过程中收拢起来时，阿瓦奈族会显得格外修长而灵活；而当它们放松或静止时，羽毛又会明显地展开。再加上它们有时呈现出中性化的外观，以及鸟类生物学特性导致雌性阿瓦奈族没有明显的胸部，对于那些更习惯于人类那种性别特征区分方式的人来说，确实很难区分阿瓦奈族的雄性和雌性。

rows.original: It is unclear how far back the history of the avanai stretches; while the birds themselves keep records, they are clearly highly romanticized and are more legend than fact. Neither, unfortunately, do their neighbors the jotuns, selkies and siorcanna know or care; to them, these bird-people have always occupied the peaks of the rift and other similar environs. What they are proud of and willing to tell anyone who will listen, of course, is that they are the better of Sorra's children, bearing her six-limbed appearance and effectively harnessing her gift instead of letting it go to waste like the stupid, scatterbrained harpies have, that they are the purveyors of her beauty and hence rulers of all flying creatures. Of course, the harpies say the exact same things about themselves, citing the more humanlike aspects of their appearance and the vital and free nature of their people as clearly representing them as more perfect incarnations of the storm goddess. Whatever the case, the two have fought since time immemorial — over resources, over suitable places to roost, and if there is nothing else, over who is the closest representation of Sorra's glory. The blood feud between the harpies and the avanai has been long, illustrious, and downright bloody, with neither side ever managing to gain the upper hand; periods of peace only exist so that each side may be refreshed for the conflict to come in the next decade or two. Harpies have the advantage of numbers that quickly replenish, which is met by avanai mysticism and magics. Perhaps the only thing that could ever stop the bloodshed would be for the goddess herself to intervene and declare a winner, but she has yet to do such a thing. Despite their lustful natures and reputation for being obsessed with eggs, harpies will not take an avanai man for breeding, but tear him apart on the spot.
rows.translation: 目前尚不清楚这些“阿瓦奈族”族群的历史可以追溯到多久以前；虽然这些鸟类自身保留着一些记载，但这些故事显然被过度美化了，更多属于传说而非事实。不幸的是，它们的邻居——诸如“约顿巨人”、“海豹精”以及“希奥卡纳”们——也不知道也不关心这些细节；在他们看来，这些“鸟类人类”从来就居住在裂谷的山峰以及其他类似的地区。 他们引以为豪，并且乐于向任何愿意听的人讲述的是：他们是索拉所有孩子中最为出色的那个。他们继承了索拉那六条腿的外貌特征，也真正掌握了她的天赋，而没有像那些愚蠢、粗心大意的女妖们那样，让这些天赋白白浪费掉。他们它们正是这种美貌的创造者，因此也统治着所有会飞的生物。当然，那些鹰身女妖也会用同样的理由来形容自己——她们认为自己那些更接近人类的外貌特征，以及她们族群那种自由自在的生活方式，恰恰体现了这些特点。他们作为风暴女神更为完美的化身， 无论如何，这两种生物自古以来就一直在争斗——为争夺资源、为争夺合适的栖息之地，而如果其他原因都不成立的话，它们也在争夺谁才能最真实地体现索拉的荣耀。鹰身女妖与阿瓦奈族之间的世仇由来已久，这场争斗充满了血腥与残酷，双方始终未能取得绝对优势；只有在短暂的和平时期，双方才能恢复元气，为接下来一二十年里的冲突做好准备。女妖们拥有数量众多且能够迅速补充的优势，而阿瓦奈的神秘主义与魔法则弥补了这一劣势。或许，唯一能够阻止这场杀戮的方法，就是让女神亲自出面并宣布胜负，但她至今仍未采取这样的行动。尽管女妖们天性好色，且以对鸡蛋的痴迷而闻名，但它们绝不会选择人类男性进行交配，而是会当场将其撕成碎片。

rows.original:
Avanai society is highly steeped in mysticism and ritual. A flock may be anywhere from a handful of families to masses of milling birds numbering in the thousands; when grounded, they bear crowding a lot better than other peoples do, often electing to live in close proximity to one another in conditions humans would find cramped. Larger avanai settlements are built in three dimensions as a result of their ability to fly; walking paths are but the lowest layer by which they get around. Masons smooth stone, excavate mountainsides and cut blocks; any other material is soon worn out by the constant winds that howl in the places they tend to live. 

        While these bird-people tend to live in high, cold places, they need not necessarily be freezing; avanai beyond the Marches reside in highlands and peaks, and may even tend to flocks of alpacas and goats where the climate is warm enough. Where circumstances allow, these bird-people are strangely compelled to build ziggurats; while they cannot quite explain it themselves, they do find such arrangements aesthetically pleasing and those who have the privilege of living within them are considered exceedingly fortunate. Their low numbers in comparison to harpies is made up somewhat by the fact that they have managed to tame rocs, using the giant birds as beasts of war and burden alike. Daily life is highly structured and filled with small genuflections and rituals to Sorra; with these people, the mystical and the mundane have little distinction.
        
        A flock is typically led by a hierophant, an individual who is possessed of psionic powers and of considerable religious import, seen by others as their link to the storm goddess. He or she is charged with leading the flock, performing rituals and making important decisions; depending on the size of the flock, there may be other lesser individuals serving other them. Avanai hierophants possess varied abilities, but those observed by other peoples include but are not limited to: compelling the truth from a liar, domination of others' minds, long-distance telepathy, clairvoyance, and sensing when mystical powers are being used by others. Chicks who emerge from the egg exhibiting psychic abilities are taken to be trained for future leadership positions, learning even more quickly than normal through the sharing of memories and experience. A flock whose hierophant passes without a heir typically dissolves, as being without one is seen as a mark of the storm goddess' disfavor; the members are typically absorbed by other flocks.
        
        Avanai technology is largely comparable to that of the current time period; due to their habit of nesting in mountainous regions and quarrying stone to build with, they have struck resources such as coal and copper while digging. Most valued amongst their kind, though, is gold; the metal is admired not so much for its beauty and luster, but because of the fact that the best lightning rods are fashioned from the conductive material, typically housed in a copper shell. When these devices are situated on various peaks, the storm goddess' blessing is harvested, stored, and made to perform all kinds of strange phenomena when joined with the hierophants' psionic powers. Although avanai do not wear much clothing, instead trusting in their feathers to cover their bodies, they will adorn themselves with gold any chance they get.
        
        Of note is the fact that avanai are particularly proud of their statuary; the ease with which they work stone has translated to them expressing themselves through this medium. A settlement may hold many aesthetically pleasing yet functional pieces, and it is customary for the remains of hierophants to be interred within statues, granting them some limited sentience or even sapience in the same fashion as echoes of souls are used by enchanters to empower items. It's said that an electrically charged statue may be able to act and move independently akin to an Old Country puppet or wizard's golem, although no outsider has seen this in action.
rows.translation:
阿瓦奈社会深受神秘主义与仪式习俗的影响。这种鸟群的规模可以从仅有几户家庭组成，到数以千计的鸟儿聚集在一起；当它们栖息在地面上时，它们比其他物种更能忍受拥挤的环境，常常会选择在人类看来极为狭小的空间里紧密地生活在一起。由于具备飞行能力，较大的阿瓦奈族聚落是三维结构建造的；人行道仅仅是他们日常通行的最低层通道。石匠们会打磨石头、开凿山体、切割石块；而在他们常居住的地区，任何其他材料都会在持续不断的强风作用下很快被磨损殆尽。 

        虽然这些鸟人通常生活在高寒地区，但并不一定意味着他们会处于极寒的环境中；那些生活在边境地区以外的鸟人则栖息在高原和山峰上，在气候较为温暖的地方，他们甚至会与羊驼和山羊群共同生活。在条件允许的情况下，这些鸟人会不由自主地建造金字塔状的结构；虽然他们自己也无法完全解释这种行为的原因，但他们确实认为这种布局在审美上非常令人愉悦，而那些有幸居住在其中的人也被认为是非常幸运的。与鹰身女妖相比，他们的人数之所以较少，其中一个原因在于他们成功驯服了巨型岩石鸟，将这些巨大的鸟类既用作战兽，也用来承担运输任务。他们的日常生活有着严格的秩序，日常生活中会经常进行一些向索拉表达敬意的仪式和动作；对于这些人们来说，神秘的事物与平凡的生活几乎没有区别。
        
        通常，一群动物会由一位拥有灵能且具有重要宗教地位的领袖来带领。其他人将这位领袖视为自己与风暴女神之间的纽带。这位领袖负责引领群体、主持仪式以及做出重要决策；根据群体的规模大小，可能还会有一些地位较低的成员协助他完成这些工作。阿瓦奈的祭司们拥有各种能力，但其他人观察到的能力包括但不限于：迫使说谎者说出真相、控制他人的思想、进行远距离心灵感应、预知未来，以及察觉他人是否正在使用神秘力量。那些从蛋中孵化出来并具备超自然能力的雏鸟，会被选中接受训练，以便将来担任领导职务。由于能够共享记忆与经验，这些雏鸟的学习速度远比普通雏鸟快得多。如果一个鸟群的领袖没有后代继承其地位，这个鸟群通常就会解散，因为人们认为这种情况意味着风暴女神的不满；这些鸟群中的成员通常会被其他鸟群吸收。
        
        阿瓦奈人的技术水平大致与当前时期相当；由于他们有在山区筑巢并开采石头用于建造房屋的习性，在挖掘过程中他们也发现了煤炭和铜等资源。然而，在同类物质中，最受人们珍视的还是黄金。人们欣赏这种金属，并非因为它的外观美观或光泽亮丽，而是因为最好的避雷针正是用这种导电性能极佳的材料制成的，而这些避雷针通常还会被包裹在铜壳之中。当这些装置被安置在各个山顶上时，风暴女神的恩赐就会被采集、储存起来，而当它们与祭司们的灵能结合在一起时，就会引发各种奇异的现象。虽然阿瓦奈人并不穿太多衣服，而是依靠自己的羽毛来遮盖身体，但他们一有机会就会用黄金来装饰自己。
        
        值得注意的是，阿瓦奈人对自己制作的雕像感到尤为自豪；他们擅长加工石材，这种技艺使他们能够通过这种媒介来表达自己的艺术理念。一个定居点里可能会摆放许多既美观又实用的艺术品，而按照习俗，祭司的遗骸会被安放在雕像之中，这样一来，这些雕像就会具备某种有限的感知能力，甚至可以说是智慧——就如同法师们利用灵魂的回响来赋予物品特殊的力量一样。据说，一座带电的雕像可能会像传统木偶或巫师的魔像一样自主行动和移动，不过至今还没有外人亲眼见过这一现象。
rows.raw:
"
        Avanai society is highly steeped in mysticism and ritual. A flock may be anywhere from a handful of families to masses of milling birds numbering in the thousands; when grounded, they bear crowding a lot better than other peoples do, often electing to live in close proximity to one another in conditions humans would find cramped. Larger avanai settlements are built in three dimensions as a result of their ability to fly; walking paths are but the lowest layer by which they get around. Masons smooth stone, excavate mountainsides and cut blocks; any other material is soon worn out by the constant winds that howl in the places they tend to live. 

        While these bird-people tend to live in high, cold places, they need not necessarily be freezing; avanai beyond the Marches reside in highlands and peaks, and may even tend to flocks of alpacas and goats where the climate is warm enough. Where circumstances allow, these bird-people are strangely compelled to build ziggurats; while they cannot quite explain it themselves, they do find such arrangements aesthetically pleasing and those who have the privilege of living within them are considered exceedingly fortunate. Their low numbers in comparison to harpies is made up somewhat by the fact that they have managed to tame rocs, using the giant birds as beasts of war and burden alike. Daily life is highly structured and filled with small genuflections and rituals to Sorra; with these people, the mystical and the mundane have little distinction.
        
        A flock is typically led by a hierophant, an individual who is possessed of psionic powers and of considerable religious import, seen by others as their link to the storm goddess. He or she is charged with leading the flock, performing rituals and making important decisions; depending on the size of the flock, there may be other lesser individuals serving other them. Avanai hierophants possess varied abilities, but those observed by other peoples include but are not limited to: compelling the truth from a liar, domination of others' minds, long-distance telepathy, clairvoyance, and sensing when mystical powers are being used by others. Chicks who emerge from the egg exhibiting psychic abilities are taken to be trained for future leadership positions, learning even more quickly than normal through the sharing of memories and experience. A flock whose hierophant passes without a heir typically dissolves, as being without one is seen as a mark of the storm goddess' disfavor; the members are typically absorbed by other flocks.
        
        Avanai technology is largely comparable to that of the current time period; due to their habit of nesting in mountainous regions and quarrying stone to build with, they have struck resources such as coal and copper while digging. Most valued amongst their kind, though, is gold; the metal is admired not so much for its beauty and luster, but because of the fact that the best lightning rods are fashioned from the conductive material, typically housed in a copper shell. When these devices are situated on various peaks, the storm goddess' blessing is harvested, stored, and made to perform all kinds of strange phenomena when joined with the hierophants' psionic powers. Although avanai do not wear much clothing, instead trusting in their feathers to cover their bodies, they will adorn themselves with gold any chance they get.
        
        Of note is the fact that avanai are particularly proud of their statuary; the ease with which they work stone has translated to them expressing themselves through this medium. A settlement may hold many aesthetically pleasing yet functional pieces, and it is customary for the remains of hierophants to be interred within statues, granting them some limited sentience or even sapience in the same fashion as echoes of souls are used by enchanters to empower items. It's said that an electrically charged statue may be able to act and move independently akin to an Old Country puppet or wizard's golem, although no outsider has seen this in action.

        "

rows.original: Given the environment in which most of them live, as well as their long lifespans, avanai reproduction is suitably rare and lengthy. Young reach physical maturity at roughly forty years of age, although they are expected to take on adult responsibilities and roles before then — or at least, adult by the definition of other peoples. Mating occurs when a flock has acquired enough resources to support new chicks — an egg, or at most two, is laid a month after the fact, and may take up to another year to hatch. Avanai chicks are slow to grow physically, but keenly intelligent, their minds outpacing their bodies; while parents take a primary role in raising the chick, there are often so few at a time in a flock that other members will dote on the young ball of feathers. Avanai chicks are able to eat solid food upon hatching, albeit torn up into little strips; by the time a couple of years have passed, they are able to get around, if not fly, and begin to assume simple responsibilities about the flock.
rows.translation: 鉴于它们大多生活的环境以及它们漫长的寿命，阿瓦奈的繁殖活动自然显得极为稀少且耗时较长。幼体大约在四十岁时才能达到性成熟，不过在此之前，它们就被期望承担起成年个体的责任与角色——至少要符合其他物种对成年个体的定义。当一群鸟积累了足够的资源来抚养新出生的雏鸟时，它们就会进行交配。通常在交配一个月后，雌鸟会产下一枚或至多两枚蛋，而这些蛋需要长达一年的时间才能孵化。阿瓦奈族雏鸟的身体发育速度较慢，但它们的智力非常敏锐，思维能力远远超过了身体发育的速度。虽然父母在抚养雏鸟方面承担了主要责任，但由于一群鸟中同时出生的雏鸟数量通常很少，其他成员也会共同照顾这些幼小的鸟儿。阿瓦奈雏鸟在孵化后就能吃固体食物了，尽管这些食物会被它们撕成小条状；几年后，它们虽然还不能飞行，但已经能够移动了，并且开始承担一些与鸟群相关的简单职责。

rows.translation: 阿瓦奈族
海豹精

rows.original: "Oh, they're pretty enough... until you see what's below the waist. Then they're just comical. No wonder they like to keep their tails under the water. Their kind sure can appreciate good music, though."
rows.translation: 哦，它们看起来确实挺漂亮的……直到你看到它们腰以下的部分。那时就只会让人觉得滑稽可笑了。难怪它们总是喜欢把尾巴藏在水下。不过，它们这个种类确实能够欣赏到美妙的音乐。
rows.raw: "\n \"Oh, they're pretty enough... until you see what's below the waist. Then they're just comical. No wonder they like to keep their tails under the water. Their kind sure can appreciate good music, though.\"\n "

rows.original: —River, traveling bard Name: Selkie (p. selkies) Sexes: Male and Female (20% male, 80% female) Height: Ranges from between 5 ft. and 6 ft. on average, with females standing slightly taller than males. If they could stand, that is. Weight: Despite their proportions, selkies are kind of light. They may weigh as much as 75% of what might be expected of a human of similar build and stature. Skin: Generally pale owing to their environment. Their seal half can be anything from black to gray, brown and white. Hair: Fundamentally human-like. Gold is most common, but bleached brown, gray and white also exist. Eyes: Selkies have human-like eyes, with brown, gold, or blue colors most common. Ears: Selkies have humanlike ears. Lifespan: About 50 years. Maturity: 18 years.
rows.translation: —瑞弗，那位游历四方的吟游诗人 名称：海豹精 性别：男性与女性（20%男性，80%女性） 身高：平均身高在5英尺到6英尺之间，雌性个头通常比雄性稍高一些——当然，前提是它们能够站立的话。 重量：尽管体型如此，海豹精的实际体重却相当轻。它们的体重可能只有那些体型和身高与人类相似的人所预期体重的75%左右。 皮肤：由于所处环境的影响，它们的体色通常较为苍白。它们的海豹下半身可以呈黑色、灰色、棕色或白色。 头发：基本上与人类相似。金色最为常见，但也存在淡棕色、灰色和白色。 眼睛：海豹精的眼睛与人类相似，最常见的颜色是棕色、金色或蓝色。 耳朵：海豹精的耳朵与人类的耳朵相似。 寿命：大约50年。 成熟年龄： 18岁。

rows.original:
Selkies, like many aquatic races, inhabit the seas and oceans of Savarra, keeping mostly to chill and frigid waters. They can be largely described as seal-mermaids — humans joined at the waist to fat, blubbery seal tails. While practical in the context of their natural habitat, the chubby seal tails give them a comical appearance when out of water and on the ice — deceptively disarming for what they're capable of.

        Owing to their physiology, selkies cannot stand; the most they can do is push their head and torso off the ground with their arms when out of water. They are, though, on average five to six feet long from head to tail; a selkie's human half tends to be quite conventionally attractive by human standards, but their seal tails are fat and blubbery even as it grants them considerable speed in water. A number of them are aware and self-conscious of this fact, and will hide their tails under the water's surface or otherwise out of sight when meeting other peoples. However, when amongst their own, they will lounge about in full view atop beaches, ice floes, and the like without a care. Despite their ungainly appearance when out of water, Selkies are able to move over ice and to a lesser extent land with surprising speed, wriggling their seal halves like snakes and bouncing over smooth surfaces.
        
        Like the seals they resemble, selkies are not truly aquatic and cannot breathe water like merpeople or siorcanna do; although they can hold their breath for hours at a time, they must return to the surface for air periodically or drown. They do not use their hands for swimming, keeping them tucked close to the body in an aquadynamic fashion while moving through the water in a wriggling fashion; instead, they rely on their tails to propel them, and their nature renders them impervious to the cold and pressure of the frigid oceans they call home.
rows.translation:
像许多水生种族一样，海豹精也居住在萨瓦拉的海洋中，主要生活在寒冷的水域里。他们可以被大致描述为“海豹美人鱼”——人类的上半身与肥胖、多肉的海豹尾巴相连。在自然栖息地中，这种尾巴确实非常实用，但当他们离开水面、站在冰面上时，这些圆滚滚的尾巴就会让他们看起来十分滑稽可笑。然而，与他们实际拥有的能力相比，这种外表反而显得有些不那么吓人。

        由于生理结构的限制，人鱼无法站立；当它们不在水中时，最多只能用双臂将头部和躯干抬离地面。不过，从头部到尾部的长度通常在五到六英尺之间；人鱼的人类部分按照人类的标准来看，往往具有相当高的吸引力，而它们的海豹尾巴虽然肥厚多肉，但却能让它们在水中游得飞快。他们中有很多人意识到了这一事实，并因此感到有些难为情；所以在遇到其他人时，他们会把尾巴藏在水底下，或者采取其他方式避免被人看到。然而，当他们处于自己的群体中时，就会毫不在意地在海滩上、冰面上之类的地方暴露着自己的身影。尽管在水中时外形显得笨拙，但海豹精能够在冰面上以惊人的速度移动，而在陆地上虽然速度稍慢一些，他们依然可以通过像蛇一样扭动身体，或在光滑的表面上弹跳来移动。
        
        与那些海豹相似，人鱼其实并不是真正的水生生物，它们无法像人鱼或希奥卡纳那样在水中呼吸；虽然它们可以屏住呼吸数小时之久，但仍然需要定期浮到水面呼吸空气，否则就会窒息。它们在游泳时并不使用双手，而是将双手紧贴身体，以一种符合水动力学的方式在水中蠕动前进；相反，它们依靠尾巴来推动自己前进。由于它们的生理构造，它们能够完全抵御寒冷以及那些冰冷海洋中的高压环境。

rows.original:
As with merfolk, selkies have occasionally interacted with seafaring or coastal peoples of land-dwelling races, appearing to ships and on beaches. Since they typically do not compete for similar territory or resources with landed peoples, interactions have been historically friendly. The same cannot be said of relations with aquatic peoples — they have clashed with merfolk on and off over territory and the hunting and fishing that comes with it. Due to merfolk organization and strategy, they typically lose, but conflicts tend to flare up every so often nevertheless. Selkies keep out of the way of siorcanna except when they heavily outnumber the latter, acknowledging the shark-peoples' superior strength and ferocity in combat.
        
        Selkies themselves have little record of their history, and what little there is takes place in the form of oral traditions handed down from mothers to daughters. Actual historical data comes from other peoples who have interacted with them — the most extensive knowledge of them comes from a Belharan functionary named Gaius Autumnstar, an elven civil servant who upon finding an injured selkie washed up on the beach took her in, kept her in a tank of seawater and nursed her to health over the course of a year. It is through the conversations with and anatomical examinations of his aquatic companion that much of the information in this codex is derived, concluding with his returning her to the ocean. It is likely that modern-day stories of the menfolk of land-dwelling races kidnapping these seal-women to be their wives by stealing their animal halves originate from Autumnstar's records — the discovery, the captivity, and the final release or escape of the selkie back where she belongs.
        
        Due to the solitary nature of selkie men, the vast majority of interactions with selkies have been with their womenfolk, giving rise to the impression that they are a monosexed people. This misunderstanding persists in several parts of the world, especially in places where they are more legend than reality. Selkies singing on beaches have been the stuff of legends since even before the Belharan empire, although they have to be approached with caution; if they feel threatened, selkies are able to weaponise their voices in ear-splitting shrieks. On land, such vocalisations are sufficient to buffet would-be attackers and even knock them off their feet, but underwater is where their voices are most terrible; the concussive force generated by a selkie shriek, projected and concentrated in a liquid medium, is able to pulverise threats to their person.
rows.translation:
与人鱼一样，海精灵也会偶尔与陆地上的航海民族或沿海居民发生接触，它们会出现在船只附近或海滩上。由于它们通常不会与陆地居民争夺相同的领地或资源，因此历史上这些接触一般都是友好的。然而，与水生民族的关系却并非如此——他们时常因为领土问题，以及与之相关的狩猎和捕鱼活动，与人鱼发生冲突。由于人鱼拥有严密的组织结构和策略，他们通常会在这些冲突中处于劣势，但即便如此，这类冲突仍会时不时地爆发。除非海豹人的数量远远超过那些鲨鱼族人，否则他们总是会避开与鲨鱼族人发生冲突——因为他们承认，在战斗中，鲨鱼族人拥有更强的力量和更凶猛的斗志。
        
        海豹精自身几乎没有关于自己历史的记载，为数不多的信息都是通过口口相传的方式从母亲传给女儿的。真正有关于他们的历史资料，都是来自那些与他们有过接触的其他民族。其中，对海豹精了解最为深入的，是一位名叫盖乌斯·秋星的白哈尔官员。这位精灵出身的公务员，在发现一只受伤的海豹精被冲上海滩后，将她收留下来，把她放在一个装满海水的容器里照料，最终在一年的时间里帮助她恢复了健康。正是通过与这种水生生物的对话以及对它们身体结构的观察，人们才获得了这份典籍中的许多信息。最终，这些故事以他将这些海豹女性送回海洋这一情节告终。很可能，现代那些关于陆地种族的男性会绑架这些海豹女性并将她们据为己妻的故事，其起源就在于秋星的记录——那些关于这些海豹女性的被发现、被俘虏，以及最终被释放或重新回到属于她们的海洋中的故事。
        
        由于海豹精男性的独居习性，人们与海豹精族群的绝大多数互动都是与他们的女性成员进行的，因此才产生了他们属于单性恋群体的印象。这种误解在世界上许多地方依然存在，尤其是在那些海豹精族更多只是传说而非现实存在的地方。早在贝尔哈兰帝国建立之前，关于海妖在海滩上歌唱的传说就已经存在了。不过，与这些生物打交道时必须格外小心——如果它们感到受到威胁，就会用震耳欲聋的尖叫声作为武器。在陆地上，这样的叫声足以震退潜在的攻击者，甚至将他们击倒；但在水中，它们的声音才真正变得致命——海妖的尖叫所产生的冲击力，在液态环境中被集中释放后，足以彻底消灭任何威胁它们生命的敌人。
rows.raw:
"
        As with merfolk, selkies have occasionally interacted with seafaring or coastal peoples of land-dwelling races, appearing to ships and on beaches. Since they typically do not compete for similar territory or resources with landed peoples, interactions have been historically friendly. The same cannot be said of relations with aquatic peoples — they have clashed with merfolk on and off over territory and the hunting and fishing that comes with it. Due to merfolk organization and strategy, they typically lose, but conflicts tend to flare up every so often nevertheless. Selkies keep out of the way of siorcanna except when they heavily outnumber the latter, acknowledging the shark-peoples' superior strength and ferocity in combat.
        
        Selkies themselves have little record of their history, and what little there is takes place in the form of oral traditions handed down from mothers to daughters. Actual historical data comes from other peoples who have interacted with them — the most extensive knowledge of them comes from a Belharan functionary named Gaius Autumnstar, an elven civil servant who upon finding an injured selkie washed up on the beach took her in, kept her in a tank of seawater and nursed her to health over the course of a year. It is through the conversations with and anatomical examinations of his aquatic companion that much of the information in this codex is derived, concluding with his returning her to the ocean. It is likely that modern-day stories of the menfolk of land-dwelling races kidnapping these seal-women to be their wives by stealing their animal halves originate from Autumnstar's records — the discovery, the captivity, and the final release or escape of the selkie back where she belongs.
        
        Due to the solitary nature of selkie men, the vast majority of interactions with selkies have been with their womenfolk, giving rise to the impression that they are a monosexed people. This misunderstanding persists in several parts of the world, especially in places where they are more legend than reality. Selkies singing on beaches have been the stuff of legends since even before the Belharan empire, although they have to be approached with caution; if they feel threatened, selkies are able to weaponise their voices in ear-splitting shrieks. On land, such vocalisations are sufficient to buffet would-be attackers and even knock them off their feet, but underwater is where their voices are most terrible; the concussive force generated by a selkie shriek, projected and concentrated in a liquid medium, is able to pulverise threats to their person.
                
        "

rows.original:
Female selkies gather in groups known as herds, which may range from two to several dozen individuals. A herd of selkies will typically claim a swathe of territory to live, forage and hunt in, only moving when circumstances prove unfavorable or when migrating to breeding sites to meet up with their menfolk. The herd is led by a matriarch, who is certainly related by blood to the vast majority, if not all of the herd's members. Customs, rituals and taboos can vary widely from herd to herd; there is no singular racial identity that has formed due to the scattered nature of herds. Herd identity is kept together via oral traditions passed down from matriarch to her heir in song and verse.

        Although selkies are omnivorous and have been observed harvesting kelp and other sea plants for food, meat and fish are necessary to sustain their lifestyle in frigid waters. Plant material is more often used for the weaving of nets, ropes and other tools; selkies are experts in shaping bone as spears and harpoons, which work just as well underwater as they do above. Hunting is carried out in packs of half a dozen or more, employing group tactics to isolate quarry from shoals and herds and flush them out towards others who will make the kill. Some selkies have been observed performing basic farming and aquaculture with ocean plants and fish and shrimp raised in netted caves, but their lack of greater organization means that few herds will ever be able to make use of any knowledge gained, and they will be unlikely to ever rise to the sophistication and technological standards of merfolk.
        
        When not feeling threatened, selkies are curious and gregarious; if a land-dweller is not overtly threatening or hostile, they will oftentimes gather around and approach in the safety of numbers before attempting to make conversation. Many selkies can speak a little Belharan and like to talk a lot; social play and interactions make up a lot of their recreational time. They can come across as easygoing and frivolous, charmed by the simplest gifts of cheap, shiny baubles. So long as the land-dweller keeps a respectful and amiable demeanour, they are likely to remain peaceful. A gift of food or useful material can be traded for directions, recent sightings, or other information; they do not like metal, though, as seawater corrodes it easily. Selkies have been observed cooperating with jotun whaling parties, serving as scouts and harassing the massive quarry towards the frost giants and their ice rafts in exchange for a portion of the kill.
rows.translation:
雌性人鱼会以群体形式活动，这些群体通常由两到几十只个体组成。一个人鱼群体往往会占据一片特定的区域，在那里生活、觅食和捕猎。只有当环境变得不利，或者它们需要迁移到繁殖地与雄性人鱼会合时，才会离开这个区域。这个兽群由一位雌性首领带领，她与兽群中的绝大多数成员，甚至可能是所有成员，都存在着血缘关系。不同的兽群在习俗、仪式和禁忌方面可能存在很大差异；由于这些兽群分布得十分分散，因此并没有形成统一的种族认同。群体的认同感是通过口述传统得以维系的——这些传统由女性族长以歌曲和诗句的形式传给她的后代。

        虽然人鱼是杂食性动物，人们也观察到它们会采集海带等海洋植物作为食物，但在冰冷的水域中，肉类和鱼类才是维持它们生存所必需的。植物材料更多是被人鱼用来编织渔网、绳索等工具；而人鱼在将骨头加工成长矛和鱼叉方面也十分擅长，这些武器在水中使用的效果与在陆地上一样好。狩猎时，这些生物会以六只或更多的群体形式行动，运用集体战术将猎物从鱼群或兽群中分离出来，然后将其驱赶向其他负责捕杀的同伴。有人观察到，某些塞尔基族会利用海洋植物进行简单的农业活动，在用网围起来的洞穴中养殖鱼类和虾类，但由于他们缺乏有效的组织结构，因此很少有整个族群能够真正运用这些知识，他们也不太可能达到人鱼那样的文明程度和技术水平。
        
        当没有感到受到威胁时，人鱼们通常是充满好奇心且喜欢群居的；如果某个陆地生物并没有表现出明显的威胁或敌意，它们往往会聚在一起，以人数优势作为保障，然后再尝试与对方进行交流。许多人鱼会说一点贝尔哈兰语，而且非常喜欢聊天；社交活动与互动构成了它们大部分的娱乐时间。它们给人的印象往往是很随和、不拘小节，最简单的、廉价而闪亮的装饰品就能让它们感到开心。只要陆地居民保持尊重他人、态度友善，他们就很有可能保持和平相处。赠送食物或有用的物品，可以用来换取方向指引、最近的目击信息或其他有用资料；不过，他们并不喜欢金属，因为海水会很容易腐蚀金属。有人观察到，人鱼会与巨鲸捕猎队合作，它们会担任侦察任务，驱赶那些庞大的猎物，引导它们朝霜巨人及其冰筏的方向游去，以此作为交换，它们能够获得猎物中的一部分。

rows.original:
As with many inhabitants of the frozen north, selkies breed in the summer when the air is marginally warmer and food more plentiful. Selkies tend to mate either on land or on ice, and depending on where they choose to breed, have different mating strategies. Selkies who choose to breed on land generally consist of one male and a harem of females; the womenfolk gather in large aggregations upon islands and the males, who have arrived earlier, are able to mate with them as well as defend them from rivals. Selkies who choose to breed over water and ice, though, are less likely to form harems of females; the instability of ice leads to breeding sites changing each year and males being unable to predict where females will stay during the breeding season. In such cases, pair-breeding for the duration of the season may occur.

        Male selkies establish territories during this time, claiming for themselves stretches of land, ice and ocean containing resources that attract their womenfolk, such as shade, tide pools or access to water. While attempting to attract females with song and courtship displays, they will also chase off rival males and potential dangers to their womenfolk. Once breeding season is over, selkie men and women part ways; the former live solitary existences outside of breeding season, while the latter form communal groups as large as the locale hunting and fishing will support.
        
        Selkie pregnancies last about a year such that the pups are born during the next spring or summer; females with newborns do not head to the breeding grounds, but instead stay to nurse their young. Selkie milk is even richer than minotaur milk; it is extremely thick and high in nutrients that pups need to grow and put on weight in order to survive cold temperatures. In the past, selkie milk, cheese and butter were delicacies in coastal Belharan cities, another ostentatious foodstuff for the rich to flaunt their wealth with. Whether this milk was freely given, traded for, or coerced from the seal-people has been lost to time. Male selkies will stay with their mothers for about a decade before leaving to their largely solitary existence, while a female will join her mother's community.
rows.translation:
与许多生活在寒冷北方的生物一样，人鱼也会在夏季繁殖——那时空气稍微温暖一些，食物也更加充足。人鱼通常在陆地或冰面上进行交配，而根据它们选择繁殖的地点不同，它们的交配策略也会有所差异。那些选择在陆地上繁衍的海豹精族，通常由一只雄性和一群雌性组成；这些雌性会聚集在岛屿上，而较早到达的雄性不仅可以与它们交配，还能保护它们免受其他竞争对手的侵扰。然而，那些选择在水域和冰面上进行繁殖的海豹精女性，不太可能形成由多个雌性组成的后宫；由于冰面的不稳定，每年的繁殖地点都会发生变化，因此雄性无法预测雌性在繁殖季节会停留在哪里。在这种情况下，整个季节都可能发生配对繁殖行为。

        在这段时间里，雄性海豹会划定自己的领地，占据那些拥有吸引雌性海豹的资源的地带——比如阴凉处、潮池或是水源地。它们会通过歌唱和求偶行为来吸引雌性，同时也会驱赶竞争对手和其他可能威胁到雌性安全的威胁。一旦繁殖季节结束，人鱼男性和女性就会分开生活；在繁殖季节之外，前者会过独居生活，而后者则会组成规模取决于当地猎物资源和捕鱼条件所能支持的集体群体，共同进行狩猎和捕鱼活动。
        
        海妖女性的妊娠期约为一年，因此幼崽会在来年的春夏季节出生。那些刚刚生下幼崽的雌性海妖并不会前往繁殖地，而是会留在原地哺育自己的孩子。海妖的乳汁比弥诺陶洛斯的乳汁更加丰富——它质地浓稠，含有丰富的营养物质，这些营养物质对于幼崽的成长和增重至关重要，能够帮助它们在寒冷的环境中生存下来。在过去，海豹精的牛奶、奶酪和黄油是贝尔哈兰沿海城市的珍馐佳肴，也是富人们用来炫耀财富的奢侈品。这种牛奶究竟是通过赠送、交易，还是通过强迫海豹精获得的，早已被时间所湮灭。雄性海豹会在母亲身边生活大约十年，之后才会开始过上主要独居的生活，而雌性海豹则会加入母亲的群体生活。

rows.translation: 海豹精
女武神

rows.original: "Lumia's gifts grant her warriors a blessing of immense power. Strength, beauty, and the stamina to traverse the oceans without tiring are just some of the benefits. Since the end of the Godswar, these valkyries have been busy in conflicts involving the remnants of the Wraiths and their kin. They act as Lumia's hands in the world, extending her protection to all who need it."
rows.translation: 卢米娅的馈赠赋予她的战士们强大的力量——力量、美貌，以及足以横渡海洋而不会感到疲倦的体力，这些仅仅只是其中的一部分益处。自神战结束以来，这些女武神一直忙于参与那些与怨灵残余势力及其同族相关的战斗。她们在世间充当卢米娅的代理人，将她的保护延伸到所有需要帮助的人身上。

They act as Lumia's hands in the world, extending her protection to all who need it.\" \n        "

rows.original: —Chronicle of the Gods of Savarra Name: Valkyrie (pl. Valkyries) Sexes: All valkyries appear as women, though they can have any genital arrangement. Height: That of the gifted race. Weight: That of the gifted race. Skin: While overall shade of fur or skin depends on the valkyrie's race, longer lived valkyries will tend to grow pale or bright silver in the case of scales or fur. Hair: That of the gifted race, though colors may brighten in some cases. Eyes: Valkyries retain their eye colors through the blessing's transformation, though when exercising their power they may glow with inner light. Ears: That of the gifted race. Wings: Some valkyries have wings like massive birds, dotted with golden feathers. Others manifest wings of light, using the sun's power itself to fly. Lifespan: Lifespan among the valkyries has been difficult to gauge. Some valkyries live much longer lives than the average of their race, but others live no longer than normal. Most often, this coincides with their retirement from general duties, or to match the lifespan of a lover. Maturity: Per base race.
rows.translation: —《萨瓦拉诸神编年史》 名称：女武神 性别：所有女武神都呈女性外貌，但可以拥有任何形式的生殖器构造。 身高：随受赐者原本的种族而定。 体重：随受赐者原本的种族而定。 皮肤：毛皮或皮肤的总体色泽取决于女武神原本的种族；寿命较长者的皮肤往往会逐渐变得苍白，鳞片或毛皮则会呈明亮的银色。 头发：随受赐者原本的种族而定，但某些情况下颜色会变得更加明亮。 眼睛：女武神在祝福带来的转变中会保留原有眼睛颜色，不过施展力量时，双眼可能从内部发出光芒。 耳朵：随受赐者原本的种族而定。 翅膀：有些女武神拥有巨鸟般、点缀着金色羽毛的翅膀；另一些则会显现光之翼，借太阳本身的力量飞翔。 寿命：女武神的寿命很难估量。有些女武神远比其种族的平均寿命长，另一些则与普通同族无异。这通常与她们何时卸下一般职责有关，也可能是为了与爱人的寿命相伴。 成熟年龄：随原本的种族而定。
