rows.original: . When the darkness of the Godswar descended, the lands beyond the desert vanished from history. Some Xenaspan imperial subjects — liontaurs in particular, as they were prized by the Belharan army and [silly|thus gave the province its well-known nickname of Sphinxistan|often became generals in its ranks] — had come to live in the Heartlands and retained some of their ancestral memories, so their original homeland wasn't seen as a wholly mythical place. But all contact was lost, and it could not be regained. Even the flow of azul stopped for well over a century. One cannot know what transpired in the former province while the rest of the empire convulsed with apocalyptic destruction, though there were rumors of great battles waged between warlords vying for power on the edges of the desert. The only people who have managed to travel there since are the mighty-winged valkyries, who are sworn to answer prayers to Lumia all over the world and have the endurance to soar even over the trackless Jassiran desert. Their global journeys are infrequent and cloaked in legend, and they are not exactly ethnographers, so many of the stories that they do tell must be taken with a large grain of salt. But in the lands beyond the desert, at least, a Heartlander can correlate their often-tall tales with what little is known from Belharan history and determine that there are now several successor realms to the old imperial province. One, Ariana, is ruled by a native dynasty of harpy-queens reduced to governors during the Belharan conquest but once again proudly independent; another, which still claims the name Xenaspa, has elven rulers. Both appear to be peopled by the same mix of Heartland-descended and indigenous folk that they were in imperial times, and both count an almost-intelligible variant of Belharan among the many tongues that they speak. According to the valkyries, the azul that has once again appeared in Arkacian markets is indeed originally from Xenaspa. The dust elves and myrmarcs that dwell there create mines to rival any in Khor'minos, extracting not merely azul but all manner of precious metals and building-stones. With the bounty of the earth, both stone and metal, they create great, well-engineered cities — albeit on the surface, rather than underground. While they cannot trade in any great amount with Jassira, they can trade in great volumes with the other places on the far side of the deserts and mountains. Their fabulous trade-wealth and well-irrigated river valleys feed a large population, a court of Narevan snake-like scholars, and a thoroughly-drilled military that still holds memories of making war like the Belharans of old. As for Ariana, it is nearly as wealthy and populous, but its greatest tradition is as the womb of heroes. Arianan legends tell of lone warriors journeying into the mountains to tame the great birds that dwell there and ally with them to vanquish darkness. Their warriors are equal in pride and prowess to any Yvennese, and many are just-as-devout worshipers of Lumia, lady of fire and sun. Some have apparently even joined the valkyrie order itself. Ariana and Xenaspa, despite still being shrouded in myth, are only the nearest of the lands that lie beyond the great desert. The tales the valkyries tell of them mostly tally with what we can reasonably verify. But as the valkyries' stories get further from Ariana and Xenaspa, the tales get taller. What lies beyond them are places without names, known mostly by the fact that their traders once ventured (and, according to the valkyries, still do) into Xenaspan markets selling wares that seem as fabulous as azul: exotic spices that lend food any taste one can imagine, horses with tremendous endurance and undying loyalty to their riders, corals even more elaborate than the ones in the seas between Jassira and the Heartlands, and clothes that are somehow light and strong at the same time and dyed with a riot of beautiful color. As ever, one of the first hints of lands beyond the horizon is trade. These things must come from somewhere, and perhaps someday the intrepid traders and explorers of the Heartlands will be able to journey to their source. Perhaps they will even journey beyond the lands that Old Belhar knew.
rows.translation: 。 神战的黑暗降临后，大沙漠彼岸的土地从历史中消失了。一些来自塞纳斯帕的帝国臣民——尤其是狮身人马，他们深受贝尔哈兰军队器重，[silly|也因此让该行省得到了“斯芬克斯斯坦”这个著名绰号|常常能在军中升任将领]——已经迁居腹地，并保留着部分祖先记忆，因此故乡并未被彻底视作神话。然而，所有联系都已中断，而且再也无法恢复；就连阿祖尔的流通也停滞了一个多世纪。当帝国其他地区在末日般的毁灭中痉挛时，无人知道这个旧行省究竟发生了什么；只有传言说，沙漠边缘曾爆发军阀争权的大战。 此后，只有拥有强健双翼的女武神成功前往那里。她们立誓回应世界各地向卢米娅发出的祈祷，也拥有飞越贾西拉无路沙漠的耐力。她们很少展开环球旅程，相关经历又笼罩在传说之中；况且她们并非民族志学者，因此讲述的许多故事都必须谨慎看待。不过，至少对沙漠彼岸的土地而言，腹地人可以把她们常常夸张的故事与贝尔哈兰历史中仅存的知识相互印证，并判断旧帝国行省如今已有数个继承国。其中之一是阿丽亚娜，由当地的鹰身女妖女王王朝统治；她们在贝尔哈兰征服时期曾被降为总督，如今又骄傲地恢复独立。另一个国家仍沿用塞纳斯帕之名，由精灵统治。两国居民似乎仍和帝国时代一样，由腹地移民后裔与当地民族共同组成；其众多语言中，也都有一种勉强能与贝尔哈兰语互通的变体。 据女武神所言，如今再次出现在阿卡西亚市场的阿祖尔确实源自塞纳斯帕。当地的尘精灵与蚁人开凿出足以媲美科尔米诺斯的矿场，不仅采掘阿祖尔，还开采各种贵金属与建筑石材。他们利用大地赐予的石料与金属，在地表而非地下建造宏伟而设计精良的城市。他们虽无法与贾西拉大规模贸易，却能够与沙漠和群山另一侧的其他地区进行巨额贸易。惊人的贸易财富与灌溉良好的河谷养活了庞大人口、由奈瑞瓦蛇族学者组成的宫廷，以及一支训练有素、仍记得古代贝尔哈兰战争方式的军队。阿丽亚娜几乎同样富庶繁荣，不过其最伟大的传统是孕育英雄。阿丽亚娜传说讲述孤身战士深入群山，驯服栖息其中的巨鸟，与它们并肩击败黑暗。当地战士的骄傲与勇武不逊于任何耶文人，许多人也同样虔诚地信奉火焰与太阳女神卢米娅；据说，其中一些人甚至加入了女武神教团。 阿丽亚娜与塞纳斯帕虽然仍笼罩在传说中，却只是大沙漠彼岸距离最近的国家。女武神关于两地的描述，大体符合我们能够合理验证的事实；但故事离阿丽亚娜与塞纳斯帕越远，就越发离奇。更远处是一些没有名字的土地；人们对它们的了解，主要来自那些曾经（据女武神说，如今依然）前往塞纳斯帕市场的商人。他们出售的商品如阿祖尔一般不可思议：能让食物呈现任何想象风味的异域香料；耐力惊人、永远忠于骑手的骏马；比贾西拉与腹地之间海域所产之物更加精美的珊瑚；以及轻盈而坚韧、染有缤纷艳丽色彩的衣物。 一如既往，贸易正是地平线之外存在其他土地的最初线索之一。这些货物必定来自某个地方；或许终有一天，腹地勇敢的商人与探险家能够抵达它们的源头，甚至走向古贝尔哈从未知晓的更远方。
rows.raw: ". When the darkness of the Godswar descended, the lands beyond the desert vanished from history. Some Xenaspan imperial subjects — liontaurs in particular, as they were prized by the Belharan army and [silly|thus gave the province its well-known nickname of Sphinxistan|often became generals in its ranks] — had come to live in the Heartlands and retained some of their ancestral memories, so their original homeland wasn't seen as a wholly mythical place. But all contact was lost, and it could not be regained. Even the flow of azul stopped for well over a century. One cannot know what transpired in the former province while the rest of the empire convulsed with apocalyptic destruction, though there were rumors of great battles waged between warlords vying for power on the edges of the desert. The only people who have managed to travel there since are the mighty-winged valkyries, who are sworn to answer prayers to Lumia all over the world and have the endurance to soar even over the trackless Jassiran desert. Their global journeys are infrequent and cloaked in legend, and they are not exactly ethnographers, so many of the stories that they do tell must be taken with a large grain of salt. But in the lands beyond the desert, at least, a Heartlander can correlate their often-tall tales with what little is known from Belharan history and determine that there are now several successor realms to the old imperial province. One, Ariana, is ruled by a native dynasty of harpy-queens reduced to governors during the Belharan conquest but once again proudly independent; another, which still claims the name Xenaspa, has elven rulers. Both appear to be peopled by the same mix of Heartland-descended and indigenous folk that they were in imperial times, and both count an almost-intelligible variant of Belharan among the many tongues that they speak. According to the valkyries, the azul that has once again appeared in Arkacian markets is indeed originally from Xenaspa. The dust elves and myrmarcs that dwell there create mines to rival any in Khor'minos, extracting not merely azul but all manner of precious metals and building-stones. With the bounty of the earth, both stone and metal, they create great, well-engineered cities — albeit on the surface, rather than underground. While they cannot trade in any great amount with Jassira, they can trade in great volumes with the other places on the far side of the deserts and mountains. Their fabulous trade-wealth and well-irrigated river valleys feed a large population, a court of Narevan snake-like scholars, and a thoroughly-drilled military that still holds memories of making war like the Belharans of old. As for Ariana, it is nearly as wealthy and populous, but its greatest tradition is as the womb of heroes. Arianan legends tell of lone warriors journeying into the mountains to tame the great birds that dwell there and ally with them to vanquish darkness. Their warriors are equal in pride and prowess to any Yvennese, and many are just-as-devout worshipers of Lumia, lady of fire and sun. Some have apparently even joined the valkyrie order itself. Ariana and Xenaspa, despite still being shrouded in myth, are only the nearest of the lands that lie beyond the great desert. The tales the valkyries tell of them mostly tally with what we can reasonably verify. But as the valkyries' stories get further from Ariana and Xenaspa, the tales get taller. What lies beyond them are places without names, known mostly by the fact that their traders once ventured (and, according to the valkyries, still do) into Xenaspan markets selling wares that seem as fabulous as azul: exotic spices that lend food any taste one can imagine, horses with tremendous endurance and undying loyalty to their riders, corals even more elaborate than the ones in the seas between Jassira and the Heartlands, and clothes that are somehow light and strong at the same time and dyed with a riot of beautiful color. As ever, one of the first hints of lands beyond the horizon is trade. These things must come from somewhere, and perhaps someday the intrepid traders and explorers of the Heartlands will be able to journey to their source. Perhaps they will even journey beyond the lands that Old Belhar knew. "

rows.translation: 冒险者

rows.original: This is you, a penniless vagabond in search of fame and fortune, love and excitement. Adventurers have a certain reputation as free spirits and troublemakers, but in the lawless frontier of the Frost Marches, you're the only hope most folk have for justice and protection.
rows.translation: 这就是你——一个身无分文、渴望名利、爱情与刺激的流浪者。冒险者们向来以自由不羁、喜欢惹是生非的形象著称，但在霜冻边境这个法纪不彰的地区，你才是大多数人们寻求正义与保护的唯一希望。
rows.raw: "This is you, a penniless vagabond in search of fame and fortune, love and excitement. Adventurers have a certain reputation as free spirits and troublemakers, but in the lawless frontier of the Frost Marches, you're the only hope most folk have for justice and protection."

rows.translation: 冰霜冠军

rows.original: An ancient title bestowed upon those who risked life and limb to defend the Winter City and its former empire, reserved for the boreal elves' greatest living heroes. To bear this title is a mark of [silly|pride and accomplishment|prestige]... though today, few enough people back home likely know the boreal elves even exist, much less what earning such a title entails.
rows.translation: 这是授予那些冒着生命危险保卫冬城及其昔日帝国之人的古老头衔，只留给极北精灵中最伟大的在世英雄。拥有这个头衔象征着[silly|骄傲与成就|声望]……不过如今，家乡大概没几个人知道极北精灵存在，更不用说获得这一头衔意味着什么了。
rows.raw: "An ancient title bestowed upon those who risked life and limb to defend the Winter City and its former empire, reserved for the boreal elves' greatest living heroes. To bear this title is a mark of [silly|pride and accomplishment|prestige]... though today, few enough people back home likely know the boreal elves even exist, much less what earning such a title entails."

rows.translation: 慈善家

rows.original: Philanthropists are rare in this day and age of Savarra, where life is harsh and brutal. Those with the desire to give often lack the means, and those with the means to give often lack the desire; it is rare that someone appears possessed of both. Yet where they do put their wealth back into the community, people are grateful for their existence and the alleviation, in some small part, of their woes.
rows.translation: 在萨瓦拉这个生活艰难而残酷的时代，慈善家实属罕见。那些愿意奉献爱心的人往往缺乏相应的手段，而那些拥有捐赠能力的人又往往缺乏这种意愿；同时具备这两种条件的人更是凤毛麟角。然而，每当有人将自己拥有的财富回馈给社会时，人们都会为他们感到感激，因为这至少能在一定程度上缓解人们的困境。
rows.raw: "Philanthropists are rare in this day and age of Savarra, where life is harsh and brutal. Those with the desire to give often lack the means, and those with the means to give often lack the desire; it is rare that someone appears possessed of both. Yet where they do put their wealth back into the community, people are grateful for their existence and the alleviation, in some small part, of their woes."

rows.translation: 道途行者

rows.original: Even at the height of imperial science and technology, the mages of Estelore jealously guarded the secret of travel through the Ways Between. Instantaneous travel over great distances was yet another way to set them apart from the common Belharan citizen, who was growing wealthier as the empire expanded. Even the aristocracy who supported them politically were denied the full extent of their capabilities, instead being restricted to entering and leaving by means of waystone idols. These privileged non-mages were known as Way-Walkers.
rows.translation: 即使在帝国科技最为发达的时期，埃斯特洛尔的法师们依然小心翼翼地守护着通过“通道”进行瞬间移动的秘密。这种能够跨越遥远距离的瞬间移动方式，使得他们与那些随着帝国扩张而日益富裕的贝尔哈兰普通民众截然不同。就连那些在政治上支持他们的贵族，也被限制了他们真正的能力范围，他们只能通过路标神像来进出这些区域。这些享有特权的非法师们被称为“路行者”。
rows.raw: "Even at the height of imperial science and technology, the mages of Estelore jealously guarded the secret of travel through the Ways Between. Instantaneous travel over great distances was yet another way to set them apart from the common Belharan citizen, who was growing wealthier as the empire expanded. Even the aristocracy who supported them politically were denied the full extent of their capabilities, instead being restricted to entering and leaving by means of waystone idols. These privileged non-mages were known as Way-Walkers."

rows.translation: 酒吧斗士

rows.original: A scuffle is a common sight once drink flows and tempers rise. Anyone experienced in bar brawling either likes to fight, or has no other establishments to choose from.
rows.translation: 一旦酒喝多了，人们的脾气也会变得暴躁，于是斗殴场面就变得十分常见。那些有过在酒吧打架经历的人，要么就是喜欢打架，要么就是因为没有其他地方可去，才不得不选择在酒吧里闹事。
rows.raw: "A scuffle is a common sight once drink flows and tempers rise. Anyone experienced in bar brawling either likes to fight, or has no other establishments to choose from."

rows.translation: 炼金术士

rows.original: Alchemists are common sights about much of the world — concoctions to induce transformations of one form or the other are one service they offer, although most of their work is far more mundane.
rows.translation: 在世界各地，炼金术士都是常见的景象——他们所提供的服务之一，就是通过各种配方来促使物质发生形态上的变化，不过他们的多数工作其实都相当平凡普通。
rows.raw: "Alchemists are common sights about much of the world — concoctions to induce transformations of one form or the other are one service they offer, although most of their work is far more mundane."

rows.translation: 暗骑士

rows.original: Dark Knights — although this is not the name they called themselves — rose to the forefront of the wraiths' armies during the Godswar. Leaders, commanders, strategists, they shared varied talents, but all held positions of importance. Whether they were always this wretched to begin with or if their experiences made them this way, who knows? The stain they have left upon history is well-recorded.
rows.translation: 暗影骑士们——尽管他们并不以这个名称自称——在神战期间成为了那些幽灵军队的中坚力量。他们中既有领导者，也有指挥官和战略家，每个人都拥有不同的才能，但都担任着重要的职务。不知道他们原本就是这样的堕落之徒，还是经历了某些事情后才变成了这样，但他们在历史上留下的污迹已经被详细记录了下来。
rows.raw: "Dark Knights — although this is not the name they called themselves — rose to the forefront of the wraiths' armies during the Godswar. Leaders, commanders, strategists, they shared varied talents, but all held positions of importance. Whether they were always this wretched to begin with or if their experiences made them this way, who knows? The stain they have left upon history is well-recorded."

rows.translation: 凯罗斯的冠军

rows.original:
Unlike others of the Seven, Keros has historically not seen fit to anoint any special champions — all foxes are his people, after all. That this policy has changed, if only once, bodes changing circumstances in the world, and the need to look forward to the future while remaining grounded in the lessons of the past.

        Or maybe he's just doing it for the kicks of it.
rows.translation:
与七人中的其他成员不同，凯罗斯历来并不认为有必要指定任何特殊的英雄——毕竟，所有的狐狸都属于他的子民。如果这一政策曾经有过一次改变，那无疑意味着世界局势正在发生变化，人们需要在铭记过去经验的同时，展望未来。

        又或许，他这么做只是为了寻求一些乐趣罢了。
rows.raw: "Unlike others of the Seven, Keros has historically not seen fit to anoint any special champions — all foxes are his people, after all. That this policy has changed, if only once, bodes changing circumstances in the world, and the need to look forward to the future while remaining grounded in the lessons of the past.\n\n        Or maybe he's just doing it for the kicks of it."

rows.translation: 行进者-[pc.mf|男爵|女男爵]

rows.original: Baron of the March is an ancient title dating back to the glory days of Belhar, when its empire stretched across nearly all the known world. The Belharan borderland was protected by a series of marches, each guarded by a military lord and his fort, sworn to guard against the barbarians and beasts beyond the imperial walls. The Frost Marches are one such region, parceled out to several imperial generals more than one hundred years before the Godswar. The March was to act as the empire's shield against the boreal elves of the far north, who successfully resisted the empire's colonization; the elves responded by building their own forts across the River Ridell and naming their own Marcher-Barons, settling into a tense peace with ancient Belhar. As a [pc.mf|Baron|Baroness] of the March, you're a landed [pc.mf|lord|lady] with the power to tax and pass judgement, to levy soldiers and to lead them in battle against invaders — though you're more likely to wage war against Kasyrra and her demons than northern barbarians. Now you have a title of your very own, [pc.name].
rows.translation: 边疆领主”这一头衔可追溯至贝尔哈尔帝国的辉煌时代，那时它的疆域几乎覆盖了整个已知世界。贝尔哈尔的边境地区由一系列边防要塞守护，每处要塞都由一位军事领主及其驻军把守，这些领主和军队誓死抵御帝国边境之外的野蛮族群与凶猛野兽。冰霜边境就是这样一个地区。在神战爆发前一百多年，这片土地被分给了几位帝国将军管辖。设立这个边境区域，初衷是让帝国能够抵御来自北方寒冷地区的精灵们的侵袭——那些精灵曾成功抵抗了帝国的殖民企图；作为回应，精灵们在里德尔河沿岸建立了自己的要塞，并任命了自己的边境领主，从而与古老的贝尔哈尔地区形成了一种紧张但相对和平的共处关系。作为[pc.mf|男爵|女男爵]到了三月份，你就该安定下来了。 [pc.mf|领主|女士]拥有征税与裁决的权力，能够征召士兵并率领他们与入侵者作战——不过你更有可能与卡希拉及其恶魔开战，而非北方的野蛮人。现在，你终于拥有属于自己的头衔了。 [pc.name]。
rows.raw: "Baron of the March is an ancient title dating back to the glory days of Belhar, when its empire stretched across nearly all the known world. The Belharan borderland was protected by a series of marches, each guarded by a military lord and his fort, sworn to guard against the barbarians and beasts beyond the imperial walls. The Frost Marches are one such region, parceled out to several imperial generals more than one hundred years before the Godswar. The March was to act as the empire's shield against the boreal elves of the far north, who successfully resisted the empire's colonization; the elves responded by building their own forts across the River Ridell and naming their own Marcher-Barons, settling into a tense peace with ancient Belhar. As a [pc.mf|Baron|Baroness] of the March, you're a landed [pc.mf|lord|lady] with the power to tax and pass judgement, to levy soldiers and to lead them in battle against invaders — though you're more likely to wage war against Kasyrra and her demons than northern barbarians. Now you have a title of your very own, [pc.name]."

rows.translation: 鹰棘镇的冠军

rows.original: Growing out of the Belharan tradition of trial by combat into agents of the nobility that could exert their influence beyond the court and across the countryside, Champions of the Realm were once sworn protectors and heroes to the common man. Even after the Godswar ended and Belhar fell to chaos in the aftermath, Champions will still arise once in a generation to lead some backwater province or city-state out of its darkest hour. Surely, Kasyrra's arrival is just that for the Frost Marches and the Barony of Hawkethorne.
rows.translation: 从贝尔哈兰传统的决斗制度演变而来，这些贵族的代理人得以将他们的影响力延伸到宫廷之外，遍布整个乡村。曾经，这些“王国的捍卫者”被人们视为普通民众的守护者与英雄。即使在神战结束、贝尔哈尔陷入混乱之后，每一代也总会有一些英雄出现，带领那些偏远省份或城邦度过最艰难的时期。毫无疑问，卡希拉的出现，正是为霜冻边境地区和鹰棘镇男爵领带来希望的。
rows.raw: "Growing out of the Belharan tradition of trial by combat into agents of the nobility that could exert their influence beyond the court and across the countryside, Champions of the Realm were once sworn protectors and heroes to the common man. Even after the Godswar ended and Belhar fell to chaos in the aftermath, Champions will still arise once in a generation to lead some backwater province or city-state out of its darkest hour. Surely, Kasyrra's arrival is just that for the Frost Marches and the Barony of Hawkethorne."

rows.translation: 光之英雄

rows.original: Lumia is no stranger to gifting heroes with the power and artifacts they need to complete their quests. Each blessing is tailored to the person who receives it, and can be wholly different from person to person. Regardless of the difference in boons, one thing stays constant: Those who receive the sun's blessing herald prosperity.
rows.translation: 卢米娅向来擅长为英雄们提供完成任务所需的能量与神器。每一份祝福都是为接受者量身定制的，因此每个人获得的奖励可能都会截然不同。尽管这些祝福的内容各不相同，但有一点是恒定不变的：那些获得了“太阳的祝福”的人，必将迎来繁荣与成功。
rows.raw: "Lumia is no stranger to gifting heroes with the power and artifacts they need to complete their quests. Each blessing is tailored to the person who receives it, and can be wholly different from person to person. Regardless of the difference in boons, one thing stays constant: Those who receive the sun's blessing herald prosperity."

rows.translation: 屠龙者

rows.original: The title given to a mighty slayer of dragons... or at least the closest living things to them.
rows.translation: 这个称号是用来称呼那些强大的屠龙者……或者至少是那些与龙最为相似的生物。
rows.raw: "The title given to a mighty slayer of dragons... or at least the closest living things to them."

rows.original:
Heralded as the [pc.mf|King|Queen] of the Khor'minos Arena.

        A title granted to those who have challenged and overcome the competitors of the arena. Officially recognized by the ruling king, allowing them certain special privileges should they wish it.
rows.translation:
被誉为[pc.mf|国王|女王]科尔米诺斯竞技场的称号。

        这一称号授予那些敢于挑战并战胜竞技场中其他参赛者的人。这一称号得到了统治国王的正式认可，因此获得这一称号的人在需要时可以享受一些特殊的优惠。
rows.raw:
"
        Heralded as the [pc.mf|King|Queen] of the Khor'minos Arena.

        A title granted to those who have challenged and overcome the competitors of the arena. Officially recognized by the ruling king, allowing them certain special privileges should they wish it."

rows.translation: 诅咒破除者

rows.original: Over the course of your adventure, people have come to know you for your specialty in identifying, analyzing, and breaking harmful curses placed on individuals, objects, or locations. It's your job to deal with dangerous curses so no one else has to.
rows.translation: 在你的冒险过程中，人们之所以认识你，是因为你擅长识别、分析并解除那些施加在个人、物品或地点上的有害诅咒。你的职责就是处理这些危险的诅咒，这样其他人就不必再为此烦恼了。
rows.raw: "Over the course of your adventure, people have come to know you for your specialty in identifying, analyzing, and breaking harmful curses placed on individuals, objects, or locations. It's your job to deal with dangerous curses so no one else has to."

rows.translation: 科尔米诺斯的伴侣

rows.original: You are a consort to the ruler of Khor'minos, chosen by the king to enter into the royal harem. While this position has no official power, it comes with a great deal of prestige and political influence.
rows.translation: 你是科尔米诺斯统治者的配偶，由国王选中进入王室后宫。虽然这一身份没有实质性的权力，但它带来了极高的声望和政治影响力。
rows.raw: "You are a consort to the ruler of Khor'minos, chosen by the king to enter into the royal harem. While this position has no official power, it comes with a great deal of prestige and political influence."

rows.translation: 破城者

rows.original: You are hailed as a hero by the people of Khor'minos, responsible for breaking the siege that had threatened to overwhelm the city. All hail the Champion!
rows.translation: 科尔米诺斯的人民将你誉为英雄，因为正是你打破了那场威胁要摧毁这座城市的围攻。向这位勇士致敬！
rows.raw: "You are hailed as a hero by the people of Khor'minos, responsible for breaking the siege that had threatened to overwhelm the city. All hail the Champion!"
