rows.original: A furniture set mainly drawing from local Marches lupine and Sailgraves orcs aesthetics. Heavy on carved stone symbols, bone, and furs for the modern would-be jarl or jarlessa who would nevertheless reach for the legitimacy of past symbology. Stark, strong, harsh and imposing. Trophies, too, although no one's going to question if you really were the one to take those beasts down.
rows.translation: 这套家具主要借鉴边疆本地狼族和帆葬群岛兽人的审美，大量使用石雕符号、骨骼与毛皮，适合想借古老象征确立正统地位的现代准领主，不论男女。风格冷峻、强硬、粗犷而威严。也有战利品装饰，虽然没人会质疑你究竟是不是亲手杀死那些野兽的人。
rows.raw: "A furniture set mainly drawing from local Marches lupine and Sailgraves orcs aesthetics. Heavy on carved stone symbols, bone, and furs for the modern would-be jarl or jarlessa who would nevertheless reach for the legitimacy of past symbology. Stark, strong, harsh and imposing. Trophies, too, although no one's going to question if you really were the one to take those beasts down."

rows.original: A furniture set aiming to mimic the aesthetics of Belhar's cultural centres before the fall of the empire, an aesthetic which is still practiced in certain places like Yvennes today. While the gilded surfaces and dark, rich woods so favored can no longer be perfectly recreated with current methods, many pieces are nevertheless good enough.
rows.translation: 这套家具旨在模仿贝尔哈尔帝国灭亡之前其文化中心所推崇的美学风格，这种审美风格至今在某些地方，比如伊文尼斯，依然被沿用。虽然如今已无法用现有的技术完全再现那些镀金表面以及那些深色、质地优良的木材，但许多家具作品依然达到了相当高的水准。
rows.raw: "A furniture set aiming to mimic the aesthetics of Belhar's cultural centres before the fall of the empire, an aesthetic which is still practiced in certain places like Yvennes today. While the gilded surfaces and dark, rich woods so favored can no longer be perfectly recreated with current methods, many pieces are nevertheless good enough."

rows.original: Want to make your Wayfort look like Carmen's castle? Now you can! Dark stone, gargoyles (not sapient or ambulatory), and heavy burnished bronze all come together for that looming, forbidding look that any sinister fortress absolutely craves. Rugs and upholstery in lovely crimson trimmed with gold, ebony furniture carved exquisitely at sharp angles to reflect the brutal and rugged nature of existence. Downright depressing, but some people like depressing.
rows.translation: 想让你的荒废驿堡城堡看起来像卡门的那座城堡吗？现在你可以实现了！深色的石头、那些毫无生命的滴水嘴，以及经过抛光处理的厚重青铜，共同营造出那种阴森、令人生畏的氛围——正是任何邪恶堡垒所必备的特征。地毯和家具装饰采用美丽的深红色，并点缀着金色边纹；乌木家具经过精巧的雕刻，其棱角分明，仿佛在反映生活中残酷而粗糙的一面。这种风格确实会让人感到压抑，但有些人就是喜欢这种压抑感啊。
rows.raw: "Want to make your Wayfort look like Carmen's castle? Now you can! Dark stone, gargoyles (not sapient or ambulatory), and heavy burnished bronze all come together for that looming, forbidding look that any sinister fortress absolutely craves. Rugs and upholstery in lovely crimson trimmed with gold, ebony furniture carved exquisitely at sharp angles to reflect the brutal and rugged nature of existence. Downright depressing, but some people like depressing."

rows.original: All roads lead to Khor'minos, or at least in the Marches. The funny thing about roads is that they also lead away from places, and bring things with them. This set of furniture is meant to evoke the feel of a wealthy minoan domicile, granite and marble tiles, sitting benches for the hallways, and drapes done up in rich purple with gold and silver trimmings for the walls and doorways. There's even a small portable fountain with a self-contained pool and a spout in the shape of a bull's head, although you'd need piping to connect it to.
rows.translation: 所有的道路最终都会通向科尔米诺斯，至少在那些边境地区是这样。有趣的是，道路同时也会把人们从某些地方带走，并将一些东西带到那些地方。这套家具的设计目的，就是营造出一种富有的米诺斯家庭氛围：使用花岗岩和大理石铺成的地面，在走廊里设置长椅，而墙壁和门框上则悬挂着用金色和银色装饰的深紫色帷幔。那里甚至还有一个小型便携式喷泉，它拥有一个独立的水池，以及一个形状像公牛头的水嘴，不过你需要连接一些管道才能让它正常使用。
rows.raw: "All roads lead to Khor'minos, or at least in the Marches. The funny thing about roads is that they also lead away from places, and bring things with them. This set of furniture is meant to evoke the feel of a wealthy minoan domicile, granite and marble tiles, sitting benches for the hallways, and drapes done up in rich purple with gold and silver trimmings for the walls and doorways. There's even a small portable fountain with a self-contained pool and a spout in the shape of a bull's head, although you'd need piping to connect it to."

rows.translation: 极北精灵

rows.original: A blend of mostly post-Godswar boer'alvar aesthetics, although some druidic influence is clear in the abundance of potted plants intended to go with the furniture. While not truly whitewood, the furniture pieces have been painted alabaster to mimic that rare sacred material, and gold trim breaks up the monotony of a single color throughout. Furs and fine fabrics work together in wall tapestries to tell stories of the snow elves, and the potted plants which range from the more mundane to the fantastical ice roses add the dimension of scent to this furniture set.
rows.translation: 这种设计风格主要融合了《神战》之后的布尔阿尔瓦风格元素，不过从那些为搭配家具而特意摆放的盆栽植物中，也能明显感受到德鲁伊文化的影响。这些家具虽然并非真正的白木材质，但被涂成了雪花石膏的颜色，以此来模仿这种稀有的神圣材料；而金色的装饰线条则打破了整体色彩的单一性，为设计增添了几分亮点。毛皮与精美的织物共同被用于制作墙挂挂毯，这些挂毯讲述了雪精灵的故事；而那些从普通的盆栽到充满奇幻色彩的冰玫瑰，则为这套家具增添了嗅觉上的享受。
rows.raw: "A blend of mostly post-Godswar boer'alvar aesthetics, although some druidic influence is clear in the abundance of potted plants intended to go with the furniture. While not truly whitewood, the furniture pieces have been painted alabaster to mimic that rare sacred material, and gold trim breaks up the monotony of a single color throughout. Furs and fine fabrics work together in wall tapestries to tell stories of the snow elves, and the potted plants which range from the more mundane to the fantastical ice roses add the dimension of scent to this furniture set."

rows.original: Stereotypically so, even when it's arguably only the most wealthy and powerful who manage to live in such surroundings. Low furniture, large cushions, heavy fabric — all of it heavily doused with perfume. Colorful, opulent in the same way people from that part of the world customarily dye their hair brightly, the furniture extends its invitation to you, an invitation into its cloying, smothering, stupor-inducing embrace. There's even a spice hookah thrown into the deal, although gods knows you might never actually use it. Still, it's decor, right?
rows.translation: 按照传统的观念，只有最富有、最有权势的人才能生活在这样的环境中。低矮的家具、厚实的靠垫、重型的布料——所有这些都被浓重的香水味所笼罩。这些色彩鲜艳、奢华华贵的家具，就如同那个地区的人们习惯将头发染成鲜艳的颜色一样，都在向您发出邀请，邀请您进入它们那令人昏昏欲睡、压抑窒息的怀抱之中。其中甚至还包含了一个调味品水烟筒，不过天知道你可能永远都不会用到它。不过，它毕竟只是个装饰品而已，对吧？
rows.raw: "Stereotypically so, even when it's arguably only the most wealthy and powerful who manage to live in such surroundings. Low furniture, large cushions, heavy fabric — all of it heavily doused with perfume. Colorful, opulent in the same way people from that part of the world customarily dye their hair brightly, the furniture extends its invitation to you, an invitation into its cloying, smothering, stupor-inducing embrace. There's even a spice hookah thrown into the deal, although gods knows you might never actually use it. Still, it's decor, right?"

rows.original: Finding pieces that work well with the Wayfort's build must have been difficult, but the task has nevertheless been achieved with an impressive degree of success. Low tables, cushions, and scroll paintings and calligraphy to be hung up on the walls, coupled with several simple straw mats and pieces of ornate lacquered furniture. Extremely lightweight and durable, if a little small, it makes for a sense of tasteful use of empty space.
rows.translation: 要找到那些能与荒废驿堡的装修风格相搭配的物品，肯定是一件相当困难的事情，但开发者们还是成功地完成了这一任务，而且取得了令人瞩目的成果。低矮的桌子、靠垫，以及可以挂在墙上的卷轴画和书法作品，再加上几块简单的草席和一些装饰华丽的漆器家具，这些元素共同营造出一种既轻盈又耐用的空间氛围，虽然这些家具的体积有点小，但使用起来却非常得体，充分体现了主人对空间布局的精妙把握。
rows.raw: "Finding pieces that work well with the Wayfort's build must have been difficult, but the task has nevertheless been achieved with an impressive degree of success. Low tables, cushions, and scroll paintings and calligraphy to be hung up on the walls, coupled with several simple straw mats and pieces of ornate lacquered furniture. Extremely lightweight and durable, if a little small, it makes for a sense of tasteful use of empty space."

rows.original: A furniture set inspired by the legacy of local shamans and witches. Though by no means a center of learning, the Frost Marches have held to arcane traditions as old as the land, passed from master to pupil. Such sages find respite in simple comforts, crafted from humble materials and etched with electrum. Their influence is displayed with mysticism, engraved into stone and wood, blending Belhar and lupine sensibilities with a touch of Tychris influence.
rows.translation: 这套家具的设计灵感源自当地萨满与女巫的传统。虽然弗罗斯特边境地区绝非学术研究的中心，但人们依然坚守着与这片土地同龄的神秘传统，这些知识代代相传，从师徒之间流传下来。这类智者往往从最简单的舒适之物中寻找慰藉——这些物品由朴实的材料制成，表面还镶嵌着电银。他们的智慧通过各种神秘符号被镌刻在石头和木头上，将贝尔哈尔与卢皮恩的文化元素与提克里斯的影响融为一体。
rows.raw: "A furniture set inspired by the legacy of local shamans and witches. Though by no means a center of learning, the Frost Marches have held to arcane traditions as old as the land, passed from master to pupil. Such sages find respite in simple comforts, crafted from humble materials and etched with electrum. Their influence is displayed with mysticism, engraved into stone and wood, blending Belhar and lupine sensibilities with a touch of Tychris influence."

rows.original: The shaggy pelts of various great beasts line the walls to keep out the cold, and hunting trophies keep cold sentinel over anyone passing down the hallway. Inexplicably, it feels more chilly than it would have been with outright bare walls...
rows.translation: 各种巨兽的蓬松毛皮被用来装饰墙壁，以此阻挡寒冷；而那些狩猎获得的战利品，则像冷峻的守卫一样，矗立在走廊的两旁，注视着每一个经过的人。不知为何，这种场景给人一种更多比起那些完全光秃秃的墙壁来说，这里要温暖得多……
rows.raw: "\n The shaggy pelts of various great beasts line the walls to keep out the cold, and hunting trophies keep cold sentinel over anyone passing down the hallway. Inexplicably, it feels more chilly than it would have been with outright bare walls..."

rows.original: Heavy carved bone braziers burn cold peat from the Frostwood with low, flickering flames, adding a sense of mysticism to the scene in line with traditional Lupine animistic beliefs. Despite the heat and light, a white mist gently rises from the mouth of each brazier, no doubt some kind of reaction between bone and peat; it lends an eerie quality to the place like a low sea fog on a winter's day.
rows.translation: 那些雕刻精美的骨制火盆用微弱而闪烁的火焰燃烧着来自霜木地的冷泥炭，这种景象与卢皮恩族传统的万物有灵信仰相契合，为整个场景增添了一股神秘气息。尽管火焰散发着热量与光芒，但每个火盆的口部却会缓缓升起一层白色雾气——这无疑是骨与泥炭之间发生的某种化学反应所致。这种雾气为这个地方带来了一种诡异的氛围，就如同冬日里弥漫的海雾一般。
rows.raw: "\n            Heavy carved bone braziers burn cold peat from the Frostwood with low, flickering flames, adding a sense of mysticism to the scene in line with traditional Lupine animistic beliefs. Despite the heat and light, a white mist gently rises from the mouth of each brazier, no doubt some kind of reaction between bone and peat; it lends an eerie quality to the place like a low sea fog on a winter's day."

rows.original: As is fitting, the largest and most impressive pelts and trophies have been reserved for this location, as has a set of orcish drums done up in traditional Sailgraves style. Perfectly functional, too, if only there were someone who could hammer out a tune.
rows.translation: 正如所应的那样，最大、最引人注目的皮毛和战利品都被安置在了这个地方，还有一组按照传统帆葬海岸风格制作的兽人鼓。这些鼓其实也能正常使用，只是可惜没有有人能够敲奏出美妙的旋律罢了。
rows.raw: "\n            As is fitting, the largest and most impressive pelts and trophies have been reserved for this location, as has a set of orcish drums done up in traditional Sailgraves style. Perfectly functional, too, if only there were someone who could hammer out a tune."

rows.original: Various carved trellises and boards ply the walls, painted with traditional Sailgraves pigments and depicting scenes of nautical prowess which surprisingly, do not include raiding. Fishing with hook, net or spear, navigating storms, whaling and confronting huge fantastical monsters at sea, yes, but not raiding, which suits you just fine. It'd probably be a bit more fitting if this were a coastal fort, but hey, you like the look of it.
rows.translation: 墙上挂满了各种雕刻精美的格架和板材，这些艺术品都用传统的帆葬海岸颜料绘制而成，上面描绘着各种航海场景。令人惊讶的是，这些作品确实不是其中当然包括劫掠行为。用鱼钩、渔网或长矛捕鱼，驾驭风暴，在海上捕鲸，以及与那些巨大的奇幻怪物搏斗——这些当然都包括在内。但是劫掠行为却并不适合你。如果这是一座沿海要塞的话，或许会更合适一些，不过嘛，你喜欢它的样子就是了。
rows.raw: "\n Various carved trellises and boards ply the walls, painted with traditional Sailgraves pigments and depicting scenes of nautical prowess which surprisingly, do not include raiding. Fishing with hook, net or spear, navigating storms, whaling and confronting huge fantastical monsters at sea, yes, but not raiding, which suits you just fine. It'd probably be a bit more fitting if this were a coastal fort, but hey, you like the look of it."

rows.original: The furniture you've set out has included some accessories for your throne, too: fur lining for your back and rear so they don't have to be in contact with hard, cold metal all the time, and a rather macabre headrest carved out from the preserved skull of some enormous antlered beast. Despite its appearance and material, though, it's surprisingly comfortable and fits the contours of your head pretty well, as if someone had taken your cranial measurements for this exact purpose. A look for a true ruler of the north, if nothing else.
rows.translation: 你摆放的那些家具中，也包含了一些为你的王座准备的配件：座椅的背部和靠背都配备了毛皮衬里，这样它们就不必一直与坚硬冰冷的金属接触了；而头枕则是由某种拥有巨大鹿角的野兽的保存完好的头骨雕刻而成的，看起来相当奇特。然而，尽管它的外观和材质如此，但它却出奇地舒适，能够很好地贴合你头部的轮廓，仿佛有人专门为你的头型进行了测量才制作了这个产品。即便不能称之为真正的“北方之主”，至少也能算得上是一个非常贴身的“头饰”吧。
rows.raw: "\n            The furniture you've set out has included some accessories for your throne, too: fur lining for your back and rear so they don't have to be in contact with hard, cold metal all the time, and a rather macabre headrest carved out from the preserved skull of some enormous antlered beast. Despite its appearance and material, though, it's surprisingly comfortable and fits the contours of your head pretty well, as if someone had taken your cranial measurements for this exact purpose. A look for a true ruler of the north, if nothing else."

rows.original: While simple in appearance, the furniture is well-made and resistant to dry rot and damp alike; the lupine style favors carving the legs of both tables and chairs with vine motifs to match the woodcuts you've displayed upon the walls. All of the art is rather stylised, but the subjects are nevertheless recognizable.
rows.translation: 这些家具外观虽然简单，但制作精良，既耐干燥也耐潮湿；采用狼族风格设计，桌子和椅子的腿上都雕刻着藤蔓图案，这些图案与您挂在墙上的木刻作品十分相配。所有的艺术作品都带有明显的风格化特征，但所描绘的主题仍然可以被人们辨认出来。
rows.raw: "\n            While simple in appearance, the furniture is well-made and resistant to dry rot and damp alike; the lupine style favors carving the legs of both tables and chairs with vine motifs to match the woodcuts you've displayed upon the walls. All of the art is rather stylised, but the subjects are nevertheless recognizable."

rows.original: You've set up simple, thick tapestries of dark blue upon the walls to keep out the cold, followed by a long carpet of matching color to span the hallway from end to end over the mosaic-tiled floor. This comes complete with a couple of hawk statues complete with pedestals to perch on, symbols of the now-defunct empire.
rows.translation: 你在墙上挂上了简单的深蓝色挂毯，用来阻挡寒气；接着，又铺了一条颜色相同的长地毯，从走廊的这一头一直延伸到那一头，地毯铺设在铺有马赛克瓷砖的地面之上。在这些装饰物旁边，还摆放着几座鹰的雕像，这些雕像都配有基座，象征着那个早已消失的帝国。
rows.raw: "\n            You've set up simple, thick tapestries of dark blue upon the walls to keep out the cold, followed by a long carpet of matching color to span the hallway from end to end over the mosaic-tiled floor. This comes complete with a couple of hawk statues complete with pedestals to perch on, symbols of the now-defunct empire."

rows.original: Bronze braziers line the main thoroughfare, kept alive with slow-burning peat; they help to keep the cold at bay. The paths are laid out in a colorful mosaic of reds, greens and blues, stretching out in all directions. It's very early imperial style as opposed to the late which dominates the rest of the theme, which isn't necessarily a bad thing given how different the foyer can be.
rows.translation: 主通道两旁排列着青铜火盆，里面燃烧着缓慢燃烧的泥炭，这些火盆有助于抵御寒冷。小路被红色、绿色和蓝色的彩色瓷砖铺成，四通八达地延伸开来。这种设计极具早期帝国的风格，与整个主题中后期流行的风格截然不同。考虑到入口区域本来就可以有如此大的差异，这种设计其实并没有什么不好。
rows.raw: "\n            Bronze braziers line the main thoroughfare, kept alive with slow-burning peat; they help to keep the cold at bay. The paths are laid out in a colorful mosaic of reds, greens and blues, stretching out in all directions. It's very early imperial style as opposed to the late which dominates the rest of the theme, which isn't necessarily a bad thing given how different the foyer can be."

rows.original: Great banners of all colors unfurl from the eaves all the way down to the floor, each one bearing the imperial hawk in gold and singing the praises of a now-dead empire that nevertheless is very, very alive in this extremely localized fashion. Reclaimed artworks — mostly statues and busts — stand in attendance, perhaps more grateful for a new home than their fate otherwise.
rows.translation: 五颜六色的巨大横幅从屋檐垂落到地面，每一幅横幅上都用黄金绘制着帝国的鹰徽，颂扬着那个早已消亡的帝国——然而，通过这种极具地方特色的表现方式，这个帝国依然“活”生生地存在着。那些被重新利用的艺术品——大多是雕像和半身像——也被陈列在那里，或许它们比任何时候都更感激自己找到了新的归宿。
rows.raw: "\n            Great banners of all colors unfurl from the eaves all the way down to the floor, each one bearing the imperial hawk in gold and singing the praises of a now-dead empire that nevertheless is very, very alive in this extremely localized fashion. Reclaimed artworks — mostly statues and busts — stand in attendance, perhaps more grateful for a new home than their fate otherwise."

rows.original: Lying against one wall are several large wine cabinets, each one ornately carved and varnished to give a sense of elegance and class. While meant for a higher class of vintage than what the local clientele is used to, Rumie's seen no reason to let extra storage go to waste and filled it with all kinds of bottles.
rows.translation: 靠在一面墙边的是几个大型酒柜，每一个都经过精心的雕刻和上漆处理，显得格外优雅高贵。虽然这些酒柜原本是为存放更高品质的陈年佳酿而设计的，但露米认为没有必要让这些额外的储存空间白白浪费，于是便把各种各样的酒瓶都放了进去。
rows.raw: "\n            Lying against one wall are several large wine cabinets, each one ornately carved and varnished to give a sense of elegance and class. While meant for a higher class of vintage than what the local clientele is used to, Rumie's seen no reason to let extra storage go to waste and filled it with all kinds of bottles."

rows.original: Given that your throne is already quite conforming to Belharan sensibilities, it doesn't require much in the way of accessorization: one school of Belharan thought held that rulers should sit uneasy on their thrones, so there's absolutely no need for upholstery of any kind. If anything, the only addition is the golden symbol of a hawk atop the back of your throne, wings spread imperiously as if about to take flight while you go about your business of managing your demesne.
rows.translation: 鉴于你的王座已经非常符合贝尔哈兰人的审美观念，因此几乎不需要添加任何装饰品：贝尔哈兰有一种观点认为，统治者坐在王座上时应该感到不安，所以完全不需要任何软垫之类的装饰。如果说有什么需要添加的话，那就是在王座的后部加上一个金色的鹰徽，它的翅膀雄伟地展开，仿佛随时准备展翅飞翔，而你则可以安心地处理你的政务。
rows.raw: "\n            Given that your throne is already quite conforming to Belharan sensibilities, it doesn't require much in the way of accessorization: one school of Belharan thought held that rulers should sit uneasy on their thrones, so there's absolutely no need for upholstery of any kind. If anything, the only addition is the golden symbol of a hawk atop the back of your throne, wings spread imperiously as if about to take flight while you go about your business of managing your demesne."

rows.original: When it comes to personal comfort for one's servants, the later imperials apparently believed in wool, lots of it if the furniture's anything to go by. Woolen sheets, woolen upholstery, woolen decor. Maybe the region that would eventually become Barania was coming up as a province around that time, you don't know, but it lends itself to a sense of fluffiness and warmth seeing the cushions and chairs abound.
rows.translation: 在为仆从提供舒适的生活环境方面，后来的皇帝们显然非常推崇羊毛制品——从家具的材质就能看出来这一点。羊毛床单、羊毛装饰品，到处都是羊毛制品。也许在那个时候，后来成为巴拉尼亚地区的地区刚刚被划为一个新的省份，虽然我们也不确定，但从那些随处可见的靠垫和椅子来看，这些羊毛制品确实营造出一种柔软舒适、温暖宜人的氛围。
rows.raw: "\n            When it comes to personal comfort for one's servants, the later imperials apparently believed in wool, lots of it if the furniture's anything to go by. Woolen sheets, woolen upholstery, woolen decor. Maybe the region that would eventually become Barania was coming up as a province around that time, you don't know, but it lends itself to a sense of fluffiness and warmth seeing the cushions and chairs abound."

rows.original: Marches borderland style tends towards the dreary and brutal, and the decor of your hallway is no exception. Slate busts of snake-haired women — some kind of Narevan symbology, one imagines — regard all who pass down the hallway with imperious disdain, and the long carpet that stretches from end to end is so lush and thick that you could stomp all over the place and not make a sound. A juxtaposition to be sure, but a very good one at that.
rows.translation: 具有边境地区风格的走廊装饰往往显得阴郁而粗犷，你的走廊也不例外。那些石板制成的、头发呈蛇形的妇女半身像——想必是纳雷万文化的象征吧——以居高临下的轻蔑姿态注视着所有经过这里的人。而那条从一端延伸到另一端的厚重地毯如此柔软，你可以在上面踩来踩去却不会发出任何声音。这种对比确实很鲜明，而且非常巧妙。
rows.raw: "\n            Marches borderland style tends towards the dreary and brutal, and the decor of your hallway is no exception. Slate busts of snake-haired women — some kind of Narevan symbology, one imagines — regard all who pass down the hallway with imperious disdain, and the long carpet that stretches from end to end is so lush and thick that you could stomp all over the place and not make a sound. A juxtaposition to be sure, but a very good one at that."

rows.original: Heavy carved bone braziers burn cold peat from the Frostwood with low, flickering flames, the vessels themselves shaped like giant hands thrusting from the tiled foyer floor to grasp at the living with clawed fingers. Despite the heat and light, a white mist gently rises from the mouth of each brazier, no doubt some kind of reaction between bone and peat; it lends an eerie quality to the place like a low sea fog on a winter's day. The slow flickering gives rise to a play of light and shadow on the arches and columns, drawing out the unsettling from the depths of one's imagination.
rows.translation: 那些雕刻精美的骨制火盆用微弱而闪烁的火焰燃烧着来自寒冰森林的冷泥炭，这些火盆的形状就像巨大的手掌，从铺着瓷砖的入口处伸出来，用带爪子的手指仿佛想要抓住在场的每一个人。尽管火焰散发着热量与光芒，但每个火盆的口部却会缓缓升起一层白色的雾气——这无疑是骨与泥炭之间发生的某种化学反应。这种雾气为这个地方增添了一丝诡异的氛围，就像冬日里弥漫的海雾一样。这种缓慢的闪烁在拱门和柱子上营造出了光与影的奇妙效果，从而激发人们想象力中那些令人不安的意象。
rows.raw: "\n            Heavy carved bone braziers burn cold peat from the Frostwood with low, flickering flames, the vessels themselves shaped like giant hands thrusting from the tiled foyer floor to grasp at the living with clawed fingers. Despite the heat and light, a white mist gently rises from the mouth of each brazier, no doubt some kind of reaction between bone and peat; it lends an eerie quality to the place like a low sea fog on a winter's day. The slow flickering gives rise to a play of light and shadow on the arches and columns, drawing out the unsettling from the depths of one's imagination."

rows.original: Gargoyles! Not sapient or ambulatory, but if they were they wouldn't be decor anyway. Most of them are in the traditional hunched-over pose, but there are a few more... unorthodox ones, to put it lightly. They dot the eaves of your grand hall, peering down judgmentally at anyone making the crossing to your throne. A lot of trouble to set up and take down, to be sure, but the effect is worth it.
rows.translation: 石像鬼！它们既没有智慧，也不能行走，但即便具备这些能力，它们也不可能被用作装饰品。大多数石像鬼都保持着那种传统的弓腰姿势，但也有一些……用委婉点的说法，就是一些比较另类的造型。它们分布在你宏伟大厅的屋檐上，居高临下地注视着任何试图走向你王座的人。虽然安装和拆除这些石像鬼需要花费不少功夫，但效果确实值得。
rows.raw: "\n            Gargoyles! Not sapient or ambulatory, but if they were they wouldn't be decor anyway. Most of them are in the traditional hunched-over pose, but there are a few more... unorthodox ones, to put it lightly. They dot the eaves of your grand hall, peering down judgmentally at anyone making the crossing to your throne. A lot of trouble to set up and take down, to be sure, but the effect is worth it."

rows.original: Lying against one wall are several large wine cabinets, each one fashioned from ebony and given a lovely red and gold trim to lend a sense of elegance and class; even more ostentatious is the glass panelling that could only have come from Tychris. While meant for a higher class of vintage than what the local clientele is used to, Rumie's seen no reason to let extra storage go to waste and filled it with all kinds of bottles.
rows.translation: 靠在一面墙边的是几个大型酒柜，每一个都是用乌木制成的，上面还装饰着精美的红金边饰，显得格外高雅奢华；而那些玻璃镶边更是显眼非凡，显然这些材料只能来自提克里斯。虽然这些酒柜原本是为存放更高品质的陈年佳酿而设计的，但露米认为没有必要让这些额外的储存空间白白浪费，于是就把各种各样的酒瓶都放了进去。
rows.raw: "\n            Lying against one wall are several large wine cabinets, each one fashioned from ebony and given a lovely red and gold trim to lend a sense of elegance and class; even more ostentatious is the glass panelling that could only have come from Tychris. While meant for a higher class of vintage than what the local clientele is used to, Rumie's seen no reason to let extra storage go to waste and filled it with all kinds of bottles."

rows.original: The furniture you've set out has included some accessories for your throne, too: lovely burgundy upholstery to sweetly cushion your back and posterior while you command your servants and administer your domain, ebony bat wings that spread dramatically from its sides and a horned headboard, both of which are detachable, and a long gold-trimmed carpet that runs all the way from the great hall to the foot of your throne, lovely, lush and never dirty. But best of all is the stand within arm's reach, the perfect size to accommodate a wine bottle and a couple of glasses.
rows.translation: 您摆放的家具中还包括一些专为您的王座设计的配件：精美的深红色座椅软垫，能在您指挥仆从、管理领地时为您的背部提供舒适的支撑；两侧可展开的乌木状“蝙蝠翅膀”；以及带有角状装饰的床头板——这些配件都可以拆卸；还有一条从大厅一直延伸到王座脚下的金色边饰长毯，它柔软美观，而且永远不会弄脏。但最棒的是，这个支架放在手边非常方便，它的大小正好可以放置一瓶葡萄酒和几杯酒杯。
rows.raw: "\n            The furniture you've set out has included some accessories for your throne, too: lovely burgundy upholstery to sweetly cushion your back and posterior while you command your servants and administer your domain, ebony bat wings that spread dramatically from its sides and a horned headboard, both of which are detachable, and a long gold-trimmed carpet that runs all the way from the great hall to the foot of your throne, lovely, lush and never dirty. But best of all is the stand within arm's reach, the perfect size to accommodate a wine bottle and a couple of glasses."

rows.original: A spot of comfort amidst the harsh architecture — heavy draperies, lush carpets and loving softness dominate the furniture, all of it done up in red, black and just a bit of gold. A spot of brightness amidst the dark dreariness of a borderlands castle, brightness which only purpose is to make the surrounding darkness all the deeper by contrast and prevent familiarity from breeding contempt. Still, the respite is welcome, regardless of how momentary it is.
rows.translation: 在那些冰冷坚硬的建筑环境中，这里是一处令人感到舒适的地方——厚重的窗帘、柔软的地毯，以及所有家具都散发着温馨的气息，这些元素都以红色、黑色和一点点金色进行装饰。在边境城堡那阴暗沉闷的氛围中，这里是一抹亮色，它的存在仅仅是为了通过对比让周围的暗影显得更加浓重，从而避免人们因过于熟悉而产生厌烦情绪。无论如何，这样的片刻宁静总是令人感到欣慰的。
rows.raw: "\n            A spot of comfort amidst the harsh architecture — heavy draperies, lush carpets and loving softness dominate the furniture, all of it done up in red, black and just a bit of gold. A spot of brightness amidst the dark dreariness of a borderlands castle, brightness which only purpose is to make the surrounding darkness all the deeper by contrast and prevent familiarity from breeding contempt. Still, the respite is welcome, regardless of how momentary it is."

rows.original: Fine marble busts of important-looking minotaur statesmen line the hallway, each one of them caught in expressions of contemplative seriousness that're certainly not embellishments. This appears to be the minoan way of commemorating important personages, and in truth it's not a bad one.
rows.translation: 走廊两旁排列着一些造型精美的大理石半身像，这些半身像所刻画的都是那些看起来地位显赫的米诺斯政治家。他们每一个都呈现出一种深思熟虑、严肃认真的神情，而这些神情显然并非刻意雕琢出来的。看来，这种纪念重要人物的方式确实是米诺斯人的传统，而且事实上，这种方式也相当不错。
rows.raw: "\n            Fine marble busts of important-looking minotaur statesmen line the hallway, each one of them caught in expressions of contemplative seriousness that're certainly not embellishments. This appears to be the minoan way of commemorating important personages, and in truth it's not a bad one."

rows.original: In addition to the flower baskets, grapevines are planted along the bases of the arches and pillars, winding their way upwards as they grow. More decorative than actually intended to bear fruit, they add a much-needed spot of greenery near the base to balance that coming from up top.
rows.translation: 除了那些花篮之外，人们在拱门和柱子的基部也种植了葡萄藤，这些葡萄藤在生长过程中会蜿蜒向上延伸。这些葡萄藤更多是用于装饰，而非真正用于结果实，但它们在基部为环境增添了一片必要的绿色植被，从而平衡了上方植被所带来的视觉效果。
rows.raw: "\n            In addition to the flower baskets, grapevines are planted along the bases of the arches and pillars, winding their way upwards as they grow. More decorative than actually intended to bear fruit, they add a much-needed spot of greenery near the base to balance that coming from up top."

rows.original: Someone's taken the time to decorate the pillars that hold up the second-floor balconies, as well as several murals depicting people fighting beasts and others alike on the sands of the colosseum. Normally it might seem out of place with the rest of the grand hall, but the decorator really put effort into making it work.
rows.translation: 有人花时间装饰了支撑二楼阳台的柱子，还绘制了几幅壁画，描绘人们在竞技场沙地上与野兽及彼此搏斗的场面。这些装饰本来可能与宏伟大厅的其他部分格格不入，但装饰者确实下了工夫，让它们相得益彰。
rows.raw: "\n Someone's taken the time to decorate the pillars that hold up the second-floor balconies, as well as several murals depicting people fighting beasts and others alike on the sands of the colosseum. Normally it might seem out of place with the rest of the grand hall, but the decorator really put effort into making it work."

rows.original: The minoan addition to your bar comes in the form of a dozen large amphorae depicting minotaurs, very predictably, getting smashed in the socially-approved boisterous and rowdy manner. While the Wayfort bar is a little more subdued than that, Rumie's nevertheless been inspired to keep the stronger liquors in the heavy clay jugs.
rows.translation: 米诺斯文化为你的酒吧增添了独特的元素——一打描绘弥诺陶洛斯的巨大双耳瓶，而这些陶瓶自然而然地以那种被社会所认可的热闹喧嚣的方式被砸碎。虽然荒废驿堡酒吧的氛围相对更为沉稳，但露米还是受到启发，决定将那些浓度较高的酒类装在这些厚重的陶罐中出售。
rows.raw: "\n            The minoan addition to your bar comes in the form of a dozen large amphorae depicting minotaurs, very predictably, getting smashed in the socially-approved boisterous and rowdy manner. While the Wayfort bar is a little more subdued than that, Rumie's nevertheless been inspired to keep the stronger liquors in the heavy clay jugs."

rows.original: The furniture you've set out has included some accessories for your throne in minoan style: a stone cushion for the throne proper, and a golden bull-head relief for the back of your throne. Also, a raised stone dais for the throne to rest on so you can loom more effectively over your subjects while you're handling them. So much stone can't be supremely comfortable, but maybe it's different for minotaurs, and it's not like a ruler is meant to sit easy, right?
rows.translation: 您摆放的这些家具中，包括了一些采用米诺斯风格的饰品来装饰您的王座：一个用于王座本身的石制靠垫，以及一个安装在王座背部的金色公牛头浮雕。此外，还有一块凸起的石制台基，让王座可以坐落在上面，这样在统治子民时，您就能更加居高临下地俯视他们。虽然这么多石头构成的家具肯定不会特别舒适，但也许对弥诺陶洛斯来说有所不同吧？而且，毕竟统治者坐得舒服与否，也不是最重要的吧？
rows.raw: "\n            The furniture you've set out has included some accessories for your throne in minoan style: a stone cushion for the throne proper, and a golden bull-head relief for the back of your throne. Also, a raised stone dais for the throne to rest on so you can loom more effectively over your subjects while you're handling them. So much stone can't be supremely comfortable, but maybe it's different for minotaurs, and it's not like a ruler is meant to sit easy, right?"

rows.original: In addition to the firepit, more personable lighting is spread out in the form of oil lands, bronze saucers suspended from stands by means of finely-worked chains. It must be a terrible bother to refill them all even just for one large room, but the light is far more conducive to sleep than that of the roaring firepit.
rows.translation: 除了火坑之外，还有其他更为美观的照明设施：那些用油灯构成的灯光装置，以及那些通过精心制作的链条悬挂在支架上的青铜灯盘。仅仅为一个大的房间补充这些灯油的麻烦肯定很大，但它们散发出的光线确实比火坑带来的光芒更有利于人们入睡。
rows.raw: "\n            In addition to the firepit, more personable lighting is spread out in the form of oil lands, bronze saucers suspended from stands by means of finely-worked chains. It must be a terrible bother to refill them all even just for one large room, but the light is far more conducive to sleep than that of the roaring firepit."

rows.original: Twin lines of spear-toting valkyrie statues fill the hallway, cold yet approachable as they stand quiet sentinel over the marble-tiled floor. Someone clearly put a lot of effort into making them as lifelike as possible, pointing to either great dedication or a great fetish...
rows.translation: 走廊两旁排列着成排手持长矛的瓦尔基里雕像，它们静静地矗立在大理石地面上，显得冰冷而庄严，却又给人一种亲近的感觉。显然，有人花费了大量的精力来让这些雕像尽可能地栩栩如生——这要么体现了他们极高的投入热情，要么说明他们对此有着特殊的癖好……
rows.raw: "\n            Twin lines of spear-toting valkyrie statues fill the hallway, cold yet approachable as they stand quiet sentinel over the marble-tiled floor. Someone clearly put a lot of effort into making them as lifelike as possible, pointing to either great dedication or a great fetish..."

rows.original: In addition to the flower baskets, ice roses are planted along the bases of the arches and pillars, winding their way upwards as they grow. The climate is still reasonably conducive to the crystalline plants' cultivation, and even if they don't have that perfect inner glow of those taken root in ice they're still very pretty.
rows.translation: 除了那些花篮之外，拱门和柱子的基部还种着冰玫瑰，这些植物会蜿蜒向上生长。这里的气候仍然非常适合这种结晶植物生长，即使它们没有那些扎根在冰中的植物所拥有的那种完美的光泽，也同样非常漂亮。
rows.raw: "\n            In addition to the flower baskets, ice roses are planted along the bases of the arches and pillars, winding their way upwards as they grow. The climate is still reasonably conducive to the crystalline plants' cultivation, and even if they don't have that perfect inner glow of those taken root in ice they're still very pretty."

rows.original: Someone's gone and given every single inch of wall the perfect alabaster treatment, painting it a pure, even white without crack or seam to betray the masonry underneath. The way it reflects the light when the sun or even any lesser light source falls upon it is simply breath-taking, creating the impression of gold where there is none.
rows.translation: 有人精心地将每一寸墙壁都处理得如同白色大理石一般，将其刷成纯净、均匀的白色，没有任何裂缝或接缝会暴露出背后的砌筑结构。当阳光或任何其他光源照射在这些墙壁上时，它们反射出的光芒简直令人叹为观止——在原本没有金色装饰的地方，仿佛真的出现了金色的光泽。
rows.raw: "\n            Someone's gone and given every single inch of wall the perfect alabaster treatment, painting it a pure, even white without crack or seam to betray the masonry underneath. The way it reflects the light when the sun or even any lesser light source falls upon it is simply breath-taking, creating the impression of gold where there is none."

rows.original: Your furniture set's addition to the bar is a wide druidic-style wine rack of hexagonal cubbyholes that fills the length of one wall, capable of holding several hundred bottles at least. The boer'alvar were, and still are, very proud of their mirrorwine, schism or no schism, and while Rumie can't possibly make use of the entire rack as-is perhaps some distant future will call for it in its entirety.
rows.translation: 你添加到酒吧里的这套家具是一组采用德鲁伊风格设计的酒架，由许多六边形的储物格组成，整个酒架占据了整面墙的长度，至少可以容纳数百瓶酒。布尔阿尔瓦人过去一直都非常自豪他们的“镜像之酒”，无论是否发生了分裂。虽然露米目前可能无法完全利用这套酒架，但也许在未来的某个时候，会需要用到它的全部容量。
rows.raw: "\n            Your furniture set's addition to the bar is a wide druidic-style wine rack of hexagonal cubbyholes that fills the length of one wall, capable of holding several hundred bottles at least. The boer'alvar were, and still are, very proud of their mirrorwine, schism or no schism, and while Rumie can't possibly make use of the entire rack as-is perhaps some distant future will call for it in its entirety."

rows.original: Since much of your throne is already gold, your furnishings have simply added white to complete the ensemble: white fur upholstery for the throne's seat, back and armrests, white for the feet and frame. While ice won't stay frozen here, crystal glass is the next best option for decor, giving the impression of icicles hanging from the throne's underside. Not bad, not bad.
rows.translation: 既然你的王座本身就已经由黄金制成，那么装饰品只需添加白色元素就能使整体造型更加完整：王座的座椅、靠背和扶手都采用白色毛皮材质，而底座和框架也同样是白色。虽然冰在这里不会持续处于冻结状态，但水晶玻璃也是另一种不错的装饰选择，它能让人们感受到仿佛有冰柱悬挂在王座下方一样。不错，确实不错。
rows.raw: "\n            Since much of your throne is already gold, your furnishings have simply added white to complete the ensemble: white fur upholstery for the throne's seat, back and armrests, white for the feet and frame. While ice won't stay frozen here, crystal glass is the next best option for decor, giving the impression of icicles hanging from the throne's underside. Not bad, not bad."

rows.original: Like the grand hall, the only real change the theming has made to your living quarters is the seamless alabaster white that covers walls and ceiling alike. While it isn't actually cold in and of itself, the all-encompassing color — or lack of one — extends a chill over the room to counterbalance the heat from the firepit.
rows.translation: 与宏伟的大厅一样，这种主题设计对你的居住空间带来的唯一真正变化，就是墙壁和天花板都被统一涂成了纯净的白色。虽然这种颜色本身并不会让人感到寒冷，但这种遍布整个空间的白色——或者说，这种缺乏色彩的布局——让房间显得有些冷清，从而有助于平衡火坑散发的热量。
rows.raw: "\n            Like the grand hall, the only real change the theming has made to your living quarters is the seamless alabaster white that covers walls and ceiling alike. While it isn't actually cold in and of itself, the all-encompassing color — or lack of one — extends a chill over the room to counterbalance the heat from the firepit."

rows.original: Heavy silk drapes in red and purple hang from the walls, trimmed in gold and silver and thick enough to wrap two or three people in; their purpose is not just to keep out the cold, but also muffle the sounds of any indiscretion taking place along the hallway and adjoining rooms. Either side of the main path through the hallway has been decorated in colorful mosaic, not so much tile but with a multitude of little brightly colored beads that produce a tingly sensation when stepped on barefoot. Therapeutic!
rows.translation: 墙上悬挂着红色和紫色的厚重丝绸帷幔，边缘装饰着金银纹样，这些帷幔厚实到足以将两三个人包裹在里面；它们的作用不仅仅是阻挡寒气，还能减弱走廊及相邻房间里发生的任何声响。走廊主干道的两侧都装饰着色彩斑斓的马赛克——其实并不是瓷砖，而是由无数颗色彩鲜艳的小珠子组成的图案，人们赤脚踩在这些珠子上时，会感受到一种刺痒的感觉，真是很有疗愈效果呢！
rows.raw: "\n            Heavy silk drapes in red and purple hang from the walls, trimmed in gold and silver and thick enough to wrap two or three people in; their purpose is not just to keep out the cold, but also muffle the sounds of any indiscretion taking place along the hallway and adjoining rooms. Either side of the main path through the hallway has been decorated in colorful mosaic, not so much tile but with a multitude of little brightly colored beads that produce a tingly sensation when stepped on barefoot. Therapeutic!"

rows.original: Bronze braziers line the main thoroughfare, kept alive with slow-burning peat; each one a large bowl balanced in the hands of a small cat statuette, they help to keep the cold at bay. Someone's added some kind of perfume or scent to the fire, given the clear mist and accompanying aroma that rises from each brazier; it gives the otherwise mundane scene a strangely ethereal quality.
rows.translation: 主通道两旁排列着青铜火盆，里面燃烧着缓慢燃烧的泥炭，火盆由小猫雕像手持，仿佛是一个个大碗。这些火盆有效地抵御了寒冷。有人还在火中添加了某种香精或香料，因此每个火盆都会冒出淡淡的雾气，散发着迷人的香气。这种平凡的场景因此而增添了一丝超脱尘世的神秘感。
rows.raw: "\n            Bronze braziers line the main thoroughfare, kept alive with slow-burning peat; each one a large bowl balanced in the hands of a small cat statuette, they help to keep the cold at bay. Someone's added some kind of perfume or scent to the fire, given the clear mist and accompanying aroma that rises from each brazier; it gives the otherwise mundane scene a strangely ethereal quality."

rows.original: The rest of the grand hall's furnishings are a testament to color and ostentatiousness: soft glowing crystal lamps, brought in all the way from Tychris, hang from chains and hooks, casting a quiet, sensual glow to the place. The power here isn't merely intense, it's also seductive in a way that only the rich wall hangings and colored flames can be. Indulgence, opulence, and the strength to make the former two a reality.
rows.translation: 大厅里其余的装饰品无不体现了人们对色彩与奢华的追求：那些从提克里斯远道运来的、会发出柔和光芒的水晶灯，悬挂在链条和钩子上，为整个空间营造出一种宁静而迷人的氛围。这里的氛围不仅充满力量，更有一种唯有华贵的壁挂与彩色火焰才能带来的诱惑力——这种诱惑力，正是奢侈与享乐得以实现的象征。
rows.raw: "\n            The rest of the grand hall's furnishings are a testament to color and ostentatiousness: soft glowing crystal lamps, brought in all the way from Tychris, hang from chains and hooks, casting a quiet, sensual glow to the place. The power here isn't merely intense, it's also seductive in a way that only the rich wall hangings and colored flames can be. Indulgence, opulence, and the strength to make the former two a reality."

rows.original: The addition of Jassiran theming has certainly tempered the behavior of the clientele — less boisterous and more genteel, perhaps. Voices laid low in conversation instead of raised in song, the heavy cloth absorbing sound and lending a muted weight to the air while scented smoke beguiles the senses and discourages rash behavior. The hookah's found its way into a place of prominence by the bar alongside several luxurious cushions, and some of the more daring patrons have ventured giving it a go.
rows.translation: 加入贾西兰主题元素后，顾客们的行为确实发生了变化——他们变得不那么喧闹，举止也更加文雅了。人们交谈时说话声调低了，不再高声歌唱；厚重的布料吸收了声音，使空气显得更加沉闷而宁静，而带有香气的烟雾则迷住了人们的感官，抑制了那些轻率的行为。水烟筒被摆放在吧台旁边显眼的位置，旁边还放着几块豪华的靠垫；一些敢于尝试的顾客也纷纷试过了这种娱乐方式。
rows.raw: "\n            The addition of Jassiran theming has certainly tempered the behavior of the clientele — less boisterous and more genteel, perhaps. Voices laid low in conversation instead of raised in song, the heavy cloth absorbing sound and lending a muted weight to the air while scented smoke beguiles the senses and discourages rash behavior. The hookah's found its way into a place of prominence by the bar alongside several luxurious cushions, and some of the more daring patrons have ventured giving it a go."

rows.original: The furniture you've set out has included some accessories for your throne, too: lovely purple upholstery to sweetly cushion your back and posterior while you command your servants and administer your domain, a footrest to give your aching feet a break while the rest of you deals with matters of state, and a long gold-trimmed carpet that runs all the way from the great hall to the foot of your throne, lovely, lush and never dirty. Everything about the Jassiran decor works to reinforce the golden resplendence of your throne, making it appear far more wealthy than it actually is, which is no small feat.
rows.translation: 您摆放的家具中还包括一些专为您的王座准备的配件：精美的紫色软垫，能够为您的背部提供舒适的支撑，让您在指挥仆从、管理领地时更加惬意；还有一个脚凳，可以让您在处理国家事务时让疲惫的双脚得到休息；还有一条长长的、边缘镶有金边的地毯，它从大厅一直延伸到您的王座脚下，这条地毯美观大方，质地柔软，而且永远不会变脏。贾西兰风格的装饰设计旨在突出你王座的金色光辉，使其看起来比实际更加富丽堂皇，而做到这一点绝非易事。
rows.raw: "\n            The furniture you've set out has included some accessories for your throne, too: lovely purple upholstery to sweetly cushion your back and posterior while you command your servants and administer your domain, a footrest to give your aching feet a break while the rest of you deals with matters of state, and a long gold-trimmed carpet that runs all the way from the great hall to the foot of your throne, lovely, lush and never dirty. Everything about the Jassiran decor works to reinforce the golden resplendence of your throne, making it appear far more wealthy than it actually is, which is no small feat."

rows.original: Comfort is more than just what meets the skin — it's a state of being that involves all the senses, and the Jassirans know that very well. Soothing shades of purple and pink, inviting perfumed scents, and the swish of silks amidst the crackle of fire work together to create an atmosphere of rest and relaxation for the living quarters. You'll be having a good night's sleep here, if nothing else.
rows.translation: 舒适并不仅仅是指那些触觉上的享受——它是一种涉及所有感官的体验状态，而贾西兰人对此有着深刻的理解。柔和的紫色与粉色色调、诱人的芳香气息，以及丝绸在火光中摇曳的声音，共同营造出一种让人放松休息的氛围。至少，在这里你一定能拥有一个美好的夜晚。
rows.raw: "\n            Comfort is more than just what meets the skin — it's a state of being that involves all the senses, and the Jassirans know that very well. Soothing shades of purple and pink, inviting perfumed scents, and the swish of silks amidst the crackle of fire work together to create an atmosphere of rest and relaxation for the living quarters. You'll be having a good night's sleep here, if nothing else."

rows.original: The hallway is otherwise largely clean and bare, speaking of careful hygiene, but a pair of scroll paintings depicting mountains and rivers as well as a porcelain plate with a flower arrangement in it offer a plash of color to break the monotony.
rows.translation: 走廊其他地方都保持着整洁和简洁，这一点充分体现了人们对卫生的重视，但墙上挂着的两幅描绘山水景色的卷轴画，以及那个上面摆放着插花的瓷盘，为这个单调的空间增添了一抹色彩，打破了沉闷的气氛。
rows.raw: "\n            The hallway is otherwise largely clean and bare, speaking of careful hygiene, but a pair of scroll paintings depicting mountains and rivers as well as a porcelain plate with a flower arrangement in it offer a plash of color to break the monotony."

rows.original: The path through the foyer is lined out in small stones, and indeed treats the entire room like a rock garden. Given the prior decorations which the furniture set is meant to complement, this is perfectly understandable, and yet...
rows.translation: 通往门厅的小路两旁铺满了小石子，这样一来，整个房间简直就像一个岩石花园。考虑到这些装饰元素其实是为了与家具相得益彰，这种设计也是完全可以理解的。不过……
rows.raw: "\n            The path through the foyer is lined out in small stones, and indeed treats the entire room like a rock garden. Given the prior decorations which the furniture set is meant to complement, this is perfectly understandable, and yet..."

rows.original: A number of folding screens allow you to split up your hall into more manageable chunks for smaller groups, if you so please. Easy to bring out and return owing to how lightweight they are, the folding screens let you give your grand hall a more personable touch when the event calls for it.
rows.raw: "\n            A number of folding screens allow you to split up your hall into more manageable chunks for smaller groups, if you so please. Easy to bring out and return owing to how lightweight they are, the folding screens let you give your grand hall a more personable touch when the event calls for it."

rows.original: It's naturally difficult to combine two disparate aesthetics, but the accessories for your throne try to make lacquered wood and gold go well together. A raised stage gives you that little extra height required to look imposing while dealing with matters of state, and a bunch of attachable dragon motifs for the back and armrests are both impressive and comfortable. If only the same could be said for the upholstery or complete lack thereof, but this does not appear to be a culture that thinks rulership should be done from a place of comfort.
rows.translation: 将两种截然不同的审美风格结合在一起自然是一件困难的事情，但为你的王座设计的这些配件确实努力让漆木与金色相互搭配得当。升高的台座为你在处理国家事务时提供了足够的高度，使你看起来更加威严；而那些可以安装在靠背和扶手上的龙形装饰既美观大方，又十分舒适。要是座椅的内饰也能如此，或者至少也有一些装饰的话，那就再好不过了。不过，这个文化似乎并不认为统治者应该在一个舒适的环境中行使权力。
rows.raw: "\n            It's naturally difficult to combine two disparate aesthetics, but the accessories for your throne try to make lacquered wood and gold go well together. A raised stage gives you that little extra height required to look imposing while dealing with matters of state, and a bunch of attachable dragon motifs for the back and armrests are both impressive and comfortable. If only the same could be said for the upholstery or complete lack thereof, but this does not appear to be a culture that thinks rulership should be done from a place of comfort."

rows.original: The addition to your living quarters comes in the form of a low table with a heavy cloth draped over it, very appropriate for cold climates. What's truly delightful, though, is the little crucible on the underside of the table in which a small amount of peat or charcoal can be burnt, making sure that your legs remain warm while the heated air gradually spills out from under the tablecloth. A delightful innovation that makes mealtimes on cold days more bearable, if you may say so.
rows.translation: 你们的生活空间里新增了一样物品：一张铺着厚厚布料的低矮桌子，这种设计非常适合寒冷的气候。不过，真正令人满意的是桌子底部的那个小炉子——里面可以燃烧少量的泥炭或木炭，这样你们的双腿就能保持温暖，而热空气也会从桌布下方慢慢散发出来。这一巧妙的设计让寒冷天气里的用餐时光变得更加舒适，真的可以说是非常贴心了。
rows.raw: "\n            The addition to your living quarters comes in the form of a low table with a heavy cloth draped over it, very appropriate for cold climates. What's truly delightful, though, is the little crucible on the underside of the table in which a small amount of peat or charcoal can be burnt, making sure that your legs remain warm while the heated air gradually spills out from under the tablecloth. A delightful innovation that makes mealtimes on cold days more bearable, if you may say so."

rows.original: [silly|Countless gourds grow out of the stone on either side of the walkway. Their vines spread across the stonework, their roots devastating the masonry. Spread amongst this strange garden are several gourds of truly exceptional size, their bloated masses seething with wyld magic. Strangely, the walkway through this hallway is completely unobstructed, roots turning on themselves to avoid your path.|Rows of planters have been stacked at each end of the hall. Countless strange plants dwell in electrum-etched homes, including many obviously foreign to the Marches. Semiprecious stones have been hung over most of the planters, casting magicked illumination across your strange garden.]
rows.translation: [silly|在小径两侧的石头上，长出了无数葫芦。它们的藤蔓蔓延在石砌的墙面上，根部正在侵蚀这些石材。在这个奇异的花园中，还有几颗大小异常的葫芦，它们肿胀的果实仿佛蕴含着狂野的魔力。奇怪的是，穿过这条走廊的小径却完全没有被这些藤蔓阻挡——那些藤蔓甚至会自行绕开你的道路。|大厅的两端堆放着一排排花盆。无数种奇异的植物生长在这些用电银工艺制成的花盆中，其中许多显然并非原产于这片边境地区。大多数花盆上还悬挂着半宝石，这些宝石散发出神奇的光芒，为这个奇异的花园增添了一抹神秘色彩。]
rows.raw: "\n            [silly|Countless gourds grow out of the stone on either side of the walkway. Their vines spread across the stonework, their roots devastating the masonry. Spread amongst this strange garden are several gourds of truly exceptional size, their bloated masses seething with wyld magic. Strangely, the walkway through this hallway is completely unobstructed, roots turning on themselves to avoid your path.|Rows of planters have been stacked at each end of the hall. Countless strange plants dwell in electrum-etched homes, including many obviously foreign to the Marches. Semiprecious stones have been hung over most of the planters, casting magicked illumination across your strange garden.]"

rows.original: [silly|Most of the windows have been covered, leaving a handful of candle-filled gourds as the sole source of light. Orange and black velvet drapes illustrate the walls, covered by thick curtains of spiderwebs. At the center of this room is a pedestal filled with sweets, inconspicuously inviting against this sinister backdrop. It wouldn't hurt just to take one or two, right?|Plush sofas and trinket-laden shelves have been arranged around the foyer, centered upon a display of icons. Occupying much of the northern wall, countless artifacts of local faiths lay haphazardly intermixed. Towering over this collection is a stylized statue of Nareva, her features obfuscated amidst a mess of symbolism engraved upon this idol. Far humbler are the relics of the other gods, lost amongst talismans of the wyld and old lupine faiths. [pc.isMage|You can feel magic in many of these objects, faded by age.]]
rows.translation: [silly|大多数窗户都被遮住了，只有少数几个装满蜡烛的葫芦作为唯一的光源。橙色和黑色的天鹅绒窗帘装饰着墙壁，而这些墙壁上还覆盖着厚厚的蜘蛛网。在这个房间的中央，有一个摆满甜食的底座，在这种阴森的氛围中，这些甜食显得格外不起眼，但却在默默地吸引人……拿一两块吃掉，应该没什么坏处吧？|大厅里摆放着柔软的沙发和摆满小饰品的架子，这些物品都围绕着中央的图标陈列区而布置。占据北侧墙壁大部分空间的地方，陈列着无数当地信仰相关的文物，它们被随意地摆放在一起。在这些文物上方，矗立着一尊风格化的娜瑞瓦雕像，她的面部特征被刻在雕像上的各种象征符号所掩盖，难以辨认。而其他神明的遗物则显得更为朴素，它们混杂在那些与荒野以及古老的狼人信仰相关的护身符之中。 [pc.isMage|在这些物件中，你能感受到岁月沉淀下来的魔力。]]
rows.raw: "\n            [silly|Most of the windows have been covered, leaving a handful of candle-filled gourds as the sole source of light. Orange and black velvet drapes illustrate the walls, covered by thick curtains of spiderwebs. At the center of this room is a pedestal filled with sweets, inconspicuously inviting against this sinister backdrop. It wouldn't hurt just to take one or two, right?|Plush sofas and trinket-laden shelves have been arranged around the foyer, centered upon a display of icons. Occupying much of the northern wall, countless artifacts of local faiths lay haphazardly intermixed. Towering over this collection is a stylized statue of Nareva, her features obfuscated amidst a mess of symbolism engraved upon this idol. Far humbler are the relics of the other gods, lost amongst talismans of the wyld and old lupine faiths. [pc.isMage|You can feel magic in many of these objects, faded by age.]]"

rows.original: [silly|Opulent furniture has been arrayed through the hall. Chairs, tables and sofas carved from blackened woods, embroidered with orange and black cushions. However, you notice odd details amidst this image of luxury: Why is there a padded coffin leaning against the wall over there? Why do some of the chairs have crude shackles wrought into the armrests? Why does...|Bizzare totems have been planted throughout the hall: still-living trunks shaped into icons of lupine mysticism. Adorning the walls are several tapestries carrying the saga of the Godswar. Here unfolds a wordless tale of gods, wraiths, and magicks black and white.]
rows.translation: [silly|大厅里摆满了华贵的家具——那些由熏黑木材制成的椅子、桌子和沙发，上面还装饰着橙色和黑色的靠垫。然而，在这奢华的场景中，你却会发现一些奇怪的细节：为什么那里有一具垫了软料的棺材靠在墙上？为什么有些椅子的扶手上还铸着粗糙的镣铐？为什么……|一些奇怪的图腾已经被已种植整个大厅里，那些仍然存活的树干被雕刻成了象征着狼人神秘主义的符号。墙壁上悬挂着几幅描绘“神战”传奇故事的挂毯。在这里，一个关于神明、幽灵与魔法的无声故事正在以黑白画面展现出来。]
rows.raw: "\n [silly|Opulent furniture has been arrayed through the hall. Chairs, tables and sofas carved from blackened woods, embroidered with orange and black cushions. However, you notice odd details amidst this image of luxury: Why is there a padded coffin leaning against the wall over there? Why do some of the chairs have crude shackles wrought into the armrests? Why does...|Bizzare totems have been planted throughout the hall: still-living trunks shaped into icons of lupine mysticism. Adorning the walls are several tapestries carrying the saga of the Godswar. Here unfolds a wordless tale of gods, wraiths, and magicks black and white.]"

rows.original: [silly|An enormous cauldron has been placed at the end of the bar, its glowing contents reeking of hard cider. Smaller bowls have been placed on individual tables, filled to the brim with glazed fruits and candies wrapped in waxed paper. A sugary haze cast by these additions fills the room, gnawing at your inhibition.|An enormous cauldron has been placed at the end of the bar, filled with a thick soup of local herbs and roots. Just being near it makes your skin crawl, threatening to mutate in protest. The remaining walls have been lined with tables piled with alchemist's tools — which have already been converted into an improvised distillery.]
rows.translation: [silly|在酒吧的尽头，摆放着一个巨大的大锅，里面沸腾着散发着浓烈苹果酒气味的液体。每张桌子上还放着一些小碗，里面装满了用蜡纸包裹着的蜜饯和糖果。这些食物散发出的甜腻气息弥漫在整个房间里，逐渐消磨着人们的抵抗力。|在酒吧的尽头，摆放着一个巨大的大锅，里面盛满了由当地草药和根茎熬制而成的浓汤。仅仅站在它的附近，就会让人感到皮肤发痒，仿佛自己的皮肤会因此发生变异来抗议这种味道。剩下的墙壁上摆满了各种炼金术工具，这些工具已经被临时改造成了一个简易的蒸馏装置。]
rows.raw: "\n            [silly|An enormous cauldron has been placed at the end of the bar, its glowing contents reeking of hard cider. Smaller bowls have been placed on individual tables, filled to the brim with glazed fruits and candies wrapped in waxed paper. A sugary haze cast by these additions fills the room, gnawing at your inhibition.|An enormous cauldron has been placed at the end of the bar, filled with a thick soup of local herbs and roots. Just being near it makes your skin crawl, threatening to mutate in protest. The remaining walls have been lined with tables piled with alchemist's tools — which have already been converted into an improvised distillery.]"

rows.original: [silly|Several alterations have been added to your throne: Orange and black upholstery adorn much of the surface, with the exposed stone painted a stark black. A skull has been placed atop the backrest's crown, candles glowing within its eyes. The throne itself has been set on a raised dais, surrounded by gourds carved with grinning skulls, candles burning from within their diabolic smiles.|Several accessories have been added to your throne: a small pile of furs have been arranged upon the seat, a rune-inscribed cloth has been folded over the backrest and a different eye-shaped talisman hangs from each armrest. [pc.bgcl arcanist scholar acolyte|You recognize the right talisman as the Gaze of Nareva, and the left as Sky-Daughter's Truth. Both are warnings against arcane lawbreaking. |]Surrounding the throne are a handful of rune-etched totems, pulsing with power. [pc.isMage|But that's the point, it's plain to you that this spectacle is just to intimidate laymen with no magical talent.|]]
rows.translation: [silly|你的王座经过了几处改造：橙色与黑色的装饰材料覆盖了王座的大部分表面，裸露的石料也被涂成了纯黑色。在王座靠背的顶部，人们放置了一个骷髅头，其眼中燃烧着蜡烛的光芒。整个王座被安置在一个高高的基座上，周围环绕着那些雕刻着咧嘴笑着的骷髅头的葫芦，这些葫芦的内部也点着蜡烛，那些恶魔般的笑容在烛光中显得更加恐怖。|您的王座上增添了几件装饰品：座位上摆放着一小堆毛皮，靠背上覆盖着一块刻有符文的布，而每个扶手上都悬挂着一个形状各异的眼形护身符。 [pc.bgcl arcanist scholar acolyte|你认出了右边的护身符是“娜瑞瓦之凝视”，左边的则是“天空之女的真理”。这两样物品都在警示人们不要违反奥术法则。 |]王座周围摆放着几件刻有符文的图腾，它们正散发着强大的能量。 [pc.isMage|但问题就在这里，你很清楚，这种场面纯粹是为了吓唬那些没有魔法天赋的外行罢了。|]]
rows.raw: "\n            [silly|Several alterations have been added to your throne: Orange and black upholstery adorn much of the surface, with the exposed stone painted a stark black. A skull has been placed atop the backrest's crown, candles glowing within its eyes. The throne itself has been set on a raised dais, surrounded by gourds carved with grinning skulls, candles burning from within their diabolic smiles.|Several accessories have been added to your throne: a small pile of furs have been arranged upon the seat, a rune-inscribed cloth has been folded over the backrest and a different eye-shaped talisman hangs from each armrest. [pc.bgcl arcanist scholar acolyte|You recognize the right talisman as the Gaze of Nareva, and the left as Sky-Daughter's Truth. Both are warnings against arcane lawbreaking. |]Surrounding the throne are a handful of rune-etched totems, pulsing with power. [pc.isMage|But that's the point, it's plain to you that this spectacle is just to intimidate laymen with no magical talent.|]]"

rows.original: Countless trinkets stamped with utilitarian runes have been scattered through the living quarters. To name a few: simple banners to heat and cool the air, small self-warming cauldrons, and across most beds lay rune-embroidered furs. Additionally, your room has been equipped with a full study: bookshelves lined with staple texts, and a fully equipped writing desk paired with a cozy chair.
rows.translation: 生活区里散落着无数刻有实用符文的小饰品。举几个例子吧：可以用来调节室内温度的简易旗帜、小型自热锅具，而大多数床铺上也都铺着绣有符文的毛皮。此外，你的房间还配备了一间设施齐全的书房：书架上摆满了各类必备书籍，还有一张设备完善的写字台和一把舒适的椅子。
rows.raw: "\n            Countless trinkets stamped with utilitarian runes have been scattered through the living quarters. To name a few: simple banners to heat and cool the air, small self-warming cauldrons, and across most beds lay rune-embroidered furs. Additionally, your room has been equipped with a full study: bookshelves lined with staple texts, and a fully equipped writing desk paired with a cozy chair."

rows.original: You're quickly growing more capable, more able to learn from the world and adapt to the harsh lessons it teaches. You've unlocked an additional power slot. You'll choose a new power to fill that slot next. Should you desire it, you can later branch out and take on powers outside those of your class, or abilities gained from teachers, mutations, or other, more esoteric sources... Access your Powers Deck from the Journal to decide what abilities you have equipped in each slot.
rows.translation: 你的能力正在迅速提升，你越来越能够从这个世界中学习，并适应它所带来的严酷考验。你已经解锁了一个额外的能力槽位，接下来你需要选择一项新的能力来填充这个槽位。如果你愿意，以后还可以尝试获取不属于你当前职业的能力，或者通过导师传授、基因突变等其他方式获得特殊能力……你可以通过“日志”功能查看自己的“能力牌组”，从而决定在每个槽位上配置哪些能力。
rows.raw: "\n You're quickly growing more capable, more able to learn from the world and adapt to the harsh lessons it teaches. You've unlocked an additional power slot. You'll choose a new power to fill that slot next. Should you desire it, you can later branch out and take on powers outside those of your class, or abilities gained from teachers, mutations, or other, more esoteric sources... Access your Powers Deck from the Journal to decide what abilities you have equipped in each slot."

rows.translation: 战士

rows.original: Primary Attribute: Toughness Class Affinities: Toughness, Strength, Agility Masters of armed combat, warriors live and die by their martial skill and the strength of their armor. As a warrior, you will be unparalleled at enduring enemy attacks and drawing their ire from your more vulnerable companions. A strong heart and raw toughness will see you through the dangers you face more than anything else, supported by your capacity to strike with great strength and agility when the going gets rough. The life of a warrior is one of triumph through violence.
rows.translation: 主要属性：体魄 类别关联：体魄、力量、敏捷 作为武装战斗的专家，战士们的生死完全取决于他们的武艺高强以及所穿戴的铠甲的坚固程度。作为一名战士，你将能够在承受敌人的攻击时无人能及，同时也会因此惹来那些较为脆弱的同伴的怨恨。坚定的意志和顽强的毅力将是你战胜一切危险的最重要支柱；而当形势变得严峻时，你强大的攻击力和敏捷的反应能力也会成为你在战斗中取得胜利的关键。战士的生活，其实就是一场通过暴力来取得胜利的征程。
rows.raw: "Primary Attribute: Toughness\nClass Affinities: Toughness, Strength, Agility\nMasters of armed combat, warriors live and die by their martial skill and the strength of their armor. As a warrior, you will be unparalleled at enduring enemy attacks and drawing their ire from your more vulnerable companions. A strong heart and raw toughness will see you through the dangers you face more than anything else, supported by your capacity to strike with great strength and agility when the going gets rough. The life of a warrior is one of triumph through violence."

rows.original: You can't change classes to your current class, duh!
rows.translation: 你当然不能将自己当前的职业改回原来的职业了，这还用说吗！
rows.raw: "You can't change classes to your current class, duh!"

rows.translation: 盗贼

rows.original: Primary Attribute: Agility Class Affinities: Agility, Cunning, Strength Adepts of shadow and subterfuge, thieves make their fortunes in the underbellies of distant cities and on the lonely trade roads with equal ease. As a thief, you're hard to pin down and hit, easily evading enemy attacks before slipping behind them for the kill. Agility is your greatest weapon — both for avoiding harm, and landing your own blows — however, having the cunning to pick out your enemies' weaknesses and the strength to exploit them are valuable assets indeed. The life of a thief is one of profit through swiftness and guile.
rows.translation: 主要属性：敏捷 职业倾向：敏捷、狡猾、力量 这些擅长隐秘行动与诡计多端的窃贼，无论是在遥远城市的阴暗角落，还是在人迹罕至的商路上，都能轻松获得财富。作为一名窃贼，你很难被抓住或击中，总能巧妙地躲避敌人的攻击，然后从他们背后发动致命一击。敏捷才是你最强大的武器——无论是用来躲避伤害，还是用来发动攻击；然而，能够敏锐地发现敌人的弱点并加以利用，这样的智慧与实力确实是无价之宝。对于一个小偷来说，快速行动与诡计多端才是获得利润的关键。
rows.raw: "Primary Attribute: Agility\nClass Affinities: Agility, Cunning, Strength\nAdepts of shadow and subterfuge, thieves make their fortunes in the underbellies of distant cities and on the lonely trade roads with equal ease. As a thief, you're hard to pin down and hit, easily evading enemy attacks before slipping behind them for the kill. Agility is your greatest weapon — both for avoiding harm, and landing your own blows — however, having the cunning to pick out your enemies' weaknesses and the strength to exploit them are valuable assets indeed. The life of a thief is one of profit through swiftness and guile."

rows.translation: 白魔法师

rows.original: Primary Attribute: Willpower Class Affinities: Willpower, Toughness, Presence Scholars of the occult who dedicate themselves to the healing and preservation of others, white mages study the magic granted to mortals by the gods long ago. As a white mage, you can use your magic to shield your allies from harm, heal their wounds, and to attune with nature for your defense. Maintaining the willpower to harness and control your magic is critical, but in the dangerous Frost Marches, you'll rely on your toughness and presence more and more to keep your party together. The life of a white mage is one of dedication to your comrades and those you deem worthy of your protection.
rows.translation: 主要属性：意志力 职业倾向：意志力、体魄、专注力 那些致力于帮助他人、守护他人健康的神秘学学者们——白魔法师们，一直在研究远古诸神赋予人类的魔法。作为白魔法师，你可以运用自己的魔法来保护盟友免受伤害，治愈他们的伤势，还可以与大自然融为一体，以此作为防御手段。保持足够的意志力来运用和控制你的魔法至关重要，但在危险的重霜之地，你将越来越依赖自己的体魄与勇气来维持团队的团结。作为一名白魔法师，你的使命就是为你的同伴们以及那些你认为值得保护的人奉献自己的一切。
rows.raw: "Primary Attribute: Willpower\nClass Affinities: Willpower, Toughness, Presence\nScholars of the occult who dedicate themselves to the healing and preservation of others, white mages study the magic granted to mortals by the gods long ago. As a white mage, you can use your magic to shield your allies from harm, heal their wounds, and to attune with nature for your defense. Maintaining the willpower to harness and control your magic is critical, but in the dangerous Frost Marches, you'll rely on your toughness and presence more and more to keep your party together. The life of a white mage is one of dedication to your comrades and those you deem worthy of your protection."

rows.translation: 黑魔法师

rows.original: Primary Attribute: Willpower Class Affinities: Willpower, Cunning, Presence Scholars of the occult who delve into the twisted, and often forbidden, secrets left behind by the Wraiths that once plagued the world are referred to %"black mages" by more traditional sorcerers. As a black mage, you command tremendous magical power, able to blast your foes with magic, corrupt their minds, or even bind spirits to do your bidding. You must have great willpower to control such magics, though, and you'll need both cunning to resist the temptations and dangers of magic, and the presence to overbear and command dangerous spirits. The life of a black mage is one of power through knowledge and secrets.
rows.translation: 主要属性：意志力 职业倾向：意志力、机敏、魅力 那些深入研究那些曾经困扰世界的幽灵们留下的扭曲而往往被禁止的秘密的神秘学者，被更为传统的巫师们称为“黑法师”。作为黑法师，你拥有强大的魔法力量，能够用魔法攻击敌人、腐蚀他们的思想，甚至操控灵魂来执行你的命令。然而，要掌控这样的魔法，你必须具备极强的意志力。同时，你还需要运用智慧来抵御魔法的诱惑与危险，同时拥有足够的气场来压制并驱使那些危险的灵魂。作为一名黑魔法师，他的生活就是一场依靠知识与秘密来获取力量的斗争。
rows.raw: 'Primary Attribute: Willpower\nClass Affinities: Willpower, Cunning, Presence\nScholars of the occult who delve into the twisted, and often forbidden, secrets left behind by the Wraiths that once plagued the world are referred to %"black mages" by more traditional sorcerers. As a black mage, you command tremendous magical power, able to blast your foes with magic, corrupt their minds, or even bind spirits to do your bidding. You must have great willpower to control such magics, though, and you\'ll need both cunning to resist the temptations and dangers of magic, and the presence to overbear and command dangerous spirits. The life of a black mage is one of power through knowledge and secrets.'

rows.translation: 魅惑师

rows.original: Primary Attribute: Presence Class Affinities: Presence, Agility, Cunning While the world is full of bards and performers, only some of these rare souls learn to blend magic and sensuality together into a unique performance that inspires lust and courage. As a charmer, you know how to bolster the courage and fighting spirit of your companions, and how to sap the wills of those who oppose you. Song, spell, and your sensual body are all means to your ends. Your presence — your innate and irresistible force of personality — is your greatest weapon, supplemented by the agility of a charmer and the cunning to both manipulate and resist the wiles of others. The life of a charmer is one of joy sought in the hearts of others.
rows.translation: 主要属性：存在感 职业倾向：存在感、敏捷、机敏 虽然这个世界上到处都是吟游诗人和表演者，但只有少数这些人能够将魔力与感官魅力完美结合，创造出那种既能激发欲望又能鼓舞勇气的独特表演。作为一位魅惑者，你懂得如何增强同伴的勇气与战斗意志，同时也知道如何削弱那些与你为敌之人的意志。歌声、咒语，以及你那充满魅力的身体，都是你达成目标的工具。你的存在——那种与生俱来、令人无法抗拒的个人魅力——才是你最强大的武器；而你像魔术师一样敏捷的思维，以及操纵他人、同时也能抵御他人诡计的聪明才智，更是为这一武器增添了威力。魅惑者的生活，就是在他人心中寻找快乐。
rows.raw: "Primary Attribute: Presence\nClass Affinities: Presence, Agility, Cunning\nWhile the world is full of bards and performers, only some of these rare souls learn to blend magic and sensuality together into a unique performance that inspires lust and courage. As a charmer, you know how to bolster the courage and fighting spirit of your companions, and how to sap the wills of those who oppose you. Song, spell, and your sensual body are all means to your ends. Your presence — your innate and irresistible force of personality — is your greatest weapon, supplemented by the agility of a charmer and the cunning to both manipulate and resist the wiles of others. The life of a charmer is one of joy sought in the hearts of others."

rows.original: Your victory at the Winter City has filled you with determination. Your HP is increased by +20.
