"Oooh, this looks like fun!" she titters, smirking at you. "Let's play!"
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]拿出[tps|]一颗拳头大小的棕色种子，直接将它插入[tps|]地面。[attacker.CombatHeShe]迅速覆上土[tps|]，[tps|就在|就在][attacker.combatHeShe]刚完成时，地面便震动开裂。一条纤细的绿色手臂突然伸出土堆，将其余身体拉出地面。一个纤瘦的植物少女随即加入战局，挥动身边的一对触手，适应这突如其来的存在。“噢，看起来真有趣！”她朝你坏笑，咯咯地说。“来玩吧！”
rows.raw: '\n\n [attacker.CombatName] produce[tps|s] a large, brown seed about the size of a fist, and thrust[tps|s] it directly into the ground. [attacker.CombatHeShe] quickly cover[tps|s] it, and no sooner [tps|has|have] [attacker.combatHeShe] done so than the ground trembles and cracks. Suddenly, a slender green arm thrusts up from the pile, pulling the rest of a body up from the earth. The figure of a slender plant girl soon joins the fray, wiggling a pair of tentacles around herself as she adjusts to her sudden introduction to existence. "Oooh, this looks like fun!" she titters, smirking at you. "Let\'s play!"'

rows.translation: 召唤清子
召唤清子

rows.original: You send your will through the amulet you wear, and beckon forth a manifestation of Kiyoko. She will remain until the end of combat or she loses grip on reality, and the manifestation's health and damage are based on your leadership bonus. Requires the Amulet of Union.
rows.translation: 你通过自己佩戴的护身符传递意志，从而召唤出清子的化身。这个化身会一直存在，直到战斗结束或它失去对现实的感知；其生命值和攻击力都会受到你领导力加成的影响。此效果需要使用“联盟护身符”才能实现。
rows.raw: "You send your will through the amulet you wear, and beckon forth a manifestation of Kiyoko. She will remain until the end of combat or she loses grip on reality, and the manifestation's health and damage are based on your leadership bonus. Requires the Amulet of Union."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] focus[tps|es] [attacker.combatHisHer] mind on the amulet about [attacker.combatHisHer] neck, making [attacker.combatHisHer] will known to Kiyoko. Seconds later, a gout of pale blue flame erupts from the amber orb, coalescing into the familiar form of [attacker.combatHisHer] kitsune lover!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]集中[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]心神，注视[attacker.combatHisHer]颈间的护符，将[attacker.combatHisHer]意愿传给清子。几秒后，一团淡蓝色火焰从琥珀球中喷出，凝成[attacker.combatHisHer]狐妖恋人熟悉的身影！
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] focus[tps|es] [attacker.combatHisHer] mind on the amulet about [attacker.combatHisHer] neck, making [attacker.combatHisHer] will known to Kiyoko. Seconds later, a gout of pale blue flame erupts from the amber orb, coalescing into the familiar form of [attacker.combatHisHer] kitsune lover!"

rows.translation: 集结吧，歌者
集结吧，歌者

rows.original: Call Lyric, your draconic ally, to your side! While Lyric isn't martially trained, [lyric.heShe] comes prepared with pre-made potions and poultices that can be used to help allies and hinder opponents.
rows.translation: 召唤你的龙族盟友莱瑞克来到你身边吧！虽然莱瑞克没有接受过军事训练， [lyric.heShe]准备了一些预先制作好的药水和治疗剂，这些可以用来帮助盟友或阻碍对手。
rows.raw: "Call Lyric, your draconic ally, to your side! While Lyric isn't martially trained, [lyric.heShe] comes prepared with pre-made potions and poultices that can be used to help allies and hinder opponents."

rows.translation: 影分身
召唤一个影分身。

rows.original: Closing [attacker.combatHisHer] eyes, [attacker.combatName's] body seems to glow brightly before the shadow [attacker.combatHeShe] cast[tps|s] along the floor starts to elongate and separate to either side of [attacker.combatHimHer]. The twisting shadows transform into pools of some pitch-black fluid, and from those puddles of darkness rise [attacker.isAlly|one figure|two figures]. [attacker.isAlly|It seems like a twisting cloud|Both of them seem like twisting clouds] of smoke, vaguely matching the form of [attacker.combatName] [attacker.combatHimselfHerself]. It doesn't end there, because once the [attacker.isAlly|shadowy body is|two shadowy bodies are] formed, dark, writhing tendrils sprout from [attacker.isAlly|its body|their bodies], eagerly seeking [attacker.isAlly|its|their] prey.
rows.translation: [attacker.combatHisHer]双眼闭合后，[attacker.combatName's]身体似乎先发出明亮光芒，随后[attacker.combatHeShe]投[tps|]在地面上的影子开始拉长，并向[attacker.combatHimHer]两侧分离。扭曲的影子化作一滩滩漆黑液体，从这些黑暗水洼中升起[attacker.isAlly|一个身影|两个身影]。[attacker.isAlly|它看起来像一团扭曲的烟云|它们看起来像两团扭曲的烟云]，轮廓隐约与[attacker.combatName][attacker.combatHimselfHerself]相似。事情还没结束：[attacker.isAlly|阴影躯体|两具阴影躯体]形成后，漆黑扭动的触手便从[attacker.isAlly|它的身体|它们的身体]上生长出来，急切地寻找[attacker.isAlly|它的|它们的]猎物。
rows.raw: "\nClosing [attacker.combatHisHer] eyes, [attacker.combatName's] body seems to glow brightly before the shadow [attacker.combatHeShe] cast[tps|s] along the floor starts to elongate and separate to either side of [attacker.combatHimHer]. The twisting shadows transform into pools of some pitch-black fluid, and from those puddles of darkness rise [attacker.isAlly|one figure|two figures]. [attacker.isAlly|It seems like a twisting cloud|Both of them seem like twisting clouds] of smoke, vaguely matching the form of [attacker.combatName] [attacker.combatHimselfHerself]. It doesn't end there, because once the [attacker.isAlly|shadowy body is|two shadowy bodies are] formed, dark, writhing tendrils sprout from [attacker.isAlly|its body|their bodies], eagerly seeking [attacker.isAlly|its|their] prey."

rows.translation: 呼叫猎鹰
CallFalcon

rows.original: Etheryn summons her white falcon companion, Harrick, from the skies.
rows.translation: 伊瑟琳从天空中召唤出她的白色猎鹰伙伴哈里克。
rows.raw: "Etheryn summons her white falcon companion, Harrick, from the skies."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] let[tps|s] loose a sharp whistle and point[tps|s] towards the enemy. An ear-piercing screech echoes down from the heavens as [attacker.combatHisHer] russet-red falcon swoops down from the heavens and takes up a protective position around its [attacker.master].
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]吹响[tps|]尖锐口哨并指向[tps|]敌人。一声刺耳尖啸从天而降，[attacker.combatHisHer]赤褐色猎鹰俯冲而下，护在[attacker.master]身边。
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] let[tps|s] loose a sharp whistle and point[tps|s] towards the enemy. An ear-piercing screech echoes down from the heavens as [attacker.combatHisHer] russet-red falcon swoops down from the heavens and takes up a protective position around its [attacker.master]."

rows.translation: 梅尔克增援部队
MercReinf

rows.original: Summon Marked Merk Mercenaries to your aid.
rows.translation: 召唤被标记的默克佣兵来协助你。
rows.raw: "Summon Marked Merk Mercenaries to your aid."

rows.original: "To me!" [attacker.combatName] yells, raising [attacker.combatHisHer] hand. It doesn't take long for two mercenaries to come running into battle with their swords in hand and shouting their battle cries. This fight isn't over yet!
rows.translation: 给我！ [attacker.combatName]大喊着，声浪越来越高[attacker.combatHisHer]手握长剑，两名雇佣兵立刻冲上战场，高声呼喊着战斗口号。这场战斗还远未结束！
rows.raw: "\n\"To me!\" [attacker.combatName] yells, raising [attacker.combatHisHer] hand. It doesn't take long for two mercenaries to come running into battle with their swords in hand and shouting their battle cries. This fight isn't over yet!"

rows.translation: 召唤菲莉亚
苏姆·菲莉亚

rows.original: Summon the salamander princess Phyria to fight by your side!
rows.translation: 召唤蝾螈公主菲莉亚，让她与你并肩作战吧！
rows.raw: "Summon the salamander princess Phyria to fight by your side!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] place your hand around the glass necklace and concentrate on the image of the salamander princess, willing her to come to your aid. A moment later and a cool wind whips around you, and the air at your side shimmers. Dark mist spills from the amulet, and from miasma steps a familiar amazonian figure, glorious in her near-nudity and brandishing a long, curved blade. "Just leave it to me," Phyria grins, whipping her aurora-tipped tail around your [pc.feet]. "I will show them the fury of Tychris!"
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]将手放在那条玻璃项链上，集中注意力想象那位蝾螈公主的形象，祈愿她能前来帮助你。片刻之后，一阵凉风突然拂过你的周围，你身旁的空气开始闪烁起来。暗影的雾气从护身符中弥漫而出，从这片迷雾中走出一个你熟悉的身影——一位亚马逊女战士，她几乎全裸着身体，手中挥舞着一把长长的弯曲刀刃。“交给我吧，”菲莉亚微笑着说道，同时用她那末端闪烁着极光色彩的尾巴轻轻拂过你的身体[pc.feet]我会让他们见识到提克里斯的愤怒！
rows.raw: '\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] place your hand around the glass necklace and concentrate on the image of the salamander princess, willing her to come to your aid. A moment later and a cool wind whips around you, and the air at your side shimmers. Dark mist spills from the amulet, and from miasma steps a familiar amazonian figure, glorious in her near-nudity and brandishing a long, curved blade. "Just leave it to me," Phyria grins, whipping her aurora-tipped tail around your [pc.feet]. "I will show them the fury of Tychris!"'

rows.translation: 神秘召唤
神秘召唤

rows.original: Summon a puppet to fight by your side!
rows.translation: 召唤一个木偶来与你并肩作战吧！
rows.raw: "Summon a puppet to fight by your side!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] concentrate[tps|s], and wisps of foxfire gather in the air. The motes soon turn into strands, mystical puppet strings binding pieces and components together as a puppet assembles itself from the junk lying around!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]集中注意力[tps|]空气中弥漫着狐火的光芒，那些微小的光点渐渐汇聚成细丝，如同神秘的提线，将各种零件和组件连接在一起，最终让这个“木偶”从散落的垃圾中重新组合而成！
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] concentrate[tps|s], and wisps of foxfire gather in the air. The motes soon turn into strands, mystical puppet strings binding pieces and components together as a puppet assembles itself from the junk lying around!"

rows.translation: 召唤黄蜂群
召唤黄蜂群

rows.original: Summon Hornet Workers to your aid.
rows.translation: 召唤黄蜂工蜂来协助你。

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] raises his free right hand, snapping his fingers with a grin. More hornets clamber up the stairs, eagerly grinning and rushing to his aid. "Did you really think I couldn't just summon more? Please... do better."
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]抬起空闲的右手，咧嘴打了个响指。更多黄蜂爬上楼梯，兴奋地笑着赶来支援。“你真以为我不能再召唤一些吗？拜托……拿出点本事。”
rows.raw: '\n[attacker.CombatName] raises his free right hand, snapping his fingers with a grin. More hornets clamber up the stairs, eagerly grinning and rushing to his aid. "Did you really think I couldn\'t just summon more? Please... do better."'

rows.translation: 召唤狼灵
Sum.WSpirit

rows.original: Call forth the spirit of a wolf to fight by your side!
rows.translation: 召唤狼灵，让它与你并肩作战！
rows.raw: "Call forth the spirit of a wolf to fight by your side!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] extend[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] forward and mutter[tps|s] some [attacker.isPC|summoning|[pc.bgcl blackmage arcanist|summoning|strange]] incantations. Magic surges before [attacker.combatHimHer] and small, portal-like hole appears on the ground beneath their weapon. Before long, a pair of ethereal paws reach out from the glowing pit, followed by an equally-spectral snout. [attacker.isPC|[attacker.CombatNames] summoned spirit snarls, ready to fight by your side|[attacker.CombatName] seems to have summoned forth a wolf spirit to fight by [attacker.combatHisHer] side].
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]向前伸出[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer][attacker.weapon]，低念[tps|]几句[attacker.isPC|召唤|[pc.bgcl blackmage arcanist|召唤|奇怪的]]咒语。魔力在[attacker.combatHimHer]面前涌动，武器下方的地面出现一个传送门般的小孔。不久，一对虚幻的爪子从发光的坑中伸出，接着是同样幽灵般的口鼻。[attacker.isPC|[attacker.CombatNames]召唤灵发出咆哮，准备与你并肩作战|[attacker.CombatName]似乎召来一只狼灵，在[attacker.combatHisHer]身旁战斗]。
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] extend[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] [attacker.weapon] forward and mutter[tps|s] some [attacker.isPC|summoning|[pc.bgcl blackmage arcanist|summoning|strange]] incantations. Magic surges before [attacker.combatHimHer] and small, portal-like hole appears on the ground beneath their weapon. Before long, a pair of ethereal paws reach out from the glowing pit, followed by an equally-spectral snout. [attacker.isPC|[attacker.CombatNames] summoned spirit snarls, ready to fight by your side|[attacker.CombatName] seems to have summoned forth a wolf spirit to fight by [attacker.combatHisHer] side]."

rows.translation: 召唤微光
召唤微光

rows.original: You separate a wisp of foxfire from your being, allowing it to act autonomously in your defense. Its power is based on your Leadership.
rows.translation: 你将自己体内的一缕狐火分离出来，让它自主地为你效力进行防御。它的力量源自你的领导力。
rows.raw: "You separate a wisp of foxfire from your being, allowing it to act autonomously in your defense. Its power is based on your Leadership."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] draw[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] hands together, focusing [attacker.combatHisHer] will. In the blink of an eye, a ball of flickering azure flame separates from [attacker.combatHisHer] being, slowly orbiting [attacker.combatHisHer] head.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]合拢[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]双手，凝聚[attacker.combatHisHer]意志。转眼间，一团闪烁的蔚蓝火焰从[attacker.combatHisHer]体内分离，缓缓绕着[attacker.combatHisHer]头部旋转。
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] draw[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] hands together, focusing [attacker.combatHisHer] will. In the blink of an eye, a ball of flickering azure flame separates from [attacker.combatHisHer] being, slowly orbiting [attacker.combatHisHer] head."

rows.translation: 喷吐精灵
喷吐精灵
生成一个被腐蚀的精灵仆从。

rows.original: A vacuous hole opens in [attacker.combatName], and from it falls one of the elves kidnapped from the gallery above. She's nude, dripping wet as if covered in mucus; her eyes glow with baleful crimson. She staggers to her feet, giggling with pure insanity... and staring at you with unbridled hunger!
rows.translation: 一个空洞的洞穴出现了[attacker.combatName]从那里，一个从上方画廊中被绑架的精灵掉了下来。她全身赤裸，湿淋淋的，仿佛被黏液覆盖了一般；她的眼睛散发着凶恶的猩红色光芒。她摇摇晃晃地站了起来，发出疯狂的笑声……用一种毫无抑制的渴望目光盯着你！
rows.raw: "\nA vacuous hole opens in [attacker.combatName], and from it falls one of the elves kidnapped from the gallery above. She's nude, dripping wet as if covered in mucus; her eyes glow with baleful crimson. She staggers to her feet, giggling with pure insanity... and staring at you with unbridled hunger!"

rows.translation: 喷火龙
喷火龙
生成一只被腐蚀的龙奴仆。

rows.original: A vacuous hole opens in [attacker.combatName], and from it, one of the dragon-women the abyssal thing devoured marches forth. She's gloriously naked, rock-hard abs and muscular limbs polished to a shine. A feral snarl is on her black lips, and her glow with devilish red. She spreads her wings and lunges into the fray!
rows.translation: 一个空洞的洞穴出现了[attacker.combatName]从其中，那个被深渊怪物吞噬的龙女之一走了出来。她全身赤裸，坚硬如岩石的腹部和肌肉发达的四肢都闪烁着光泽。她的黑色嘴唇上挂着凶狠的獠牙，皮肤呈现出恶魔般的红色。她展开双翼，冲入了战斗之中！
rows.raw: "\nA vacuous hole opens in [attacker.combatName], and from it, one of the dragon-women the abyssal thing devoured marches forth. She's gloriously naked, rock-hard abs and muscular limbs polished to a shine. A feral snarl is on her black lips, and her glow with devilish red. She spreads her wings and lunges into the fray!"

rows.translation: 召唤孢子幼体
孢子体

rows.original: Summons Minuta, the adorable and highly explosive sporeling.
rows.translation: 召唤可爱的、具有极高爆炸性的孢子幼体——米努塔。
rows.raw: "Summons Minuta, the adorable and highly explosive sporeling."

rows.original: "Come forth my child," [attacker.CombatName] call[tps|s]. "Come forth, sporeling!" The earth beside [attacker.combatHimHer] erupts with a trio of mushrooms, rising and breaking out of one another until a final mushroom launches clear and into the air. Its brim grows wide and a magical wind grabs it, carrying the now-smiling and creamy-colored mushroom girl to keep her aloft. [char.CombatName] gives you a tiny wink, whimsically twirling around the battlefield without a care in the world.
rows.translation: “出来吧，我的孩子。”[attacker.CombatName]呼唤[tps|]道，“出来吧，小孢子！”[attacker.combatHimHer]身旁的土地猛然冒出三朵蘑菇，一朵从另一朵中破出、向上生长，直到最后一朵脱离其余蘑菇，飞向空中。它的伞盖展开，一阵魔法风托起这个如今面带微笑、身体呈奶油色的蘑菇女孩，让她飘在半空。[char.CombatName]朝你轻轻眨眼，无忧无虑地在战场上轻巧旋转。
rows.raw: '\n        \n        "Come forth my child," [attacker.CombatName] call[tps|s]. "Come forth, sporeling!" The earth beside [attacker.combatHimHer] erupts with a trio of mushrooms, rising and breaking out of one another until a final mushroom launches clear and into the air. Its brim grows wide and a magical wind grabs it, carrying the now-smiling and creamy-colored mushroom girl to keep her aloft. [char.CombatName] gives you a tiny wink, whimsically twirling around the battlefield without a care in the world.'

rows.translation: 召唤女武神
Sum.Valkyrie
召唤一位女武神。

rows.original: "Warrior host, attend your queen!" [attacker.CombatName] bellows. A moment later, [char.combatName] appears, brandishing her weapon cloaked with solar radiance. "Long may the sun shine!
rows.translation: 勇士们，前来迎接你们的女王吧！ [attacker.CombatName]鼓风机。片刻之后， [char.combatName]出现了，手中挥舞着那把被太阳光芒笼罩的武器，说道：“愿太阳永远照耀大地！
rows.raw: '\n"Warrior host, attend your queen!" [attacker.CombatName] bellows. A moment later, [char.combatName] appears, brandishing her weapon cloaked with solar radiance. "Long may the sun shine!'

rows.translation: 召唤公牛
召唤公牛
召唤一头狂怒的火焰公牛。

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] hold[tps|s] out a hand palm-up and the air in front of [attacker.combatHimHer] begins to shimmer, a hazy beast materializing. It's an enormous bull formed of fire, and it looks angry! The bull paws the ground and lowers its head.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]持有[tps|]将手掌朝上伸出来，让空气停留在自己的手掌前方[attacker.combatHimHer]开始闪烁起来，一道朦胧的身影逐渐显现——那是一头由火焰构成的巨型公牛，看起来显得非常愤怒！这只公牛用蹄子猛烈地踩踏地面，同时低下了头。
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] hold[tps|s] out a hand palm-up and the air in front of [attacker.combatHimHer] begins to shimmer, a hazy beast materializing. It's an enormous bull formed of fire, and it looks angry! The bull paws the ground and lowers its head."

rows.translation: 召唤火焰舞者
Sum.FDancer

rows.original: Summon a dancer imbued with Terrestrial Fire to fight at your side.
rows.translation: 召唤一位拥有大地之火力量的舞者，让她与你并肩作战。
rows.raw: "Summon a dancer imbued with Terrestrial Fire to fight at your side."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] hands and invoke[tps|s] the ancient rites learned beneath the Temple of Terrestrial Flame, concentrating on the strikingly muscular figure of the obsidian dancer. Black flame spills from [attacker.combatHisHer] hands, pooling on the ground; from it emerges a strikingly tall, powerful figure, drawing forth a pair of dark blades as she materializes before [attacker.combatName], ready to serve.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]举起[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]双手，施展[tps|]在大地之火神殿下方学会的古老仪式，专注于黑曜石舞者那肌肉发达的身影。黑色火焰从[attacker.combatHisHer]双手涌出，汇聚到地面；一个格外高大强健的身影从中浮现，在[attacker.combatName]面前凝成实体，拔出一对漆黑的利刃，准备听候差遣。
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] hands and invoke[tps|s] the ancient rites learned beneath the Temple of Terrestrial Flame, concentrating on the strikingly muscular figure of the obsidian dancer. Black flame spills from [attacker.combatHisHer] hands, pooling on the ground; from it emerges a strikingly tall, powerful figure, drawing forth a pair of dark blades as she materializes before [attacker.combatName], ready to serve."

rows.translation: 召唤火焰骑士
Sum.FKnight

rows.original: Summon a warrior imbued with Terrestrial Fire to fight at your side.
rows.translation: 召唤一位拥有大地之火力量的战士，让他与你并肩作战。
rows.raw: "Summon a warrior imbued with Terrestrial Fire to fight at your side."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] hands and invoke[tps|s] the ancient rites learned beneath the Temple of Terrestrial Flame, concentrating on the strikingly muscular figure of the obsidian knight. Black flame spills from [attacker.combatHisHer] hands, pooling on the ground; from it emerges a strikingly tall, powerful figure, drawing forth a mighty two-handed blade of fire as he makes ready to serve.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]提高[tps|] [attacker.combatHisHer]动手操作并调用相关功能[tps|]在大地之火神殿中所学的古老仪式，让人们将注意力集中在那位肌肉发达的黑曜石骑士身上。黑色的火焰从他身上喷涌而出[attacker.combatHisHer]双手在地面汇聚，从中出现了一个高大威猛的身影。他拔出一把威力巨大的双手持火剑，准备展开行动。
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] hands and invoke[tps|s] the ancient rites learned beneath the Temple of Terrestrial Flame, concentrating on the strikingly muscular figure of the obsidian knight. Black flame spills from [attacker.combatHisHer] hands, pooling on the ground; from it emerges a strikingly tall, powerful figure, drawing forth a mighty two-handed blade of fire as he makes ready to serve."

rows.translation: 分裂自我
创建一个与自己一模一样的副本。

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] clasp[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] hands together and concentrates briefly. The shadows pour about [attacker.combatHimHer], solidifying into a perfect recreation of the original!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]合拢[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]双手，短暂凝神。阴影涌到[attacker.combatHimHer]周围，凝成了与本体一模一样的分身！
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] clasp[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] hands together and concentrates briefly. The shadows pour about [attacker.combatHimHer], solidifying into a perfect recreation of the original!"

rows.translation: 诱妖之歌
诱妖之歌

rows.original: The lureling's song of madness, terror and beauty. Stuns a companion and creates a nightmare copy to shield the lureling from damage.
rows.translation: 这种鱼所吟唱的歌声充满了疯狂、恐惧与美丽。它的歌声会使同伴陷入昏迷，同时会制造出一个噩梦般的副本来保护自己免受伤害。
rows.raw: "The lureling's song of madness, terror and beauty. Stuns a companion and creates a nightmare copy to shield the lureling from damage."

rows.original:
The terrible and discordant echoes of otherworldly song wrap about [attacker.CombatName], reverberating in the air.

        "[rand
            |Your friends. Will betray you.
            |You are. Already dead.
            |Your courage. Will fail.
            |Death. Is close.
            |You will betray. Your friends.
            |You will die.
            |You. Are weak.]"
            
        [target.CombatName] watch[tps|es] the beast, eyes dilating and jaw slack as the horror invades [target.combatHisHer] mind. Visions and illusions swirl about [attacker.CombatName], bringing your worst nightmares into the flesh!
rows.translation:
异界歌声那可怕而不和谐的回响环绕着[attacker.CombatName]，在空中震荡。

        “[rand
            |你的朋友。会背叛你。
            |你。已经死了。
            |你的勇气。终将溃散。
            |死亡。近在咫尺。
            |你会背叛。你的朋友。
            |你会死。
            |你。很软弱。]”
            
        [target.CombatName]注视[tps|]着那头野兽；恐惧侵入[target.combatHisHer]脑海，令瞳孔放大、下巴松垂。幻景与错觉在[attacker.CombatName]周围盘旋，将你最可怕的噩梦化为实体！
rows.raw:
'
        
        The terrible and discordant echoes of otherworldly song wrap about [attacker.CombatName], reverberating in the air.

        "[rand
            |Your friends. Will betray you.
            |You are. Already dead.
            |Your courage. Will fail.
            |Death. Is close.
            |You will betray. Your friends.
            |You will die.
            |You. Are weak.]"
            
        [target.CombatName] watch[tps|es] the beast, eyes dilating and jaw slack as the horror invades [target.combatHisHer] mind. Visions and illusions swirl about [attacker.CombatName], bringing your worst nightmares into the flesh!'

rows.translation: 召唤兽人
召唤兽人
召唤一只阿尔法兽人。

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] snarl[tps|s] over [attacker.combatHisHer] shoulder and gesture[tps|s] sharply. Moments later, a gnoll arrives by [attacker.combatHisHer] side, eager and willing to fight!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]扭头朝[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]肩后低吼，并猛地打出手势[tps|]。片刻后，一个豺狼人来到[attacker.combatHisHer]身旁，迫不及待地准备投入战斗！
rows.raw: "\n[attacker.CombatName] snarl[tps|s] over [attacker.combatHisHer] shoulder and gesture[tps|s] sharply. Moments later, a gnoll arrives by [attacker.combatHisHer] side, eager and willing to fight!"

rows.translation: 剑魂
《剑魂》

rows.original: You meld your will with the Dawnsword's, allowing it to become more than just an extension of yourself and act on its own.
rows.translation: 你将自己的意志与晨曦剑融为一体，让它不仅仅成为你自身的延伸，而是能够独立行动的存在。
rows.raw: "You meld your will with the Dawnsword's, allowing it to become more than just an extension of yourself and act on its own."

rows.original: Focusing [attacker.combatHisHer] consciousness into the corrupted relic, [attacker.combatName] taps into the Dawnsword's vicious bloodthirst. No longer does the blade's will merely guide [attacker.combatHisHer] blows, but it springs to life, striking of its own accord and simply dragging [attacker.combatNames] arm along for the ride.
rows.translation: 将[attacker.combatHisHer]意识集中到腐化的圣物中，[attacker.combatName]唤醒了晨曦剑残酷嗜血的本性。剑的意志不再只是引导[attacker.combatHisHer]攻击，而是活了过来，自行出击，只管拖着[attacker.combatNames]手臂一同挥舞。
rows.raw: "\n\n        Focusing [attacker.combatHisHer] consciousness into the corrupted relic, [attacker.combatName] taps into the Dawnsword's vicious bloodthirst. No longer does the blade's will merely guide [attacker.combatHisHer] blows, but it springs to life, striking of its own accord and simply dragging [attacker.combatNames] arm along for the ride."

rows.translation: 召唤塔尔森
苏姆·塔尔森

rows.original: Summon the ghostly storm shaman Talsenne to fight by your side!
rows.translation: 召唤幽灵风暴萨满塔尔森，让他与你并肩作战吧！
rows.raw: "Summon the ghostly storm shaman Talsenne to fight by your side!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] hands to the heavens, shouting the name "Talsenne!" into Sorra's domain. There's an otherworldly rumbling, as if the aether itself was wracked by storms, culminating in a lightning strike at [attacker.combatHisHer] feet. From the smoke rises a curvaceous, ghostly cowgirl wearing nothing but a feathered mantle, a spear in one hand and a falcon totem in the other.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]提高[tps|] [attacker.combatHisHer]人们双手叉腰，向着索拉的领域高呼“塔尔森！”此时，一阵超自然的轰鸣声骤然响起，仿佛整个以太空间都在遭受风暴的侵袭，最终，一道闪电划破了天际[attacker.combatHisHer]从烟雾中浮现出一个身形曲线优美的女牛仔，她身上只披着一件羽毛制成的斗篷，一手握着长矛，另一手则拿着一只猎鹰图腾。
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] hands to the heavens, shouting the name \"Talsenne!\" into Sorra's domain. There's an otherworldly rumbling, as if the aether itself was wracked by storms, culminating in a lightning strike at [attacker.combatHisHer] feet. From the smoke rises a curvaceous, ghostly cowgirl wearing nothing but a feathered mantle, a spear in one hand and a falcon totem in the other."

rows.translation: 召唤触手
触手怪
召唤一条邪异触手。

rows.original: You hear the distinct, telltale sound of flesh being ripped and pulled apart – and, with a half-pleasured, half-pained groan from [attacker.combatName], a new tentacle sprouts from her main body, still soaked in amniotic fluids. She can probably do this infinitely. You'll have to target the body to beat her!
rows.translation: 你听到了那种清晰可辨、极具辨识度的声音——那是肉体被撕裂、被撕开的声响……伴随着一声既带着愉悦又带着痛苦的呻吟[attacker.combatName]她的主体上又长出了一条新的触手，这条触手仍然浸泡在羊水中。 她很可能能够无限次地重复这个动作。要想打败她，就必须针对她的身体部位进行攻击！
rows.raw: " You hear the distinct, telltale sound of flesh being ripped and pulled apart – and, with a half-pleasured, half-pained groan from [attacker.combatName], a new tentacle sprouts from her main body, still soaked in amniotic fluids. She can probably do this infinitely. You'll have to target the body to beat her!"

rows.translation: 召唤触手
触手怪

rows.original: Conjure forth a writhing mass of ichorous tentacles to grasp and grope your enemies, dealing Tease damage..
rows.translation: 召唤出一团蠕动着的、布满黏液的触手，这些触手会抓住并缠绕住你的敌人，造成“戏弄”伤害。
rows.raw: "Conjure forth a writhing mass of ichorous tentacles to grasp and grope your enemies, dealing Tease damage.."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] thrust[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] hand down to the ground and quickly trace[tps|s] the outline of a pentagram, chanting a spell of conjuration into the dark void at the edge of reality. Shadows coalesce around the binding circle, taking on an inky black, abyssal hue. Those selfsame shadows begin to writhe, coiling at arms and legs that stray too close.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]猛地将[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]手按向地面，迅速画出[tps|]五芒星的轮廓，向现实边缘的黑暗虚空吟诵召唤咒语。阴影在束缚法阵周围聚拢，呈现出深渊般的漆黑。随即，那些阴影开始蠕动，缠住靠得太近的手臂和腿。
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] thrust[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] hand down to the ground and quickly trace[tps|s] the outline of a pentagram, chanting a spell of conjuration into the dark void at the edge of reality. Shadows coalesce around the binding circle, taking on an inky black, abyssal hue. Those selfsame shadows begin to writhe, coiling at arms and legs that stray too close."

rows.translation: 召唤腐朽触手
Sum.C.Tentacle

rows.original: You summon a tentacle of raw corruptive energy to batter the wills of your opponents.
rows.translation: 你召唤出一条由原始腐蚀能量构成的触手，用来削弱对手的意志力。
rows.raw: "You summon a tentacle of raw corruptive energy to batter the wills of your opponents."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] laugh[tps|s], reaching into some indeterminable space before whipping [attacker.combatHisHer] hand at the enemy. A tentacle forms, gesturing menacingly and bleeding eldritch magics.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]大笑[tps|]着，伸手探入某处难以确定的空间，随后将[attacker.combatHisHer]手猛地甩向敌人。一条触手随之形成，威胁般地挥动着，渗出诡异的魔力。
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] laugh[tps|s], reaching into some indeterminable space before whipping [attacker.combatHisHer] hand at the enemy. A tentacle forms, gesturing menacingly and bleeding eldritch magics."

rows.translation: 召唤卡西迪
萨姆·卡西迪

rows.original: Summon the watery bard Cassidy to fight by your side!
rows.translation: 召唤水之吟游诗人卡西迪，让他与你并肩作战吧！
rows.raw: "Summon the watery bard Cassidy to fight by your side!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] [silly|doot|blow][tps|s] the horn of tides, [attacker.hasHair|hair blowing back|eyes watering] at the backblast. The sound of jangling bells, harmonic string and wind instruments, and the 'sploosh' of water heralds a beautiful cat[cassidy.fsm|girl|girl|boy] forming out of nothing and casting off droplets of moisture. "Lets [silly|fuckin' GO :D|do this]!" Cassidy cheers.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName][silly|嘟嘟吹响|吹响][tps|]潮汐号角，反冲的气流让[attacker.hasHair|头发向后飞扬|双眼泪汪汪]。叮当的铃声、和谐的弦乐与管乐声，以及水花“哗啦”溅起的声音中，一位美丽的猫[cassidy.fsm|女孩|女孩|男孩]凭空浮现，抖落身上的水滴。“我们[silly|他妈的上吧 :D|动手吧]！”卡斯欢呼道。
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] [silly|doot|blow][tps|s] the horn of tides, [attacker.hasHair|hair blowing back|eyes watering] at the backblast. The sound of jangling bells, harmonic string and wind instruments, and the 'sploosh' of water heralds a beautiful cat[cassidy.fsm|girl|girl|boy] forming out of nothing and casting off droplets of moisture. \"Lets [silly|fuckin' GO :D|do this]!\" Cassidy cheers."

rows.translation: 召唤格伦根迪尔
苏姆·格伦根迪尔

rows.original: Invoke the spirit lingering in Grungendyr's skull to fight by your side!
rows.translation: 召唤蕴藏在格伦根迪尔头骨中的灵魂，让它与你并肩作战吧！
rows.raw: "Invoke the spirit lingering in Grungendyr's skull to fight by your side!"

rows.original:
[attacker.CombatName] produce[tps|s] the boar skull [attacker.combatHeShe] claimed and channel[tps|s] a little of [attacker.combatHisHer] own essence into it. "Grungendyr! I invoke your spirit to sow terror once again!"
        The air ripples, and from the shadows skulks the one-eyed nightmare itself. [party.has ryn
            |Etheryn squeals in terror, curling in on herself.
        ]
rows.translation:
[attacker.CombatName]制作[tps|]野猪头骨[attacker.combatHeShe]声明并指定渠道[tps|]一点点[attacker.combatHisHer]将自身的精髓融入其中。“格伦根迪尔！我召唤你的灵魂，让恐惧再次降临！”  
        空气中荡起涟漪，从阴影中缓缓浮现出那个独眼噩梦的实体。 [party.has ryn
            |埃瑟琳吓得尖叫起来，整个人缩成一团。
        ]
rows.raw:
'

        [attacker.CombatName] produce[tps|s] the boar skull [attacker.combatHeShe] claimed and channel[tps|s] a little of [attacker.combatHisHer] own essence into it. "Grungendyr! I invoke your spirit to sow terror once again!"
        The air ripples, and from the shadows skulks the one-eyed nightmare itself. [party.has ryn
            |Etheryn squeals in terror, curling in on herself.
        ]'

rows.translation: 召唤冰霜蛾
冰霜蛾

rows.original: You call forth the spirit of a fey moth imbued with the power of elemental frost to fight at your side.
rows.translation: 你召唤出一只蕴含元素寒霜力量的精灵蛾，让它与你并肩作战。
rows.raw: "You call forth the spirit of a fey moth imbued with the power of elemental frost to fight at your side."

"

        [attacker.CombatName] reach[tps
            |es
        ] out into the aether, calling forth invocations of elemental frost — and a spirit of motherine beauty answers, stepping forth from the veil between worlds and shaking ice crystals from her wings. She draws forth a rune-etched sword and wand, ready to fight!"

rows.translation: 召唤欲望元素
欲望元素总和

rows.original: You call forth a creature made of pure lust to fight by your side in battle.
rows.translation: 你召唤出一只由纯粹欲望构成的生物，让它站在你身边并肩作战。
rows.raw: "You call forth a creature made of pure lust to fight by your side in battle."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] arms and start[tps|s] to chant. A swirl of pink mist begins to rise from the ground. Sparks of pink lightning arc through the mist as it coalesces into a form resembling a buxom woman whose very form seems to sway and jiggle even as the creature stands idle.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]提高[tps|] [attacker.combatHisHer]准备行动吧[tps|]人们开始吟诵着咒语。一阵粉红色的雾气从地面缓缓升起，粉红色的闪电在雾气中闪烁着，最终这些雾气凝聚成了一个形状酷似丰满女性的形象——即使这个生物静止不动，她的身体似乎仍在摇摆着、跳动着。
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] raise[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] arms and start[tps|s] to chant. A swirl of pink mist begins to rise from the ground. Sparks of pink lightning arc through the mist as it coalesces into a form resembling a buxom woman whose very form seems to sway and jiggle even as the creature stands idle. "

rows.translation: 召唤黏液怪
召唤史莱姆

rows.original: You call a slime girl to shield you against foes!
rows.translation: 你召唤了一位黏液女孩来保护你免受敌人的攻击！
rows.raw: "You call a slime girl to shield you against foes!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] reach[tps|es] a pouch and withdraws a small handful of slime that [attacker.combatHeShe] then toss[tps|es] to the ground in front of [attacker.combatHimHer]. [attacker.CombatHeShe] proceed[tps|s] to, with a gesture of the arms and a few words of arcane power, channel magic into the small pile. It grows and grows until a full-sized slime girl stands between [attacker.combatName] and [attacker.combatHisHer] foes.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]伸手探入[tps|]袋子，取出一小把黏液，随后[attacker.combatHeShe]将其抛到[tps|][attacker.combatHimHer]面前的地上。[attacker.CombatHeShe]接着[tps|]挥动双臂，念出几个充满奥术力量的词，将魔力注入那小堆黏液。它不断膨胀，直到一个完整大小的史莱姆女孩站在[attacker.combatName]与[attacker.combatHisHer]敌人之间。
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] reach[tps|es] a pouch and withdraws a small handful of slime that [attacker.combatHeShe] then toss[tps|es] to the ground in front of [attacker.combatHimHer]. [attacker.CombatHeShe] proceed[tps|s] to, with a gesture of the arms and a few words of arcane power, channel magic into the small pile. It grows and grows until a full-sized slime girl stands between [attacker.combatName] and [attacker.combatHisHer] foes."

rows.translation: 召唤重装步兵
步兵战士

rows.original: Imbue the lapis hoplite figurine with power and summon the memory of the warrior it's based upon to fight at your side.
rows.translation: 赋予这种拉皮斯重装步兵雕像力量，让它唤醒所象征那位战士的记忆，从而站在你的身边并肩作战。
rows.raw: "Imbue the lapis hoplite figurine with power and summon the memory of the warrior it's based upon to fight at your side."

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] lift[tps|s] the hoplite figurine overhead and channel[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] will into it, calling forth the memory imprinted deeply into its lapis-painted wyldwood. A moment later and from the earth rises an echo armed in the style of an ancient warrior-hero, with a royal-purple plume atop her head and a lunar-crested shield in hand. The elven soldier falls into a defensive stance at [attacker.combatNames] side, spear raised to [attacker.combatHisHer] foes. "For the glory of the Blue Moon!"
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]将重装步兵雕像举过头顶[tps|]，把[tps|][attacker.combatHisHer]意志注入其中，唤醒深深烙印在那涂着青金石颜料的野木中的记忆。片刻后，一个装备如古代英雄战士的残影从地面升起：她头顶皇家紫色的羽饰，手持带有月纹的盾牌。这位精灵士兵在[attacker.combatNames]身旁摆出防御姿态，将长矛指向[attacker.combatHisHer]敌人。“为了蓝月的荣耀！”
rows.raw: '\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] lift[tps|s] the hoplite figurine overhead and channel[tps|s] [attacker.combatHisHer] will into it, calling forth the memory imprinted deeply into its lapis-painted wyldwood. A moment later and from the earth rises an echo armed in the style of an ancient warrior-hero, with a royal-purple plume atop her head and a lunar-crested shield in hand. The elven soldier falls into a defensive stance at [attacker.combatNames] side, spear raised to [attacker.combatHisHer] foes. "For the glory of the Blue Moon!"'

rows.translation: 集结吧，熊兄弟！
集结吧，熊兄弟！

rows.original: Pour from the Mug of Bear.
rows.translation: 从熊的杯子中倾泻而出。

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] upend[tps|s] the Mug of Bear and out comes a full-grown brown-furred bear. It looks angry.
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]颠覆[tps|]那个熊罐子一打开，里面竟然出现了一只成年棕色毛皮的熊，它看起来非常生气。
rows.raw: "\n\n        [attacker.CombatName] upend[tps|s] the Mug of Bear and out comes a full-grown brown-furred bear. It looks angry."

rows.translation: 拉利·卡莉希娅
拉力卡莉

rows.original: Call for Kalysea to aid you in battle!
rows.translation: 召唤卡莉希娅来协助你作战吧！
rows.raw: "Call for Kalysea to aid you in battle!"

rows.original: [attacker.CombatName] call[tps|s] for Kalysea and the druidic centaur appears, ready to aid you against your enemies!
rows.translation: [attacker.CombatName]呼叫[tps|]为卡莉希娅和那些德鲁伊半人马而来，他们已准备好协助你对抗敌人！
